Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het Woo-verzoek m.b.t. het noodbevel van de Driehoek Den Haag aangaande de demonstratie van Farmers Defence Force van 29 juni 2023

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Interior about the Hague mayor's emergency order and the restriction of a 29 June 2023 farmers' protest near parliament, including whether the Speaker of the House interfered, the use of tractors, the lack of advance notice, and whether mayors should be the ones to restrict demonstrations. The minister answered that the Speaker only discussed the scenario and had no decision-making role, that each demonstration is assessed individually by the local authority, and that mayors are accountable to the municipal council.
That the Speaker of the House was consulted about this is not unusual.
Dat hierover is gesproken met de voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer is niet vreemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de kinderopvangtoeslag

MP Van Haga asks whether the CBS's new energy-price method distorts inflation figures, making childcare allowances inadequate, and whether rising personnel costs and wage-price spirals in childcare are addressed. Minister Van Gennip replies that the method change has negligible effect on the 2024 maximum hourly rates, that the indexation system deliberately avoids a wage-price spiral, and that childcare tariffs and use are monitored.
The picture that the childcare allowance is therefore inadequate for parents with children in childcare is not one I share.
Het beeld dat de kinderopvangtoeslag voor ouders met kinderen op de kinderopvang daardoor ontoereikend is, deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verdenking dat de treinen met Romeins huisafval mogelijk de bron zijn van het Blauwtongvirus type 3.

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether waste trains from Rome to AEB Amsterdam could be the source of bluetongue serotype 3, and asked about permits, objections, risk analysis, sampling, and vaccine efficacy. The Minister answered that the EVOA notification gave no public objection route, no risk analysis was required, no sampling was planned as there was no reason to suspect Italy, and sequencing shows the Dutch strain is unrelated to the Italian one, while refusing to halt the transports.
No, that did not happen. That is not part of the notification procedure.
Nee dat is niet gebeurd. Dat is geen onderdeel van de kennisgevingsprocedure.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Haga over "het tekort aan aandacht voor personeel in steenkolensector"

An MP asked the government how it will support workers in the coal sector facing job loss from the energy transition, including how the 22 million euro coal fund will be spent and what it will do for those near retirement. The minister acknowledged the worries, said the primary responsibility for reemployment lies with employers and unions, and pointed to a contingency fund being prepared with FNV for cases employers and workers cannot resolve.
That is why I am working on a provision that can be deployed if there are adverse employment effects, particularly from phasing out coal, that employers and employees cannot resolve together.

Daarom werk ik aan een voorziening die ingezet kan worden als er nadelige gevolgen voor de werkgelegenheid aan de orde zijn, met name als gevolg van het uitfaseren van kolen, die werkgever en werknemer niet samen kunnen oplossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Veense Put vervuild door zandstort: “We varen nu door een plastic soep.”’

An MP asked the minister about contamination of the Veense Put from soil and dredging spoil dumping, possible effects on drinking water intake and bathing water, and links to algal blooms. The government answered that no violations of the soil quality decree were found under regular and extra inspections, that drinking water intake was not halted, and that no causal link to blue-green algae could be established.
In regular supervision and the extra checks during the shallowing of the Veense Put, no violations of the rules in the Soil Quality Decree have been found to date.
In het regulier toezicht en de extra controles bij de verondieping van de Veense Put zijn er tot op heden geen overtredingen van de regels in het Besluit Bodemkwaliteit geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het Woo-verzoek 2022.217, betreffende o.a. de overeenkomsten met laboratoria tijdens de coronacrisis

MP Van Haga asks why the signed contracts between government bodies and commercial laboratories on COVID-19 sample testing, requested under Woo case 2022.217 over a year ago, have not yet been published, and asks for a publication timeline. Minister Kuipers answers that the documents are still being assessed for exemptions, which took longer than expected, that the volume of Woo requests causes delays, and that a partial decision was issued with a phased approach; affected parties will be informed by sub-decision as contracts are cleared.
Once (part of) the contracts falling under the Woo request have been assessed and are eligible for publication, the requester will be informed of this by means of a partial decision.

Zodra er (een deel van de) contracten die onder het Woo-verzoek vallen beoordeeld zijn, en deze voor publicatie in aanmerking komen, wordt de indiener van het Woo-verzoek hierover geïnformeerd aan de hand van een deelbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de waterkwaliteit in Nederland en de gevolgen van schadelijke stoffen in oppervlakte- en drinkwater voor de volksgezondheid

An MP asked ministers about bisphenol A, pharmaceutical residues and other pollutants in surface and drinking water, their health effects, and whether monitoring and reporting should be tightened. The minister answered that existing EU rules and monitoring apply, that BPA is being tightened and pharmaceutical residues addressed through sector programmes, and declined to commit to annual reporting of BPA levels in people because such data is not measured.
Because BPA values are not measured annually in children and adults in combination with health complaints, annual reporting on this is not possible.
Omdat de waardes BPA niet jaarlijks worden gemeten bij kinderen en volwassen in combinatie met gezondheidsklachten, kan hier niet jaarlijks over gerapporteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over klimaatstress onder jongeren

MP Van Haga asked the ministers about climate stress among young people, the role of government and media communication, mental health effects, and whether the government would change its communication strategy. The minister answered that the government shares concern, is running a public climate campaign and youth participation measures, rejects any intent to instil fear, and reports insufficient data on long-term effects and no specific programmes for climate-stressed youth.
The cabinet wants to prevent young people from experiencing stress due to climate change.
Het kabinet wil voorkomen dat jongeren stress ervaren door klimaatverandering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over zorgmedewerkers die ziek worden na coronavaccinatie

An MP asks the Minister of Health about a study showing healthcare workers falling ill more often after repeated COVID vaccinations, and about whether the government will investigate, inform staff, or reconsider autumn booster vaccinations for this group. The Minister answers that no specific national data exist, rules out a comparable study, notes the Health Council recommends revaccination for healthcare workers, and says no further communication on side effects is planned.
There are no specific figures known on health complaints after vaccination among healthcare workers in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen specifieke cijfers bekend over gezondheidsklachten na vaccinatie bij zorgmedewerkers in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de situatie met betrekking tot de vermoorde snackbareigenaar

An MP asks the government why the widow of a murdered snack-bar owner receives no state help, which pushes successful entrepreneurs onto welfare, and whether rules will change. The Minister replies that existing schemes (Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven, Bbz, Anw, victim compensation and advance payment) already cover such cases, sees no reason to change the rules, and declines to share the crowdfunding campaign.
Therefore I see no reason to amend the rules.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden om de regels aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over dreigende sluiting ziekenhuis Parkstad

MP Van Haga asks whether the minister knows that Zuyderland/Parkstad hospital may lose its inpatient beds and emergency department by 2030, whether the minister will work to keep it, and how Parkstad's poverty and health problems bear on this. The minister replies that two options are under consideration, that the region's care must be reorganised within the IZA framework with the hospital and insurers deciding, and that he will follow the regional plan closely without committing to a specific step to preserve the hospital.
I will continue to follow the elaboration of the regional plan and the scenarios closely.
Ik blijf de uitwerking van het regioplan en de scenario's nauw volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de hertellingsprocedure bij de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior how recounts for the 2022 Tweede Kamer election are made public, which safeguards and protocols apply, and whether audits, sealing and documentation ensure transparency. The Minister answered that counting and recounts are public, that procedures are set by the Kieswet with multiple checks, that counting is manual with independently tested software, and that recounts and corrigenda are documented and published.
The counting of the votes is public.
De telling van de stemmen is openbaar voor publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de rapportagemaatregelen van de NPO voor Ongehoord Nederland

An MP asks the Secretary of State whether the NPO has a legal basis for requiring bimonthly reporting from Ongehoord Nederland and whether the NPO may impose such demands and sanctions before a licence decision. The Secretary of State answers that the NPO is an independent administrative body, that the matter is for the courts through objection and appeal, and that the minister cannot impose obligations on the NPO.
It is not for me to hold a political opinion on administrative decisions of an independent administrative body such as the Board of Directors of the NPO.
Het is niet aan mij om een politiek oordeel te hebben over bestuurlijke besluiten van een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan zoals de Raad van Bestuur van de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verzameling van CT-waardendata van coronatests

An MP from Groep Van Haga asked the health minister why the ministry and RIVM repeatedly said no CT-value data existed when over 1.2 million were collected, and questioned the medical and epidemiological relevance of CT values, quarantine practice, data destruction clauses and the withholding of information. The minister answered that the data were pseudonymised, collected from private labs the ministry does not control, that the labs were asked not to destroy data pending court cases, and that CT values are medically irrelevant in isolation.
All received CT values have been anonymised and cannot be traced back to individuals by the RIVM.
Alle ontvangen CT-waarden zijn geanonimiseerd en door het RIVM niet herleidbaar tot personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de coronapersconferenties van het kabinet

Van Haga asks the Health Minister whether the cabinet's COVID press conferences presented contested science as settled, misinforming the public about measures and vaccines, and why it persisted with 'the science' framing. The minister refers to the Safety Board reports and prior answers, denies misinforming the public, and states that the government continues to follow science.
As new scientific insights became known, this was incorporated openly and transparently into public communication.
Naarmate er nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten bekend werden, is dit open en transparant in de publiekscommunicatie verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de social media politie

MP Van Haga asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority (Belastingdienst) collected large amounts of sensitive personal data, including from social media, through the RAM system, and whether RAM was set up to monitor disfavoured people and opinions. The State Secretary answered that conclusions must await the ongoing investigations by the Tax Authority and the Dutch Data Protection Authority, that RAM was not created to monitor disfavoured opinions but for supervision, and that an external investigation into RAM will be instituted.
Only after these investigations are completed can conclusions be drawn about RAM and any actions be taken.
Pas na afronding van deze onderzoeken kunnen conclusies worden getrokken over RAM en eventuele acties ondernomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de analyse van de Zweedse coronacrisisaanpak

An MP asked the Minister of Health about an analysis claiming Sweden's COVID-19 approach caused less excess mortality and harm than Dutch lockdown-style measures, and about the role of trust and whether Dutch policy was counterproductive. The Minister rejected the comparative claim as not demonstrable, pointed to ongoing ZonMw and RIVM effectiveness research and parliamentary reporting, and declined to commit to reverting the Public Health Act (Wpg) measures.
To be able to learn from other countries' approaches, I have asked the RIVM to research the effectiveness of measure packages and individual measures.
Om te kunnen leren van de aanpak van andere landen heb ik het RIVM gevraagd onderzoek te doen naar de effectiviteit van maatregelenpakketten en individuele maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het onderzoek 'COVID-19 Infection Rates in Vaccinated and Unvaccinated Inmates: A Retrospective Cohort Study'

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the Minister of Health about a study finding higher COVID-19 infection rates among vaccinated than unvaccinated inmates, and about the effectiveness of bivalent boosters, monitoring, and vaccine contract disclosure. The minister rejects the study's conclusions as methodologically limited, states vaccines mainly prevent severe disease, and declines to add monitoring or change the programme.
No, I see no reason to do so.
Nee, ik zie hier geen reden toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de rol van meesterdiplomaat Frans Timmermans bij de vrijlating Venezolaanse drugsbaron Hugo Carvajal

A Groep Van Haga MP asked whether the then foreign minister Timmermans' 2014 release of Venezuelan Hugo Carvajal in Aruba, criticised by US and Aruban officials, would be investigated and why it was ordered. The minister answered that the matter had been explained in detail to parliament in 2014, that Carvajal was entitled to consular immunity under the Vienna Convention, and that justice in Aruba is autonomous.
The matter, including the role of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, was explained in detail in 2014 through answers to parliamentary questions.
De kwestie is, inclusief de rol van de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, in 2014 uitvoerig toegelicht aan de hand van antwoorden op Kamervragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over mRNA-coronavaccins, de potentiële gevaren daarvan en de aanstaande vaccinatieronde

An MP asked the health minister about claims that mRNA COVID vaccine spike protein persists for weeks or months, possible myocarditis and immune effects, DNA contamination, and whether Lareb monitors harms actively. The minister referred to earlier answers, stated the Swiss study showed mild, temporary myocardial injury with no long-term effects expected, said there is no evidence linking vaccination to long COVID, and declined to introduce active myocarditis monitoring.
I see no reason to intensively and actively monitor for myocarditis.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om intensief en actief te monitoren op myocarditis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over over het bericht ‘Boerin Anje is piekbelaster en vreest toekomst’

An MP asks the minister about the nitrogen 'piekbelasting' approach that may force a dairy farmer to close, questioning fairness, banks' cooperation, the reliability of the AERIUS model after a reported factor-200 error, and whether the EU buyout scheme is correctly applied. The minister answers that participation is voluntary, the methodology is internationally leading and maintained, the scheme is state-aid approved, and withdrawal-related reimbursement only applies if conditions are breached, while refusing to comment on controversy designation.
I wish to emphasise that participation in the peak-load approach is voluntary.
Ik hecht eraan te benadrukken dat deelname aan de aanpak piekbelasting vrijwillig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over politieke processen die beperkte OM-capaciteit opsouperen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether limited Public Prosecution Service capacity is being drained by political prosecutions (Wilders, De Mos, Van Meijeren), leaving cases like animal cruelty and fraud unpursued, and whether appeals against full acquittals conflict with ne bis in idem. The minister rejects the premise that these are political prosecutions, says the OM independently sets priorities, and defends the appeal in the De Mos case as serving restoration, control and legal-unity functions.
I do not agree with this view.
In deze mening kan ik mij niet vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over milieu- en klimaatvervuiling door mondneusmaskers tijdens de coronacrisis

An MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the environmental and climate damage from face masks during the COVID-19 crisis, including whether impact analyses were made, whether compensation or health funds are planned, and how future pandemics will be handled. The minister acknowledged the RIVM study, said no environmental impact analysis was made at the time, and gave largely non-committal answers, noting that the mask obligation was judged to outweigh the environmental harms and that waste is a broader problem.
At the time the decision was taken, it was not chosen to make an environmental impact analysis, and the cabinet was not aware of any warnings about the environmental consequences of using face masks.

Ten tijde van het nemen van het besluit is er niet voor gekozen om een milieu-impactanalyse te maken en waren het kabinet geen waarschuwingen bekend over de gevolgen van de inzet van mondneusmaskers voor het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de zaak Willem Engel

Member Van Haga asked the ministers about the Willem Engel case, including alleged prosecution influence on a VOG decision, a GRIP registration, monitoring and a media campaign against Engel and Viruswaarheid, and the minister's public statements. The minister denied OM instructions and media campaigns, declined to discuss individual cases, and stated that intelligence services do not comment on their work.
As I also indicated in the earlier answer, I cannot make statements about specific VOG applications.
Zoals ik in de eerdere beantwoording ook aangaf, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over specifieke VOG-aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het toenemend aantal explosies

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether the rising number of explosions is caused by drug gang feuds and what measures, including financial support for municipalities, will be taken. The minister answers that police and prosecutors cannot yet say whether gang feuds are the cause, that additional measures will be considered if so, and that the existing broad anti-organised-crime approach will be continued and reinforced.

Should it turn out that most explosions are indeed the result of feuds between drug gangs, I will, together with relevant partners including the police and the Public Prosecution Service, consider which additional measures are needed.

Mocht blijken dat inderdaad de meeste explosies het gevolg zijn van ruzies tussen drugsbendes, dan zal ik samen met betrokken partners, waaronder de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie, bezien welke aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de gevolgen van dure benzine voor de grensregio

An MP asks the government why fuel excise is high despite cross-border fuel and grocery spending, whether it will reverse the temporary excise cut, and why no cross-border effects test has been applied. The state secretary answers that excise is mainly budget-driven, that the cut was temporary and cannot be extended without budget cover, and that cross-border effects are already part of the policy framework and monitored.
Taking cross-border effects into account is included in the integrated assessment framework (IAK) and is supported by the Guideline on Cross-Border Effects.
Het meenemen van grenseffecten is opgenomen in het integraal afwegingskader (IAK) en wordt ondersteund door de Leidraad Grenseffecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van het lid Van Haga over de problemen bij het afschaffen van btw op groente en fruiover het btw-nultarief op leveringen van groente en fruit

An MP asked the Finance and Health ministers about the problems with abolishing VAT on fruit and vegetables, including costs, legal definition issues, and the Tax Administration's enforceability concerns. The government answered that no decision has been taken, that budgetary impact ranges from 500 to 950 million euros depending on the variant, and that a legally defensible demarcation is difficult, leaving the choice to a future cabinet.
No decision has yet been taken on whether to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and/or alternative health measures.
Er heeft nog geen besluitvorming plaatsgevonden over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit en/of alternatieve gezondheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het opslaan van medische gegevens van Nederlanders door externe softwareleveranciers

An MP asked the health minister about medical records of millions of Dutch patients being copied weekly by a commercial software supplier (Calculus/VIPLive) and stored elsewhere without patient consent, questioning legality, the role of GPs, and whether the state should provide a public system. The minister replied that the Data Protection Authority, not the ministry, judges legality, GPs are the controllers responsible for informing patients, and that data is encrypted and stored in the EEA, while promising to raise awareness with professional bodies and a catalogue of care IT systems.
It is not for me to assess whether this data sharing is unlawful.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of onderhavige gegevensdeling onrechtmatig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het verkeerd informeren van de Eerste Kamer over de PCR-test tijdens de coronacrisis

Senator Van Haga asked Minister Kuipers why the Eerste Kamer was allegedly misinformed about PCR test cycle thresholds during the COVID crisis, including whether high Ct values inflated case numbers and affected measures. The minister answered that the PCR data was never called irrelevant, that Ct relevance was explained to parliament, that there is no scientific consensus that Ct above 38 is unreliable, and that the government had no role in test interpretation, largely refusing to engage with the substance of the allegations.
I have consistently informed both chambers correctly and fully about the irrelevance of Ct values for taking measures during the covid crisis.
Ik heb beide Kamers steeds juist en volledig geïnformeerd over de irrelevantie van Ct-waarden voor het nemen van maatregelen in de covid-crisis.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over de terugkeer en de gevaren van de wolf in Nederland

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the minister whether the wolf should be classed as a problem animal after a wolf attacked a farmer, whether prevention is adequate, whether hybrid wolves are excluded, and about aid for affected farmers. The minister acknowledges the incident, refers to the Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden advice and existing provincial measures, and declines to create new protocols or a separate aid desk.
I have asked the Advisory Council on Animal Affairs, as an independent and expert party, to advise me on coexistence with the wolf.
Ik heb de Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden, als onafhankelijke en deskundige partij, gevraagd om mij te adviseren over het samenleven met de wolf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het cancellen van politici door Op1

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that BNNVara ended Op1 after a conflict with a WNL director, and about allegations that politicians are being dropped from broadcasts for not fitting the broadcaster's outlook, and whether public broadcasting spends taxpayers' money responsibly. The state secretary answered that the NPO, not the minister, is responsible for programme content and quality, that broadcasters decide form and content and treat guests properly under the Mediawet, and that the NPO and the Commissariaat voor de Media oversee efficient use of funds.
It is not appropriate for me as State Secretary for media to interfere with the content of and requirements for programmes.
Het past niet dat ik mij als Staatssecretaris van media bemoei met de inhoud van en eisen aan programma's.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de ‘goedkeuring’ van de FDA voor het voorschrijven van Ivermectine als behandeling tegen Covid-19

An MP asks why the Dutch government and IGJ treated off-label ivermectin prescribing for COVID-19 as unsuitable, whether the IGJ's fines on doctors were lawful, and whether government communication was misleading. The minister replies that ivermectin is not registered for COVID-19, that EMA, SWAB and NHG advised against it, that the IGJ independently enforced the rules, and that the courts upheld the fines.
The IGJ is an independent supervisory body. It is therefore for the IGJ to decide whether or not to act on the signals and reports it receives.
De IGJ is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder. Het is derhalve aan de IGJ om te beslissen om al dan niet op te treden op basis van de ontvangen signalen en meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Alrijne Ziekenhuis: 'Geld verzekeraars op dus we sluiten operatiekamers'

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that insurer budget limits lead Alrijne hospital to close operating theatres, and what the government will do about insurers' power. The Minister replied that insurers have a statutory duty of care, that the NZa supervises it and has received no signals of discontinuity, and that he will monitor the situation.
The NZa supervises whether health insurers fulfil their duty of care.
De NZa houdt er toezicht op dat de zorgverzekeraars hun zorgplicht nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de komst van azc op vakantiepark De Lindenberg in Holten

MP Van Haga asks the State Secretary how residents of De Lindenberg holiday park in Holten were informed about a planned asylum reception centre and whether the government will abandon the plan if the municipal council rejects it. The State Secretary says the urgency for reception places remains high, describes the municipality's information sessions and council meeting, and states the council's position is positive towards the purchase.
I remain committed to preventing any nuisance and ensuring the safety of residents, staff and local residents.
Ik blijf mij onverminderd inzetten om eventuele overlast te voorkomen en de veiligheid van bewoners, medewerkers en omwonenden te garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichten dat AEB (Amsterdams afvalverwerkingsbedrijf) door de gemeente Amsterdam opnieuw in de verkoop is gezet

An MP asked the state secretary about Amsterdam's renewed sale of waste-incinerator AEB, its capacity reduction goals, and whether the state could buy AEB to close it. The secretary answered that the climate fund reservations are not meant for buying and closing plants, and that gradual scaling down is preferred.
However, buying a company with the aim of closing it falls outside the scope.
Het kopen van een bedrijf met als doel het te sluiten valt echter buiten de scope.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de publicatie 'Rare link between coronavirus vaccines and Long-Covid-like illness starts to gain acceptance'

An MP from Groep Van Haga asked the health minister about a Science article linking COVID-19 vaccines to a Long Covid-like illness ('Long Vax') and asked what the government was doing to investigate, communicate and report on this possible link. The minister answered that Lareb and other bodies are monitoring the research, that Lareb is studying reports of long-term complaints after vaccination including a questionnaire study of 27,000 vaccinated people, and that there is currently no scientific evidence of a link between long-term complaints and vaccination.
The Lareb adverse reactions centre is currently researching reports of alleged long-term complaints after vaccination.
Bijwerkingencentrum Lareb doet op dit moment onderzoek naar meldingen van vermeende langdurige klachten na vaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de wereldwijd dalende geboortecijfers en de mogelijke oorzaken daarvoor

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the global decline in birth rates, possible causes, and whether COVID-19 policy or vaccination could be involved, including menstrual and fertility effects and pregnancy outcomes. The Minister answered that the decline fits demographic transition theory, that existing research covers it so no new study is planned, and that the data and registries show no link to vaccination, with no impact analysis planned.
Because a lot of research has already been and is being done on this, I will not start a new study.
Omdat daar al veel onderzoek naar is en wordt gedaan, ga ik niet een nieuw onderzoek starten.

Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘de negatieve impact op het midden- en kleinbedrijf (mkb) van earningsstrippingmaatregel (wijziging artikel 15b Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting per 1 januari 2025)’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the impact on SMEs of removing the EUR 1 million threshold from the earnings-stripping rule for real estate entities renting out property from 1 January 2025, and about the rationale, transition period and alternatives. The government answered that the measure targets artificial splitting of property investments across companies, that the details are still being worked out, and that it sees no reason for a transition period.
The design of the measure will be further elaborated in the coming period. The impact of the measure depends on its final design.
De vormgeving van de maatregel zal in de komende periode nader worden uitgewerkt. De impact van de maatregel is afhankelijk van de uiteindelijke vormgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘plattelandsbewoners die onevenredig hard worden geraakt door rekeningrijden’

MP Van Haga asked the minister whether road pricing (Betalen naar Gebruik) unfairly burdens rural residents given poor public transport there, and why the government pursues it, and whether preparations should stop after the cabinet fell. The minister answered that the government studies regional public transport measures, that research shows average rural mileage is slightly lower than urban, and that the cabinet has not yet decided on the tariff structure; on stopping preparations, the answer defers to Parliament's decision on controversial status.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het ombouwen van ziekenhuizen tot asielwalhalla’s

Van Haga asked the state secretary and health minister whether it is undesirable to close hospitals while care demand grows, and whether asylum seekers should be kept out of the empty Tergooi hospital in Blaricum. The government replied that the hospital operator decides on its own organisation within legal limits, that national government is responsible for asylum reception, and that a bill giving municipalities a reception task is pending but its timing cannot be stated.
It is the responsibility of the care provider, in this case Tergooi MC, to decide on the organisation of the care organisation
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder, in dit geval het Tergooi MC, om te beslissen over de inrichting van de zorgorganisatie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verloren 13.000 banen door inkrimping Schiphol

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about job losses and lost value added from the planned Schiphol flight reduction, including support for affected workers, Lelystad Airport, and alternatives such as innovation. The minister answers that net employment effects are limited because most displaced workers find new jobs within about six months, that a reduction is needed since fleet innovation is no short-term alternative, and that the government keeps working on balancing Schiphol with the living environment.

In the next progress letters the House will be kept informed of the efforts of the Ministry and the employers at Schiphol to limit the negative employment effects of the main decision as far as possible.
In de volgende voortgangsbrieven zal de Kamer op de hoogte worden gehouden over de inspanningen van het Ministerie en de werkgevers op Schiphol
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de overlast van asielzoekers in Maarheeze

An MP asks the State Secretaries about nuisance caused by asylum seekers in Maarheeze, including a shop closure and train drivers wanting to bypass the station, and why nothing was done earlier and whether offenders are punished and returned. The State Secretary answers that nuisance is unacceptable, lists measures taken with COA and the municipality (fencing, supervision, sports field, mobile shop, camera plans, a supervision team, possible COA hosts at the station), and explains that asylum status can be refused or revoked on public order grounds only after a conviction for a serious or particularly serious offence, with return proceedings following.
Any form of nuisance caused by asylum seekers is unacceptable, including in Maarheeze.
Iedere vorm van overlast veroorzaakt door asielzoekers is onacceptabel, zo ook in Maarheeze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over nieuwe Europese wetgeving die de zoektocht naar vermiste kinderen bemoeilijkt

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the EU AI Act's effect on searching for missing children, including the question of whether it could be blocked in Brussels and whether the Amber Alert model should be used across Europe. The minister said the government opposes a total ban on real-time facial recognition and will seek narrow exceptions, will pursue a balanced text with other member states, and that cross-border child alerts must go through formal channels.
The cabinet will, in close cooperation with other member states and the Council presidency, work hard in the coming period for a balanced text
Het kabinet zal zich de komende tijd in nauwe samenwerkingen met andere lidstaten en het voorzitterschap van de Raad hard maken voor een gebalanceerde tekst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving over de inkoop en uitrol van de coronavaccinaties in Nederland

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the Minister of Health about press reports on how COVID-19 vaccine contracts were negotiated, including liability waivers for manufacturers, the Janssen 'Dansen met Janssen' campaign, and outside influence on procurement. The Minister denies a European compensation fund and manufacturer liability waivers beyond strict conditions, says procurement was coordinated with partner countries, and refuses to publish the internal HollandBio email while promising to share the contract liability terms confidentially with the House.
I will not make the redacted passage from the internal email exchange public, because the interest in disclosure does not outweigh the interest in the proper functioning of the State.
Ik maak de gelakte passage uit de interne mailwisseling niet alsnog openbaar, omdat het belang van openbaarmaking niet opweegt tegen het belang van het goed functioneren van de Staat.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Haga over websites met kindermisbruik op Nederlandse servers

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of a rise in child sexual abuse websites hosted on Dutch servers, what action was taken, who owns the servers, and how such content is enforced against. The government answered that the Dutch share has actually fallen, outlined self-regulation with hosting providers and the planned ATKM enforcement authority, and said precise ownership and perpetrator data are unavailable.
We do not have a complete overview by nationality and ownership.
Een totaal overzicht naar nationaliteit en eigenaarschap hebben wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het vrijgeven van CBS-data met betrekking tot de doodsoorzakenregistratie tijdens de coronacrisis

An MP asked the ministers why the CBS refuses to release the Dutch-language dictionary table used for automatic cause-of-death coding under the Woo, and whether it will publish it independently. The minister answers that the CBS has granted the request and provided the tables to the requester, that the tables are publicly obtainable, and that the Dutch dictionary is necessary for automatic coding while COVID-19 forms were coded manually.
The tables are obtainable by anyone.
De tabellen zijn voor eenieder opvraagbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het vrijgeven van CBS-data met betrekking tot de doodsoorzakenregistratie tijdens de coronacrisis

An MP asks the Minister of Health why the CBS refuses to release the Dutch dictionary table used for automatic cause-of-death coding under the Open Government Act, and whether it should be published. The Minister replies that the CBS granted the request on 19 June 2023 and that the tables are now available, confirming a Dutch dictionary table is needed for automatic coding but that COVID-19 forms were coded manually.
According to the publication on the CBS website on 19 June 2023, the CBS made a decision under the Open Government Act whereby the tables were provided to the requester.
Het CBS heeft blijkens de publicatie op de website op 19 juni 2023 een besluit genomen op grond van de Wet open overheid, waarbij de tabellen aan de verzoeker zijn verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de AH-steker uit Den Haag

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a suspect's prior history of violence, earlier complaints on Curaçao, and whether cuts to mental health care explain the rise in confused persons on the street. The minister declined to give details beyond an earlier letter, pointing to a criminal investigation and an Inspectorate inquiry, argued the registration rise may not reflect a real increase, and said curative mental health spending rose rather than fell.
At this moment it is not possible to provide more information than contained in the letter with which I informed your House last Thursday about this terrible incident.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk om meer informatie te verstrekken dan opgenomen in de brief waarmee ik uw Kamer afgelopen donderdag over dit verschrikkelijke incident informeerde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een eventuele kerncentrale in Twente

An MP asked the minister whether a small nuclear plant in Twente could replace wind turbines, whether it would be feasible and supported, and whether research could be commissioned quickly. The minister replied that the advice feeds into the regional energy strategy, pointed to a market analysis and regional planning as the route, and promised a national SMR programme plan by end 2023.
I expect to be able to share the elaboration of the SMR programme with your House at the end of 2023.
De invulling van het SMR-programma verwacht ik eind 2023 met uw Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis en -maatregelen op het gezondheidsstelsel

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether COVID-19 measures had collapsed the health system, harmed women's health and work, and caused immune and vaccine-related harms, citing Brownstone Institute articles. The minister rejected the causal claims, cited a Groningen study and PFZW and TNO data, and said the evidence did not support the claim that women were disproportionately harmed in the Netherlands.

The conclusions of both articles, that the coronavirus crisis and the measures taken by governments worldwide served as a catalyst for the further deterioration of health systems in many countries, including the Netherlands, I do not share.

De conclusies van beide artikelen dat de coronacrisis en de coronamaatregelen die wereldwijd door overheden zijn genomen als katalysator hebben gediend voor het (verder) verslechteren van gezondheidssystemen in veel landen, waaronder Nederland, deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het rapport van Bureau Hoffmann, inzake het onderzoek van recherchebureau Interludium

An MP asks the Minister of Health about a Hoffmann Recherche report that examined claims in an Interludium report about Stichting Open Nederland, including foreign transactions, verification methods, interview records, and why the report is confidential. The Minister answers that the report was shared only confidentially with parliament, that the main findings are the claimed transfers and offshore/foreign accounts were not substantiated, and that confidentiality is justified by legal advice on harm to the reputation and privacy of named individuals, while declining to give detailed methods, notes or sources in the answer itself.
My conclusion, based on legal advice, is that there is indeed sensitive information here that could harm the persons involved.
Mijn conclusie, op basis van juridisch advies is, dat hier wel sprake is van gevoelige informatie die betrokken personen kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over geweld tegen jeugdzorgmedewerkers

An MP asked the government about rising aggression against youth care workers, the causes, complaint follow-up, prevention measures and information on incidents. The State Secretary answered that employers are primarily responsible, that no systematic data on incidents or sick leave is kept, and pointed to existing measures and planned regional meetings.
I do not know how many youth care workers drop out as a result of aggression in the work situation.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel jeugdzorgmedewerkers uitvallen als gevolg van agressie tijdens de werksituatie.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over het naar voorbeeld van Frankrijk en België in verzet komen tegen 'klimaatpaus' Timmermans

An MP asked the government whether it shares Belgian and French concern about EU climate policy under Timmermans, including the risk of another legal nitrogen crisis and too many green rules, and whether it will pause new EU green legislation. The minister answered that the government supports the green transition, will press Dutch interests in negotiations (e.g. weakening the nature restoration law's binding targets), and will inform parliament via BNC-fiches.
For the cabinet, the green transition is not up for discussion.
Voor het kabinet staat de groene transitie niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de totstandkoming van de prijs van het Paleis Soestdijk

An MP asked the minister for Housing and Spatial Planning whether the sale price of Paleis Soestdijk was too low relative to land value and why the valuation behind it is still not disclosed six years on. The minister replied that the price was set through an open tender with the highest bid accepted, that the RVB checked it against an external valuation, and that this valuation is commercially confidential and will not be published.
This valuation is commercially confidential and not public.
Deze taxatie is commercieel vertrouwelijk en niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het geweld bij het AZC in Heemserveen.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a renewed brawl at the Heemserveen asylum centre, how repeated violence can occur, what measures are planned, whether closure is an option, and whether violent asylum seekers will be expelled. The government answered that incidents appear unconnected, outlined a coordinated person-focused approach with the municipality and COA including extra security, a 'lik-op-stuk' prosecution approach, and that closure is undesirable given capacity needs while the asylum procedure of offenders is being accelerated.
The cabinet is therefore very keen to restore peace and security in the municipality of Hardenberg.
Het kabinet is er daarom alles aan gelegen om de rust en veiligheid in de gemeente Hardenberg te herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over sterfte aan COVID-19 in vergelijking met de normale griepsterfte

An MP asked the Minister of Health why, given CBS data in June 2020 showing COVID-19 excess mortality comparable to a severe flu season, the government continued strict measures, whether contracts or negotiations were ongoing, why the data was not communicated publicly, and whether the pandemic law was justified. The Minister rejected the comparison with flu, said the data showed unusually high deaths despite measures, denied that negotiations drove policy, said the Chamber was regularly informed, and referred to earlier answers and the OMT advice.
However, making public the agreements on COVID-19 vaccines with pharmaceutical companies would constitute a breach of contract.
Het openbaar maken van de overeenkomsten omtrent de COVID-19-vaccins met farmaceuten is echter een vorm van contractbreuk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de beperkte invloed van het bron- en contactonderzoek en de CoronaMelder-app op de bestrijding van de pandemie

An MP asks the minister why the contact tracing programme and CoronaMelder app were introduced and continued despite evidence of limited effectiveness, and why parliament was not informed earlier. The minister replies that contact tracing was a statutory task with limited added value later in the pandemic, that no prior impact analysis was done, and that the app's modest benefit was evaluated and monitored with results shared with parliament.
The outcomes of these studies have been communicated to your House.
Over de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken is uw Kamer geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de grote zorgen over de zorg in de Achterhoek

An MP asked the health minister about concerns that gemeenten in the Achterhoek were excluded from the regional acute care body (ROAZ) and about downgrading of the Zutphen emergency department to daytime hours only. The minister replied that ROAZ is limited to care providers and insurers, that municipalities can raise issues but have no formal role, and that sufficient regional capacity remains.
I do not have this data.
Ik beschik niet over deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het financieel wanbeheer bij het ministerie van VWS

An MP asks the Minister of Health about reported financial mismanagement at the ministry, including COVID-related procurement that breached procurement law, unlawful contract extensions, and unverifiable spending. The minister answers that the irregularities stem from urgency-based procurement, outlines improvement measures and a cultural change process, and points to the Audit Service and Court of Audit as the independent controllers.
In the operations section of the 2022 annual report, the ministry accounts for expenditures that were made unlawfully and for the causes of these.
In de bedrijfsvoeringsparagraaf van het jaarverslag 2022 verantwoordt het ministerie zich over uitgaven die onrechtmatig zijn gedaan en wat hier de oorzaken van zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het rapport van Unicef over het afnemende vertrouwen in vaccinaties voor kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a UNICEF report on declining confidence in childhood vaccines, challenging the government's transparency about COVID-19 vaccines, pressure applied, and responsibility for falling vaccination rates. The minister rejected the premise that information was withheld or that pressure was excessive, pointed to existing information channels, a continuing confidence campaign, and the limits of government control over vaccine confidence, and committed to no new concrete step beyond existing plans.
I do not share the assumptions in the questions.
Ik deel de aannames in de vragen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘het bestrijden van beroepsvandalen van Extinction Rebellion’

An MP asked the Justice Minister how to deal with Extinction Rebellion protests that block roads and disrupt public order, including whether the Overlastwet, group bans, damages recovery, subsidies and dialogue with the group could be used. The minister replied that demonstrations should be facilitated, that the mayor may restrict them only for health, traffic or public order reasons, that the Overlastwet does not apply to demonstrations, that damages can be recovered through civil or criminal routes, that no government subsidy was given, and that the minister does not talk with demonstration organisers.
The right to demonstrate is a great good, but the right to protest is not a licence to commit criminal offences.
Het demonstratierecht is een groot goed, echter het recht op betoging is geen vrijbrief voor het plegen van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Haga over de zaak De Mos

MPs Wilders and Van Haga asked the Justice Minister about the De Mos corruption case, which they say has politically paralysed The Hague after the Rotterdam court acquitted most suspects, and whether the minister would use her instruction power to halt the case. The minister answered that the prosecution service decides independently, that the case's length reflects its complexity, and that she will not use her instruction power, since ministerial interference in individual criminal cases must be avoided.
I am not willing to use my special instruction power, as referred to in articles 127 and 128 of the Judicial Organisation Act.
Los daarvan, ben ik niet bereid gebruik te maken van mijn bijzondere aanwijzingsbevoegdheid, zoals bedoeld in artikelen 127 en 128 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Smolders over het feit dat Italiaans huisvuil de woningbouw nog verder op slot zet en de Amsterdamse lucht vervuilt

Two MPs asked whether it is acceptable that weekly trains carry about 900 tonnes of Italian household waste to Amsterdam incinerators, citing CO2 emissions, air pollution, housing construction and public health concerns. The government answered that incineration with energy recovery is accepted while waste cannot yet be processed higher up the hierarchy, that the capacity imbalance explains cross-border transport, that Dutch incinerators must meet strict emission rules, and that the cabinet plans to reduce incineration capacity over time.
The cabinet is working nationally and at EU level to promote the highest possible level of processing, so that ultimately less waste needs to be incinerated or landfilled.
Het kabinet zet nationaal en Europees in op het stimuleren van zo hoogwaardig mogelijke verwerking waardoor er uiteindelijk minder afval moet worden verbrand of gestort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het met voeten treden van de wet door ambassades

Van Haga asked the Foreign Minister why foreign embassies in the Netherlands ignore Dutch court rulings in labour disputes with local staff, invoking diplomatic immunity, and what concrete help victims will get. Minister Hoekstra answered that embassies must respect Dutch labour law, that the state is not itself a party to these disputes, and that the ministry lobbies, sends notes, holds information sessions and offers only a mediating role, without committing to a new concrete remedy.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs regularly points to this duty, as laid down in Article 41 of the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken wijst geregeld op deze plicht, zoals deze in artikel 41 van het Verdrag van Wenen inzake diplomatiek verkeer («Wenen diplomatiek») is vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over kwaliteitsmonitoring van coronavaccins

MP Van Haga asked how the quality of COVID-19 vaccines is monitored, including batch testing, production locations, expiry dates and transparency. The minister answered that batches are tested by the manufacturer and independently by OMCL laboratories including RIVM before a batch release certificate is issued, and that test results are withheld as commercially confidential.
Due to the commercially confidential nature of this information, test results and production details cannot be shared.
Vanwege de commercieel vertrouwelijke aard van deze informatie zijn testuitslagen en productiedetails niet deelbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over vermeende vervuiling van Pfizer en Moderna mRNA coronavaccins

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether reported DNA contamination in Pfizer and Moderna mRNA COVID-19 vaccines, spike-protein persistence, post-vaccination complaints and batch-number data warrant further investigation. The Minister rejects the hypothesis as not credible, cites the non-verifiable sample origin and existing safeguards, and declines to release batch-linked adverse event data, stating no batch-related signals were found.
There are no reported adverse events linked to batch numbers supplied by Lareb to the RIVM.
Er zijn geen gemelde bijwerkingen gekoppeld aan batchnummers aangeleverd door Lareb aan het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aanhoudende asielcrisis

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the ongoing asylum crisis, including whether an emergency should be declared, the Refugee Convention, a Rwanda deal, and a five-point plan. The State Secretary answered that short-term measures are in place for Ter Apel, that the legal conditions for an emergency regime are not met, and that the other proposals are either ongoing EU work, already addressed, or under review.
Yes, I am aware of the reports and inventory mentioned.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de genoemde berichtgeving en inventarisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de 'Week van de lentekriebels' en de berichtgeving daarover

An MP asked the minister whether the 'Week van de lentekriebels' sex-education theme week had become more explicit over the years, whether its material was age-appropriate, and whether parents should be able to opt children out. The minister replied that participation is voluntary, the material follows expert and WHO-based standards, parents have a shared responsibility, and no change to the programme is planned.
I trust that schools and teachers can make a sound judgement in choosing teaching materials or programme packages.
Ik vertrouw erop dat scholen en leraren een goede afweging kunnen maken in de keus voor lesmateriaal of lespakketten.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over 'Wokegedram van het LAKS'

An MP asks the minister to end subsidy to the national pupils' union LAKS over its inclusive language guide and to redirect the funds to teacher shortages. The minister answers that schools may choose whether to use the guide, that inclusivity matters, and that there is no reason to end the subsidy relationship.
We therefore see no reason to end the subsidy relationship with the LAKS.
We zien dan ook geen reden om de subsidierelatie met het LAKS te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over onderzoek van de WENR en SGN over de wolf

An MP asked the minister about DNA research on dead wolves by WENR, Senckenberg and BIJ12, including whether hybridisation is tested and whether all DNA results should be made public. The minister confirmed awareness, said the analyses are commissioned by the provinces and published on the BIJ12 website, and described the species and hybrid testing procedure.
As I indicated in the answers to parliamentary questions from MP van der Plas and in my letter of 4 April, the analysis results are available via the BIJ12 website.

Zoals ik in de beantwoording van Kamervragen van het lid van der Plas (Aanhangsel Handelingen 2022–2023, nr. 920 ) en in mijn brief van 4 april jl. (Kamerstuk 36 200, nr. 120 ) heb aangegeven, zijn de analyseresultaten via de website van BIJ12 beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Haga over strengere regelgeving voor attractietoestellen

An MP asked whether strict safety rules halting steam trains in Zuiderpark amount to overregulation and asked for an exemption. The minister replied that the existing Warenwetbesluit already covers such trains as attractions, that the rules have not become stricter, and that no exemption will be granted.
No, there is no question of overregulation; this rests on a misconception.
Nee, er is hier geen sprake van overregulering, dit berust op een misvatting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de antwoorden op eerder gestelde vragen omtrent de risico´s van insectenconsumptie

An MP asked the ministers about labelling rules for insects in food, EFSA independence, subsidies to insect farms, the Protifarm closure, protein transition targets and insect welfare. The minister replied that novel-food labelling rules apply and NVWA enforces them, that EFSA opinions are the basis for approval, that subsidy data is not centrally kept, and that the Health Council advice on protein transition is expected in autumn 2023.
From the ministries of LNV and VWS no subsidies are granted to individual insect farmers.
Vanuit de ministeries van LNV en VWS worden geen subsidies verstrekt aan individuele insectenkwekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Verontrustende signalen bij start vaccinatiecampagne’

An MP (Van Haga) asked the Minister of Health about reports that health workers were hesitant about COVID-19 vaccination, whether adverse-event reports were downplayed, and whether the government misled the public about vaccine safety. The Minister denied any suppression or misleading communication, said uptake among health workers was 83%, and said vaccine safety was monitored transparently; he referred back to earlier answers on several points.

I expressly dissociate myself from the claim that no thorough research would be done into the chance of side effects and that there would be no transparent communication about the potential risks of COVID-19 vaccination.

Ik neem nadrukkelijk afstand van de stellingname dat er geen gedegen onderzoek zou worden gedaan naar de kans op bijwerkingen en dat er niet transparant zou worden gecommuniceerd over de potentiële risico’s van vaccinatie tegen COVID-19.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘bureaucratisch geharrewar reddingsplan grutto’

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about reports that millions of euros for the grutto (black-tailed godwit) rescue plan have sat unused for 2.5 years, whether the population decline reflects a stalemate between national government and provinces, and how funding and long-term cost responsibility will be resolved. The minister denied a stalemate, pointed to EUR 69.5 million in the CAP strategic plan for 2023–2027, said the 2023 funds are fully requested by collectives, and explained that provinces are cautious about long-term contracts pending decisions on the Transitiefonds and future CAP funding.
The suggestion that there would be a stalemate between national government and provinces over the Aanvalsplan Grutto is something I do not endorse.
De suggestie dat er sprake zou zijn van een patstelling tussen Rijk en provincies over het Aanvalsplan Grutto onderschrijf ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het advies van de WHO om mensen met een kwetsbare gezondheid een extra coronaprik te geven

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the government will follow a WHO recommendation for an extra COVID-19 vaccine dose for people with fragile health, and questions the excess-mortality research and vaccine safety. The minister replies that only severely immunosuppressed people are referred for a booster on a case-by-case basis, that vaccine safety is well established, and that the excess-mortality studies are ongoing and will be awaited.
I have adopted this advice and informed your House about it on 10 March 2023.
Dit advies heb ik overgenomen en ik heb uw Kamer hierover op 10 maart 2023 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het aansteker incident tijdens de wedstrijd Feyenoord-Ajax

MP Van Haga asked the Justice Minister about a lighter-throwing incident at the Feyenoord-Ajax match, whether football vandalism is rising, why proposals from a 2012 initiative note were not implemented, and what is being done on higher penalties, stadium and area bans, travel restrictions for hooligans, fines, and broader use of the Football Act. The minister answered that measures are continuously tightened, that the existing toolkit is being applied more strictly, and that a stronger criminal-law role and a Dutch-English model are being explored, while rejecting some proposals as disproportionate.
Only after the end of the football season will all figures be published that answer this question.
Pas na afloop van het voetbalseizoen worden alle cijfers gepubliceerd die antwoord geven op deze vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het Algemeen Dagblad artikel van 16 april ‘Waarom Brabant broeinest is voor criminelen: ‘Gaat niet om geografische ligging’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether she knows that Brabant's rural areas are a haven for drug criminals, whether she will set up a dedicated team to patrol rural areas, and whether she will raise reporting by residents. The minister said enforcement is spread across regions by agreed allocation and local authorities decide deployment, pointing to pilots, RIEC initiatives and a rural trust person, without committing to a new dedicated team.
It is then up to the local authorities, the mayors and public prosecutors, to decide how the (additional) capacity is deployed.
Het is vervolgens aan het lokaal gezag, de burgemeesters en officieren van justitie, om te bepalen hoe de (additionele) capaciteit wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over informatie over voorkennis over vaccinatieschade bij Pfizer en de Nederlandse overheid

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the government knew of Pfizer data on harms of mRNA COVID vaccines in pregnant and breastfeeding women and infants, when it knew, whether the vaccination programme should have been halted, and related questions. The minister replies that the government is not informed directly by marketing authorisation holders of adverse event reports, that there are no secrecy agreements, refers to Lareb reports, and refers back to earlier answers without new commitments.
There are no agreements concluded about keeping reports confidential.
Er zijn geen overeenkomsten gesloten over het geheimhouden van meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Smolders over het azc in Budel

Two Groep Van Haga MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the government will close the Budel asylum centre given local residents' complaints about nuisance and insecurity. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing measures such as street patrols and a neighbourhood connection plan, and said he remains in talks with the municipality, province and COA about the centre's future and further measures, without committing to closure.
I am and remain in discussion with the municipality of Cranendonck, the province, the COA and other key partners about the future of the reception centre.
Ik ben en blijf met de gemeente Cranendonck, de provincie, het COA en andere belangrijke partners in gesprek over de toekomst van het aanmeldcentrum.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen m.b.t. het artikel van Cochrane Library, over het effect van mondneusmaskers op de verspreiding van het SARS-COV-2 virus

MP Van Haga asks the Minister of Health why the government will not refute a Cochrane review finding that face masks have negligible or no effect on respiratory virus spread, and why it keeps defending the mask mandate despite unproven individual effectiveness, harms, and exemption problems. The Minister maintains that masks, combined with other measures, were a reasonable choice given no scientific consensus, denies knowledge of lasting harms, and declines to remove the mandate from the Wpg or commission new harm research beyond a forthcoming RIVM publication.
I am not aware of any cases of long-term complaints from wearing a face mask properly.
Er zijn mij geen gevallen bekend van langdurige klachten door het op de juiste wijze dragen van een mondneusmasker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de beantwoording van het CBS op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de doodsoorzakenregistratie ten behoeve van het onderzoek naar de oversterfte

Van Haga asks the Minister of Health how Statistics Netherlands (CBS) determines underlying causes of death for COVID-19, whether all COVID-mentioned death certificates were coded manually, and whether there is a COVID bias in the data. Minister Kuipers answers that WHO coding rules govern COVID-19 as underlying cause, that all COVID-mentioned certificates were manually coded by trained medical coders, and that the CBS sees no evidence of systematic over- or under-diagnosis, while declining to commit to a technical briefing invitation.
All death certificates on which a doctor reported COVID-19 in the causal chain of events have been manually coded and checked by the CBS.
Alle doodsoorzaakverklaringen waarop door een arts melding is gemaakt van COVID-19 in de causale keten van gebeurtenissen zijn door het CBS handmatig gecodeerd en gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen inzake de betrokkenheid van het Ministerie van J&V en de DJI bij de zaak Engel

Rep. Van Haga asks the Ministers of Legal Protection and Justice & Security why the OM shared a summons with Justis, why a VOG decision was taken on 23 March 2022, why access to a prison was refused, and about the Engel case and NCTV involvement. The ministers answer that the VOG process and information requests follow fixed procedure, that no political instruction occurred, that no access was refused, and that information about an ongoing criminal case is withheld in the interest of the State and privacy.
Beyond being informed about this case, she has no other involvement in this case.
Naast dat zij geïnformeerd is in deze zaak heeft zij verder geen betrokkenheid bij deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een nieuw ongeluk naast bocht van de A59 naar de A2 bij knooppunt Empel

An MP asked the minister whether, after a new non-fatal crash at the Empel junction, a guardrail would finally be installed where two people had died earlier, and whether the government would act now. The minister said Rijkswaterstaat found the infrastructure contributed to the severity, that guardrails and other measures will be installed at all four junction curves, with the first guardrail placed on 3-4 May 2023 and the rest planned within the year.
On the evening and night of 3 to 4 May, the first guardrail will be installed.
In de avond en nacht van 3 op 4 mei wordt de eerste geleiderail geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aanleg van de A15 tussen Bemmel en Duiven/Zevenaar

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure about the Raad van State's interim ruling on nitrogen calculations for extending the A15, the resulting delay, and whether the government would pressure for the project. The minister welcomed the interim ruling, said the final judgment rests with the Raad van State and that no pressure would be exerted on that procedure, and noted that nitrogen issues and capacity constraints slow other projects.
On that procedure I do not want to and cannot exert any pressure.
Op die procedure wil en kan ik geen druk uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over verkeershinder door afsluitingen Heinenoordtunnel

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Rijkswaterstaat is failing to limit traffic disruption for Dordrecht businesses caused by closures of the Heinenoordtunnel, and about proposed alternatives such as adjusted lane allocations and traffic controllers. The minister rejected the claim that Rijkswaterstaat falls short, described the lane and road measures being taken, and said the measures can limit but not remove the nuisance.
Rijkswaterstaat, municipalities, the province and the water board are deploying an extensive package of measures to limit the nuisance.
Rijkswaterstaat, gemeenten, provincie en waterschap zetten een uitgebreid pakket aan maatregelen in om de hinder te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de opvang van asielzoekers in Hotel aan de Linge

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the emergency accommodation of asylum seekers in a hotel in Kedichem, whose owner objected and whose rights were allegedly overridden. The State Secretary answers that a summary-proceedings court ruled on lawfulness, that the municipality contracted with the hotel operators (not the state or COA), that no expropriation or seizure occurred, and that municipalities decide how to shelter homeless people.
In no case was there any seizure or requisition of the hotel property in question when the hotel was rented in the municipality of Vijfheerenlanden.
In geen geval is er bij de huur van het genoemde hotel in de gemeente Vijfheerenlanden sprake geweest van inbeslagname dan wel vordering van het pand in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Mishandeling van een boswachter’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a reported assault on a forest ranger in Limburg, rising aggression against rangers, which equipment rangers are authorised to carry, and whether bodycams should be issued. The minister confirmed the incidents, gave incident counts, said equipment choice rests with employers, and noted Staatsbosbeheer's request for pepper spray was met in 2019.
The police do not specifically record incidents of aggression against forest rangers.
De politie registreert niet specifiek op incidenten van agressie tegen boswachters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de ‘Desinformatie-operatie’ van de overheid

An MP asks the government why its earlier answers denied any 'disinformation operation' despite Woo documents showing counter-disinformation bodies, LIMC surveillance of critical citizens, avatar use, and an unclear legal basis; the minister maintains the reporting gives a distorted picture, refers back to earlier answers and a commission report, and denies key allegations. The answers repeatedly decline to add detail or to provide the requested overview of who did what, citing prior answers, privacy, and other responsibilities.
Also, the names of the think tank participants are not made public in connection with the protection of personal privacy.
Tevens worden de namen van de deelnemers van de denktank niet openbaar gemaakt in verband met de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een klip en klaar onderzoek van het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) aangaande het invoeren van een niet-effectieve gedragstaks

Van Haga asks the Finance Minister whether the government will drop its plan for extra taxes on meat, dairy and flying after a CPB study found behavioural taxes ineffective. The state secretary acknowledges the tax system has become complex and that tax instruments are not a cure-all, and says the government weighs effectiveness before new taxes and cites an impact analysis for the flight tax increase, without committing to drop the plans.
Fiscal arrangements can only be justified if they do what they are intended to do, that is, if they are effective and efficient.
Fiscale regelingen zijn alleen te verantwoorden als ze doen wat ze beogen, oftewel doeltreffend en doelmatig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over lagere prijzen in Duitsland voor dagelijkse boodschappen en het uitblijven van de grenseffectentoets

Van Haga asked the Economy and Climate minister why grocery prices are lower in Germany and Belgium, whether this is causing border-region decline, and whether a border-effects test will be applied to policy. The minister replied that price differences are limited and driven by many factors, that no evidence of a hollowed-out border region was found, and that the cabinet has made border-effects assessment a mandatory quality requirement since 2021.

Since 2021 the cabinet has included in the integrated assessment framework (IAK) a mandatory quality requirement to take border effects into account in proposed new or amended policy and regulation, where relevant.

Het kabinet heeft sinds 2021 als verplichte kwaliteitseis in het integraal afwegingskader (IAK) opgenomen, om bij voorgenomen (nieuw of gewijzigd) beleid en regelgeving – wanneer aan de orde – ook rekening te houden met grenseffecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de ontslaggolf bij PostNL

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Social Affairs about job cuts at PostNL, whether postal workers could be deployed as neighbourhood eyes to avert dismissals, and whether a loneliness-detection pilot like Rotterdam's could be launched elsewhere. The minister answered that the reorganisation does not affect parcel and post delivery staff, that PostNL is offering permanent contracts to postal workers, that UWV provides support for the unemployed, and that a PostNL loneliness-signalling pilot is expanding, while declining to impose such duties on companies.
It is not obvious that the government should impose an obligation on companies here: it is up to PostNL to weigh whether and how people are deployed.
Het ligt niet voor de hand hier vanuit de overheid een verplichting op te leggen aan bedrijven: het is aan PostNL om af te wegen of en hoe mensen worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de laatste oversterftecijfers van het CBS

Rep. Van Haga asks the health minister how he views CBS excess-mortality figures, the claim that vaccines are not linked to excess deaths, and whether a dedicated study on vaccination and excess mortality will be commissioned. The minister rejects the misinformation framing, defers explanations until an independent excess-mortality study reports, and points to ongoing ZonMw-funded studies on vaccination status and excess mortality.
For further explanation, I want to await the results of the excess-mortality study.
Voor verdere duiding wil ik de resultaten van het oversterfteonderzoek afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over capaciteit coronavaccinatielocaties en het advies van het OMT-V

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the capacity of GGD COVID vaccination sites, why the OMT-V advice was awaited, the costs of keeping sites open, and the terms of government vaccine contracts with pharmaceutical firms. The minister said capacity will be scaled down based on RIVM and LCCB advice, costs are not yet known, and contract details will not be published under an EU agreement.
At European level it has been agreed not to make the agreements with pharmaceutical companies on COVID-19 vaccines public.
Op Europees niveau is afgesproken om de afspraken met farmaceuten omtrent de COVID-19 vaccins niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving van the Wall Street Journal over natuurlijke immuniteit tegen het SARS-COV-2 virus

MP Van Haga asks the Minister of Health about a Wall Street Journal piece claiming natural immunity to SARS-CoV-2 was dismissed by government, and whether vaccination pressure and treatment of unvaccinated people were justified. The Minister answers that the government followed the best available knowledge and independent advice (Gezondheidsraad, OMT), rejects the suggestion of misleading the public or demonizing the unvaccinated, and refers back to earlier answers.
Vaccination policy has always been based on scientific advice from the Health Council and the OMT-V.
Het vaccinatiebeleid is altijd gebaseerd op wetenschappelijke adviezen van de Gezondheidsraad en het OMT-V.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verkiezingen in Limburg

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about miscounted votes in the Limburg water board election, possible counting errors in the provincial election, and nine 'Waterbelang' lists linked to the CDA. The minister explained the discrepancies came from preliminary municipal tallies and a spreadsheet error, found no substantive counting problems in the provincial election, and said no new restrictive rules were planned.
I currently have no plans for restrictive regulation on this point.
Ik heb momenteel geen voornemens voor beperkende regelgeving op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het onderzoeksrapport van forensisch bureau Hoffman met betrekking tot het onderzoek naar Interludium

MP Van Haga asked Minister Kuipers to send the Hoffman forensic report on the Interludium investigation into Stichting Open Nederland's finances to parliament immediately. The minister answered yes and shared the report confidentially with MPs.
Yes, I hereby share the Hoffmann Recherche research report confidentially with your House
Ja, hierbij deel ik het onderzoeksrapport van Hoffmann Recherche vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het verdwijnen van de traditie van Paas- en Vreugdevuren

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen whether nitrogen permit rules are destroying the Easter bonfire tradition and what will be done to protect it.
