Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het verbranden van persoonlijk beschermingsmiddelen (PBM) en de mondkapjes van de ’Sywert-deal’

MP Van Haga asked the health minister why about 20 million face masks from the Sywert deal and around 300 million PPE items from the emergency stockpile are being destroyed, questioning procurement, expiry management, the market-distortion rationale for not donating them, and the destruction tender. Minister Kuipers answered that stockpiling reflected crisis-time uncertainty, that the goods exit strategy and tender are underway, and that cost figures are not yet available, while largely defending the approach without committing to new measures.
It is not possible to give insight now into the expected processing costs; these costs are part of the currently ongoing European tender.
Het is niet mogelijk om nu inzage te geven in de te verwachten verwerkingskosten, deze kosten zijn onderdeel van de momenteel lopende Europese Aanbesteding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over kennis van klinische data over effectiviteit en potentiële bijwerkingen van coronavaccins

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the government withheld clinical data on COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness and side effects, including transmission, and whether this breached informed consent and the bodily integrity guarantee. The Minister answers that uncertainties were communicated openly, that trial gaps on reproductive toxicity and carcinogenicity are explained by ethical limits and preclinical evidence, and that no information was deliberately withheld.
Such information is therefore not withheld from the citizen.
Dergelijke informatie wordt dus niet voor de burger achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over windmolenverzet in Brielle

An MP asks the minister about a protest in Brielle against two wind turbines, whether EU court rulings invalidate Dutch turbine norms requiring a halt to onshore projects, and whether Denmark and Germany's distance norms should lead to a stop. The minister says the Council of State ruled on a procedural error, responsibility for local norms lies with competent authorities, a national plan-MER is in preparation, and flashing lights will be reduced via proximity detection.

I previously informed you, jointly on behalf of the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, about the consequences of this ruling and the process to arrive at new national environmental norms for wind turbines based on a plan-MER.

Ik heb u eerder, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (IenW), geïnformeerd over de gevolgen van deze uitspraak en het proces om te komen tot nieuwe landelijke milieunormen voor windturbines op basis van een plan-MER.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over a-symptomatisch testen voor Corona en het opheffen van de DOBC

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the Minister of VWS why asymptomatic COVID-19 testing and the CoronaMelder app were pushed despite claims of false positives, and whether the DOBC advisory committee was compromised. The minister replies that policy drew on the latest scientific advice, that asymptomatic testing aimed at presymptomatic contacts, and that the DOBC was independent; he declines to estimate false positives and denies that the policy was wrong.
It is not possible to estimate the number of false-positive test results in the Netherlands.
Het is niet mogelijk een inschatting te maken van de hoeveelheid vals-positieve testuitslagen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het laten lopen van echte criminelen door focus op zaak De Mos

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether it is acceptable that 53 cases were dropped, letting drug dealers and growers escape punishment, and why a local politician is being prosecuted while real criminals go free, asking also for staff and cost figures. The minister declined to comment on individual cases because one is before a court, stated that the Public Prosecution Service decides independently under the opportunity principle, and said the cost figures are not kept.
To prevent political interference, the Public Prosecution Service has an independent authority to decide in which cases to prosecute or not.
Om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen heeft het Openbaar Ministerie een eigenstandige bevoegdheid om te beslissen in welke zaken wel of niet wordt vervolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Haga over ‘het kapot maken van de visserij’

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports that the demersal fishing sector is collapsing, with fishers making heavy losses and signing up for a decommissioning scheme, and whether innovation funds and a future perspective would be provided. The minister acknowledged the losses and the scheme sign-ups, described a socio-economic impact analysis due in early 2023, said the innovation network was starting up, and stated her mission is supporting a smaller, sustainable fleet without offering guarantees.
At present I am having a socio-economic impact analysis carried out to map the relationship between the primary sector, the chain and communities.
Op dit moment laat ik een sociaaleconomische impactanalyse uitvoeren om de relatie tussen de primaire sector en de keten en gemeenschappen in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over kinderontvoeringen naar het buitenland

An MP asked the Justice Minister why international child abduction from the Netherlands is rising, whether migrant-parent involvement is tracked, how to prevent abductions, and whether penalties should be raised or abducting parents barred from entry. The minister said the data show no structural rise, no further study or risk analysis is needed now, and no bill to increase penalties is planned, while describing prevention training and efforts to improve travel-consent checks.
I do not consider further research necessary at this time.
Nader onderzoek acht ik op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord opvragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving met betrekking tot vaccinatieverplichting voor personeel in Isala ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the Health Minister about reports that Isala hospitals require COVID-19 vaccination for staff on oncology and haematology wards, and whether this is unconstitutional, risky for patients, and who bears liability. The minister answered that the matter is a civil-law employer-employee issue, that the hospital's policy is not for the government to judge, that there was no contact with the ministry, and that liability questions are for civil courts.
It is not for me to judge the desirability of the Isala hospital group's policy or to assess whether this policy fits within the legal framework outlined above.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de wenselijkheid van het beleid van de Isala-ziekenhuisgroep of te beoordelen of dit beleid binnen het hierboven geschetste wettelijk kader past.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Rellen verpesten kermis in Osdorp’.

Van Haga asks the Justice Minister about youth riots at a fairground in Osdorp, Amsterdam, and how the government will combat them, recover police costs and shopkeepers' losses, and confiscate youths' property or impose area bans and curfews. The Minister points to the prevention-and-sanctions youth crime approach, says policing costs are not recharged, refers victims to civil or criminal compensation routes, and refers back to the answer on question 2.
Costs incurred by the police for enforcing public order are not recharged.
Kosten gemaakt door politie voor handhaving van de openbare orde worden niet doorberekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over “de stinkende biomassacentrale in Steenwijkerland”

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether the Ice Bear biomass plant in Steenwijkerland, which residents and the municipal council say causes odour, night noise and fine dust, will be closed and why biomass is a poor energy source. The minister said subsidies for new wood-based electricity have stopped, pointed to tightened emission limits and the Clean Air Agreement, and said closure is for the municipality and province as licensing and enforcement authorities.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Onderzoek naar financiële transacties van/naar Stichting Open Nederland

An MP asked ministers whether they knew of a private investigation report into financial transactions of Stichting Open Nederland and why the Chamber was not informed, and whether the report was forwarded to ministries and press. The government answered that the report was unreliable, that VWS commissioned its own check finding no evidence of the transactions, that the report cannot be published pending possible legal proceedings, and that it was not informed of the investigation when it took place.
Pending possible legal proceedings and measures, the research report commissioned by VWS cannot currently be made public.
In afwachting van mogelijke juridische procedures en maatregelen kan het in opdracht van VWS opgeleverde onderzoeksrapport nu niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitspraak van het Tuchtcollege m.b.t. een huisarts die Covid-19 patiënten off-label medicatie voorschreef

An MP asked the minister whether a Tuchtcollege ruling that a GP did not violate the Medicines Act by prescribing hydroxychloroquine and ivermectin off-label for COVID-19 is accepted, and whether fines and government discouragement of such prescribing were unfounded. The minister declined to go into substance, saying the inspectorate is still considering the ruling and that treatment guidelines are set by the medical profession, not the minister.
The inspectorate has informed me that it is currently considering the Tuchtcollege ruling and its possible consequences for other cases.
De inspectie heeft mij laten weten zich op dit moment te beraden op de uitspraak van het tuchtcollege en op de mogelijke consequenties hiervan voor andere zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht dat grote steden extra hulp willen bij onderwijs aan asielkinderen

Van Haga asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about big cities requesting extra help for education of asylum children, linking population growth to teacher shortages, workload and social cohesion, and asked whether the government would push to curb population growth. The minister acknowledged the pressures and pointed to teacher-shortage measures and a civics expertise point, but declined to commit to pushing for curbing population growth, referring the question to a state commission reporting in 2023.

The State Commission on Demographic Developments, which started this autumn, will advise on 1 November 2023 on scenarios, possible policy options and the government's courses of action regarding the societal consequences of demographic developments

De Staatscommissie Demografische ontwikkelingen die dit najaar van start is gegaan, brengt 1 november 2023 advies uit over scenario's, mogelijke beleidsopties en handelingsperspectieven van de regering
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over garanties om de Haringvlietbrug en de Heinenoordtunnel nooit tegelijk dicht te doen voor verkeer

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Haringvlietbrug and Heinenoordtunnel can be guaranteed never to be closed to traffic at the same time, given the severe disruption this would cause. The minister guarantees they will not be closed simultaneously, sets out three risks and mitigation and fallback scenarios, and notes that the regional authorities were informed.
That is why the Haringvlietbrug and the Heinenoordtunnel will not be closed simultaneously.
Daarom zullen de Haringvlietbrug en de Heinenoordtunnel niet gelijktijdig afgesloten worden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over de schadelijke gezondheidseffecten van windturbines

An MP asks the Ministers of Health and of Climate and Energy whether BPA in wind turbine blades, released through erosion, harms health and water quality, and why turbines are still built. The government answers that residual BPA is very low (0.001 to 0.01%), that water is monitored with no signs of threat, and that a RIVM quickscan on emissions is pending, with the Chamber to be informed afterwards.
The Chamber will be informed once the quickscan is completed about which follow-up research and/or steps are deemed necessary.
De Kamer wordt geïnformeerd zodra de quickscan is afgerond over welke vervolgonderzoeken en/of stappen noodzakelijk worden geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het tweede OVV-rapport over de Nederlandse aanpak van de coronacrisis

An MP asks the government to explain why COVID-19 measures between September 2020 and July 2021 were presented as scientifically founded despite the OVV's finding that their effects were unclear, and whether information was withheld or communication misleading. The minister denies any deliberate misleading, says effects were monitored and evaluated, defers the full government reaction to the OVV report, and largely refers to a letter of 11 November 2022 without substantive new evidence.
Regarding this subject, I have informed your House in my letter of 11 November 2022.
Met betrekking tot dit onderwerp heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd in mijn brief van 11 november 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het faillissement van Aldel te Delfzijl

An MP asked the minister about the bankruptcy of aluminium producer Aldel in Delfzijl, its job impact, what the government did to keep it alive, what options exist for other energy-intensive firms, and whether the government will find investors for a restart. The minister acknowledged the bankruptcy, explained that a prior state aid request was assessed under the framework and rejected for lack of political-social interest, said a broader impact analysis and framework will follow by year end, and stated that finding investors is not a government task.
Parliament was at the time informed about this in confidence.
Hierover is uw Kamer destijds in vertrouwen geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een mogelijk verband tussen de start van de najaars-vaccinatiecampagne en de oplopende sterfte

MP Van Haga asks whether excess mortality after the autumn COVID-19 booster campaign start could be linked to vaccination, and whether immunocompromised people and cumulative vaccination effects were investigated. Minister Kuipers answers that correlation is not causation, earlier CBS/RIVM and Lareb monitoring found no causal link, no further study of the immunocompromised group is planned, and oversterfte data access is being pursued.
There are no indications that the COVID-19 booster would lead to an increased risk of death.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat de herhaalprik tegen COVID-19 zou leiden tot een verhoogd risico op overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht Minister dwingt gemeenten tot nieuwe dure gascontracten, geld gaat naar Rusland

Van Haga asks the Minister for Climate and Energy why municipalities were forced to terminate Gazprom Energy/SEFE gas contracts, raising costs and possibly sending more money to Russia, and whether compensation will be given. The Minister says the termination follows from the EU sanctions regulation, acknowledges the price effects and the subsequent German nationalisation of SEFE GmbH, promises compensation for costs from 10 October to 31 December 2022, and states that existing SEFE contracts may now be maintained.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de ‘Geleverde streek aan vissers’

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether she knew fishers were angry about the decommissioning scheme's requirement that fishing quotas lapse, and why she was shrinking the fleet, including whether she would abandon this and honour earlier promises. The minister replied that the quota lapse is a condition of the voluntary scheme, needed because of reduced EU quotas after Brexit, that consultation with the sector took place except on this point to avoid insider trading, and that two further compensation schemes will open in 2023.
This was done because prior consultation on this part of the decommissioning scheme could lead to insider trading, which is undesirable.
Dit is gedaan omdat vooroverleg over dit onderdeel van de saneringsregeling zou kunnen leiden tot handel met voorkennis, wat ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het blokkeren van het amendement op de Tijdelijke wet maatregelen Covid-19 (Twm) (nieuwe versie)

Van Haga asks the Health Minister why ministry officials discussed a GroenLinks amendment to the COVID-19 temporary law as a dangerous 'powerful weapon', why the ministry seemed to object to opposition being able to block a ministerial regulation, and whether this undermines parliamentary democracy. The minister rejects the claims, saying the amendment was assessed on its merits for effects on epidemic response capacity and that the final law gave parliament a stronger democratic role.
It is customary for every submitted amendment to be assessed on its merits.
Het is gebruikelijk dat elk ingediend amendement op zijn merites wordt beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de nieuwe coronagolf, de terugkeer van influenza en de vaccinatiecampagnes

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a new COVID wave, the return of influenza, the link between vaccination and COVID policy, and the capacity of care and GP services. The Minister answered that the policy is based on immunity and vaccine protection, that care scale-up uses the existing LNAZ plan and TAZ programme, that COVID and flu vaccines can be given together safely, and that GP access is being maintained, without committing to new concrete measures.
The RIVM provides factual information about the current epidemiological situation and the effectiveness of COVID-19 vaccination.
Het RIVM verstrekt feitelijke informatie over de huidige epidemiologische situatie en de effectiviteit van vaccinatie tegen COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over aangepaste bivalente vaccins tegen het coronavirus en boostercampagnes

An MP asked the Minister of Health why a population-wide booster campaign with bivalent vaccines is still needed given natural immunity and reported weak booster effectiveness, and questioned whether vaccination rates should inform restrictive measures. The Minister rejected the premise, stating boosters add protection against severe disease and some transmission reduction, and declined to change testing, tracing or vaccination policy.
I see no reason at this time to revise the testing and tracing policy or the vaccination strategy for the coming period.
Ik zie op dit moment geen reden om het test- en traceerbeleid of de vaccinatiestrategie voor de komende tijd te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over boetes voor huisartsen die niet-toegestane medicijnen tegen Corona voorschreven

An MP asks the Health Minister why the Inspectorate fined 16 doctors for off-label prescribing of ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine for COVID-19, questioning proportionality, privacy, procedure and consistency. The Minister defends the fines as lawful and proportionate, states the inspectorate acts independently, and declines to review patient outcomes or change the protocols.
I am not intending to conduct research into this.
Ik ben niet voornemens hier onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over 'WOB-dossier: Intimideren van artsen door de IGJ'

An MP asks the health minister about reports that the inspectorate (IGJ) intimidated doctors over off-label COVID treatments, including whether ministry pressure shaped inspectorate action, and on what legal basis doctors' social media statements were policed. The minister answers that the IGJ acts independently under its legal mandate, that off-label prescribing rules were applied, and that no ministerial instruction was given, though regular contact took place.
The Decree on the Performance of IGJ Duties provides that the IGJ is independent in its judgment and does not allow it to be influenced by ministerial or political pressure.
In het Besluit Taakuitoefening IGJ wordt geregeld dat de IGJ onafhankelijk is in haar oordeel en dit niet laat beïnvloeden door ministeriële of politieke druk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het feit dat sollicitanten niet op Schiphol worden aangenomen omdat zij te ver weg wonen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether security firms at Schiphol reject applicants living too far away, and whether this is justified given staff shortages. The minister answered that firms weigh commute distance for continuity reasons, that exact numbers of rejected applicants cannot be obtained, and that the matter is the responsibility of the firms and Schiphol.
Exacte aantallen zijn niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de tientallen klachten over misbruik en mishandeling in jeugddorp De Glind

An MP asked whether the government would investigate dozens of complaints of abuse and mistreatment at the De Glind youth village and whether youth-care reporting duties are enforced. The state secretary said the provider Pluryn will commission an independent investigation, noted mandatory incident reporting to the IGJ, and announced follow-up research on abuse patterns in youth care.
Pluryn has indicated that it will have an investigation carried out by an independent party into the misconduct that took place.
Pluryn heeft laten weten dat zij een onderzoek gaan laten uitvoeren naar de misstanden die hebben plaatsgevonden door een onafhankelijke partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de documentaire ‘Taken – Kinderen van de Staat’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health about the documentary on child protection, the IGJ findings on unjustified out-of-home placements, decentralised youth care, financing, workforce shortages and compensation. The government acknowledged serious problems, promised a reform agenda and a plan to improve legal protection, but rejected re-auditing all placements and any compensation scheme.
In all cases examined, multiple problems existed in the family, such as addiction, debt, domestic violence or parenting problems.
In alle onderzochte zaken speelden meerdere problemen in het gezin, zoals verslaving, schulden, huiselijk geweld of opvoedproblemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de regeling Tegemoetkoming Energiekosten en de maatregelen vanaf november

Van Haga asked why the cabinet waited months to act on high energy costs for energy-intensive SMEs, whether it had failed them, and how Parliament can scrutinise support options before November. The minister acknowledges the problem, explains the TEK scheme is retroactive from November with payouts expected in Q2 2023 due to feasibility and EU approval, and points to tax deferral and bank bridge financing as interim help, but does not share the options before the consultation.
For these energy-intensive enterprises I have announced the Tegemoetkoming Energiekosten (TEK scheme).
Voor deze energie-intensieve ondernemingen heb ik de Tegemoetkoming Energiekosten (TEK-regeling) aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over onderbreking datastroom RIVM met betrekking tot vaccinatiecampagnes

An MP asked why detailed weekly COVID-19 vaccination reports on the RIVM website were unavailable after a data-flow interruption between GGD-GHOR and RIVM, and whether they would be restored. The minister said the reports were not moved, the data interruption was caused by changes to vaccination registration, the reports were republished from 25 October including the gap period, and one email exchange with ECDC is attached.
The adjustments to the data flow have now been completed. The detailed reports will again be published weekly on the RIVM website as usual.
De aanpassingen in de datastroom zijn inmiddels verwerkt. De gedetailleerde rapportages worden zoals gebruikelijk weer wekelijks gepubliceerd op de website van het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga  over personeelstekorten overheid

An MP asked the government about staff shortages at implementing agencies such as the Tax Administration, UWV and IND, including longer waiting times, causes such as budget cuts and added tasks, recruitment plans, and technology use. The ministers acknowledged service pressure, listed measures (contact tool, callbacks, higher starting salaries, the Werk aan Uitvoering programme with 600 million per year, a recruitment campaign) and said technology cannot fully replace human work.
The cabinet has endorsed the conclusions of the TCU report and the WaU report.
Het kabinet heeft de conclusies uit het TCU-rapport en het WaU rapport onderschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het SBS6-programma Undercover in Nederland, waar afvalcoaches zonder enige gewetenswroeging misbruik maken van (minderjarige) anorexiapatiënten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government will investigate and protect minors with anorexia from exploitative 'pro-ana' coaches shown in an SBS6 broadcast, including possible sexual abuse and dangerous advice. The Minister says the issue is a priority, points to police investigation capacity, funding, prevention and help programmes, and existing criminal law, but commits to no new specific measures beyond ongoing and planned steps.
Ultimately it is up to the public prosecutor to decide in a specific case whether to prosecute, and then up to the judge to assess a pending case and determine any sentence.

Het is uiteindelijk aan de officier van justitie om in een specifieke zaak te bepalen of vervolging wordt ingesteld en vervolgens aan de rechter om een voorliggende zaak te beoordelen en de eventuele strafmaat te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga  over 45.000 Brabantse huishoudens die buiten het prijsplafond vallen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about reports that 45,000 Brabant households, including those with block heating, students and shared housing, may fall outside the energy price cap and face evictions. The minister acknowledged the concern and said he is working with RVO.nl, the Tax Administration and suppliers on a solution, while warning that a guarantee for everyone by 1 January cannot be given.
Yes, I share this concern and that is why I indicated in my letter to your House of 4 October 2022 that I am making every effort to come up with an appropriate solution for exceptional cases
Ja, ik deel deze zorg en daarom heb ik in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 4 oktober 2022 aangegeven dat ik mij tot het uiterste inspan om met een passende oplossing te komen voor uitzonderingsgevallen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het prijsplafond voor energie en verwarming met propaan

Van Haga asked whether households and businesses heating with propane, who fall outside the energy price cap, will get a separate scheme, and whether they can join the TEK business support scheme. Minister Jetten said no separate scheme is planned due to limited time and data, that propane is excluded from TEK because of practical differences, and that some businesses may claim electricity support.
Because a relatively small share of households uses propane gas and the cabinet has little insight into its consumption and costs, realising a supplementary scheme for propane users is not feasible.

Doordat een relatief klein deel van de huishoudens gebruik maakt van propaangas en het kabinet weinig zicht heeft op het verbruik en de kosten hiervan, is het realiseren van een aanvullende regeling voor gebruikers van propaan niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘het totaal onvoorbereid zijn op een nucleaire oorlog’

An MP asked the government about Dutch unpreparedness for a nuclear war, Russian nuclear rhetoric, air defence, public shelters, iodine tablets, reinstating Bescherming Bevolking and de-escalation. The government answered that it takes Russian nuclear rhetoric seriously, relies on NATO deterrence, sees no basis to revive shelters or Bescherming Bevolking, and that iodine tablets are available for specific cases.
The cabinet has taken note of this advice. It is currently not opportune to fall back on a facility that was abolished 37 years ago.
Het kabinet heeft kennis genomen van dit advies. Het is op dit moment niet opportuun om terug te vallen op een voorziening die 37 jaar geleden is afgeschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over goedkeuring coronavaccins voor kinderen vanaf 6 maanden door de EMA

An MP asked the Minister of Health about EMA approval of COVID-19 vaccines for children from six months, including medical need, cost, side effects, monitoring and whether vaccination would enter the national programme. The Minister said no decision has been taken, that the Health Council is advising on high-risk young children and a structural programme, and declined to pre-empt that advice.
After I receive the advice of the Health Council, I will make a decision on the use of these vaccines and inform the House of Representatives about it.
Nadat ik het advies van de Gezondheidsraad heb ontvangen zal ik een besluit nemen over de inzet van deze vaccins en uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de term piekbelaster en de lijst van piekbelasters

An MP asked the minister whether a list of farms to be bought out (piekbelasters) exists, after Johan Remkes suggested one did. The minister answered that no concrete list of farms exists, that the analysis used anonymised data, and that a short-term approach and further information to the Chamber will follow in November.
There is no concrete list of farms that must stop.
Er is geen concrete lijst van boerenbedrijven die moeten stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht 'VWS blijft dwangsommen betalen voor het niet openbaren Sywert-communicatie'

An MP asked the health minister why the ministry has not yet released internal communication on the Sywert deal despite a court order, why it keeps paying penalty payments, and what grounds it relies on for withholding. The minister answered that chat messages need review for cabinet confidentiality, the selection is incomplete, and the Woo process is capacity-intensive, while committing to transparency and declining to specify the refusal grounds before the Woo decision is taken.
The Ministry of VWS does everything to provide requesters with information as quickly and purposefully as possible, while observing the due-care requirements the Woo sets.
Het Ministerie van VWS doet er alles aan om verzoekers zo snel en zo doelgericht mogelijk van informatie te voorzien met in achtneming van de zorgvuldigheidseisen die de Woo stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het TrendMeetnet Verzuring van het RIVM

MP Van Haga asked the minister about the RIVM TrendMeetnet Verzuring, which showed a 55% drop in nitrogen in upper groundwater between 1988 and 2010, and why the government claims nitrogen accumulates in soil and why the monitoring was discontinued. The minister confirmed the findings, cited WUR soil measurements as the basis for accumulation claims without having sent them to parliament, explained the monitoring ended with the acidification research programme in 2014 and was replaced by a new NGN project, and said nitrate levels have risen recently, likely due to drought.
The results were not actively sent to the House of Representatives, but were published in scientific journals.
De resultaten zijn niet actief naar de Tweede Kamer gezonden, maar wel gepubliceerd in wetenschappelijke tijdschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitspraak van de Pfizer-directeur in het Europees Parlement over effectiviteit coronavaccin tegen verspreiding van het coronavirus

MP Van Haga asks the minister whether the government knew that Pfizer's COVID-19 vaccine was never tested for effectiveness against transmission, whether it misled the public, and whether vaccination-based measures such as the CTB should be dropped. The minister replies that the government was transparent, that transmission was studied as evidence emerged, that vaccination is voluntary, and that the CTB is kept as a possible tool though no legal basis currently exists.
As I explained in the answers to questions 2 through 4, the cabinet has consistently been transparent about the available information on the effectiveness of the BioNTech/Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine.

Zoals ik in de antwoorden op vraag 2 tot en met 4 heb toegelicht, is het kabinet steeds transparant geweest over de beschikbare informatie rondom de effectiviteit van het COVID-19-vaccin van BioNTech/Pfizer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over dwangsommen voor Overijsselse boeren

An MP asks the minister about enforcement penalties (dwangsommen) threatened against Overijssel farms that operated legally under the PAS until the Council of State struck it down in 2019, and whether the minister will act to prevent them. The minister confirms the province must enforce after a court ruling, says the cabinet continues the legalisation programme with extra funding, but gives no specific step toward the province.
I am not aware of the content of the imposed burdens.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de inhoud van de opgelegde lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over hoog-risico biolaboratoria en gain-of-function onderzoek

An MP asked the Minister about high-risk biolaboratories and gain-of-function research, covering permitting, oversight, incident reporting and emergency preparedness. The government defended current rules as sufficient for biosafety and biosecurity, admitted it keeps no central overview of labs or gain-of-function viruses, and declined to issue a reaction to a 2020 IFV report while pledging an internal inventory of possible additional measures.
There is no central overview of the number of high-risk laboratories in the Netherlands, but gain-of-function research is not carried out in every high-risk laboratory.
Er is geen centraal overzicht van het aantal hoog-risico laboratoria in Nederland, maar niet in elk hoog-risico laboratorium wordt gain-of-function onderzoek uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de oversterfterapportage en immuungecompromitteerde personen

An MP asks the Minister of Health why immunocompromised people were excluded from the CBS/RIVM excess mortality study on deaths shortly after COVID-19 vaccination, and why COVID-19 deaths were left out of that chapter, and requests further research. The Minister answers that the booster analysis excluded immunocompromised patients whose third dose was part of the basic series, that no increased mortality risk was found for them after the first and second dose, that no additional research is planned, and that vaccine safety is monitored via Lareb, EMA and CBG.
Suspected side effects, including death, are reported to the Lareb side-effects centre, as previously indicated.
Vermoedens van bijwerkingen, waaronder overlijden, worden zoals eerder aangegeven gemeld via Bijwerkingencentrum Lareb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Het mogelijk uitbuiten van kwetsbare jongeren voor (waarschijnlijk) hogere kijkcijfers

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that vulnerable young participants in the TV programme Dream School are exploited for higher ratings, including staged arguments, lack of promised aftercare, and penalty clauses of 5,000 euro for speaking to the press. The state secretary replied that broadcasters set their own content, that the NTR and producer deny staging conflicts, that aftercare has been professionalised and penalty clauses dropped since 2019, and that no further steps are warranted.
In response to the NTR's reaction, I see no reason to take further steps.
Naar aanleiding van de reactie van de NTR, zie ik geen aanleiding om nadere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het luxe Walhalla op de zogeheten asielboot

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a TikTok video showing luxury conditions aboard a ferry used for asylum reception, arguing it attracts asylum seekers and is unaffordable for taxpayers. The State Secretary acknowledged the video, explained that the ferries offer only basic provisions due to a shortage of regular reception places, and said the ministry cannot exclude some pull effect but does not recognise the luxury depicted.
Provisions necessary to meet basic needs are of course available, including shelter and meals.
Voorzieningen die nodig zijn om te voorzien in basisbehoeften zijn uiteraard beschikbaar, waaronder onderdak en maaltijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Britse regering kondigt hardere koers tegen illegale immigranten aan’

MP Van Haga asked whether the Netherlands would follow the UK in barring illegal entrants from claiming asylum, capping arrivals, and pursuing migration partnerships and tighter border controls. The Secretary of State answered that such bans and caps conflict with EU and international law, pointed to ongoing EU migration measures and partnership work, and referred to letters already sent to parliament.
Setting a maximum on the number of asylum seekers who may lodge an asylum application in the Netherlands would conflict with international treaties and EU law to which the Netherlands is bound.
Het zetten van een maximum op het aantal asielzoekers dat in Nederland een asielverzoek mag indienen, zou in strijd zijn met internationale verdragen en EU-recht waaraan Nederland gebonden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de veiligheid van het knooppunt Empel

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about prior accidents at the Empel junction, what measures were taken since 2009, and whether the junction's safety would be investigated after a fatal crash. The minister acknowledged prior accidents, described signage and a 2021 guardrail addition, explained that the junction was not in the Meer Veilig priority programme and that guardrail extension would occur only at the next major reconstruction, and said RWS analyses fatal crashes and will inform Parliament if the police investigation reveals new road-design information.
Should new information emerge from the ongoing police investigation and/or the RWS accident analysis regarding the role of the road design in the accident, follow-up will of course be given.

Mocht uit het lopende politieonderzoek en/of de ongevalsanalyse van RWS nieuwe informatie komen met betrekking tot de rol van de weginrichting bij het ongeval, zal hier uiteraard opvolging aan gegeven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over openbaargemaakte Wob-verzoeken aangaande corona-communicatie

An MP asks the Minister of Health why leaked FOI requests show corona communication used emotional and image-based techniques, possibly misleading information and questionable mask-policy justification, and what the government will do going forward. The Minister answers that factual information is the foundation of communication, that the communication approach evolved with evaluations and remains defended, and that the government never deliberately gave misleading information.
There has never been any deliberately misleading and incorrect information from the government.
Van bewust misleidende en onjuiste informatie is vanuit de overheid nooit sprake geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitspraken inzake het indammen van de bevolkingsgroei

MP Van Haga asked the housing minister, De Jonge, how his statements about curbing population growth fit with cabinet policy and the record immigration of recent years. The minister replied that he wants more grip on demographic developments in line with the coalition agreement, pointed to a state commission due to report in late 2023, and gave no concrete measures to curb population growth.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het verbod op vleesreclames in Haarlem

An MP asked the Minister whether a Haarlem ban on meat advertising in public space is censorship and an unacceptable restriction on entrepreneurship, and whether it threatens pig farmers and shifts production abroad. The Minister replied that the ban follows a council motion, that it does not stigmatise meat eaters or restrict purchasing, that whether it is unacceptable is a matter for the courts, and that the sector would not disappear.
Whether the ban on meat advertising in Haarlem is an unacceptable infringement is not for me to answer, but possibly for the court to judge.
Vraag of het verbod op vleesreclames in Haarlem een onaanvaardbare aantasting is, is niet aan mij om te beantwoorden, maar eventueel aan de rechter om een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht 'Nederland betaalde opgeschorte steun aan Oeganda toch uit, ondanks gewelddadige verkiezingen vorig jaar'

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development why the Netherlands paid out a suspended aid tranche to Uganda's justice sector (JLOS) despite violent elections, and why Parliament was not informed. The Minister answers that only the first payment was made for already-completed activities, the final €850,000 was withheld in September 2022 to press for accountability over election-related police violence, and that Parliament was informed later via the evaluation and the answers, while rejecting calls to end aid immediately.
Parliament was not informed at the time of the first payment because the expectation was that the decision on the final payment would follow within a few months.
De Kamer is destijds niet geïnformeerd over de eerste betaling omdat de verwachting was dat het besluit over de slotbetaling binnen enkele maanden zou volgen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de goedkope framing dat Groep Van Haga nepnieuws zou verspreiden en over de poging om Kamerleden politieke instrumenten uit handen te willen nemen

MP Van Haga asked the Health Minister about a press report calling his claims fake news, the number of his written questions, and threats against him. The minister said the 'fake news' label was not used in her answers, defended the need to answer questions within the constitutional duty to inform while noting the burden of high question volumes, declined to change speaking-time rules, and condemned threats against MPs.
Of course, MPs themselves decide the frequency and content of the parliamentary questions they ask.
Uiteraard gaan Kamerleden zelf over de frequentie en de inhoud van de Kamervragen die zij stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het afschaffen van de vrije artsenkeuze

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the Integraal Zorgakkoord, by restricting free choice of doctor, is mainly a cost-cutting measure that favours insurers and endangers patients needing specialist care. The Minister answers that the agreement does not remove free choice of doctor, guarantees full choice for GP care and complex tertiary care in university medical centres, and that insurers' task is to purchase care efficiently.
As you can read in the IZA, there is no question of abolishing free choice of doctor.
Zoals u in het IZA kunt lezen is er geen sprake van het wegnemen van de vrije artsenkeuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over WOB-documenten met betrekking tot uitgaven in het kader van de coronapandemie

An MP asked the Health Minister how hundreds of millions in COVID-19 spending were accounted for, who was responsible, what outcomes were achieved, and whether the spending was justified given economic damage. The minister answered that spending was reported to parliament through regular budget channels and ODA reporting, that international pandemic investment was necessary, and that the spending was justified.
On spending on combating the COVID-19 pandemic and its objectives, the House has been regularly informed in line with the regular budget system.
Over de uitgaven aan de bestrijding van de COVID-19-pandemie en de doelstellingen hiervan is de Kamer, conform de reguliere begrotingssystematiek, regelmatig geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de onduidelijkheid over de veiligheid van coronavaccins voor zwangere vrouwen

Van Haga asks the Minister of Health whether the Pfizer/BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine has been adequately shown safe for pregnant and breastfeeding women, whether the government misled this group, and what monitoring and research will follow. Minister Kuipers answers that the cited UK document was not substantively updated, that observational data show no added risk, that vaccination was deferred until safety was sufficiently shown, and that no new studies or compensation are planned.
I see no reason to make adjustments in this or to carry out additional research.
Ik zie geen reden om hierin aanpassingen te maken of aanvullend onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het veiligstellen van Ct-waarden door de Minister

An MP asks the Minister of Health how the government will preserve Ct-values from COVID-19 tests as ordered by the Council of State during a pending Woo disclosure case, and whether new lab contracts with one-year retention will be adjusted. The Minister confirms the interim order was passed to the private labs, declines to request Ct-values directly, and says no decision on tender changes can be made until the main case is decided.

To ensure the requested information (the Ct-values) is not destroyed during the procedure, the interim relief judge of the Council of State's Administrative Jurisdiction Division instructed me to ensure the requested Ct-values remain available until a ruling is made on the main case.

Om er zeker van te zijn dat de gevraagde informatie (de Ct-waarden) gedurende de procedure niet wordt vernietigd, heeft de voorzieningenrechter van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State (Afdeling) mij opgedragen ervoor te zorgen dat de verzochte Ct-waarden beschikbaar blijven totdat er uitspraak is gedaan in de hoofdzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over nieuwe onderzoeksresultaten m.b.t. schade door mRNA coronavaccins Pfizer en Moderna

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether new study findings showing more serious adverse events from Pfizer and Moderna mRNA COVID vaccines warranted new risk analyses, a halt to vaccination, compensation, or informing citizens. The minister replied that the study's methodology does not establish causation, that vaccine safety is closely monitored, that benefits still outweigh the small risks, and that no new steps or vaccination mandate are planned.
I do not consider it necessary to take additional steps following the results of this study and other findings on heart damage in young men.
Ik vind het niet nodig extra stappen te zetten naar aanleiding van de resultaten van dit onderzoek en andere bevindingen rondom hartschade bij jonge mannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de goedkeuring en het gebruik van aangepaste coronavaccins

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether adapted (bivalent) COVID-19 vaccines were properly approved and tested in humans, questioning their necessity, safety monitoring, repeated vaccination and possible links to excess mortality. The Minister answers at length, defending EMA approval, citing human trials of the BA.1 vaccines, the monitoring by Lareb and the Gezondheidsraad advice, and says no new study is needed.
I rely on the careful assessment by the EMA and the OMT-V and see no reason at this time to wait before offering the renewed vaccines.
Ik vertrouw op de zorgvuldige beoordeling door het EMA en het OMT-V en zie geen reden op dit moment te wachten met het aanbieden van de vernieuwde vaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over stikstofreductie, stikstofminnende planten en insecten

Van Haga asked whether the proposed nitrogen reduction in 2030 and 2035 could be ruled out as harming flora, fauna and insects, and asked for figures on nitrogen-loving plants, insect biomass and dependent birds. The minister answered that a negative effect can be ruled out, gave rough shares of nitrogen-sensitive plants and insectivorous birds, and said insect biomass is not measured structurally so no trend or figures can be given.
No comprehensive research is carried out in the Netherlands into changes in insect biomass.
Er wordt in Nederland geen dekkend onderzoek gedaan naar verandering in de biomassa van insecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Onaanvaardbare wijzigingen bij de Nationale Indiëherdenking en over het aandringen bij Indonesië voor het maken van excuses voor de Bersiap

Mr Van Haga asked the Prime Minister 15 questions about changes to the National Indies Commemoration of 15 August, including a larger role for the Indonesian ambassador and whether Indonesia should be urged to apologise for the Bersiap. The Secretary of State answered that the commemoration foundation is independent, the government did not request the changes or agree any deal with Indonesia, and the government will not press the foundation to reverse them or urge Indonesia to apologise.
The Nationale Herdenking 15 augustus 1945 foundation is an independent organisation that itself decides how the commemoration is shaped in substance.
De stichting Nationale Herdenking 15 augustus 1945 is een onafhankelijke organisatie die zelf bepaalt hoe de herdenking er inhoudelijk uitziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over advies WRR m.b.t. potentiële vaccinatieplicht voor het coronavirus

An MP asks the health minister about a WRR-led scenario report and whether a COVID-19 vaccination mandate is epidemiologically justified, how it would be implemented and enforced, and its effects on rights, society and the economy. The minister replies that the government has no plans for a mandate, that the report does not recommend one, and that vaccination remains a personal choice, while declining to speculate on hypothetical implementation, consequences or liability.
The cabinet has no intention or plans to introduce a vaccination mandate.
Het kabinet heeft geen voornemens of plannen om een vaccinatieplicht in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over geldstromen naar het RIVM tijdens de coronacrisis

An MP asked the Minister of Health how much of the government's COVID-19 spending reached the RIVM, how its funds were spent and whether they financed bonuses, donations or commercial parties, and asked about payments to Stichting Open Nederland. The minister referred almost every question to publicly available annual reports and open data, denied that RIVM funds went to bonuses, lobby groups or commercial parties, and said SON received no RIVM money.
This information is publicly accessible in the annual report of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS).
Deze informatie is openbaar toegankelijk in het jaarverslag van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en sport (VWS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de betaling Stichting Open Nederland aan Jaap van Dissel

An MP asked the Health Minister about reports that the Stichting Open Nederland paid EUR 750,000 to OMT head Jaap van Dissel, about a Belgian bank account, the ministry's payments to the foundation, and a possible Anguilla account with Minister Hoekstra. The minister could not confirm the payment, said no ministry payments went to that account, called the reports unfounded and retracted, and promised no investigation.
Accountability is and will be rendered through the normal procedures.
Verantwoording is en wordt afgelegd via de normale procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het direct of indirect volgen van politiek geëngageerde burgers op de social media en het mogelijk plegen van censuur

MP Van Haga asked ministers whether government monitors politically engaged citizens on social media, coordinates counter-disinformation with platforms, and whether a police home visit and a later account removal involved state interference. The government answered that platform contacts concern how platforms tackle disinformation with no formal minutes, that no structural policy targets citizens' posts, and that it cannot discuss individual cases such as the Enschede visit.
As indicated in the answer to question 13, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 13 kan er niet worden ingegaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over paspoortwalhalla voor topcriminelen

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Dutch municipal officials, including one in The Hague, helped criminals obtain false identities by issuing passports, and about why the official stayed employed for years after an integrity investigation. The state secretary answered that RvIG has engaged The Hague and that the municipality handled personnel sanctions itself, and pointed to a July letter listing measures against identity fraud and a forthcoming RvIG inquiry into procedural deviations.
I want to state up front that the municipality of The Hague is responsible for its own personnel policy.
Ik wil voorop stellen dat de gemeente Den Haag over haar eigen persoonsbeleid gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over uitspraken Maarten van Rossem en opstarten van een boerderij door de Staatstelevisie

An MP asks the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science about Maarten van Rossem's remarks on a TV quiz (suggesting a farmer-hater be shot) and the public broadcaster's farm programme, and asks about Van Rossem's pay. The state secretary replies that content judgments are not hers to make, points to the Commissariaat voor de Media and the NPO Ombudsman, says the broadcaster confirms his pay is within the rules, and denies that the state runs a farm.
However, it is not for me to judge the content of individual programmes or the statements made in them.
Het is echter niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van afzonderlijke programma’s of uitlatingen die daarin worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht dat de aanpak van de fileknelpunten op de A4 op de lange baan is geschoven

An MP asks whether the A4 Leidschendam-Leimuiden widening, and other A4 bottlenecks, are being postponed because too few experts are available for nitrogen calculations, and whether compensation is due to the flower sector. The minister confirms the project is delayed, explains prioritisation between projects and mobility measures, and says compensation is not appropriate because capacity is not reduced.
The project will be delayed more than the priority projects.
Het project zal meer vertraging oplopen dan bij de prioritaire projecten het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de mogelijke komst van de Noordtak Betuweroute en de druk op de (groene) ruimte in bredere zin in Twente en de Achterhoek

An MP asks the government about public opposition to a proposed Noordtak rail line through Twente and the Achterhoek, its legal status, the pressure on rural space, and whether cheaper alternatives such as inland shipping should replace it. The Staatssecretaris answers that a joint options paper found the need for a new freight route not yet established, that the line is far from certain, and that further study with stakeholders will follow before conclusions are drawn.
I will discuss with stakeholders what exactly still needs to be investigated and how we will do this.
Ik zal met belanghebbenden bespreken wat er precies nog verder moet worden onderzocht en hoe we dit gaan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aanhoudende oversterfte

An MP asks the Minister of Health about persistent excess mortality since 2022, whether vaccination or other causes explain it, and whether the vaccination programme should be paused or policy reconsidered. The Minister answers that CBS data show excess mortality from week 13 onward, that causes are not yet fully established but cause-of-death data and an ongoing ZonMw research track are being used, that studies find no raised mortality risk after vaccination, and that there is no reason to halt vaccination.
Of course I attach importance to further research into possible causes of the excess mortality and I encourage this through the implementation of track 3 of the excess mortality research via ZonMw.
Uiteraard hecht ik belang aan verder onderzoek naar mogelijke oorzaken van de oversterfte en stimuleer dit door middel van de uitvoering van traject 3 van het oversterfte onderzoek via ZonMw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Recente onderzoeksresultaten over de werking van ivermectine bij corona-infecties

An MP asked the health minister whether a 2022 study showing ivermectin cut COVID-19 deaths would prompt renewed use, new research, GP prescribing permission, and excuses or compensation for doctors penalised for prescribing it. The minister declined to assess the study, deferred to medical bodies and EMA guidance, refused new research and excuses, and noted IGJ enforcement under off-label rules.
It is not for me or the Ministry of VWS to interpret studies on the use of ivermectin for COVID-19; this is a matter for the medical-scientific professional associations.
Het niet aan mij of het Ministerie van VWS om studies naar de inzet van ivermectine bij COVID-19 te duiden, dit is aan medisch wetenschappelijke beroepsverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over dreigende stalbezettingen door extremisten

The MP asked whether the government will protect farms against extremist stable occupations, whether it will consider harsher penalties like Australia's, and whether it would follow that model. The minister answered that police contact points, a factsheet and a police operational framework exist, that current criminal provisions for trespass are adequate, and that the penalty maxima already exceed the Australian ones.
I consider the current legal possibilities to prosecute illegal stable occupations and punish them appropriately to be adequate.
De huidige juridische mogelijkheden om illegale stalbezettingen te vervolgen en passend te bestraffen acht ik toereikend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de vergoedingen die netbeheerders betalen voor duurzaam opgewekte stroom

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about grid operators' payments for renewable electricity they could not feed into the national grid, including redispatch costs, their pass-through to consumers, and whether grid reinforcement and new wind farm connections should be halted. The Minister replied that TenneT's 2021 redispatch costs in the Netherlands were EUR 336 million (EUR 188 million to June 2022), that costs are regulated by the ACM and largely passed to grid operators' customers, that grid capacity cannot yet meet demand so a specific stop on wind projects is not desirable, and that non-firm connection contracts are being proposed to the ACM.
Given current conditions on the energy market, it is not possible for TenneT to give an outlook on how redispatch costs will develop in the coming period.
Gezien de huidige omstandigheden op de energiemarkt is het voor TenneT niet mogelijk om een vooruitblik te geven over hoe de redispatchkosten zich de komende tijd gaan ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het SBS-programma Undercover in Nederland

Van Haga asked the Justice Minister about a convicted sex offender who allegedly abused new victims while awaiting appeal, about controls on masseurs who massage children, and about a petition calling for better monitoring of sex offenders. The Minister declined to comment on the ongoing case, said existing criminal law and supervision tools are sufficient, explained the limited IGJ oversight of masseurs, and rejected new measures for now.
However, I cannot interfere in ongoing criminal cases.
Ik kan mij echter niet in lopende strafzaken mengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de hoge gasprijs in Nederland in vergelijking tot de rest van de Europese Unie

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy why Dutch gas prices are higher than the EU average, whether Groningen gas explains this, and whether taxes and windfall revenue could be used to lower household costs. The Minister answered that the comparison is based on a limited sample of new-customer offers and is not representative of prices paid, that gas prices are set internationally, and that the government already cut energy taxes and will announce 2023 measures on Prinsjesdag.
The questions have been answered as quickly as possible.
De vragen zijn zo snel als mogelijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over hartschade bij jonge jongens na coronavaccinatie

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a study reporting cardiac harm in vaccinated adolescent boys, whether Dutch research and compensation would follow, and whether vaccination of young people should stop. The minister replied that myocarditis risk is very small, lower than after infection, that Lareb and EMA monitor side effects, and that the vaccination strategy and the COVID certificate for unvaccinated youth were maintained.
At this moment I see no reason to doubt this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om hieraan te twijfelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Minister wil verkeersboetes ook nu laten meestijgen met inflatie’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why traffic fines should be indexed to inflation amid the economic crisis, whether there is any obligation to index them, and whether fines improve road safety. The Minister defended annual indexation to preserve the deterrent weight of fines, admitted no legal obligation exists, and pointed to enforcement measures and a review of the indexation method.
I have, however, instructed my department to review the long-standing system of indexing Wahv fines based on inflation.
Wel heb ik mijn departement opdracht gegeven om de reeds lang bestaande systematiek voor de indexering van Wahv-boetes gebaseerd op de inflatie tegen het licht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over vandalisme bij het Leidse Indië-monument en oproep tot beeldenstorm

Van Haga asks the Justice Minister whether vandalism and calls for an iconoclastic 'beeldenstorm' at Leiden's Indies monument are punishable, whether such groups like Doorbraak could be banned, and how monuments and street names will be protected and offenders tackled. The Minister says existing law (art. 350 and 131 Sr, art. 2:20 BW) suffices, that prosecution depends on circumstances and the Public Prosecution Service, that protecting monuments is a local authority responsibility, and refers back to the answer on question 2 for the rest.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to start any investigation into a possible ban on the type of organisations referred to in the question.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om een eventueel onderzoek te starten naar een mogelijk verbod op het in de vraag aangehaalde type organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de problemen bij jeugdzorgaanbieder Partners voor Jeugd

An MP asks the state secretary how Partners voor Jeugd fell so far behind that complex-care children cannot be helped on time, why it was not caught earlier, and what is being done about regional waiting lists and decentralised youth care. The government acknowledges serious problems, points to primary municipal responsibility with inspectorates and the Jeugdautoriteit providing oversight, and promises reform measures and a letter on short-term relief.
In our decentralised youth care system, municipalities are primarily responsible for providing a qualitatively and quantitatively adequate supply of child protection, youth probation and youth care.

In ons decentrale jeugdzorgstelsel zijn de gemeenten primair verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van een kwalitatief en kwantitatief toereikend aanbod voor jeugdbescherming, jeugdreclassering en jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Britse berichtgeving over sterfte door lockdowns

An MP asked the Minister of Health about British reports that lockdowns caused excess deaths, and whether similar harm occurred in the Netherlands, including deferred care, missed diagnoses, compensation and accountability. The Minister answered that no direct link between lockdowns and deaths can yet be shown, pointed to a ZonMw-funded research track on excess mortality, and defended the lockdown measures as democratically legitimised and aimed at relieving pressure on care.
In the Netherlands we cannot (yet) establish a direct link between the lockdowns and people's deaths.
In Nederland kunnen we (nog) geen direct verband leggen tussen de lockdowns en het overlijden van mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ziekenhuisopnames van gevaccineerde personen

An MP from Groep van Haga asked the Minister of Health why many fully vaccinated people are being hospitalised with COVID-19 and whether vaccines are effective, and questioned the new autumn vaccination campaign. The Minister answered that rising infection pressure explains the trend, that booster vaccination still substantially reduces hospitalisation risk, and that no additional study is needed beyond RIVM's monthly reports.
The RIVM publishes a monthly report on COVID-19 hospital and ICU admissions by vaccination status in the Netherlands.
Het RIVM publiceert maandelijks een rapport over de ziekenhuis- en IC-opnames door COVID-19 per vaccinatiestatus in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over opzeggen Vluchtelingenverdrag

Opposition MP Van Haga asked whether the asylum crisis is uncontrollable, whether the 1951 Refugee Convention pulls in asylum seekers, and whether withdrawing from it would make regional reception possible. The government answered that the asylum situation is under strain but not uncontrollable, that the Convention has no proven pull effect, and that withdrawal would not change Dutch obligations under the ECHR and EU law.
The cabinet does want to gain more grip on migration and to be able to anticipate in time.
Het kabinet wil wel meer grip krijgen op migratie en tijdig kunnen anticiperen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de chanterende commissaris van de Koning in Flevoland

Van Haga asked the Minister of Interior whether the Flevoland Commissioner of the King coerced councillors into accepting an asylum reception centre, including via a suggested link to the Lelylijn, and whether an investigation or dismissal would follow. The Minister answered that the commissioner acted as a state organ in facilitating cooperation, that the concerns reflect subjective experiences, and that no investigation or dismissal is warranted.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over 25.000 woningen op boerengrond

An MP asks the minister whether the government and provinces are working together to remove farmers from their land to facilitate immigration-driven housing growth, citing a reported plan for 25,000 homes near Stroe. The minister denies any plan for 25,000 homes in Stroe, says the province is only exploring scenarios, reaffirms the national housing target, and rejects attributing the housing shortage to migration alone.
There are no plans for the construction of 25,000 homes in Stroe.
Er zijn geen plannen voor de bouw van 25.000 woningen in Stroe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de klokkenluider Huig Plug

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about whistleblower Huig Plug, staff departures at the JCvSZ prison hospital, and whether the Inspectorate of Justice and Security (Inspectie J&V) suppressed whistleblower reports and handled a complaint against itself improperly. The minister answers that staff departure reasons are withheld for privacy, inspection interview records and the identity of reporters are confidential, the complaint was handled under the General Administrative Law Act, the Inspectorate's move is delayed, the Integrity Commission could not act on the anonymous reports, and no new investigation is warranted because prior inspections found no misconduct.
No, the Inspectorate does not in principle report that to me, because it concerns supervision-confidential information.
Nee, dat meldt de Inspectie en Veiligheid mij in beginsel niet, omdat dat toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het memo 'Toelichting bij richtinggevende emissiereductiedoelstellingen per gebied'

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about a RIVM memo on emission reduction targets per area, including which non-public data sources were used, how they were made GDPR-compliant, and whether calculations could be traced to individual farms or the Kringloopwijzer database. The minister answered each question, explaining the data came from RVO and CBS sources, was aggregated to 64-hectare grid cells, and that the Kringloopwijzer database was not consulted.
The RIVM indicates that it did not do so.
Het RIVM geeft aan dat niet te hebben gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de gesprekken met boeren

An MP asks the Prime Minister about his talks with farmers, the Zuid-Holland provincial livestock relocation scheme, and whether he will withdraw or postpone the nitrogen plans and share the conversation records. The Prime Minister answers that the scheme is a voluntary instrument, that talks aim to listen, that no minutes were kept and one official's notes will not be shared, and that the nitrogen policy will continue jointly with the provinces.
No minutes were made of the conversations; personal notes of one conversation were made by an official.
Er zijn geen verslagen gemaakt van de gesprekken, er zijn van één gesprek persoonlijke aantekeningen gemaakt door een ambtenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de tweet basisserie vaccinatie

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the Health Minister why the ministry tweeted that the COVID-19 vaccine basic series should be completed, citing manufacturer statements, natural immunity and a Radboud study suggesting vaccination could impair immune response. The minister answers every question on substance, defending the advice to vaccinate and rejecting the claim that the cited study shows harm.
No, I do not find this undesirable.
Nee, dit vind ik niet onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over personeelsbeleid GGD m.b.t. coronapandemie en voortzetting vaccinatiecampagne

MP Van Haga asked whether GGD staff are kept on standby for a new COVID outbreak, how this is justified and paid for, and whether proactive testing would artificially create a wave. Minister Kuipers answered that GGDs keep a limited basic capacity for testing and vaccination that can be scaled up, that on-call staff are paid only when called (or partially under availability duty per CAO), and that the contract terms are public.
No, if an on-call worker is not called up by the GGD, they are not paid.
Nee, als een oproepkracht niet wordt opgeroepen door de GGD wordt deze niet betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over drinkwater

An MP asks whether the government accepts that drinking water bills will rise sharply due to inflation and investment needs, and whether it will prevent this price rise for a primary necessity. The minister confirms tariffs will rise because they must be cost-covering under the Drinkwaterwet, says the government is aware of inflation effects, and notes that full independence from foreign water sources is not possible.
Drinking water tariffs must be cost-covering (Article 11 of the Drinking Water Act).
De tarieven van drinkwater dienen kostendekkend te zijn (artikel 11 van de Drinkwaterwet).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over luxetaks op drinkwater

Van Haga asked whether the reported luxury tax on drinking water is known and whether the government will reject it, since drinking water is a basic need. Minister Harbers confirmed awareness, said drinking water is a basic necessity whose affordability matters, and said no decision has been taken; a survey of water-saving measures, including a higher tariff for above-average use, will be sent to parliament this autumn.
No decision has yet been taken on the possible measures and instruments in the forthcoming survey.
Over de mogelijke maatregelen en instrumenten in de nog te verschijnen verkenning heeft nog geen besluitvorming heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het plan om af te willen van overstappassagiers op Schiphol

An MP asked the minister whether his reported plan to phase out cheap transfer passengers at Schiphol was government policy, and how it fits the coalition agreement's hub ambition, with nine questions in total. The minister denied it is official policy, said he only noted higher costs and a shift toward quality, and reaffirmed commitment to Schiphol's hub function, while promising to clarify the position with KLM.
No, the position expressed in the Bloomberg interview is neither my own position nor an official cabinet position.
Nee, het standpunt dat wordt verwoord in het Bloomberg-interview is noch mijn eigen standpunt, noch een officieel kabinetsstandpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de wettelijke verankering van coronamaatregelen in de Wpg

MP Van Haga asks the Minister of Health about the proposed permanent legal basis for COVID-type collective measures in the Wpg, criticising the timing, necessity, effectiveness, costs and rights impact. Minister Kuipers responds that the bill concerns Group A1 infectious diseases generally, not COVID specifically, that advice and consultation have been obtained, that the bill includes safeguards and parliamentary involvement, and that the bill is still being finalised and will be sent to parliament in September, so many questions cannot yet be answered substantively.
The bill in fact contains safeguards to limit as much as possible the exercise of fundamental rights when such measures are taken.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat juist waarborgen om de uitoefening van grondrechten bij het nemen van dergelijke maatregelen zo min mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de toename van het aantal plofkraken

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether she would act against the rise in explosive ATM robberies, including tougher sentences and alternative security measures such as relocating ATMs inside buildings. The minister replied that prosecution guidelines were tightened in 2018 with higher sentence demands, and that measures agreed with municipalities and banks in 2019-2020 have reduced incidents, with monitoring continuing.
The picture for 2022 is for now that the decline is continuing.
Het beeld van 2022 is vooralsnog dat de daling wordt voortgezet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de Denktank Desinformatie

An MP asks the Health Minister how the Denktank Desinformatie (counter-disinformation think tank on vaccines) was staffed, what its links to government, NCTV and platforms are, whether it reported accounts, and asks for all documents. The state secretary answers that participants joined voluntarily, are unpaid, have no assessment process, that VWS does not run the Facebook group, that only meeting minutes are attached now with other documents promised within three months, and that no reporting of accounts is planned for investigation.
I will share other relevant documents with the House within a period of three months.
Overige, relevante documenten zal ik binnen een termijn van drie maanden delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over bijwerkingen coronavaccinaties

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the number of reported side effects of COVID-19 vaccinations, the likelihood of underreporting, causes, oversterfte, and whether vaccination should be halted or expanded. The Minister answers that most reported effects are known, mild and short-lived, that Lareb, CBG and EMA monitor reports, and that the vaccines remain justified, while refusing to halt vaccination.
There is broad scientific consensus that the benefits of COVID-19 vaccination outweigh the small chance of (serious) side effects.
Er is brede wetenschappelijke consensus over het gegeven dat de voordelen van vaccinatie tegen COVID-19 opwegen tegen de geringe kans op (ernstige) bijwerkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga inzake het plegen van meerdere ambtsmisdrijven tijdens coronacrisis

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether Dutch officials and ministers committed criminal misconduct (ambtsmisdrijven) during the COVID crisis by weakening evidence bases, using measures that allegedly breached the Constitution and ECHR, and signing the Twm law, and asked about the lack of constitutional review. The Minister of Health, on behalf of the Prime Minister, rejected all claims, arguing the measures were grounded in RIVM modelling, were enacted through the democratic legislative process with parliamentary and Council of State involvement, and that no misconduct occurred.
The judgement that signing and cooperating on the Twm amounted to criminal misconduct has no basis whatsoever.
Het oordeel dat met ondertekening van en meewerken aan de Twm ambtsmisdrijven zouden zijn begaan, mist iedere grond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de effectiviteit van coronavaccins

MP Van Haga asked the health minister about the declining effectiveness of COVID-19 vaccines, repeated boosters, long-term side effects, and the government's communication and treatment of the unvaccinated. The minister answered that waning protection is partly due to infections and confounding, that vaccines remain effective against severe disease, that boosters remain advisable, and that repeated-vaccination costs are budgeted, while rejecting claims of misleading communication.
At this moment it cannot be predicted whether it will be necessary to call on the population annually or several times a year for vaccination.
Het is op dit moment niet te voorspellen of het nodig is de bevolking jaarlijks of meerdere keren per jaar op te roepen voor een vaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over puntief onderzoek door de IGJ ten aanzien van de voorganger van Baptistengemeente De Rank

MP Van Haga asks the Minister of Health why the inspectorate IGJ is pursuing a punitive investigation and proposed fine against a pastor for religious statements about COVID-19 treatments, arguing this restricts religious freedom and public debate. Minister Kuipers replies that IGJ acted on a report and independently applies its powers, that religious freedom can be limited for public health, and refuses to instruct IGJ to exempt serious religious or scientific contributions from advertising rules.
IGJ is an independent supervisor that makes its own considerations and I do not interfere in this consideration.
IGJ is onafhankelijk toezichthouder die haar eigen afwegingen maakt en ik meng mij niet in deze afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het Duitse evaluatierapport Corona en de datachaos bij het Robert Koch Instituut
