MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Health about a German evaluation report claiming 2.5 million people were treated for COVID-19 vaccine side effects and about incomplete data from the Robert Koch Institute, and whether similar problems exist in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the figure does not appear in the report, that it reflects mostly mild, unreportable side effects, that Dutch data and COVID-19 policy differ, and that he is working to make more source data available for independent research on excess mortality.
I refer you to the answer to question 2.
Ik verwijs u naar het antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Van Haga over De tweet van Dr. Chantal Bleker-Rovers en langdurige bescherming na infectie

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether a tweet by OMT adviser Chantal Bleker-Rovers claiming no winter immunity after a summer infection is consistent with a Qatar study showing long-lasting natural protection, and asks for her to substantiate or retract the claim. The Minister declines to adjudicate the scientific dispute, says all literature including natural-immunity studies is taken into account in advice, and points to public RIVM model documentation for how protection is modelled.
It is not my role to settle a discussion between scientists; science is perfectly capable of doing that itself.
Het is niet mijn rol om een discussie tussen wetenschappers te beslechten; de wetenschap is daar uitstekend zelf toe in staat.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over onzorgvuldige uithuisplaatsingen kinderen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the Inspectorate's finding that child out-of-home placement investigations are often careless, why less drastic measures are not tried first, why parents are denied information, and about youth care reform and profit-driven providers. The State Secretary acknowledged improvement is needed, promised a plan of action on parents' legal protection in autumn 2022, and gave a limited response on providers' profits and compensation.
As indicated in our letter on the IGJ investigation of 27 June 2022, the Minister for Legal Protection and I will jointly take this up and report back to your House in autumn 2022.
Zoals aangegeven in onze brief over het IGJ-onderzoek van 27 juni 2022, zullen de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming en ik dit gezamenlijk oppakken en in het najaar van 2022 aan uw Kamer terugkoppelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over uitstellen operaties in Drentse ziekenhuizen door tekort medische materialen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether he knew of Drenthe hospitals postponing operations due to a shortage of medical materials, whether he would tackle this decisively, and whether the Netherlands could become self-sufficient in producing medical materials. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited multiple causes and European action plans with manufacturers, and said full self-sufficiency is not feasible, though supply security will be strengthened through cooperation with other EU countries.
I am in discussion with the field about how we can support manufacturers and purchasing parties in this.
Ik ben hierover in gesprek met het veld om te kijken hoe we de fabrikanten en inkopende partijen hierin kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het oproepen tot gebruik vetorecht inzake EU-wanbeleid boeren

An MP asked the Minister-President about a report that Brussels is also examining Dutch manure policy, and whether the government would invoke a national veto against nitrogen demands and the manure policy. The Minister of Agriculture answered that Nitrate Directive obligations follow from EU law adopted through the normal procedures, that Dutch interests are served through the Council, and that member states have no veto in EU legislation.
Member states have no veto in this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het (tijdelijk) sluiten van de Spoedeisende Hulpafdeling in Zoetermeer

An MP asks the health minister whether the temporary closure of the emergency department at LangeLand Hospital in Zoetermeer is unacceptable, what will be done about the SEH doctor shortage, and how to respond to a citizens' initiative on expanding care capacity, including using the army. The minister denies the closure is unacceptable, says a statutory procedure with a continuity plan was followed, and says the shortage is being addressed through training capacity and workforce measures while military deployment is a last resort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Haga over medicatie tegen druk op de gezondheidszorg

An MP asks the Minister of Health why Paxlovid is not yet available in the Netherlands, why RIVM modelling omits the effect of antiviral treatment, and why the government does not negotiate directly with Pfizer. The Minister answers that Pfizer will not offer the drug through the regular route, that the Netherlands participates in an EU joint procurement, that the ZonMw preventive-treatment study was withdrawn, and that RIVM models already include treatment effects.
As long as Pfizer chooses to put other interests above patient interests, I will do everything to make the drug available through central procurement, but only on acceptable purchase terms.

Zolang Pfizer ervoor kiest om andere belangen boven het patiëntenbelang te stellen, zal ik er alles aan doen om het middel alsnog via centrale inkoop beschikbaar te maken, maar wel alleen tegen acceptabele inkoopvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving aangaande de 320.000 verloren levensjaren door uitgestelde zorg in Nederland

MP Van Haga asks the Minister of Health whether the estimated 320,000 lost healthy life-years from postponed care during COVID-19 justify the measures, whether losses are underestimated, whether excess mortality and compensation, staff retention and capacity expansion are being addressed. Minister Kuipers replies that the RIVM estimates concern quality-adjusted life-years rather than deaths, that measures aimed to keep regular care going, that evaluations are underway, and that action plans and letters to parliament are in progress.
That is why many measures were deployed so that, in the subsequent waves, regular care could continue as much as possible.
Daarom zijn vele maatregelen ingezet zodat, in de opvolgende golven, de reguliere zorg zoveel mogelijk doorgang kon vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het ontbreken van een volwaardig ziekenhuis Voorne-Putten

An MP asked the Minister of Health why Voorne-Putten lacks a full hospital with a 24-hour emergency department and maternity ward, and what steps will restore one. The Minister answered that ambulances go to the best-suited hospital, that closure decisions rest with providers and insurers, and that the NZa sees no signs of inadequate acute care.
It is up to healthcare providers and health insurers to make choices about the care offered.
Het is aan zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars om keuzes te maken over het zorgaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over belangenverstrengeling van Ab Osterhaus met Bavarian Clinic

An MP asked the Minister of Health about possible conflicts of interest of virologist Ab Osterhaus, a shareholder in Viroclinics, which did research for Bavarian Nordic, the monkeypox vaccine supplier, and about his media role and past advisory role. The minister said Osterhaus has no official advisory role on monkeypox, that media choose their own experts, that data confidentiality rules apply, and that the financial details are irrelevant, without committing to further action.
Mr Osterhaus has no role in advising on, combating, or providing public information on behalf of the government regarding the monkeypox virus.
De heer Osterhaus heeft geen rol bij de advisering over, bestrijding van of voorlichting namens de overheid over het apenpokkenvirus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bezoek aan Oekraïne

An MP asked the Prime Minister why he speaks of 'our war' in Ukraine and whether this amounts to declaring war on Russia, and questioned whether war rhetoric and arms deliveries help peace, whether arms makers profit, and what diplomatic steps are being taken toward negotiations. The Prime Minister denied Netherlands is at war with Russia, framed 'our war' as figurative, defended military and financial support to Ukraine, and said negotiations are for Ukraine to decide while a diplomatic channel to Russia is maintained.
The Netherlands is not at war with Russia.
Nederland is niet in oorlog met Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aanhoudende chaos bij asielzoekerscentrum Ter Apel en de bevindingen van het Rode Kruis

The MP asks the State Secretary how he will address the chaos at the Ter Apel asylum centre, the Red Cross's warnings about an inhumane situation, safety in the area, and whether immigration-restricting measures are needed. The State Secretary responds that a crisis structure with three phases is being activated, that further measures including emergency shelter expansion and use of spatial-planning instruments are planned, that he does not agree with closing the tap, and that a legal exploration of an asylum admission stop will follow after the summer recess.
During the committee debate of 30 June I promised your House a legal exploration of, among other things, a temporary asylum processing stop.
Tijdens het commissiedebat van 30 juni jl. heb ik uw Kamer een juridische verkenning toegezegd naar o.a. een tijdelijke asielbehandelstop
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over derde- en veiligelanders die bij bosjes Nederland in komen

Van Haga asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about third-country and safe-country nationals entering the Netherlands among asylum seekers, whether border controls should be strengthened, a second and third reception centre, IND staff vacancies, and the impact on social cohesion. The State Secretary answered that asylum claims are assessed individually, that internal border controls can only be reinstated on serious threats to public order, that a second reception centre is needed and more may follow, that IND vacancies reflect a tight labour market, and that migration policy depends on public support.
At the same time, I do not rule out that more reception centres will be established in the future.
Daarbij sluit ik niet uit dat er in de toekomst nog meer aanmeldcentra zullen komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over noodkreet burgemeester Hardenberg over overlastgevende asielzoekers

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a mayor's call over nuisance from asylum seekers, including whether those from Morocco and Algeria should be excluded and whether applications should be destroyed, and about the government's plan to help Hardenberg. The State Secretary rejects the exclusionary positions, points to the procedural rights of asylum seekers and existing measures, and outlines contact with the mayor, a funding scheme and a planned process location.
During the asylum procedure, asylum seekers have the right to reception, regardless of where they come from.
Tijdens de asielprocedure hebben asielzoekers recht op opvang, ongeacht waar ze vandaan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de communicatie van de voormalig Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport aangaande de mondkapjesdeal met Sywert van Lienden

An MP asks why the health ministry ignored a court ruling ordering release of communications about the face-mask deal with Sywert van Lienden, whether this violates the Open Government Act, and whether withholding information undermines public trust. The ministers defend a phased FOIA approach, say the ruling disregarded it, admit delays, and promise decisions on the remaining documents and chat messages within set timeframes.
In the ruling in question, this phased approach to handling Open Government Act requests related to the corona epidemic was disregarded.
In de uitspraak waar het hier om gaat, werd voorbijgegaan aan deze gefaseerde werkwijze voor de aanpak van Woo-verzoeken die verband houden met de corona-epidemie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het monitoren van zedendelinquenten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about recidivism among sex offenders, the follow-up to earlier research on supervision, and how supervision is shared between police, prosecutors and probation. The minister answered at length on the risk-assessment and sentencing process, the 2018 cooperation agreements, and the police's mainly reactive role in supervision.
Sex crimes have a great impact on victims and society.
Zedenmisdrijven hebben veel impact op de slachtoffers en de maatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over meer incidenten met verwarde personen

Van Haga asks whether the rise in incidents involving confused persons is linked to GGZ budget cuts and whether a nationwide network of psycholance ambulances will be set up. The minister says the police report figures do not reflect unique persons, rejects the link to GGZ cuts, and states transport should run via the RAV, leaving regional organisation to local partners.
We consider it important to stress that we must provide appropriate care and support to people showing confused behaviour.
We vinden het belangrijk te benadrukken dat we mensen die verward gedrag vertonen passende zorg en ondersteuning dienen te bieden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over aanhoudende diefstal, intimidatie en agressie veroorzaakt door asielzoekers

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum-seeker nuisance, theft and intimidation in Ter Apel, including the status of a promise on expelling offenders, figures on removals, compensation for residents and businesses, and when the borders will close. The State Secretary answers that the open-order policy is existing practice, provides figures on revoked asylum permits and removals, points to support schemes and an intended separate facility for weak asylum cases, and rejects closing the borders as unrealistic.
This is not a promise, but existing policy that is being implemented.
Dit is geen belofte, maar staand beleid dat wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘Slachting onder bedrijven dreigt: 200.000 ondernemers op rand faillissement’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that around 200,000 entrepreneurs face bankruptcy, the state's role in supporting them, and whether firms hit by energy prices and the Ukraine war should be supported. The minister said the government is providing a range of debt and financing instruments, bankruptcies remain low, and it monitors the situation but does not plan generic new compensation for energy costs.
The cabinet further keeps a close watch and remains in dialogue with the business community.
Het kabinet houdt verder de vinger aan de pols en blijft in gesprek met het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over oneigenlijk gebruik leefgeld

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Ukrainian arbeidsmigranten who were already in the Netherlands before the war are claiming leefgeld, and how misuse of refugee facilities and exploitation of Ukrainians will be tackled. The government answered that such workers can fall within the temporary protection group and so be eligible, that municipalities get support and verification via the IND, and that the Arbeidsinspectie is investigating possible labour-law violations and the Aanjaagteam recommendations are being implemented.

Persons who were already in the Netherlands as labour migrants before the Russian attack can therefore fall within the target group and in that case are also eligible for reception and the associated leefgeld.

Personen die voor de Russische aanval al in Nederland waren als arbeidsmigrant kunnen derhalve onder de doelgroep vallen en komen in dat geval ook in aanmerking voor opvang en het bijbehorende leefgeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de grote belangstelling voor de regeling ‘Impulsaanpak winkelgebieden’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the oversubscription of the Impulse programme for shopping areas, whether funds from the fourth tranche could be moved forward, and how the programme would inspire others and tackle vacancy. The minister said no acceleration is planned for now, that 16 projects requesting 38 million against 22 million available are being assessed and decisions follow in August, and that she will work with partners on knowledge sharing and transformation.
I see no reason to do so at this moment.
Daarvoor zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over compensatie voor stijgende energieprijzen voor de consumenten van LPG

MP Van Haga asked why a temporary reduced VAT rate on LPG (propane) is not possible under the EU VAT Directive, why LPG consumers are treated differently from natural gas users, and whether LPG-heating households can be compensated for rising energy prices, including via the one-off energy allowance. The State Secretary answered that propane is not listed in Annex III of the Directive, that LPG consumers benefit from the excise cut and can apply for the one-off allowance via municipalities, and that no extra compensation or EU initiative is planned.
Propane, an LPG, is not natural gas and propane/LPG is also not mentioned elsewhere in Annex III.
Propaan, een LPG, is geen aardgas en propaan/LPG wordt ook niet elders in Bijlage III genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over toenemende druk op mantelzorgers en ouderenmishandeling

An MP asked the government about pressure on informal carers, respite care availability, and monitoring and registration of elder abuse. The State Secretary answered that carers' overload is addressed through the upcoming WOZO and carer policy agenda, that a national respite network is not planned in favour of local tailored provision, and that monitoring of informal help is not structurally done and registration is not favoured, while promising talks on earlier detection of abuse.
I will engage with the VNG, the Landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis and relevant parties such as MantelzorgNL on the possibilities to identify derailed informal care earlier.
Ik zal met de VNG, het Landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis en betrokken partijen zoals MantelzorgNL in gesprek gaan over de mogelijkheden om ontspoorde mantelzorg eerder in beeld te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘plezierhuwelijken’

An MP asked whether the minister knows of reports that a Hague mosque would cooperate in short-term forced marriages for sex and money, whether the mosque should be closed immediately, and whether research into so-called pleasure marriages will be commissioned. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that forced marriage and unlawful religious marriage without a civil marriage are criminal, declined immediate closure, and said no signals of such marriages in the Netherlands justify a study.
At this moment the state sees no reason to have the mosque closed immediately.
Op dit moment ziet het Rijk geen aanleiding om de moskee per direct te laten sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het toezenden van adviezen van de Landsadvocaat met betrekking tot de WOZ-cap en de middenhuur

An MP asked the housing minister to disclose Landsadvocaat advice on the WOZ cap and mid-rent regulation, arguing that Article 68 of the Constitution requires full information unless state interests are harmed. The minister refused, citing the state's procedural interest in possible litigation and the confidentiality of legal advice, while stating that no advice on mid-rent had yet been issued.
The procedural interest of the state – and therefore the state's interest – also precludes making the Landsadvocaat's advice available to the House confidentially for inspection.
Het procesbelang – en daarmee het belang van de staat – verzet zich ook tegen het vertrouwelijk bij de Kamer ter inzage leggen van het advies van de Landsadvocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de behandeling van een klokkenluider door een topambtenaar bij het ministerie van OCW

An MP asked the government about how a senior civil servant at OCW handled a whistleblower's report on alleged abuses at the NPO, including a 2020 meeting arranged via MPs and claims about personal ties to the NPO chair. The state secretary answered that the Auditdienst Rijk is investigating the facts and declined to pre-empt its findings, while promising to inform parliament once the investigation is complete.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over bedreigingen aan het adres van Lale Gül

An MP asked the government about threats against writer Lale Gül, whether she is considering leaving the country, what protects writers from threats, and what is being done about rising Jewish emigration due to threats. The minister called threats to freedom of expression unacceptable, said the state pays for government-imposed protection measures, declined to comment on specific security matters, and pointed to the national antisemitism coordinator and funding for anti-antisemitism projects.
I cannot make statements about specific security matters.
Over specifieke veiligheidsaangelegenheden kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Vlissingen en Velsen eerste mega-opvanglocaties voor vluchtelingen

MP Van Haga asks the State Secretary about reports of cruise ships and a land site being used as mass refugee reception locations in Vlissingen, Velsen and The Hague, including how the sites were chosen, costs, rationale, and impacts on local communities. The State Secretary answers that no formal decisions have been taken, that municipalities decide and talks are ongoing, that cruise ships are a short-term buffer during a reception crisis costing per-day charter fees plus extra costs, and that COA will prepare plans for liveability, safety and local impacts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht 'De warmtepompen van Hugo de Jonge besparen geen aardgas en geen CO2'

Van Haga asks the minister about a report claiming heat pumps save neither gas nor CO2 when electricity is counted, and questions the rising electricity demand, costs of insulation and the 2026 obligation. The minister rejects the claim, citing heat pump efficiency and cost savings, and refuses to reverse the 2026 obligation.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de Bilderberg-conferentie

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the Bilderberg conference, including what was discussed and decided, costs to taxpayers, and whether full transparency will be provided. The government answered that discussions fall under Chatham House Rules, no decisions are taken there, the total cost of the minister's participation was EUR 8,837.99 and is publicly disclosed, and that voters influence the government through elected MPs.

As also indicated in the answers to the questions from the member Van Houwelingen, the discussions during the conference fall under the Chatham House Rules in order to promote an open exchange of ideas and opinions.

Zoals ook aangegeven in de beantwoording op de vragen van het lid van Houwelingen vallen de besprekingen tijdens de conferentie onder de Chatham House Rules om zo een open uitwisseling van ideeën en meningen te bevorderen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aansturing van het Land Information Manoeuvre Centre (LIMC) door de Nationaal Coördinator Terrorismebestrijding en Veiligheid (NCTV), de samenwerking tussen het LIMC en de

An MP asks the Justice Minister about NCTV steering of the LIMC military information unit, police social media surveillance cooperation with LIMC, and information provided to parliament. The minister answers that NCTV's role was limited to exploratory talks, police OSINT cooperation was a short-lived exploration stopped in October 2020, and police surveillance operates under Politiewet article 3 and the criminal procedure framework without targeting opinions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het feit dat boeren bang zijn dat koeien niet meer buiten mogen zonder vergunning

Van Haga asked whether the government will prevent a permit requirement for grazing cows and fertilising land, which farmers fear under nitrogen policy. The minister replied that by agreement with provinces most grazing and manuring need no permit, that a Council of State appeal on this is pending, and that if the ruling goes against the government it will seek ways to keep grazing permit-free.

If the Council of State's Administrative Jurisdiction Division agrees with the district courts' judgment, we will work with the provinces to find ways to ensure farmers can graze their animals without an additional permit.

Indien de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State meegaat in het oordeel van de rechtbanken, zullen wij samen met provincies zoeken naar mogelijkheden om te borgen dat agrariërs hun dieren zonder aanvullende vergunning kunnen laten weiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over dienstauto’s

An MP asks the Interior Minister why the government's civil vehicle fleet will not be fully zero-emission until 2028 and whether comfort concerns justify the delay. The minister defends the 2028 target as a large operation, notes 18% of the civil fleet is zero-emission, and promises to ask colleagues to apply a 'zero-emission unless' principle to new service cars.

To give fresh impetus to the chosen path toward a fully zero-emission civil government fleet by 2028, I will ask my ministerial colleagues to apply the 'zero-emission unless' principle, insofar as this is not already happening, when purchasing new service cars.

Om de ingeslagen weg naar uiteindelijk een zero-emissie civiel Rijkswagenpark in 2028 een impuls te geven, zal ik mijn collega-bewindspersonen vragen het «zero-emissie, tenzij» principe – voor zover dit niet al gebeurt – bij de aanschaf van nieuwe dienstauto’s te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over aanranding door asielzoekers

Van Haga asks whether the State Secretary agrees that asylum seekers who break the law should forfeit their asylum prospects and be deported, whether he will deport three suspects in an assault case, and whether Nederland is too lenient toward misbehaving asylum seekers. The State Secretary answers that offenders are prosecuted in the Netherlands, that residence can be refused or withdrawn only after serious criminal convictions under EU rules, that individual cases cannot be discussed, that a shuttle bus was introduced to curb nuisance, and that the House will be informed annually through incident reports.
Without a criminal conviction there is no legal basis to proceed with termination of residence and deportation.
Zonder strafrechtelijke veroordeling bestaat er geen juridische grondslag om over te gaan tot verblijfsbeëindiging en uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het opstappen van een raadslid vanwege ‘doodsbedreigingen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a municipal councillor's resignation over death threats would be investigated and whether the mayor's reaction would be addressed. The minister answered that every representative must be able to work safely, that the municipality itself is responsible and could call on the Commissioner of the King, that it is not for the minister to judge the mayor's wording, and that the public prosecutor is reportedly already investigating.
The municipality is itself responsible here and could, if asked, appeal to the Commissioner of the King (as a national body).
De gemeente is hier zelf aan zet en zou desgevraagd een beroep op de commissaris van de Koning (als rijksorgaan) kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de term piekbelasting

An MP asks the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen what 'piekbelaster' (peak polluter) means, how it relates to four candidate criteria, how the buyout schemes MGA and LBV select farms, and how buyouts weigh against food security. The minister admits there is no fixed definition, describes the selection criteria of both schemes, and argues that sustainable agriculture is the path to long-term food security.
'Peak polluter' is not a fixed defined term.
Piekbelaster is geen vast omschreven begrip.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het toevoegen van de 'koloniale oorlog in Indonesië' aan Dodenherdenking

An MP asked whether the government would press the National Committee for 4 and 5 May to remove the added reference to the 'colonial war in Indonesia' from the Remembrance Day text, arguing it wrongly includes Indonesian combatants and undermines the national character of the commemoration. The minister answered that the National Committee is an independent body, that the change names all Dutch and Indonesian victims in line with government terminology, and that there is no reason to press for reversal.
The National Committee 4 and 5 May is an independent organisation that independently decides how the commemoration on 4 May is shaped.
Het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei (NC) is een onafhankelijke organisatie die zelfstandig besluit over de wijze waarop de herdenking op 4 mei wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over woningverbeteringssubsidie Groningers

MP Van Haga asks the Minister why the Groningen home-improvement subsidy is being paid out in phases rather than by the 1 May deadline, whether the minister will commit to complete payment before the summer recess, and challenges the minister's excuse for withholding information during the recess. The minister rejects the criticism, explains that the motion only required information on the plan by 1 May, and says the subsidy opens in phases from 6 July 2022 on SNN advice, with the agency working to process applications as quickly as possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de Russische olieboycot door Brussel

Member Van Haga asked the Prime Minister about the economic and price consequences for Dutch citizens of an EU oil embargo on Russia, and why de-escalation and a peace mission were not pursued. The government answered that the economic impact cannot be fully predicted, that the sanctions package contains transition periods, and that consumers and firms will feel the costs, while maintaining support for Ukraine and Russia's sole responsibility for the war.

However, it is not possible to determine the economic consequences in detail in advance, because the precise impact depends on the extent to which companies manage to secure replacement supplies in time.

Het is echter niet mogelijk om de economische gevolgen vooraf in detail duidelijk te krijgen, omdat de precieze impact afhangt van de mate waarin bedrijven erin slagen om tijdig vervangend aanbod aan te kunnen trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over nieuwe onaanvaardbare chaos op Schiphol

An MP asked the minister whether the army should be deployed to ease staffing shortages and chaos at Schiphol, whether the chaos harms the economy, what is being done on recruitment and wages, and whether the airport director should be reprimanded. The minister said airport staffing is Schiphol's responsibility, only Marechaussee deployment is in play, recruitment and a social agreement are underway, and the director's position is for the supervisory board.
Primarily it is the responsibility of Schiphol to solve its staff shortage.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid Schiphol om hun personeelstekort op te lossen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Minister: 'Rode diesel keert niet terug'

Two MPs asked whether the government will reinstate red diesel for farmers, given that Belgium and Germany offer farmers cheaper fuel and that Dutch farmers face heavy regulation. The minister refused to reinstate red diesel, pointing to the temporary fuel excise cut and EU crisis reserve funds, and gave no separate scheme for farmers.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de panelsessie ‘Securing Europe’ van het WEF van 24 mei 2022

An MP asks the Defence Minister whether she, speaking for the Dutch government at a WEF panel, backed a 'strong European defence', given Parliament's motions against a European army, and whether she considers that contradictory. The minister confirms she spoke for the government, states there is no European army, and rejects any contradiction.
There is no question of forming a European army.
Er is geen sprake van de vorming van een Europees leger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over hydroxychloroquine als vroeg-behandeling tegen Covid-19 en de werkwijze van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd

An MP asked the Minister of Health about hydroxychloroquine as early Covid-19 treatment, the IGJ's 2020 ban on off-label prescribing in primary care, and its enforcement. The minister answered that the IGJ only enforces existing law, that the Wob document was of little relevance, and that the ministry bought the drug as a precaution, with one fine and one disciplinary case issued.
The IGJ does not itself create laws and regulations, but supervises on the basis of laws and regulations.
IGJ stelt zelf geen wet- en regelgeving op, maar houdt toezicht op grond van wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over miljoenen aan meerkosten renovatie Afsluitdijk

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether officials knew in advance that the Afsluitdijk renovation would fail, causing hundreds of millions in extra costs, and whether investigation of those officials is warranted. The minister answered that a technical risk was flagged in 2018, formally raised with contractor Levvel in 2019, the minister informed in 2019, and that no investigation of officials is warranted, while acknowledging that cost overruns on complex projects cannot be fully excluded and describing new contracting approaches.
Contrary to what the above article suggests, the view is not shared that RWS officials knew in advance that the Afsluitdijk renovation would run into these problems.
Anders dan het bovengenoemde artikel suggereert wordt de mening niet gedeeld dat ambtenaren van RWS vooraf op de hoogte waren dat de renovatie van de Afsluitdijk tegen deze problemen zou aanlopen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over de bereikbaarheid in Den Helder en de Kop van Noord-Holland

An MP asked the minister about poor accessibility of Den Helder and the Kop van Noord-Holland, including the N9 road, rail link, N9-A7 connection and bus services, and the status of road widening and rail doubling. The government acknowledged an accessibility challenge in the region but stated there are currently no plans to widen the N9 or build the A7 connection, nor to double the rail line, citing low congestion, and pointed to the province for bus services.
Currently there are no plans to widen the N9 between Alkmaar and Den Helder to a four-lane road (2x2) along the Noordhollandsch Kanaal and to realise the N9 connection to the A7.
Momenteel zijn er geen plannen om de N9 tussen Alkmaar en Den Helder te verbreden tot een vierbaansweg (2x2) langs het Noordhollandsch Kanaal en om de aansluiting van de N9 op de A7 te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de grove uitzetting van journalist Dulmers uit Oekraïne

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the government relied on Ukraine's account of the expulsion of Dutch journalist Dulmers, why no official charge exists, and why the government has not pressed harder or sought apologies and lifting of a ten-year entry ban. The minister replied that the ministry requested information but Ukrainian authorities could not provide it due to wartime conditions, that the case was raised with Foreign Minister Kuleba who promised to look into it, and that Dulmers can pursue domestic legal remedies.
The ministry has asked the Ukrainian authorities for further information.
Het ministerie heeft de Oekraïense autoriteiten gevraagd om nadere informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de peperdure renovatie van het Binnenhof

An MP asks the minister why the Binnenhof renovation budget rose from 475 to 734 million euros, who is accountable, what compensation was agreed with The Hague for the closed Binnenhof, and what the restored moat costs. The minister attributes the increases mainly to higher security requirements and extra sustainability wishes of the House plus price-level adjustments, promises a fuller account of possible external-cause disclaimers in the next progress report, and says compensation costs are commercially confidential.
Regarding any reliance on the disclaimers shared with your House, i.e. causes influenced by external factors, I will inform you in the next progress report, as has always been the case.

Over het eventuele beroep op de met uw Kamer gedeelde disclaimers, dat wil zeggen de oorzaken die door externe factoren worden beïnvloed, zal ik u zoals steeds het geval is geweest in de volgende voortgangsrapportage informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het gedrag van zogenaamde 'vluchtelingen'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reported misconduct by asylum seekers at the emergency shelter at Soesterberg, and whether those responsible should be expelled immediately. The State Secretary condemned threats and vandalism, acknowledged frustration over shelter conditions, and said expulsion for crimes is governed by rules referred to in earlier answers.
In general terms, aggressive or nuisance-causing behaviour is unacceptable and undermines public support for sheltering people fleeing war, violence or persecution.
In algemene zin geldt dat agressief of overlastgevend gedrag onacceptabel is en het draagvlak aantast voor de opvang van personen die vluchten voor oorlog, geweld of vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het kapotmaken van een klokkenluider

An MP asked the Interior Minister how the government judges the municipality of Lopik's treatment of a whistleblower, including alleged favouritism in tenders, staff emails discussing ways to damage him, and whether the council should be placed under supervision or its leadership suspended. The minister declined substantive comment because court and criminal proceedings are ongoing, pointed to existing whistleblower protections and the Huis voor klokkenluiders, and said the commissioner of the King could act on integrity concerns.
For that reason I cannot respond substantively to this matter at this time.
Om die reden kan ik nu niet inhoudelijk reageren op deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het uitkopen van boeren in Gelderland

An MP asked the ministers whether the buyout of farmers for the A15 road project in Gelderland went against the province's wishes, and questioned the informal style and 'surprise' tactics used by the minister and deputy. The government answered that the buyouts were voluntary, agreed within existing province-state policy frameworks, and that the minister acknowledged the 'overvallen' wording was sharp but had not informed officials in advance of a commitment made in talks with provincial deputies.
The Minister had not informed her officials in advance that she wanted to make this commitment, and the officials only heard of it after the administrative agreement had been made.
De Minister had van tevoren niet gemeld aan haar ambtenaren dat ze deze toezegging wilde doen en de ambtenaren hoorden dit nadat deze bestuurlijke afspraak was gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Maastricht Aachen Airport

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat about the future of Maastricht Aachen Airport, the alleged information gap of Limburg provincial councillors, measures to limit noise nuisance for South Limburg, and economic benefits such as local employment. The minister answered that the airport is a regional matter for its owner the province of Limburg, that the state will not fund operations and gives no legal means to direct flights, and listed noise-reduction agreements and a provincial decision process still pending.
It is therefore up to the airports (and their shareholders), in cooperation with the region, to determine the future.
Het is daarom aan de luchthavens (en hun aandeelhouders) om in samenwerking met de regio de toekomst te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het wegmoffelen van oversterfte door Coronadashboard

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the national coronavirus dashboard hid excess mortality and whether it should be dissolved or excess-mortality analyses handed to independent experts. The minister answered that a technical error had made the expected-mortality band too wide, which was corrected retroactively, and pointed to independent RIVM/CBS analyses and planned academic access to data.
The coronavirus dashboard did not hide excess mortality.
Het coronadashboard heeft de oversterfte niet weggemoffeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het buitensluiten van de partij Richard de Mos

MPs Van Haga asked whether the prolonged criminal investigation into Richard de Mos's party, and its exclusion from coalition talks in The Hague, undermines rule of law and public trust, and whether the government will urge the Public Prosecution Service to speed up or drop the case. The minister replied that coalition choices are for the parties and that the OM acts independently, so the government will not press for speed or dismissal of an individual case.
The OM makes these decisions without political interference, as is proper in a state governed by the rule of law.
Het OM neemt deze beslissingen zonder politieke inmenging, zoals dat hoort in een rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over verhogen van de eigen bijdrage voor medicijnen

MP Van Haga asked the health minister whether raising the patient co-payment for medicines, possibly through recalculating reimbursement limits, would unfairly burden chronically ill people, and whether the government could guarantee they would be spared. The minister replied that he does not intend to raise co-payments, that patient costs arise only if manufacturers do not lower prices, and that mitigating measures including a co-payment cap will accompany the recalculation, with a further letter to follow.
I do not intend to raise the co-payment for medicines.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de eigen bijdrage voor medicijnen te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het niet nakomen van afspraken

An MP asked why the state secretary broke the promise to inform Groningen residents about the 10,000 euro home-improvement subsidy by 1 May 2022, and whether the subsidy would be paid before the summer recess. The state secretary apologised for the delay, explained the preparations and reasons for later notification, and said the scheme opens in phases from 6 July 2022 with payment within 15 working days of approval.
I apologise that it did not succeed by 1 May 2022 to inform Groningers about the new round for applying for the home-improvement subsidy.
Ik bied mijn excuses aan dat het niet voor 1 mei 2022 gelukt is om Groningers te informeren over de nieuwe ronde voor het aanvragen van de woningverbeteringssubsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de 75th World Health Assembly van 22 tot 28 mei 2022

The MP asks the Health Minister about the 75th World Health Assembly: which ministers attend, the proposed WHO contribution increase and its cost, the US amendments to the International Health Regulations, their binding force, parliamentary involvement, and whether WHO could declare emergencies over the Netherlands. The minister answers that the amendments are not yet voted on except a shortening of notification deadlines, that the contribution rise adds about 1.1 million euros per year, and that parliament is usually informed afterwards but an annotated agenda could be introduced.
If desired, we can introduce such a working method.
Indien gewenst kunnen we een dergelijke werkwijze invoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de drukte op Schiphol

An MP from Groep Van Haga asked the minister about the chaos at Schiphol over the May holidays, whether it could have been foreseen, the CEO's absence, the airport charge increase and staff shortages. The minister answered that bookings rose faster than expected alongside rising staff sickness, that Schiphol apologised and has four action lines, and that operational and personnel matters are the responsibility of Schiphol's management and employers, with the Autoriteit Consument en Markt handling charge complaints.
The Ministry of IenW has no role in determining the airport charges.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft in de vaststelling van de luchthavengelden geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over stelende asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum seekers in Ter Apel who commit shoplifting and public disorder, and whether their asylum applications should be stopped and they should be sent back. The State Secretary acknowledged the overcrowding, announced a broader nuisance-reduction approach and a review of a binding legal instrument, but said shoplifting usually does not meet the threshold for revoking asylum status and that no figures on removals after theft are recorded.
It is not registered how many foreigners who commit theft are subsequently also deported.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd hoeveel vreemdelingen die een diefstal plegen vervolgens ook uitgezet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over miljoenentekorten gemeenten door onvoldoende Rijksgelden

Van Haga asks the Interior Minister about municipal deficits from insufficient state funds, including the Frisian lobbying, whether new tasks can be assigned without extra budget, why funding did not rise after 2015 decentralisations, and how citizens will be protected from service cuts and tax increases. The minister says the 2026+ financing system will be reviewed with the associations and a contour note sent before summer, points to coalition-agreement funds and a new allocation model that reportedly leaves no municipality worse off in 2023-2025, promises an implementation test for new tasks, explains that jeugdzorg costs rose beyond projections, and stresses municipal autonomy over budgets.

I therefore intend to set up an implementation test for decentralised governments (udo): an assessment process that makes clearer upfront the effects of new central government policy on sub-national governments.

Ik ben daarom voornemens een uitvoeringstoets decentrale overheden (udo) in te richten: een afwegingsproces dat aan de voorkant beter inzichtelijk maakt wat de effecten voor medeoverheden zijn van nieuw beleid van het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de toeslagenaffaire

An MP asks the State Secretary about delays in the childcare allowance scandal compensation law, support for affected children and ex-partners, backlogs in objections, and alleged bullying and unlawful conduct by the Tax Administration. The government answers that the restoration bill will go to the Council of State for urgent advice and aims to submit it before the summer recess, that children's compensation and flanking support are being prepared, that the ex-partner scheme needs more time, and that the objection backlog and past misconduct are acknowledged and addressed.
The cabinet aims to submit the Wet hersteloperatie Toeslagen bill to the House before the summer recess.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om het wetsvoorstel Wet hersteloperatie Toeslagen voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het International Migration Review Forum (IMRF) van 17 t/m 20 mei 2022 te New York

An MP asked the State Secretary about Dutch consultations with civil society on the Global Compact on Migration, the Netherlands' stance at the International Migration Review Forum, the return of rejected asylum seekers and cooperation with countries of origin. The government answered that consultations with NGOs took place, that return cooperation is a stated priority, but gave no concrete numbers or specific targets for agreements on rejected asylum seekers.
The cabinet cannot give precise figures or information with certainty about the composition of this group.
Het kabinet kan geen precieze aantallen geven of met zekerheid informatie geven over de samenstelling van deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de chaos bij asielzoekerscentrum Ter Apel

An MP asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the overnight crisis at the Ter Apel asylum centre, where asylum seekers spent hours outside the gate, how such situations will be prevented, which nationalities make up recent arrivals, and how many asylum seekers the Netherlands can absorb. The State Secretary regrets the situation, says no guarantee can be given, commits to preparing emergency shelter and new locations, but answers the questions on nationalities and absorption capacity only by reference to other answers or general statements.
I find it undesirable and inappropriate that we were unable for several hours to provide these people with a roof over their heads, and I regret this.
Ik vind het ongewenst en ongepast dat we deze mensen een aantal uren geen dak boven het hoofd hebben kunnen bieden en dat betreur ik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over sluiten operatiekamers Gronings ziekenhuis

An MP asks the Health Minister whether closing half the operating theatres of a Groningen hospital due to staff absence is acceptable, and what policy addresses the structural healthcare staff shortage, including a possible national taskforce. The minister answers that postponing non-urgent operations was unavoidable given high sick leave, cites staff retention measures and the Prognosemodel, and declines to set up a new national taskforce, referring instead to existing advice.
No. Over recent years several bodies and committees, including the SER and the Commission on Working in Healthcare, have given useful advice on the healthcare labour market.
Nee. De afgelopen jaren hebben verschillende organen en commissies, waaronder de SER en de Commissie Werken in de Zorg, nuttige adviezen gegeven over de arbeidsmarkt in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de additionele steun vanuit de Europese Vredesfaciliteit aan Oekraïne

Van Haga asked whether the EU's proposed extra 500 million euro military aid to Ukraine via the European Peace Facility exceeds the 2022 ceiling, whether member states fund it, and whether Dutch opt-out or refusal is possible. The ministers confirmed the Council's approval, said the total ceiling of 5.7 billion would be kept by spreading payments, noted the EPF sits outside the EU budget and is funded by member states, and explained constructive abstention rules.
Given the extremely unpredictable course of the war in Ukraine, the cabinet cannot rule out a future discussion on the level of the European Peace Facility.
Gezien het uiterst onvoorspelbare verloop van de oorlog in Oekraïne kan het kabinet een toekomstige discussie over de hoogte van de Europese Vredesfaciliteit niet uitsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verkeersveiligheid van de N50 bij Kampen

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the road safety of the N50 near Kampen, after a fatal accident and a transport company's offer to fund improvements, and whether the state had long known of the dangers. The minister acknowledged the urgency, listed past measures, explained that nitrogen-permit delays slowed the Kampen–Kampen Zuid project, which is now prioritised, and promised a study, short-term measures and a Kamer update before the June MIRT debate.
On the research into the possibilities for these short-term measures, your House will in any case be informed of the state of affairs before the MIRT committee debate of 30 June.
Over het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheden van deze korte termijn maatregelen zal uw Kamer in elk geval voorafgaand aan het Commissiedebat MIRT van 30 juni worden geïnformeerd over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de permanente goedkeuring van het Pfizer/BioNTech coronavaccin voor de medicijnmarkt

MP Van Haga asks whether Pfizer/BioNTech's annual report, which lists a risk that the vaccine may not obtain permanent authorisation, shows the vaccine is experimental, unsafe or ineffective, and whether the public was misinformed and how victims would be compensated. Minister Kuipers rejects these premises, explaining the report describes a risk rather than a finding, the vaccine holds a conditional marketing authorisation based on a positive benefit-risk balance, and product liability claims go to the producer with state indemnity under strict contract conditions.
The contracts signed by the European Commission provide for a confidentiality clause for all parties involved, including representatives of the 27 member states.
De Europese Commissie voorzien in een geheimhoudingsverklaring voor alle betrokken partijen inclusief de vertegenwoordigers van de 27 lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne.

Van Haga asked the Defence Minister for an overview of all weapons and equipment supplied to Ukraine, the personnel involved, supply routes, oversight and end-use controls, and whether the weapons have been used or caused casualties. The government referred to earlier confidential letters, said it withholds route details and deployment information for operational security, and described end-user certificates and pre-delivery vetting.
After the Russian invasion of Ukraine, the cabinet decided, for reasons of (operational) security, to communicate less openly about the military goods Defence supplies to Ukraine.

Na de Russische invasie van Oekraïne heeft het kabinet met het oog op de (operationele) veiligheid besloten om minder openlijk te communiceren over de militaire goederen die Defensie aan Oekraïne levert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de grove uitzetting van journalist Dulmers uit de Oekraïne

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the forced expulsion of Dutch journalist Robert Dulmers from Ukraine, including reports he had a loaded pistol pressed to his head, and whether the ambassador should be summoned and a full report requested. The minister answers that Ukrainian authorities cite wartime security rules and claim Dulmers endangered lives by revealing details of an attack; the ministry raised press freedom and proportionality with Ukraine, but said a full report is not possible due to the war.
Due to the current war situation, it is not possible to prepare and hand over a full report.
Wegens de huidige oorlogssituatie is het niet mogelijk om een volledig rapport op te stellen en te overhandigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het benoemen van burgerraadsleden in het algemeen en het wegstemmen van BVNL-burgerraadsleden in de gemeente Haarlemmermeer in het bijzonder

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the Haarlemmermeer council voting down two civic council members nominated by the one-person BVNL faction, and whether this impairs faction representation. The minister answered that the appointment of non-council committee members is a local matter, the commissioner of the King can mediate only in cases of seriously disturbed relations, and no national legal anchoring is currently considered necessary.
The appointment of committee members who are not councillors is a local competence, so in principle it is not for me to comment on the motives.
De benoeming van commissieleden niet zijnde raadslid is een lokale bevoegdheid, daarmee is het in beginsel niet aan mij om in de motieven te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het volgen van politiek geëngageerde burgers op sociale media en het mogelijk plegen van censuur

An MP asks ministers whether the government monitored and pressured politically engaged citizens on social media, including a BVNL board member, and whether this amounted to censorship or coordinated trolling. The government denies targeting individuals, says monitoring tools are used only to gauge public debate, denies censorship and trolling, and states it has no legal basis for requiring platforms to remove disinformation.
This is not correct. The central government does not discredit citizens with critical opinions.
Dit klopt niet. De rijksoverheid brengt burgers met een kritische mening niet in diskrediet.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over diversiteit en inclusiviteit bij Defensie

Van Haga asks the State Secretary for Defence about personnel shortages, the justification for a 30% female target, the KMA study on gender norms, and whether preferential policy for women works against recruitment and selection on quality. The State Secretary answers that recruitment is needed, that the 30% target is an ambitious, analysed goal to be set by the defence leadership, that it is a target rather than a quota, and that quality remains leading in selection.
We are going to work with target figures and not with a quota.
We gaan werken met streefcijfers en niet met een quotum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over gesloten SEH’s

An MP asks the health minister about temporary closures of emergency departments due to staff sick leave, a reported halving of SEH numbers in the 2020 Houtskoolschets, and how patient transfer will be improved. The minister denies deliberate cuts, says reducing SEH numbers is not government policy, and promises a letter before the summer recess on the future acute care framework.
Reducing the number of SEHs is not a goal in this cabinet's acute care policy.
Het verminderen van het aantal SEH’s is geen doelstelling in het beleid over de acute zorg van dit kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het ontwikkelen van een Europese digitale identiteit in het algemeen en in het bijzonder in relatie tot het coronatoegangsbewijs

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior about the EU European Digital Identity framework, its links to the COVID certificate and Dutch e-ID infrastructure, the data attributes to be included, and GDPR data minimisation. The State Secretary answered that the framework is a revision of eIDAS, that the COVID certificate technology is separate though lessons will be used, that vaccination status is not among the minimum attributes, and that the government is cautious about scope and timing.
Question 21: Can you answer these questions before 22 March 2022 in connection with the planned committee debate? Answer 21: No.
Vraag 21 Kunt u deze vragen beantwoorden voor 22 maart 2022 in verband met het geplande commissiedebat Digitale overheid, datagebruik en algoritmen, digitale identiteit? Antwoord 21 Nee.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de voorbereiding van de WHO om een «International treaty on pandemic prevention and preparedness», dat het verdrag van 2005 (de Internationale Gezondheidsregeling) uitbreidt (

An MP asked the ministers how Dutch representation and commitments in the WHO pandemic treaty process are organised, who decides on pandemic measures, whether national sovereignty and parliamentary control are preserved, and whether the WHO is independent. The government answered that the treaty content is not yet fixed, that the Staten-Generaal would have to approve ratification, that Dutch parliamentary control is ensured through that approval, and that the WHO is not independent of its member states; it declined to answer the provisional-application question yet and noted the negotiation timetable.
In the Netherlands this means the treaty must be submitted to the States General for approval before it can enter into force for the Netherlands.
In Nederland betekent dit dat het verdrag aan de Staten-Generaal ter goedkeuring moet worden voorgelegd, voordat het voor Nederland in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over bevindingen van Rita Verdonk

An MP asked the minister whether he knew of the FTM report on Rita Verdonk's findings about a dysfunctional VWS culture, its cost to taxpayers, the possibility of 400-600 million euros in annual savings, and whether he would investigate and whether civil servants were in charge. The state secretary answered that the Model Prestatiecodes Jeugd is being impact-analysed by Significant with results expected in March 2022, that decision-making is a political choice made with parliament, and that civil servants prepare policy under political direction.
On behalf of VWS, the agency Significant is currently carrying out an impact analysis.
In opdracht van VWS verricht bureau Significant op dit moment een impactanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over toenemen geweld tegen ambulancepersoneel

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether penalties for violence against ambulance staff should be increased through administrative fines, loss of municipal privileges, eviction or benefit cuts, and why reported violence seems to have doubled and reporting appears to be declining. The minister rejected extra sanctions, pointing to the existing prosecution policy of tripling the sentence demand and the pending bill on banning community service, and said the rise in incidents is modest rather than doubled while the Taskforce and reporting measures address reporting barriers.
At present I see no need to tackle violence against care workers in any other way.
Op dit moment zie ik geen noodzaak om geweld tegen hulpverleners op andere wijze aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het artikelen ‘Bedrijf ademtest eist miljoenen van staat’ en ‘De teloorgang van de elektronische neus’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the government's contract with Breathomix for the SpiroNose breath test, including why it was ordered, why it was terminated, and the GGD fee dispute. The minister denied several allegations, explained the test failed validation on sensitivity and specificity, and said the government did not disclose the financial risk of the ongoing lawsuit beyond the amount Breathomix claims.
Breathomix is currently asking the State to pay, on top of the already paid amount of about €25 million (excluding VAT), another approximately €25 million.
Breathomix verzoekt de Staat momenteel om, bovenop het reeds betaalde bedrag van circa € 25 mln. (exclusief BTW), nog eens circa 25 mln. te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over fraudemiljoenen

Van Haga asked the agriculture minister why parliament was not informed about the FresQ fraud millions, why LTO's chairman was involved, how the NVWA criminal complaint relates to the refusal to repay Brussels, whether this affects the nitrogen derogation, and about EU state aid recovery for nature organisations. The minister answered that ongoing bankruptcy, criminal and EU procedures prevent full disclosure, that a request was made to the Commission to charge the amount to the EU agricultural fund, and that the derogation question is separate.
In this matter several ongoing matters play a role, such as the bankruptcy settlement by the curator and a criminal case.
In deze kwestie spelen nog diverse lopende zaken een rol, zoals de faillissementsafwikkeling door de curator en een strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uithaal van een VN-rapporteur

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a UN rapporteur's criticism of police conduct at protests, police understaffing and high workload, and how disproportionate force will be curbed. The minister defends police professionalism, says force is reported and reviewed, notes understaffing expected to ease by 2024-25, and promises to respond carefully to the UN letter and discuss any unlawful force with the police chief.
If cases of demonstrably unlawful use of force by the police give reason for it, I will discuss this with the chief of police.
Indien gevallen van gebleken niet rechtmatige geweldstoepassing door de politie daartoe aanleiding geven ga ik hierover met de korpschef in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga, Ephraim en Smolders over juridisch bindende overeenkomsten met het World Economic Forum en aanverwante zaken

MPs Van Haga, Ephraim and Smolders asked whether the government has binding agreements with the World Economic Forum and whether Parliament can inspect them. The minister confirmed binding implementation agreements and grants under Dutch law, said the subsidy decisions are attached, and stated that the WEF is a private Swiss foundation and that the agreements fall within the budget Parliament approves.
Annex 3 contains the subsidy decisions issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to the WEF.
In de bijlage 3 treft u de aan het WEF verstrekte subsidiebeschikkingen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over grootschalige rooftochten van Oost-Europese bendes

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about large-scale thefts of car catalytic converters by Eastern European gangs, including arrest and sentencing figures, asset recovery, cooperation with source countries, a task force, and fencing prevention. The minister answered with police reports figures, describes the barrier model, the Taskforce Mobiel Banditisme, international operations, and digital anti-fencing tools, while stating that court and prosecution data on specific sentences cannot be provided.

It is therefore not possible to provide an overview, from the registrations of the police, the Public Prosecution Service and the Council for the Judiciary, of the number of arrests, sentence demands and imposed sentences relating to mobile banditry.

Het is daarom niet mogelijk om uit de registratie van politie, Openbaar Ministerie en de Raad voor de Rechtspraak een overzicht te geven van het aantal arrestanten, de strafeisen en de opgelegde straffen met betrekking tot Mobiel Banditisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het 'quarantaine-koppel'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the forced isolation and quarantine of a couple after a COVID-19 case linked to the omicron variant, including why they were held after negative tests. The minister replied with a timeline of events, explained the legal basis for the measures under the Public Health Act, and defended the safety region chair's conduct as appropriate.
I note that the mayor of Haarlemmermeer, in her role as chair of the Kennemerland safety region, has acted adequately.
Ik constateer dat de burgemeester van Haarlemmermeer, in haar rol als voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio Kennemerland, adequaat heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over oproepen tot geweld in uitzending FunX

MP Van Haga asked the state secretary about a FunX broadcast calling for violence against two YouTube presenters, whether this is illegal, and why FunX and the public broadcaster did not intervene. The state secretary said the public broadcaster is independent and responsible for its own content, and that courts decide whether free speech limits were exceeded if a complaint is filed.
It is not for me as State Secretary of Education, Culture and Science to judge the content of public broadcaster broadcasts.
Het is niet aan mij als Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van uitzendingen van de publieke omroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het voornemen om het kindhartcentrum in Groningen te sluiten

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the Minister of Health why the child heart centre in Groningen should close, given the regional impact, the loss of expertise and the pressure on intensive care staff. The Minister replies that concentration of child heart interventions in two centres is needed for quality and continuity, that regional centres keep diagnostic and aftercare roles, that the NZa will conduct an impact analysis, and that he would reconsider only if a UMC-backed alternative with two intervention centres or substantive grounds from the impact analysis emerge.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een Engels COVID-onderzoek

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a UK study claiming vaccinated deaths are misclassified as unvaccinated and about a blog analysis suggesting no excess mortality under 65 in the Netherlands, asking whether the vaccination policy should change. The minister answered that the blog is non-peer-reviewed, that the vaccine status classification follows manufacturer-recommended periods, that Lareb and RIVM monitor deaths after vaccination, and that the evidence gives no reason to change vaccination policy.
No, this research gives no reason to change the vaccination policy.
Nee, dit onderzoek geeft geen aanleiding om het vaccinatiebeleid te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Bersiap

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the Rijksmuseum's use of the term Bersiap and whether a national Bersiap monument should be investigated. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the report, said the museum will keep the term with added historical context, and saw no reason to investigate a national monument.
I currently see no reason to investigate the establishment of a national Bersiap monument.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de oprichting van een Nationaal Bersiap-monument te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de entertainment- en evenementenbranche

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Health about the impact of COVID-19 closures on the entertainment and events sector, the lack of outdoor event permissions, the Fieldlab research programme and the absence of structural consultation. The minister answered that support measures, Fieldlab research and sector consultation are in place, but gave generic answers and declined to commit to reopening events or a dedicated compensation scheme.
The cabinet holds talks with all sectors so that the support measures align as well as possible with the affected sectors.
Het kabinet voert gesprekken met alle sectoren, zodat de steunmaatregelen zo goed mogelijk aansluiten op de getroffen sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aangenomen motie-Van Haga c.s. over het wegnemen van obstakels voor het isoleren van monumenten

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior how obstacles to insulating listed buildings would be removed, following an adopted motion. The minister replied that guidance and updated restoration guidelines already exist, and promised a study with the Cultural Heritage Agency and other bodies on knowledge gaps and whether a national guideline is useful, with findings before summer 2022.
I expect to send my findings to your House before summer 2022.
