Ik verwacht uw Kamer voor de zomer van 2022 mijn bevindingen te zullen sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de intocht van Sinterklaas

An MP asks ministers whether they will urge mayors to allow QR-code-free Sinterklaas parades and whether they will act against municipalities that refuse Zwarte Piet via subsidy conditions. The government replies that it supports broad access to the parade, that children under 18 are exempt from the coronavirus pass, and that municipalities decide on subsidies and the parade themselves.
The arrival of Sinterklaas is a local matter.
De intocht van Sinterklaas is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Valneva

MP Van Haga asked the health minister whether the government would study offering inactivated or subunit COVID-19 vaccines to people unwilling to take mRNA or vector vaccines, and why it declined the Valneva contract announced on 3 November 2021. The minister answered that the portfolio was chosen for supply and diversity, bought 840,000 Novavax doses and 10,000 Valneva doses, and would review the RIVM research on alternatives and buy more if demand warrants.
I will also in future factor the interpretation of available research results into my further considerations.
Als aangegeven zal ik ook in de toekomst de duiding van beschikbare onderzoeksresultaten betrekken bij mijn nadere afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het gedrag van de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Commission President's use of a private jet for a short trip is hypocritical given her climate stance, and whether the government would voice this to her. The minister replied that the trip was part of a multi-country visit tied to recovery plans, that charters are used only when no commercial alternative fits, and that Commissioners are accountable under their own code of conduct, so the cabinet will not judge the case.
Eurocommissioners account for their conduct within the codes of conduct drawn up for them.
Eurocommissarissen leggen verantwoording af in het kader van de daarvoor opgestelde gedragscodes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verlenging van de geldigheid van het coronaherstelbewijs

An MP asked the Minister of Health when the extension of the COVID recovery certificate's validity from 180 to 365 days after a positive test would appear in the CoronaCheck app. The minister answered that the extension took effect on 30 November, users with an app recovery certificate will be notified they can renew it, while paper certificates keep the 180-day validity.
This amendment entered into force on 30 November.
Deze wijziging is op 30 november jl. in werking getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over mondkapjeszwendel

An MP asks why the investigation into the face-mask deal with Van Lienden is delayed, whether the leak affects the timeline, and whether the minister will request a criminal investigation or act as shareholder against misuse of KLM's name. The minister says the research is delayed by complex data and privacy rules, the leak is not expected to affect delivery dates, the OM will assess the complaint itself, and the state as shareholder is not responsible for KLM's claims.
That is why I am having an independent investigation carried out into the agreement with RGA.
Daarom laat ik onafhankelijk onderzoek doen naar de overeenkomst met RGA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over hardhandig politieoptreden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police use of force in The Hague on 31 October 2021, shown in circulated footage, including its cause and how excessive force will be addressed. The minister confirmed the incident, said ten arrests were made, that an officer is a suspect in an ongoing OM-led investigation, and that individual force cases cannot be discussed while proceedings continue, while arguing that most uses of force are lawful.
The police action visible in the footage took place on Sunday 31 October around the Paul Krugerplein in The Hague.
Het politieoptreden dat op de beelden is te zien vond plaats op zondag 31 oktober rond het Paul Krugerplein in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over “Het karige loonbod”

An MP asks the Defence Minister how a meagre pay offer can fill nearly ten thousand vacancies, whether it will worsen staff shortages, whether it should be withdrawn, and about shortages of equipment, munitions and instructors. The minister answers that the offer used the full available pay room, that the vacancy count is nuanced, and that funding of about four billion euros per year is needed, a decision for the next cabinet.

I am of the opinion that Defence, together with the trade union federations, has extracted everything from the pay room available from the cabinet and has presented the maximum achievable outcome to defence personnel.

Ik ben van mening dat Defensie samen met de vakcentrales alles uit de door het kabinet beschikbare arbeidsvoorwaardenruimte heeft gehaald en een maximaal haalbare uitkomst aan het defensiepersoneel heeft voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de opmerkingen van de hoofdredacteur van Joop.nl over ongevaccineerden

An MP asks the Minister for Media whether the public broadcaster-linked website Joop.nl should be allowed to exclude unvaccinated people, whether the editor-in-chief's remarks wishing unvaccinated people dead should be condemned, and whether apologies or an end to subsidy should be demanded. The Minister replies that public media institutions determine their own content under the Mediawet, that he does not interfere in programme content, and that criminal matters are for the courts.
As Minister for media I do not interfere with the content of programmes broadcast by the NPO, not even in this case
Ik bemoei mij als Minister voor media niet met de inhoud van programma's die door de NPO worden uitgezonden, ook niet in dit geval
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het coronabeleid

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Health about whether IC capacity had been sufficiently expanded before new COVID measures were introduced, which hospitals and emergency departments had reopened, how IC beds and healthcare staff had changed over ten years. The Minister replied that IC capacity can be scaled to 1,350 beds for a short peak with a refreshed plan, that the ministry does not hold data on reopened hospitals or emergency departments, and gave NICE bed counts and CBS staffing figures.
No. I do not have this information.
Nee. Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over disproportioneel handelen door de burgemeester van Nijmegen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Nijmegen mayor acted disproportionately and used show of force when closing a café for COVID rule violations, including threats to arrest young staff. The Minister declined to assess the mayor's decision, saying proportionality is for the courts and the mayor is accountable to the municipal council, and refused to summon the mayor.
I cannot intervene in that as Minister. Ultimately, the judgment on whether the government acted proportionately rests with the courts.
Ik kan daar als Minister niet in treden. Uiteindelijk is het oordeel over proportioneel handelen door de overheid aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over uitblijven resultaten onderzoek mondkapjesdeal

MP Van Haga asks the minister about delays in the investigation into the face-mask deal with Sywert van Lienden, the foundation's removal of financial accountability promises, possible ministerial integrity concerns, the separation of investigation parts, and whether the state will recover profits or punish officials. The government says the investigation takes longer due to complex data handling under privacy law, that two separate parts with results delivered separately are planned for early 2022, and that the state will not join the planned criminal complaint while awaiting the investigation outcome.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de grote financiële tekorten bij de krijgsmacht

An MP from Van Haga asked the Defence Minister about ammunition shortages, an estimated structural €700 million budget gap, possible unit closures and what was meant by a 'fundamentally different' armed forces. The minister confirmed the mismatch between needs and budget, pointed to €95 million and the Hermans motion funding, said €13-17 billion extra is needed in the Defence Vision, and left choices to the next cabinet.
Decisions on this are for a next cabinet.
Besluiten hierover zijn aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht dat de Australische staat Victoria ongevaccineerde parlementsleden niet meer toelaat in het parlementsgebouw

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns Victoria's ban on unvaccinated MPs entering parliament as an attack on democracy. The minister answered that Victoria's rule was adopted democratically, that no comparable mandate exists in the Netherlands, and that he would not object to Australian domestic legislation.
However, in my view it is not appropriate to reject Australian domestic legislation, which was democratically enacted.
Het is echter wat mij betreft niet aan de orde om Australische binnenlandse wetgeving, die democratisch tot stand is gekomen, af te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de grote tekorten aan gas

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about rising gas and electricity prices, energy poverty, gas storage levels, and the possibility of renewed Groningen gas extraction with dedicated funds. The government answered that it cannot set market tariffs but has cut energy taxes temporarily for 2022, provided extra funds for insulation, ruled out renewed Groningen extraction and nitrogen injection, and rejected domestic-only gas use as legally and strategically unfeasible.
The cabinet wants the energy transition to be feasible and affordable for everyone.
Het kabinet wil dat de energietransitie voor iedereen haalbaar en betaalbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de hoge belasting op de energierekening

An MP from Groep Van Haga asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why taxes make up about half of energy bills, whether this causes energy poverty, and whether energy taxes such as the ODE levy and VAT should be cut. The government replied that it controls energy taxes but not supply tariffs, announced temporary 2022 reductions worth about 430 euro for an average household, and pointed to insulation and energy-saving programmes while saying it monitors energy poverty closely.
To address the rising energy bill in the short term due to high gas prices, the cabinet is making two temporary adjustments to energy taxes for 2022 only.

Om tegemoet te komen voor de stijgende energierekening op de korte termijn als gevolg van de hoge gasprijzen doet het kabinet incidenteel en alleen voor 2022 een tweetal aanpassingen in de energiebelastingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bedreigen en intimideren van een raadslid

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a mayor of Noardeast-Fryslân threatened and intimidated a councillor over a Facebook post, and whether the mayor should be called to order. The Minister answered that after an open conversation the mayor's remark about possible consequences was not intended as a threat, and that she sees no reason to call the mayor to order.
In view of this reporting, I conclude that the mayor of Noardeast-Fryslân did not threaten or intimidate a councillor.
Gelet op deze berichtgeving deel ik de conclusie dat de burgemeester van Noardeast-Fryslân een raadslid heeft bedreigd of geïntimideerd niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verbreding van de A4

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the widening of the A4 motorway and a new aqueduct at Roelofarendsveen could start by 2026, whether it could be brought forward, and how congestion will be tackled. The minister gave no guarantee on timing, citing a new 25 km emissions reference distance and procedural requirements, and stated that widening is necessary and that a broader package of congestion measures is being pursued.
At this moment, unfortunately, no guarantees can yet be given about the planning of the motorway construction programme.
Op dit moment kunnen er helaas nog geen garanties gegeven worden over de planning van het aanlegprogramma snelwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het inperken van het demonstratierecht voor de ingang van de nieuwe Tweede Kamer

An MP asked the government whether restricting protest space in front of the temporary Tweede Kamer building, and the Hague municipality's updated demonstration policy, undermine the constitutional right to demonstrate, and what role the Chamber's presidium and the cabinet played. The minister answered that the right is fundamental, that protest facilitation is solely the local mayor's responsibility, and that the cabinet and presidium have no competence, while not committing to any concrete step.
Facilitating demonstrations is a local responsibility.
Het faciliteren van demonstraties is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving inzake Facebook

An MP asked the minister whether social media giants like Facebook and LinkedIn should be politically impartial, whether Facebook deliberately disabled emergency measures before the Capitol riot, and how to counter platform influence on public debate. The minister said the government cannot assess the Facebook claim, pointed to voluntary self-regulation via the disinformation code and to planned EU DSA obligations on very large platforms, and referred to earlier letters on account blocking.
The cabinet cannot assess whether Facebook actually disabled the relevant emergency measures deliberately too early.
Het kabinet kan niet beoordelen of Facebook daadwerkelijk de desbetreffende noodmaatregelen bewust te vroeg heeft uitgeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over klimaatplannen vanuit Brussel

Mr Van Haga asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate how the EU Fit-for-55 climate proposals will avoid burdening citizens and the middle class, what will be done about experts' criticism, and why nuclear energy is absent while biomass is included. The government answers that impacts depend on further EU and national decisions, defers a full impact analysis to a next cabinet, and refers to its letters on the Fit-for-55 package.
The precise socio-economic consequences of the Fit-for-55 package are not yet known at this stage, because they depend on further European decision-making
De precieze sociaaleconomische gevolgen van het Fit-for-55-pakket zijn in deze fase nog niet bekend, omdat deze afhankelijk zijn van verdere Europese besluitvorming
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitspraken om zo min mogelijk vluchtelingen uit Afghanistan op te vangen

An MP asked Prime Minister Rutte to explain his reported statement that as few Afghan refugees as possible should come to the Netherlands, and whether this conflicts with municipalities being asked to find reception places, and whether the country's absorption capacity has been reached. Rutte answered that the cabinet prefers regional protection while still honouring international obligations, that asylum seekers are received during procedures, and that the government is seeking new reception places and faster housing flow for permit holders, while housing pressures stem from complex causes not simply migration.
I do not share the view that these principles are at odds with each other.
Ik deel niet dat deze uitgangspunten haaks op elkaar staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de medische uitzondering voor het dragen van een mondkapje in het buitenland

An MP asked whether a medical exemption from mask-wearing exists abroad, whether the Dutch self-declaration form is valid there, why it is not uniform in the EU, and why the government website does not say so. The minister answered that mask rules are national, foreign requirements vary and travellers should check local rules via Wijs op Reis, without committing to new steps.
Listing all the countries where the medical exemption applies would produce an unworkable list.
Het noemen van alle landen waar de medische uitzondering geldt, levert een niet werkbare lijst op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het rapport waarin de lockdown werd ontraden

An MP asks the Prime Minister and Health Minister about an internal report, reportedly obtained under FOI, that advised against a lockdown while estimating 520,000 QALYs lost, and whether the cabinet and OMT knew of it. The government answers that the note was an early-2020 internal discussion paper, was not shared with the Health Minister, Prime Minister or OMT, and that it rejects claims of concealment, while acknowledging the minister of Economic Affairs saw it.
This internal note was shared neither with the Minister of VWS nor with the Prime Minister.
Deze interne notitie is noch met de Minister van VWS noch met de Minister-President gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bestellen van vrachtwagens die hoger zijn dan wettelijk toegestaan

An MP asked the Defence Minister why 1,600 new trucks were ordered that turned out to exceed the legal 4-metre height limit, and when exemptions or consequences would follow. The minister confirmed the overshoot, said the supplier is fixing it, and explained that temporary road-use permissions valid up to twelve weeks have been granted via the NMCC with RDW route advice, while the supplier's fix timeline is unknown.
Based on this finding, it was decided that this combination may not drive on public roads until road-use permission is granted and/or the problem is resolved by the supplier.

Op basis van deze constatering is besloten dat deze combinatie niet op de openbare weg mag rijden, totdat een toestemming voor weggebruik is verleend en/of het probleem door de leverancier is opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht 'Beruchte topcrimineel deelt lakens uit in Bajes Zaanstad'

Van Haga asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a prominent criminal runs a prison ward, smuggles phones, intimidates staff and inmates, and gets access to staff data at JC Zaanstad, and asks what is being done. The Minister answers that smuggling and criminal conduct are being addressed through searches, detection measures and disciplinary action, but withholds details of individual cases because investigations are ongoing and for privacy reasons.
Since an criminal investigation is currently underway, I cannot make any statements about this individual case.
Aangezien er momenteel een opsporingsonderzoek loopt, kan ik over deze individuele casus geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het voornemen om te stoppen met coronasteun aan de zwaar getroffen horecasector

An MP asks the minister whether ending corona support for the hospitality sector, which warns that businesses will fail, is justified and why festivals cannot reopen when stadiums and Formula 1 can. The minister answers that generic support ends on 1 October 2021 because the economy is recovering, that targeted measures such as guarantee schemes and payment arrangements remain, and that festivals are judged riskier than seated events because of mixing crowds.

Now that the restrictive measures have largely been phased out and economic prospects are good, the expectation is that continuing generic support (TVL, Tozo, TONK, NOW) increasingly obstructs the normal dynamics of business formation and closure.

Nu de beperkende maatregelen (grotendeels) zijn afgebouwd en de economische vooruitzichten goed zijn, is de verwachting dat continuering van generieke steun (TVL, Tozo, TONK, NOW) de normale dynamiek van bedrijfsoprichting en – beëindiging steeds meer in de weg gaat zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de jarenlange afsluiting van rijbanen op de Haringvlietbrug

An MP asked the minister about long-running lane closures on the Haringvlietbrug, the resulting traffic disruption, the failed clamp repairs since 2017, compensation for employers, possible acceleration of renovation and funding for infrastructure maintenance. The minister acknowledged the disruption, described the mitigation measures and the planning, and said compensation claims are assessed under existing policy, while maintenance funding gaps are for the next cabinet to address.
The design of the new clamps came about in 2017 from an expert meeting of Rijkswaterstaat with various contractors and engineering firms.
Het ontwerp van de nieuwe klemmen is in 2017 tot stand gekomen uit een expertmeeting van Rijkswaterstaat met verschillende aannemers en ingenieursbureaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over uitspraken van de landsadvocaat

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about remarks by the state advocate (landsadvocaat) on nitrogen policy, including whether he should be struck from the bar roll and whether the government intends to harm the farming sector. The minister replies that the state advocate gives objective expert advice which the cabinet weighs, that the government balances measures for farmers who stop and those who continue, and that it aims to keep a sustainable agricultural sector.
It is the task of the state advocate to advise objectively, on the basis of his expertise, when advice is requested.
Het is de taak van de landsadvocaat om, als advies wordt gevraagd, op basis van zijn deskundigheid objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over personeelstekort horeca

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the labour shortage in hospitality, including why unemployment remains high and what the government is doing to help the sector find staff. The minister answered that the government supports reintegration through employers' service points, municipal budgets, UWV campaigns and training for chef and restaurant roles, and that helping unemployed people into work is part of the approach for shortage sectors.
Yes, guiding people to work towards shortage occupations is therefore already part of the approach.
Ja, het begeleiden naar werk richting krapte(beroepen) is daarom al onderdeel van de aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bespioneren van burgers door ambtenaren

An MP asks the Interior Minister about municipal officials monitoring citizens' social media, including fake accounts, whether this is illegal, whether it is a police task, and when a ministry protocol will be available. The minister answers that monitoring occurs widely under GDPR limits enforced by the privacy authority, that a monitoring guidance document is expected by year end, and that municipalities bear primary responsibility for compliance.
Enforcement is carried out by the Dutch Data Protection Authority and can lead to fines.
Handhaving vindt door de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens plaats en kan tot boetes leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over “prullemanderen stikstofregels”

Rep. Van Haga asks the ministers about reports that shrinking the livestock sector would cost billions and jobs, and whether nitrogen rules are self-imposed and harm regional investment and the economy. The government replies that the nitrogen measures follow binding EU habitat law and Council of State rulings, that economic losses from shrinking sectors must be weighed against losses from inaction, and that it is working with regions on investment obstacles and a vestigingsklimaat (investment climate) agenda.

It therefore does not concern 'self-imposed nitrogen rules', but compliance with laws and regulations and following court rulings, as may be expected of a government within a state governed by the rule of law.

Het betreft derhalve geen «zelf opgelegde stikstofregels», maar het voldoen aan wet- en regelgeving en het volgen van rechtelijke uitspraken, zoals van een overheid binnen een rechtstaat verwacht mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over poging verdonkeremanen rapport homodiscriminatie.

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why a report on anti-gay discrimination in Amsterdam was sent to the city council months late, about its perpetrators being often young men of non-Dutch background, and whether a stronger signal should be sent to Amsterdam. The minister answered that anti-LHBTI violence must be tackled, that an action plan and an update of the perpetrator research are underway, and that the timing of the municipal report and the council's business are not for her to judge.
I, as Minister, do not decide on the timing of sending reports from a college of mayor and aldermen and on the interaction between the college and the municipal council.
Ik ga als Minister niet over de timing van het verzenden van rapporten van een college van B&W en de interactie tussen het college en de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over verkeerd afleveren van patiënten bij ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the minister why seriously injured trauma patients are often delivered to the wrong hospital and why the trauma centre volume norm is not met. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described triage protocols, training, an app under evaluation and planned discussions with stakeholders, but gave no firm timeline or binding commitments.

VWS will discuss with the National Network Acute Care, the Dutch Association of Hospitals, Ambulance Care Netherlands and Zorgverzekeraars Nederland which further improvements they will make in trauma patient care.

VWS zal met het Landelijk Netwerk Acute Zorg (LNAZ, dit netwerk coördineert landelijk de traumazorg), de Nederlandse Vereniging van Ziekenhuizen (NVZ), Ambulancezorg Nederland (AZN) en Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) bespreken welke verdere verbeteringen zij zullen gaan aanbrengen in de zorg voor traumapatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over materiële waardering voor veteranen

MP Van Haga asked the Defence Minister how far she is willing to investigate material recognition for veterans, such as discounts at municipal facilities like swimming pools and libraries. The minister pointed to the veterans card issued by NLVi, private-sector discounts via Stichting Onbekende Helden, and said she will explore with the VNG at the next consultation how local governments could increase material recognition.
At the next consultation I will explore the possibilities to increase material recognition for veterans from the local government.
Bij het eerstvolgende overleg zal ik de mogelijkheden verkennen om de materiële waardering voor veteranen te vergroten vanuit de lokale overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een ondernemer die van de Belastingdienst duizenden euro’s voor gezonde lunch voor werknemers moet (terug)betalen

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether it is acceptable that an entrepreneur must pay back tens of thousands of euros in tax on healthy lunches provided to staff, and what will be done to ease rules for such employers. The State Secretary said healthy meals are supported by tax rules, explained the meal valuation and free-space regime, and stated that existing law already allows favourable treatment of healthy meals.
Employers who want their staff to eat healthily are also supported in this with tax measures.
Werkgevers die personeel gezond willen laten eten worden hierin ook met belastingmaatregelen ondersteund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over invoeren prijsopdrijvende startersvrijstelling

An MP asks why the government introduced the first-time buyer exemption from transfer tax despite advice from officials and Dialogic reports warning of price effects and inefficiency, and why it did not consult the market. The State Secretary answers that the effect on house prices is too early to judge, that the final design differs from the studied variants, that the scheme was introduced quickly in line with a parliamentary motion, and that a 2024 evaluation will follow.
In 2024 the Act on differentiated transfer tax will be evaluated.
In 2024 zal de Wet differentiatie overdrachtsbelasting worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het missen van een huwelijksplechtigheid door coronamaatregelen

An MP asked the Justice Minister why a Colombian couple's wedding guests, including the bride's parents and brother-in-law, could not enter the Netherlands under the EU entry ban despite full vaccination and negative tests, and whether rules would be made more uniform and an exception granted. The minister confirmed the rules, said weddings are not an exception category and that Colombia's high-risk status blocks vaccinated travellers, and answered the final question only by reference to earlier answers.
Attending a wedding by (third-country national) parents or a brother-in-law does not fall under the exception categories for the entry ban.
Het bijwonen van een huwelijk door (derdelander) ouders of een zwager valt niet onder de uitzonderingscategorieën op het inreisverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ventileren overheidsgebouwen

An MP asked the government about ventilation in government buildings and schools, citing calls to air homes and school ventilation survey results showing only 38% compliance. The minister answered that most of the ~1,000 state buildings meet ventilation norms, outlined remedial measures, and described SUViS funding and ongoing work on a parliamentary motion for schools.
For the other (semi-)government buildings, the information is not centrally maintained.
Voor de overige (semi-) overheidsgebouwen wordt de informatie niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Kuik en Van Haga over de brief van 14 januari betreffende vrijwilligersreizen

Four MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development about orphanage tourism, development policy on orphan care, the UN Child Rights resolution, ANBI charity status rules, timelines for regulatory follow-up, and sector campaigns. The minister answered that orphan care is not a separate policy focus, that ANBI rules are neutral and offer no basis for extra checks, that further regulatory options will be decided in Q4 2021, and that the sector should self-organise with government in an information role.
Several ministries are currently examining which of the listed courses of action are realistic, desirable and feasible, and which concrete actions could be attached to them.
Er wordt momenteel met verschillende ministeries bezien welke van de genoemde handelingsperspectieven realistisch, wenselijk en haalbaar zijn en welke concrete acties hieraan verbonden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over toenemend antisemitisme

An MP asked the government about rising antisemitism, reports of Jewish emigration and bullying of Jewish pupils, and what it would do about them. The minister described existing and planned measures (a national antisemitism coordinator, EU strategy, school safety duties and inspectorate oversight) without committing to new concrete steps.
A school must be a safe environment for everyone.
Een school moet voor iedereen een veilige omgeving zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het lerarentekort

A Van Haga MP asks the education minister whether he will freeze the extra COVID catch-up money, draw up a teacher-shortage plan, and give bonuses to teachers in large cities and incentives for part-timers to go full-time. The minister answers that the money helps schools recover learning losses, that a labour-market allowance of EUR 375 million is planned, and that part-time incentives will be tested with results reported in autumn.
In spring 2022 I will inform you about the progress.
In het voorjaar van 2022 informeer ik u over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over vermeende sponsoring van terreurorganisaties

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch funds support Palestinian NGOs with alleged links to the PFLP and what checks exist to prevent terrorism financing. The minister replied that the Israeli information lacks concrete evidence for indirectly funded organisations, that Nederland has suspended UAWC funding and commissioned an external investigation, and that a government response will follow after the summer recess.

After it emerged that the salary of two suspects in a fatal bombing was partly paid from the Dutch contribution to UAWC's overhead costs, the Netherlands suspended funding to UAWC and commissioned an external investigation.

Nadat bleek dat het salaris van twee verdachten van een dodelijke bomaanslag deels betaald werd uit de Nederlandse bijdrage aan de overheadkosten van UAWC, heeft Nederland de financiering aan UAWC opgeschort en een extern onderzoek ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over winkelstraten

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate what the government is doing to keep shopping streets viable, including financial support for retailers, spatial planning guidelines, and an action plan. The state secretary pointed to the Retailagenda platform, a 100 million euro Impulsaanpak for shopping areas, a shift back to normal retail conditions after COVID support, and an approach that leaves specific measures to local actors rather than issuing general guidelines or an action plan.
The instruments of spatial planning play an important role in preventing "Swiss cheese scenarios" in shopping streets.
Het instrumentarium op het gebied van ruimtelijke ordening speelt een belangrijke rol bij het voorkomen van «gatenkaasscenario’s» in winkelstraten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving rondom de Fauci-mails

An MP asked the Health Minister about reports from released Fauci emails suggesting early consideration of a Wuhan lab leak, the role of Dutch virologist Marion Koopmans, and whether her work on OMT and the Health Council should be suspended. The minister said the lab-leak hypothesis was a legitimate scientific question, that publication of the emails and related advice constitutes transparency, and that he sees no reason to suspend Koopmans.
I see no reason whatsoever for what you request, and I would like to take this opportunity to express my explicit support for Professor Koopmans and other scientists.
Ik zie geen enkele aanleiding voor het door u gevraagde en ik wil graag van de gelegenheid gebruik maken om mijn expliciete steun uit te spreken voor professor Koopmans en andere wetenschappers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Houwelingen en Van Haga over de succesvolle toepassing van Ivermectine, het mogelijk beperkte effect van vaccineren en de prijs van uitgestelde zorg

MPs asked the minister about reported success of ivermectin for COVID-19, why GPs do not prescribe it, customs seizures, the threatened fine for off-label prescribing, trends in ICU admissions and deaths, and years of life lost from postponed non-COVID care. The minister answered that studies are for professional bodies to assess, that customs seizures follow the lack of licence, that fines follow the off-label rules, and that a reliable estimate of lost life-years is not possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over nieuwe Europese wetgeving, die een bedreiging vormt voor Nederlandse garnalenvissers

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how she would respond to a European Parliament resolution that could ban bottom trawling and threaten Dutch shrimp fishers, and how to inform MEPs better. The minister answered that the resolution is a non-binding call, that the Noordzee Akkoord guides her position, and that a shrimp vision is being developed with the sector, but declined to influence the independent European Parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het gebruik van Ivermectine bij de behandeling van COVID-19

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health whether ivermectin should be used off-label for COVID-19 patients, citing studies and foreign protocols, and whether doctors could be allowed to prescribe it despite a fine. The Minister replied that evaluating the studies is for medical specialists, that off-label use outside research is currently not permitted given the lack of evidence and the NHG, SWAB and EMA advice against it, and that the decision lies with the treating doctor within legal limits.
No, this is not permitted unless there is a clinical study.
Nee, dit is niet toegestaan tenzij er sprake is van een klinische studie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het munitietekort van militairen

Van Haga asks whether the defence ammunition budget for training falls structurally from 140 to 80 million euro from 2023, what the consequences are, and how training quality, staff morale and vacancies (over 9,000) will be safeguarded. The State Secretary says there is no structural cut, that a 40 million euro top-up is used for 2020-2022 with a structural fix still being sought, and that vacancies and HR measures are addressed in a separate letter.
To fully solve the mismatch structurally, further steps will be considered depending on the room in the Defence budget.
Om de volledige mismatch structureel op te lossen, worden afhankelijk van de ruimte op de Defensiebegroting, verdere stappen bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over sneltesten middels de QuBA

Rep. Van Haga asked the Health Minister about the validation status and timeline of the Quick Breath Analyzer (QuBA) rapid COVID test, and who may validate it. The minister said the ministry is not involved in validation, that validation is time-consuming and the manufacturer is responsible, that IGJ supervises but does not validate, and that WHO antigen criteria are used in NL but do not apply to QuBA.
The Ministry of VWS is not involved in the validation of the Quick Breath Analyzer.
Het Ministerie van VWS is niet betrokken bij de validatie van de Quick Breath Analyzer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verplichte vaccinatie voor militairen

An MP from FvD asked the Defence Minister whether COVID-19 vaccination is on the list of compulsory military vaccinations, whether refusal leads to dismissal, and whether there will be compulsion. The State Secretary answered that a temporary scheme allows mandatory COVID-19 vaccination only for deployments abroad, decided per deployment on expert advice, with exemption procedures and no dismissal, only non-deployability.
For each service deployment abroad a separate decision is taken, based on expert advice.
Per dienstverrichting in het buitenland wordt een afzonderlijk besluit genomen, op basis van deskundig advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over “het advies van het Veiligheidsberaad met betrekking tot het openen van de terrassen met Pasen”

Van Haga asked the Justice Minister why the unanimous advice of the 25 safety regions to open terraces at Easter was not adopted, and requested OMT advice and modelling. Minister Grapperhaus explained that the cabinet weighed multiple advices, postponed loosening after R-number and hospital figures did not stabilise, and referred to already-published OMT advices, with partial terrace opening later allowed under conditions.
All OMT advices are public and are being presented to your House.
Alle adviezen van het OMT zijn openbaar en worden aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het inreisverbod vanuit landen buiten Europa, en dan met name Zuid-Afrika

An MP from FvD asked the Justice Minister whether travel bans from outside Europe, particularly South Africa, apply equally to all countries, why the UK ban was lifted, and why family and long-distance partner visits are treated differently. The government explained the EU entry ban plus the national flight ban for listed countries including South Africa, the advice behind lifting the UK flight ban, and that family visits qualify for exceptions only under the EU ban, not the flight ban.
The flight ban is a supplementary measure and was introduced for countries where VOCs, including the South African variant, occur more often than in the Netherlands.
Het vliegverbod is een aanvullende maatregel en is ingesteld voor landen waar VOCs, waaronder de Zuid-Afrikaanse variant, meer voorkomen dan in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de mondkapjesverplichting voor kinderen

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Health about the scientific basis, proportionality and harms of the mask requirement for children, citing a court ruling and studies on infections and child wellbeing. The Minister answers that the measures follow WHO, ECDC and OMT advice, that the requirement applies only in secondary schools and only briefly, and that exemptions exist for those who cannot wear masks.
I therefore see no reason to lift the mask requirement immediately.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om de mondkapjesverplichting onmiddellijk op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over buitensporig geweld door politie en ME bij demonstraties

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice about anonymous BPOC2020 interview transcripts with police officers and about alleged excessive force by police and ME riot units against peaceful demonstrators, asking who is ultimately responsible. The Minister acknowledged the interviews but said their source and validity cannot be established, declined to judge the force used (a matter for other authorities or the courts), explained the statutory safeguards and the mayor's and police chief's responsibilities, and said he is politically responsible for police functioning.
It is for other authorities, where appropriate the courts, to make that assessment.
Het is aan andere autoriteiten – in voorkomende gevallen de rechter – om die beoordeling te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Houwelingen en Van Haga over het vrijwillig laten vaccineren van mantelzorgers en de (geestelijk) gehandicapte personen die zij verzorgen

MPs Van Houwelingen and Van Haga asked why family caregivers are not given priority COVID-19 vaccination like care workers, and whether caregivers authorised to act for mentally disabled persons should decide on their charges' vaccination. Minister De Jonge answered that vaccination follows age and medical risk on Gezondheidsraad advice, and that a legal representative, never the caregiver, decides for incapable clients.
No, when a client is incapable of making such decisions, there is a legal representative who makes these decisions for the client.
Nee, op het moment dat een cliënt wilsonbekwaam ter zake is voor dergelijke beslissingen, is er een wettelijk vertegenwoordiger die deze beslissingen voor de cliënt neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het gebruik van het middel ivermectine tegen COVID-19

An MP from the FvD asked the Minister of Health about recent studies suggesting ivermectin reduces COVID-19 hospitalisation, infection and mortality, and what the government has done to investigate it. The Minister said the SWAB currently advises against ivermectin on the basis of available evidence, that ZonMw has not funded ivermectin studies, and that vaccination remains preferable because the measures and treatments serve different purposes.
However, it is not for me to interpret these studies, but for medical scientific specialists.
Het is evenwel niet aan mij om deze studies te duiden, maar aan medisch wetenschappelijke specialisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over PLEV’s

Van Haga (FvD) asked the minister about legalising personal light electric vehicles (PLEVs) such as e-steps, including the choice of the German over the Belgian model, safety, public transport use and the TNO study. The minister answered that the Dutch approval framework follows the German model for safety reasons, that PLEVs get a separate, evaluated approval route, and that a new framework will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
Before the summer recess, the elaborated policy framework will be sent to your House.
Vóór het zomerreces zal het uitgewerkte beleidskader naar uw Kamer worden verstuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Bisschop, Madlener en Van Haga over het schrappen van artikel 8b uit het Besluit gebruik meststoffen ter uitvoering van het zesde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

MPs from VVD, CDA, SGP, PVV and FvD asked whether the minister would drop article 8b of the manure decree (requiring drempels between potato ridges on clay and loess soils), citing hindrance to integrated cultivation and conflicting research findings. The minister answered that the article cannot be amended after publication, so it will be excluded from entry into force by royal decree, while stating that nutrient runoff measures remain important for the seventh action programme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de mogelijke terugtrekking van de Corman-Drosten paper inzake de PCR-test

An MP from FvD asked the Health Minister whether the Corman-Drosten PCR paper, used as basis for SARS-CoV-2 test kits, should be retracted following a peer-review challenge, and whether RIVM should respond and testing policy should change. The minister acknowledged the critique, said the journal is conducting its own independent review and that he awaits its outcome, and rejected the calls to change testing policy.
Via RIVM I understand that the journal is currently conducting its own independent research to see whether the criticism is justified.
Via het RIVM heb ik begrepen dat het tijdschrift momenteel haar eigen onafhankelijk onderzoek verricht om te bezien of de kritiek terecht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de gewijzigde criteria bij het beoordelen van een PCR-test

Van Haga asked the health minister whether changed PCR test assessment criteria (fragment targets and cycle threshold raised from 30 to 35) explain the rise in positive tests, why changes were not communicated, and whether this distorts the data. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter ('Gewijzigde criteria PCR-test', Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 765) and provides a footnote link to the RIVM guideline, without answering the questions on substance.

Further answer: the written questions from MP Van Haga (FvD) to the Minister of Health on the changed criteria for assessing a PCR test (submitted 13 October 2020) have been answered by letter 'Changed PCR test criteria' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 765).

Nader antwoord De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Van Haga (FvD) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gewijzigde criteria bij het beoordelen van een PCR-test (ingezonden 13 oktober 2020) ( 2020Z18662 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Gewijzigde criteria PCR-test» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 765 ) X
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de betalingen voor de Jongeren Corona campagne van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport aan diverse artiesten

An MP asked the Health Minister about a EUR 66,574 invoice paid to an advertising agency for a youth COVID campaign using rapper Boef and Famke Louise, whether the fees were excessive, and whether there was a conflict of interest linked to Ali B's later video. The minister defended the use of artists for reaching youth, said the fees were lower than typical for their reach, and denied any conflict of interest because he was not involved in contracting.
Neither in the request to Roorda by the NKC, nor in Roorda's proposal to deploy these artists, nor in the contract negotiations was I involved.
Noch bij de uitvraag aan Roorda door het NKC, noch bij het voorstel om deze artiesten in te zetten door Roorda, noch bij de contractonderhandelingen ben ik betrokken geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de classificatie van COVID-19 en aanverwante vragen

An MP asked the health minister about the case fatality and infection fatality rates of COVID-19 versus influenza, its A-class classification, the 1.5-metre distancing rule and the PCR test validity. The minister answered with figures, explained that the CFR difference reflects changed testing policy, kept the A-classification and gave the rationale for 1.5 metres, while withholding some model data by referring to the RIVM website.
I see no reason to change the classification of COVID-19 at this time.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de classificatie van COVID-19 op dit moment aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Baudet over het opgelaaide conflict in Nagorno-Karabach

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Nagorno-Karabakh escalation, including Turkish involvement, Syrian fighters, Turkish President Erdogan's rhetoric and possible sanctions. The minister declined to attribute responsibility yet, called for de-escalation via the OSCE Minsk Group, said Turkey's military involvement was very likely and that Syrian fighters were confirmed, and ruled out sanctions for now.
At this moment the cabinet makes no statements on attribution; the facts must first be established.
Op dit moment doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over attributie, daarvoor moeten de feiten eerst vaststaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de huidige visie van het kabinet op het gebruik van hydroxychloroquine in de strijd tegen COVID-19

Two MPs asked the minister about a Dutch study reporting reduced ICU admission with early hydroxychloroquine and whether the government will keep hydroxychloroquine available and follow up on the findings. The minister answered that the government will leave the judgement on hydroxychloroquine to experts, monitor developments and keep supply under review, and that an advisory panel will assess further research.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) over de polymerase chain reaction-test (PCR-test)

The MP asks the Minister of Health to provide substantive answers to 14 questions on the PCR test, after a brief earlier reply was judged insufficient. The Minister refers the MP to a separate letter on the COVID-19 situation, which has answered the questions, and points to the earlier related questions.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Status update letter COVID-19'
zijn beantwoord middels brief «Stand van zaken brief COVID-19»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) over fout-positieve uitslagen van de PCR-testen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about news reports of possibly hundreds of false-positive PCR test results per week, and whether this affects case statistics and the corona measures. The answer, given by referring to a separate letter on the state of COVID-19, does not address the questions on substance and provides no new information in this document.
The written questions from MP Van Haga to the Minister of Health on false-positive PCR test results have been answered by means of the letter 'State of affairs letter COVID-19'.

De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over fout-positieve uitslagen van de PCR-testen ( 2020Z16256 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Stand van zaken brief COVID-19»
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) over testmethodes voor COVID-19

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the status, accuracy (false positives and negatives), costs and use of antigen, serological and PCR COVID-19 tests. The Minister's answer refers the questions to a separate letter on the COVID-19 situation (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 656) rather than answering them directly.
The written questions from MP Van Haga to the Minister of Health on COVID-19 test methods (2020Z16247) have been answered by means of the letter 'Status update letter COVID-19'.

De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over testmethodes voor COVID-19 ( 2020Z16247 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Stand van zaken brief COVID-19»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Baudet over hydroxychloroquine

Two MPs (Van Haga and Baudet) asked the health minister about the status of national hydroxychloroquine trials for COVID-19 after the Lancet paper was retracted, and why no extra efforts were made to keep the drug available for early use. The minister said inclusion in the trials was stopped, that there is still no objective reason for extra efforts, and that interpreting clinical research is for experts.
It is for experts to interpret clinical research.
Het is aan de deskundigen om klinisch onderzoek te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aanpassing van de Drank- en Horecawet

Van Haga asked the State Secretary for Health whether the planned 1 January 2021 start of the amended Drank- en Horecawet is too early given the lead time needed for discount campaigns, and why the NVWA would publish its enforcement policy only one month before entry into force. The State Secretary answered that he will consult retailers and producers on a reasonable transition period and that the NVWA publishes enforcement policy at latest one month ahead, since enforcement details should not affect campaign preparation.
I will continue the discussion with them over what such a period could be in the coming month.
Ik zal het gesprek met hen over wat een dergelijke termijn zou kunnen zijn, daarom in de komende maand voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het rapport 'Nitrogen deposition and ammonia concentrations in the Dwingelderveld as affected by surrounding dairy farms'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a study claiming ammonia deposition near Dwingelderveld is overestimated by OPS model, and what consequences it has for policy. The minister disagreed that deposition ends at 400 metres, argued OPS is suitable locally and already includes a crop compensation point, and said the report gives no reason to revise the structural nitrogen approach.
The report by Mr Santing gives no reason to revise the policy on this.
Het rapport van dhr. Santing biedt geen aanleiding om het beleid hierop te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de tijdens de persconferentie de dato 6 augustus 2020 aangekondigde aanvullende maatregelen voor studenten en studieverenigingen

Van Haga asks why introduction activities of general student associations are restricted differently from those of study and sports associations, and why the risk differs. The Minister explains the measures were set to limit infection among young people, and after consultation with the safety regions general student associations were later allowed small-scale activities under strict conditions.
After consultation with the Security Council on 17 August, it was decided to also give student associations the opportunity to organise small-scale physical introduction gatherings.
Na overleg met het Veiligheidsberaad op 17 augustus jl. is besloten om ook studentenverenigingen de gelegenheid te geven om kleinschalige fysieke introductiebijeenkomsten te organiseren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga inzake de polymerase chain reaction-test (PCR-test)

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the reliability of PCR tests for COVID-19, including false positives, detection of old viral fragments, and whether positive results should be treated as infection, across 14 questions. The minister answered by letter, referring to the government's broader testing and tracing strategy rather than answering each question individually.

The written questions from MP Van Haga to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (submitted 18 August 2020) have been answered by letter 'Testing and tracing: jointly tackling the Corona pandemic strategically' (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 510).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (ingezonden 18 augustus 2020) zijn beantwoord middels brief » Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 510 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Haga over het bericht dat een man die de dochter van een columnist bedreigde een taakstraf van twintig uur kreeg opgelegd

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Haga asked whether a light community service sentence for threatening a columnist's daughter with rape and murder was acceptable and whether the OM's threat guideline should be tightened. Minister Grapperhaus answered that such threats are unacceptable, that sentencing is for the prosecutor and judge, and that the existing OM guideline and LOVS orientation points already allow higher sentences for aggravating factors, without committing to revise them.
Whether there is reason to impose a sentence in a particular case and, if so, which one, is determined by the public prosecutor or by the judge.
Of er in een bepaald geval aanleiding is om een straf op te leggen en zo ja, welke, wordt bepaald door de officier van justitie of door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen lid Van Haga over de uitvoering van de aangenomen motie Van Haga / Hiddema inzake duidelijkheid voor de dansscholen

An MP asked the Minister of Health how the adopted motion on clarity for dance schools would be implemented, why sports gyms could reopen while dance schools could not, and whether dance schools could restart on 1 July 2020. The minister answered that the motion was already settled through the 1 July loosening decision, that dance schools fall under indoor sport which was permitted again from 1 July, and that earlier outdoor lessons had been possible.
Indoor sports were not permitted until 1 July, so this also applied to gyms.
Binnensporten was tot 1 juli niet toegestaan, dus ook niet voor sportscholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitvoering van de aangenomen motie inzake geen coronaboetes voor studenten in hun eigen studentenhuis

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how he would implement the adopted motion that students should not receive corona fines for group gatherings in their own student house, whether already issued fines would be reversed, and whether the definition of a shared household should be regulated nationally. The minister answered that the emergency ordinance now explicitly limits the group-gathering ban to public spaces, that fined persons can contest the penalty order before a judge, and that the definition will be addressed in forthcoming legislation.
If someone believes a fine was wrongly imposed for group gathering outside the public space, that person can object to the OM penalty order before the judge.
Als men van mening is dat ten onrechte een boete is opgelegd voor groepsvorming buiten de publieke ruimte, dan kan de betrokkene tegen de opgelegde OM-strafbeschikking in verzet gaan bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het voorgenomen uitstel van nieuwe btw-regels voor e-commerce van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the government about the EU proposal to postpone new VAT e-commerce rules, which would delay VAT on low-value parcels from outside the EU, and whether Nederland would contest this and restore the level playing field. The government confirmed the postponement, said Nederland is not ready for 1 January 2021 and benefits from delay, and gave no concrete commitment to change the EU timetable.
For these reasons, the Netherlands benefits from the proposed postponement.
Nederland is dan ook om die redenen gebaat bij het voorgestelde uitstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Haga over hydroxychloroquine

MPs Baudet and Van Haga asked the health minister about Dutch research on hydroxychloroquine for COVID-19, stockpiling, international cooperation, the minister's 'quackery motion' remark, and reports of prescribing abroad. The minister replied that Dutch trials were paused after a Lancet study, that SWAB and CBG advise against first-line use since efficacy is unproven and risks exist, that about 17,000 packs were secured for hospitals, and that the motion was rightly characterised.
I will closely monitor developments in order to, in consultation with parties across the whole medicines chain, take additional efforts where necessary.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen om in overleg met de partijen in de gehele geneesmiddelenketen 5 waar nodig over te gaan tot extra inspanningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het artikel 3:305a BW

MP Van Haga asks the Minister for Legal Protection about article 3:305a of the Dutch Civil Code (collective actions by foundations and associations), including representativeness, democratic legitimacy of judges, and the Urgenda case. The Minister replies that representativeness has been an explicit admissibility requirement since 1 January 2020, that judges applying law do not assess what is 'in the interest of' the population, and that the Urgenda implications will be reported to the House later.
The collective action right as anchored in article 3:305a BW I consider a useful and meaningful element of our legal system.
Het collectief actierecht zoals dat is verankerd in artikel 3:305a BW acht ik een nuttig en zinvol element van ons rechtssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het kraakbeleid

An MP asks the Justice Minister why police did not intervene during a squatting of a house on Stadhouderskade in Amsterdam, whether Amsterdam is ignoring the squatting ban, and what the national government will do. The minister answers that local police priorities are for the local triangle, that Amsterdam denies any standing instruction not to intervene, that there is no basis for national intervention, and that Amsterdam has tightened enforcement.
It is further up to the local triangle whether and to what extent the police act when a property is or has been squatted.
Het is verder aan de lokale driehoek, of en in hoeverre de politie optreedt wanneer een pand gekraakt is of wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitvoering van de aangenomen motie inzake de verruiming van de verliesverrekening van de Vpb

MP Van Haga asked how and when the adopted motion to extend corporate tax loss carry-back and carry-forward periods would be implemented, and which tax year would be first affected. Staatssecretaris Vijlbrief answered that the government instead introduced a fiscal corona reserve in the Besluit noodmaatregelen, to be legislated in Belastingplan 2021, and sees no reason for now to extend the loss-offset periods because they do not quickly improve liquidity.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlanders in Marokko in het licht van de pandemie

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how many Dutch citizens remain stranded in Morocco, why Morocco is refusing repatriation, what pressure the government applies, and what the EU and other member states are doing. The minister answered that over 1000 are registered, four special repatriation flights and some ambulance flights have taken place, Morocco cooperates on urgent cases, and the government continues to press for repatriation within EU coordination.
The aim of the Netherlands is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de huidige betrekkingen tussen Nederland en Taiwan

An MP asked the minister about Netherlands-Taiwan investment levels, sector breakdown, support for Taiwan, a supposed EU-Taiwan investment agreement, Chinese pressure, and why the Trade Agenda lacks separate attention to Taiwan. The minister confirmed the investment figures, said there is no EU-Taiwan investment agreement or negotiation, and stated the government remains committed to its one-China policy and monitors Chinese pressure.
There is no bilateral investment agreement between the EU and Taiwan, and no negotiations on such an agreement are taking place.
Er is geen bilaterale investeringsovereenkomst tussen de EU en Taiwan en er wordt ook niet onderhandeld over een dergelijke overeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Van Dam en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Overheid sponsort eigen verzet’

MPs asked whether government-subsidised legal aid for environmental and other organisations suing the state, including squatter-type groups, is appropriate and whether the practice is being evaluated. The minister answered that subsidised legal aid can cover administrative cases, that stacking of procedures is possible but no business model is evident, that eligibility rules apply, and that the long-overdue evaluation of the reduced environmental-organisation contribution will be shared with parliament in the first half of 2020.
This evaluation, however, never took place and is now being carried out after all.
Deze evaluatie heeft evenwel nooit plaatsgevonden en wordt nu alsnog uitgevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de vrijwaringsmaatregelen op walsdraadstaal

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the EU's revised steel safeguard quota that lowered the progressive quota increase for wire rod from 5% to 3%, and its effects on Dutch firms, asking whether the matter could be taken to the competition commissioner and what the effects were. The Minister confirmed the vote and the change applying to all 26 steel categories, referred the Chamber to the comitology register for the meeting minutes, justified the safeguards as a balance between steel producers and steel users, pointed companies to the competition directorate, and said the Commission will review the effects next year.
I therefore refer you to that register.
Ik verwijs u derhalve naar dat register.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over het aanstaande Buitengewone Congres van de Wereldpostunie

MPs Weverling and Van Haga asked the state secretary about the extraordinary UPU congress, US threats to withdraw over postal terminal dues, Dutch and EU positions, and consequences of a US exit. The government confirmed attendance, said the Netherlands supports reform of the terminal dues system with gradual change, and answered most questions substantively while declining to endorse US proposals and disputing the Economic Report's characterization of Dutch positions.
I refer you for the answer to my extensive response of 20 September on questions 11 and 12 of the questions on the same subject of 27 June.
Ik verwijs u voor het antwoord naar mijn uitgebreide reactie van 20 september jl. op de vragen 11 en 12 van de vragen over hetzelfde onderwerp van 27 juni jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over de verkoop en distributie van pakketjes door Alibaba in Nederland

VVD MPs Weverling and Van Haga asked the government about Alibaba/AliExpress parcel distribution, unfair competition from China, Universal Postal Union tariffs and US proposals. The State Secretary answered at length, largely defending the 2016 tariff reform and EU/WTO tools, while withholding PostNL commercial figures as confidential.
Information about commercial agreements between parties is confidential, and making it public would harm PostNL's international competitive position.
Informatie over commerciële afspraken tussen partijen zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en het publiek maken daarvan zou de internationale concurrentiepositie van PostNL schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Haga over het opschorten van de hulp aan UNRWA

MPs Voordewind and Van Haga asked whether the UNRWA leadership should be replaced and whether Dutch payments should resume only after the ethics investigation, citing alleged misconduct, nepotism and procurement bypassing. Minister Kaag replied that Dutch funding is suspended pending the UN's independent inspection, that payments will require the usual preconditions, and that the government will not pre-empt the UN findings or the outcome on the Commissioner-General.
It is up to the UN to provide clarity and to act adequately.
Het is aan de VN om opheldering te geven en toereikend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over het kabinetsbeleid ten aanzien van de defensie-industrie

MPs Van Haga and Bosman ask the government to reconcile its support for the domestic defence industry with its strict arms-export policy and with the FMO exclusion list that bars firms earning 10% or more from weapons from trade-promotion and financing instruments such as DTIF. The ministers confirm the policy tension, state that generic trade instruments are now open to defence firms, and say the government will review remaining aspects of defence trade support by Prinsjesdag 2019 while denying any intent to penalise the sector.
At present, however, the cabinet is considering whether trade support for the defence sector can be adjusted on this point in light of the DIS.
Op dit moment beziet het kabinet echter of de handelsinzet voor de defensiesector op dit punt in het licht van de DIS kan worden aangepast
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over de impact van het eenzijdig aangescherpte wapenexportbeleid voor de concurrentiepositie van de Nederlandse defensie-industrie

MPs Van Haga and Bosman asked about the impact of the Dutch tightened arms export policy toward the UAE, Egypt and Saudi Arabia on the competitiveness of the Dutch defence industry, including comparisons with German, French, Spanish and Czech practice, the Dutch military presence in the UAE, and whether defence firms can join trade missions. The government answered that the Netherlands is not acting alone since Germany and Finland also restricted exports, that the policy is justified by international obligations and humanitarian law, and that it regrets the negative effects on Dutch defence firms while pursuing harmonisation within the EU and opening trade missions to defence firms.
Arms export control is a national competence. EU member states are themselves responsible for assessing arms export applications against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position on arms exports.

Wapenexportcontrole is een nationale bevoegdheid. EU-lidstaten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de toetsing van wapenexportaanvragen aan de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Malmström – Finalizing Mercosur deal is ‘priority number one’

MPs Lodders and Van Haga asked about the state of the EU-Mercosur trade negotiations, the urgency of concluding them, whether farm and chemical standards would be weakened, and what concessions on agriculture were on the table. The ministers answered that a political agreement had been reached, that EU standards will not be lowered, that the cabinet will assess the balance once consolidated texts are available, and that they would not disclose other ministers' reactions.
Once the consolidated texts become available, the cabinet can assess the balance of the advantages and disadvantages of the trade agreement for the Netherlands.
Als de geconsolideerde teksten beschikbaar komen, kan het kabinet de balans op te maken van de voor- en nadelen van het handelsakkoord voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Haga over het bericht 'Chinese webgigant AliExpress in strijd met Europese regels'

Two MPs asked whether AliExpress's terms breach Dutch and EU consumer rules, what the government will do to protect Dutch consumers buying from non-EU sellers, and why China strategy omitted this. The Secretary of State said enforcement lies with the ACM and courts, outlined EU cooperation, WTO e-commerce talks, product safety pledges, and an awareness campaign, and argued the share of purchases from Chinese webshops is still small.

It is up to the supervisory authority Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) and the courts to assess whether a company complies with the consumer rules in force in Europe and the Netherlands and, if not, which rules have been breached.

Het is aan de toezichthouder Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) en de rechter om te beoordelen of een bedrijf zich aan de in Europa en Nederland geldende consumentenregels houdt en zo nee, welke regels zijn overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Lodders over haar bewering dat gebonden hulp verleden tijd is

MPs Van Haga and Lodders asked the minister about her claim that tied aid is a thing of the past, including notification obligations, transaction-level data on tied aid notifications, and ODA tied/untied breakdowns. The minister confirmed the claim, explained OECD notification rules, withheld transaction-level notification data as confidential under the Arrangement but offered aggregated figures, and stated the government supports untied aid while still promoting Dutch firms where they have a comparative advantage.
However, I offer you non-traceable, aggregated data regarding questions 3d and 3e, which gives an impression of the scale of this trade-related tied aid.
Wel bied ik u met betrekking tot de vragen 3d en 3e niet herleidbare, geaggregeerde data aan, waarmee een beeld ontstaat van de omvang van deze handelsgerelateerde gebonden hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Wise persons' to scrutinize EU development finance’

An MP asked the minister about an EU High-Level Group of Wise Persons scrutinizing EU development finance architecture, including fragmentation and China's role. The minister said the group will assess EU external investment architecture and that Nederland will use its recommendations in negotiations on the EFSD+, and promised to inform parliament of the conclusions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over de verkoop en distributie van pakketjes door Alibaba in Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister for Foreign Trade about cheap Alibaba parcels shipped to the Netherlands, counterfeit goods, postal delivery fee rules under the Universal Postal Union, and the risk of unfair competition from China. The government answered at length, stating that many details are commercially confidential, that the postal fee system is being phased toward parity, that the US threat to leave the UPU is being addressed multilaterally, and that China trade issues will be pursued via the WTO and the new China strategy.
This concerns commercially sensitive and confidential business information.
Dit betreft commercieel gevoelige en bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over de gevolgen van Braziliaans landbouwbeleid voor Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the agriculture and trade ministers about the effects of Brazil's farm policy under Bolsonaro, including deforestation, approval of 120 chemicals banned in the EU, residue controls on Brazilian imports, and the Dutch sugar beet seed derogation. The minister acknowledged concerns, said the Netherlands is raising them with Brazil and at EU level, noted that residue monitoring shows no reason for extra controls, and defended the refusal of a neonicotinoid derogation while confirming a temporary alternative pesticide exemption.
