The Netherlands is intensifying dialogue with the Brazilian government on agriculture and climate, to convey our concerns on the one hand
Nederland is de dialoog met de Braziliaanse overheid op het gebied van landbouw en klimaat aan het intensiveren, om aan de ene kant onze zorgen over te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Europa pakt Oekraïense kippenvleesexport aan’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that the EU was tackling Ukrainian chicken meat exports, including how a quota increase from 20,000 to 70,000 tonnes fits with the removal of duties on chicken parts and whether a provisional application of the Association Agreement amendment should proceed before European Parliament consent. The minister explained that Ukrainian exporters exploited an unforeseen tariff loophole, that renegotiation is underway and requires Council and European Parliament approval, and that the government will assess the Commission's proposal and raise concerns about the quota and SPS/animal welfare implementation.
In anticipation, the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality sent a letter on 25 April 2019 to Commissioner Hogan expressing concerns about the provisional outcome of the negotiations.

Vooruitlopend hierop heeft de Minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit op 25 april 2019 een brief aan Commissaris Hogan gestuurd waarin zorgen worden geuit over de voorlopige uitkomst van de onderhandelingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Haga over de miljardendeals van Frankrijk met China

MPs Koopmans and Van Haga asked the government about Italy's and Luxembourg's signing of China's Belt and Road memoranda and whether this undermines a common EU China policy and screening of Chinese investment. The minister answered that member states may maintain bilateral ties, that the EU investment screening regulation enters into force on 19 April, and that member states remain committed to EU-level consensus on China.
EU member states are free to maintain bilateral relations with China, as the Netherlands also does.
Het staat EU-lidstaten vrij bilaterale relaties te onderhouden met China, dat doet Nederland ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de mate waarin China profiteert van Europese ontwikkelingsgelden

Van Haga asks the minister whether China benefits from European development aid, citing a DAC report showing Chinese firms win a significant share of tenders and questioning the claim that Chinese firms have no access to EU aid funds. The minister answers that Chinese parties generally lack direct access to EU external-action instruments, that indirect management can allow wider participation, and that exact tender data and World Bank/ADB loan figures are provided or not centrally available.
I cannot provide the Chamber with such an overview.
Ik kan de Kamer geen dergelijk overzicht doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en van Haga over de berichten ‘Limburg genoemd als locatie voor megadistributiecentrum van Chinese webwinkelreus Alibaba’ en 'Rutte wil Alibaba binnenhalen, maar douane is e-com

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the growing role of online retail, the possible Alibaba distribution centre in the Benelux, cross-border goods flows, customs and product-safety gaps for non-EU online sellers. The government answered that data on cross-border flows is largely unavailable, customs and market supervisors already control non-EU imports, and it is pushing in EU negotiations for an EU-based contact point for third-country online sellers.
No figures are known on this, and well-founded estimates cannot be given.
Hierover zijn geen cijfers bekend, en goed onderbouwde schattingen zijn niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een malversatie in een Nederlands ontwikkelingsprogramma in Tanzania

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation about a proven embezzlement in a Dutch-funded infrastructure programme in Tanzania, including why it was detected late, recovery of damages, prior cases and remaining Dutch projects. The minister answered that the programme's installations are being completed under an action plan with partial recovery, that the Tanzanian anti-corruption investigation is ongoing, and that the Dutch government has no bilateral programmes there but still has thematic ones.
Parliament is informed in an annex to the departmental annual report about proven cases of embezzlement and the sanctions imposed.
Het parlement wordt in een bijlage bij het departementale jaarverslag geïnformeerd over bewezen gevallen van malversaties en de daarbij getroffen sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over de modernisering van de ODA-definitie en de toerekening van hulp voor de Nederlandse Bovenwindse eilanden aan ODA

MPs Van Haga and Bosman asked whether the UK's push to count disaster aid to richer territories as ODA could apply to the Dutch Caribbean islands, and why the Netherlands opposed the UK proposal. The minister answered that Saba, Sint Eustatius and Sint Maarten cannot count as ODA because they are not on the DAC list, and that the Netherlands opposes raising the income threshold while DAC support for the UK proposal is negligible.
Saba and Sint Eustatius are, as special municipalities, part of the Dutch state.
Saba en Sint-Eustatius zijn – als bijzondere gemeenten – onderdeel van de staat Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de felle kritiek van de Europese Rekenkamer op het EU-noodfonds voor Afrika

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the European Court of Auditors' criticism of the EU emergency trust fund for Africa, including its lack of focus, weak implementation, difficulty measuring results, Dutch contributions and complementarity with bilateral efforts. The minister acknowledged the criticism, pointed to planned focus shifts, monitoring and a 2019 evaluation, reported results and a Dutch contribution of EUR 26.4 million, and described coordination with EU partners.
The cabinet will urge the European Commission to apply these recommendations as well as possible.
Het kabinet zal er bij de Europese Commissie op aandringen dat deze aanbevelingen zo goed als mogelijk worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het schenden van oorlogsgraven in de Waddenzee en de Noordzee

An MP asked the Defence and Culture ministers about looting of WWI-era war wrecks (British submarines E3 and E5, German cruiser SMS Mainz) in the Wadden Sea and North Sea and how these war graves are registered and protected. The government answered that protection is hard to guarantee at sea, described the stricter Heritage Act rules and a planned UNESCO convention, and promised to restate existing agreements to divers and deepen cooperation.
For war wrecks of foreign warships found in Dutch waters, including HMS E3 and HMS E5, the Netherlands does not structurally search for relatives of the crew members who died on those ships.

Ten aanzien van in Nederlandse wateren aangetroffen oorlogswrakken van buitenlandse oorlogsschepen, waaronder ook HMS E3 en HMS E5, wordt niet structureel vanuit Nederland gezocht naar nabestaanden van op die schepen omgekomen bemanningsleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitzending ‘2Doc: liever dood dan vermist’

MP Van Haga asks ministers about a documentary on unrecovered WWII aircraft wrecks, including the municipal discretion over salvage, cost sharing, and calls for harmonisation. The government acknowledges the emotional concerns, defends municipal discretion on safety and public order grounds, notes a 70% Rijk contribution and a working group on a decision framework, but does not change the rules.
The national government is willing to contribute to harmonising municipal policy.
Het Rijk is bereid een bijdrage te leveren aan het harmoniseren van het gemeentelijk beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Belhaj over fraude met oorlogswrakken in de Java-zee

Two MPs (Van Haga and Belhaj) asked ministers of Defence and Education, Culture and Science about reports of illegal salvage of Dutch WWII wrecks in the Java Sea, including permits and possible mass burial of remains. The ministers answered that Indonesia denies issuing permits, that the coordinates do not match the wrecks, that further joint on-site investigation is being arranged, and that next of kin are being informed.
The Netherlands is therefore currently in close consultation with the Indonesian authorities about the possibility of follow-up on-site investigation.
Nederland voert daarom op dit ogenblik nauw overleg met de Indonesische autoriteiten over de mogelijkheid van vervolgonderzoek ter plaatse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving dat resten van zeehelden op de vuilnisbelt liggen

An MP asked the Defence, Foreign Affairs and Health ministers about reports that human remains of Dutch naval war dead lie at dump sites near the Java Sea, and whether the government will recover and rebury them. The government confirmed contact with Indonesia and other flag states, offered help and requested on-site investigation, and said it will inform the families and parliament once there is clarity, though it cannot yet give a timeline.
Once there is clarity about the on-site investigation, we will inform you of this.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over het onderzoek ter plaatse, zullen wij u hierover berichten.

Motie van de leden Van Oosten en Oskam over het bestuursrechtelijk instrumentarium om panden te kunnen sluiten

requests the government to send the report to the House before summer, with a policy response

Asks the government to request Norwegian authorities not to help detainees in Norgerhaven file asylum applications from the prison.
requests the government to ask Norwegian authorities not to facilitate asylum applications by future detainees in Norgerhaven

Motie van de leden Van Helvert en Oskam over een financiële oplossing voor ouders van misbruikte kinderen
Asks the government to find a financial solution for parents who paid care and damages costs themselves after their child was abused, before the next budget debate.
requests the government to find a financial solution for parents who have demonstrably paid for care and affection damages themselves until the bill takes effect.
verzoekt de regering, een financiële oplossing te zoeken voor ouders die tot aan de inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel schadevergoeding zorg- en affectieschade zelf aantoonbaar zijn opgedraaid

Adds an article requiring the Minister of Justice and Security to report to parliament within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the victim speaking-rights law.
Our Minister of Security and Justice shall send the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice within three years of its entry into force.

The Minister of Justice and Security sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law within five years of its entry into force.

verzoekt de regering, in overleg te gaan met de Kamers van Koophandel teneinde ertoe te komen dat zij gebruik gaan maken van de mogelijkheid om bij vermoedens van mensenhandel niet over te gaan tot inschrijving
Motie Kooiman en Oskam over bezuinigingen op het gevangeniswezen
Asks the government to consult stakeholders and involve the House before finalising prison budget cuts so the House is not faced with faits accomplis.
also to involve the House explicitly so that the House is not faced with faits accomplis in spring 2013
ook de Kamer hier nadrukkelijk bij te betrekken zodat de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2013 niet voor voldongen feiten wordt geplaatst
Motie Van der Staaij c.s. over het terugdringen van dwang en mensenhandel
Asks the government to present an integrated approach to reduce coercion and human trafficking in prostitution, including a higher age limit and stricter Bibob rules.
requests the government to come by 1 March 2013 with a concrete integrated approach
verzoekt de regering, uiterlijk 1 maart 2013 te komen met een concrete, integrale aanpak
Motie Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen over het naar rato verdelen van de investering van 105 miljoen
Asks the government to divide the 105 million euro police investment proportionally among the police, prosecution, judiciary and probation service.
requests the government to distribute the 105 million investment proportionally across the national police, the Public Prosecution Service, the judiciary and probation
verzoekt de regering, de investering van 105 miljoen naar rato te verdelen over de nationale politie, het Openbaar Ministerie, de rechtspraak en de reclassering
Motie Van der Staaij c.s. over de DEMO-instellingen
Motion asks the government to inform the House by 1 April on the new funding scheme for DEMO institutions and how expertise will be safeguarded.
requests the government, after consulting professionals, to give the House insight by 1 April into the outline of the new funding scheme
verzoekt de regering, na overleg met de betrokken professionals, de Kamer uiterlijk 1 april inzicht te geven in de hoofdlijn van de nieuwe bekostigingsregeling
Motie Kooiman c.s. over het ontzien van het gevangeniswezen bij de bezuinigingstaakstelling
Asks the government to extend the savings target beyond prisons to the whole Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen and to protect the primary process.
not limit this large savings package only to the prison system
dit omvangrijke bezuinigingspakket niet slechts betrekking te laten hebben op het gevangeniswezen
qa: Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over coffeeshops die in verzet komen tegen de komst van scholen in de buurt

MPs Oskam and Rog asked the Minister of Justice and Security about coffeeshops resisting nearby schools, including the 250-metre distance agreement with the VNG, enforcement in Amsterdam, and whether the distance criterion should be written into the Aanwijzing Opiumwet. The minister replied that the distance rule is a local choice under local tailoring, that 84.5% of coffeeshop municipalities have a distance criterion (55% at 250 m or less), that Amsterdam's approach is a local matter, and that he sees no need to change the current policy.
Reducing the visibility of coffeeshops to pupils is local tailoring.
Het verkleinen van de zichtbaarheid van coffeeshops voor scholieren is lokaal maatwerk.
Vragen van de leden Oskam (CDA) en Kooiman (SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over criminelen die shoppen bij spionagewinkels (ingezonden 11 november 2015).

MPs Oskam (CDA) and Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criminals buying gadgets from spy shops to frustrate police investigations, asking for a product overview, enforcement practice, and a possible blacklist. The Minister said such devices are only punishable if illegal or knowingly used to facilitate crime, that enforcement is up to the OM and police, that no complete data exist, that a blacklist is not practical, and that Amsterdam is exploring a licensing scheme with which he will engage.
I do not have conclusive data on the range of products sold by spy shops.
Ik beschik niet over sluitende gegevens met betrekking tot het assortiment van spyshops.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het bericht ‘Boete tijdens vervoer doodziek kind’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a speeding fine issued to a driver transporting his critically ill daughter escorted by ambulance and police vehicles, and how the OM and CJIB weigh such circumstances. The Minister answered that the OM erred, reduced the fine to zero, apologised, and that the CJIB cannot fully reconsider cases beyond narrow correction grounds, with €15 million committed to OM service improvement.
The OM has indicated that the decision of the public prosecutor, as well as the reasoning behind it, was incorrect in this case.
Het OM heeft aangegeven dat de beslissing van de officier van justitie, alsmede de motivering van deze beslissing, in deze zaak onjuist is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de uitbreiding van de voorschotregeling voor slachtoffers van misdrijven per 1 januari 2016

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the extension of the advance payment scheme for crime victims from 1 January 2016, including communication to victims, outstanding compensation orders and cases closed by the CJIB. The minister confirmed the extension, described the communication plan, but refused to extend the scheme retroactively to older outstanding orders for cost reasons and declined to change the notification process.

Retroactively extending the expansion of the advance payment scheme to outstanding compensation orders from 1 January 2016 would conflict with the decision of my predecessor, Minister Hirsch Ballin, on phased introduction.

Het per 1 januari 2016 alsnog verruimen van de uitbreiding van de voorschotregeling naar openstaande schadevergoedingsmaatregelen zou haaks staan op het besluit van mijn ambtsvoorganger, Minister Hirsch Ballin, tot gefaseerde invoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Oskam over binaire opties

MPs Ronnes and Oskam (CDA) asked the Finance and Justice ministers about binary options, whether they should fall under gambling law rather than securities supervision, and the status of the AFM court case and warnings. The government answered that binary options are financial instruments under MiFID and the Wft, that the AFM's appeal is pending before the CBb, that the AFM has warned investors but imposed no sanctions, and that it will push for harmonised cross-border supervision.
Due to supervisory confidentiality, the AFM cannot address whether investigations into specific parties are ongoing or whether it intends to impose measures on such a party.

Vanwege toezichtvertrouwelijkheid kan de AFM niet ingaan op de vraag of er nog onderzoeken naar specifieke partijen lopen of dat er een voornemen is tot het opleggen van maatregelen aan een dergelijke partij.
Vragen van het lid Oskam (CDA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Meer drugszaken sneuvelen bij rechter» (ingezonden 19 november 2015).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether rising acquittals in drug cases reflect critical judges and whether municipalities facilitating cannabis clubs fit the government's drug policy. The minister disputed that drug acquittals are unusually high, found no LOVS guideline change explaining the trend, and said Utrecht and Amsterdam do not facilitate cultivation and no enforcement is needed.
The share of acquittals in Opium Act cases in 2014 does not differ from the share of acquittals in all criminal cases, 11%.
Het aandeel vrijspraken in Opiumwetzaken wijkt in 2014 niet af van het aandeel vrijspraken bij alle misdrijfzaken, 11%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over een wijziging van het procesreglement Civiel Jeugdrecht

CDA MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether the change to the Civil Youth Law procedure rules, which stops non-guardian parents from relying on their rights as interested parties, could be reversed by a judge and how many parents are affected. The Minister answered that the judge decides who is an interested party, that no body records how many parents are affected, and that the Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht is advising, with a report expected in spring 2016.
We have asked the Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht to advise on the concept of interested party within the meaning of article 798(1) Rv in cases concerning supervision orders.
Wij hebben de Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht verzocht om te adviseren over het begrip belanghebbende in de zin van artikel 798 lid 1 Rv in zaken betreffende de ondertoezichtstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over het bericht dat coffeeshops in verzet komen tegen de komst van scholen in de buurt

Two MPs asked the Justice and Education ministers about coffeeshops opposing nearby schools, including Amsterdam's refusal of a school location due to a nearby coffeeshop and whether closures or hour limits should follow. The minister answered that distance criteria and school housing are local matters, no overlap with him occurred, and gave no commitment to new action.
Because the location of coffeeshops near schools are local matters, no consultation has taken place with me about the cases mentioned.
Omdat de vestiging van coffeeshops in de buurt van scholen lokale aangelegenheden zijn, heeft er geen overleg met mij plaatsgevonden over genoemde casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Noorden laat zware misdaad liggen'

MPs Oskam and Mulder asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the north of the Netherlands neglects serious crime, including staffing of the Ondermijning team and the risk of a waterbed effect. The minister answered that the team is being expanded to 69 FTE with temporary staff bridging vacancies, that large investigations increased, that the OM's warning was about long-term effects rather than observed displacement, and that the information position still needs strengthening.
The Ondermijning investigation team of the Regional Criminal Investigation Service had a formal staffing of 35.43 FTE as of 1 November 2015 and will be expanded to 69 FTE in the new establishment.
Het team Opsporing Ondermijning van de Dienst Regionale Recherche heeft per 1 november 2015 een formele bezetting van 35,43 fte en wordt in de nieuwe formatie uitgebreid naar 69 fte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de toegestane hoeveelheid harddrugs tijdens het Amsterdam Dance Event

An MP asked the Justice Minister how many drug-related arrests occurred at the Amsterdam Dance Event, how the local Amsterdam prosecution threshold of 5 pills or 0.5 gram relates to the national OM guideline, and how that policy came about. The minister answered that about 176 suspects were arrested at the Arena zone (170 for drugs), 131 were dismissed below the threshold, 39 face prosecution, and the threshold was set locally for capacity and trafficking-indication reasons, with the OM still reviewing capacity.
The OM has indicated it will keep looking at the capacity that can be deployed at such events.
Het OM heeft aangegeven te blijven kijken naar de capaciteit die bij dergelijke evenementen kan worden ingezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Oskam over de financiële gevolgen van het voorgenomen besluit van de Raad voor de rechtspraak zeven rechtbanken te ontmantelen en de toekomst of leegstand van deze gebouwen

MPs Van Nispen and Oskam asked about the financial consequences of the Judiciary's plan to dismantle seven courthouses, including ownership, costs, reuse of vacant buildings, and effects on court users and regions. The Minister answered that the Judiciary projects savings of 6 to 15 million euros annually, that the State owns most buildings, and that he declined to ask the Judiciary to assess negative effects in advance because the Minister's oversight is ex post.
For this reason I do not consider it appropriate for me to ask the Judiciary Council in advance to map out all possible negative (financial) consequences of the Judiciary's proposed location policy.
Daarom acht ik het niet passend dat ik de Raad vooraf verzoek allerlei mogelijk negatieve (financiële) gevolgen van het voorgenomen locatiebeleid van de Rechtspraak in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Pieter Heerma over de uitlatingen gedaan op Facebook om Israëlische toeristen 'total loss' te slaan

MPs Oskam and Heerma asked whether Facebook calls by Youness Ouaali to attack Israeli tourists are punishable, whether a criminal investigation is underway and whether pre-trial detention could apply. The Minister of Justice answered that the statements are condemned, that a criminal investigation is ongoing and no further details can be given for its sake, and that pre-trial detention requirements are set out in law without pre-judging the case.
A criminal investigation into Mr Ouaali is currently ongoing. In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made at this time.
Op dit moment loopt er een strafrechtelijk onderzoek tegen de heer Ouaali. In het belang van het onderzoek, kunnen op dit moment verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over politievrijwilligers

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reorganisation of the national police, recruitment and retention of police volunteers, the proposal of a volunteer in police leadership, pay and benefits differences, and uniform volunteer policy. The minister answered that volunteer intake is postponed to after 2017 with priority on existing volunteers, that a uniform volunteer policy and legal status regulation are being developed with unions and the LOPV, and that a leadership vision will be presented in December.
However, there are currently no plans to appoint a police volunteer to the top of the police organisation.
Vooralsnog zijn er echter geen plannen om een politievrijwilliger te benoemen in de top van de politieorganisatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen, Oskam, Swinkels en Van Der Staaij over de geruchten dat er extra geld vrijkomt om de gaten in de begroting van Veiligheid en Justitie te dichten en de door de bezuin

MPs from SP, CDA, D66 and SGP asked whether extra money is available for the Justice and Security budget for 2016, how it would be allocated across police, prosecution, judiciary, forensics, probation and prisons, and whether it should be decoupled from the Eerste Kamer risk on fee and legal aid measures. The answer refers the MPs to the government's budget letter for the 2016 Justice and Security budget (Kamerstuk 34 300 VI, nr. 23) rather than answering each question directly.

Further answer: the written questions from MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen (both SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) and Van Der Staaij (SGP) have been answered by way of the letter 'Draft budget 2016 Security and Justice'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen (beiden SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) en Van Der Staaij (SGP) Van Oosten (VVD) vraagnummer 2015Z21968 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Ontwerpbegroting 2016 Veiligheid en Justitie»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de uitzendingen van Radar d.d. 5 en 19 oktober jl. over de vergoeding van schade door middel van een contra-expertise door verzekeraars

An MP asked whether insurers' policy clauses capping reimbursement of counter-expert costs at the level of the insurer's own expert fees comply with the Civil Code, and what the AFM and insurers' association will do about it. The minister answered that such a general cap is incompatible with the statutory reasonableness standard, that reasonableness must be judged case by case, and that the AFM will examine the issue in its 2015-2016 claims-handling study.
A general capping of reasonable costs to an amount lower than the insured sum is not compatible with the aforementioned provisions.
Het in algemene zin maximeren van de redelijke kosten tot een lager bedrag dan de verzekerde som is met voornoemde bepalingen niet verenigbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Tellegen, Van der Staaij en Oskam over een hooggeplaatst lid van ISIS

Six MPs asked ministers whether a report that a senior ISIS member was en route to the Netherlands or Germany was credible and how intelligence services had examined it. The government answered that the report closely resembles earlier media reports, that services remain vigilant, and that it cannot publicly discuss the nature of its investigations.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about the nature of the services' investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de aard van onderzoek door de diensten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de onderhandelingen van stichting 'Qanitoen' om een pand in de Schilderswijk te kopen ten behoeve van de prediking van de radicaal salafistische imam

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the radical imam Fawaz, his prior convictions, the foundation Qanitoen's attempts to secure premises in The Hague, and what the government will do to prevent him gaining a fixed base. The minister answered that individual cases are not discussed, that municipalities and local partners decide intervention strategies case by case, and that a new counter-terrorism administrative measures law is pending before the Council of State.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen mededeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘OM wil van RIVM info hielprik baby container’

MPs Oskam and Bruins Slot asked whether the Public Prosecution Service could compel RIVM to release medical data from a newborn heel-prick test in a baby-in-container case, and how medical confidentiality is protected. The ministers replied that no court action is currently under consideration, that confidentiality can be overridden only in exceptional circumstances as set by the Supreme Court, and that RIVM has rarely received such requests and has not overridden confidentiality since 2012.
Taking legal steps is currently not at all on the agenda.
Het nemen van gerechtelijke stappen is op dit moment in het geheel niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de invoering van de digitale meldplicht en vernieuwing van het Voetbal Volg Systeem

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the digital reporting obligation (digitale meldplicht) for football violence had not yet been used, why municipalities showed little interest, and whether the Voetbal Volg Systeem renewal would be delayed. The minister answered that the option became legally available on 1 July 2015, two municipalities are exploring it, municipalities bear the costs, and the Voetbal Volg Systeem's further development is planned to start in 2016 subject to police absorption capacity.
Because no administrative decision-making has yet taken place in these municipalities, I cannot name them.
Omdat in deze gemeenten nog geen bestuurlijke besluitvorming heeft plaatsgevonden, kan ik ze niet bij naam noemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de business case om de rechtbank Almelo half te ontmantelen

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a business case exists for halving the Almelo court, whether local officials can receive it, and whether it will be made public. The minister answered that the judiciary prepared no business case for Almelo, only financial projections based on reference projects and existing contracts, and that the figures were shared with local administrators.
The judiciary, as the Council for the Judiciary has informed me, has not prepared a business case for the planned housing arrangements for Almelo.
De rechtspraak heeft, zo heeft de Raad voor de rechtspraak (hierna: Raad) mij meegedeeld, voor de voorgenomen huisvestingplannen met betrekking tot Almelo geen business case opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over de gevolgen van een wijziging van een procesreglement van de rechtbanken

MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether a 2015 change to the Civil Youth Law procedural regulation, based on a Supreme Court ruling, removed parents without custody from the status of interested party in child supervision and placement cases, along with their rights to information, file access and participation, and what support they would receive. The minister confirmed the change, said the removal of automatic party status is a consequence of the ruling, that no data on the group exist, that parents should not be blamed and the consequences will be examined, and that no extra measures are planned because information provision is considered adequate.
That a parent without custody is no longer (by default) regarded as an interested party therefore means that the abovementioned rights lapse.
Dat een ouder zonder gezag niet langer (standaard) als belanghebbende wordt aangemerkt betekent dus dat de hierboven genoemde rechten vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het bericht dat de rechtbank in Almelo compleet wordt uitgekleed

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about plans to strip the Almelo court of its functions, citing the Teeven/Heerts motion, earlier commitments, the penitentiary link, travel times and unemployment. The minister answered that the 32 hearing locations are equivalent but may differ in case mix, that the plan is driven by building vacancy and budget cuts, and that the Masterplan has not yet been adopted by the judiciary, which will be sent to parliament after adoption.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Agnes Mulder over de gevolgen van de huisvestingsplannen van de Rechtspraak voor de rechtbank Assen

MPs Oskam and Agnes Mulder ask the Minister of Justice how the judiciary's proposed housing plans would reduce the Assen court's caseload and staff, whether Assen remains a full sitting location, and how local consultation is handled. The Minister answers that Assen remains one of 32 sitting locations, that the plan is only a proposed decision, that criminal cases against detained suspects and commercial claims over EUR 25,000 would likely no longer be heard there, and that detailed staff and travel figures cannot yet be given.
At this stage, in which the Council and the presidents have taken a proposed decision, I cannot give an answer to this question.
Op deze vraag kan ik in dit stadium, waarin de Raad en de presidenten een voorgenomen besluit hebben genomen, geen antwoord geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Oskam over het bericht dat woningen onbereikbaar worden

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether housing is becoming unreachable due to the rise in asylum residence permits, and what the government is doing about it. The minister answered with figures on the housing quota for permit holders, mentioned the Ministerial Commission on Migration and local tools, but gave few concrete commitments.
I further expect that the measures proposed by the Ministerial Commission will offer further additions in this regard.
Ik verwacht daarnaast dat de maatregelen die door de Ministeriële Commissie voorgesteld worden daarop nog aanvullingen zullen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het aantal paspoorten dat vervallen verklaard wordt

Opposition MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government to reconcile conflicting figures on passports declared void for suspected jihadist travel, whether Dutch citizens' passports are revoked alongside second-nationality passports, and whether cooperation with Turkey and Morocco exists on revoking passports. The Minister gave figures clarifying the difference between total signalled passports and active signals, acknowledged that identity cards can still enable travel, announced a bill on travel bans and identity card revocation, and stated there are no specific agreements with Turkey on mutual passport revocation.
I do not provide further statements about individual cases.
Over de individuele gevallen doe ik geen nadere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Terrorist sprak in moskee’

Members Oskam and Van Helvert (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a convicted terrorist and a controversial preacher spoke at the Al Houda mosque in Geleen and what authorities knew and did. The minister answered that police found no evidence that the man in the footage is Ouaboer or of any criminal offence, so no investigation was opened, and that the government considers preaching of intolerant or anti-democratic messages unacceptable, while declining to detail information sharing between agencies.
However, I will not go into further detail on the extent and manner in which information was shared between the authorities involved.
Ik zal echter niet nader ingaan op de mate en wijze waarop informatie is gedeeld tussen betrokken instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht «Voormalig Paleis van Justitie in handen omstreden vastgoedman»

An MP asked whether the Bibob screening of the director of developer M7 was properly weighed against his prior prosecution settlement with the Public Prosecution Service, and about the sale of the former Amsterdam courthouse. The minister declined to discuss the Bibob advice details due to confidentiality, stated the sale is completed, and said any further zoning and Bibob decisions rest with the municipality.
I therefore cannot go into the specific content of the Bibob advice.
Ik kan derhalve niet op de specifieke inhoud van het Bibob-advies ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Oskam over het bericht dat Kosovaren in toenemende mate komen asielshoppen

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about reports that Kosovars increasingly apply for asylum mainly to obtain the return allowance, and whether this abuse is tolerable, why it was not restricted earlier, and whether Switzerland's fast procedure or a broader evaluation of the return scheme is warranted. The state secretary answered that monitoring showed a sharp rise in Kosovar asylum applications, that the allowance was likely a key reason, and that Kosovar eligibility for return support has been ended, while defending the current procedure and declining a large-scale evaluation.
Where there are indications that return support is being used improperly, measures are taken and countries can be excluded.
Daar waar er aanwijzingen zijn dat op oneigenlijk wijze gebruik wordt gemaakt van de terugkeerondersteuning, worden maatregelen getroffen en kunnen landen worden uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht “Pleidooi voor instellen speciaal tuchtrecht voor politie-agenten”

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a special disciplinary law for police officers, similar to that for soldiers, should be studied given calls from police unions and experts. The Minister acknowledged the proposal and said it is being considered within the broader reform of how police use of force is handled, promising to inform parliament before the 2016 budget debate.
In the short term, and in any case before the budget debate of my ministry for 2016, I will inform your House of my intentions on this matter.
Op korte termijn – en in ieder geval voor de behandeling van de begroting van mijn ministerie voor het jaar 2016 – zal ik uw Kamer informeren over mijn voornemens hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over een uitspraak van de RSJ d.d. 29 april 2015

MPs Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a Council for Criminal Justice and Youth Protection ruling that the Van der Hoeven clinic breached privacy by publishing factual information about a TBS patient in its internal newsletter. The State Secretary confirms the ruling, explains the Article 8 ECHR test and says the clinic is looking for less far-reaching alternatives, consulting relevant parties if needed.
I agree with the RSJ that disseminating such privacy-sensitive information is only permissible when it is sufficiently justified.
Met de RSJ ben ik van mening dat het verspreiden van dergelijke privacy-gevoelige informatie alleen toelaatbaar is wanneer dit voldoende gemotiveerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van Oosten, Rebel, Oskam, Van Tongeren en Van der Staaij over de inzet van de Koninklijke Marechaussee bij de bestrijding van mensenhandel

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Royal Marechaussee's role in combating human trafficking, its legal basis in the Police Act, and more sniffer dogs for searching lorries. The minister confirmed the KMar's frequent involvement and stated that its trafficking-combating task is covered by existing police tasks, with a review of possible legal changes ongoing and some capacity measures taken.
Consultations are currently taking place between my department, the Public Prosecution Service, the police and the KMar to further improve cooperation in combating human trafficking.

Momenteel vindt er overleg plaats tussen mijn departement, het Openbaar Ministerie, de politie en de KMar om de samenwerking op het gebied van de bestrijding van mensenhandel nog verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog inzake het bericht 'Verplicht archeologisch onderzoek'

CDA MPs asked whether a fire victim in Alkmaar must pay about 60,000 euro for mandatory archaeological excavation before rebuilding, and whether the 'polluter pays' principle can be applied to victims. The minister confirmed the amounts (halved by the municipality from 120,000), explained that municipalities set conditions via the environmental permit, and said the RCE will report on insurers' practice by 31 December 2015.
I have asked the Cultural Heritage Agency to carry out an exploration of insurers' conduct in these cases and report to me by 31 December 2015.
Aan de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed heb ik gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de handelwijze van verzekeraars in deze gevallen en mij hier voor 31 december 2015 over te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het niet vervolgen van Rabobankiers bij de Libor/Euribor-fraude

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked which Rabobank settlement transactions were agreed, whether the Dutch settlement shields staff from prosecution, and why the Libor/Euribor case led to no prosecution of current employees. The government answered that the non-prosecution decision was an independent OM decision confirmed in the settlement, refused to publish the Dutch settlement, and defended the approach as proportionate while acknowledging slow DNB action and FIOD evidence handling issues.
In the Dutch system a settlement agreement is not made public.
In het Nederlandse stelsel wordt een vaststellingsovereenkomst niet openbaar gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Pieter Heerma over de uitspraak van de burgemeester van Hilversum, die “de noodzakelijke emancipatieslag voor moslims” waarnaar wordt verwezen, vergelijkt met “emancipatiebeweging

CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Hilversum mayor's comparison of Muslim emancipation with the Catholic labour movement, and whether such statements and radicalisation figures were appropriate. The minister answered that the mayor may freely express his opinion, that the city council has already received his explanation, and that national agencies monitor departures to Syria/Iraq and inform municipalities when needed.
In addition, administrators are accountable to a representative body.
Daarnaast zijn bestuurders verantwoording schuldig aan een vertegenwoordigend lichaam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Oskam over de toename van voedselfraude binnen het Europese voedselsysteem

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about the rise in food fraud in the EU, citing a 2015 Europol/OHIM report, and asked about EU coordination, training, labelling and non-EU organic certification fraud. The government answered that food fraud is hard to measure, that the NVWA, the Food Fraud Network and training initiatives are underway, and that importers and private certifiers bear primary responsibility.
Food is one of the many product categories that were assessed.
Voedsel is één van de vele productcategorieën die zijn beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de buitenlandse financiering van islamitische instellingen

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked ministers about foreign funding of Islamic institutions, the AIVD's remit, and ANBI transparency obligations for mosques and churches. The government answered that the RAND study revealed nothing new, that it will apply ANBI publication rules from 2016 and revoke status where obligations are unmet, and that intelligence services investigate foreign influence only where serious suspicions arise.
No public statements can be made about how the AIVD concretely organises its investigations.
Over de wijze waarop de AIVD concreet onderzoeken inricht, kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het benutten van wettelijke mogelijkheden om uitreizen naar IS-gebieden te voorkomen

CDA MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government why local authorities do not use passport measures to prevent jihadist departures to IS territory, and about information provision to mayors and the monitoring of departures. Minister Van der Steur answered that passport signalling is one useful tool within a broader package, that mayors and municipal councils have been adequately informed, that about seventy passports were flagged for invalidation, and that the government will not publish per-municipality departure figures, which remains the responsibility of each municipality.
As indicated, it is not for the cabinet to communicate about individual departing persons or the number of departures per municipality.
Zoals aangegeven is het niet aan het kabinet om over individuele uitreizigers of het aantal uitreizigers per gemeente te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Weer twee Gouwenaars vertrokken naar Syrië’

MP Oskam (CDA) asked why measures failed to prevent two young men from Gouda leaving for Syria, whether they were among about 20 people the municipality monitored, and whether they had ties to recruiters. Minister Van der Steur answered that the local approach is person-focused and preventive, that departure cannot always be prevented, and declined to comment on specific cases while noting periodic confidential briefings to the municipal council.
I do not make statements about specific cases.
Over specifieke gevallen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Helvert over het boetebeleid dat gemeenten hanteren middels de buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaren en over het overnemen van een parkeerkaartje

MPs Oskam and Van Helvert asked about inconsistent municipal fining policy by enforcement officers (boa's), whether boa's should take on more police fining powers, and the legality of transferring a parking ticket. The government replied that local enforcement differences are a municipal matter, it opposes extending boa fining powers into police territory, and it will not change the fiscal parking rules, while noting that no administrative fine but a tax assessment is imposed for ticket transfer.
Given local circumstances and differences in the nature and extent of nuisance, there is no need for national uniformity in government action against local nuisance.
Gelet op de lokale omstandigheden en verschillen in de aard en omvang van overlast is er geen noodzaak tot (landelijke) eenheid in overheidsoptreden bij de aanpak van lokale overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het voornemen van het kabinet om de verheerlijking van anorexia te verbieden

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether the government would investigate a ban on pro-ana content after France, and why it had not pursued such measures earlier. The government answered that existing law does not criminalise encouraging extreme dieting, that a ban would not be effective, and that it will instead update the pop-up warning system with providers and engage the fashion sector.
Banning and criminalising these expressions sends the wrong signal to these people and does not encourage them to seek help.
Het verbieden en strafbaar stellen van deze uitingen is een verkeerd signaal naar deze personen en bevordert niet dat zij hulp gaan zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Potters, Oskam en Karabulut over het bericht dat een omstreden sjeik naar Eindhoven komt

MPs from ChristenUnie, VVD, CDA and SP asked ministers whether a controversial sheikh who was to visit Eindhoven had received a visa, how entry bans and SIS alerts work, whether the mayor and foreign partners were consulted, and whether a list of hate preachers exists. The government answered that the Italian visa was withdrawn so the sheikh may not stay in the Netherlands, that the mayor consulted the NCTV, that entry-ban and SIS procedures are explained in general terms, and that an alert list of preachers is in use but numbers are not disclosed.
I cannot provide any information on the number of persons on this list.
Over het aantal personen op deze lijst kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de bouw van een moskee in Gouda

MPs Oskam, Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked ministers how the sale of the PWA barracks in Gouda to a large mosque project was handled, including the origin of its funding, the Bibob review, and whether the state would follow the process. The ministers answered that the matter is a local responsibility, that a new local process is under way, and that financing was checked by a forensic accountant and Bibob advice, but that the results are not publicly disclosed and no independent state investigation will be launched.
No, this concerns a local matter.
Nee, dit betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Oskam over het bericht ‘Utrecht vreest komst Belgische martelsjeik’

Two MPs (Segers and Oskam) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Utrecht feared a visit by a Belgian preacher and about possible blacklists, visa measures, and cooperation against hate preachers. The minister answered that the local triangle found no legal grounds to act, that no blacklist exists though an alerting list is kept, and that the answers on intelligence and foreign contacts are limited.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht 'Willekeur aanpak growshops'

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about regional differences in enforcement against growshops after the new offence of preparing illegal cannabis cultivation took effect, including risks of displacement, advertising of anonymous sales, and whether enforcement reaches large online suppliers. The Minister answered that enforcement only began on 1 March 2015, that a national approach with local room for tailored enforcement is in place, that no displacement signals have been received, that the offence can be triggered by selling a single product where there is serious reason to suspect illegal cultivation, and that results and follow-up investigations are still pending.
Since the law took effect on 1 March 2015 and the investigations following the inspections are still ongoing, I cannot yet provide information on more serious and underlying forms of crime.

Aangezien de wet 1 maart 2015 in werking is getreden en de onderzoeken naar aanleiding van de controles nog lopen, kan ik nog geen informatie geven over zwaardere en achterliggende vormen van criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het bestemmingsplan in Utrecht omtrent het (Nieuwe) Zandpad

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Utrecht zoning plan for 162 brothel windows at the Nieuwe Zandpad, including police and task force involvement in past closures linked to human trafficking and resource implications. The minister said local authorities are responsible for such choices, that the police and prosecution systems cannot report time spent in FTE at the requested level of detail, and that no national inspection was involved.
The systems of the police and the Public Prosecution Service are not designed to determine the time spent in FTEs in a simple and reliable way at the requested level of detail.
De systemen van de politie en het OM zijn er niet op ingesteld om op een eenvoudige en betrouwbare wijze tot op het gevraagde detailniveau de bestede tijd in fte's te bepalen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over zijn voorgenomen besluit gebruik te maken van zijn aanwijzingsbevoegdheid om het bestuur van de Stichting Scholengemeenschap Bonaire tot aftreden te dwingen

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary whether funds meant for education at the Stichting Scholengemeenschap Bonaire were spent on non-education items and whether the Inspectorate had found signals of this. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate found no concrete indications of unlawful spending, that the accountant will still review lawfulness, and that he would recover any unlawfully spent euro if it later emerged.
There are currently no concrete indications of unlawful spending. Should this later prove to be the case, it is my policy to recover every unlawfully spent euro from the board concerned.

Er zijn op dit moment geen concrete aanwijzingen dat sprake is van onrechtmatige bestedingen. Mocht dit later blijken, dan is het mijn beleid om iedere onrechtmatig bestede euro terug te vorderen van het bestuur in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Brand door hennepteelt breekt vaak uit in bewoond huis’

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about a report that cannabis-cultivation fires often break out in occupied homes, and what measures will be taken to dismantle more plantations in 2015 and whether energy-theft identification requirements will be introduced. The minister says the problem is serious, describes existing enforcement measures and the new preparatory-acts offence, and reports talks with the energy sector on civil claims and an identification requirement, which remain under consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Oskam over de taak van gemeenten in relatie tot radicalisering en uitreizende jihadisten

MPs Heerma and Oskam asked how municipalities are supported by central government in tackling radicalisation and jihadist departures, including the expert unit and the claim that municipalities lack clarity. The minister replied that the expert unit became operational in February 2015 and is being built up, that a range of support tools exist, and that a 10-point plan was drawn up for municipalities.
Central government assists municipalities in preventing radicalisation and managing social tensions.
Het Rijk staat gemeenten bij in de preventie van radicalisering en de beheersing van maatschappelijke spanningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Knops over de komst van een megamoskee in Gouda

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government's position on the Gouda mega-mosque had changed after the Prime Minister's remarks on financing doubts, whether the municipality had withdrawn the original plan, and whether the sale of the former PWA barracks should be suspended. The Minister replied that the government takes no position on this local matter, described the PwC financial investigation and pending Bibob advice, noted the mosque board's offer of a smaller building, and refused to suspend the sale, stating that Muslims in Gouda have the right to build a mosque provided they obey the law.
In line with the constitutional structure of the Netherlands, the cabinet has taken no position on this local matter.
Het kabinet heeft conform de staatkundige inrichting van Nederland geen standpunt ingenomen over deze lokale kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het arrest van de Hoge Raad dat de Staatsloterij kopers van staatsloten in de periode 2000-2008 zou hebben misleid

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government about a Supreme Court ruling that the State Lottery misled ticket buyers in 2000-2008, including revenue figures, possible misleading draw practices, the Kansspelautoriteit investigation, and liability. The government answered that the KSA found no reason to suspend draws, recommended measures the lottery will implement by Q2 2015, and that no assessment of damages can yet be made.
The KSA expects that the State Lottery will have implemented the final measures to carry out the recommendations by the end of the second quarter of 2015 at the latest.
De KSA verwacht dat de Staatsloterij uiterlijk aan het einde van het tweede kwartaal 2015 de laatste maatregelen ter uitvoering van de aanbevelingen heeft ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Knops over het bericht dat criminele organisaties in Zuid-Limburg minderjarigen inzetten op hennepplantages

MPs Oskam and Knops asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that criminal organisations in South Limburg use minors to trim cannabis plants, and what is being done to protect them, prosecute recruiters, and tackle the phenomenon through the RIEC and regional teams. The minister replied that the Public Prosecution Service found no information on minors in cannabis cultivation, that the chief prosecutor urged anonymous reporting, that the offences are already criminal under the Opium Act with sentencing able to reflect involvement of minors, and that intensified undermining-crime teams have been active since late 2014 with reported arrests and seizures and accountability reports to follow.
However, the investigation has yielded no information about minors being deployed in cannabis cultivation.
Het onderzoek heeft echter geen informatie opgeleverd over minderjarigen die worden ingezet bij de hennepteelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Oskam over de aanpak van synthetische drugs en georganiseerde misdaad

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about tackling synthetic drugs and organised crime, including a generic ban on new precursor chemicals, extra investigative capacity in the south, RIEC case backlogs, NFI turnaround times, and protective clothing for police at drug labs. The minister answered that a generic ban would be too broad, that the Labour Inspectorate investigation is ongoing, and that protective gear is provided only to specialist LFO staff while Parliament will be informed by end of April.
The instrument of a generic criminalisation is therefore too coarse-meshed.
Het middel van een generieke strafbaarstelling is dus te grofmazig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de afschaffing van de opbrengsten van de proces verbaal-vergoeding voor gemeenten

CDA MPs asked whether the WODC study on abolishing the proces-verbaal fee for municipalities will examine effects on neighbourhood liveability, police workload, BOA dismissals, municipal budgets and use of administrative fines. The minister answered that the study focuses on registration and spending of the fees rather than direct effects, that no signals of BOA dismissals or budget cuts have been found, and that no VNG inventory is needed for now.
The short time elapsed since the abolition of the fee scheme, as well as the period made available for the study, currently make it impossible to map the effects of the abolition.

De korte tijd die is verstreken sinds de afschaffing van de vergoedingsregeling, alsmede de voor het onderzoek beschikbaar gestelde periode, maken het op dit moment niet mogelijk de effecten van de afschaffing in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Oskam en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Eerste stap naar vergunning voor gokbedrijven’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the Kansspelautoriteit's survey of interest in online gambling licences was justified, whether it should be halted before the bill passed, how many applications were expected, and how advertising violations by gambling firms were monitored and sanctioned. The State Secretary answered that the survey was the regulator's own decision to prepare for licensing, that he hoped licensing would be swift for consumer protection, that expected applications rested on a 2011 study and contacts with regulators, and that individual enforcement cases could not be disclosed to protect ongoing investigations.
Offering this possibility to interested parties for a licence was an independent decision of the gambling authority.
Het bieden van deze mogelijkheid aan geïnteresseerden voor een vergunning is een zelfstandige beslissing van de kansspelautoriteit geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat gevangenisbewaarders onder druk staan

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked the State Secretary about a DJI staff satisfaction survey showing reduced feelings of safety, violence against staff, working-time law breaches, understaffing, sick leave, cell opening practice, management ratios and the 'stoplicht' promotion model. The State Secretary answered that the ISZW and staff survey reports would be responded to substantively in April, gave sick-leave and staffing figures and management ratios, and denied unrest about the stoplicht model.
At the General Consultation on the Prison Service of 22 January, the then State Secretary committed to giving Parliament a substantive response to both reports.

Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over het Gevangeniswezen van 22 januari jl. heeft de toenmalige Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie uw Kamer toegezegd een inhoudelijke reactie te geven op beide rapporten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over de rol van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bij een psychiater die veroordeeld is voor het bezit van kinderporno en nog

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked how the health inspectorate (IGZ) and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) handled a psychiatrist convicted of possessing child pornography who kept practising, and whether the employer should have been informed. The ministers answered that the IGZ was informed in 2012, opened an investigation and a supervision plan, took a disciplinary case in 2014, and that the OM-IGZ cooperation protocol is being revised to allow sharing of such information.

From the standpoint of patient safety, my view is that possessing, distributing or viewing child pornography by healthcare professionals is so transgressive that it poses a risk to patient safety, and that the convicted psychiatrist should have informed his employer of his conviction.

Vanuit oogpunt van de patiëntveiligheid is mijn standpunt dat het, verspreiden of bekijken van kinderporno door zorgprofessionals dermate grensoverschrijdend is dat het een risico vormt voor de veiligheid van patiënten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het intrekken van de visa van predikers

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked why the NCTV letter on withdrawing visas for preachers bears a 23 February creation date and a 3 March date, and about its reference number, timing, inter-communication, Schengen coordination and a database of banned preachers. The government explained the letter was written and sent on 17 February, copied on 23 February with only the official's name removed, that the reference number reflects creation date, that other Schengen states can be asked to revoke visas, and that a usable alert list will be delivered by 1 April.
The NCTV letter to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs was written, signed and sent on 17 February.
De brief van de NCTV aan het Ministerie van BZ is op 17 februari geschreven, ondertekend en verstuurd naar het Ministerie van BZ.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam (beiden CDA) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de Staatssecretaris van Financiën over een bijeenkomst in Rijswijk op 8 maart 2015

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked the ministers about a planned March 2015 event in Rijswijk featuring preachers linked to extremist views, including visa revocations, whether the organiser's ANBI status could be withdrawn, and the list of speakers. The government answered that visas for three speakers were revoked on public order grounds, that the event was scaled back, and that the tax authority could investigate ANBI status if signals warranted, but gave no commitment to a specific investigation.
Without going into individuals, it can be said that seven preachers had been invited to give lectures on 8 March.
Zonder in te gaan op individuen kan verteld worden dat zeven predikers waren uitgenodigd voor het geven van lezingen op 8 maart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een mega-moskee in Gouda

CDA MPs asked the government about the financing of a planned large mosque in Gouda, its links to salafist fundraising, and the sale of the former Prins Willem Alexander barracks with a nuclear bunker. The minister answered that the sale and onward sale are a local matter, that PWC found no obstacles and a Bibob advice is pending, that the bunker will be demolished, and that national security is not a criterion for such sales.
The proposed decision on the onward sale to El Wahda may be changed by the mayor and aldermen after receipt of the Landelijk Bureau Bibob advice.
Het voorgenomen besluit over de doorverkoop aan El Wahda kan door het college van burgemeester en wethouders eventueel worden gewijzigd na ontvangst van het advies van het Landelijk Bureau Bibob.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Helvert en Oskam over het grondwaterproblemen in de Vliettunnel Leidschendam

MPs Van Helvert and Oskam (CDA) asked the minister about recurring groundwater problems in the Vliettunnel in Leidschendam that forced closures, and whether lowering the groundwater level could be explored with the province and water board. The minister confirmed the problems and said a study on a structural solution, including groundwater lowering and other options, is underway with completion expected in summer 2015.
That is why I am now having research carried out into a structural solution.
Daarom laat ik nu onderzoek doen naar een structurele oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘OM biedt jeugd in Veen 600 euro’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Security and Justice why the Public Prosecution Service proposed a higher compensation of 200 euro per day to 88 youths detained after New Year's riots in Veen, how the amount was calculated, and whether it sends a wrong signal given the tougher stance on disorder. The Minister defends the extra compensation by pointing to harsh detention conditions and long uncertainty, rejects claims of arbitrary haggling, and states that the cases were dismissed for lack of legally convincing evidence.
In its advice on calculating the amount of compensation, the Public Prosecution Service took into account the criteria of article 89 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the case law based on it.
Het OM heeft in zijn advies bij de berekening van de hoogte van een schadevergoeding rekening gehouden met de criteria van artikel 89 Sv en de daarop gebaseerde jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een moskee/islamitisch centrum in Gouda

MPs Oskam, Omtzigt and Knops asked ministers about a planned mega-mosque and Islamic centre in former Gouda barracks, including sale arrangements, financing from abroad, links of preachers to jihadism and counter-radicalisation measures. The government answered most questions, declining to comment on individual cases and noting that the municipality is responsible for land use and the financing investigation is ongoing.
I do not make public statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht '2600 rechtszaken om functies bij Nationale Politie'

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that about 2,600 lawsuits were filed over job classifications in the National Police, and how many disputes remain before the courts and whether the reorganisation timelines are at risk. The minister confirmed about 9,872 objections, around 2,652 appeals, 16 rulings so far (confirming the employer acted correctly), and stated the appeals are separate from the reorganisation and do not affect its progress.
Of the 2,587 appeal cases actually submitted to the court, a ruling has so far been issued in 16 cases.
Van de 2.587 beroepszaken die daadwerkelijk aan de rechter zijn voorgelegd is inmiddels in 16 zaken een uitspraak gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de vuurwerkopslag in Heerde

Three MPs (Oskam, Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij) asked whether a fireworks storage facility in Heerde close to a care centre and supermarket is safe, and whether other veiligheidsregio's should inventory similar risks. The state secretary replied that the Vuurwerkbesluit's construction requirements, sprinklers and fire resistance keep the effects of any calamity within the storage facility, declined to order a nationwide inventory, and described the uniform incident-response approach.
As I indicated in the answer to question 1, the consequences of any calamity are limited to the storage facility itself.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 1 heb aangegeven, beperken de gevolgen van een eventuele calamiteit zich tot de bewaarplaats zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Marcouch over zijn aanpak om het aantal winkeldiefstallen te verminderen en de derving voor de retailers terug te dringen

MPs Oskam and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he will reduce shoplifting and the losses retailers suffer, and about the rules for sharing camera images of suspected shoplifters between shops and chains. The minister answered that no concrete reduction target can be set from the barometer, that sharing suspect data outside a corporate group requires prior review by the CBP, and that a draft bill and a sector protocol are in preparation.
Sharing images of (suspects of) shoplifting between entrepreneurs from different legal entities and groups is part of that.
Het uitwisselen van beelden van (verdachten van) winkeldiefstal tussen ondernemers uit verschillende rechtspersonen en groepen is daar onderdeel van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het bericht dat de georganiseerde misdaad 25% van de wereldwijde beroepsmatige sportbeoefening in handen heeft

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether the minister knew the WADA director general's claim that organised crime controls about 25% of professional sport, and asked about Interpol information, a possible global anti-matchfixing agency, and links with doping. The minister said the claim could not be traced to Interpol information, that it was not verifiable, that no link with doping was found, and that Dutch support for the Council of Europe matchfixing convention is the chosen route.
As I already indicated during the Sport Legislative Consultation of 27 October 2014, you cannot expect me to forward all third-party information to your House.
Zoals ik al aangaf tijdens het Wetgevingsoverleg Sport van 27 oktober 2014 kunt u van mij niet verwachten dat ik alle informatie van derden aan uw Kamer doorstuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Segers over draagmoederschap

Two MPs asked the government about surrogacy, including unregulated online matching, risks to children, enforcement under the Criminal Code, and the status of existing policy. The Secretary of State answered that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming investigates only when it learns of a possible surrogacy arrangement, that reporting and a new reporting structure are not needed, that enforcement is limited and largely left to the Public Prosecution Service, and that policy will await the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap, expected in 2016.
It is not inconceivable that single men also make contact with potential surrogate mothers.
Het is niet ondenkbaar dat ook alleenstaande mannen contact leggen met potentiële draagmoeders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat de rechtbank Utrecht niet goed beveiligd is

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked about reports that fake weapons were smuggled into the Utrecht court through a back door and whether court security was tightened. The Minister answered that the incident at the Midden-Nederland court exposed a pass registration and authorisation problem, outlined the Rijkspas security framework, and listed measures such as replacing all passes and checking deactivation of departed staff's passes.
I find this a worrying incident to which the Midden-Nederland court responded adequately.
Ik vind dit een zorgwekkend incident waar de rechtbank Midden-Nederland adequaat op heeft gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Oskam over de wijkagent als spilfunctie in het verbeteren van de veiligheid in wijken en buurten

Two CDA MPs asked whether the neighbourhood police officer (wijkagent) is truly a central figure in improving safety, whether the 1-per-5,000-inhabitants norm is met, where it is not, and how specialised support and police posts are secured. The minister affirmed the role, stated the norm is met nationally as a regional average with vacancies being filled, pointed to the other answers for regional figures, and described district-level flex teams and recherche support.
For an overview of the average norm per regional unit, I refer you to the answers to questions 1, 2 and 3 that MP Van Raak (SP) asked on 11 August 2014.
Voor een overzicht van de gemiddelde norm per regionale eenheid verwijs ik u naar het antwoord op de vragen 1, 2 en 3 die het lid Van Raak (SP) op 11 augustus 2014 stelde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en De Rouwe over bericht ‘Personeel rechtbank weg uit Leeuwarden’

MPs Oskam and De Rouwe (CDA) asked whether all office staff of the Leeuwarden court and clerk's office staff of the Assen court will move to Groningen, and how this fits with promises to keep Leeuwarden a full justice city and to protect employment in Fryslân. The Minister answered that Leeuwarden and Assen remain hearing locations with clerk's offices, that the Public Prosecution Service will keep 30 workplaces in Leeuwarden until 2016, and that the Council for the Judiciary will consult court boards on the office function.
Leeuwarden remains a full justice city.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat een fraude-aanklager verdacht wordt van fraude

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether an advocate-general at the Amsterdam appeals court is being prosecuted for fiscal fraud, whether his appointment was properly screened, and whether other cases show non-transparent appointments of VVD affiliates. The minister confirmed a criminal investigation into the advocate-general for private-sphere tax fraud, stated that the regular selection procedure was followed with no contra-indications found, and said no other such cases are known.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements are being made at this time.
In het belang van het onderzoek worden op dit moment geen nadere mededelingen gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en De Rouwe over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof Den Haag dat het Openbaar Ministerie iemand die een alcoholslot opgelegd heeft gekregen niet ook nog eens strafrechtelijk mag vervol

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a Hague appeals court ruling that the prosecutor may not also prosecute a driver already subject to a mandatory alcohol-lock programme, and about reports of faults in alcohol locks. The government answered that the ruling does not affect the administrative alcohol-lock measure, that the matter is still before the courts, that the CBR imposes the programme uniformly without individual balancing (with an investigation into possible change), and that it is studying mouth-alcohol false readings with a Wageningen University study.
When the alcohol-lock programme was introduced, the legislature deliberately chose to impose it mandatorily and uniformly, without room for individual balancing of interests.
Bij de introductie van het alcoholslotprogramma is door de wetgever bewust gekozen om het programma dwingend en uniform op te leggen zonder ruimte voor individuele belangenafweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam,Omtzigt en Segers over de radicale prediker ‘Tarik ibn Ali’ uit België die naar Gouda

Three MPs asked the ministers whether a Belgian imam with radical messages, invited by a Gouda mosque board, would be barred and whether criminal action was underway. The minister answered that no hateful content is currently expected, the local authority has agreed no incitement will occur, criminal action would follow if it did, and no Belgian investigation is known.
At this moment we have no indications that this person is coming to the Netherlands to proclaim a hateful or inciting message.
Op dit moment hebben wij geen aanwijzingen dat deze persoon naar Nederland komt om een haatzaaiende of opruiende boodschap te verkondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Geen politie: geen strafzaken in Almere’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether criminal and family cases at the Almere court would stop because the National Police would no longer assign parquet police there, and about the police capacity problems and the planned meeting with the judiciary. The Minister answered that the police still had enough capacity for parquet tasks, that the court management could move hearings for safety reasons, and that no other courts would lose parquet police.
The National Police has sufficient capacity available for carrying out parquet tasks.
De Nationale Politie heeft voldoende capaciteit beschikbaar voor de uitvoering van parkettaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Reclassering in de knel door bezuinigingen’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about warnings from Reclassering Nederland over budget cuts, including longer waiting lists and reduced supervision hours. The State Secretary answered that the cuts reduce supervision and advice hours by about 8% but are expected to avoid further waiting-list growth without changing risk-based supervision levels, and that the review of the probation system, including the pending application of Info-Excellente, will be reported before the budget debate.
A definitive assessment of the application by Info-Excellente will take place in light of the outcomes of the review of the adult probation system currently being carried out.

Een definitieve beoordeling van de aanvraag van Info-Excellente zal plaatsvinden in het licht van de uitkomsten van de verkenning naar het stelsel van de volwassenenreclassering die op dit moment wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de voortvluchtige vrouwenhandelaar Saban B.

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked whether fugitive trafficker Saban B. is seen in Facebook photos in Turkey, the status of the investigation, and whether Turkey agreed to enforce his sentence. The minister confirmed authorities know he is in Turkey, that Turkey has been formally asked to take over enforcement since 2013, and that talks continue, but gave no further details citing the interest of the case.
I cannot make further statements at this time in the interest of the case.
Ik kan in het belang van de zaak op dit moment geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Kweekschool voor criminelen’
