Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a newspaper report calling youth detention centres a breeding ground for crime, and about sick-leave levels, staffing and reorganisations in the Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen. The State Secretary rejected the report as one-sided, gave sick-leave figures by institution, and said that staffing problems at De Hartelborgt were structurally resolved and that the closures had not reduced quality.
I find the article paints an unbalanced picture of what happens in the Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI's).
Ik vind het artikel een onevenwichtig beeld schetsen van hetgeen in de Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI's) gebeurt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht van Brandweer Haaglanden, dat alle eerstelijns ademluchttoestellen met een snelsluiting (‘quick connect-aansluiting’) vervangen worden door exemplaren met schroefdraa

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Brandweer Haaglanden's replacement of quick-connect breathing apparatus couplings after three incidents, and about the investigation timelines and safety measures. The minister confirmed the incidents and the pending manufacturer and regional investigations, but said equipment choice and safety are the employers' (veiligheidsregio's) responsibility and that the Social Affairs ministry is examining the product under the Warenwet.
This concerns an employer's responsibility – in this case of the safety regions – to provide personnel with sound equipment enabling them to carry out tasks safely and effectively.
Het betreft een werkgeversverantwoordelijkheid – in casu van de veiligheidsregio's – om personeel te voorzien van deugdelijke middelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Politie omzeilt regels met miljoenenorders: Dure apparatuur op dubieuze wijze besteld'

An MP asked whether the police bypassed procurement rules by ordering 10,000 walkie-talkies and 800 mobile radios, whether the minister knew of this, and what steps will prevent non-compliant purchases. The minister said urgent safety needs justified buying outside the regular tender rules, that he was informed in outline, acknowledged non-compliant contracts in the past, and said these are being re-tendered.
I was informed that due to operational necessity the radio equipment had to be purchased outside the regular procurement rules.
Ik ben op de hoogte gebracht van het feit dat uit operationele noodzaak de randapparatuur buiten de reguliere aanbestedingsregels moest worden aangeschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Oskam over de zorgen van de gemeente Raalte over de beperkte dekking van het C2000 netwerk

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about coverage gaps in the C2000 emergency radio network near Heeten, raised by the municipality of Raalte, including consequences for emergency services, the number of white spots and plans for full coverage. The minister confirmed the gap, said 24 coverage problems are open with eight being addressed yearly, explained that emergency services can fall back on direct radio and mobile phones, and said the Heeten problem may be solved in 2015 with a decision in January 2015.
I share the concern of the municipality of Raalte.
Ik deel de zorg van de gemeente Raalte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Nu al even veel drugsafval gedumpt als in heel 2013’

MPs Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked the Justice Minister about the rise in synthetic drug waste dumping in Noord-Brabant, its cleanup costs, enforcement capacity, and why prosecutors did not appeal an acquittal in a cannabis-grow case. The minister gave figures on dumpings and costs, described intensified enforcement and funding decisions, and declined to provide some registration data citing administrative burden.
The College of Procurators-General has informed me that it does not have an overview of cases in which suspects were convicted for dumping drug waste.
Het College van procureurs-generaal heeft mij gemeld dat het niet beschikt over een overzicht van zaken waarin verdachten zijn veroordeeld ter zake van het dumpen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Oskam over de doorstart van het kinderdagverblijf Estro

Two CDA MPs asked whether investment firm HIG, a part-owner of bankrupt childcare company Estro, arranged a pre-packaged sale and re-start in which it effectively negotiated with itself, and whether directors or HIG should be held liable. The Minister answered that the curator's report describes a lawful pre-pack process, that HIG was the highest bidder after other bids were sought, that liability is for the curator and courts, and that creditors generally benefit from pre-packs.
It is for him to assess whether there are indications that the directors were guilty of mismanagement in the run-up to the bankruptcy.
Het is aan hem om te beoordelen of er aanwijzingen zijn dat de bestuurders zich in de aanloop naar het faillissement schuldig hebben gemaakt aan wanbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Nu al even veel drugsafval gedumpt als in heel 2014’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how many Brabant and Limburg mayors had requested extra capacity against drug crime, whether organised drug crime is shifting to the south, and what he learned on a recent visit to Brabant. The minister acknowledged serious concern in the south, said police capacity will be redirected within existing strength from 1 October 2014 (detailed in a separate letter), and reported that mayors raised worries about smaller municipalities; he did not give a count of mayors' requests.

The competent authority in the south of the Netherlands has therefore decided that from 1 October 2014, within existing strength, more police capacity will be deployed against undermining and organised crime.

Het bevoegd gezag in Zuid-Nederland heeft dan ook besloten om per 1 oktober 2014, binnen de bestaande sterkte, meer politiecapaciteit in te gaan zetten op de aanpak van ondermijnende en georganiseerde criminaliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de nog steeds niet uitgevoerde motie over het uitwisselen van informatie over in het buitenland veroordeelde zedendelinquenten, zodat ze niet in Neder

CDA MPs asked why a motion to exchange information on foreign-convicted sex offenders, so they cannot obtain a VOG and work in childcare, remains unimplemented, and whether Dutch children are adequately protected. The Minister confirmed the motion, said information exchange with non-EU countries happens only case by case, and promised an Interpol-related study and a progress report before the end of 2014, while acknowledging the VOG cannot fully exclude misuse.
in contrast to the arrangements within the EU, criminal information is not exchanged structurally with countries outside the EU
wordt in tegenstelling tot de afspraken die gelden binnen EU-verband, niet op structurele wijze strafrechtelijke informatie uitgewisseld met landen buiten de EU
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de uitzending ‘Opa en oma in de ban’

An MP (Oskam, CDA) asked the State Secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about grandparents' difficulties keeping contact with grandchildren after divorce, the legal test for contact orders, and whether the law should be changed. The government answered that the scale of the problem cannot be measured, that courts apply a two-step test (close personal bond, then child's best interest), that Germany and France name grandparents in law but the Dutch route via the court is adequate, and that grandparents feature in the anti-conflict-divorce action plan.

I nevertheless consider the previously outlined possibility for grandparents to obtain a contact arrangement through the court adequate, and therefore see no reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik acht de eerder geschetste mogelijkheid voor grootouders om via de rechter tot een omgangsregeling te komen niettemin afdoende en zie daarom geen aanleiding hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat tijdens de brand op het Shellcomplex aan de Chemieweg in Moerdijk d.d. 3 juni 2014 tegen de afspraken in de drinkwaterbedrijven niet zijn geïnformeerd

An MP asked whether drinking water companies Brabant Water and Evides were not properly informed during the June 2014 Shell Moerdijk fire, and what this means for water quality, cooperation with safety regions and convenant implementation. The minister answered that Midden- en West-Brabant did not alert the water companies because no risk was seen, that Zuid-Holland Zuid did inform Evides, that water quality was not endangered, and that implementation of the covenants is being monitored and pushed, with a fuller plan to follow.
The Dutch Safety Board is conducting further investigation into, among other things, crisis management including communication.
De Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid verricht nader onderzoek naar o.a. de crisisbeheersing inclusief de communicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Pieter Heerma over de onrust tijdens de IS-betoging in Den Haag

CDA MPs asked whether a counter-demonstration disrupting an anti-IS march in The Hague, allegedly by sympathisers with IS, is worrying, how many arrests were made, and what the government will do to prevent further incidents. The minister condemned IS and stressed fundamental rights, explained that mayors under the Public Manifestations Act cannot ban demonstrations for their content, and said the Public Prosecution Service had not been informed of other incidents.
The Public Prosecution Service has not been informed of incidents other than those in The Hague during demonstrations.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is niet op de hoogte gesteld van incidenten – anders dan die in Den Haag – tijdens demonstraties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Oskam over het bericht dat Franse hardrijders vrijuit gaan omdat met het uitwisselen van gegevens over verkeersboetes tussen Frankrijk en Nederland zaken niet goed geregeld zij

MPs De Rouwe and Oskam asked why French and Polish drivers committing traffic offences in the Netherlands escape fines while Dutch drivers are fined in France, and whether Dutch data sharing with France would be suspended. The minister answered that the Netherlands complied with the EU obligation to open its vehicle register, that enforcement adjustments for French and Polish plates are being phased in with completion targeted this year, and that the revenue loss cannot be quantified.
I aim to have the adjustments for processing offences by French plate holders completed this year, and afterwards those for Polish plate holders.
Ik streef ernaar de aanpassingen voor het verwerken van de overtredingen van Franse kentekenhouders dit jaar gereed te hebben en daarna die voor de Poolse kentekenhouders.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de aangenomen motie Omtzigt (Kamerstuk 33 750 V, nr. 30) over informatie over veroordelingen van Nederlanders voor zedendelicten in het buitenland

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked about information exchange on Dutch nationals convicted of sex offences abroad, which can allow them to obtain a VOG and work with children. The government explains that EU exchange works under treaties and ECRIS, while information exchange with non-EU countries occurs only case by case, with Thailand approached and an Interpol-based approach being explored.
It is not separately recorded in how many cases a VOG was refused to a person with a Dutch passport for a sex offence conviction abroad.
Er wordt niet apart geregistreerd in hoeveel gevallen de VOG is geweigerd aan iemand met een Nederlands paspoort voor een veroordeling voor een zedendelict in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Baay-Timmerman over het stoppen met de paspoortuitgifte bij consulaten

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Baay-Timmerman ask why the government is phasing out passport issuance at consulates before informing parliament and before 2016, and demand a cost-benefit analysis and a halt to the process. The Minister replies that biometric passport services at honorary consulates are being phased out for cost and efficiency reasons, that the consulate-general plans are still in draft and parliament will be informed later, and that he will provide the cost-benefit analysis in that letter.
The cost-benefit analysis of phasing out consular services at the consulates-general will be made after the action plans are assessed and included in the letter promised to your House.

De kosten-baten analyse bij afbouw van de consulaire dienstverlening bij de consulaten generaal zal na beoordeling van de plannen van aanpak gemaakt worden en verwerkt in de aan uw Kamer toegezegde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Nispen en Oskam over de uitspraken en antwoorden op vragen over een slachtoffer van identiteitsfraude

MPs from SP and CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether earlier answers on the compensation claim of identity-fraud victim Mr Kowsoleea were accurate, why the case remains unresolved despite earlier assurances, and whether the minister will personally arrange talks. The minister confirmed the earlier answers, said the state requested a further substantiation of the claim, and said he would like to see the case resolved soon without committing to a specific step.
Therefore the person concerned has been asked for a (further) substantiation of the alleged unlawfulness and of the causal link between the conduct attributed to the State and the claimed damage.
Daarom is betrokkene gevraagd om een (nadere) onderbouwing van de gestelde onrechtmatigheid en het causaal verband tussen het aan de Staat verweten handelen en de geclaimde schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het binnenvallen van drugspanden door de politie op basis van onvoldoende (geverifieerde) anonieme informatie

MP Oskam asked the Justice Minister whether it is acceptable that a Arnhem court acquitted a suspect of a cannabis grow after police entered a premises on an insufficiently verified anonymous tip, and how such tips are checked, and whether prosecutors should review use of powers. The minister said police did check energy use and the business registration before entry, that the court found no unambiguous consent, that the prosecution chose not to appeal, that no data exists on similar cases, and that the judiciary does not generally see powers as stretched.
No data on these aspects can be extracted from the registration systems of the Public Prosecution Service and the Council for the Judiciary.
Over deze aspecten zijn uit de registratiesystemen van het OM en de Raad voor de Rechtspraak geen gegevens te destilleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de strijd tegen hennep en het dumpen van illegaal afval in Noord-Brabant

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the fight against cannabis and synthetic drug crime and illegal drug-waste dumping in North Brabant, including police capacity, cross-border cooperation, legal frameworks and a proposed guarantee fund. The minister answered that enforcement capacity is sufficient and is being strengthened, that legalising cannabis cultivation is not a solution, that a joint approach and cross-border action programme are in preparation, and that Pluk Ze funds cannot be earmarked for victims of dumping.
Police and the Public Prosecution Service are on track to meet the target I set when I took office in 2010.
Politie en OM liggen op koers bij de realisatie van de doelstelling die ik bij mijn aantreden in 2010 heb gesteld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Baay-Timmerman over de sluiting van het honorair-consulaat in de Spaanse provincie La Nuncia per 1 september 2014

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Baay-Timmerman asked why the honorary consulate in La Nucia (Spain) would lose its passport and visa functions from 1 September 2014, whether the minister had promised to wait until 2016, and whether a cost-benefit analysis was made. The minister replied that the change is part of budget cuts and the network modernisation, that the consulate remains available for emergencies, that the 2016 timeline still applies, and that the chosen cuts will not be reversed.
A cost-benefit analysis was made for the honorary consulates with biometric equipment.
Er is een kosten/baten analyse gemaakt voor de honoraire consulaten met biometrische apparatuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat de internationale jacht op drugs gehinderd wordt door de  Nederlandse bezuinigingen op de vaste liaisons in Europa

An MP asked whether Dutch cutbacks to permanent police liaison posts in Europe, notably at the MAOC-N drug interdiction centre in Lisbon, hamper international drug interdiction, and whether the Minister's plans were unclear and criticised from Lisbon. The Minister answered that Nederland remains an active partner, that a flexible liaison (FILO) has been in place at MAOC-N since September 2013, that a permanent liaison in Lisbon is being reconsidered within a new deployment plan due end 2014, and that the Rome liaison stays until mid-2015.
At the end of 2014 I will, as promised, inform your House about the new deployment plan.
Eind 2014 zal ik uw Kamer – conform toezegging – informeren over het nieuwe plaatsingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Politiebond: Opstelten pakt geweld tegen agenten niet aan’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criticism from a police union that the national police were insufficiently implementing the protocol on violence against police officers, including caseworker capacity, training hours, compensation funds, anonymous reporting and registration of threats in the private sphere. The Minister answered that the protocol applies organisation-wide, that only 12 FTE of caseworkers are available nationally within a 29 FTE HRM structure, that existing instruments are adequate for recovering damages, and that further measures will be reported to Parliament in the autumn.
In the autumn I will inform your House, as promised in my letter of 11 April, about the further approach.
In het najaar zal ik uw Kamer conform toezegging in mijn brief d.d. 11 april jl. informeren over de verdere aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over digitaal solliciteren bij de politie

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police online application windows for hoofdagent and politiekundige posts were open only briefly, causing server overload and missed applications, and asked for a second chance. The minister confirmed the overload, said the police capped applicants to manage selection, promised new procedures and said affected applicants can still take part, but gave no date for new training places.
After evaluating this system, it has since been decided to develop new instruments to select the most suitable candidate efficiently and effectively among a large number of interested applicants.

Na evaluatie van dit systeem is er inmiddels voor gekozen om nieuwe instrumenten te ontwikkelen om bij een groot aantal belangstellenden op een doelmatig en slagvaardige manier tot de selectie van de meest geschikte kandidaat te kunnen komen.

Vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Oskam (beiden CDA) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over overtredingen met voertuigen voorzien van buitenlandse kentekens (ingezonden 8 mei 2014)

Two CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about traffic offences by foreign-registered vehicles, including enforcement statistics, uncollected fines and the status of the Cross Border Enforcement directive. The Minister answered that speed cameras only recognise Dutch, German, Belgian and Swiss plates, gave collection figures and described the phased extension of enforcement to Polish and French plates.
The report is an internal civil-service working document without formal status and is not intended or suitable for publication.
Antwoord 7 Dit rapport is een intern ambtelijk werkdocument zonder formele status en is niet bedoeld of geschikt voor publicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskamp over het bericht dat torrentsites een omzet halen van 165 miljoen euro

The CDA MP Oskamp asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report that torrent sites earn 165 million euro, including whether Dutch torrent sites pay copyright fees and taxes, the financial damage to the sector, and whether advertisers on illegal sites can be addressed. The State Secretary confirmed knowledge of the report, estimated about 70 Dutch torrent sites per year, stated that damage estimates vary and that rights holders must establish them, and described Brein's outreach to advertisers.
In the first instance it is up to the rightsholder to establish the extent of the damage.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de rechthebbende om de omvang van de schade vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de ophef die is ontstaan sinds het nieuws dat de veroordeelde pedoseksueel Benno L. in Leiden huisvesting heeft gekregen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior and Justice about public outcry over housing a convicted sex offender in Leiden, including whether mayors and councils should be informed and whether citizens should have more say. The minister acknowledged residents' concerns, said mayors decide case by case with partners and need not inform the council beforehand, and announced a joint VNG/OM/reclassering meeting in March 2014 without committing to new structural powers.
Based on the risk analysis, the mayor will decide how and with whom to communicate in order to safeguard the neighbourhood's safety, the victim and the returning sex offender.

Op basis van de risicoanalyse zal de burgemeester beslissen op welke manier en met wie gecommuniceerd dient te worden om de veiligheid van de wijk, het slachtoffer en de terugkerende zedendelinquent te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Pas bij een arrestatie begreep ik de waarde van een bodycam’

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about body-worn cameras for police, following a news report and foreign experiences, and whether a new pilot could be run. The minister replied that a 2009 pilot did not lead to national introduction, that existing cameras are used for supervision and events, and that new pilots (a Eastern Netherlands real-time imaging pilot and a helmet-camera pilot with the NCTV) are underway with evaluation due December 2014.
Further research abroad is not necessary.
Nader onderzoek in het buitenland is niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het bericht dat een gevangene is beschoten met een spijkerpistool

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked the State Secretary about a reported shooting of a prisoner with a nail gun at the Alphen aan den Rijn detention facility, the status of the investigation, occupancy, and whether security was under pressure after G4S guards left. The State Secretary answered that a police investigation is ongoing so the circumstances cannot yet be disclosed, occupancy was above 95%, the security concerns are not shared, and that the department monitors security and incidents internally.
The police investigation is ongoing. As long as the police investigation has not been concluded, no conclusive statement can yet be given about the circumstances of the incident.
Het politieonderzoek is gaande. Over de toedracht van het incident kan, zolang het politieonderzoek nog niet is afgerond, vooralsnog geen uitsluitsel worden gegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Helder en Oskam over zijn uitspraak dat er goede gesprekken zijn met de advocaat van een slachtoffer van identiteitsfraude en zijn toezegging de Kamer hierover te informeren

MPs Gesthuizen, Helder and Oskam asked why the minister said in parliament that talks with the lawyer of an identity-fraud victim were going well, and whether the Chamber had been properly informed. The minister replied that talks took place, the last on 16 April 2013, that the state asked for substantiation of the claimed damages, and that the lawyer was still considering a response; he said the earlier statement was accurate and that individual cases are not usually discussed substantively in the Chamber.
It is not customary to discuss an ongoing individual case in substance in the Chamber.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om in uw Kamer inhoudelijk in te gaan op een lopende individuele zaak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Hijum over de berichten dat online met aanschaf van bitcoins een semi-automatisch wapen is aangeschaft en een tiener zichzelf gedood heeft met een omgebouwd pistool

MPs Oskam and Van Hijum asked about reports that an illegal semi-automatic weapon was bought online with bitcoins and a teenager died from a converted pistol, including what has been done to tighten firearms law, border controls, international cooperation and online arms trade. The minister answered that prior measures concerned legal gun ownership, that border scanning is overwhelmed by volume but being strengthened, that existing enforcement is adequate, and that existing laws and an upcoming bill address online weapon trade, while declining to ban bitcoin.

Yes, the Computer Crime III bill, which I expect to be able to send to the Council of State within a reasonable time, provides among other things for creating an explicit statutory power for the police to enter a computer remotely.

Ja, het wetsvoorstel Computercriminaliteit III, dat ik binnen afzienbare termijn naar de Raad van State verwacht te kunnen sturen, voorziet onder andere in het creëren van een expliciete wettelijke bevoegdheid voor de politie om op afstand een computer te betreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Oskam over het bericht dat “verdachten profiteren in kinderpornozaken van een te vage tenlastelegging”

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that suspects in child pornography cases benefit from vague charging documents, and about a legal disagreement between the Public Prosecution Service and the Hague court on how possession charges must be drafted. The Minister confirmed a legal disagreement limited to a few court chambers, said several dozen cases were delayed and four summons declared void with only occasional sentence effects, and stated there are no formal OM-judiciary agreements, with the OM pressing for a uniform court position and a new test case expected to clarify matters.
The OM Den Haag will soon bring another case using the new method of charging.
Het OM Den Haag zal binnenkort weer een zaak aanbrengen met de nieuwe wijze van tenlastelegging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over een nieuwe speler op de reclasseringsmarkt: ‘Info-Excellente’

An MP asked whether the new organisation Info-Excellente, which seeks recognition as a reclassering provider, counts as a new player and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The minister answered that it is not yet a recognised reclassering institution, that the three existing organisations remain responsible, and that the request and alternatives to the current system will be examined and reported after summer 2014.

Regarding the precise meaning and nature of this application, I have over the past period been in discussion with Info-Excellente itself, the three existing reclassering organisations and the Public Prosecution Service.

Over de precieze betekenis en het karakter van deze aanvraag ben ik de afgelopen periode in gesprek geweest met Info-Excellente zelf en met bestaande drie reclasseringsorganisaties en het Openbaar Ministerie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen naar aanleiding van diens brief over ‘tapgesprekken in de zaak Van Rey’, een reconstructie van de NOS, en het bericht dat de uitleg over de tapgesprekken onwaarsch

MPs Oskam and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about recurring wiretap system outages, a September 2012 power failure that lost roughly 2,000 taps in the Van Rey case, and missing incident records. The minister answered that the outage was an internal power-supply fault rather than a utility failure, that storage and logging procedures are being tightened, and that expert review and a technical backup are being considered.
In the concrete case of the outage on 20 September 2012, it was regrettably neglected to immediately inform the users of the wiretap system that an outage had occurred.
In het concrete geval van de storing op 20 september 2012 is helaas verzuimd om direct de gebruikers van het tapsysteem op de hoogte te stellen van het feit dat zich een storing had voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de financiële ondersteuning van verboden wietclubs door de gemeente Utrecht

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he would hold the municipality of Utrecht to account for paying setup costs and legal advice for two cannabis clubs whose cultivation experiment was not permitted under the Opium Act. The minister answered that no violation of the Opium Act appears to have occurred, that a foundation's exemption request is pending, and that municipal spending is a matter for Utrecht's own council and executive.
Furthermore, the spending of municipal funds is a matter for the municipal executive and council of Utrecht.
Verder is de besteding van gemeentemiddelen een zaak voor het gemeentebestuur en de gemeenteraad van Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over bezuinigingen op grensbewaking

MP Oskam asks whether cuts to the PARDEX border management system undermine the need for better insight into travel movements of persons posing a threat, given the raised threat level, and what budgets and alternative financing exist. The Minister acknowledges insufficient insight into jihadist travel, states a reduced PARDEX scope is retained, and promises a letter by end November on national use of travel data financed through EU funds.
At the end of November I will send the House a letter with the planned measures on travel data.
Eind november stuur ik de Kamer een brief met de voorgenomen plannen rond reisgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Knops over een strakker regime van certificering van schietverenigingen

MPs Oskam and Knops asked whether the stricter certification regime for shooting clubs from 2015 is in place, and about the model self-declaration for new members, its privacy compliance, objections from clubs, whether board members can judge applicants, verification of answers, and whether shooting guilds are exempt. The minister confirmed the regime, said the KNSA model was tested under privacy law and discussed with the ministry, that boards are trained to assess risks, and that no exemption is planned since guilds were already consulted.
There is no certainty that the questions have been answered truthfully.
Er bestaat geen zekerheid of de vragen naar waarheid zijn ingevuld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het bericht dat het Bureau Medicinale Cannabis van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport wiet gaat leveren voor een Utrechts experiment met hasjver

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether a Utrecht experiment supplying cannabis to psychiatric patients could receive an Opium Act exemption and whether the government would block it. The government answered that no exemption application has been filed, so no cannabis will be supplied, and that the Public Prosecution Service would act against any unlicensed experiment.
No application for an Opium Act exemption has yet been submitted for an experiment
Er is nog geen aanvraag voor een Opiumwetontheffing ingediend voor een experiment
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het artikel ‘Politiebonden: ‘Werkgever, ga aan de slag met een veilige werkplek’

An MP asks whether police staff are being told they may not raise workplace problems with unions or works councils, and whether misconduct can be raised through normal dialogue with the employer. The minister denies the picture, points to internal complaint channels, the Onderzoeksraad Integriteit Overheid and a whistleblower procedure, and says culture change is underway with an inspectorate monitor.
Employees are otherwise free to join a trade union and carry out the activities that belong to it.
Het staat medewerkers verder vrij om zich te verenigen in een vakbond en de activiteiten die daarbij horen te verrichten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen over duizenden onterechte boetes op de A13

MPs Oskam and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of thousands of wrongly issued speeding fines on the A13 after a missing speed sign near hectometre post 11.0. The minister replied that the speed limit is sufficiently clear, that no investigation or refunds are needed, and that Rijkswaterstaat checks reported signage problems.
There is indeed no sign in the central reservation.
Er staat inderdaad geen bord in de middenberm.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het bericht “13 duizend euro voor cursus ‘Digitaal leiderschap’”

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked whether a 13,000-euro social media course for civil servants, taught partly by a member of the 'Project X Haren' commission, is a fitting follow-up to that commission's recommendations and how the government will build social media skills without relying on this course. The minister answered that the commission has finished and its knowledge may be spread further, that civil servants are not obliged to take such a course, and that social media training is part of the regular education offer.
It is up to the government and the civil servants concerned themselves to decide which courses should be followed and by whom.
Het is aan de overheid en betrokken ambtenaren zelf om de afweging te maken welke cursussen gevolgd (dienen) te worden en door wie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over 30 km zones

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether speed enforcement in 30 km zones is deprioritised by the police due to capacity shortages, and whether municipal enforcement officers (BOA's) should be empowered to enforce speed limits there. The minister replied that local authorities set enforcement priorities, that 30 km zones should be self-enforcing through road design, and that extending BOA powers to traffic enforcement is not desirable given lack of support from the VNG, police and prosecution.
Extending the powers of municipal BOA's in the context of traffic enforcement is therefore not something I consider desirable.
Uitbreiding van de bevoegdheid van gemeentelijke boa's in het kader van de verkeershandhaving vind ik dan ook niet wenselijk.

Vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat slechts ongeveer de helft van de diplomaten in Den Haag hun verkeersboete betaa

Two CDA MPs asked whether roughly half of diplomats in The Hague leave their traffic fines unpaid, how many fines Dutch diplomats abroad pay, which countries complained, which ten missions owe the most, and what action is taken. The government confirmed the non-payment, said no central figures exist for fines abroad, listed the ten missions with the largest arrears, and described quarterly reminders and occasional summons, noting it lacks enforcement tools. It also gave a limited answer on minister car fines, pointing to published overviews.
No central figures are available on fines and traffic fines imposed abroad on officials and family members sent out by the Netherlands.
Er zijn op centraal niveau geen cijfermatige gegevens beschikbaar van in het buitenland opgelegde boetes en verkeersboetes aan door Nederland uitgezonden ambtenaren en hun gezinsleden.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP) en Oskam (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over kansspelen op het internet (ingezonden 31 juli 2013).

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked the State Secretary why online gambling by unlicensed operators remains easy despite the ban, whether the enforcement criteria are too lax, how the parliamentary motion excluding illegal operators from licences and cutting off banks and payment providers is being implemented, and whether a fast-lane for compliant firms is possible. The government answered that it prioritises enforcement against operators clearly targeting the Dutch market, will add stronger enforcement powers including binding instructions to payment and internet service providers, will exclude persisting operators from licences, is studying a fast-lane but sees limited scope, and is working with banks on a blacklist.
I intend to include in the online gambling bill several additional enforcement instruments to further strengthen the gambling authority's enforcement powers against illegal online gambling.

Bovendien ben ik voornemens in het wetsvoorstel kansspelen op afstand enkele aanvullende handhavingsinstrumenten op te nemen om de handhavingsmogelijkheden van de kansspelautoriteit om illegale online kansspelen aan te pakken verder te versterken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten, Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat een  in afwachting van hoger beroep zijnde veroordeelde zedendelinquent een baan in de gehandicaptenzorg kon krijgen

MPs asked why a convicted sex offender awaiting appeal could take a job in disability care, and how the government will prevent similar cases, including VOG requirements, IGZ reporting of sexual misconduct complaints, and supervision of offenders pending appeal. The state secretary said the pending Wkkgz bill would require providers to vet staff and allow a VOG requirement by decree, IGZ transparency is limited by confidentiality, and immediate enforceability of probation conditions now exists though no figures are kept, with evaluation planned after three years.

With every request for information, a judgement is made about which information can be disclosed without harming those involved, breaching medical confidentiality, or disrupting the treatment process.

Bij elk verzoek om informatie wordt de afweging gemaakt welke informatie naar buiten kan worden gebracht zonder de betrokkenen te beschadigen, het medisch beroepsgeheim te schenden, of het behandelproces te verstoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Steekincident hing in de lucht'

Two MPs from the CDA asked the state secretary about a press report on a fatal stabbing in the Nieuwegein prison, including whether the deceased inmate had complained about overcrowding, the occupancy rate, staffing, transfers after the incident, and whether discrimination played a role. The minister answered that no complaint about overcrowding is known, the occupancy was 82%, staffing was sufficient, five inmates were transferred to restore order, and details of the incident cannot be disclosed because of an ongoing criminal investigation.
The circumstances of this stabbing incident are the subject of an ongoing criminal investigation into the suspect and therefore I cannot make any statements about it.
De toedracht van dit steekincident is onderwerp van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de verdachte en derhalve kan ik geen mededelingen hierover doen.
Vragen van het lid Oskam (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht NS-beveiliger wil ook zakkenrollers pakken (ingezonden 31 juli 2013).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether NS station security staff (boa's) have adequate powers, whether cooperation with police is deteriorating, and what changed with the creation of the national police. The minister replied that boa's already have the powers they need, sees no reason to expand them, denies the reported cooperation problems while promising to monitor them, and says police support for NS will remain a top priority.

The powers of boa's in the public transport domain were developed together with their employers, the Public Prosecution Service and the police, and are sufficiently tailored to the functions and tasks in this domain.

De bevoegdheden van de boa's in het domein openbaar vervoer zijn samen met hun werkgevers, het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de politie tot stand gekomen en zijn voldoende toegesneden op de functies en taken in dit domein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht 'Meer over schiettoets nieuw dienstwapen'

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report on the shooting test for the new service weapon, including whether officers surrender their old weapon at the start of the test and whether those who fail lose the right to use the old weapon. State Secretary Teeven confirmed officers hand in the old weapon, explained that failing officers keep the old weapon in storage at the force leadership's initiative, and said officers without a firearm are restricted to lighter means and must retake a test within a week.
The new weapon is issued if the employee has passed the test.
Het nieuwe wapen wordt meegegeven als de medewerker geslaagd is voor de toets.
Vragen van het lid Oskam (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het CJIB, Marnix State te Leeuwarden (ingezonden 20 juni 2013).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the CJIB office renovation in Leeuwarden, including the cost of furnishings and whether it fits budget cuts. The state secretary answers that the cost of about 1.7 million euro fits Rijk-wide norms, that the published photos show another building, and that the reorganisation aims at more efficient use of office space.
What matters to me is that the costs fit within the norms in force across the central government.
Wat voor mij van belang is dat de kosten passen binnen de (rijksbreed) geldende normen.

Vragen van het lid Oskam (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het in rekening brengen van administratiekosten bij verkeersboetes dat tot ergernis en tot verwarring leidt (ingezonden 21 juni 2013)

An MP asks the state secretary whether administrative costs added to traffic fines cause annoyance and confusion, and whether he agrees with a district court ruling that collection measures were disproportionate in a small case. The state secretary says the fine notice clearly shows the amount, cites appeals court rulings that the charges are lawful, and refuses to include them in the planned evaluation of the fine system.
It does not befit me as Minister of Security and Justice to have a judgment on the ruling of a district court judge in an individual case.
Het past mij als Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie niet om een oordeel te hebben over de uitspraak van een kantonrechter in een individuele zaak.
Antwoord vragen Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het rapport inzake de luchtkwaliteit in celruimten in huizen van bewaring en gevangenissen

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked the State Secretary about a report on air quality in prison cells, whether cell ventilation will meet standards quickly, the impact on the Masterplan DJI, the costs, and whether multi-person cell use is possible. The State Secretary answered that only ventilation capacity was measured, that the report has no consequences for the Masterplan, that ventilation cleaning protocols will be tested at selected locations with further measures if needed, that costs are unknown, and that multi-person cell use will only occur in suitable cells.
If the test with cleaning protocols does not achieve the desired results and other measures prove necessary, measures will be taken depending on the planned closure date.

Mocht de test met reinigingsprotocollen niet tot de gewenste resultaten leiden en mochten daardoor andere maatregelen noodzakelijk blijken, dan zullen afhankelijk van het tijdstip van voorgenomen sluiting maatregelen genomen worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam ver het bericht ‘Werden Deutsche Autofahrer im Ausland abgezockt?’

Oskam (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Dutch police regularly fine German drivers at the Denekamp border for a missing hyphen between letters and numbers in vehicle papers, and how this enforcement fits police priorities. The minister answered that he had made inquiries and the police and CJIB are not aware of such fines, so the third question does not arise.
I have made inquiries with the National Police. The Police and the CJIB state that they are not aware of such fines.
Ik heb bij de Nationale Politie navraag gedaan. De Politie en het CJIB geven aan niet bekend te zijn met dergelijke bekeuringen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat criminelen in toenemende mate APAAN gebruiken als grondstof voor de productie van synthetische harddrugs

MP Oskam asked ministers whether criminals increasingly use APAAN as a precursor for synthetic hard drugs, and why it is not listed under the Dutch precursor law or the EU registered-substances list. The government confirmed rising seizures and conversion labs, explained that the Den Bosch ruling concerned precursor registration rather than drug status, said the appeal was partially withdrawn pending EU Court preliminary questions, and declined to ban APAAN under the Opium Act because it is not a psychoactive drug.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has argued at EU level that APAAN should be placed on the list of registered substances.
Verder heeft Nederland in EU verband bepleit dat APAAN op de lijst met geregistreerde stoffen komt te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat Eindhoven Airport een belangrijke schakel zou zijn in de internationale mensenhandel

MPs Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Eindhoven Airport is a key hub for international human trafficking and what steps are being taken there. The minister confirmed awareness, described a Public Prosecution Service project and Marechaussee information-building at the airport, and answered that no other small border-region airports hold a comparable position.
The Public Prosecution Service has started a project aimed at further improving the approach to criminal networks involved in human trafficking.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is met een project gestart dat zich richt op het verder verbeteren van de aanpak van criminele samenwerkingsverbanden inzake mensenhandel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de vergunningplicht op grond van de Wet op het financieel toezicht op het gebied van onder andere curatele en bewindvoering

An MP asked whether banks demanding AFM licences from court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) to open accounts can be stopped, given the minister's promised exemption. The minister confirmed the promise, said he asked the banks' association to inform members, and aims to publish the exemption by 1 July 2013, retroactive to 26 February.
I have therefore asked the NVB to point its members to my commitment and my intention with it.
Ik heb de NVB daarom gevraagd haar leden te wijzen op mijn toezegging en mijn bedoeling daarmee.
Antwoord vragen Oskam over de berichten ‘Gokbranche wil lagere belasting’ en ‘Het Nederlandse model voor gokken op internet komt eraan’

Oskam (CDA) asked whether the government should accept online gambling firms' demands for a much lower gambling tax rate, and how it would prevent evasion from tax havens like Malta. The government confirms it is considering a lower 20 percent rate for remote gambling, arguing a high rate drives players to illegal operators, and says a strong regulated regime and enforcement will address evasion.
A lower rate for legal remote gambling is indeed being considered.
Een lager tarief voor legale kansspelen op afstand wordt inderdaad overwogen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de toegezegde medewerking van de gemeente Haarlemmermeer aan de vestiging in Hoofddorp van wat het grootste sekscomplex van Europa gaat worden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the planned mega sex complex in Hoofddorp, Haarlemmermeer, conforms to local prostitution and zoning policy, what risks it poses (drug trade, trafficking), and how it could be prevented. The minister answered that no formal application exists yet, so conformity cannot be judged; the current zoning plan does not permit a sex business and a new plan would be needed; sector regulation addresses criminal risks; and municipalities may lawfully permit such businesses, so no reason exists to block it.
Since no concrete application has yet been submitted to the municipality for the sex business, the intended size of the establishment is not fixed.
Aangezien er nog geen concrete aanvraag is ingediend bij de gemeente voor de vestiging van het seksbedrijf staat de beoogde grootte van de vestiging niet vast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Oskam over het bericht  “Onrust over VKB-regeling”

MPs Agnes Mulder and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criticism that the new Vkb small-business security scheme was rushed, unequal for suppliers, non-transparent in its criteria and lacking appeal options. The minister defended the open tender run by the CCV with an independent adviser, said the criteria were not specified in the invitation, denied that only one supplier was designated, and promised evaluation of the scheme in autumn 2013.
The Centre for Crime Prevention and Safety (CCV) is responsible for implementing the new approach and has partly its own freedom of action and assessment within the frameworks set by my ministry.

Het Centrum voor Criminaliteitspreventie en Veiligheid (CCV) is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering de nieuwe aanpak en heeft binnen de door mijn ministerie gestelde kaders deels een eigen handelings- en beoordelingsvrijheid.
Antwoord vragen Oskam over het bericht Intern onderzoek naar vervalsing telefoontaps

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a Alkmaar court found falsified wiretap transcripts, leading to the prosecution being declared inadmissible and the defendant being freed pending appeal. The minister confirmed the court's findings on four inaccurate transcripts and related concerns, and said an internal police investigation was launched instead of the Rijksrecherche, which could be called in later.
It was decided to have the investigation carried out by a separate unit within the Noord-Holland police, namely the Safety, Integrity and Complaints department.
Besloten is het onderzoek te laten verrichten door een aparte afdeling binnen de politie Noord-Holland, te weten de afdeling Veiligheid, Integriteit en Klachten.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over het bericht dat een meisje misbruikt is door haar groepsleider in de instelling van de Hoenderloo Groep waar zij verbleef voor behandeling als gevolg van misbruik door l

MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether a youth care group leader's abuse of a girl at the Hoenderloo Groep was reported to the Inspectie Jeugdzorg, what the institution did, whether other victims were investigated, the status of the criminal case, and whether the suspect could still work with minors. The government answered that the inspectorate required improved reporting and protocols, no other victims were found, the investigation is in its final phase, and mandatory VOG screening for youth care staff is being introduced.
The inspectorate pointed out to the Hoenderloo Groep that in future it must itself report such an incident promptly.
De inspectie heeft de Hoenderloo Groep (DHG) erop gewezen dat zij in het vervolg een dergelijke calamiteit zelf en tijdig dient te melden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Oskam over het bericht dat ZZP’ers (zelfstandigen zonder personeel) slachtoffer zijn van cybercriminaliteit

MPs Agnes Mulder and Oskam asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Security and Justice whether they recognise a trend of cybercriminals targeting sole traders and small firms, some going bankrupt, and what will be done about it. The government said it has no information on such a trend or on bankruptcy figures, points to an ongoing police study and a planned survey in Flevoland, and lists awareness campaigns and websites for SMEs and sole traders.
We have no information about the trend reported in the article that cybercriminals increasingly target sole traders and small firms.
Wij hebben geen informatie over de in het artikel gesignaleerde trend dat cybercriminelen het in toenemende mate voorzien hebben op eenmansbedrijven en kleine ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Kooiman en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat er geen sms wordt verzonden via AMBER Alert na 22 uur

MPs Oskam, Kooiman and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether AMBER Alert SMS messages are withheld between 22:00 and 07:00 and why, and whether differentiated night-time delivery could be arranged. The minister confirmed that night-time SMS alerts were stopped after complaints about disturbed sleep, and promised a website option allowing participants to opt in to night-time SMS within one to one and a half months.
There was a risk that participants would drop out because they were disturbed at night by incoming SMS messages.
Het risico ontstond dat deelnemers zouden afhaken omdat ze ’s nachts gestoord worden door binnenkomende SMS-berichten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de vangst van 900 kilo qat tijdens een grenscontrole op de A16

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about a seizure of 900 kilos of qat at the A16 border check, whether qat trade has grown since the ban, and how the ban is being enforced and publicized among Somali communities. The minister answered that there are no signs of increased trade, that enforcement attention has increased and the seizures indicate success, and that information on the ban has been distributed to a broad network with further consultations planned.
Since 5 January 2013 the investigative services have given extra attention to the criminalisation of possession of qat.
Binnen de opsporingsdiensten is sinds 5 januari 2013 extra aandacht gegeven aan de strafbaarstelling van het bezit van qat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat de voormalige wethouder van Roermond de documenten die door het Openbaar Ministerie zijn gevorderd bij de gemeente Roermond heeft ingezien

MP Oskam asked ministers about a former Roermond alderman who obtained documents seized by the Public Prosecution Service from the municipality, including building project files, and whether rules exist for such requests. The government answered that the municipality handled his requests as Wob requests, that the decision is for the municipality and reviewable in court, that no specific rules exist, and that he must pay fees.
It is up to the municipality to take a decision on the requests.
Het is aan de gemeente om een besluit te nemen naar aanleiding van de verzoeken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de vergunningplicht Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) op het gebied van onder andere curatele en bewindvoering

An MP asked whether court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) need an AFM licence to open bank accounts for clients, and whether that conflicts with the Civil Code duty to open such accounts. The minister answered that opening accounts is brokering requiring a licence in principle, but because the administrator is already legally obliged and supervised by the court, a licence exemption will be created with the AFM, also for curators, and that other categories will be discussed with the AFM.
I will therefore create an exemption in consultation with the AFM.
Ik zal dan ook in samenspraak met de AFM een vrijstelling vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Oskam over pedofiele praktijken door vrouwen

MPs from VVD, SP, D66 and CDA asked the Justice Minister about a broadcast on female paedophile practices, including whether the conduct is prosecutable, whether a new network exists, and whether police and prosecutors are aware of female offenders. The minister condemned the conduct, said the OM is cooperating with Greek investigators and will assess Dutch prosecution, and confirmed existing awareness of female offenders while referring to earlier answers.

In light of the findings within the Greek investigation, it will be examined whether the conduct is prosecutable under Dutch law, individually or in association, and whether a criminal investigation in the Netherlands is warranted.

Mede naar aanleiding van de bevindingen binnen het Griekse opsporingsonderzoek zal worden bezien of gedragingen individueel dan wel in verenigingsverband naar Nederlands recht vervolgbaar zijn en een strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Nederland aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over het blowverbod op scholen in Amsterdam

MPs Oskam and Rog asked whether the government supports a legal basis for a cannabis-smoking ban around schools in Amsterdam, how it squares with the Council of State ruling on municipal bans, and what enforcement tools municipalities have. The minister answered that the government is exploring stricter school rules, that municipalities can set coffee shop distances and local bans through the Opium Act enforcement guideline, and that court cases on the Amsterdam ban are pending.
The ministries involved are cooperating to strengthen a healthy school environment and are exploring the possibilities to tighten the rules.
De betrokken ministeries trekken samen op om een gezonde schoolomgeving te versterken en verkennen de mogelijkheden om de regels aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de rapportage ‘Drugshaven’

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Omroep Brabant report on cocaine smuggling through Antwerp and whether 95% of it transits to the Netherlands, and what is being done on cooperation with Belgium. The minister said the 95% figure is not based on OM data and cannot be confirmed, that cooperation with Belgium is intensifying, and that Europol prioritises cocaine smuggling.
The public prosecution service (OM) has informed me that the stated percentage is not based on their data.
Het openbaar ministerie (OM) heeft mij meegedeeld dat het genoemde percentage niet is gebaseerd op hun gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en De Rouwe over het gevaar van krachtige laserpennen

MPs Oskam and De Rouwe asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the dangers of high-powered laser pointers, including pilot complaints, sales, and possible prohibition. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to new criminal provisions on endangerment and sales restrictions already in place, and saw no need for Wet wapens en munitie changes, noting some municipalities have local bans.
I see no reason for that.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Knops over schutterijen die aanlopen tegen knelpunten in de wapenwet- en regelgeving

MPs Oskam and Knops (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether shooting clubs (schutterijen) would get their own weapons rules, and about practical problems under the Cwm and Wwm, including carrying deactivated weapons, replica weapons, sponsor shooting with children, and the KNSA licence requirement. The State Secretary answered that the club input was considered in the evaluation, that some problems (carrying during drill, sponsor shooting) will be examined and may lead to rule changes, but rejected the idea that clubs could issue their own licences and KNSA membership could lapse.
I will examine whether the laws and regulations need to be adjusted on this point.
Ik zal bezien of de wet- en regelgeving op dit punt aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het onderzoek ‘Erven zonder financiële zorgen’

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked the government about a study proposing three routes to protect heirs from unintended acceptance of an estate's debts, about the number of households with negative home equity, and about delays in CAK and Toeslagen decisions affecting inheritances. The government said it has no exact count of negative-equity households (estimated around 700,000), announced mortgage-debt measures and a temporary tax deduction for residual debt, and promised a reply on the study's preferred route by year-end.
The cabinet does not have information that gives insight into the exact number of households with negative home equity.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die inzicht geeft in het exacte aantal huishoudens met een negatieve overwaarde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat diefstal uit kerken en kloosters een onderschat probleem lijkt te zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether theft from churches and monasteries is underestimated and whether a national prosecutor for art and heritage crime should be restored, plus questions on opening the stolen-art database and a separate reporting code. The minister answered that art crime is being addressed through dedicated police task-accent holders and national OM contacts, that the national database is not public but feeds Interpol's, and that a separate reporting code is not favoured.
One of the measures is appointing a task-accent holder for art crime within each (future) regional police unit.
Een van de maatregelen is het aanstellen van een taakaccenthouder kunstcriminaliteit binnen elke (toekomstige) regionale politie-eenheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat de reclassering de huisvesting van een zwervende pedofiel zou blokkeren

Amendement van het lid Rouvoet c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het voortzetten van de financiering van de uitstapprogramma's voor prostituees
Shifts budget within the justice and crime article to continue funding exit programmes for prostitutes in 2011.
to continue the funding of exit programmes for prostitutes for the year 2011
de financiering van uitstapprogramma’s voor prostituees voor het jaar 2011 voort te zetten
Motie Gesthuizen en Vendrik over de rol van de aanbestedingsdesk
Asks that the procurement desk be obliged to report complaints it receives to a municipal council, provincial states or the responsible parliamentary committee.

requests the government to lay down in law the obligation for the desk to report complaints to either the municipal council, provincial states or the standing House committee responsible for oversight
verzoekt de regering de verplichting vast te leggen voor de desk om klachten te melden bij ofwel de gemeenteraad, ofwel Provinciale Staten ofwel de vaste Tweede Kamercommissie
Motie Vendrik c.s. over inzet in Europees verband voor een CO2-norm voor energiecentrales
Asks the cabinet to push for an EU CO2 standard of 350 g per kWh for power plants and to introduce such a standard in the Netherlands, in response to planned coal plants.
requests the cabinet to work at European level for a CO2 standard of 350 grams of CO2 per kWh of energy produced
verzoekt het kabinet om zich in Europees verband in te zetten voor een CO 2 -norm van 350 gram CO 2 per kWh geproduceerde energie
Motie Vendrik c.s. over een verplicht aandeel duurzame energie
Motion asks the government to propose a mandatory share of renewable energy supplied by energy companies, rising over time.
requests the government to make proposals by 1 March 2010 for a mandatory share of renewable energy
verzoekt de regering voor 1 maart 2010 voorstellen te doen voor een verplicht aandeel duurzame energie
Motie Gesthuizen en Vendrik over de functie van de kredietdesk
Motion asking the government to have the credit desk also mediate in loan applications and give second opinions on rejected credit applications.
requests the government to ensure the credit desk also acts as mediator in credit applications
verzoekt de regering ervoor zorg te dragen dat de kredietdesk ook de functie vervult van bemiddelaar bij kredietaanvragen
Motie Gesthuizen en Vendrik over misbruik van inkoopmacht
Asks the government to inform the House how the competition authority NMa can and will tackle abuse of purchasing power, possibly including amending the Competition Act.
requests the government to inform the House on how abuse of purchasing power can and will be tackled by the NMa
verzoekt de regering de Kamer te informeren over hoe misbruik van inkoopmacht kan en zal worden aangepakt door de NMa
Motie Van der Vlies / Gesthuizen over de relevante markt voor het leveren van diensten in de eerste lijn
Asks the government to declare that the relevant market for first-line care services is regional or national, a competition-law view unrelated to executive checks.
declares that the relevant market for providing first-line services is therefore a regional or national market
spreekt uit dat de relevante markt voor het leveren van diensten in de eerste lijn dientengevolge een regionale dan wel een nationale markt is
Motie Gesthuizen over het inkopen van natuursteen die niet door kinderen gedolven is
Asks the government to buy only natural stone not quarried by children and in line with ILO fundamental labour rights.
requests the government to ensure Dutch governments only purchase natural stone not quarried by children
verzoekt de regering ervoor zorg te dragen dat de Nederlandse overheden vanaf nu alleen nog natuursteen inkopen die niet door kinderen gedolven is
Motie Vos c.s. over het op hetzelfde niveau houden van de consumentenbescherming
Asks the government to keep consumer protection in the Netherlands at least at its current level despite a proposed EU harmonisation.
calls on the government to keep consumer protection in the Netherlands at least at the same level
roept de regering op de consumentenbescherming in Nederland op ten minste hetzelfde niveau te houden
Motie Gesthuizen over het inzichtelijk maken van gelden voor innovatieprojecten
Asks the government to make transparent how innovation funds will be spent, as effectively, efficiently and openly as possible.
requests the government to make clear how these funds will be deployed as effectively, efficiently, carefully and transparently as possible
verzoekt de regering inzichtelijk te maken hoe deze gelden op een zo effectief, efficiënt, zorgvuldig en zo transparant mogelijke wijze zullen worden ingezet
Motie Gesthuizen over investeringen van het bedrijfsleven in relatie tot gebruikmaking van kennisinfrastructuur
Asks the government to study how companies' R&D investments relate to their use of publicly funded knowledge infrastructure.
requests the government, through a study, to make clear how companies' investments in research and development relate
verzoekt de regering via een onderzoek inzichtelijk te maken hoe de investeringen in onderzoek en ontwikkeling van bedrijven zich verhouden
Motie Ortega-Martijn over het niet schenden van fundamentele arbeidsrechten in de toeleveringsketen van bedrijven die overheidssubsidie ontvangen
Motion asking the government to require subsidised firms to show they do not violate fundamental labour rights in supply chains, and to stop support if they refuse.
requests the government to ask companies receiving government subsidies, credits or trade mission support to make transparent that they are not involved in violating fundamental labour rights
verzoekt de regering bedrijven die overheidssubsidie krijgen, kredieten ontvangen, meegaan op handelsmissies of anderzijds door de overheid gesteund worden, te vragen om inzichtelijk te maken
Motie Gesthuizen en Aptroot over opheffing van het Innovatieplatform
Asks the government to dissolve the Innovatieplatform as quickly as possible because it duplicates ministry tasks.
requests the government to dissolve the Innovatieplatform with the utmost urgency
verzoekt de regering het Innovatieplatform met de grootst mogelijke spoed op te heffen

Amendement van het lid Gesthuizen om de voorgestane high trust beleid te keren en om op langere termijn ook hogere inkomsten voor de toezichthouders (NMa/Dte en OPTA) en daarmee de Staat te realiseren
Shifts budget from the Innovation Platform to market-supervision budget lines to reverse reduced competition oversight by NMa/Dte and OPTA.
Furthermore, in the longer term this amendment will very likely also lead to higher income for the supervisory authorities (NMa/Dte and OPTA) and thus for the State.
Voorts leidt dit amendement op langere termijn zeer waarschijnlijk ook tot hogere inkomsten voor de toezichthouders (NMa/Dte en OPTA) en daarmee de Staat.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de voorgestelde versobering van opvang van asielzoekers in Griekenland

Four MPs asked the State Secretary about a proposed tightening of reception for asylum seekers in Greece under the EU-Turkey deal Joint Action Plan, and Human Rights Watch's criticism. The government answered that the JAP aims to speed up asylum procedures and improve safety and reception capacity, denied that Greece is a policy laboratory, and said it expects no worse conditions or longer stays on the islands.

The government does not expect a severe deterioration of conditions for people on the Greek islands or longer stays, because the JAP also works on faster and more efficient Greek asylum procedures and more regular returns to Turkey.

Het kabinet verwacht geen grove verslechtering van de situatie voor de mensen of een langere verblijfsduur op de Griekse eilanden, omdat onder het JAP ook wordt gewerkt aan bijvoorbeeld het sneller en efficiënter verlopen van de Griekse asielprocedures en terugkeer naar Turkije op regelmatiger basis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de gang van zaken in de nasleep van de moord op drie vrouwen in Parijs

The MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked whether Dutch authorities knew that suspect Ömer Güney had died, what information was exchanged with France and Turkey about the Paris murders, whether he was a Turkish infiltrant, and how information misuse can be prevented. The government answered that it did not know of his death until media reports, declined to discuss the information exchange or the French indictment, said it had no information about an infiltrant, and deflected questions on Turkish use of shared information.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het vragen naar de geaardheid van asielzoekers door het COA

An SP MP asked whether COA staff question asylum seekers about their sexual orientation, after reports from LHBT residents at Ter Apel. The State Secretary replied that no formal complaints were received, that such questions are not customary but may arise in sensitive individual conversations, and that COA has no task to collect information on sexual orientation.
COA has not received any formal complaints from LHBT residents of the Ter Apel asylum centre about COA conduct regarding their sexual orientation.
Het COA heeft geen formele klachten ontvangen van LHBT-bewoners van het asielzoekerscentrum in Ter Apel over gedragingen van het COA met betrekking tot hun geaardheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over subsidieverlening aan organisaties voor slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik in de kerk

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about the resignation of KLOKK's supervisory board, the salary and spending of KLOKK's director, the handling of sub-funding to MCU, and the continuation of grant support. The government replied that the board resigned on its own choice over a disrupted relationship with the executive board, that the director's pay is set by the supervisory board, that remaining improvement points are being followed up, and that the grant will not be renewed after 2017 and disbursement was paused.
However, it is for the Supervisory Board, in its role as employer of the director, to set the director's employment conditions.
Het is evenwel aan de Raad van Toezicht, in de rol van werkgever van de directeur, om de arbeidsvoorwaarden van de directeur vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen over de 9e rapportage van de Europese Commissie over relocatie en hervestiging van vluchtelingen

MPs asked the State Secretary about the Commission's 9th relocation report, including the number of asylum seekers eligible for relocation from Greece and how Dutch refusals were justified. The State Secretary answered that about 20,000 relocation candidates are now present in Greece, that roughly 20 cases were refused on public order or national security grounds, and that the 10th report will clarify figures.
That is why the Cabinet considers it important to communicate about this consistently and unambiguously.
Daarom vindt het Kabinet het belangrijk om hier steeds helder en eenduidig over te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het terugsturen van kinderen naar Afghanistan

The SP MP Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about returning Afghan children to Afghanistan, including the Joint Way Forward agreement, the child-rights risks, adequate reception, return interviews and protection of unaccompanied minors from exploitation. The State Secretary Dijkhoff answered that the agreement sets no numbers, that the asylum procedure protects those in need, that adequate reception is assessed case by case, and that EU cooperation addresses trafficking, while promising to answer each question separately.
The Joint Way Forward contains no agreements on numbers of returnees.
De Joint Way Forward bevat geen afspraken over aantallen terugkeerders.
Antwoord op vragen die van de leden Voordewind, Voortman , Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen (SP) over de motie inzake de Regeling langdurig verblijvende kinderen

MPs asked whether the government would accept that citing the coalition agreement does not justify ignoring an adopted motion, and whether it would impose a deportation stop for long-resident asylum children until a new cabinet forms. The Secretary of State says the coalition agreement was not decisive, but declines to amend the Regeling or impose a deportation stop, citing disruption of removal procedures and raised expectations.
However, I did not want to leave out of the letter my observation that the motion is at odds with the coalition agreement.
Ik heb echter de constatering dat de motie op gespannen voet staat met het regeerakkoord niet achterwege willen laten in de brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Merkies en Smaling over de mate waarin Nederlandse verzekeraars zich inzetten voor toegang van mensen in arme landen tot medicijnen

SP MPs asked why Dutch insurers score poorly on health and access to medicines in responsible investment rankings, and what the government will do about it. The minister said several insurers have not signed the Access to Medicine Index investor statement, but that the sector is being engaged through a planned IMVO covenant and that DNB oversees insurers' prudential risk management without setting investment policy.
The investment policy of insurers is primarily the responsibility of those insurers themselves.
Het investeringsbeleid van verzekeraars is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van die verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voordewind over het bericht dat de UNHCR gehinderd wordt door Turkije in de monitoring van de vluchtelingendeal

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked about reports that UNHCR lacks unhindered access to Turkish reception centres and to monitor returned migrants under the EU-Turkey deal, and about deaths at the Syrian border. The minister replied that access is a recurring topic with Turkey and the Commission, that there is no systematic refusal, that the government cannot confirm the reported shooting deaths, and that it will keep raising access in the Commission's regular reporting.
The Netherlands will therefore continue to press the Commission that regular access forms part of the joint approach, and that this receives attention in the regular reporting.
Nederland zal dan ook bij de Commissie blijven bepleiten dat regelmatige toegang deel uitmaakt van de gezamenlijke aanpak, en dat daarvoor bij de reguliere rapportage aandacht bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Gesthuizen, Oosenbrug en Agnes Mulder over de locatie Zeewolde voor de middengolfzender

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Zeewolde medium-wave mast is a non-duplicable monopoly, whether the owner NOVEC must provide sharing under the Telecommunications Act, and whether the government should help find an alternative site for Groot Nieuws Radio before its lease ends. The minister answered that finding a suitable site is the licence holder's responsibility, that the government will help assess alternatives, and that the access dispute is pending before the ACM, so he cannot comment on the substance.
During ongoing legal proceedings I cannot make substantive statements about the matter in question.
Gedurende lopende juridische procedures kan ik geen inhoudelijke uitspraken over de desbetreffende zaak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over het illegaal de grens overzetten van migranten naar Servië

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary about reports that migrants are illegally pushed back across the border from Hungary and Croatia into Serbia, with police violence, and about reception shortfalls in Serbia, EU responsibility and safe routes. The government condemns violence against refugees, says the Commission is primarily responsible for enforcing EU law and that Serbia has enough reception capacity, and declines to start resettlement from Serbia or to take a new EU initiative.
The cabinet condemns all forms of violence against refugees.
Het kabinet veroordeelt iedere vorm van geweld tegen vluchtelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Raak over Russische hackers die gebruikmaken van Nederlandse server

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Russian hackers used a Dutch server, and whether such attacks can be prevented and how Dutch email vulnerabilities are addressed.
