The minister declined to comment on the specific case, said the government will keep parliament informed through general threat reports, and stated that political parties are primarily responsible for their own information security while the government raises cybersecurity awareness.
The cabinet does not make public statements about specific cases.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over specifieke casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het terugsturen van kinderen naar Afghanistan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about returning Afghan children (including unaccompanied minors) under the EU-Afghanistan Joint Way Forward, given child rights violations, adequate reception, and trafficking risks. The State Secretary answered that the arrangement sets operational terms without quotas, that return of unaccompanied minors prioritises family reunification with adequate reception as a condition, that DT&V uses regular return counsellors and interpreters, and that EU cooperation against trafficking continues, without committing to new measures.
The document contains no agreements on numbers of returnees.
Het document bevat geen afspraken over aantallen terugkeerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de overname van PostNL-loketten door DHL en Sandd

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about PostNL counter services being taken over by DHL and Sandd in Bruna shops, and whether this threatens universal postal service for vulnerable groups. The minister answered that negotiations are ongoing, that PostNL must meet statutory coverage and consultation requirements overseen by ACM, and that there is no sign of breach.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat burgemeesters af willen van kansloze asielzoekers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security how to respond to reports that mayors want to be rid of rejected asylum seekers causing nuisance, including Dublin procedure risks, EU pressure on origin countries, numbers of nuisance-causing asylum seekers, and mayors' powers. The State Secretary answered that a package of tougher measures, case-based local cooperation and EU-level pressure on origin countries are in place or being pursued, while acknowledging returns cooperation with Morocco and Algeria is limited and complex.
As communicated to your House on 17 January 2017, during the New Year's period a total of 340 immigration-law measures, area bans, were imposed on nuisance-causing asylum seekers.

Zoals op 17 januari 2017 aan uw Kamer is gecommuniceerd, is er tijdens de jaarwisseling uiteindelijk 340 maal een vreemdelingrechtelijke maatregel – gebiedsgebod- opgelegd aan overlastgevende asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over Eritrese ambassades (Herdruk)

MPs Gesthuizen asked whether the Eritrean embassy's requirements (a repentance form and 2% diaspora tax) for passport renewal, and refusals to help Eritrean women, were acceptable and what the government would do. The State Secretary answered that the government considers linking consular services to repentance forms objectionable, has raised the issue with Eritrea and adopted a sanctions-based ban on tax collection involving coercion, and will raise concerns with European partners.
The Cabinet considers linking consular services to signing repentance forms objectionable.
Het Kabinet acht de koppeling van consulaire dienstverlening aan het tekenen van spijtbetuigingsformulieren laakbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman over alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen die slachtoffer worden van mensenhandel en uitbuiting

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked about the Save the Children report on unaccompanied minor victims of trafficking in Italy, the rise in Nigerian minors arriving via Italy, whether the Netherlands bears special responsibility, Albania's EU accession and anti-trafficking cooperation with Italy and the Balkans. The Minister described the figures as worrying, pointed to EMPACT THB cooperation, liaison officers and joint investigations, and said Albania is not yet ready to open accession negotiations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over staatloosheid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a UN complaint by a stateless child born in the Netherlands, the status of the statelessness determination bill, the protection of stateless people in the meantime, the lack of a humanitarian (buitenschuld) residence permit for them, and whether years registered as 'nationality unknown' count toward naturalisation. The State Secretary said the complaint is in UN procedure and will be summarised in the annual report if it reaches the government, that the bill goes to the Council of State around early 2017, that stateless people have access to schooling, youth care and legal aid, and that return impossibility can qualify for a buitenschuld permit while years registered as unknown are not relevant for naturalisation.
The petition has not been forwarded to the government for response by the Human Rights Committee. Should that happen in future, the procedure must first run its course.
Het verzoekschrift is door het Mensenrechtencomité niet voor reactie aan de regering toegezonden. Mocht dat in de toekomst gebeuren, dan zal eerst de procedure zijn beloop moeten krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma, Voortman, Van der Staaij en Thieme over uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether the extradition of two Rwandan-national suspects should be reconsidered in light of testimony from Witteveen about Rwandan courts, fair-trial risks and the Bandora case, and whether a broader extradition inquiry should be conducted. The minister refused to revisit the decision, stating Witteveen's findings were already weighed, the Court of Appeal found no real fair-trial risk, and the two men were extradited on 12 November 2016.
I see no reason to revisit the decision regarding the extradition.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de beslissing ten aanzien van de uitlevering te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over betrokkenheid van ABN Amro bij de aanleg van de Dakota Access-oliepijpleiding en het neerslaan van protesten daartegen

MPs Gesthuizen and Merkies asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO's involvement in the Dakota Access pipeline, whether the state (via NLFI) is liable, whether it will investigate alleged human rights abuses against protesters, and how the banking CSR covenant applies. The minister answered that ABN AMRO is not in the financing consortium, that NLFI is not responsible for its investments, that the US legal system is the proper forum, and that complaints can go to the OECD National Contact Point.
It is not for the Dutch government to investigate this.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid om hier onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Verhoeven over de zeer hoge uitkering aan de topman van NXP bij de verkoop van het bedrijf

MPs Gesthuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the reported USD 428 million payout to NXP's chief executive from the company's sale, and the risks of such exorbitant pay, were acceptable, and whether the clawback rules and NXP subsidies would be reviewed. The minister, on behalf of the economic affairs minister, declined to judge the amount, said pay assessment is for shareholders and the company, referred to earlier answers on clawback and subsidies, and gave no new commitments.
I have no opinion on the amount reported in the media that the NXP chief executive would keep from the takeover if he exercised his options and sold his shares.
Ik heb geen oordeel over de in de media genoemde hoogte van het bedrag dat de uitvoerend bestuurder van NXP zou overhouden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de mislukte aanbesteding van Zaakgericht Werken (ZGW) door de Dienst ICT Uitvoering

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Zaakgericht Werken tender by DICTU failed and why the work was then awarded through a minicompetition, including tender conditions, pricing, cost arrangements and whether AT and IGZ have clarity. The minister answered that the minicompetition covered a different assignment, that the original tender was withdrawn under its reserved rights, and that AT and IGZ have approved a phased approach with a proof-of-concept phase completed.
In this case there is no question of 'the same assignment'.
Er is in casu geen sprake van «dezelfde opdracht».
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het niet inzetten van registertolken bij de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst en de Nationale Politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the failure to use registered sworn interpreters at the IND and police, the use of unsworn interpreters and short interrogations, and oversight by courts. The Minister said the Wbtv permits exceptions, that the legal framework and court review suffice, and that the Raad voor de Rechtspraak will be asked to address stricter control of registered interpreter use.
I will bring the aspect of the mandatory use of registered interpreters and the recording of deviating use to the attention of the Raad voor de Rechtspraak.
Ik zal het aspect van het verplichte gebruik van geregistreerde tolken en het vastleggen van een afwijkend gebruik bij de Raad voor de Rechtspraak onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de taakstelling huisvesting statushouders en de aanpak sociaal domein in Den Haag

The MP asks why 144 housing places for status holders in The Hague remain unfilled, why the 1466 target differs from the 144 matchable holders, and whether The Hague's approach can be applied nationally. The Secretary of State attributes the shortfall to lower asylum inflow, notes catch-up obligations and recent matchings, and says housing is a municipal task while promising to share successful approaches.
The housing of permit holders is an independent task of the municipalities.
De huisvesting van vergunninghouders is een eigenstandige taak van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het door derden onttrekken van gegevens aan het WOZ-waardeloket

Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether third parties are harvesting WOZ property valuation data from the WOZ-waardeloket for commercial purposes, whether this is allowed under Article 40a Wet WOZ, how it is monitored and prevented, and whether access could be restricted via DigiD. Minister Plasterk answered that automated bulk extraction is not permitted, that anti-scraping safeguards and monitoring by the Kadaster are in place, but that full prevention is not feasible without undermining transparency, and that the government will decide on bulk provision after evaluation and a working group is examining further openness.
It is indeed not permitted to extract data from the WOZ-waardeloket in an automated manner.
Het is inderdaad niet toegestaan om op geautomatiseerde wijze gegevens aan het WOZ-waardeloket te onttrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het leeftijdsonderzoek bij alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen

An MP asked the State Secretary about oversight of age assessment for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers, court rulings on age shouldering, scientific research, EASO guidance on guardians, legal remedies and contra-expertise. The State Secretary explained the division of inspection roles, the revised IND viewing procedure, ongoing research into alternative imaging methods, the existing guardian and information arrangements, that age-test outcomes are challengeable only via a negative residence decision, and that contra-expertise remains possible with ongoing consultation on expert availability.
Following the case law you refer to, the IND has critically reviewed its working method and decided to draw up further instructions.
Naar aanleiding van de jurisprudentie waar u aan refereert, heeft de IND zijn werkwijze kritisch in ogenschouw genomen en besloten nadere instructies op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over jonge statushouders die gaan studeren

MPs Bashir, Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked the Minister about poor coordination between COA and municipalities that leaves student housing for young refugees underused, and about how the gaps in study guidance and information will be addressed. The Minister replied that municipalities are responsible for housing, that the Rijk has introduced early screening of refugees' education and work background, and that study guidance is a task of the educational institutions, with specialised support from UAF.
Municipalities are responsible for the housing of refugee status holders.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de huisvesting van statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het besluit- en vertrekmoratorium voor asielzoekers uit Jemen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the decision and departure moratorium for Yemeni asylum seekers had expired, whether it would be extended, what has changed in Yemen, and whether repeated extensions create an uncertain situation for asylum seekers. The State Secretary confirmed it expired on 11 August 2016 and cannot be extended again, promised to inform parliament after a Foreign Affairs report on Yemen's security situation, and rejected the claim that repeated moratoria harm asylum seekers.
The decision and departure moratorium for asylum seekers from Yemen expired on 11 August 2016.
Het besluit- en vertrekmoratorium voor asielzoekers uit Jemen is op 11 augustus 2016 afgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het afschaffen van de logeerregeling voor statushouders

SP MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about abolishing the guest-family arrangement for status holders, including usage numbers, costs, integration effects, and confusion over whether the scheme was ended. The State Secretary answered that the scheme remains open, the self-care arrangement ended by law, no data exists on integration effects, and the scheme's future is under review.
No data is available on the effect that a status holder's stay with a guest family has on their civic integration.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het effect dat het verblijf van een vergunninghouder in een gastgezin heeft op zijn/haar inburgering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Sjoerdsma, Gesthuizen en Voortman over de uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

Five MPs asked whether the Netherlands is extraditing two genocide suspects to Rwanda despite expert doubts about fair trials there, and whether this should be suspended pending independent review. The minister confirmed the extradition proceeds after appeal courts found no real risk of an unfair trial, argued trial in the country of the crime is preferred, and refused to suspend extradition or commission new independent research.
I am therefore not willing to suspend the extradition.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid de uitlevering op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Nederlandse bedrijven in India kleding laten produceren onder het minimumloon

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch clothing firms are responsible for sub-contractors in India paying below the legal minimum wage and whether they will be held to account. The minister says firms have due diligence duties under OECD guidelines and a sector covenant, commits to raising the living wage collectively and to the report being put to the firms, but declines to name the factories and leaves enforcement largely to firms and the Indian government.
The cabinet wants to discuss the report 'Uitgekleed-Aangekleed' within the framework of the IMVO covenant for the clothing and textile sector concluded in July.
Het kabinet wil de discussie over het rapport «Uitgekleed-Aangekleed» voeren in het kader van het in juli afgesloten IMVO-convenant voor de kleding- en textielsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de kosten van het verzoek om Nederlander te worden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice to explain how the naturalisation fees (single, multiple, child, stateless/asylum and option applications) are built up and why they differ, and whether lower fees could be introduced for less wealthy applicants. The government answered that fees aim to cover IND and municipal costs with cross-subsidisation, that differentiation reflects workload, and that it will not investigate a lower tariff for less wealthy people.
I am not willing to investigate the possibility of allowing less wealthy people to qualify for a lower tariff.
Ik ben niet bereid tot het onderzoeken van de mogelijkheid om minder vermogende mensen in aanmerking te laten komen voor een lager tarief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Bruins en Gesthuizen over de toegezegde evaluatie van de Winkeltijdenwet

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the status of the promised evaluation of the Shop Opening Hours Act, including whether workers' interests, Sunday rest and small retailers are considered, whether municipalities copy neighbouring municipalities' policy, and when the report will be sent. The Minister answered that an external evaluation is underway covering these interests and neighbouring-municipality effects, that he will not anticipate its outcome, and that the results and a policy letter will be sent before year-end.
So as not to anticipate matters, I first await the outcomes of the evaluation.
Om niet op de zaken vooruit te lopen, wacht ik eerst de uitkomsten van de evaluatie af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de mislukte aanbesteding van Zaakgericht Werken door de Dienst ICT Uitvoering

MP Gesthuizen asked the minister why DICTU abandoned the failed tender for Zaakgericht Werken, why it then ran a mini-competition among framework partners, and how the BIT advice was reflected. The minister explained that stopping the tender was a separate DICTU judgement made before the BIT advice, that the mini-competition followed BIT recommendations with a focus on implementing the case system for AT and IGZ, and described the selection of Atos.
The decision to stop the tender was a standalone assessment by DICTU.
Het besluit om de aanbesteding te stoppen is een op zichzelf staande afweging geweest van DICTU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Kuiken, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over de brand in het vreemdelingendetentiecentrum Rotterdam

MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a fire at the Rotterdam immigration detention centre, including the lack of aftercare, isolation and searches of detainees, the non-central unlocking of doors, and why the Inspectorate did not investigate earlier. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate will investigate the events, expected to finish by late November 2016, and will report to parliament afterwards, and that it has now decided to open a further inquiry since the Amnesty account covers different facts.
The Inspectorate of Security and Justice will carry out an investigation into the course of events surrounding the fire.
Inspectie VenJ) zal onderzoek verrichten naar de gang van zaken rond de brand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over uitwisseling van passagiersgegevens tussen EU en Canada

The SP MP Gesthuizen asked the Justice Minister how the government views the Advocate General's opinion that the EU-Canada passenger data agreement breaches fundamental rights, and what it means for the Canada and US agreements and the PNR directive. The minister declined substantive comment while the Court of Justice is still deliberating, noting the Parliament's referral under Article 218(11) TFEU, and promised to report on the Court's ruling.
I therefore refrain from a further substantive response at this time.
Ik onthoud mij daarom op dit moment van een nadere inhoudelijke reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Gesthuizen over bancaire dienstverlening aan activiteiten van humanitaire organisaties in sanctielanden als Syrië en Rusland

MPs Dijkgraaf and Gesthuizen asked whether Dutch banks are wrongly over-applying sanctions regimes and blocking banking services to humanitarian organisations in Syria and Russia, and whether the government will act. The government replied that banks make their own risk assessments within EU sanctions rules, that humanitarian exemptions can be requested from the Ministry of Finance, that it is in dialogue with banks and will encourage them to facilitate humanitarian organisations, and that a 'white list' idea merits further EU discussion.
The cabinet is in dialogue with the banks on sanctions policy.
Het kabinet is over het sanctiebeleid in dialoog met de banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Oosenbrug en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Voor je het weet, troggelt de doorverbindsite je centen af’

MPs Jacobi, Oosenbrug and Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about commercial websites that route consumers to police, tax authority and company customer-service numbers via expensive 0900 numbers costing up to 90 cents per minute. The minister finds this undesirable, notes the ACM supervises 0900 numbers and unfair trade practices, has discussed the numbers with the ACM, and says new rules would only be considered if current law proves inadequate.

I consider it undesirable that consumers are misled by this and pay unnecessarily high information rates to contact agencies or companies that are reachable by phone for free or at limited call costs.

Ik vind het onwenselijk als consumenten hierdoor worden misleid en onnodig hoge informatietarieven betalen om telefonisch contact op te nemen met instanties of bedrijven die gratis of tegen beperkte belkosten telefonisch bereikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over misleidende datingsites met valse profielen

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about dating sites using fake profiles, including whether such sites can be taken offline and how victims are supported. The government answered that the ACM can investigate and fine misleading practices but cannot take websites offline, that this power is under discussion at EU level, and that it is working with victim support organisations.
It is not possible to take websites offline, because the ACM lacks the power to do so.
Het is niet mogelijk om websites offline te halen, omdat de bevoegdheid hiertoe bij de ACM ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Ahold na de fusie met Delhaize leveranciers met terugwerkende kracht minder gaat betalen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Ahold Delhaize's plan to retroactively reduce payments to suppliers breaches the fair trading code, and about competition and complaint options. The minister said the matter is being discussed in the agrofood fair-trade code steering group, that no specific rules govern such talks, and that the ACM has no grounds to act yet, promising a further letter by end of September 2016.
I am awaiting the outcome of this consultation before giving a further substantive response.
Ik wacht de uitkomst van dit overleg af alvorens een verdere inhoudelijke reactie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het Onderwijsaccountantsprotocol 2016

An SP MP asked the education and economic affairs ministers why the 2016 accountant protocol limits procurement checks above EU thresholds to administrative organisation and internal control, and how this fits with the earlier growth model. The minister replied that full checks were never required, that the lighter scope was chosen to reduce burden and respond to accountants' objections, and that oversight remains via the accountant's reporting, the civil courts and the Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts.
Because I am responsible for making a workable audit protocol available to the institutional accountants, I chose to heed their objections and opted for a less burdensome form of control.

Omdat ik ervoor verantwoordelijk ben een uitvoerbaar controleprotocol aan de instellingsaccountants beschikbaar te stellen, heb ik ervoor gekozen gehoor te geven aan hun bezwaren en gekozen voor een minder zware vorm van controle.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de rechten van alleen-staande minderjarige vreemdelingen

MPs Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind and Sjoerdsma asked the State Secretary about the rights of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers (AMVs): how many special building-exception residence permit requests were made and refused, long-term prospects, the revised Dublin Regulation, the COA improvement plan, and placement procedures. The State Secretary answered that about ten such requests were filed and all refused, stressed family reunification and child-interest considerations, committed to monitoring and a possible evaluation, supported the best-interests principle in Dublin revision, and promised the COA improvement letter before the summer recess ends.
No permits have been issued ex officio under the building-exception policy either. The reason for this is not recorded in the IND's automated system.
Ook zijn er geen ambtshalve vergunningen verstrekt op grond van het buitenschuldbeleid. De reden hiervoor wordt niet in het geautomatiseerde systeem van de IND geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de  stakingen bij PostNL in Nijmegen

An SP MP asked whether PostNL strikes in Nijmegen also involved non-payment of worked hours, whether employers must pay worked rather than rostered hours, and what powers the Inspectorate SZW has over rostering and treatment of staff. The minister confirmed media reports of non-payment as one reason for the strike, said the wage question is for the civil court to decide, and described the Inspectorate's inspection and enforcement powers and complaint routes.
It is not for me or the Minister of Economic Affairs but for the civil judge to give a ruling on this.
Het is niet aan mij of de Minister van Economische Zaken maar aan de burgerlijke rechter om hierover een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Turkije Syrische vluchtelingen niet laat uitreizen

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that Turkey is blocking 52 Syrian refugees holding German visas from leaving, and about selection criteria and numbers for resettlement from Turkey under the EU-Turkey statement. The State Secretary answered that the people remain in Turkey while bilateral talks continue, declined to provide education or medical data per individual, stated that education level should not be a selection criterion, and gave resettlement figures and a planned monthly quota of about 100 for the Netherlands.
No, I do not have such detailed data on the German cases.
Nee, ik beschik niet over dergelijke gedetailleerde gegevens over de Duitse zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Tongeren over het gebruik van een privé-e-mailadres voor werkaangelegenheden

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about his use of a private email account for work matters, the security rules that apply, the 2014 hacking investigation and possible foreign access to the data. The minister admitted frequent but not prohibited business use of private email, ordered an Auditdienst Rijk investigation into whether classified material was present, and promised to inform parliament after the summer recess.

I have therefore instructed the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) to investigate whether documents bearing the classifications Departmental Confidential, State Secret Confidential, State Secret Secret or State Secret Top Secret under the VIR-BI were present in my private email account.

Ik heb daarom de Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) opdracht gegeven onderzoek te doen naar de vraag of documenten met de rubriceringen Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, Staatsgeheim Confidentieel, Staatsgeheim Geheim of Staatsgeheim Zeer Geheim zoals bedoeld in het Voorschrift Informatiebeveiliging Rijksdienst Bijzondere Informatie (VIR-BI) op mijn privé e-mailaccount aanwezig waren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Gesthuizen over claimstichtingen van massaschades

MPs Van Nispen and Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about oversight of claim foundations pursuing mass-damage claims, after reports that many lacked adequate safeguards against misuse of funds and conflicts of interest. The minister acknowledged the problems, said courts currently check only limited criteria, and announced a bill tightening rules for collective representatives, while rejecting a mandatory public annual accounts requirement and a separate Onderzoeksraad for mass damages.
In practice, the review against the criterion of sufficiently safeguarded interests has so far been limited.
In de praktijk blijkt de toetsing aan het criterium van de voldoende gewaarborgde belangen tot op heden beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Gesthuizen over digitale platforms voor verhuur van woningen aan toeristen, zoals Airbnb en Wimdu

Two SP MPs asked the Ministers for Housing and Economic Affairs about short-term tourist rental of homes via platforms like Airbnb, including whether social rental homes may be rented out and whether a notification duty is needed. Minister Blok answered that social housing must not be used for tourist rental, that existing laws (Huisvestingswet, Woningwet, Wro) already give municipalities enough enforcement tools, and that no notification duty is planned for now, while the government is working on a tax-data provision and on local agreements with platforms.
Due to privacy considerations, there is currently no possibility to oblige Airbnb to provide the data of providers or users of its services to the government.
In verband met de privacy is er op dit moment geen mogelijkheid om Airbnb te verplichten de gegevens van aanbieders of gebruikers van hun diensten aan de overheid te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de kwaliteit van postbezorging

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about declining postal delivery quality, theft of post, working conditions and market competition, citing a VGP survey showing slight declines in business mail. The minister answered that universal service quality is stable or improving per ACM and PostNL data, that the VGP sample is not fully representative, and that a market review is planned with a new policy rule on postal obligations.
I committed to your House on 30 March to such a study in response to the Vos and Bosma motion.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 30 maart een dergelijk onderzoek toegezegd in reactie op de motie Vos en Bosma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat er met amv’ers wordt gesleept

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that 28 unaccompanied minor asylum seekers would be moved, whether Nidos may make exceptions to its small-scale reception policy, and whether jongeren turning 18 can stay longer in reception. The State Secretary replied that the new small-scale model is in force, Purmerend's parties reached agreements on housing, and exceptions for 18-year-olds are ruled out, while relocations will be reviewed.
As also recently indicated to various civil society organisations during a meeting on children in reception, the number of relocations will be examined further.
Zoals ook recent richting diverse maatschappelijke organisaties is aangegeven tijdens een bijeenkomst over kinderen in de opvang, zal nader worden gekeken naar het aantal verhuisbewegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat het COA mensen op straat laat slapen

An SP MP asked whether COA made asylum seekers sleep on the street as punishment after a fight, whether this is policy, and how often it occurs. The Staatssecretaris confirmed awareness of the report and explained that the COA's ROV regulation allows withholding allowances or temporarily denying reception, with 243 such denials in 2015 ranging from one week to three months.
As a measure, financial allowances may be withheld or reception facilities may be denied, temporarily or otherwise.
Als maatregel kunnen financiële verstrekkingen worden ingehouden of opvangvoorzieningen, al dan niet tijdelijk, worden ontzegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen, Kuiken, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat opvang wordt geweigerd aan (zieke) vreemdelingen die bereid zijn om het land te verlaten

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary whether asylum seekers willing to leave the Netherlands are being refused shelter at Ter Apel, including sick ones, and why the buitenschuld regime and the motions on voluntary return and bed-bad-brood arrangements are not reflected. The state secretary denied the premise, explained that shelter is conditional on demonstrated active cooperation with return, and stated that medically necessary care is available with a possible deferral of departure under article 64 Vw.
It is generally correct that not all foreigners who request shelter at the VBL are actually admitted to the VBL.
Het is in algemene zin juist dat niet alle vreemdelingen die verzoeken om onderdak in de VBL daadwerkelijk tot de VBL worden toegelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het terugsturen van asielzoekers naar Burundi

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether returns of asylum seekers to Burundi remain safe given escalating violence and UN warnings of possible civil war, and how many Burundians are in asylum or return procedures. The State Secretary answered that fewer than 10 Burundians are in each procedure, that a six-month decision and departure moratorium has been introduced, and that a new general country report has been requested from Foreign Affairs.
I have informed your House today that I am introducing a decision and departure moratorium for Burundi for a period of six months.
Ik heb uw Kamer heden geïnformeerd dat ik voor Burundi een besluit- en vertrekmoratorium instel voor de duur van zes maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over Ethiopische vluchtelingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about Ethiopian asylum seekers: lack of birth registration, OLF document authenticity, detention and release, and Eritrean nationality proof. The State Secretary answered that no OLF document has been rejected as forged, that few Ethiopians are detained and returns are possible, and that case-by-case attention applies to undocumented asylum seekers.
In not a single case has this led to the conclusion that the documents cannot be accepted as genuine.
In geen enkel geval heeft dit geleid tot de conclusie dat de documenten niet als echt kunnen worden geaccepteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Gesthuizen over uitblijven van genoegdoening aan (indirecte) slachtoffers van mijnbouwactiviteiten in Colombia

MPs Jan Vos and Gesthuizen asked whether the government would urge Dutch energy firms to halt coal purchases from Colombian suppliers linked to paramilitary violence until victims receive redress, and how it would address victims' access to remedy in the peace process. The minister answered that the government favours an inclusive transitional justice approach within the FARC peace deal, encourages companies to use supplier leverage and due diligence rather than suspension, and says the Cesar victims exploration will not proceed because the peace agreement is now the vehicle.
The cabinet encourages energy companies to use their trading relationship with mining companies to achieve these improvements, so that the option of temporary suspension does not have to be invoked.

Het kabinet moedigt de energiebedrijven aan om hun handelsrelatie met de mijnbouwbedrijven in te zetten voor deze verbeteringen om te voorkomen dat de optie van een tijdelijke opschorting ingeroepen moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de situatie van Bhutanese vluchtelingen in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands had promised to resettle 500 Bhutanese refugees from Nepal, whether resettlement missions continue, how illiterate refugees can complete integration, whether naturalised refugees can travel to Bhutan, and how many political prisoners Bhutan holds. The government said no numerical promise was made, resettlement missions ran 2008–2011 and were halted after Nepal and Bhutan failed to act, integration allows extended deadlines, refugee travel documents exclude the home country, and no reliable information on political prisoners exists.
There is no unambiguous, reliable information about the presence of political prisoners in Bhutan.
Er is geen eenduidige, betrouwbare informatie over de aanwezigheid van politieke gevangenen in Bhutan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen over Subsidie voor ontwikkelingsprojecten van Heineken in Afrika

Two MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Dutch subsidies to Heineken development partnerships in Africa, including additionality, job losses, tax avoidance, water use and alcohol promotion. The minister defended the partnerships, said additionality is assessed by market conditions rather than a mathematical test, and rejected repayment, committing to no concrete new action.
Additionality of the government contribution is a condition for a partnership with the business sector.
Additionaliteit van de overheidsbijdrage is een voorwaarde voor een partnerschap met het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over het bericht dat op Sheremetyevo Airport een vluchteling vast zit in de transit-zone

SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Syrian asylum seeker is stranded in Sheremetyevo airport's transit zone, including Russia's asylum practice, passport handling, how common such stranding is, and whether the Netherlands will intervene. The minister confirmed the case, said Russia rarely grants formal asylum but more often temporary status, described passport handling as standard practice, and said the Dutch embassy works through UNHCR rather than direct action on the specific case.
The Dutch embassy regularly has contact with the local UNHCR office in Moscow on refugee and migration matters.
De Nederlandse ambassade heeft regelmatig contact met het lokale kantoor van UNHCR in Moskou over vluchtelingen- en migratiezaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat de afgelopen maanden 60 kindbruiden Nederland zijn binnengekomen

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked about reports that around 60 child brides had entered the Netherlands in recent months, the number of Syrian child brides, and how minors' safety and registration would be ensured. The state secretary confirmed roughly 60 married minor girls entered independently between September 2015 and January 2016, said the IND would not separately register child marriages, and described existing guardianship and reception measures while declining to discuss individual cases for privacy reasons.
For privacy reasons I cannot go into the individual circumstances.
Vanwege privacyaspecten kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Gesthuizen over de samenwerking tussen het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en Belastingdienst in ontnemingskwesties

MPs Van Nispen and Gesthuizen asked why cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Tax Authority on confiscating criminal assets was so weak for eighteen years and why the AAFD protocol came only in 2015. The minister replied that cooperation does exist, that the protocol is not a dead letter, and that the Prosecution Service and Tax Authority will tighten the rules and the Lower House will be informed later.
Following the recommendations of the Investigation Committee, the College of Procurators-General is revising the Aanwijzing and Instructie on asset confiscation.
Naar aanleiding van de aanbevelingen van de Onderzoekscommissie herziet het College van procureurs-generaal de Aanwijzing en de Instructie afpakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over ongewenste sms-dienstabonnementen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about unwanted premium SMS subscriptions, including whether the sales practices violate unfair commercial practice rules, whether minors can be signed up, and whether self-regulation or new legal rules are needed. The minister said the ACM is responsible for enforcement, declined to comment on individual cases, supported adjusting the mobile industry code to use the term 'betalen' and said he would convey this to the code foundation, and called for prevention under shared responsibility while deferring judgement on new legislation.
This data is not known to me.
Deze gegevens zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de inzet van PostNL in de onderhandelingen over de PostNL- en zaterdagbestellers-cao

The SP MP Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether PostNL's cao proposals linking falling profits to the costs of employing former self-employed parcel couriers, and PostNL's pricing relative to competitors, reflect a competitive disadvantage that merits ACM market-power investigation. The minister confirmed knowledge of the letter, declined to assess it as part of ongoing union-company talks, noted PostNL's annual report figures, said the ACM's ongoing parcel market scan would address pricing and level playing field, and deferred to the independent ACM on whether to start further market analyses.
It is not fitting for me as Minister to express an assessment of that.
Het is past mij als Minister niet om daarover een waardering uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman over de dood van een Eritrese asielzoeker

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked whether police and prosecutors would investigate the disappearance and death of an Eritrean asylum seeker, why COA and police information was not shared with German authorities, and whether a conflict with a roommate was reported. The minister replied that the German authorities handled and closed the investigation, that the COA reported a roommate dispute but no threat, that the person was moved to another room, and that the COA's notice to the EMM was not passed on under standard procedure, while promising to inform relatives if new insight arises.
The investigation into the death of the Eritrean asylum seeker, Mr. Mekonen, falls under the competence of the German authorities.
Het onderzoek naar het overlijden van de Eritrese asielzoeker, de heer Mekonen, valt onder de bevoegdheid van de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de verlaging van vergoedingen aan winkeliers met een postpunt

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about PostNL's plan to cut fees paid to shop-based postal points, the reasons for stamp price rises, expected closures and effects on liveability, and whether an exclusivity clause in PostNL's contracts is compatible with competition law and should be investigated by the ACM. The minister answered that the matter is primarily between PostNL and the retailers' association, that universal service rules and spreading requirements in the Postbesluit remain in place, and that he sees no reason to ask the ACM for a specific investigation.
I therefore see no reason to specifically ask the ACM to carry out an investigation now.
Ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding om ACM nu specifiek te vragen een onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat gevluchte Eritrese vrouwen zijn gedwongen tot seks

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Eritrean refugee women were forced into sex, including how many are pregnant and whether they are in asylum centres. The minister answers that about 25 women report unwanted pregnancy and three report rape, that COA took preventive measures and reported signals to police, and that no formal complaints have yet been filed and no criminal offences established.
COA cannot assess the seriousness and truthfulness of these signals and has reported them to the police and the Expertise Centre on Human Trafficking and Smuggling (EMM).
Het COA kan de ernst en het waarheidsgehalte van deze signalen niet inschatten en heeft deze signalen gemeld bij de politie en Expertisecentrum Mensenhandel en Mensensmokkel (EMM).
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Siderius en Gesthuizen inzake de problemen rond de huisvesting van de Internationale Schakelklas (ISK)

MPs Siderius and Gesthuizen asked the state secretaries about problems finding adequate school housing for asylum-seeker children in the International Transition Class, and about funding and a possible national contribution. The government answered that municipalities are responsible for school housing, acknowledged difficulties in some cases, said a national scheme for secondary education is being explored, and is in talks with affected municipalities and school boards.

For secondary education, the possibility is being examined of quickly designing a scheme, modelled on the OHBA scheme for primary education with standard amounts, that addresses school housing problems in municipalities.
Voor het voortgezet onderwijs wordt de mogelijkheid onderzocht om op korte termijn een regeling te ontwerpen, die naar analogie aan de OHBA-regeling voor het primair onderwijs met normbedragen werkt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over de belastingvoordelen voor Shell, Total en ENI in Nigeria

SP MPs asked the government to react to an ActionAid report on tax holidays worth 3.3 billion dollars for Shell, Total and ENI in Nigeria, and whether such incentives help poor countries, and asked about Dutch involvement and aid to Nigeria. The minister answered that tax incentives should be used narrowly, that Nigeria is responsible for its own incentive design, that the Netherlands did not actively help Shell obtain its incentive, that tax holidays show weak effects and the OECD and IMF advise restraint, and gave Nigeria aid figures.
The Dutch government does not support individual Dutch companies in obtaining favourable tax treatment in developing countries.
De Nederlandse overheid geeft geen ondersteuning aan individuele Nederlandse bedrijven om een gunstige fiscale behandeling in ontwikkelingslanden te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid in de kobaltmijnbouw

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour in cobalt mining in DR Congo, raised by an Amnesty report, including the EU conflict minerals regulation, OECD due diligence alignment, sales of affected devices, and the IMVO covenant for electronics. The minister replied that child labour in cobalt mining is among the worst forms, that companies should follow OECD due diligence, that cobalt is not on the negotiating table since no institution proposed adding it, that the origin of cobalt cannot be traced after smelting so the number of affected devices is unknown, and that cobalt will be placed on the covenant agenda only if the electronics sector takes an initiative.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kuiken over de moeilijke positie van LHBT in de asielopvang

MPs Gesthuizen and Kuiken asked about a reported suicide attempt by a gay asylum seeker in Alphen aan den Rijn linked to LHBT insecurity, reports of abuse of LHBT residents in reception centres, low reporting of crimes, and whether separate shelter or a dedicated contact person should be provided. The Secretary of State said the resident was moved at his own request, rejected a separate inquiry, said discrimination is not tolerated and the COA will pursue perpetrators, declined separate categorical shelter and a dedicated LHBT contact person, and promised a letter by March 2016 on stricter enforcement plus a study meeting to improve information on rights and reporting.
I therefore see no reason to have a further investigation carried out into the circumstances.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om een nader onderzoek te laten doen naar de toedracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de betrokkenheid van bedrijven uit de Nederlandse financiële sector bij de bosbranden in Indonesië

MP Gesthuizen asked the minister whether Dutch financial institutions such as Rabobank, ABN AMRO and ABP should be held responsible for financing palm oil firms linked to deliberate forest fires and land grabbing in Indonesia, and whether banks, insurers and pension funds would be included in covenant negotiations and a ban on such palm oil considered. The minister answered that due diligence under OECD guidelines applies, that banks and other sectors are engaged through IMVO covenants and dialogue, and that a legal ban is currently not internationally feasible in favour of voluntary, certification-based approaches.
I do not have an overview of the companies operating in the Netherlands that purchase palm oil grown in Kalimantan for the Dutch market.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de in Nederland opererende bedrijven die voor de Nederlandse markt palmolie inkopen die op Kalimantan is verbouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de druk op de beveiliging in asielzoekerscentra groot is

SP MPs asked whether reports of high pressure on security at asylum reception centres were accurate, how many violent incidents occurred, whether training and police support were adequate, and how staff safety is ensured. The Secretary of State answered that incidents rose in number but are not disproportionate, that contracted security is certified, that a mantle agreement with the security firm covers staff safety, and that police support is available, while stating that incidents with weapons are not separately registered and that the COA could not split its figures by location type.
Incidents involving weapons are not registered separately.
Incidenten waarbij wapens betrokken zijn worden niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over overdracht van persoonsgegevens op grond van de Europese Dataprotectieverordening

An SP MP asked whether the new Article 43a of the EU data protection regulation means foreign demands for personal data from companies can only be met via an international agreement, and what this means for businesses, including smaller firms. The minister answered that other legal bases in Chapter V (administrative arrangements, Article 44(1)(h) derogation) remain available, that businesses should know the relevant law, and that he considers Article 43a a balanced provision.

I consider Article 43a of the GDPR, also against the background of Chapter V of the GDPR as a whole, a provision that ensures an adequate balance between the interests of personal data protection and the interests of the EU, the Member States and third countries.

Ik acht artikel 43a van de AVG, mede tegen de achtergrond van Hoofdstuk V van de AVG in zijn geheel, een bepaling die een voldoende evenwicht waarborgt tussen de belangen van de bescherming van persoonsgegevens en de belangen van de EU, de lidstaten en derde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen over het besluit de gefinancierde rechtsbijstand voor bepaalde groepen asielzoekers af te schaffen

MPs Voordewind and Gesthuizen asked whether asylum seekers need a lawyer from the first decision stage, and questioned the planned removal of state-funded legal aid for an asylum group expected to be granted, plus the speed, documentation and security screening of that track. Secretary Dijkhoff answered that the procedure keeps sufficient safeguards, that legal aid is removed only where a grant is foreseeable, and that the rest of the questions are addressed through consultation and implementation, while refusing to postpone the measure.
Only asylum seekers who belong to the designated group and for whom a grant is foreseeable will no longer receive subsidised legal aid.
Enkel de asielzoekers die behoren tot de aangewezen doelgroep en waarvan voorzienbaar is dat de aanvraag zich leent voor inwilliging krijgen niet langer gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat gebruikers van Popcorn Time schadeclaims kunnen verwachten

An SP MP asked the Minister whether users of Popcorn Time face copyright damage claims, whether such claims are rising, and whether downloading should be punished. The Minister answered that enforcement is largely a private matter, that individual rightsholders may sue users only via court orders against internet providers, that no such claims against end users are known in the past five years, and that the government supports legal online offerings and awareness campaigns.
I do not have information from which it can be quantified to what extent this has led to an increase in illegally exchanged films and series.
Ik beschik niet over informatie aan de hand waarvan kan worden gekwantificeerd in hoeverre dit tot een toename van illegaal uitgewisselde films en series heeft geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het nareisbeleid ten aanzien van Tibetanen

An MP asked the government about family reunification for Tibetans, including whether the permanent residence requirement, the Chinese passport problem, the lack of biometric capacity at the Nepal honorary consulate and UNHCR registration in India create special circumstances warranting exemptions. The government answered that the IND does not count how often the requirement is applied, that it accepts individual exemptions on humanitarian grounds and does not usually apply the requirement to family members of refugees, but it did not commit to a general exemption.
The IND does not record how often the permanent residence requirement is cited as a ground for refusal in MVV procedures.
De IND registreert niet hoe vaak het bestendigheidsvereiste als afwijzingsgrond wordt tegengeworpen bij MVV-procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat opsporingsdiensten witwasdossiers laten liggen

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that money-laundering case files are left unprocessed by investigative services, asking about FIU cooperation, reasons for not investigating signals, and capacity. The minister answered that FIU reports are not equal to case files, that signals are continuously weighed with the OM, that the FIU receives no feedback from the Belastingdienst, and that capacity is considered sufficient with time allocated to money laundering rising.
A suspicious transaction that FIU-Nederland passes on to an enforcement or investigative body cannot be equated with a money-laundering case file.
Een verdachte transactie die FIU-Nederland doorgeeft aan een handhavings- of opsporingsinstantie kan niet gelijk gesteld worden aan een witwasdossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het onderzoeken van signalen van mensensmokkel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about signals of human smuggling and trafficking linked to the death of an Eritrean asylum seeker, Kahsay Mekonen, and whether police investigated, shared information with German authorities and gave the family access to records. The minister answered that police and prosecutors found no concrete trafficking signals, that the German authorities ruled the death a suicide, that a wiretap was shared with Germany, and that the file would not be reopened, though the police will review any evidence Argos provides.
If the police investigation is not reopened, are you willing to nonetheless grant access and openness regarding documents, including in the IBIS system, concerning Mekonen?
Indien het politieonderzoek niet heropend wordt, bent u bereid alsnog inzage en openheid te geven inzake documenten in onder meer het IBIS-systeem rondom Mekonen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Verhoeven en Keijzer over kosten van RADAR

MPs from SP, D66 and CDA asked about the cost of the RADAR ICT system, including the value of the Capgemini delivery contract, extra work paid after termination, and external staffing costs. The State Secretary corrected earlier figures, estimated about 350,000 euro extra for Capgemini's support on the KvK interface, declined a detailed breakdown of staffing costs as too burdensome, and promised a planning for that answer.
I therefore suggest, given the administrative burden, that you refrain from this effort.
Ik geef u daarom in overweging mee, met het oog op administratieve lastendruk, af te zien van deze inspanning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over minderjarige Syrische bruiden

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked how the government will prevent forced child marriages of Syrian girls who come to the Netherlands to reunite with husbands, what steps follow arrival, how many child brides have arrived, and what support is offered. The government answered that the Wet Huwelijksdwang will set the minimum marriage and recognition age at 18, that Nidos, IND and COA watch for signs of forced marriage, that research on informal marriages is underway, and that tailored psychological support and specialist shelter are available.
Child brides are not separately registered in the IND registration system.
Kindbruiden worden niet apart geregistreerd in het IND-registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voortman over de gesloten gezinsvoorziening in Kamp Zeist

MPs Gesthuizen and Voortman asked the State Secretary why the temporary closed family facility at Kamp Zeist is becoming permanent, how it differs and is child-friendly, how it fits 2013 rules on families, and how many children were detained and deported. The State Secretary answered that the facility becomes structural, with child-friendly design, and gave detention and removal figures for 2013-2015, while referring some points to earlier letters and not fully answering whether families can await removal at their previous location.

As indicated in the letter of 13 September 2013 you cite, asylum applications from families with minor children arriving at the external border are not processed in the closed extended asylum procedure.

Zoals in de door u aangehaalde brief van 13 september 2013 is aangegeven worden asielaanvragen van gezinnen met minderjarige kinderen, die aankomen aan de buitengrens, niet in de gesloten verlengde asielprocedure behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kooiman en Gesthuizen over de balans tussen veiligheid en rechtsstaat

Three SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the balance between security and the rule of law has tipped toward security, how he would restore it given budget cuts, and whether the police should return to the Ministry of the Interior. The minister denied any tipping, pointed to intensifications, and declined to change the police's ministerial placement, saying a future cabinet could decide that.
The cabinet sees no reason to anticipate this.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding hierop vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Gesthuizen inzake onderwijs aan meerderjarige vreemdelingen

MPs Siderius and Gesthuizen asked whether the government's rules denying adult foreigners without a residence permit the ability to start or switch education are desirable, and whether they conflict with the European Convention on Human Rights. The minister answered that residence-permit applicants and those with lawful stay can enrol, that unlawfully staying adults may only finish courses already begun under the Koppelingswet's aims, and that no legislative change is planned.
The cabinet sees no need to take further measures.
Het kabinet ziet geen noodzaak om verdere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over Dublin overdrachten naar Hongarije

MPs Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma and Voordewind asked about reports of poor reception conditions in Hungary, continued Dublin transfers there, and whether transfers should be suspended. The State Secretary answered that Dublin transfers to Hungary continue under the mutual trust principle, that the matter is before the Council of State, and that no concrete suspension is planned.
As answered to the questions from MPs Voortman, Kuiken and Maij, I maintain the principle of inter-state trust towards Hungary and see insufficient reason to suspend Dublin transfers.

Zoals geantwoord op de vragen van de leden Voortman, Kuiken en Maij houd ik vast aan het interstatelijke vertrouwensbeginsel ten opzichte van Hongarije en zie ik onvoldoende aanleiding om Dublinoverdrachten op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de tekorten bij Frontex

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister of Defence about reported shortages of border guards and equipment at Frontex, why many member states have not responded to its calls, and whether the Netherlands has made an extra contribution. The government confirmed the shortages, said member states decide their own contributions, and listed Dutch additional personnel and equipment for 2015 while noting it has no overview of other states' pledges.
I have no overview of the total deployment or the additional pledges made by individual member states to Frontex in 2015.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de totale inzet of de extra toezeggingen die afzonderlijke lidstaten in 2015 aan Frontex hebben gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat voorschotfraude toeneemt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why advance-fee fraud (fake inheritance and lottery scams) appears to be rising, what causes it, how it is prevented and prosecuted, and whether international cooperation is adequate. The minister answered that the reported increase is partly overstated, attributed rises to internet use and awareness, pointed to prevention, the Veiligheidsagenda target of 1,500 horizontal fraud cases in 2015, and an international working group, while stating he has no data on the exact chance of being caught.
I do not have data to determine the exact chance of being caught.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens om de exacte pakkans te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind en Voortman over scheiding van gezinnen vanwege tegenwerping 1F

MPs Gesthuizen, Voordewind and Voortman asked whether families separated by an Article 1F exclusion would have the exclusion re-examined, whether the government could guarantee the utmost care, and which countries still prosecute alleged war crimes. The State Secretary replied that Article 1F is assessed in the asylum procedure separately from family life under Article 8 ECHR, that the exclusion is examined with all safeguards, that the choice to leave lies with family members, and that prosecution abroad is a separate matter that the Public Prosecution Service monitors.
Can you guarantee the Chamber that, where a family's situation is so serious, the Article 1F exclusion will be examined with the utmost care to determine whether it can stand?

Vraag 2 Kunt u de Kamer garanderen dat, indien sprake is van een voor een gezin dusdanig ernstige situatie, met de groots mogelijke zorgvuldigheid wordt onderzocht of de 1F-tegenwerping stand moet houden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat het nieuwe tapbeleid van Justitie een aanval is op onze grondrechten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the new interception standard means police now tap phone and internet data by default, and questioned proportionality, transparency, retention and the CBP's role. The Minister replied that the change is technical and procedural only, that the legal framework and tapping practice are unchanged, that each tap request is reviewed by the prosecutor and examining magistrate, and that tap counts no longer distinguish phone from internet taps.
There is no situation in which all telephone and internet data are now tapped by default.
Er is geen sprake van een situatie dat nu standaard alle telefoon- en internetgegevens worden getapt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Oosenbrug over het gebruik van open standaarden in de informatievoorziening van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) en het departement van Veiligheid en Ju

MPs Gesthuizen and Oosenbrug asked whether UWV PDF documents could be read by open-source readers, what UWV's open-standards rules are, and whether the government will follow the motion favouring open standards and open-source software. The minister answered that UWV switched some letters to a more advanced PDF version that failed in open-source and mobile readers, so it reverted to simpler PDFs, and promised to inform the House on the motion's implementation.
Following these signals, UWV has meanwhile reverted to using the less advanced PDFs for the most frequently used letters to customers.
Naar aanleiding van die signalen is UWV voor de meest gebruikte brieven aan klanten inmiddels weer overgegaan op het gebruik van de minder geavanceerde PDF's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen over het bericht van de uitzetting van twee kinderen

MPs Voortman, Sjoerdsma and Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary why a family including two children was detained in a closed family facility, whether the children should await appeal in the Netherlands, and whether the 10-year policy for relatives of 1F persons applies to the Children's Pardon. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, noted the family has been released, said the children's pardon scheme excludes relatives of 1F persons, and said the appeal rule applies only when the claim is upheld.
Beyond that, I will not go into the considerations in individual cases.
Voor het overige ga ik niet in op (de afwegingen in) individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Gesthuizen en Kooiman over het artikel ‘De 7 plagen van het ministerie van Veiligheid & Justitie’

The SP MPs Van Nispen, Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice to react to a NRC article describing dysfunction at the ministry, including image management and weak business operations. The minister disputes the article's characterisations, says the ministry manages its operations well and is open and transparent, and promises separate answers and reference to the Oosting inquiry.
I do not recognise the claim in the article that problems are taboo or that we operate in a hostile environment.
Ik herken mij bijvoorbeeld niet in de bewering in het artikel dat problemen «taboe» zijn of dat we in een «vijandige omgeving» opereren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Gesthuizen over de omgang met sociale media in (geestelijke gezondheids) zorginstellingen

MPs Leijten and Gesthuizen asked the health minister how mental health institutions handle patients' social media use and whether family can be involved in treatment after a mother complained in Metro. The minister answered that no similar signals are known, that self-determination limits restrictions unless a patient is involuntarily admitted under the Bopz, and that family policy and a new family support module are being developed.
It is important that providers are alert to translating the policy into day-to-day practice.
Het is wel van belang dat aanbieders alert zijn op het doorvertalen van het beleid naar de werkvloer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Gerven over het bericht dat TNO bezuinigt op onderzoek naar maatschappelijke thema’s

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reported cuts at TNO affecting research on societal themes such as work and health, the effect of VAT rules, and which research would stop. The minister answered that the cuts stem from earlier coalition agreement targets, that TNO will keep quality of work and health knowledge, that a preliminary allocation is still being negotiated, and that the Beschikking will be finalised by the cabinet later.
The national government will carefully monitor over the coming year whether the desired quality is still being provided.
De rijksoverheid zal het komende jaar zorgvuldig monitoren of de gewenste kwaliteit nog steeds wordt geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over de opslag van DNA-data bij onder andere Google en Amazon

MPs Gesthuizen and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about the lack of oversight of DNA data storage and sale by companies such as Google, Amazon and Illumina, including consent, legal basis, and the role of the Cbp. The minister answered that DNA is a free market regulated by privacy law, that the Cbp decides independently whether to investigate, and that a planned bill on control over body material and EU data-protection rules are in progress.
Given the independent position of the Cbp, it is up to the Cbp itself to determine whether it proceeds to do so.
Gelet op de onafhankelijke positie van het Cbp, is het aan het Cbp zelf om te bepalen of het daartoe overgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat toekenning van DLO-gelden via de topsectoren een hoog ons-kent-ons-gehalte heeft

SP MPs Smaling and Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether allocation of DLO research funds via the top sectors shows an 'old boys network' bias, questioning transparency, SME access and the balance of research topics. Minister Kamp answers that the calls are open and transparent with predefined criteria, that government is substantively involved in the top sector agendas, that multiple roles held by individuals are disclosed, and that conflict-of-interest and complaint procedures apply.
The assessment of the proposals proceeds transparently.
De beoordeling van de voorstellen verloopt transparant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder en Verhoeven over de aanbesteding van boekscanners en de digitalisering van rijksarchieven door het Nationaal Archief

MPs from VVD, SP, CDA and D66 asked the minister why the Nationaal Archief's digitisation of national archives is being in-sourced to the Belastingdienst rather than tendered, despite a parliamentary motion and the Commission of Procurement Experts' advice against it. The minister defends in-sourcing as lawful internal shared services, citing cost, logistics and business-case reasons, while acknowledging the earlier letter wording on loan of scanners was unfortunate and deferring answers pending a research report.
Reversing the in-sourcing of the work, as the motion requests, would lead to a further delay of, expected, at least one year.
Terugdraaien van de inbesteding van de werkzaamheden, zoals de motie vraagt, leidt tot een verdere vertraging van, naar verwachting, minimaal een jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind en Voortman over de scheiding van een gezin vanwege tegenwerping 1F

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the 1F exclusion (Refugee Convention) against a father, which has split his family, could be re-examined, and why the Public Prosecution Service did not prosecute. The State Secretary confidentially provided the court and Council of State rulings, declined to comment on prosecution, and refused to reopen the 1F assessment because the Council of State had already confirmed it.
I cannot inform your House. The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements about this individual case.
Ik kan uw kamer niet informeren. Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen mededelingen over dit individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het ontbreken van afdoende mogelijkheden multinationals aansprakelijk te stellen voor rampen die verderop in de handelsketen plaatsvinden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether multinationals can be held liable for disasters deeper in their supply chains, citing a dissertation on contractual control and liability. The minister agreed responsibility lies with companies under the UN Guiding Principles and OECD guidelines, said a University of Utrecht study on companies' duty of care is pending, and stated that the government will report to parliament on supply-chain agreements if sectors fail to act.
At three-quarters of the process, at the evaluation moment, I will report to the House on this.
Op driekwart van het proces, tijdens het evaluatiemoment, zal ik hierover rapporteren aan de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over problemen bij aanbestedingen door het COA

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about delays in the Den Helder AZC construction, whether COA faces extra costs, and why COA did not tender renovation work in Zutphen and withheld information from the procurement expert committee. The State Secretary answered that delays stem partly from a legal dispute and a separate installation tender, that costs fall on the contractor, that no tender was required in Zutphen because the building was to be delivered turn-key, and that COA sees no reason to supply the withheld information now.
COA then took the view that the information it had refused could not be obtained after all through a complaint to the Commission of Procurement Experts.
Het COA was vervolgens van oordeel dat de geweigerde informatie niet via een klacht bij de Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts alsnog verkregen kon worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over genitale verminking in Guinée

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the 2014 Guinea country report's claim that female genital mutilation is declining is backed by hard figures, and whether asylum policy for minor girls from Guinea should be reconsidered given that FGM persists. The government answered that the report rests on multiple sources, that the policy under the Vreemdelingencirculaire 2000 already offers protection where a real risk of FGM exists, and that a thematic country report is unnecessary.
The identity and background of the interview partners are generally not made public in order not to endanger their safety and thereby their reliability.
De identiteit en achtergrond van de gesprekspartners wordt in de regel niet openbaar gemaakt om hun veiligheid en daardoor hun betrouwbaarheid niet in gevaar te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de EU maritieme missie EU NAVFOR MED

An MP asks whether the EU is seeking a Chapter VII UN Security Council resolution for the EU naval mission EU NAVFOR MED against migrant smuggling from Libya, how migration could count as a threat to peace, and Libyan authorities' attitude to an EU mission in their waters. The government answers that negotiations in New York are stalled pending talks with Libya, that a draft cannot be shared confidentially, that Security Council resolutions under Chapter VII have precedent for migration-linked crises, and that the Libyan government lacks effective control in western Libya.
Due to the confidential nature of the discussions in New York, a draft version cannot be shared.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van de besprekingen in New York kan een conceptversie niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het misbruiktribunaal binnen de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a Vatican tribunal on bishops who failed to act on child abuse is sufficient, whether it is independent, and why such bishops were not sanctioned earlier. The minister answered that the tribunal is solely the Catholic Church's responsibility, declined to judge its independence or the application of canon law, welcomed church measures in general, and said criminal prosecution of abuse is a state task that may apply where ignoring abuse amounts to complicity.
The establishment of the tribunal falls entirely under the responsibility of the Roman Catholic Church.
De instelling van het tribunaal geschiedt volledig onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over beleggingen van verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen in de wapenhandel

MPs asked whether insurers and pension funds should stop investing in arms makers supplying controversial states, and about reported billions in such holdings, including APG's. The government answered that only cluster munitions are legally barred, that it promotes IMVO covenants, and that the banking and insurance sectors are pursuing sector-specific covenants.
For investments in cluster munitions there is a statutory ban; beyond that, there are no other binding legal restrictions on insurers and pension funds investing in companies.

Voor investeringen in clustermunitie geldt er een wettelijk verbod, verder zijn er geen andere dwingende wettelijke belemmeringen voor het investeren in bedrijven door verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over Conflict chipfabrikant NXP en vakbonden Thailand en Filipijnen

Gesthuizen (SP) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reported NXP intimidation of unions, dismissal of union negotiators and excessive overtime in Thailand and the Philippines, and whether the government would press NXP. The minister called the SOMO findings worrying, said embassies will contact unions and NXP, committed to raising OECD guideline compliance with the company, and noted NXP is involved in the metal and electronics sector covenant via FME.
The Dutch embassies in Bangkok and Manila will contact the local trade unions following the report.
De Nederlandse ambassades in Bangkok en Manilla zullen naar aanleiding van het rapport contact opnemen met de lokale vakbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de governance gap op het gebied van bedrijfsgerelateerde mensenrechtenschendingen

SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Foreign Affairs about the global governance gap in preventing business-related human rights abuses, whether a binding Business and Human Rights Treaty would help, why the Netherlands joins TTIP talks but not the treaty talks, and the government's position and EU parameters for the IGWG. The ministers answered that the UN Guiding Principles and the national action plan are the preferred route, that the EU parameters for joining the IGWG have not been met, and that the Netherlands chairs the Council of Europe instrument negotiations.
The cabinet expects companies to respect in other countries the same human rights standards as in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven dat ze in het buitenland dezelfde mensenrechtenstandaarden eerbiedigen als in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over storingen bij TenderNed

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether earlier questions about TenderNed have led to fewer reported outages being posted or removed from the TenderNed Twitter account. The minister answered that only one outage tweet was removed because the fault had already been fixed, and that part of TenderNed's infrastructure was adjusted on 22 June, with results being monitored.
One report of a malfunction has been removed, because the malfunction had already been resolved directly after the tweet was posted.
