Er is één melding van een storing verwijderd, omdat de storing al verholpen was direct na het plaatsen van de tweet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de beoordeling door de IND van de geloofwaardigheid van Koptische asielzoekers

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked whether IND officials wrongly disbelieve Coptic asylum seekers from Egypte, whether staff have sufficient expertise and knowledge of Coptic conditions, the grant rate for Christian asylum seekers, and how abolishing the POK test affects credibility assessments. The Secretary of State replied that credibility is assessed case by case using the official country report, that staff receive training, that IND does not systematically record religion so grant rates cannot be given, and that dropping the POK test is a motivation change rather than a policy change.
The IND assesses the asylum application within the context of everything known from public, reliable sources about the country of origin.
De IND beoordeelt de asielaanvraag binnen de context van al hetgeen uit openbare, betrouwbare bronnen bekend is over het land van herkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over het bericht dat in Frankrijk wetgeving van kracht wordt die het aanmoedigen van anorexia strafbaar stelt

SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands could ban and prosecute pro-anorexia websites, as France was doing, and what the effects of the current pop-up warning approach are. The state secretary answered that encouraging self-starvation is not a crime under current law, that a ban would not be effective, that he will talk with providers and clinicians about updating the pop-up system, and that a treatment standard for eating disorders is in preparation.
The French initiative prompted me to examine whether a ban on pro-ana content would be desirable and legally possible in the Netherlands.
Het Franse initiatief is voor mij aanleiding geweest om te bezien of een verbod van pro-ana uitingen ook in Nederland wenselijk en juridisch mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over studenten in vreemdelingendetentie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether students who occupied the Maagdenhuis and were held in immigration detention, some for up to nine months, were misused under immigration law and should be released. The state secretary answered that the students were released once their identity was confirmed, that the court awarded modest damages for unlawful detention but found no misuse of powers, and that police and officer training will be adjusted.
The court, however, did not rule that there was a misuse of powers.
De rechter heeft echter niet geoordeeld dat sprake is van misbruik van bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het artikel “Organisaties die schending van de privacy willen verhullen”

An SP MP asked the Justice minister how to respond to reports that companies go to court to block publication of privacy-violation findings by the CBP, and whether the CBP should be legally obliged to publish its investigations. The state secretary said courts weigh publication against the harm to the complainant, and agreed to examine a statutory publication duty for CBP findings and enforcement decisions, reporting back by year-end.
I am, together with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, willing to examine whether a statutory duty to publish could and should be introduced for the CBP.

ben ik, mede namens de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, graag bereid om te onderzoeken of er voor het Cbp een wettelijke openbaarmakingsplicht in het leven kan en moet worden geroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Voortman en Voordewind over een verwachte uitspraak van de Raad van State

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary why he is awaiting a ruling on vrijheidsbeperkende locaties (VBL) rather than the pending cases on municipal bed-bad-brood shelters, and whether the expected Council of State ruling was about VBL adequacy. The State Secretary answered that he is not waiting for a ruling, that the existing system complies with treaty obligations, that the Council of State cases were withdrawn on 11 May 2015 so no ruling will follow in them, and that other related cases are pending.
First of all, I consider it important to note that I am not waiting for a court ruling.
Allereerst acht ik van belang op te merken dat ik niet wacht op een rechterlijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de verwachte uitspraak van de Raad van State

MP Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary whether, given the withdrawal of the lawyer's appeal before the Council of State, he would inform parliament of his next steps instead of awaiting a ruling. The State Secretary replied that he is not waiting for a ruling, will discuss additional measures with municipalities, and considers that no further obligations follow for the Dutch state from the treaties concerned.
I consider it important to emphasise that I am not waiting for a ruling.
Ik vind het van belang te benadrukken dat ik niet wacht op een uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de problemen op de markt van overheidswerk voor tolken en vertalers

An MP asked the government about problems in the market for interpreting and translation services for public bodies, including concerns over the quality of interpreters in asylum and legal aid cases, the supply obligations and clustering of tenders, and cartel and pricing issues. The State Secretary replied that new tariffs are higher, the IND does not use intermediaries, registered interpreters are used in most cases, the supply obligation does not lower quality, tenders were designed to admit newcomers, and market prices are set by competition.
I do not share the NGTV's view that contractual supply percentages put quality under pressure.
Ik deel de opvatting van het NGTV niet dat contractuele leveringspercentages de kwaliteit onder druk zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Gesthuizen over een tekort aan woningen voor statushouders (opnieuw en nu met de nagezonden tabellen)

MPs Karabulut and Gesthuizen asked the government about a shortage of social rental housing for status holders and how municipalities are meant to house them. The Minister replied that no overview exists of municipalities reporting shortages or of housing waiting lists, that the 14-week housing norm is based on a 2012 agreement, and that no budget is available for new solutions such as converting the housing tax.
There is no overview of municipalities that indicate they have too few social rental homes to house asylum seekers with a residence permit (status holders).
Er is geen overzicht van gemeenten die aangeven dat ze te weinig sociale huurwoningen hebben om asielzoekers met een verblijfsvergunning (statushouders) te huisvesten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Bashir en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de overheid de bouwsector genadeloos uiteen speelt

MPs of the SP asked the government about reports that it squeezes the construction sector, including cost overruns on A15 and A2 projects, the risks of a Ballast Nedam bankruptcy, and whether lowest-price awarding and design-build-finance-maintain contracts cause sector losses. The minister answered that cost overrun figures are confidential, that Rijkswaterstaat compensates responsibly-caused extra costs, that EMVI (best value) is the main award criterion, and that the Aanbestedingswet evaluation will be sent to parliament by summer.
Financial information from contractors, insofar as I have it, I cannot make public.
Financiële informatie van opdrachtnemers, voor zover ik hierover beschik, kan ik niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het verlopen van het besluit- en vertrekmoratorium voor verschillende provincies in Irak

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the decision and departure moratorium for Iraqi asylum seekers from seven provinces, expiring after six months, would be extended and how the security situation now looks, and when a new country report would be published. The State Secretary answered that the moratorium ends on 16 April 2015, that a new Iraq country report will be published around that date, that he will decide on extension based on it, and that he expects to inform parliament within a week after publication.
On the basis of that country report I will take a decision on the extension of the decision and departure moratorium.
Aan de hand van dat ambtsbericht zal ik een besluit nemen over de verlenging van het besluit- en vertrekmoratorium.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aanvraag van het Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers (COA) tot omzetting van een opvanglocatie naar een asielzoekerscentrum (AZC) met een capaciteit voor 800 tot 1000 per

An MP asks the State Secretary how a COA request to expand an asylum centre in the tiny village of Oranje to 800-1,000 residents (against roughly 150 inhabitants) fits earlier assurances about proportionality, and whether alternatives and local support were considered. The State Secretary replies that the municipality decides on locations, that the municipality earlier agreed to 1,400 and later 1,000 residents, and that a regular consultation group with residents exists.
The final decision on establishing a location belongs to the municipality.
Het uiteindelijk besluit tot de vestiging van een locatie hoort toe aan de gemeente.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aanvraag van het Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers (COA) tot omzetting van een opvanglocatie naar een asielzoekerscentrum (AZC) met een capaciteit voor  800 tot 1000 pe

An MP asked whether the Midden-Drenthe municipal executive bound itself to COA to expand the Oranje reception site to 800-1,000 places without council involvement, and whether a council opinion should have been sought for the deviation from the zoning plan. The State Secretary declined to assess the municipal executive's conduct, citing the division of responsibilities between government tiers, and answered none of the questions on substance.
It will be clear to your House that, given the division of powers between the tiers of government in our country, it is not appropriate for me to give such an assessment.
Het zal uw Kamer duidelijk zijn dat het mij, gelet op de in ons land geldende bevoegdheidsverdeling tussen de bestuurslagen, niet past een dergelijke beoordeling te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het inhuren van dure ICT-specialisten

The SP MP Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Security and Justice why external ICT specialists were hired at a reported cost of 50,000 euro to search for a receipt related to a settlement, how many externals were hired, why the ministry lacks this expertise, what it spends on external hiring, and how it decides between hiring externals and training staff. The minister answered that three external and six internal staff were involved at a cost of 6,902.50 euro for the external staff, that external hiring is used when expertise is unavailable internally, and that shared service centres are being built to bundle expertise.
The ICT costs for the external staff amounted to 6,902.50 euro.
De ICT-kosten voor de externe medewerkers bedroeg € 6.902,50,-.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Gesthuizen en Schouw over de tot nu toe verstrekte informatie over de omvang en aard van (legale) identiteitswisselingen en mogelijke fraude met reisdocumenten

Three MPs (Omtzigt, Gesthuizen, Schouw) asked the Dutch State Secretary and Minister about the scope and nature of legal identity changes and possible passport/identity fraud, including why Parliament was not informed earlier of NVIK/police signals from 2011 and 2013 and of the April 2014 meetings. The government answered that the signals were operational, not quantified, that duplicate registrations were largely legal name changes or data-entry errors, and that several measures and studies are underway.
It is not customary to inform the Chamber while an investigation is ongoing.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om lopende een onderzoek de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over de opkomst van Apple en Google in het betalingsverkeer

MPs Merkies and Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether the uneven playing field between banks and tech firms like Apple and Google in payments, data-use rules and payment data protection should be closed. The government answered that all parties must comply with the same privacy law, that the voluntary banking code is only a further interpretation of it, and that the new EU directives and privacy regulation will add registration and risk-based duties.
All the parties mentioned, both financial institutions and other companies, must comply with the same privacy legislation.
Alle genoemde partijen, dus zowel financiële instellingen als andere bedrijven, moeten voldoen aan dezelfde privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie grootschalig data van vliegtuigpassagiers wil opslaan

An SP MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that the European Commission wants to store passenger (PNR) data broadly, raising privacy and proportionality concerns under EU case law. The minister replied that no new Commission proposal has been adopted yet, that the Commission intends to add data protection safeguards, that the Netherlands welcomes stronger fundamental-rights protection, and that the Chamber will be kept informed before any step is taken.
As agreed with the Chamber, we are awaiting the process and will not take any step without informing the Chamber.
Zoals afgesproken met de Kamer wachten wij het proces af en zetten geen stap zonder de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Schouw, Van Tongeren en Gesthuizen over de onwettigheid van de bewaarplicht van telecomgegevens van burgers

Four MPs asked whether the Dutch data retention law, which the Court of Justice had found incompatible with EU rights, should be suspended, and whether providers could claim damages or be shielded from client claims. The minister replied that the Dutch regime is more detailed than the annulled directive and is compliant, that there is no reason to suspend it, that providers may face damages claims left to the courts, and that no reliable investment estimate exists.
I see no reason to freeze the implementation of the current law until parliament has dealt with the proposed amendment.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de uitvoering van de huidige wet te bevriezen totdat het parlement de voorgestelde wetswijziging heeft behandeld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens wil dat Facebook de nieuwe privacy voorwaarden uitstelt

An MP asked the minister whether he agrees with the Data Protection Authority's (CBP) request that Facebook postpone its new privacy policy pending investigation, how the CBP will enforce it, and whether results will be sent to parliament. The state secretary declined to comment on the CBP's independent enforcement decision, noted Facebook postponed the policy to 30 January 2015, and said the CBP will publish its findings itself, after which he will assess whether a response is needed.
The CBP is independent. It is therefore not appropriate for me to comment on a decision of the CBP in an individual enforcement case.
Het CBP is onafhankelijk. Het past mij daarom niet commentaar te leveren op een beslissing van het CBP in een individuele handhavingszaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over de veronderstellingen van het Centraal Planbureau (CPB)

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the CPB's assumptions, its quality checks, and whether wage moderation drove Dutch productivity, investment and export share. The minister replied that the CPB has multiple internal and external quality controls, that Dutch productivity and export share remained stable or high, and that wage moderation is a second-best tool against unemployment.
Many checks and balances have been built into the CPB's working method to prevent one-sided views that are not based on scientific consensus and facts.
Er zijn in de werkwijze van het CPB veel checks and balances aangebracht om het ontstaan te voorkomen van een eenzijdige, niet op wetenschappelijke consensus en op feiten gebaseerde visie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Omtzigt over fraude door middel van legale naamwisselingen

MPs Gesthuizen and Omtzigt asked the ministers how the government responded to RTL reports on fraud through legal name changes, which signals from abroad and the police it received, whether the Matching Autoriteit was consulted, and whether databases should be cross-matched. The government answered that no overview of signals is kept, that operational services act on signals as needed, that no separate report was required on the police signal, and that after investigation no evidence of fraud through double registration was found, so no further cross-matching is planned.
No overview is kept of all signals exchanged in the course of regular operational work.
Er wordt geen overzicht bijgehouden van alle signalen die in het kader van de reguliere taakuitvoering worden uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de uitlatingen van het Bureau Medische Advisering (BMA) over een suïcidale vreemdeling

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a BMA medical advisory report that suggested no post-deportation medical arrangements were needed for a suicidal foreign national, and whether the reasoning was acceptable. The State Secretary rejected the reading that the BMA had reasoned cynically, said the passage was misinterpreted out of context, and declined to order an investigation.
I am of the view that there is an incorrect interpretation of the relevant passage in the BMA report.
Ik ben van mening dat er sprake is van een onjuiste interpretatie van de betreffende passage in het BMA-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kerstens over de kritiek van de vakbonden op TNT

MPs Gesthuizen and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about union criticism of TNT, including reports that dismissed workers were rehired via subcontractors while receiving unemployment benefits. The Minister said he had no evidence of rule violations, pointed to ongoing Inspectorate monitoring and the pending anti-sham-construction bill, and deemed TNT's voluntary-departure policy a matter for employers.
I currently have no indications that the rules are being broken. I am therefore awaiting the further findings of the Inspectorate SZW.
Ik heb vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen dat de regels overtreden worden. Ik wacht daarom de nadere bevindingen van de Inspectie SZW af

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Den Haag, nevenzittingsplaats Groningen, inzake het tienjarenbeleid omtrent gezinsleden van vreemdelingen aan wie artikel 1F Vluchtelingenverdr

An SP MP asked the State Secretary how he will respond to a Hague District Court ruling that the ten-year residence rule in the Vreemdelingencirculaire still applies under the Kinderpardon scheme even where 1F exclusion is invoked against a parent, and whether he will apply it. The State Secretary says he disagrees with the ruling, will appeal to the Council of State, and will not change policy pending that appeal.
I cannot agree with the ruling and will lodge an appeal against it with the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.
Ik kan mij niet verenigen met de uitspraak en zal daartegen hoger beroep aantekenen bij de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Smaling over Vluchtelingensituatie in Turkije

MPs Gesthuizen and Smaling asked the government to respond to Amnesty International's report on Syrian refugees in Turkey, including alleged shootings of refugees at the border and forced returns. The government denied structural forced returns, attributed the incidents to a period before the Kobani surge, and pointed to Dutch humanitarian funding of EUR 30 million and EUR 12 million for 2015 with a resettlement quota of 250 Syrians.
The cabinet does not believe there are structural problems regarding forced return of Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat er sprake is van structurele problemen met betrekking tot gedwongen terugkeer van Syrische vluchtelingen uit Turkije.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Nispen (beiden SP) aan de Staatssecretaris en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Man Ingabire in oorlog met justitie» en soortgelijke berichten (ingezonden 5 no

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Nispen asked whether reports of unfair trials and misuse of genocide charges against Rwandan opposition figures are true, whether the Netherlands checks them, and whether extradition or deportation to Rwanda is safe. The government answered that it raises suspected unfair trials with Rwanda, that extradition has safeguards including court review and detention guarantees, and that it declines to discuss an individual case, while describing the IND's Article 1F procedure and its verification of intelligence reports.
As your House is aware, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Gesthuizen en Van Raak over het ontbreken van een geboortedatum op verblijfsdocumenten en in de basisregistratie personen

Four SP MPs asked why residence documents and the BRP carry placeholder birth dates such as 00-00 and whether a single fictitious date would be adopted. The minister acknowledged the problem, said Wet BRP article 2.17 now takes the fictitious date from the Justice Minister, and declined to retroactively assign dates to existing cases because of the consequences for acquired rights.
It was therefore decided, when article 2.17 of the Wet BRP was drafted, not to make such an arrangement for these existing cases.
Er is daarom bij de totstandkoming van artikel 2.17 Wet BRP besloten af te zien van het treffen van een dergelijke regeling voor deze bestaande gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Straffen bankfraude-zaak fors lager door traag OM’

SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether lower sentences in a large bank fraud case resulted from the Public Prosecution Service leaving the case idle for two and a half years, and what caused any delay. The minister denied a two-and-a-half-year delay, said the case was reopened in late 2012 and scheduled for trial, that the prosecution applied a sentence reduction for the excessive length, has appealed the verdict, and that there is no lack of fraud-fighting expertise or capacity.
This transfer period, however, did not last two and a half years as the cited report claims.
Deze overdrachtsperiode heeft echter geen twee en een half jaar geduurd zoals in het aangehaalde bericht wordt beweerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over uitwisseling van persoonsgegevens tussen Belastingdienst, AIVD, politie en justitie

An MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers how personal data exchange between the Tax Administration, AIVD, police and prosecution works under the convenant and article 43c of the tax implementing regulation, including transparency, oversight by the CBP, and ANPR data. The ministers answered that exchanges rest on statutory bases, are limited to necessary purposes and published in working agreements, while acknowledging that the number of prosecution requests is not aggregated.
A request is always made under the Code of Criminal Procedure and must at all times meet the requirements set out in it.
Vordering vindt altijd plaats op grond van het Wetboek van Strafvordering, en moet te allen tijde voldoen aan de daarin opgenomen vereisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Van Ojik over Textiel/Bangladesh, Compensatie Rana Plaza slachtoffers

MPs asked the minister what results followed their call for companies to compensate Rana Plaza victims, how to fill the half-empty fund, whether Dutch firms must sign the Bangladesh safety accord, and about supply-chain transparency and safety nets for workers. The minister reported an extra 2 million USD raising the fund to 19.4 million of the needed 40 million, said companies bear responsibility, and noted voluntary contributions and ongoing IMVO covenant talks.
I will continue to raise this issue with my colleagues and the government of Bangladesh.
Ik blijf dit onderwerp bij mijn collega’s en de overheid in Bangladesh agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over de tekortschietende financiering van Wageningen UR

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked whether the 2% cap on annual funding changes for Wageningen UR, set in 2001, disadvantages the institution compared with other universities, and whether the rule should be reconsidered. Minister Kamp answered that the cap avoids sharp budget fluctuations, that the rule will be included in a government review of funding for Economic Affairs and OCW education with results feeding into the 2016 budget, and that compliance with the top-income norm is monitored.

This arrangement will be included in the study the cabinet is starting into education funded by the Ministry of Economic Affairs and education funded by the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.

Onderhavige regeling wordt betrokken in het onderzoek dat het kabinet start naar onderwijs bekostigd door het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en het onderwijs bekostigd door het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap.
Antwoord van het lid Gesthuizen over de gevolgen van de stroomlijning van de toelatingsprocedures

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the streamlining of admission procedures since 1 April 2014, under which the IND ex officio tests all possible humanitarian grounds and treats later applications on those grounds as subsequent applications with reduced legal aid fees, impairs access to a lawyer and an effective remedy. The State Secretary defended the policy as avoiding stacked procedures, stated that legal aid remains available, and refused to drop ex officio testing of regular residence grounds.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een paranoïde Pool alleen celstraf krijgt omdat geen kliniek hem wil behandelen

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary why a paranoid Polish offender convicted of manslaughter received only a prison sentence because no clinic would treat him, and how this fits the TBS guidance for foreign nationals and the handling of repatriation and leave for TBS patients. The State Secretary replied that the prosecution declined TBS with conditions because the offender had no health insurance or income, that prison psychiatric care is available, and that leave and repatriation rules were adjusted from April 2014.

Because enforcing a TBS with conditions would encounter practical obstacles, as the person has no own income and no individual health insurance, the Public Prosecution Service refrained from it and sought only a prison sentence.

Omdat de tenuitvoerlegging van een tbs met voorwaarden echter op praktische bezwaren zou stuiten, omdat betrokkene geen eigen inkomen heeft en ook geen individuele ziektekostenverzekering, heeft het Openbaar Ministerie daarvan afgezien en alleen een gevangenisstraf geëist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat Sociale Zaken mogelijk de privacywetgeving schond

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt asked who authorised linking personal data for fraud detection without a legal basis, whether the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) supervised this, and why a statutory basis was only created in 2013. Minister Asscher answers that the Wbp and the WWB/SUWI provided a basis for data linking, that the CBP was consulted and informed parliament via letters in 2005, 2007, 2009 and 2011, and that the 2013 SUWI amendment (SyRI) was chosen for transparency rather than because the earlier practice was unlawful.

Although the bureau concludes that the Wbp provides a sufficient legal basis to work within a 'Black Box' environment, a separate statutory basis is chosen for reasons of transparency and a clear division of tasks and responsibilities.

Ofschoon het bureau concludeert dat de Wbp voldoende juridische basis heeft om binnen een «Black Box» omgeving te werken, wordt er om redenen van transparantie en heldere taak- en verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling voor gekozen een aparte wettelijke basis te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kooiman en Gesthuizen over inzake het integriteitsbeleid bij het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responded to a report finding the ministry's integrity policy was not in order, why the review was commissioned, which recommendations were accepted or rejected, and why no separate integrity unit was created. The minister rejected the negative picture, said several units manage integrity well, adopted two of three recommendations, and declined a separate integrity department because integrity should remain a line responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een ICT-bedrijf fraudeerde met overheidsaanbestedingen

An SP MP asked ministers whether ICT firm Ordina committed procurement fraud with government tenders, how investigations would be followed, how such leaks of confidential information could be prevented, and whether an overarching anti-fraud authority is needed. The government answered that investigations are ongoing and information is limited for investigative reasons, outlined existing safeguards and planned conflict-of-interest rules, and deferred the anti-fraud authority question to a later letter.

Insofar as informing your House does not conflict with the investigative interests, you will be informed by the relevant ministers about the outcomes of ongoing investigations and measures, where there is cause to do so.

Voor zover het inlichten van uw Kamer het opsporings- en onderzoeksbelang niet in de weg staat zal u – indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat – over de uitkomsten van de lopende onderzoeken en maatregelen worden geïnformeerd door de desbetreffende Ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het gebruik van omstreden spionagesoftware door de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the police use FinFisher spyware, which software functions it has, what it is used for, and how privacy is protected. The minister said police use software installed on suspects' computers only to intercept confidential communication under art. 126l Sv, remote search only under art. 125i with examining judge authorisation, and declined to give details on specific software for security reasons.
Providing information on which specific software the police investigative services possess, test and use entails major risks for the usability of those means.

Het verstrekken van informatie over welke specifieke software de opsporingsdiensten van de politie beschikken, testen en gebruiken brengt grote risico's met zich mee voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Gesthuizen over de zelfmoord van een 17-jarige Afghaanse jongen op de campus voor alleenstaande minderjarigen in Oude Pekela

MPs asked the State Secretary about the suicide of a 17-year-old Afghan boy at the Oude Pekela campus for unaccompanied minors, including his psychological care, his residence permit, the delay in finding him, communication with relatives, and prevention measures. The State Secretary declined to address individual aspects of the case, said suicide is not always preventable, and reported that the Inspectorate for Youth Care received notification and decided not to start a further investigation.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om bij de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de gang van zaken bij het faillissement van Estro

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about bonuses paid to Estro's executives shortly before its bankruptcy, whether creditors could reclaim them, and what safeguards exist against abuse of quick bankruptcies. The minister answered that the curator and courts must assess the specific case, outlined the possible recovery routes (undue payment, director liability, bankruptcy pauliana), and pointed to planned reforms such as civil director bans and modernised bankruptcy offences.
It is up to him to investigate whether bonuses were indeed paid shortly before the bankruptcy and to assess whether this was done on improper grounds.
Het is aan hem om te onderzoeken of er inderdaad kort voor het faillissement bonussen zijn uitgekeerd en te beoordelen of dit al dan niet op oneigenlijke gronden is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Voordewind, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Discussie illegalen op scherp’

Four MPs asked the state secretary whether he would immediately ensure that rejected asylum seekers have access to bed, bath and bread after two such people died or were seriously injured in Amsterdam. The state secretary expressed regret but rejected any link to national policy, arguing that the reception system covers vulnerable groups and that those who fulfil their departure obligation need not be without shelter.
Providing shelter to people without prospect or conditions, without requiring work towards departure, would not only undermine the credibility and sustainability of the Dutch migration system.

Het zonder perspectief of voorwaarden bieden van onderdak aan personen zonder te verlangen dat wordt gewerkt aan vertrek, zou niet enkel afbreuk doen aan de geloofwaardigheid en houdbaarheid van het Nederlandse migratiestelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Merkies, Smaling over Toegang tot Medicijnen

SP MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she would hold Dutch insurers and pharmaceutical firms accountable for poor medicine access in poor countries, and whether insurers should use their investments to push for better access. The minister said investment policy is primarily the companies' own responsibility, pointed to voluntary initiatives and OECD/IMVO standards, and said she would invite the insurers' association to discuss the Access to Medicine Index.
Investment policy is primarily the responsibility of the companies themselves.
Het investeringsbeleid is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Voordewind over het bericht “Grensdetentie is niet langer houdbaar”

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report calling border detention of asylum seekers, including children, incompatible with human rights norms and EU law. The State Secretary answered that detention and refusal of entry are applied under EU and national rules with individual assessment, that about 77% of asylum seekers detained at the border in 2013 eventually gained access, and that new policy for families with minor children and an IND work instruction would be introduced.
Furthermore, refusing entry and imposing border detention must take place with care.
Voorts geldt dat het weigeren van toegang en het opleggen van grensdetentie zorgvuldig moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen, Maij en Schouw over de opvang van Syrische vluchtelingen

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary about the timing of resettling Syrian refugees from Amman and Beirut, whether pending refugees face unexplained delays, and whether a Article 1F exclusion risk affects some cases. The government answered that the arrivals fall under the regular quota, that the standard six-month preparation period applies, that more than 250 Syrians have been accepted, and that UNHCR nominations are assessed case by case for Article 1F risk.
It is the standard procedure in resettlement that refugees arrive in the Netherlands no later than 6 months after acceptance.
Het is de standaard procedure bij hervestiging dat vluchtelingen uiterlijk 6 maanden na acceptatie naar Nederland komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het aantal vreemdelingen in isoleercellen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how often foreign nationals in immigration detention were placed in isolation in 2011–2014, and for breakdowns by reason and duration. The State Secretary gave yearly counts (741 in 2012, 662 in 2013, 167 in Jan–Apr 2014), noting the registration system is not fully reliable, and gave shares by reason (disciplinary vs. protective order) and average durations.
The registration system consulted for this purpose, given its current automated processing, does not provide a fully reliable picture.
Het hiervoor geraadpleegde registratiesysteem voorziet wegens de huidige geautomatiseerde verwerking niet in een volkomen betrouwbaar beeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Schouw over de gevolgen van de definitieve beslissing van het Europees Comité van de Sociale Rechten (ECSR) inzake de opvang van vreemdelingen

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government has responded to the European Committee of Social Rights' final decision on a complaint about shelter for undocumented and rejected asylum seekers, and asked for the findings to be shared and for prompt measures and clarity for municipalities. The Staatssecretaris answered that the findings were sent confidentially to the Committee of Ministers and the parties, cannot be shared until the Committee of Ministers adopts a position or four months pass, and that the government is not obliged to act within four months, promising to inform the House once the Committee of Ministers has spoken.

The findings of the ECSR only become public once the Committee of Ministers has adopted a position, or four months after their transmission if the Committee of Ministers has not yet adopted a position by then.

De bevindingen van het ECSR worden pas openbaar als het Comité van Ministers een standpunt heeft ingenomen, dan wel vier maanden na toezending van de bevindingen in het geval het Comité van Ministers op dat moment nog geen standpunt heeft ingenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de kwetsbaarheid van iTunes

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether iTunes has a vulnerability letting hackers intercept passwords, how many Dutch users are affected, whether the flaw might be deliberate and whether action will be taken. The Minister answered that the flaw is likely an implementation error by Apple, that no active abuse is known in the Netherlands, and that no specific steps will be taken beyond the general cyber security strategy.
No, I will not take specific steps.
Nee, ik ga geen specifieke stappen ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen en Van Laar over kinderarbeid en schending van andere arbeidsrechten

MPs Voordewind, Gesthuizen and Van Laar asked the minister about a Fair Labor Association study on child labour and long hours in Turkish hazelnut harvesting, and what the government, ILO, Turkish authorities and Dutch retailers and firms would do about it. The minister acknowledged the findings, said Turkey is primarily responsible, pointed to Dutch support for an ILO project and a 90,000 euro contribution, and said she raised the issue with Turkish officials and FNLI, which committed to a meeting with industry.
I have committed a contribution of 90,000 euros to the above-mentioned follow-up project of the ILO.
Ik heb hier een bijdrage van 90.000 euro toegezegd aan het hierboven genoemde vervolgproject van de ILO.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het tekort aan woningen voor ex-asielzoekers (ingezonden 11 juni 2014).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether ex-asylum seekers with residence status could move in with partners immediately, to ease the housing shortage, and whether he would consider changing the rules. The State Secretary answered that there are no obstacles to such a move and that he sees no solution to the housing shortage in the proposal.
In your proposal I therefore see no solution to the shortage of housing for the accommodation of permit holders mentioned in the article.
In uw voorstel zie ik dan ook geen oplossing voor de in het artikel vermelde tekort aan woningen voor de huisvesting van vergunninghouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Maij, Schouw, Voordewind en Voortman over het bericht dat scholen niet in staat zijn kinderen uit Somalië en Eritrea te onderwijzen

MPs asked whether Dutch schools can adequately teach asylum-seeker children from Somalia and Eritrea, many of whom have had no schooling, and what additional measures will prevent them falling behind. The State Secretary disagreed that schools are inadequate, pointed to extra funding and an inspection report showing improved quality, and said he would discuss with Lowan and the VNG and PO-Raad the municipalities and schools that fail to take their responsibility, with no detailed further measures given.
I will therefore enter into discussion with Lowan, the VNG and the PO-Raad on this matter.
Ik zal daarom samen met Lowan het gesprek met de VNG en de PO-Raad hierover aangaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Nispen en Oskam over de uitspraken en antwoorden op vragen over een slachtoffer van identiteitsfraude

MPs from SP and CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether earlier answers on the compensation claim of identity-fraud victim Mr Kowsoleea were accurate, why the case remains unresolved despite earlier assurances, and whether the minister will personally arrange talks. The minister confirmed the earlier answers, said the state requested a further substantiation of the claim, and said he would like to see the case resolved soon without committing to a specific step.
Therefore the person concerned has been asked for a (further) substantiation of the alleged unlawfulness and of the causal link between the conduct attributed to the State and the claimed damage.
Daarom is betrokkene gevraagd om een (nadere) onderbouwing van de gestelde onrechtmatigheid en het causaal verband tussen het aan de Staat verweten handelen en de geclaimde schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over Montana Beheer en de toezichthouders

An SP MP asked the ministers of Finance and Justice about the Montana Beheer investment fraud, complaints made to the AFM from 2010, and why the regulator and the FIOD took so long to act, and whether delays generally harm victims. The minister answered that the AFM and FIOD acted within normal deadlines and due care, described the steps taken, and saw no reason for additional measures, while promising to review if delays are signalled in future.
The AFM and the FIOD acted within the regular time limits and due care standards in this case.
De AFM en de FIOD hebben in deze zaak gehandeld binnen de reguliere termijnen en zorgvuldigheidsnormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voortman over nareis van meerderjarige ongehuwde kinderen

MPs Gesthuizen and Voortman asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the family reunification of adult unmarried children, citing a case of a Syrian refugee's daughter too old to join her parent, and about the European Commission's guidance on the Family Reunification Directive. The State Secretary said Dutch law deliberately allows adult unmarried children to join asylum-holding parents subject to an individual 'more than normal emotional dependency' test, promised a general reply on the guidance after an expert meeting, and stated that the directive applies to these cases.
How many cases have a situation comparable to the individual case in question, I do not have insight into.
In hoeveel zaken zich een vergelijkbare situatie voordoet als in de betreffende individuele zaak, heb ik niet inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over schikkingen in fraudezaken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether large fraud cases settled by high-value transactions create an appearance of class justice, whether the OM's guidelines have adequate criteria, whether press releases explain settlements, whether settlements stall legal development, and whether judicial review of transactions should be introduced. The Minister answered that high transactions are rare, used only when most appropriate, that the guidelines are sufficient, that the OM will consider more detail in press releases, that the accused keep recourse by refusing a transaction, and that no comparative plea-bargaining study is planned.
The defence always has the option of not accepting the transaction proposal, after which the OM will summon the suspect and the case will be brought before the judge.
De verdediging heeft echter altijd de mogelijkheid niet op het transactievoorstel in te gaan, waarna het OM tot dagvaarding zal overgaan en de zaak aan de rechter wordt voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de misstanden bij steenkoolbedrijf Drummond

An MP asks whether Drummond, a coal company in Colombia accused of human rights abuses, should provide redress to victims, whether Bettercoal is a suitable instrument, and whether it will publish audit results. The minister answers that redress is a matter for the Colombian state and judiciary, that Bettercoal audits are ongoing with results to be discussed further, and that she has urged Drummond toward transparency.
The process for redress for victims of the conflict is a responsibility of the Colombian government.
Het proces voor genoegdoening voor slachtoffers van het conflict is een verantwoordelijkheid van de Colombiaanse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Voortman over de betekenis van de uitspraak van het Europees Comité voor Sociale Rechten (ECSR)

MPs asked the State Secretary how his refusal to take immediate measures after a European Committee of Social Rights ruling squares with a Amsterdam court ruling recognising a right to a dignified existence, and whether he will provide bed, bath and bread to rejected asylum seekers living on the street. The State Secretary replied that the court case concerned municipal welfare obligations rather than the ECSR letter, that the individual still had ongoing procedures, and that he sees no reason to change his position, judging the Dutch system balanced.
The ruling of the Amsterdam court therefore gives me no reason to revisit my position following the ECSR letter.
De uitspraak van de rechtbank Amsterdam vormt voor mij dan ook geen aanleiding om terug te komen op mijn standpunt naar aanleiding van de brief van het ECSR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Van Hijum, Voordewind en Voortman over het onderzoeksrapport naar de medische behandeling van een uitgezette minderjarige asielzoekster

MPs asked whether the health and justice inspectorates were refusing to release an unredacted report on the medical care of a deported six-year-old asylum seeker, and whether the family's consent should change that. The government replied that the report was withheld to protect medical confidentiality, that the family had not consented to an unredacted version, and that a redacted version was sent to parliament on 27 May 2014.
It is undesirable for reports of an investigative committee to be made public if they contain privacy-sensitive and medical information traceable to a person.
Het is ongewenst dat verslagen van een onderzoekscommissie openbaar worden gemaakt indien daarin privacygevoelige en medische informatie die tot een persoon te herleiden is, is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Human Rights Watch concludeert dat Bulgarije asielzoekers mishandelt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the government would act on a Human Rights Watch report alleging Bulgarian border police push back and mistreat asylum seekers, and how this squares with EASO and Bulgarian government statements. The State Secretary replied that the government sees no reason for action beyond continued support to Bulgaria, citing Bulgarian denials, Red Cross and UNHCR reports, and announced a loosening of its earlier lenient Dublin policy on Bulgaria.
In view of the above, I see no reason to take action following the HRW report.
Gelet op het vorenstaande zie ik geen reden om naar aanleiding van het HRW-rapport acties te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Laar, Thieme en Voordewind over misstanden bij de productie van handgeknoopte tapijten in India

MPs from SP, PvdA, PvdD and ChristenUnie asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour and forced labour in India's hand-knotted carpet industry, and whether Dutch importers are involved. The minister acknowledges the severe abuses, reports that the Dutch import market is small and that voluntary initiatives such as Goodweave and Care & Fair have limited reach, and lists development projects and dialogue with India as follow-up.
Statistics Netherlands publishes only aggregated data and provides no overview of individual companies importing carpets from India.
Het CBS publiceert alleen geaggregeerde data en geeft geen overzicht van individuele bedrijven die tapijten uit India importeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw, Voortman en Gesthuizen over de uitzending van Zembla van 30 april jl. en de schriftelijke verklaring van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie aangaande het uitzett

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a Zembla broadcast and ministry statement on deporting people to Guinea, including whether Dutch authorities are responsible for checking the validity of travel documents issued by Guinean officials and whether deportations should be halted. The State Secretary answered that Guinea is responsible for the validity of its documents, that no concerns have been raised by the Guinean government, that monitoring deportees is not appropriate, and that the Commission Integraal Toezicht Terugkeer is reviewing the matter.
It is not for the Dutch government to make statements on whether certain (replacement) travel documents for return are valid or not.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid uitspraken te doen over of bepaalde (vervangende) reisdocumenten ten behoeve van terugkeer al dan niet rechtsgeldig zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het gebruik van de stille sms door de politie ten behoeve van de opsporing

Four MPs asked the minister about police use of silent SMS (stealth SMS) to locate phones in criminal investigations, including whether repeated use amounts to systematic observation, what procedural tightening was announced, and whether frequency of use is registered and disclosed. The minister answered that privacy impact depends on the case and is judged by the public prosecutor, that procedure now requires recording duration and frequency in the case file, but that the number of uses will not be publicly disclosed to protect investigations and because the criminal judge reviews lawfulness.
For that reason I do not intend to make this information public.
Om die reden ben ik niet voornemens deze informatie openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over de plannen rond ArtEZ en het functioneren van de Raad van Toezicht en het College van Bestuur

MPs Van Dijk and Gesthuizen asked about ArtEZ's plans to relocate or close programmes, the excessive pay of the interim chair of the Executive Board, a board member's business link with the interim chair's firm, and the Supervisory Board's functioning. The minister says the plans must improve quality, the Inspectorate is investigating the Wnt pay breach, the conflict of interest was checked and found acceptable, and governance matters are for the institution itself.
At the end of 2013 I informed ArtEZ that I regret that the remuneration of the interim chair of the Executive Board may exceed the norm.
Eind 2013 heb ik ArtEZ laten weten dat ik het betreur dat de bezoldiging van de interim-voorzitter van het College van Bestuur (CvB) de norm mogelijk overschrijdt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de transparantie bij onderhandelingen over een Memorandum of Understanding met Somalië

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the status of negotiations on supplementary working arrangements to a 2010 Memorandum of Understanding with Somalia, and whether the Chamber would be informed and given the MoU's content. The State Secretary said no response has been received, the timing is unknown, and the MoU cannot be published without Somali consent, though agreements may be shared confidentially; no forced return flights are currently booked.
If Somalia agrees to publication of the working arrangements, I will send them to your Chamber.
Indien Somalië instemt met openbaarmaking van de werkafspraken, zal ik deze aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Nederlandse websites massaal privacywetgeving schenden door het ongevraagd plaatsen van tracking cookies

MP Gesthuizen asked whether enforcement of privacy law is failing given reports that many Dutch websites place tracking cookies before consent, and how enforcement will be improved. The government answered that the ACM and CBP are pursuing lasting behaviour change rather than fines (none imposed yet), that market transparency is recognised as a problem, and that existing law is adequate, with no tightening planned.
For enforcement it is important that the supervisory authorities act in such a way that lasting behavioural change occurs among companies to which the law applies.
Voor de handhaving is belangrijk dat de toezichthouders zo optreden dat het komt tot een blijvende gedragsverandering bij bedrijven waarop de wet van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Schouw en Voortman over schade die kinderen oplopen tijdens het verblijf in asielzoekerscentra

Four MPs asked the State Secretary whether children suffer developmental harm while living in asylum reception centres, citing a court ruling, and asked about oversight, relocation of children and the state's duty under the Convention on the Rights of the Child. The State Secretary rejected the claim that children face harm merely from reception centre stay, pointed to existing oversight by the COA Supervisory Board and inspectorates, and committed to no new independent oversight body or relocation study.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aanpak van vacaturefraude

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Social Affairs about vacancy fraud (money mule schemes), its scale, the measures taken against it, and whether victims who became unwitting money launderers could receive leniency. The Minister described the scheme, reported complaint and report figures, the UWV's screening and registration measures, and said leniency must be judged case by case by the prosecutor and courts.
No figures are available on the number of criminal cases concerning this specific form of fraud.
Er zijn geen cijfers over het aantal strafzaken aangaande deze specifieke verschijningsvorm van fraude beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat ING adverteerders inzicht wil bieden in klantgedrag

SP MPs Merkies and Gesthuizen asked the Finance Minister how he reacts to ING's plan to give advertisers insight into customer behaviour, and whether the pilot breaches privacy law, the sector code, consent rules and customer data ownership. The minister says he and the AFM and DNB are critical, that consent under the Wbp would be required for commercial use, that the Cbp is responsible for enforcement and may investigate, and that no further legal change seems necessary for now.
It is not for me nor for the State Secretary of Security and Justice to pronounce on compatibility with the Code of Conduct or the Wbp.
Het is niet aan mij noch aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie om een uitspraak te doen over de verenigbaarheid met de Gedragscode of de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat slechts tien procent van de gedownloade boeken middels de legale weg wordt verkregen

An SP MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about reports that only ten percent of downloaded e-books are obtained legally, and about copyright compensation, the 21% VAT rate on e-books and market reform. The state secretary answered that downloading for private use falls under the private-copy exception with levies pending a CJEU ruling, supported an awareness campaign, pointed to the author contracts bill, and said VAT harmonisation is under EU review while market actors should develop business models.

Downloading (reproducing) e-books for one's own practice, study or use, on the other hand, falls under the private-copy exception of Article 16c of the Copyright Act, so the rightholder's consent is not required.

Het downloaden (reproduceren) van e-boeken voor eigen oefening, studie of gebruik, daarentegen, valt onder de thuiskopie-exceptie van artikel 16c van de Auteurswet zodat toestemming van de rechthebbende niet is vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over het bericht dat een ernstig zieke vader is uitgezet naar Guinee

Four MPs (SP, ChristenUnie, D66, GroenLinks) asked State Secretary Teeven why a seriously ill Guinean father was deported despite pending Article 8 ECHR proceedings, medical concerns, questions about travel documents, and Utrecht's offer of care. The State Secretary defended the deportation as the outcome of careful individual assessments, said medication was confirmed available in Guinea, and declined to discuss the individual case beyond what was necessary.
It is known to your House that I do not consider it desirable to enter into individual cases in public debate.
Het is uw Kamer bekend dat ik het niet wenselijk acht in het publieke debat in te gaan op individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Helder en Oskam over zijn uitspraak dat er goede gesprekken zijn met de advocaat van een slachtoffer van identiteitsfraude en zijn toezegging de Kamer hierover te informeren

MPs Gesthuizen, Helder and Oskam asked why the minister said in parliament that talks with the lawyer of an identity-fraud victim were going well, and whether the Chamber had been properly informed. The minister replied that talks took place, the last on 16 April 2013, that the state asked for substantiation of the claimed damages, and that the lawyer was still considering a response; he said the earlier statement was accurate and that individual cases are not usually discussed substantively in the Chamber.
It is not customary to discuss an ongoing individual case in substance in the Chamber.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om in uw Kamer inhoudelijk in te gaan op een lopende individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat honderden mensen Mogadishu ontvluchten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether reports of Al-Shabaab attacks and people fleeing Mogadishu would change asylum, foreign-nationals and return policy for Somalia, and whether forced returns of rejected asylum seekers should stop. The State Secretary said the situation is worrying, that targeted violence has become more concentrated, that certain groups were designated as at-risk and the admission policy adapted, but saw no reason to change policy on arbitrary violence and promised a new country report in autumn.
Regarding the reports of recent arbitrary violence in Mogadishu, I see no reason for now to change my policy.
Voor wat betreft de berichtgeving over recent willekeurig geweld in Mogadishu zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om mijn beleid aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over documentaires over detentiecentra

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether he agrees that the public should be able to learn about daily life in Dutch immigration detention centres, and whether a documentary maker could be granted access, as Switzerland and Italy have allowed. The State Secretary agreed, pointed to the recent documentary 'Borders' and said he is in talks with broadcaster HUMAN about a documentary on Detentiecentrum Rotterdam.
Requests for such documentaries will therefore always be carefully considered by me.
Aanvragen voor dergelijke documentaires zal ik dan ook altijd zorgvuldig bekijken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het door de overheid in eigen beheer nemen van de bezorging van reguliere pakketten, het verzorgen van koeriers- en transportdiensten en de bezorging van gerechtelijke briev

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the government about worker anxiety, job security, staff numbers and service quality as the state plans to bring parcel delivery, courier services and delivery of court letters in-house via IPKD. Minister Blok answered that no decision on staff transfers can yet be given, that Valid Express workers will be taken over where no suitable post exists at PostNL, and that legal quality standards for court letters will be ensured.
What consequences the in-sourcing plans will have for staff of companies currently performing these tasks cannot be stated in advance.
Welke gevolgen de inbestedingsvoornemens hebben voor personeel van bedrijven die deze taken nu uitvoeren, is niet op voorhand te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de inzet van kledingbedrijf CoolCat om te komen tot verduurzaming van de textiel- en kledingsector

The SP MP Gesthuizen asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about CoolCat's director's statements on the Bangladesh fire and building safety accord, its claimed controllability, its use of own inspectors, and its BSCI membership. The Minister answers that CoolCat's long-term supplier relations aid controllability, that own inspections help but do not guarantee safety, that BSCI is not a certification scheme, and that she revises her earlier view because CoolCat signed the accord.
BSCI is not a certification process, but focuses on helping companies improve working conditions.
BSCI is geen certificatieproces, maar richt zich op het helpen van bedrijven om de arbeidsomstandigheden te verbeteren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de problemen waar ongedocumenteerde hiv-patiënten in Nederland tegenaan lopen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how undocumented HIV patients risk losing medication, whether the IND tests real access to care in the country of origin, and how the new 5-euro medicine co-payment affects them. The State Secretary rejects the Aids Fonds conclusions, states that the IND assesses availability (not actual accessibility) through BMA advice, places responsibility for access on the patient and treating doctors, and declines to change the Vreemdelingencirculaire.
I do not share the conclusions of the Aids Fund.
Ik deel de conclusies van het Aids Fonds niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het onderzoek in opdracht van de Europese vakorganisatie UNI Post & Logistics over de werkgelegenheidseffecten van de liberalisatie van de postsector

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how he views a UNI Post & Logistics report finding that postal liberalisation in Europe largely had negative employment and working-condition effects, including whether liberalisation failed to deliver better service and lower prices and whether dropping the five-day delivery obligation will worsen service. The minister acknowledged job losses and worse conditions, attributed them mainly to falling mail volumes from digitalisation, said liberalisation benefited business customers, and said a periodic evaluation of the universal postal service will be added to the upcoming bill.
The intention is therefore to include a statutory, periodic evaluation of the universal postal service in the bill modernising the UPD.
Het voornemen is daarom om in het wetsvoorstel ter modernisering van de UPD een wettelijke, periodieke evaluatie van de UPD op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de gemaakte afspraken om het werk in kledingfabrieken in Bangladesh veiliger te maken nog te weinig effect hebben

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked why Bangladesh had not yet hired the promised 200 extra labour inspectors after the Rana Plaza collapse, which projects the EUR 1 million Dutch contribution funded, how oversight of subcontractors would work, and when the agreements would take effect. Minister Ploumen answered that the inspector hiring was delayed by elections but other steps had been taken (42 vacancies filled, 200 factories inspected on building safety, ILO programme with EUR 6 million from the Netherlands, five-year timeline), and that the Accord inspections were not delayed.
It is important that the Bangladeshi government keeps the agreements made and promptly appoints the 200 extra inspectors.
Het is belangrijk dat de Bengaalse overheid de gemaakte afspraken nakomt en spoedig de 200 extra inspecteurs aanstelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit, Gesthuizen en Merkies over een schikking van het Openbaar Ministerie met KPMG

MPs De Wit, Gesthuizen and Merkies (SP) asked why the Minister approved a Public Prosecution Service settlement with KPMG over its role in the Ballast Nedam fraud, and whether it should be reversed. The Minister answered that he approved it after weighing all interests, that the settlement with its fine and publicity serves punishment goals, and that reversal is not possible.
With this settlement the investigation into the responsible natural persons has not ended; that investigation continues.
Met deze transactie is het onderzoek naar verantwoordelijke natuurlijke personen niet beëindigd; dat onderzoek wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit, Gesthuizen, en Merkies over de door het openbaar ministerie getroffen schikking met KPMG in een fraudezaak van Ballast Nedam

MPs De Wit, Gesthuizen and Merkies asked whether KPMG's top has known about the Ballast Nedam bribery affair for ten years, whether this was kept from the prosecution, whether the OM is investigating KPMG leadership, and whether the minister will reconsider the settlement with KPMG. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, declined to answer the specific questions because the investigation into three accountants is ongoing, and stood by the settlement.
To avoid harming this ongoing investigation, I cannot answer the specific questions you ask at this time.
Om dit nog lopende onderzoek niet te schaden kan ik de specifieke vragen die u stelt nu niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over medicijnkosten voor vreemdelingen

MPs Gesthuizen and Leijten asked whether the €5 per-medicine charge for uninsured foreigners would deter needed care, how pharmacies could assess ability to pay, the CVZ's collection costs and savings, and whether it breaches the European Social Charter. Minister Schippers defended the measure as enforcing the principle that uninsured foreigners pay for care, saying it does not block necessary care, no means test is needed, collection costs are nil, savings are not the aim, and the Charter does not cover illegal residents.
I see no insurmountable barrier to obtaining care in the five-euro measure.
Ik zie in de vijf-euromaatregel geen onoverkomelijke drempel voor het verkrijgen van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Dijkgraaf over de toename van het aantal winkelopenstellingen op Eerste Kerstdag

MPs Gesthuizen and Dijkgraaf asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the rise in shop openings on Christmas Day and the protection of workers and small shopkeepers, and whether municipalities need a separate exemption with a draagvlak study. The minister replied that municipalities must weigh interests under the Algemene wet bestuursrecht, that workers can invoke existing laws and cao rules, and that enforcement against unlawful openings is a municipal responsibility, with no specific requirements for a support survey.
I do not have an overview of how the various municipalities give substance to this.
Ik heb geen overzicht over hoe de verschillende gemeenten hier invulling aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jan Vos, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder, Thieme, Baay-Timmerman en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de katoenproductie in Turkije

Seven MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour in Turkish cotton production, the follow-up to a Dutch-funded study, pressure on Turkish authorities and the ILO, the textile sector's responsibility, traceability of Turkish cotton, the MVO risk analysis, ILO child labour figures and child labour raised on trade missions. The minister answered that projects, workshops and a sector action plan are underway, that no EU action plan is needed given ILO efforts, that traceability is not feasible, and that the sector selection will be presented in summer 2014.
The Turkish government is primarily responsible for eliminating child labour.
De Turkse overheid is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitbanning van kinderarbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een Armeense man na 14 jaar rechtmatig verblijf alsnog moet terugkeren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary why a long-resident Armenian man was facing return after 14 years, whether his asylum account was properly examined given a different name had been given, and whether removal would breach EU procedural rules and Article 8 ECHR. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, explained revocation and appeal rules in general terms, and said the answers to the MP's questions and the mayor's letter would come before any removal.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over medicijnkosten voor vreemdelingen

SP MPs asked whether the 2014 requirement that undocumented migrants pay EUR 5 per prescription line at pharmacies, and must pay in full where a pharmacy lacks a CVZ contract, undermines access to necessary care and whether hospital access and reimbursement problems will be addressed. The minister defended the EUR 5 charge as a means to reduce non-payment, denied conflict with the law, said hospital access is sufficient and refused to commission further research.
I therefore do not share the view that an amount of EUR 5 hinders access to medically necessary care.
Ik deel dus niet de mening dat een bedrag van € 5 de toegankelijkheid tot medisch noodzakelijke zorg belemmert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Dijk over investeringsverdragen

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about investment treaties, including ISDS, regulatory chill, South Africa's termination of its bilateral investment treaty with the Netherlands, and the Ping An claim. The Minister replied that the Netherlands seeks a balance between investor protection and policy space, supports the right to regulate and OECD guidelines in EU treaties, sees little financial risk, and promised a study on ISDS risks.
I will inform the House of the results of this study.
Ik zal de Kamer over de resultaten van dit onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aanpak van horizontale fraude en het collectief verhalen van schade

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government accepts that victims of horizontal fraud are left unassisted and whether collective civil claims should be broadened, and whether the state should fund legal costs. The minister replied that victims receive support via the Fraudehelpdesk, asset recovery, new conservatory seizure and voorschotregeling, that enforcement is not prioritised toward vertical fraud, that art. 3:305a BW is being amended to allow collective damages claims, and that funding legal costs through the Wrb is rejected.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de uitzetting van een Eritreese vrouw

Labour MP Gesthuizen asked the state secretary whether an Eritrean woman facing expulsion could be prevented from being passed between authorities and whether she should receive a residence permit on discretionary grounds. The state secretary declined to address the individual case, saying it is not appropriate to request discretionary permit grants through parliamentary questions.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om bij de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over een psychisch zieke vreemdeling die is geïsoleerd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a mentally ill Guinean asylum-seeker held for six months and repeatedly isolated with no prospect of return, and about who bears responsibility for care after release. The State Secretary answered that detention is subject to judicial review, that isolation is used sparingly and reviewed, that medical care is guaranteed even for unlawfully resident persons, and promised a new detention bill in spring 2014.
There must then be a real risk of absconding and actual prospect of removal. This is reviewed by the judge.
Er dient dan een reëel risico op onttrekking en daadwerkelijk zicht op uitzetting te zijn. Dit wordt getoetst door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman en Schouw over het Nederlandse asielbeleid voor Russische LHBT-ers

MPs Gesthuizen, Voortman and Schouw asked whether Russia's anti-gay propaganda law endangers LGBT people, what the Netherlands is doing about it, whether visa liberalisation should be suspended, and whether Russian LGBT asylum claims will be processed faster. The minister replied that the Netherlands raises LGBT rights through dialogue with Russia, the EU and the Council of Europe, that visa liberalisation is only at an exploratory stage with human rights weighed in future steps, and that LGBT asylum claims are assessed case by case under existing criteria without priority processing.

The Netherlands continues to focus primarily, both bilaterally and multilaterally, on broad international attention and dialogue on the human rights situation and the position of the LGBT community in Russia, rather than hardening positions.

Nederland blijft zowel op het bilaterale als multilaterale spoor primair inzetten op brede internationale aandacht en dialoog over de mensenrechtensituatie en de positie van de LHBT-gemeenschap in Rusland, in plaats van het verharden van standpunten.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de Minister en Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over achterblijvende resultaten van de Nationale politie (ingezonden 14 oktober 2013).

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the Minister and State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that the National Police is failing on crime, high tech crime clearance, burglary and street robbery clearance, and a possible unofficial quota for arresting illegal immigrants. The minister rejected the claim of failure, said high tech crime targets were behind schedule but being addressed, and maintained there is no quota, pointing to prioritised immigration enforcement and referring to the performance agreements and annual reports.
Of course I am and will remain in discussion with the police, mayors and the Public Prosecution Service to jointly look at how lagging results can be further improved.
Uiteraard ben en blijf ik met de politie, de burgemeesters en het Openbaar Ministerie in gesprek om gezamenlijk te kijken hoe achterblijvende resultaten verder verbeterd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over naar Nederland gevluchte Noord-Koreanen die terug moeten keren naar Zuid-Korea

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister whether North Korean asylum seekers in the Netherlands face danger if returned to South Korea and whether South Korea cooperates with returns. The government answered that South Korea admits all voluntary North Korean defectors who automatically gain citizenship, that no returns have yet occurred, and that the risk to asylum seekers and their families is weighed case by case.
All relevant circumstances raised by the foreign national are taken into account when assessing an asylum application.
Alle door de vreemdeling aangevoerde relevante omstandigheden worden meegewogen bij de beoordeling van een asielaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Brazilië gebruikersdata binnen de grenzen wil houden

Two SP MPs asked whether Brazil's plan to force foreign tech firms to store user data domestically would protect Dutch citizens' data, and whether Dutch law can bind foreign companies. The minister replied that US jurisdiction over Google means server location is not decisive, saw no reason to contact Brazil, and explained that the Wbp applies to firms with a Dutch establishment or that process data using Dutch-located means.
This follows from the fact that the United States claims very broad jurisdiction, which leads to extraterritorial effects.
Dit vloeit voort uit het feit dat de Verenigde Staten zichzelf een zeer ruime rechtsmacht aanmeten die tot extraterritoriale effecten leidt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het in land van herkomst fysiek overdragen van uitgezette zieke vreemdelingen

The SP member Gesthuizen asked how the government applies the condition that seriously ill foreigners may only be expelled if physical handover to a medical provider in the country of origin takes place, and whether that handover always succeeds. State Secretary Teeven answered that the BMA can set such conditions, DT&V arranges and verifies them with receiving clinics, no registration is kept of failed handovers, and if handover proves impossible the person is brought back to the Netherlands.
No registration is kept of physical handovers that are not possible in the country of origin.
Er wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van fysieke overdrachten die niet mogelijk zijn in het land van herkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de posttarieven van PostNL per 1 januari 2014 wederom gaan stijgen
