An SP MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the reported 4-cent rise in the postage stamp price from 2014, questioning whether a 45% increase since 2010 is acceptable, why PostNL uses its full tariff room, and whether the rise follows from withdrawing a claim against Sandd. The minister answered that declining volumes make the universal postal service costlier, that the price stays below the West-European average, that PostNL's proposed tariff room is needed for a viable service, and that cost increases are rightly borne by users alongside cost-cutting measures such as fewer post offices, with a bill in preparation.
It is reasonable that an increase in the costs of the UPD is paid by users of the UPD.
Het ligt in de rede dat een toename in de kosten van de UPD wordt betaald door gebruikers van de UPD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Schouw, Gesthuizen, Ouwehand en Voordewind over de voorgenomen ontruiming van de vluchtflat

MPs asked the state secretary what happens to residents of the Amsterdam 'vluchtflat' without residence prospects after its planned eviction, whether immigration detention is appropriate for them, who bears responsibility for their welfare and medical care, and whether alternative shelter will be provided before eviction. The state secretary replied that residents may choose to work on return and then get shelter in a freedom-restricting location with DT&V facilitation, that detention is a last resort applied case by case, that residents remain responsible for their own choices while retaining right to necessary medical care, and that he shares the ambition to prevent residents ending up on the street.
Since the residents of the Vluchtflat show no willingness to return and hardly want to talk to the DT&V, I do not rule out that in individual cases immigration detention may be the last resort.

Nu de bewoners van de Vluchtflat niet getuigen van terugkeerbereidheid en nauwelijks willen praten met de DT&V, sluit ik niet uit dat in individuele gevallen vreemdelingenbewaring het uiterste middel kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Schouw over de opvang van Syrische asielzoekers door Bulgarije

MPs Maij, Gesthuizen and Schouw asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reception conditions for Syrian asylum seekers in Bulgaria, including access to procedures, shelter, child provisions, EU minimum standards and other affected countries. The State Secretary answered that Bulgaria faces overcrowded centres and UNHCR criticism, that an EU/Frontex/EASO mission was planned, that the Commission monitors EU law compliance, and that Greece and Cyprus would also be visited.
It is not for me, but precisely for the European Commission, to monitor the correct application of EU law.
Het is niet aan mij, maar juist de taak van de Europese Commissie om over correcte toepassing van het EU-recht te waken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Schouw over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Angolese asielzoeker

MPs from ChristenUnie, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government would reconsider the age cutoff of the Kinderpardon scheme, which excludes a 22-year-old Angolan asylum seeker who arrived at age ten, and whether he could await his objection procedure in the Netherlands and why he remains in detention. The State Secretary refused to revisit the upper age limit, allowed the man to await his objection procedure in the Netherlands, and defended detention given his earlier evasion of lighter measures.
I have now decided that the person concerned may await his objection procedure in the Netherlands.
Inmiddels heb ik besloten dat betrokkene zijn bezwaarprocedure in Nederland mag afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de nieuwe PI Zaanstad geschikt is voor vreemdelingenbewaring

An SP MP asked whether the new Zaanstad prison, reported as suitable for immigration detention, signals a reversal of the plan to cut immigration detention capacity, and how this fits the planned shift to alternatives. The state secretary answered that the building is designed as a multifunctional facility that will be used by the prison sector, while immigration detainees will stay in Rotterdam, Schiphol and Zeist, and that the capacity cut and shift to supervision measures are unaffected.
Foreigners placed in custody will be housed in the three detention centres Rotterdam, Schiphol and Zeist.
Vreemdelingen die in bewaring worden gesteld, zullen worden ondergebracht in de drie detentiecentra Rotterdam, Schiphol en Zeist.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en De Wit over de megaschikking met een oliehandelaar en het afkopen van strafvervolging

MPs Gesthuizen and De Wit asked the Justice Minister about the settlement with oil trader John Deuss's bank, FCIB, under which pending criminal proceedings and appeal were withdrawn in exchange for 34.5 million euros in confiscation and a 500,000 euro transaction. The minister defended the settlement as proportionate given the verdicts already reached, the limited prospects of a higher outcome due to imminent statute of limitations, and said the transaction was approved on 21 June 2013 after review limited to reasonableness.
My review is limited to that assessment.
Mijn toetsing beperkt zich tot die beoordeling.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over de slechte arbeidsomstandigheden van garnalenpelsters in Marokko (ingezonden 27 juni 2013).

The MP asks about relocation of Moroccan shrimp-peeling factories from the Tangier free zone, alleged poor working conditions, dismissal and loss of rights, and whether Dutch firms should take responsibility. The minister replies that VEBEGA and the firms say they promote decent employment and will talk with NGO TIE Netherlands, that primary enforcement lies with Moroccan authorities, that relocation effects vary, and that firms will meet the ministry and NGO.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Irakees gezin met kinderen die onder toezicht zijn gesteld en uit huis zijn geplaatst

MPs Voordewind and Gesthuizen asked about the planned deportation of an Iraqi family whose children were under supervision and placed out of home, questioning the state's conduct in detaining the children and whether their rights were protected. The state secretary declined to discuss the individual case, but said the children's detention was lifted, the family was placed in a family location, and a plan is being worked out with Nidos and the family.
As you know, when answering parliamentary questions I do not go into specific aspects of individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik bij de beantwoording van kamervragen niet in op specifieke aspecten van individuele zaken.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitspraken van een internist over het medi

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether police and the DV&O breach medical confidentiality and patients' rights toward foreign nationals at emergency departments, and whether they would act on a case reported by an internist. The minister replied that local police, hospital and prosecution agreements exist and are periodically evaluated, that he does not see a structural problem, that DV&O staff are bound by a duty of secrecy, and that he will contact the author of the article.
As long as these agreements and the mutual evaluation are carried out properly, I do not share the fear that people will feel inhibited from speaking freely to doctors.
Zolang deze afspraken en de onderlinge evaluatie goed wordt uitgevoerd deel ik niet de vrees dat personen zich belemmerd zullen voelen in het zich uiten jegens artsen.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Oosenbrug (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat providers niet-geanonimiseerde gegevens van Nederlandse burgers opslaan (i

MPs Gesthuizen and Oosenbrug asked whether Dutch telecom providers stored non-anonymised data on customers' website and app use, for what purpose, whether this breached the law, and whether broader investigation and new regulation are needed. The minister said the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) found violations of the Wbp at KPN, Tele2, T-Mobile and Vodafone, that enforcement decisions are pending, and that no new legislation is needed because existing instruments suffice.
During the investigation, the CBP found violations of the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp) at all companies.
Tijdens het onderzoek constateerde het CBP bij alle bedrijven overtredingen van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit en Gesthuizen over de dreigende uitlevering van de heer K. aan Turkije

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the extradition of Mr K. to Turkey, given his serious health condition, was responsible, what medical-care guarantees Turkey had given, and whether the decision would be reconsidered. The minister replied that the extradition procedure was complete and approved, that he sees no reason to reconsider, that actual surrender will not proceed until he is satisfied the health consequences are not especially harsh, and that he has consulted the prison medical adviser and entered into consultation with Turkish authorities on the manner of surrender and care.

I can make no statements about the content of that advice, except that I saw reason to enter into consultation with the Turkish authorities about how any extradition will take place and about the care Turkey will then provide.

Ik kan over de inhoud daarvan geen mededelingen doen, behalve dat ik er aanleiding in heb gezien om in overleg te treden met de Turkse autoriteiten over de wijze waarop een eventuele uitlevering zal plaatsvinden en over de zorg die dan door Turkije zal worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over werknemers van PostNL die tijdens de staking het werk van de zelfstandige pakketbezorgers overnemen

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether PostNL was right to call on its staff to deliver parcels with private cars during the strike by self-employed couriers, whether this breaches the right to strike, and how staff were insured. The minister said the parties reached an agreement, that the right to strike is for courts to weigh case by case, and that PostNL insures its staff and would be held liable as client in case of third-party damage.
It is therefore not for me but, where applicable, for the court to judge any possible conflict with the right to strike.
Het is dus niet aan mij maar in voorkomend geval aan de rechter om een oordeel te vellen over eventuele strijdigheid met het stakingsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat online zoeken naar gezondheidsgerelateerde informatie privacyrisico’s met zich meebrengt

An SP MP asked the ministers about reports that online searches for health information, such as herpes, create privacy risks through tracking cookies and data leaks to third parties. The minister answered that Dutch law (Wbp, Telecommunicatiewet cookie rules) protects such data, that the CBP and ACM are investigating tracking cookies and can enforce, but gave no specific new action beyond pointing to existing supervision and public information.
The CBP cannot make further statements about these ongoing investigations.
Over deze lopende onderzoeken kan het CBP geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de uitzetting van een zesjarig meisje met acute leukemie

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the state secretary about the transfer to Poland of a six-year-old asylum seeker with acute leukaemia, how her medical situation was taken into account, and whether an investigation would be started. The state secretary answered that medical confidentiality and an announced IGZ/IVenJ investigation prevent substantive comment on the medical handling, explained the BMA and fit-to-fly procedures in general terms, and said the inspectorates will investigate the medical handling and information transfer in the chain.

Because of the medical confidentiality that applies to medical files and because of the investigation announced by the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Inspectorate Security and Justice (IVenJ), I cannot currently make statements on the substantive aspects of the medical handling in this case.

Vanwege het medische beroepsgeheim dat geldt voor medische dossiers en vanwege het door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) aangekondigde onderzoek kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen over de inhoudelijke aspecten van het medisch handelen in deze zaak.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Thieme, Krol en Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid en lage lonen bij Nederlandse zaadbedrijven in India

Four MPs asked the minister about child labour and low wages at Dutch seed companies Bejo Zaden and Nunhems in India, and about the sector's due diligence and CSR commitments. The minister responded that the government wants child labour eliminated, that Bejo Sheetal did not join the FLA, that Plantum will evaluate members' policies, and that Bejo and Nunhems will introduce new measures including monitoring and minimum wage commitments.
In the meeting with Plantum, the implementation of the Plantum statement on the prevention of child labour was discussed.
In het gesprek met Plantum is de uitvoering van de « Plantum statement on the prevention of child labour» aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de betrokkenheid van Shell bij een grote brand in Bodo, Nigeria

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether an independent investigation into the Shell-linked fire in Bodo, Nigeria was needed, after Shell contractors were arrested, and what steps had been taken on UNEP recommendations and an offer of technical assistance to Nigerian oil oversight. The minister replied that Shell's internal inquiry includes an NGO representative who considers it independent, that any further investigation is for the Nigerian government (with a possible Dutch legal-assistance request), that the embassy is pursuing UNEP follow-up and a mediation process, and that Nigeria has not responded to the technical assistance offer.
It is up to the Nigerian government whether or not to order an additional investigation into this incident.
Het is aan de Nigeriaanse overheid al dan niet een aanvullend onderzoek naar dit incident in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat ook in Nederland door justitie veel gegevens worden verzameld

Opposition MP Gesthuizen asked whether Dutch investigative services can freely query collected telecom and internet data without independent oversight, and whether foreign agencies can access it directly or bypass mutual legal assistance. The state secretary referred to earlier letters on the CIOT system, stated that queries (2.758.435 in 2012) are subject to judicial control and audits, and denied that foreign agencies have direct access, saying foreign requests always go through mutual legal assistance.

These documents describe the basis and working method of CIOT queries, the number of authorisations and the number of queries (2,758,435 queries in 2012), and the (judicial) control and supervision of the queries.

In deze stukken worden de grondslag en de werkwijze van CIOT-bevragingen beschreven, het aantal autorisaties en het aantal bevragingen (2.758.435 bevragingen in 2012) en de (rechterlijke) controle en het toezicht op de bevragingen.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (I

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel ask about two Chinese interpreters removed from the IND interpreter file, their training requirements, integrity checks, use in Uyghur asylum cases and risks to family members in China. The state secretary answers that the IND sets no general training requirements for its interpreters, that the two interpreters were removed, and that Uyghurs' cases and family risks are weighed case by case without informing Chinese authorities.
The IND does not set general further-training requirements for interpreters, partly because training courses for the foreign languages these interpreters speak often do not exist.
De IND stelt geen algemene bijscholingseisen aan tolken, mede daar er op het gebied van de door die tolken gesproken vreemde talen vaak geen tolkenopleidingen bestaan.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over «family tracing» (ingezonden 25 juni 2013).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about how the IND and DT&V trace families of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in their country of origin, including timing, consent, safety and verification. The State Secretary answered that tracing starts only after a final decision, that minors are informed and may involve their guardian, and that family refusal to take a child back does not automatically grant a residence permit.
It is therefore not correct that tracing already starts before a decision has been made on the asylum application.
Het is dus niet juist dat tracing al start als er nog geen beslissing is genomen op de asielaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de veiligheidssituatie in Irak

Three MPs asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about the deteriorating security situation in Iraq, especially Baghdad and central Iraq, including civilian casualty figures compared with 2011-2012 and when a departure moratorium would be needed. The state secretary reported a rise in violence in April-June 2013 but argued the situation does not amount to a breach of Article 3 ECHR, and said a departure moratorium is not the appropriate instrument, with a general country report due in autumn.
In my view, however, the available information does not show that the situation in Iraq is so serious that return to that country would amount to a violation of Article 3 ECHR.
Naar mijn opvatting kan echter uit de beschikbare informatie niet worden opgemaakt dat de situatie in Irak zo ernstig is dat terugkeer naar dat land een schending van artikel 3 EVRM oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het voorgestelde decryptiebevel en het terughackvoorstel

An SP MP asked whether the proposed decryption order and hacking-back proposal violate human rights and whether the Council for the Judiciary's advice warrants a legality study and prior judicial authorisation. The minister replied that a TILT study on the decryption order was already done and sent to parliament, that the Council's advice is taken on board (including the Chambaz case), and that the draft bill already provides prior review by an investigating judge.
The draft bill put to consultation provides for prior review of the proposed investigative powers by the investigating judge.
Het conceptwetsvoorstel dat in consultatie is gegeven voorziet in de voorafgaande toetsing van de voorgestelde opsporingsbevoegdheden door de rechter-commissaris.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitvoering van de kinderasielregeling (ingezonden 28 juni 2013).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the IND sends intent-to-impose-entry-ban letters to applicants under the children's asylum scheme while their applications are pending, and how the promised individual review of borderline cases is applied. The State Secretary answers that such letters are sent to preserve the right to be heard before a decision, that the wording will be clarified to avoid confusion, and that borderline cases are reviewed individually and submitted to him.
To prevent confusion, I will have the letter adjusted so that its purpose becomes clearer and it is also clear that the letter does not anticipate the decision on the residence application.

Om verwarring te voorkomen, zal ik de brief laten aanpassen, zodat de bedoeling van de brief duidelijker wordt en tevens helder is dat de brief niet vooruitloopt op de beslissing op de verblijfsaanvraag.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het uitzetten van Noord-Koreaanse asielzoekers naar Zuid-Korea (ingezonden 14 juni 2013).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary why North Korean asylum seekers can be returned to South Korea since 1 January 2013, whether this fits the coalition agreement and the ECHR, the risk to relatives left in North Korea, and how other member states act. The minister replies that applications are assessed individually, that South Korean citizenship can justify rejection, that relatives' risk is weighed case by case, and gives a comparative overview and asylum figures.

In view of this, it is assessed on an individual basis whether protection in the Netherlands is needed, also testing whether it can reasonably be expected that the foreigner can rely on protection from South Korea.

Met het oog daarop wordt op individuele basis beoordeeld of bescherming in Nederland nodig is, waarbij ook wordt getoetst of in redelijkheid kan worden verwacht dat de vreemdeling zich onder de bescherming kan stellen van Zuid-Korea.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het bericht dat justitie door uitzetting een moeder van haar kinderen wil scheiden

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that the Dienst Terugkeer & Vertrek plans to deport a Moroccan mother whose minor children hold Dutch nationality, and asks for an answer before the summer recess since she is in immigration detention. The State Secretary confirms the earlier questions were noted and says the questions were answered as quickly as possible.
I have answered the questions as quickly as possible.
Ik heb de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk beantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de basisschool op asielzoekerscentrum Gilze dreigt te worden gesloten

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether closing the primary school at the Gilze asylum centre, which lacks extra funding for effective education of rejected asylum children, breaches children's right to education under the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The government answered that schools can claim additional funding, that the threatened closure has been averted after talks, and that per-pupil funding for these groups will rise from the 2013–2014 school year.
That is why I recently decided to earmark €45,500 for the Prinsenbosschool to relieve the school's distress in the short term.
Daarom heb ik onlangs besloten de Prinsenbosschool een bedrag van € 45.500,00 in het vooruitzicht te stellen, om de nood op de school op korte termijn te lenigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat justitie door uitzetting een moeder van haar kinderen wil scheiden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether it is in a child's interest to deport a Moroccan mother of Dutch-national children when the father cannot care for them, and how the best interests of the child are weighed. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, stated that having Dutch children is not in itself a ground for a residence permit, and explained that the child's interests and the family-life test under Article 8 ECHR are weighed in the application process, while the decision to reject an application also implies a duty to leave.
As you know, in answer to written questions I do not provide information from individual case files.
Zoals u bekend is, verstrek ik in antwoord op schriftelijke vragen geen informatie uit individuele dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (IND) op non-actief zijn gezet

Two MPs asked why the IND suspended two Chinese-speaking Uyghur interpreters suspected of leaking confidential information to Chinese authorities, whether they face prosecution, how they passed vetting, and what is being done for affected asylum seekers. The state secretary answered that a criminal complaint was filed, the interpreters were excluded from further use, all asylum cases were re-assessed with almost all granted asylum, and no Uyghurs were returned to China.
The IND has filed a criminal complaint against the interpreters concerned.
Er is door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) aangifte gedaan tegen de betreffende tolken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het publiceren van 112-meldingen op internet

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the minister whether P2000 emergency paging traffic will be encrypted from 2014, so that privacy-sensitive 112 messages stop appearing online and journalists lose access. The minister replied that encryption is under study with a decision only after consultation, that the current contract runs to 2017, and that journalists will be informed via a national press-alarm guideline drawn up with the Dutch journalists' association.
In consultation with the National Police and the Security Council, I will examine in the coming months the options for improving citizens' privacy on this point
In overleg met de Nationale Politie en het Veiligheidsberaad onderzoek ik in de komende maanden de mogelijkheden om de privacy van burgers op dit punt te verbeteren
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de verslechtering van de veiligheidssituatie in bepaalde gebieden in Irak

MPs asked the state secretary about the worsening security situation in central Iraq and whether a new country report, a departure moratorium for asylum seekers, and asylum policy changes were warranted. The state secretary said an updated report on Iraq, including security by region and the position of ethnic and religious groups, is expected in autumn, and that a departure moratorium is not necessary at present while developments are monitored.
I have already asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs for an updated country report on the general situation in Iraq.
Ik heb reeds aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken een geactualiseerd ambtsbericht gevraagd over algehele situatie in Irak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Schouw over uitzettingen van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the state secretary whether Guinean laissez-passers for deportations were issued despite the Guinean ambassador's claim that he signed none, and why Guinea did not take part in taskforces. The state secretary answered that about 20 laissez-passers were obtained in 2013 from the Brussels mission, signed by the consul, that two deportations have taken place, and that there is no reason to suspend deportations to Guinea.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de uitspraken van een internist over het medisch beroepsgeheim en vreemdelingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether an internist's claims that detained foreign nationals are accompanied by guards or police during medical consultations, and that this breaches medical confidentiality, are accurate, and whether the government will change its policy. The State Secretary replied that detainees receive necessary care, that supervision during hospital visits is justified on security grounds with confidentiality balanced case by case, and that he sees no need to revise the policy, while complaints can follow the usual route.

All in all, I am of the view that for reasons of security it may be justified, after careful weighing against the respect owed to the doctor's professional secrecy, to infringe on the doctor-patient confidentiality.

Al met al ben ik van mening dat het uit oogpunt van veiligheid gerechtvaardigd kan zijn om – na zorgvuldige weging het te respecteren beroepsgeheim van de arts – een inbreuk te maken op de arts-patiënt vertrouwelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het Nederlandse visitatiebeleid in vreemdelingendetentie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about body search practices in immigration detention, including whether they comply with ECHR case law (Valasinas) and whether the policy should be revised before a new detention law. The State Secretary explained the legal basis and restrictive internal criteria for body searches, said the courts can review individual cases, and declined to revise the policy ahead of the forthcoming bill.
Whether body searches in individual cases were lawfully applied can be reviewed by the judge on the basis of the concrete circumstances of the case.
Of het onderzoek aan het lichaam in individuele gevallen rechtmatig is toegepast kan door de rechter worden getoetst aan de hand van de concrete omstandigheden van het geval.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Schouw en Voordewind over uitzettingen van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, D66 and ChristenUnie asked about cooperation between the Guinean embassy in Brussels and the Guinean taskforce in the Netherlands on deportations, why a May 2013 taskforce was postponed, and whether there is a dispute between them. The state secretary answered that presentations are coordinated with both channels, that the postponement was due to unspecified Guinean reasons, that he knows of no dispute, and that about 100 travel documents were issued in 2012 with roughly a third of those returned, with no reason to suspend deportations.
I am not aware of any disagreement between the Guinean taskforce and the Guinean government.
Van onenigheid tussen de Guineese taskforce en de Guineese overheid is mij niets bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat 20 procent van de illegalen medische zorg wordt geweigerd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a report that one in five undocumented migrants was refused medical care in 2012, and whether the Gesthuizen motion had been implemented. The State Secretary replied that a letter on care for undocumented migrants would be sent shortly by the health minister, which would also report on implementing the motion.
The minister of Health, Welfare and Sport will inform the House about the implementation of the aforementioned motion in the earlier-mentioned letter.
Bij eerder genoemde brief van de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport wordt uw Kamer bericht over de uitvoering van voornoemde motie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Oosenbrug over het bericht dat in vergelijking met andere Europese landen het mobiele dataverkeer in Nederland het duurst is

MPs Gesthuizen and Oosenbrug asked whether mobile data prices in the Netherlands, reportedly the highest in Europe, indicate an insufficiently functioning market and what the minister will do about it. Minister Kamp disagrees that the market is failing, citing the report's narrow focus on premium data-only plans and difficulties in international comparison, but promises to study how to make a more meaningful price comparison and report in autumn.
I will investigate how we can arrive at a more meaningful international comparison of mobile telecommunications tariffs and will inform you of the outcomes of such a comparison this autumn.

Ik ga onderzoeken hoe we tot een betekenisvollere internationale vergelijking kunnen komen van mobiele telecommunicatietarieven en zal u over de uitkomsten van zo'n vergelijking dit najaar informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat PostNL mensen met een arbeidshandicap aan een baan gaat helpen als postbezorger

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked why PostNL, after reducing jobs for employees with disabilities, now plans to employ people with work disabilities as postal deliverers, and whether this replaces costlier staff. The government answered that PostNL denies disadvantaging disabled staff, that the job cuts stem from market changes, and that it sees no evidence of replacing employees with cheaper workers.
I have no indications that PostNL found its own employees with disabilities too expensive and is now replacing them with cheaper workers with disabilities.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat PostNL de eigen medewerkers met een beperking te duur vond en deze nu vervangt door goedkopere werknemers met een beperking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Gesthuizen over een humaan asielbeleid

MPs Schouw (D66) and Gesthuizen (SP) asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about a more humane asylum policy, covering the wider policy direction, the return policy and the ground-for-no-fault criterion, criminalisation of illegal stay and aid to illegal migrants, the illegals quota for police, and conditions and numbers in immigration detention. The state secretary answered that the current policy leaves room for humane treatment, pointed to planned reviews, the forthcoming bill on criminalising illegal stay, and reduced detention capacity plans, while declining to discuss an illegals quota.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over zelfmoordpogingen in grensdetentie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about two suicide attempts in border detention and how psychiatric care, lawyer notification, isolation and Dublin cases are handled. The State Secretary answered that standard medical intake and crisis procedures were followed, that lawyers are not automatically informed, and that he will send a future vision on alternatives to detention before the summer recess.
An attempted suicide in border detention on 14 March 2013 is not known to me.
Een poging tot suïcide in grensdetentie op 14 maart 2013 is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Voortman en Voordewind over de uitzetting van een ernstig zieke vreemdeling

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why a seriously ill Togolese former unaccompanied minor, resident over eleven years, faces deportation, why the state appealed a court ruling in his favour, and whether the discretionary power should be used. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, restated the medical-stay procedure and the general policy framework, and said rootedness is not an objective criterion.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, vind ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de overheid laks is geweest na een aanval door een botnet

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security minister why the government reacted poorly after a botnet attack, why police did not pursue the case further, and whether the NCSC could use stolen data to alert operators of critical infrastructure. The minister replied that the NCSC acted within its existing powers, alerted 16 organisations whose IP ranges matched, lacked a legal basis to use the stolen data fully, and promised a review of its tasks and powers.
The NCSC could not, under its existing tasks and powers, receive the information and has no legal basis to do so.
Het NCSC kon op grond van haar bestaande taken en bevoegdheden de informatie niet in ontvangst nemen en heeft daar ook geen rechtsbasis voor.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een Syrische familie wordt uitgezet naar Polen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a Syrian family would be deported to Poland, citing reported poor reception conditions and possible violations of the Return Directive, and asked whether the Dublin transfer would be reconsidered. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, stated that Dublin transfers are barred where Article 3 ECHR or Article 4 of the EU Charter would be breached, and said the government is not responsible for checking other member states' compliance with EU law.

As I indicated in my answers to the questions of MP Maij, a transfer to a member state may not take place if the foreign national would be subjected to inhuman or degrading treatment within the meaning of Article 3 ECHR or Article 4 of the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights.

Zoals ik in mijn antwoorden op de vragen van het lid Maij heb aangegeven, mag een overdracht naar een lidstaat niet plaatsvinden indien de vreemdeling in die lidstaat onmenselijk of vernederend wordt behandeld in de zin van artikel 3 EVRM of artikel 4 van het Handvest van de Grondrechten van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de vrijheid van telecombedrijven bij het aanbieden en in rekening brengen van mobiel dataverkeer

An MP asked the economic affairs minister how consumers can be protected from unexpectedly high mobile data bills, including blocked-data subscribers still being charged and the lack of insight into data use. The minister said providers bear primary responsibility, pointed to a 2012 transparency code and existing alerts and dispute-committee routes, and declined to commit to new legislation.
I consider it first and foremost the responsibility of the providers to properly inform consumers about their products and services.
Ik vind het allereerst de verantwoordelijkheid van de aanbieders om consumenten goed te informeren over hun producten en diensten.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat Post NL mensen met een arbeidshandicap aan een baan gaat helpen als postbezorger

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked whether PostNL's plan to employ about 500 people with work disabilities as part-time postal deliverers, via secondment from sheltered workshops or social assistance, risks displacing regular workers and serving as cheap labour. The state secretary called the initiative positive, said PostNL reports no displacement, and said no indications of exploitation exist, while declining to cancel planned cuts to sheltered workshops.
I currently have no indications that there is any displacement or exploitation.
Ik heb thans geen aanwijzingen dat er sprake is van verdringing en uitbuiting.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse autoriteiten onderzoek doen naar de mogelijke corruptie bij Microsoft

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they know of Microsoft bribing or approaching Dutch officials for software contracts, whether they contacted foreign authorities, and what influence Microsoft had on the NOiV open-standards programme. The minister answered that no bribery is known, that contact between officials and companies is normal, that no information was sought abroad given the ongoing US inquiry, and that Microsoft did not sign the open-standards manifesto.
I am not aware of any bribery.
Van omkoping is mij niets bekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over het bericht ‘FBI-agenten hacken mee met de Nederlandse politie’ en de detentieomstandigheden van de Nederlander in de Verenigde Staten

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked the Justice Minister about reports that FBI agents work embedded in Dutch police cybercrime units and about the detention of Dutch national David S. in the US, including whether Dutch authorities were informed of his arrest in Romania and whether his transfer back to the Netherlands can be expedited. The minister answered that the Netherlands had no role in the arrest, that no investigative acts took place on Dutch soil without consent, that a liaison officer's role is governed by Dutch law, and that he is willing to contact US authorities to speed up a transfer request once the sentence is final.
I am willing to contact the American authorities in this case to expedite the procedure where possible.
Ik ben bereid in deze zaak met de Amerikaanse autoriteiten contact op te nemen om zo mogelijk de procedure te bespoedigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Wit, Gesthuizen en Kooiman over het bericht dat het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie slecht samenwerkt met de Nationale ombudsman

SP MPs De Wit, Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice to respond to press reports that the ministry cooperates poorly with the National Ombudsman, whose criticism described it as immune to criticism and hard to work with. Minister Opstelten answered that he takes the criticism note of, responds to all requests, follows most recommendations, holds consultations where he does not adopt one, and will consult the ombudsman more often and improve deadline monitoring.
I answer all requests from the ombudsman.
Ik geef op alle verzoeken van de ombudsman antwoord.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat internetoplichting voortaan een zaak voor de civiele rechter zou zijn

MP Gesthuizen asked whether a Supreme Court ruling means internet fraud where payment is taken but goods are not delivered can no longer be prosecuted as embezzlement, and whether it should instead be treated as a civil matter. Minister Opstelten answered that embezzlement no longer applies but fraud (oplichting) may still apply in some cases, and that he will consult the Public Prosecution Service on whether new criminal options are needed.
Following the ruling, I will consult with the Public Prosecution Service to examine whether, and if so how, new criminal law options should be created.
Ik zal naar aanleiding van het arrest in overleg met het Openbaar Ministerie bezien of, en zo ja op welke wijze, nieuwe strafrechtelijk mogelijkheden gecreëerd moeten worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen en Schouw over het bericht dat circa 100 huizen van Pakistaanse christenen zijn verbrand vanwege vermeende belediging van Mohammed

Four MPs asked the state secretary whether the Pakistani government adequately protects Christian minorities after about 100 homes were burned over an alleged blasphemy case, and why Christians are not classed as a risk group for asylum purposes. The state secretary answered that Pakistani authorities often fail to protect and prosecute perpetrators, that no reliable data on 2012 incidents exists, and that after considering the Lahore incident he still does not consider Pakistani Christians a risk group.
No, there is no reliable information available on this.
Nee, er is hierover geen betrouwbare informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (IND) op non-actief zijn gezet

Two SP MPs asked why the IND suspended two Chinese-speaking interpreters suspected of leaking information to Chinese authorities about Uyghurs in the Netherlands, how interpreters are screened, and what the consequences are. The government answered that an AIVD warning concerned these individuals only, that screening rules apply, that about 1,000 case files used these interpreters with 75 percent granted asylum, and that the Minister of Foreign Affairs asked China for clarification.
In about 75 percent of these files asylum protection was granted.
In ongeveer 75 procent van deze dossiers is asielbescherming toegekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een Afghaanse vreemdeling die in Nederland een 1F-status heeft toch een vergunning krijgt in België

MP Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary about reports that an Afghan person suspected of war crimes under article 1F received a residence permit in Belgium after years of failed proceedings in the Netherlands, and whether Dutch 1F policy should be revised. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case in detail, explained that Belgium granted a residence card on EU family-link grounds outside Dutch responsibility, rejected the call to revise the policy, and gave statistics on 1F investigations and rejections.
The issuing of residence cards by Belgium does not fall under my responsibility.
De afgifte van verblijfskaarten door België valt niet onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Irak niets doet voor teruggekeerde landgenoten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Iraq does nothing for returnees, whether voluntary return is therefore not an option, what became of the offer of 5.5 million euro for reintegration, and whether talks were under way after reports that the Netherlands would refuse 15,000 Iraqis. The State Secretary disputed the characterisation, described the reintegration support available to returnees and the still-open 5.5 million euro offer, and said the reports misrepresented a meeting in Baghdad and the number of voluntary returns.
No, this report is not correct.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over een incident met een inwoner van detentiecentrum Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about an incident at the Rotterdam detention centre in which a detainee lost a finger in a cell door, whether guards had closed the door on his hand, whether detainees were placed in isolation afterwards, and whether the Inspectorate was notified. The State Secretary answered that the detainee had behaved aggressively, that a supervisor and the detainee both pulled the door so the hand was caught, that all residents were temporarily locked in with three disciplined for refusing, and that the Inspectorate saw no reason to investigate.
The inspectorate reported that it sees no reason to launch an investigation.
De inspectie heeft gemeld dat zij geen aanleiding ziet om een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het publiceren van 112-meldingen op internet

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about websites publishing 112 emergency call details, including addresses of callers or incidents, and how this fits with privacy and the legal basis. The minister said the Police Act 2012 permits sharing incident data where serious privacy intrusion is absent, that a guideline is coming in early 2013, that encrypted P2000 messaging will end scanning, and that he will consult journalists' association on agreements.
I share your concerns about the publication of privacy-sensitive data on the internet.
Ik deel uw zorgen over de publicatie van privacy gevoelige gegevens op internet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat geen van de tien grootste levensmiddelenconcerns uitblinkt in milieu en mensvriendelijkheid

Two SP MPs asked the minister whether it is unacceptable that major food companies sell products linked to serious social and environmental harm, whether consumers are misled by CSR claims, and how transparency on land deals will be promoted. The minister answered that companies should improve along OECD guidelines, that CSR claims must be verifiable, and that the Netherlands supports transparency initiatives such as the Land Matrix and an EU working group, without committing to new binding measures.
The cabinet is of the view that we may ask companies to commit to realising that improvement.
Het kabinet is van mening dat we van bedrijven mogen vragen dat zij zich inzetten om die verbetering te realiseren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de klacht van de kerken tegen Nederland over het vreemdelingenbeleid

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the State Secretary whether the government would respond to a complaint by churches to the European Committee of Social Rights that the Netherlands treats undocumented migrants in breach of the European Social Charter, and whether it would act before the Committee's ruling. The State Secretary answered that the complaint had only been received for information, that the Committee would decide in March whether to request a government response, and that he would not comment on the merits or anticipate the Committee's decision.
In view of this, I do not consider it appropriate at this stage to go into the merits of the complaint or to anticipate a decision of the Committee.
Gelet daarop acht ik het niet juist in dit stadium in te gaan op de merites van de klacht of om op een beslissing van het Comité vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over de beveiliging van de website van het UWV

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt asked about an expired security certificate on the UWV complaints webpage, its risks, whether data was intercepted, and UWV's security policy. Minister Asscher answered that the outdated certificate was in use from 21 January to 1 February 2013, was fixed once discovered, that no misuse or intrusion was found, and that UWV's security measures are regularly audited.
Unfortunately, the outdated certificate was mistakenly used in that process.
Helaas is daarbij abusievelijk het verouderde certificaat gehanteerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aangifte wegens valsheid in geschrifte in een strafzaak tegen het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about a criminal case in which a terrorism suspicion was added to the charges only after months, whether oil bunkering in Nigeria can be prosecuted in the Netherlands, and whether the prosecution relied on Nigerian intelligence. The minister confirmed the terrorism element was later dropped, that bunkering is not a listed terrorist offence, that prosecution of such acts abroad is a matter of international cooperation, and declined to say whether intelligence from Nigeria was used due to the ongoing investigation.
No statements are made about the possible cooperation of the Public Prosecution Service with intelligence services.
Over de mogelijke samenwerking van het Openbaar Ministerie met inlichtingendiensten worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over het bericht dat Nederland laks is in de bestrijding van corruptie

Two SP MPs asked the government how it can tolerate that 14 of 22 signalled foreign bribery cases were never investigated and none led to conviction, and what it will do about it. The minister replied that the OECD evaluation is part of three pending reviews, that an integrated policy response is due in autumn 2013, that a new prosecution guideline was adopted, 150 extra FIOD investigators are being recruited, and several legislative and prosecution measures are underway, but gave no firm timetable for the OECD-recommended legislative changes.

The cabinet letter presenting the OECD report stated that the cabinet aims to present an integrated policy response on Dutch anti-corruption efforts to the House after the three evaluations are complete.

In de Kamerbrief ter aanbieding van het OESO-rapport 2 is aangegeven dat het kabinet ernaar streeft om na afloop van de drie evaluaties een integrale beleidsreactie over de Nederlandse corruptiebestrijding aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de cookiemuur van de Publieke Omroep niet rechtsgeldig is

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked the government how it would respond to the CBP's criticism of the public broadcaster NPO's cookie wall, which denies access to sites for users who refuse tracking cookies, and what steps it would take. The state secretary said OPTA and the CBP are responsible for enforcement, that the government will consult the NPO within a month on alternatives, and that tracking cookies are not needed for basic site functions.
It is up to OPTA to judge the lawfulness of the NPO's conduct in light of the cookie provision.
Het is dus aan OPTA om een oordeel te vellen over de rechtmatigheid van de handelwijze van de NPO in het licht van de cookiebepaling.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het bericht van het lekken van gevoelige informatie door 50.000 harddisks en scanners

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responds to a broadcast showing tens of thousands of internet-accessible hard drives, scanners and printers with weak security, and whether producers should build in security or inform consumers. The minister said users and businesses bear primary responsibility, pointed to NCSC guidance, the DigiVeilig programme and a website for businesses, and noted that suppliers should also take responsibility, with the Economic Affairs ministry exploring a security standard and certification for software.
That is and remains primarily a responsibility of businesses and consumers themselves.
Dat is en blijft primair een verantwoordelijkheid voor bedrijven en consumenten zelf.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Ojik en Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid in de katoensector in Turkije

MPs Voordewind, Van Ojik and Gesthuizen asked the ministers about child labour in Turkey's cotton sector, including unconditioned state price-support subsidies and Dutch clothing retailers selling products made with child labour. Minister Ploumen answered that Turkey is primarily responsible, that she raised ILO cooperation with Turkish authorities, and that she will support a textile-sector action plan on supply-chain transparency and ending child labour, expected mid-2013.
I am willing to play an active role in supporting the textile sector in fulfilling its supply-chain responsibility.
Ik ben bereid een actieve rol te spelen om de textielsector te ondersteunen bij het invullen van hun ketenverantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Tongeren, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about reports that Somali asylum seekers whose applications were rejected were put back on the street after leaving a tent camp in Amsterdam, and whether this could have been avoided under the earlier motion and the Bestuursakkoord; they also asked how this squares with a Raad van State ruling on detention and how many Somalis had returned voluntarily. The state secretary answered that about 50 were sent away, that only a shelter conditional on cooperating with return was offered and not taken up, that conditional shelter remains policy, and that about 25 Somalis returned voluntarily since 2010, with forced return to all of Somalia now possible again.
I am willing to offer shelter to these foreigners, on condition that they cooperate with return.
Ik ben bereid om onderdak te bieden aan deze vreemdelingen, onder de voorwaarde dat wordt meegewerkt aan terugkeer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks, D66 and 50PLUS asked whether most residents of the former Amsterdam tent camp were put on the street on 30 November, whether this is responsible in winter, and whether it could have been prevented under the Gesthuizen motion and the 2007 agreement with the VNG. The State Secretary answered that most were sent away after arrest, that the alternative shelter required cooperation with return, and that he sees no need for structural emergency shelter by municipalities.
It is true that the majority of the foreigners were sent away after their arrest.
Het klopt dat het merendeel van de vreemdelingen na hun aanhouding is heengezonden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het advies van de federatie Goud en Zilver aan juweliers om geen gebruik meer te maken van de pakketdienst van PostNL

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Federation Goud en Zilver advised jewellers to stop using PostNL parcel delivery after parcels went missing, and about PostNL's handling of complaints and subcontracted delivery workload. The minister replied that the federation only advised using better-secured parcel services, that complaint volumes showed no clear increase, that PostNL is liable only in limited cases, and that he will monitor complaints linked to PostNL's reorganisation.
I committed during the Voortgezet Algemeen Overleg of 28 November 2012 to monitor the complaints arising from the reorganisation and to provide an analysis.
Ik heb tijdens het Voortgezet Algemeen Overleg van 28 november 2012 toegezegd de klachten naar aanleiding van de reorganisatie te volgen en van een analyse te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw c.s. over de zaak Van Rey - Weekers

Opposition and coalition MPs ask the State Secretary for Finance about the Van Rey–Weekers affair: a billboard donation, the sale of a tax office and a tax request involving real estate. They press on the nature and financing of the donation, contacts about closing tax offices, and handling of a personal tax request. The item is a bundle of written questions; the answers are not included in the text provided.
Have you verified that the donation was indeed made only by Mr Van Rey and, as agreed, processed via the regional campaign fund? Can you make the accounts public?

Heeft u zich ervan vergewist dat de donatie inderdaad alleen door de heer Van Rey is gedaan en, zoals afgesproken, via de regionale campagnekas is afgehandeld? Kunt u de rekeningen hiervan openbaar maken?
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over het gebruik van cookies door de NPO

Two SP MPs asked whether agreements with the ministry oblige the NPO to obtain consent for cookies on its websites and to explain which functions require them, and whether cookie data is shared with third parties. The state secretary replied that the NPO uses functional, analytic, advertising and social media cookies, that consent is sought except for functional cookies, that data is anonymised and not passed to third parties, and that some social media trackers are controlled by those providers.
As promised at the Telecommunications General Consultation of 21 November, it is currently being examined whether, and under what conditions, analytic cookies can be regarded as necessary cookies.

Zoals bij het Algemeen Overleg Telecommunicatie van 21 november jongstleden is toegezegd wordt momenteel onderzocht of, en zo ja onder welke voorwaarden, analytische cookies kunnen worden beschouwd als noodzakelijk cookies
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over een Amerikaanse waarschuwing voor Chinese telecombedrijven

SP MPs Van Bommel and Gesthuizen asked whether the Netherlands would act on a US warning that Chinese telecom firms Huawei and ZTE pose a security risk and may pass information to China, and what Dutch authorities do about it. The government replied that the public part of the US report gives no reason to change its stance, that the non-public part has not yet been received, that Huawei and ZTE are active in the Netherlands, that no Chinese espionage via this equipment has been established, and that no further US cooperation is currently needed.
We do not yet have access to the non-public part of the report and therefore cannot yet assess the conclusions from it, or their underpinning.
Wij hebben op dit moment nog niet de beschikking over het niet-openbare gedeelte van het rapport en kunnen de conclusies daaruit – en de onderbouwing daarvan – dus nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Thieme, Gesthuizen, Krol, Maij, Mulder en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de productie van schoenen door grote ketens

MPs asked the government whether shoe companies using child labour in their supply chains should be held to account, excluded from state support and trade missions, and whether embassies and public procurement could be used to address it. The minister answered that due diligence duties under the OECD guidelines apply, that no shoe companies receive state support or joined trade missions, and that embassies raise labour standards where possible, while procurement social conditions already apply.
No, there are no shoe companies currently receiving government support or having previously joined trade missions.
Nee, er zijn geen schoenenbedrijven die momenteel overheidssteun ontvangen of in het verleden mee zijn geweest met handelsmissies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het waarborgen van een effectieve bestrijding van faillissementsfraude

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about insufficient capacity at the FIOD and police to tackle bankruptcy fraud, proposed dedicated police units, and urged criminalising absence of proper bookkeeping in bankruptcy and a professional ban for fraudsters. The minister answered that a letter of 27 November outlines concrete actions on expertise, capacity and detection, a broader revision of bankruptcy criminal law including inadequate administration, and a civil-law administrative ban.
In the letter sent to your House on 27 November I addressed strengthening the role of criminal law in combating bankruptcy fraud in practice.
In de brief die op 27 november aan uw Kamer is gestuurd ben ik ingegaan op de versterking van de rol van het strafrecht bij bestrijding van faillissementsfraude in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het wegebben van steun van kennisinstellingen en bedrijfsleven aan het innovatiebeleid van het ministerie

An SP MP asks the Economics Minister whether declining support from knowledge institutions and business for the ministry's innovation policy, and a planned EUR 110 million cut, threaten the innovation agenda. The minister answers that the stimulus funding was temporary, that the top-sector policy is being made structural, and that private R&D is expected to rise, while detailed budget breakdowns will follow later.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Dijksma en Grashoff over het bericht dat de fouten bij de bouw van een detentiecentrum ruim 13 miljoen euro hebben gekost

MPs Gesthuizen, Dijksma and Grashoff asked the state secretary about reports that construction faults at the Alphen aan den Rijn detention centre cost taxpayers 13.1 million euro, and whether the government knew of leaks and fire-safety problems from 2009 and misinformed parliament. The minister replies that the actual cost to the state was 8.8 million euro with the rest used for upgrades, that the fire-safety study found the cells compliant, that the closure was due to electrical defects and inspections rather than an unsafe situation, and that the building cost stayed within budget.
The repair did not cost the state 13.1 million euro but 8.8 million euro (2/3 of 13.1 million euro).
Het herstel heeft het Rijk geen € 13,1 miljoen gekost maar € 8,8 miljoen (2/3 van € 13,1 miljoen).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de toegang van de VS tot data in de cloud

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked whether the US access to cloud-stored data of Dutch users, including protected data, is a problem and whether the government will advise against cloud use and consult US and EU counterparts. The state secretary replied that the risk is known, that responsibility lies primarily with data controllers, that no advice against cloud use is needed, and that the issue is being raised in EU negotiations on the data protection regulation.
I consider this an undesirable situation. This problem is known within the European Union, and the proposal for a General Data Protection Regulation seeks to offer a solution.
Ik acht dit een onwenselijke situatie. Dit probleem is bij de Europese Unie bekend, en het voorstel voor een Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming poogt daarvoor een oplossing aan te reiken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de huis-aan-huis-verkooppraktijken voor ‘goede doelen’

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether companies selling door-to-door cards for supposed charities must disclose recipients and the share actually donated, whether municipalities check and regulate these sellers, and whether the government will act against Care Promotions. The state secretary answered that disclosure is not mandatory, that municipalities license such sellers with CBF advice and conditions, that consumers rely on signals and public licence lists, and that the Consumer Authority may act under unfair trading rules.
Municipalities can, under the local general bylaws (APV), require a permit for anyone who collects money or goods door-to-door.
Gemeenten kunnen op basis van de (plaatselijke) APV een vergunning verplicht stellen voor iedereen die huis-aan-huis geld of goederen inzamelt
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Thieme over vrijheidsbeperking

Six MPs asked the minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether a Hague court ruling requiring individual proportionality for restricting the liberty of rejected asylum-seeking families with children should lead to halting transfers to family locations and to a rethink of shelter provided under liberty restrictions after a Supreme Court ruling on children's rights. The minister replied that the ruling concerns one case with a lack of reasoning and draws no general conclusions, that transfers are handled with care pending government formation, and that the Supreme Court ruling does not conflict with the liberty-restriction measure, which serves public order and availability for departure.
In this individual case the court concluded that insufficient reasons were given for imposing a liberty-restricting measure.
In deze individuele zaak is door de rechter geconcludeerd dat onvoldoende was gemotiveerd waarom een vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Albert Heijn een betalingskorting oplegt aan haar leveranciers

An MP asked the ministers whether Albert Heijn's imposed two-point payment discount on suppliers is lawful, what role the government sees for itself in curbing abuse of purchasing power, and whether the NMa should supervise purchasing power preventively. The minister replied that the relationship is private law between firms, that Albert Heijn suspended the discount, that the ministry is facilitating a code of fair trading practices, and that studies on enforcement of the abuse-of-dominance ban and on existing law are forthcoming.
However, I also note that in practice it is difficult to demonstrate abuse of an economic dominant position.
Ik constateer echter ook dat het in de praktijk lastig is om misbruik van een economische machtspositie aan te tonen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen aangaande de falende postbezorging van PostNL

An SP MP asked the state secretary about persistent postal delivery failures at PostNL, including complaints about held-back mail, whether PostNL still meets the Universal Postal Service delivery norm, and whether staffing problems explain the decline. The state secretary replied that OPTA found no evidence of deliberate withholding on Mondays, that OPTA will assess compliance with the 95% next-day norm for 2012 by mid-2013, and that PostNL suspended its reorganisation until at least 2013 and is preparing an improvement plan.
OPTA assesses annually whether PostNL meets the norm.
OPTA beoordeelt jaarlijks of PostNL aan de norm voldoet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de gevaren van het spionagevirus Flame voor Nederland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Flame spy virus had infected Dutch systems and what research and steps were planned. The minister answered that eight Dutch IP addresses do not mean eight infected computers, that there are no current indications of Dutch infections, and that the intelligence services are already investigating and will inform parliament if warranted.
If the investigation by the intelligence and security services gives cause for it, the House of Representatives will be informed via the appropriate channels.
Indien het onderzoek van de I&V-diensten hier aanleiding toe geeft dan zal de Tweede Kamer hierover geïnformeerd worden via de geëigende kanalen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, en Schouw over het uitzetten van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration whether deportations of rejected asylum seekers to Guinea rely on corrupt authorities, how travel-document delegations and payments work, and whether a specific mother and children case and related investigations will be addressed. The minister answered that cooperation is necessary but structured via MoUs and delegations from Guinean ministries, that payments follow standard return practice, and that deportations will not be suspended, with the family case to be reported by end 2012.
Your House will be informed further about the family concerned before the end of 2012.
Uw Kamer wordt over het betreffende gezin voor het eind van 2012 nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het uitzetten van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

An SP MP asked whether a corruption complaint against the Dutch return service (DT&V) was dropped because prosecutors cannot act against ministers without a royal decree or parliamentary decision, and whether the minister's claim that the case had been investigated was accurate. The minister confirmed that the Public Prosecution Service declined the complaint on jurisdictional grounds and stated that the case had only been examined in that narrow sense, while promising to look at the individual case further.
Moreover, I indicated to you during the oral question hour that I will examine the individual case in question.
Daarnaast heb ik u in het mondelinge vragenuur aangegeven dat ik de genoemde individuele zaak zal bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat prijzen van Nederlandse verblijfsvergunningen te hoog zijn

An MP asked the immigration minister how he would respond to a Council of State ruling that Dutch fees for residence permits for family reunification are too high, and whether he would cut them from EUR 1250 to EUR 130. The minister answered that the ruling will require lower fees, that the decision on the new fee level is left to the next cabinet because of a EUR 19.2 million annual revenue loss, and that excess fees will be refunded.
The ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State will have to lead to a reduction of the fees for applications for residence permits for family reunification.
De uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State zal moeten leiden tot een verlaging van de leges voor de aanvragen voor verblijfsvergunningen ten behoeve van gezinshereniging.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat asielkinderen niet op straat mogen komen te staan

The SP MP Gesthuizen asked the Minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum how the government would respond to a Supreme Court ruling that minor asylum children may not be put on the street, and why the Netherlands had not followed earlier findings by the European Committee of Social Rights on housing for undocumented children. The minister answered that Article 31(2) of the European Social Charter does not cover children residing illegally, that the Netherlands is not in breach, that the ruling is being implemented, and that no families are currently being put on the street and there is sufficient family shelter capacity.
I informed your House on 24 October 2012 about the significance of the Supreme Court ruling and how I will implement this ruling.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 24 oktober 2012 geïnformeerd over de betekenis van het arrest van de Hoge Raad en de wijze waarop ik uitvoering zal geven aan dit arrest.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de verzekeringsmaatschappij van DigiNotar niet meewerkt aan verzoek van de curator

An SP MP asked whether the insurer of bankrupt DigiNotar refusing the curator's request for policy documents should be met with legal action, and whether the minister would intervene. The minister replied that the report was misquoted, the insurer had sent the file, the curator has ample statutory powers including court orders, and he has neither the power nor need to intervene in a specific bankruptcy.
I have neither the power nor the need to interfere in a specific bankruptcy.
Ik heb noch de bevoegdheid noch de behoefte om mij in een specifiek faillissement te mengen.

Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de wijziging van de Regeling Wet werk en bijstand (WWB) in verband met de vrijlating van de vergoeding aan slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik in de Rooms-katholieke Kerk

An SP MP asked whether the WWB Regulation was changed in July 2012 to exempt compensation for victims of abuse in the Roman Catholic Church from the means test, why this is not reflected in public information, and how recipients will be protected if municipalities are unaware. The State Secretary denied any change to the central regulation, explained that municipalities already can exclude such compensation case by case, and promised to inform municipalities via a letter.
The WWB gives the municipality the option to assess case by case whether, and to what extent, the compensation is counted in the means test of the WWB.
De WWB biedt de gemeente de mogelijkheid om per individueel geval te beoordelen of en zo ja in welke mate de schadevergoeding wordt meegenomen in de middelentoets van de WWB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over de uitgezette Libiër A.F.

MPs Van Bommel and Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Immigration about the 2004 expulsion of Libyan Abu Farsan to Sudan, his alleged rendition to Libya, the role of the CIA and MI6, and whether an independent Dutch investigation will be held following Human Rights Watch's findings. The government's answer, sent confidentially to MPs, was delivered by Minister Leers on behalf of both ministers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de slachtoffer-dadergesprekken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the low uptake of victim-offender conversations, the sharing of personal data by police and the Public Prosecution Service with the organisation Slachtoffer in Beeld, and whether the government would act on a motion. The State Secretary replied that case numbers are rising, that prisons and probation are being engaged, and that data-sharing with police is still under review, with results expected in October 2012.
I am currently having it investigated whether there are legal obstacles.
Ik laat op dit moment uitzoeken of er juridische belemmeringen zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman over slachtoffers van internetoplichting die in de kou blijven staan

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about victims of internet fraud left unprotected, including police capacity, the role of marketplace sites and banks, and reversing payments. The minister says the Meldpunt Internetoplichting and the Fraudehelpdesk have improved the approach, that consumers must act cautiously, and that banks decide on action themselves.
A lot has been invested in improving the approach to fraud via auction and sales sites.
Er is veel geïnvesteerd om de aanpak van oplichting via veiling- en verkoopsites te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Braakhuis, Voordewind en Gesthuizen over ketentransparantie, kinderarbeid en uitbuiting in de kledingindustrie

MPs from GroenLinks, ChristenUnie and SP asked the government about implementing a motion on full supply-chain transparency and ending child labour in the garment sector, including IMVO policy, EU action and India/Bangladesh cases. The government answered that talks with textile industry associations continue, that a national action plan on business and human rights will come around the new year, and that it is primarily up to the industry to set feasible transparency commitments.
The cabinet expects internationally active companies to comply with the OECD Guidelines.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven die internationaal actief zijn dat zij de OESO Richtlijnen naleven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de vele kwaadaardige websites die in Nederland worden gehost

MPs Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Dutch servers host a large share of malicious websites, and whether Dutch policy on hosting providers and rogue ISPs is adequate and enforced. The minister disputes the reported figures as inconsistent, says Dutch cybercrime enforcement is strong, promises to put enforcement on the Platform Internetveiligheid agenda, and states that the NCSC is not a supervisor and imposes no sanctions.
The NCSC is not a supervisor and therefore imposes no sanctions.
Het NCSC is geen toezichthouder en legt daarmee geen sancties op.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over dubieuze faillissementen en doorstarters in de transportsector

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked ministers about bankruptcy fraud and abusive re-startups in the transport sector, including whether curators' criminal complaints and Dutch-German cross-border transport permits are adequately handled. The ministers answered that an integrated anti-fraud approach is underway, an analysis of bankruptcy fraud is being prepared, and Dutch and German authorities have strengthened cooperation on transport licences, but they declined to add further measures or meet with the unions and foundation.

In addition to this report, I can inform your House that an analysis of bankruptcy fraud is being drawn up, on the basis of which the information position and cooperation in the chain can be further strengthened.

In aanvulling op deze rapportage kan ik uw Kamer melden dat er een analyse faillissementsfraude wordt opgesteld op basis waarvan de informatiepositie en de samenwerking in de keten verder kan worden versterkt.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen, Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het stopzetten van de behandeling van alle verblijfsaanvragen door Iraanse vreemdelingen

MPs asked whether the IND had stopped processing residence applications from Iranian students and nationals, and whether this amounted to discrimination. The minister answered that applications are decided, but students in restricted fields need a ministry exemption under UN resolution 1737 and EU regulation 267/2012, and that some applications for work were temporarily held before resuming processing.
It is a misunderstanding that the IND does not process applications from Iranian students.
Het is een misverstand dat de IND geen aanvragen van Iraanse studenten in behandeling neemt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bestoken van ondernemers met spooknota’s

An SP MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers why fake invoices (spooknota's) causing an estimated 400 million euro in losses to businesses are not clearly criminalised, and how many fraudsters have been convicted. The minister answered that sending such invoices rarely constitutes a criminal offence because the victim usually consented to the contract, that a Criminal Code change is not the right tool, that prevention is the focus, and that the prosecution service cannot separate these cases from broader data.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over het asielbeleid voor Somaliërs

MPs Van Bommel and Gesthuizen asked the minister how the Council of State ruling on asylum for Somalis affects long-resident Somalis at risk from Al-Shabaab, and whether they should be exempt from return and given shelter.
