The minister said the ruling is applied by testing whether Somalis from south/central Somalia have lived under Al-Shabaab rules, rejected the claim that Somalis cannot return through no fault of their own, and refused a standard non-fault procedure or shelter, while noting that new asylum applications are possible.
Of course I will give effect to the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State (the Division).
Uiteraard geef ik invulling aan de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State (de Afdeling).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat vreemdelingen ten onrechte vastzitten op Schiphol

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the minister whether detention of refused-entry foreigners at Schiphol is unlawful and what follow-up would be taken, and whether these detainees would be included in alternatives-to-detention research. The minister disagreed that the detention is unlawful, pointing to article 6 of the Aliens Act and a temporary AMvB based on a Council of State ruling, and said this group is not part of the alternatives pilots.
I disagree with the claim made in the article that foreigners refused entry at the border are detained unlawfully.
Ik ben het oneens met de in het artikel bepleitte stelling dat grensgeweigerde vreemdelingen onrechtmatig gedetineerd zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi, Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Dijksma, Thieme, Schouw over het bericht 'Syrische asielzoekers eisen duidelijkheid'

Six MPs asked the minister about a report that Syrian asylum seekers demanded clarity on their status, including whether group-wide protection under the Qualification Directive applies and how hunger strikes could be prevented. The minister replied that a 3 August letter sets out the policy, that individual assessment remains the starting point, and that Syrians not shown to be active supporters of the regime may receive temporary asylum residence permits under the Aliens Act.
On 3 August I informed your House about how I have shaped the country-based asylum policy regarding Syria.
Op 3 augustus jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de wijze waarop ik het landgebonden asielbeleid ten aanzien van Syrië heb vormgegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg Gesthuizen en Bouwmeester inzake de opsplitsting cq. verplaatsing van het Pieter Baan Centrum

MPs Van Toorenburg, Gesthuizen and Bouwmeester asked whether the government would fully inform parliament about plans to split up or relocate the Pieter Baan Centrum, a forensic psychiatric observation institute, after press reports and without debate on the matter. Minister Opstelten answered that the building is outdated and the funds for renovation are lacking, so a relocation to Almere is planned for 2013 with decentralised observation places, and that the move was not discussed in the June debate because there were no new developments beyond earlier letters to parliament.
As I also indicated in answering questions from MP Van der Steur (VVD), the Netherlands Institute for Forensic Psychiatry and Psychology (NIFP) is continuously working to improve quality.

Zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in de beantwoording van de vragen ( 2012Z14241 ) van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) werkt het Nederlands Instituut voor Forensische Psychiatrie en Psychologie (NIFP) voortdurend aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de waarschuwing van het Industrial Control System Cyber Emergency Response Team

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the government responded to a US ICS-CERT warning about vulnerabilities in Siemens SCADA/ICS software, and whether Dutch operators had applied the recommended protections. The state secretary called the warning valuable, said it is unknown whether and how widely these Siemens products are used in the Netherlands, pointed to NCSC factsheets and checklists, and noted that organisations are primarily responsible while sectoral regulators supervise vital sectors.
It is not known whether, or to what extent, the SCADA and ICS-related Siemens web and software applications mentioned are used in the Netherlands.
Het is niet bekend of en in welke mate er in Nederland gebruik wordt gemaakt van de genoemde SCADA en ICS gerelateerde web- en software applicaties van Siemens.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het deskundigenregister

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that the forensic expert register (NRGD) lacks independence, including its admission criteria, links of registered experts to NFI and NIFP, and an alleged letter to a judge. The State Secretary replied that the NRGD is independent, criteria are objective and unchanged since 2010, no misconduct is found, and an evaluation is planned for 2011-2015.
As may be apparent from the answers to the previous questions, in my view there is no question of misconduct.
Zoals mag blijken uit de antwoorden op de voorgaande vragen is er naar mijn mening geen sprake van misstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Drugsinfiltrant VS actief in Nederland’

MPs Çörüz and Gesthuizen asked whether a newspaper report about a US drug informant operating in the Netherlands was accurate and what rules apply to foreign and criminal civilian informants. The minister said the US denied any DEA undercover operation in the Netherlands, that foreign police may not act independently on Dutch soil, and that criminal civilian informants are in principle not permitted except in exceptional terrorism cases with safeguards.
Investigation in the Netherlands on behalf of another state always takes place under the supervision and direction of the Dutch public prosecution service and the police.
Onderzoek in Nederland ten behoeve van een andere staat vindt altijd plaats onder toezicht en leiding van het Nederlandse openbaar ministerie en de politie.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de aanpak van faillissementsfraude en het strafbaar stellen van het ontbreken van een juiste en volledige administratie in een faillissement

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why a bankruptcy fraud case reported by the curator in 2011 was not pursued, why earlier answers said no complaint had been filed, and whether the proposal to criminalise incomplete bankruptcy administration would be considered. The minister admitted the complaint had reached the FIOD in September 2011 but was not investigated because a related case was already advanced, apologised for the earlier omission, pointed to an existing integrated fraud approach, and argued existing civil liability already sanctions incomplete administration.
Further investigation revealed that the relevant complaint was received by the FIOD in September 2011.
Uit nader onderzoek is gebleken dat de betreffende aangifte in september 2011 bij de FIOD is binnengekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het plukken van criminele winsten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the FinEC anti-financial-crime programme was replaced by the Afpakken (asset recovery) programme, about asset-recovery teams and their results, the 3-4x return assumption, information-sharing with the Tax Service, FIU access for financial investigators, OM and judicial financial expertise, and extra financial investigators. The minister answered that asset-recovery programmes build on FinEC, reported 44.6 million euro recovered in 2011, cited the 3x return from FinEC results, said data access rules allow inquiry on serious suspicion, described the FIU system change and expertise training, and said financial investigation will be secured in the national police plans.
As promised during the 14 June committee debate on organised crime, I will send your House a letter on government-wide asset recovery before the summer recess.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het algemeen overleg van 14 juni jongstleden over georganiseerde criminaliteit stuur ik uw Kamer nog voor het zomerreces een brief over het overheidsbreed afpakken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het tekort aan rechters

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that courts are hesitant to hire judges and that case quality and backlogs are under strain. The State Secretary answered that judicial staffing fell 1% in 2011, that backlogs are generally decreasing although some sectors still miss targets, and that he meets periodically with the judiciary and will inform parliament via the Council's reports.
I am periodically in discussion with the judiciary about the state of affairs regarding the administration of justice and any bottlenecks experienced.
Ik ben periodiek in gesprek met de Rechtspraak over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de rechtspleging en de eventuele knelpunten die worden ervaren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het negeren van adviezen van artsen bij de dreigende overlevering van een suïcidale Palestijn aan Zweden

An SP MP asked why the extradition court allowed transfer of a traumatised Palestinian man to Sweden despite psychiatric and psychological advice that extradition was medically unacceptable and posed a suicide risk, and asked whether prosecution in the Netherlands and talks with Sweden were possible. The state secretary replied that the court did not examine health issues under the Extradition Act framework, that the public prosecutor may postpone surrender on humanitarian grounds, that a further health investigation was ordered, and that the actual surrender is not imminent due to a summary proceeding.
Moreover, that also does not form part of the assessment framework prescribed for the judge by the Extradition Act.
Overigens vormt dat ook geen onderdeel van het in de Overleveringswet voorgeschreven beoordelingskader van de rechter.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijksma en Gesthuizen over een uit Zuid-Korea afkomstige jongen uit Kampen die na een bezoek aan een voetbalwedstrijd in Londen Nederland niet meer in komt

MPs Dijksma and Gesthuizen asked why a 19-year-old South Korean-born student from Kampen, who has lived in the Netherlands since age five, was refused re-entry after a trip to London and cannot take his VWO retakes, and whether he should receive a residence permit. The minister confirmed an entry ban for illegal residence, declined to lift it, arranged for the retakes to be taken at the Dutch embassy in Seoul, and rejected granting a residence permit.
I see no reason to temporarily lift the entry ban.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het inreisverbod tijdelijk op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het mogelijk geven van foutieve informatie door Shell inzake de olielekkages in de Nigerdelta

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Shell may have given inaccurate and incomplete information on the size of Niger Delta oil spills and the extent of sabotage, and whether he would discuss the Accufacts findings with Amnesty International and Shell. The State Secretary answered that the matter is handled through the OECD Guidelines National Contact Point, which has held talks with the parties, and that a separate discussion on the report was not considered appropriate beyond regular contacts.
The NCP has held several talks with the parties involved over the past year and hopes to reach positive, forward-looking steps with them.
Het NCP heeft in het afgelopen jaar meerdere gesprekken gevoerd met de betrokken partijen en hoopt met hen te kunnen komen tot positieve, toekomstgerichte stappen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Dijksma, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Oproep: stop uitzetten kinderen’

MPs from four parties asked the immigration minister whether he knew of the Children's Ombudsman's call to halt deportations of children, how many child-involved deportations were planned, when he would respond to the report, and whether he would suspend planned removals until the Samsom/Voordewind bill is debated. The minister refused a deportation stop, arguing it would not serve the children's interests, create legal inequality and undermine return procedures, and said he could not give a count of planned deportations because the information changes daily.
It is not possible to indicate how many deportations involving minor children are planned for the coming months.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel uitzettingen, waarbij minderjarige kinderen zijn betrokken, er voor de komende maanden gepland zijn.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen, Dijksma, Voordewind, Dibi en Schouw over de ontstane situatie in Ter Apel

Five MPs asked the minister whether a clearance of the tent camp of rejected asylum seekers in Ter Apel had begun, and about its course, the pending summary proceedings, and the medical condition of residents. The minister replied that residents were offered temporary shelter with a freedom-restriction measure, that the Iraqi group left voluntarily, and that the mayor issued an emergency order to end the action on safety grounds.
In line with my commitment made in the emergency debate of 15 May 2012, I will inform you fully in writing as soon as possible once the action has ended.
Conform mijn toezegging gedaan in het spoeddebat van 15 mei 2012, zal ik u schriftelijk zo spoedig mogelijk volledig informeren zodra de actie is afgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat drie homoseksuele Afrikanen uit Senegal, Oeganda en Sierra Leone een asielvergunning wordt geweigerd

An MP asks whether the minister suggested gay asylum seekers should hide their sexual orientation to avoid persecution, and whether asylum claims were rejected on that basis. The minister responds that discretion cannot be required, that the three cited cases were rejected because the asylum story was not credible though the sexual orientation was accepted, and that the policy will be clarified in the Vreemdelingencirculaire.
I will further clarify the policy on this in the Vreemdelingencirculaire.
Ik zal het beleid hierover verder verduidelijken in de Vreemdelingencirculaire.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Verhoeven over de oproep van de NMa aan ziekenhuizen om grote inkoopcombinaties te vormen

MPs Gesthuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the NMa's call on hospitals to form large purchasing alliances conflicts with their amendment against unnecessary clustering of public tenders, and whether the advice is one-sided. The minister replied that the NMa's recommendation does not require merging tenders, is not in conflict with the amendment or current procurement rules for academic hospitals, and has not created confusion, so no action against the NMA is planned.

I am of the view that the NMa's call for more purchasing alliances does not conflict with the amendment Verhoeven/Gesthuizen, adopted by the House of Representatives, on unnecessary clustering of public contracts.

Ik ben van mening dat de oproep van de NMa om meer inkoopcombinaties te vormen niet haaks staat op het onlangs door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen amendement Verhoeven/Gesthuizen over het onnodig clusteren van overheidsopdrachten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het aangiftevolgsysteem bij de politie

SP MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked which police forces use the case-tracking systems (AVS, MVS, BVS), whether they are satisfied, how they relate to the new victims' law, and whether forces developing their own software should stop pending the national police. The minister answered that four forces use AVS, twelve use BVS, MVS is nowhere operational, forces are satisfied, a national AVS is being planned, and he agrees forces should stop developing their own software.
I am not aware of this.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen  over het bericht dat prijzen van Nederlandse verblijfsvergunningen te hoog zijn

An SP MP asked the Immigration minister how the Court of Justice ruling on high residence-permit fees for long-term third-country nationals (Directive 2003/109) affects Dutch fees, whether they are disproportionate, and whether they will be lowered before 1 July 2012. The minister answered that the Netherlands will respect and implement the ruling, is still deciding how, and aims to adjust the fees before 1 July.

Although the Netherlands argued in the proceedings that the fees for long-term resident third-country nationals are not unlawfully or disproportionately high, the Netherlands will respect the Court's ruling and implement it.

Hoewel Nederland in de procedure heeft aangevoerd dat de leges voor langdurig ingezetene derdelanders niet onrechtmatig en onevenredig hoog zijn, zal Nederland de uitspraak van het Hof respecteren en ten uitvoer brengen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam, Gesthuizen, Dibi, Schouw en Voordewind over het stopzetten van zestien hoger beroepprocedures en het niet uitzetten van zestien Somaliërs

MPs from five parties asked the immigration minister why he withdrew appeals in sixteen Somali asylum cases and stopped detention and removals, given the security situation in Mogadishu. The minister replied that return to North Somalia remains possible via Mogadishu airport, that the appeals were withdrawn because forced return could not be organised in a way he considered responsible at present, that detention was lifted, and that returnees without state-funded shelter are not entitled to accommodation.
That is why the appeals were withdrawn.
Daarom zijn de hoger beroepen ingetrokken.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het niet aanpakken van een ‘schoolvoorbeeld van faillissementsfraude’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a transport company bankruptcy, described as a textbook case of bankruptcy fraud, had not been prosecuted, and what would be done about the liquidator's lack of funds and the involvement of TNT. The minister answered that no criminal complaint had been filed so far, so no investigation was underway, that bankruptcy handling is primarily a private-law matter for the curator, and that a revised liquidator guarantee scheme takes effect on 1 May 2012.
Specifically regarding the bankruptcy of this transport company, the Public Prosecution Service has informed me that to date the curator has not filed a complaint of bankruptcy fraud.
Specifiek over het faillissement van het onderhavige transportbedrijf heeft het OM mij bericht dat er tot op heden door de curator geen aangifte van faillissementsfraude is gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de berichtgeving over de NOvA en het toezicht op de advocatuur

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports of a looming conflict with the Dutch Bar Association (NOvA) over reform of supervision of the legal profession, including whether he rejected a joint solution and demanded irreversible steps be avoided. Secretary Teeven answered that a draft amendment is pending before the Council of State, that NOvA's objections were considered, that he asked the NOvA not to pursue irreversible situations before parliamentary decision-making, and that he will consider further consultation after the Council of State's advice.
This amendment note regulates, among other things, the revision of supervision of the legal profession.
Deze nota van wijziging regelt onder meer de herziening van het toezicht op de advocatuur.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dam en Gesthuizen over een Iraaks gezin met kinderen dat uit de asielopvang is geplaatst en dakloos is geworden terwiji de asiel procedure nog loopt

MPs Van Dam and Gesthuizen asked why an Iraqi asylum-seeking family with children was evicted from reception while its asylum procedure was still pending, despite a court having annulled the earlier rejection and an appeal being outstanding. The minister's answer, as far as the text goes, was delivered confidentially and the substantive reasons are placed in a confidential annex.
I request that you treat these answers confidentially.
Ik verzoek u deze antwoorden vertrouwelijk te behandelen
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Gesthuizen over de verstoorde 112 dienstverlening

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the minister why a back-up system for the 112 emergency line was not used immediately during the KPN outages and whether such a system should always be deployed at once. The minister answered that a back-up network exists, was used during the 31 March outage, and that deploying it immediately is not always necessary, with additional agreements made with KPN.
Additional agreements have now been made with KPN on the accessibility and risk management of the 112 network.
Met KPN zijn inmiddels aanvullende afspraken gemaakt over de bereikbaarheid en het risicomanagement van het 112-netwerk.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de mogelijkheden voor justitie om een gestolen en gelokaliseerde iPad te achterhalen

An SP MP asked why police could not pursue a stolen, app-located iPad traced to a house, and whether the government would propose changes. The minister said the OM judged the location too imprecise for a home search warrant, outlined alternative investigative powers, and considered the existing toolkit adequate.
The OM operated within a balanced system of criminal procedural powers.
Het OM heeft geopereerd binnen een afgewogen stelsel van strafvorderlijke bevoegdheden.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de onafhankelijkheid van deurwaarders gevaar loopt

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether allowing non-bailiff participation of up to 49% in bailiff practices threatens the independence of bailiffs, who exercise delegated public authority, and whether a ban on third-party participation (a 'nuloptie') should be adopted. The state secretary answered that the 49% participation option already exists, that the proposed extension need not impair independence depending on safeguards in the amended regulation, that the KBvG lacks sufficient support for a ban, and that he will assess any safeguards when the regulation is submitted for approval.

For this reason, the Independence Regulation already stipulates that all decisions on, among other things, the execution of assignments are taken solely by or under the direct responsibility of a bailiff.

Daarom is in de Verordening Onafhankelijkheid reeds vastgelegd dat alle beslissingen over ondermeer de uitvoering van opdrachten uitsluitend worden genomen door of onder directe verantwoordelijkheid van een gerechtsdeurwaarder.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de financiële consequenties van het Europees Arrestatie Bevel en de veroordeling in de proceskosten van een strafzaak

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about the financial consequences of a European Arrest Warrant surrender to Poland, including a fine, a bail forfeiture and procedural costs imposed on a Dutch citizen, and about legal aid and suspension of cooperation. The minister answered that the Polish case is for the suspect, his lawyer and Polish authorities, that EU law does not regulate fine collection or costs, that other countries also impose costs, and that cooperation will not be suspended.
I therefore see no reason to consult with my Polish counterpart about this criminal case.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding tot overleg met de Poolse ambtgenoot over deze strafzaak.
Antwoord vragen Dibi, Hilkens, Schouw, Voordewind en Gesthuizen over het groeiende aantal gemeenten dat kritiek uit op het illegalenbeleid

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about municipalities criticising the government's policy on undocumented migrants and whether municipalities may set their own police priorities on this. Minister Leers answered that the police keep priority on criminal and nuisance-causing foreigners, that municipal mayors have authority over local police priorities, and that the police will still address vulnerable illegals with due regard for their situation.
Within his authority, the mayor can independently set priorities regarding police deployment in his municipality.
In het kader van zijn gezag kan de burgemeester eigenstandig prioriteiten stellen met betrekking tot de politie-inzet in zijn gemeente.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Irrgang over de terugbetaling van geïnde omstreden Amerikaanse invoerheffingen aan het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven

Two SP MPs asked whether the EU-US deal ending zeroing duties, which does not require refunds of wrongly collected duties to Dutch firms, is acceptable, and what can be done about collective recovery. The minister called the refund outcome disappointing but acceptable, said the EU lacks legal means to force US refunds, and said firms themselves must decide on collective action in US courts.
The agreement reached was the highest achievable and is therefore disappointing on refunds but wholly acceptable to me.
Het bereikte akkoord was het hoogst haalbare en is voor mij dan ook op het punt van terugbetaling teleurstellend maar in zijn geheel acceptabel.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen(SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat het Centraal Orgaan Opvang Asielzoekers (COA) al jarenlang veel te veel voor onderhoud van de gebouwen op de asielzoekerscen

An SP MP asked the minister for Immigration and Asylum whether complaints about COA overpaying for building maintenance were filed earlier with the Interior Ministry, what happened to them, and whether the issue will be included in the investigation into COA waste. The minister refers to earlier answers to parliamentary questions and to the COA inquiry report, which discusses complaint handling.
For the answer to your question I refer to the answer to questions 2, 3 and 4 from MP Spekman
Voor het antwoord op uw vraag verwijs ik naar het antwoord op de vragen 2, 3 en 4 van het lid Spekman

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat de ambtenaren van Minister Leers onjuiste informatie hebben gegeven aan het Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers (COA) in de

An SP MP asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about reports that his civil servants gave incorrect and incomplete information to the COA during salary negotiations with its chair, and about the consequences, the cause of the confusion, and the minister's role. The minister answered that the core issue was a technical dispute over about EUR 2,000 gross per year, while the inconsistency in information from the COA's director concerned over EUR 20,000 per year, and referred to the Commission of Inquiry report for details.
The report of the COA Commission of Inquiry discusses in detail, in section 5.5 and annex 5, how the contacts between the COA and the department on setting the remuneration took place.

In het rapport van de Commissie van onderzoek COA wordt in paragraaf 5.5 en bijlage 5 uitgebreid ingegaan op de wijze waarop de contacten tussen het COA en het departement over de vaststelling van de beloning hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de toepassing van het Europees Arrestatie Bevel door Duitsland dat twee keer overlevering vraagt voor hetzelfde feitencomplex

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether Germany's second European Arrest Warrant for the same drug-plantation facts, after a sentence already served in the Netherlands, breaches ne bis in idem and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that the offences are similar but not identical, that the court found no ne bis in idem violation, and that he sees no reason to change the grounds for refusal or to consult the German minister.
I see no reason to consult with my German counterpart.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om met mijn Duitse ambtgenoot te overleggen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Recourt, Dibi, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Zorgen over quotum aanhouden illegalen’

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about reports that police were given a quota of undocumented migrants to apprehend, and how this affects their access to care and education. The minister answered that the agreement aims to keep the police migration-enforcement task prioritised within existing capacity, that illegal residents keep their right to necessary care and minors to education, and that police decide how to implement the task.
The WODC presented in 2011 the results of a study estimating the number of illegal residents in the Netherlands in 2009.
Het WODC heeft in 2011 de resultaten van een onderzoek naar het geschatte aantal illegalen in Nederland in 2009 gepresenteerd.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de oprichting van een nationaal anti-fraudebureau

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the UK National Fraud Authority model, a single national anti-fraud bureau, should be created in the Netherlands, citing estimates of savings and fraud volume. The minister replied that Dutch fraud policy already aligns with NFA goals through prevention, public-private cooperation and repressive measures, cited a 2006 estimate of 6 to 12 billion euro in fraud proceeds, and did not commit to creating a national bureau.
In my previous answers I indicated that the Cabinet's current fraud policy corresponds with the objectives the NFA in the United Kingdom pursues.

In mijn vorenstaande antwoorden heb ik aangegeven dat het ingezette Kabinetsbeleid op het terrein van de fraudebestrijding overeenkomt met de doelstellingen die de NFA in het Verenigd Koninkrijk nastreeft.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanschaf van 500 Google Apps-accounts door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (ing

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel (SP) asked why the Foreign Affairs ministry bought 500 Google Apps accounts without a pilot as a fallback for emergency email, and how privacy and security were safeguarded given AIVD warnings about cloud services. The minister confirmed the purchase, justified it by open standards, low cost and reliability, said no other ministry uses it, and said confidential information may not be shared via these accounts.
In the event of emergencies, the normal, non-classified email communication of Foreign Affairs with the Dutch missions abroad must in any case be able to continue.

Indien calamiteiten zich voordoen dient in elk geval de normale, niet-gerubriceerde, e-mailcommunicatie van Buitenlandse Zaken met de Nederlandse vertegenwoordigingen in het buitenland door te kunnen gaan.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Gesthuizen over sluizen, gemalen en bruggen die slecht beveiligd zijn

Two SP MPs asked whether locks, pumping stations and bridges that can be operated remotely over the internet are insecure, whether other municipalities use the same SCADA systems, why earlier warnings from the NCTb were not acted on, and whether these structures should be manned again. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat-managed structures are largely not internet-connected, that security is continuously monitored, and that she is responsible only for Rijkswaterstaat objects, not for municipalities.

As minister I am responsible for the management of locks, pumping stations and bridges managed by Rijkswaterstaat, and I therefore cannot answer for the municipality of Veere or for other municipalities or authorities.

Als minister ben ik verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van sluizen, gemalen en bruggen die door Rijkswaterstaat beheerd worden en ik kan derhalve niet antwoorden voor de gemeente Veere of voor andere gemeenten of overheden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Samsom, Dibi en Voordewind over de uitzetting van een Georgisch gezin



G.B.M. Leers

Five MPs asked the minister about the planned deportation of a 17-year-old Georgian girl after ten years in the Netherlands, including her mother's disability, the duration of asylum procedures, the father's alleged risks in Georgia, and whether she should be spared removal pending answers. The minister's reply was sent only for confidential inspection, citing privacy sensitivity, so the substantive answers are not public.

Given the privacy-sensitive aspects, I request that the answers be made available solely for confidential inspection at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives of the States General.
Gelet op de privacygevoelige aspecten verzoek ik u de antwoorden enkel ter vertrouwelijke inzage bij het Centraal Informatiepunt van de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal te leggen.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over ontslagen bij uitgeverij Wegener

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether they condone the planned loss of 300 to 350 jobs at publisher Wegener, whether regional news provision is important, and how they would support regional news. The ministers said job cuts are a private company decision, acknowledged the importance of news provision, and pointed to regional media centre cooperation and the Stimuleringsfonds voor de Pers as measures.
Although I regret the loss of employment, it is primarily up to Wegener to decide on this.
Hoewel ik het verlies aan werkgelegenheid betreur, is het primair aan Wegener om hierover een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Irrgang over afschaffen omstreden Amerikaanse  invoerheffingen en terugbetaling van de geïnde heffingen aan het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven

Two SP MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister about the end of US 'zeroing' anti-dumping duties and why no refund of duties already paid by Dutch exporters was agreed. The state secretary welcomed the deal, said the WTO ruling was prospective only, and noted that the EU tried but failed to secure refunds, leaving affected firms to pursue US courts.
The ruling applies to the future and has no retroactive effect.
De uitspraak geldt voor de toekomst en heeft geen terugwerkende kracht.
Antwoord vragem Gesthuizen over het negeren van ‘Bel-me-niet register'

An MP asks the minister why companies ignore the Bel-me-niet telemarketing register, whether OPTA fines deter violations, and what steps will reduce complaints. The minister says complaints are falling, OPTA has imposed 1.2 million euro in fines, no company has been fined repeatedly, and an evaluation will be sent to parliament this spring.
This evaluation will be sent to your House this spring.
Deze evaluatie wordt uw Kamer dit voorjaar toegezonden.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over een Irakees gezin dat een week geleden op straat is gezet

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked why an Iraqi family with minor children was put on the street in winter after a rejected repeat asylum application, despite a court ruling, and whether there was an alternative shelter. Minister Leers answered that the family had no right to shelter after a repeat application, that they were later placed in a family location after DT&V judged the frost an exceptional situation, that no investigation would follow, and that migrants should comply with their departure obligation.
Without wishing to go into detail on the content of this individual case, I can state that the foreign nationals concerned have so far not indicated they wish to cooperate with their return.
Zonder uitgebreid in te willen gaan op de inhoud van deze individuele zaak kan ik aangeven dat betrokken vreemdelingen tot nu toe niet hebben aangegeven mee te willen werken aan hun terugkeer.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over ongeldige vonnissen van e-Court

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the state secretary whether e-Court's arbitral judgments, found invalid by a court, mislead contract partners and whether government will act, and about the use of binding advice and the Intrum Justitia deal. The state secretary replied that e-Court is a private body and must adapt its procedure itself, that the information given was correct, that arbitration rules are public, and that government will not intervene in private agreements.
Since this concerns a private dispute resolution body, it is not for me to take action.
Aangezien het om een private geschilbeslechtingsinstantie gaat is het niet aan mij om actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat een Turkse moslimextremist asiel heeft aangevraagd in Nederland

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked about a Turkish national seeking asylum despite a Turkish conviction, and about the number of asylum seekers excluded under Article 1F of the Refugee Convention who remain in the Netherlands. Minister Leers answered that extradition is pending, that about 810 people have had 1F applied, around 240 are still in the country (about 200 for over ten years), and that no clear solution is planned for those who cannot be removed.
At this stage I do not consider it appropriate to provide information about the sentence imposed or the facts stated in the extradition request.
Ik acht het in dit stadium niet dienstig om mededelingen te doen over de opgelegde straf of over de feiten die in het uitleveringsverzoek worden genoemd.
Antwoord vragen Bashir, Gesthuizen en Irrgang inzake het toezicht op goede doelen

MPs Bashir, Gesthuizen and Irrgang (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about supervision of charities after a VPRO programme found many ANBI-listed organisations did not meet the listing conditions, including missing policy plans and governance requirements. The State Secretary declined to assess the CIGD study because only an anonymised extract was provided, described the Tax Authority's supervision and revocation powers, and said legislation requiring ANBIs to publish balance sheets is being prepared for submission before summer.
If it turns out that an institution does not meet one or more conditions, the Tax Authority can ask the institution's board to remedy the omissions within a reasonable period.

Indien mocht blijken dat een instelling niet voldoet aan één of meer voorwaarden, dan kan de Belastingdienst het bestuur van een instelling verzoeken om binnen een redelijke termijn de omissies te herstellen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over de contracten van subcontractors die werken voor Post NL

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries about a Zembla broadcast on subcontracted parcel couriers working for PostNL, including whether their contracts amount to disguised employment and whether the tax authority agreed special arrangements. The government answered that the contracts are free commercial arrangements, that employment status depends on the facts and can be tested by the Tax Authority or courts, and that it cannot disclose any Tax Authority agreements with specific taxpayers due to confidentiality rules.
However, no information can be provided about any agreements with specific taxpayers.
Over eventuele afspraken met specifieke belastingplichtigen kan echter geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over kinderarbeid in de cacaoketen

MPs Dikkers, Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked the government about child labour in the cocoa chain, including the Child Labour Platform, IDH's programme links, the Harkin-Engel Protocol targets and the reliability of industry commitments. The State Secretary answered that the CLP was set up independently of IDH programmes, that child labour is integrated in certification standards, and that guarantees cannot be given, especially in Ivory Coast.
Guarantees can certainly not be given in Ivory Coast.
Zekerheden zijn zeker in Ivoorkust niet te geven.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het laten werken van gedetineerden na detentie en de rol van het Uitvoeringsorgaan wer

An SP MP asked the state secretaries of Justice and Social Affairs about job placement for prisoners before release, the UWV role, the effect of new four-week job-search waiting periods for under-27s, and budget cuts. The government answered that the UWV service continues but is moving to a digital format, that the waiting period applies to all young people registering with the UWV, and that prisoners themselves must take responsibility for their reintegration.
The state secretary of Justice and Security will inform you about work in detention no later than 1 May 2012.
Over arbeid in detentie wordt u uiterlijk 1 mei 2012 door de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie geïnformeerd.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitzetting van een Irakese familie (ingezonden 30 november 2011).

MPs Gesthuizen and Spekman asked the minister about the deportation of an Iraqi family after 13 years in the Netherlands, the children's rooting and mental health care, and the effect of long residence on child rights under the CRC. The minister declined to discuss individual circumstances, stated that the family's case was being handled by using discretionary power, and argued that long residence alone does not justify a residence permit.
Because the family has made its situation public through the media, I consider it important to state that I have decided to use my discretionary power regarding the Hassan family.

Omdat het gezin via de media bekendheid heeft gegeven aan hun situatie acht ik het evenwel van belang hierbij te melden dat ik ten aanzien van de familie Hassan heb besloten om gebruik te maken van mijn discretionaire bevoegdheid.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een geheime keylogger op 141 miljoen smartphones (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

The MP asks whether Carrier IQ spyware (keylogging, SMS and https interception) is on Dutch smartphones, whether it is sold to third parties, and whether government phones are affected. The minister answers that no evidence of such software on phones sold in the Netherlands was found, that data sales are denied by the company, and that other supervisors could investigate if needed.

Should it turn out that such software is present on smartphones delivered in the Netherlands, it is up to the Data Protection Authority, the Independent Post and Telecommunications Authority or the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether there is reason to investigate from their responsibilities.

Mocht toch blijken dat dergelijke programmatuur voorkomt op in Nederland geleverde smartphones, dan ligt het op de weg van het College bescherming persoonsgegevens, de Onafhankelijke Post en Telecommunicatie Autoriteit of het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of er vanuit hun verantwoordelijkheden aanleiding is onderzoek te doen
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het op non-actief stellen van een klokkenluider binnen het gevangeniswezen (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

An MP asks why a department head at PI Zwolle prison was placed on leave, whether media disclosure played a role, who is responsible for the disclosure of his identity, and whether he qualifies as a whistleblower entitled to protection. The state secretary says the leave was an administrative measure with pay due to service interests, apologises for the internal disclosure of his name, and states that the whistleblower procedure under the Regeling was followed, with an investigation finding no misconduct.

In doing so, the reporter was promised legal protection in accordance with the Regulation, and was also told that he would not suffer any adverse consequences in the performance of his duties in any other way.
Daarbij is de melder, conform de Regeling, rechtsbescherming toegezegd en toegevoegd dat hij ook niet op een andere wijze bij de uitoefening van zijn functie nadelige gevolgen zou ondervinden.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er niet naar de zorgen en signalen van familie van de patiën

SP MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers whether family and friends of schizophrenia patients have nowhere to turn with their concerns, and how often police, municipalities, housing corporations and care providers receive such signals. The minister answered that relatives can approach GPs, municipal complaint points and the IGZ, that no figures are registered for most bodies, and that a family-involvement policy and a pending mental-health bill are being developed.
It is not possible to quantify "signals or cries for help from family members" from police systems.
Het is niet mogelijk om «signalen c.q. noodkreten van familieleden» uit de politiesystemen te kwantificeren.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat een groep Somaliërs in de kou is gezet (ingezonden 30 november 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about a report that a group of rejected Somali asylum seekers was left on the street, including why they were refused, the role of COA and IND, their current custody and return, and the government's stance on emergency shelter. The minister answered that the group refused cooperation with return and was placed in custody, that the government does not provide funds for emergency shelter and sees no municipal role, and that providing shelter would make illegal stay more attractive.
On 16 December 2011, on the court's order, the immigration detention of this group was lifted due to insufficient prospect of removal.
Op 16 december 2011 is op last van de rechtbank de vreemdelingenbewaring van deze groep opgeheven vanwege onvoldoende zicht op uitzetting.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over Google en het ongevraagd gebruik maken van gebruikersdata voo

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) and El Fassed (GroenLinks) asked whether Google, Apple and others collect Wi-Fi location data from consumers' phones without consent and whether a ban is needed. The State Secretary answered that the Data Protection Act gives the regulator enough room to impose a ban if needed, and that consent is the basis for collecting movement data while Wi-Fi router data may be collected under legitimate interest with safeguards.
Such a specific ban is not necessary.
Een dergelijk specifiek verbod is niet nodig.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat een moeder met kinderen op straat is gezet (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the immigration minister whether rejected asylum families with minor children are still being left on the street before return is carried out, and whether this breaches a Hague Court of Appeal ruling. The minister replied that the ruling does not oblige shelter for all such families, that a family seeking a second asylum application had left its shelter voluntarily, and that the family will be readmitted to shelter pending the new application.
The ruling does not give cause to offer shelter, outside the applicable rules on asylum reception, to persons who did not already receive shelter.
Vormt de uitspraak geen aanleiding om, buiten de geldende regelgeving in relatie tot opvang voor asielzoekers, opvang te bieden aan personen die niet reeds opvang genoten

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de nieuwe werkwijze van het Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau en de overeenkomsten met gerechtsdeurwaarders (ingezonden 7 decembe

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Security and Justice whether the CJIB is reopening its contracts with bailiffs and moving to no-cure-no-pay, and about risks, justification and savings. The state secretary replied that the CJIB is exploring more cost-efficient options with bailiffs, that no-cure-no-pay is one option but the form is not settled, and that the KBvG will be involved in developing the new approach.
The precise working method still has to be further developed. The KBvG will also be involved in this.
De precieze werkwijze moet nog nader worden ontwikkeld. Daarbij zal ook de KBvG worden betrokken.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de opvang van een Afghaans asielzoekersgezin in de gezinslocatie in Katwijk (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

MPs Spekman and Gesthuizen asked the minister about an Afghan asylum-seeking family split across rooms in the Katwijk family reception location, a 14-year-old's interrupted schooling, and a planned transfer to Gilze en Rijen. The minister answered that the family chose separate rooms, that schooling was arranged, and that the transfer to Gilze en Rijen never took place because the family cancelled its appointment.
The family agreed to this and thereby made the choice themselves to live separately.
De familie heeft hiermee ingestemd en heeft daarmee zelf de keuze gemaakt gescheiden te wonen.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat huisartsen aan de bel trekken over de situatie van vreemdel

SP MPs asked the immigration and health ministers about reports that GPs were alarmed at inhumane medical care for rejected asylum-seeking families in COA reception locations, and about a COA-Menzis contract and handover problems. The minister said COA is responsible under the law, access to medical care is guaranteed, COA and Menzis have agreed transfer safeguards, and he sees no reason for further investigation.
I therefore see no reason to conduct further investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om nader onderzoek te doen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de afpersing bij telefoonabonnementen (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

The SP MP asks whether the government knows that young adults, often with mild intellectual disabilities, are coerced into taking out expensive phone contracts, and what will be done about it, including prevention in schools, phone company obligations, re-joining the credit registry, and police investigation. The ministers acknowledge the problem but say the scale is unknown, point to ongoing police-telecom cooperation, note the existing information helpdesk and under-18 parental consent rule, say the sector is exploring an extension of Preventel, and state that police do take complaints but often lack investigative leads.
Telephone companies are working with the police to map the scale more precisely and to consider what proportionate and effective measures could reduce or prevent such practices.
Telefoonmaatschappijen werken samen met de politie om de omvang nader in kaart te brengen en te bezien wat mogelijke proportionele en effectieve maatregelen zijn.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouten (ChristenUnie), Ferrier (CDA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Dijkhoff (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP), Dikkers (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Hachchi (D66)

Ten MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour in Turkish hazelnut harvesting one year after it was first reported, including whether enforcement is adequate, whether companies are meeting their responsibilities, and the status of various studies and working groups. The government answered that the problem lies mainly with Turkey, that the embassy raised it with Turkish authorities and funds a study, that industry bodies have adopted guidelines and a Turkish action plan exists, but that it could not confirm concrete results of the Turkish working group and could not answer in time for the scheduled debate.
The cabinet will continue to raise this issue within the EU framework, including in the Council conclusions.
Het kabinet zal hier in EU-kader aandacht voor blijven vragen, ook in de Raadsconclusies.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Braakhuis (GroenLinks), Hamer (PvdA) en Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de falende postbezorging van Post.nl (ingezonden 25

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and PVV asked the state secretary about widespread failed and late mail delivery by PostNL shown in a TV broadcast, whether the claimed 96.5% next-day delivery rate is credible, and whether staffing policy is to blame. The state secretary replied that PostNL is responsible for quality, that the 95% overkomstduur norm is measured by an independent bureau and supervised by OPTA, that he sees no reason to revisit the norm, and that staffing is PostNL's own responsibility.
If PostNL does not meet the stated requirements, OPTA can act under the Postal Act.
In het geval PostNL niet aan de gestelde eisen voldoet, kan OPTA op grond van de Postwet optreden.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de opmerking dat een gevangenis geen hotel is (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

MP Gesthuizen asks the state secretary whether the prison is now a hotel, what hotel-like elements exist, and whether he misrepresented research on sentencing preferences by selectively quoting it. The state secretary says 'a prison is not a hotel' meant privileges should be earned via promotion and demotion, and denies misrepresenting the research, citing findings that support recidivist minimum-sentence policy.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het overplaatsen van een gevangenisdirecteur en beschuldigingen aan zijn adres (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

An MP asks whether allegations against the dismissed Tilburg prison director were dropped, whether a 'cover-up' took place, and how the internal investigation, hidden camera use and his transfer were handled. The state secretary replies that the BI&V investigation found conflicting witness accounts, the director withdrew from his post and was reassigned, and that covert camera surveillance was ended once the works council objected.
In no way is there therefore any question of a cover-up affair.
Op geen enkele wijze is dan ook sprake van een doofpotaffaire.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik van spionagesoftware door de Nederlandse overhei

The SP and GroenLinks MPs asked whether Dutch government services bought the German spyware 'Bundestrojaner', on what suspicion it is deployed, how often, and whether its use stays within the law. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, referred to earlier answers on costs and which bodies may use it, said deployment requires a serious offence with pre-trial detention possible, and stated the software should only be used for serious crimes, pointing to earlier answers for safeguards.
I share the view that such software should only be deployed when investigating serious offences.
Ik deel de mening dat dergelijke software enkel dient te worden ingezet bij het onderzoeken van ernstige misdrijven.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over notarissen die uit het ambt ontzet zijn en het toezicht op het notariaat (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about two notaries struck off by the Amsterdam appeals court for having deeds passed without their presence and without proper client information, whether this reflects a wider problem, and about the oversight of the notariat. The State Secretary called the practice unlawful and laakbaar, denied signals it is widespread, pointed to new Bureau Financieel Toezicht powers from 1 July 2012 to examine legal errors, and provided sanction statistics from 2005 to 2010.
In the Act of 29 September 2011 amending the Notaries Act, the tasks of the Bureau Financieel Toezicht have been expanded.
In de Wet van 29 september 2011 tot wijziging van de Wet op het notarisambt, zijn de taken van het Bureau Financieel Toezicht uitgebreid.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitzetting van een Afghaans asielzoekersgezin en de verwijdering van hun oudste zoon uit z

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about the deportation of an Afghan asylum family, including arguments that the daughter had become westernised and that return would breach Article 3 ECHR, and about the removal of the eldest son from school. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, described the general assessment framework and the policy for westernised Afghan girls, and said no facts were known about the school removal.
As I have previously informed your House, I consider it in principle undesirable to provide information about individual cases.
Zoals ik uw Kamer eerder heb gemeld, acht ik het in beginsel onwenselijk informatie te verstrekken over individuele gevallen.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Smeets (beiden PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de ca

MPs from PvdA, ChristenUnie and SP asked the state secretaries whether the cocoa sector is failing to eliminate child and forced adult labour, whether self-regulation works, and how the Dutch government intends to lead, including the scope of the 2010 cocoa sustainability declaration and the IDH programme. The government answered that progress is being made but the problem is not solved, that certification and the declaration are the main tools, that IDH is showing results, and that dialogue continues through the Child Labor Platform and international cocoa agreement.
I do not agree with your observation that self-regulation does not work.
Ik ben het niet met uw constatering eens dat zelfregulering niet werkt.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de ontwikkelingen rond het bijstaan van slachtoffers in een strafproces (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked whether stricter application of rules for granting legal aid (toevoeging) to aggrieved parties in criminal proceedings weakens victims' position, notably for those with moderate injuries and domestic violence victims. The state secretary replied that the rules have not changed, that Slachtofferhulp Nederland is the primary support route with exceptions for complex cases, and that victims' position has been strengthened by recent legislation.
The policy on granting the legal aid allowance has been harmonised for all regional offices.
Het beleid omtrent het verstrekken van de toevoeging is voor alle regiokantoren geharmoniseerd.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Recourt (PvdA) en Van der Steur (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het Europees arrestatiebevel in relatief kleine strafzaken (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether the European arrest warrant should be used for Mr E., who faces surrender to Poland over a suspected bribe of about 25 euro, and whether Poland could use alternatives and proportionality could be raised. The minister replied that the warrant concerns two sentences totalling over three years plus prosecution for bribing a prison guard, that surrender was ordered with a guarantee of return, that Poland's changing warrant practice has been noted without specific action, and that no special intervention with Polish authorities is considered necessary.
Given the seriousness of the facts, I find it understandable that the Polish authorities issued a warrant in this case.
Gelet op de ernst van de feiten vind ik het begrijpelijk dat de Poolse autoriteiten in deze zaak een EAB hebben uitgevaardigd.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de berichten dat botonderzoek bij jonge asielzoekers niet voldoet (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP asks the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about criticism that bone-age testing of young asylum seekers is unreliable, including the claim that the SMAK critics are expert and that an independent study is needed. The minister rejects the criticism as unfounded, defends the protocol and the scientific basis of the clavicle examination, and declines to commission independent research, pointing to the existing Commissie Leeftijdsonderzoek.
In my view, an independent study therefore adds no value.
Hiermee is naar mijn mening een onafhankelijk onderzoek van geen toegevoegde waarde.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Gesthuizen (SP), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het onderzoek op basis waarvan een project voor ex-ama’s is

Five MPs asked the minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the government's claim that the project for former unaccompanied minor asylum seekers performed worse than the Dienst Terugkeer & Vertrek was a misreading of the CVO research, and whether a scientifically sound comparison would be made. The minister answered that a sound comparison was not feasible for research reasons, that the CVO findings were correctly interpreted, and that the conclusion that the project was not performing stands.
No, there is no question of an incorrect interpretation of the CVO research.
Nee, van een onjuiste interpretatie van het onderzoek van CVO is geen sprake.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de WOTS-procedure en de voortgezette tenuitvoerlegging (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister why transfer requests under the WOTS law are often refused for lack of remaining sentence, why Venezuela is handled only by conversion procedure, and about the conditions of Dutch detainees in Venezuela. The minister answered that slow foreign processing is a matter for those countries, that continued enforcement is used only in exceptional cases, that consular visits were temporarily cancelled by local authorities and have resumed, and that welfare of detainees is primarily Venezuela's responsibility.
However, this goal is not achieved by granting WOTS requests when no remaining sentence exists.
Dit doel wordt echter niet bereikt door WOTS-verzoeken toe te wijzen als een strafrestant ontbreekt.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de weigering van het CBR om de rijbevoegdheid van een goed functionerende TNT-chauffeur toe t

An SP MP asks the ministers why the CBR refused to restore driving eligibility to a well-functioning TNT driver taking Tryptizol, despite claimed positive medical advice, and whether the bureau can deviate from rules in individual cases. The government replies that the CBR has no discretion to deviate from the medical fitness rules, that no positive psychiatric advice was received in this case, and that it will ask WINAP whether the drug's categorisation should change for chronic use.
No, the CBR has no authority to deviate from the rules on medical fitness to drive in individual cases.
Nee, het CBR heeft geen bevoegdheid om in individuele gevallen van de regels ten aanzien van de medische rijgeschiktheid af te wijken
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid & Justitie over diverse onderwerpen aangaande acquisitiefraude (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the Justice Minister why acquisition fraud continues largely unpunished, why the Holland Internet Group has not been prosecuted, and whether helpdesks, reporting facilities, EU action and consumer-style rules for businesses will be provided. The minister replies that prosecution was dropped for insufficient evidence, that much of this conduct is not criminal, that prevention is emphasised, and that some proposals are being examined with other ministries.
Should new facts and circumstances arise in which the named companies commit criminal offences, the Public Prosecution Service will again examine the possibilities for criminal action.

Mochten zich nieuwe feiten en omstandigheden voordoen waarbij de genoemde bedrijven zich schuldig maken aan strafbare feiten, dan zal het Openbaar Ministerie de mogelijkheden van strafrechtelijk optreden wederom onderzoeken.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de mensenrechtenschendingen door Frontex in Griekse vluchtelingenopvang (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

MP Gesthuizen asks the immigration minister about detention conditions for migrants in Greece, the handling of asylum cases, and whether Frontex violates fundamental rights, citing Human Rights Watch. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says Greece bears primary responsibility and is being supported through EASO, states that Frontex is only coordinating and that member states remain responsible for detention, and points to new Frontex rules with a fundamental rights officer and advisory forum.
I currently do not have information to answer your specific questions about the duration of individual asylum procedures in Greece.
Ik beschik momenteel niet over informatie om uw concrete vragen over de duur van individuele asielprocedures in Griekenland te beantwoorden.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Spekman (PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het lid Wilders (PVV) dat een immigratiedaling van 50 procent

Four MPs asked the immigration minister whether he was aware of PVV leader Wilders' claim that immigration of non-Western migrants would fall by 50 percent, and how the government would prevent such statements from damaging the Netherlands' image. The minister replied that the government's package of measures is expected to cut inflows substantially over the longer term, that there are no target percentages, that the PVV is responsible for its own statements, and that 2010 and early 2011 figures do not yet show a decline.
As the cabinet has stated several times, there are no target percentages.
Zoals het kabinet verschillende keren heeft aangegeven 2 is er geen sprake van streefpercentages.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de grote gevolgen van schaalvergroting in de supermarktbranche voor kleine

MPs Gesthuizen, Dijkgraaf and Schouten asked the economy minister whether expanded Sunday opening harms small supermarket owners relative to chains and whether it should be reversed. The minister replied that the 2011 tightening of the tourism exemption is expected to help small shops, that Sunday opening is only one factor among several, and that no new measures are planned.
No, as I have already indicated, the expanded Sunday opening is only one of the factors contributing to the declining turnover and number of small supermarkets.
Nee, zoals ik reeds heb aangegeven is de ruimere openstelling op zondag slechts één van de factoren die een rol spelen bij de dalende trend van de omzet en aantal van kleine supermarkten.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gasnetwerk (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

The MPs Gesthuizen and Jansen (SP) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice about the risks of old cast-iron gas mains, including the OVV chairman's claim that the advice had not been acted on, where risks are greatest, how far network operators are moving, and the status of the Gasunie transmission network. The minister answers that the advice has been followed through legal changes, SodM supervision agreements and completed risk inventories, that replacement is risk-based over decades, and that the Telegraaf map concerns regional networks rather than the Gasunie transmission network.
However, I do not agree with his claim that insufficient action has been taken on the Safety Board's recommendations.
Ik ben het echter niet eens met zijn stelling dat er onvoldoende is gedaan met de adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Spekman (PvdA) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de eventuele uitzetting van een Iraanse vrouw en haar twee kinderen (in

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PvdA and SP asked the immigration minister about the possible expulsion of an Iranian woman and her two children, and about a pending new country report on Iran. The minister replied that expulsion is not currently imminent because a follow-up asylum application was filed, that the report and new country report were sent to parliament, and that the family may await the decision in the Netherlands.
There is currently no question of an imminent expulsion of the woman and her children.
Van een dreigende uitzetting van de vrouw en haar kinderen is thans geen sprake.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de WOTS-procedure (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

The MP asks whether the Dutch policy of refusing WOTS transfer requests when too little sentence remains is still in force, and whether long foreign procedures (e.g. Venezuela, Spain) should be softened, plus whether pending cases are being dropped and whether lawyers can get legal aid in the pre-request phase. The minister confirms the remaining-sentence requirement, rejects softening it since WOTS is for resocialisation in NL, states from 1 October 2011 EU requests go through continued enforcement (old requests handled as before), and declines to widen legal aid because pre-request work is between states.
I see no reason to expand the legal aid policy in WOTS cases.
Ik zie geen reden om het toevoegingsbeleid in WOTS-zaken te verruimen.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Gesthuizen (SP) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht da

MPs asked the government about reports that shop staff in Zoetermeer are pressured into Sunday work, and whether this reflects a wider trend, whether workers can enforce their rights, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate compliance. The minister answered that the Zoetermeer decision meets the legal tourism criteria subject to a pending appeal, that workers can invoke the Working Hours Act and Civil Code before the courts, and that the government will not have the Labour Inspectorate supervise collective agreement provisions.
The judge has the final say in assessing whether the municipality of Zoetermeer rightly used the tourism provision.
De rechter heeft het laatste woord bij de beoordeling van de vraag of de gemeente Zoetermeer terecht gebruik heeft gemaakt van de toerismebepaling.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de gebeurtenissen in het detentiecentrum voor asielzoekers in Rotterdam van afgelopen wee

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a sit-in by asylum detainees at the Rotterdam detention centre, alleged use of force, placement in isolation cells, the number of detainees and the justification and alternatives to immigration detention. The government answered that the detainees refused to return to their cells, that force was limited to the internal assistance team, that four detainees received 14-day isolation for incitement and intimidation, and that it sees no reason for further investigation while alternatives to detention are being studied.
The course of events is for me no reason for further investigation.
De gang van zaken vormt voor mij geen aanleiding voor een nader onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks), Gesthuizen (SP) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de steun van overige lidstaten voor de kabinetsplannen om EU-regelgeving op het gebied van asiel en i

MPs asked which EU member states support the cabinet's plans to make EU asylum and immigration rules stricter, how they expressed that support, and on what timeline the changes could be adopted. The minister answered that support is expressed informally, names no specific states, says a timeline depends on EU procedures, and declines to share support details because of negotiation considerations.
Finally, I would point out that from a negotiating standpoint it is unwise to share widely in advance with outsiders which country has expressed how much support for what.
Tot slot wil ik u er op wijzen dat het vanuit onderhandelingsoogpunt onverstandig is al op voorhand breed met de buitenwereld te delen wie, hoeveel steun, waarvoor kenbaar heeft gemaakt.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Van Toorenburg (CDA) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het SBF-verlof voor gev

MPs Gesthuizen, Van Toorenburg and Bouwmeester asked why the SBF leave scheme for prison staff left DJI personnel inadequately and late informed about lower net income, why P-Direkt information was deficient, and whether the scheme should be changed or allow continued working. State Secretary Teeven answered that the lower net leave benefit was known from the start, that information was slow but not incorrect, that continued working is decided case by case on service interests, and that the scheme is a safety net not meant to encourage longer working.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het door Google verstrekken van internetdata aan de Amerikaanse autor

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether US authorities can easily obtain data on Dutch internet users from Google, which apparently complies with most US demands, and which other popular online services share information with US authorities. The minister replied that he lacks a full overview of the Patriot Act framework, that such requests require prior judicial review by a US court, that no cases are known of Dutch-facing services being compelled, and referred to earlier answers on privacy.
I am not aware whether, and if so which, other providers of online services that (also) target Dutch consumers have been confronted with requests from the American authorities to provide data.

Het is mij niet bekend of en zo ja welke (andere) leveranciers van online diensten die zich (ook) richten op Nederlandse consumenten geconfronteerd zijn met vorderingen van de Amerikaanse autoriteiten om gegevens te verstrekken.

Vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de problemen met zendmasten (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

MPs Van Dijk and Gesthuizen asked the ministers about the failures of the Hoogersmilde and Lopik broadcast masts, the fragmented private ownership, the lack of clear responsibility, whether masts should be publicly owned, and an investigation. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing, that masts are not in principle a public responsibility except for non-duplicable infrastructure, that existing emergency-broadcast arrangements suffice, and that a mediator has been appointed for Lopik.
The investigations into the cause of this serious situation resulting from the fires have not yet been completed.
De onderzoeken naar het ontstaan van deze ernstige situatie als gevolg van de branden zijn nog niet afgerond.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Spekman (PvdA), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de berichten dat er geen sprake zou zijn geweest van gedwong

MPs from five parties asked the immigration minister whether an Iranian asylum seeker who took his own life was told that forced removal was not possible, whether detention without realistic prospects of removal is acceptable, and whether courts are misled by claims of 'prospect of removal'. The minister confirmed the matter was discussed in a 2009 departure interview, stated that forced return to Iran is not impossible in all cases if the person cooperates, and denied that courts are misled.
The conversation report can be found in the annex for confidential inspection.
Het gespreksverslag vindt u in de bijlage ter vertrouwelijke inzage.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over postbezorging door gemeentelijk werkbedrijf Iederz in Groningen (ingezonden 28 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether a municipal work company in Groningen, Iederz, uses welfare recipients in reintegration trajectories to deliver mail and parcels for TNT Businesspost at €0.50 per hour, and whether this displaces regular jobs and undermines the collective labour agreement. The state secretary answers that the reported facts are not known, that no reintegration participants do parcel delivery and no Iederz staff are seconded to PostNL, and that parcel delivery is done by Wsw-indicated employees on Wsw collective agreement pay.
Parcel delivery by the municipal work company Iederz/Businesspost Groningen is not carried out by welfare recipients in reintegration trajectories.
Pakketbezorging door het gemeentelijke werkbedrijf Iederz/Businesspost Groningen wordt niet verricht door bijstandsgerechtigden (in re-integratie trajecten).

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitzending van Uitgesproken VARA over de kinderen van lang verblijvende, uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers uit Tadzjikist

MPs Spekman and Gesthuizen asked the Immigration minister about a VARA broadcast on a long-resident failed asylum family, whose children are rooted in the Netherlands, and why no residence permit was granted in the children's interest. The minister said the family has not done enough to return, that no permit is warranted under the discretionary or outside-fault policy, and that the municipality and ministry agreed the family may stay in Aalden while cooperating on departure.
The starting point for me is that information on individual cases is treated confidentially.
Uitgangspunt is voor mij dat informatie over individuele zaken vertrouwelijk wordt behandeld.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Hamer (PvdA) en Braakhuis (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het UWV dat weiger

MPs from SP, PvdA and GroenLinks asked why UWV refused PostNL dismissal permits for sorting staff and how the dismissal rules were applied, including the shift from permanent to flexible work and a motion on UWV's work instruction. The minister answered that permits were refused because the selection did not follow the afspiegelingsbeginsel and because it was unclear whether temporary and agency staff would continue, and that the work instruction did not play a role in this assessment.
In this case the permits were refused because the dismissal selection was not in line with the afspiegelingsbeginsel.
In dit geval zijn de vergunningen geweigerd omdat de ontslagkeuze niet in overeenstemming was met het afspiegelingsbeginsel.

Vragen van de leden Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het raadsbesluit om in Zoetermeer 52 koopzondagen toe te staan (ingezonden
