Three MPs asked the minister whether Zoetermeer's council decision to allow 52 Sunday shopping days under the tourism exemption of the Shop Opening Hours Act was lawful, given that the exemption should be interpreted strictly, the tourism must be autonomous and substantial, and workers' interests must be weighed. The minister answered that the municipality's assessment is its own responsibility, that an objection and possible appeal are pending before the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal, and that the courts have the final word.
The judge has the last word in assessing whether the municipality of Zoetermeer rightly used the tourism exemption.
De rechter heeft het laatste woord bij de beoordeling van de vraag of de gemeente Zoetermeer terecht gebruik heeft gemaakt van de toerismebepaling.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het blijven gebruiken van Deep Packet Inspection door telecombedrijven (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

MP Gesthuizen asked whether continued use of Deep Packet Inspection by telecom firms defies the House's wishes, whether the Dutch data protection authority's findings will be published quickly, and when. The minister denied a need for immediate action, said regulators (OPTA, CBP) are investigating and no strafrechtelijk onderzoek will follow, and gave no date for the CBP results.
Pending an investigation, the CBP makes no statements about the content or the procedural course of the investigation.
Hangende een onderzoek doet het CBP geen uitspraken over de inhoud noch over het procedurele verloop van het onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de in Zwitserland vrijgegeven miljoenen van Klaas Bruinsma (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

The MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Justice Minister when Dutch authorities learned of millions in a Swiss account possibly linked to the late drug figure Klaas Bruinsma, how cooperation with Switzerland went, whether Dutch justice pushed for speedy handling, and whether the money could still be claimed. The minister replied that a Swiss criminal probe, assisted by the FIOD, led to the account being blocked in 1995 on Swiss orders, that no Dutch seizure was made, and that a Dutch Public Prosecution Service team is verifying recent reports and has no further comment yet.
In response to these reports, a team under the leadership of the Public Prosecution Service has been set up to verify the reports and examine whether further investigation is possible.

Naar aanleiding van deze berichtgeving is er een team samengesteld dat onder leiding staat van het OM om deze berichtgeving te verifiëren en te bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om nader onderzoek te doen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verrichten van arbeid door gedetineerden direct na gevangenisstraf (ingezonden 27 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked whether short prison sentences should end with a community sentence (taakstraf) so offenders can work for society and learn daily structure, following a proposal by Reclassering Nederland. The minister rejected the proposal, arguing a taakstraf is a separate main penalty that cannot replace part of a prison term, while noting structure is already addressed through the penitentiary programme, conditional release and 20 hours weekly work in custody.
In view of my answer to questions 1 to 4, I do not intend to come forward with proposals to replace short prison sentences with a community sentence.
Gelet op mijn antwoord bij de vragen 1 t/m 4 ben ik niet voornemens om met voorstellen te komen om kortdurende gevangenisstraffen af te sluiten met een taakstraf.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het niet uitleveren door India van de kluiskraker van DNB (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Foreign Affairs whether India is refusing extradition of a suspect in the theft of 1.25 million euro from De Nederlandsche Bank, and what steps the government will take. The government answered that India has not yet decided on the extradition request, that the request dates from March 2010 under an 1898 treaty, and that it will monitor the case and stress its importance where needed.
India has not yet taken a decision on the Dutch extradition request.
India heeft op het Nederlandse uitleveringsverzoek nog geen beslissing genomen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Immigratie en Asiel over de berichten dat kosten voor uitzetting mogelijk worden verhaald (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Immigration and Asylum why the government plans to investigate recovering removal costs from rejected asylum seekers, whether financial support for return will end, whether this deters departure, and why the press learned of the plans before parliament. The minister answered that recovering costs from those who do not depart voluntarily is considered appropriate, that voluntary return support will be expanded rather than abolished, that cost recovery is expected to encourage voluntary departure, and that parliament was informed by letter after the cabinet meeting.

The intention to examine whether it is possible to recover from the foreign national the costs the government incurs in the return process, I have described in the letter 'Return in immigration policy'.

Het voornemen om te onderzoeken of het mogelijk is de kosten die de overheid maakt in het terugkeerproces te verhalen op de vreemdeling, heb ik beschreven in de brief «Terugkeer in het vreemdelingenbeleid»

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over antwoorden op eerdere Kamervragen over hulp en ondersteuning aan een persoon die na langdurige detentie is vri

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) and Recourt (PvdA) asked the state secretary to explain why prior answers on informing a released acquitted detainee's municipality appeared inconsistent, what the prison did, which municipality received information, what measures will prevent recurrence, and whether the government will report on talks with insurers. The state secretary answered only by referring to answers given to earlier questions of 6 June 2011.
For the answers to your questions, I refer to my answers 3 to the identical questions from members Gesthuizen, Recourt and van Toorenburg, submitted on 6 June 2011.
Voor de beantwoording van uw vragen verwijs ik naar mijn antwoorden 3 op de gelijkluidende vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Recourt en van Toorenburg, ingezonden op 6 juni 2011.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het meerpersoonscelgebruik in vreemdelingendetentie (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

An SP MP asks why immigration detainees are routinely placed in multi-person cells from intake and why the government does not adopt the Inspectorate's recommendations on single-cell placement, climate control and evaluation. The state secretary defends multi-person cell use as a regular form of detention, explains intake medical screening, announces ventilation improvements at Zeist, and says the Inspectorate's report does not warrant a separate evaluation for immigration detention.
The intake report is reviewed by a prison physician who bears final responsibility.
Het verslag van de intake wordt gezien door een justitieel geneeskundige die de eindverantwoordelijkheid draagt.

Vragen van de leden Arib (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over nazorg van misbruik in de Rooms-katholiek

MPs Arib, Gesthuizen and Dibi asked the health and justice ministers whether aftercare for victims of sexual abuse in the Catholic Church is sufficient and whether the state should support victim gatherings and urgently provide aftercare before the Samson and Deetman inquiries report. The minister answered that existing arrangements with Slachtofferhulp Nederland and regular mental health care are adequate, that no extra measures are needed now, and that the state has no role in organising victim meetings.
I therefore see no reason at this moment to provide extra assistance and prefer to first await the results of the ongoing investigations.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om in extra hulpverlening te voorzien en geef er de voorkeur aan nu eerst de resultaten van de lopende onderzoeken af te wachten.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verwikkelingen in een zaak van het Europees Arrestatiebevel (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

The SP MP asks the Justice Minister about a Dutch man extradited to Poland under a European Arrest Warrant, raising concerns about food, medication, video recording of lawyer-client talks, prison overcrowding, and a judge allegedly pressuring him over charges outside the extradition. The State Secretary answers that the man ate his own food and received medication and a doctor visit, that no lawyer-client video was made, that the prison situation is addressed in a separate letter, and that Polish authorities report no plans for a new warrant or coercive bail use.
Upon request, the Polish authorities have informed me that there was no video recording of the person concerned and his counsel.
Desgevraagd hebben de Poolse autoriteiten mij meegedeeld dat er geen sprake is geweest van het maken van video-opnamen van betrokkene en zijn raadsman.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het opleggen van sancties aan gedetineerden en tbs’ers die spreken met journalisten (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked whether the Nieuwegein prison's sanction on an inmate for talking to journalists was justified, and whether the grounds for refusing media contact in the Penitentiary Principles Act (art. 40) are so broad that contact is almost always refused. The minister replied that the sanction followed from a letter to a fictitious law firm found in a cell inspection, that art. 40 grounds are exhaustive and applied case by case, that complaints can go to the complaints committee and the appeals committee, and that he sees no reason to change policy.
These grounds for refusal are exhaustive.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over investeringen van Shell in Syrië (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Shell's oil and gas investments in Syria, including its role in the sector, possible use of fuel by security forces, EU sanctions compliance, and whether Dutch firms should halt production. The government answer (Rosenthal, on behalf of the ministers) addresses these points, which are primarily about corporate conduct and sanctions rather than a check on executive power.
These questions were answered in a letter dated 4 July 2011 (Parliamentary paper 32 734, no. 12).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 4 juli 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 734, nr. 12 ).
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verrichten van arbeid door gedetineerde 65-plussers (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Security and Justice whether detained people aged 65 and over, who no longer receive AOW pensions in detention and are not obliged to work, should receive the wage-replacement allowance, and whether that allowance should not depend on a medical examination. The state secretary answered that 90 such detainees were held, that they will now be able to choose to work and receive a set allowance if they do not work, and that the arbeidsloon regulation will be amended.
I will amend the Regulation on prisoner labour wages for this purpose.
Ik zal hiervoor de Regeling arbeidsloon gedetineerden aanpassen.
Vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de topsalarissen bij Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary about top salaries at Buma/Stemra (over 200,000 euro for several board members), whether they should be capped, whether members have democratic means to act, and whether a spokesperson gag and oversight investigation are justified. The state secretary said the salary decision lies with the board and members, pointed to planned transparency and salary-normalisation rules in the pending Wet toezicht amendment, and said the College van Toezicht saw no reason to investigate for now.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de miljoenenfraude en massale belastingontduiking in de vastgoedsector (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked why only eight cases in a large real-estate tax fraud investigation were referred for criminal prosecution, how decisions are made, and whether criminal law should be used more. The State Secretary explained the tripartite selection criteria, the 17 suspects and their status, and that the tax authority will keep the sector under targeted supervision, while declining to give exact detection rates.
It is not possible to state how high the probability of detection is for tax evasion.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoe hoog de pakkans is voor belastingontduiking.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over zoekgeraakte organen bij het NFI (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that organs from possibly murdered babies were discarded at the NFI, complicating counter-examination, and about the procedures, expertise and timing involved. The minister denied the report, said the case is before a court so details are withheld, and stated the NFI followed standard protocols and that no further investigation is warranted.
As the case is still before the court, I refrain from a detailed account of the course of events in the investigation concerned.
Aangezien de zaak nog onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij van een gedetailleerde weergave van de gang van zaken in het betreffende onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over lopende onderzoeken naar mogelijke misdragingen van oud-rechters en het aanzien van de rechterlijke macht (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the timing of Rijksrecherche investigations into former judges Westenberg and Kalbfleisch, whether sanctions and dismissal powers are adequate, and whether the Raad voor de Rechtspraak should keep paying their legal costs. The minister gave no timeline for the investigations, promised to prepare legislation broadening disciplinary measures against judges, and said the Raad decides on legal cost coverage with no fixed reimbursement rule.
I cannot give a forecast of when the investigations will be concluded.
Ik kan geen prognose geven over wanneer de onderzoeken afgerond zullen zijn.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Gesthuizen (SP), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie waarin in een

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum how the government will respond to a CJEU ruling that imprisoning an irregular migrant for illegal stay conflicts with the Return Directive, and whether the planned criminalisation of illegal stay and breach of entry bans is therefore incompatible with EU law. The Minister declined to pre-judge the pending bill and the Raad van State advice, said the ruling concerned Italian law, and stated the government will respect EU law while seeking to change EU rules.
It does not seem appropriate to anticipate the handling of this bill now.
Het lijkt mij niet opportuun nu reeds op de behandeling van dit wetsvoorstel vooruit te lopen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gevolgen van het SBF-verlof voor gevangenispersoneel (ingezonden

An MP asked why the SBF leave benefit leaves prison staff born after 1949 with substantially less net income than the former FLO/FPU scheme, and why no compensation is offered. The state secretary answered that the lower net amount follows from general tax and premium rules, that a second-career arrangement is available, and that he does not consider the effect unduly harsh.
The lower net SBF leave benefit is not intended, but is the outcome of deductions on the benefit under generally applicable statutory rules on taxes and premiums.
De lagere netto SBF-verlofuitkering is niet beoogd, maar is de uitkomst van inhoudingen op de uitkering volgens algemeen wettelijke voorschriften ten aanzien van belastingen en premies.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de werkwijze van de OPTA met betrekking tot abonnementswijzigingen van KPN (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister about OPTA's handling of KPN's business subscription changes, including whether customers who declined annual contracts were nonetheless moved to them and why OPTA did not enforce further. The minister answered that KPN states such customers were not moved, that OPTA is independent and the minister will not comment on its decision, and that KPN will allow telephone-only cancellation for business contracts while other cancellation routes remain possible.
OPTA is an independent regulator and makes its own decisions. I do not consider it appropriate for me as minister to give an opinion on OPTA's decisions
OPTA is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder en neemt zelfstandig besluiten. Ik vind het niet passend om als minister een mening te geven over de besluiten van OPTA

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Justitie geld heeft geboden om een schandaal bij het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut te verzwijgen (i

MPs asked whether Justice offered the parents of Denise Schouten money to keep silent about the NFI scandal over her missing heart, and whether they understand the parents' wish to know what happened. The minister denies it was hush money, saying a damages settlement was offered with customary conditions, that no agreement was reached, and that the Rijksrecherche investigated and reported to parliament in 2009.
The gist of the article is incorrect.
De strekking van het artikel is onjuist.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het Europees Arrestatiebevel (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the European Arrest Warrant is used for trivial offences, whether Polish issuance and detention conditions are problematic, and whether the Dutch court should have wider review powers and rights safeguards. The Minister argued the proportionality problem is mainly a Polish issue that is declining, saw no reason to widen the court's review beyond the framework decision, and said Article 6 ECHR does not apply to EAW procedures.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over wettelijke belemmeringen tussen toezichthouders (ingezonden 27 a

SP MPs asked the ministers whether the competition authority NMa is barred by law from sharing information on tax evasion and fraud with other enforcers, how often this occurs, and whether the Competition Act should be changed. The minister answered that legal options for information exchange with other supervisors and the Public Prosecution Service will be widened, with safeguards, via a forthcoming amendment merging NMa, OPTA and the Consumer Authority.
Yes, together with the NMa I have concluded that the legal possibilities for information exchange with other agencies can be widened.
Ja, samen met de NMa ben ik tot de conclusie gekomen dat de wettelijke mogelijkheden voor informatie-uitwisseling met andere instanties kunnen worden verruimd.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de onduidelijke status van fraudeurs die een schikking hebben getroffen (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the unclear status of fraud suspects who settled with the Public Prosecution Service, including whether financial firms can refuse business with them and whether a settlement counts as a public admission of guilt. The minister replied that a settlement is not an explicit admission of guilt, that it is recorded on the criminal record and may affect certificates of conduct, that blacklisting is a matter for market parties under data protection rules, and that the status of a settlement is clear.
I cannot anticipate the further course of the legal proceedings.
Ik kan niet op de verdere rechtsgang vooruit lopen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie naar aanleiding van diverse nieuwsberichten over het schietincident in Alphen aan de Rijn (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

The MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about firearms oversight after a shooting in Alphen aan den Rijn, including home checks of licence holders, the duration of the OvV investigation, age limits, sports shooters storing weapons at home, and KNSA youth recruitment. The state secretary Teeven said the OvV expects to publish in September 2011, that the government will review licensing and oversight policy after the investigations, and that the OvV's scope is its own to determine.
I therefore cannot say which aspects of the shooting incident in Alphen aan den Rijn will be examined by the OvV.
Ik kan derhalve geen uitspraken doen over welke aspecten van het schietincident in Alphen aan den Rijn door de OvV zullen worden onderzocht.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het gebrek aan opvang voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel (ingezonden 7 april

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about shortages of shelter places for trafficking victims, including CoMensha's 2010 figures and whether the government had understated the shortage. Minister Opstelten acknowledged remaining shortages and groups of exploited workers who cannot be housed in regular shelters, pointed to a task force protocol and a pilot under evaluation, and said structural responsibility and financing would be decided later.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid van Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over gebruikmaking van bedrijven en hun diensten van gedragsprofilering over internetgebruik

The MP asks whether the government will inform parliament about OPTA's study on unlawful cookie use, whether the problem extends to online data collection generally, whether resale of such data can be excluded without consent, and what the progress is on EU do-not-track and right-to-be-forgotten rules. The minister refers to OPTA's independent study, says data collection is not per se unlawful and resale is not explicitly prohibited, and describes the EU process with a Commission proposal expected by summer.
Yes, the use of cookies is only one of the ways in which user data on the internet can be collected.
Ja, het gebruik van cookies is slechts een van de manieren waarop gegevens van gebruikers op het internet kunnen worden verzameld.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het detentieregime van een moeder die vervangende hechtenis ondergaat (ingezonden 17 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the detention regime for a mother serving substitute detention for an unpaid victim compensation order, who has a six-year-old child. The State Secretary replied that substitute detention is a measure applied to compel payment, that the regular regime applies with extra child visits, and that detention phasing is not offered because the end date is not fixed.
Substitute detention is not a custodial sentence but a measure, imposed only when the person fails to comply with the compensation measure imposed by the court.
Vervangende hechtenis is geen vrijheidsstraf maar een maatregel, die pas wordt opgelegd als de betrokkene niet voldoet aan de door de rechtbank opgelegde schadevergoedingsmaatregel.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een koopzondagenbesluit van de gemeenteraad van Vlaa

MPs Dijkgraaf, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink and Gesthuizen asked the minister whether Vlaardingen's council decision allotting 18 Sunday shopping days, with shopkeepers choosing 12, violates the Winkeltijdenwet, and whether the minister will petition for annulment. The minister answers that the council ordinance is lawful since it delegates 12 days to the mayor and aldermen, that the college's later designation has been ordered brought into line with the law, and that he will await the municipality's reply before deciding on annulment.
I have pointed this out to the municipality and asked it to adjust the designation of the number of Sunday shopping days so that it complies with the Winkeltijdenwet.
Ik heb de gemeente hierop gewezen en verzocht om de aanwijzing van het aantal koopzondagen aan te passen, zodat deze in overeenstemming met de Winkeltijdenwet is.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Gesthuizen (SP) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en In

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour and underpaid adult labour in Dutch cocoa and hazelnut supply chains, including whether hazelnut processors acting through the FNLI and the IDH business network can be held responsible. The government answered that industry bodies are meeting their supply-chain responsibility within the limits of reasonable expectation, describes FNLI and IDH activities, and says the SZW dialogue with Turkey has not yet taken place.
Our answer of 15 December 2010 stated that companies must simply do what can reasonably be expected of them to combat child labour in their chain.
In ons antwoord van 15 december 2010 is aangegeven dat bedrijven zonder meer dienen te doen wat redelijkerwijs van hen mag worden verwacht om kinderarbeid in hun keten te bestrijden.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de vertrekpremie van David Montgomery (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

Parliamentary questions from SP MP Gesthuizen ask the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs how they view the €2.7 million extra severance for Mecom's David Montgomery, amid job losses at Wegener, and what powers exist over pay in foreign-owned firms. The minister replies that remuneration and reorganisation are primarily matters for the companies and their shareholders, notes that no large reorganisation is planned at Wegener, points to the Dutch corporate governance code's comply-or-explain principle, and attributes falling newspaper revenue to declining advertising and competition from free online news.
Mecom's shareholders are the designated parties to intervene if they disagree with how Mecom is run.
De aandeelhouders van Mecom zijn de aangewezen partijen om in te grijpen indien zij het niet eens zijn met de gang van zaken bij Mecom.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over «De Tbs-paradox» (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about the tbs (forensic psychiatric detention) system, including alleged political interference in a release decision, a reported decline in unaccompanied leave, a psychiatrist's report being blocked, lengthy leave applications, and a patient placed in isolation. The state secretary largely rejected the allegations, stated that the release refusal was based on public safety, acknowledged the drop and later rise in unaccompanied leave, and promised a policy letter on improving the system.
I do not recognise the described sequence of events.
Ik herken mij niet in de beschreven gang van zaken.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het onderzoek naar de onrust in de Koepelgevangenis in Breda (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether four suicides in one prison year (PI Breda, 2010) warranted a joint investigation by the Health Care Inspectorate and the Sanctions Inspectorate, and why suicides in prisons rose from 10 to 18. The secretary replied that the Health Care Inspectorate reviewed the calamity-commission reports and saw no link between the deaths, so a joint investigation was unnecessary, and offered a general study of suicide determinants without seeing a structural increase.
I can agree with the position of the IGZ and the ISt.
Ik kan mij vinden in het standpunt van de IGZ en de ISt.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Financiën over Nederlandse belangen in Wit-Rusland (ingezonden 21 febr

Two SP MPs asked ministers about Dutch economic and financial interests in Belarus, including ABN AMRO and Gazprom deals, Dutch imports of Belarusian-origin oil and gas, and Dutch support for the Lukashenko regime. The government answered that it has no insight into the commercial activities of the companies concerned, that the state played no role in those projects, and that the EU has tightened sanctions on the regime.
The cabinet has no insight into the commercial activities of the Belarussian Oil Company, Gazprom or Shell in the countries mentioned.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de commerciële activiteiten van de Belarussian Oil Company, Gazprom of Shell in de genoemde landen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Justitie over inbeslagnames door de stichting BREIN (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice whether BREIN's seizure of pirates' servers was unlawful and whether copyright enforcement should be handed to a government body instead. The State Secretary declined substantive comment while the parties are in talks and a court case may follow, and rejected transferring enforcement to a public authority, pointing to civil and criminal remedies.
I therefore refrain from a substantive response.
Ik onthoud mij daarom van een inhoudelijke reactie.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de plannen voor privatisering van het gevangeniswezen en het bericht «kleinere cel is beter» (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

SP MP Gesthuizen asked the state secretary about privatising prisons, smaller cells, cost breakdowns, cuts and staff safety. The state secretary said there are no concrete plans to shrink cells, gave the average day rate of 231 euros, and said a WODC study on privatisation would report in summer before any decision.
I expect the outcomes of the study this summer, after which I will inform your House further after the summer recess.
Ik verwacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek deze zomer, waarna ik uw Kamer na het zomerreces nader zal informeren.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de «uiterst benarde» positie van consumenten bij faillissementen (ingezonden 16 februari

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether consumers who prepaid for goods from a bankrupt retailer are in a weak position compared with banks, and what measures would rebalance this. The government answered that consumers rank as ordinary creditors with little prospect of recovery, that some retailers partly compensated customers, and that it sees no reason to change preferences, pointing instead to consumer protection tools and third-party deposit schemes.
We see no reason to place private individuals in a position similar to banks, for example by abolishing privileges and preferences in bankruptcy.
Wij zien geen aanleiding om particulieren, bijvoorbeeld door de afschaffing van voorrechten en preferenties in faillissement, in een soortgelijke positie als banken te brengen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat de Onafhankelijke Post en Telecommunicatie Autoriteit (OPTA) twijfelt aan de bezorgkwaliteit va

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about OPTA's doubts over TNT's mail delivery quality and TNT's refusal to be open about its figures, including how TNT weights its 95.2% result. The state secretary answered that the matter is a regulatory dispute, that TNT reported its weighting method and figures to OPTA, and that OPTA itself must decide what information it needs.
It is up to OPTA to determine what information it needs to carry out its tasks.
Het is aan OPTA om te bepalen welke informatie zij nodig heeft voor de uitvoering van haar taken.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Den Haag schrijft tbs-kliniek pillen voor» (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether ministry officials dictate treatment and medication in TBS clinics, whether a former minister demanded full medical files, whether ex-directors are gagged, and about post-TBS recidivism. The state secretary denied officials dictate treatment, said full files are consulted only when the Chamber requests a reconstruction, and said free speech of clinic directors is not restricted by rules, though prior consultation is expected.
Qualified doctors are required for medical treatments.
Voor geneeskundige behandelingen zijn gekwalificeerde artsen vereist.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de ingediende moties over het Europees Arrestatiebevel (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An SP MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice why he discouraged two motions on the European Arrest Warrant, whether the Amsterdam court really conducts substantive review, whether the court's surrender decisions can be delayed, and whether the Commission's concerns will be followed up. The Minister rejects the motions, states the court reviews thoroughly within the legal framework, notes no legal basis exists for postponing surrender and that the ECtHR rejected an interim measure, and commits only to raising the question with Commissioner Reding at the next Council meeting.
I therefore see no reason to change my position.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding mijn standpunt te wijzigen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over eventuele prijsverhogingen naar aanleiding van surfgedrag op internet (ingezonden 11 feb

An SP MP asked ministers whether online browsing behaviour could lead to price discrimination and profiling, and whether research into device fingerprinting and behavioural targeting should be commissioned. The minister replied that no complaints of price increases on repeat visits are known, that research into security effects is not warranted, that profiling falls under the privacy watchdog's agenda, and that a cookie study by OPTA/IVIR-TNO will be published.
No complaints are known about price increases following a repeat visit to the same webshop.
Er zijn geen klachten bekend over prijsverhogingen naar aanleiding van een herhaald bezoek aan dezelfde webwinkel.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de problemen voor jongeren om een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag te verkrijgen (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why over 1,200 young people a year are refused a Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) for minor offences, arguing the four-year exclusion from jobs and training is disproportionate and counterproductive. The minister answered that refusals are under 1% of applications, that the balance tips in favour of young applicants, that the VOG is a preventive administrative tool rather than a sanction, and that after a pilot ('VOG onder voorwaarden') no need to loosen the criteria is seen.

To examine whether a better balance can be found between the young person's interest in resocialisation and limiting risks to society, the then Minister of Justice started the 'VOG under conditions' pilot in Rotterdam.

Om te onderzoeken of een beter evenwicht kan worden gevonden tussen het belang van resocialisatie van de jongere en het belang van het beperken van de risico's voor de samenleving, heeft de toenmalige Minister van Justitie in Rotterdam de pilot «VOG onder voorwaarden» gestart.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over misstanden bij huis aan huis verkoop van kaarten voor een goed doel (ingezonden 11 januari 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Security and Justice how he responds to a Kassa broadcast exposing misleading door-to-door sales of cards for charity, and whether gemeenten should be informed and a licensing obligation introduced. The secretary says citizens should ask for ID and permits, that misleading information is prohibited under the Unfair Commercial Practices Act enforced by the Consumentenautoriteit, and that municipalities already require permits under local bylaws with CBF advice, so no new licensing obligation or new action is announced.
It is not intended that these companies tell citizens that the proceeds almost entirely go to a good cause while in fact only a small part reaches the good cause.

Het is niet de bedoeling dat deze bedrijven burgers voorhouden dat de opbrengst vrijwel geheel naar een goed doel gaat terwijl feitelijk slechts een gering deel daarvan bij het goede doel terechtkomt.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie over commissarissen (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Justice about supervisory board members' time commitments, diversity, outside appointments via personal networks, and transparency. The minister answered that the matter depends case by case, that current rules and the Corporate Governance Code suffice, and that no new regulation is planned.
I see no reason for further regulation on this point.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nadere regelgeving op dit punt.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, Veiligheid en Justitie en van Financiën over het bericht dat de raad van commissarissen (RvC) van Crucell een persoonlijk

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked ministers whether the Crucell supervisory board, given its share-based pay and personal interest in the takeover, can balance shareholder and company interests, and how the Corporate Governance Code applies. Minister Opstelten answered that supervisory directors must act in the company's interest, consider employees and society, and that share-based pay and sector-wide deviations from the Code are for shareholders to assess.

It is for the general meeting of shareholders of the company concerned to determine whether it considers the given account of compliance with the Code, including the explanation of any deviation, sufficient.

Het is aan de aandeelhoudersvergadering van de betreffende onderneming om te bepalen of zij de gegeven verantwoording over de naleving van de Code, waaronder de uitleg van een afwijking voldoende vindt.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de alarmerende stijging van identiteitsfraude (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

MP Gesthuizen asked the Justice minister whether the 166 reported identity-fraud cases were only the tip of the iceberg, whether justice is lax, whether the Criminal Code suffices, and what measures will be taken. The minister said the true scale is unknown and a study is due mid-2011, rejected the laxity charge citing a police handbook and the CMI, said existing criminal provisions are largely adequate with a draft bill on ID-document fraud to be consulted soon, and saw no reason for additional measures because growth could not be confirmed.
My colleague of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is having research carried out into the scale of identity fraud based on existing sources.
Mijn ambtgenoot van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties laat onderzoek doen naar de omvang van identiteitsfraude op basis van bestaande bronnen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de mogelijkheid van het stellen van eisen bij het toekennen

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Economic Affairs whether ESF subsidies to TNT could carry conditions preventing displacement of real jobs by 'pulpbanen' (artificial jobs) at taxpayers' expense, and whether the Commission's concerns about displacement were rejected. The government answered that no additional conditions on displacement were set, that a displacement test would be undesirable and unworkable, and that ESF subsidy requests are not assessed for displacement effects.
No, no further requirements have been set for project applications regarding displacement.
Nee, er zijn geen nadere eisen gesteld aan projectaanvragen inzake verdringing.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de fiscale aftrekbaarheid van schikkingen in fraudezaken (ingezonden 13 januari 20

SP MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers why transactions were again concluded in the Klimop real-estate fraud case, on what basis, and whether settlements are tax-deductible so taxpayers effectively subsidise them. The minister defended the transactions as a proportionate disposal of part of the case, explained the withholding of settlement amounts, and referred to earlier answers on tax deductibility.

The press release did not state the amount of the arrangement between the injured parties and the suspects, because the parties also reached agreement on damage claims and real claims and debts from work, beyond agreement on the unlawfully obtained benefit.

In het persbericht is hoogte van de regeling tussen de benadeelde partijen en de verdachten niet weergegeven, omdat de partijen naast overeenstemming over het wederrechtelijk verkregen voordeel ook overeenstemming bereikt over schadeclaims en reële vorderingen en schulden uit werkzaamheden.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht over de onrust in de Koepelgevangenis in Breda (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports of unrest and four suicides at Breda's Koepelgevangenis, including staff sick-leave, complaint numbers and whether an investigation would be ordered. The reply states that each suicide was investigated by an internal commission, that the IGZ and ISt will inspect, and that the IGZ found no causal link between improvement points and the suicides, while the ISt will not start a separate probe now.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het in tegenspraak met eerdere toezeggingen op straat zetten van asielzoekers in vrieskou (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum why two asylum seekers were left on the street in freezing weather in Ter Apel on 16 December 2010, despite earlier assurances this would not happen, and what would be done to fix it. The minister answered that the couple had announced a subsequent asylum application, that no reception right arises until the application is actually lodged, and that shelter was offered once difficulties in finding accommodation became clear, but was not used.
Merely expressing the wish to lodge a subsequent application does not create a right to reception.
Door het enkele kenbaar maken van de wens een vervolgaanvraag te willen indienen, ontstaat er echter geen recht op opvang.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over buitenlands beleid dat is afgestemd op Shell (ingezonden 25 januari 20

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch foreign policy on Iran sanctions was shaped to protect Shell, whether Shell deserved preferential treatment over other Dutch firms, and whether a Foreign Affairs secondment to Shell created conflicts of interest. The ministers replied that the leaked US cables are the US's responsibility, that the Netherlands backs strict EU sanctions, that the secondment serves sector knowledge, and that government economic diplomacy serves Dutch business as a whole.
Where the interests of Dutch companies are disproportionately affected by this, we will stand up for them.
Wanneer belangen van Nederlandse bedrijven hierdoor onevenredig geraakt worden, zullen wij hiervoor opkomen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over franchisenemers die ten onder gaan aan wurgcontracten waarbij de franchisegever voordeel heeft (ingezonden 14 januari 2

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether franchisees are being induced into onerous contracts under false pretences by franchisors who benefit, and whether a study of the scale of the problem and additional measures are planned. The minister replies that no structural abuses were found in a 2009 EIM study, that the sector should self-regulate, and that he will repeat the research but sees no current need for new government measures.
Of course I am willing to repeat the study that was published in December 2009.
Uiteraard ben ik bereid om het onderzoek dat in december 2009 uitkwam te herhalen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over nanodeeltjes in voedingsmiddelen (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Health about how Dutch support for EU initiatives on nanoparticle traceability and labelling should be read, and what other EU countries are doing on a reporting obligation. The minister answered that the Netherlands favours a uniform EU approach, describing a Belgian-presidency discussion without conclusions and a draft labelling provision in the food information regulation, and noted that France alone has a national registration requirement, whose compatibility with EU law remains uncertain.
The Netherlands is in favour of a uniform European approach to the traceability of nanoparticles in products.
Nederland is een voorstander van een uniforme Europese aanpak ten aanzien van traceerbaarheid van nanodeeltjes in producten.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de korting op de humanistische geestelijke verzorging voor gedetineerden (ingezonden 31 december 2010).

An SP MP asks the state secretary of Justice and Security whether the 1 January 2011 cut in humanist pastoral care for prisoners, which would leave only one in ten prisoners with access to a non-religious chaplain, was justified and consistent with Article 41 of the Penitentiary Principles Act. The state secretary answers that the cut follows falling prisoner numbers and a voorkeurspeiling showing only 12.3% prefer humanist care, that this is compatible with the law, and that he sees no reason for a different allocation.
I therefore see no reason to arrive at a different allocation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om te komen tot een andere verdeling.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het Europees Arrestatie Bevel en overlevering van een Nederlander aan Polen (ingezonden 20 januari 2011).

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister about the European Arrest Warrant and the surrender of a Dutch national to Poland, including whether Dutch courts can review evidence, statute of limitations, proportionality, health, detention conditions and fair trial guarantees. The minister answers that the surrender procedure does not test evidence, that health-based postponement is limited by law, that proportionality is not a refusal ground, and that no specific guarantees were demanded from Poland, while confirming the surrender will proceed.
A surrender procedure is not a criminal trial and therefore the surrender judge's review does not cover the evidence.
Een overleveringsprocedure is geen strafproces en daarom ziet de toetsing door de overleveringsrechter niet op het bewijs.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de weigering van CanalDigitaal zich aan te sluiten bij een geschillencommissie (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the minister why CanalDigitaal refuses to join a dispute committee for consumer complaints, given its near-monopoly in areas without cable alternatives, and whether the minister would use his statutory power to require accession. The minister said the market power question belongs to the regulators, that he is negotiating voluntary accession with CanalDigitaal, and that he is considering a mandatory accession obligation for programme service providers if that fails.
I am currently in discussion with CanalDigitaal about joining a dispute committee on a voluntary basis.
Ik ben op dit moment in gesprek met CanalDigitaal over aansluiting bij een geschillencommissie op vrijwillige basis.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de bestrijding van faillissementsfraude (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

An SP MP asks the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers how bankruptcy fraud is tackled, including detection rates, the role of the Chamber of Commerce, curator guarantees, and whether fraud should be a separate priority. The minister says the approach has improved, a joint strategy is planned for early 2011, and the Chamber of Commerce screening and civil and criminal management bans are being introduced, while declining to confirm the MP's conviction-rate figure.

In the first quarter of 2011 the directly involved actors (the Ministry of Security and Justice, the Public Prosecution Service and the association of insolvency lawyers) will consult with each other to arrive at a joint strategy.

In het eerste kwartaal van 2011 zullen de direct betrokken actoren (ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie, Openbaar Ministerie en de Vereniging van insolventierecht-advocaten) met elkaar overleggen om te komen tot een gezamenlijke strategie.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over device fingerprinting (i.e. «instrumentgebruik vingerafdrukken») (ingezonden 10 decembe

An MP asked ministers whether citizens are adequately protected against device fingerprinting used by internet companies for behavioural advertising, whether the CBP or GOVCERT should investigate, whether users should be informed, and whether a do-not-track register or risk analysis should be produced. The state secretary answered that Dutch law (Wbp) provides sufficient protection, that complaints can go to the CBP, that a register is unworkable and that no further risk analysis is planned.
I am of the view that Dutch citizens are legally sufficiently protected against companies that advertise in a targeted way during internet use.
Ik ben van mening dat de Nederlandse burger wettelijk gezien voldoende beschermd is tegen bedrijven die gericht adverteren tijdens internetgebruik.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat goede doelen de dupe worden van het Bel-me-niet register (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether he would act on reports that charities lose donation income because of the Bel-me-niet register, and what measures he would take. The minister replied that inventories and a Intomart GfK study found no proven causal link, so no measures are taken for now, but he will examine the effects in the register's evaluation later in 2011 and act if harm is shown.
The inventory does nevertheless signal that charities may be experiencing hindrance from the Bel-me-niet register.
Wel geeft de inventarisatie een signaal af dat Goede Doelen mogelijk hinder ondervinden van het Bel-me-niet register.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over Wikileaksberichten over Shell (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

Mr Gesthuizen (SP) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Affairs about Wikileaks reports that Shell settled a corruption case in Nigeria, that the Dutch embassy lobbied for Shell against the Petroleum Industry Bill, and that Shell could stop gas flaring in 2011. The ministers answered that the Netherlands promotes transparency, CSR and human rights in Nigeria, disputes the embassy's role only partly by describing meetings rather than phone calls, and say they will keep pressing Shell and Nigeria to end flaring as soon as possible.
This, however, was not a telephone conversation but a meeting.
Dit betrof overigens geen telefoongesprek maar een bijeenkomst.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het stelen via het internet door middel van internetincasso (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about fraud via online direct debit (internetincasso), where people authorise debits on others' accounts by ticking a box, and how victims can recover money and offenders be prosecuted. The government answered that such cases are rare (80-100 per year), victims are refunded by their bank, criminal investigation follows reporting, and that it sees no need for further restrictions given planned European direct debit rules.
If that report is correct, one always automatically gets the money back from the bank.
Als die melding klopt, krijgt men altijd automatisch het geld terug van de bank.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat rekeningen steeds vaker niet betaald word

Two SP MPs asked ministers about reports that household bills are increasingly left unpaid, probing causes, the effect on small firms, household debt stability, and the wage share. The government answered that responsibility lies with debtors and creditors and municipalities, cited research on causes, rejected a link between consumer debt and financial instability, denied a declining labour share, and pointed to municipal debt-relief funding and a pending bill.
Het kabinet zet in op zelfstandigheid.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de berichten dat kleine bedrijven in de autoherstelbranche uit de markt worden gedrukt door de grote jongens en de verz

An SP MP asked the Economics minister about reports that small car-repair firms are being squeezed out by large chains and insurers, and about alleged flaws in the NMa sector scan and SEO critique. The minister replied that insurers and repairers must follow competition law, that the NMa sector scan is independent and not a formal investigation, that no further research is planned after a court upheld it, and that the sector had ample chances to respond.
In view of the above, I therefore do not consider it useful to conduct new or additional research or to examine whether a different research approach would lead to different outcomes.
Gelet op het bovenstaande acht ik het dan ook niet zinvol nieuw of aanvullend onderzoek te doen of te bezien of een andere onderzoeksaanpak tot andere uitkomsten zou leiden.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, Veiligheid en Justitie en van Financiën over het bericht dat de Raad van Commissarissen (RvC) van Crucell een persoonlijk

An SP MP asked ministers whether supervisory board members of Crucell, who receive shares and options, have a personal interest in the Johnson & Johnson takeover, why Crucell deviated from best practice provision III.7.1 of the Dutch corporate governance code, and what measures will prevent personal interests from compromising independent judgement. The minister answered that the interests of the company and its boards were aligned, that share-based remuneration of supervisory directors is a matter for companies under the comply-or-explain principle, and that the forthcoming governance bill would regulate conflicts of interest.
It was concluded that the interests of Crucell, its shareholders, and the members of the boards were aligned.
Geconcludeerd is dat de belangen van Crucell, haar aandeelhouders, bestuurders en commissarissen parallel lopen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over handel in .nl-domeinnamen (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether SIDN sells lists of domain names in quarantine, how quarantined .nl names are allocated, whether safeguards prevent hijacking, and whether registrar Domainorder.nl's practices are fair and transparent. The minister denied SIDN sells such lists, explained the first-come-first-served allocation and anti-abuse measures, and said the current registration system appears fair and transparent, while leaving the regulation to the self-regulating SIDN.
Based on the current registration practice explained below, I cannot conclude that the current registration is unfair or not transparent.
Op basis van de huidige registratiepraktijk die hieronder toegelicht wordt, kan ik niet concluderen dat de huidige registratie niet eerlijk zou zijn of niet transparant.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de mislukte concurrentie in de post en het bericht dat veel post door Sandd en Selektmail verkeerd wordt bezorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that Sandd and Selektmail deliver much mail late, whether this undermines competition in postal services, and whether the Netherlands should reconsider opening the postal market given below-minimum-wage practices and pressure on mail secrecy. The state secretary said business mail is not covered by the delivery-time obligation, referred the possible below-cost pricing to the competition authority NMa, defended the full market opening as a European-wide decision, and declined to reconsider it.
I have asked the NMa to conduct an investigation into the possible use of predatory prices on the Dutch postal market.
Ik heb de NMa verzocht een onderzoek te laten verrichten naar het hanteren van eventuele roofprijzen op de Nederlandse postmarkt.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de wijziging van de Faillissementswet (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

An SP MP asks the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers why the draft new insolvency law has stalled for about two years, whether it would save firms and curb bankruptcy fraud, and why curator fees should not come from the estate. The ministers reply that the draft's controversial proposals (abolishing fiscal and UWV preferences, changes to bank positions, labour law) are unacceptable in the crisis, that no savings estimate exists, and that legal stability outweighs a wholesale reform, while rejecting the motion on curator fees.
The draft itself contains no economic analysis, quantitative indicators or impact assessment.
Het voorontwerp zelf bevat geen economische analyse, kwantitatieve indicatoren of een impact assessment.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een promotioneel kansspel: «Heel Nederland pint en wint» (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

An MP asked whether automatic participation in the 'Heel Nederland pint en wint' promotional game via card payments was acceptable, how account holders were informed, whether data use complied with the Wbp, and the odds of winning. The state secretary said automatic participation by paying is not acceptable, will be communicated to Pin B.V., and that data protection compliance is for the College bescherming persoonsgegevens; the winning odds and slogan are for the advertising code commission or a court to judge.

Because the campaign has now ended, I will point out the above to Pin B.V. and urgently request that in any future promotional game it does not assume automatic participation through making a card payment.

Omdat de actie inmiddels is afgelopen, zal ik Pin B.V. op het bovenstaande wijzen en dringend verzoeken bij een toekomstig promotioneel kansspel niet uit te gaan van een automatisch deelnemerschap door het doen van een pinbetaling.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over eventuele Chinese staatssteun bij de verkoop van Draka (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the Economy minister whether Chinese state aid might be involved in the Xinmao bid for Draka, and about the loss of technology, a skewed playing field, and whether foreign takeover rules should be tightened. The minister answered that China Minsheng Banking appears commercial, that the bid is a market matter, that foreign investment brings benefits, and that existing rules sufficiently protect public interests, while promising to monitor the takeover.
I will continue to actively follow the takeover process and keep a close eye on the interests of the Dutch economy, Dutch employees and shareholders.
Ik zal het proces van de overname actief blijven volgen en de belangen van de Nederlandse economie, van de Nederlandse werknemers en van de aandeelhouders scherp in het oog houden.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over twee recente gerechtelijke uitspraken over de thuiskopieheffing en do

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister about two appeals court rulings: one on the private-copy levy (thuiskopieheffing) and one suggesting linking to downloadable files can be punishable, and whether this conflicts with the earlier Mininova case. The government declined to comment substantively because the cases are pending (one at first instance, one in cassation), noted the FTD ruling was unlawful conduct rather than a criminal offence, and promised a letter on copyright measures in early 2011.
Since the court still has to rule in both cases, I cannot at this time go into the substance of these cases.
Aangezien de rechter zich in beide zaken nog dient uit te spreken, kan ik op dit moment niet inhoudelijk op deze zaken ingaan.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bezuinigingen bij de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen die de rechtspraak frustreren (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

An SP MP asked whether budget cuts at the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen caused a suspect in the Almelo hostage case to arrive late at court, and how often late transport happens and what will be done. State Secretary Teeven answered that the delay resulted from a combination of circumstances, not budget cuts, that late arrivals are rare and unregistered, and that no measures are needed.
No, due to a combination of circumstances the suspect arrived late at the court.
Nee, door een samenloop van omstandigheden is de verdachte te laat bij het hof gearriveerd.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bescherming van persoonsgegevens van Europese consumenten in de Verenigde Staten (ingezonden 1 december 2010).

An MP asked the government whether the US Safe Harbor certification adequately protects Europeans' personal data, citing claims of fraud, weak US enforcement, and calls for a binding US-EU data protection treaty. The Secretary of State answered that Safe Harbor is important but not the only legal basis, that the claims about the Australian research are not endorsed, that enforcement is largely by the FTC on complaint, and that the Commission, not the Dutch government, must address enforcement and evaluate the scheme, while offering to approach the Commission.
Enforcement of the Safe Harbor decision, however, is a matter that can only be addressed at European level by the Commission.
De handhaving van de «Safe Harbor»-beschikking is echter een zaak die uitsluitend op Europees niveau door de Commissie kan worden aangepakt.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Irrgang (beiden SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over kinderarbeid bij hazelnotenproductie in Turk

MPs Gesthuizen, Irrgang and Voordewind asked ministers about reports of widespread child labour and school absence in Turkish hazelnut harvesting, and whether Dutch companies and the state should act in line with ILO conventions. The government answered that the problem is complex and mainly the responsibility of Turkey, that Dutch firms should exercise due diligence and will be consulted again in early 2011, and that it will raise the issue bilaterally with Turkey without committing to new investigations of Dutch companies.
Due to the confidentiality of commercially sensitive information, these data cannot be traced back to individual companies.
Vanwege vertrouwelijkheid van bedrijfsgevoelige informatie zijn deze gegevens niet herleidbaar naar individuele bedrijven.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat technologiebedrijven uitwijken naar het buitenland (ingezonden 15 november 2010)

Mr Gesthuizen (SP) asked the minister of Economic Affairs about a report that technology firms are relocating abroad, asking for a response, R&D employment figures for key sectors, and measures to prevent high-value activity leaving. The minister said the survey does not establish a rising trend, reported R&D workforce figures for key sectors falling in line with the business sector, and outlined a forthcoming innovation and business policy with a competitiveness agenda.
In 2011 the cabinet will set out the new economic and innovation policy in a business policy memorandum.
In 2011 zal het kabinet het nieuwe economische en innovatiebeleid vastleggen in een nota bedrijfslevenbeleid.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de zaak van een gedetineerde Nederlander in Mexico (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

Parliamentarian Gesthuizen asked the foreign minister about the detention of Dutch national Bronkhorst in Mexico, including concerns about his fair trial, his safety in detention, and whether the government would raise these with the Mexican justice minister or seek release pending trial. The minister answered that the embassy and consulate have repeatedly raised the case and his safety with Mexican authorities, that the authorities say they cannot influence the independent court, and that a bail request was rejected, with further support to be provided if his lawyer requests it.
If the lawyer decides to do so and requests support, I am willing to provide it.
Indien de advocaat daartoe besluit en daarbij om ondersteuning verzoekt, ben ik daartoe bereid.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister voor Veiligheid en Justitie over het onervaren personeel bij de Schipholbrand en de brandveiligheidsmaatregelen in justitiële inrichtingen (ingezonden

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about inexperienced staff and fire-safety measures at the Schiphol detention centre before and after the 2005 Schiphol fire, including staff surveys, maintenance complaints, training, outsourcing and spending. The state secretary answered that staff concerns led to a survey but the fire halted follow-up, that all executive staff now take fire-safety training, that outsourcing is for flexibility and budget figures were given, and declined to answer questions 9 to 12 in time for the budget debate.
Unfortunately this has not proven possible, but of course this matter can also receive attention in the general consultation with your House on 8 December.
Tot mijn spijt is dit niet mogelijk gebleken, maar uiteraard kan ook in het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer op 8 december aanstaande aandacht worden besteed aan deze materie.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de mislukte concurrentie in de post en het bericht dat de officiële cijfers van TNT over de postbezorging niet

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether reports that TNT's official postal delivery figures are inaccurate would be taken into account in OPTA's investigation into universal service compliance, and how they would change its findings. The state secretary answered that the 95% next-day norm applies only to universal service mail, that the black-book figures use a different scope and method than TNT's, and that OPTA decides whether and how to include such reports in its ongoing investigation.
It is up to OPTA to determine whether and how it can include such reports in the investigation.
Het is aan OPTA om te bepalen of en hoe zij dergelijke berichten kan betrekken bij het onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de verkoop van het belang in het Oostenrijkse Redmail door TNT vanwege de invoering van een nieuwe postwet «die

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Dutch postal company TNT's sale of its stake in Austrian Redmail, and Austrian rules blocking mailbox access, distorts the EU postal market to TNT's disadvantage. The State Secretary answered that TNT had announced limiting Redmail to newspaper delivery, that the Austrian mailbox access issue is a transitional matter to be resolved under new Austrian law, and that the European Commission monitors Postal Directive implementation.
I will raise this issue with the European Commission.
Ik zal hiervoor aandacht vragen bij de Europese Commissie.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman, Gesthuizen en Smits (allen SP) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het weigeren van onderwijs aan asielkinderen (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

SP MPs asked why dozens of children in the Ter Apel asylum facility had gone without secondary education for weeks, and what measures would prevent recurrence. The government answered that unclear funding responsibility between the municipality and COA left education unavailable until mid-October, that education is now available again, and that COA and the municipality agreed on a structural funding solution.
In consultation with COA, a solution to this situation has been reached.
In overleg met het COA is tot een oplossing voor deze situatie gekomen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de opstartproblemen van het Nederlands Register Gerechtelijk Deskundigen (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

An MP asked the minister about criticism that admission standards for the Dutch Register of Forensic Experts are too low, how many experts have registered, and how appointment via the examining magistrate is working. The state secretary rejected the criticism as premature, reported small registration numbers so far, and said the College monitors progress and government will give impulses where needed, without committing to new measures.
The number of expert appointments is not registered centrally.
Het aantal deskundigenbenoemingen wordt niet centraal geregistreerd.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het individueel beoordelen door het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens bij uitzettingen naar Irak (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

SP MP Gesthuizen asked whether every Iraqi asylum seeker facing removal can have his case individually reviewed by the European Court of Human Rights and how the government will inform them of this before removal. Minister Leers replied that Iraqis can still file complaints and interim measures requests with the ECtHR, that the Court will again assess these case by case, and that detained removal candidates have access to a lawyer, though he gave no specific commitment to new notification procedures.
Anyone, including a rejected Iraqi asylum seeker, who believes they are the victim of a violation of the ECHR can therefore submit their complaint to the ECtHR for assessment.
Een ieder, dus ook een uitgeprocedeerde Irakese asielzoeker, die meent dat hij het slachtoffer is van een schending van het EVRM, kan zijn klacht dan ook ter beoordeling voorleggen aan het EHRM.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over nanodeeltjes in voedingsmiddelen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the ministers whether powdered foods on the Dutch market contain manufactured nanoparticles, whether their health, nature and environmental effects are known, what safety requirements, notification duty, and enforcement apply, and whether a precautionary ban is planned. The government answered that nanosilica (part of E551 silica) occurs in some foods, that its effects are still under study, that it opposes a national notification duty but supports EU labelling, and that it sees no grounds for a ban.
The Netherlands is particularly in favour of labelling nanomaterials in foodstuffs.
Nederland is met name voorstander van het etiketteren van nanomaterialen in voedingsmiddelen.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Voordewind (beiden ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over uitbuiting door toeleveranciers van C&A en H&M

MPs from several parties asked the Economic Affairs minister about labour exploitation at Indian suppliers of C&A and H&M, including KPR Mills, its SA8000 certification, and government risk lists. The government answered that the companies have tried to influence the supplier, that it does not subsidise or supervise them, and that it will continue dialogue with the sector and the Indian government without committing to new binding measures.
We see no role for the government in this.
Wij zien hierbij geen rol voor de overheid.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het melden en meten van agressie en geweldsincidenten in penitentiaire inrichtingen (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a fight between inmates and prison staff at PI Rotterdam Hoogvliet, how violence in prisons is recorded, and staffing and safety measures. The state secretary confirmed the incident, reported falling violence figures since 2006, and said staffing norms are unchanged while describing safety measures.
However, I take the staff's feelings seriously and will consult with them to examine what causes the divergent perception.
Ik neem de gevoelens van het personeel evenwel serieus en zal in overleg met hen bekijken wat de afwijkende perceptie veroorzaakt.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemers Verzeke

An SP MP asked whether UWV recruiting part-timers to replace dismissed TNT postal workers amounts to helping TNT's dismissal plan and pressuring working conditions. The minister rejected that view, saying UWV acts within the law and that TNT and its works council and unions bear primary responsibility for the decisions.
The view that the UWV is cooperating in TNT's mass dismissal plan as described in the question is a view I do not share.
De visie dat het UWV meewerkt aan het massaontslagplan van TNT zoals in de vraagstelling beschreven, deel ik niet.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het steeds vaker opsluiten van alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

SP MPs asked the Justice Minister why unaccompanied minor asylum seekers are increasingly detained, whether this violates the Children's Rights Convention, and about its effectiveness and aftercare. The minister answered that about 20 such minors were in immigration detention, that detention is a last resort, that outcomes of detention were tallied, and that the Maasberg regime will be examined for a more open character.
I will inform your House of the outcome once the research has been completed.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomst zodra het onderzoek is afgerond.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Justitie over de berichten dat Wegener «wordt leeggezogen» (ingezonden 7 oktober 2010).

The SP MP asked whether parent company Mecom might hollow out publisher Wegener by outsourcing its ICT activities under shareholder pressure, and what measures the government would take. The minister replied that no evidence of such conduct is known, that Dutch law lets the parent give guidance but Wegener's board remains responsible, that remedies exist via courts, works council and enquiry procedures, and that he sees no reason to contact Mecom's chief executive now.
Under Dutch law a parent company as shareholder may give guidelines and directions to the boards of subsidiaries within the group.
Naar Nederlands recht kan een moedervennootschap als aandeelhouder richtlijnen en aanwijzingen geven aan het bestuur van dochtervennootschappen binnen het concern.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de berichten dat kleine bedrijven in de autoruitherstelbranche uit de markt worden gedrukt door de grote jongens en de

An MP asks the minister for Economic Affairs how the NMa's finding that insurers may steer repair work fits with a price gap of 412 versus 250 euro for windscreen repairs, and whether small repairers are being squeezed out.
