Motie van het lid Ypma c.s. over wegnemen van wettelijke belemmeringen in het reguliere onderwijs
Asks the government to extend the education-time deviation option to regular schools via a bill and to ease funding rules for tailored provision.
the possibility the Expertise Centres Act already offers to deviate from prescribed teaching time also be applied to pupils in regular education, and to prepare a bill for this

de mogelijkheid die de Wet op de expertisecentra nu reeds biedt om af te wijken van de voorgeschreven onderwijstijd ook door te voeren voor leerlingen in het regulier onderwijs en hiervoor een wetsvoorstel voor te bereiden
Motie van de leden Jadnanansing en Straus over loopbaanoriëntatie en -ontwikkeling in het vmbo
Motion asks the Inspectorate of Education to check more closely how career guidance is delivered in vmbo and mbo and report annually.
requests the government to instruct the Inspectorate of Education to better check how career guidance is shaped in vmbo and mbo
verzoekt de regering, de Inspectie van het Onderwijs op te dragen beter te controleren hoe LOB in het vmbo en het mbo wordt vormgegeven
Motie van het lid Straus over de tevredenheid van werkgevers over de aansluiting van opleidingen op de arbeidsmarkt
Motion asking the government to measure employer satisfaction with how education connects to the labour market, starting with vocational training, as a budget indicator.
requests the government to start measuring employer satisfaction with the connection of training to the labour market
verzoekt de regering, de tevredenheid van werkgevers over de aansluiting van opleidingen op de arbeidsmarkt te gaan meten
Amendement van de leden Straus en Jadnanansing over de input van leerlingen op het personeelsbeleid
Requires school personnel policy plans to state how student input on that policy is taken into account.
It is only for the Inspectorate to assess whether the school plan personnel policy contains input from students.
Het is slechts aan de Inspectie om te beoordelen of het schoolplan personeelsbeleid bevat waarin ook de inbreng van leerlingen is meegenomen.
Motie van de leden Straus en Dijkgraaf over toetsen en evalueren van de deugdelijkheidseisen
Asks the government to test the existing quality requirements for education against current supervision practice and report to the House before the summer recess, and to evaluate them periodically.
requests the government to test the existing quality requirements on their current application, consistency and effectiveness in supervision and to inform the House before the summer recess

verzoekt de regering om, de bestaande deugdelijkheidseisen te toetsen op hun hedendaagse toepassing, consistentie en effectiviteit in het toezicht en de Kamer hierover voor het zomerreces te informeren
Amendement van de leden Straus en Dijkgraaf over het invoeren van een evaluatiebepaling
Adds a clause requiring the minister to report to the States General within five years on the effectiveness and effects of the law in practice.
Motie van het lid Straus over een plan van aanpak voor buurtaalonderwijs in Nederland
Asks the government to consult border-region schools and draw up a plan to strengthen neighbouring-language education and inform the House before summer.
requests the government to consult educational institutions in the border region
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te treden met onderwijsinstellingen in de grensregio
Amendement van het lid Straus waarmee een dekkend aanbod aan onderwijsondersteuning gegarandeerd blijft.
Lets school boards in a special-education cooperative set their own admission criteria for special groups with unanimous consent, and adjusts the related procedure references.
the cooperative body may set criteria included in the support plan

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus over het starten van een Vrije School in Schin op Geul

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Education whether a Waldorf (Vrije School) can be opened in Schin op Geul, and whether current law allows such initiatives and transitional arrangements. The State Secretary answers that current law blocks new schools and dislocations in this case, but a bill (Meer Ruimte voor Nieuwe Scholen) is in preparation to ease this.
That is why I have a bill in preparation that will in the future offer more options to start a school based on actual interest and a quality test.
Daarom heb ik een wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding dat in de toekomst meer mogelijkheden biedt om op basis van daadwerkelijke belangstelling en een toets op de kwaliteit, een school te kunnen starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Veldman inzake het bericht Technieklokaal Winterswijk bang voor sluiting door te weinig geld

MPs Straus and Veldman asked whether the government would close the funding gap threatening the Winterswijk technology classroom, which faces closure without it. The state secretary said schools decide how to spend funds, that the classroom can continue under school choice through 2020, and that the national government does not give individual grants to support organisations.
The national government does not give individual contributions to supporting organisations; this runs via the schools themselves.
De rijksoverheid geeft geen individuele bijdragen aan ondersteunende organisaties, dit loopt via scholen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en Straus over het bericht ‘Inzet budgetcoaches Vebego: sociaal en slim. Nu het onderwijs nog!’

MPs Moors and Straus asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about budget coaches for employees, prevention of debt, and financial education in schools (kerndoelen 35 and 42), and about measuring effectiveness and using Nibud rules of thumb. The State Secretary welcomed budget coaching and prevention, said curriculum responsibility lies with OCW, cited existing projects and the WiG platform, and said the effectiveness of financial education cannot yet be stated overall.
Including financial skills, learning to manage money and learning to budget in the school curriculum is the responsibility of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.
Het opnemen van financiële vaardigheden, het leren omgaan met geld en het leren budgetteren, in het curriculum voor scholen is de verantwoordelijkheid van het Ministerie van OCW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Straus over het artikel ‘Schoolbestuur, waar is uw jaarrekening?’

MPs Duisenberg and Straus asked about a press report finding that many school boards do not publish their annual reports, despite agreements in the Good Governance Code, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary confirms the problem, says the government will amend sector laws and the reporting regulation to require publication if the agreements are not kept, and refers to the Inspectorate's forthcoming report.

Afterwards, further instructions on publishing the full annual report, consisting of the board report, the financial statements and other relevant documents, will be given in the Regulation on Education Annual Reporting.

Daarna worden in de Regeling Jaarverslaggeving Onderwijs nadere aanwijzingen omtrent de openbaarmaking van het gehele jaarverslag, bestaand uit zowel het bestuursverslag, de jaarrekening en overige relevante stukken gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus inzake aanmeldleeftijd in het onderwijs

An MP asked the state secretary whether a Hague convenant setting a single enrolment age and limiting parents to one school application complies with the WPO and WVO, and what can be done about it. The government answered that the convenant conflicts with the law, that it will be adjusted with the municipality and school boards, and that it will raise the issue with schools and examine any other cases that come to light.
For that reason the convenant must be adjusted in a way that fits within the framework of the WPO.
Daarom moet het convenant worden aangepast op een manier dat het binnen de kaders van de WPO past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus over diploma-erkenning in Duitsland

MP Straus asked the Minister of Education about recognition of Dutch vocational diplomas in Germany, the motion to negotiate with German states, and timelines. The Minister said recognition problems are limited to about 150 regulated professions, ongoing bilateral talks with North Rhine-Westphalia and Lower Saxony are under way with expert working groups, and no deadline can yet be given.
Work is being done hard on implementing the motion. I cannot yet name a deadline, because I cannot decide this alone.
Er wordt hard gewerkt aan de uitvoering van de motie. Een deadline kan ik nog niet noemen, omdat ik dit niet alléén kan beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus, Aukje de Vries en Moors inzake vmbo-leerlingen die aangeven onvoldoende kennis van geldzaken te hebben

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Finance about a survey showing vmbo pupils feel insufficiently informed about money matters, and what schools, the curriculum and the Wijzer in Geldzaken programme do about it. The government answers that money management is embedded in existing curriculum goals and subjects, that monitoring of school practice is not done centrally, and that prevention is preferred to municipal debt write-offs.
However, it is not monitored nationally in what way and with what intensity schools pay attention to societal themes such as managing money, nor why they do so.
Er wordt echter niet landelijk gemonitord op welke wijze en met welke intensiteit scholen aandacht besteden aan maatschappelijke thema's zoals omgaan met geld, en ook niet waarom zij dat zo doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Lodders inzake de doorstroom van voortgezet speciaal onderwijs naar regulier voortgezet onderwijs

MPs Straus and Lodders asked the state secretary about a havo pupil whose examination results from special secondary education could not be carried over to regular secondary education, and how pupils transfer and are informed. The state secretary answered that results can be transferred if the receiving school has an exemption, that transfer need not cause delay, and that the specific case was resolved by granting such an exemption.
This has already happened. There was contact between the school and the Ministry of OCW to discuss this specific case.
Dit is reeds gebeurd. Er is contact geweest tussen de school en het Ministerie van OCW om deze specifieke casus te bespreken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Bosman inzake samenwerking tussen scholen in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen die worden geconfronteerd met leerlingendaling

Two VVD MPs asked the education state secretary about cooperation between secondary schools in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen facing declining pupil numbers, including whether a full range of school types should be maintained. The state secretary said schools' boards are primarily responsible for provision and coordination, that OCW supports cooperation through a regional process facilitator and earlier advisory support, and that the boards must intensify cooperation.
The starting point is that school boards in the region are themselves responsible for the educational provision and its mutual coordination.
Uitgangspunt daarbij is dat schoolbesturen in de regio zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het onderwijsaanbod en de onderlinge afstemming daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus inzake techniekopleidingen in het nieuwe vmbo

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether vocational (vmbo) schools will offer fewer specialised technical programmes because of higher costs, as VNO-NCW feared. The State Secretary replied that vmbo schools receive higher funding per student, that transition costs can be covered from reserves, that regional planning should preserve a broad offering, and that a sample survey of schools' profile choices would be carried out with results expected in May.
A sample survey is currently being carried out, partly due to concerns from VNO/NCW, to gain more insight into the choices schools intend to make in their offering of profiles.
Er wordt op dit moment vanwege de zorgen van onder andere VNO/NCW een steekproef uitgevoerd om meer zicht te krijgen op de keuzes die scholen voornemens zijn te maken in hun aanbod aan profielen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Straus inzake scholen die ouders onder druk zetten om hun kind ADHD-medicatie te geven

Two VVD MPs asked whether schools pressure parents to medicate children with ADHD medication or be transferred to special education, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary says schools may not give medical advice, must meet their duty of care under the Passend Onderwijs law, and that no inspection investigation was opened due to few complaints, while a joint action plan on ADHD care is being pursued.
Parents may not be forced by schools to give medication to their child.
Ouders mogen door scholen niet gedwongen worden om medicatie aan hun kind te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus inzake het omruilen van christelijke voor islamitische feestdagen

MP Straus asked the State Secretary whether schools may swap Christian holidays for Islamic ones, and how schools should promote Dutch traditions, values and national holidays, including whether teachers are equipped to discuss sensitive topics. The State Secretary replied that only non-officially recognised days may be swapped, that civic education already covers national values and holidays, that teachers mostly feel equipped with support from School en Veiligheid, and that overlap with sector organisations PO-Raad and VO-raad already exists.
Swapping a generally recognised public holiday for an Islamic holiday is not at issue.
Het inruilen van een algemeen erkende feestdag voor een islamitische feestdag is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus inzake een boete voor de Leidse 'plasticjager'

An MP asked whether the state secretary would allow more flexibility in the compulsory education law for children travelling abroad with parents, given a fine imposed on a Leiden 'plastic hunter' family. The state secretary answered that a bill will allow up to six months of distance learning per level under strict conditions, but that until then current rules apply and truancy officers cannot yet act in the spirit of the new flexibility.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus inzake het niet verlenen van een ontheffing aan Nederlandse kinderen woonachtig in Duitsland die onderwijs in Nederland willen volgen

MP Straus asked whether Germany's North Rhine-Westphalia state refusing exemptions from compulsory schooling for Dutch-national children living in Germany who want to attend school in the Netherlands is contrary to EU free movement and whether other border regions are affected. The Secretary of State answered that the exemption was granted after all in one case, that the state government confirmed no policy change, that he will ask the German counterpart to address the local authority, and that the requested follow-up information took longer but the answers are sent.
I will ask my NRW counterpart to consult with the local authority concerned, to prevent recurrence.
Ik zal mijn collega van NRW vragen in overleg te treden met de betrokken lokale autoriteit, om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Straus over de vervangersproblematiek

MPs Mulder and Straus asked whether the minister knew of a Catholic primary school foundation's letter to parents saying children might be sent home because substitute teachers can now only be engaged three times for a half-day under the new law, and what the government would do. The minister says sending children home is undesirable, notes the sector's cao runs until 1 July 2016 so current rules still apply, and says the substitute problem will be addressed in cao negotiations.
That is why collective labour agreement parties can make agreements deviating from the law, both for on-call contracts (zero-hours or min/max contracts) and for temporary contracts.
Daarom kunnen cao-partijen van de wet afwijkende afspraken maken, zowel als het gaat om oproepcontracten (nuluren- of min/max contracten) als om tijdelijke contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Teeven over problemen bij de inschrijving voor de Marechaussee opleiding

MPs Straus and Teeven asked the State Secretary of Education and the Minister of Defence about raised entry requirements for a one-year mbo level 2 security course that feeds into the Royal Marechaussee training, which excluded vmbo basic-track pupils without prior communication. The minister acknowledged the requirement was not in line with law, said the ROCs failed to inform the KMar, promised the pupils would be admitted via the usual selection, and committed to requiring ROCs to restore the legal entry requirement and rename the course.
The ROCs concerned will have to bring the entry requirement back to the statutory entry requirement for vmbo-bb.
De betrokken ROC's zullen de instroomeis terug moeten brengen naar de wettelijke instroomeis vmbo-bb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Anne Mulder over de gevolgen van de nieuwe Wet werk en zekerheid (Wwz) voor het onderwijs

MPs Straus and Anne Mulder asked whether the new Wwz limit of three flexible contracts would cause problems replacing teachers and substitutes in primary and secondary education, and whether a sector exception to the chain rule was needed. The minister answered that substitution remains feasible through internal flexibility, substitute pools, on-call and min/max contracts, and cao deviations, so no sector exception is needed, though he will provide information and help find solutions.
An exception for education is therefore not necessary.
Een uitzondering voor het onderwijs is daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Straus over het bericht ‘Schrik na drie steekpartijen op school in week’

MPs Tellegen and Straus asked the state secretary and justice minister about school stabbings and rising reported weapon possession among pupils, including its causes, the types of weapons, and measures to curb it. The government answered that it is addressing weapon possession through school safety policy, checklists and the Convenant Veilige School, but that the monitor cannot confirm an objective rise in weapon possession, which may reflect stricter reporting and zero-tolerance policy.
I will also have the checklist for introducing weapon possession controls at schools updated.
Ook laat ik de «checklist invoering controle op wapenbezit scholen» actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Elias en Straus over het functioneren van L1 als rampenzender tijdens de asbest-situatie in Roermond

Two VVD MPs asked whether regional broadcaster L1 should function as a disaster broadcaster during the Roermond asbestos fire, how quickly it reported compared with national media, and whether the government will improve regional disaster reporting. The minister replied that L1 was not formally activated as calamity broadcaster, that the safety region chose other channels, and that an evaluation with the province, safety regions and L1 will follow.
For the timeline of journalistic coverage of the incident on the various platforms of broadcaster L1 and other media, I refer you to the broadcasters concerned.
Voor de tijdlijn van de journalistieke verslaggeving van het incident op de verschillende platforms van omroep L1 en andere media, verwijs ik u naar de betreffende omroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Straus over de effecten van Voor- en vroegschoolse educatie (VVE)

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Education about a Radboud University study finding little effect of early childhood education (VVE), its relation to the Inspectorate's critical 2013 report, whether quality will improve, and measurability and segregation issues. The state secretary disputes the study's conclusion as not supported (no baseline or control group, quality still lagging 2007-2011), promises a progress report in November and a 'pre-cool' cohort study in 2015, and declines to tighten effectiveness scrutiny.
The conclusion that VVE has hardly any effect cannot be drawn on the basis of the report mentioned.
De conclusie dat vve nauwelijks effect heeft kan op basis van het genoemde rapport niet worden getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Lucas over het bericht dat MBO scholen nee moeten verkopen

MPs Straus and Lucas asked the Minister of Education about reports that MBO schools must turn away students due to shortages of internship places. The minister acknowledged shortages in some sectors, placed responsibility on employers and schools, and said new study guides and quality agreements would address the issue rather than direct intervention.
I therefore make an urgent appeal to businesses to take their responsibility to combat youth unemployment.
Ik doe dan ook een klemmend beroep op het bedrijfsleven om zijn verantwoordelijkheid te nemen om jeugdwerkloosheid tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus over het rapport van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs inzake de kwaliteit van schoolleiders

An MP asked the education minister how to interpret the Inspectorate's finding that school leaders fall short of their profession's own competence standards, and what training and quality measures will follow. The state secretary answered that leaders generally function adequately, that a school leaders' register, a professional profile, training accreditation and extra professionalisation budgets are being pursued, and that the effects are not yet measurable.
The inspection research shows that the quality of school leaders is related to the quality of lessons.
Het inspectieonderzoek toont aan dat de kwaliteit van schoolleiders samenhangt met de kwaliteit van lessen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Duisenberg over Duits in de grensregio

MPs Straus and Duisenberg asked the education minister about shortages of German teachers, recruiting German teachers, and the role of German in border-region vocational education. The minister answered that shortages are a regional matter, that a German-teacher training programme and a small pilot already exist, and that she opposes replacing English with German in mbo, instead encouraging border institutions to use existing flexibility.
I have therefore, by letter, called on mbo institutions in the border regions to make greater use of the possibilities the mbo system offers them.
Ik heb daarom met een brief de mbo-instellingen in de grensregio's opgeroepen meer gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheden die het mbo-stelsel hen biedt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Straus en Neppérus over het verschil in btw voor naschoolse programma’s in het primair onderwijs

MPs Straus and Neppérus asked why some after-school educational programmes in primary education are VAT-exempt and others are not, and whether technology programmes should be exempt too. The State Secretary explained that only programmes derived from the publicly funded regular curriculum or tied to primary education are exempt, that CRKBO registration does not apply to primary-school programmes, and that no separate technology exemption is planned.
No separate statutory VAT exemption is provided for teaching programmes focused on technology.
Er is niet voorzien in een aparte wettelijke vrijstelling van btw voor lesprogramma's die zijn gericht op techniek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Straus over het advies van de KNAW: Digitale geletterdheid in het voortgezet onderwijs. Vaardigheden en attitudes voor de 21ste eeuw

Rep. Straus (VVD) asked the state secretary for Education about the KNAW advice on digital literacy in secondary education, including whether informatics is in dire straits, whether uptake of the subject (5.3%) should be raised, and how US initiative Code.org fits. The state secretary disputed the 'dire' characterisation and the 5.3% figure (11.2% of havo and 11.9% of vwo students chose it), said he will commission SLO research on effective measures, and promised a broader reaction before summer.
I will instruct the Netherlands Institute for Curriculum Development (SLO) to carry out research into the most effective actions.
Ik zal de Stichting voor de Leerplanontwikkeling (SLO) opdracht geven om een onderzoek uit te voeren naar de meest effectieve acties.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Straus over “Bumpy start for Pan European MOOCs”

MPs Duisenberg and Straus asked the education minister about reports of a bumpy start for the pan-European MOOC platform OpenupEd, and about US and Dutch online-learning participation figures. The minister answered that Dutch higher education has large opportunities in ICT-supported and open online learning, cited SURF, Wikiwijs and EU initiatives, and promised a policy letter in autumn 2013 on MOOCs and possible regulatory barriers.
I have promised your House to send a policy letter on this in the coming autumn.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd hierover in het komend najaar een beleidsbrief te sturen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Straus over het huiswerkblad van Maandtaak

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether a Maandtaak primary-school homework sheet on modern farming (on the farm, chicken, calf, pig) gives a one-sided picture, who is responsible for the content, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that the content of educational materials is not for the government to assess, that schools choose their own methods and sources, and that the government does not steer method choice, so no action is committed.
It is not for the (national) government to assess the content of educational materials.
Het is niet aan de (rijks) overheid om de inhoud van educatieve materialen te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen Straus over hoge frequentie en duur separeren van psychiatrische patiënten

An MP asks the minister about Erasmus MC research showing coercive seclusion of psychiatric patients in the Netherlands lasts far longer than elsewhere, and what will be done about training, the multidisciplinary guideline, patient wishes and the Verplichte GGZ bill. The minister says the research was not commissioned by her ministry, outlines the Bestuurlijk Akkoord GGZ and sector-led guideline work, and promises to send the Verplichte GGZ memorandum in autumn.
I expect to send the memorandum on the report on the Verplichte GGZ Act, together with the amendment memorandum, to your House in the autumn.
Ik verwacht de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag van de Wet verplichte ggz tezamen met de nota van wijziging van de Wet verplichte ggz in het najaar naar uw Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord vragen Straus over het geweld tegen hulpverleners in de psychiatrie dat vaak onbestraft blijft

An MP asked the government about violence against psychiatric staff that often goes unpunished, including low reporting rates, weak prosecution, and differences between institutions and patient groups. The minister answered that the government is taking the issue seriously, points to the Actieplan Veilig werken in de zorg, the ELA agreements and the new Politie-GGZ convenant, and reports no evidence of differences in prioritisation or treatment.
In it we have included measures aimed at the care sector to improve the legal approach to the perpetrator, including an increase in willingness to report.
Daarin hebben wij op de zorgsector gerichte maatregelen opgenomen om de juridische aanpak van de veroorzaker te verbeteren, inclusief een verhoging van de aangiftebereidheid.

Vragen van het lid Straus (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over diverse gemeenten die een eigen wijze van uitvoering van het toezicht en de handhaving van de wet kinderopvang hanteren (ingezonde

An MP asks the minister about several municipalities, including Boekel, that deviate from the statutory childcare supervision regime by cutting inspections or shifting them to childcare agencies. The minister replies that such approaches conflict with the Wko, that the Inspectie will discuss it with Boekel, and that a binding instruction is possible but not currently expected.
I have urgently requested municipalities to carry out the inspections and to adhere to the system of the Wko.
Ik heb gemeenten dringend verzocht de inspecties uit te voeren en zich te houden aan het systeem van de Wko.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum (CDA) en Straus (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de gemeentelijke leges voor opname van gastouders in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang (LRK) (ingezonden 15

Two MPs asked the minister why municipalities charge fees to register childminders in the national childcare register, what those costs are, and whether central registration is planned. The minister answered that municipalities are legally entitled to charge cost-recovery fees, that the funding allocation may be refined for 2012, and that centralising only the registration step would yield no efficiency gain, while promising to inform parliament by end of April.
The precise costs of the action a municipality takes to register a childminder in the LRK are not known to me.
De precieze kosten van de handeling die een gemeente verricht om een gastouder op te nemen in het LRK, zijn mij niet bekend.

Vragen van de leden Straus, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bosman en De Boer (allen VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over gevolgen voor de werkgelegenheid door centralisatie overheidsdiensten (inge

MPs of the VVD asked whether preserving administrative employment in shrinking regions is crucial and what measures the government takes so that central government reorganisations strengthen the economic structure and jobs in those regions. Minister Donner answered that regional authorities are responsible for regional economic vitality, that location choices weigh efficiency and service above regional employment, and that earlier analysis showed no disproportionate regional job effects.
The initiative for successful cooperation between these parties lies with governments at the regional level.
Het initiatief voor een succesvolle samenwerking tussen deze partijen ligt bij de overheden op regionale schaal.
Vragen van het lid Straus (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en over misbruik in kinderdagverblijven in Amsterdam (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister how childcare organisations' structures and information sharing, the LRK register, GGD inspections and training may have allowed abuse of children by a worker in Amsterdam childcare centres. The minister answered that an independent investigation requested by the Amsterdam mayor has been started and will last three months, and that he will report his conclusions and address the questions once the results are known.
Once the results of this investigation are known, I will inform you further about my conclusions.
Zodra de resultaten van dit onderzoek bekend zijn, zal ik u nader inlichten over mijn conclusies.
Vragen van de leden Straus en Neppérus (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over megafraude met subsidie kinderoppas (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a newspaper report on large-scale fraud with childcare subsidies, asking about its size, the planned double checks, whether controls would be intensified, and what structural measures and recovery steps were envisaged. The State Secretary answered that millions of euros are likely involved, described the risk-based checks and a doorlichting of rules and implementation, and said all means including forced recovery and prosecution would be used.
Depending on the outcome of this review, it will be examined whether and which further measures should be taken.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomst van deze doorlichting, zal bezien worden of en welke maatregelen verder moeten worden genomen.
Vragen van de leden Straus, Venrooy-van Ark , Mulder en Van der Burg (allen VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zorg voor autisten (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

Four VVD MPs asked the health minister about the quality of care for people with autism, including misdiagnosis, separation and long admissions, and whether the government can pressure institutions. The minister acknowledged specialist knowledge is scarce, pointed to good practices and early-detection initiatives, said she cannot directly pressure institutions but the IGZ can investigate complaints, and agreed diagnosis must improve.
I cannot directly exert pressure on institutions to improve care for autistic people. If there are complaints about care, the IGZ can launch an investigation on that basis.
Ik kan niet direct druk uitoefenen op de instellingen om de zorg voor autisten te verbeteren. Als er klachten zijn met betrekking tot de zorg dan kan de IGZ op basis hiervan een onderzoek instellen.
Vragen van het lid Straus (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de opleidingseisen voor gastouders (ingezonden 12 november 2010).

MP Straus asked the minister whether the official diploma list for childminders (gastouders) should be expanded so that a HBO childcare diploma is recognised, and whether the list would be revised quickly given the 31 December 2010 deadline for childcare allowance. The minister declined to comment on individual diplomas, said the branch proposed a equivalence committee, and that the government is examining how to implement and legally anchor it before adding diplomas.
I want to respond positively to the proposal from the sector.
Ik wil positief reageren op het voorstel van de branche.

requests the government to make the effects of the AOW pension gap transparent, weigh them integrally and reconsider them in the Defence white paper

Asks the government to pay the structural 10 million euro for top sport to NOC*NSF as soon as possible and to inform the House on its use.
requests the government to pay out the extra 10 million euro in the 2018 budget to NOC*NSF as soon as possible

Asks the government to give the external investigation commission on sexual intimidation in the armed forces enough resources and powers to examine practice within operational units.
requests the government to give the commission doing this independent external investigation sufficient resources and means to also examine practice within the operational units

ook extra alert te zijn op de signalen die op een angstcultuur zouden kunnen wijzen binnen Defensie

requests the government to offer the victims of the Schaarsbergen incidents psychological help and personal guidance

Asks government to have the Health Council advise on retention periods for implant patient data, given a planned extension to twenty years and the Council's earlier advice of at least thirty years.
requests the government to have the Health Council issue advice on the retention period of implant data

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Staaij c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 22 over het terugdraaien van de bezuiniging op de Stichting Adoptievoorzieningen

Asks the government to consult with the VNG and ministerial transition bureaus on cooperation for decentralisation and report to the House in spring 2012.

to establish an independent legal body within the armed forces responsible for issuing university diplomas
een onafhankelijk rechtsorgaan binnen de krijgsmacht te realiseren dat verantwoordelijk wordt voor de uitgave van universitaire diploma's
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder over het bericht dat een Iraniër in Duitsland veroordeeld is voor brandstichting in opdracht van de Iraanse staat

MPs Ceder and Brekelmans asked the Foreign Minister whether a German court ruling convicting an Iranian for arson on a synagogue on Iranian state orders could support listing the IRGC as a terrorist organisation, and whether the government would use it in its efforts. The minister said the EU Legal Service advice is confidential, that several member states support listing but there is no Council consensus, and that the Netherlands strongly supports listing and will use all available avenues.
The advice of the Legal Service of the Council of the European Union is confidential.
Het advies van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad van de Europese Unie is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Rwandese ambassade in Den Haag intimideert en bedreigt critici van regime-Kagame in Nederland'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the ministers about reports that the Rwandan embassy in The Hague intimidated and threatened critics of the Kagame regime, including allegations of plotted assassinations, surveillance of demonstrators, and the role of the 1F procedure and Dutch rule-of-law aid. The minister answered that the ambassador enjoys immunity, that the government condemns foreign interference and has summoned the ambassador, that OM and police handle prosecution, that Dutch rule-of-law aid totalled EUR 144 million and was positively assessed, and that a more intensive anti-interference approach is underway with further letters promised.
It should be noted that the ambassador in the Netherlands enjoys inviolability and immunity, which stands in the way of (supporting) an investigation.
Daarbij moet worden opgemerkt dat de ambassadeur in Nederland onschendbaarheid en immuniteit geniet hetgeen (het ondersteunen van) een onderzoek in de weg staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Becker, Erkens, Paternotte en Bamenga over ‘het bericht dat de nieuwe partij NL Plan steunt op organisaties verbonden aan de Chinese Communistische Partij’

MPs from VVD and D66 asked ministers about reports that the new party NL Plan received support from organisations linked to the Chinese Communist Party, and about foreign interference and the effectiveness of the ban on foreign donations under the Dutch party financing law. The minister answered that NL Plan reported no donations above the threshold, that enforcement and oversight of the ban are still being assessed, and that a study on Chinese interference and a new political parties law are in preparation.

I would like to refer to the extensive media coverage of the recently arrested employee of German AfD lead candidate Maximilian Krah, who allegedly spied for China, and to the Belgian politician Filip de Winter, who allegedly worked for years on behalf of the Chinese Communist Party.

Ik verwijs hier graag naar de uitgebreide berichtgeving in de media over de recent gearresteerde medewerker van de Duitse AfD-lijsttrekker Maximilian Krah die gespioneerd zou hebben voor China en over de Belgische politicus Filip de Winter die jarenlang in opdracht van de Chinese Communistische Partij gewerkt zou hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Brekelmans over het optreden van de Russische propagandisten Vladimir Pozner en Ivan Urgant in Theater Amsterdam op 28 mei 2024

MPs Martens-America and Brekelmans asked the government about a Dutch theatre performance by Russian propagandists Pozner and Urgant, including its risk of spreading Russian disinformation and how it fits EU and Dutch sanctions and anti-interference policy. The government answered that free expression weighs heavily, that theatres decide their own programming, and that no coercion by a state actor was identified, while promising no specific new step beyond restating existing policy.
In a democratic constitutional state freedom of expression is a great good and must weigh heavily alongside protection of the democratic constitutional state.
In een democratische rechtstaat is vrijheid van meningsuiting een groot goed en deze dient zwaar te wegen naast de bescherming van de democratische rechtsstaat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de voortgang van het programma Grensverleggende IT (GrIT)

An MP asked the state secretary for Defence about the progress of the GrIT programme, including the new ICT assessment advice, business case, costs and timing of contract signing. The government confirmed it will inform parliament before irreversible steps, shares the advice and response, but defers details on costs, the business case and timing until a decision is made.
As you can read in the response to the BIT advice, I am deliberating on the future course of the programme. Once I have decided on this, I will inform the House.
Zoals u in de reactie op het BIT-advies kunt lezen, beraad ik mij over het vervolg van het programma. Nadat ik hierover heb besloten zal ik de Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de wachttijden van veteranen voor keuringen door het ABP

An MP asked the Defence Minister why veterans face unacceptably long waits for military disability pension assessments at the ABP, including a one-year extension of reassessment deadlines. The minister attributed the delays to a shortage of insurance physicians, outlined hiring and outsourcing measures, provided case and appeal figures, and promised to clear backlogs by 2020 and cooperate with the ombudsman's inquiry.
Due to capacity problems at the ABP's Social Medical Examination Company (SMO) – problems that also occur elsewhere – it was decided to suspend the reassessments planned for 2018.
Vanwege capaciteitsproblemen bij het Bedrijf Sociaal Medisch Onderzoek (SMO) van het ABP – problemen die ook elders spelen – is besloten om de in 2018 geplande termijnherbeoordelingen op te schorten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bruins Slot over het vervoer tijdens de Formule 1 in Zandvoort

MPs Amhaouch and Bruins Slot asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about transport capacity to Zandvoort for the Formula 1 Grand Prix, including visitor numbers, the mobility plan, and rail upgrades. The State Secretary answered that the organiser and municipality are responsible for the mobility plan, that the line can run about six trains per hour with extra measures, and that ProRail is studying the cost and timeline for further upgrades.
Ensuring a mobility plan and good accessibility for the event is the responsibility of the organiser in cooperation with the municipality of Zandvoort.
Het zorgdragen voor een mobiliteitsplan en een goede bereikbaarheid van het evenement is de verantwoordelijkheid van de organisatie in samenwerking met de gemeente Zandvoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Bruins Slot over de algemene ledenvergadering van de Koninklijke Bond van Oranjeverenigingen en het manifest ‘Versterk vrijwilligerswerk’

MPs Bruins Slot and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers about the Koninklijke Bond van Oranjeverenigingen's manifesto on volunteering, including regulatory burden, asylum-seeker volunteering, training, municipal subsidy rules and event bureaucracy. The government supports the goals and the activities of Oranjeverenigingen, declines to abolish the volunteer declaration or change several rules, promises to examine further reductions in event regulation, and answered the final question (on Koningsdag 2019) as not answered in time.
The cabinet is also exploring other options to further reduce the regulatory burden of organising events.
Het kabinet onderzoekt daarnaast andere mogelijkheden om de regeldruk bij het organiseren van evenementen verder te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het item ‘Inspectie tikt Defensie op de vingers voor omgang gevaarlijke stoffen’

An MP asked why the state secretary of Defence had not made clearer the many warnings from the labour inspectorate on carcinogenic substances and chromium-6 exposure, and what would be done about them. The minister acknowledged the inspectorate's findings, said they were partly expected within an ongoing improvement programme with completion targeted for end 2020, and declined to comment further on the open enforcement process.
This is an ongoing process on which I cannot make a statement.
Dit is een lopend traject waarover ik geen uitspraak kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het tegengaan van ongewenste toegang tot het Netherlands Armed Forces Integrated Network (NAFIN)

MP Bruins Slot asked about protecting the Defence NAFIN fibre network from unwanted state and non-state influence, espionage and sabotage, including ownership, shared use by other government bodies, supply chain risks and a risk analysis. The Minister answered that NAFIN is autonomously managed by Defence, that shared use is virtually separated, and that a risk analysis exists but cannot be made public, while committing to no new report.
A risk analysis is part of the existing information security plan of NAFIN. This is not suitable for public disclosure.
Een risicoanalyse is onderdeel van het bestaande informatiebeveiligingsplan van het NAFIN. Dit leent zich niet voor openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over het bericht dat de VS Turkije uit F-35 programma dreigen te gooien om Russische raketten

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Van Helvert asked whether the US halting F-35 equipment deliveries to Turkey over its planned purchase of Russian S-400 air defence systems is accurate, whether Nederland agrees with the US reasoning, and whether Dutch industry could take over Turkish F-35 work. The government confirmed the US decision, shared US concerns, said it has raised them bilaterally and in NATO, and declined to speculate on further steps while Turkey remains a partner.
At this stage it is undesirable to speculate openly about possible follow-up steps in the programme.
Het is onwenselijk om in dit stadium openlijk te speculeren over mogelijke vervolgstappen in het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over antidrone maatregelen bij vliegvelden

The CDA MP Bruins Slot asked the ministers of Defence and Justice and Security about counter-drone measures at airports, covering current capabilities, near-term additions, a knowledge programme, cooperation with partners and other countries. The minister answered that Defence has radar and electronic jamming capabilities but use within the Netherlands is limited by legal frameworks, that procurement and a 2019-2022 knowledge programme are underway, and that cooperation with the Justice and Security ministry and foreign partners continues, withholding operational details for sensitivity reasons.
Regarding the number of systems and specifications, I cannot make a statement due to operational sensitivity.
Over aantallen systemen en specificaties kan ik vanwege de operationele gevoeligheid geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Kazerne moet lang wachten op keuken'

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder asked why the kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen faces a long wait for new construction and whether it could be accelerated. The State Secretary answered that new building requires several lengthy steps, that an interim kitchen will open in the second half of 2019, and that procurement and appeal rules leave no room to speed up construction.
Based on the laws and regulations on procurement, objection and appeal, there are no options to speed up the new construction.
Op basis van de wet- en regelgeving op het gebied van aanbesteding, bezwaar en beroep zijn er geen mogelijkheden om de nieuwbouw te versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over de regelgeving voor verkeersregelaars

MPs Bruins Slot and Van der Molen ask why the 2017 amendment to the traffic controllers regulation makes it harder for volunteer event traffic controllers and their organisations, including the lack of substitution and individual-only e-instruction. The minister replies that the changes aimed to reduce administrative burden, that the process is supported digitally, that individual e-instruction is intentional, and that a meeting with SVNL is possible but no regulatory change is proposed.

I am always willing to talk with SVNL, but it is already possible to obtain appointment (after completing the e-instruction) as a volunteer event traffic controller for a period of one year per municipality.

Ik ben altijd bereid om in gesprek te gaan met SVNL, alleen is het al mogelijk om de aanstelling (na het afronden van de e-instructie) tot vrijwillige evenementenverkeersregelaar voor een periode van een jaar per gemeente te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over antidrone maatregelen bij vliegvelden

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands can detect and counter drones at airports and critical infrastructure after the Gatwick disruption, and whether the armed forces can assist civil authorities. The minister answered that Defence has detection and some interception capabilities, that counter-drone capacity is being expanded in the short term, and that police and Marechaussee can request support through the competent authority.
Defence is expanding these counter-drone capabilities in the short term.
Defensie vergroot deze counter-drone capaciteiten op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Peters over de zorg voor en begeleiding van (oud-)topsporters

MPs Bruins Slot and Peters asked about mental health and career-end support for current and former top athletes, including a symposium, prevalence research, whether TeamNL offers structural post-career support, and whether a dedicated programme for former athletes is needed. The minister answered that research shows mental problems comparable to the general population, that TeamNL@Work provides tailored post-career support, and that NOC*NSF will explore enriching it with input from former athletes.
The project is still under development and NOC*NSF will in the coming period look at how current support can be further enriched, with input from former top athletes.
Het project is nog volop in ontwikkeling en NOC*NSF zal de komende tijd dan ook kijken naar hoe de huidige ondersteuning verder verrijkt kan worden, met de inbreng van oud-topsporters.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Behoud gebouwen schietbanen Leusderheide’

Two CDA MPs asked the government whether it values the former Leusderheide shooting-range buildings as cultural-historical military heritage and what Defence and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf are doing to preserve them. The minister replied that no specific reuse or demolition plans exist, the buildings are in the maintenance programme, and a final position will follow a broader heritage vision and action plan.

Based on the coherent vision and action plan for management, preservation, research and public presentation of Second World War heritage and archaeology that I promised you, I will determine my position.

Op basis van de samenhangende visie en het actieplan voor beheer, behoud, onderzoek en aan een breed publiek tonen van erfgoed en archeologie uit de Tweede Wereldoorlog dat ik u heb toegezegd, zal ik mijn standpunt bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat het AMC honderden hoofden van omstreden Amerikaans bedrijf kocht

The MP Bruins Slot asked the Minister of Health about reports that the AMC bought hundreds of heads from a controversial US body-brokering company, including whether financial incentives for body donation and imports of body parts are acceptable under Dutch law. The Minister answered that paying donors beyond their costs is prohibited or will be, that commercial use of body material is acceptable if donors are properly informed, and that the forthcoming Wzl bill will regulate imported material, while not committing to a new import rule for body parts.
I intend to set rules on this in the Wzl.
Ik ben voornemens hierover regels te stellen in de Wzl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Rog over uitbreiding regeling Gratis VOG

Two CDA MPs asked why compulsory-VOG volunteers in schools, childcare and out-of-school care cannot use the free VOG scheme, and whether it could be extended to them. The minister answered that the scheme is only for organisations not already legally required to obtain a VOG, to stimulate voluntary integrity policy, and that no extension is planned, though communication will be intensified.
This is roughly in line with expectations.
Dit is bij benadering conform de verwachtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de rol van instanties rond het langdurig misbruikschandaal in de atletiekwereld

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked why police and the OM only started an investigation after publication, whether a Rotterdam athletics coach is in the sports misconduct register, and how registers, information-sharing agreements and public disclosure of disciplinary rulings are being developed. The minister answered that ongoing criminal investigations cannot be discussed, that the coach is listed in the register, that a separate sex-offence register is undesirable under the GDPR, and that a joint register and a cooperation document with police and the OM are in preparation.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over “een onzichtbaar cyberleger”

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the size, mandate and role of the Defence Cyber Command (DCC), including whether it is understaffed, whether it can conduct offensive operations, and its role in protecting vital infrastructure. The minister answered that staffing is being strengthened with new funding, that offensive use requires a political decision and mandate under international law, and that Defence will play a larger role in protecting vital infrastructure in coordination with civilian authorities.
The supply and demand of Defence's cyber capabilities will be mapped in consultation with civilian authorities and relevant public and private partners.
Vraag en aanbod van cybercapaciteiten van Defensie worden in overleg met de civiele autoriteiten en betrokken publieke en private partners in kaart gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de rol van de Raad van Europa en het uitvoerend WADA-comité bij het opheffen van de schorsing van de Russian Anti-Doping Agency

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the Council of Europe's role and WADA's executive committee in lifting RUSADA's suspension, including the procedural flaw that left the Council's representative without a mandate. The minister confirmed the concern, said the Netherlands raised objections via CAHAMA and with WADA, but acknowledged the decision was made by majority and is unlikely to be reversed.
I have urged WADA that decision-making on this subject requires a higher degree of care going forward.
Ik heb er bij WADA op aangedrongen dat in het vervolg besluitvorming op dit onderwerp een hogere mate van zorgvuldigheid vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over medicijnmisbruik in de sport

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about thyroid hormone misuse by Dutch top athletes, including whether NOC*NSF had reported internal findings from Pyeongchang and whether thyroid medication should be placed on the WADA prohibited list. The minister said a general signal was passed to the Dopingautoriteit, that the ministry supported a WADA submission requesting listing, that WADA has asked for further research, and that no complaints had been filed with the Medisch Tuchtcollege.
I will keep bringing the importance of this research to attention so that it may be placed on the prohibited list.
Ik zal het belang van dit onderzoek onder de aandacht blijven brengen zodat het mogelijk op de prohibited list wordt geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Kuik over handhaving van het rookbeleid op festivals door de NVWA

MPs Bruins Slot and Kuik asked the State Secretary about NVWA enforcement of the smoking ban at festivals, including fines for big versus small volunteer-run events and whether volunteers should be expected to remove smokers. The State Secretary reported 60 fines and 2 warnings from 111 controls, said the organiser bears the duty to enforce the ban, and announced a meeting with festival organisers to share experiences and consider support.
The NVWA cannot distinguish small from large festivals in its analysis of the data from all inspected festivals.
De NVWA kan in de analyse van de data van alle gecontroleerde festivals geen onderscheid maken in kleine en grote festivals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Belhaj over het bericht 'Jassenblunder gevolg van ‘inschattingsfout’'

MPs Bruins Slot and Belhaj asked the Defence State Secretary about cold-weather injuries among soldiers in exercises Bison Drawsko and Enhanced Forward Presence, and about winter clothing procurement for Trident Juncture. The State Secretary answered that about 35 cold injuries were reported in each case, that winter clothing is being supplied centrally, and that the procurement rules already allow exceptions in urgent situations.
The Ministry of Defence, including the KPU company, has all the options available in tenders that are included in the Procurement Act 2012 and the Procurement Act for the defence and security sector.

Het Ministerie van Defensie, inclusief het KPU-bedrijf, beschikt bij aanbestedingen over alle mogelijkheden, die in de Aanbestedingswet 2012 en de Aanbestedingswet op defensie- en veiligheidsgebied zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de vrijwilligers- en bestuurdersproblematiek binnen de breedtesport

An MP asks the Minister whether declining membership and volunteer shortages in sports clubs are a concern and how the EUR 9 million for vital sports providers will be allocated. The Minister says the decline is overstated, attributes the split between thriving and shrinking clubs to capable boards, and says the allocation plan will be sent to parliament before the Christmas recess.
I will inform the House about this before the Christmas recess.
Ik zal de Kamer voor het kerstreces hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘430.000 gulden voor onderzeeër’

An MP asked the Defence and Economic Affairs state secretaries about reports on the submarine replacement project and the new Defence Industry Strategy, including timing and industrial participation. The government answered that the strategy will be published in Q4 2018, that market consultation with potential suppliers was held, and that the B-brief on submarines is delayed to early 2019 but the strategy will be sent to parliament before it.
The DIS will be sent to the House earlier than the B-letter on replacing submarine capacity.
De DIS zal eerder aan de Kamer worden aangeboden dan de B-brief voor de vervanging van onderzeebootcapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van den Berg over de bodemverontreiniging en explosieven op terrein marinierskazerne Vlissingen

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence about soil contamination and unexploded WWII ordnance on the planned Vlissingen Marines barracks site, including whether earlier agreements exist and how much land is affected. The State Secretary answered that contamination was known since 2012, only about 2 of 70 hectares will be remediated, the rest carries use restrictions, and clearance and cost-sharing agreements with the region exist and are largely public.

These agreements were shared by the province with the provincial states and are publicly available, except for the agreements on the buy-out sum for preparing the land, which the province shared with the provincial states under confidentiality.

Deze overeenkomsten heeft de provincie gedeeld met de provinciale staten en zijn openbaar in te zien, met uitzondering van de afspraken over de afkoopsom voor het bouwrijp maken van de grond, die de provincie onder geheimhouding heeft gedeeld met de provinciale staten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over genetische testen voor zwangere vrouwen die door huisartsen aangeboden worden

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether GP-offered prenatal carrier tests fall under the Wbmv and WBO licensing regimes, and about the status of a UMCG study on psychological impact. The Minister said the GP practices work under UMCG responsibility within Wbmv rules, that the WBO need not apply, and that the study has been completed with results being prepared for publication, with no commitment to new policy yet.
If the research results give cause to revise current policy on offering prenatal carrier tests, I will inform your House of this.
In geval de onderzoeksuitkomsten aanleiding geven om het huidige beleid rondom het aanbieden van prenatale dragerschapstests te herzien zal ik uw Kamer hiervan op de hoogte stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over regeldruk voor kleine evenementen en festivals zoals de Lauwersland Fietsvierdaagse

CDA MPs asked the government about red tape for small events and festivals, including the Lauwersland Fietsvierdaagse needing municipal permits, cost burdens, temporary structure rules, event classification and safety handbooks. The minister answered that the rules are municipal, that the cycling event goes ahead in 2018, and that the government and VNG will keep monitoring, without committing to new national rules.
I endorse the social importance of volunteer organisations and associations, such as Oranje, scouting, carnival, sports and other associations.
Ik onderschrijf het maatschappelijk belang van vrijwilligersorganisaties en verenigingen, zoals Oranje-, scouting-, carnavals-, sport- en andere verenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Bruins Slot over het gebruik van levensgevaarlijke doping door amateursporters

Two MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the dangerous slimming agent DNP used by amateur athletes, including prevalence, government warnings, a planned doping action plan and customs and enforcement findings. The minister said prevalence of DNP use is unknown, described existing warnings and education programmes, noted a RIVM study showing 0.5% of adults used performance-enhancing substances in the past year, and reported that the NVWA investigation into seized DNP shipments is complete with prosecutions ongoing.
Figures on the use of DNP in the Netherlands are not known.
Cijfers over het gebruik van DNP in Nederland zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over de hoge OZB-rekeningen voor sportverenigingen en andere Sociaal Belang Behartigende Instellingen (SBBI)

CDA MPs asked whether municipalities charging sports clubs property tax (OZB) and then refunding it via subsidy is bureaucratic, whether non-residential OZB burdens on SBBI's are excessive, and whether the Municipalities Act should be amended to allow equal rates or an exemption. The minister answered that OZB rates and subsidies are a local democratic choice, declined to amend the law or grant a blanket exemption, and said no general judgement on burdens is possible.
An amendment of the Municipalities Act is not necessary in my view at this moment.
Een aanpassing van de Gemeentewet vind ik op dit moment niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht van Omroep Brabant dat omstreden zelfmoordpoeder wekenlang te koop was op Marktplaats

An MP asked the health minister about reports that controversial suicide powder was sold on Marktplaats for weeks, and about platform responsibility and inspection oversight. The minister acknowledged the undesirability, said Marktplaats removed ads after reports and contacted the NVWA, described existing inspection tools, and promised to report on an ongoing exploration of regulating such substances in spring.
I will inform you of the outcomes of the exploration still this spring.
Ik zal u nog dit voorjaar informeren over de uitkomsten van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht 'US body brokers supply world with torsos, limbs and heads'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about Reuters reports on US body brokers, an FBI raid on a company with a Dutch branch, and infected body parts, asking about Dutch import rules and inspection. The minister answered that the FBI had not contacted the Netherlands, the Dutch branch appears to be administrative, existing rules do not target body-part trade, and the Dutch customs do not inspect for disease, leaving responsibility with the user.
There is no legislation providing for checks on disease in the import or export of body parts.
Er is geen wetgeving die voorziet in controles op het terrein van ziektes bij de import of export van lichaamsdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Dam over onnodige regeldruk voor vrijwillige verkeersregelaars

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dam asked about burdensome rules for volunteer traffic controllers, including the annual e-learning requirement and rising costs for events. The minister answered that eligibility was simplified from October 2017, that annual refresher training is kept for quality reasons, and that the matter of extra professional controllers is for municipalities to decide.
The trade-off has certainly been considered to extend this period, but insufficient justification was found for it.
De afweging is zeker gemaakt om deze periode op te rekken, maar daar is onvoldoende onderbouwing voor gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Omtzigt en Rudmer Heerema over de btw-vrijstelling voor denksporten

MPs Bruins Slot, Omtzigt and Rudmer Heerema asked about the VAT exemption for mind sports (bridge, chess, draughts) after the 2017 CJEU ruling that such activities are not 'sport'. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling removes the sports exemption, estimates about EUR 1 million extra VAT revenue, and says talks are underway on possibly listing mind sports under the cultural services exemption, with a letter to the House promised before the summer recess.
However, I aim to inform the House in more detail about this before the summer recess.
Ik streef er echter wel naar uw kamer voor het zomerreces hierover nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van der Staaij en Karabulut over het personeelstekort bij de militaire luchtverkeersleiding

MPs asked the state secretary of Defence about staff shortages at military air traffic control, including suspended services, limited flight information, and whether flight safety is at risk. The government acknowledges chronic shortages and service suspensions, says safety is preserved by suspending services, and outlines training, retention and cooperation measures with LVNL, while rejecting a pay rise.
Air Operations Control Station (AOCS) has struggled with staff shortages for years. Currently 17 of the 73 established posts are vacant.
Air Operations Control Station (AOCS) kampt al jaren met een personeelstekort. Momenteel zijn 17 van de 73 organieke functies vacant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over berichten dat Belgische en Duitse defensiehelikopters met grote problemen kampen

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Helvert asked the Defence Minister about reports that Belgian and German defence helicopters have serious availability problems, and what this means for Dutch operations in Mali. The government answered that the Belgian NFH-90 retrofit affects the Belgian contribution to MINUSMA only marginally, that the Dutch NH-90 upgrade is planned around operations, that Germany's helicopter fleet is a German matter, and that no change to Dutch operations is needed, while promising to inform parliament about helicopter capacity for the second half of 2018.
As soon as more is known about the deployment of helicopter capacity in the second half of 2018, you will be informed, as I promised you during the committee debate of 4 December 2017.
Zodra meer bekend is over de inzet van helikoptercapaciteit in de tweede helft van 2018 wordt u hierover geïnformeerd, zoals ik u tijdens het algemeen overleg van 4 december 2017 heb toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Nederlandse infrastructuren onvoldoende zijn gedimensioneerd op het transport van zwaar militair materiaal

An MP asked whether Dutch infrastructure is still dimensioned for heavy military transport, and whether the Commander of the Armed Forces' warning about mobility risks is accepted. The ministers answered that current standards suffice for military transport, that bottlenecks are being mapped, and that EU and NATO initiatives are underway, but gave no firm national inventory timeline.
Currently it is being examined which infrastructural, legal and regulatory obstacles exist in the Netherlands.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht welke infrastructurele, juridische en regelgevende belemmeringen in Nederland precies gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht 'Russische whizzkid wordt rijk door jouw documentjes'

An MP asked about Dutch tax returns with citizen service numbers and an intelligence service newsletter appearing on a Russian-run document site, and about the risks of identity fraud, malware and Google's role. The State Secretary answered that such posting is not permitted without consent, that identity fraud risk is mainly from combining data, and that the Data Protection Authority can act but may lack jurisdiction over foreign operators.
The Ap therefore itself decides when it does so.
De Ap bepaalt dus zelf wanneer zij dat doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het naar Nederland terughalen van de Formule 1

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether a feasibility study for returning Formula 1 to Zandvoort was known, whether the TT circuit in Assen was also studying it, and whether the Sports Council would be asked for advice. The minister confirmed the Zandvoort report but said it was only a first exploration with too many uncertainties, so no advice request would be made yet, though the Sports Council could be asked later.
There are too many uncertainties to arrive at a concrete request for advice to the Dutch Sports Council.
Er zijn te veel onzekerheden om tot een concrete adviesaanvraag aan de Nederlandse Sportraad te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat militairen mishandeld zijn bij ontgroeningsritueel

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that soldiers were abused during an initiation ritual, including whether soldiers were barred from speaking to outsiders, how many complaints and sexual-abuse reports had been filed since 2014, and what measures were taken. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the 2013 incident and internal inquiry, explained the non-disclosure rule as protecting investigation integrity and promised to revise the rules, gave complaint counts, and referred to a separate letter on measures.
Given the lack of clarity that may arise, the rules will be amended.
Gelet op de onduidelijkheid die kan ontstaan zullen de regels worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over onnodige regeldruk voor kleine evenementen en festivals

The MP asks the government about excessive regulatory burden for small events and festivals, citing an Actal advisory report, and asks whether it will harmonise local rules, shift regulation toward small events, improve municipal service and simplify volunteer allowances and permits. The minister answers that municipal autonomy is important, points to a new national Besluit brandveilig gebruik that will replace many local rules from 1 January 2018, rejects several proposals as unnecessary, and says recommendations to municipalities are for them to adopt, with VNG playing a facilitating role.
At the outset, municipal policy freedom is of great importance in order to do justice to local circumstances and needs and to provide local tailor-made solutions.
Voorop staat dat de beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten van groot belang is om daarmee recht te doen aan de plaatselijke omstandigheden en behoeften en om te voorzien in lokaal maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bruins Slot over nationale veiligheidseisen bij aanbestedingen van cruciale communicatiediensten van de overheid

MPs Van den Berg and Bruins Slot asked about national security requirements in government tenders for critical communications services, including the IWR2017 mobile communications tender won by CM Telecom and privacy safeguards. The minister answered that the tender concerns public-network SIM services without classified communication, that privacy is protected by the Wbp and Telecommunicatiewet, and that the new security risk instruments could not yet be applied to this tender.
IWR2017 Mobile Communication Services concerns a tender for telephony services (SIM cards) for use on the public telephone network.
IWR2017 Mobiele Communicatiediensten betreft een aanbesteding van telefoniediensten («simkaarten») voor gebruik op het publieke telefonienetwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat er camera’s hangen in de kleedkamers van fitness keten Fit For Free

MPs Koopmans (VVD) and Bruins Slot (CDA) asked whether cameras in changing rooms of fitness chain Fit For Free, even if switched off, violate privacy, and what oversight exists. The government answered that cameras in changing rooms and toilets go too far, that installed-but-unused cameras involve no personal data processing, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority handled two complaints and the cameras were removed, and that no law change is needed.
Camera surveillance in changing rooms or toilets goes too far because people would be filmed undressed.
Cameratoezicht in kleedkamers of toiletten gaat te ver omdat mensen dan ontkleed in beeld komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Hoe criminelen Kluivert in de val lokten’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a Volkskrant report on a betting syndicate that lured footballer Kluivert, asking about the syndicate's identity, licensing and enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit. The government declined to give details citing an ongoing criminal investigation, stated that only reliable operators will be licensed, and said that rules restrict sponsorship and advertising targeting young people.
The syndicate you refer to is the subject of a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service (investigation Feniks, see also answer 6).
Het syndicaat waar u in uw vraag naar verwijst is onderwerp van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie (onderzoek Feniks, zie ook antwoord 6).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over acute zorg op de Zuid-Hollandse eilanden

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the continuity of acute care on the South Holland islands, including emergency department pressure, ambulance response times, the role of the regional acute care body ROAZ and of municipalities. The State Secretary answered that the ROAZ is monitoring the situation, has taken steps on training and staffing, and that municipalities are not formal members but should be informed, while declining to require consultation of municipal councils.
I am aware of the signals that residents and local organisations are concerned about the future of acute care on the South Holland islands.
Ik ken de signalen dat bewoners en lokale organisaties zich zorgen maken over de toekomst van de acute zorg op de Zuid-Hollandse eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over de toekomst van het Besthesdaziekenhuis in Hoogeveen en het Refaja ziekenhuis in Stadskanaal

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked about the future of the Bethesda hospital in Hoogeveen and Refaja hospital in Stadskanaal, including obstetrics, level 3 emergency care, loss of eye care, and dialogue with the region. The State Secretary answered that nothing has changed since earlier answers, obstetrics and emergency care remain guaranteed, Treant plans regional dialogue, and the regional acute care working group's conclusions are expected before summer.
For all hospital locations of Treant Zorggroep (Bethesda in Hoogeveen, Refaja in Stadskanaal and Scheper in Emmen), clinical and acute obstetrics is available 24/7.
Voor alle ziekenhuislocaties van de Treant Zorggroep (Bethesda in Hoogeveen, Refaja in Stadskanaal en Scheper in Emmen) geldt dat de klinische en acute verloskunde 24/7 voorhanden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over de subsidieregeling Energiebesparing en duurzame energie sportaccommodaties die opnieuw overvraagd wordt

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked whether the energy-saving subsidy scheme for sports facilities was again oversubscribed within days, and about the scale of applications, the effect on club finances, and whether more funding would be provided. The State Secretary reported 583 applications totalling about 6.7 million euros as of 1 March 2017 with half still under review, gave breakdowns by measure and sport, estimated the cost of full coverage, and said the government will not add extra funds but will reuse unspent 2016 money.
I have previously informed you that this cabinet is not willing to make extra funds available for this subsidy scheme.
Ik heb u eerder laten weten dat dit kabinet niet bereid is om extra middelen vrij te maken voor deze subsidieregeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Knops over de lobby om het Europese geneesmiddelenagentschap naar Nederland te halen

Two CDA MPs asked why the government focuses its bid to host the European Medicines Agency on a site near Schiphol and whether South Limburg was considered. The minister answered that Schiphol's accessibility and facilities best meet the agency's criteria and that South Limburg was assessed but offers fewer connections, while declining to commit to including South Limburg in the bid.
The Netherlands wants to put the best possible bid on the table, and the cabinet believes the Netherlands creates the most promising offer with an EMA location near Schiphol.
Nederland wil het best mogelijke bod op tafel leggen en het kabinet is van mening dat Nederland het meest kansrijke aanbod creëert met een locatie van de EMA in de nabijheid van Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “Elke dag kijk ik in haar kamer of ze nog leeft!”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about reports of long waiting lists for eating disorder clinics, whether young people who have not responded to Dutch treatment should be able to try therapy abroad, and whether the government would commission advice on options at home and abroad. The Minister gave waiting time figures, pointed to a new care standard in preparation and to insurers' and the NZa's role, said treatment abroad must be proven effective to be reimbursed, and declined to request advice for now.
For now I see no reason to request advice in this area.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om op dit gebied om een advies te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Leijten over het bericht dat kinder IC’s in Nederland vol zouden zitten
