MPs Bruins Slot and Leijten asked whether all Dutch paediatric intensive care units were full in December 2016, forcing cancelled elective surgery and transfers abroad, and about capacity, staffing, oversight and discharge problems. The minister confirmed that all eight PICUs were full, that some elective operations were postponed for at least three weeks and ten children were transferred to Belgian and German hospitals, while noting the IGZ was informed and that the NVK and hospital heads will analyse causes and propose improvements.
I expect the PICUs to implement these quickly.
Ik verwacht van de PICU’s dat ze één en ander snel doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over financiële arrangementen voor hepatitis C-medicijnen

The MP Bruins Slot asked whether the financial arrangements for hepatitis C drugs apply to asylum seekers, prison inmates and long-term addiction care patients, and what savings would result. The Minister confirmed the arrangements only cover the Zorgverzekeringswet, explained the separate payment routes for these groups, and declined to give confidential figures on the possible savings.
Due to confidentiality, I cannot say anything about the possible savings on these gross expenditures if the financial arrangements were also applied to this scheme.
In verband met de vertrouwelijkheid kan ik geen uitspraak doen over de mogelijke besparingen op deze bruto uitgaven indien de financiële arrangementen ook op deze regeling van toepassing zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Voortman over Physician Assistants in de GGZ

MPs Bruins Slot and Voortman asked why the NZa excluded Physician Assistants from the GGZ DBC profession table, whether this restricts their ability to open DBCs, and whether it undermines task-shifting from psychiatrists. The minister answered that PAs never had this authority, the NZa relied on advice from the Netwerk Kwaliteitsontwikkeling GGZ, task-shifting remains possible without table inclusion, and that the NZa talks with the professional association itself.

The Network advised not to include the Physician Assistant in the profession table because it is currently insufficiently clear how Physician Assistant psychiatry is a clear addition compared with the existing professions.

Het Netwerk heeft geadviseerd de Physician Assistant niet op te nemen in de beroepentabel omdat het momenteel onvoldoende duidelijk is op welke wijze de Physician Assistant-psychiatrie een duidelijke toevoeging is ten opzichte van de reeds bestaande beroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Bruins Slot en Amhaouch over het bericht dat een verwarde man in de boeien is geslagen

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a report of a confused man being hit while handcuffed, whether the police apology was appropriate, and the state of municipal care for confused persons. The minister answered that the matter is covered in a separate letter, that the Aanjaagteam found in September 2016 that no municipality had a well-implemented integrated approach, and that the Schakelteam will monitor progress and share results with parliament.
The Schakelteam has been tasked with promoting and monitoring progress towards an integrated approach.
Het Schakelteam heeft als opdracht meegekregen de voortgang van de sluitende aanpak te bevorderen en te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de uniforme herkenbaarheid van voorrangsvoertuigen

An MP asked the ministers whether the Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid (IFV) was right to enforce against reputable transport providers using OOV striping and the Star of Life, and how the policy was applied to resold ambulances and to historic 2002 rules. The minister answered that unauthorised use is unacceptable, that GP out-of-hours services will adopt the secondary ambulance livery within five years, that talks with the transplant foundation are ongoing, and that the goal of uniform recognisability stands.
An agreement has been reached with the organisation of GP out-of-hours services (InEen) that they will adopt the so-called secondary variant of the ambulance house style.
Met de organisatie van huisartsenposten (InEen) is overeengekomen dat zij de zogenoemde secundaire variant van de ambulancehuisstijl gaan voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Amhaouch en Knops over ziekenhuizen in Limburg die operaties moeten uitstellen omdat ze door de jaarvergoeding heen zijn

MPs asked whether Limburg hospitals such as VieCuri, AZM, Laurentius and Sint Jans Gasthuis had exhausted annual budgets and postponed operations, and how insurers and the NZa ensure patient information and waiting-time norms. The minister said she lacks insight into individual hospitals' finances, placed responsibility on hospitals and insurers, and pointed to NZa supervision of insurer information duties.
I have no insight into the financial situation of individual hospitals.
Ik heb geen zicht op de financiële situatie van individuele ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Volp over het voorkomen van seksueel misbruik in de zorg

MPs Bruins Slot and Volp asked why the Public Prosecution Service (OM) had apparently not shared with the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) a conviction of a healthcare worker for a serious sexual offence committed in private, and how the procedure works. The minister replied that the OM has informed the IGZ only once since July 2015, that the OM does not register professions, that the protocol is considered sufficiently watertight with no known failures, and that no retroactive review will be ordered.
I currently have no indications that the arrangement set out in the Cooperation Protocol is not watertight.
Ik heb op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat de regeling die nu in het Samenwerkingsprotocol is verwoord niet sluitend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Bruins Slot over de ziekte van Huntington

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a TV item claiming a medical breakthrough for Huntington's disease was possible with four million euros, about the scope of Health Deals investment, past ZonMw funding, and how expertise centres are financed. The Minister called the breakthrough claim doubtful, said the 130 million euros are existing programme budgets rather than new Huntington investment, and said the Huntington-specific research funding figures are not known to her.
I am not aware of which amounts are available within these centres for research into Huntington's disease.
Het is mij niet bekend welke bedragen binnen deze centra beschikbaar zijn voor onderzoek naar de ziekte van Huntington.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over kankerverwekkende stoffen in rubbergranulaat op kunstgrasvelden

An MP asked the Health Minister when the research plan on playing on artificial turf would be presented, how sites were selected, whether tiles are included, whether the IndusTox study was funded by manufacturers, why a small study was used, the replacement cost, and the basis for claiming barbecuing is more dangerous than artificial turf. The minister answered that RIVM publishes its protocol, selects sites randomly, covers tiles separately, takes industry funding into account under REACH, and that the scientific basis for barbecue risks is stronger than for turf.
The National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) regularly makes information available via its website on the status of the research.
Het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) stelt regelmatig informatie beschikbaar via zijn website over de stand van zaken van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Patiënten VGZ niet meer welkom zijn bij ziekenhuis MST

An MP asked the health minister whether insurer VGZ properly informed its insured about volume caps at hospital MST, whether patients could still be treated there, and how waiting-time norms are protected. The minister answered that the NZa judges compliance, that ongoing treatments and urgent care continue, that insurers must buy sufficient volume, and that disputes should not be fought over patients' backs.
The NZa does not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doet de NZa geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de hulpbereidheid bij eerste hulp (Herdruk)

An MP asked the health minister about low public willingness to give first aid, the share of Dutch people with first-aid certificates, costs of courses and insurance, and plans to recover AED pad costs from insurers. The minister answered that the figures do not support firm conclusions, that first aid is voluntary, that course costs and insurance are varied, and promised to inform parliament about AED pad reimbursement in spring 2017.
I expect to be able to inform you about this in spring 2017.
Ik verwacht u hierover in het voorjaar van 2017 te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over patiënten die als proefkonijn werden gebruikt in het Erasmus MC

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about reports that Erasmus MC doctors tested a new atrial fibrillation instrument on patients without their knowledge, and about whether this was regular care or research under the WMO. The Minister said the IGZ is still investigating (with the CCMO) and will report in early 2017, declined to judge the specific case, and explained the consent rules under the WMO and the WGBO.
I will inform your House of the outcome of the investigation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomst van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de uitzending van De Monitor over “verwarde personen”

Christian Democrat MP Bruins Slot asked the ministers of Health and Justice about a De Monitor broadcast on confused persons, the police plan to stop transporting and holding such persons from 1 January 2017, the legal basis for police cell detention, the readiness of municipalities and mental health providers, and the availability of assertive community treatment teams. The minister answered that the police will phase out this role in 2017, that no full coordinated approach will be in place by 1 January 2017, and that a Schakelteam and ZonMw funding will support municipalities until 2018.

That the police want to stop holding confused persons in cells from 1 January and transporting them during 2017 when they have committed no offence is in line with the recommendations of the Confused Persons Task Force.

Dat de politie per 1 januari wil stoppen met de opvang in cellen en in de loop van 2017 met het vervoer van verwarde personen die geen strafbaar feit hebben gepleegd, is in lijn met de aanbevelingen van het Aanjaagteam Verwarde Personen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Zorgverzekeraars claimen 50 miljoen bij aanbieders wijkverpleging en het bericht van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland dat zorgverzekeraars verbaasd zi

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked about reports that health insurers claim 50 million from home-care providers for exceeding revenue caps, and about insurers' duty of care for insured persons. The State Secretary answered that such contractual revenue caps and clawbacks are a matter between insurers and providers, that insurers' statutory duty of care remains intact, and described the dispute-resolution route and the numbers of additional contracts and care hours.
This concerns a component of a contractual agreement between an individual care provider and an individual health insurer, of which I am not a party.
Dit betreft een onderdeel van een contractuele overeenkomst tussen een individuele zorgaanbieder en een individuele zorgverzekeraar waarin ik geen partij ben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de voorgenomen wijziging van de Regeling verkeersregelaars

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the planned amendment of the traffic controllers regulation, including whether separate appointment decisions can be abolished, whether permits and no-objection declarations can be linked, whether the one-year validity of the instruction declaration was reviewed, and practical problems for motorcycle escorts. The Minister answered that the separate appointment decisions will be abolished and embedded in event permits, that permits and declarations cannot be coupled to traffic controller appointments, that the annual e-learning is retained for quality, and that talks with stakeholders are ongoing on the motorcycle escort issue.
The appointment of the event traffic controller will be arranged in the event permit.
De aanstelling van de evenementenverkeersregelaar wordt in de evenementenvergunning geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over tekortschietende leeftijdscontrole van jongeren die onder de zonnebank willen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about lax age checks for young people using sunbeds, the NHG's skin-cancer guideline, the role of GPs versus dermatologists, and SCENIHR findings on sunbed-related melanoma, and asked whether licensing or ID requirements for sunbed providers should be introduced. The Minister replied that the guideline is due in mid-2017, that she is awaiting SCENIHR's final opinion and is exploring with stakeholders how to improve compliance, and that she has no conclusions yet on NVWA enforcement powers.
On ways to improve the enforcement powers of the NVWA, I do not yet want to draw conclusions at this point.
Over manieren om de handhavingsmogelijkheden van de NVWA te verbeteren, wil ik op dit moment nog geen conclusies trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over zingeving in de zorg

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the ZonMw report on meaning-giving (zingeving) in care, the NPCF finding that 83% of patients want attention to meaning in care, and whether knowledge agendas and funding should follow. The Minister agreed meaning-giving should be part of personalised care, noted that under half of patients have experienced such attention, and pointed to existing ZonMw programmes and a NVKG research agenda while promising to keep raising the issue.

I agree with the authors of the report that, since not everyone finds all aspects of meaning-giving equally important, it is necessary to make individual needs discussable, producing care tailored to each person.
Ik ben het met opstellers van het signalement eens dat, aangezien niet iedereen alle aspecten van zingeving (even) belangrijk vindt, het noodzakelijk is om individuele behoeften bespreekbaar te maken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Wijkverpleegkundigen helpen steeds vaker met huishoudelijke taken”

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked whether district nurses increasingly perform household tasks, what hourly rates apply, and whether gemeenten and insurers coordinate home care sufficiently. The state secretary said district nurses should not normally do household work, saw no link to volume and tariff cuts, and agreed to raise the issue with the VNG, while declining to collect data on how often it happens.
I do not have figures on this. Requesting them would lead to additional administrative burdens for district nurses.
Ik heb hier geen cijfers over. Het uitvragen hiervan zal leiden tot extra administratieve lasten voor wijkverpleegkundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over de uitgaven wijkverpleging 2015 en de inkoop wijkverpleging 2016

MPs Bruins Slot and Keijzer (CDA) asked the State Secretary about 2015 spending overruns, 2016 volume and tariff cuts, shortages of community nurses, the new 'Beloning op maat' payment, administrative burden, and coverage of on-call services. The State Secretary answered that the 2015 overrun of EUR 37.7 million is modest, that contracting is a shared responsibility of insurers and providers, and listed measures on staffing, innovation and administrative burden, with a monitor from the NZa promised, but gave no data on specific care volumes.

I have no figures on the volumes of specific care forms such as intensive child care and palliative care, because these care forms are declared under the regular nursing and care services and insurers and providers keep no separate registration.

Ik heb geen cijfers over de volumes van specifieke zorgvormen zoals intensieve kindzorg en pallatieve zorg omdat deze zorgvormen worden gedeclareerd onder de reguliere prestaties verpleging en verzorging en er geen aparte registratie wordt bijgehouden door verzekeraars en aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over spoed-ambulances die vaak te laat komen

An MP asked the health minister why ambulances often miss the 15-minute emergency response norm, whether it is a planning or performance norm, and what sanctions apply to insurers who fail their duty of care. The minister answered that the norm is a performance norm, that insurers share responsibility with the RAV, that the NZa is overseeing improvement plans, and that no firm deadline or change to the temporary rules will be set.
Following the investigation, the NZa has instructed insurers together with the RAVs in regions where the norm is not met to draw up improvement plans.
De NZa heeft naar aanleiding van het onderzoek zorgverzekeraars opgedragen om samen met de RAV-en in de regio's waar de norm niet wordt gehaald verbeterplannen op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over regiebehandelaarschap van de orthopedagoog generalist

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health why the orthopedagogue generalist was excluded from acting as regiebehandelaar under the model quality statute for mental health care, and whether inclusion in the BIG register would be expedited. The Minister said the consequences are limited, noted a transitional arrangement, and promised to inform parliament before summer about the timing of a bill amending the BIG Act.
I will inform you further about the planning of this bill before the summer.
Ik zal u vóór de zomer over de planning van dit wetsvoorstel nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Nieuwe drug vervangt de zware XTC-pil'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about health risks of the new drug 4-FA (XTC-light), its long-term effects, prevention, and whether it will be banned under the Opium Act. The State Secretary answered that long-term risks are unknown, the drug is monitored, prevention runs through regular channels, and no ban is planned for now based on the 2015 CAM quick scan and WHO advice.
The CAM will examine this year whether there is reason to update the quick scan.
Het CAM zal dit jaar bekijken of er aanleiding is de quick scan te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over de onnodige regeldruk voor vrijwilligers die voortvloeit uit de Regeling verkeersregelaars 2009

Two MPs asked about excessive regulatory burden on volunteer traffic marshals under the 2009 traffic marshals regulation, following Actal advice, and about sports bodies' exclusion from consultation and proposed reforms such as a national database and removal of individual appointments. The minister replied that a working group has a draft amendment ready for internet consultation, that the national e-learning database will replace separate appointment passes, and that motorcycle marshals remain barred from giving signals from vehicles for safety reasons.
It is expected that this draft proposal will be put to internet consultation by the Ministry of IenM this spring.
Naar verwachting zal dit conceptvoorstel dit voorjaar door het Ministerie van IenM in internetconsultatie kunnen worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert inzake afwikkeling verkeer rond Utrecht

Two CDA MPs asked the infrastructure minister about traffic congestion risks on national and provincial roads around Utrecht from the city's draft mobility plan, including doubts about the modelling and the business impact. The minister said the effects cannot yet be determined, that Rijkswaterstaat has concerns and submitted an objection, and that the plan is a municipal matter, with follow-up agreements and talks with the municipality promised.
Rijkswaterstaat does have concerns about traffic flow on the main road network and the access roads in the city, and therefore about the city's accessibility.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft wel zorgen over de doorstroming op het hoofdwegennet en de toeleidende wegen in de stad en daarmee over de bereikbaarheid van de stad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de subsidieregeling energiebesparing sportaccommodaties

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the sports-venue energy-saving subsidy, which was nearly exhausted within days of opening and whose abolition of the energy-tax refund may leave clubs worse off. The minister answered that the scheme's popularity is a success, gave application breakdowns, and declined to add budget or ask for additional funds.
I see the great willingness of sports clubs to invest in energy saving and sustainable energy as a success
Ik zie de grote bereidheid van de sportverenigingen om te investeren in energiebesparing en duurzame energie als een succes
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Toorenburg, Leijten en Dik-Faber over de tariefverhoging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag en de gevolgen hiervan voor vrijwilligerswerk

MPs from CDA, SP and ChristenUnie asked the government to explain the 38% fee increase for the Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) and its impact on volunteer organisations, and to reconcile it with earlier statements. The state secretary attributed the increase mainly to cost-recovery of Justis integrity products, said 7.5% covers the free VOG scheme, declined to commission an impact study on volunteer organisations, and said no consultation with VWS took place.
I am not willing to conduct research into the consequences of the fee increase for volunteers and their organisations.
Ik ben niet bereid onderzoek te verrichten naar de gevolgen van de tariefverhoging op het effect voor vrijwilligers en hun organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Onderzoek baarmoederhalskanker mogelijk veel duurder. Veel meer vrouwen met hpv besmet dan gedacht’

MPs Van Gerven and Bruins Slot asked whether a Jeroen Bosch Hospital study showing higher HPV infection would raise the costs of the new cervical cancer screening, affect patients' own-risk payments, and whether the IMPROVE study and cost-effectiveness analysis were sound. The minister said the findings were not new, that costs are uncertain but patients would pay less overall, that the cost-effectiveness results are expected this year, and that the new screening's start is based on the Health Council's advice.
The tender request from the RIVM, containing the research assignment, is attached.
Het offerteverzoek van het RIVM, met daarin de onderzoeksopdracht, is bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Bruins Slot, Bergkamp, Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over een verzekeraar die wijkverpleegkundigen passeert met nieuw pgb-beleid

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about insurer CZ's new policy limiting which home-care nurses may assess persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) eligibility, designating preferred organisations per region, and whether this restricts budget-holders' choice. The State Secretary answered that CZ's approach is within the agreed rules, budget-holders remain free to choose other providers with reduced reimbursement, the insurer has at least two providers per region, and an AMvB will be sent to parliament with a letter on the motion.
Control lies in all cases with the PGB holder.
De regie ligt in alle gevallen bij de pgb-houder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over onverwachte rekening mortuariumkosten voor nabestaanden

An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of hospital mortuary charges unexpectedly billed to bereaved families, whether these charges are clearly disclosed, and what remedies and complaint routes families have. The minister answered that responsibility lies primarily with mortuary operators who must conclude explicit agreements, that complaints should go to the mortuary operator, and that the ministry has no data on whether information has improved.
Bereaved relatives should primarily direct complaints to the mortuary operator.
Nabestaanden dienen klachten primair te richten aan de mortuariumbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de “Erfelijkheidstest voor alle mensen met een kinderwens”

MPs Bruins Slot asked whether the planned preconception carrier screening offered by AMC and VUmc is covered by the Population Screening Act and needs a licence, and how it fits the minister's health check policy. The minister answered that carrier testing falls under the Medical Special Procedures Act licence for clinical genetics rather than the Population Screening Act, and that it is outside the health check definition, with quality safeguards and ongoing UMCG research.
The clinical genetic examination involved in the carrier test does fall under the licensing requirement defined in Article 2 of the Medical Special Procedures Act (WBMV).
Het klinisch genetisch onderzoek dat bij de dragerschapstest aan de orde is, valt wel onder de vergunningplicht zoals gedefinieerd in artikel 2 Wet op Bijzondere Medische Verrichtingen (WBMV).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Toorenburg en Pieter Heerma over de Al Fitrah-moskee in Utrecht

CDA MPs asked whether the Al Fitrah mosque in Utrecht received funding from Kuwaiti organisations linked to Al-Qaida, whether tax and intelligence services checked its income, whether it publishes accounts, and what the mayor has done about it. The government largely declined to comment on specific cases citing confidentiality and procedural secrecy, while describing a three-track approach of dialogue, confrontation and enforcement and promising a forthcoming salafism letter.
In general I do not make statements about concrete cases.
In zijn algemeenheid doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de ‘wereldwijde noodsituatie’ door het zikavirus

MP Bruins Slot asked the health minister how Erasmus MC, RIVM and WHO cooperate on the Zika emergency, whether travellers are tested, the origins and seriousness of the virus, blood donation rules, sexual transmission advice, tyre import controls, and testing of invasive mosquitoes. The minister answered that the institutes share work and data, travellers are not routinely tested or screened at airports, blood donors must wait four weeks after leaving Europe, enforcement on tyre importers runs through municipalities with a planned law change to shift responsibility to the minister, and invasive mosquitoes are not tested for viruses.
The bill is currently with the Council of State. I expect to submit it to your House at the end of March or beginning of April 2016.
Het wetsvoorstel ligt op dit moment bij de Raad van State. Ik verwacht het eind maart, begin april 2016 aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat bij veel zelfzorggeneesmiddelen noodzakelijke informatie ontbreekt

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dijk asked whether many over-the-counter medicines lack information on shelf life after opening, and whether the CBG and government enforce the duty to test and label it. The minister answered that since 2001 manufacturers must test and label post-opening shelf life, that the CBG checks this at licensing, and that the CBG is negotiating with industry to label it on all multi-use products.
This obligation is checked by the CBG when granting a marketing authorisation, at which point the product information is also approved.
Deze verplichting controleert het CBG bij het verlenen van een handelsvergunning, waarbij ook de productinformatie wordt goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de WK-kandidatuur van Nederland en België

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked whether the minister pressed the KNVB for an independent investigation into the Netherlands-Belgium 2018 World Cup bid, who commissions and conducts it, whether the Public Prosecution Service will investigate, what the 2009 departure of Alain Courtois and ministry knowledge of alleged Belgian misconduct involved, and whether the minister has contacted Belgian counterparts. The minister answers that the KNVB independently commissioned an independent accountant's investigation expected in Q1 2016, that the ministry has contact with the KNVB and will be informed of results, that the Public Prosecution Service cannot comment on its investigations, that the 2011 evaluation was limited in scope, that the ministry had no subsidy relationship with Beltomundial, and that the ministry has contacted Belgian colleagues who await their own internal investigation.
Once the results are known, the KNVB will inform me of the findings and conclusions and I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra de resultaten bekend zijn, zal de KNVB mij op de hoogte brengen van de bevindingen en conclusies en zal ik Uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bruins Slot over over een dreigend tekort aan een geneesmiddel voor schildklierpatiënten

MPs Dijkstra (D66) and Bruins Slot (CDA) asked the health minister about an impending shortage of the thyroid medicine Thyrax Duotab 0.025 mg, including whether the manufacturer's planning error, its legal duty to keep stock, the inspectorate's enforcement and the EMA's role were handled properly. Minister Schippers answered that the inspectorate is investigating possible breach of the duty to keep stock and will not prejudge it, that alternative suppliers can partly fill the gap, and that she is concerned by the rising number of shortages and will bring parties together.
While the investigation is ongoing, the IGZ and I cannot say anything about the possible outcome or any enforcement action.
Lopende het onderzoek kunnen de IGZ en ik over de mogelijke uitkomst en eventuele inzet van handhaving niets zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over budgetplafonds die de vrije artsenkeuze inperken

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether budget caps in health insurer contracts with providers undermine free choice of doctor, whether these caps are secret and whether insurers should disclose them, and whether restitution policies should be exempt from the caps. The minister answered that insurers must inform policyholders about contracting, that the NZa supervises this, that insurers' duty of care remains, and that she will not intervene in private negotiations on caps, so no concrete new obligation is promised.
The NZa supervises health insurers' compliance with these transparency requirements.
De NZa houdt toezicht op de zorgverzekeraars op het naleven van deze transparantievereisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de prijsverhoging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) in 2016

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked why the VOG fee would rise in 2016 and whether volunteer organisations had been consulted, and asked the government to reconsider eligibility rules and make VOGs free for all volunteers working with minors. The Secretary of State confirmed the fee rise, said the cost of the free VOG scheme was built in, refused to change eligibility conditions, and declined to extend free VOGs beyond the existing 100,000-per-year scheme citing budget limits.
No, I am not willing to change the existing conditions.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid om bestaande voorwaarden te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het bericht “Brabant Zorg sluit geen contract af met DSW en Menzis voor wijkverpleging in 2016”

MPs Bruins Slot and Keijzer asked about BrabantZorg not contracting DSW and Menzis for district nursing in 2016, the price and budget figures, and how insured people are protected. The Secretary of State says the zorgplicht ensures insured people keep access to care, reports preliminary 2015 spending figures that may exceed the budget by about €50 million, and says the MBI would only be considered after definitive figures and analysis of causes.
Before the MBI is applied, several steps will be carried out.
Voordat het MBI wordt ingezet zullen er verschillende stappen worden doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de uitzending “Hogere eigen bijdragen ziekenhuis”

An MP from the CDA asks the minister about a Radar broadcast on higher hospital co-payments, focusing on the hardship (hinderpaal) criterion for non-contracted care, budget insurance policies, insurers' duty to inform, and whether fixed reimbursement percentages should be set. The minister answers that insurers must disclose contracting information, that the hardship criterion cannot be captured in a calculation model, that the NZa will scrutinise reimbursement below 75 percent for 2016 policies, and that the overstapseizoen will be evaluated.
Insurers will evaluate the functioning of the information leaflet after the switching season, also examining whether additional measures are necessary.
Zorgverzekeraars gaan de werking van de bijsluiter na het overstapseizoen evalueren, waarbij ook zal worden nagegaan of aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bruins Slot en Dik-Faber over de financiering van geestelijke begeleiding bij palliatieve zorg in de thuissituatie

MPs Van der Staaij, Bruins-Slot and Dik-Faber asked why spiritual care for terminally ill patients at home is not reimbursed under the Zvw and whether insurers are meeting their duty of care. The Secretary of State answered that spiritual guidance on religion and spirituality is not insured care, that palliative care by nurses and GPs is covered, and that Agora will be asked to inventory improvements with stakeholders.

I am not aware of any signals that health insurers are not purchasing and reimbursing the support for coping with illness and treatment, as described by the professional groups themselves within the limits of care that GPs and nurses normally provide, and are therefore failing their duty of care.

Mij zijn geen signalen bekend dat zorgverzekeraars de begeleiding bij de verwerking en het omgaan met ziekte en behandeling, zoals door de beroepsgroepen zelf beschreven binnen de grenzen van zorg zoals huisartsen en verpleegkundigen die plegen te bieden, niet inkopen en vergoeden en dus hun zorgplicht niet nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de berichtgeving van het Vlietland Ziekenhuis om de kraamafdeling op te heffen en te verhuizen naar het Sint Franciscus Gasthuis in Rotterdam

The CDA MP Bruins Slot asks the minister about Vlietland Hospital's plan to close its maternity ward and move it to Franciscus Gasthuis Rotterdam, including the 45-minute accessibility norm, traffic congestion and regional maternity care planning. The minister answers that hospital boards and insurers are responsible for accessible care, that the accessibility model does not account for refusals or financial barriers, and that the RIVM analysis shows neither hospital is sensitive to closure, but offers no concrete government action.

It is the responsibility of the Boards of Directors of Franciscus Gasthuis and Vlietland hospital to ensure, mindful of the steering group's advice and in consultation with parties in the maternity care chain, adequate infrastructure meeting the relevant guidelines and regulations.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad van Bestuur van het Franciscus Gasthuis en Vlietland ziekenhuis om, indachtig het advies van de stuurgroep en in overleg met betrokken partijen in de verloskundige keten, te zorgen voor een adequate infrastructuur
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de afnemende beschikbaarheid van smalspectrum antibiotica

An MP asked the health minister about the disappearance of narrow-spectrum antibiotics from the Dutch market, linked to antibiotic resistance, and whether rules on importing alternatives and insurer reimbursement should change. The minister denied a rising trend in withdrawals, pointed to existing shortage and emergency import mechanisms, and said insurers should reimburse at maximum tariffs and consider quality of care.

In line with my commitment during the infection prevention committee debate, I will ask the working group on medicine shortages whether it is necessary to speed up the procedures for importing unregistered medicines.

In lijn met mijn toezegging tijdens het AO infectiepreventie zal ik de werkgroep Geneesmiddelentekorten vragen of het noodzakelijk is om de procedures rond de import van ongeregistreerde geneesmiddelen te versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de mogelijke gevolgen van het Trans-Atlantic Trade and Investment Partnerschip (TTIP) voor het beleid rond medicijnen en medische hulpmiddelen

An MP from the CDA asks the Health Minister, in ten questions, how the TTIP trade deal could affect medicine pricing, reimbursement, data exclusivity, patents and generics, and whether the Dutch mixed healthcare system is protected. The minister answers that IP scope is still undecided and Netherlands will push for restraint, that the Commission must stay within its mandate, and that public health services are excluded by a general carve-out, with the Netherlands checking whether its mixed system needs an explicit exemption.
The Netherlands, like other member states, is closely involved in the negotiations conducted by the European Commission.
Nederland is, net als andere lidstaten, nauw betrokken bij de onderhandelingen die de Europese Commissie voert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘OM wil van RIVM info hielprik baby container’

MPs Oskam and Bruins Slot asked whether the Public Prosecution Service could compel RIVM to release medical data from a newborn heel-prick test in a baby-in-container case, and how medical confidentiality is protected. The ministers replied that no court action is currently under consideration, that confidentiality can be overridden only in exceptional circumstances as set by the Supreme Court, and that RIVM has rarely received such requests and has not overridden confidentiality since 2012.
Taking legal steps is currently not at all on the agenda.
Het nemen van gerechtelijke stappen is op dit moment in het geheel niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over wachtlijsten die door omzetplafonds worden veroorzaakt

An MP asked the health minister about waiting lists caused by insurer revenue caps (omzetplafonds), including whether the Treeknorm waiting-time standard was missed and whether insurers can use waiting lists to steer patient flows. The minister answered that waiting times are broadly stable, that publishing waiting times per insurer or per department is not feasible due to administrative burden, that insurers may refer to the Treeknorm in contracts, and that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care, while declining to commit to new transparency measures.
As I noted in my letter of 15 September following this article, publishing waiting times per health insurer is not feasible, as it would lead to a great deal of administrative burden for providers.

Zoals ik in mijn bief van 15 september naar aanleiding van dit artikel opmerk, is het publiceren van wachttijden per zorgverzekeraar niet uitvoerbaar, aangezien dit leidt tot veel administratieve lasten bij de aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over extreem magere modellen in de mode-industrie

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health about the EenVandaag/Viva poll on banning extremely thin models, whether the fashion industry should avoid them, and the status of promised talks with the fashion sector, and about the effects of bans in Spain, Italy, Israel and France. The State Secretary agreed that such models can have undesirable effects, said talks with the fashion world were ongoing with results to be shared possibly before the 14 October committee meeting, and said foreign effects were still unknown and changes would take a long time.
This is still ongoing and I will inform you of the outcomes as soon as they are known.
Dit loopt nog en ik zal u over de uitkomsten informeren zodra deze bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Teeven over de financiering van het verjaardagsfeestje van de VARA door het vfonds

MPs Bruins Slot and Teeven asked whether the vfonds, an independent foundation for veterans, funded the VARA's 90th anniversary party and a half-million-euro TV series on labour history, and whether this fits its mandate and was coordinated with Defence. The Minister replied that the vfonds is independent with its own spending authority, confirmed the subsidy, declined to judge the foundation's guidelines, and said she held no consultation because the subsidy does not affect veteran care funding.
The National Fund for Peace, Freedom and Veterans Care (vfonds) is an independent foundation with autonomous control over its expenditure.
Het Nationaal Fonds voor Vrede, Vrijheid en Veteranenzorg (vfonds) is een onafhankelijke stichting, met autonome zeggenschap over haar uitgaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat tientallen miljoenen in de zorg aan onnodig fiscaal advies verspild zijn

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether medical specialists' founding of new companies to keep entrepreneurial status was unnecessary after declaration rules changed, and about the role of tax advice and Article 3.5 Wet IB 2001. The State Secretary answered that the loss of direct declaration rights generally does not by itself establish entrepreneurship, that the Tax Service did not pressure parties, and that eligibility depends on all relevant risks, with the government open to contracts being submitted to the Tax Service.
I note that in practice some unclarity has arisen about the extent of the personnel risks to be borne.
Ik merk hierbij op dat in de praktijk enige onduidelijkheid is gerezen over de omvang van de te lopen personeelsrisico's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Pia Dijkstra over apotheken die ’s nachts in dorpen soms tien keer duurder zijn dan in de stad

MPs Bruins Slot and Pia Dijkstra asked why out-of-hours pharmacy prices differ up to tenfold between regions and whether the 2014 financing model, a possible night closure, or a national tariff could fix this. The minister acknowledged the problem and said it is resolved from 2016 after talks with the NZa and stakeholders, but declined to commit to a national tariff, citing subsidiarity and proportionality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de MERS-uitbraak in Zuid-Korea

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about lessons from the 2015 MERS outbreak in South Korea, including hospital infection control, contact tracing, cooperation with aviation, and traveller information. The minister answered that the outbreak was winding down, listed the contributing factors identified by WHO, and described existing guidance, reporting and traveller information measures without announcing new structural changes.

This outbreak shows the importance of early detection of the disease by doctors (GPs and secondary-care specialists), applying the right prevention measures (such as isolating the patient) when MERS-CoV is suspected, and identifying and continuing to monitor contacts.

Deze uitbraak toont het belang aan van vroegsignalering van de ziekte door artsen (huisartsen en tweedelijns specialisten), het uitvoeren van de juiste preventiemaatregelen (zoals isolatie van de zieke) bij een verdenking van MERS-CoV en het inventariseren en blijven monitoren van contacten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over tekorten aan medicijnen die tot recordhoogte zijn opgelopen

An MP from the CDA asks the Health Minister about record-high medicine shortages, questioning the impact on patients, why shortages persist when the same products are available in neighbouring countries, and what measures she will take. The Minister acknowledges the rising shortages and concern, says the working group is not yet sufficient, attributes causes to market conditions such as low prices, and commits to talking with insurers and encouraging broader supplier participation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de alternatieve geneeswijze ‘cupping’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the alternative practice of cupping (hijama), including its health risks, whether it is a reserved medical act under the BIG Act, and whether clinics need licensing and who supervises them. The Minister answered that cupping involving tissue disruption is a reserved act under the BIG Act, that the IGZ supervises it with fines and criminal enforcement possible, and that no licensing requirement exists for cupping clinics unlike tattoo and piercing shops.
Only designated and competent healthcare providers, such as doctors, are formally authorised to perform this act. The IGZ supervises this.
Alleen daartoe aangewezen en bekwame zorgverleners, zoals artsen, zijn formeel bevoegd deze handeling uit te voeren. De IGZ houdt hier toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het artikel “Ik wil niet dood, ik wil alleen hulp”

An MP asks the minister about a newspaper article describing a person seeking mental health help who cannot get adequate care, including bridging care gaps and who is responsible for it. The minister acknowledges the concern, explains the professional and legal framework for treatment, waiting-time norms and the division of responsibilities between municipalities, insurers and the Wlz, but does not commit to a new concrete action.
The signal in the article that cuts are being made in mental health care I do not recognise.
Het signaal in het artikel dat wordt bezuinigd in de GGZ herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het hoofdbehandelaarschap GGZ in de zorginkoop voor 2016

An MP asked the health minister about the consequences for 2016 insurer purchasing of rules on the GGZ main-practitioner role, including whether orthopedagogues-generalist and intellectual disability doctors can be main practitioners and the delay in responding to a request to register orthopedagogues in the BIG Act. The minister replied that the commission's advice targets 2017, that current NZa rules allow tailoring for some professionals but not intellectual disability doctors in 2016, and that a bill to register orthopedagogues-generalist under the BIG Act will be submitted to parliament.
I have decided to submit a bill to parliament to include the orthopedagogue-generalist in Article 3 of the BIG Act.
Ik heb besloten een wetsvoorstel voor te leggen aan het parlement om de orthopedagoog-generalist op te nemen in artikel 3 van de Wet BIG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Matchfixing in amateurvoetbal aan orde van de dag”

MPs Van Dekken and Bruins Slot asked the government about match-fixing in amateur football, including preventive measures, disciplinary and criminal tools, and reporting to the KNVB. Minister Schippers answered that the KNVB and NOC*NSF run education and reporting channels, a national platform coordinates enforcement, and the OM takes signals seriously but intervenes only when there are sufficient grounds.
Match-fixing can only be combated through close cooperation between the sports, gambling and investigation and prosecution sectors.
Matchfixing kan alleen worden bestreden door nauwe samenwerking tussen de sectoren sport, kansspel en opsporing en vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over omzetplafonds in de zorg

An MP asks the health minister to explain how patients are protected when hospital volume caps (omzetplafonds) are reached mid-treatment, including whether patients must seek another provider and whether NZa supervises adequate volumes. The minister answers that patients keep the right to continue ongoing treatment, that NZa is examining contracting and access to care through reports due in 2015, and that transparency measures for policies are being pursued.
I expect care providers to complete a care pathway that has started, unless for clinical reasons it is desirable for care to continue elsewhere.
Ik verwacht van zorgaanbieders dat zij een zorgtraject dat is gestart ook afronden, tenzij het om zorginhoudelijke redenen wenselijk is dat de zorg elders wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het voornemen van het kabinet om de verheerlijking van anorexia te verbieden

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether the government would investigate a ban on pro-ana content after France, and why it had not pursued such measures earlier. The government answered that existing law does not criminalise encouraging extreme dieting, that a ban would not be effective, and that it will instead update the pop-up warning system with providers and engage the fashion sector.
Banning and criminalising these expressions sends the wrong signal to these people and does not encourage them to seek help.
Het verbieden en strafbaar stellen van deze uitingen is een verkeerd signaal naar deze personen en bevordert niet dat zij hulp gaan zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat medisch specialisten volgens de Belastingdienst nog steeds zelfstandig ondernemers zijn

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether the Tax Authority's view that medical specialists remain self-employed contradicts government policy on integrated care funding and whether the costs of cooperative models were unnecessary. The minister answered that the government's position is unchanged, that self-employment depends on facts and circumstances, and that the transition subsidy aims to make employment a real option.
The cabinet has not changed its position on the self-employment of medical specialists.
Het kabinet heeft zijn standpunt ten aanzien van het ondernemerschap van medisch specialisten niet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het risico van gebruik van zonnebanken

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether a licensing system and ID requirement for sunbed operators will be introduced after reports of minors using sunbeds and declining compliance with the age limit. The Minister confirmed the health risks, said she is considering a licence or ID requirement and will review the new SCENHIR advice, but does not plan a ban and prefers the industry to comply with existing rules.
I intend to examine the various options to counter the irresponsible offering of sunbeds.
Ik ben voornemens de verschillende mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om het onverantwoord aanbieden van zonnebanken tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de brief van de stomapoli van het Diakonessenziekenhuis te Leiden

An MP asked the health minister about a letter from a hospital stoma clinic on the role of stoma nurses, the choice of stoma materials, cost transparency and patients' recourse when a supplied device does not fit. The minister answered that insurers must meet their duty of care, that patients can ask for reconsideration and complain to SKGZ, and promised further information on a ZonMw study and talks with the NZa before summer.
It is for the health insurer to give substance to its duty of care for adequate aids for its insured.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraar om invulling te geven aan zijn zorgplicht voor adequate hulpmiddelen voor zijn verzekerde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het bestemmingsplan in Utrecht omtrent het (Nieuwe) Zandpad

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Utrecht zoning plan for 162 brothel windows at the Nieuwe Zandpad, including police and task force involvement in past closures linked to human trafficking and resource implications. The minister said local authorities are responsible for such choices, that the police and prosecution systems cannot report time spent in FTE at the requested level of detail, and that no national inspection was involved.
The systems of the police and the Public Prosecution Service are not designed to determine the time spent in FTEs in a simple and reliable way at the requested level of detail.
De systemen van de politie en het OM zijn er niet op ingesteld om op een eenvoudige en betrouwbare wijze tot op het gevraagde detailniveau de bestede tijd in fte's te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over het dopingrapport van de UCI (Internationale Wielrenunie)

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the UCI cycling doping report, including the role of government investigative powers, the reporting of doctors to the IGZ, and European coordination. The Minister confirmed the report's findings, explained that criminal investigative powers apply to doping-related offences but not to doping use itself, noted that tuchtrechter referral does not require IGZ reporting, and pointed to existing European anti-doping cooperation.
For taking a case to the disciplinary court, reporting to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is not necessary.
Voor een gang naar de tuchtrechter is melding bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over psychiaters en psychotherapeuten die weigeren contracten te tekenen met zorgverzekeraars

An MP asks the minister about psychiatrists and psychotherapists refusing contracts with health insurers, insurers' control over treatment techniques, ROM data benchmarking, privacy of medical data used by insurers (including for mortgages), and complaint routes. The minister defends contracting as the quality and cost vehicle, says insurers may only assess whether treatments meet standards, describes ROM and the benchmark as safeguarded and generally non-uniform, denies misuse of data for mortgages, and cites statutory privacy protections and NZa rules, promising a bill and AMvB to be submitted later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de gevolgen van omzetplafonds in de zorg

Member Bruins Slot (CDA) asked the Minister of Health whether turnover caps (omzetplafonds) in healthcare could create waiting lists, how insurers inform insured persons, what volumes are purchased, and who pays for ongoing treatment when a cap is reached. The Minister answered that insurers must meet their duty of care by mediating to other providers or making extra agreements, that she sees no current risk of waiting lists, and that the NZa supervises insurers' purchasing and information duties.
It is up to the NZa to supervise this.
Het is aan de NZa om hierop toe te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het onderzoek van ActiZ naar de inkoop wijkverpleging 2015

Two MPs from the CDA asked the minister about an ActiZ study showing large volume cuts (up to 40%) imposed by health insurers on district nursing providers in 2015, and the resulting threats to waiting lists, specialised care, budgets and contract terms. The state secretary answered that the cuts are within the agreed framework, insurers have a duty of care, budgets are monitored, and the issue of splitting segment 1 and 2 will be addressed in a forthcoming letter.
The NZa supervises health insurers' implementation of the Zvw and enforces when necessary.
De NZa houdt toezicht op de uitvoering van de Zvw door zorgverzekeraars en handhaaft wanneer noodzakelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over de rol van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bij een psychiater die veroordeeld is voor het bezit van kinderporno en nog

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked how the health inspectorate (IGZ) and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) handled a psychiatrist convicted of possessing child pornography who kept practising, and whether the employer should have been informed. The ministers answered that the IGZ was informed in 2012, opened an investigation and a supervision plan, took a disciplinary case in 2014, and that the OM-IGZ cooperation protocol is being revised to allow sharing of such information.

From the standpoint of patient safety, my view is that possessing, distributing or viewing child pornography by healthcare professionals is so transgressive that it poses a risk to patient safety, and that the convicted psychiatrist should have informed his employer of his conviction.

Vanuit oogpunt van de patiëntveiligheid is mijn standpunt dat het, verspreiden of bekijken van kinderporno door zorgprofessionals dermate grensoverschrijdend is dat het een risico vormt voor de veiligheid van patiënten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de uitzending Beschadigd

An MP from the CDA asks the Health Minister about a documentary on self-harm and negative experiences of patients at emergency departments, covering prevalence, treatment, the quality of care and training, and whether 'no self-harm' contracts are used. The Minister finds the treatment unacceptable, reports that the IGZ is examining signals received via the Landelijk Meldpunt Zorg and will act within weeks, and says she has no insight into the use of such contracts.
Within a few weeks the IGZ will consider what it can and will do with the picture from the signals.
Binnen een aantal weken beziet de IGZ wat ze met het beeld uit de signalen kan en gaat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de ingangsdatum van de subsidieregeling energiebelasting voor sportverenigingen

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked why the energy-tax refund for sports clubs is being abolished, whether clubs face higher costs in 2015 with no refund or subsidy available for that year, and how provinces and clubs are affected. The minister replied that the 2014 refund is still paid in 2015, the new energy-saving subsidy starts 1 January 2016 with no transitional compensation, and the change is designed to reward sustainability investment and is compatible with provincial schemes.
No compensation can be claimed for the calendar year 2015.
Over het kalenderjaar 2015 kan geen compensatie worden aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgverzekeraars voor juiste informatievoorziening via vergelijkingssites

An MP (CDA) asked the Minister of Health how to respond to a Health Care Authority (NZa) finding that some comparison websites give consumers misleading information about insurance policies, and who is liable for wrongly chosen policies. The Minister says insurers must check how comparison sites interpret policy terms and will ask the NZa for rules, but she could not say how many people were misled and referred consumers to existing complaint and court routes.

Health insurers must not only ensure correct information is supplied to comparison sites, but also check afterwards whether the information published about their policies has been correctly processed.

Zorgverzekeraars moeten niet alleen zorg dragen voor een juiste informatieverstrekking aan vergelijkingssites, maar ook achteraf nagaan of de daarop vermelde informatie over hun polissen juist is verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over minutenregistratie voor persoonsgebonden budgetten

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked whether insurers' requirement to declare personal budget care in five-minute blocks, and their earlier promise to act against minute registration, would be addressed. The Secretary of State says insurers will change their declaration method in consultation with ZN and Per Saldo so pgb holders can declare in a way comparable to the AWBZ, with some insurers needing time to adjust their forms.
In consultation with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) and Per Saldo it was discussed that this creates an undesirable situation for pgb holders.
In overleg met Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) en Per Saldo is besproken dat dit voor pgb-houders een onwenselijke situatie oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het onderzoeksrapport van Unie KBO ‘Ruim half miljoen senioren verloren voor internet’

An MP asked ministers how they would address the finding that about 600,000 seniors want to learn internet skills and that many seniors will never use the internet, and how offline seniors can keep contact with government. The minister responded that internet access among seniors is improving, pointed to subsidised digital-skills programmes and alternative offline channels, and said digital government services will continue to be developed toward 2017 with a measurement to be reported later this year.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen dreigen patiënten te weigeren om dure medicijnen

An MP from the CDA asked the Health Minister whether hospitals may refuse patients expensive medicines because of unclear cost responsibility, and how insurers' duty of care and complaint routes work. The minister answered that financial barriers may not justify refusing covered care, that the risk is only signalled by stakeholders, and that a working group and NZa analysis will investigate and report before summer.
I have agreed with them to set up a working group in which all relevant stakeholders are represented.
Ik heb met hen afgesproken om een werkgroep in te stellen waarin alle relevante veldpartijen zijn vertegenwoordigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ellemeet en Bruins Slot over de vergoeding van niet-gecontracteerde zorg in academische ziekenhuizen

MPs Ellemeet and Bruins Slot asked the Minister of Health whether there is an overview of treatments at academic hospitals that are always reimbursed even when the hospital is not contracted, and how insured persons can know in advance what is covered. The Minister declined to publish a full overview, pointing to insurers' duty of care (zorgplicht) and their obligation to publish contracted providers, and explained that disputes go to the insurer, the SKGZ or the civil court.
Such an overview for all treatments and all insurers is impossible to provide in this way.
Een dusdanig overzicht voor alle behandelingen en voor alle verzekeraars is onmogelijk om zo te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Bruins Slot en Van der Staaij over de toekomst van het landelijk centrum De Riethorst voor geestelijke gezondheidszorg voor doven en slechthorenden

MPs asked the minister when she would talk with De Riethorst, why doven-ggz is funded differently from general institutions, whether max-max tariffs suffice, and whether an emergency fix like GGMD's can keep the unit open. The minister replied that insurers bear responsibility for access, that she will talk with insurers and commission an NZa study on funding, and that she sees no reason for extra transition measures.
It is not for me to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij om daarin te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over omzetplafonds in de zorg

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether insurer Zilveren Kruis's volume caps (omzetplafonds) on care providers, which can push patients into waiting lists or cut their coverage, are transparent and lawful, and what the insurer must disclose. The Minister answered that insurers must inform policyholders about caps and their consequences under the NZa policy rule, that the insurer's duty of care applies when a cap is reached, and that the NZa is examining budget policies for contracting consistency.
In my letter of 2 December to the NZa I asked it to examine explicitly whether contracting through these budget policies is sufficient to meet the duty of care.

In het verlengde hiervan heb ik in mijn brief van 2 december aan de NZa gevraagd om ten aanzien van de budgetpolissen expliciet te kijken of de contractering via deze polissen voldoende is om aan de zorgplicht te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over foute artsen

A CDA MP asked the health minister about a US-licensed dentist whose misconduct was not reflected in the Dutch BIG register, how US revocations are weighed, and whether Dutch language tests for EU dentists are feasible. The minister explained that foreign sanctions are generally taken over in full, that language proficiency is required for safe care, and promised to inform parliament on implementation of the amended EU directive during 2015.
Foreign measures are taken over in full, unless taking them over would lead to an unreasonable result under the BIG Act (hardship clause).
Buitenlandse maatregelen worden integraal overgenomen, tenzij overname zou leiden tot een onredelijk resultaat in het kader van de Wet BIG (hardheidsclausule).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over naar de uitzending van Zembla “Fijn dat we verzekerd zijn”

An MP asks the health minister about a Zembla broadcast on insurers selecting against chronically ill patients, risk equalisation shortfalls, and reduced insurer investment in care for undercompensated groups such as home nursing users. The minister acknowledges indirect risk selection as a concern, outlines NZa monitoring and a forthcoming NZa study due May 2015, but says she does not know which insurers or patient groups are affected and commits to further reports and possible measures.
I do not know which health insurers are reluctant to invest in care procurement and innovation, nor for which patient groups precisely and for how long this would have been occurring.
Ik weet niet welke zorgverzekeraars terughoudend zijn in het investeren in zorginkoop en innovatie en niet voor welke groepen patiënten precies en hoe lang dit al zou spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het bericht dat de georganiseerde misdaad 25% van de wereldwijde beroepsmatige sportbeoefening in handen heeft

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether the minister knew the WADA director general's claim that organised crime controls about 25% of professional sport, and asked about Interpol information, a possible global anti-matchfixing agency, and links with doping. The minister said the claim could not be traced to Interpol information, that it was not verifiable, that no link with doping was found, and that Dutch support for the Council of Europe matchfixing convention is the chosen route.
As I already indicated during the Sport Legislative Consultation of 27 October 2014, you cannot expect me to forward all third-party information to your House.
Zoals ik al aangaf tijdens het Wetgevingsoverleg Sport van 27 oktober 2014 kunt u van mij niet verwachten dat ik alle informatie van derden aan uw Kamer doorstuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de beschikbaarheidsbijdrage spoedeisende hulp en acute verloskunde

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether emergency-room and acute obstetric availability payments should remain available for vulnerable hospitals, how the NZa applies its criteria, and what happened to the Gemini hospital in Den Helder. The minister answered that the NZa has refused all applications, that insurers retain their duty of care, and that the NZa will supervise compliance, but declined to comment on the individual Gemini case.
I will not comment on individual applications for an availability contribution. That is an exclusive statutory competence of the NZa.
Ik ga niet in op individuele aanvragen voor een beschikbaarheidsbijdrage. Dat is een exclusieve wettelijke bevoegdheid van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het advies objectief verdeelmodel Wmo 2015 van de Raad voor de financiële verhoudingen

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government will adopt the Rfv's advice against introducing the objective Wmo 2015 distribution model for centre municipalities on 1 January 2015, given large redistribution effects and cuts, and about transition arrangements, contracts and GGZ-C criteria. The state secretary agreed the model should not be introduced in 2015, kept historical budgets for next year, committed to a transition path and consultation with the VNG and providers, but referred some matters to municipalities and the Zorginstituut.
I share this conclusion. It was never the intention to introduce an objective distribution model on 1 January 2015.
Ik deel deze conclusie. Het is ook nooit de bedoeling geweest een objectief verdeelmodel per 1 januari 2015 in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs Van Nispen, Van Tongeren and Bruins Slot asked the ministers about reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and about the Health Council's findings on forensic medicine training and funding. The minister replied that existing registers and quality guidelines suffice for now, declined to fund the forensic physician training or a chair, and promised a further update in mid-2015.
Recent signals from the field and from your House are grounds to examine whether the quality of the body inspection should be tightened.
Recente signalen vanuit het veld en uw Kamer zijn aanleiding om na te gaan of de kwaliteit van de lijkschouw dient te worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de vrije artsenkeuze en Europeesrechtelijke belemmeringen

An MP from the CDA asks the Health Minister whether the proposed amendment of Article 13 Zorgverzekeringswet, which limits reimbursement for non-contracted care under naturapolissen, conflicts with EU law and the ruling in the Petru case, and what this means for free choice of doctor and for medical tourism. The Minister rejects the claim of incompatibility, argues the amendment fits Directive 2011/24/EU, says the Petru ruling changes nothing in existing practice, and promises transparency obligations for insurers overseen by the NZa.
I do not share that conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het voorkomen van onnodige ziekenhuisopnames in de laatste levensfase

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister how to prevent unnecessary hospital admissions at the end of life, including discussing non-treatment options, reimbursing conversations about end-of-life care, and financing palliative home-care consultations. The minister agreed that doctors should raise non-treatment options, pointed to existing and planned tariffs and the National Palliative Care Programme, and said funding for palliative home-care teams is being examined.
I therefore agree with the suggestion that GPs, but also other doctors, raise the option of not treating with people who are terminally ill.
Ik ben het daarom eens met de suggestie dat huisartsen, maar ook andere artsen, de optie «niet behandelen» aan de orde stellen bij mensen die ongeneeslijk ziek zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Bruins Slot en Van der Staaij over afspraken tussen supermarkten over het weren van effectieve controlesystemen handhaving alcoholleeftijd

MPs asked the state secretary whether supermarkets agreed to exclude effective age-verification systems for alcohol sales, whether this is unacceptable, what the government knew and what it has done about alcohol-age enforcement compliance (around 50%). The state secretary answered that it is up to supermarkets to choose their approach, that the ACM has not closed its investigation into possible prohibited agreements, that the government is monitoring compliance and is reluctant to impose systems, and that a pilot did not improve compliance.
The ministry is not aware of unlawful agreements between supermarkets.
Het ministerie is niet bekend met ongeoorloofde afspraken tussen supermarkten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het uitbreiden van de pilot voor zzp’ers in de zorg

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries about the pilot allowing self-employed care workers (zzp'ers) to obtain VAR-wuo statements, including how many were contacted, how many enrolled, and whether the pilot would continue. The State Secretary answered that about 650 contracts were concluded, that all care offices participated, and that the pilot's future depends on the long-term care reform and a short-term review of alternative business models.
However, no registration is kept of the reasons why self-employed persons decline participation in the pilot.
Er wordt echter geen registratie bijgehouden van de motieven waarom zzp'ers afzien van deelname aan de pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de mogelijke wijziging van het Sportbesluit

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about possible changes to the VAT sports exemption after the Bridport judgment, including effects on municipalities and sports clubs. The government answered that the Bridport ruling requires reviewing the exemption, that no decision or cost estimate has been made yet, and that the review will weigh all financial and legal aspects.
As stated, a carefully considered decision on the design of the sports exemption will be taken after weighing all financial, organisational, legal, administrative and implementation aspects.

Zoals gemeld zal met afweging van alle financiële, organisatorische, juridische, administratieve en uitvoeringsaspecten een weloverwogen besluit worden genomen over de vormgeving van de sportvrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de rol en zorgvuldigheid van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the Inspectorate's handling of an informal agreement with a psychologist who had a relationship with a patient, the legal basis for such agreements, the Tuchtcollege ruling on the lack of a transitional arrangement, and an erroneous IGZ report on a Leeuwarden hospital. The Minister answered that the case did not involve an informal agreement under the agreed criteria, that the policy change was documented and public, that 13 individuals were identified with no current involvement, and that the erroneous wording was corrected by erratum.
In this case there is no question of an informal occupational restriction agreement between the practitioner and the IGZ.
Er is in deze casus geen sprake van een onderhandse beroepsbeperkende afspraak tussen de beroepsbeoefenaar en de IGZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de mogelijke sluiting van de Spoedeisende Hulp in Weert

MPs Bruins Slot and Knops asked the minister about the possible closure of the emergency department at Sint Jans Gasthuis in Weert, the planned regional reorganisation of acute care, and whether the 45-minute access norm and quality criteria are adequately protected. The minister answered that insurers bear primary responsibility for contracting, the joint insurer plan has been suspended after ACM concerns, and the 45-minute norm remains the key safeguard, while declining to make the regional plans public.
It is also not for me to make these plans public.
Het is ook niet aan mij om deze plannen openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs asked the government how it responds to reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and whether training should be publicly funded to prevent a shortage and quality problem. The minister said employers are responsible for staffing, a professional register safeguards quality, and no short-term measures or public funding are currently warranted.
I saw and see no reason to take measures in the short term.
Ik zag en zie daarin geen aanleiding om op korte termijn maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over handel in illegale en levensbedreigende afslankproducten en doping

MPs Bruins Slot and Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about the easy online sale of illegal slimming pills, anabolics and EPO, low prosecution priority, enforcement capacity, reporting of counterfeit medicines and the doping law. The minister answered that enforcement is part of regular inspection work, a reporting point is being studied with results expected late 2014, and a doping bill has been delayed to late 2014.
After the summer recess you will receive a letter from me on the implementation of the Bruins Slot/Pia Dijkstra motion.
Na het zomerreces ontvangt u van mij een brief over de uitvoering van de motie Bruins Slot/Pia Dijkstra
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de (dreigende) uitbraak van MERS-CoV

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about the WHO warnings on the rising MERS-CoV outbreak, the apparent contradiction on human-to-human transmission, Saudi advice to risk groups on Hajj, and support for research on animal-to-human transmission. The minister answered that the Netherlands follows WHO advice, informs travellers and clinicians via RIVM and LCR, and that further research on animal transmission should happen mainly on the Arabian peninsula.
Ik onderschrijf de adviezen van de WHO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Bruins Slot en Voortman over het gesloten zorgakkoord met de vijf-partijencoalitie

MPs Leijten, Bruins Slot and Voortman asked the health minister for the text and financial basis of the June 2014 care agreement with the five-party coalition, whether the Finance Ministry and CPB were involved, which care organisations took part, and her view on amendments to the Health Insurance Act. The minister answered that no written agreement exists beyond the amendments, that Finance and CPB were involved in the costing, that the sector bodies signed the sector-level agreements, and that she supports most amendments while opposing those that would reverse the change to article 13.
Apart from this, there is no agreement committed to writing.
Er is hiernaast geen sprake van een op schrift gesteld akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de mortuariumkosten van ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about hospital mortuary charges for post-mortem care, including whether tariffs should be published, whether maximum tariffs should apply, and whether pacemaker removal counts as necessary care. The Minister said the state should not regulate tariffs for offered services, that families should explicitly agree to desirable care, and that she sees no ministerial responsibility for publishing tariffs.
I am of the view that the government should not concern itself with how service providers (in this case hospitals) agree on their services with the recipients of those services.
Ik ben van mening dat de overheid zich niet moet bezighouden met de wijze waarop dienstverleners (in casu ziekenhuizen) over hun diensten afspraken maken met de afnemers van die diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over garanties in het kader van het bid voor het Europees Kampioenschap voetbal in 2020
