MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Health about why government guarantees for the Euro 2020 football bid, including tax exemptions and a no-new-legislation commitment, were signed before parliament was informed, and requested documents and details of the tax guarantees. The minister replies that guarantees were kept within existing legal frameworks, that parliament was informed once the bid was finalized, that the tax guarantees do not create specific exemptions beyond existing law, and that some documents will be sent later or are publicly available.
I then informed the House that same day about the submission of the bid and the government guarantees I signed on behalf of the state, which form part of the bid.
Ik heb vervolgens de Kamer die dag terstond geïnformeerd over het uitbrengen van het bid en de overheidsgaranties die ik namens het Rijk heb ondertekend en onderdeel uitmaken van het bid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over ‘Mening: onjuist geïnformeerd over risicoselectie in de zorg’

An MP asks whether the Minister misinformed parliament about risk selection in health insurance, citing an academic who questions the claim that a level playing field removes selection incentives, and asks about known losses on former AWBZ-indicated insured persons. The Minister rejects the claim that parliament was misinformed, explains ongoing model improvements and a planned study on morbidity-based criteria, and promises to address selection incentives qualitatively in the autumn letter.
In possible model improvements I use signals and suggestions from the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa), insurers, patient associations, research bureaus and universities.
Ik maak bij de mogelijke modelverbeteringen gebruik van signalen en suggesties van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa), verzekeraars, patiëntenverenigingen, onderzoeksbureau en universiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Hijum en Keijzer over stijging van de zorgpremie

MPs Bruins Slot, Van Hijum and Keijzer asked why the CPB projects the nominal health insurance premium rising by EUR 144 to 2015 when the minister had claimed an increase of at most EUR 20 from the transfer of AWBZ care, and asked about funding, compensation and the own-risk increase. The minister answered that the EUR 20 figure covers only the transfer effect, that the remainder stems from the 50/50 rebalancing, reserves and autonomous cost growth, that the temporary state contribution is covered within the revenue framework, and that low-income households are fully compensated via the healthcare allowance, including for the own-risk rise.

The premium increase of at most EUR 20 mentioned in the letter of 4 March 2014 relates only to the expected rise in the nominal premium under the Health Insurance Act (Zvw) in 2015 due to the transfers.

De premiestijging van maximaal € 20 die wordt genoemd in de brief van 4 maart 2014 heeft enkel betrekking op de verwachte stijging van de nominale premie in de Zorgverzekeringswet (Zvw) in 2015 door de overhevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “buitenlandse uitzendkracht genept met goedkope zorgpolis”

An MP asked whether health insurance tied to temporary agency workers' contracts is being used against them, including employers keeping collective discounts, unclear policy terms, and loss of cover on dismissal. The minister answered that workers are free to decline employer-offered policies, that employers must not withhold policy information, and that she will discuss the matter with employment agencies, employers and unions.
It is not intended that the employer or the health insurer profit from this at the expense of the migrant worker.
Het is niet de bedoeling dat de werkgever of de zorgverzekeraar daar ten koste van de arbeidsmigrant voordeel uit haalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bruins Slot over de dreigende sluiting van ruiter- en mountainbikepaden beheerd door Staatsbosbeheer

MPs Geurts and Bruins Slot asked whether the government shares fears that horse-riding and mountain-bike paths managed by Staatsbosbeheer will decline, and how it oversees path maintenance and possible user fees. The state secretary replied that no closures are planned, that the government does not supervise path maintenance, that it steers Staatsbosbeheer only at a general level, and that it leaves the matter to talks between the agency and sports federations.
The cabinet does not supervise this.
Het kabinet houdt hier geen toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de problemen van zzp’ers in de zorg om een VAR-wuo te krijgen of te behouden

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked how the Tax Authority assesses VAR-wuo self-employment declarations for care workers, and whether withdrawals are leaving zzp'ers without clients. The government answers that the assessment follows uniform legal criteria, that care provision in kind generally implies employment with the institution, and that the policy is unchanged, while noting a pilot allowing direct contracting with care offices and some withdrawals were wrongly made.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over een spotgoedkope zorgverzekering voor buitenlandse arbeidsmigranten

An MP asked the Health Minister whether a cheap health insurance construction for foreign seasonal workers, which reinsures the deductible through supplementary insurance, fits the law and avoids risk selection, and whether tying basic and supplementary insurance is improper bundling. The minister answered that such constructions lie outside the Health Insurance Act, are limited in size and were monitored by the NZa, that deductibles are pro-rated for short coverage, and that the zorgtoeslag is based on annual income under EU rules.
At the time I agreed with the NZa that it would monitor developments regarding reinsurance of the deductible.
Ik heb destijds met de NZa afgesproken dat zij de ontwikkelingen rondom het herverzekeren zouden volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat de IC van het Reinier de Graaf Gasthuis dreigt weg te vallen

An MP asked the minister whether plans by health insurers to close the intensive care unit at Reinier de Graaf Gasthuis, including the stakeholder support and municipal involvement, were sound. The minister replied that the plan is still a draft to be discussed with regional parties, that acute basic care spreading is important, and that municipal involvement is not necessarily logical for specialised emergency care.
Involvement of municipal governments is not necessarily logical by definition.
Betrokkenheid van gemeentebesturen is niet per definitie logisch.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de financiering van eerstelijns geboortecentra

An MP asked the health minister whether small birth centres should have independent WMG funding, why NZa tariff increases had not raised insurer payments, and how insurers and hospitals should settle costs. The minister answered that birth centres already have a separate payment title, that a national evaluation will report in 2016, and that the NZa will consult stakeholders shortly on integrated funding.
The NZa will shortly consult all stakeholders on a number of planned policy changes and integrated funding.
De NZa treedt op korte termijn in overleg met alle betrokkenen over een aantal voorgenomen beleidswijzigingen en integrale bekostiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat de spoedeisende hulp (SEH) van het LangeLand Ziekenhuis gaat verdwijnen

An MP asked the health minister about insurers' plans to close the emergency department and intensive care at LangeLand Hospital, and about the 45-minute access norm, the future of basic hospitals and the impact on Zoetermeer. The minister said the plans are premature, that insurers must safeguard the 45-minute norm under their duty of care, and promised a vision on regional spread of basic hospitals in April.
I will send you this vision in April.
Ik zend u deze visie in april.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat geneesmiddelen van fabrikant Ranbaxy in opspraak zijn, maar in Nederland nog steeds als preferent middel worden voorgeschreven

The MP asked why the IGZ did not immediately act after the US FDA banned imports of Ranbaxy active ingredients, why it did not order a full recall, and what concrete steps were taken after the June 2013 debate. The minister answered that the IGZ took precautionary measures mirroring the FDA import ban, that there is no direct health risk, and that Ranbaxy plants are inspected jointly with European bodies through the EMA.
The IGZ regards the FDA findings as a signal that the plant does not have its quality system in order, which calls for a strong response toward the company.
De IGZ weegt de bevindingen van de FDA als een signaal dat de betreffende fabriek zijn kwaliteitssysteem niet op orde heeft, hetgeen een krachtige reactie vraagt richting de firma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “Ex-patiënt staat met lege handen”

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether patients harmed by medical errors at a bankrupt hospital can claim damages without being placed behind other creditors, and what the government will do about it. The Minister said the matter is sub judice (a preliminary ruling was issued, possibly appealed) and declined to give a substantive view, while expressing sympathy for the patients.
I therefore do not think it is appropriate to give a substantive judgment on this case.
Ik vind het derhalve niet opportuun om een inhoudelijk oordeel te geven over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het sluiten van de apotheekdiensten in Lelystad na 22.00 uur

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the closure of Lelystad's night pharmacy service, the consequences for residents needing urgent medication, and whether insurers' duty of care is breached. The minister answered that insurers and pharmacists have a duty of care, that the NZa and IGZ supervise compliance, that closure is not per se a breach, and that a 45-minute time criterion applies, leaving the assessment to the IGZ.
Whether health insurers comply with their duty of care is for the specific supervisor, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa), to assess.
Of zorgverzekeraars zich aan hun zorgplicht houden staat ter beoordeling van de specifieke toezichthouder de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Bruins Slot over toename openstaande rekeningen in de zorg

MPs Bouwmeester and Bruins Slot asked the Minister of Health about rising unpaid hospital bills from uninsured people, including whether EU citizens can be effectively pursued and whether CVZ should investigate. Minister Schippers answered that EU residents must be insured if they stay over three months and that CVZ's tracing is limited to registered persons, but declined to commission research, saying debt prevention is hospitals' responsibility, while only asking NVZ and NFV to map the losses.
I do not consider research into the nature, scope and causes of uninsured EU citizens failing to take out insurance a task for the CVZ, nor a task for the Dutch government as such.

Ik vind onderzoek naar de aard, omvang en oorzaak van het niet afsluiten van een verzekering door niet verzekerde EU-burgers geen taak voor het CVZ, noch een taak voor de Nederlandse overheid als zodanig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over Legionella op de Verpleegafdeling kortverblijf inwendige geneeskunde in het LUMC

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers why legionella bacteria were found in water at a LUMC ward for years, why patients are told not to drink or shower with tap water, and why bottled water is used instead of filters, and whether this is acceptable. The ministers answer that LUMC is taking preventive measures, that the contaminated pipes are being replaced, that the Inspectorate (ILT) reports and enforcement approach are described, and that other measures were chosen by the hospital.
It is good that the LUMC takes preventive measures when legionella exceeds the norm in the drinking water installation, to prevent contamination of persons with the legionella bacterium.
Het is goed dat het LUMC preventieve maatregelen neemt bij een normoverschrijding van legionella in de drinkwaterinstallatie ter voorkoming van besmetting van personen met de legionellabacterie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Rooise ondernemers met de Nixpress de landelijke kranten halen

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about a report that Roosendaal entrepreneurs run a bus taking minors to Belgian discotheques, circumventing the new Dutch age limit, and asked what municipalities and the police can do. The State Secretary agreed it is undesirable, said no alcohol sale to minors occurs so the Drink and Hospitality Act is not violated and municipal plans play little role, and noted that public drunkenness on return could be prosecuted under article 453 of the Criminal Code.
As long as no alcohol is sold to minors on the bus, there is no violation of the Drink and Hospitality Act.
Zolang in de bus geen alcohol wordt verkocht aan minderjarigen, is geen sprake van overtreding van de Drank- en Horecawet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het BNN-programma “Tot op het bot”

An MP asked the health minister about a BNN programme on anorexia treatment, including mortality, whether hospitals focus only on weight restoration, and hospital-to-GGZ handover. The minister confirmed viewing the programme, cited international mortality figures, pointed to the existing multidisciplinary eating-disorder guideline and the GGZ administrative agreement, and said she would explore further steps in 2014.
I am of the view that more attention can be paid to the relationship between mind and body in care.
Ik ben van mening dat aan de relatie tussen psyche en somatiek meer aandacht kan worden besteed in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de beperkte en onduidelijke uitleg van het Sportbesluit

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Belastingdienst's handling of VAT on sports facilities, including a court ruling on artificial turf, long waiting times for advice, the treatment of walking and cycling routes, and a call for clearer rules. The State Secretary answered that the tax office has appealed the district court ruling and continues to challenge artificial constructions, that advice can take weeks to over a year, that reserved routes qualify under the reduced rate, and that an updated policy decision is expected in early 2014 after consultation with sports bodies.
I intend to update the aforementioned policy decision of 27 October 2011.
Ik heb het voornemen om het hiervoor genoemde beleidsbesluit van 27 oktober 2011 te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het Foetaal Alcohol Syndroom

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Health about fetal alcohol syndrome, including whether professionals and specialised care are adequate and why a pregnancy warning logo on alcohol will only be sector-wide by 2016. The State Secretary replied that professionals are informed but have little FAS experience, that five specialised centres exist, that the alcohol sector has committed to a logo with compliance targets and monitoring, and that full implementation takes until 2016.
VWS receives annual progress reports from the alcohol sector, with an outlook for the coming year.
VWS ontvangt van de alcoholsector jaarlijkse rapportages over de voortgang, met daarbij een vooruitblik op het komende jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat de grootste online hulpwebsite van Nederland, hulpmix.nl, wordt opgedoekt

An MP asked whether the closure of the online help site hulpmix.nl for migrant youth, and the funding gap for online prevention, was consistent with e-health policy and how the government would address it. The minister acknowledged the closure is unfavourable, explained that preventive online counselling is not covered by insurance and that the subsidy scheme applies only to anonymous care, and said the state is not responsible for such youth chat services, referring initiators to municipalities and insurers.
It is not the task of the central government to provide this form of online help.
Het is geen taak van de rijksoverheid om te voorzien in deze vorm van online hulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over de effectiviteit van de Bob-campagne

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP and CDA asked the ministers whether independent research shows the Bob campaign works, especially for young drivers, and whether a new, harder campaign concept is needed. The minister answered that annual effect measurements show a decline in drink-driving offenders, particularly among 18–24 year old men, and rejected a new youth concept and harder confrontational messaging as unsupported by evidence.
I do not agree with that finding.
Ik ben het niet eens met die constatering.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het opinieartikel het opinieartikel “Niet alleen pillen, ook preventie nodig in de zorg; Grote veranderingen in laatste honderd jaar hebben conflict veroorzaakt tussen onze

An MP asked the minister about an opinion piece calling for a shift from curative to preventive medicine, the role of diet, GP and pharmacist nutrition knowledge, and foreign prevention programmes. The minister agreed prevention deserves a larger role, described existing initiatives and the National Prevention Programme, but declined to adopt a central role for diet or to implement the Iowa model directly.
The plea fits the shift in thinking from illness/care/dependence to health/behaviour/own strength.
Het pleidooi past bij de omslag in het denken van ziekte /zorg/afhankelijkheid naar gezondheid/gedrag/eigen kracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Nederland blind is voor matchfixing

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands is blind to matchfixing, whether there were signals of foul play in the Netherlands-Hungary World Cup qualifier, whether that match was monitored, and when the ongoing judicial preliminary investigation would conclude. The minister referred to earlier answers for the first questions and said the public prosecutor's preliminary inquiry into football fraud has no fixed end date.
The public prosecution service has informed me that examining signals within the preliminary investigation is not linked to an end date.
Het OM heeft mij meegedeeld dat het bekijken van signalen in het kader van het voorbereidend onderzoek niet is gekoppeld aan een einddatum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Huizing en Bruins Slot over kickboksen door kinderen

Three MPs asked the health minister about children's kickboxing with head strikes allowed, the need for binding rules across fragmented kickboxing federations, and the quality of instructors. The minister agreed head contact is undesirable, said NOC*NSF will lead a plan for sector-wide rules expected by summer 2014, and said she would advise parents against such training while not yet ruling out a legal fallback.
For this, an impulse from outside is needed.
Daartoe is een impuls van buitenaf nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het Bruins Slot over het bericht dat een medische test homo’s moet ‘detecteren’ en uit Golfstaten weren

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Health whether they consider the development of a medical test aimed at detecting homosexuality, reportedly to bar gay people from Gulf states such as Kuwait, undesirable, and whether they will raise it with those countries and with FIFA regarding the 2022 World Cup. The minister answered that such a test is undesirable, that the proposal under consideration by Kuwait concerns a joint GCC gender test for work and residence visa applicants, and that the ministry is monitoring the situation and will act jointly with partners if appropriate.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is closely monitoring the situation, is in contact with EU partners and will take appropriate action jointly with international partners if opportune.

Het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken volgt de situatie op de voet, staat in contact met EU-partners en zal indien het opportuun mocht zijn gepaste actie ondernemen gezamenlijk met internationale partners.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het bericht dat het Bureau Medicinale Cannabis van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport wiet gaat leveren voor een Utrechts experiment met hasjver

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether a Utrecht experiment supplying cannabis to psychiatric patients could receive an Opium Act exemption and whether the government would block it. The government answered that no exemption application has been filed, so no cannabis will be supplied, and that the Public Prosecution Service would act against any unlicensed experiment.
No application for an Opium Act exemption has yet been submitted for an experiment
Er is nog geen aanvraag voor een Opiumwetontheffing ingediend voor een experiment
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Bruins Slot over de fraude met AGB-codes

MPs Bouwmeester and Bruins Slot asked the health minister about fraud with AGB provider codes, including reported fake doctors submitting false claims, NZa knowledge, Vektis responsibilities, tribunal suspensions and sanctions. The minister answered that Vektis will periodically check AGB registrations via linked public registers, that NZa is investigating, that suspended practitioners should be blocked, and that sanctions are being reviewed in a December progress report.
Vektis will check the AGB files more often in the short term.
Vektis gaat op korte termijn de AGB bestanden vaker controleren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de uitspraken van de Russische minister van Sport

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether Russia's anti-gay law would apply to athletes at the Sochi Winter Olympics, whether Russia would guarantee non-interference, and how the Dutch government would act under its human rights note and EU LGBTI guidelines. The government condemned the law as discriminatory, reported the IOC's written guarantee from Russia, and committed to raising the issue in the EU Foreign Affairs Council and in bilateral contacts.
The Netherlands will continue to press internationally that the anti-gay propaganda law not be applied to participants and visitors during the 2014 Winter Games.
Nederland zal in internationaal verband er op blijven aandringen dat de anti-homopropagandawet tijdens de Winterspelen in 2014 niet op deelnemers en bezoekers wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het bericht ‘dat er nog altijd veel mis is in de gehandicaptenzorg’

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about a Nieuwsuur report on continued problems in disability care, including untrained staff in risky situations, low staffing scores, and high rates of unjustified coercive measures. The state secretary answered that inspection signals do not show more untrained staff, disputed the comparability of the inspection figures, and pointed to the Zorg en dwang bill and the Actieprogramma onvrijwillige zorg as the response.
With the Action Programme on involuntary care I am stimulating that.
Met het Actieprogramma Onvrijwillige zorg stimuleer ik dat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Drinken tijdens zwangerschap kan gewoon’

MPs Bruins Slot, Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether a UK study suggesting moderate drinking in pregnancy is harmless changes government advice, and how professional guidance and a warning logo will be addressed. The State Secretary answered that the advice to avoid alcohol in pregnancy stands, will be raised with professional groups, and that talks with the drinks sector on a voluntary pregnancy logo continue, with a report to follow after summer.
The government's position remains that it is best to avoid drinking alcohol when you want to become pregnant, are pregnant or are breastfeeding.
Het standpunt van de overheid is nog altijd dat het het beste is het drinken van alcohol te vermijden wanneer je zwanger wilt worden, zwanger bent of borstvoeding geeft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat online alcoholhoudende drank kopen kinderspel is

MPs Van der Staaij and Bruins Slot asked whether municipalities lack effective enforcement powers over online alcohol sales to minors, and whether the Drank- en Horecawet should change. The state secretary acknowledged weak enforcement of online sales, outlined interministerial work on eID-based age verification with no firm timeline, and argued that parents bear primary responsibility.
In practice it has proved difficult to exercise adequate supervision here, because delivery takes place at the front door at unpredictable moments.
In de praktijk is het lastig gebleken hier adequaat toezicht op te houden, omdat het gaat om levering aan de voordeur op niet te voorspellen momenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “Seksuele intimidatie co-assistenten”

An MP asked the health minister about reports of sexual intimidation of medical co-assistants, whether existing confidential advisers are used, and what sanctions hospitals can impose on staff. The minister said such intimidation is unacceptable, pointed to CAO rules, hospital disciplinary regulations and an action plan, and offered to monitor the problem.
I am willing to monitor sexual intimidation of healthcare workers.
Ik ben bereid seksuele intimidatie van zorgverleners te monitoren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot over de vraag “Wie controleert de dokter”?

MPs Bruins Slot and Bouwmeester asked the health minister whether patients in disciplinary proceedings against doctors should receive more support, such as IGZ assistance, the ability to amend complaints during hearings, and a reversed burden of proof. The minister said IGZ will not represent patients, that a new Zorgloket will guide complainants, that she will examine amending complaints within the Wet BIG, and that the Wkkgz will make incident documentation mandatory, shifting the burden of proof indirectly.
I support the idea behind this and will examine the proposals further in the context of amending disciplinary law in the Wet BIG.
Ik steun de gedachte hier achter en zal de voorstellen nader onderzoeken in het kader van de aanpassing van het tuchtrecht in de Wet BIG.

Vragen van het lid Bruins Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een omstreden neuroloog niet op de zwarte lijst van het BIG-register staat (ingezonden 3 mei 2013).

An MP asked the health minister whether a British ban on a controversial neurologist applies in the Netherlands, and why he is not on the BIG register's blacklist. The minister said conditional restrictions can be recorded but the UK deregistration was administrative, and that clarity on recording would follow within three weeks, and described new bilateral data exchange with the UK.
Currently it is being examined whether the competence-restricting conditions imposed on the controversial neurologist in the UK at the time must be recorded in the BIG register.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht of de bevoegdheidsbeperkende voorwaarden die destijds in het VK aan de omstreden neuroloog zijn opgelegd, in het BIG-register moeten worden aangetekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over dopingdealers

An MP asked ministers about doping dealers, including the risks of doping use, illegal laboratories, cooperation with Belgian and German authorities, and why doping use itself is not criminal. The ministers answered that enforcement is shared among several agencies, that the three IGZ investigations led to one conviction and two dismissals, and that doping use is a sporting rule rather than a crime, so the government focuses on prevention.
Whether this is mostly the case is not known to the OM.
Of dit veelal het geval is, is het OM niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het artikel “Toezichthouder zorg is mislukt”

An MP asks the health minister about a newspaper article and a PhD thesis claiming the Dutch health care authority (NZa) rarely used its market-power powers, may overlap with the competition authority (NMa), and risks conflict with EU competition law, and whether those powers should be integrated into the ACM. The minister answers that the NZa's powers are useful and necessary, that EU-law conflict risk exists for market-power instruments but not for article 45, that a review is scheduled for 2014, and that the NMa's lost fine cases are a matter for the courts.
I consider the NZa's competition powers useful and necessary.
Ik vind de mededingingsbevoegdheden van de NZa nuttig en noodzakelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de huidige schaarste in Nederlandse winkels aan melkpoeder

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about shortages of baby milk powder in Dutch shops, its risks, supply security for hospitals, and whether she would join an industry meeting. The minister answered that there is no absolute shortage, only of certain brands; parents can switch brands, hospitals report no problems, and she sees no need to attend the meeting.
Fortunately, there is no absolute shortage of baby milk powder in the Netherlands.
Gelukkig is er in Nederland geen sprake van een absoluut tekort aan babymelkpoeder.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de btw-heffing bij zelfstandigen in de zorg

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked whether self-employed nurses in hospitals, who are exempt from VAT under the BIG-registration logic, should charge 21% VAT, and how this squares with Article 10 of the VAT Directive and a Breda court ruling. The state secretary answers that such nurses are treated like temporary-staffing agencies, that the work is taxable labour provision, that the Tax Authority has appealed the Breda ruling, and that payment arrangements exist for back-tax assessments.
The Tax Authority has therefore lodged an appeal against the Breda district court ruling.
De Belastingdienst heeft daarom hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Breda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘’ Medische gegevens via hoorwinkels op straat”

An MP asked the health minister about reports that customers' medical data from hearing-aid fitting was accessible across hearing shops, raising fraud and privacy concerns. The minister replied that the digital hearing protocol was taken offline after audiciens could view each other's client files, that the access was disproportionate, and that the system will only return once shops guarantee careful handling of client data.
On closer inspection, access to these files appears to have been too generous and not proportionate.
Bij nader inzien blijkt de toegang tot deze dossiers te ruimhartig en niet proportioneel te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Uitstoot van ammonia bij BASF De Meern”

MPs Geurts and Bruins Slot asked whether BASF De Meern was shut down over safety concerns after an ammonia and nitrogen oxide emission, and requested inspection histories, violations, sanctions and emission data. The government answered that the municipality halted the plant temporarily by administrative coercion, that the Inspectorate SZW found no worker safety risk, and listed past exceedances and inspection results, while noting that the ILT does not supervise the BRZO and that the answers needed more time.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht CNV Publieke zaak “Herregistratie BIG-register”

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that care institutions in disability care have lower-qualified staff carry out reserved medical acts, and about training, liability and inspection. The minister answered that only certain BIG-registered professionals may perform reserved acts independently, that others may do so on instruction if competent, that training is the profession's own responsibility, and that the Inspectorate checks whether institutions have competent staff.
It is not permitted for staff to perform reserved acts for which they are not competent.
Het is niet toegestaan dat medewerkers voorbehouden handelingen verrichten waar ze niet bekwaam voor zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bruins Slot over matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Bruins Slot asked the ministers of Justice and of Health about matchfixing, including Belgian and German approaches, the claim that Dutch enforcement is lax, possible prosecution of Dutch nationals abroad, and the need for special investigative powers or a dedicated unit at the Public Prosecution Service. Minister Opstelten replied that there are no concrete indications of matchfixing in the Netherlands, that investigations will start if signals arise, that a German investigation concerns Dutch suspects and falls under territoriality, and that special powers and a new unit are not currently justified.
There is no question of concrete indications regarding matchfixing in the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake van concrete aanwijzingen met betrekking tot matchfixing in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Hilkens over de uitzending van 1Vandaag over de drug GHB

Two MPs from CDA and PvdA asked the state secretaries about a 1Vandaag broadcast on GHB, covering prevention, addiction treatment waiting lists, hospital care, enforcement, and the GBL precursor. The government answered that prevention and local tailored approaches are underway, that treatment capacity is limited and some regions have waiting lists, and that it will commission a quick scan on GBL and consider policy adjustments.
I will instruct the Coordination Committee for Assessment and Monitoring of New Drugs to carry out a quick scan on the use of GBL.
Ik zal de Coördinatiecommissie Assessment en Monitoring nieuwe drugs opdragen een quick scan uit te voeren met betrekking tot het gebruik van GBL
Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot (CDA) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een lijst van 1000 medische missers (ingezonden 21 februari 2013).

Two MPs asked the health minister about a list of 1000 medical errors that the Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) mistakenly leaked to RTL, including privacy safeguards, calamity reporting and triage quality. The minister acknowledged the leak was unacceptable and unintentional, promised improvement measures and a legal duty to inform patients of calamity reports, and committed to a Zorgloket and periodic transparency reporting.
As I have previously stated, I find it unacceptable that confidential information from the IGZ became known to RTL.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, vind ik het onacceptabel dat vertrouwelijke informatie van de IGZ bij RTL bekend is geworden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Bruins Slot over diefstal van medicatie uit een ziekenhuis

MPs Bouwmeester and Bruins Slot asked the health minister about a hospital in Bergen op Zoom where morphine was handed out on a fictitious patient's name, raising protocol, oversight by the IGZ and insurer declaration questions. The minister agreed the situation was serious, said the hospital had a protocol and has tightened its procedures, and pointed to IGZ oversight and the hospital's own responsibility, while stating that individual patient medication cannot be traced from insurer declarations.
Subsequently the procedures in the hospital have been tightened. The IGZ supervises this.
Vervolgens zijn de procedures in het ziekenhuis aangescherpt. De IGZ houdt hierop toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht op de site van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Kinderfysiotherapie

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about insurers' new contract terms for child physiotherapists, which removed care at special schools and medical day-care centres, and their late announcement. The minister answered that insurers are free to set terms, that the late notice concerned one insurer which has since introduced a transitional arrangement, and that talks with the professional association and insurers on defining necessary care are ongoing.
Health insurers are free to make agreements about the care they purchase and the manner in which it is delivered.
Het staat zorgverzekeraars vrij om afspraken te maken over de zorg die zij inkopen en op welke manier deze wordt geleverd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat tot tweemaal veroordeelde huisarts nog altijd als bevoegd arts in het BIG-register staat

The CDA MP Bruins Slot asked why a GP convicted twice for child pornography remained registered in the BIG register, why the IGZ did not pursue deregistration, and what options exist. The minister declined to discuss the case citing privacy, pointed to the IGZ-OM cooperation protocol, and announced a plan to require VOG certificates for all medical professionals including self-employed doctors.
Because of the privacy of the person concerned, I cannot go into the background of this specific case.
Omwille van de privacy van betrokkene kan ik niet ingaan op de achtergronden van dit concrete geval.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat de minister geen lijst kan presenteren van artsen waarmee de IGZ een deal heeft gesloten om te stoppen met werken

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked why the minister cannot provide a complete list of IGZ restrictive agreements with doctors since 2000, and whether such agreements are lawful, including the case of Jansen Steur before the 2014 limitation date. The minister answered that the IGZ never systematically recorded these agreements, estimated 10-20 per year, said legality is for the courts, and explained tuchtrecht options against Jansen Steur while promising stronger registration and ICT investment.
Because restrictive agreements were not systematically recorded by the IGZ in the past, including by its regional offices, it is not possible to provide a detailed overview.

Omdat de beroepsbeperkende afspraken in het verleden door de IGZ niet structureel zijn bijgehouden – ook niet door haar regiokantoren – is het niet mogelijk om hiervan een (gedetailleerd) overzicht te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de brief van de Caribisch Nederlandse Vereniging van fysiotherapeuten met daarin de wijziging van de ziektekostenverzekering op Caribisch Nederland per 1

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about the late announcement and cut-back of physiotherapy and dental care in the Caribbean Netherlands' basic insurance from 1 January 2013, questioning consultation and the 5-working-day notice. The minister conceded five working days was too short, extended the transition to 1 July 2013, promised to announce future package decisions by 1 July of the prior year, but refused to postpone or revise the decision.
For that reason it was decided to introduce a transition period of half a year, in line with common practice in European Netherlands.
Daarom is besloten tot een overgangsperiode van een half jaar conform de gangbare praktijk in Europees Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over bericht dat de vooruitgang van patiëntveiligheid in ziekenhuizen traag gaat

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether the slow progress on patient safety in hospitals is confirmed, why the VMS programme's goal of halving preventable deaths was missed, and how the government will continue and fund patient safety efforts after 2012. The Minister acknowledges that progress is slower than desired, says the 2012 target outcome is still being studied and promises a follow-up letter, and points to sector-led agreements and existing ZonMw programmes as the way forward.
It is still too early to conclude that this target has not been met, but the figures from the latest measurement are not optimistic.
Het is nu nog te vroeg om te concluderen dat deze doelstelling niet is gehaald, maar de cijfers van de laatste meting stemmen niet optimistisch.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat dhr. Jansen Steur zich in 2006 geregistreerd heeft in Duitsland als arts?

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether Jansen Steur registered as a doctor in Germany in 2006, which bodies knew, how the IGZ and prosecutors handled the matter, and why he was allowed to work abroad. The minister confirmed the German registration, explained the IGZ's 2006 decisions and the ongoing criminal case, and said he cannot work in the Netherlands because he is not BIG-registered.
The Public Prosecution Service sent several requests for legal assistance to the German authorities in the investigation that led to the case now pending before the Almelo court.

Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft in het kader van het onderzoek dat heeft geleid tot de rechtszaak die nu aanhangig is bij de rechtbank Almelo, meerdere rechtshulpverzoeken doen uitgaan naar de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Omtzigt en Rog over het onderzoek in de affaire Jansen Steur

Three CDA MPs asked the health and education ministers whether the scientific work of neurologist Jansen Steur should be examined, why no body had reviewed it earlier, and about his publications and drug-trial involvement. The minister agreed the reasoning on unreliable research is sound, explained that the IGZ halted its probe after the criminal investigation was dropped, and promised to consult Medisch Spectrum Twente and the KNAW on reviewing the publications.
I will first consult with the former employer of Mr Jansen Steur, Medisch Spectrum Twente, on the design and results of the study into publications set up by that institution.

Er zal door mij eerst met de voormalige werkgever van de heer Jansen Steur, Medisch Spectrum Twente, overlegd worden over opzet en resultaten van het door deze instelling opgezette onderzoek naar publicaties
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de beroepsbeperkende afspraken door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about the legal basis and enforceability of informal professional restriction agreements the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) made with doctors, notably the Jansen Steur case, and about limitation periods and transparency. The minister replied that since 2010 the IGZ uses only public-law measures, that past agreements were not centrally registered, and that IGZ can request expedited tuchtrecht handling but will not reopen past agreements, while promising to refer one question to the CBG.
Since September 2010 the policy is that the IGZ may no longer make private-law professional restriction agreements, but uses its statutory powers to take public-law measures.

Sinds september 2010 geldt het beleid dat de IGZ geen privaatrechtelijke, beroepsbeperkende afspraken meer mag maken, maar gebruik maakt van haar wettelijke bevoegdheden om publiekrechtelijke maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over matchfixing in de topsport

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about press reports that tennis player Raemon Sluiter was approached about match-fixing, and why the government said there was no evidence of it in the Netherlands, and about an anonymous reporting line and the handling of old reports. The minister replied that a broad study into the nature and extent of match-fixing is underway, that an anonymous reporting line is being considered, and that the Public Prosecution Service can investigate reports that meet the criminal-law criteria.

That is why I am having, together with my colleague of Justice and Security, an in-depth study carried out into the nature and extent of match-fixing in the Netherlands and the possibilities to prevent, detect and tackle it.

Vandaar dat ik samen met mijn ambtgenoot van Veiligheid en Justitie een diepgaand onderzoek laat uitvoeren naar de aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland en de mogelijkheden om matchfixing te voorkomen, op te sporen en aan te pakken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat jongeren onder 18 jaar nog steeds tot zonnebankstudio’s worden toegelaten

MPs Bruins Slot and Geurts asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that studios still admit under-18s to sunbeds, with many non-member studios breaking the age rule. Minister Schippers acknowledged non-compliance (about 80% overall compliance, higher among SVZ members), defended existing Warenwet rules and NVWA enforcement, and declined for now to criminalise minors or introduce an age-check obligation.
For now, the current legislation, aimed at sunbed providers, is sufficient.
Vooralsnog is de huidige wetgeving, gericht op de aanbieders van zonnebanken, afdoende.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over een antidopingcommissie in het Nederlandse wielrennen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the newly created doping inquiry commission in Dutch cycling, including the ministry's role, the commission's access to justice information, and its added value relative to the Doping Authority. The minister answered that the ministry shapes the mandate, subsidises up to a third of costs and sits on a supervisory group, that the commission has confidential testimony powers the Doping Authority lacks, and that the Doping Authority's existing powers are adequate.
I cannot comment further on the powers of foreign judicial authorities to share such information.
Ik kan mij verder niet uitlaten over de bevoegdheden van buitenlandse justitiële autoriteiten om dergelijke informatie te delen.
Antwoord vragen De Rouwe en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Verloskunde Sionsberg sluit definitief in december’

MPs De Rouwe and Bruins Slot asked the health minister about the early closure of obstetrics at De Sionsberg hospital, including community consultation, IGZ involvement, travel times and home birth. The minister replied that the closure follows staff departures, that the IGZ was informed and had accepted a reorganisation plan, and that measures were taken to keep emergency access within 45 minutes.
The decision to stop clinical obstetrics at De Sionsberg earlier follows the departure of staff, in anticipation of the closure of the clinical obstetrics department in May 2013.
Het besluit om eerder te stoppen met de klinische verloskunde in De Sionsberg volgt op het vertrek van medewerkers, vooruitlopend op de sluiting van de afdeling klinische verloskunde in mei 2013.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over een schone sport

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about the USADA findings on doping at US Postal and Rabobank, the state's role in anti-doping, the status of a doping law, enforcement of trade bans, information sharing with the Anti-Doping Authority, and a response to a 2010 Health Council advice. The minister answered that sport should largely police itself but the state supports anti-doping through funding and WADA, promised a doping law bill in 2013, rejected a formal information-sharing power while agreeing to convene consultations with justice and customs, and pointed to earlier policy letters.
I will however initiate consultation at official level between my ministry, the Ministry of Security and Justice and the Anti-Doping Authority
Wel zal ik op ambtelijk niveau een overleg initiëren tussen mijn ministerie, het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie en de Dopingautoriteit
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Bruins Slot over gehoorschade bij de jeugd

MPs Voordewind and Bruins Slot asked about hearing damage among young people from loud music, including its long-term costs, the adequacy of current prevention, and whether a Flemish-style noise limit should be introduced. The state secretary answered that cost data is lacking and a RIVM study is pending, that the music sector's convenant and Oorveilig label are the main tools, and that action will depend on a 2012 evaluation.
On the basis of this evaluation I will examine whether the current approach works or whether further action is necessary and desirable.
Ik zal op basis van deze evaluatie bekijken of de huidige aanpak werkt of dat er nadere actie nodig en gewenst is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Bevallen kan niet meer in ziekenhuis Meppel’

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder ask about the decision to end childbirth at Meppel hospital from 2013, including IGZ quality findings, alternatives such as a satellite model, the 45-minute ambulance norm, regional standards, costs, and local consultation. The minister answers that the decision was driven by the expected gynaecologist shortage and low birth volume, that the RIVM and insurer Achmea show accessibility will not worsen, that the regional parties must set cooperation agreements with IGZ oversight, and that local residents were not directly involved in the decision.
The local population was not involved in the decision-making.
De lokale bevolking is in de besluitvorming niet betrokken geweest.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “Apothekers kunnen zorgkosten drukken”

MP Bruins Slot asked the minister about a report by Booz & Company suggesting pharmacists could reduce care costs through medication reviews, better medication handover and therapy adherence, and whether the claimed savings of 515 to 755 million euro are accurate. The minister said the report is not public, called the measures sensible but not new, admitted the savings rest on assumptions and are hard to realise, and pointed to pharmacists' role in the care chain.
This report is (still) not publicly available.
Dit rapport is (nog) niet openbaar beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Leijten, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over het toegenomen aantal zelfdodingen

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the rising number of suicides, the effect of prevention policy, the new suicide treatment guideline, weekend psychiatric care and bank staff training. The minister acknowledged the increase, said the effect of policy is hard to measure, will seek advice from the VU on a target figure, and said weekend crisis care is sufficient while training bank staff is the financial sector's own responsibility.
Given that the absolute number of suicides rose again over the past year, I consulted relevant stakeholders on whether a target figure is possible and desirable.
Mede gezien de omstandigheid dat het absolute aantal suïcides over het afgelopen jaar wederom is gestegen, heb ik overleg gevoerd met betrokken veldpartijen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Holtackers en Bruins Slot over het artikel ‘Utrecht verbant vieze auto’s uit centrum’

CDA MPs asked the state secretary whether Utrecht may ban older private cars from its centre under an environmental zone, how this relates to the national convenant, Amsterdam's earlier plan, proportionality, and exemptions for residents and low-income groups. The state secretary replied that municipalities are legally competent to create such zones, no national convenant exists for passenger cars, the Utrecht proposal is broadly comparable to Amsterdam's, and Utrecht will weigh air quality against motorists' interests.
Municipalities are legally competent to create environmental zones under the Road Traffic Act 1994.
Gemeenten zijn juridisch bevoegd om in het kader van de Wegenverkeerswet 1994 milieuzones in het leven te roepen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over gebrek aan ggz familiebeleid en tekortschietende hulp voor kinderen van verslaafde en/ of verwarde ouders

Two MPs asked the minister of Health about inadequate family policy in mental health care and insufficient support for children of addicted or mentally ill parents. The minister acknowledged the importance of family involvement, pointed to existing initiatives, a planned handbook for municipalities, and the forthcoming compulsory mental health bill, but did not commit to mandatory systematic attention to children.
It is the professional responsibility of the individual treating clinician to take this aspect into account in treatment.
Het is de professionele verantwoordelijkheid van de individuele behandelaar om in de behandeling dit aspect mee te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over een tv-uitzending waarin kinderen hun toekomstige pleegouders kunnen kiezen

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary whether a Talpa/Spirit TV format letting children choose their foster parents exploits vulnerable children and whether she would intervene. The state secretary said Jeugdzorg Nederland judged the format unsuitable, that the plans might be dropped, and that she trusts the body to protect the children's privacy, while committing to foster-care recruitment campaigns and legislation on foster parents' legal position.
I have had myself informed by the responsible parties.
Ik heb mij laten informeren door de verantwoordelijke partijen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het artikel “Ouders op ramkoers met de GGZ”

The MP asks the minister about a newspaper report on a psychiatric patient's care dispute with the GGZ institution, the role of family, the Inspectorate's handling of notifications, and the limited powers of the consultation centre CCE. The minister says the individual case cannot be assessed from the press report, describes the Inspectorate's earlier reviews and planned follow-up, and states the CCE has no enforcement powers but the Inspectorate can act.
Following the stalled treatment situation now described, the Inspectorate will examine whether the information recently aired in the media may lead to new insights.
Naar aanleiding van de nu beschreven vastgelopen behandelingsituatie zal de IGZ nagaan of de recent in de media geuite informatie nog tot nieuwe inzichten kan leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het artikel ‘Energiedrank de supermarkt uit’

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about a proposal to restrict energy drinks to specialist shops and about warnings for children. The minister rejected the restriction, pointed to parental responsibility and existing labelling rules, and declined to pursue new regulation.
I do not think this is a good idea.
Ik vind dit geen goed idee.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het artikel “Probleemgezin kost 40.000 euro”

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a newspaper report that problem families cost about 40,000 euro a year across many agencies, and about fragmented services, integrated help plans, pooled funding and a family support budget. The secretary acknowledged the figures as plausible, backed a single family, single plan, single coordinator approach, and promised to support monitoring and pilots and to examine the family support budget with the VNG.
For example, I finance the monitoring of the 'VOLG' project, initiated by the MO group and GGD Nederland.
Ik financier bijvoorbeeld de monitoring van het project «VOLG», het door de MO-groep en GGD Nederland geïnitieerde project
Antwoord vragen De Rouwe, Van der Werf en Bruins Slot over de erfpacht in Amsterdam

Three CDA MPs asked several ministers about municipal ground leasehold (erfpacht) in Amsterdam, including canon increases, the lack of a right to buy the land, the legal remedies available, the threat of fines, and whether the municipality meets banking-sector criteria. The minister answered that leasehold is a private-law matter for the landowner (the municipality), that objection is possible only via the civil courts, that the municipality is revising its terms, and that the fine clause is rarely used.
Because leasehold is a private-law figure, public-law objection and appeal are not open here; the route to the civil court must be followed.
Omdat erfpacht een privaatrechtelijke figuur is, staan publiekrechtelijk bezwaar en beroep hier niet open, maar moet de weg naar de burgerlijke rechter worden gevolgd.
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over EU-miljarden naar topclubs

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dekken asked the health and sport minister about EU-backed bailouts of Spanish football clubs, including debt forgiveness, and related EU and UEFA financial fair play rules. The minister agreed that such debt forgiveness is undesirable, noted UEFA and European Commission cooperation on fair play and state aid rules, and said ECB lending decisions are for individual banks and fall outside her remit.
When granting financial support to professional football organisations, national and local governments in the EU must comply with the state aid rules.
Bij het verlenen van financiële steun aan betaaldvoetbalorganisaties (bvo's) moeten de nationale en lokale overheden in de EU zich houden aan de staatssteunregels.
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Enveloppen in Huis ter Duin. Talloze lijntjes Duitse gokmaffia lopen naar Nederland’

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dekken asked whether the government will act on reports of Dutch involvement in match fixing and bribery in international football. The minister answers that the sports sector is primarily responsible, that no Dutch criminal offences have been identified so far, and that the government will share knowledge and support prevention at national and EU level.
The sports world is primarily responsible for the integrity of sport and gives substance to this itself.
De sportwereld is primair verantwoordelijk voor de integriteit van de sport en geeft daar ook invulling aan.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Joldersma over het bericht dat hulpverleners in de psychiatrie regelmatig slachtoffer worden van geweld veroorzaakt door een patiënt, en daarvan vaak geen aangifte doen of meld

MPs Bruins Slot and Joldersma (CDA) asked the health minister about reports that psychiatric staff are often assaulted by patients and rarely report it to police, and about how to improve reporting, prosecution follow-up, and support. Minister Schippers answered that violence against care workers is unacceptable, pointed to the Actieplan Veilig werken in de zorg, to planned measures including time-outs and new patient-oriented coercion laws, and to annual training support for 100 institutions.
Whatever the background, aggression and violence against care workers is unacceptable.
Wat de achtergrond ook is, agressie en geweld tegen zorgverleners is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Smilde over een omstreden maagchirurg in Duitsland

MPs Bruins Slot and Smilde asked the health minister about a controversial stomach surgeon in Germany and how disqualified doctors can be prevented from practising across borders. The minister said the IGZ can inform foreign authorities, that a BIG-register entry for foreign measures is being introduced, and that EU-level information exchange and a warning mechanism are being pursued.
First, the IGZ can inform the competent authorities in the receiving country if the professional concerned is known to those authorities.
Ten eerste kan de IGZ de bevoegde autoriteiten in het ontvangende land informeren ingeval de betrokken beroepsbeoefenaar bij die autoriteiten bekend is.
Antwoord vragen Smilde, Bruins Slot en Blanksma-van den Heuvel over het bericht "dure verzekering voor dikke mensen"

Three CDA MPs asked how a person of normal health but high BMI (1.60 m, 90 kg) can pay higher insurance premiums, and how insurers assess health and lifestyle. The minister explained that insurers may use lifestyle factors including overweight for life and disability insurance, that assessment follows insurers' own policies within legal limits, and that health insurance premiums must generally be uniform.
Insurers may not ask more questions than are included in this model health declaration.
Verzekeraars mogen niet meer vragen stellen dan op deze model-gezondheidsverklaring zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Menzis doet aangifte tegen Jansen Steur’

Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the minister about Menzis filing a criminal complaint against a former neurologist and whether insurers should recover costs of improperly prescribed treatment. The minister said insurers may pursue claims but the decision is theirs, that IGZ is responsible for investigating improper prescribing, and that she lacks data on past recoveries.
When the IGZ becomes aware that a medicine has been prescribed on incorrect grounds, it is up to the IGZ to investigate this and, where necessary, to take action.
Wanneer de IGZ op de hoogte raakt van het voorschrijven van een geneesmiddel op onjuiste gronden dan ligt het op de weg van de IGZ om daar onderzoek naar te doen en zo nodig op te treden.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de intrekking van de btw-vrijstelling voor steunstichtingen van sportverenigingen en van wereldwinkels

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked the state secretary of Finance about withdrawing the VAT exemption for fundraising by support foundations of sports clubs and by fair-trade shops, and about its consequences and EU compliance. The state secretary confirmed the withdrawal as required by the EU VAT Directive, with a transitional arrangement until 1 July 2012, and said the existing exemption for certain associations was preserved through a statutory change.
By withdrawing the contested policy decision, Dutch regulations have been brought into line with the VAT Directive.
Door middel van intrekking van het gewraakte beleidsbesluit is de Nederlandse regelgeving in overeenstemming gebracht met de btw-richtlijn.

Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de veiligheid tijdens de Olympische Spelen in 2012 in Londen (ingezonden 25

The MPs asked whether the government shares US concerns about security at the 2012 London Olympics, how contact with responsible bodies is maintained, and whether the Netherlands would send its own security staff with the Dutch team. The minister answered that the UK is responsible, a Dutch liaison is stationed in London, Dutch security is considered adequate, and no Dutch security personnel will be sent unless the UK requests support.
The Netherlands has stationed a liaison from the KLPD and the Royal Marechaussee in London for this purpose.
Nederland heeft daarvoor een liaison van de KLPD en de Koninklijke Marechaussee in Londen gestationeerd.
Vragen van het lid Bruins Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een neuroloog in Twente (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the Inspectorate's use of disciplinary complaints, including why it sometimes handles cases itself, why disciplinary courts do not always suspend practitioners pending appeal, and how it balances interests in deciding whether to file complaints. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate uses a range of enforcement tools case by case, explained the Leerdam psychotherapist case, and said a note on disciplinary law and the BIG register would follow this autumn.
In addition, the IGZ can also file a disciplinary complaint when the general interest – read patient care – requires it.
Daarnaast kan de IGZ ook een tuchtklacht indienen wanneer het algemeen belang – lees de patiëntenzorg – dit vordert.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de exploitatie van buitensportaccommodaties door gemeenten en sportstichtingen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT treatment of municipal and sports-foundation sports facilities, including a planned Sportbesluit with percentage-based rental rules and the Supreme Court's case law. The State Secretary denied that only symbolic fees allow VAT deduction refusal, explained abuse-of-law structures, and said draft guidelines would be revised, with final guidelines expected in October without the percentage link.
In this context, on 11 July 2011, draft guideline texts prepared at official level were sent for comment to various interest organisations, in line with the normal procedure for policy decisions.

In dit kader zijn op 11 juli 2011 conform de normale procedure voor de totstandkoming van beleidsbesluiten op ambtelijk niveau opgestelde conceptrichtlijnteksten voor commentaar naar verschillende belangenorganisaties gestuurd.
Vragen van het lid Bruins Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de vergoeding op basis van de verdeelmaatstaf buitenwater (ingezonden 24 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the 10,000 ha cap on the outer-water allocation criterion in the municipal fund, its basis, and whether the cap would be reconsidered in the fund's revision. The minister confirmed the cap, said it aims to match municipal costs of coastal location, and declined to explicitly revisit it in the revision because the financial disadvantage from mergers is considered negligible.

Given the negligibility of the financial disadvantage of mergers of at least two municipalities with more than 10,000 ha of outer water, it is not considered necessary to explicitly include the cap in the revision of the municipal fund.

Gezien de verwaarloosbaarheid van het financiële nadeel van samenvoegingen van in ieder geval twee gemeenten met meer dan 10 000 ha. buitenwater wordt het niet nodig geacht de maximering expliciet te betrekken bij de herijking van het gemeentefonds.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Bruins Slot (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over aandacht voor de Paralympische Spelen (ingezonden 11 augustus

CDA MPs asked whether public broadcasting gives enough attention to the Paralympic Games after a sailor criticised media coverage of disabled sport. The minister replied that the complaint targets Dutch media generally, that the NOS must cover the Paralympics under the 2008 Media Decree, and that NOS plans expanded daily coverage in London, so no measures are needed.
On the basis of the above, I do not consider it necessary to take measures.
Op grond van het bovenstaande acht ik het niet nodig maatregelen te nemen.

Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Zoon was een tijdbom, er moet een p

CDA MPs asked the health and justice ministers about a newspaper report on parents who cannot get help for a psychologically troubled adult child, including how families can raise alarm signals and whether a central reporting point is needed. Minister Schippers answered that no figures exist on unmet voluntary care demand, pointed to existing family support, the Bopz framework and the new compulsory mental health law, and rejected a central reporting point.
I am not in favour of setting up a reporting point.
Ik ben niet voor het opzetten van een meldpunt.

Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over illegaal gokken op wedstrijden (ingezonden 3 maa

Two CDA MPs asked the health and justice ministers about illegal betting on sports matches, including whether the minister attended the IOC Lausanne meeting and what steps will be taken toward an international definition and coordinated approach. The minister confirmed illegal betting threatens match-fixing and fair play, said she did not attend but provided the joint declaration, and pointed to a new working group, EU Council work and the planned Kansspelautoriteit.
The annexes provide, for your information, both the Joint Declaration and the press release.
In de bijlagen treft u ter informatie zowel de Joint Declaration als het persbericht aan.
Vragen van het lid Bruins-Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de mediazuil in de isoleercel (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether TV in isolation cells in mental health care prolongs seclusion, whether it creates unwanted stimuli, how it relates to earlier sanitation problems, and whether the free-of-charge arrangement with a manufacturer is normal. The minister says the effect on seclusion duration is unknown but will be evaluated, that TV is a quality instrument to reduce deprivation and boredom, and that purchasing terms are the institution's own responsibility.
At present it is not known whether the media column affects the length of stay in seclusion.
Vooralsnog is niet bekend of de mediazuil gevolgen heeft voor de duur van het verblijf in de separeer.

Only metadata is provided for this answer to MPs Bruins Slot and Verburg on cooperation between companies, entrepreneurs and top athletes; the body of the questions and answers is not included. The content of the answer therefore cannot be assessed beyond its title and publication details.
Answer to questions from Bruins Slot and Verburg on cooperation between companies, entrepreneurs and top athletes
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Verburg over samenwerking tussen bedrijven, ondernemers en topsporters
Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Defensie over gevechtstenue voor vrouwelijke militairen (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Knops asked the Defence Minister whether Defence is developing a combat uniform for women, what it would cost, and whether this is justified given shortages of basic clothing and equipment. The minister confirmed that size specifications for women's combat uniforms were set, that they are not materially different from men's, and that they will be ordered with regular stock replenishment at no extra cost.
This clothing does not differ further from that of male military personnel.
Deze kleding wijkt verder niet af van die van mannelijke militairen.
Vragen van het lid Bruins Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Defensie over het afblazen van opleiding en baan voor 476 nieuwkomers (ingezonden 6 augustus 2010) .

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Defence whether postponing the training and future jobs of 476 new recruits, amid staff shortages, sends a negative signal about the armed forces as a reliable employer, and asked about the categories affected, contract breach and recruitment. The Minister answered that this was a postponement of intake by several months rather than a cancellation, applied to non-scarce categories, involved no contract breach, and that recruitment campaigns continue.
It is not a cancellation but a postponement of the intake by a few months to half a year.
Het gaat niet om afstel maar om uitstel van de opkomst met enkele maanden tot een half jaar.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over het ontzeggen van toegang aan de Brits-Palestijnse dokter Ghassan Abu-Sittah tot het Schengengebied

MPs Piri and Paternotte asked why the government did not grant an exception to the German entry ban for British-Palestinian surgeon Ghassan Abu-Sittah, and whether Dutch obligations under the host-state agreements with the ICC and OPCW apply to him as a witness or expert. The government declined to share information on individual cases, said he is no longer listed in the SIS, and stated that the ICC and OPCW alone decide who qualifies as a witness or expert, so it commits to no action.
On behalf of the Minister of Asylum and Migration, the cabinet as a rule does not share information about individual cases with the House.
Namens de Minister van Asiel en Migratie deelt het kabinet in de regel geen informatie over individuele zaken met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken waarschuwde voor humanitaire gevolgen stop steun UNRWA’

An MP asked whether the government was warned in a February memo that suspending UNRWA funding would cause regional destabilisation and human suffering, and how the January suspension decision was reached. The minister answers that the memo concerned risks of prolonged or suspended committed support, that funding was paused to signal seriousness about allegations, and that the decision lies with the minister for foreign trade and development, without detailing internal disagreement.
The decision on financing to UNRWA falls within the responsibility of the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Assistance.
Het besluit over financiering aan UNRWA ligt binnen de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingshulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de zorgelijke mensenrechtensituatie in Tunesië

Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the government about the deteriorating human rights situation in Tunisia, including arrests of lawyers, NGO workers and journalists, and about Dutch and EU funding and oversight. Minister Veldkamp answered that concerns were raised at senior official level, that trial monitoring and rights support continue, and that the EU Ombudsman inquiry into the EU-Tunisia MoU is ongoing, while giving limited detail on programmes and funding.
Given the confidential nature of these activities, the cabinet cannot go into further detail on this.
In verband met het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze activiteiten kan het kabinet hier niet verder op in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over de procedure van Nederland en Australië tegen Rusland bij ICAO ten gevolge van de aanslag op vlucht MH17

MPs Paternotte and Bamenga asked whether Russia's withdrawal from the ICAO proceedings over MH17 is sabotage, what steps the government will take, whether Russia's voting rights should be suspended, and whether the issue will be raised at the current ICAO Council meeting. The government regrets Russia's withdrawal, says the Netherlands and Australia will pursue the case and asked the Council to decide in their favour, and states that suspending voting rights requires a finding of a Chicago Convention violation, which the withdrawal alone is not, though the claim already requested such suspension.
The Netherlands and Australia are determined to pursue the proceedings in order to achieve truth-finding, justice and accountability.
Nederland en Australië zijn vastbesloten de procedure door te zetten, om waarheidsvinding, gerechtigheid en rekenschap te bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vagen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat in Gambia genitale verminking weer legaal dreigt te worden

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Nederland will speak out against a bill that would legalise female genital mutilation in Gambia, and what diplomatic tools are used, including questions on whether human rights are framed as Western impositions and on rights pressures elsewhere. The minister replied that parliament had rejected the bill, that the Netherlands opposes it mainly through quiet diplomacy led by local civil society, and that the embassy and EU have raised it with the Gambian government and monitor rights pressures worldwide.
The Netherlands therefore speaks out against revoking the ban on female genital mutilation through quiet diplomacy.
Nederland spreekt zich daarom middels stille diplomatie uit tegen het intrekken van het verbod op vrouwelijke genitale verminking.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Ellian over het voorkomen van een moordaanslag op een Iraanse dissident in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports of an Iranian plot to assassinate a dissident in the Netherlands, the government's earlier denial of involvement in the Vidal-Quadra case, Iran's use of criminal networks, risks to Iranian dissidents, and listing the IRGC on the EU terror list. The minister answered that the Dutch authorities were not involved in the Spanish case, that an ongoing criminal investigation limits detail, that the government opposes foreign interference and uses a three-track approach, and that there is no EU consensus yet on listing the IRGC.
I cannot go further into the details of an ongoing criminal investigation because this could harm the ongoing investigation.
Ik kan niet verder ingaan op de details van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek omdat dit het lopende onderzoek zou kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het aanhoudende geweld tegen christenen in Nigeria

MP Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about kidnappings and killings of mostly Christians in Nigeria, whether religion is a driver versus land and water scarcity, the reliability of a report claiming 100,000 Christians were killed, and whether Nigeria will be raised at the UN Human Rights Council. The minister answered that violence stems from mixed causes including scarce resources and religion is not confirmed as root cause, could not yet verify the report's figures, and committed to raising religious freedom violations in Nigeria at the Human Rights Council later this year.
As a member of the Human Rights Council, the Netherlands intends to raise obstacles to freedom of religion or belief, including violence against believers in Nigeria, in the Council later this year.

Nederland is, als lid van de Mensenrechtenraad, voornemens om later dit jaar belemmeringen van de vrijheid van religie en geloofsovertuiging, waaronder geweld tegen gelovigen in Nigeria, aan de orde te stellen in de Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de gevolgen van de apparaattaakstelling voor het postennet

An MP asked whether the 22 percent cut to the ministry's operating budget would close 34 diplomatic posts and weaken Dutch security, prosperity and international position. The minister replied that the effects are still unclear, that the government aims to keep an adequate network, that 34 closures will not happen, and that choices will follow later.
It is still unclear what the effects of this cut are
Het is nog onduidelijk wat de effecten zijn van deze taakstelling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Kolonisten in Palestijns gebied krijgen hun helmen en drones van orthodox-christelijk Nederland'

An MP asks the ministers whether tax-deductible donations from the Dutch charity Christenen voor Israël fund protective gear and drones for settlers in occupied territory, and whether that conflicts with Dutch policy. The government says it was unaware of the donations, considers settlements contrary to international law and undesirable to fund, but states that under neutral ANBI rules protective helmets and vests can count as generally beneficial and the charity status is not withdrawn, while pledging continued EU sanctions efforts against violent settlers.
Because the tax authority is bound by the confidentiality duty of article 67 of the General Tax Act, no further information can be provided about individual institutions.

Omdat de belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan geen nadere informatie worden verstrekt over individuele instellingen.
