Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht 'U.S. expected to sanction IDF unit for human rights violations in West Bank'

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister how she assesses the IDF Netzah Yehuda battalion, which the US planned to sanction over human rights abuses in the West Bank, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit. The minister called the reports very concerning, said Israel must prevent settler violence, and declined to follow the US measure, which she described as a Leahy Law restriction rather than a sanction, while pointing to EU settler sanctions the Netherlands supports.

Because the Netherlands only cooperates with Israel within the internationally recognised 1967 borders, the Netherlands has no relationship with the Netzah Yehuda battalion and there is no sanction in the sense of entry bans or asset freezes, the Netherlands does not follow the American example.

Omdat Nederland alleen met Israël binnen de internationaal erkende grenzen van 1967 samenwerkt, Nederland geen relatie met het Netzah Yehudabataljon heeft en er geen sprake is van een sanctie in de zin van inreisverboden of tegoedbevriezingen, volgt Nederland het Amerikaanse voorbeeld niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het staatsbezoek van de Emir van Qatar

An SGP MP asked the government about the state visit of the Emir of Qatar, including the royal lunch, whether the Emir would be pressed to free Israeli hostages, and the presence of Hamas leaders in Doha. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the visit followed standard protocol, that the hostage release was stressed in talks, and that Qatar's mediation role requires its ties with Hamas.
During the conversation with the Emir, the importance of releasing the hostages was strongly emphasised.
Tijdens het gesprek met de Emir is het belang van de vrijlating van de gegijzelden sterk benadrukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Nord Stream gasleiding

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch government supports China's call for a UN-led international investigation into the Nord Stream pipeline sabotage, and why it has not, given that Danish and Swedish probes were closed without naming a culprit. The government answered that it does not support the call, that German authorities are investigating and have received Danish and Swedish evidence, and that it will not speculate on the outcome.
German authorities are already conducting an investigation into the explosions at the Nord Stream pipeline.
Er wordt door de Duitse autoriteiten reeds onderzoek gedaan naar de explosies bij de Nord Stream pijpleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de situatie in Republika Srpska

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about rising tensions in Republika Srpska, including Dodik's secessionist rhetoric, minority safety, EU sanctions and Russian influence. The minister answered that the government sees Dodik undermining Bosnian state structures and the Dayton Agreement, that EUFOR Althea is monitoring and ready to scale up, and that the EU lacks consensus for sanctions while Nederland opposes funding for RS authorities that violate the rule of law.
The government remains committed to ensuring the EU does not in any way support Dodik's secession agenda, including under the Hungarian presidency.
Het kabinet blijft zich ervoor inzetten dat de EU de afscheidingsagenda van Dodik op geen enkele wijze zal steunen, ook niet onder het Hongaars voorzitterschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de dood van een Pakistaanse christen na een aanval door een gewelddadige menigte

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about the death of a Pakistani Christian after a mob attack over alleged blasphemy, including whether he was formally charged, how often Pakistan's minorities are attacked, how often the government raised minority protection, and whether Pakistan's GSP+ trade status should be questioned. The minister confirmed the death, said only a complaint was filed, pledged to raise the case with Pakistani authorities, and outlined bilateral, EU and UPR engagement but declined to reconsider GSP+ at this time.
The Netherlands will strongly advocate that abuse of blasphemy laws and related violence be discussed at the next meeting of this Sub-Group.
Nederland zal zich er sterk voor maken dat misbruik van blasfemiewetten en hiermee samenhangend geweld wordt besproken tijdens het volgende overleg van deze Sub-Group.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Dobbe over ontwikkelingen in Jemen

MPs Ceder and Dobbe asked the government about humanitarian needs in Yemen, stalled peace talks, follow-up on a motion to pursue war crimes investigations, and the abolition of the national arms export presumption of denial for Saudi Arabia and the UAE. The ministers answered that Nederland remains a substantial humanitarian donor with no additional funding planned, supports the UN envoy and multilateral efforts, could not secure support in the Human Rights Council for a war crimes investigation, and maintains strict arms export review under EU rules.
The Netherlands will continue to support the mandate of the UN envoy and to consistently draw attention to this forgotten conflict in multilateral settings.
Nederland blijft het mandaat van de VN gezant ondersteunen en in multilateraal verband voortdurend aandacht vragen voor dit vergeten conflict.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over samenwerking met de Palestijnse autoriteit

Stoffer (SGP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about Dutch security cooperation with the Palestinian Authority, including the Martyrs Fund, the risk of aid reaching terrorist groups, and the role of Hamas and Fatah in Gaza. The government declined to share the MOU text, said no specific budget is attached, stated Dutch budget support via PEGASE was stopped, and outlined risk-mitigation measures such as vetting under USSC and per-activity risk assessment.
International (policy) agreements are not made public, given international and diplomatic interests.
Internationale (beleids)afspraken worden, met het oog op de internationale en diplomatieke belangen, niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Abed zit al maanden vast in Gaza, wat wordt er in Nederland gedaan om hem terug te krijgen? 'Niemand heeft me gebeld''

MP Van Baarle asks the Foreign Minister what is being done to bring back Abed Al Attar, a Dutch-linked resident stuck in Gaza, and whether Israeli authorities can be compelled to list him. The minister replies that the ministry is working through diplomatic channels, that border lists are set by Israeli and Egyptian authorities, that Dutch law gives no legal leverage in the area, and cites privacy rules limiting detail on individual cases.
In accordance with the GDPR, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is reticent in providing more details about individual cases.
Conform de AVG is het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken terughoudend in het geven van meer details over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over luchtverdediging voor Oekraïne

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about air defence for Ukraine, including a request to deliver more systems, the implementation of a bilateral security agreement, and whether the Netherlands would take the lead again and supply further Patriot systems. The government answered that it is coordinating a Patriot coalition, provides three launchers and a radar, has funded air defence initiatives, and is still examining the consequences of NATO capability targets for its own readiness and training before deciding on further support.
The Netherlands itself makes three launchers and a radar available; the other essential core components are supplied by an ally.
Nederland stelt zelf drie lanceerinstallaties en een radar beschikbaar, de overige benodigde kerncomponenten worden door een bondgenoot geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de kernwapentaak van de F-35

MP Dobbe (SP) asked whether nuclear weapons are in the Netherlands now that the F-35 has taken over the nuclear mission from the F-16, whether the B61-12 is present, and how this fits with NPT disarmament obligations. The government declined to disclose numbers, locations and certification details for security reasons, rejected the claim that the motion Van Dijk on transparency was insufficiently implemented, and argued the B61-12 is not a new weapon.
As your House is aware, on the basis of allied and legally binding agreements no statements can be made about the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe.

Zoals uw Kamer bekend, kunnen op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp en Paternotte over mogelijkheden om bevroren Russische tegoeden te gebruiken voor hulp aan Oekraïne

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Estonia's law enabling use of frozen Russian assets for Ukraine could serve as a basis in the Netherlands and the EU, and about the state of the Brekelmans motion and a possible 'Navalny Act'. The minister answered that Dutch sanctions law does not allow confiscation of private assets outside criminal proceedings, that no international consensus exists on using the underlying assets, and that the government remains ambitious in exploring options.
Without this criminal-law framework, confiscation on the basis of sanctions raises serious questions about safeguarding individual rights such as property rights.
Zonder dit strafrechtelijk kader roept het overgaan tot confiscatie op basis van sancties serieuze vragen op omtrent de waarborg van individuele rechten zoals het eigendomsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over de vervolging en benarde positie van christenen in Pakistan

MPs Diederik van Dijk and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about violence against Christians in Pakistan after blasphemy-linked mob attacks in Sargodha, and about police protection, compensation, support for civil society and contacts with religious leaders and courts. The minister answered that the government is concerned, has raised the issue with Pakistani authorities, describes the trends in blasphemy prosecutions, and outlines Dutch and EU engagement, including monitoring some trials and possible travel by the EU envoy.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about these acts of violence in Sargodha, Pakistan, arising from blasphemy accusations.
Het kabinet maakt zich ernstige zorgen over deze gewelddadigheden in Sargodha, Pakistan, als gevolg van beschuldigingen van blasfemie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat Nederland en Pakistan de banden gaan aanhalen

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the Netherlands is deepening ties with Pakistan while death threats against a Dutch MP come from there, whether pilot projects and technology transfer should stop, and whether military or dual-use technology could flow to Pakistan. The minister answered that the Dutch government consistently condemns the threats with Pakistani authorities, that the projects are mainly private or water and climate related, and that no military technology transfer is planned, while declining to commit to halting cooperation.
The cabinet strongly condemns the fatwas and the threats against the Dutch MP and raises this at all levels with the Pakistani authorities.
Het kabinet keurt fatwa's en de bedreigingen aan het adres van de Nederlandse volksvertegenwoordiger ten sterkste af en bespreekt dit op alle niveaus met de Pakistaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over het artikel 'Kiew ruft Ukrainer aus dem Ausland zurück und erwartetUnterstützung – doch die Bundesregierung spielt auf Zeit'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Ukraine's suspension of consular services for men aged 18 to 60 abroad, its mobilisation implications for Ukrainians in the Netherlands, and the Ukrainian ambassador's remarks. The government answers that consular assistance is Ukraine's decision, that the Netherlands was informed and remains in contact with the embassy, that lapsed documents do not make residence illegal, and that questions were answered before the debate.
Under international law there is no obligation for a state to provide consular assistance.
Er bestaat onder internationaal recht geen verplichting voor een staat om consulaire bijstand te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp, Paternotte en Teunissen over de Tent of Nations in de buurt van Bethlehem

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations peace farm near Bethlehem, including land registration delays, a road built on the family's land, restricted access, and whether the government will press Israeli authorities. The minister answered that the access restrictions and road works are illegal under international law and should stop, that the Dutch mission raises the matter regularly and will keep pressing, and that the case is typical of pressures on Palestinian farmers in Area C.
The Netherlands will continue to press on this.
Nederland zal hier op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de kwestie Tent of Nations en effectieve bescherming van Palestijnen

MP Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations land registration case and the effective protection of Palestinians in Area C, including delays, road closures, and access to police. The minister answered that the registration process remains unresolved despite a 2006 court ruling, that Israeli authorities have not clarified the delay, and that the Netherlands continues to press Israel on access, protection, and settlement policy.
The Netherlands will continue to press for reopening.
Nederland zal blijven aandringen op heropening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Surveillance and interference: Israel’s covert war on the ICCexposed'

An MP asked the government about reports that Israeli officials conducted surveillance of the ICC and Palestinian rights groups to obstruct investigations, and about the safety of ICC staff and witnesses. The government said it is aware of foreign interference risks, is in ongoing contact with the ICC, and summoned the Israeli ambassador, but declined to give details of individual cases or its own investigation for security reasons.
For security reasons, the nature of these discussions or the specific matters raised cannot be discussed in detail.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan er niet in detail worden getreden over de aard van deze besprekingen of de specifieke zaken die daar aan de orde komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Spying, hacking and intimidation: Israel’s nine-year ‘war’ on the ICC exposed’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Israel spied on, hacked and intimidated the ICC, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The ministers answered that the Netherlands opposes all interference with the ICC, is in contact with the Court on security, will not comment on individual cases for security reasons, and has discussed the matter with the US and the Israeli ambassador.
For security reasons, no statements can be made about individual cases.
Om veiligheidsoverwegingen kunnen er geen uitspraken worden gedaan over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het artikel ‘Russia plotting sabotage across Europe, intelligence agencies warn’

Two CDA MPs asked the government about warnings from European intelligence services of a growing Russian threat of violent sabotage, including to North Sea infrastructure, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The government answered that it shares the concern, points to the North Sea infrastructure protection action plan and the national response framework, and says EU cooperation is being strengthened, while declining to detail the services' current knowledge of targets.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy, the working methods and current knowledge level of the services are not discussed publicly.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding wordt er in het openbaar niet ingegaan op de werkwijze dan wel het actuele kennisniveau van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘In slechts 67 seconden slaagde de Georgische regeringspartij erin de Europese droom van talloze Georgiërs in gevaar te brengen’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the consequences of Georgia's foreign-agent law for press freedom, human rights, regional stability, EU accession, and possible Russian hybrid influence, and whether Dutch and EU action or an extraordinary Foreign Affairs Council is planned. The minister answered that the law forces NGOs and media with over 20% foreign funding to register, is criticised by the Venice Commission, has damaged Georgia's EU track, and that the government will keep supporting civil society and monitor the October elections, while deeming an extraordinary Council unnecessary for now.
The Netherlands will continue in the coming months to stress that these elections must be free and fair.
Nederland zal de komende maanden blijven uitdragen dat deze verkiezingen vrij en eerlijk moeten verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over marteling van Papoea’s door Indonesische militairen in West-Papoea

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of torture of Papuans by Indonesian soldiers, including a video-recorded incident, and about Indonesia's obligations, an independent investigation, and a UN High Commissioner visit. The minister confirmed awareness, noted that the army arrested 13 people over the filmed incident, said the Netherlands will keep raising Papua, and that it is not involved in UN visit talks.
The Indonesian army has no obligation to inform the public about internal investigations.
Het Indonesische leger heeft geen verplichting om het publiek te informeren over interne onderzoeken.
Antwoord op de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over de reeks (Islamitische) aanvallen op Koptische Christenen in Egypte

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on Coptic Christians in Egypt, including Al Minya, and what the Dutch government and EU are doing about religious freedom and impunity. The minister answered that the government shares concern, the embassy is monitoring, Egyptian authorities have responded, and religious freedom is a diplomatic priority raised at various levels, with the Special Envoy for Religion and Belief engaging the Egyptian ambassador.
I do not have independent information about the alleged perpetrators and therefore cannot judge them.
Ik beschik niet over eigenstandige informatie over de vermeende daders, en kan daar dan ook geen oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Etnische zuiveringen in Darfur en mogelijk zelfs genocide, stelt Human Rights Watch'

MPs Bamenga and Paternotte asked the government about Human Rights Watch's findings of possible ethnic cleansing and genocide in West Darfur, including sanctions, ICC cooperation, fact-finding access, humanitarian access and resettlement. The minister responded that the government is very concerned, is working with the EU on expanded sanctions, supports the ICC and the FFM, and explains the current asylum moratorium that blocks resettlement of Sudanese refugees.
The cabinet is very concerned about the situation in Darfur.
Het kabinet is zeer bezorgd over de situatie in Darfur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht dat Corendon Russische toeristen naar de zon blijft vliegen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Corendon's flights carrying Russian tourists to Turkey breach EU sanctions and whether the government will act against profit from trade with Russia. The minister replied that EU sanctions do not ban such flights, that the government cannot disclose its figures or discussions with individual firms, and that a study into Dutch firms is not opportune.
The cabinet cannot publicly discuss what it discusses with individual companies.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op wat het bespreekt met individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Honderden lichamen ontdekt in massagraven in Gaza, maar onderzoek bijna onmogelijk’

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of mass graves in Gaza and whether independent investigation is being obstructed by Israel, and about preservation of evidence and accountability for war crimes. The minister supports independent investigation, says Israel has not yet admitted investigative teams, and points to Dutch funding for the ICC and OHCHR while noting the ICC's investigations are confidential.
The cabinet cannot judge the precise nature and extent of the evidence collected so far by the Office of the Prosecutor of the ICC.
Het kabinet kan geen oordeel vellen over de precieze aard en omvang van het tot op heden door de Aanklager van het Strafhof vergaarde bewijsmateriaal.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over de uitspraken van Commandant der Strijdkrachten van Estland over Russische activiteiten in de Baltische regio met betrekking tot GPS-verstoringen.

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about Estonian military remarks on Russian GNSS jamming and spoofing and the resulting risks to aviation, NAVO operations and critical infrastructure, including measures, airspace safety and cyber/electronic warfare strategy. The government acknowledges the threat as a destabilising hybrid one, points to existing rules (Wbni), sector-led protection, NAVO policy and Galileo PRS work, and answers each question without committing to new oversight or parliamentary reporting.
The cabinet is aware of this statement.
Het kabinet is bekend met deze stelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over door de Chinese overheid gefinancierde weekendscholen

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker and Brekelmans asked whether the government has oversight of Chinese state-funded weekend schools and their teaching materials, and about the delayed bill on supervising informal education. The minister says the government has no full overview of informal education, will seek talks with China and consider signal-based supervision, but gives no firm timeline beyond consultation before Prinsjesdag.
I will make efforts to enter into consultation with the Chinese government and will ask whether they can provide the transparency you desire.
Ik zal mij inspannen om in overleg te treden met de Chinese overheid (zie mijn antwoord op vraag 9) en zal daar vragen of zij de door u gewenste transparantie kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de resolutie van de VN veiligheidsraad over een wapenstilstand in Gaza

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about UN Security Council resolution 2728 on a Gaza ceasefire, including whether non-compliance should trigger Dutch sanctions, whether F-35 parts and a defence status agreement with Israel should be halted, and the Chief of Defence's visit to Israel. The government answered that it urges compliance bilaterally and multilaterally, points to the Court of Appeal ruling on F-35 parts it is implementing, says the SOFA is separate from the resolution, and declined to give details on the Qatar-mediated negotiations.
The Netherlands is however not part of these negotiations. I therefore cannot give you further details.
Nederland is echter geen onderdeel van deze onderhandelingen. Ik kan u daarom verder geen details geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de uitlatingen van de woordvoerder van het Russische ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Russian MFA spokesperson Zakharova's accusation that the EU civilian mission in Armenia (EUMA) conducts espionage, its implications for staff safety, the number of Dutch personnel, and whether the Netherlands would push for armed protection. The minister rejected the espionage claim as false and a disinformation tactic, stated six Dutch experts serve in the mission, and explained that most patrols proceed unarmed while risk assessments are ongoing with armed escort used where military presence is strong.
The claim that EUMA mission personnel carry out espionage activities is categorically untrue and is presumably aimed at stoking tensions and undermining the credibility of EUMA and the EU as a whole.

De stelling dat het missiepersoneel van EUMA spionageactiviteiten uitvoert is pertinent onjuist en heeft als vermoedelijk doel het aanwakkeren van spanningen en het ondermijnen van de geloofwaardigheid van EUMA en de EU als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de prognose dat dit jaar een kwart van alle in Europa verkochte elektrische auto’s uit China afkomstig zullen zijn

An MP asks whether the government shares concerns about dependence on China for EVs, Chinese subsidies and market distortion, possible protective measures, Chinese access to driver data, and progress on China market access. The ministers state they share the concerns on strategic dependencies and support the EU anti-subsidy investigation, which may lead to provisional measures by 4 July 2024, but largely describe existing EU frameworks and general trade dialogue without committing to new national measures.
Het onderzoek is nog in volle gang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het marineschip Zr.Ms. Holland en humanitaire hulp aan Gaza

An SP MP asked why the navy ship Zr.Ms. Holland was returned from the Gaza region, what humanitarian aid efforts were made, and how the government will implement the adopted motion on airdrops and ship deliveries to Gaza. The minister answered that Holland was pre-positioned for possible evacuation or a maritime corridor, that the corridor had not materialised in time, that Dutch airdrops with Jordan were carried out, and that overland access remains the priority with Israel blocking adequate access.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over of Oekraïne lid kan worden van de NAVO

Van Houwelingen (FVD) asks the Foreign Minister, in eight questions, whether Ukraine can join NATO while still at war with Russia and whether accession would automatically draw NATO into war under Article 5, and why the government's earlier answer was not a simple yes or no. The government answers that allies reaffirmed Ukraine will join once conditions are met and all allies agree, that Article 5 is not automatic and would be decided by allies in context, and that Article 5 would apply to Ukraine upon unconditional accession.
To provide the proper context for the issue, the answer to the questions is served by substantive explanation.
Om het vraagstuk van de juiste context te voorzien, is het antwoord op de vragen gediend bij inhoudelijke toelichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Zuid-Afrika gaat burgers straffen als ze vechten voor Israël'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that South Africa would prosecute citizens who served in the Israeli army, and about Dutch nationals serving in Israeli forces and possible war crimes. The government answered that South Africa's constitution bars such participation, that the Netherlands does not track Dutch nationals in the Israeli army, that serving there is not a crime under Dutch law, and that the Public Prosecution Service can investigate indications of international crimes.
The Netherlands does not keep track of this because the Netherlands is not in armed conflict with Israel.
Nederland houdt dit niet bij omdat Nederland niet in gewapend conflict is met Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de huidige ontwikkelingen rondom Gaza

Paternotte (D66) asked about a French proposal for UN monitoring of a Gaza ceasefire, humanitarian access, the World Central Kitchen deaths, and evacuation of Dutch nationals from Gaza. The minister said no French text exists yet and Nederland is not on the Security Council, promised diplomatic pressure on access and safety of aid workers and on faster evacuation, but gave no concrete parliamentary accountability step.
There is currently no final resolution text presented by France on which the members of the UN Security Council can vote.
Er is op dit moment nog geen definitieve resolutietekst gepresenteerd door Frankrijk waar de leden van de VN-Veiligheidsraad over kunnen stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Erkens over de levering van Patriot-systemen en raketten aan Oekraïne

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about supplying Patriot systems and missiles to Ukraine, including use of Dutch stocks, production acceleration, interoperability and NASAMS. The minister answered that the government is actively examining options, committed funds for air defence, and is pursuing joint procurement and production efforts, though it gave no firm decisions on several points.
In weighing this, the impact on operational readiness, international obligations and the ability to keep training Dutch military personnel is critically examined.
Hierbij wordt in de afweging kritisch gekeken naar de gevolgen voor de operationele gereedheid, internationale verplichtingen en de mogelijkheid om Nederlandse militairen te blijven trainen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over de beïnvloeding van de Eritrese diaspora door de Eritrese regering

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked whether the Eritrean government influences its diaspora in the Netherlands, what measures will prevent this, and whether a new investigation is planned. The minister answers that the evidence of pressure is mixed, that the OBI approach and earlier measures remain in place, that diaspora taxation cannot be banned under current law, and that no new investigation is planned beyond the earlier study.
The cabinet acknowledges that the social pressure Eritreans in the Netherlands apparently experience cannot be ignored.
Het kabinet erkent dat de sociale druk die Eritreeërs in Nederland kennelijk ervaren niet kan worden genegeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht inzake toegenomen export van landbouwmachines en diervaccins naar Rusland

MP Boswijk asked whether rising Dutch exports of agricultural machinery and animal vaccines to Russia strengthen Russian food self-sufficiency and whether such goods could be sanctioned. The minister confirmed the export increase, called the self-sufficiency link plausible but uncertain, rejected food as a weapon, and said it weighs food-security effects of sanctions while refusing to disclose future sanctions options.
The cabinet does not provide information on possible future sanctions measures, as this would undermine the effectiveness of the sanctions instrument.
Het kabinet verstrekt geen informatie over mogelijke toekomstige sanctiemaatregelen, daar het de effectiviteit van het sanctie-instrument ondermijnt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga en Piri over het bericht ‘UNRWA Chief Tells Haaretz: We Take Israel's Claims of Hamas Infiltration Seriously, but Yet to See Evidence Against Gaza ‘Employees’

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga and Piri asked the Dutch ministers about UNRWA staff allegedly involved in the 7 October attacks, whether Israel had shared evidence, and whether Dutch aid to UNRWA should be resumed during the investigation. The minister replied that the UN OIOS is investigating, that Israel has shared public information without it being independently verified, and that donors will decide individually on resuming funding while referring to a letter of 26 April 2024.
The cabinet and other donors therefore call on all parties to fully cooperate with the investigation.
Het kabinet en andere donoren roepen alle partijen daarom op tot volledige medewerking aan het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Sneller en Veldkamp over het artikel 'Gemeenten bereiden zich voor op ‘paspoortpiek’, vacatures staan open en noodplannen liggen klaar'

MPs Paternotte, Sneller and Veldkamp asked about a expected peak in passport renewal applications, its effect on applications from abroad and voting in the European elections, and whether a French digital passport renewal experiment could be adopted in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that demand will be two to three times higher through 2028, capacity and information campaigns have been expanded, voters need only a valid ID by 31 May, and remote biometric renewal is not yet secure enough, with the government monitoring developments.
The French government website states that from 1 March 2024 an experiment takes place in Canada and Portugal.
Antwoord 8 Op deze website 3 van de Franse overheid is te lezen dat met ingang van 1 maart 2024 een experiment plaatsvindt in Canada en Portugal.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Piri en Kathmann over nieuwssites die al jaren pro-Chinese desinformatie verspreiden

MPs Piri and Kathmann asked the government about a network of news sites spreading pro-Chinese disinformation, including reach, platform promotion, and whether EU rules (DSA, disinformation code) can address it. The government answered that the sites have negligible reach, fall largely outside DSA scope, that it will report on its disinformation strategy in spring, and that further EU regulation is not yet needed.
The cabinet is in close contact, both bilaterally and multilaterally, with friendly countries on foreign interference and Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI).

Het kabinet staat zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband in nauw contact met bevriende landen over de problematiek van buitenlandse inmenging en Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Kahraman de fraudezaak betreffende het Europees coronaherstelfonds

MPs Van Hijum and Kahraman asked about a suspected large-scale fraud case involving the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF) in Italy, the number of fraud cases, EU and Dutch anti-fraud measures, and consequences for future payments. The minister answered that the investigation is ongoing, no consequences for Italian payments have been decided yet, and existing EU control systems and the Dutch audit framework are considered sufficiently robust, while noting the Commission's annual reports will provide further insight.
At this moment there are no consequences for future payments to Italy as a result of the suspected fraud case.
Op dit moment zijn er geen gevolgen voor toekomstige uitbetalingen aan Italië als gevolg van het vermoede fraudegeval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de vervolging van enkele hulpverleners in Letland

MP Boswijk asked the Foreign Minister whether Latvian law blurs the line between aid workers and smugglers, exposing humanitarian helpers to prosecution, and what the status and handling of the Council of Europe Human Rights Commissioner's criticism is, plus support for two Dutch nationals prosecuted in Latvia. The minister answered that Latvian law has no special status for helpers, that the Dutch Criminal Code likewise does not separate them but humanitarian necessity can exclude punishment case by case, that the Commissioner's criticism was rejected by Latvia and its parliament adopted the amendments, and that consular assistance is being provided while the Netherlands does not interfere in foreign criminal proceedings.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs provides the two Dutch nationals with consular assistance.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken verleent de twee Nederlanders consulaire bijstand.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht over het visumbeleid door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

The MP asks whether the ministry ran a statistical bias test on the visa risk algorithm (IOB/KVV) after the PMP report, and if not, why the answer claims compliance. The minister says an external bias test by SigmaRed found no undue discrimination except a Yemeni-nationality deviation explained by documented hits, plus an experiment finding labels did not affect decisions; the earlier RIG study was rejected and monitoring will be added.
Yes, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs had a statistical validation study (bias test) carried out.
Ja, het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft een statistisch validatieonderzoek (bias-toets) laten uitvoeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Palestinians ‘beaten and sexually assaulted’ at Israeli detention centres, UN report claims.'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a UN report alleging abuse and sexual assault of Palestinian detainees in Israeli detention centres, and what the government would do about it. The minister said the report is not yet public, that the government finds the allegations concerning, supports NGO monitoring such as Hamoked, and will raise detainee rights and access for organisations like the ICRC with Israel, but made no firm commitment to its own investigation.
The UN report referred to in the Guardian article is not public.
Het VN-rapport waarover in het artikel van de Guardian wordt gesproken, is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Zeedijk over de Chinese cyberaanvallen op Nederlandse Kamerleden

MPs Sneller and Zeedijk asked the government about Chinese cyberattacks on Dutch MPs and on journalists, activists and businesses, including the APT31 group, and whether state secrets or information from Dutch politicians were obtained. The government answered that it cannot discuss the methods and knowledge of the intelligence services in public, referred to the public threat reports, and said it shares concerns and raised them with Chinese authorities.
The working methods and level of knowledge of the intelligence and security services are not discussed in public.
Er wordt in het openbaar niet ingegaan op de werkwijze en het kennisniveau van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een tweet van de Letse president

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Latvian president's tweet saying 'Russia delenda est' and whether it threatens Russia, raises conflict risk, and whether the ambassador would be raised. The minister answered that the government does not target destruction of any state, that preventive force is not permitted under Article 51 of the UN Charter, that Russia started an unprovoked war, and that raising the matter with the ambassador is not warranted.
The policy of the Dutch government is not aimed at the destruction of any country or state whatsoever.
Het beleid van de Nederlandse regering richt zich niet op de vernietiging van welk land of welke staat dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht 'Netanyahu: leger zal hoe dan ook Rafah binnenvallen'

Volt MP Dassen asked the Foreign Minister about Netanyahu's statement that the army would enter Rafah regardless, including humanitarian consequences, evacuation feasibility, Hamas, Dutch action, and two-state policy. The minister answered that the Netherlands urges Israel not to launch a large-scale Rafah offensive, supports UNSC resolution 2728, and backs a two-state solution, while giving only general or partial answers on evacuation, Hamas, and concrete leverage.
The Netherlands has therefore repeatedly stated, in talks with Israel and in consultation with like-minded countries, that a ground offensive in Rafah cannot be justified and should be avoided.

Nederland heeft daarom in gesprekken met Israël en in samenspraak met gelijkgezinde landen herhaaldelijk aangegeven dat een grondoffensief in Rafah niet te rechtvaardigen is en vermeden dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Houwelingen over de dreiging van een nucleaire oorlog tussen Nederland en Rusland

MPs Baudet and Van Houwelingen asked the government about the risk of nuclear war with Russia, including whether troops would be sent to Ukraine, the effects of nuclear weapons, and whether Ukraine could join NATO and the EU. The ministers answered that Russia's invasion is illegal, that Nederland is not at war with Russia, that deterrence is maintained, and that no decision on troop deployment can be anticipated, while several questions were answered jointly or left to later decisions.
The cabinet cannot elaborate further on the nature of the discussions due to confidentiality.
Het kabinet kan in verband met vertrouwelijkheid niet verder op de aard van de besprekingen in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de Nederlandse bijdrage aan openbare hoorzittingen bij Internationaal Gerechtshof

An MP asked why the Dutch contribution to the ICJ oral hearings on the legal consequences of Israel's occupation policies only set out general international law rules, without naming Israel or the Occupied Palestinian Territories or appraising the occupation. The minister replied that the Netherlands aimed to assist the Court by identifying applicable law and presenting its legal view, that the Court itself must apply the law to the facts, and that it would not share a substantive appraisal while the advisory proceedings are pending.
No. The request for an advisory opinion is now before the court.
Nee. Het verzoek om advies is nu onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Paternotte over de doelgerichte aanvallen door Israël op journalisten

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Israeli strikes on journalists in Lebanon and Gaza, including calls for independent investigation, protection of journalists, and access for foreign journalists to Gaza. The minister says Netherlands expects compliance with international law, supports UNESCO and Media Freedom Coalition efforts, and funds protection programmes, but gives no commitment to call for specific investigations or to press Israel on access.
In the first instance, it is up to the parties themselves to investigate alleged violations of international humanitarian law.
Het is in eerste instantie aan partijen zelf om onderzoek te doen naar vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Daniëlle Jansen en Krul over het evenement ‘Navigating Nicotine Regulation: Insights from Sweden’

Two MPs asked the ministers about a Business Sweden event in Parliament on nicotine regulation, with speakers linked to the tobacco and nicotine industry, and whether it breaches FCTC Article 5.3. The State Secretary opposed the event, said Dutch snus and nicotine pouch policy will be maintained, but stated that the House itself is responsible for its contacts with the tobacco industry.
I trust that members of the House will hold each other to account when there is contact with the tobacco industry.
Ik vertrouw erop dat Kamerleden elkaar aanspreken wanneer sprake is van contact met de tabaksindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans en Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Kabinet moet alerter zijn op spionage met Chinese scanners bij douane’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government should reconsider using Nuctech scanners at Dutch customs given espionage risks, and why Nuctech has not been excluded as other countries did. The state secretary answered that a TNO-led study found current use does not endanger national security, that a retest is underway because of planned algorithm integration, and that the government will share results around summer recess.
The conclusions of the TNO-led study were submitted to the House of Representatives on a confidential basis.
De conclusies van het onderzoek onder regie van TNO zijn vertrouwelijk aangeboden aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over het bericht ‘Nederlanders betalen reisbureau hoge bedragen voor evacuatie familie Gaza’

MP Van Baarle asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Dutch citizens paid travel agencies very high sums to evacuate relatives from Gaza, and about delays in getting Dutch nationals out. The minister said the ministry is pursuing diplomatic efforts with Israel and Egypt, cannot verify the reported sums, and that consular assistance follows official channels without paying for services.
In accordance with the GDPR, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is restrained in providing further details on individual cases.
Conform de AVG is het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken terughoudend in het geven van meer details over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bamenga over EU and Rwanda sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Sustainable Raw Materials Value Chains

MPs Boswijk and Bamenga asked the Minister about the EU-Rwanda Memorandum of Understanding on sustainable raw materials, including whether the Commission consulted member states, the scale of Rwanda's resources, and the timing given DRC-Rwanda tensions. The minister answered substantively on the MoU's content and rationale, acknowledged the DRC tensions, and promised a separate letter to the House on the situation in eastern Congo.
I recently committed to sending the House a letter on this matter.
Ik heb recent toegezegd uw Kamer daarover een Kamerbrief te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Van Hijum over het bericht 'Slovakia’s president warns Robert Fico is testing ‘limits of democracy''

MPs Van Campen and Van Hijum asked the Foreign Minister about Slovakia's rule-of-law backslide, Russian influence and Fico's pro-Russian statements, and what the Netherlands would do in EU fora. The minister answered that the Commission is the primary actor to assess and act on Slovakia's rule-of-law problems, that the Netherlands stresses full use of EU rule-of-law instruments, and that it will keep raising the issue with the Commission and member states without committing to a specific new step.

It is now primarily for the Commission, in its role as guardian of the Treaties, to assess whether Slovakia violates the rule-of-law principles laid down in the Treaties and to act against this if necessary.

Het is nu primair aan de Commissie om, in haar rol als hoedster van de Verdragen, te beoordelen of Slowakije de rechtsstatelijke beginselen die in de Verdragen zijn neergelegd schendt en hier indien nodig tegen op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Van genocidale opruiing betichte Israëlische president komt naar Nederland voor opening Holocaustmuseum’

MP Van Baarle (DENK) asked the Foreign Minister why Israeli President Herzog, whose remarks were cited by the ICJ in its genocide-related order, was welcomed to the Holocaust museum opening, and whether he could be arrested or declared persona non grata given alleged incitement to genocide. The minister answered that the visit was a bilateral courtesy tied to Dutch-Israeli relations, that Dutch prosecutors decide on investigations of international crimes, that head-of-state immunity under customary law bars prosecution while in office, and that the government will not declare him persona non grata.
The starting point of Dutch policy is that the Netherlands may not be a safe haven for perpetrators of international crimes.
Uitgangspunt van het Nederlands beleid is dat Nederland geen vluchthaven mag zijn voor plegers van internationale misdrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de bilaterale veiligheidsovereenkomst tussen Nederland en Oekraïne

An MP from FVD asked the Dutch government about the bilateral security agreement with Ukraine, including its similarity to other countries' agreements, the lack of parliamentary consultation, Ukraine's obligations, and the Nord Stream sabotage. The minister answered that the agreement follows the G7+ declaration, commits to ten years of support, and that Nord Stream questions are under investigation, with some answers partial and the Nord Stream question left to the investigation.

Since the signing of the G7+ declaration on 12 July 2023, the cabinet has frequently and consistently informed the House about its efforts to conclude a security arrangement for multi-year support to Ukraine.

Het kabinet heeft de Kamer sinds het ondertekenen van de G7+-verklaring van 12 juli 2023 veelvuldig en consequent geïnformeerd over de inzet van het kabinet om een veiligheidsarrangement voor meerjarige steun aan Oekraïne af te sluiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een tweet waarin beweerd wordt dat “Ambassadeurs van EU-landen in Rusland een ontmoeting met de Russische minister van Buitenlandse Zaken hebben geweigerd”

An MP from FVD asked the Foreign Minister whether a claim by Medvedev that EU ambassadors in Russia refused a meeting with Lavrov is correct, whether the Dutch ambassador also refused, and whether the ambassador is working to bring Russia and Ukraine to the negotiating table. The minister confirmed the EU ambassadors, including the Dutch one, collectively declined a meeting they judged to be a propaganda exercise, and explained the Dutch role in supporting Ukraine's peace formula.
Jointly it was decided that, as EU ambassadors, they would not accept the invitation.
Gezamenlijk is besloten om als EU-ambassadeurs niet op de uitnodiging in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de arrestatie van de NOS-correspondent in China

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Dutch NOS correspondent was pushed to the ground and detained during a Chengdu demonstration, what steps the government took, and whether it would summon the Chinese ambassador and raise the issue in the Media Freedom Coalition. The minister confirmed the incident, said the embassy engaged with the correspondent and would protest on his behalf if he wished, declined to summon the ambassador, and said individual cases are raised in multilateral fora only at the journalist's request.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot publicly address individual cases.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kan publiekelijk niet ingaan op individuele zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Stoffer over Turkse drone-aanslagen op christelijke leden van Noord-Syrische milities en berichten over Turkse betrokkenheid bij misdrijven in door Turkije bezette gebieden

MPs Ceder and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish drone strikes on Christian members of Northeast Syrian security forces and reports of abuses in Turkish-occupied areas, including whether the government would raise this with Turkey, NATO or the EU. The minister confirmed the strike, said Turkey invokes self-defence, and said the government raises proportionality and civilian protection bilaterally but sees no reason to raise it in NATO, while saying it cannot establish displacement figures or refugee flows.
The cabinet sees no reason to raise these operations within NATO either.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om deze operaties ook in NAVO-verband aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het inzetten van mensen met het syndroom van Down

An MP from FVD asked the Foreign Minister whether videos showing people with Down syndrome deployed and abused as soldiers by Ukraine are authentic, whether this breaches the laws of war, and whether the government will question the Ukrainian ambassador. The minister said the government cannot verify the videos, which Ukrainian authorities call inauthentic, that international humanitarian law contains no such ban, and declined to speculate or to answer within three weeks.
The cabinet has not received any verified reports of such deployment.
Het kabinet heeft geen geverifieerde berichten ontvangen van een dergelijke inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Houwelingen over de Kamerbrief betreffende de staat van de oorlog in Europa d.d. 23 februari jl

Two MPs from FVD asked the government to substantiate claims in its letter on the war in Europe, including Russian territorial ambitions, Ukraine's role in peace talks, and whether the 2022 talks failed due to Boris Johnson. The government answered that Russian officials' statements and past conduct support its assessment, that Ukraine decides when conditions for negotiations exist, that the Johnson claim is Russian disinformation, and that NATO enlargement strengthens deterrence.
Questions 3 and 4 follow on from each other, and are therefore answered together.
Vragen 3 en 4 liggen verder in het verlengde van elkaar, en zijn daarom gezamenlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over de situatie van Al-Aqsa tijdens de Ramadan

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister about reported Israeli plans to restrict Muslim access to Al-Aqsa mosque during Ramadan, and about Dutch positions on the status quo and Israeli compliance. The minister answered that the Netherlands upholds the status quo, has conveyed its message to Israel, that Netanyahu said no additional restrictions would apply, and that no summons of the Israeli ambassador is planned.
The cabinet considers upholding and respecting the status quo of the Haram al-Sharif/Temple Mount essential and calls on all parties to take their responsibility in this regard.
Het kabinet acht handhaving van en respect voor de status quo van de Haram al-Sharif/Tempelberg essentieel en roept alle partijen op om daartoe hun verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bekend zijn van uitspraken Poetin waarin hij dreigt met het (militair) binnenvallen van één of meer landen van de Europese Unie

An MP from FVD asked the Foreign Minister whether the government knows of statements by President Putin threatening military invasion of one or more EU member states, and if so, asked for exact quotes with sources. The minister replied that the government is not aware of direct threats by Putin of that kind, while noting increasingly aggressive rhetoric and hybrid actions by Russian officials and pointing to the invasion of Ukraine as evidence of willingness to use force.
The government is not aware of direct statements by President Putin threatening military invasion of one or more European Union countries.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met directe uitspraken van president Poetin, waarin gedreigd wordt met het militair binnenvallen van een of meer landen van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitlevering van Julian Assange

An MP from FVD asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch government shares the German chancellor's hope that Julian Assange will not be extradited to the United States. The minister replied that press freedom matters, but that extradition between two democratic states is not Dutch business and Dutch government should not interfere in another country's legal process.
This concerns an extradition request between two democratic constitutional states without Dutch involvement.
Het betreft hier een uitleveringsverzoek tussen twee democratische rechtsstaten zonder Nederlandse betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het rapport van Amnesty International International ‘From freedom to censorship, the consequences of the Hungarian propaganda law’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Amnesty report on Hungary's anti-LGBTIQ+ 'propaganda law', covering information rights, discrimination, sex education, rule of law and EU Article 7 proceedings. The minister condemned the law, supported the Commission's infringement case before the EU Court, and listed Dutch support for LGBTIQ+ groups in Hungary, but did not answer the questions separately.
The Netherlands will participate in this court case and has actively worked to ensure that as many other EU member states as possible do the same.
Nederland zal aan deze hofzaak deelnemen en heeft zich er actief voor ingezet dat zoveel mogelijk andere EU lidstaten dit ook doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over de Russische desinformatiecampagne via sociale media in Duitsland

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about a reported Russian disinformation campaign on X in Germany and whether similar campaigns target the Netherlands, including the adequacy of Dutch law, the EU Digital Services Act and platform responsibility. The minister acknowledged foreign interference risks, said no concrete Dutch cases were identified in the election, pointed to EU and NATO information sharing, announced a review of whole-of-government disinformation policy, and noted the European Commission opened a formal DSA procedure against X.

In its letter of 9 November 2023 the cabinet already announced it would examine whether, and if so how, the whole-of-government approach to disinformation about the core democratic processes should be strengthened.

In de brief 9 november 2023 heeft het kabinet daarom al aangekondigd te onderzoeken of, en zo ja hoe, de Rijksbrede aanpak van desinformatie over de kernprocessen van de democratie versterkt moet worden.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'Noodkreet rijksambtenaren aan kabinet: laat Israël stoppen met geweld'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a letter from civil servants urging the cabinet to press Israel to stop violence fits the civil service rules on expressing opinions. The government answered that officials may hold and voice views within the limits of Article 10 of the Civil Servants Act, that internal, non-public expression of concern does not in itself threaten good performance, and that the ministry has created internal channels for dissenting views.
Voicing concerns internally, or in targeted (non-public) communication, does not in itself give reason to assume that the proper performance of a function would not reasonably be assured.

Het intern uiten van zorgen, of het uiten van zorgen in gerichte (niet openbare) communicatie, vormt op zichzelf geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat een goede vervulling van een functie in redelijkheid niet zou zijn verzekerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder en Tuinman over het artikel 'Rijksambtenaren Buitenlandse Zaken demonstreren tegen Nederlands Israëlbeleid'

MPs Stoffer, Ceder and Tuinman asked whether civil servants of the Foreign Ministry demonstrating for a ceasefire during lunch breaks, and their associated petition, conflict with government policy and the Civil Servants Act 2017. The minister answered that the demonstrations fall in the lunch break, that the call for a permanent ceasefire is not government policy, that civil servants have freedom of expression subject to Article 10 of the Act (assessed case by case by the employer), and that the ministry has held internal discussions and reminded staff of guidance.
Civil servants, like all other citizens, enjoy freedom of expression.
Ambtenaren kennen net als alle andere burgers de vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over de Kamerbrief over de inzet voor de jaarlijkse Vergadering van verdragspartijen van het Statuut van Rome

MP Brekelmans asked the government about its stance on possibly amending Article 15bis of the Rome Statute to extend ICC jurisdiction over the crime of aggression, including risks to relations with the US, interaction with Article 8bis(2)(f), and the Responsibility to Protect. Minister Bruins Slot answered that the Dutch position is unchanged, that the government will assess in 2024 whether to propose an amendment with like-minded partners, and that it will inform parliament before any formal diplomatic step.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het onderzoek van de Groene Amsterdammer naar de illegale export van Nederlandse microchips naar Iran

An MP asked the government about a Groene Amsterdammer investigation into illegal export of Dutch microchips to Iran, including customs controls on Iranian trucks and parcels, company identity checks, export figures, and penalties. The minister replied that customs checks are risk-based, sanctions evasion is already punishable, the government will not raise maximum penalties now, and sanctions law modernisation will add administrative fines.
Sanctions evasion is unfortunately a well-known problem.
Sanctieomzeiling is helaas een bekend probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelman over het nieuwsbericht 'Chinese overheid sponsort weekendles Chinees-Nederlandse kinderen'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the government about RTL reporting on Chinese state-funded weekend schools for Chinese-Dutch children, including oversight, visas for Chinese teachers, foreign interference and possible visitation of schools. The government answered that it has no data on these informal schools, that it is working on a bill for signal-based oversight, and that it sees no reason yet to raise the matter with the Chinese government.
The cabinet does not have figures on informal education institutions, where they are located, how many pupils attend them, or what their funding structure is.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers van instellingen voor informeel onderwijs, waar zij zich bevinden, hoeveel leerlingen deze instellingen bezoeken of hoe de financieringsstructuur eruit ziet.
Antwoord op  vragen van het lid Dobbe over het gebruik van artikel 100 van de Grondwet met betrekking tot de aanvallen in Jemen

An MP asks the Foreign Minister why Article 100 of the Constitution was not invoked, how the US self-defence justification applies, and who decides on 'compelling reasons' for not informing parliament in advance of the Houthi strikes support. The minister answers that the deployment rests on international law and Article 97, that the one staff officer falls outside the Article 100 framework, and that prior notification was withheld for operational security.
The letter of 12 January 2024 stated that the Minister of Defence and I did not inform the House in advance of the operation because of the confidentiality of the operation.
In de Kamerbrief van 12 januari 2024 is aangegeven dat de Minister van Defensie en ik de Kamer omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid van deze operatie niet voorafgaand aan de operatie hebben geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over uitspraken van president Poetin waarin hij luidkeels en openlijk “filosofeert over een invasie van EU-landen”

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Putin has openly speculated about invading EU countries and requested exact quotes with sources. The minister declined to comment on a social media post by another MP, said Russia's invasion of Ukraine shows Putin's willingness to use force, and did not provide any quotes, referring back to that answer.
It is not my role to interpret the post by MP Dassen.
Het is niet mijn rol om het bericht van het lid Dassen te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht dat er een gebrek is aan beschikbare afspraken voor het vernieuwen van een Nederlands paspoort in het buitenland

Boswijk (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Dutch citizens abroad face months-long waits or no available slots to renew passports, and what the government will do. The minister acknowledged limited waiting times at some locations due to a passport peak, said appointments are generally available within weeks, and listed capacity increases and public information campaigns, without committing to new structural measures.
I do not recognise the picture that it would be impossible for Dutch nationals abroad to apply for a new passport.
Het beeld dat wordt geschetst dat het onmogelijk zou zijn voor Nederlanders in het buitenland om een nieuw paspoort aan te vragen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Veldkamp over het omzeilen van sancties op Rusland via geografische U-bochtconstructies

MPs Paternotte and Veldkamp asked the government about Dutch goods reaching Russian weapons and surging exports to Russia's neighbours used to evade sanctions. The ministers answered that circumvention is a shared concern, cited EU measures and enforcement, but declined to give a definitive account of the export-surge cause and said the answer to question 10 could not be provided in time.
The cabinet is committed to taking restrictive measures against companies in third countries that circumvent EU sanctions, also in line with the Van der Lee motion.
Het kabinet is gecommitteerd aan het nemen van beperkende maatregelen tegen bedrijven in derde landen die EU-sancties omzeilen, ook in lijn met de motie Van der Lee
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over een overleg met de Iraakse Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a December 2023 meeting with Iraq's foreign minister addressed cooperation on returning rejected Iraqi asylum seekers, and what leverage the government would use. The minister confirmed migration cooperation, including returns, was raised, outlined ongoing dialogue and operational work, and said visa and aid measures are one instrument among several, without committing to specific pressure.
Unfortunately this was not achieved in time for the budget debate.
Helaas is dit niet gelukt voor de begrotingsbehandeling.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Dobbe over de doorvoer van onderdelen van F-35’s of andere wapensystemen aan Israël

An MP (Dobbe, SP) asked the ministers about the transit of F-35 parts and other weapons systems to Israel via Woensdrecht, including the amendments to the NL009 general licence, whether other weapon components were shipped after 7 October 2023, and whether the licence is subject to periodic review against EU export criteria. The ministers answered that the licence was amended in 2021 (technical) and 2024 (following a court ruling), that no other weapon parts are stored at the warehouse, that two individual licences were granted after 7 October, and that annual re-review of general licences is not required, though the government will appeal the court ruling.
An annual mandatory review of valid general licences against the EUGS criteria is not considered necessary by the cabinet.
Een jaarlijkse verplichte toets van de geldige algemene vergunningen aan de criteria van het EUGS acht het kabinet niet noodzakelijk
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid de Roon over een airdropping boven Gaza

Party MP De Roon asked why Jordan, rather than itself, carried out and paid for airdrops of aid to a Jordanian field hospital in Gaza, and whether Jordan had already done several such drops. The government confirmed the drops were jointly conducted at Jordan's request with Israel's consent, said it keeps exploring air and sea routes for aid under existing motions, and praised Jordan's contributions.
In this case, the airdrops were carried out jointly with Jordan at Jordan's request and with Israel's consent.
In dit geval gaat het om airdrops die op verzoek van Jordanië, en met instemming van Israël, gezamenlijk met Jordanië zijn uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de kosten van afschalen van de steun aan Oekraïne

An MP asked the ministers whether the financial costs of withdrawing support from Ukraine, and the costs of a Russian victory, have been mapped, and whether the cabinet will communicate more actively about these risks. The ministers answered that support continues, that consequences are broader than financial, that scenario analyses are discussed with research institutes without being shared publicly, and that the cabinet already communicates about these risks.
For security reasons, the cabinet cannot publicly go into the details of these scenarios.
Het kabinet kan omwille van de veiligheid niet publiekelijk ingaan op details van deze scenario's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Ceder over uitingen van UNRWA medewerkers rond 7 oktober en de oorlog in Israël en Gaza

Questions from MPs Stoffer and Ceder asked about social media statements by UNRWA staff praising the 7 October attacks, whether the government condemns them, and whether Dutch funding should be suspended as in 2019. The minister condemned such statements, said Dutch additional funding is suspended pending two UN investigations, and explained UNRWA's unique mandate for Palestinian refugees.
Any additional Dutch funding to UNRWA is suspended until further notice.
Eventuele Nederlandse aanvullende financiering aan UNRWA is tot nader orde opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Boswijk, Kahraman en Ceder over het Open Doors rapport 2024 en het rapport 'Freedom of Thought' van het humanistisch verbond

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the Open Doors 2024 and Humanist Association 'Freedom of Thought' reports on religious persecution, including Christian persecution in Nigeria, the Sahel, China and Iraq, and whether policy or diplomacy should be tightened. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, cites existing diplomatic, multilateral and development programmes, and largely points to existing policy without committing to new measures.

The cabinet recognises trends mentioned in the Open Doors report, including an increase in religiously motivated violence in the Sahel and repression of people because of their religion or belief in countries such as Nicaragua, China and India.

Het kabinet herkent trends zoals genoemd in het Open Doors rapport, waaronder toename van religieus gemotiveerd geweld in de Sahelregio en onderdrukking van mensen vanwege hun religie of levensovertuiging in onder andere Nicaragua, China en India.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Diederik van Dijk over de reeks (Islamitische) aanvallen op Christenen in Nigeria rond kerst

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister how to interpret the deadly late-December 2023 attacks on Christian villages in Nigeria's Plateau state, what Nigerian authorities and the Netherlands are doing about religious violence and foreign financing, and what the Dutch and EU freedom-of-religion envoys are doing. The minister answered that the violence is a broader resource conflict not aimed solely at one group, that Nigerian security capacity is insufficient, that the Netherlands raises concerns bilaterally and in UN review, and that its envoys raise Nigeria in FoRB fora.
Nigerian citizens of Christian or Muslim faith have for years been victims of interreligious and intra-religious violence.
Nigeriaanse burgers met een Christelijke of Moslim geloofsovertuiging zijn al jaren slachtoffers van interreligieus en intra-religieus geweld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur. The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023
