An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de deelname van Abou Rashed aan een Nederlandse Handelsmissie in Qatar in 2020

An MP asked how Hamas-linked Abou Rashed was able to attend a Dutch trade mission to Qatar in 2020, who invited him, what the ministry knew of his ties, and what will prevent recurrence. The ministers answer that he attended some programme parts as a listener invited by a participant, that the government did not invite him, that the ministry had no advisory role for him, that individual vetting of such contacts is impractical, and that they will tighten registration conditions.
Vetting business contacts and attendees at the individual level is practically not feasible, partly because of the large numbers.
Een toetsing van zakelijke contacten en toehoorders op individueel niveau is praktisch niet uitvoerbaar, mede vanwege de grote aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de inzet van Zr. Ms. Holland bij de hulpverlening aan de Gazastrook

An MP asks why the Netherlands is not acting on Israeli foreign minister Cohen's stated support for a maritime humanitarian corridor to Gaza, and why it does not itself contact Israel about deploying Zr. Ms. Holland. The government answers that full Israeli cooperation is not yet present, that land access is the priority, and that the ship will return to the Netherlands at the end of January while maritime options remain under review.
For now, this has not sufficiently crystallised in the international context.
Vooralsnog heeft zich dit in internationaal verband onvoldoende uitgekristalliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de rol van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken rondom het WK mannenvoetbal in Qatar

MPs asked whether the Foreign Ministry blocked open criticism of host country Qatar for the 2022 World Cup, kept risks for LGBTIQ+ visitors out of Parliamentary letters, and what has been done for migrant workers. The government denies prioritising trade, says the process was a delicate balancing of interests, and outlines its constructive-critical dialogue, ILO-linked reforms, and planned follow-up.
The official tension could well have been mentioned.
Het ambtelijk spanningsveld had wel genoemd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Veldkamp over de Turkse militaire aanvallen in Syrië en Irak

MPs Kahraman and Veldkamp asked the Dutch ministers about Turkish air and drone strikes in Syria and Iraq in late December 2023, including civilian casualties, damage to civilian infrastructure, consistency with international law, NATO coordination, asylum effects and protection of minorities. The government acknowledged Turkey's security concerns and stressed proportionality and avoiding civilian harm, but said it could not independently verify infrastructure damage, declined to assess Turkish compliance with humanitarian law as too complex, and gave evasive answers on asylum impact.
The cabinet has not been able to independently verify whether critical civilian infrastructure was hit in the drone and air strikes.
Het kabinet heeft niet eigenstandig kunnen verifiëren of bij de drone- en luchtaanvallen kritieke civiele infrastructuur is getroffen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over de, op vrijdag 12 januari 2024 plaatsgevonden, door de Verenigde Staten geleide aanvallen op Houthi trainings-, lanceer- en opslaglocaties van drones, raketten, kruisvluchtwape

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch capacity to counter Houthi drone, missile and cruise-missile attacks at sea, the Defence Projects Overview, munitions stocks and deep-strike plans. The minister answered that the Netherlands contributes staff officers to Operation Prosperity Guardian and a US-led coalition, is studying a further maritime contribution, and that acquisition timelines and munitions shortfalls remain constrained by available funds.
Once the study gives reason to do so, your House will be informed.
Zodra het onderzoek hier aanleiding toe geeft, zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de situatie van Abed Al Attar in Gaza

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why Dutch national Abed Al Attar remains stuck in Gaza despite his Dutch passport and why he was not on the Rafah crossing list, and what the ministry is doing. The minister said the ministry is in regular contact, is pressing Israeli and other authorities to add him to the list, and cannot give details on the individual case because of privacy rules.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is bound, among other things, by the GDPR regarding individual consular cases and must therefore be reticent in giving details about individual cases.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is gebonden aan onder andere de AVG rondom individuele consulaire zaken en moet daarom terughoudend zijn in het geven van details over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over het rapport van Don’t Buy into the Occupation (DBIO) aangaande investeringen in nederzettingen op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

MPs Piri and Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister about a DBIO report finding European financial institutions, including Dutch ones and Booking.com, active in Israeli settlements, and why the Dutch discouragement policy is not working. The minister reaffirmed that settlement activity is undesirable, pointed to the existing discouragement policy and OECD guidelines, said the government will approach Dutch financial institutions and study the report's recommendations, and declined to say why Booking.com was not approached earlier beyond stating it had been in discussion with the ministry.
The cabinet will carefully study the recommendations in the report.
Het kabinet zal de aanbevelingen in het rapport zorgvuldig bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over kernwapenoefeningen op luchtmachtbasis Volkel

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked whether the 312 squadron at Volkel takes part in NATO nuclear sharing, whether it has trained on the B61-12 bomb since 2021, and whether the F-16 is planned to carry it, and about the timing of F-35 transition and bomb deliveries. The ministers confirmed Nederland's NATO nuclear task at Volkel but declined to give details on training, transition timing, or weapons numbers and locations, citing security and alliance arrangements.
For security reasons, no statements can be made about details relating to the Netherlands' nuclear weapons task.
Om veiligheidsredenen kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over details die verband houden met de kernwapentaak van Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid het lid Ceder over de vervolging van een christelijke vrouw in Nigeria wegens vermeende godslastering en de brute moord op een christelijke studente door een groep islamitische medestudente

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of Rhoda Jatau in Nigeria for sharing a video condemning the killing of a Christian student, the death penalty risk, and impunity for the lynching. The minister reported that Jatau was released on bail in December 2023, that the case continues, that the Netherlands raises death penalty and religious freedom issues bilaterally and multilaterally, and that Nigerian justice is responsible for the investigation.
The Netherlands does not intervene in the legal proceedings of another country.
Nederland treedt niet in de rechtsgang in een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over bericht ‘Sabotage in Iran: een missie in duisternis’

An SP member asked the Interior and Foreign Ministers for a timeline of the alleged AIVD operation sabotaging Iran's nuclear program, when the AIVD was approached by the CIA and Mossad, whether Parliament was informed, and whether AIVD agents routinely join foreign services' operations. The government declined on substance, citing the statutory duty of secrecy on service methods, and pointed to CTIVD oversight and the CIVD channel for any future briefing.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy regarding the services' methods, I cannot respond substantively to the alleged Dutch involvement.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding van de werkwijze van de diensten, kan ik niet inhoudelijk reageren op vermeende betrokkenheid van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de veroordeling van Nobelprijswinnaar Muhammad Yunus in Bangladesh

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the conviction of Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus in Bangladesh, the concern of world leaders over threats to democracy, whether the upcoming elections will be fair, whether the cases amount to political retaliation, and whether the Netherlands has publicly spoken out. The minister answers that the Netherlands monitors the situation and raises it bilaterally and in the EU, but does not intervene in other countries' judicial processes and has not publicly condemned the conviction.
The Netherlands does not intervene in the judicial proceedings of other countries.
Nederland intervenieert niet in de rechtsgang van andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Van Esch en Van Raan over Vergunning, Toezicht en Handhaving op de BES-Eilanden

Green MPs asked the government whether permit, supervision and enforcement (VTH) on Bonaire is adequate in light of a critical Inspectorate (ILT) report, covering coastal hotels without permits, coral damage, unpermitted businesses in the marine park, and related questions on delegation to regional environmental services and planned development at Bolivia plantation. The state secretary acknowledged serious shortcomings and announced a VTH improvement programme and written responses from the island authorities, but declined to call it neglect of duty, said no binding instruction would be issued, and gave largely non-committal or deferred answers on specific sites.
I will inform the chamber shortly about the process for arriving at an assessment of the conclusions and recommendations of the ILT report.
Ik zal de kamer op korte termijn informeren over het proces om te komen tot een waardering van de conclusies en aanbevelingen van het ILT-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Lee over de gevangenschap van en de rechtszaak tegen journalist en uitgever Jimmy Lai in Hongkong

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would condemn the national security trial of journalist Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong as an attack on press freedom, whether it would act against the breach of the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration, and whether it would join the US and UK in calling for his release. The minister answered that the Netherlands, with 23 other countries in the Media Freedom Coalition, has voiced serious concern and will keep raising the issue and monitoring the trials, but did not commit to calling for release or dropping the case.
The Netherlands will continue to raise attention to this together with this coalition of like-minded countries, including the US and the UK.
Nederland zal hier in samenwerking met deze coalitie van gelijkgezinde landen, waaronder de VS en het VK, aandacht voor blijven vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de mijnramp in Suriname

MP Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about the Surinamese government's rescue response to a mine shaft collapse in Brokopondo, whether Surinamese services have sufficient resources, and whether the Netherlands is in contact about possible assistance. The minister described the coordinated Surinamese response with French Guiana's help, expressed condolences, and said no Dutch aid request had been received.
In all contacts with the Surinamese government, including via the Dutch embassy in Paramaribo, the Netherlands has not received a request for assistance.
In alle contacten met de Surinaamse regering, ook via de Nederlandse ambassade in Paramaribo, heeft Nederland geen hulpverzoek ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het verzoek om voorbehoud en een parlementaire behandeling van de wijziging van de IHR van de WHO

Van Haga asks whether the government sent the WHO a letter rejecting the IHR amendments on behalf of 30 MPs who requested parliamentary approval, why parliament was informed late, and whether the WHO and government breached procedures. The minister says a diplomatic note was sent on 16 August 2023 rejecting the amendments pending parliamentary approval, that preparations for the approval procedure are underway, and denies any breach or lack of oversight.
I do not recognise the picture sketched here and in my view it is incorrect.
Het hier geschetste beeld herken ik niet en is mijns inziens onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Graus over de overname van Delfts chipbedrijf NOWI door Nexperia

PVV MPs De Roon and Graus asked whether the Dutch government would investigate Nexperia's takeover of chip firm NOWI, citing claims that IoT chips could be used for sabotage against countries. The minister answered that NOWI's products are not dual-use or military goods, so the transaction falls outside the retroactive scope of the investment screening law, and that Defence applies security measures in procurement generally.
NOWI's products cannot be classified as dual-use products or military goods.
De producten van Nowi zijn niet aan te merken als producten voor tweeërlei gebruik of militaire goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Paternotte over het onderzoek naar het overlijden van een Nederlandse staatsburger in Gaza

D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister how long the government had pressed Israel for an explanation of the death of a Dutch national in Gaza, how many Dutch citizens remain in Gaza, and what steps were taken to evacuate them. The minister answered that Israel has promised information but not yet delivered it, that the government will keep pressing, and that evacuation efforts depend on the security situation.
Israel reportedly also draws up battle damage assessments after military operations. However, these documents are confidential and are not shared with other countries.
Daarnaast stelt Israël na afloop van militaire operaties naar verluidt «battle damage assessments» op. Deze stukken zijn echter vertrouwelijk en worden niet met andere landen gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dijk over de doorlevering van F-35-onderdelen naar Israël

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Israel used F-35s with 2,000-lb bombs in Gaza, whether F-35 parts flow via the European Regional Warehouse in Woensdrecht without case-by-case export review under general licence NL009, and why that licence was not suspended for Israel. The government said it lacks verified information on bomb types and Israeli F-35 use, maintains its decision not to intervene in the licence after an integrated foreign-policy and security assessment, and that the investigation into intervening in NL009 is not yet complete.
The government does not have verified information about the specific bombs Israel uses in its F-35 operations.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over geverifieerde informatie over de specifieke bommen die Israël gebruikt bij zijn F-35-inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het gebruik van Russisch uranium door de kerncentrale Borssele

An MP asked the ministers about EPZ's long-term contract with a European supplier that uses a Russian subcontractor for reprocessing Borssele's uranium, and why earlier answers said no such dependence existed. The government acknowledged an indirect relationship with Russia, said no short-term alternative exists, and committed to examining how to break the dependence and to reviewing EPZ's evaluation, while declining to discuss confidential details of the Russian subcontractor.
We will among other things look at developing alternatives to reuse as much used uranium as possible, and the consequences of possibly not reprocessing will be further mapped out.

Wij zullen onder meer kijken naar het ontwikkelen van alternatieven om zoveel mogelijk gebruikt uranium te hergebruiken en ook de consequenties van eventueel niet-opwerken zullen nader in beeld gebracht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het optreden van de Libische kustwacht tegen bootvluchtelingen

MP Ceder asked the ministers about the Libyan coast guard's ramming of a migrant rubber boat, EU support to that coast guard, monitoring, and accountability for abuses against migrants. The government answered that no deaths were registered, that it sees limited Commission tools to mitigate human rights risks, and that it keeps pressing for transparency and monitoring reports, though it has not stopped the EU support.
Due to the safety of the actors carrying out the monitoring, the Commission does not share written reports.
Vanwege de veiligheid van de actoren die de monitoring uitvoeren deelt de Commissie geen schriftelijke rapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het D66-plan ‘Toekomst van toetreding’

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister whether the government agrees that the EU enlargement process should be reformed, and to respond to the party's plan for phased accession. The minister defended the current merit-based, conditional and reversible enlargement methodology, noted some faster integration options and declined to back revising the methodology.
Although the cabinet is open to new ideas for cooperation with candidate member states, the government is not in favour of revising the methodology of the EU enlargement process.
Hoewel het kabinet openstaat voor nieuwe ideeën voor samenwerking met de kandidaat-lidstaten, is de regering geen voorstander van het herzien van de methodologie van het EU-uitbreidingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Mutluer en Piri over de aanhouding van medewerkers van NCTV en politie vanwege het lekken van staatsgeheime informatie

MPs Sneller, Mutluer and Piri asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the arrest of NCTV and police staff for allegedly leaking state secret information, including risks to people, critical infrastructure, timing of an investigation, and foreign contacts. The minister declined to give operational details pending criminal and Auditdienst Rijk investigations, said no signals currently show acute risk to critical infrastructure, and promised to inform parliament once the investigation concludes.
In the interest of those investigations, and given the risk of harm if sensitive or classified information reaches third parties prematurely, no additional information can be provided at this time.

In het belang van die onderzoeken en gelet op het afbreukrisico indien voortijdig gevoelige of gerubriceerde informatie bij derden terechtkomt, kan er op dit moment geen aanvullende informatie worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hammelburg, Piri, Van der Lee en Dassen  over ‘De Russische oorlog tegen Oekraïne is eenpraktijkexamen voor Europa – en de tijd begint te dringen’

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and Volt asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the government sees risks to US military aid to Ukraine from congressional gridlock and a possible 2024 US administration cutting support, and whether Europe can cover any shortfall. The government answered that US, European and international support remains essential, that a new House speaker has been appointed, that Europe must take more responsibility, and that it will continue support in consultation with allies while F-16 transfer and munitions decisions depend on training, infrastructure, US export approval and EU criteria.
The cabinet will continue to support Ukraine for as long as necessary.
Het kabinet blijft Oekraïne steunen zolang als dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Drost over de visumverlening aan en bezoek van Taliban-vertegenwoordiger Abdul Bari Omar aan Nederland

MPs Ceder and Drost asked how a Taliban representative received a Dutch visa to attend a WHO forum in the Netherlands, who invited him, and whether the minister would share the visa files and apologise to relatives of fallen Dutch soldiers. The minister answered that the WHO invited him, that the visa was assessed under the EU Visa Code and he was not on sanctions lists, that visa files cannot be shared, and that the government will review the visa process and invitation policy, while acknowledging he should not have received a visa.
No information is shared from individual visa application files.
Van individuele visumaanvraagdossiers wordt geen informatie gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Wilders over de aanwezigheid van een hoge Talibanfunctionaris op het WHO-congres in Den Haag

MPs Eerdmans and Wilders asked how a senior Taliban health official could attend a WHO conference hosted by the Netherlands and receive a Schengen visa, and how the procedure will be tightened. The minister explains the visa was assessed under the EU Visa Code, the person was not on any sanctions list, the government acknowledges it is undesirable and will review visa and invitation procedures, and provides figures on sanctioned Taliban members.
Although the person concerned is not on any of these sanctions lists, the cabinet does draw lessons from these events
Hoewel betrokkene niet op een van deze sanctielijsten staat, trekt het kabinet wel lering uit deze gebeurtenissen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over nieuwsberichten over Soedan

An MP from the Labour party asks the Foreign Minister about the conflict in Sudan, humanitarian aid, EU sanctions, and the security contract with Shield Protective Solutions, including whether the embassy knew of its links to the RSF. The minister answers that the conflict continues, describes Dutch humanitarian and diplomatic efforts, says the embassy did not know of the RSF links at the time, and explains the shift to Shield for security while promising an evaluation report early next year.
The House of Representatives will be informed about this.
De Kamer zal hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over kernwapens en de toetsingsconferentie TPNW

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the Netherlands should attend the second TPNW meeting of states parties as an observer, given Russia's withdrawal of ratification of the CTBT and Russian nuclear retaliation exercises, and which Western countries will attend. The Minister answered that the Netherlands can fulfil its bridging role without observer status, reiterated why it will not sign or support the TPNW, and listed Germany, Norway and Belgium as observers alongside Austria.
The Netherlands does not need to be an observer at the second meeting of the TPNW in order to continue fulfilling this bridging role.
Nederland hoeft geen waarnemer bij de tweede bijeenkomst van het TPNW te zijn, om deze brugfunctie te kunnen blijven vervullen.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Van der Graaf over de aanval van Azerbeidzjan op de Armeense enclave Nagorno-Karabach

MPs Ceder and Van der Graaf asked the Foreign Minister how ethnic cleansing of Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh can be prevented, what the EU will do, whether the EU gas deal with Azerbaijan should continue, and whether sanctions remain ineffective. The minister answered that the government condemned the escalation, that a separate letter will address whether ethnic cleansing occurred, that the EU is considering support for Armenia and monitoring missions, that the gas deal is a diversification measure with limited share, and that sanctions remain under discussion with action if new violence threatens.
The cabinet will address this question in a separate letter, partly within the framework of the adopted motion by MP Ceder.
Het kabinet zal in een separate brief op deze vraag ingaan, mede in het kader van de aangenomen motie van het Lid Ceder

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht in Russische media inzake voorbereidingen van het Kremlin op de presidentsverkiezingen van 2024 door middel van een “lijst van vertrouwelingen”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the Kremlin is drawing up a list of loyalists backing Putin's 2024 re-election campaign, and whether individuals on it should face EU sanctions such as entry bans before the list is public. The minister said the government will monitor developments, that sanctions are assessed per individual on solid evidence, and that people cannot be sanctioned before the list is published, while not disclosing future sanctions plans.
The cabinet does not provide information on possible future sanctions measures, as this would undermine the effectiveness of the sanctions instrument.
Het kabinet verstrekt geen informatie over mogelijke toekomstige sanctiemaatregelen, daar het de effectiviteit van het sanctie-instrument ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ngo’s diede oversteek van illegale immigranten over de Middellandse Zee faciliteren

Baudet (FVD) asked whether NGOs conducting sea rescues in the Mediterranean are subsidised by the Dutch government, where rescued migrants are landed, and whether rescues encourage irregular crossings. The government replied that it funds no such NGOs, that SAR rules place landing responsibility with the coordinating rescue centre, that it values rescue work while seeking clearer EU landing arrangements, and it did not provide the total number rescued.
The cabinet does not have the total number of persons rescued by vessels operated by NGOs.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over het totaal aantal personen dat gered is door schepen in beheer van ngo's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over de situatie van Nederlanders en van gegijzelde Israëliërs in de Gazastrook

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about the situation of Dutch nationals and Israeli hostages in Gaza, including evacuation, Egypt's border, PA funding and regional responsibility. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, has evacuated groups of Dutch nationals via Rafah, presses for humanitarian pauses and access, and that EU budget support to the PA is to resume once the review is complete.
In the interest of the matter, the cabinet cannot make further statements about the Dutch commitment.
In het belang van de zaak kan het kabinet verder geen uitspraken doen over de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Piri over de actuele situatie in Israël en Gaza

MPs Klaver and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about humanitarian access, the al-Ahli hospital explosion, hostage release, Gaza blockade and the Rafah crossing. The minister answered that the Netherlands backs a humanitarian pause and unhindered aid, supports independent investigation via the ICC, and says it cannot yet determine whether a total blockade violates international law.
Thorough and independent investigation will be necessary to bring the relevant facts to light.
Gedegen en onafhankelijk onderzoek zal nodig zijn om de relevante feiten boven water te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over straffeloosheid van Israël

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's conduct in Gaza after 7 October 2023 amounts to war crimes, whether its self-defence is proportionate, and whether the Netherlands will support ICC investigations and humanitarian access, among other questions. The minister answered that the Netherlands calls for proportionality and humanitarian law compliance, that independent investigation is needed before judging specific acts, and that the Netherlands supports the ICC's investigation with additional funding.
Thorough and independent investigation will be necessary to bring the relevant facts to light.
Gedegen en onafhankelijk onderzoek zal nodig zijn om de relevante feiten boven water te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over geweld tegen Palestijnse bewoners van de westelijke Jordaanoever

MP Ceder asks the Foreign Minister about reported killings and attacks on Palestinians in the West Bank by Israeli settlers, including alleged passivity or participation by Israeli soldiers, investigations, weapons distributed by the Israeli national security minister, seizure of crops, and what Netherlands can do. The minister condemns settler violence, says Israel has a duty to protect Palestinians and prevent such violence, notes Dutch lobbying and EU/UN statements, but states the government lacks full facts and that Dutch options for direct protection are limited.
The cabinet does not have all the facts of these cases.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over alle feiten van deze gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de Nederlandse onthouding bij stemming in de VN Algemene Vergadering over een humanitair staakt-het-vuren

An MP asked why the Netherlands abstained on a UN General Assembly resolution calling for a humanitarian ceasefire in Gaza, and whether the full cabinet or vice-premiers were informed. The minister explains the abstention as a balance of supported elements against missing ones (Israel's right to self-defence, condemnation of Hamas, release of hostages), keeps EU unity, and admits in hindsight that broader consultation would have been better, while stating the steminstructie was not normally put to the cabinet.
As a rule, a voting instruction is not submitted to the Council of Ministers.
In de regel wordt een steminstructie niet voorgelegd aan de ministerraad.
Antwoord op van het lid Sjoerdsma over het persbericht van de VN over de stemmingsuitslagen met betrekking tot de resolutie die oproept tot ‘humanitair staakt-het-vuren’ in de Gazastrook

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands abstained rather than voted for the UN resolution calling for a humanitarian ceasefire in Gaza, and how it squares with the Prime Minister's call for more aid. The minister replied that the Netherlands abstained with an explanatory statement to preserve EU unity, citing missing condemnation of Hamas and gaps on hostage release, and committed to continued advocacy for humanitarian pauses, aid access and hostage release.

For this reason the Netherlands chose to abstain with an explanatory statement setting out the points it fully supports, the points it objects to, and the points it would have liked to see in the resolution.

Om deze reden koos Nederland voor een onthouding met een stemverklaring waarin de punten zijn uitgelicht die Nederland volmondig steunt, de punten waar Nederland bezwaar tegen maakt, en de punten die Nederland graag in de resolutie opgenomen had zien worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de levering van JSF-onderdelen aan Israël

MPs Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government would stop F-35 parts flowing through the European Regional Warehouse to Israel despite warnings of humanitarian law violations. The ministers answered that the government decided not to intervene in the general licence NL009, citing an integrated security assessment, that the F-35 deters regional threats, and alliance reliability, while no export licence test applies to these US-owned parts.
It was decided not to intervene in the operation of the General Licence NL009 regulation.
Er is besloten niet in te grijpen in de werking van de Regeling Algemene vergunning NL009.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Nederland blijft Israel F-35 onderdelen leveren ondanks waarschuwing schending oorlogsrecht'

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the government approved F-35 parts deliveries to Israel despite official warnings of serious humanitarian law violations, and why parliament was not informed. The ministers answered that no new decision to supply Israel was taken, that the existing general licence NL009 was left in place for integrated foreign-policy and security reasons, and that the relevant legal advice was attached as documents.
It was decided not to intervene in the operation of the General Licence Regulation NL009.
Er is besloten niet in te grijpen in de werking van de Regeling Algemene vergunning NL009.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de levering van F-35 onderdelen

An MP asks why the government did not block Dutch-routed deliveries of F-35 parts to Israel despite advice warning of possible humanitarian law violations, and asks for the advice, prior refusals and civilian casualty figures. The ministers answer that they chose not to intervene in the general licence NL009 on integrated foreign-policy and security grounds, provide the two internal memos and legal annexes, and decline to share diplomatic implications.

To meet your request as transparently as possible, we provide you with the full memos containing the legal elements as well as the other elements that contributed to the broad assessment underlying the decision taken.

Om zo transparant mogelijk aan uw verzoek tegemoet te komen geven we u de volledige nota's waarin u de juridische elementen aantreft evenals de andere elementen die hebben bijgedragen aan de brede afweging die ten grondslag ligt aan het genomen besluit.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de oproep van de Israëlische regering om 300.000 militaire reservisten deelte laten nemen aan de lopende vijandelijkheden, met name in deGazastrook

An MP asked the government whether Israel's call-up of 300,000 reservists for fighting in Gaza also reaches Dutch citizens, whether this constitutes prohibited recruitment, and about Dutch citizens in Israel and settlements. The government answered that it has no data on Dutch citizens serving in the IDF, that calling up reservists is not recruitment under Article 205 of the Criminal Code, and condemned settler violence while calling on Israel to prevent it.
The cabinet does not know how many Dutch nationals are currently active in the Israeli army, nor how many have recently been called up or travelled there.
Het is het kabinet niet bekend hoeveel Nederlanders momenteel actief zijn in het Israëlische leger noch hoeveel recentelijk zijn opgeroepen of afgereisd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Overheid haalt eigen diversiteitsdoelen niet of nauwelijks’

An MP from DENK asked the Interior Minister whether central government meets its own diversity targets for its workforce, including ethnic and gender representation in senior roles, and what it will do about it. The State Secretary answered that some quantitative diversity goals are met and others are not, that targets for cultural diversity are an effort obligation rather than a binding result, that the internal monitoring reports will stay internal, and listed ongoing measures such as inclusive recruitment and monitoring.
With a view to sharp and constructive coordination, it is preferable to keep using the monitoring reports as an internal sounding board.
Met oog op een scherpe en constructieve afstemming heeft het de voorkeur om de monitorrapportages als intern klankbord te blijven inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de antisemitische uitlatingen van de Palestijnse president Abbas

MP Ceder asks the Foreign Minister whether the government condemns antisemitic remarks by Palestinian President Abbas, whether it will challenge them, and whether Dutch support to the Palestinian Authority should be reconsidered. The minister answers that the Netherlands condemned the remarks in EU and bilateral channels, that it provides no direct budget support to the Palestinian Authority, and that it considers linking the remarks to aid counterproductive.
The cabinet condemns the antisemitic remarks of Palestinian President Abbas and has conveyed this disapproval both within the EU and bilaterally.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de antisemitische uitlatingen van de Palestijnse president Abbas en heeft deze afkeuring zowel in EU-verband als bilateraal overgebracht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de situatie in West-Papoea over de uitspraken van Alice Wairimu Nderitu, de Speciale Adviseur van de Secretaris-Generaal van de Verenigde Naties voor de Preventie van Genocide

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses the UN Special Adviser on Genocide Prevention's remarks on Papua, including arrests, land dispossession, foreign companies, the 1969 Act of Free Choice and a UN High Commissioner visit to Indonesia. The minister answered that the human rights situation is concerning and complex, that the government respects Indonesia's territorial integrity, that it will keep raising the issue and would still welcome a visit by the High Commissioner, but declined to comment on foreign companies and gave no concrete new commitments.
The Netherlands will continue to make efforts in this regard.
Nederland zal zich hiervoor blijven inspannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over huwelijksdwang of achterlating in het buitenland

Two MPs asked ministers about forced marriage and abandonment of girls abroad, including BRP deregistration, prevalence data, residence and nationality recovery, legal aid and feminist foreign policy. The government answered that precise prevalence data are lacking, outlined existing registration and reporting rules, pointed to planned research and measures, and described routes for recovering residence status and nationality.
Precise and reliable figures on the extent of forced marriage in the Netherlands are lacking.
Precieze en betrouwbare cijfers over de omvang van huwelijksdwang in Nederland ontbreken.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de situatie in de zuidelijke Kaukasus

An MP from the CDA asks the Foreign Minister about ethnic cleansing in Nagorno-Karabakh, EU engagement with Azerbaijan, possible Azerbaijani escalation toward Nakhchivan, EU gas dependence, sanctions and humanitarian aid. The minister answers that the Armenian population fled out of insecurity, that whether this is ethnic cleansing is legally complex and will be addressed in a separate letter, and that the EU is exploring non-lethal support, monitoring mission strengthening and economic aid while no concrete sanctions against Azerbaijan are currently planned.
The cabinet will address this question in a separate letter, partly in the context of the adopted motion by MP Ceder.
Het kabinet zal in een separate brief op deze vraag ingaan, mede in het kader van de aangenomen motie van het Lid Ceder
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'EU and G7 tankers facilitating Russian oil exports, report finds'

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to reports that EU and G7 tankers, including Greek-registered ones, help Russia evade the oil price cap and sanctions, and whether it will push for a lower cap or a ban on second-hand tanker sales. The minister answered that such services are permitted under the cap, that sanction breaches are criminal and investigated, that the Netherlands raises circumvention in the EU, and that a lower cap or tighter service rules are being examined in consultation with EU and G7 partners.
Signals about this are worrying and the cabinet takes them seriously.
Signalen hierover zijn zorgelijk en het kabinet neemt deze serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'VS roept Servië op om zich terug te trekken uit grensgebied met Kosovo'

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about US concerns over Serbian troop build-up near Kosovo, the release of Radoicic after the Banjska attack, KFOR and EUFOR Althea reserves, and Hungary's role. The government answers substantively on most points, notes the Kosovo police investigation is pending, and describes ongoing EU de-escalation efforts without committing to new measures.
The cabinet awaits the outcomes of this investigation.
Het kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink en Van der Staaij over de banden met Iran in Nederland

MPs Eppink and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister why she met Iran's foreign minister, why Iran sanctions evasion via Dutch firms (NIOC, 01 International BV) was not acted upon, and whether NIOC should be sanctioned. The minister said the Iran policy is unchanged, that conversations are used to raise human rights and nuclear concerns, that meeting notes and individual cases will not be disclosed, and that sanctions enforcement is a priority but no sanctioning announcements or company lists will be made.
The cabinet does not make such meeting notes public.
Het kabinet maakt dergelijke gespreksnotities niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de ruwe verwijdering van de Israëlische ambassadeur bij de VN

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the UN treated the Israeli ambassador roughly while an Iranian president was given speaking time, whether Dutch representatives attended that speech, and whether the minister would avoid closer ties with Iran. The minister answered that both states have speaking rights at the UN, that a Dutch official attended the speech at working level, that Dutch human rights pressure on Iran continues and ties are not being deepened, and that the Dutch UN mission expressed solidarity with Israel.
It is standing Dutch policy that during the so-called General Debate a representative of the Kingdom of the Netherlands is always present in the hall.
Het is staand beleid van Nederland dat er gedurende het zgn. General Debate altijd een vertegenwoordiger van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden in de zaal zit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'HRC54: Russia, China and Burundi are not fit to sit at the Human Rights Council'

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about the UN Human Rights Council seats for Russia and China, and whether the government would block their candidacies or re-elections. The minister answered that Russia failed to win a seat and that the government opposes its membership, while China was re-elected by a majority and the Netherlands will use its membership to press China on human rights.
The Netherlands and other international partners actively brought that position to the attention of other countries.
Nederland en andere internationale partners hebben dat standpunt actief onder de aandacht van andere landen gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over levering van munitie met verarmd uranium door de VS aan Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the US supply of depleted-uranium ammunition to Ukraine is acceptable given IAEA and UN concerns, and whether the Netherlands will oppose its use and raise it at the UN. The minister replied that the IAEA found no radiological danger to populations, that the Netherlands follows a precautionary approach by not using or supplying such ammunition, and that it discusses substitution of hazardous substances with partners without taking a new stance on the US supply.
Because of the scientific uncertainties about the effects of using weapons and ammunition with depleted uranium, the Netherlands indeed supports a precautionary approach.
Vanwege de wetenschappelijke onzekerheden over de gevolgen van het gebruik wapens en munitie met verarmd uranium, steunt Nederland inderdaad een voorzorgsbenadering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over de detentie van een Nederlander in Spanje

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked about the detention in Spain of a Dutch national from Tilburg, whether the Netherlands was involved, whether he was flagged for terrorism, and whether a 'white list' should be created. The ministers declined detailed comment citing the pending case and privacy rules, stated the Netherlands had no link to the Spanish grounds for arrest, noted he had since been returned to the Netherlands, and rejected a generic white list as unsuitable.
The case of the person concerned is currently before the court.
De zaak van betrokkene is op dit moment onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de Nederlandse man die al twee maanden om onduidelijke redenen vast zit in een Spaanse cel, in aanvulling op de vragen het lid Van Baarle

An MP asked why a Dutch man not suspected of any crime in the Netherlands has been held in a Spanish prison for two months, and whether Dutch-shared information caused it. The ministers declined to discuss the case substantively, citing the pending court proceedings and privacy rules, but said Dutch police and prosecutors confirmed he is not wanted in the Netherlands and that consular contact and information sharing with his lawyer have taken place.
The case of the person concerned is currently before the court.
De zaak van betrokkene is op dit moment onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het toenemend wantrouwen in de overheid onder jongeren

An MP asks several ministers about growing distrust of government among young people, its link to conspiracy theories and anti-institutional extremism, and how prevention of polarisation and radicalisation is organised. The Minister answers that youth distrust is a concern, outlines existing prevention efforts and coordination between ministries, and announces ongoing work such as a new training on anti-institutional extremism.
It is part of a healthy democracy that people can voice criticism of the government.
Het hoort bij een gezonde democratie dat mensen kritiek kunnen uiten op de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Valstar over het rapport 'Stormbreak: Fighting through Russian defences in Ukraine’s 2023 offensive'

MPs Brekelmans and Valstar asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about the RUSI report 'Stormbreak' on Ukraine's 2023 offensive, including whether NATO/EU safety rules limit realistic training, whether training is too focused on individual tactics, and whether brigade staff training is deficient. The Minister largely rejected the report's analysis, saying training is adapted to Ukraine's needs within safety requirements and that NATO doctrine is taught where useful, while committing only to continue existing coordination efforts.
I do not recognise this picture.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Temmink over het bericht dat de gemeente Den Haag, in navolging van de gemeente Deventer, cameradrones toepast bij het inspecteren van dakkapellen en uitbouwen

MPs Van Nispen and Temmink asked about municipalities using camera drones to inspect dakkapellen and extensions, raising privacy, DPIA, aviation permit, retention, anonymisation and legality concerns. The Minister answered that municipalities are responsible for privacy compliance, that Deventer and Den Haag have taken steps (DPIA, notices, blurring, limited retention), and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and courts will judge lawfulness.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for compliance with privacy legislation.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mogelijke plaatsing van Amerikaanse kernwapens in Groot-Brittannië

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether US tactical nuclear weapons may be deployed in the UK, on what legal basis, whether this breaches the NPT and whether the government will urge the UK to refrain, and how it will prevent escalation. The government declined to comment on the bilateral UK-US matter, said the NPT articles do not govern relations between nuclear-weapon states, rejected the escalation framing, and reaffirmed Dutch commitment to disarmament.
The cabinet cannot comment on this; it is a bilateral matter between the United States and the United Kingdom.
Het kabinet kan hier geen commentaar op geven, het betreft een bilaterale kwestie tussen de Verenigde Staten en het Verenigd Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over mogelijke spionage via Chinese röntgencamera’s voor de douane

Two MPs asked whether Chinese X-ray scanners from Nuctech used by Dutch customs pose espionage risks, citing a Belgian ruling allowing exclusion of the supplier and US/Canadian warnings. The state secretary answered that Dutch procurement law does not allow excluding an EU-established supplier that meets requirements, that national security tools and stricter security requirements are applied, and that the government will explore reducing dependence on a single supplier and coordinate with European customs.
Under the Public Procurement Act 2012 it is not possible to exclude a supplier established in the European Union that meets the stated requirements and conditions.
Op basis van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 is het niet mogelijk om een (in de Europese Unie gevestigde) leverancier, die wel aan de gestelde eisen en voorwaarden voldoet, uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over "Het bericht Deense regering wil koranverbrandingen voorkomen met wet"

An MP from DENK asked the government about Denmark and Sweden considering laws to ban Quran burning, and whether the Netherlands would do the same. The Minister said the government monitors those developments, sees no need for its own study, and stresses that free expression and peaceful demonstration are constitutionally protected, with only specific discriminatory speech punishable.
At present the cabinet sees no reason for its own study into additional legal options to prohibit desecration of religious books at demonstrations or in certain places.

Op dit moment ziet het kabinet geen aanleiding voor een eigen onderzoek naar aanvullende juridische mogelijkheden om het schenden van religieuze boeken bij demonstraties of op bepaalde plekken te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de haatactie van Pegida in Den Haag

An MP asked ministers whether they condemn Pegida's planned Koran-burning action in The Hague, whether they would press the mayor to ban it, and how it affects relations with Turkey. The government called the act provocative but said freedom of expression is a fundamental right, that the mayor is responsible for demonstrations under the Wom, and that Turkey was raised in bilateral talks.
The Public Demonstrations Act (Wom) places responsibility for facilitating demonstrations with local authorities.
De Wet openbare manifestaties (Wom) legt de verantwoordelijkheid voor het faciliteren van demonstraties bij het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de juridische positie van Taiwan in het kader van de komende Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties (78e zitting)

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about China's aggressive stance toward Taiwan, the official Dutch reading of UN Resolution 2758, and whether Taiwanese individuals and journalists could attend the upcoming UN General Assembly. The minister said Chinese military activity is worrying and that the Dutch one-China policy rests on Resolution 2758, while supporting meaningful Taiwanese participation in international bodies only case by case and in consultation with partners.

The cabinet, while respecting the Dutch one-China policy and together with like-minded countries, favours meaningful participation of Taiwan in international organisations and meetings where this is in the interest of the international community

Het kabinet is, met in achtneming van het Nederlandse één-Chinabeleid en samen met gelijkgestemde landen, voorstander van betekenisvolle deelname van Taiwan aan internationale organisaties en bijeenkomsten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over de vernieling van kerken in Pakistan

Members Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked the government about the destruction of over twenty churches in Jaranwala, Pakistan, the failure of local police to protect Christians, and possible Dutch and EU action. The minister acknowledged serious concern, noted that Pakistan has arrested over 130 people and set up an inquiry, and described existing Dutch and EU support including humanitarian aid and human rights engagement, without committing to new diplomatic steps.
The cabinet therefore currently sees no need to also request clarification from the Pakistani authorities, but will closely follow the outcomes and follow-up of the investigation.
Het kabinet ziet daarom vooralsnog geen noodzaak om ook opheldering te vragen aan de Pakistaanse autoriteiten maar zal de uitkomsten en de opvolging van het onderzoek nauw volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over afkalvende bestaanszekerheid voor mensen met publieke beroepen door kostenstijgingen en loonbeslag

An MP from the PvdA asked several ministers about falling financial security among care and public-sector workers, including reports that many skip doctor or dentist visits and that some have wage garnishments. The government answered that it lacks sector-specific garnishment data, that such garnishments are not shown to be more common in the public sector, and pointed to existing debt-relief measures and the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet, with no change to the exempt amount planned.

The cabinet does not have figures on wage garnishment in (subsectors of) care and cannot say whether the share of employees with a wage garnishment among district nurses and nursing home staff is larger than among other occupational groups or branches within care.

Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers over loonbeslag in (subsectoren van) de zorg en kan dus ook niet zeggen of het percentage medewerkers met loonbeslag onder wijkverpleegkundigen en zorgpersoneel in verpleeghuizen groter is dan onder andere beroepsgroepen dan wel branches binnen de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hans Teunissen over het bericht 'Gemeenten worstelen met desinformatie'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are adequately supported in tackling misleading information and conspiracy theories that undermine local democracy ahead of elections. The minister answered that the government works with the VNG on support measures, points to existing handbooks, webinars and a national strategy, and promises a further letter to parliament at year-end.
At the end of this year, your House will be further informed about the progress of these discussions and the further actions from the national strategy for an effective approach to disinformation.
Eind dit jaar wordt uw Kamer verder geïnformeerd over de voortgang van deze gesprekken en de verdere acties uit de Rijksbrede strategie effectieve aanpak van desinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hans Teunissen en Sneller over het artikel ‘VNG waarschuwt voor tekort aan stembureauvrijwilligers bij volgende verkiezingen’

MPs Teunissen and Sneller asked the Interior Minister about a shortage of polling-station volunteers, the planned recruitment campaign, the tax treatment of allowances, small-ballot experiments and the location of polling stations. The minister answered that recruitment is mainly a municipal task supported by a national campaign, that allowance talks with municipalities are ongoing with a report due by year-end, and that experiments and a letter on preparations will follow.
I intend to call on people via regional media (radio and newspapers) and social media to register with a municipality as a polling-station member or teller.
Ik ben voornemens om via de regionale media (radio en dagbladen) en via social media mensen op te roepen om zich bij een gemeente aan te melden als stembureaulid of als teller.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over e-mailverkeer van en naar het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport dat onlangs is vrijgegeven

An MP from FvD asked the Ministers of VWS and BZK about released emails in which a VWS official suggested asking Twitter to block a person, whether the IGJ was involved because he is a BIG-registered care provider, and about Facebook and Twitter attending BZK meetings. The government answered that identifying details are withheld, the IGJ shared disinformation signals and advised formal reports where law might be broken, and that no official minutes of the meetings with social media platforms exist.
Data that could lead to the identifiability of a specific individual will not be made public.
Gegevens, die kunnen leiden tot herleidbaarheid van een specifiek individu, worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het schieten met een pistool en mitrailleur op een foto van mijn hoofd

The MP Wilders asks whether the government is aware of a video showing a threat against him, whether the AIVD and NCTV were informed, what steps are taken to trace the perpetrator, and whether diplomatic measures will be taken if the video comes from Pakistan. The minister condemns the threat, declines to comment on intelligence and protection matters or on the individual investigation, and says the Pakistani ambassador would be informed of concerns and that a legal assistance request is possible.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I cannot go into individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken, dit om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de parlementaire BBQ

An MP asked ministers about the parliamentary BBQ, renamed NLvoedt, and whether its meat, fish and dairy industry organisers, including a sitting senator, give disproportionate lobbying influence, and whether ministers should attend. The government replied that lobbying is a legitimate part of democracy, that the event's partners are publicly listed, that attendance is a matter for individual politicians, and that it sees no ground to exclude such events, while committing to an evaluation of agenda and lobby-paragraph transparency tools.
To improve transparency and accountability, the guideline on transparency of ministers' agendas has been tightened in line with the Van Baarle-Dassen motion.
Om transparantie en verantwoording te verbeteren is de «Uitvoeringsrichtlijn transparantie agenda’s bewindslieden» aangescherpt in lijn met de motie Van Baarle-Dassen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Dekker-Abdulaziz en Bromet over het artikel 'Nederlandse gemeenten overtreden massaal de wet door achterkamertjes in te duiken'

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch municipalities unlawfully hold informal closed meetings to avoid public scrutiny, and how the Municipalities Act and the Open Government Act apply. The Minister replied that the law sets openness as the rule, that informal technical or information meetings without decision-making are not regulated by the Municipalities Act, that no unlawful closed meetings were established, and that a circular on committees is being prepared.
I do not have figures on the number of municipalities that use closed meetings within the meaning of the Municipalities Act and other types of meetings.
Ik beschik niet over cijfermateriaal over het aantal gemeenten dat gebruik maakt van besloten vergaderingen in de zin van de Gemeentewet en andere type bijeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over gevallen waarin Nederlandse moslims gecremeerd worden

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Interior about cases where Dutch Muslims were cremated despite requests for Islamic burial, including whether care homes were negligent and what rules exist for unclaimed bodies. The Minister answered that care homes are not responsible for funerals, that the Burial Act requires respecting the deceased's wishes where reasonably possible, and that the municipal mayor is the fallback, while leaving documenting wishes to the individuals themselves.
Arranging the funeral is not the responsibility of care homes.
Zorgdragen voor de lijkbezorging is geen verantwoordelijkheid van verzorgingstehuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Grevink over de uitspraak van Gerechtshof ’s-Hertogenbosch over forse verhoging van de forensenbelasting in 2020

MPs Idsinga and Grevink (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior whether the government shares concern about a court ruling on a sharp municipal forensenbelasting increase and whether municipalities are overstepping their powers. The minister replied that municipal taxation is an autonomous competence, that the courts and municipal politics provide sufficient safeguards, and declined to assess the case or propose new limits.

The tax levy concerned is an autonomous competence of the municipality and, given the role of the independent judge, it is not for me to give a judgment on the assessment and/or the court ruling on it.

De betreffende belastingheffing is een autonome bevoegdheid van de gemeente en gegeven de rol van de onafhankelijke rechter, is het niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de aanslag en/of de rechtelijke uitspraak daarover.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Haga over websites met kindermisbruik op Nederlandse servers

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of a rise in child sexual abuse websites hosted on Dutch servers, what action was taken, who owns the servers, and how such content is enforced against. The government answered that the Dutch share has actually fallen, outlined self-regulation with hosting providers and the planned ATKM enforcement authority, and said precise ownership and perpetrator data are unavailable.
We do not have a complete overview by nationality and ownership.
Een totaal overzicht naar nationaliteit en eigenaarschap hebben wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de geblokkeerde herbenoeming van klokkenluiders bij het College voor de Rechten van de Mens

Leijten (SP) asks the Minister whether blocking the reappointment of whistleblowers at the College voor de Rechten van de Mens amounts to disadvantaging them, who is responsible for their protection, and why Parliament was not informed earlier. The Minister says protection duties apply, an independent Sorgdrager commission is investigating, the Minister cannot undo the Raad van Advies decision because of the College's independence, and Parliament was informed later after media coverage.
I have taken note of the decision of the College's Advisory Council shared on 3 April 2023 with the College members and the ministry.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van de beslissing van de Raad van Advies van het College die op 3 april 2023 is gedeeld met de leden van het College en met het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Sneller over ‘Versterking kennisfunctie van de Rijksoverheid’

Sneller (D66) asked how the government has followed up on a 2018 KWINK report on open publication of ministry research and protection against political or civil-servant steering, whether a Rijksbrede knowledge function should be strengthened (Rijkslab, chief science officers), and whether ministries should have their own knowledge institutes like the WODC. The minister answered that departments already promote open publication, that no government-wide stakeholder study is needed, that the knowledge function remains a departmental responsibility with only possible interdepartmental agreements, and that the answers could not be given before the committee debate.
I therefore see no need for a government-wide stakeholder study.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak voor een Rijksbreed stakeholdersonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over de subsidiëring van jongerenorganisaties

MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh asked about government subsidies and study-grant (bestuursbeurzen) schemes for youth organisations, including who qualifies, representativeness, rejected applications and the treatment of vocational students. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that no integral overview exists, explained the eligibility criteria and rejections, and largely declined to change the scheme's scope beyond planned extensions for mbo students.
There is no integral overview of all youth organisations that receive facilities or subsidies from the national government.
Er is geen integraal overzicht van alle jongerenorganisaties die faciliteiten of subsidie krijgen van de landelijke overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verwenij en Omtzigt over de bestrijding van desinformatie door de denktank Desinformatie

MPs Pouw-Verwenij and Omtzigt asked the health and interior ministers about the government's role in countering vaccine disinformation through the Denktank Desinformatie, including access to platform reporting portals, membership, mandate, definitions, interventions and legal basis. The state secretary answered that the think tank had no special platform status or decision-making power, that no complete overview of government contacts with platforms exists, and that participants acted on personal title, while documents were attached.
There is no overview of the deployment of the Ministry of VWS and the bodies falling under it in the area of disinformation.
Er is geen overzicht van de inzet van het Ministerie van VWS en de daaronder vallende gremia op het gebied van desinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het gepubliceerde AIVD-rapport over 'anti-institutioneel-extremisme'

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the AIVD has ever investigated an alleged 'malicious elite' mentioned in its anti-institutional extremism report, and whether a hypothetical foreign private organisation with close ties to cabinet and the royal house should be investigated. The minister confirmed the remark, said the AIVD sees no indication of such a malicious elite, and declined to comment on the hypothetical, saying no threat to national security is apparent.
The AIVD does not go further into hypothetical examples.
De AIVD gaat verder niet in op hypothetische voorbeelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het nieuws dat de Binnenlandse Veiligheidsdienst jarenlang illegaal advocaten en academici bespioneerde

Left-wing SP MPs asked the Interior Minister about reports that the BVD illegally surveilled lawyers and academics, including Bakker Schut and people around him, and whether this resembled police-state methods and was a criminalisation of a lawyer. The minister replied that the 1970s investigations took place under a much thinner legal framework, that the RAF terrorism context applied, that today's stricter safeguards for lawyers (court authorisation, CTIVD oversight) are in place, and that the AIVD cannot publicly discuss the specific operational case.
Finally, I cannot publicly discuss the intelligence investigations of the AIVD and its predecessors.
Ik kan, ten slotte, in het openbaar niet ingaan op de inlichtingenonderzoeken van de AIVD en diens voorgangers.
Vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over AIVD

The MP asked whether the AIVD's reported violent 'anti-institutional extremists' have led to prosecutions or convictions, and why the cases were not sent to parliament if they are public. The minister answered that the AIVD does not comment publicly on individual cases, described the threat of the 'malicious elite' narrative in general terms, and cited one foiled assassination plot against then-prime minister Rutte as an example.
As is known, the AIVD does not make public statements about casuistry regarding persons or organisations under investigation.
Zoals bekend, doet de AIVD geen uitspraken in het openbaar over casuïstiek omtrent personen of organisaties die in onderzoek zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over desinformatie

An MP asked the State Secretary of the Interior about disinformation, including criminal law use, algorithms and echo chambers, platform obligations under the DSA, and the role of citizens and media. The government answered that the DSA will bind very large platforms, that the state stays restrained on factchecking, and that it will report on the national strategy by end 2023.
At the end of 2023 we will inform the House about the progress in implementing the national strategy.
Eind 2023 zullen we uw Kamer informeren over de voortgang van de uitvoering van de Rijksbrede strategie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en El Yassini over Artikelen ‘Kansengelijkheid helpt de wetenschap vooruit’ en ‘Nieuw onderzoeksprogramma voor kansengelijkheid en inclusie academische wereld’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Education and Interior about NWO's funding of research into quotas for racialised academic staff and whether NWO's remit covers diversity goals. The ministers answered that individual merit matters, that no quota policy is planned, that NWO's core statutory task is research quality, and that they see no reason to act while awaiting the research results.
NWO is funding research into quotas for racialised academic staff. As funder, NWO is not responsible for the details of this research.
NWO financiert een onderzoek naar quota voor geracialiseerd academisch personeel. NWO gaat als financier niet over de details van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Succesvolle retoursticker voor moeilijke brieven’

An MP asked about a campaign encouraging citizens to return hard-to-understand government letters with a sticker requesting plain language, and about the effectiveness of plain-language covenants. The Secretary of State supports plain language, points to the Direct Duidelijk deal, the Werk aan Uitvoering programme, Belastingdienst letter rewrites and a planned amendment to the Awb on plain-language reasoning, without committing to new oversight measures.
Government organisations must ensure that the person for whom they write can read the letter.
Overheidsorganisaties moeten er namelijk voor zorgen dat degene voor wie zij schrijven de brief kan lezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Sjoerdsma en Wuite over stemregistratie voor de Europese Parlementsverkiezingen in de Caribische Landen van het Koninkrijk

D66 MPs asked how the government will make European Parliament elections as accessible in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom as in the Netherlands, how it will involve Caribbean citizens in EU engagement, and how the planned dialogues and events will reach them. The minister says a policy paper will set out options (more voting locations, abolishing the registration requirement) with consultation of the Caribbean countries, and that the dialogues and events will be digital and open to all, with extra effort for youth and hard-to-reach groups.
The policy paper will set out a number of routes to increase the accessibility of the EP elections in the countries and to facilitate voters as much as possible in casting their vote.

In de hoofdlijnennotitie wordt een aantal sporen uitgewerkt waarlangs de toegankelijkheid van de EP-verkiezingen in de landen kan worden vergroot en kiesgerechtigden zoveel mogelijk kunnen worden gefaciliteerd in het uitbrengen van hun stem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht “Schrikbarende’ conclusies in zeer kritisch advies: Den Haag heeft ‘de regio’ stelselmatig verwaarloosd’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether she endorses the advisory report finding that government policy has widened gaps between rich and poor regions, and what steps will address regional neglect, central government visibility, efficiency focus, and regional electoral representation. The minister acknowledges concern, points to Regio Deals and planned responses, and states government will reply to the advisory report before the summer recess, while outlining measures on civil service distribution, participation, and a proposed candidate-vote electoral reform.
As a cabinet we are currently working on a response to the advisory report 'Elke regio telt!'. It will be sent to the House before the summer recess.
We zijn als kabinet op dit moment bezig om te komen tot een reactie op het adviesrapport «Elke regio telt!». Voor het zomerreces zal deze aan de Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Wassenberg over ‘de grootschalige verzameling van data over demonstranten door de politie’

MPs Teunissen and Wassenberg asked whether police mass-query personal data of demonstrators in the BRP population register, and whether this is proportionate and lawful. The minister answers that such queries are used for risk assessment and only when necessary and proportionate under the Wet politiegegevens, that internal training exists, and that no supervisory referral to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is planned.

Under article 3.2 of the Wet basisregistratie personen, the police have been issued an authorisation decision allowing them to obtain data from the BRP for performing their duties under article 3 of the Police Act 2012.

Op grond van artikel 3.2 Wet basisregistratie personen is aan de politie een autorisatiebesluit afgegeven waarin wordt bepaald dat de politie voor de uitvoering van artikel 3 Politiewet 2012 gegevens uit de BRP mag verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over ‘de grootschalige verzameling van data over demonstranten door de politie’

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about police collecting large-scale personal data on demonstrators, its legal basis, proportionality, and privacy oversight. The minister defended the practice as necessary for managing demonstrations and proportionate, refused to give case-level detail or provide demonstrator-group statistics, and declined to request an Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens review.
It is not possible to give the House insight into the queries, because these concern personal data of individuals.
Het is niet mogelijk om de Kamer inzage te geven in de bevragingen, omdat dit persoonsgegevens van individuen betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bouw van het datacentrum van Microsoft

An SP MP asked how Microsoft could keep building a data centre without a permit, whether preferential treatment undermines trust, whether the project should be halted, and what role EZK and NFIA played. The minister answered that the province of Noord-Holland, as competent authority, allowed construction via two gedoogbeslissingen, that the omgevingsvergunning was granted on 19 April but is not yet final, that the data centre is within designated zoning, and that NFIA's involvement was limited to investor relations and referral to regional authorities.
The college of gedeputeerde staten of the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority for permit granting, supervision and enforcement.
Het college van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Noord-Holland is het bevoegd gezag voor vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de miljarden aan kosten voor de pensioenen van militairen en politieke ambtsdragers waarvoor geen voorziening is getroffen is en waardoor er geld bijgestort zal moeten worden

MP Omtzigt asked about billions in unfunded pensions for military personnel and political office holders, including whether reserves were set aside, the cost of pre-funding the APPA pensions, and why the Wet toekomst pensioenen memorandum lacked estimates. The minister answered that military pensions are budgeted via a reserve, APPA pensions are not yet reserved pending a separate legislative process, municipalities and provinces are urged to build adequate provisions, and the facts study will be repeated.
During this year I will, together with the subnational governments, repeat the factual study into the provisions already made in the budgets.
In de loop van dit jaar zal ik samen met de medeoverheden het feitenonderzoek herhalen naar de al getroffen voorzieningen op de begrotingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het toestaan dat raadsleden voor een gemeenschappelijke regeling werken

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the 2023 amendment to Article 13 of the Municipal Act, which bars councillors from working as officials for joint arrangements in ways tied to their own municipality, has excluded councillors from such roles, and how it is interpreted. The Minister says the rule aims to keep councils and boards independent, is meant to stay narrow, has produced no confirmed cases of councillors forced out, and that interpretation will be clarified with the councillors' association and clerks' association.
I will consult with the Dutch Association of Councillors and the Association of Clerks to ensure a uniform interpretation and application of the amended Article 13 of the Municipal Act.
Ik ga in overleg met de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Raadsleden en de Vereniging van Griffiers, om een eenduidige interpretatie en toepassing van het gewijzigde artikel 13 Gemeentewet te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Five MPs asked the government about progress toward its 2030 targets, including a halving of nitrogen emissions and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that the nitrogen target is set as deposition thresholds rather than halving, that the latest projection shows only 43% of nature area meeting the norm with a risk of missing the target, and that a new projection will follow in late 2023 with additional measures and a 15% organic farmland plan under monitoring.
The cabinet indicated in 2021 that it wanted to respond to the call.
Het kabinet heeft in 2021 aangegeven gehoor te willen geven aan de oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Cora van Nieuwenhuizen heeft een lobbyverbod maar bemoeit zich met het werk van klimaatminister Jetten’
