MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked the Minister of the Interior whether former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen breached the post-ministerial lobbying ban through contacts with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, and how enforcement will be ensured. The government answers that the ban was triggered by her brief five-day interim ministerial role, that her later letters were treated as Energie-Nederland positions, and that a statutory ban and register will follow in a forthcoming bill.
The lobbying ban makes no distinction based on the nature and duration of the ministerial office.
Het lobbyverbod kent geen onderscheid naar de aard en duur van het ministerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een Wob/Woo-verzoek uit januari 2021 naar de reactie op het rapport ‘Ongekend Onrecht’

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked for a detailed timeline of how the government handled a Wob/Woo request from January 2021 for drafts and related documents on the response to the 'Ongekend Onrecht' report, including court rulings, why it was omitted from an earlier list, and disclosure of the inventory and drafts. The Minister answered most questions substantively, providing timelines, the court ruling and decisions, but refused to release draft letters, citing the need for internal confidentiality, and deferred assessment of the handling to the court.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de registratie van fraudeurs door verzekeraars naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Nederlandse verzekeraars spelen voor aanklager en rechter tegelijk'

An MP asks the Finance and Interior ministers about insurers registering suspected fraudsters in a shared warning system without court review, including limits on listing duration, notification, objections, and age/occupation-based refusals. The ministers defend the PIFI protocol as approved by the Dutch data protection authority, describe objection and complaint routes, and say they see no need for new regulation on uninsurability or refusals.
So I do not share your view that fraudsters should only be placed on a list after a judge or another independent body has examined the evidence.
Ik deel dus niet met u dat fraudeurs pas op een lijst moeten kunnen komen nadat de rechter of een andere onafhankelijke instantie naar het bewijs heeft gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de beloftes van het kabinet na het aftreden vanwege het kinderopvangtoeslagschandaal

An MP asks the cabinet to report on progress on all promises made after the childcare benefits scandal, including a timeline for redress for parents and children, and a full list of commitments with status, spending and responsibility. The government answers that it refers to its earlier progress letters and departmental contributions on the recovery operation, transparency, the legality principle and hardship clauses, but does not provide a single consolidated status overview of every promise.
In this letter the cabinet proposed to inform the House further in future about progress on the actions from the cabinet response in the relevant separate tracks.
In deze brief heeft het kabinet het voorstel gedaan om de Kamer voortaan verder te informeren over de voortgang van de acties uit de kabinetsreactie in de relevante afzonderlijke trajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het weerbaar maken van onze democratie tegen heimelijke (politieke) beïnvloeding

MPs Sneller and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked the ministers about dark money, transparency of advertising and campaign financing, foreign donations to Dutch NGOs, and possible foreign influence on elections. The ministers answered that transparency is being strengthened through the EU political advertising regulation, the Wtmo bill and the Wfpp, but that many issues are still under negotiation or fall under other levels of government.
The cabinet is committed to further increasing this transparency.
Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in om deze transparantie verder te vergroten.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over voorbeelden van gewelddadige uitwassen,

An FvD MP asked the Interior Minister to confirm an AIVD annual report sentence describing a limited number of violent excesses by anti-institutional extremists, and to give concrete examples leading to prosecutions. The minister confirmed the sentence but declined to give examples, saying the AIVD does not comment publicly on such matters and its wording reflects its investigative mandate.
As is known, the AIVD does not make public statements about this.
Zoals bekend doet de AIVD hier in het openbaar geen uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de gevolgen voor mensen als de Staat blijft procederen

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether the State should be more restrained in appealing against citizens who already won in first instance, given the financial and mental burden, and whether the framework 'Behoorlijk omgaan met schadeclaims' and the Leijten/Ellian motion on the State as litigant will be applied. The minister acknowledges the burden, says the existing framework requires restraint and weighing of individual interests and that its current relevance will be reviewed, with a government update expected around summer.
As I indicated above, there is a framework within central government to ensure proper handling of damage claims within central government.
Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven, bestaat er binnen de rijksoverheid een kader om een behoorlijke omgang met schadeclaims binnen de rijksoverheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Koerhuis, Rajkowski en Valstar over het bericht ‘‘Verdachte’ Chinese kranen staan ook in Nederlandse havens: zorgen om spionage’

The VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Chinese ZPMC cranes in Dutch ports could enable Chinese digital access, espionage, or disruption of military transports, and about Logink data links and subsidies. The government answered that the risks are being investigated in an interdepartmental review due in autumn 2023, that port facilities are responsible for securing their systems, that no Logink cooperation exists in Rotterdam, and that EU rules and NIS2/CER directives may address the risks.

Whether it is possible for the ZPMC facilities in China to gain digital access to the cranes, or whether they are connected in any way or have access to information in the port of Rotterdam, is being investigated in consultation with the Port of Rotterdam Authority.

Of het mogelijk is om vanuit de ZPMC-faciliteiten in China digitale toegang te krijgen tot de kranen, of dat deze op enigerlei wijze verbonden zijn of toegang hebben tot informatie in de Rotterdamse haven, wordt onderzocht in afstemming met het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het artikel ‘Landbouwlobby liet maatregelen uit nieuw waterbeleid van het Rijk afzwakken’

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked whether the agricultural lobby (LTO) influenced the new national water policy after a press report, and about the nature of its contacts with ministers. The government answered that the meetings were consultations tied to a policy letter rather than formal administrative consultation, that no minutes were kept, and that some suggestions were adopted while others were not.
No meeting report was made, but an appointment was made for a follow-up meeting.
Er is geen gespreksverslag gemaakt, wel een afspraak voor een vervolggesprek.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over contacten tussen de AIVD en de Nederlandse pers

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers about AIVD contacts with the Dutch press, including what information the AIVD shares with journalists and whether it had contact with other newspapers and broadcasters. The minister answered that the AIVD may share information with media without personal data or state secrets, and refused to provide all communication between the AIVD, MIVD, NCTV and media because no integral overview exists.
There is no legal basis to keep records of all communication with the media.
Er is geen juridische grondslag om alle communicatie met media bij te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de definitieve fatwa en de oproep aan Nederlandse moslims mij te vermoorden

An MP from the PVV asked the government to condemn a Pakistani fatwa calling for the MP's murder, to explain how such threats are handled, and to consider expelling the Pakistani ambassador. The government condemned the threats, said it raised concerns with Pakistan, noted a prosecution decision, and declined to discuss threat cases or intelligence assessments in public.
As is known to your House, I cannot publicly make statements about the working methods of the intelligence and security services, or about concrete threat cases and personal security measures.

Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend kan ik over de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten, alsmede informatie over concrete dreigings-casuïstiek en beveiligingsmaatregelen van personen, in het openbaar geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de ‘Desinformatie-operatie’ van de overheid

An MP asks the government why its earlier answers denied any 'disinformation operation' despite Woo documents showing counter-disinformation bodies, LIMC surveillance of critical citizens, avatar use, and an unclear legal basis; the minister maintains the reporting gives a distorted picture, refers back to earlier answers and a commission report, and denies key allegations. The answers repeatedly decline to add detail or to provide the requested overview of who did what, citing prior answers, privacy, and other responsibilities.
Also, the names of the think tank participants are not made public in connection with the protection of personal privacy.
Tevens worden de namen van de deelnemers van de denktank niet openbaar gemaakt in verband met de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Vestering, Van Esch en Van Raan over het adequaat beschermen van kwetsbare en unieke natuur en koraal op en rondom de BES-eilanden

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked how a motion to halt irreversible building steps at Plantage Bolivia on Bonaire, port expansion near Hato, coral damage, and enforcement against coastal construction on Sint Eustatius were being implemented. The government answered that no irreversible steps are legally possible before the environmental impact assessment is complete, that the port and coral issues will be examined in the MER, and that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport report on local enforcement capacity and related follow-ups will be sent by end May 2023.

Since the revision of the Bonaire spatial development plan will not be started in procedure until the MER has been established and assessed, I note that it is currently not legally possible to take irreversible steps.

Aangezien de herziening van het Ruimtelijke Ordeningsplan Bonaire (ROB) niet in procedure worden gebracht, zolang de MER niet is vastgesteld en beoordeeld, constateer ik dat het op dit moment juridisch niet mogelijk is om onomkeerbare stappen te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verkiezingen in Limburg

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about miscounted votes in the Limburg water board election, possible counting errors in the provincial election, and nine 'Waterbelang' lists linked to the CDA. The minister explained the discrepancies came from preliminary municipal tallies and a spreadsheet error, found no substantive counting problems in the provincial election, and said no new restrictive rules were planned.
I currently have no plans for restrictive regulation on this point.
Ik heb momenteel geen voornemens voor beperkende regelgeving op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het verdwijnen van stembureaus

An MP asks the Minister of Interior Affairs about the decline in polling stations, its uneven spread across neighbourhoods, long travel distances, election posters and whether a minimum norm should be set. The minister says the causes and spread are being studied in the evaluation of the 2023 provincial and water board elections, that gemeenten are legally responsible for polling stations, and opposes a fixed norm, promising to report findings in September.
It is a statutory responsibility of municipalities to ensure sufficient polling stations.
Het is een wettelijke verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om te zorgen voor voldoende stemlokalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Van der Graaf over de afname van het aantal stembureaus

MPs Bushoff and Van der Graaf asked the Minister of the Interior about the reported reduction in polling stations, accessibility, turnout and the Van Raak motion. The minister answered that an evaluation of the provincial and water board elections is ongoing, that results on the number of polling stations per municipality will be sent in September, and that municipalities are legally responsible for designating polling stations.
An overview of which municipalities have set up fewer polling stations is not yet available.
Een overzicht van welke gemeenten minder stembureaus hebben ingericht is nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Den Haag schiet tekort voor het Limburgs’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior about a report that the Dutch government pays too little attention to the Limburgish dialect, and about calls for legal language rights and wider use in education and media. The minister replied that Limburgish is recognised under the European Charter, that the province of Limburg leads language policy under a 2019 covenant, and that the covenant is being evaluated with results expected in autumn.
At present the Covenant on the Dutch recognition of the Limburgish language is being jointly evaluated by the Ministry of BZK and the Province of Limburg.
Op dit moment wordt het Convenant inzake de Nederlandse erkenning van de Limburgse taal door het Ministerie van BZK en de Provincie Limburg gezamenlijk geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over stemmen via DigiD

MP Van Haga asks whether voting via DigiD should be enabled, arguing it would raise turnout and that security fears are overblown. The Minister refuses to introduce internet voting, citing cyber risks to secrecy and integrity, and notes research showing it does not raise turnout.
No, given the cabinet's position on internet voting as set out in the answers above, I do not intend to take steps to enable internet voting.
Nee, gelet op het kabinetsstandpunt omtrent stemmen per internet zoals verwoord in de bovenstaande antwoorden, ben ik niet voornemens om stappen te nemen om internetstemmen mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over dreigende onbereikbaarheid van Omrop Fryslân

An MP asked about DAB+ coverage gaps for Omrop Fryslân and whether FM should stay available, citing Frisian language rights. The government says coverage is a licensing matter for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and the RDI, that FM and online remain available, and that no FM switch-off is planned before 2035.
Yes, I am aware of these statements.
Ja, ik ben bekend met deze uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over lobbyregels bij provincies

An MP asked the Interior Minister about lobbying rules at provinces, the lack of decentralised integrity research and whether minimum integrity standards should apply uniformly across provinces and match national rules. The minister said provinces share the same statutory integrity rules, that local integrity policy is their own responsibility, and that an integrity policy note with possible additional measures for local government will be sent to parliament soon.
In the announced integrity in public administration note, I will examine further the relationship between policy and the available figures.
In de aangekondigde nota integriteit openbaar bestuur ga ik nader in op de relatie tussen het beleid en de – beschikbare – cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het vertrouwen in het bestuur

An MP from the PvdA asks the Interior Minister and Prime Minister about declining public trust in local government, linking it to national failures on Groningen gas extraction, the childcare benefits affair and asylum reception at Ter Apel, and asks whether the Prime Minister's refusal to answer questions on 2030 government targets undermines accountability. The minister answers that local government still enjoys more trust than national institutions, that trust drivers include responsiveness and reliability, and that the government is working on participation and administrative reforms, while declining to give a direct answer on the 2030 targets, which were referred to the responsible ministers with a commitment to inform parliament before Accountability Day 2023.
Restoring trust between residents and government is a task for the entire cabinet.
Het herstel van het vertrouwen tussen inwoners en overheid is een opgave voor het gehele kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het karakter en het moment van Provinciale Statenverkiezingen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether provincial elections should focus on provincial issues, be staggered, allow mid-term dissolution of provincial councils, be strengthened by regional media, and be less overshadowed by the Senate election, and whether the 2027 evaluation will assess their use as a national popularity poll. The minister largely declines structural change: she opposes staggering to protect turnout, keeps mid-term dissolution under study without commitment, notes regional broadcasters' efforts, supports the Senate-by-halves bill as giving provincial mandates a purer basis, and promises a survey report on the role of national politics by year end.
I would find that undesirable. In view of the above, I currently have no intention of making proposals that would enable staggering of the state elections.
Ik zou dat onwenselijk vinden. Gelet op het bovenstaande heb ik op dit moment geen voornemens om voorstellen te doen die spreiding van de statenverkiezingen mogelijk maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Thijssen over ‘procedures door de overheid’

MPs Bromet and Thijssen asked how many administrative objection, appeal and enforcement procedures on nitrogen (stikstof) had been run since the Council of State ruling on the PAS, who was party to them, what they cost, whether the government commonly takes external legal advice, and why government often fails to respond to enforcement requests. The minister answered that such figures are not registered centrally, gave a partial overview of cases per competent authority, said costs are unknown, and argued that enforcement is an obligation in principle but may be set aside in exceptional cases, with reasons to be given.
No, this is not possible because this information is not registered.
Nee, dit is niet mogelijk omdat deze informatie niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het online gebiedsverbod

D66 MPs asked ministers whether the Utrecht court ruling that the mayor could not impose an online area ban (ruling it an impermissible restriction of free expression reserved to national legislation) should be accepted, and what alternatives exist to tackle online incitement. The government declined to comment on the pending case, outlined administrative measures and a framework for mayoral powers, and said it would consider alternatives without committing to a specific legislative proposal.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about individual and/or pending cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om uitspraken te doen over individuele en/of lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Raan over de Uitvoeringsagenda Internationale Sociale Voorwaarden (ISV)

An MP asked why the government's International Social Conditions (ISV) implementation agenda lacks measurable targets, timelines and responsible departments for procurement, and whether it will impose stronger obligations. The minister answered that research on targets, sector scope and award criteria is underway with completion targeted for Q4 2023, and that the approach mixes support measures with an examination of mandatory use.
The aim is to complete this research in Q4 2023.
Het streven is dit onderzoek in Q4 2023 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over de Corruption Perceptions Index 2022

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked the minister about the Netherlands' 2022 Corruption Perceptions Index drop to eighth place, Transparency International's criticism of political integrity rules, party financing and lobbying oversight, and planned measures. The minister acknowledged the drop as a signal to take seriously, pointed to recent integrity measures and pending legislation, and said the government will act on the lobbying study and integrity follow-up.
The cabinet considers that this insufficiently does justice to the efforts made here over the past year.
Het kabinet vindt dat dit onvoldoende recht doet aan de inspanningen die hier het afgelopen jaar op zijn gepleegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht ‘Provincie Utrecht gebruikt als eerste overheid in Nederland een eerlijke CO2-prijs’

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers how the national government factors the costs of climate change into policy, whether a national CO2 price should be used, and whether ministers should report climate costs. The minister answered that the IAK and MKBA guidance already include CO2 prices, that the planning bureaus' efficient CO2 prices differ from Utrecht's social-cost approach, that he is willing to work toward a national CO2 price, and that reporting and decision-note requirements are left to individual ministers.
I would prefer to leave this to the ministers themselves.
Dit laat ik graag aan de Ministers zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kröger over de aanhouding van klimaatactivisten

MPs Ellemeet and Kröger asked whether the preemptive arrest of climate activists for incitement was proportionate, whether it chilled the right to demonstrate, and what concrete threat justified it. The Minister answered that the eight people were arrested for incitement that had already occurred, released the same day with a area ban that courts partly upheld, and that the police acted under the prosecutor's authority, while not addressing the preventive-arrest and proportionality concerns in detail.
The eight arrests were made because of the suspicion of a criminal offence, namely incitement.
De acht aanhoudingen zijn verricht als gevolg van de verdenking tot een strafbaar feit, namelijk opruiing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bereikbaarheid van stemlocaties

An MP asked whether the government is aware that a regional transport strike on election day could make some polling stations inaccessible, and whether it would discuss free public transport with unions and operators. The minister confirmed awareness, said both the strike right and access to polling stations matter, and reported having urged the unions not to strike on election day without committing to any concrete structural measure.
I understand the concerns raised by a strike on election day, but of course also respect the right to strike.
Ik begrijp de zorgen die leven bij een staking op de verkiezingsdag, maar respecteer uiteraard ook het stakingsrecht.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Westerveld over het bericht ‘Slechtzienden blijven thuis door ov-staking: zorgen over actie op verkiezingsdag’

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers how far blind and partially sighted voters must travel to vote, how many polling stations are accessible to them, how many voters would be affected by a public transport strike on election day, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that accessibility varies by municipality, that the government urged unions not to strike on election day and asked VNG municipalities to arrange alternative transport, while stating the Kieswet offers no basis for home voting or early voting.
I have urged the VNG municipalities to try to offer alternative transport to voters who need it because of a possible strike.
Ik heb met de VNG gemeenten opgeroepen om te proberen alternatief vervoer aan te bieden voor de kiezers die dat vanwege een mogelijke staking nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over aanhoudingen door de politie

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the Justice and Interior ministers about police arrests of Extinction Rebellion activists before a planned A12 blockade, including Amnesty's concerns about the right to demonstrate. The minister answered that the arrests were for suspected incitement, not preventive detention, that courts upheld most area bans, and that a full response to Amnesty's report will follow before summer 2023.
There has been no question of preventive arrests.
Er is geen sprake geweest van preventieve arrestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het niet-vervolgen van doodsbedreigers

An MP asks why the Public Prosecution Service declined to prosecute people who threatened him with death, and whether this undermines his safety and the rule of law. The Minister of Justice answers that individual prosecutorial decisions cannot be discussed to avoid political interference, that threats against MPs are assessed with great care regardless of political affiliation, and that the AIVD monitors threats to protected persons.
As Minister of Justice and Security I cannot address individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken, dit om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over fatwa’s en bedreigingen

An MP asks the Prime Minister and several ministers what has concretely been done to identify, prosecute or extradite people who issued fatwas and death threats against him, and how many threat cases were prosecuted. The minister replies that individual cases cannot be discussed, that Pakistan has not answered legal assistance requests, that the Public Prosecution Service decides prosecution case by case, and that threats are forwarded to the intelligence services.
I cannot go into individual cases; the Public Prosecution Service is the designated body to inform you confidentially about such matters.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken, het Openbaar Ministerie is de aangewezen instantie om u, als betrokkene, vertrouwelijk over dergelijke zaken te informeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Wassenberg over het demonstratierecht

Two MPs from the Animal Party asked about the mass arrests of 768 Extinction Rebellion protesters in The Hague on 28 January, use of force, detention of journalists, pre-emptive arrests for incitement, and unequal treatment compared with farmer protests. The Minister answered that the mayor and police acted to end an unlawful motorway blockade, that the protest right is a fundamental right but does not justify crimes, that pre-emptive arrests were for incitement and courts upheld some restrictions, and that the government will send a letter on the protest right before summer.
Sometimes it is unavoidable for the police to use force in carrying out their duties. The police only do so when it is absolutely necessary.
Het is voor de politie soms onvermijdelijk om bij het uitvoeren van haar taak geweld te gebruiken. Dit doet de politie alleen als het absoluut noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over de gang van zaken rond de vergunningverlening ofwel legalisering van de activiteiten van eendenslachterij Tomassen Duck-To in Ermelo

MPs Vestering and Wassenberg asked the Minister of Interior about the handling of the permit application and legalisation of a duck slaughterhouse in Ermelo, including closed-door council meetings, a threatened damages claim, and a temporary permit. The Minister answered that the permit decision lies with the municipal executive, that the council may meet in closed session under the Municipalities Act, and that the Minister could intervene by royal decree only on unlawful decisions, while stating the answers were delayed as the municipality was consulted.
The authority to grant an environmental permit lies with the municipal executive (college of mayor and aldermen) of the municipality concerned.
De bevoegdheid een omgevingsvergunning te verlenen ligt bij het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de betreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de inmenging van de Rijksoverheid in het publieke debat over de coronacrisis en het censureren van kritische burgers

Groep Van Haga asked ministers whether the central government covertly influenced public debate on COVID-19, including through 'debunking', alleged avatars and trolls, surveillance of critics, and pressure on media and fact-checkers. The government denied any 'disinformation operation', said it only informs press and debunks factual errors, and pointed to earlier letters, independent LIMC research and existing NCTV/IGJ responsibilities.
No 'disinformation operation' took place as described in the cited article.
Er heeft geen «desinformatie-operatie» plaatsgevonden zoals beschreven in het genoemde artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Podt over het bericht ‘Joana Duarte wil Nederlander worden met een Friese eed (maar of dat mag, is de vraag)’

MPs Romke de Jong and Podt asked the Minister of Interior about a report that a candidate for Dutch citizenship wanted to take the oath in Frisian, and whether the Frisian Language Use Act allows this in all cases. The minister confirmed the Act permits swearing in Frisian, acknowledged implementation gaps, and committed to clarifying the rules to Frisian municipalities by letter.

Therefore I will, ahead of the new administrative agreement on Frisian language and culture, clarify in a letter to the Frisian municipalities in the short term how the Frisian Language Use Act applies to taking an oath, declaration or pledge.

Daarom zal ik, vooruitlopend op de nieuwe Bestuursafspraak Friese taal en cultuur, op korte termijn per brief aan de Friese gemeenten de toepassing van de Wet gebruik Friese taal bij het afleggen van een eed, verklaring of belofte verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijkheid dat de Nederlandse overheid toegang heeft of had tot portals voor het aangeven van desinformatie bij sociale media

Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch government, including ministries, intelligence services, police, regulators and other bodies, has or had access to platform portals for reporting disinformation or other content on social media, and what that access was used for. The government answered that the ministry of BZK holds trusted flagger status at several platforms, used only sparingly around elections, along with several regulators and the police for illegal or harmful content, and that intelligence services will not comment; it could not answer all questions within the deadline and withheld some operational guidance.
Through these channels the Ministry of BZK has no power to compel these companies to remove certain content or take other actions.
Het Ministerie van BZK heeft via deze kanalen geen bevoegdheid deze bedrijven te dwingen bepaalde content te laten verwijderen of andere acties te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de overheid die burgers monitort via sociale media

MP Leijten asks on what legal basis ministries, the Tax Authority and the Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority store and process public social media posts, and why this differs from the NCTV practice the cabinet found unlawful, plus questions on transparency, sharing, use in policy and oversight. The State Secretary says such monitoring needs a legal ground under the GDPR and that a DPIA will be requested to map the practice, while acknowledging the need for transparency, limits on data, and oversight by the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Because several government bodies are involved, I intend to ask my colleagues to map the use of social media monitoring through a DPIA.

Omdat het hier gaat om verschillende overheidsinstanties, ben ik voornemens om mijn collega’s te verzoeken het gebruik van sociale media monitoring in kaart te laten te brengen door middel van een DPIA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de racistische leuzen op de Erasmusbrug

An MP asked the Justice and Interior Ministers about racist slogans projected on the Erasmus Bridge during New Year's Eve, whether the government condemns them, whether further actions are planned, whether a criminal investigation will conclude soon, how to protect vulnerable youth, and how to coordinate with other countries. The government condemned the expressions, said a criminal investigation by the OM and police is ongoing and it cannot comment on it, described planned measures against radicalisation and online extremism, and referred to existing and forthcoming policy documents.
We cannot make further statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen wij geen verdere uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Strolenberg over ‘een centraal digitaal en openbaar register van alle personen in Nederland die een koninklijke onderscheidingen hebben gekregen’

MP Strolenberg asked why there is no central, digital, public register of all Dutch royal decoration recipients, and whether privacy law or other rules block one. The minister answered that a central register exists but is held by the Chancellery and is not public, as it contains privacy-sensitive data and designating a public register requires a formal law, and that there is no current need or occasion to create a public register.
It is not a public register and is also unsuitable for such use.
Een openbaar register is dit niet en voor een dergelijk gebruik ook ongeschikt.
Antwoord op het lid Van Haga  over 'opruiend gedrag van een GroenLinks Statenlid te Groningen'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether a GroenLinks provincial councillor in Groningen incited hatred by framing right-wing politicians as populists in a speech in the provincial hall, whether the provincial executive and the commissaris van de Koning should have intervened, and whether the minister would act. The minister answered that robust debate is inherent to democracy, that the chair (commissaris van de Koning) and fellow members can address overstepping of the rules of order, that no criminal complaint or investigation for incitement is known, and that the chair is accountable to the provincial council.
The provincial council holds the commissaris van de Koning to account for his conduct as chair during or around the debate and during periodic consultation meetings.
Provinciale staten spreekt de commissaris van de Koning aan op zijn handelen als voorzitter tijdens of rondom het debat en tijdens periodieke klankbordgesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het artikel 'Nieuwe app Forum lek: privégegevens alle 92.000 (oud-)leden op straat'

An MP asked the government about a reported data leak from the Forum party app exposing personal data of 92,000 current and former members, and about party member data handling, retention, oversight and subsidy use. The minister answered that parties may process member data under the UAVG with safeguards, that the Data Protection Authority decides compliance and will not comment on individual cases, and that the Wfpp requires an accountant's check of member counts, while a Wet op de politieke partijen is in consultation.
When asked, the AP indicated it does not wish to make statements about individual reports and cases in the context of any investigation.
Desgevraagd heeft de AP laten weten dat zij geen uitspraken wenst te doen over individuele meldingen en zaken in het kader van eventueel onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de brandbrief van 50 topambtenaren over de verhouding tussen politiek en ambtenarij

An MP asks the Prime Minister whether he regards it as acceptable that a letter from 50 senior civil servants about the politics-civil service relationship reached the press, and asks for examples, the training content, and the letter itself. The government answers that civil servants work under ministerial responsibility and cannot speak publicly on policy, provides the letter, notes the matter was discussed with secretaries-general, and promises continued dialogue but gives no examples.
The letter makes no mention of this training.
In de brief wordt geen melding gemaakt van deze training.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over de rechtsstaat en beloofde verbeteringen na het toeslagenschandaal

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the government about progress on promises made after the childcare benefits scandal, including the eleven 'buikpijn' cases, the implementation of softer legal discretion, the role of inspectorates and ombudsman signals, the Landsadvocaat, and the Ministerial Commission on the childcare benefits recovery. The minister answered that the cases are being pursued by the relevant departments, gave progress updates across the reaction to the 'Ongekend onrecht' report, and said the Landsadvocaat and commission data are not available as overviews, while promising ongoing reporting to parliament.
No overviews are available of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er buitensporig vaak inzage in de persoonsgegevens van slachtoffers van het toeslagenschandaal heeft plaatsgevonden

MP Leijten asked whether police and other authorities queried personal data of victims of the childcare benefits scandal excessively often via the BRP, why, and whether such access is checked or logged. The government answered that police cannot identify victims in their records, that excessiveness cannot be judged generally, that no signals of excessive queries were known beyond the FTM report, and it outlined existing AVG and Wpg accountability and access rules, with logging of police data use (art. 32a Wpg) due to take effect by May 2023.
The police do not know which persons are victims of the childcare benefits affair.
Het is voor de politie niet bekend welke personen gedupeerden van de toeslagenaffaire zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Chris Simons over de vertraging bij de realisatie van het Justitieel Complex Vlissingen

MPs Ellian and Chris Simons asked why the Justitieel Complex Vlissingen (EBI) is delayed to around eight years, whether Zeeland faces abandonment, how to provide high-security cells sooner, and whether tendering can be accelerated. Minister Weerwind answered that the delay is regrettable but the project is not cancelled, that an EBI-plus or mini-EBI is only being studied, and that EU tender rules and a switch to partly secret tendering cause the extra time.
The arrival of the JCV is absolutely not up for discussion.
De komst van het JCV staat absoluut niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het online gebiedsverbod

Two D66 MPs asked the government about Almelo's municipal bylaw banning online posts that could cause physical disruption of public order, including enforcement, constitutional free-speech concerns under Article 7 of the Constitution, and the lack of a promised legal framework for municipal online monitoring. The Justice Minister answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for their bylaws, that enforcement rests with the mayor, that the censorship ban limits municipalities, and that the promised guidance on social media monitoring is delayed to Q1 2023.
I have understanding for the search by municipalities for ways to maintain public order where the cause lies in online conduct.
Ik heb begrip voor de zoektocht van gemeenten naar manieren om de openbare orde te handhaven als de oorzaak is gelegen in online gedragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Michon-Derkzen en Mutluer over ‘Het schrijnende tekort aan forensisch artsen’

MPs asked the ministers about the severe shortage of forensic doctors, including how often shifts went unfilled, whether child abuse evidence was lost, and what structural solutions exist. The government reported recurring unfilled shifts in some regions, no known cases of lost child-abuse evidence, a temporary arrangement through 2023 with a sustainable solution still being developed, and that more funding is still being sought.
This despite many forensic doctors already working more shifts than desired.
Dit ondanks dat veel forensisch artsen al meer diensten draaien dan gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het artikel 'Hoe Thierry Baudet de winst opstrijkt van een uitgeverij die met overheidssubsidie is opgezet'

Two D66 MPs asked the Interior Minister whether Forum voor Democratie used party subsidy to set up the publisher Amsterdam Books, now run by party-linked figures, and whether the subsidy should be stopped or recovered. The minister answered that the Wfpp does not regulate party structure or the conduct of party-linked persons, that the subsidised activities do not cover the BV's founding, and that subsidy would be recovered only if the audited accounts show unlawful spending.
If the process above shows that a political party has spent subsidy unlawfully, this may lead to recovery of the subsidy.
Indien op basis van het hierboven genoemde proces blijkt dat een politieke partij subsidie op onrechtmatige wijze heeft besteed, dan kan dat leiden tot het terugvorderen van de subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Sylvana Simons over het Zwarte Piet-geweld in Staphorst

MPs Klaver and Simons asked the Justice and Interior ministers about violence against anti-Zwarte Piet demonstrators in Staphorst, police preparation and protection, and whether independent inquiries or a demonstration-rights review would follow. The minister condemned the violence, pointed to criminal investigations, a mayoral inquiry and an Inspectorate of Justice and Security inquiry, declined to pre-empt them, and saw no reason to ask the Ombudsman or Safety Board to investigate.
This investigation will in any case focus on the police's performance of duties in preparing for the demonstration, during the confrontation between demonstrators and their attackers, and afterwards.
Dit onderzoek zal in elk geval gericht zijn op de taakuitvoering door de politie bij de voorbereiding op de demonstratie, gedurende de confrontatie tussen demonstranten en hun belagers en daarna.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Dekker-Abdulaziz over Nederlanders in het buitenland die mogen stemmen op het Kiescollege niet-ingezetenen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked about low registration by Dutch citizens abroad for the Kiescollege niet-ingezetenen election and what outreach is planned. The minister reports 23,427 registrations as of 22 December, describes the information campaign and notes that reasons for non-registration will be examined in the evaluation later.
As part of the evaluation of the Kiescollege election, this will be done among voters in the permanent register who have not registered for the Kiescollege election.
In het kader van de evaluatie van de kiescollegeverkiezing zal dit wel worden gedaan onder kiezers in de permante registratie die zich niet voor de kiescollegeverkiezing hebben geregistreerd.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over spionage met gebruik van Pegasus- of vergelijkbare software

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government distinguishes security risks for ministers and senior officials, whether it will raise security measures against spyware such as Pegasus, and how it oversees use of intrusion software. The ministers answered that departments are responsible for their own digital security under the BIO framework, that intrusion software use is subject to legal safeguards and judicial, prosecutorial and intelligence oversight, and that they will not publish which software is used.
To protect means and methods, it is not possible to give public insight into which software the police use when carrying out this power.
Het is voor de afscherming van middelen en methodieken niet mogelijk om openbaar inzicht te geven in welke software de politie gebruikt bij de uitvoering van deze bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Kwint en Van Nispen over de inzet van voorspellende algoritmes met betrekking tot kinderen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether the police would keep using the ProKid Plus algorithm to predict violent crime among children, and about oversight, data, safeguards and links to youth care and the Top400 approach. The minister answered that ProKid Plus was used only once in a 2016 Amsterdam trial, is no longer used, that a new police alerting system (ProKid 23-) is still under legal and ethical assessment, and described existing legal safeguards and oversight, while committing to no new structural rule changes.

The experiences with ProKid Plus underline the importance of good safeguards for the use of algorithms, to which the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations, together with the Minister for Legal Protection, is giving extra attention.

De ervaringen met ProKid Plus onderstrepen het belang van goede waarborgen voor het gebruik van algoritmen, waar de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties in samenwerking met de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming extra aandacht voor heeft.

Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) over de voorbereiding van de Tijdelijke wet onderzoeken AIVD en MIVD naar landen met een offensief cyberprogramma op basis van de eerste Woo-besluiten van de ministeries van

An MP asked the Ministers of Interior and Defence about the preparation of the Temporary Act for AIVD and MIVD investigations into states with offensive cyber programmes, including which MPs were consulted, withheld content in disclosed Woo documents, informal contact with the Council of State, the use of 'white coats' to promote the bill, and the role of the oversight bodies TIB and CTIVD. The Minister answered that consultations were held to gauge support, that redactions reflect personal policy views and confidentiality of drafts, that the bill shifts prior authorisation to ongoing oversight by CTIVD to match cyber practice, and that the oversight bodies were consulted but not on the steering group.
The passages redacted under the Woo in these notes mainly concern the content of the draft bill.
De op basis van de Woo gelakte passages in deze nota’s, betreffen hoofdzakelijk passages over de inhoud van het conceptwetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over het voorafgaand toezicht op televisie-uitzendingen van Ongehoord Nederland

MP Van Meijeren asked whether the NPO may exercise prior review over TV broadcasts, given Article 7 of the Constitution, after refusing Ongehoord Nederland a Zwarte Piet broadcast. The state secretary replied that the NPO is not competent for prior content review, that programme selection is constrained by limited airtime and budget, that the NPO is independent of government, and that objections can be pursued through the ordinary appeal route.
It is not for me to assess the NPO's decision.
Het is niet aan mij om het besluit van de NPO te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de ‘escalatie kanalen’ en het ‘desinformatieteam BZK’ naar aanleiding van een Wob-verzoek

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Interior about the government's 'trusted flagger' escalation channels with Facebook, Google and Twitter, their use, and how the disinformation team distinguishes deliberate from unintentional misleading information. The Minister answered that BZK uses trusted flagger status sparingly around elections, has made few reports, cannot order content removal, does not itself establish intent, and attached the requested correspondence.
The ministry has no authority through these channels to have particular content removed.
Het ministerie heeft via deze kanalen geen bevoegdheid bepaalde content te laten verwijderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Hammelburg inzake het verspreiden van antisemitische complottheorieën in Ahoy

MPs Belhaj and Hammelburg asked whether antisemitic conspiracy theories were voiced at a spiritual event in Rotterdam Ahoy and what the government will do about the spread of such theories and rising antisemitism. The minister says criminal enforcement applies if complaints are filed, that NCTV monitoring of open sources is currently suspended pending legislation, and points to the antisemitism action plan and a planned extremism strategy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Strolenberg en Bevers over het artikel: ‘Rijk trekt zich steeds verder terug uit Friesland, diensten krimpen met tientallen ambtenaren’

MPs Strolenberg and Bevers asked the Minister of the Interior how the reported shrinkage of national government jobs in Friesland fits the goal of spreading public employment evenly across provinces, and what will be done about it. The minister answered that the drop is largely administrative (Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie staff reassigned across provinces), that a motion on fairer distribution is being worked out, and that a guideline will follow later.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over het bericht dat gemeenten duurdere gascontracten moeten sluiten

MPs Inge van Dijk and Bontenbal asked whether Dutch municipalities should be forced to switch away from Gazprom-linked gas contracts, arguing this benefits Russia, and asked about costs and compensation. The minister answered that SEFE (formerly Gazprom Germania) was nationalised so existing contracts can be kept and no exemption is needed, while confirming municipalities will be compensated for extra costs incurred from switching.
That information is not available at my ministry and is commercially confidential, and was therefore also not shared with us by the company or the German government.
Die informatie is bij mijn ministerie niet aanwezig en is commercieel vertrouwelijk en dus ook niet gedeeld met ons door het bedrijf of de Duitse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het artikel dat de inlichtingendiensten AIVD en MIVD journalisten ronselen

An MP asked whether the AIVD and MIVD recruit journalists, both abroad and in the Netherlands, and whether they may pay journalists, provide them information, or give them favours in return. The minister rejected the word 'recruit', said cooperation with sources is voluntary, confirmed the services may approach anyone including journalists and may give background interviews, and said any payment to sources is possible but not aimed at influencing public opinion, with oversight by the CTIVD.
Publicly, I cannot go into the sources and methods of the AIVD and MIVD.
In het openbaar kan ik niet ingaan op de bronnen en werkwijze van de AIVD en de MIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over de naleving van de banenafspraak door het Rijk

The MP De Kort (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about large differences among ministries in meeting the Banenafspraak quota for people with a work disability, the sharing of effective methods, shared responsibility, inclusive employment, monitoring compliance with Social Return contract requirements, the planned network organisation, and accessibility of ICT tools. The minister answered that ministries are responsible for their own quotas, that a central financing arrangement and a Social Return network organisation are planned, that monitoring of contract compliance will be set up as a first action, and that accessibility improvements are underway, with full compliance expected by end 2023.
No monitoring has been set up for compliance with contract requirements.
Voor de naleving van contracteisen is geen monitoring ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Mutluer over schulden bij publieke dienstverleners, waaronder politieagenten en andere ambtenaren

MPs Kuiken and Mutluer asked whether police officers and other civil servants in integrity-sensitive roles are screened for problematic debts, and what is being done given rising energy prices. The ministers confirm debt is a screening criterion for security clearances, describe monitoring of wage garnishments, and list existing support schemes (social funds, financial helplines, occupational social work) across police, central government, Defence and municipalities.
There is no central registration of problematic debts among civil servants as a whole.
Er is geen centrale registratie van problematische schulden onder overheidspersoneel als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Van Baarle over moslimdiscriminatie

MPs Belhaj and Van Baarle asked about a study finding Muslim women wearing headscarves are rejected far more often in job applications in the Netherlands, and about measures against labour market discrimination, including meldplicht and sanctions. The minister acknowledges the findings, outlines ongoing research, the Wetsvoorstel toezicht gelijke kansen, an action plan, and says the meldplicht advice will be sent to parliament by year end.
I aim to share this amendment note with your House shortly (before the end of the year), so that the treatment of this bill can be continued.
Ik streef ernaar deze nota van wijziging op korte termijn (voor het einde van het jaar) met uw Kamer te delen, zodat de behandeling van dit wetsvoorstel vervolgd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Boswijk over het artikel 'Munitie-tekort explodeert: problemen met locaties en vergunningen voor kogelfabrieken'

MPs Valstar and Boswijk asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about Dutch dependence on imported ammunition, the lack of domestic munitions factories, and permitting barriers for new production sites. The government acknowledged the strategic dependence and the value of European cooperation, but said it will not pursue active policy to restart domestic munitions production, that no Defence sites are available, and that the timeline is unknown.
There are no more ammunition factories in the Netherlands. If they were to come, that would be good, but we will not pursue active policy on this.
Er zijn geen munitiefabrieken meer in Nederland. Als die er zouden komen is dat goed, maar we gaan hier geen actief beleid op voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een mislukt ICT-project dat gegund is aan een stichting van een ambtenaar

MP Leijten asked why the Ministry of BZK awarded a failed ICT project to a foundation whose board included civil servants of the same ministry, and about the decision-making, advice, information to parliament and mistakes made. The minister answered at length, acknowledging that the foundation was set up outside the Stichtingenkader procedure, that the award was insufficiently justified and documented, that the appearance of conflict of interest arose, and that parliament was not informed, while promising improvements.
Your House was not informed about the award of the assignment to and the termination of the cooperation with foundation NTF.
Uw Kamer is niet geïnformeerd over de opdrachtverlening aan en het beëindigen van de samenwerking met stichting NTF.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het verstrijken van de termijn om nieuwe informatie aan te leveren aan de GRECO (te weten 30 september 2022) naar aanleiding van de nog niet afgeronde behandeling van de GRECO

An MP asked about the former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen's contacts with the government on energy compensation, the deadline for information to GRECO, and the definition of lobbyist in the lobby register proposal. The government answered that she did not take part in the energy price talks, that the GRECO deadline moved to December 2022, and that a definition of lobbyist requires research by Professor Braun first.
Question 2: Can you send an overview of all contacts (including phone calls) between Ms Van Nieuwenhuizen and Ministers and State Secretaries over the past six months?
Vraag 2 Kunt u een overzicht sturen van alle contacten (inclusief telefoongesprekken) tussen mevrouw Van Nieuwenhuizen en Ministers en Staatssecretarissen van de afgelopen zes maanden?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Sjoerdsma over de Europese Parlementsverkiezingen van 2024 naar aanleiding van het kabinetsstandpunt over het initiatiefvoorstel van het Europees Parlement over de verk

The MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Sjoerdsma asked how many non-Dutch EU residents registered to vote in the 2019 European Parliament elections, how they were informed, whether turnout was evaluated, and about the timeline and direction of the European Electoral Act reform. The Minister answered that 56,637 registered in 2019, that municipalities are legally obliged to inform them, and that the Netherlands does not track their actual turnout, while promising further outreach and noting Council negotiations on the Electoral Act have only just begun.
The Netherlands does not keep track of how many of these persons actually went to vote.
Nederland houdt niet bij hoeveel van deze personen daadwerkelijk zijn gaan stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het bericht 'lucratieve bijverdiensten voor fulltime topbestuurders'

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked whether top executives in the (semi-)public sector who earn above the WNT pay cap through side functions as supervisors should be restricted, and about their workload and transparency. The minister answered that the anti-cumulation rule was deliberately limited to executive posts, that no data on cumulative earnings exist, that a public side-function register would add administrative burden, and that the government will examine tightening the rule within a planned WNT amendment.
As part of the planned WNT amendment that the cabinet recently announced, I am willing to examine the pros and cons of further tightening the anti-cumulation provision.

In het kader van de wetswijziging Wnt die ik namens het kabinet onlangs heb aangekondigd, ben ik wel bereid om nader uit te laten zoeken wat de voor- en tegens zijn van het verder aanscherpen van de anticumulatiebepaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Strolenberg over het artikel 'Crematorium is van het gas af'

Strolenberg (VVD) asked about a news report on gas-free crematoria, the cost and sustainability of alkaline hydrolysis (resomation) as an alternative, and why it is not yet legally recognised or accelerated in the planned Burial Act modernisation bill. The minister said alkaline hydrolysis will be regulated in the bill, now due in the first half of 2024, after the effluent disposal rules are assessed, and that government will not actively promote one form of burial over another.
The bill cannot be submitted before financial decision-making has taken place.
Het wetsvoorstel kan niet worden ingediend voordat financiële besluitvorming heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Vestering en Teunissen over investeringen in de intensieve veehouderij door ABP

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether ABP's investments in intensive livestock farming conflict with animal welfare, climate and Paris goals, and what the government can do to steer the pension fund. The government replied that the ABP board is independently responsible for investment policy, that the government has no formal control over it, and pointed to existing voluntary IMVB and climate commitments with review later.
The cabinet, as one of the sector employers involved with ABP, has no formal means to steer the implementation of the pension scheme.
Het kabinet heeft, als één van de sectorwerkgevers betrokken bij het ABP, geen formele mogelijkheden ter sturing op de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het direct of indirect volgen van politiek geëngageerde burgers op de social media en het mogelijk plegen van censuur

MP Van Haga asked ministers whether government monitors politically engaged citizens on social media, coordinates counter-disinformation with platforms, and whether a police home visit and a later account removal involved state interference. The government answered that platform contacts concern how platforms tackle disinformation with no formal minutes, that no structural policy targets citizens' posts, and that it cannot discuss individual cases such as the Enschede visit.
As indicated in the answer to question 13, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 13 kan er niet worden ingegaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een journalist die jarenlang gevolgd wordt door de AIVD

Opposition MP Leijten asks the Interior Minister whether journalist Stella Braam, followed by the AIVD for decades, can do her work freely, whether such surveillance is standard practice, why she was not informed, and what safeguards apply. The minister answers that surveillance of journalists is exceptional, subject to heightened safeguards (Hague court authorisation, stricter proportionality test, CTIVD oversight), declines to discuss the individual case, and says the AIVD will improve its inzage procedure explanations.
Surveillance of journalists (meaning AIVD investigation using special powers) occurs only in exceptional cases.
Van «volgen» (te weten: het doen van onderzoek door de AIVD met inzet van bijzondere bevoegdheden) van journalisten is slechts in uitzonderlijke gevallen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de langdurige spionage van een journalist door de AIVD

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked the Minister of Interior about reports that the AIVD monitored journalist Stella Braam for 35 years, whether this reflects unlawful data collection, whether the CTIVD should investigate, and how CTIVD recommendations on journalists and lawyers were implemented. The Minister denied a pattern of unlawful conduct, declined to discuss the individual case given ongoing procedures, rejected a CTIVD investigation citing the pending access request and complaint route, described the stricter safeguards for journalists, and referred the question of a broader CTIVD investigation to the independent CTIVD.
There is an ongoing procedure in the context of Ms Braam's access request.
Er is sprake van een lopende procedure in het kader van het inzageverzoek van mevrouw Braam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bewust vertragen van Wob-verzoeken en het betalen van dwangsommen door de regering

MP Omtzigt asked whether Wob freedom-of-information requests are deliberately delayed by ministries, whether courts have imposed penalty payments (dwangsommen) on ministries for missed deadlines, and for the list of cases and the interdepartmental Wob/Woo meeting minutes. The minister admits many statutory deadlines are missed and that over two million euros in penalties were incurred in 2019-2021, cites complexity and backlog as causes, acknowledges one request (datacenter Zeewolde) was deliberately postponed at third-party request, promises improvement measures and minutes, but answers were late and some details were withheld.
I also see that in many cases the statutory deadlines are not met and that the ministries, including my own, are not complying with the law.
Ook ik zie dat in veel gevallen de wettelijke termijnen niet worden gehaald en dat de Ministeries, waaronder mijn eigen Ministerie, zich daarmee niet aan de wet houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over lekkende zorgdata

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the ministers how a commercial software firm could leak medical data of tens of thousands of patients, why warnings from a former employee were not acted on, whether patients and GPs must be informed, and whether additional protections against commercial use of medical data are planned. The government answered that providers are primarily responsible, that the AP supervises GDPR compliance, that it cannot comment on AIVD/MIVD investigations, and that existing rules are sufficient with further awareness and enforcement efforts.
No public statements are made about the working methods and investigations of the AIVD and MIVD.
Over werkwijzen en onderzoeken van de AIVD en MIVD worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel ‘Belangenverstrengeling van Statenleden bij stemmingen over stikstofbeleid’

MPs Sneller and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether provincial councillors working in agriculture who voted on nitrogen policy motions, and sometimes filed motions themselves, breached the conflict-of-interest rule in article 28 of the Provinciewet. The Minister answered that the rule only bars voting where a councillor has a direct personal interest, that no conflict of interest can be concluded from the rules, and that commissioners of the King will be informed.
On the basis of this legal framework, the conclusion cannot be drawn that there would have been a conflict of interest.
Op basis van dit wettelijk kader kan niet de conclusie worden getrokken dat sprake zou zijn geweest van belangenverstrengeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over de Circulaire Samenloop vergoedingen raadsleden met een uitkering en het borgen van inclusiviteit in de lokale democratie

Two CDA MPs asked whether municipal councillors receiving WIA disability benefits must surrender 75% of their council allowance, how this compares with Participatiewet rules, and whether the 2015 circular should be updated to promote inclusiveness in local democracy. The ministers answered that the WIA offset rules apply to council allowances, outline the rules by benefit phase, confirm the circular is substantively correct but needs updating, and point to an action plan and a planned website expansion.

However, it indeed needs to be updated because, for example, the decision on the legal position of council and committee members was replaced by the Decision on the Legal Position of Decentralised Political Office Holders as of 2019.

Zij moet echter inderdaad geactualiseerd worden omdat bijvoorbeeld het rechtspositiebesluit raads- en commissieleden per 2019 is vervangen door het Rechtspositiebesluit decentrale politieke ambtsdragers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Mutluer over mbo-studenten die niet worden toegelaten in Utrechtse cafés, andere uitgaansgelegenheden en sportfaciliteiten

MPs De Hoop and Mutluer asked whether refusing mbo students at Utrecht bars and sports facilities, while admitting university and HBO students, amounts to discrimination and whether it is covered by the constitutional non-discrimination clause. The minister condemned the unequal treatment and noted a conversation with the café owner, but said refusal by level of education is not legally prohibited and falls outside the equal-treatment statutes, relying on moral persuasion and a forthcoming mbo work agenda.
In horizontal legal relationships, meaning relations between citizens, citizens can invoke various equal treatment laws
In horizontale rechtsverhoudingen, waarmee de relatie tussen burgers onderling wordt bedoeld, kunnen burgers wel een beroep doen op verschillende gelijke behandelingswetten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de chanterende commissaris van de Koning in Flevoland

Van Haga asked the Minister of Interior whether the Flevoland Commissioner of the King coerced councillors into accepting an asylum reception centre, including via a suggested link to the Lelylijn, and whether an investigation or dismissal would follow. The Minister answered that the commissioner acted as a state organ in facilitating cooperation, that the concerns reflect subjective experiences, and that no investigation or dismissal is warranted.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het optreden van een CdK als Rijksheer ten behoeve van asielopvang

An MP asked whether the Flevoland commissaris van de Koning acted as a Rijksheer (state officer) rather than as a Rijksorgaan when facilitating asylum reception, and what legal basis applied. The Minister answers that the commissaris acted as Rijksorgaan under article 182 Provinciewet and Ambtsinstructie, without decision-making power, and that terminology has been used loosely but has no consequences for legal validity.
We will bring this to the attention of all those involved, to prevent future confusion.
Wij zullen dit bij alle betrokkenen onder de aandacht brengen, om toekomstige verwarring te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de vergunningverlening aan Chogogo Resort

MP Van Esch asked the ministers about the permitting of Chogogo Dive & Beach Resort on Bonaire, including whether conditions on a seawall were met, the enforcement memo, a fine for unpermitted sand dumping, and oversight of nearby developments. The Staatssecretaris answered that the authority believes the seawall conditions are met and is legalising the existing wall, that the enforcement memo and related documents will be shared, and that enforcement and VTH capacity on Bonaire will be strengthened with a monitoring plan and checks and balances.
I am willing to share all information with the House and am also willing to have it assessed by experts if necessary.
Ik ben bereid om alle informatie met de Kamer te delen en ben ook bereid deze zonodig te laten beoordelen door experts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt inzake Centric en de mogelijkheid en wenselijkheid een enquête te houden

Omtzigt asked whether the government is aware of the resignation of Centric's board after a conflict with its owner, the planned Ondernemingskamer action over mismanagement, and DNB's departure from Centric, and whether there are public-interest grounds for an enquiry (enquête) that the Advocate-General could order. The minister confirms awareness, notes DNB is re-tendering and temporarily continues using Centric, and says the OM has started a preliminary investigation into whether to request an enquiry, without pre-empting its outcome.
The OM was already aware of signals of ongoing unrest within the company and has started a preliminary investigation to assess whether a request will be made to the Enterprise Chamber.

Het OM was al bekend met de signalen over aanhoudende onrust binnen de onderneming en is een verkennend onderzoek gestart teneinde te beoordelen of een verzoek bij de Ondernemingskamer zal worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over signalen dat gemeenten slecht voldoen aan de verplichtingen uit de privacywet

An MP asked the government about signals that municipalities poorly comply with privacy law (AVG) and lack resources for data protection, and what oversight exists. The state secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to a WODC study and a 150 million euro investment, said the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and municipal data protection officers hold supervisory roles, and promised further talks with the VNG and a review of a national register for data protection officers.
The cabinet does not supervise compliance with the GDPR at municipalities.
Het kabinet houdt geen toezicht op de naleving van de AVG bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de verschillen in handhaving bij boerenprotesten en klimaatdemonstraties

An MP asked whether police enforcement differed between farmer protests and climate demonstrations and whether this unequal treatment is desirable. The Minister acknowledged differences but argued circumstances differ, that the law applies equally, and that enforcement is a local matter, offering statistics on fines and arrests without committing to new action.
It is indeed not for me as Minister to step into the responsibility of local authorities.
Het is inderdaad niet aan mij als Minister om in de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de Kamerbrief Versterking VTH-stelsel.

An MP asked why the interbestuurlijk programma VTH (IBP VTH) was sent to the Chamber late, why environmental service boundaries are not aligned with safety regions, and how the Van Aartsen recommendations on environmental crime, enforcement capacity, uniform enforcement policy and independence of enforcement bodies are being followed up. The government answered that the programme was delayed by the pre-recess workload, that alignment with safety regions is a stated aim being examined under pillar 1, and that the recommendations are being worked out in pillars 1 to 5 with progress reports twice a year.
As indicated in the programme plan, this recommendation is also being taken up.
Zoals in het programmaplan aangegeven, wordt ook deze aanbeveling opgepakt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het vervallen van de Tijdelijke wet digitale beraadslaging en besluitvorming provincies, gemeenten, waterschappen en openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint-Eustatius en Saba

An MP asked why the temporary law allowing digital deliberation and decision-making by local and provincial councils lapsed on 1 July 2022 despite rising COVID cases, and what problems local councils face. The minister answered that the law was not extended after parliamentary committee advice, that no major problems have been reported, that councils have fallback options within the current law, and that a new temporary law or permanent regulation will be introduced if needed.
If the health situation requires it, a new Temporary Act will be initiated so that decentralised representative bodies can meet digitally in a safe manner.
Indien de gezondheidssituatie daarom vraagt, zal een nieuwe Tijdelijke wet in procedure worden gebracht, zodat decentrale volksvertegenwoordigingen op een veilige wijze digitaal kunnen vergaderen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuishouding

An MP (Leijten, SP) asked the Minister of Interior about measures at her ministry after the childcare benefits scandal regarding hardship rules and information management, including investigations into harsh regulations, a baseline measurement for information management, the EUR 780 million budget, and chat message retention. The minister answered that each department is conducting inventories of harsh rules, that the Open op Orde programme and a regeringscommissaris Informatiehuishouding are in place, and that the departmental action plans and baseline measurements will be sent to the House, with promises of further updates after the summer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het toenemende gebruik van Signal onder bewindspersonen en het verwijderen van berichten door de minister-president

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the growing use of Signal by ministers, the deletion of messages by the Prime Minister, and whether this complied with government records policy and Council of State case law. The minister answered that the Prime Minister followed the government-wide policy that only messages on administrative decision-making not otherwise recorded must be kept, that an Inspectorate investigation into archiving at the Ministry of General Affairs is ongoing with results expected 1 October 2022, and that providers do not retain deleted messages.
There was coordination over which department would take on the answer. On the substantive answer there was no coordination between the Ministry of BZK and the Ministry of General Affairs.

Er heeft afstemming plaatsgevonden over welk departement de beantwoording op zich neemt. Over de inhoudelijke beantwoording heeft geen afstemming plaatsgevonden tussen het Ministerie van BZK en het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het nieuwsbericht 'Faillissement door verkoopverbod tabak? Lobby klopte cijfers op'

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked about a news report that a tobacco-sales-ban impact study commissioned by the government, by SEO Economisch Onderzoek, overstated bankruptcy risk under lobby pressure, and asked how commissioned research is checked for representativeness, objectivity, lobbying influence and Framework Convention compliance. The State Secretary answers that existing codes (ARVODI, ALLEA, GIR) provide sufficient safeguards, that the research design was approved by VWS and adjusted after supermarkets refused cooperation, that the government does not deem Article 5.3 FCTC breached, and that a lobby register and a new ministers' code will be pursued.
The cabinet will ask a professor with expertise in interest representation and political decision-making for advice on a lobby register, and report on it in autumn 2022.
Het kabinet zal een hoogleraar met expertise op het gebied van belangenbehartiging en politieke besluitvorming vragen om advies over een lobbyregister, en hierover najaar 2022 nader berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over het artikel 'Op de banenmarkt van Schiphol voelen werkzoekenden zich ‘heel speciaal’ – mits ze uit Nederland komen'
