MPs from D66 asked the ministers whether the government shares a newspaper's claim that only people resident in the Netherlands for eight years can obtain a security clearance (VGB) for Schiphol jobs, and how employers' misconceptions could be addressed. The minister denies any legal eight-year rule, explains that the Wvo has no nationality or residence requirement but foreign stays can lengthen screening, and promises to raise the issue with Schiphol and employers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het artikel ‘Kabinet mist kans echt transparant te zijn bij het ultieme lobby-evenement’

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked why not all ministers' agendas from the World Economic Forum were made public and requested full disclosure of meetings with persons and organisations. The government replied that the programmes of the ministers attending the 2022 annual meeting are now public and are attached to the answers.
The programmes of the ministers during the 2022 annual meeting are now public.
De programma’s van de bewindspersonen tijdens de jaarvergadering van 2022 zijn inmiddels openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over woonwagenbewoners die op zwarte lijsten staan bij gemeenten

MP Van Baarle asked whether Dutch municipalities place caravan dwellers (woonwagenbewoners) on 'black lists' under an anti-undermining (ondermijning) checklist, and whether this constitutes ethnic profiling and stigmatisation. The Minister acknowledges the checklist wrongly names caravan dwellers as a group, commits to asking the Justice Ministry to amend it against the Human Rights College framework, and says the government is coordinating an investigation into discriminatory risk models.
That caravan dwellers are named as a specific group on the checklist is incorrect. The Minister of Justice and Security will request that the checklist be adjusted on this point.
Dat woonwagenbewoners als specifieke groep worden genoemd op de checklist is onjuist. De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zal verzoeken de checklist op dit punt aan te laten passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het stemmen voor mensen met een beperking

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of the Interior about voting barriers for people with disabilities, including unclear rules on assistance in the polling booth and proxy voting. The minister acknowledged the importance of independent voting, said rules are clear but not always applied well by polling staff, and promised a pilot law on assistance in the booth with a letter to parliament by year-end.
I am committed to keeping attention on this issue.
Ik zet mij er voor in hier aandacht voor te houden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Poetin noopt de RUG tot uitbreiden blended onderwijs'

An MP asked whether the government is concerned that a university's expansion of blended online teaching, driven by rising energy prices, undermines in-person education, and what support and sustainability policy applies to education buildings. The minister replied that institutions themselves are responsible for their teaching vision, that compensation via energy tax and price indexation is available, and outlined the sustainability roadmaps and building rules without committing to new funding or changes.
Educational institutions are themselves responsible for their educational vision and quality.
Onderwijsinstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de onderwijsvisie en -kwaliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het verschijnen van de Annual Review of the Human Rights Situation of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex People covering events that occurred in Europe and Central Asi

An MP from Volt asked several ministers about the ILGA Europe 2021 review of LGBTI rights, including Dutch LGBTI conditions, asylum treatment of transgender applicants, violence, intersex surgery, transit leave and bi+ visibility. The government broadly recognises the report's account of the Netherlands, declines to assess other states' asylum procedures, and outlines ongoing measures and studies while promising letters on several items later.
The cabinet considers it too early to anticipate the outcomes of these processes.
Het kabinet vindt het te vroeg om op de uitkomsten van deze trajecten vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het jaarverslag van de AIVD

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Interior about the AIVD 2021 annual report, questioning its focus on right-wing over left-wing extremism, its definitions and evidence for 'anti-government extremists' and disinformation, and whether an arts-spitting remark was 'hostile thinking'. The Minister answered that all extremism is a threat, right-wing extremism shows growth, the AIVD does not publicly discuss specific complot theories or actors, and the AIVD's mandate and public reporting are explained.
The AIVD does not make statements about this in public.
De AIVD doet hier in het openbaar geen uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Leijten over discriminatie en racisme bij politie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten (SP) asked the Justice and Interior ministers about discrimination and racism within the police, following a documentary in which police officers said they would not return to the force. The minister acknowledged the problem, described a new police leadership statement, a national coordinator for combating racism, and a planned tiered sanctions regime, but declined to set a firm timeline and gave limited concrete figures.
I will inform your House as soon as possible about the elaboration of this.
Over de uitwerking hiervan zal ik uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het intimideren van kritische ambtenaren van BZK

An MP asked whether BZK staff critical of the Omgevingswet were pressured or intimidated, and whether officials feel free to dissent. The minister acknowledged signals of pressure on staff, said four people had come forward and a complaint is being examined, but denied knowing of such signals within BZK and could not rule out intimidation of dissenting officials.
In addition, in response to the signals received, the secretary-general is holding discussions within the organisation on conduct and the limits of integrity-compliant escalation behaviour.
Daarnaast voert de secretaris-generaal naar aanleiding van de ontvangen signalen binnen de organisatie het gesprek over omgangsvormen en de grenzen van integer escalatiegedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Sjoerdsma en Dassen over de gele kaart procedure met betrekking tot de Europese kiesakte.

MPs asked whether the eight-week yellow card deadline for the European electoral act started from the Commission's publication date (3 May 2022), which would have expired before the 5 July vote on the motion. The minister answered that the period runs from the date the proposal was transmitted to national parliaments, which was 19 May 2022, so the deadline runs until 14 July and has not expired.
This means that the period within which each of the Chambers could issue a yellow card will expire on 14 July 2022 and therefore has not already expired on 28 June.
Dit betekent dat de termijn waarbinnen elk van de Kamers een gele kaart zou kunnen trekken op 14 juli 2022 zal verlopen en dus niet reeds op 28 juni is verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over de huisvesting van onderwijsexpertisecentrum De Berkenschutse

An MP asks whether municipality Heeze-Leende can finance new premises for the special-education centre De Berkenschutse, and whether small municipalities generally can fund school buildings with regional functions. The minister answers that municipalities are responsible for school housing, funded via the general fund without earmarking, that the Education Expertise Centres Act offers no room for school boards to co-finance, and that ministry officials will visit the school on 1 July 2022 and report after the summer.
It is the responsibility of the municipality to provide suitable housing for the school that meets the legal requirements, as set out in the Building Decree.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente te voorzien in passende huisvesting van de school, die voldoet aan de wettelijke vereisten, zoals opgenomen in het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Strolenberg, Sjoerdsma en Sneller over de mogelijkheid tot online stemmen voor Nederlanders in het buitenland

Four MPs from VVD and D66 asked whether Dutch citizens abroad could be allowed to vote online, citing France's online voting for expats. The Minister of Interior replied that internet voting is rejected because it creates cyber risks to secrecy, freedom, and integrity of elections, that no steps are planned, and that no new study will be commissioned.
Introducing internet voting makes the electoral process vulnerable to cyber risks that put these safeguards at risk, such as ballot secrecy, freedom of voting and integrity.
Het introduceren van internetstemmen maakt het verkiezingsproces kwetsbaar voor cyberrisico's waarbij er risico's zijn voor deze waarborgen, zoals het stemgeheim, de stemvrijheid en de integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘plezierhuwelijken’

An MP asked whether the minister knows of reports that a Hague mosque would cooperate in short-term forced marriages for sex and money, whether the mosque should be closed immediately, and whether research into so-called pleasure marriages will be commissioned. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that forced marriage and unlawful religious marriage without a civil marriage are criminal, declined immediate closure, and said no signals of such marriages in the Netherlands justify a study.
At this moment the state sees no reason to have the mosque closed immediately.
Op dit moment ziet het Rijk geen aanleiding om de moskee per direct te laten sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de uitzending van Kassa over digitale toegankelijkheid en verdere verantwoordelijkheden rond een toegankelijke samenleving13-6-2022

MP Werner (CDA) asked the ministers about a Kassa broadcast on the digital inaccessibility of government websites and apps, the widening digital divide, enforcement of the 2018 accessibility decision, ministerial responsibility for an accessible society, support for businesses, and whether a government accessibility commissioner should be appointed. The minister acknowledges persistent accessibility problems, describes a step-by-step plan with strengthened supervision and an accessibility facilitator, but declines to appoint a separate commissioner.
To ensure that improvement measures actually lead to better accessibility, not only extra support is offered to government organisations, but supervision of compliance is also strengthened.

Om te waarborgen dat verbetermaatregelen daadwerkelijk leiden tot betere toegankelijkheid wordt niet alleen extra ondersteuning geboden aan overheidsorganisaties, maar ook het toezicht op de naleving versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over een klokkenluidersmelding bij de publieke omroep

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked about the handling of a whistleblower report at the public broadcaster and the applicable procedures, including whether the report was treated as a whistleblower report and what rights the whistleblower has. The State Secretary answered that the Auditdienst Rijk is investigating the facts and declined to pre-empt the outcome, while describing the applicable procedures and complaint routes (ombudsman, Huis voor klokkenluiders) and refusing to give a timeline or the number of reports.
The factual course of events surrounding this report is being investigated by the ADR, as stated in my answer to question 3.
Naar de feitelijke gang van zaken rond deze melding wordt door de ADR onderzoek gedaan, zoals gemeld in mijn antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de behandeling van een klokkenluider door een topambtenaar bij het ministerie van OCW

An MP asked the government about how a senior civil servant at OCW handled a whistleblower's report on alleged abuses at the NPO, including a 2020 meeting arranged via MPs and claims about personal ties to the NPO chair. The state secretary answered that the Auditdienst Rijk is investigating the facts and declined to pre-empt its findings, while promising to inform parliament once the investigation is complete.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over de beloning van topinkomens

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about top-income rules under the WNT: how many executives and supervisors fall under it, whether they exceed the cap, how enforcement works, and whether accountants' fees and supervisory pay are adequately controlled. The government answered that the WNT is broadly effective, that some overruns persist and are enforced through reclaim and penalties, and that a limited amendment to simplify the act is being prepared.
Following the evaluation, a limited amendment of the WNT is being prepared, and the House of Representatives will receive a letter on it shortly.
Naar aanleiding van de evaluatie wordt een beperkte wetswijziging van de WNT voorbereid, op korte termijn ontvangt de Tweede Kamer daarover een brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over bedreigingen aan het adres van Lale Gül

An MP asked the government about threats against writer Lale Gül, whether she is considering leaving the country, what protects writers from threats, and what is being done about rising Jewish emigration due to threats. The minister called threats to freedom of expression unacceptable, said the state pays for government-imposed protection measures, declined to comment on specific security matters, and pointed to the national antisemitism coordinator and funding for anti-antisemitism projects.
I cannot make statements about specific security matters.
Over specifieke veiligheidsaangelegenheden kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Strolenberg over het artikel in Binnenlands Bestuur 'Beschouw de burger als volwaardige gesprekspartner'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about citizen assemblies (burgerfora) and how to involve citizens in major policy choices, including lessons from the Brenninkmeijer report and foreign experience. The Minister agreed citizen involvement should grow, described the planned law on participation at local level, and said citizen assemblies are a useful supplement to representative democracy under set conditions, with further steps to follow.
I am working on the bill strengthening participation at the decentralised level.
Ik werk aan het wetsvoorstel Versterking participatie op decentraal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het ethisch profileren bij de IND bij 'erkend referenten'

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked why the IND's risk model for recognised sponsors (erkend referenten), which registered company board composition and reportedly profiled by origin, was stopped without public notice, whether other ministries were informed, and whether risk profiling by government should be halted. The government replied that the model had no consequences for decisions, that the board-composition indicator was never used in scoring but was wrongly registered, that it acknowledged an unheeded 2017 legal warning, and that it will inform the House before the summer recess on the results of the Motion#21 investigation into discriminatory risk models.
I regret that an internal memo from the IND's Legal Affairs department, which in 2017 advised stopping the risk model, was not acted on more quickly.
Ik betreur dat er niet sneller opvolging is gegeven aan een interne notitie van de afdeling Juridische Zaken van de IND, die in 2017 adviseerde met het risicomodel te stoppen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over risicoprofilering door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND)

MP Mutluer asked the government about the IND's risk model for recognised sponsors, which since 2014 recorded the ethnic background of company boards and continued until May 2021 despite internal warnings. The State Secretary admitted the registration should not have happened, said it had no effect on decisions, and announced a new risk model under review by TNO.
I want to state at the outset that registering the origin of the company board should not have happened.
Ik wil voorop stellen dat het registreren van de afkomst van het bedrijfsbestuur niet had mogen gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de uitgaven ten aanzien van discriminatiebestrijding

The MP asks the Minister of Interior how the structural 12 million euros for anti-discrimination efforts is spent, whether there are funds for new policy, and how the national programme is financed. The Minister provides a breakdown table, says the national programme will come with a letter with financial accountability, and states that new plans must be financed or they remain plans.
In the accompanying letter I will address the request made in the motion Van Baarle/Simons
In de begeleidende brief zal ik in gaan op het verzoek dat gedaan is in de motie-van Baarle/Simons
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het gebruik van hacksoftware, zoals Pegasus, in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked about Dutch use of hacking software such as Pegasus, including purchases, users, offences, targets, supplier screening, statistics, and the Wet CCIII evaluation. The government answered that police buy commercial intrusion software under judicial authorization, that operational details and expenditures cannot be disclosed for protection of methods, and that the Wet CCIII evaluation is delayed and expected after summer 2022.

Providing third parties with information on which specific software the police hold and use for this special investigative power entails unacceptable risks for the usability of those means and thereby for the investigative interest.

Het verstrekken van informatie aan derden over welke specifieke software de politie beschikt en gebruikt bij de inzet van deze bijzondere opsporingsbevoegdheid, brengt onaanvaardbare risico’s met zich mee voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen en daarmee het opsporingsbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over dienstauto’s

An MP asks the Interior Minister why the government's civil vehicle fleet will not be fully zero-emission until 2028 and whether comfort concerns justify the delay. The minister defends the 2028 target as a large operation, notes 18% of the civil fleet is zero-emission, and promises to ask colleagues to apply a 'zero-emission unless' principle to new service cars.

To give fresh impetus to the chosen path toward a fully zero-emission civil government fleet by 2028, I will ask my ministerial colleagues to apply the 'zero-emission unless' principle, insofar as this is not already happening, when purchasing new service cars.

Om de ingeslagen weg naar uiteindelijk een zero-emissie civiel Rijkswagenpark in 2028 een impuls te geven, zal ik mijn collega-bewindspersonen vragen het «zero-emissie, tenzij» principe – voor zover dit niet al gebeurt – bij de aanschaf van nieuwe dienstauto’s te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over dienstauto’s, in aanvulling op eerdere vragen over hetzelfde onderwerp van het lid Van Raan

MP Van Raan asked the Minister of the Interior about delayed answers to earlier questions on ministerial service cars, why ministers do not switch to zero-emission vehicles, and the broken charging points at the temporary Tweede Kamer building. The minister answered that the delay was due to staff shortages, that security requirements can override zero-emission driving, that charging points at government buildings are about half built, and that the broken chargers will be replaced before the summer recess.
My starting point is that I always answer your questions on time or send a postponement letter if more time is needed to answer.
Mijn uitgangspunt is dat ik uw vragen altijd tijdig beantwoord of een uitstelbrief stuur indien meer tijd nodig is voor beantwoording.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het opstappen van een raadslid vanwege ‘doodsbedreigingen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a municipal councillor's resignation over death threats would be investigated and whether the mayor's reaction would be addressed. The minister answered that every representative must be able to work safely, that the municipality itself is responsible and could call on the Commissioner of the King, that it is not for the minister to judge the mayor's wording, and that the public prosecutor is reportedly already investigating.
The municipality is itself responsible here and could, if asked, appeal to the Commissioner of the King (as a national body).
De gemeente is hier zelf aan zet en zou desgevraagd een beroep op de commissaris van de Koning (als rijksorgaan) kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld over het bericht 'Nationaal Coördinator tegen Racisme: 'Stop met solliciteren voor stageplek''

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Education minister how the government views the call to have schools arrange internships to combat internship discrimination, and about direct placement pilots and their effects. The minister says stage discrimination must be tackled, points to a revised mbo approach due after summer and ongoing research on matching, but states that no study yet specifically examines direct placement and that effects on workload are not being mapped.
Depending on the outcomes, I will consider whether follow-up research into the effects of direct placement is desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten bekijk ik of een vervolgonderzoek naar de effecten van direct placement wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Azarkan en Omtzigt over recente nihilstellingen in de kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Leijten, Azarkan and Omtzigt asked about recent nihilstellingen (zeroing-out of childcare allowance) for 2020/2021, including how the process, notification, reasons, objection and repayment are handled after the Ongekend Onrecht report. The State Secretary answered that about 4,500 2020 cases were zeroed out, described new procedural safeguards, admitted decisions do not yet state reasons in the formal beschikking, and promised improvements without firm dates.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het toevoegen van de 'koloniale oorlog in Indonesië' aan Dodenherdenking

An MP asked whether the government would press the National Committee for 4 and 5 May to remove the added reference to the 'colonial war in Indonesia' from the Remembrance Day text, arguing it wrongly includes Indonesian combatants and undermines the national character of the commemoration. The minister answered that the National Committee is an independent body, that the change names all Dutch and Indonesian victims in line with government terminology, and that there is no reason to press for reversal.
The National Committee 4 and 5 May is an independent organisation that independently decides how the commemoration on 4 May is shaped.
Het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei (NC) is een onafhankelijke organisatie die zelfstandig besluit over de wijze waarop de herdenking op 4 mei wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Erdogans Trolle Schwören sich auf Wahlkampf ein'

MPs Becker and Rajkowski asked the government about reports that Turkish influencers and trolls target Turkish-Dutch and German voters ahead of Turkey's 2023 elections, and whether this interference happens in the Netherlands, along with related questions on counter-strategies, UETD training of candidates, campaign rules and social media regulation. The government condemned unwanted foreign interference, said it has no signals that Turkey is interfering in the 2023 elections, pointed to its existing counter-interference approach, support for municipalities and the Digital Services Act, and did not provide figures on UETD-trained candidates.
These figures are not known to the central government.
Deze cijfers zijn niet bekend bij de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Boulakjar over de situatie rondom de Regeling Huisvesting Aandachtsgroepen

Two D66 MPs asked the housing minister why funds under the Regeling huisvesting aandachtsgroepen remained unspent, whether legal deadlines and start-date rules hinder realisation, and what the Ukraine crisis changes for municipalities. The minister answered that nearly all applications were granted, that a mid-term evaluation and 2021 accountability are pending, that deadlines are meant to ensure timely delivery, and that no formal signals of spending problems or financial strain have been received.
At the end of June I will share the outcomes of an interim evaluation of this scheme with you by letter.
Eind juni zal ik per brief de uitkomsten van een tussenevaluatie op deze regeling met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'The Rights Forum legt absurde eis op tafel'

An SGP MP asked ministers whether a Woo/Wob information request by The Rights Forum, which covered Israeli universities and institutions, could amount to antisemitism and whether institutions can refuse it or be protected from its burden and insecurity. The minister answered that the request is a legitimate Woo request to be assessed by each institution's board under the law's exemptions, such as privacy, while offering the IHRA definition as an aid and noting contact with Universiteiten van Nederland.
It is up to the institution's governing board to further handle this request along the lines of the law.
Het is aan het instellingsbestuur van de universiteit dit verzoek langs de lijnen van de wet verder te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over grootschalige kabelinterceptie door AIVD/MIVD

An MP asked whether intelligence services could use cable interception to tap communications at neighbourhood or national level and whether this breached proportionality and the Wiv 2017 intent; the ministers answered that such regional or national bulk tapping is not technically possible or practised, that cable interception is always targeted via research assignments, and that additional safeguards and independent TIB review apply. The answers also point to a forthcoming temporary law and enhanced CTIVD oversight.
The AIVD and MIVD do not use research-assignment-based interception on the cable to tap neighbourhoods or regions in the Netherlands.
De AIVD en MIVD zetten onderzoeksopdrachtgerichte interceptie (hierna: OOG-interceptie) op de kabel niet in op het aftappen van wijken of regio's in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van Ginneken over het gebruik van omstreden Chinese bewakingscamera’s door de Nederlandse overheid en politie

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Van Ginneken asked the ministers whether the Dutch government and police use Chinese surveillance cameras (Hikvision, Dahua), what security risks this poses, and what will be done. The government confirmed use of Chinese cameras, stated that national security is weighed in procurement case by case, announced a study into camera risks within central government, but said the police will keep using Dahua cameras and no central overview exists.
For this reason there is no central overview available of Chinese cameras in use by the government, the risks associated with them, or the considerations behind their purchase.

Daarom is er geen centraal overzicht beschikbaar van Chinese camera’s in gebruik bij de overheid en eventuele risico’s die daarmee verbonden zijn en ook niet van de afwegingen die ten grondslag lagen bij de aankoop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Recordaantal klachten en vragen over discriminatie in 2021'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about a report that discrimination complaints in 2021 were at a record high, mostly concerning disability and chronic illness, and about accessibility, measures under the UN Disability Convention, and the effects of COVID-19. The ministers answered that accessibility remains a matter of awareness, that 88% of respondents complied with rulings, that a 2022 policy approach continues implementation, and that they will continue inclusion efforts and housing and labour market initiatives.
88% of the respondent parties found to be in violation were willing to take measures following a ruling finding a breach of equal treatment legislation.

88% van de in het ongelijk gestelde verwerende partijen waren bereid om maatregelen te treffen naar aanleiding van een uitspraak waarin tot schending van de gelijke behandelingswetgeving werd geoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over dwang richting gemeenten om asielzoekers op te vangen

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the government whether there is an asylum crisis, why it previously denied one, and what legal basis exists to force municipalities to provide asylum reception, including the role of safety-region chairs and the Rotterdam letter. The state secretary answered that a crisis exists only for Ukrainian displaced persons, that no binding legal instrument currently compels municipalities on asylum reception, and that the government will explore one and avoid the term 'aanwijzing' in future.
A study is currently underway into the possibilities of arriving at a binding legal instrument to realise asylum reception.
Momenteel vindt een verkenning plaats naar de mogelijkheden om tot een dwingend juridisch instrumentarium te komen om asielopvang te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het kapotmaken van een klokkenluider

An MP asked the Interior Minister how the government judges the municipality of Lopik's treatment of a whistleblower, including alleged favouritism in tenders, staff emails discussing ways to damage him, and whether the council should be placed under supervision or its leadership suspended. The minister declined substantive comment because court and criminal proceedings are ongoing, pointed to existing whistleblower protections and the Huis voor klokkenluiders, and said the commissioner of the King could act on integrity concerns.
For that reason I cannot respond substantively to this matter at this time.
Om die reden kan ik nu niet inhoudelijk reageren op deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten 'Waarom een moslimpoliticus de eed niet mag wijzigen' en 'Eed aan Allah door raadslid niet geldig'

MP Bisschop asked whether oaths by political office holders must follow the prescribed formula and how the government will ensure chairs and clerks know and apply the rules, and whether invalid oaths affect council decisions. The minister answered that the statutory oath wording must always be used, that invalid oaths make councillors unable to take part in decisions which can be challenged, and that chairs and clerks will be reminded at elections and the answers sent to municipal and provincial associations.

Since the oath or promise under article 14 of the Municipalities Act is a constitutive requirement for councillors to perform their function, a defect in taking it means the person concerned cannot validly take part in deliberation and decision-making.

Aangezien de eed of belofte ingevolge artikel 14 Gemeentewet een constitutief vereiste is voor raadsleden om hun functie te kunnen uitoefenen, leidt een gebrek bij het afleggen hiervan ertoe dat de persoon in kwestie niet geldig kan deelnemen aan de beraadslaging en besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het buitensluiten van de partij Richard de Mos

MPs Van Haga asked whether the prolonged criminal investigation into Richard de Mos's party, and its exclusion from coalition talks in The Hague, undermines rule of law and public trust, and whether the government will urge the Public Prosecution Service to speed up or drop the case. The minister replied that coalition choices are for the parties and that the OM acts independently, so the government will not press for speed or dismissal of an individual case.
The OM makes these decisions without political interference, as is proper in a state governed by the rule of law.
Het OM neemt deze beslissingen zonder politieke inmenging, zoals dat hoort in een rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over een oud-bewindspersoon die lobbyt bij het ministerie

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked why a former minister working for a lobbying firm was given access to the Ministry of Defence, whether this creates conflict of interest, and whether a network-scan and cross-government checks on part-time lobbyists will be carried out. The government answered that access is limited to needed areas, that the secretary-general restricted his dealings with Defence for a two-year cooling-off period, that a whole-of-government integrity code and an organisation-level scan pilot are in progress, and that case-by-case assessment rules out a blanket check.
It is not the case that someone who has been politically active may under no circumstances have access to a ministry. That must be assessed on an individual case basis.
Het is niet zo dat iemand die politiek actief is geweest in geen geval toegang zou mogen hebben tot een ministerie. Dat dient per individueel geval beoordeeld te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het artikel ‘Lobbyist Jack de Vries heeft toegangspas tot het ministerie van Defensie’

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked about lobbyist Jack de Vries holding a Defence Ministry access pass, the status of a motion for a mandatory lobbying register, and rules on lobbying while employed by a department. The government replied that lobbyists have no free access to ministries, that a code of conduct for ministers is due mid-2022 with the motion taken into account, and that no overview of department staff with lobbying side jobs exists.
Lobbyists as such do not have free access to a ministry, and therefore also not to the Ministry of Defence.
Lobbyisten hebben als zodanig geen vrije toegang tot een ministerie, en dus ook niet tot het Ministerie van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over kosten die de rijksoverheid per jaar uitgeeft aan de inhuur van externe consultants

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior how much central government spent yearly from 2017 to 2021 on hiring external consultants, broken down by five named consultancy firms. The minister reported total external hiring rising from 1.29 to 2.29 billion euros, and per-firm figures for 2017-2020 from spend data, noting 2021 is not yet broken down by firm.
The annual financial reports contain aggregated information and therefore not at supplier level.
De financiële jaarverslagen bevatten geaggregeerde informatie en dus niet op leveranciersniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Datalek gemeente Buren’

An MP asked the Minister about reports that about 130 GB of data, including personal data, from municipalities Buren and Neder-Betuwe was offered on the darkweb after a ransomware attack on Buren, and about notification of affected people, risk of similar attacks, lessons learned and the cyberdefence protocol motion. The state secretary confirmed the breach, said a police report was filed, that affected residents are being informed and that research and an evaluation are pending, and that municipalities are bound by the BIO security baseline without a single national protocol, promising further measures after the findings.
The investigation is in full swing and the results will, the municipality of Buren informs me, be made available in a public report.
Het onderzoek is in volle gang en de resultaten zullen, zo meldt de gemeente Buren mij, in een publiek rapport beschikbaar worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de datahonger van de overheid

The MP Leijten asked how many bodies can access a citizen's BRP personal data, whether access should be restricted, why ministries and police can query family data, and how the SILA's access can persist despite earlier commitments. The Secretary of State answered that access is strictly authorised per user and purpose, that some queries are necessary, that the SILA access will be ended via a forthcoming general administrative order with consent through MijnOverheid, and that uncontrolled logging of purposes is not planned.
It is not possible to estimate the number of users who can query data about an arbitrary citizen, because that would require analysing logging data on search-based disclosures for all citizens.

Het is niet mogelijk een schatting te geven van het aantal gebruikers dat gegevens kan opvragen over een willekeurige burger omdat daarvoor protocolleringsgegevens over verstrekkingen op basis van zoekvragen (ad 1) van (alle) burgers moeten worden geanalyseerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over miljoenentekorten gemeenten door onvoldoende Rijksgelden

Van Haga asks the Interior Minister about municipal deficits from insufficient state funds, including the Frisian lobbying, whether new tasks can be assigned without extra budget, why funding did not rise after 2015 decentralisations, and how citizens will be protected from service cuts and tax increases. The minister says the 2026+ financing system will be reviewed with the associations and a contour note sent before summer, points to coalition-agreement funds and a new allocation model that reportedly leaves no municipality worse off in 2023-2025, promises an implementation test for new tasks, explains that jeugdzorg costs rose beyond projections, and stresses municipal autonomy over budgets.

I therefore intend to set up an implementation test for decentralised governments (udo): an assessment process that makes clearer upfront the effects of new central government policy on sub-national governments.

Ik ben daarom voornemens een uitvoeringstoets decentrale overheden (udo) in te richten: een afwegingsproces dat aan de voorkant beter inzichtelijk maakt wat de effecten voor medeoverheden zijn van nieuw beleid van het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Sylvana Simons  en Arib over de uitkomsten van PwC-onderzoeken naar de Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV)

MPs Koekkoek, Simons and Arib asked the government about PwC findings on the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including use of ethnicity-based risk profiles and whether this amounts to institutional racism. The State Secretary largely declined to characterise the practice as racism, stated that nationality will only be used in supervision with a clear legal basis, promised a compensation scheme and reforms, but deferred many substantive questions on racism and definitions.
I cannot make a general statement about that.
Ik kan daar geen algemene uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Kent en Alkaya over de compensatie voor de gestegen energie- en brandstofprijzen

SP MPs asked why the 120% of social minimum income test for the one-off energy allowance counts the single-parent supplement of the child-related budget as income while excluding the child budget itself, and questioned how income is defined and applied across municipalities. The minister explained that the child budget including the single-parent supplement is excluded from income under the Participatiewet, acknowledged that the concept of income is hard for citizens to grasp, and said municipalities have discretion in specialist assistance while the wage increase was not feasible in time.
For social assistance benefits, a supplement under the child-related budget is a benefit within the meaning of the General Act on Income-Dependent Schemes.
Voor bijstandsuitkeringen geldt dat een toeslag in het kader van het kindgebonden budget een tegemoetkoming is in de zin van de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van Der Molen over het bericht 'Wachttijd voor identiteitsbewijzen loopt op tot maanden'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van Der Molen asked about reported months-long waiting times for passports, ID cards and driving licences, and what causes them. The government answered that waiting times are not centrally tracked, that a sample showed up to 13 weeks with most municipalities offering appointments within two weeks, and pointed to Ukrainian refugee registration, elections and seasonal peaks, while declining to extend document validity beyond legal limits.
It is not centrally tracked what the waiting time is at municipalities.
Er wordt niet centraal bijgehouden wat de wachttijd is bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het benoemen van burgerraadsleden in het algemeen en het wegstemmen van BVNL-burgerraadsleden in de gemeente Haarlemmermeer in het bijzonder

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the Haarlemmermeer council voting down two civic council members nominated by the one-person BVNL faction, and whether this impairs faction representation. The minister answered that the appointment of non-council committee members is a local matter, the commissioner of the King can mediate only in cases of seriously disturbed relations, and no national legal anchoring is currently considered necessary.
The appointment of committee members who are not councillors is a local competence, so in principle it is not for me to comment on the motives.
De benoeming van commissieleden niet zijnde raadslid is een lokale bevoegdheid, daarmee is het in beginsel niet aan mij om in de motieven te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Toezichthouder heeft dubbel gevoel bij reclames WOZ-aanslag’

An MP asked the government about rising WOZ property-valuation objections, the profits and public fees of no-cure-no-pay firms, their success rates versus citizens filing themselves, and the Waarderingskamer's advice. The government confirmed the trends, defended low-threshold legal protection including via no-cure-no-pay firms, and promised its reaction to the report before summer.
Yes, it is important that citizens' legal protection against the determination of the WOZ value is low-threshold.
Ja, het is belangrijk dat de rechtsbescherming van de burger tegen de vaststelling van de WOZ-waarde laagdrempelig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het volgen van politiek geëngageerde burgers op sociale media en het mogelijk plegen van censuur

An MP asks ministers whether the government monitored and pressured politically engaged citizens on social media, including a BVNL board member, and whether this amounted to censorship or coordinated trolling. The government denies targeting individuals, says monitoring tools are used only to gauge public debate, denies censorship and trolling, and states it has no legal basis for requiring platforms to remove disinformation.
This is not correct. The central government does not discredit citizens with critical opinions.
Dit klopt niet. De rijksoverheid brengt burgers met een kritische mening niet in diskrediet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de werking van de Wet normering topinkomens bij goededoelenorganisaties

An MP asked whether fundraising agencies working for charities should be subject to the same top-income cap as the Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) and whether the charity sector should be brought under it. The minister said the sector's own code already ties charity director pay to the WNT norm, that fundraising agencies are commercial firms outside its remit, and that the government does not intend to extend the WNT to the private charity sector.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations does not intend to bring the entire private charity sector and all commercial organisations providing services to the charity sector under the WNT.

De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties is niet voornemens de gehele private goede doelensector en alle commerciële organisaties die diensten verrichten voor de goede doelen sector, onder de werking van de WNT te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het T-rijbewijs in de grensregio

Three CDA MPs asked why T-category agricultural licences are not harmonised in the EU, why Belgian and German T-licences are not recognised in the Netherlands, and what cross-border options exist for residents of the border region. The minister answers that T-licences fall outside EU harmonisation, that mutual recognition is being explored pending a comparative study by CBR, and that residence requirements apply, with several questions answered by cross-reference.
The CBR has been asked to produce a comparative overview of the national examination requirements in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.
Aan het CBR is gevraagd om een vergelijkend overzicht te maken van de nationale exameneisen in Nederland, België en Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over bericht ‘CBS past indeling rond migratie’

An MP asked the government about the CBS's revised classification of migration categories, including its consultation process, participants and whether 'Dutch' should be used. The minister explained the WRR-based rationale, said the ministry is still exploring terminology and declined to disclose CBS's internal deliberations.
I have no insight into CBS's considerations, nor into the precise input of participants.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de afwegingen van het CBS, noch in de precieze input van deelnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het naleven van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en rechterlijke uitspraken

An MP asked ministers why documents on Schiphol aviation safety were withheld despite a court ruling ordering their full disclosure under the Wob. The minister agreed that disclosure should be the norm, but withholds 17 of the 54 documents under the Rijkswet Ovv and EU Regulation 376/2014, and has referred the matter to the Council of State.
I cannot make the 17 documents public because I want to comply with the regulations that protect information from investigations into civil aviation incidents.
Ik kan de 17 documenten niet openbaar maken omdat ik de regelgeving wil naleven die ervoor zorgt dat informatie uit onderzoek naar voorvallen in de burgerluchtvaart wordt beschermd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Leijten over het bericht ‘Maxima als test voor de monarchie’ uit het Algemeen Dagblad van 31 januari 2022 en de documentaire ‘Een Porseleinen Huwelijk van BNNVARA

MPs Sneller and Leijten asked the Prime Minister and ministers about press and documentary reports on the 2001 decision not to prosecute Jorge Zorreguieta, the role of the Prosecution Service, and an intelligence check on him and Edwin de Roy van Zuydewijn without ministers being informed. The government answered in detail on the chain of communication, the BVD check, and safeguards, denying political influence over the prosecution decision and describing the current naslag arrangements.
No indication of political influence on the content of this decision has been found.
Van politieke beïnvloeding van de inhoud van deze beslissing is niet gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Raadsleden worstelen met werkdruk’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about reports that municipal councillors struggle with workload, including whether time spent is the main reason for leaving, the effects of decentralisation and inter-municipal cooperation, and whether the 50% volksvertegenwoordigende norm should be adopted. The Minister acknowledges the time-burden problem, notes that the 2004 Leemhuis report sets no 50% norm, and points to measures on councillor support, training and the rechtspositie of councillors.

Through the implementation of the Van Dijk motion, adopted during the Tweede Kamer's handling of the amendment to the Joint Arrangements Act, the development direction of domestic governance is being discussed with the other tiers of government.

Via de uitvoering van de motie-Van Dijk, aangenomen bij de behandeling van de wijziging van de Wet gemeenschappelijke regelingen in de Tweede Kamer, wordt met medeoverheden gesproken over de ontwikkelrichting van het binnenlands bestuur
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Omtzigt en Klaver over het gebruik van privé berichtenservices en privé mailboxen door bewindspersonen voor hun werk

MPs asked whether ministers' use of private email and messaging apps for government work is covered by the Wob and parliamentary inquiries, and about the Kamp Gmail and Snel phone cases. The government answered that work-related messages on private accounts fall under the Wob and parliamentary inquiry powers, that a ministry review of the VWS/BZK private accounts found no security or archiving risk, and it promised to supply usage overviews for the current and previous cabinets later.

Under Article 6(1) of the Parliamentary Inquiry Act, a parliamentary inquiry committee can demand copies of, access to, or knowledge of work-related documents, regardless of the form of communication used.

Op grond van artikel 6, eerste lid, van de Wet op de Parlementaire enquête kan er door een ingestelde parlementaire commissie een afschrift van, inzage in of kennisneming van werkgerelateerde documenten gevorderd worden, ongeacht de gehanteerde vorm van communicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rol en kosten van samenwerkingsverbanden

An SP MP asks the Interior Minister about the costs, opacity and democratic control of intermunicipal cooperation bodies (gemeenschappelijke regelingen) and their effect on municipal mergers. The minister answers that no national cost figures exist, that municipalities spend about 20% of budgets via such bodies, that democratic control is partly addressed by a pending Wgr amendment and better governance, and that gemeenschappelijke regelingen are extended local government rather than a shadow state.

However, as I argued above, this can to a large extent be mitigated by professional governance of and within cooperation bodies, which also invests in the relationship between participating executives and councils.

Dit kan echter, zoals ik hierboven ook heb betoogd, voor een groot deel worden ondervangen door een professionele sturing (governance) op en binnen samenwerkingsverbanden waarbij ook wordt geïnvesteerd in de relatie tussen deelnemende colleges en raden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de racistische intimidatie van een gezin in Giethoorn en de gebrekkige reactie daarop van lokale instanties

MPs Belhaj asked about the racist intimidation of a Turkish-origin family in Giethoorn and the slow police and municipal response. The minister acknowledged the failings, said police will stress discrimination policy, a discrimination detective pilot is planned, and the mayor's role is being discussed, but declined to comment on individual cases.
It is not for the cabinet to intervene in individual cases, and for that reason no substantive answer can be given to this question.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om in individuele zaken te treden en om die reden kan op deze vraag geen inhoudelijk antwoord worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Nispen over signalen dat verzekeraars en gemeenten mogelijk weer afspraken zouden willen maken over Wmo-regresrecht

An SP MP asked whether insurers and municipalities might again agree to buy out Wmo recourse rights for injury claims, and whether victims are being passed between municipality and insurer. The government answered that victims keep the freedom to choose between municipality and insurer, that no new convenant is planned, that VNG and the insurers' association keep talking, and that it sees no added value in raising the matter again with them.
In practice the victim has the freedom to choose between the municipality and the insurer.
In de praktijk heeft het slachtoffer de vrijheid om te kiezen tussen gemeente en verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het vernietigen van stukken die onderdeel zijn van een politiek debat en deel uitmaken van een Wob-procedure

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether destroying documents subject to a Wob request or political debate creates an impression of concealment, what rules apply, and whether the Woo will make such NTA reports public. The minister cited Council of State case law and Woo article 4.1a barring destruction after a request, declined to judge the Delft case, and explained the Woo active disclosure duties, noting they are not retroactive and are subject to exemptions.
An administrative body must therefore, after a request for information under the Wob has been submitted, preserve the documents to which that request relates.
Een bestuursorgaan dient dan ook na indiening van een verzoek om informatie op grond van de Wob de documenten waarop dat verzoek ziet, te bewaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het meedoen van het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties aan de Nationale Week Zonder Vlees & Zuivel en het invoeren van het principe ‘Carnivoor? Geef het

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Interior whether her department would join the National Week Without Meat and Dairy and adopt a plant-based default catering principle. The minister answered that the department participates in the week through its catering contractor but declined the plant-based default, pointing instead to Rijks-wide circular catering and CO2-reduction measures.
No, because BZK makes its contribution in a different way.
Nee, want BZK levert de bijdrage op een andere wijze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Strolenberg over het bericht ‘verdrievoudiging van bedreigingen en geweld tegen gemeenteraadsleden

Rep. Strolenberg (VVD) asked the Interior Minister about threats and violence against municipal councillors, the evaluation of the Veilige Publieke Taak programme, and how to improve council functioning and councillor satisfaction. The minister said threats are unacceptable, pointed to a joint norm and reporting procedure with Netwerk Weerbaar Bestuur, cross-ministry cooperation on safety, and planned research and measures to strengthen local councils.
I am having research carried out into the political culture of municipalities and provinces with the aim of developing a self-diagnosis instrument.
Ik laat onderzoek doen naar de politieke cultuur van gemeenten en provincies met als doel te komen tot een zelfdiagnose-instrument
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Tjeerd de Groot over de aandacht voor de Friese taal bij de introductie van bewindspersonen

Two MPs asked why the introduction dossiers and CVs of new ministers are translated into English, French, German and Papiamento but not Frisian, and why the rijksoverheid.nl website lacks Frisian content. The minister replied that translation decisions are left to departments under the government translation policy, that Frisian-speaking residents are a designated target group, and that Frisian versions of some information exist, while agreeing that some key information should be available in recognised languages.
It is up to the individual departments to decide whether translations into other languages are desirable.
Het is aan de individuele departementen om de afweging te maken of vertalingen in andere talen wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht ‘verdrievoudiging van bedreigingen en geweld tegen gemeenteraadsleden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked about a report that threats and violence against municipal councillors had tripled since 2015, and about support, aftercare and measures against intimidation. The minister responded that the government works with the Netwerk Weerbaar Bestuur on norms, prevention and aftercare, will report monitoring results before summer, and that the doxing bill will be sent to parliament after the Council of State advises.
I consider it important to periodically monitor how the number and form of intimidation and threats against councillors and other local political office holders develop.
Ik vind het belangrijk om periodiek te monitoren hoe het aantal gevallen en de vorm van intimidatie en bedreiging onder raadsleden en andere decentrale politieke ambtsdragers zich ontwikkelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over risicoselectie op basis van uiterlijk voorkomen

An MP asked the government whether the Tax Authority used risk profiles based on appearance, nationality and other personal traits, following PwC findings on its FSV blacklist. The State Secretary acknowledged examples referring to nationality and migration background, said no explicit appearance-based criteria were found beyond one 2016 email, stated that discrimination in risk selection is not permitted except in exceptional cases, and announced further investigations and safeguards while not answering all questions fully.
Unfortunately it has not proven possible to answer the questions within the deadline set by the member.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken de vragen binnen de door het lid gestelde termijn te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het artikel ‘Van Nieuwenhuizen wilde aanblijven als minister toen ze baan aannam in de lobbysector, Rutte was akkoord’

Two MPs asked the government about former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen taking a lobbying job for the energy sector while still in office and attending cabinet budget meetings, and about whether Prime Minister Rutte's approval and existing integrity rules were adequate. The government answered that the former minister bears primary responsibility for integrity, that she left office in August 2021 after the Prime Minister's political assessment, and that a revolving-door ban, cooling-off period and independent advisory commission are planned via future legislation.
In the letter of 29 November 2021 from the then Minister of the Interior, three new measures were announced regarding the integrity policy for former office holders.

In de brief van 29 november 2021 van de toenmalig Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zijn drie nieuwe maatregelen aangekondigd ten aanzien van het integriteitsbeleid voor gewezen bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar oversterfte tijdens de coronapandemie

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about the academic study into excess mortality during the pandemic that parliament had ordered by motion, including the timeline, independence of RIVM and CBS, data access, and whether a commission and standards for independent research would be set up. The minister replied that two parallel tracks would deliver results (first around mid-February, the broader one around end of June), that RIVM and CBS are independent by law and will not design the research question alone, and that existing codes suffice, but he declined to set up a commission or ask KNAW/WRR for new standards and gave only partial data access.
I consider independent research very important. Of course RIVM and CBS are fully independent; this is regulated by law.
Ik vind onafhankelijk onderzoek erg belangrijk. Uiteraard zijn RIVM en CBS volledig onafhankelijk, dit is bij wet geregeld.
Vragen van het lid Bruins Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de sterftecijfers van het Ruwaard van Puttenziekenhuis (ingezonden 18 juni 2013).

MP Bruins Slot asks the health minister about high mortality figures at Ruwaard van Puttenziekenhuis, why they were not flagged earlier by the hospital board and the IGZ, and how mortality data and incident follow-up are handled. The minister confirms the figures were high, explains the timeline of reporting and inspection, commits to publication of mortality rates for 2013 and diagnosis-group rates from 2014, and says the NZa is preparing the rules.
As promised during the patient safety consultation, I am committed to ensuring hospitals publish their mortality figures for 2013 and mortality figures based on diagnosis groups from 2014.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het Nota overleg patiëntveiligheid zet ik mij ervoor in dat de ziekenhuizen over 2013 hun sterftecijfers publiceren en vanaf 2014 sterftecijfers op basis van diagnosegroepen.

m: Motie van de leden Van Ark en Pia Dijkstra over informeren over euthanasie bij dementie
Asks the government to provide broad and targeted information to people with dementia, their relatives and doctors about euthanasia and related end-of-life choices.
requests the government to ensure broad and targeted information provision to people with dementia
verzoekt de regering, zorg te dragen voor een brede en gerichte informatievoorziening aan mensen met dementie
Motie van het lid Venrooy-Van Ark over een onderzoek naar het functioneren van de boekenmarkt
Asks the government to study the book market and the effects of abolishing the fixed book price, including for foreign and digital books.
requests the government to carry out a study into the functioning of the book market
verzoekt de regering, een onderzoek uit te voeren naar het functioneren van de boekenmarkt
Amendement van het lid Monasch c.s. over het verlagen van de korting op het Rijksmuseum Twenthe naar 25%
Shifts funds within the culture budget so the Rijksmuseum Twenthe subsidy cut is reduced from 50% to 25% for 2013.
The cut is reduced to 25% for 2013
De korting wordt voor 2013 verlaagd naar 25%
Motie van het lid Monasch c.s. over het opschorten van de besluitvorming over Rijksmuseum Twenthe
Asks the government to suspend the decision on Rijksmuseum Twenthe pending examination of a position in the future museum system and to arrange interim funding.
requests the government, in line with the Council for Culture advice, to suspend decision-making on this museum
verzoekt de regering, aansluitend bij het advies van de Raad voor Cultuur besluitvorming over dit museum op te schorten
Motie van het lid Venrooy-van Ark over een meldplicht voor professionals
Asks the government to replace the elder abuse reporting code with a mandatory reporting duty for professionals, since the code does not fix under-reporting.
requests the government to replace the elder abuse reporting code with a mandatory reporting duty for professionals
verzoekt de regering, de meldcode ouderenmishandeling te vervangen door een meldplicht voor professionals
Motie van het lid Dille c.s. over verstandelijk/meervoudig beperkte kinderen
Motion asking the government to give extra attention to the transition bureau regarding children with intellectual disabilities who need care under different regimes.
requests the government to have the transition bureau pay extra attention to this target group
verzoekt de regering, om het transitiebureau extra aandacht te laten besteden aan deze doelgroep
Amendement van de leden Venrooy-Van Ark en Dille ter vervanging van nr. 35 over een goede informatievoorziening
Obliges insurers, providers and assessment bodies to supply personal data to municipalities for Wmo tasks, with ministerial rules on data handling and security.
provide to the municipal executive free of charge the personal data of insured persons
verstrekken aan het college van burgemeester en wethouders kosteloos de persoonsgegevens van verzekerden
Amendement van het lid Venrooy-Van Ark over een goede informatievoorziening
Requires care insurers, providers and assessment bodies to supply personal and health data of insured persons to municipalities free of charge for Wmo tasks.
provide to the municipal executive free of charge the personal data of insured persons, including health-related personal data
verstrekken aan het college van burgemeester en wethouders kosteloos de persoonsgegevens van verzekerden, waaronder persoonsgegevens betreffende de gezondheid
Amendement van de leden Venrooy-Van Ark en Dille over het afstemmen van de individuele voorziening op eventuele aanspraken op grond van de AWBZ
Requires municipalities to align individual in-kind support under the Wmo as closely as possible with care entitlements under the AWBZ.
The proposed paragraph imposes a duty on the college to ensure the individual provision is as well aligned as possible with care to which the person is entitled under the AWBZ.

Het nu voorgestelde lid legt daarbij een verplichting voor het college vast om ervoor te zorgen dat de individuele voorziening zo goed mogelijk is afgestemd op zorg waarop betrokkene ingevolge de AWBZ recht heeft.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Venrooy-van Ark en Dille ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het bieden van de keuze voor een pgb indien op grond van de AWBZ ook ondersteuning wordt ontvangen
Gives Wmo clients who receive a personal care allowance or PGB under the AWBZ an enforceable right to choose a PGB from the municipality, limiting municipal discretion.
The municipal executive offers persons entitled to an individual provision ... the choice between receiving a provision in kind and receiving a personal budget

Het college van burgemeester en wethouders biedt personen die op grond van de verordening, bedoeld in het eerste lid, aanspraak hebben op een individuele voorziening ... de keuze tussen het ontvangen van een voorziening in natura en het ontvangen van een persoonsgebonden budget
Amendement van het lid Venrooy-Van Ark over het bieden van een keuze tussen een voorziening in natura en een pgb in geval van een aanspraak op een voorziening in natura
Amendment requires municipalities to offer a choice between in-kind care and a personal budget (pgb) for individual Wmo provisions.
Amendement van de leden Venrooy-van Ark en Dille over het bieden van de keuze voor een pgb indien op grond van de AWBZ ook ondersteuning wordt ontvangen
Gives people entitled to in-kind support under the WMO and AWBZ the option of a personal budget instead, with municipalities obliged to offer it.
that person is offered the option to choose a personal budget instead of the in-kind provision
wordt die persoon de mogelijkheid geboden in plaats van de voorziening in natura te kiezen voor een persoonsgebonden budget
Asks the government not to transfer Zvw and AWBZ aids to the Wmo but keep them under the Zvw, leaving current Wmo aids unchanged.
requests the government not to transfer Zvw aids and AWBZ aids to the Wmo
verzoekt de regering geen Zvw-hulpmiddelen en geen AWBZ-hulpmid delen over te hevelen naar de Wmo
Motie Venrooy-van Ark/Dille over een maximale termijn van AWBZ-zorg in het buitenland
Motion asks the government to limit AWBZ-funded care abroad to a maximum of four weeks.
requests the cabinet to enable a maximum term of four weeks for AWBZ care abroad
verzoekt het kabinet een maximale termijn van AWBZ-zorg in het buitenland mogelijk te maken van vier weken
Motie-Venrooy-van Ark over palliatieve zorg in het buitenland
Asks the government not to make palliative care abroad available under the AWBZ benefits scheme.
requests the government not to make palliative care abroad possible under the AWBZ
verzoekt de regering palliatieve zorg in het buitenland onder de AWBZ niet mogelijk te maken
