qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over berichtgeving in de media t.a.v. het tekort aan behandelaren waardoor er lange wachtlijsten zijn in de GGZ en instellingen zich genoodzaakt voelen tot een patiëntenstop

An MP asked the state secretary about media reports of a shortage of mental health treatment staff, long waiting lists and patient admission stops, and whether more GZ-psychologist training places should be funded. The state secretary said he follows the Capaciteitsorgaan's advice on training places, sees no reason to add places now, and that a decision on funding orthopedagogue training is for the next cabinet.
I therefore see no reason to make more training places available.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om meer opleidingsplaatsen beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het niet voldoen aan internationale eisen voor antidopingbeleid en de mogelijke sancties voor de Nederlandse Sport

MPs Van der Laan, Kuiken and Van Nispen asked why the Netherlands fails to meet WADA's revised anti-doping code, when the government and the anti-doping authority learned of the non-compliance, and what sanctions Dutch sport could face. Minister Blokhuis answered that the independence of the Doping Appeals Committee (BND) is the remaining compliance issue, that legislation is being prepared, and that sanctions would not apply retroactively and could be contested before CAS.
I have answered the questions separately.
Ik heb de vragen afzonderlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld over het bericht 'GGD-directeur laat naam Tata Steel uit longkankerrapport schrappen'

MPs Bouchallikh and Westerveld asked whether the GGD Kennemerland director had improperly removed Tata Steel from a lung cancer report, whether a commercial polluter should have seen the report early, and whether the health service's independence is safeguarded. The state secretary answered that an independent investigation (Heskes) found the report was produced with integrity, that early access for Tata Steel was plausible for media preparation, and that no broader investigation is planned, while committing to balancing health against economic interests under existing law.
The research report, carried out by investigator and former Hague ombudsman Peter Heskes, concluded that the director and his staff acted with complete integrity.

In het onderzoeksrapport, dat door onderzoeker en voormalig ombudsman van Den Haag Peter Heskes is uitgevoerd, is geconcludeerd dat er volstrekt integer is gehandeld door de directeur en zijn medewerkers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Teunissen over een brandbrief van KDS over de hoge slachtsnelheid in slachthuizen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about a letter from the works council of KDS, the meat inspection body, complaining that high slaughter line speeds prevent proper inspection and threaten food safety and worker safety. Minister Schouten answered that the government takes the concern seriously, has frozen line-speed increases pending an investigation due at year-end, and that legally it cannot order a structural reduction in speed immediately.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ark over het werkprogramma van de Europese Commissie en de routekaart voor een betere ‘werk-privé balans’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether EU work-life balance legislation is needed and whether it fits the EU's less-regulation agenda; the minister answered that a roadmap and planned package are only at consultation stage, that subsidiarity will decide the Dutch position, and that work-life balance is primarily a matter for partners and employers. The answers are largely referrals to future BNC fiches and restate the subsidiarity principle without committing to concrete steps.
On these proposals and the Dutch position on them, the cabinet will inform you in due course in the usual way via BNC fiche(s).
Over deze voorstellen en het Nederlandse standpunt daarover zal het kabinet u te zijner tijd op de gebruikelijke wijze via BNC fiche(s) informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ark en Van ‘t Wout over het bericht ‘ Timmermans wil Brusselse afspraken om meer vrouwen aan het werk te helpen’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the EU should regulate women's labour participation and work-care balance, and whether the government would resist such regulation. The minister answered that the Commission is only at the roadmap and consultation stage, that subsidiarity applies, that work-care division is primarily a matter for partners, and that the government will inform Parliament via BNC fiches and a planned SER advice and 2016 consultation.
On these proposals and the Dutch position on them, the cabinet will inform you in due course in the usual way via BNC fiches.
Over deze voorstellen en het Nederlandse standpunt daarover zal het kabinet u te zijner tijd op de gebruikelijke wijze via BNC fiche(s) informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ark en Tellegen over de berichten ‘Aangifte doen na aanranding zo makkelijk nog niet’ en ‘Onbegrip over verplichte bedenktijd bij aangifte aanranding’

VVD MPs Van Ark and Tellegen asked whether the mandatory reflection period offered to victims of sexual offences before filing a report, and related protection and anonymity questions, deter reporting. Minister Van der Steur answered that the reflection period is optional and flexible, that victims can file immediately if they wish, that the police inform victims about procedure, and that protection and anonymity options exist but full anonymity toward a known suspect is impractical.
It is not a procedural requirement before a report can be filed.
Het gaat niet om een procedurele verplichting alvorens aangifte gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Ark over het beter rekening houden in het familierecht met kinderen en volwassenen die leven met een intersekse conditie

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Ark asked about the population size of people with intersex conditions, whether people should not face pressure to register a sex, and whether the Staatscommissie Familierecht should examine allowing people not to register a sex. The minister agreed sex registration has lost legal weight, promised to consider steps to reduce burdens, and said he would ask the Staatscommissie herijking ouderschap to examine whether sex can be dropped from parenthood legislation.
I am willing to ask the Staatscommissie herijking ouderschap to examine whether it is possible and desirable to omit the mention of sex from parenthood legislation.

Ik ben bereid de Staatscommissie herijking ouderschap te vragen om te onderzoeken in hoeverre het mogelijk en wenselijk is om in de wetgeving over het ouderschap af te zien van vermelding van het geslacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ark over homoacceptatie en Coming Out Day

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about LGBT acceptance in the workplace, the KNVB acceptance plan, and whether a round table could coordinate an action around IDAHO. The Minister welcomed these initiatives, promised a midterm emancipation review and a round table before year end with a report to the House.
I aim to hold the round table meeting before the end of this year. I will inform the House of Representatives about its outcomes.
Ik streef ernaar de rondetafelbijeenkomst voor het einde van dit jaar te houden. Ik zal de Tweede Kamer over de uitkomsten daarvan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Van Ark over het bericht ‘Buurt maakt jacht op Amersfoortse homo: ik moest kruipend naar huis’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how to respond to reports of a neighbourhood hounding a gay man in Amersfoort, and whether existing legal tools are adequate and how many similar cases occur. The minister condemned such intimidation, pointed to local authorities and the local triangle as primarily responsible, cited police figures on anti-gay violence, and said existing tools suffice while promising support and a national awareness campaign.
It is therefore the task of local authorities to solve these problems in the municipality.
Het is dus de taak van lokale autoriteiten om deze problemen in de gemeente op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Ark over het bericht dat in Uganda een Belg vastzit vanwege homoseksualiteit (definitief)

MPs De Caluwé and Van Ark asked the government about reports that a Belgian man was detained in Uganda over alleged homosexual conduct, whether other Europeans were held, the status of Uganda's anti-homosexuality bill, what aid had done for LHBT people, and whether aid would be suspended. The minister answered that the Belgian was released on bail and has left Uganda, that no other Europeans are known to be held, that the President signalled he would not sign the bill in its current form but later indicated he would, and that the Netherlands will await formal presidential signature before reacting while consulting LHBT organisations on aid measures.
Depending on those discussions, we want to consider whether and which measures we take.
Afhankelijk van die gesprekken willen we bezien of en welke maatregelen we nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Ark over het bericht dat het parlement in Oeganda een anti-homowet heeft aangenomen

MPs De Caluwé and Van Ark asked whether the government would condemn Uganda's anti-homosexuality law, whether budget for Uganda would be cut or redirected to LGBT groups, and whether it would coordinate action with donors. The government answered that the law is not yet in force, that Nederland has urged joint EU pressure and raised concerns with Uganda's prime minister, that existing funds already support LGBT-related organisations, and that it will examine options for extra support without committing to budget cuts yet.
It is too early to decide on consequences once the law is introduced.
Het is te vroeg om te besluiten over consequenties bij de invoering van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Ark over het bericht dat homoseksualiteit weer strafbaar wordt gesteld in India

MPs Ten Broeke and Van Ark asked the Foreign Minister about India's Supreme Court ruling reinstating criminalisation of same-sex relations, and whether legal steps, political support for reform, and EU pressure are possible. The minister answered that the court left reform to parliament, that a review petition is possible but mainly addresses procedural errors, that protests occurred, and that the EU High Representative had already expressed concern.
With this ruling the Supreme Court has placed the initiative with the legislature to remove or amend this provision.
Met deze uitspraak heeft het Hooggerechtshof het initiatief bij de wetgevende macht neergelegd om deze bepaling te verwijderen dan wel te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Ark over de doodslag van twee mannen vanwege seksuele gerichtheid

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a reported video of two gay men beaten to death in Kenya, and whether the government would press for prosecution and cut aid if not prosecuted. The minister answered that the event apparently did not take place in Kenya, so no Kenyan investigation exists, and declined to take further action on that basis.
On the basis of environmental details it is clear that it did not take place in Kenya.
Op basis van omgevingsdetails is wel duidelijk dat het niet in Kenia heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Ark over het op het laatste moment verplaatsen van de Gay Pride op Curaçao

Two VVD MPs asked why the Curaçao Gay Pride venue was changed at the last moment, whether this affects freedom of assembly, and how LGBT safety and expression are guaranteed on Curaçao. The minister answered that public order is an autonomous Curaçao matter whose considerations are unknown to him, that only one MP's letter was received, and that no signals of unsafety were received.
It is up to the Curaçao government to weigh whether additional requirements for organizing the Gay Pride are necessary to maintain public order and safety.

Het is aan de overheid van Curaçao om een afweging te maken in hoeverre het nodig is om aanvullende eisen te stellen aan de organisatie van de Gay Pride om daarmee de openbare orde en veiligheid te handhaven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Ark over het bericht "homo's Rusland digitaal vernederd"

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of digital humiliation of gay people in Russia and about rising anti-LGBT violence after Russia's anti-'homopropaganda' law. The minister acknowledged the law's discriminatory effect, said Nederland will raise LGBT rights with Russia and seek an EU position, and noted IOC assurances that the law will not apply during the Sochi Games.
At the next Foreign Affairs Council meeting, the Netherlands will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly and push for a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.

Nederland zal bij de eerstvolgende bespreking van de RBZ de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen en bevorderen dat over de anti-homopropagandawet een gezamenlijk EU-standpunt zal worden ingenomen.
Antwoord vragen Venrooy-van Ark over het reddingsplan voor het Tropenmuseum

An MP asked the education and foreign trade ministers about the rescue plan for the Tropenmuseum, including its merger conditions, budgets, funding sources and whether it amounts to a cut for culture and development aid. The minister confirmed the merger and collection-transfer conditions, gave budget figures and funding splits, but declined to commit to post-2016 funding and said the rescue is a cut for development cooperation.
I cannot make any commitment for after the current subsidy period, for any institution whatsoever.
Ik kan geen toezegging doen voor na de huidige subsidieperiode, voor welke instelling dan ook.
Antwoord vragen Venrooy-van Ark over de inkomensgrenzen in de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo)

An MP asked the state secretary about income limits in the Wmo, following a Kassa broadcast and a VNG letter, asking how non-compliant municipalities are held to account, how retroactive support and individual remedies work, and how the Wmo fits with policy capacity. The state secretary replied that municipalities are expected to comply, that objection and appeal rights exist, that enforcement is not appropriate in this decentralised law, and that the VNG was the right channel for clarification.
Further enforcement, insofar as it is appropriate in this decentralised law, is therefore not at issue.
Nadere handhaving, voor zover passend in deze gedecentraliseerde wet, is dan ook niet aan de orde.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Profronde van Noord-Holland blaast alles af bij gebrek aan politiebegeleiding'

MPs Heerema and others asked whether cycling races are being cancelled for lack of police escorts and what legal rules prevent races without full police escort. The minister answered that no races were cancelled solely for lack of police motorcycle escorts, that no legal rule bars races without police escort, and that an experiment with trained civilian traffic marshals is being examined given existing legal limits.
There is no legal rule that prevents the passage of races without police escort.
Er bestaat geen wettelijke regel die de doorgang van koersen zonder politiebegeleiding verhindert.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het aanvullend onderzoek door Deloitte Forensic & Dispute Services B.V (Deloitte) naar de inkoop van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen voor de zorg (PBM)

An MP asked the government to release the full Deloitte assignment for the investigation into PPE procurement for healthcare, to explain delays, and to commit to a thorough probe of procurement irregularities. The Staatssecretaris provided the assignment confirmation as an annex, withheld the underlying service agreement as commercially confidential, gave a partial answer on the scope and delays, and pointed to a meldpunt and to the landsadvocaat's advice.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het initiatief van een aantal ziekenhuizen in de strijd tegen geneesmiddelkaping

An MP asked the minister whether he knows of and supports a hospital initiative with compounding pharmacy A15 to counter drug price increases through registration of compounded drugs, and asked about a NFKOO subsidy with similar aims and the IGJ's preference for commercial parties. The state secretary answered that the initiative is known and welcomed for affordability, that the NFKOO subsidy partly overlaps with it and is being used to support A15, and that the IGJ applies neutral quality-based supervision, while committing to EU-level adjustment of the orphan drug regulation and a FAST helpdesk.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het feit dat patiënten soms zonder medische noodzaak moeten wisselen naar een andere dosering van medicatie, waardoor zij meer moeten bijbetalen voor dezelfde hoeveelheid werkza

An MP asked whether patients are forced to switch to another dosage of a medicine without medical need, paying more for the same active ingredient, and what can be done about it. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem stems from reimbursement limits, supply shortages and pharmacy purchasing, pointed to a planned modernisation of the reimbursement system and a EUR 250 annual cap on co-payments, and rejected calling the situation unfair.
I do not know how often this occurs.
Ik weet niet hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: Sekseverschil blijft bij onderzoek naar corona vaak onderbelicht’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about under-representation of sex differences in COVID-19 research, data publication, and possible under-diagnosis of women with Long COVID. The minister answered that data publication via EMA is expanding, that guidelines and research already address sex and risk groups, and that C-support and an updated multidisciplinary guideline are being set up.
Therefore, for medicines authorised in Europe, study data are published on the clinical data website of the European Medicines Agency (EMA).
Daarom worden voor geneesmiddelen, waarvoor in Europa een handelsvergunning is verleend, de studiedata gepubliceerd op de klinische data website van de het Europees Geneesmiddelen Agentschap (EMA).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de berichten dat de kosteloze verstrekking van CGRP-remmers voor migrainepatiënten die hiervan afhankelijk zijn stopt

An SP MP asked whether the state should accept the end of free provision of CGRP migraine inhibitors for patients dependent on them, and why Zorginstituut advice had been delayed. The Staatssecretaris answered that the free supply is the manufacturers' choice, that reimbursement for therapy-resistant chronic migraine starts 1 November 2021, and that episodic migraine patients must rely on alternatives or manufacturers until a further advice is issued.
It is up to manufacturers whether and to whom they provide their medicines free of charge during an assessment by the Zorginstituut.
Het is aan fabrikanten of en aan wie zij hun medicijnen kosteloos ter beschikking stellen tijdens een beoordeling door het Zorginstituut.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht Nieuw record aan beleggingen in zorgvastgoed

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about foreign investment in healthcare real estate, including the sale of part of Albert Schweitzer hospital's property to NorthWest Healthcare REIT, who supervises such sales, and why foreign investors find the Dutch market attractive. The minister answered that the CSZ supervises sales by Wtzi-approved institutions but the property sale was by a non-Wtzi property BV and so falls outside CSZ oversight, that foreign investors are bound by Dutch rules, and that the reasons for foreign interest are not fully clear.
The recent sale, however, was from the property BV to the new investor, so it does not fall under the CSZ's supervision.
De recente verkoop is echter van de vastgoed BV aan de nieuwe investeerder, waardoor dit niet onder het toezicht van het CSZ valt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de artikelen 'accountantscontrole op 'coronawinst' ziekenhuizen ontbreekt' en 'solidariteit onder ziekenhuizen ontbreekt bij financiële afhandeling coronacrisis'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the lack of accountant checks on hospital 'corona profits' and solidarity among hospitals in settling COVID compensation, including hospital-level compensation figures and whether hospital directors must declare no double funding. The minister said the ministry lacks hospital-level data because insurers call it commercially confidential and 2020 settlements are not final, pointed to insurer contract clauses and NZa rules against double funding, and declined to add a declaration requirement for hospital directors.
VWS does not have an overview of the financial compensation for loss of income and additional costs per hospital.
VWS beschikt niet over een overzicht van de financiële compensatie voor inkomstenderving en meerkosten per ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Medische kwalen gemist door tekort aan artsen voor verstandelijk gehandicapten’

An MP asked about reports that medical conditions of people with intellectual disabilities are missed due to a shortage of physicians for people with intellectual disabilities (AVG), and how access to care and training intake will be ensured. The minister acknowledges the shortage and low intake, describes a labour-market strategy, an agreement on cooperation, NZa exploration of funding adjustments, and follow-up with GPs and the training institution.
I intend to closely monitor this process.
Ik ben voornemens dit proces nauwgezet te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het sinds 1 januari 2021 geldend verbod van Zilveren Kruis om medische hulpmiddelen via apotheken en apotheekhoudende huisartsen te verstrekken

MP Bikker asked the minister about Zilveren Kruis's 2021 rule that medical supplies such as incontinence material and test strips may only be ordered from contracted specialist shops and delivered home, with high extra costs and patient harm concerns. The minister confirmed awareness of the change, said insurers must meet their duty of care under the Zorgverzekeringswet monitored by the NZa, noted the insurer set service terms, and declined to intervene as long as the insurer stays within legal limits.
I regularly organise consultations with health insurers. That does not alter the fact that I also hear your concerns.
Ik organiseer regelmatig overleggen met zorgverzekeraars. Dat neemt niet weg dat ik ook uw zorgen hoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de berichten 'Kamervragen over nachtelijke HAP sluiting in Oostburg?' en 'Koester al het jonge bloed'

An MP asked the Minister about a pilot to close the Oostburg out-of-hours GP post at night, distance to Terneuzen, cross-border care, death certification, GP working hours and training placement rules. The Minister answered that arrangements are the responsibility of local GPs and the insurer, that 92% of residents remain within the 30-minute norm, and declined to disclose confidential data on Knokke providers while promising to explore physician-assistant involvement in death certification.
How out-of-hours care is organised is the shared responsibility of the GPs in the region together with the health insurer.
Hoe het zorgaanbod in de avond-, nacht-, en weekenduren is ingericht, is de gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid van de huisartsen in de regio in samenwerking met de zorgverzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over verkeerd afleveren van patiënten bij ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the minister why seriously injured trauma patients are often delivered to the wrong hospital and why the trauma centre volume norm is not met. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described triage protocols, training, an app under evaluation and planned discussions with stakeholders, but gave no firm timeline or binding commitments.

VWS will discuss with the National Network Acute Care, the Dutch Association of Hospitals, Ambulance Care Netherlands and Zorgverzekeraars Nederland which further improvements they will make in trauma patient care.

VWS zal met het Landelijk Netwerk Acute Zorg (LNAZ, dit netwerk coördineert landelijk de traumazorg), de Nederlandse Vereniging van Ziekenhuizen (NVZ), Ambulancezorg Nederland (AZN) en Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) bespreken welke verdere verbeteringen zij zullen gaan aanbrengen in de zorg voor traumapatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over zwaargewonde slachtoffers die niet in het juiste ziekenhuis terecht komen

An MP asked the state secretary about a study finding that a third of severely injured accident victims are taken to the wrong hospital, especially older women, and what will be done about selection, the 90% target and the 240-patient norm. The government acknowledged the problem, pointed to triage protocols, training and an app, said the 90% norm is not yet met and will be discussed with partners, and deferred concentration decisions to a future cabinet.
VWS will discuss with the LNAZ, NVZ, AZN and ZN which further improvements they will make in care for seriously injured patients.

VWS zal met het Landelijk Netwerk Acute Zorg (LNAZ, dit netwerk coördineert landelijk de traumazorg), de Nederlandse Vereniging van Ziekenhuizen (NVZ), Ambulancezorg Nederland (AZN) en Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) bespreken welke verdere verbeteringen zij gaan aanbrengen in de zorg voor ernstig verwonde patiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht dat een cruciaal oogmedicijn tot 2022 niet beschikbaar is

An MP asked the minister about reports of a shortage of the eye medicine Visudyne until 2022, how many patients are at risk, why stock was lacking, and what can be done. The state secretary answered that harm to patients is likely, that imports and local compounding are not feasible, and that the government will work on EU supply security and inform parliament later.
It is not clear how many patients will actually suffer eye damage.
Het is niet duidelijk hoeveel patiënten daadwerkelijk oogschade zullen oplopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over mogelijke overheidssteun voor Formule 1 races

Two PvdD MPs asked whether the government would rule out financial support for the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, citing earlier promises, the organiser's request for compensation, and fly-past plans. The state secretary answered that the organiser does not qualify for the event guarantee scheme, that no state financial support was given, and that the fly-past was cancelled.
However, the DGP does not meet the requirements of the event guarantee scheme, because the event was not prohibited by the central government.
De DGP voldoet echter niet aan de eisen van de garantieregeling evenementen, omdat het evenement niet door de rijksoverheid is verboden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Quin Dokters kampt met een acuut tekort aan huisartsen’

An MP asked the minister about Quin Dokters, a GP practice group facing an acute shortage of GPs that left about 14,000 patients without access, including questions on app safety, the inspectorate's oversight, takeovers of practices and possible NZa investigation. The state secretary answered that the IGJ is monitoring and investigating, that capacity measures have been taken, and that the NZa sees no reason to investigate insurers, while placing most responsibility for quality of care with the provider.
The IGJ has received signals about the accessibility and availability of Quin Dokters' practices.
De IGJ heeft signalen ontvangen over de bereikbaarheid en toegankelijkheid van de praktijken van Quin Dokters.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Berg over de uitvoering van de motie jaarverantwoordingsplicht (Kamerstuk 35 830 XVI, nr. 14)

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van den Berg asked the minister how the motion on annual public accountability for primary care providers is being implemented, including whether the government will reconsider the regulation, share the SIRA cost calculation and ATR opinions, and justify the CBS questionnaire. The state secretary answers that the compromise regulation stays, that alternatives proposed by the Eerstelijnscoalitie do not fit the law's purpose, that the regulatory burden for small providers fell 91% to under two hours a year, and that the ATR advice was addressed by shortening the questionnaire and adding a digital decision tree.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bekendheidsonderzoek over PGO

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a survey on awareness of personal health records (PGO), their role in digitising care, the state of their development, and how best practices are spread. The State Secretary said the survey shows more information is needed, described PGO development and MedMij certification, and outlined the alliance and programme activities promoting PGO use.
The study clearly shows that information about the usefulness and necessity of PGOs is needed.
Het onderzoek laat duidelijk zien dat voorlichting over nut en noodzaak van PGO’s nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over de verkeersondersteuning bij wielerwegwedstrijden

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether police shortages threaten cycling road races, whether volunteer or certified motorcycle traffic marshals could replace police escorts, whether a legal status for the race caravan is being considered, and about the timeline for measures. The ministers answer that police are willing to help find solutions, that a package of no-regret measures is being implemented with evaluation by the end of 2022, and that a study into the tolerated practice of traffic rule violations will be started.
The preparations for the study into the tolerated situation regarding traffic rule violations during cycling races will be started as soon as possible.
De voorbereidingen voor het onderzoek naar de gedoogsituatie omtrent verkeersregels tijdens wielerwedstrijden zetten we zo spoedig mogelijk in gang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de ingewikkelde coronamaatregelen voor speeltuinen, stads- en kinderboerderijen

An SP MP asked why small neighbourhood playgrounds reopened in March 2021 while city and children's farms stayed closed, and when those farms could reopen. The minister explained the phased reopening approach, noting children's farms mainly outdoors reopened on 19 May as part of step 2 of the plan.
It is always important that children can play and move outdoors.
Het is te alle tijden belangrijk dat kinderen in de buitenlucht kunnen spelen en bewegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het initiatief Extra handen voor de Zorg

MPs Den Haan asked the minister about how personal data of volunteers signed up to Extra Handen voor de Zorg were stored and matched, whether fees were charged, match criteria, outcomes for people with care backgrounds, the Nationale Zorgklas, follow-up after the Commissie Werken in de Zorg report, and data transfer to a new platform. The minister answered in detail, describing the data handling with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, the deletion of Excel files, match statistics, and planned follow-up such as an inventory and a Nationale Zorgreserve exploration, while some questions were answered only in part or referred to pending inventories.
Extra Handen voor de Zorg was set up as a temporary crisis facility to provide organisations in need with temporary extra staff.
Extra Handen voor de Zorg is opgericht als tijdelijke crisisfaciliteit om zorgorganisaties in nood te voorzien van tijdelijke extra mensen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'SCP: samenleving nog steeds niet ingericht voor mensen met een lichamelijke beperking'

An MP from the CDA asked the minister for Medical Care about a SCP report finding that society is still not accessible for people with physical disabilities, including discrimination, whether ratifying the Optional Protocol to the UN Disability Convention would help, progress since 2016, measurability of commitments, municipal inclusion agendas and the accessibility website. The minister acknowledges remaining barriers, points to the Onbeperkt meedoen! programme, existing complaint bodies and a planned national discrimination coordinator, and says ratifying the Optional Protocol alone would not suffice.
The cabinet wants to appoint an NCDR who, together with parties in this broad field, will work on a multi-year national programme.
Het kabinet wil een NCDR aanstellen die samen met de partijen in dit brede veld aan de slag gaat met een meerjarig nationaal programma
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de overtreding van de coronaregels bij een kalverslachthuis in Apeldoorn

The MP Van Esch asked the Minister for Medical Care how positive-tested workers at the Apeldoorn calf slaughterhouse ESA were allowed on site, whether they were pressured to work, and what the NVWA knew of earlier COVID-19 rule violations. The Minister answered that the NVWA halted operations, that pressure could not be ruled out or traced through contact tracing, that inspections and a shutdown followed, and that the Inspectie SZW took enforcement action.
It is important that the competent authorities gain and maintain a clear view of any coercion and of who it comes from.
Het is van belang dat de bevoegde autoriteiten goed zicht krijgen en houden op eventuele dwang en van wie die dwang uitgaat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Statushouders komen amper aan de bak in de zorgsector’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care why refugees with recognised status (statushouders) rarely find work in the care sector, asking how diploma recognition works, how many have care backgrounds, why Germany's process is faster, and how the sector can use this potential. The Minister explained the recognition procedure and costs, said data on refugees with care backgrounds is not available, acknowledged Germany's process differs, and committed to inform the House in autumn on streamlining the procedure.
I am not aware how many refugees with recognised status have a care background.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel statushouders een zorgachtergrond hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over de bewezen ernstige gevolgen van siliconen borstimplantaten

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that breast implants cause serious harm, including whether women are adequately warned, whether the inspectorate should act, and whether routine MRI screening and removal coverage should change. The minister says she cannot verify every surgeon's counselling but points to patient information, a planned IGJ thematic inspection, a RIVM research programme, and a standing Zorginstituut position under which removal is reimbursed only for medical necessity, with no change planned for now.
It is of course not possible for me to check whether every plastic surgeon informs the woman correctly and fully, because I am not present in every treatment room.
Het is voor mij natuurlijk niet mogelijk om te controleren of elke plastisch chirurg de vrouw op de juiste wijze en volledig voorlicht, omdat ik niet aanwezig ben in iedere behandelkamer.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht dat vrouwen die een mislukte cosmetische operaties hebben ondergaan, hard onder druk worden gezet om daar geen negatieve recensies over op sociale media te zet

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that women with failed cosmetic surgery were pressured by intermediary agencies, through silence contracts and threats, not to post negative reviews, and asked about IGJ oversight, reporting duties and a campaign. The Minister said such practices are unacceptable and pointed to existing complaint channels, a bill making silence clauses void, and the IGJ's limited reach over foreign-based agencies, while rejecting a mandatory reporting duty for surgeons.
I find such practices unacceptable; silence contracts are therefore highly undesirable.
Ik vind dergelijke praktijken onacceptabel; zwijgcontracten zijn dan ook zeer ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Paternotte en Bikker over de zogenoemde mondkapjesdeal

MPs Kuiken, Paternotte and Bikker asked the Minister about the face-mask deal with Relief Goods Alliance, including stock levels, objections raised by the LCH, alternative suppliers, contacts between ministers and RGA, and advance payments. The Minister answered mostly by pointing to a forthcoming Deloitte review, shared some documents, withheld details of the other large contracts pending receipt, and committed to passing many questions to the researchers.
I will ask the research bureau to include this question in the supplementary investigation and also to address the reason why protest was lodged where this happened.
Ik zal het onderzoeksbureau vragen om deze vraag mee te nemen in het aanvullende onderzoek en dan ook in te gaan op de reden waarom er protest werd aangetekend indien dit gebeurde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Sociaal sekswerker hunkert naar erkenning: ‘Mensen met een beperking hebben ook behoeften en fantasieën”

MPs Wiersma and Tellegen asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a report on social sex work for people with disabilities, asking whether it should be recognised as normal work, whether it is regulated, and whether municipalities are responsible. The State Secretary answered that sex work is a legitimate profession, that no data on users exist, that social sex work is not a municipal care responsibility under the Wmo, and that a research study on intimacy and sexuality for people with disabilities will be commissioned.
Such an overview is not available, because such data are not registered.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet voorhanden, omdat dergelijke gegevens niet geregistreerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de toekomst van het ziekenhuis in Zutphen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the uncertain future of the Gelre hospital in Zutphen, its decision-making process, regional demographic data, emergency department figures and the link to the national recovery plan. The minister answered largely by relaying information from Gelre Ziekenhuizen and Zilveren Kruis, stated that no closure is planned, and pointed to a forthcoming ministerial regulation for the motion-based impact assessments.
Your House has meanwhile received a draft of this ministerial regulation.
Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels een concept van deze ministeriële regeling ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het tweemaal betalen van eigen risico voor hetzelfde behandeltraject als gevolg van uitgestelde behandelingen door het afschalen van de reguliere zorg

An SP MP asks the health minister about patients paying their deductible twice for one treatment trajectory when care was postponed during COVID-19, and asks whether a compensation scheme will be created. The minister acknowledges the problem and the NZa advice to decouple the deductible from DBC rules, but declines a compensation scheme on the grounds that patients pay only for care received, and says a decoupling exploration is nearly finished and will be sent before the summer recess.
Are you willing to create a goodwill compensation scheme to compensate these people for having had to pay their deductible twice as a result of the scaling down of regular care?

Bent u bereid om een coulanceregeling in het leven te roepen om deze mensen te compenseren voor het feit dat zij, als gevolg van het afschalen van de reguliere zorg, twee keer een eigen risico hebben moeten betalen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Laan over sportprotheses

Two MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care whether sports prostheses should be covered by health insurance or municipalities, the costs involved, co-payments and waiting or appeal issues. The minister answered that eligibility for insurance coverage is based on clinical criteria, that prostheses for social participation go through municipalities, cited cost estimates and the Uniek Sporten Hulpmiddelen fund, and promised further monitoring and a progress update.
How many cases are currently not reimbursed and the outcomes of appeal procedures are currently not known.
In hoeveel gevallen er momenteel niet vergoed wordt en de uitkomsten van bezwaarprocedures zijn momenteel niet inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de inhaalzorg in de curatieve zorg

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about the scope, patient allocation, oversight and enforcement of catch-up care in curative care, including the role of the ACM and NZa. The minister answers that insurers and the NZa will give the scope by mid-July, that patients are informed via insurers and information cards, that the NZa monitors and supervises insurers, and that no new research will be initiated.
By mid-July, insurers and the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) are expected to provide insight into the scope of catch-up care per specialty.
Half juli kan naar verwachting het inzicht worden gegeven door zorgverzekeraars en de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZA) over de omvang van de inhaalzorg per specialisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over de beschikbaarheid en de betaalbaarheid van het aanbod van sport op televisie

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked whether paywalls making popular sport available only on subscription harm access and what could be done, including a review of the events list. The minister says the market should set broadcasting, notes the events list guarantees free-to-air access for major events, and promises an evaluation in 2023 but no immediate new research.
It is up to the public and commercial broadcasters to determine the content of their programming.
Het is aan de publieke en commerciële omroepen om de inhoud van hun programmering te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het gebrek aan maatregelen tegen de gezondheidsrisico’s van de geitenhouderij

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister why the government does not take national precautionary measures against health risks from goat farming, and whether provincial moratoria should be left to provinces. The Minister answers that moratoria are a provincial competence, that the government supports them and funds follow-up research into the cause of raised pneumonia risk near goat farms, and that existing national zoonosis and Q-fever measures remain in place.
Establishing, lifting or extending such a moratorium is a competence of the province.
Het instellen, opheffen of verlengen van een dergelijk moratorium is een bevoegdheid van de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Noodkreet: tandarts gezocht voor Rotterdam, laat meer studenten toe’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about regional shortages of dentists in Zeeland and Rotterdam, dental care for children, training capacity and whether regional inventories and policy options will be produced. The Minister acknowledges the shortages and planned monitoring and a 2022 Capaciteitsorgaan forecast, but states no additional funding is available for expanding training places and that new training programmes are a matter for education institutions and the CDHO procedure.
The Capaciteitsorgaan will also map the regional distribution of dentists and dental visits in its next forecast in 2022.
Het Capaciteitsorgaan zal in zijn volgende raming in 2022 ook de regionale spreiding van tandartsen en van tandartsbezoek in kaart brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de uitzending van Zembla ‘Stoppen met de pillen’

MP Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Zembla broadcast on the difficulty of stopping antidepressants, including the high cost of tapering medication, uneven reimbursement by insurers, and whether tapering medication should enter the basic package. The Minister answered that the evidence base for tapering is insufficient, that insurers reimburse tapering according to the multidisciplinary guideline and case-by-case, and that further research (TAPER-AD) is under way, so basic-package inclusion is not yet justified.
Without evidence, I cannot include treatments in the basic package.
Zonder bewijs kan ik geen behandelingen opnemen in het basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over longkankerpatiënten die overlijden zonder dat ze de beste behandeling kregen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that lung cancer patients miss targeted therapy because molecular testing (such as NGS) is not done uniformly across clinics, and about the use of immunotherapy without biomarker testing. The Minister acknowledges uneven testing and inequality, points to ongoing work with the Zorginstituut on molecular diagnostics and centralisation of complex diagnostics, but states no concrete new legal change.
I find it undesirable that patients currently do not have the same access to diagnostics and care.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat patiënten momenteel niet dezelfde toegang tot diagnostiek en zorg hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een borstkankerpatiënt naaktfoto’s van zichzelf moest opsturen naar de zorgverzekeraar

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether it is acceptable that a breast cancer patient had to send nude photos to her health insurer, and whether insurers will be told not to request such photos. The minister said photos should be shared only in a secure environment with patient consent, that the insurer must verify claims without judging treatment, and that Menzis and other insurers will review their procedures and inform providers.
I will also ask the other health insurers to review their procedures for exchanging photos in the context of authorisations and to actively bring them to the attention of care providers.
Ik zal ook de andere zorgverzekeraars vragen om hun procedures rondom het uitwisselen van foto's in het kader van machtigingen te bezien en bij zorgaanbieders actief onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht dat onderzoekers met het Zorginstituut een rekenmodel hebben ontwikkeld voor reële prijzen voor oude medicijnen die opnieuw op de markt komen

MP Paulusma asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Amsterdam UMC and Zorginstituut cost model for reasonable prices of old medicines relaunched as orphan drugs, and whether it could be applied more widely and to reimbursed drugs. The minister agreed excessive price hikes are undesirable, supported tighter EU orphan-drug rules, said the model suits only a limited set of drugs and is not a replacement for value-based pricing.
The Zorginstituut is currently exploring whether it is feasible to flag these kinds of developments at an early stage.
Het Zorginstituut is momenteel aan het verkennen of het haalbaar is om in een vroeg stadium dit soort ontwikkelingen te signaleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijnink over de overnameplannen van het IJsselland Ziekenhuis door het Erasmus MC

The SP MP Hijink asked the Minister for Medical Care about the planned takeover of IJsselland Hospital by Erasmus MC, including distance, patient choice, financial performance, consultation and whether cooperation would suffice. The Minister answered that the ACM is examining the takeover's effects on quality, accessibility and affordability, that the hospital is financially healthy, and that the ACM will assess the matter, declining to intervene.
The question of the extent to which such a takeover would lead to greater travel distances and less freedom of choice for patients is therefore the subject of the further investigation by the ACM.
De vraag in hoeverre een dergelijke overname zal leiden tot grotere reisafstanden en minder keuzevrijheid voor patiënten is dus onderwerp van het nadere onderzoek door de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de opbrengsten en meerwaarde van speeltuinen

An SP MP asked the government to respond to an Ecorys cost-benefit study claiming playground work yields €52 million a year, to address municipal funding shortfalls, and to adopt a national legal framework for playgrounds. The state secretary answered that playgrounds are a local responsibility, that the study's savings are indicative and mostly later and in other domains, and that no new national legislation is needed.
Playgrounds are primarily a matter for the local level.
Speeltuinen zijn primair een aangelegenheid van het lokale niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Bruins over het artikel ‘Zet kinderen niet onder druk met genderkeuze’

MPs Bisschop and Bruins asked whether a Rutgers teaching guide on intersex and sex diversity is scientifically sound, and about the rise in gender care referrals among young people. The ministers answered that schools are free to choose their sources, that Rutgers' subsidised role justifies the guide, and that research into the rise in referrals is being done in the Netherlands and abroad.
Schools have the freedom to choose which information sources they want to use.
Scholen hebben de vrijheid om zelf te kiezen welke informatiebronnen zij willen gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het toevoegen van illegale middelen aan traditionele medicijnen

Two MPs asked the ministers about illegal painkillers (paracetamol, meloxicam) found in the herbal supplement Montalin sold in Dutch webshops, the trade in endangered species in traditional medicines, and the need for follow-up research into the goods flow. The minister confirmed that the NVWA inspected five webshops, which stopped selling Montalin, that samples are being tested, and that follow-up research into the goods flow is complex and is being handled through existing NVWA and customs efforts.
The NVWA immediately started an investigation into the sale of Montalin in the Netherlands.
De NVWA is direct een onderzoek gestart naar de verkoop van Montalin in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de onzekere toekomst van het ziekenhuis in Zutphen

An MP asks the Minister about the uncertain future of the Gelre hospital in Zutphen, including whether emergency care, acute obstetrics and other basic services will be lost and how the proposed scaling-down is justified given the hospital's financial health. The Minister answers that Gelre is still examining its future configuration with stakeholders, that no closure decision has been taken, that the RIVM accessibility analysis would be required before any closure of acute services, and that the broader care landscape is a matter for a future cabinet.
Moreover, if there is a concrete intention to close the Zutphen location, an accessibility analysis must be requested from the RIVM by the hospital.
Overigens geldt als er een concreet voornemen is om de locatie Zutphen te sluiten er een bereikbaarheidsanalyse moeten worden opgevraagd bij het RIVM door het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de afwijzing van een nieuw medicijn tegen taaislijmziekte

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care why a new cystic fibrosis drug (Kaftrio) is not reimbursed in the Netherlands despite its benefits, its cost, the country comparison, the wait for patients, and whether societal benefits are weighed. The Minister replies that the Health Care Institute finds the cost-effectiveness very unfavourable at the asking price, that price negotiations are underway, that the manufacturer is partly responsible for the delay, and that societal benefits are included in the institute's analysis.
I will talk with the manufacturer about making Kaftrio available to patients during the negotiations.
Ik ga met de fabrikant in gesprek over het tijdens de onderhandelingen ter beschikking stellen van Kaftrio aan patiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Paternotte en Bikker over de mondkapjesdeal

Three MPs (Kuiken, Paternotte, Bikker) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the face mask purchase deal with Relief Goods Alliance, including overpayment, contacts with the initiators, disclosure of documents, and the role of the minister and secretary-general. The minister answered that the prices fell within the reasonable range at the time, shared a timeline of contacts and two purchase orders, but declined to publish the general conditions and deferred disclosure of the initiators' presentation to the company.
I have no objection to sharing this, but VWS is not the owner of this document.
Ik heb er geen bezwaar tegen om deze te delen, maar VWS is niet de eigenaar van dit document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over de problemen met het halen van je recht na een medische misser

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink asked about long claim-settlement times and high rejection rates for victims of medical errors, and about measures such as GOMA, a no-fault fund and a faster complaints route. The Minister of Medical Care answered that long durations are largely due to complex causation questions, that existing measures and a Chamber for long-running injury cases are being pursued, and that a no-fault fund is not supported because the Belgian experience showed little gain.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Paulusma over het bericht dat het Zorginstituut Nederland adviseert om een nieuw medicijn tegen taaislijmziekte niet op te nemen in het basispakket vanwege de te hoge prijs van f

MPs Kuiken and Paulusma asked the Minister of Medical Care about the Zorginstituut's advice not to add the cystic fibrosis drug Kaftrio to the basic package because of Vertex's price, and about joint European negotiation, transparency and legal tools against high drug prices. The Minister replied that the Institute advised conditional inclusion (including a price reduction), that joint Benelux negotiation was not considered opportune, that new price deals for existing CFTR modulators are not yet decided, and that she is pursuing price transparency and referred to her policy letter for further measures.
Joint negotiation is complex because the agreements already made on Orkambi and Symkevi are confidential.
Anderzijds is gezamenlijk onderhandelen complex omdat de reeds gemaakte afspraken over Orkambi en Symkevi vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over etikettering van producten uit illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An SP MP asked the government about a fine imposed on a wine importer for mislabelling products from Israeli settlements, whether duties are correctly levied on them, and how much is imported from settlements. The minister confirmed the fine, explained that origin labelling is enforced by the NVWA and customs on the basis of EU rules, and said neither the government nor the Commission has figures on settlement trade.
Customs cannot provide information on individual declarations because of its duty of confidentiality under EU customs legislation.
De Douane kan vanwege haar geheimhoudingsplicht op basis van EU-douanewetgeving geen informatie verstrekken over individuele aangiften
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over de NOS-berichten inzake matchfixing

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked the government about rising gambling addiction during the COVID crisis, the expected effects of opening the online gambling market, and matchfixing risks. The Minister answered that addiction trends cannot be verified because the LADIS database is not operational, that the market opening on 1 October 2021 will proceed with stricter prevention rules, and outlined existing matchfixing cooperation and reporting arrangements.
Unfortunately it is not possible to determine whether the number of people with a gambling addiction seeking help has increased.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om in beeld te brengen of het aantal mensen met een gokverslaving dat zich heeft gemeld bij hulpverlening is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Smeets over het fixen van matchfixing

MPs Van der Laan and Smeets asked about match-fixing, including how bookmakers, the FIU, the Wwft and privacy rules affect timely reporting to sports bodies, and who is responsible for what. The minister answered at length, setting out each actor's role, explaining that Wwft confidentiality can delay signals reaching sports bodies, and describing a planned 'fast lane' at the FIU to be evaluated after a year.
To prevent possible delay, it has been agreed with the sports federations that a so-called fast lane will be set up at the FIU-Netherlands for signals of possible match-fixing.
Om mogelijke vertraging te voorkomen is speciaal voor signalen van mogelijke matchfixing met de sportbonden afgesproken dat bij de FIU-Nederland een zogeheten fast lane zal worden vorm gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Nispen over kinderen die geen zwemdiploma halen

MPs Westerveld and Van Nispen asked why about 1% (later 4%) of children lack a swimming diploma, which groups are affected, what barriers exist including for children with disabilities, and what financial and quality measures the minister will take. The minister cited a Mulier Institute study finding about 45,000 children without a diploma, outlined planned research into motives and barriers due in 2021, referenced municipal fee schemes and the National Swimming Safety Plan, but committed to further study rather than concrete new measures.
I previously commissioned a repeat of the 2018 study.
Ik heb in een eerder stadium opdracht gegeven de studie van 2018 te herhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht '1.5 miljoen Nederlanders kunnen de tandarts niet betalen, Richard is een van hen: 'Mijn tanden waren afgebrokkeld''

Written questions from MP Hijink (SP) ask the Minister for Medical Care about reports that 1.5 million Dutch people cannot afford dental care and that funds in some cities are overwhelmed, and whether this justifies reversing the decision to exclude dental care from the basic insurance package. The Minister says the data on dental avoidance is unclear, points to municipal support and a planned review of compensation, rejects reinstating dental care in the basic package in favour of targeted local measures and a dental health monitor, and calls the economic-loss estimate uncertain.
I consider it of great importance that everyone in the Netherlands has access to good dental care.
Ik vind het van groot belang dat iedereen in Nederland toegang heeft tot goede mondzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Paternotte over het bericht 'Hoe vrouwen vergeten werden in het Covid-19-onderzoek'

MPs Van der Laan and Paternotte asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that women were overlooked in Covid-19 research, including whether sex differences should be studied in treatments and medication and whether the Netherlands will push this at EU level. The minister agrees sex should be considered in research, says the CBG review results do not directly require changes to regulatory guidelines, and states that the Gender and Gezondheid programme continues with 3 million euro proposed for 2021 and diversity requirements added to ZonMw funding.
Where appropriate, the Netherlands will emphasise the importance of including relevant diversity characteristics, including sex, in research.
Waar opportuun zal vanuit Nederland het belang worden onderstreept dat bij onderzoek relevante kenmerken van diversiteit, waaronder sekse, worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de verantwoordelijkheid van de Inspectie gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) bij meldingen over bijwerkingen van medische hulpmiddelen

An MP asked the minister how many complaints about the Essure implant reached the health inspectorate IGZ/IGJ from 2001 to 2017, what concrete steps it took and when, whether it adequately assessed the product's benefits against its risks, and whether it has adequate post-market surveillance and responsibility for handling such complaints. The minister answered with complaint figures from 2012 onward, described a chronology of consultations, Europe-wide coordination and a 2016 RIVM study, and argued that the inspectorate acted appropriately while the notified body and manufacturer carry primary responsibility.
The inspectorate continues to follow this file and is currently examining information recently obtained from research into the removal of Essure coils.
De inspectie blijft dit dossier volgen en onderzoekt momenteel informatie die recent beschikbaar is gekomen uit onderzoek naar het verwijderen van Essure-veertjes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan ‘over matchfixing en het Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR)’

An MP from D66 asked the minister about match-fixing in basketball and whether the private Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR) has enough powers and funding to investigate, and how it relates to the prosecution service and police. The minister answered that the ISR is a private body without investigative powers, that criminal investigation lies with police and prosecutors, and that extra funding for the ISR is aimed at handling more reports.
The ISR is a private organisation and therefore does not have the investigative powers reserved for our investigative authorities.
Het ISR is een private organisatie en heeft derhalve niet de beschikking over de opsporingsmiddelen die zijn voorbehouden aan onze opsporingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Esch over het feit dat er niet wordt ingegrepen bij een clusteruitbraak van bijna 100 coronabesmettingen bij Vion Boxtel

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care why no intervention follows a cluster of nearly 100 COVID-19 infections at the Vion Boxtel slaughterhouse, covering the earlier claimed inspection, cluster definition, comparisons with other sites, enforcement powers and worker exposure. The minister answers that the 2 March inspection did not take place, that the GGD sees no grounds for closure, that the Inspectie SZW lacks a closure power under the temporary COVID law but may halt work under the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet, and that a bill to allow mayoral closure is in preparation.
Currently the Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act does not provide the authority to order the closure of a location.
Momenteel biedt de Tijdelijke wet maatregelen COVID-19 niet de bevoegdheid om over te gaan tot sluiting van een locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat duizenden zorgmedewerkers de zorgbonus missen

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care why thousands of healthcare workers who believed they qualified for the COVID-19 care bonus did not receive it, whether this is unjust, how many were wrongly excluded, and whether the scheme was unclear. The Minister replies that the bonus was an employer-judged supplement, that applications depended on the care provider, that most eligible staff did receive a bonus, and that the criteria were clear except the broadly defined 'exceptional performance'.
Whether or not to grant the bonus was within the care provider's room for assessment.
Het wel of niet toekennen van de bonus behoorde tot de beoordelingsruimte van de zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over misleidende informatie van fabrikanten van hartkleppen

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about manufacturers of heart valves allegedly giving misleading size information on packaging, possible harm to patients, the roles of the IGJ and RIVM, unregistered implants and undisclosed Medtronic consultancy contracts. The Minister answers that no harm or wrongful valve sizing has been established, that existing rules and standards are adequate for now, that the IGJ saw no reason for enforcement, and that the transparency register is functioning well, while promising further talks with the IGJ and professional groups.
I will however discuss with the IGJ whether improvements to the system of standards can still be achieved.
Ik zal wel met de IGJ in gesprek gaan of er nog verbeteringen in het systeem van normen zijn te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het gedrag van zorgverzekeraars inzake voorschrijven op basis van medische noodzaak

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about insurer VGZ's preferred-medicine policy and its treatment of pharmacists, including tariff cuts and profiling, when doctors certify medical necessity for non-preferred drugs. The minister largely deflected: it called the policy a proven cost tool, said insurers should clarify their profiling transparently, acknowledged insurers may check medical necessity but must give substantive reasons to refuse reimbursement, and gave no quantified savings estimate beyond a general figure.
I can imagine that the health insurer first of all removes this unclarity and is transparent about its way of working.
Ik kan me voorstellen dat de zorgverzekeraar allereerst deze onduidelijkheid wegneemt en transparant is over de werkwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Massale diagnosefraude bij behandeling burn-out’

An SP MP asked the minister about reports of mass diagnosis fraud in burn-out treatment, whether psychologists are changing diagnoses to get treatment reimbursed, and why burn-out care was removed from the basic insurance package. The minister called misdeclaration unacceptable, pointed to NZa oversight and past fines, explained burn-out is not a disorder and refers people to occupational care and GPs, and declined to reconsider.
When care for a burn-out diagnosis is claimed from the health insurer as basic-package care, there is at least unlawfully claimed care.
Wanneer bij een diagnose burn-out de zorg wordt gedeclareerd bij de zorgverzekeraar als zorg die onder het basispakket valt, is op zijn minst sprake van onrechtmatig gedeclareerde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over "de crisissteunmaatregelen voor amateursportverenigingen"

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked why amateur sports clubs filing nil payroll returns for June 2020 are excluded from NOW 3.0 wage support while others get a fallback month, and asked for a fix. The minister says the rules are not unjust, points to the TASO scheme as a compensation route, and says the government is examining widening TASO for the first two quarters of 2021 without changing the NOW reference month.
In addition, it is being examined whether the TASO scheme for the first and second quarters of 2021 can be widened to support sports associations as appropriately as possible with wage costs.
Daarnaast wordt onderzocht of de TASO-regeling voor het eerste en tweede kwartaal van 2021 kan worden verruimd om sportverenigingen zo passend mogelijk te ondersteunen in de loonkosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Von Martels over "amateurvoetbalverenigingen die in financiële problemen komen vanwege een bureaucratische regel van de overheid"

Two CDA MPs asked why amateur football clubs miss NOW 3.0 wage compensation because June 2020 was chosen as the reference month, when many clubs have no trainers on payroll during the summer break. The minister acknowledges the problem but says no fix is possible without undue risk, points clubs to the TASO scheme, and says the government is looking at extending TASO for the first and second quarters.
The cabinet hopes in this way to meet the amateur clubs.
Het kabinet hoopt hiermee de amateurclubs tegemoet te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Reddingsbrigade Nederland maakt zich ernstige zorgen over start zomerseizoen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Ministers of Medical Care and Infrastructure about the Reddingsbrigade's concerns over lifeguard preparation for summer and the impact of pool closures on children's swimming lessons. The Minister answered that swimming lessons for children up to 12 have resumed, that the Reddingsbrigade may now train if commissioned by safety regions, and that a meeting with the brigade has taken place.
This conversation has now taken place and the Reddingsbrigade has the opportunity to practise and provide training in the context of water safety.
Inmiddels heeft dit gesprek plaatsgevonden en heeft de Reddingsbrigade de mogelijkheid om te oefenen en opleidingen te verzorgen in het kader van de waterveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Reddingsbrigade ernstige zorgen heeft over het zomerseizoen

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the minister understands the Reddingsbrigade's concern that COVID-19 measures prevent lifeguards from preparing for the summer season, and whether exemptions will be granted so they can train in pools and open water. The minister answers that the Reddingsbrigade has been informed that lifeguards with a mandate to supervise official swimming locations may train under an exemption from the group-formation ban and the safe-distance rule, and that practical certification may take place in pools.
We have since been in contact with Reddingsbrigade Nederland to explain how they can train within the current applicable measures
Wij hebben inmiddels contact gehad met Reddingsbrigade Nederland om toe te lichten op welke wijze zij binnen de huidige geldende maatregelen kunnen trainen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Leraar Khalid A. had meiden dansschool ‘volledig in de greep’: ‘Naar de top in ruil voor seks’'

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether a dance teacher who allegedly abused girls was able to act for so long, whether screening tools suffice to keep abusers out of sports and youth settings, and what the 15 million euro structural funding for sex-crime capacity has achieved. The government answered that it cannot comment on ongoing criminal investigations, relies on the VOG screening and the abuser register, sees no added value in a dedicated prosecutor for cross-database pattern searches, and reports about 90 new detectives phased in.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de berichten waaruit blijkt dat sprake is van tekortkomingen bij het Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR)

MP Westerveld asks the Minister for Medical Care about shortcomings at the Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR), the pace of its professionalisation, handling times and suspended cases in gymnastics abuse complaints, the risk of contact between accused coaches and victims, whether reporting is deterred by sports federation involvement, and aid for former gymnasts including the motion on acute help and access to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven. The Minister replies that professionalisation is progressing as fast as feasible, handling times are hard to predict, the accused may be instructed by federation measures not to contact complainants, and a Schadefonds route has been explored but victims must meet generic conditions.
The Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR) recently appointed a kwartiermaker to help shape the organisation further.
Het Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR) heeft onlangs een kwartiermaker aangesteld die de organisatie verder gaat helpen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over passende zorg bij complexe zorgvragen

An MP from D66 asks the Minister for Medical Care about the failure to provide appropriate care for a young man with autism and intellectual disability, the role of the IGJ and complaints rules, waiting lists for complex care, and related policy issues. The minister answers that privacy limits specifics, describes the IGJ's powers and the Juiste Loket and Unit Complexe Zorgvragen routes, and provides waiting list data and outlines programmes like Volwaardig Leven, though many questions are answered with general descriptions rather than specific commitments.
Because of the client's privacy and situation, I cannot go into this case in too much detail.
Vanwege de privacy van de cliënt en diens situatie kan ik niet al te specifiek ingaan op deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over alternatieve zorg tijdens de lockdown

MP Dik-Faber asked the health minister about the closure of alternative care (complementary therapies and lactation care) during the lockdown, citing a petition, CBS usage figures and health harms. The minister answered that the ban on contact professions, which covered alternative care, was a necessary emergency measure, has since been lifted, and that lactation care is again available, while declining to seek new OMT advice.
The temporary ban on contact professions also included a ban on providing alternative care.
Het tijdelijke verbod op het uitoefenen van contactberoepen hield ook een verbod op het verlenen van alternatieve zorg in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Hartklepfabrikanten misleiden hartchirurgen en patiënten’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that heart valve manufacturers omit correct sizes on packaging and influence standards and professional bodies, raising patient risk. The minister replied that no evidence of harmful sizing errors has been found beyond one signal, points to an updated ISO standard and ongoing registry analyses, rejects a motion to ban all gifts to doctors, and will talk with NEN and the IGJ on standards and patient representation.
I will however discuss with the IGJ whether improvements to the system of standards can still be achieved.
Ik zal wel met de IGJ in gesprek gaan of er nog verbeteringen in het systeem van normen zijn te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de Corona Opt-In, de wijze waarop mensen hun medische gegevens kunnen beschermen en mogelijk verkeerde antwoorden van de minister

An MP asks whether the Corona Opt-In, which opens medical records of about 8 million people who never consented to access by emergency services, remains in force, why it cannot be ended, who can view the data, and whether oversight of access is adequate. The minister replies that the measure remains necessary, that access is limited to authorised professionals with consent and logging, that pharmacies have no access, and that hospital audits are being arranged.
I believe that sufficient safeguards have been built into the Corona Opt-In to let the measure continue for as long as necessary within the Covid-19 context.
Ik vind dat er in het kader van de Corona Opt-in voldoende waarborgen zijn ingebouwd om de maatregel zolang noodzakelijk in het kader van Covid-19 te laten voortduren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over zorgverzekeraars die ALS-patiënten op oneigenlijke gronden overhevelen naar de langdurige zorg.

MP Kuiken asks whether insurers push ALS patients into long-term care (Wlz) by challenging their indications, and whether this is financially motivated and consistent with the duty of care. The minister answers that insurers may not force a Wlz application, that palliative terminal patients keep their insurance-based care, that risk-equalisation settles costs and that the NZa is handling the complaint independently.
A health insurer cannot force a client to apply for a Wlz indication.
Een zorgverzekeraar kan een cliënt niet dwingen om een indicatie voor de Wlz aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de uitrol van 5G

An MP asked the government about the health effects of 5G radiation and whether more independent research should precede rollout, citing a Journal of Epidemiology article calling for the precautionary principle. The government replied that ICNIRP limits, endorsed by the Gezondheidsraad and confirmed by a court, adequately protect health, and that it will pursue further research such as the COSMOS project.
The cabinet will, as advised by the Health Council, pursue more research.
Het kabinet zal zoals geadviseerd door de Gezondheidsraad inzetten op meer onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over onrechtmatig handelen van zorgverzekeraars aangaande de uitvoering van de Zorgverzekeringswet

MP Hijink asks the minister about health insurers allegedly pressuring ALS patients to move from the Zvw to long-term care (Wlz), refusing care hours and undermining palliative care agreements. The minister replies that insurers may not refuse patients for financial reasons, that the Wlz is only reached via CIZ assessment, and that insurers may check, but not force, Wlz eligibility, while promising no change beyond existing procedures.
It is not permitted for health insurers to try to exclude patients for financial reasons.
Het is niet toegestaan dat zorgverzekeraars uit financiële overwegingen patiënten proberen te weren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Westerveld over het ontbreken van zwemlessen voor kinderen

MPs Van Nispen and Westerveld asked the minister why swimming lessons for children remained suspended and how the risks to child water safety, compensation and reopening were being addressed. The minister acknowledged the sector's disappointment, announced that pools reopen for swimming lessons for children up to 12 from 16 March, and said the Nationale Raad Zwemveiligheid is consulted on resumption.
With this adjustment the cabinet wants to prevent a generation of children without a swimming diploma entering the summer.
Met deze aanpassing wil het kabinet voorkomen dat een generatie kinderen zonder zwemdiploma de zomer in gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Tienduizenden jonge, gezonde mensen gesloopt door corona: ‘Ik neem afscheid van wie ik was’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Medical Care about the four-month referral deadline for paramedical recovery care after COVID-19, and whether it is evidence-based and understood by patients. The minister defends the time limit as rarely a problem in practice, points to a C-support case route and ongoing research, and says the scheme's continuation is still under consideration.
The temporary scheme targets people in the recovery phase after COVID-19 who need paramedical support.
De tijdelijke regeling richt zich op de mensen die in de herstelfase na covid-19 behoefte hebben aan paramedische ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Molen over opleidingsplekken voor huisartsen, physican assistants en verpleegkundig specialisten

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Medical Care and of Education about shortages of GP training places and the funding of physician assistant and nurse specialist training, and whether the Capacity Plan advice could be followed. The government answered that more trainers are needed, that intake is growing more slowly than advised, and that about 22.6 million euros structurally would be needed for the GP advice, with no funds currently available.
At this moment no funds are available in the budgets of OCW and VWS to finance this.
Op dit moment zijn geen middelen beschikbaar op de begroting van OCW en VWS om dit te bekostigen.
