Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de Radar-uitzending 'Groeiremmers en verminderde vruchtbaarheid, wat wisten medici?'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Radar broadcast on growth inhibitors (ethinylestradiol) and reduced fertility, including how many girls were prescribed them, whether the drug should still be given to healthy girls, whether research and compensation or IVF coverage should follow. The minister replied that the drug is registered and still prescribed in limited numbers, that fertility risk has been in the leaflet since 2012, that the CBG will raise awareness with specialists, and that IVF coverage will not be extended because the cause of reduced fertility is not relevant to eligibility.
I have made inquiries with the Medicines Evaluation Board (CBG).
Ik heb navraag gedaan bij het College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over mondzorg in het basispakket

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about adding dental care to the basic insurance package, including costs, premiums, access for low-income people, and productivity losses. The minister answered that evidence is insufficient to confirm dental care saves costs elsewhere, that adding it would raise premiums by about 15 euro per year, and that a new monitor of oral health will start in 2022.
I consider it important that structural information becomes available on the oral health of people in the Netherlands.
Ik vind het van belang dat er structurele informatie beschikbaar komt over de mondgezondheid van mensen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over tekortschietende toegankelijkheid voor mensen met een assistentiehond

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Medical Care about refusals of assistance dogs in supermarkets, medical settings, taxis and hospitality despite the legal duty to admit them, and proposed measures such as uniform identification and sector campaigns. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to the ongoing European standardisation track and sector campaigns with business associations, and declined a national hospital protocol or a foreign comparison study.
I would point out that an assistance dog must in principle be admitted, unless this would impose a disproportionate burden, for example because safety or health is at stake.
Ik wil daarbij wel markeren dat een assistentiehond in beginsel toegelaten moet worden, tenzij dit een onevenredige belasting vormt bijvoorbeeld omdat de veiligheid of de gezondheid in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het antwoord op eerdere schriftelijke vragen en de uitzending van Argos ‘Spraakverwarring in de spreekkamer’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the availability of professional interpreters for non-Dutch speakers in healthcare, the funding of interpreter costs, and the standard on interpreter use, following a broadcast on language barriers in consulting rooms. The Minister said the inspectorate sees interpreter use well established in asylum centres but less so in primary care, that the Zorginstituut has no planning yet for a quality standard, that NZa tariffs cover interpreter costs in principle, and that the Minister will talk with the Zorginstituut and NZa about funding and regulatory bottlenecks.

Yes, I will talk with the Zorginstituut and the NZa about the use and funding of interpreters in healthcare to inventory whether bottlenecks exist in current regulations that hinder funding of necessary interpreter use.

Ja, ik ga met het Zorginstituut en de NZa in gesprek over de inzet en financiering van tolken in de zorg om te inventariseren of in de huidige regelgeving knelpunten bestaan die het financieren van noodzakelijke tolkeninzet bemoeilijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verzekering van kraamzorg bij draagmoederschap

An MP asks whether intended parents of a child born via a surrogate can claim postnatal care (kraamzorg) under the basic insurance, whether the eight-day transfer matters, and whether the Landelijk Indicatieprotocol should explicitly cover surrogacy and intended parents. The minister answers that intended parents are fully entitled, that care can be delayed or covered by supplementary insurance, that the protocol is being revised with completion expected end 2022, and that consultation bureaux are adequately equipped.
Intended parents, adoptive parents and foster parents, regardless of whether they are same-sex or opposite-sex couples, can fully claim reimbursement for postnatal care.
Wensouders, adoptieouders en pleegouders (hierna: wensouders), ongeacht of het paren van gelijk geslacht of verschillend geslacht betreft, kunnen volledig aanspraak maken op vergoeding van kraamzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Neusspray tegen depressie: oude wijn in nieuwe verpakking'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the high price of esketamine nasal spray for depression compared with the older injectable form, the lack of justification for Janssen's price, and whether the patent was justified. The minister said the product is not reimbursed yet, that she is negotiating a financial arrangement with the manufacturer as advised by the Zorginstituut, and that she will ask Janssen for cost information, while explaining that patent rules for new uses of known substances apply strict requirements.
The company Janssen has not provided any justification for the price of esketamine nasal spray.
De firma Janssen heeft geen onderbouwing gegeven voor de prijs van esketamine neusspray.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de verhuizing van een huisartsenpost naar Roosendaal

An MP asked the minister whether the move of the Bergen op Zoom out-of-hours GP post to Roosendaal, which affects Tholen residents, had been properly decided with consultation of affected parties and whether travel times meet the 30-minute norm. The minister answered that the decision is still provisional, that consultation with residents has been postponed due to Covid-19, and that a RIVM analysis shows 97.8% of residents can still reach a post within 30 minutes.

I therefore consider it important that decision-making on changes to acute care provision proceeds properly and that before a final decision a number of process steps are carefully followed, including early consultation of residents, municipalities, health insurers and care providers.

Ik acht het daarom van belang dat besluitvorming over wijzigingen in het zorgaanbod van acute zorg op een goede manier verloopt en dat voor het nemen van een definitief besluit een aantal processtappen zorgvuldig worden doorlopen, waaronder vroegtijdige consultatie van bewoners, gemeenten, zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Restcapaciteit reguliere zorg bleef lang onbenut'

MP Hijink asked whether the minister is shocked that regular-care capacity stayed partly unused during the first COVID wave for strategic reasons, whether hospitals avoided referring patients out of competition concerns, and whether insurers' safety-net arrangement encouraged hospitals to keep patients. The minister denied knowledge of deliberate withholding, attributed the unused capacity to nationwide scaling-down and reduced referrals, and committed to no further action beyond existing monitoring and a planned insurer-hospital financial settlement framework.
I am not aware of any facts indicating that care capacity was deliberately left unused during the first wave.
Er zijn mij geen feiten bekend over zorgcapaciteit die tijdens de eerste golf doelbewust onbenut is gebleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over onvoldoende reguliere zorg door strategische belangen van ziekenhuizen en onvoldoende regie van zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked whether hospitals and insurers left regular care unused during the first COVID wave for strategic or financial reasons, and whether insurers' regulatory role failed patients. The minister denied knowledge of deliberate withholding, said capacity was reduced for pandemic reasons, and described insurer intermediation and financing arrangements without committing to new measures.
I am not aware of any facts showing that care capacity was deliberately left unused during the first wave.
Er zijn mij geen feiten bekend over zorgcapaciteit die tijdens de eerste golf doelbewust onbenut is gebleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat zorginstelling ’s Heeren Loo de zorg in Zeeland centraliseert

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the plan by care organisation 's Heeren Loo to concentrate disabled clients in large central residential parks in Zeeland, moving them away from small-scale housing, complies with the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. The Minister rejected the characterisation of this as a step back, said the plan improves quality and safety and was agreed with regulators, and gave general assurances about consultation with residents, but did not address the convention articles on substance or commit to any specific step.
I do not consider achieving good-quality care and safety a step back in time.
Ik vind het realiseren van kwalitatief goede zorg en veiligheid geen stap terug in de tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over COVID-19-herstelzorg door fysiotherapeuten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about problems with the temporary COVID-19 paramedical recovery care scheme, including the four-month referral window, the mandatory specialist referral for a second treatment period, and whether the scheme will be extended beyond 1 August. The minister said no official national figures exist yet, pointed to an advisory committee and implementation consultations to examine tight rules, and said she is still considering whether and how the scheme will continue.
However, there are not yet official national figures available on the number of patients or costs within the temporary scheme for paramedical recovery care.
Er zijn echter nog geen officiële, landelijke cijfers beschikbaar over aantallen patiënten of kosten binnen de tijdelijke regeling voor paramedische herstelzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Hoe een bejubeld personeelsplan in de zorg toch sneuvelde’

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about press reports that a praised staffing plan for healthcare was dropped, and about the slow results of regional and national scale-up plans for covid-era staffing. The minister's answers largely defer to other parties and existing programmes, describe the scale-up plans and subsidies, and decline to say how much extra staff was delivered.
I have no insight into how much extra staff the local and regional scale-up plans have delivered.
Ik heb geen zicht op hoeveel extra personeel de lokale en regionale opschalingsplannen hebben opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Slechte eigenrisicokeuzes maken de zorgverzekering duurder voor laagopgeleiden'

MP Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care how to respond to research showing that people with lower education or income more often choose a low voluntary deductible, making insurance more expensive for them, and whether abolishing the voluntary deductible would be fairer. The Minister acknowledges the pattern, points to consumer information initiatives and financial literacy efforts, notes that about 13 percent of insured persons choose a voluntary deductible, and argues that the cross-subsidy cost is small (about 3 euro per person) and that abolishing it would raise care spending by about 100 million euro per year.
I consider it important that insured persons are well informed about the voluntary deductible.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat verzekerden goed geïnformeerd worden over het vrijwillig eigen risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Diertens over tekortkomingen bij het Instituut Sportrechtspraak

MPs Westerveld and Diertens asked the Minister for Medical Care about shortcomings at the Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR), including halted cases of former gymnasts, case duration, melder safety, capacity and alternatives for athletes. The minister answered that cases are not halted but under external review, promised extra funding and a kwartiermaker for professionalisation, and said the KNGU talks and aftercare will follow the April investigation outcomes.
The Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak (ISR) is an independent organisation.
Het Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak (ISR) is een onafhankelijke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Horizon’s Tepezza supply dwindles as manufacturer Catalent pivots to Warp Speed Vaccines’

MP Veldman asked the Minister for Medical Care whether non-COVID medicine supply is being delayed or cancelled because production capacity is shifted to COVID-19 vaccines, and what risks, measures and patient safeguards apply. The Minister answered that no shortage reports attribute delays to vaccine prioritisation, that the Meldpunt monitors notifications and manufacturers are legally required to report expected shortages, and that alternatives are usually found for affected patients.
The Meldpunt for medicine shortages and defects has received no reports of expected supply problems with the reason being a change in the prioritisation of production capacity for vaccines.
Bij het Meldpunt geneesmiddelentekorten en -defecten zijn geen meldingen van verwachte leveringsproblemen met als reden verandering in prioritering van productiecapaciteit ten behoeve van vaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'HTM-directeur Bruno Bruins wordt commissaris bij vaccin-instituut'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether appointing former minister Bruno Bruins as a supervisory board member of Intravacc, shortly after leaving office, creates conflict of interest given the lobbying ban and his role in planning its privatisation. The minister replied that the Corporate Governance Code and the lobbying circular were applied, that Bruins was recruited for his political-administrative experience and had no role in the operational decision, and that the post pays EUR 27,500 per year.
The appointment process took into account the Dutch Corporate Governance Code and the Circular on the lobbying ban for ministers and state secretaries.
In het benoemingsproces zijn de Nederlandse Corporate Governance Code en de Circulaire lobbyverbod Bewindspersonen meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over fysiotherapie

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about an Ecorys report finding physiotherapy may substitute costlier care and whether it should be covered by the basic package, and about why the Zorginstituut judged cost-effectiveness differently. The Minister agreed in principle that cost-effective care should be covered, pointed to existing programmes and the Zorginstituut's ongoing review, and said he would leave the assessment of the Ecorys findings to the Zorginstituut and inform parliament in spring 2021.
In spring 2021 I will receive a progress letter from the Zorginstituut on the transition trajectory for the system advice on physiotherapy and exercise therapy.
In het voorjaar van 2021 ontvang ik een voortgangsbrief van het Zorginstituut met betrekking tot het overgangstraject systeemadvies fysio- en oefentherapie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het kabinet het vaccininstituut Intravacc alsnog wil verkopen

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked why the cabinet would sell vaccine institute Intravacc during the pandemic despite the need for domestic vaccine production and dependence on foreign supply. The minister replied that no sale decision has been taken; Intravacc is placed in a temporary state-owned holding for up to two years, with a final decision left to the next cabinet.
There is therefore currently no question of a decision to sell the vaccine institute Intravacc.
Er is op dit moment dan ook geen sprake van een besluit tot het verkopen van vaccininstituut Intravacc.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Kuik over het bericht 'Schrikbarend veel misbruik van ADHD-medicatie onder Nederlandse studenten'

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether they were alarmed by reports of widespread non-medical use of ADHD medication by Dutch students to boost academic performance, what the Trimbos/RIVM monitor shows, and what action will be taken, including about illegal online medicine sellers registered abroad. The minister answered that the monitor results arrive in mid-2021, that signals are being taken seriously and that action will follow if the monitor does not reassure, and that IGJ has no formal power over websites hosted abroad, though it takes part in Interpol's Operation PANGEA.
If the outcome does not provide a reassuring picture, I am prepared to take action to curb the undesirable development.
Als de uitkomst geen geruststellend beeld oplevert, ben ik bereid over te gaan tot actie om de ongewenste ontwikkeling af te remmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de parkeertarieven bij het Albert Schweitzer ziekenhuis verdrievoudigen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the planned tripling of parking fees at the Albert Schweitzer hospital and whether staff, patients and visitors should pay less. The minister answered that parking policy and tariffs are the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities and depend on local context, and declined to comment on the hospital's appeal against the zoning plan, which is a matter between the hospital and the municipality.
Parking policy and the associated tariffs are the responsibility of healthcare providers and municipalities and depend on the local context.
Het parkeerbeleid en de bijhorende tarieven zijn een verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders en gemeenten en afhankelijk van de lokale context.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Medische hulpmiddelen: de patiënt betaalt de rekening'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether medical aids prescribed as medically necessary must be reimbursed, whether insurers are squeezing supplier prices, who is responsible for patients getting the right aids, and whether producers are leaving the market. The Minister explained the medical indication and insurance coverage rules, said insurers face lower prices and the Bestuurlijk Overleg Hulpmiddelenzorg is tackling transparency, and noted no concrete signals of supply risk, with insurers responsible for alternatives.
For the BOH, patient associations also regularly conduct surveys to collect bottlenecks.
Ten behoeve van het BOH worden door patiëntverenigingen ook regelmatig enquêtes uitgevoerd om knelpunten te verzamelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Medische hulpmiddelen: de patiënt betaalt de rekening'

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a report on a patient paying about 800 euro a year for hulpmiddelen (medical aids) that the insurer refused to reimburse, and about stoma patients not receiving the right aids. The minister said the individual case is before the courts, pointed to an ongoing study on cumulative patient costs, explained the medical-indication framework, and promised to raise the issue again in the Bestuurlijk Overleg Hulpmiddelenzorg, while noting that disputes can go to the civil courts or the SKGZ.
The case of this specific patient is currently before the court.
De casus van deze specifieke patiënt ligt op dit moment voor aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over opleidingsplaatsen voor huisartsen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about the shortage of GP training places in Zeeland, a basic doctor's placement in Zwolle rather than Zeeland, and whether the placement rules allow exceptions. The minister said the central placement system aims at even regional spread, that no exceptions are possible after formal placement, and that complaints can be filed with the Commissie Uitvoering Selectie.
After formal placement, no exception is possible.
Na de formele plaatsing is geen uitzondering mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over de onderzoeken naar de werking van mondmaskers

MPs Marijnissen and Hijink asked the Minister for Medical Care about the scientific basis for claims that face masks could create false security, and about whether RIVM guidance discouraged medical mask use in care settings. The minister referred to earlier answers, said RIVM guidance is evidence-based, denied that its statements covered medical masks in care, and noted that a procurement route via ROAZ existed.
RIVM does not speak in its guidance of reluctance to use medical face masks in care.
Het RIVM spreekt in de uitgangspunten niet over terughoudendheid in het gebruik van medische mondmaskers in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het bericht 'Medisch specialisten haken af door werkdruk: 'het was structureel''

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that medical specialists in training leave due to workload, including costs lost, acceptable working hours, which specialties are most affected, and whether training more doctors would reduce workload. The minister answered that dropout is about 10% and stable, workload is high across specialties, the Capacity Body's advice on training numbers is followed, and the response lies in improving the work and learning climate on the shop floor.
The reasons for dropout are not investigated.
De redenen voor de uitval worden niet onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Ziekenhuizen zuinig met dure darmkankerbehandeling'

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the minister whether hospitals' restraint in prescribing expensive targeted colorectal cancer therapy, the differences between hospitals, and a VGZ refusal to purchase a drug indicate undertreatment, financial motives, conflict with the motion against postcode medicine, and patient information gaps. The minister answered that the prescribing variation cannot be judged as undesirable from these figures, that no financial signals are known, that patients have information rights under the WGBO, and that VGZ follows the CieBAG advice.
However, on the basis of these figures I cannot assess whether there is undesirable variation.
Op basis van deze cijfers kan ik echter niet beoordelen of hier sprake is van ongewenste variatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Weyenberg over instroom in de WIA van mensen met ME/CVS

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Van Weyenberg asked whether people with ME/CVS who cannot work are not classed as fully incapacitated, whether WIA reassessments rely on outdated assessments, and about appeals, regional inflow and the Raemakers motion. Minister Koolmees answered that UWV assesses earning capacity case by case, that a fresh WIA claim assessment is always done by an occupational physician, that the Raemakers motion is being implemented, and gave appeal and regional inflow figures.
An insured person with ME/CVS may be eligible for a reassessment if the occupational physician found at the previous assessment that the insured person had not done enough to recover.

Een verzekerde met ME/CVS komt mogelijk in aanmerking voor een herbeoordeling indien de verzekeringsarts bij de vorige beoordeling heeft vastgesteld dat de verzekerde niet voldoende gedaan had aan zijn herstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over het bericht 'Wederom groot aantal geneesmiddelentekorten'

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reported drug shortages, when the government was informed, what measures were taken and planned, why no significant steps had been made on a strategic stockpile, and whether patients suffered complications. The minister acknowledges the long-running shortage problem, points to EU-level research, the national shortage reporting point and a stockpile being mapped, and states that most shortages are resolved without serious harm for patients.
I am therefore currently mapping how other European countries have organised their stockpile policy.
Ik breng daarom op dit moment in kaart op welke wijze andere Europese landen hun voorraadbeleid ingericht hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de wijze waarop verzekeringsartsen omgaan met de aanbevelingen van de Gezondheidsraad en de beleidsdocumenten van het UWV omtrent ME/CVS

An SP MP asked the Minister whether insurance physicians must weigh Health Council recommendations and UWV policy documents on ME/CVS, whether they may depart from them, and how the GAV and NVVG positions align. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, said UWV policy and guidelines are the basis for assessments with justified deviation allowed, and pointed to a Zorginstituut quality standard process with a deadline of 1 October 2021.
It does not befit me to go into this individual case in more detail.
Het past mij niet om nader in te gaan op deze individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Ommelander Ziekenhuis zet ‘laatste stappen’ in financiële herziening’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about press reports on the financial difficulties of the Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groningen, including guarantees on emergency and obstetric care, staff job losses, NZa and ministry involvement. The minister answered that there are no acute financial problems, that negotiations with insurers and financiers are ongoing, that access to care is a matter for insurers under their duty of care, and that the NZa sees no short-term risk while the ministry would escalate only if needed.
OZG does not consider it wise to publish an interim balance in public while those talks are ongoing.
OZG vindt het niet verstandig gedurende die gesprekken in het openbaar een tussenbalans op te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het tekenen van een contract om de zorgbonus terug te moeten betalen als deze niet wordt uitgekeerd

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether employers require staff to sign contracts agreeing to repay the healthcare bonus if the employer does not receive the subsidy, and what the government will do. The minister says this is not good employership, that the risk should not be shifted onto care workers, and that employers have been asked to act in line with the subsidy rules, while staff are advised to raise concerns with the works council.
In my view this does not reflect good employership, and the risk of not meeting the subsidy conditions and obligations is not meant to be shifted onto the care professional.

Het getuigt wat mij betreft niet van goed werkgeverschap en het is ook niet de bedoeling dat het risico van het niet voldoen aan de subsidievoorwaarden en -verplichtingen wordt afgewenteld op de zorgprofessional.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over gebruik van remdesivir bij de behandeling van patiënten besmet met het covid-19 virus

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why Dutch treatment advice on remdesivir was not changed after the WHO advised against it, and questioned its effectiveness, cost (about 2,000 euro per treatment versus low production cost), and Gilead's profits. The Minister defended continued use as a medical-professional matter, said the EMA narrowed the indication, acknowledged the pricing raises questions, and said the Netherlands pressed the EU procurement committee for a price reduction, while withholding financial details citing a confidentiality clause.
Due to a confidentiality obligation within this agreement, I cannot make any financial statements.
In verband met een geheimhoudingsverplichting binnen deze overeenkomst kan ik geen financiële mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Kwart van de jongedokters overweegt te stoppen met opleiding’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that a quarter of young doctors consider quitting their training, citing overtime, workload and lack of supervision. The minister acknowledged the concern, said working hours are set in collective agreements and that supervision is the supervisor's call, and promised to explore workload measures with hospitals and young doctors.
Residents and assistant residents must be able to carry out their training and work in a safe environment with sufficient attention to workload and overtime.
Aios en anios moeten hun opleiding en werk in een veilige omgeving kunnen uitvoeren waar voldoende aandacht is voor werkdruk en overwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Onverwacht zwanger door nieuw koperspiraaltje'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of unexpected pregnancies and expulsions with the Ballerine copper IUD, including whether the product should be withdrawn, whether registration requires randomized evidence, and whether conflicts of interest exist with a clinic and distributor. The Minister answered that reports are being monitored by the IGJ and MEBI, that the IGJ has asked French authorities and the notified body for clarification and will publish a summary, and that the current certification system with notified bodies will be retained.
The IGJ is currently working on an assessment of all information, including the ongoing investigation by the notified body into the Ballerine coil.
De IGJ werkt momenteel aan een duiding van alle informatie, waaronder het lopende onderzoek van de betrokken notified body naar de Ballerine spiraal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Özütok, Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Onverwacht zwanger door nieuw koperspiraaltje'

MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of unexpected pregnancies and expulsions linked to the Ballerine copper IUD, including how adverse events are reported, what risk assessment is underway, and how EU medical device rules and notified body oversight will protect patients. The Minister answered that the IGJ is analysing the reports, that a MEBI alert is planned, and that the EU MDR applying from May 2021 will tighten requirements, while acknowledging room for improvement.
Furthermore, I call on healthcare providers, manufacturers and patients to continue reporting their complaints and side effects related to medical devices through the available channels.
Verder roep ik zorgverleners, fabrikanten en patiënten op hun klachten en bijwerkingen met betrekking tot medische hulpmiddelen te blijven melden via de beschikbare kanalen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Op weg naar de juridische fusie’

An SP MP asked the health and education ministers about reported plans for a legal merger of AMC and VUmc, including a Stichting Amsterdam UMC target of 1 January 2022, staff and emergency-department concerns, and the need for WHW amendment. The minister answered that the bestuurlijke fusie was completed in 2018, that the legal merger requires a WHW amendment to be submitted around end-2021, that the Kamer was informed in November 2020, and that staff and patient councils were involved, while the SEH closure timeline is not yet decided.
The bill amending the law so that the desired cooperation can be facilitated is aimed to be submitted to the House by the end of 2021.
Het wetsvoorstel waarmee de wet zodanig wordt gewijzigd dat de gewenste samenwerking kan worden gefaciliteerd, eind 2021 in te dienen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Kerstens over de zorgbonus die pas in 2023 wordt uitgekeerd

Three PvdA MPs asked why some care workers may not receive the 1,000 euro corona bonus until 2023, why small care organisations remain unclear about eligibility, and whether workers should be asked to sign repayment undertakings. The minister called waiting until 2023 unacceptable under the subsidy rules, said workers should not bear the risk of repayment, and noted most subsidies have already been paid out while directing questions to the employer and DUS-I.
Following these reports I have already told employers what the intention is and asked them to act in line with the purpose, conditions and obligations of the Subsidy Scheme.

Ik heb naar aanleiding van deze berichten reeds richting werkgevers aangegeven wat de bedoeling is en hen verzocht in lijn met het doel, de voorwaarden en de verplichtingen van de Subsidieregeling te handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over microplastics in placenta’s van ongeboren baby’s

An MP asked several ministers about reports that microplastics were found in unborn babies' placentas, and about the health risks, product bans and parental information. The government acknowledges the concern, says there is insufficient evidence on health effects, and points to ZonMw research, a knowledge agenda, and planned EU-level and environmental measures without committing to bans or consumer warnings.
There is currently insufficient knowledge to conclude whether microplastic particles pose a danger to the development of unborn babies.
Er is op dit moment onvoldoende kennis om de conclusie te kunnen trekken of microplasticdeeltjes een gevaar vormen voor de ontwikkeling van ongeboren baby's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het belang van het openhouden van speeltuinen

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister why regional safety authorities closed managed playgrounds during the COVID-19 lockdown, given children's need for outdoor play, and whether an exception should be made. The State Secretary answered that closing public places including managed playgrounds is necessary to limit virus spread for now, that outdoor play is important, and that the measures are temporary and will be reviewed.
That is why the cabinet had to take further measures to close public places, including managed playgrounds, until at least 9 February 2021.
Daarom heeft het kabinet verdergaande maatregelen moeten treffen om tot in elk geval 9 februari 2021 publieke plaatsen te sluiten, met inbegrip van beheerde speeltuinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van donderdagavond 10 december 2020 'Sterke stijging anorexiapatiënten tijdens coronacrisis'

CDA MPs asked the government about a Nieuwsuur report on a sharp rise in anorexia patients during the coronavirus crisis, rising waiting lists for complex psychiatric care, bed shortages for anorexia treatment, interim care, regional high-complexity care tables, and the Court of Audit's view that long waits worsen conditions. The State Secretary acknowledged the mental health impact, described measures such as a consultation line, transparency rules and an evaluation of high-complexity care, but gave averages rather than specific anorexia waiting-list figures and did not provide case counts.
I will send you this evaluation.
Ik zal u deze evaluatie doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Voor deze ouderen geen plek meer’

An SP MP asks the health and medical care ministers about older patients who cannot be placed in nursing homes or receive home care after hospital treatment, and whether this has worsened during the coronavirus crisis. The minister reports current care-capacity figures, notes staffing shortages as the main cause, describes the regional and national procedures for staff support, and points to funding for small-scale housing for older people.
For privacy reasons, figures broken down by age are not available.
Vanwege privacyoverwegingen zijn cijfers op basis van leeftijd niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gevolgen van de Brexit voor de levering van Nederlandse medicijnen aan het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP asked the health minister about Brexit blocking supply of Dutch-produced cannabis oil to 42 British child epilepsy patients, whether alternatives are adequate, what talks with the UK are underway, and about other affected medicines. The minister confirmed the Brexit cause, said a temporary arrangement continues supply until 1 July 2021 pending a UK-produced solution, and reported no other medicine problems besides cannabis oil.
Until 1 July 2021, the handover of cannabis oil to existing patients from the Netherlands will continue on the same basis as before Brexit.
Tot 1 juli 2021 wordt de terhandstelling van cannabisolie voor bestaande patiënten vanuit Nederland voortgezet op dezelfde voet als vóór de Brexit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het belang van professionele tolken in de zorg

An MP asked the health minister whether professional interpreters in care should be made standard, citing a Kassa report on savings, the use of informal interpreters, the status of the Zorginstituut's quality norm, and funding. The minister answered that good communication is required, that the cost savings are hard to quantify, that the quality norm and existing NZa tariffs already cover interpreter costs, and that a broader standard is for professional groups to develop.
It is primarily up to professional groups to deliver this norm, and they may involve patient organisations and health insurers.
Het is primair aan beroepsgroepen om deze norm op te leveren, waarbij zij ook patiëntenorganisaties en zorgverzekeraars kunnen betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bergkamp over het ontbreken van chiropractors en osteopaten op de lijst van uitgezonderde contactberoepen

MPs Van den Berg and Bergkamp asked why osteopaths and chiropractors were left off the list of exempt contact professions during the lockdown, despite some patients needing their care. The Minister answered that exemptions follow existing law (Zvw, Wlz, Wmo, Jeugdwet, BIG), that osteopathy and chiropractic are not basic insured care and have no protected titles, and that patients can be referred to physiotherapists and GPs.

I will therefore bring this group of people to the attention of the national professional organisations of GPs and physiotherapists, so that they can help or refer these people to the right specialist where needed.

Ik ga deze groep mensen daarom onder de aandacht brengen van de landelijke beroepsorganisaties van huisartsen en fysiotherapeuten, zodat zij deze mensen zo nodig kunnen helpen of doorverwijzen naar de juiste specialist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over koolmonoxide vergiftigingen door onveilige cv-ketel

MP Beckerman asked the government about a carbon monoxide poisoning incident in Amsterdam-Oost and the safety of AGPO Ferroli boilers, including recall warnings, certification, and enforcement. The minister answered that the incident was not caused by a defective Ferroli boiler but by improper reinstallation of a flue after maintenance, that Ferroli had issued warnings, and that new certification rules apply from 2022.
The carbon monoxide poisoning turns out not to have been caused by a defective boiler, but by the flue duct not being carefully reinstalled after maintenance.
De koolmonoxidevergiftiging blijkt niet veroorzaakt te zijn door een defecte cv-ketel, maar doordat het rookgasafvoerkanaal na onderhoud niet zorgvuldig werd teruggeplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'Brabants ziekenhuis merkte jarenlang datalekken niet op'

An MP asked the health minister about a Brabant hospital that failed for years to detect staff misuse of medical records, and how oversight, patient access to logs and sanctions work. The minister said the hospital detected misuse in 2018, took labour-law measures, reported to the data protection authority and is strengthening security, while logging duties and patient portals are the responsibility of providers and the regulator.
Given the privacy of those involved, Bravis hospital provides no further details about the incident described by NRC.
Het Bravis ziekenhuis geeft, gezien de privacy van betrokkenen, geen verdere details over de gebeurtenis waar de NRC over schrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'CZ en VGZ beperken vrije zorgkeuze van patiënten die fysiotherapie nodig hebben'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about insurers CZ and VGZ restricting free choice of physiotherapists by lowering reimbursement for non-contracted providers, and whether low tariffs and a two-tier access risk exist. The Minister replied that insurers compete on contracting and that restitution policies preserve choice, that tariffs are free and handled via negotiation and a cost study, and that the withdrawn contracting bill may be revisited if non-contracted care does not fall.
Should it turn out that despite these measures the share of non-contracted care does not fall sufficiently, the bill may still be submitted.
Mocht blijken dat ondanks deze maatregelen het percentage niet-gecontracteerde zorg onvoldoende daalt, dan kan alsnog tot indiening van het wetsvoorstel worden overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Medewerker Shell krijgt meer korting op zorgverzekering dan thuiszorgmedewerker'

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether collective discounts in supplementary health insurance cause cross-subsidy, whether such discounts should be abolished, and how average discounts compare between care workers and business employees. The minister said supplementary insurance is outside the basic-package statute and insurers may set premiums, acknowledged that most collective discounts lack care-related justification and amount to cross-subsidy, and announced a legislative process to abolish the collective discount for the basic insurance.
I have no insight into the average collective discount that care workers versus business employees receive.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de gemiddelde collectiviteitskorting die zorgmedewerkers versus medewerkers uit het bedrijfsleven ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de collectiviteitskorting op de zorgverzekering

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about collective insurance discounts that let employees of large firms such as Shell get bigger health-insurance discounts than others, and whether the discount should also end for supplementary insurance. The minister confirmed the discount is unjustified cross-subsidy, announced a legislative process to abolish it for basic insurance, but declined to act on supplementary insurance, citing insurers' own premium-setting powers and limited legal leverage.
That is why I have decided to start the legislative process to abolish the collective discount for basic health insurance.
Daarom heb ik besloten het wetstraject in gang te zetten om de collectiviteitskorting voor de basisverzekering af te schaffen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Tielen over het bericht 'NBBU en SoloPartners dringen er bij zorginstellingen op aan de zorgbonus voor uitzendkrachten en zzp’ers alsnog ter beschikking te stellen'

MPs Regterschot and Tielen asked whether the COVID-19 care bonus is genuinely open to temporary agency workers and self-employed care workers, and whether institutions are being pressed to apply for them. The ministers answer that the bonus is contract-neutral, that GGZ Nederland's earlier advice was a misunderstanding, that about a third of applicant institutions applied for third parties, and that the application window was extended.
The final figures will be compiled in the coming weeks.
De definitieve cijfers worden de komende weken opgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het niet vergoeden van het middel Orkambi voor een patiënt met cystic fibrosis

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care why an insurer refuses to reimburse Orkambi for a non-homozygous cystic fibrosis patient despite expert support and a Supreme Court ruling, and why the SKGZ dispute committee upheld the refusal, along with questions on the insurer's conduct and lobbying claims. The Minister declined to judge the individual insurer decision or SKGZ ruling, pointed to the reimbursement rules and independent Zorginstituut advice, and noted a possible GVS procedure for new indications.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ''Illegale pokeravonden in de voetbalkantine: 'Dan is dus je hele club naar de Filistijnen''

MPs Heerema and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked how the government will tackle criminal interference in amateur sports clubs and what steps it will take. The minister answers that a broad study confirmed such interference, points to existing cooperation (RIEC's, awareness campaigns, planned guidance and local sports agreements) and says criminal law is a last resort, while not answering question 8 about the committee meeting.
I therefore want to examine whether additional information campaigns could play a role here.
Ik wil dan ook bezien of extra voorlichting hier een rol kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'VGZ legt met nieuwe puffers bom onder harde lockdown'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about VGZ's preferential inhaler policy for dry-powder inhalers, which would not reimburse formoterol-budesonide for new patients and could force switches for existing users, raising concerns about lung patients, extra consultations and transparency. The minister answered that about 7,000 new patients a year are affected, that the rule applies only to new users for now, that VGZ may apply its preference policy within the rules, and that the NZa oversees insurer information duties, while leaving joint solutions to insurers and care professionals.
Health insurers, and in this case healthcare professionals, must jointly give shape to the preference policy.
Zorgverzekeraars, en in dit geval zorgprofessionals, moeten gezamenlijk invulling geven aan het preferentiebeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over menstruatiearmoede in Nederland

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government whether it would provide free menstrual products in public places and follow Scotland's example to tackle period poverty. The state secretary answered that most women do not face cost problems, pointed to general poverty measures and local municipal responsibility, and declined to introduce free provision.
I do not share that view. Circumstances and needs of women differ, but for most women the cost of menstrual products is not a problem.
Die mening deel ik niet. Omstandigheden en behoeften van vrouwen verschillen, maar voor de meeste vrouwen vormen de kosten van menstruatieproducten geen probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over wetenschappelijk onderzoek naar de werking van medicinale cannabis

MP Bergkamp asked the minister whether the Zorginstituut's criteria for accepting scientific evidence on medicinal cannabis would be shared with researchers, and whether the ongoing research meets those criteria. The minister answered that the criteria are public, that ZonMw's review found mostly low-quality evidence, that the research programme will focus on applied research, and that only the Zorginstituut itself can judge whether studies meet its requirements.
This question can ultimately only be answered on the basis of assessment by the Zorginstituut itself.
Deze vraag kan uiteindelijk alleen worden beantwoord op grond van toetsing door het Zorginstituut zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Westerveld over het bericht van NOS Sport op 21 december 2020, 'Sportrechtbank kraakt door machtsmisbruikzaken: dit is groter dan het turnen'

MPs Diertens and Westerveld asked the minister, after a NOS report on the Sports Arbitration Institute (ISR) being overwhelmed by abuse-of-power complaints, about funding, volunteer judges, timelines for handling the gymnastics cases, and planned professionalisation. The minister answered that structural funding from 2021 and an extra 1 million euro from 2022 will enable Berenschot's recommendations, while giving timelines and capacity figures but no firm deadlines for the pending cases.
Yes, from 2021 there is structural financial support for the ISR.
Ja, vanaf 2021 is er sprake van een structurele financiële ondersteuning aan het ISR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat oud-medewerkers van het Slotervaartziekenhuis in hun nieuwe functie geen toegang meer hebben tot de dossiers van hun patiënten

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about reports that former Slotervaart hospital staff can no longer access their former patients' electronic records after the hospital's bankruptcy and transfer of the records to UMC Utrecht. The Minister explains the 20-year retention rule, the transfer of records to UMC Utrecht, that requests are now made via a UMC Utrecht counter with patient consent limited to the relevant specialty, and that restoring old login access is not possible.
Since that date, care providers (in the context of treatment and with the patient's consent) can request medical data from the MC Slotervaart counter at UMC Utrecht.
Sinds die datum kunnen zorgverleners (in het kader van de behandeling en met toestemming van de patiënt) medische gegevens opvragen bij het MC Slotervaart-loket van het UMC Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat de Nederlandse kosten door beroerten met miljarden dreigen te stijgen

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister of Medical Care about an Oxford report projecting stroke costs in the Netherlands rising from about 1.3 to 3.3 billion euro per year by 2040, and what measures would be taken, including on rehabilitation decline and proposals from a patient organisation. The minister acknowledged the projected rise driven by ageing, pointed to existing policy (the hospital care accord, reimbursed treatments, ZonMw research) and said implementation is decentralised to care professionals.
It is up to care professionals to determine how good stroke-related prevention and care should concretely take shape.
Het is aan zorgprofessionals om te bepalen hoe goede beroerte-gerelateerde preventie en zorg concreet vorm moet krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het artikel 'Eerste besmetting met westnijlvirus in Nederland'

D66 MPs De Groot and Diertens asked the ministers about the first human West Nile virus infection in the Netherlands, expected case numbers, measures against mosquitoes, and a letter warning about the tiger mosquito. The minister said case forecasts are not possible, mosquito control for West Nile is still under study with a first advice expected in December, and the tiger mosquito is unrelated to West Nile transmission and is already being eradicated by the NVWA.
A first advice from the zoonoses response team is expected at the beginning of December.
Begin december wordt een eerste advies verwacht vanuit het responsteam zoönosen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de uitzending van Kassa over fysiotherapie: 'Duurdere aanvullende verzekering voor minder behandelingen'

An MP from the CDA asked the minister, after a Kassa broadcast, whether people with chronic conditions face high physiotherapy costs, whether the chronic-conditions list is still adequate, and how the government will investigate alternatives for including physiotherapy in the basic package. The minister answered that coverage remains broad, that the government is working with the Zorginstituut on a transition track and will report in Q1 2021, and that evidence for all physiotherapy forms is not yet sufficient.
Of course I will inform the House of Representatives about the progress of the transition track on the system advice.
Vanzelfsprekend informeer ik de Tweede Kamer over de voortgang van het overgangstraject systeemadvies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het verdwijnen van spoedeisende hulpen funest is voor kleinere ziekenhuizen

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister for Medical Care how she responds to warnings that disappearing emergency departments would harm smaller hospitals such as in Winterswijk and Doetinchem, and whether this is acceptable given the role hospitals played during the COVID-19 crisis. The Minister answered that the acute care sketch is a non-binding consultation document, that only highly complex acute care would be concentrated, that accessibility would be maintained, and that final decisions rest with the next cabinet.
After I have received the responses, I will bundle, summarise and send them to your House.
Nadat ik de reacties heb ontvangen zal ik die reacties bundelen, samenvatten en aanbieden aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Beatrixziekenhuis dreigt zijn spoedeisende hulppost te verliezen'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether the Beatrix hospital in Gorinchem risks losing its emergency department under the acute-care sketch, and whether such closures are planned. The minister replied that the emergency department is not at risk, that no closure is planned, and that the acute-care sketch is only a discussion document with final decisions left to the next cabinet.
No, that is not the case. A large number of topics from the charcoal sketch, such as the design of integrated emergency posts, still need to be explored, substantiated and elaborated.
Nee, dat is niet het geval. Er moet nog een groot aantal onderwerpen uit de houtskoolschets, zoals de invulling van integrale spoedposten, nader worden verkend, onderbouwd en uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘SEH-artsen waarschuwen: “Ernstig zieke patiënt komt op verkeerde spoedpost” ‘

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care how she responds to SEH doctors' warnings that seriously ill patients may end up at the wrong emergency post under the acute care sketch, and about risks to staffing, quality, cost and access. The minister said the houtskoolschets is a discussion document with consultation open until 1 January 2021, that high-complexity acute care will be concentrated while other care moves to integrated emergency posts, that the number of locations is not yet determined, and that final decisions rest with the next cabinet.
Final decision-making rests with the new cabinet.
Definitieve besluitvorming is aan het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de European Disability Card

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the European Disability Card, its benefits, its visibility for invisible disabilities, and whether the Netherlands should introduce it. The Minister opposed introducing the card, favouring general accessibility and the 'Onbeperkt Meedoen!' programme, while noting risks for foreign visitors without the card.
No, like my predecessor I want to work on improving accessibility for everyone, even without a card having to be shown.
Nee, net als mijn voorganger wil ik inzetten op verbetering van toegankelijkheid voor iedereen, ook zonder dat een kaart hoeft te worden getoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'Ook homo’s mogen bloedplasma doneren, verhoogd risico ondervangen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Medical Care about news that men who have sex with men (MSM) may now donate blood plasma, and why the risk is now managed, and questioned whether donor selection based on sexual orientation is discriminatory. The Minister answered that Sanquin's plasma product portfolio changed so that pathogen reduction allows MSM plasma to be used safely, with a four-month deferral from start of 2021, and that RIVM is studying a shift to individual risk behaviour as the criterion.
I consider it a step in the right direction that men who have sex with men (MSM) will soon be eligible to donate blood plasma.
Ik vind het een stap in de goede richting dat mannen die seks hebben met mannen (MSM) binnenkort toch in aanmerking komen voor het doneren van bloedplasma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de compensatieregeling voor het ziekenhuis St Jansdal

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the generic COVID compensation scheme between hospitals and insurers, which uses 2019 as base year and disadvantages St Jansdal, and whether tailored compensation and contact with the insurers Zilveren Kruis and VGZ would follow. The minister acknowledged the disadvantage, said insurers and the hospital are negotiating on the hardship clause, and committed to contacting the hospital and insurers.
The health insurers and the hospital are still in discussion with each other about the application of the hardship clause.
De zorgverzekeraars en het ziekenhuis zijn nog in gesprek met elkaar over de toepassing van de hardheidsclausule.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Kerngroep ‘verbaasd, teleurgesteld en bezorgd’ over sluiting huisartsenpost Venray'

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about the proposed closure of the Venray out-of-hours GP post, citing concerns about access, travel times and patient choice. The Minister replies that the decision lies with the GPs and insurers under the current system, that RIVM analysis shows 99.9% of residents can reach the Venlo post within 30 minutes, that the hospital is not closing, and that the NZa monitors access and will act if needed.
In the current healthcare system, GPs together with health insurers are primarily responsible for organising GP care during evenings, nights and weekends.
In het huidige zorgstelsel zijn de huisartsen samen met de zorgverzekeraars primair verantwoordelijk voor de organisatie van de huisartsenzorg in de avond-, nacht- en weekenduren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Sluiting huisartsenpost Venray een flinke stap dichterbij’

An MP asked the minister about a planned closure of the Venray out-of-hours GP post in Limburg, its effects on response times and quality of acute care, and whether it fits regional plans. The minister answered that the decision rests with the local GPs and cooperative Cohesie, that a RIVM analysis shows 99.9% of residents can reach another post within 30 minutes, and that the minister has no insight into specific agreements between GPs.
It is up to them to reach agreement together in good consultation.
Het is aan hen om hier samen in goed overleg uit te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over onterechte medische claims van de 'Healy'

MP Ploumen asked the minister why the Healy device was admitted to the Dutch market despite false medical claims, whether it poses health risks, and what can be done against it. The minister answered that the CE certificate was issued by a German notified body, that the IGJ found no direct injury reports, and that enforcement options are limited for CE-marked devices, while pointing to the new EU rules from May 2021.

Propagating false, scientifically unproven medical claims made for (medicinal) products can potentially be fined under the Medicines Act; no such possibility exists for medical devices once they carry a CE marking after assessment by a notified body.

Het propageren van onterechte, niet wetenschappelijk bewezen, medische claims die aan (genees)middelen worden toegeschreven kan eventueel worden beboet op grond van de Geneesmiddelwet; een dergelijke mogelijkheid is er voor medische hulpmiddelen niet wanneer deze na beoordeling van een notified body een CE-markering hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Ommelander Ziekenhuis in zwaar weer: 'ingrijpende maatregelen' dreigen'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that the Ommelander Ziekenhuis faces severe financial difficulties and possible drastic measures, and about the role of government, insurers and regulators. The minister answered that the hospital's problems are being negotiated primarily between the hospital and insurers, that supervisors (NZa, IGJ) are informed, that a rescue plan exists, and that a review of the emergency availability contribution is underway, without committing to direct ministry involvement.
It is up to OZG to discuss the care provision and the financial compensation with the health insurers.
Het is aan OZG om samen met de zorgverzekeraars te spreken over het zorgaanbod en de financiële vergoeding die daar tegenover staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de financiële situatie van het Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groningen (OZG)

Mr Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the financial situation of the Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groningen, its contacts with insurers and supervisors, the cause of the insufficient emergency availability payment, possible effects of closing emergency care, catchment numbers, and consultation with regional stakeholders. The Minister answered that talks between the hospital and insurers are ongoing, that the NZa and IGJ have been informed, that the emergency availability payment is being reviewed with the NZa and NVZ, and that closure is not under discussion, while largely deferring responsibility to insurers and the hospital.
The health insurers must meet their duty of care in doing so.
De zorgverzekeraars moeten daarbij voldoen aan hun zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Ommelander Ziekenhuis in zwaar weer: 'ingrijpende maatregelen' dreigen’

MPs Ploumen and Nijboer asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that the Ommelander Ziekenhuis in Scheemda faces financial trouble and drastic measures, and about accessibility of care in the region. The Minister replied that there is no acute financial crisis, that the hospital's strategy is being adjusted with insurers and other financiers, that the NZa sees no current risk to the duty of care, and that the matter is primarily for the hospital and insurers to resolve.
It is primarily up to OZG and the health insurers and other financiers to now hold the discussion together.
Het is primair aan OZG en de zorgverzekeraars en andere financiers om nu samen het gesprek te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over een opnamestop bij de Zuyderland ziekenhuizen door een ict-storing

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a full admission stop at Zuyderland hospitals caused by an ICT failure during the second COVID wave, including effects on care and whether backup systems should exist. The minister said hospitals are responsible for backup arrangements, that no planned operations were postponed, and that the hospital had a dual setup that became unstable after a cable was damaged.
Healthcare providers are responsible for delivering good and safe care.
Zorgaanbieders zijn verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van goede en veilige zorg.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de razendsnelle verspreiding van het vogelgriepvirus en de politieke verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontstaan van een nieuwe zoönose in de Nederlandse veehouderij

An MP asked the Minister about the rapid spread of bird flu variants, how zoonotic risks are monitored, the handling of infected birds, and political responsibility for a possible new zoonosis from Dutch livestock farming. The government answered that the RIVM and a signalling consultation monitor zoonotic risks, that biosecurity and culling measures apply, and that VWS and LNV share responsibilities under separate legal frameworks.
As indicated in my answer to question 5, we monitor the zoonotic risk closely.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 5, volgen we het zoönotische risico intensief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geurts over kinderboerderijen, boerencampings en zorgboerderijen die Q-koortsregels schenden

MPs Van den Berg and Geurts asked how the government responds to reports that dozens of petting farms and farm campsites broke Q-fever rules, and how the NVWA inspects and follows up on such violations. The minister replied that compliance is checked at about 10% of such farms with 43-55% compliance over four years, that re-inspections are carried out only where needed, and that farms must document vaccination before allowing visitors again.
The NVWA has started an intensive communication campaign this year to point these businesses to the importance of complying with the rules.
De NVWA is dit jaar een intensief communicatietraject gestart om deze bedrijven te wijzen op het belang van naleving van de regels die zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Kröger over het bericht ‘Asbest gevonden in make-up van Douglas en Hema’

MPs Laçin and Kröger asked whether the minister would act after asbestos was found in make-up sold by Douglas and Hema, and whether a broad investigation into talc use in cosmetics would be launched. The minister called asbestos in cosmetics unacceptable, said the NVWA is checking whether further investigation or enforcement is needed, but declined a broad new investigation, citing a 2018 study that found asbestos in only 2 of nearly 300 samples.
The NVWA supervises compliance with the legislation and enforces where necessary.
De NVWA houdt toezicht op de naleving van de wetgeving en treedt zo nodig handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het seksueel misbruik van jongeren in de gehandicaptenzorg

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked about sexual abuse of young people in disability care, citing reports that it is barely addressed, and asked about prevention measures, incident counts, reporting levels, and whether staff dismissed for abuse can move to other care jobs. The minister outlined prevention materials, the mandatory reporting duty to the inspectorate (90 reports in 2019), screening tools like VOG and the Waarschuwingsregister, and said she sees no clear sign of low reporting but will act if it exists.
Unfortunately we can never fully rule out that a situation arises in which someone moves on to work elsewhere in care after abuse has taken place.
Helaas kunnen we nooit helemaal uitsluiten dat zich een situatie voordoet waarin iemand elders in de zorg aan de slag gaat, nadat er misbruik heeft plaatsgevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Regterschot over de petitie-aanbieding van De Nederlandse Vereniging van Anesthesiemedewerkers m.b.t. niet erkennen beroep van anesthesiemedewerker in artikel 3 van Wet BIG

Ten MP Regterschot asked the Minister for Medical Care why anaesthesia assistants were not recognised under the BIG Act, whether the government would re-engage with their association, reinstate a nursing specialisation by general administrative order, and address training and representation. The minister answered that the Health Council advice was adopted under the 'no unless necessary' principle, that no further talks are planned, that training routes via hbo-vt/BMH will be explored, and that the group should be involved in matters affecting it.
I therefore see no reason to re-engage with the NVAM regarding professional regulation.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om opnieuw met de NVAM in gesprek te gaan wat betreft de beroepsregulering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Renkema over het bericht 'Betalen ziekenhuizen de rekening van het afval van de kerncentrale Borssele?'

MPs Kröger and Renkema asked about reports that hospitals may bear costs of radioactive waste from Borssele and whether COVRA discriminates against small waste producers. The state secretary answers that COVRA applies uniform tariffs for standard waste, that the ANVS withdrew its intended penalty after COVRA provided information, and that a regulatory framework for financing waste management still needs to be developed.
From my department, consultation on this elaboration will be started with, in the first instance, the Ministry of Finance and the ANVS.
Vanuit mijn departement wordt het overleg over deze uitwerking opgestart met in eerste instantie het Ministerie van Financiën en de ANVS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over waarom de zorgbonus niet wordt uitgekeerd aan zorgverleners die werkzaam zijn in het gevangeniswezen

An SP MP asked the Ministers for Medical Care and Legal Protection why prison and forensic (TBS) healthcare staff are excluded from the COVID-19 care bonus, whether 1.5 metre distancing can be guaranteed there, and whether the exclusion should be lifted. The government answered that DJI follows RIVM guidance with extra measures where distancing is impossible, and that the bonus scheme does not cover DJI, which instead must apply the CAO Rijk extra-reward framework at managers' discretion.
DJI falls outside the scope of the bonus scheme, so no subsidy application for a bonus can be submitted for DJI staff.
DJI valt niet onder de werkingssfeer van de bonusregeling, zodat voor personeel werkzaam bij DJI geen subsidieaanvraag voor een bonus kan worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over de mogelijke sluiting van de huisartsenpost in Venray

MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the possible closure of the Venray GP out-of-hours post, consultation with stakeholders, travel times and patient numbers. The minister confirmed a proposed closure decision by Cohesie, said consultation steps under a draft AMvB would be followed, and cited a RIVM analysis showing 99.9% of residents could reach the Venlo post within 30 minutes, while declining to provide patient numbers and admission splits, referring to care providers.
I therefore have no insight into the wishes of each individual GP in the region.
Ik heb dan ook geen inzicht in de wensen van iedere individuele huisarts in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht dat zorgmedewerkers met corona toch moeten komen werken

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the health minister whether zorgmedewerkers with COVID-19 may still be made to work, whether they accept exceptions to isolation rules when rosters cannot be filled, and how care continuity is ensured without endangering patients. The minister answered that positive staff must not work and cannot be forced to, that narrow exceptions in FMS and RIVM guidance require documented, safe risk assessments, and that regional steering groups and staffing measures will be used; the answer to the eighth question was not given in time for the committee debate.
Staff who have tested positive may not work and may also not be forced to work.
Medewerkers die positief getest zijn, mogen niet werken en mogen ook niet worden gedwongen om te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het sluiten van zwembaden en het stoppen van zwemlessen voor kinderen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the sudden closure of swimming pools and cessation of children's swimming lessons, the miscommunication about it, and the lack of impact assessment. The minister admitted a website error, said the child-specific effects were not assessed since the measures were temporary and part of a package, and announced reopening for groups of up to 30 from 19 November.
The specific consequences of closing swimming pools have not been mapped out.
De specifieke gevolgen van de sluiting van zwembaden zijn niet in kaart gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars CZ en VGZ verhogen hun premies voor 2021’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about health insurers CZ and VGZ raising their 2021 premiums above the budget forecast, the causes, compensation for those unable to pay, budget policies, reserves, and contract negotiations. The minister explained the premium gap (about 5 euro per year) as driven by higher expenditure and reserve drawdown, pointed to the healthcare allowance for compensation, rejected a single basic policy and banning budget policies, and said contract negotiations in medical specialist care were slow and being monitored.
I have asked the NZa to monitor the contracting process; they will hold a checkpoint in early December and inform me about it.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om het contracteerproces te monitoren, zij zullen begin december een peilmoment houden en mij daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over ‘Topvrouw HMC: ‘Bronovo is ongeschikt voor de opvang van coronapatiënten’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether HMC Bronovo, which the HMC chair called unsuitable for COVID patients, could be used as an emergency or calamity hospital and reopened. The minister answered that Bronovo was not included in the regional expansion plan, that a separate emergency hospital was judged infeasible due to staffing, and that Bronovo will close as a hospital after three to four years, with decisions left to the hospital and insurers.
After investigation by the NAZW, it was concluded that realising such a facility, at this location or elsewhere in the region, is not feasible.
In het NAZW is, na onderzoek door het NAZW, geconcludeerd dat realisatie van een dergelijke voorziening, op deze locatie of elders in de regio, niet haalbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het uitblijven van een covid-19-bonus voor zorgprofessionals in Caribisch Nederland

An MP asked why healthcare workers in Caribbean Netherlands were excluded from the covid-19 bonus paid in European Netherlands and whether they would be given it. The state secretary said the bonus scheme does not apply there, but a $1,000 net bonus for March to December 2020 is being arranged, with the payment mechanism still to be worked out.
Therefore, work is currently underway on a method to make a care bonus of $1,000 net for healthcare professionals in Caribbean Netherlands possible.
Daarom wordt er op dit moment gewerkt aan een werkwijze om een zorgbonus van $ 1.000 netto voor zorgprofessionals in Caribisch Nederland mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de onderzoeken naar de werking van mondmaskers

Two SP MPs asked the minister to explain the basis of RIVM's claims that medical face masks could create false security, given that the RIVM said no scientific study showed this and later cited preprints. The minister answered that the remarks concerned FFP2 masks used in care, were based on expert opinion and WHO/ECDC consensus, and that the earlier reference to studies was an error, but did not provide the studies requested.
Unfortunately, confusion has arisen about Mr Van Dissel's statements on the use of face masks during the technical briefing of 22 April 2020 and the possible occurrence of false security.

Er is helaas onduidelijkheid ontstaan over de uitspraken van de heer Van Dissel over het gebruik van mondneusmaskers tijdens de technische briefing op 22 april 2020 en het mogelijk optreden van schijnveiligheid daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Patiënt betaalt prijs voor plannen Zorginstituut'

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care to respond to a newspaper report that the Zorginstituut's ruling against high-mountain treatment for severe asthma was factually wrong and clashed with pulmonologists' views and an independent study. The minister defends the Zorginstituut's decision as based on the 2018 study, says the evaluation of the process and the Kaderwet evaluation are underway, and states longrevalidatie remains reimbursed.
The Zorginstituut has reported carefully on the process leading to this position, which has been sent to your House.
Het Zorginstituut heeft over het proces om te komen tot dit standpunt zorgvuldig verslag gedaan, hetgeen aan uw Kamer is verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het bericht 'Apothekers vrezen dat patiënten uit regio Amersfoort ’s avonds en in het weekend naar Utrecht moeten voor medicijnen'

MPs Van Gerven and Hijink asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that Zilveren Kruis and other insurers did not renew the contract of the Dienstapotheek Eemland, so out-of-hours pharmacy care would move to Utrecht. The minister answered that insurers cite lack of transparency in the pharmacy's proposed tariff, that care will be delivered from Utrecht with home delivery, and that insurers must meet their duty of care.

I assume that health insurers in the Eemland region will fulfil their duty of care and that good pharmaceutical care will therefore be provided in that region during out-of-hours periods, also in 2021.
Ik ga er vanuit dat zorgverzekeraars in de regio Eemland hun zorgplicht nakomen en dat dus in die regio goede farmaceutische zorg wordt geboden tijdens ANZ-uren, ook in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de dreigende sluiting van de spoedapotheek in Amersfoort

An MP asks the Minister whether insurers abruptly terminated the emergency pharmacy contract in Amersfoort, whether consultation took place, and what the Minister will do given earlier commitments to dialogue. The Minister confirms the termination, explains insurers' reasoning about pharmacy transparency on tariffs, and says supply will be taken over by another pharmacy in Utrecht.
Insurers conclude contracts with pharmacies on a non-competitive basis.
Verzekeraars sluiten op non-concurrentiële basis contracten af met dienstapotheken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de toenemende agressie richting zorgmedewerkers en anderen door de coronamaatregelen

MP Kerstens asked the Minister for Medical Care about rising aggression against healthcare workers and others implementing COVID measures, and whether the government would act. The minister acknowledged the problem as unacceptable, cited a planned branch-specific approach with social partners, a justice-ministry taskforce, and cooperation to improve reporting, but offered no hard data.
I will intensify support for healthcare workers and healthcare employers with a branch-specific approach to safe working in healthcare.
Ik ga de ondersteuning aan zorgmedewerkers en zorgwerkgevers intensiveren met een branchegerichte aanpak voor veilig werken in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Nispen over onderzoeken die uitwijzen dat koppen in de sport leidt tot hersenschade

MPs Westerveld and Van Nispen asked the health minister about reports that major sports bodies obstruct research into head-injury damage from heading and fund congresses on the topic. The minister answered that research must be independent, that sports bodies' funding is acceptable if independence is guaranteed, that she is in talks with the KNVB on heading measures, and that the KNVB-AMC/VU heading study results are expected in spring 2021 but delayed.
I believe that scientific research must always be conducted independently.
Ik vind dat wetenschappelijk onderzoek altijd onafhankelijk moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het niet vergoeden van explantatie van borstimplantaten

An MP asks the minister about a petition and calls for reimbursement of breast implant removal (explantation) for all women, plus a protocol and a diagnostic test. The minister answers that removal is covered when medically necessary, will ask the Zorginstituut to re-examine its 2018 standpoint, and says the protocol talks are ongoing and the Platinum Screen evidence is insufficient.
As indicated above, under current laws and regulations, removal of breast implants is part of the basic package when there is a medical necessity for removal.

Zoals hierboven al aangegeven is, volgens de huidige wet- en regelgeving, explantatie van borstimplantaten onderdeel van het basispakket wanneer er sprake is van een medische noodzaak voor verwijdering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de BIG-registratie van alternatieve artsen
