An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that BIG re-registration of alternative doctors is weakly checked, and whether stricter file audits and mandatory quality visitations and continuing education should apply to them. The minister denied that alternative doctors are often wrongly re-registered, rejected 100% audits as unjustified, saw no need to tighten the criteria, and only pointed to planned dialogue tables on expertise development regarding quality visitations.
I am not in favour of carrying out 100% checks on doctors who provide non-regular care, because I consider it important that all professions are treated equally.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van om 100% controle te doen bij artsen die niet reguliere zorg verlenen, omdat ik het van belang vind dat alle beroepen gelijk worden behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Raemakers over het artikel ‘Buitenlandse Artsen in Nederland: ‘Ik denk dat niemand mij zal bellen’

MPs Paternotte and Raemakers asked the ministers about a press article on foreign-trained doctors facing long, costly re-qualification procedures and about the abolition of the supervised-practice scheme. The minister said patient safety comes first, promised to explore streamlining the procedure with the CBGV and VBGA, and gave historical and procedural explanations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over een isotopenfabriek in Groningen

An MP asked the health minister about a proposed SHINE Medical isotope plant in Groningen, SHINE's concern about state aid to competitor Pallas, the repayment deferral of loans to Pallas, and the Lighthouse technology moving to Belgium. The minister welcomed SHINE's interest, said the Pallas loans are to be repaid, promised a confidential letter on Pallas before year end, and said the decision on Pallas would weigh innovation and supply security.
I will inform your House further before the end of the year in a separate confidential letter (due to the ongoing negotiations)
Ik zal uw Kamer nog voor het einde van het jaar in een aparte vertrouwelijke (vanwege de lopende onderhandelingen) brief hier nader informeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het gemaakte onderscheid binnen de topsport

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care why top-sport competitions other than the Eredivisie were halted, questioning infection figures, comparisons with other countries and possible discrimination. The minister defended the general halt as part of a package limiting social contacts and travel, noted that top-sport infections were under 100 versus nearly 195,000 nationally, and said reopening would be discussed with the sector.
I myself have no insight into the precise number of infections in top sport.
Ik heb zelf geen inzicht in het precieze aantal besmettingen in de topsport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het wel of niet stilleggen van de eredivisie voor vrouwen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the women's Eredivisie was initially halted by the new corona measures, whether this was considered, and what the government will do about inequality in women's football. The minister said it was not initially clear, the women's league was placed on equal footing with the men's once the KNVB guaranteed equal safety measures, and promised to press the KNVB for structural change toward equal status and pay.
It was not clear in advance that the women's Eredivisie would also be halted.
Het was niet op voorhand duidelijk dat ook de Vrouwen Eredivisie zou worden stilgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over ‘Geen enkele huisarts wil in huis genomen moeder als patiënt.’

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about a Radar report in which no GP would register a mother, living with her daughter after leaving a care institution with a Wlz indication, as a patient, and about who is responsible for her medical care. The minister says GPs must serve Wlz patients, that the insurer should help when problems arise, that a sector covenant and a pending NZa advisory report will address the issue, but that the responsibility is shared and no concrete timed measures are given yet.
Everyone in the Netherlands must, when needed, be able to access general medical care 24 hours a day.
Iedereen in Nederland moet, als dat nodig is, 24 uur per dag terecht kunnen voor medisch-generalistische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het afschaffen van de collectiviteitskorting

An MP asked the health minister whether abolishing the collective discount on health insurance would also end municipal group policies, and whether exemptions and a review of the CPB report were possible. The minister answered that municipal policies can remain, that the discount is being abolished for the basic insurance as an artificial premium surcharge, and that municipalities and insurers decide on alternative arrangements, with some remedial measures announced.
Abolishing the collective discount does not necessarily mean the municipal group policy disappears.
Afschaffing van de collectiviteitskorting hoeft niet te betekenen dat de gemeentepolis verdwijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over bonussen die uitgekeerd worden aan personeel op het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

An SP MP asked the health ministry how many staff received corona-related one-off bonuses, their highest and average amounts, the criteria used, and whether they had been paid. The minister reported 373 of about 1,500 staff received bonuses of 100 to 3,500 euro net (average 1,092 euro), based on overtime and duration, consistent with union agreements, and that all have been paid.
The employees who were granted a one-off reward have now received it.
De medewerkers die een incidentele beloning toegekend hebben gekregen, hebben deze inmiddels ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht meer dan een applaus voor de kraamzorg

An MP asked the ministers about a report on care workers in maternity care during COVID-19, including social distancing, protective equipment, the role of maternity carers, pay, and eligibility for the 2020 bonus. The minister answered that protective equipment follows RIVM guidance with employers responsible for supplying it, pay is for social partners to negotiate, and bonus eligibility is for care providers to assess, with no commitment to new action.
The Ministry of VWS does not consider it plausible that maternity care professionals fall one-to-one under the delineation criteria set out in the guidance.
Het Ministerie van VWS acht het niet aannemelijk dat de zorgprofessionals in de kraamzorg een op een vallen onder de afbakeningscriteria zoals gesteld in de handreiking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Nijboer en Moorlag over de slechte toegankelijkheid van huisartsenspoedzorg in Noordoost-Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about the reduction of night-time GP emergency car visits in Noordoost-Groningen, the loss of the Delfzijl post, and the erosion of acute care in the region. The minister replied that GPs and insurers are responsible for 24-hour care, that the inspectorate found no patient-safety breach so far, that a draft AMvB on acute care would require careful process if closures were decided, and that no signals of unacceptable care had been received.
I have currently received no signals from the relevant supervisory bodies that the quality or availability of care is at stake.
Ik heb op dit moment geen signalen ontvangen van de betreffende toezichthouders dat kwaliteit of beschikbaarheid van zorg in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht 'Geen voetbalwedstrijden voor jonge asielzoekers door strenge FIFA-regels'

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether FIFA's stricter transfer rules, which now apply to amateur football, exclude young asylum seekers from matches and whether this amounts to discrimination. The minister answered that exclusion is undesirable but that the rules serve to prevent trafficking, that the KNVB is working with FIFA on a limited minor exception, and that the Chamber will be kept informed.
I will keep your Chamber informed of the progress and results.
Ik zal uw Kamer op de hoogte houden van de voortgang en resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geluk-Poortvliet over opleidingsvergoedingen voor transfers van vrouwenvoetballers

MPs Von Martels and Geluk-Poortvliet asked whether the absence of training compensation for transferred women footballers constitutes discrimination and whether the government will raise it with the KNVB and in Europe. The minister answers that gender equality is paramount, that the KNVB is working on professionalising the youth structure and studying training compensation, but that international responsibility lies with FIFA and the government will keep discussing developments with the KNVB.
Equality between men and women in general, and therefore also in sport and football, is paramount for me.
Gelijkwaardigheid tussen mannen en vrouwen in het algemeen en dus ook in de sport en daarmee het voetbal, staat voor mij voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Vaccindeals staatsgeheim: experts roepen op tot transparantie’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about press reports that the EU vaccine purchase deals are state secrets and experts call for transparency, including comparisons with the H1N1 pandemic, the legal basis of confidentiality, and liability for vaccine damage. The Minister says the contracts are confidential under a Commission clause and binding on member states, that transparency is provided where possible, and that Nederland cannot commit to bear no liability costs, pointing to product liability law and limited indemnification.
I can say little about the precise text of the contracts.
Over de precieze tekst van de contracten kan ik weinig kwijt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Restitutieverzekering onder druk’

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about the pressure on restitution health insurance policies, the risk that contracting rules narrow patient choice and favour large providers, unclear co-payments for non-contracted care, and fraud enforcement, and whether the minister will limit free choice of provider. The minister replies that insurers decide which policies to offer, that contracting and risk equalisation are being improved, that the NZa monitors contracting and transparency, and that free provider choice is not being restricted.
It is up to the health insurer to make such choices.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraar om dergelijke keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over bonussen aan personeel op het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

MPs Hijink asked whether ministry staff at VWS are dissatisfied with a 500 euro bonus, whether some received up to 5,000 euro, and how many received bonuses and how much. The minister answered that dissatisfaction is not known, that incidental rewards are standard practice across ministries under Rijk-wide frameworks, and that corona-related one-off rewards were agreed with unions, without giving the individual figures requested.
Incidentally, there is no question of a generic reward here.
Van een generieke beloning is hierbij overigens geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Paternotte en Raemakers over het tekort aan virusremmer remdesivir tegen corona

Three MPs asked the Health Minister how many remdesivir doses the EU allocated to the Netherlands, when shortages became clear, how the EU distributes supply, and whether shortages would persist. The minister answered that the Netherlands received 24,000 doses for October, that EU allocation follows hospital admission incidence, and that a monthly supply contract with Gilead now applies, though precise longer-term supply and the effect of shortages remain unknown.
The Netherlands was allocated 24,000 doses (for about 4,000 patients) for the month of October.
Nederland heeft voor de maand oktober een hoeveelheid van 24.000 doses (voor ongeveer 4000 patiënten) toegewezen gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de toelatingsprocedure van medicijnen voor kankerpatiënten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Medical Care why cancer medicines reach the Dutch market months later than in the US and how the EMA and Dutch reimbursement procedures could be sped up. The Minister acknowledged the tension between speed and care, pointed to a parallel assessment pilot, argued that Dutch uptake of oncolytics is relatively quick compared with most EU states, and promised to review the sluis procedure for expensive drugs with the Zorginstituut.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over gebrekkige afspraken over betaalbaarheid, transparantie en toegankelijkheid van geneesmiddelen in de toolkit Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Licentiëren

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about gaps in the NFU toolkit for responsible licensing of publicly funded medicines, including price transparency, affordability and access, and whether government should take the lead. The Minister says some clauses could be useful, that the toolkit will be evaluated in two years, that government lacks the expertise to impose licence clauses now, and that EU-level cooperation and transparency on pricing are the preferred routes.
Confidential price agreements were made about Myozyme by my predecessor, and I cannot elaborate on them.
Over Myozyme zijn door mijn ambtsvoorganger vertrouwelijke prijsafspraken gemaakt, waarover ik niet kan uitweiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Jonge meiden over feestjes bij hockeytrainers: ‘Megaveel drank en dan bed in lokken’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Rudmer Heerema asked about press reports of sexual misconduct by hockey coaches and what could keep such coaches out of sport, including data-sharing powers and a dedicated prosecutor. The minister answered that the government supports sports bodies' prevention efforts, screening tools such as the VOG and the disciplinary registry, and reporting campaigns, but declined to extend the football violence law or appoint a special prosecutor.
No. The Football Violence Measures Act grants powers to mayors, public prosecutors and criminal judges to prevent disturbances of public order.

Nee. De Wet Maatregelen bestrijding voetbalvandalisme en ernstige overlast kent bevoegdheden toe aan burgemeesters, officieren van justitie en strafrechters die zij kunnen inzetten ter voorkoming van verstoringen van de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de Radar-uitzending ‘Medicijnverspilling: wat is er tegen te doen?’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Radar broadcast on medicine waste, covering cost estimates, the Praluent case, hospital home-medication rules, pharmacy payment incentives, co-reimbursement conditions and packaging sizes. The minister answered that waste is mainly addressed through self-regulation and best-practice collection, that the payment system is not a barrier, and that reimbursement conditions serve appropriate use.
My predecessor made a commitment to collect best practices that help prevent medicine waste.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft een toezegging gedaan voor het verzamelen van best practices die verspilling van medicijnen helpen voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Onrust over geheime vaccinonderhandelingen'

The MP asks about secret EU negotiations for COVID-19 vaccine contracts, including liability waivers for manufacturers such as AstraZeneca, the identity of negotiators, and profit margins. The minister replies that EU product liability law is fully respected, negotiators are bound by confidentiality, pricing is withheld, and the government will keep the Chamber informed in general terms.
Information relating to financial aspects of each contract, such as price agreements, falls under the confidentiality obligation.
De informatie die betrekking heeft op financiële aspecten van elk contract zoals prijsafspraken, valt onder de geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het verbieden van een sekswinkel als hoofdsponsor bij een voetbalclub

An MP asked the minister why the KNVB barred a sex shop from appearing as main sponsor on FC Emmen's shirt, on what grounds, who decides, and whether clubs can appeal. The minister answered that the KNVB's board of professional football applies sponsorship rules on shirt advertising, that a temporary arrangement allows the ad this season, that a club can challenge such decisions in civil court, and that the wider question will go to the General Assembly.
A professional football club can challenge the board's decision not to approve an advertisement on match kit in the civil court.
Een BVO kan het besluit van het bestuur betaald voetbal om een reclame-uiting op wedstrijdkleding niet goed te keuren, aanvechten bij de burgerrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het nauwelijks openbaar maken van medicijnonderzoek

An MP asked the minister why only about 3% of clinical drug trial results are published, whether patients and money are at risk, why the UK and Ireland publish far more, and how the CBG and the EU rules enforce registration. The minister answers that registration is a voluntary guideline-based duty for now, that the binding EU regulation is expected to take effect around end-2021, and that the Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd, not the CBG, supervises compliance.
When the EU regulation on clinical trials enters into force, the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate will also be able to impose sanctions if the publication obligations are not met.

Als de verordening klinisch geneesmiddelenonderzoek in werking treedt, krijgt de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd ook de mogelijkheid om sancties uit te oefenen als niet wordt voldaan aan de betreffende verplichtingen met betrekking tot openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de dreigende uitval van zorgpersoneel door stress

An MP asked the ministers about warnings that healthcare staff face burnout and stress-related absenteeism before a second COVID-19 wave, and whether the government will compensate staff for the deductible when they contract COVID-19 at work. The minister answered that psychosocial support initiatives, a second bonus and a workload programme exist, but rejected waiving the deductible for staff and said employers, not government, hold the duty of care for work-related illness.
However, it is not known or traceable whether healthcare workers contracted the virus at work or outside of it.
Het is echter niet bekend of te achterhalen of zorgmedewerkers het virus tijdens hun werk hebben opgelopen of daarbuiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Kuiken over een BIGregistratie voor personen die een opleiding hebben genoten op een van de eilanden van Caribisch Nederland

MPs Bosman and Kuiken asked whether nursing diplomas from the Caribbean Netherlands are recognised in Europe, whether nurses from there can get BIG registration, and how to treat these diplomas as equivalent. The minister confirmed that the Bonaire nursing programme is equivalent to the Dutch mbo-4 programme and announced a practical workaround for Bonaire diploma holders, with the issue to be addressed in a future BIG amendment.
I intend to apply a practical approach, ahead of a definitive legal arrangement, to the diplomas issued by Fundashon Mariadal
Ik ben voornemens om, vooruitlopend op een definitieve wettelijke regeling, een praktische werkwijze te hanteren met betrekking tot de door Fundashon Mariadal afgegeven diploma's
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Farmalobby wil dekking tegen claims over vaccins’

An MP asks the health minister whether pharmaceutical companies should be shielded from liability claims for COVID-19 vaccines, and whether EU liability rules still apply and what precedents and contract terms exist. The minister replies that EU product liability rules fully apply and citizens' rights are unaffected, but that member states may indemnify manufacturers under strict conditions in contracts that are confidential.
However, the agreements do contain arrangements for member states to indemnify pharmaceutical companies against third-party claims.
Wel worden in de overeenkomsten afspraken gemaakt over een vrijwaring door de Lidstaten van de farmaceutische bedrijven ten aanzien van claims van derden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de oproep om al het zorgpersoneel een bonus te geven

Labour MP Kerstens asks why medical technicians, ICT staff, office workers and roster planners in healthcare are excluded from the COVID-19 bonus, and whether the bonus will be paid this calendar year. The minister defends the targeted design of the bonus, declines to change it, and says the government cannot guarantee payment by year-end because employers control the final payout.
An amendment of the bonus scheme is therefore not necessary in my view.
Een aanpassing van de bonusregeling acht ik dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat de opschaling van ic’s bij een nieuwe coronagolf in gevaar is

An MP asked the ministers about reports of staffing shortages threatening ICU expansion in a second COVID wave, including nurses' limited involvement in planning and reluctance to work extra hours. The minister answered that the CNO advice on nurse involvement is being followed up after the autumn recess, that regional plans are reportedly progressing, and that an extra bonus and staff-involvement measures are planned.
On how we will follow up the CNO's advice, your House will be informed after the autumn recess, as stated.
Over hoe we vervolg gaan geven aan het advies van de CNO wordt uw Kamer zoals gezegd geïnformeerd na het herfstreces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over het besluit Nr. 1/2020 van het Associatiecomité EU-Marokko van 16 maart 2020

ChristenUnie MPs asked whether the EU-Morocco association committee decision on annual information exchange, and the trade preferences extended to products from Western Sahara, has led to exports to the EU and the Netherlands, whether such products are correctly labelled, and whether a list of exported products will be requested and enforced by the NVWA. The government confirmed the exports and the operational information mechanism, said food labelling rules apply regardless of origin and enforcement lies with the NVWA on a risk basis, but did not commit to a new list or specific enforcement.
Part of the agreed information exchange between the EU and Morocco is that Morocco shares with the EU data on exports of products originating in Western Sahara to the EU.

Onderdeel van de overeengekomen informatie-uitwisseling tussen de EU en Marokko is dat Marokko gegevens over de uitvoer van producten van oorsprong uit de Westelijke Sahara naar de EU deelt met de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat een meneer na 123 dagen op de IC overleed aan corona

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister for Medical Care about a reported COVID-19 patient who died after 123 days in intensive care, and about current ICU numbers and long ICU stays. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, gave the number of COVID ICU patients on 16 September (54), and provided a table of COVID admissions lasting over 21 days by period, but did not answer before the deadline.
On 16 September there were 54 COVID patients in the ICU
Op 16 september lagen er 54 COVID-patiënten op de IC
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de dreiging van een boete voor het Israël Producten Centrum

MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP asked the minister why the NVWA is enforcing the 2015 EU interpretive notice on labelling of settlement goods against the Israel Producten Centrum, and why this is not applied equally to other occupied territories, and about consistency with UN and BDS positions. The government answered that EU origin-labelling rules apply uniformly, that the NVWA acted after a complaint, inspection and re-inspection under its intervention policy, and that the 2019 CJEU ruling confirms settlement products must be labelled as such.
There is no exception for Israel or the Israeli-occupied territories or any other country or territory.
Er is geen uitzondering voor Israël of de door Israël bezette gebieden of een ander land of gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht van weer dreigende tekorten aan beschermingsmiddelen

MPs asked whether a shortage of protective equipment such as gloves and protective gowns was looming in hospitals, including reports of staff using rain jackets, and whether supplies would be sufficient in a possible second wave. The minister replied that the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen has stockpiled ample supplies (21 million isolation gowns and 118 million gloves ready for delivery), that hospitals can order from it, and that signals of shortages are being checked, while noting the global market remains volatile.
Signals about possible shortages are therefore explicitly being checked.
Signalen over mogelijke tekorten worden daarom nadrukkelijk nagetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Viecurie vreest voor zelfstandigheid'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about the cancelled merger between VieCuri and Laurentius hospitals and its consequences for regional acute care, emergency departments, obstetrics, and decision-making. The minister answered that the government leaves the matter to hospitals and insurers, that quality of care must be safeguarded, and described the regional data, stakeholder views and involvement in the decision.
It is for the health insurers to talk with the hospitals to secure continuity and quality of care.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraars om met de ziekenhuizen in gesprek te gaan om de continuïteit en kwaliteit te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over geen beroeps- en bezwaarprocedure compensatie eigen bijdrage kinderopvang

An MP asked the State Secretary why parents receiving the childcare fee compensation may be under-compensated, whether there is a hardship clause or appeal route, and how the group of parents not covered by any scheme will be compensated. The State Secretary acknowledged the approximation, said objections remain possible within normal deadlines, admitted that a website statement wrongly implied otherwise, and said a compensation scheme for uncovered parents is being developed.
Parents can always object within the usual time limits if they disagree with the compensation.
Ouders kunnen binnen de gebruikelijke termijnen altijd in bezwaar gaan als zij het niet eens zijn met de vergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over over de verdubbeling van de prijzen voor persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen door het Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH)

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the doubling of prices for personal protective equipment by the national LCH consortium, why the August letter did not mention this, and whether domestic production should be prioritised. The minister confirmed the price increase on three products, justified it as necessary to avoid market distortion and dependence on the LCH, and described domestic production contracts and a planned strategic stockpile.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "het schrikbewind jegens bijstandsgerechtigden in de gemeente Enschede"

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether residents of Enschede who were harmed by alleged unlawful welfare practices (unlawful waiting periods, late advances, incorrect minimum-income calculations, reduced benefits, privacy breaches) should be compensated, and about other individual cases. The state secretary answers that municipal implementation is primarily the responsibility of the municipal council and the college, declines to judge individual cases, and points to objection, appeal, damages claims and complaint routes as remedies.
It is not for me to pass judgment on individual descriptions such as those in the broadcast you cite.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over individuele beschrijvingen zoals in de door u aangehaalde uitzending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de ziekte van Parkinson en het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen

An MP asks the government about a publication linking certain pesticides to Parkinson's disease, the adequacy of EU approval testing for neurotoxic effects, and monitoring of residues. The minister says the EU procedure will be tightened, commits to asking the Commission to revise data requirements, and points to ongoing Gezondheidsraad and monitoring work.
I have in the meantime asked the European Commission by letter to start a process to revise the data requirements on neurological disorders.
heb de Europese Commissie inmiddels per brief verzocht een traject te starten om de datavereisten op het gebied van neurologische aandoeningen te herzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verdrinkingen deze zomer en de financiële problemen bij de Reddingsbrigade

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of Medical Care about drownings in summer 2020 and the Reddingsbrigade's financial problems, including volunteers paying fees, the status of a drowning-prevention plan, and a motion on structural funding. The minister expressed sympathy, endorsed shared responsibility for water safety, said talks with the Reddingsbrigade on finances are ongoing, and promised more insight this autumn.
I expect to have more insight this autumn into what is needed to secure the continuity and quality of the Reddingsbrigade's work so that water safety is not compromised.
Ik verwacht dit najaar meer inzicht te hebben wat nodig is om de continuïteit en de kwaliteit van het werk van de Reddingsbrigade te borgen zodat de zwemveiligheid niet in het geding komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Zorgmedewerkers willen voorrang bij coronatests nu wachttijden oplopen'

An MP from the PvdA asked the health ministers whether they would grant priority coronavirus testing to healthcare workers after unions and care employers called for it amid growing test waiting times, and why shortages persisted despite claims of sufficient capacity. The answer refers the MP to a letter on test-and-trace strategy and does not address the questions directly.

The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to the Ministers of Health, Welfare and Sport and for Medical Care (submitted 17 August 2020) have been answered by letter 'Testing and tracing: strategically combating the Corona pandemic together'.

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan de Ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Medische Zorg (ingezonden 17 augustus 2020). zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Ouders kwaad over weigeren snotterende kinderen bij kinderdagverblijf’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that parents were angry at childcare centres refusing children with colds, and asked for clarity on the RIVM guidance and talks with the sector. The state secretary acknowledged the signals, summarised the June 2020 RIVM guidance allowing children under 4 and school-age children with only a runny nose and no fever to attend, and said signals are discussed with the RIVM.
The RIVM guideline was adjusted in June.
De richtlijn van het RIVM is in juni aangepast
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Kankerverwekkende stof ontdekt in partijen paracetamol’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of a carcinogenic impurity (para-chloroaniline) in paracetamol batches, the divergent EMA and EFSA risk assessments, the supply chain, and whether the supplier identity should be disclosed. The Minister replied that CBG and IGJ found no batches exceeding the ICH limit, that the regulatory norms are sound, and that supplier disclosure is withheld under confidentiality rules applied in line with EU guidance.
The CBG does not provide data on the basis of joint agreements. It is up to the manufacturer itself to make this data public.
Het CBG verstrekt geen gegevens op basis van gezamenlijke afspraken. Het is aan de fabrikant zelf om deze gegevens openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over met de kankerverwekkende stof PCA vervuilde paracetamol

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about paracetamol contaminated with the carcinogenic substance PCA, including the timing of an IGJ investigation, differing EMA/EFSA safety limits, the non-disclosure of the Chinese supplier's customers, and whether shops should be consulted. The minister replied that the CBG and IGJ examined batches with the regulatory limits in mind, that the ICH M7 approach was retained, that supplier names are commercially confidential under the Dutch WOB, and that no product recall or retailer consultation was warranted.
The CBG does not provide data on the basis of joint agreements.
Het CBG verstrekt geen gegevens op basis van gezamenlijke afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de crash tussen wielrenners Fabio Jakobsen en Dylan Groenwegen op woensdag 5 augustus in de Ronde van Polen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the serious crash in the Tour of Poland sprint finish that injured cyclist Fabio Jakobsen, and whether cycling safety rules should be tightened. The minister said the UCI and national federations are responsible for race safety rules, while offering to discuss the KNWU's safety requirements.
It is up to the UCI (the international cycling federation) to set further rules, together with its members including the KNWU, on matters such as a safe finish area.
Het is aan de UCI (de internationale wielerfederatie) om daar samen met zijn leden, waaronder de KNWU, nadere regels te stellen aan onder andere een veilig finishgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het kwijtschelden van schulden in Arnhem

An MP asked the state secretary about municipal debt write-offs for welfare recipients, fines and surcharges on unpaid health premiums, and stacking of penalties across agencies. The government answered that it does not know how many municipalities use the arrangement, defended the existing penalty regime while promising personalised debt support, rejected using the penalty to repay health debts and automatic deduction of other fixed costs, and committed to a report on surcharges due in autumn 2020.
It is not known how many municipalities together with health insurers use the exit scheme for welfare recipients.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten samen met zorgverzekeraars gebruikmaken van de uitstroomregeling bijstandsgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de beperkte mogelijkheden om maatwerk te leveren bij de kostendelersnorm

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the sparing use of municipal discretion (maatwerk) under the cost-sharer norm in the Participation Act, its effect on homelessness and informal care, and whether the norm should be abolished. The State Secretary pointed to a Divosa handbook subsidy and an ongoing study by Significant APE, said the link to homelessness is not proven, referred to municipal responsibility for implementation, and declined to abolish the norm before the study's results.
The causal link between the cost-sharer norm and homelessness, however, has not been demonstrated.
Het oorzakelijk verband tussen de kostendelersnorm en dakloosheid is evenwel niet aangetoond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Diertens over berichten in het Noord-Hollands Dagblad over intimidatie en misbruik van jonge turnsters

MPs Westerveld and Diertens asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of abuse of young gymnasts, including whether an involved coach remains in the Olympic track, support for victims, complaint figures at the CVSN, handling by the ISR, and coach training. The minister answered that the KNGU suspended the Team NL women's programme pending an independent inquiry, outlined the victim support and reporting structures, gave complaint and case figures, and declined to make vertrouwenspersonen mandatory while pointing to federations for coach standards.
I am very reluctant to impose obligations on sports associations.
Ik ben zeer terughoudend met het opleggen van verplichtingen aan sportverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Turncoach Gerrit Beltman verbreekt stilzwijgen over zijn onmenselijke trainingsmethoden

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care (VWS) about coach Gerrit Beltman's admitted abuse of young gymnasts and the KNGU's response. The minister condemned the conduct, said VWS funds independent research, pledged support for follow-up with the CVSN, described existing VOG and registration-list screening, and noted the KNGU suspended a Team NL program with six coaches pending the investigation.
That is why the Ministry of VWS is funding independent research into the nature, scale and approach of boundary-crossing behaviour in gymnastics.
Daarom financiert het Ministerie van VWS het onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de aard, omvang en aanpak van grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de turn- en gymsport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het artikel 'UEFA wil maatregelen tegen koppen in jeugdvoetbal'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about UEFA's recommendation to limit heading by children in youth football and about risks of head injuries in combat sports. The minister answered that the KNVB already applies UEFA-aligned measures, that no conclusive evidence of harm exists yet with research due in spring 2021, and that the ban on kicking and punching the head for under-18 combat athletes is enforced by the sector and the Vechtsportautoriteit.
Based on current scientific knowledge, there is no unambiguous evidence of harm resulting from heading.
Op basis van de huidige wetenschappelijke kennis is geen eenduidig bewijs van schade als gevolg van koppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over "het verdringen van reguliere arbeid"

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Karabulut asked why the government's Participation Act factsheet gives no information on displacement testing, what 'other workplaces' include, and whether municipalities test for displacement of regular work, asking for figures, follow-up and measures. The state secretary answered that displacement testing is a municipal responsibility not monitored centrally, that no figures on detected displacement exist, that the existing legal framework is adequate, and that he opposes a statutory displacement test (Wet verdringingstoets).
Testing for displacement is a decentralised responsibility of municipalities, and no statistical information on it is collected centrally.
De toetsing op verdringing is een decentrale verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en daarover wordt (centraal) geen statistische informatie verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het bericht 'Crisis legt bom onder banenafspraak gehandicapten'

An MP asked whether the COVID-19 crisis is endangering jobs for people with disabilities under the jobs agreement, and whether rules on earning income while on benefits should be relaxed. The state secretary answered that data will only be available later in 2020, that consultations on extra measures are ongoing, and that relaxing benefit income rules would undermine existing policy.
The first indication of the corona effect on the results for the jobs agreement will be the UWV trend report at the end of October 2020, as stated in the answer to question 2.
De eerste indicatie van het coronaeffect op de resultaten voor de banenafspraak zal zoals in het antwoord op vraag 2 aangegeven de trendrapportage van UWV van eind oktober 2020 zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een mogelijke aanbesteding van het Centraal Administratie Kantoor

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the CAK's collection tenders overlap with the CJIB, why small bailiff offices are excluded by the lot structure, and whether price is effectively the selection criterion. The minister explains the CAK is transferring most enforcement to the CJIB, the remaining tender is a separate gradual transition, and lots are limited for efficiency and single-contact reasons, with 70% weight on quality.
Within the tender the CAK applies the following price and quality ratio: price 30% and quality 70%.
Het CAK hanteert binnen de aanbesteding de volgende verhouding voor prijs en kwaliteit: prijs = 30% en kwaliteit = 70%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de schuldsanering en een effectieve schuldenrechter

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister about debt relief, the accessibility of the Wsnp debt-discharge procedure, and a more effective debt judge. The Minister answered that the government is working with the State Secretary on better linking the voluntary and statutory debt tracks, and will inform Parliament in summer 2020 on concrete steps, while rejecting an external supervisory body and a maximum duration for voluntary debt assistance.
I am not in favour of a maximum term, but I am in favour of progress and transparency.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een maximumtermijn, maar wel van voortgang en transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over problemen voor sociale ondernemingen met de Tijdelijke Noodmaatregel voor Overbrugging Werkgelegenheid (NOW)

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk asked whether talks with Cedris stalled, whether social workplaces will get compensation, and whether the NOW wage subsidy should be opened to them. The State Secretary replied that the Wsw grant was raised by €90 million for compensation, that social enterprises are treated like other firms for revenue loss under the NOW, and that no further commitment to municipalities is given beyond referring to the earlier letter.
Social workplaces and social entrepreneurs are not treated differently from other companies and institutions in the scheme when assessing revenue loss for the NOW.
Sociale werkvoorzieningen en sociaal ondernemers worden in de regeling niet anders behandeld dan andere bedrijven en instellingen bij de beoordeling van het omzetverlies voor de NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over problemen voor sociale ondernemingen met de NOW

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether social workplaces and social entrepreneurs are disadvantaged under the NOW wage subsidy because subsidies count toward turnover, and whether a special compensation scheme is planned. The State Secretary replied that they are eligible, that subsidies must count toward turnover to avoid double financing, and that the government increased the Wsw contribution by 90 million euros for March to June 2020 while noting ongoing municipal financial pressure.
That I find undesirable and therefore I am not willing to do so.
Dat vind ik onwenselijk en daarom ben ik daartoe niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de borging van veilig en gezond werken bij het verwijderen van asbesthoudende vensterbanken

An MP from the SP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs why the Sci 547 committee rejected a request to classify asbestos-containing window sills as risk class 1, how this fits a 2019 pilot and a 2009 letter, whether workers were exposed above limits, and why the CCvD Asbest proposal was not adopted. The State Secretary replies that the committee has since approved the downgrade to risk class 1, that the ministry did not authorise the pilot, that exposure measurements stay below the limit value, and that the CCvD proposal conflicted with existing regulation and certification principles.
With the opening of the Validation and Innovation Point (VIP) the Sci 547 Committee has indeed been dissolved and no new applications for innovative working methods have been handled by it since.

Met de opening van het Validatie- en Innovatiepunt (VIP) is inderdaad de Commissie Sci 547 opgeheven en zijn door de Commissie Sci 547 geen nieuwe aanvragen voor innovatieve werkwijzen meer in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over corona onder het personeel van het vleesbedrijf Vion in Boxtel

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether measures at Vion's Boxtel meat plant are effective after new COVID-19 cases among staff, whether labour and food inspectorates oversee the plant and temporary agency workers, and why the plant stayed open when Vion's Apeldoorn site was closed. The government answered that the new cases were found at health checks at the gate, that the Inspectorate SZW enforces the Working Conditions Act and has started inspections of slaughterhouses, and that the NVWA and safety region monitor the measures, while noting the causes of infections are still under study.
The Inspectorate SZW will deploy additional inspections at slaughterhouses in the coming period.
De Inspectie SZW zal de komende tijd extra inzetten op inspecties bij slachthuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over de berichten 'Coronabesmettingen bij VION in Boxtel nog altijd aan de orde van de dag'

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked whether the ongoing COVID-19 infections at the Vion slaughterhouse in Boxtel, and the company's claim that its workplace is safe, warrant closure in light of a parliamentary motion. The Staatssecretaris replied that closure decisions lie with the regional safety board chair on GGD advice, that the plant resumed production on 2 June with extensive measures, and that a national coordination platform is being set up, while stating no signals currently show the measures are ineffective.
The chairs of the safety regions are, under the Public Health Act, the Safety Regions Act and emergency ordinances, the competent authority to take measures at regional level.

De voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio's zijn op basis van de Wet publieke gezondheid, de Wet op de Veiligheidsregio's en Noodverordeningen het bevoegd gezag in deze om op regionaal niveau maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Postma over het verwachte personeelstekort in de kinderopvang deze zomer

MPs Van Meenen and Postma asked the state secretary about an expected summer staff shortage in childcare, the sector's views on labour market tightness, and the timing of a promised labour market vision and plan. The state secretary answered that short-term shortages may persist, that the emergency childcare payment scheme provided stability, that a recession could reduce demand later, and that talks with the sector will resume with a report to parliament to follow.
I will inform your House of the outcome of these talks.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomst van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld,Kwint, Gijs van Dijk, Bruins en Postma over het bericht 'Grootste Nederlandse kinderopvangbedrijf zit fiscaal op de Kaaimaneilanden'

MPs from five parties asked whether the largest Dutch childcare company, owned via investment funds in the Cayman Islands, is permissible, whether public money leaks to tax havens, and whether ownership rules should change. The Secretary of State answered that childcare quality rules apply regardless of ownership, cited existing anti-avoidance measures, declined to confirm specific dividend flows citing tax secrecy, and rejected extra ownership restrictions.
To the extent information is known to the Tax Authority, the cabinet cannot, under the statutory tax confidentiality duty, confirm or deny which payments an individual taxpayer makes and to whom.

Voor zover hierover informatie bij de Belastingdienst bekend is, kan het kabinet op grond van de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht bevestigen noch ontkennen welke betalingen door een individuele belastingplichtige worden gedaan en aan wie dat gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Aartsen en Van der Linde over het bericht 'AFM waarschuwt voor schulden bij leasen van een auto of wasmachine’

MPs asked the government about AFM warnings on debt risks from private leasing of cars and appliances, including its size, contract terms, consumer information, BKR registration and whether it should fall under AFM supervision. The minister answered that private lease is unregulated and growing, outlined existing self-regulation and information, and committed to talks with market parties and the AFM on possible measures.
I will ask the AFM and other relevant parties to provide more insight into, among other things, the growth of private lease, the causes of this growth and the risks for consumers.
Ik zal de AFM en andere relevante partijen vragen om meer inzicht te geven in onder andere de groei van private lease, de oorzaken van deze groei en de risico's voor consumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over “snelle toegang van zzp’ers tot het Besluit bijstandverlening zelfstandigen (Bbz)”

MPs from D66 asked the State Secretary how quickly self-employed people without staff can obtain Bbz benefits during the coronavirus crisis, including eligibility conditions, processing times, capacity, and tax deferral information. The State Secretary answered that eligibility conditions apply, that municipalities are responsible for processing and speed, and pointed to the temporary Tozo scheme as the faster route.
There is no data known about the actual average decision time by municipalities.
Er zijn geen gegevens bekend over de feitelijke, gemiddelde beslisduur door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over “zelfstandigen die net buiten de Tijdelijke overbruggingsregeling zelfstandig ondernemers (Tozo) dreigen te vallen”

An MP asked whether self-employed people with a VAT number but no Chamber of Commerce registration on 17 March 2020 are excluded from the Tozo, and how municipalities should handle hardship cases and advances that must be repaid. The state secretary confirmed that registration in the trade register is a cumulative legal requirement, that VAT status does not substitute for it, that deviation is only possible under strict 'very urgent reasons' rules, and that the criteria were not changed from the earlier published framework.
The number of self-employed persons registered with the Chamber of Commerce but without a VAT number can only be small.
Het aantal zelfstandigen dat beschikt over een inschrijving bij de Kamer van Koophandel, maar niet over een btw-nummer, kan niet anders dan gering zijn.
Antwoord op van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de schuldenaanpak in Purmerend

An MP asked the state secretary about the Purmerend debt-prevention approach, whether debt becomes problematic when third parties profit, whether a new debt offensive and waiver of collection surcharges is needed during the corona crisis, whether commercial trustees and bailiffs should be regulated, and about a national debt fund. The government answered that early-warning debt policy is supported, that collection should be responsible, that a study on surcharge waivers and trustee fee rules is underway, and that no national debt fund exists though several initiatives are being explored.
There is no national debt fund.
Er is geen sprake van een Nationaal Schuldenfonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht “Schuldhulp Eindhoven faalt" in het Eindhovens Dagblad van 28 mei 2020

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that debt assistance in Eindhoven was failing, citizens' right to timely and consistent debt help, funding, a national debt fund, incassо practices and access to the Wsnp debt-relief procedure. The government answered that the Eindhoven evaluation was municipally initiated, pointed to statutory standards and existing and planned initiatives, and promised further information to parliament on Wsnp access.
The cabinet will inform the House this summer about the outcomes of the investigations and the steps taken to improve the link between voluntary debt assistance and the Wsnp.
Wij zullen uw Kamer deze zomer informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken en de stappen die genomen worden om de aansluiting tussen de minnelijke schuldhulpverlening en de Wsnp te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Smeulders over veilig werken in tijden van corona

MPs Renkema and Smeulders asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about unsafe working conditions during the coronavirus pandemic, including workers' numbers, the Inspectorate's enforcement, the legal basis for enforcing corona rules, and the status of sector protocols. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate receives many complaints and resumed on-site inspections under conditions, that enforcement of emergency ordinances lies mainly with safety regions, and that legislation to strengthen the Inspectorate's powers is being prepared.
However, I can report that up to and including 29 May, 1,586 corona-related reports were made to the Inspectorate SZW.
Wel kan ik melden dat tot en met 29 mei jl. 1.586 corona gerelateerde meldingen bij de Inspectie SZW zijn gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "een garantietermijn van twee jaar bij de nieuwe Wajong".

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the state secretary how the adopted motion on temporary crisis measures would be implemented, whether the Wajong guarantee period should be extended for people with work disabilities given COVID-19 labour market effects, and whether stakeholder organisations would be consulted. The state secretary answered that the two-year extension would be considered within the Stienen motion, that effects will be monitored with a letter to the Senate in summer 2020, and that the ministry and UWV keep in contact with the target group and interest organisations, without committing to an extension now.

In line with the Stienen motion, I will inform the Senate in summer 2020 about how I will monitor the effects of the crisis and in 2021 will work to strengthen the crisis resilience of the guarantee amount.

Conform de motie Stienen c.s. zal ik de Eerste Kamer in de zomer van 2020 informeren over hoe ik de gevolgen van de crisis ga monitoren en in 2021 zal inzetten op het versterken van de crisisbestendigheid van het garantiebedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over overwerk in relatie tot toeslagen

Two SP MPs asked whether the government will protect care and other essential workers from losing childcare, rent and healthcare allowances because of overtime during the coronavirus crisis, and whether it will give certainty about having to repay allowances. The government answered that it cannot identify overtime effects on household income, that allowances must follow actual income, and that it will focus on communication and individual arrangements rather than a special scheme, apologising for the delay.

The cabinet will now primarily focus on communication to point citizens to the importance of reporting expected changes in household income for 2020 to the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances as soon as possible.

Het kabinet zal nu primair inzetten op communicatie om burgers te wijzen op het belang om verwachte wijzigingen in het huishoudinkomen van 2020 zo snel mogelijk door te geven aan de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Peters over het bericht ‘Aanpassing Arbobesluit 7.23d werkbakken leidt tot meer ongevallen

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary whether the amended Arbobesluit 7.23d allowing work baskets on crane hooks for personnel transport increases risks, citing TNO and RIVM findings and claimed costs of over 42 million euro per year. The State Secretary defended the amendment as a narrowly conditioned extension that remains exceptional, disputed the cost figure and said the RIVM study did not assess relative risks of work methods.

With the proposed amendment of Article 7.23d of the Arbobesluit, the possibility has been created to use equipment not designed and set up for transporting persons when no suitable equipment or work methods exist to reach the locations safely.

Met de voorgenomen wijziging van artikel 7.23d van het Arbobesluit is de mogelijkheid gecreëerd om een arbeidsmiddel, dat niet bestemd en ingericht is voor het vervoer van personen, in te zetten als er geen geëigende arbeidsmiddelen en/of werkmethodes zijn om de plaatsen veilig te kunnen bereiken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Weyenberg over de berichten: 'Coronaslachters Groenlo mogelijk aan het werk in plaats van in quarantaine' en 'Varkensstallen dreigen vol te raken door sluiting slachthuizen

Two D66 MPs asked the government about reports of Groenlo slaughterhouse workers possibly working while in quarantine, overcrowded pig stables due to slaughterhouse closures, and related labour, enforcement and animal welfare concerns. The government answered that the regional safety authorities and the NVWA/Inspectie SZW are responsible for enforcement, that a breeding ban is disproportionate, that borders cannot be closed to EU live animals, and that sectors will develop short-term scenarios.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Peters over het bericht 'Samenwerking bij verwijderen asbest loopt vast, 'overheid moet ingrijpen''

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a critical report on the asbestos certification system (Ascert, innovation, possible independent authority, risk classes, schemes) and the government answered each question, rejecting an independent regulator for now, pointing to its reform measures and new innovation body VIP, and declining to answer one question because it belongs to another ministry. The answers commit to several concrete steps such as a convenant with Ascert and an upcoming scheme update, while largely restating existing policy.
An independent authority on top of the existing ones is not on the agenda.
Een onafhankelijke autoriteit bovenop de reeds bestaande, is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over oplopende armoede door corona

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about rising poverty and debt during the corona crisis, covering debt relief, youth benefits, collective special assistance, food banks, utility disconnections, evictions and rent increases. The State Secretary answers that existing measures, municipal debt assistance funding, a targeted rather than generic rent freeze and assurances on food banks and utilities are in place, while declining categorical benefits and giving limited data.
No figures are available on the number of disconnections, but as far as I am aware no companies in these sectors have failed to adapt their disconnection policy to the corona crisis.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal afsluitingen, maar voor zover mij bekend zijn er geen bedrijven in deze sectoren die hun afsluitbeleid niet hebben aangepast aan de coronacrisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over “uitsluiting van studenten en jongeren voor de Tijdelijke overbruggingsregeling zelfstandig ondernemers”

An MP asked why young self-employed people under 21 receive only the youth benchmark under the Tozo and why students are excluded entirely. The state secretary explained that the youth norms follow the Participatiewet and parental maintenance duty, and that students are excluded because studiefinanciering counts as a prior provision, while committing to no retroactive change.
Due to the decentralised implementation of the Tozo, I do not have the requested data.
Vanwege de gedecentraliseerde uitvoering van de Tozo beschik ik niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Leijten en Van Kent over kinderopvangtoeslag in werkloosheid tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs of the SP asked whether childcare allowance is stopped after three months of unemployment during the coronavirus crisis and whether the government will extend that period to six months given weak job prospects and childcare waiting lists. The State Secretary answered that parents keep the allowance for three months and can use remaining hours until year-end under the annual system, and declined to extend the period because past extensions had limited effect and the economic outlook is uncertain.

Given the room that the existing unemployment period and the annual system already offer, and given the limited effects in the past, the uncertainty about the economic outlook and its effect on waiting lists, I do not consider it opportune to extend the unemployment period.

Gegeven de ruimte die de bestaande werkloosheidstermijn en de jaarsystematiek reeds bieden, en gegeven de beperkte effecten in het verleden, de onzekerheid over het economische beeld en het effect daarvan op wachtlijsten, vind ik het niet opportuun om de werkloosheidstermijn te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Jasper van Dijk over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat verhoging van het minimumloon weinig banen kost

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about a CPB update finding that raising the minimum wage costs fewer jobs than previously thought, and whether the government would reconsider its opposition to a substantial minimum wage increase. The ministers welcomed the study, said the job losses are smaller but still substantial when the benefit link is kept, and saw no reason to change their position or raise the minimum wage now.
At this moment I see no reason to revise the response to the initiative note and raise the minimum wage.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om de reactie op de initiatiefnota te herzien en het WML te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de armoede en schulden onder jongeren als gevolg van de Participatiewet

An MP asked the state secretary whether young people on welfare or minimum youth wages can live independently, how many young people are affected, and whether the rules should change (cost-sharing norm, youth norm, four-week search period, debt administration costs). The secretary defended the youth norm and parental maintenance duty, pointed to case-by-case supplementary assistance by municipalities, gave cost estimates for possible changes, and declined to scrap the four-week search period except temporarily during the coronavirus crisis.
The cabinet considers it important that young people do not provide for their living costs through a benefit, but work on their labour market prospects through study or work experience.
Het kabinet vindt het van belang dat jongeren niet door middel van een uitkering voorzien in hun bestaanskosten, maar werken aan hun perspectief op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over de vraag hoe mensen die kinderopvang geheel zelf betalen ook gecompenseerd zullen worden

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked how parents who pay for childcare entirely themselves, without childcare allowance, will be compensated during the COVID-19 closure, and why the compensation scheme relies on Tax Authority data that does not capture them. The State Secretary answered that only a few thousand such parents are estimated, that the scheme uses existing Tax Authority data for speed and privacy reasons, and that the government will consider a form of compensation for this group once more is known about them.
The number of people who do not qualify for childcare allowance cannot be estimated.
Het aantal mensen dat niet in aanmerking komt voor kinderopvangtoeslag is niet in te schatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Kuik en Kuiken over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs asked the government about the consequences of the COVID-19 crisis for people in prostitution, including unregistered workers without income support, bed-bath-bread shelter, exit programmes, police raids, and online advertising for physical services. The minister answered that sex workers can access existing support schemes and municipal shelters, that a ban on prostitution applies under the emergency ordinance, that exit demand has not yet grown substantially, and that the ordinance may be amended to address online advertising.
Such possibilities are currently being examined.
Op dit moment worden zulke mogelijkheden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de positie van mensen met schulden in de coronacrisis

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about debt-related disconnections from telecom and utility services during the coronavirus crisis, forced evictions, collection of childhood school-book debts after age 18, and access to debt-restructuring schemes. The government answered that providers have agreed to be lenient and offered tailored solutions, that a sector-wide evictions moratorium applies, that parents are liable for children's debts, and that it will work on improving access to the Wsnp, with some items left for later updates.
No figures are available on the number of evictions in the past three months, but it is not likely that there have been many evictions.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal huisuitzettingen van de afgelopen drie maanden, maar het is niet waarschijnlijk dat er veel huisuitzettingen zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over de Kamerbrief ‘Uitbreiding doelgroep Tijdelijke overbruggingsregeling zelfstandig ondernemers’

Two CDA MPs asked why cross-border self-employed people (living in NL with a business abroad, or living abroad with a business in NL) are treated differently under the Tozo and foreign benefits, and asked about monitoring, communication and numbers. The Secretary of State explained the territoriality principle, stated the reasoning behind eligibility, said no monitoring is planned because refusals cannot show who falls between the schemes, and gave rough estimates of affected entrepreneurs.
The answer to the first question is yes, with a caveat.
Het antwoord op de eerste vraag luidt ja, met een kanttekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Jasper van Dijk over het onderzoek ‘Undercover bij Wehkamp’

MPs Peters and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act against Wehkamp's instalment-credit practices, including a 14% interest rate, lenient collection and a business model that resembles lending. The minister answered that the maximum credit fee will be temporarily cut to 10%, an external study on a structural cut is under way, and further measures will be assessed at the end of the year, while citing limited data on the direct effect of mail-order credit on debt problems.
To better protect consumers against the high costs of credit in this difficult period, I am temporarily lowering the maximum credit fee from 14 percent to 10 percent.
Om consumenten in deze lastige periode beter te beschermen tegen de hoge kosten van krediet, verlaag ik tijdelijk de maximale kredietvergoeding van 14 procent naar 10 procent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Werkgever beboet voor discrimineren zwangere: Velen gaan de fout in’

An MP asks the Secretary of State about pregnancy discrimination at work, including the burden of proof, fixed-term contracts, the temporary-agency clause and the new recruitment-discrimination law. The government acknowledges the problem, points to existing legal protection and to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, and declines to change the law for now while the courts decide pending cases.
I will bring this possibility more firmly to attention in communication about the rights of pregnant women and women who have just given birth.
Ik zal in de communicatie over de rechten van zwangere vrouwen en vrouwen die net bevallen zijn deze mogelijkheid steviger onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over "het doorprocederen door de overheid"

Two SP MPs asked whether Enschede's municipality acted improperly by pursuing a benefit recovery to cover social investigation costs and monitoring bank spending to the euro, and whether this reflects a wider practice of prolonged litigation by government. The state secretary answered that it is a municipal case for the council to supervise, that no signals suggest a systemic practice, and that the government will share an interdepartmental plan to reduce unnecessary procedures with parliament before summer.
This concerns a case within an individual municipality. It is not for me or the Minister for Legal Protection to pass judgment on individual descriptions such as those in the article you cite.

Het betreft hier een casus binnen een individuele gemeente. Het is niet aan mij of de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming om een oordeel te vellen over individuele beschrijvingen zoals in het door u aangehaalde artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over stelende bewindvoerders

MPs Van Dijk and Peters asked the government about trustees (bewindvoerders) who embezzled clients' money in Limburg, including why intervention was slow, prosecution capacity, complaint handling, and whether a blacklist or regional lists should be created. The minister answered that courts dismissed the trustees, criminal proceedings are pending with the OM, quality requirements since 2014 are monitored by the judiciary, and that no blacklist is planned, while complaint routes and a white list are described.
The OM does not have this data because it is not registered by occupational group or profession of the suspect.
Het OM beschikt niet over deze gegevens omdat niet wordt geregistreerd op beroepsgroep of beroep van de verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over falende bewindvoerders

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked about rogue court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) who allegedly defraud clients, and what the government will do about supervision and complaints. The minister answered that dismissal, liability and court supervision exist, that quality requirements and the Landelijk Kwaliteitsbureau are in place, and that stakeholders will explore mandatory training and the government will look into the motion on improving the system.
I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over ontwikkelingen op het dossier BUIG, bekostiging bijstandsuitkeringen en uitspraak Centrale Raad van Beroep

MP Renkema (GroenLinks) asked why Utrecht and The Hague are returning to court over 2015 social assistance budget allocations, why arbitration was not pursued, and how the BUIG budget model and surpluses/deficits for municipalities are handled. The State Secretary answered that SZW recalculated 2015 budgets for four municipalities using the 2017 model as basis, that the model is objective and rewards effective municipalities, and that structural solutions for the wider social domain are being pursued via further talks.
It is therefore up to the CRvB to give the final judgment in these cases.
Het is daarmee aan de CRvB om het uiteindelijke oordeel te geven in deze zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over arbeidsmigranten onvoldoende beschermd tegen het coronavirus

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether migrant workers in vital sectors are adequately protected against coronavirus given crowded housing, transport and dependence of housing on employment. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to shared responsibilities of employers and agencies, promised communication in multiple languages and referred enforcement of safety rules to the Labour Inspectorate and municipalities, without committing to new binding measures.

Yes. Cooperation is taking place with employers' organisations, trade unions, municipalities and embassies to address as well as possible the problems now arising for migrant workers and employers, and to enforce where possible.

Ja. Er wordt samengewerkt met werkgeversorganisaties, vakbonden, gemeenten en ambassades om de problemen die nu ontstaan voor arbeidsmigranten en werkgevers, zo goed mogelijk aan te pakken en waar mogelijk te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over gevolgen van de coronacrisis

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs how municipalities handle reintegration duties, sanctions and the work obligation under the Participatiewet during the COVID-19 crisis, and about safety at workplaces and the risk to thrift shops. The State Secretary answered that municipalities apply case-by-case discretion and safety rules, declined a categorical suspension of obligations, and said no specific signals of thrift-shop bankruptcy were known.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in armoede, voedselbanken en sociale werkvoorzieningen

An SP MP asked the Minister and State Secretary of Social Affairs about food banks, poverty, flex and zero-hour workers, debt enforcement, sheltered employment and migrant housing during the coronavirus crisis. The State Secretary answered that a temporary food bank fund of four million euros is provided, that income support schemes (NOW, Tozo) exist, that enforcement restraint is agreed with landlords and bodies, and that migrant housing is being addressed, mostly by referring to existing measures and further letters.
A one-off subsidy of four million euros is made available by the cabinet as a safety net for the calamity fund.
Er wordt eenmalig een subsidie van vier miljoen euro als vangnet voor het calamiteitenfonds beschikbaar gesteld door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht "Deeltijdbaan met bijstand werkt niet"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that part-time work combined with social assistance is hard to make work, including the option to widen income disregards and to pay allowances monthly. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to the Simpel Switchen project, the planned calculation tool and the IBO Toeslagen review, and did not commit to new legislation or a set timetable.
That is why I am working with Divosa and municipalities in the Simpel Switchen project on solutions to make part-time work alongside supplementary social assistance less complex.

Daarom werk ik in het project Simpel Switchen in de Participatieketen samen met Divosa en gemeenten aan oplossingsrichtingen om deeltijdwerken met een aanvullende bijstandsuitkering minder complex te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over “menstruatie-armoede in Nederland”

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government will tackle period poverty, including by providing free menstrual products as Scotland does. The state secretary answered that the government favours an integrated poverty approach with municipalities responsible, mentioned school sexuality education and a few municipalities exploring stadspas access, and declined to commit to free provision.
Zie hiervoor het antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over schadelijke effecten voor werknemers in kantoortuinen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about harmful effects of open-plan office landscapes on workers' concentration and health, and whether research, norms and works council involvement should be pursued. The State Secretary answered that existing Arbo rules already cover workplace design, that monitoring will be added to the National Working Conditions Survey, and that the NEN norm for office workplaces will be reviewed.
I want to gain more insight into the situation in the Netherlands and am therefore willing to conduct further research.
Ik wil meer zicht krijgen op de situatie in Nederland en ben dus bereid tot nader onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een man die zijn arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering kwijtraakt vanwege een fysiotherapie behandeling

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a self-employed man whose disability insurer refused benefits after he did not disclose physiotherapy treatment on his health declaration, and about whether insurers should face an acceptance obligation and whether the government will act. The Minister defended the legal framework and insurers' disclosure rules, pointed to AFM findings of no structural misconduct, and said a government proposal on mandatory self-employed disability insurance would come before summer 2020.
I have taken note of this report.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van dit bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Westerveld, Renkema en Futselaar over het rapport van WOinActie ‘Inventarisatie omvang en gevolgen van structureel overwerk aan de Nederlandse universiteiten’

Three opposition MPs asked the government about a WOinActie report on structural unpaid overtime at Dutch universities, including whether it is lawful, the government's responsibility, job insecurity and workload causes. The minister answered that the Inspectie SZW will examine the complaints in its planned inspections of the 14 universities, that the Wml, Atw and Arbowet set the legal limits, and that she will press institutions and VSNU on permanent contracts and workload reduction.
It is up to the Inspectie SZW to investigate whether this is indeed the case.
Het is aan de Inspectie SZW om te onderzoeken of dit inderdaad het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over SyRi

An MP asked the state secretary why earlier answers on SyRi in Capelle aan den IJssel omitted that no investigations resulted from the risk reports, and how this discrepancy arose. The state secretary admitted the two answer sets were confusing because a draft report was used for the second set, said the error should have been flagged, and stated that no investigations followed from SyRi risk reports in that project.
The confusion could have been prevented by stating at the time that an error had been made in the publication of the reports.
De verwarring had voorkomen kunnen worden door toen te melden dat er een fout in de publicatie van de rapporten was gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Gehandicapte mag werkbonus nog steeds niet houden, Kamerleden boos'

Two VVD MPs asked why a disabled worker (Wajong recipient) must hand a 12.5-year service bonus to UWV and whether the Wet LB 1964 could be amended for this group, and whether alternatives will be explored. The State Secretary answered that the bonus counts as wage and is offset against the Wajong benefit, that amending the Wet LB 1964 is not the appropriate instrument, and that a harmonised income rule keeps at least 30 percent of extras while UWV lacks reliable data to exempt them fully.
A one-off payment after at least 12.5 years of service is wage within the meaning of the Wet LB 1964 and therefore falls under the income concept.
Een eenmalige verstrekking bij ten minste 12,5 jaar in dienst is loon in de zin van de Wet LB 1964 en valt daarmee onder het inkomensbegrip
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Peters over het bericht dat het extraatje i.v.m. een 12,5 jarig jubileum moet worden ingeleverd vanwege de Wajong-uitkering
