MPs Palland and Peters (CDA) asked how Wajong recipients can keep extra payments above their monthly income, such as a 12.5-year service jubilee bonus, and why a manual reporting process or an exemption from the wage definition was not feasible. The State Secretary replied that Wajongers keep at least 30 percent of extras under the proposed harmonised rule and fully keep one-off payments under the guarantee scheme, but that UWV lacks reliable data on extras and a manual process carries fraud and enforcement risks.
To deviate for the Wajong by exempting extras above the monthly income, UWV must be able to rely on reliable data on the actual amount of these extras.
Om voor de Wajong af te wijken door extra's boven het maandinkomen vrij te stellen, moet UWV kunnen beschikken over betrouwbare gegevens over de feitelijke hoogte van deze extra's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Marktgerichte kinderopvang is schadelijk voor jonge kinderen'

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the State Secretary about a newspaper opinion piece claiming market-oriented childcare harms young children, including group instability, quality shortfalls, and low response to a quality monitor. The State Secretary rejected the picture of poor quality, pointed to GGD inspections and the Landelijke Kwaliteitsmonitor showing generally good quality, and declined to start new research.
I do not recognise the picture painted in the opinion piece.
Het beeld dat in het opinieartikel wordt geschetst, herken ik dan ook niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Nijkerken-de Haan en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘schorsing om herkenbare leerlingen in bescherming te nemen’ en ‘drie jongens opgepakt voor mishandeling Gorinchem’

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Education ministers why students filmed in a violent assault in Gorinchem were suspended rather than arrested, whether the schools protected perpetrators, and whether parents should lose child benefit, plus questions on youth gangs and the number of suspects. The minister answered that police arrested fourteen suspects under sixteen, all six incidents were reported, suspensions were to protect school calm, child benefit cannot be cut for under-sixteens, no national overview of youth gangs exists, and he will report on administrative approaches to street terror before the recess.
Due to the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot make further statements about this case.
In verband met het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over de stevige impact van armoede op leerlingen in het basisonderwijs

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister, with the social affairs state secretary, how poverty affects primary school pupils and whether schools should take specific measures, such as referring parents to helpers and creating funds for school trips. The minister agreed equal opportunities matter and described existing municipal poverty funding, a school handbook and a forthcoming handreiking for schools, while stating schools cannot solve poverty alone.
Together with the state secretary of SZW, I am focusing on supporting schools in dealing with poverty at schools.
Met de Staatssecretaris van SZW zet ik in op ondersteuning van scholen in het omgaan met armoede op scholen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over tekortschietende aanpak van armoede in Nederland

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs why poverty has not fallen despite a booming economy and budget surpluses, and what measures would reduce child poverty. The government answered that poverty stagnated mainly because wages rose little and more status holders entered welfare, pointed to income-support measures, child poverty ambitions with municipalities, and a planned SER exploration, while declining to quantify individual measures' effects.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Palland over het bericht dat extraatje vanwege 12,5 jarig jubileum moet worden ingeleverd vanwege Wajonguitkering

MPs Peters and Palland (CDA) asked why a Wajong beneficiary's anniversary bonus of a 12.5-year service is deducted from his benefit and whether this can be changed. The State Secretary answered that such bonuses count as wage for tax purposes and UWV must offset them; exempting them would need a change to the wage tax act, which the cabinet considers disproportionate, and within current rules full exemption is not possible, though beneficiaries keep at least 30 percent and those on the guarantee benefit can keep one-off payments in full.
Within the current legal framework it is not possible to fully exempt extras above monthly income such as bonuses and gratuities.
Binnen het huidige wettelijke kader is het niet mogelijk om extra's boven het maandinkomen zoals bonussen en gratificaties volledig vrij te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het korten op de Wajong-uitkering bij het krijgen van een eindejaarsuitkering

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether Wajong benefit recipients who receive year-end bonuses should be exempt from benefit reductions, and how the government will implement the Van Brenk motion and treat similar bonuses under the Participatiewet. The state secretary answered that a full exemption is not feasible under current law, that a planned harmonised income rule will keep at least 30 percent of extras for Wajong recipients, and that Participatiewet bonuses already fall under a partial exemption with no further change planned.
With the proposed harmonised income scheme, Wajong recipients will retain at least 30 percent of extras received above their monthly income.
Met de voorgestelde geharmoniseerde inkomensregeling behouden Wajongers bij het ontvangen van extra's boven het maandinkomen in ieder geval minimaal 30 procent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over korten op de bijstand vanwege zonnepanelen

MPs asked whether returns from home solar panels count as means under the Participatiewet and could lead to benefit reductions, and whether municipalities differ in applying this. The State Secretary answered that such returns for private use are a saving on energy use, not income, so they do not affect benefit entitlement, while noting the ministry does not know whether municipalities take them into account.
Whether, and if so to what extent and in which municipalities, the return from solar panels is taken into account when assessing entitlement to benefit is not known to the Ministry of SZW.

Of en zo ja, in welke mate en bij welke gemeenten er bij de beoordeling van het recht op bijstand wél rekening wordt gehouden met de opbrengst van zonnepanelen is bij het Ministerie van SZW niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smals en Remco Dijkstra over het artikel "KLM onderzoekt blootstelling aan chroom-6"

MPs Smals and Dijkstra asked about KLM's investigation into past chromium-6 exposure of workers and the Inspectorate's role, inspections and sector risks. The state secretary answered that the employer bears responsibility, the Inspectorate has inspected KLM and checks chromium-6 risks, and the advisory commission's report on occupational disease compensation is now expected by 1 April 2020.
The Inspectorate SZW oversees compliance with the Working Conditions legislation and, in that role, has no involvement in KLM group's investigation.
De Inspectie SZW ziet toe op de naleving van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwetgeving en heeft vanuit die rol geen betrokkenheid in het onderzoek van de KLM-groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Kidsplus onder verscherpt toezicht'

MP Gijs van Dijk asks the state secretary why Kidsplus childcare locations remain open despite poor inspection reports, whether oversight is fragmented across municipalities and GGDs, and whether the government will act or create a legal basis for intervention. The state secretary replies that municipalities and GGDs are responsible for enforcement, that several problem locations were closed or face heavy enforcement, that information exchange between municipalities is being improved with VNG and GGD GHOR, and that no national intervention power is needed.
Municipalities are responsible for supervision and enforcement in childcare. I do not consider it desirable to step into this responsibility.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor toezicht en handhaving in de kinderopvang. Ik vind het niet wenselijk om in deze verantwoordelijkheid te treden.
Antwoord op van het lid Buitenweg over het gebruik van SyRI in Capelle aan den IJssel

The MP Buitenweg asks the State Secretary whether earlier answers on the SyRI project in Capelle aan den IJssel were complete, given an evaluation stating none of the 41 risk reports led to further investigation, and why publication was delayed. The State Secretary says 137 risk reports led to 41 addresses, the data were destroyed before the earlier answer, the project was applied incompletely, and publication was delayed by personnel changes, admitting it would have been better to publish earlier.
I note that it would have been more proper and better to publish earlier, even if no statutory deadline exists for it.
Ik constateer dat het netter en beter was geweest om eerder te publiceren, zelfs als daar geen wettelijke termijn voor bestaat.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het persbericht van Divosa van 1 oktober jl., over de Budgetten gebundelde uitkeringen 2019 en 2020 en over de middelen voor re-integratie en minimabeleid

Van Brenk (50PLUS) asks the state secretary about Divosa's warnings on the BUIG welfare budget, recurring municipal deficits and budget fluctuations, the shrinking re-integration budget, and the adequacy of minimum-income funding. The secretary rejects the claim that structural deficits dominate, says the budget model is sound and under review, and promises further research and talks with the VNG without committing to new funding.
I do not share Divosa's concerns.
Ik deel de zorgen van Divosa niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het Gijs van Dijk over de vertraging van de wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet

An MP asks why the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet, which protects the subsistence minimum, is delayed again and what the government will do to protect debtors meanwhile. The state secretary answers that implementation is still targeted for 1 January 2021, that interim measures are in force, and that further steps will depend on clarity expected in early 2020.
I have promised to inform your House about this at the beginning of 2020.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd u hierover begin 2020 te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over data van werkzoekenden die massaal ontbreken bij een databank van het UWV

An SP MP asked the government about a UWV database of job seekers with disabilities, its failed candidate-finder tool, and a suppressed 2018 report. The minister defended the tool as part of a wider labour-market programme, declined to publish the internal report, and promised structural data-exchange improvements.
UWV sent the report to me in mid-September and also published it itself on its website on 1 October.
UWV heeft het rapport medio september jl. aan mij toegezonden en op 1 oktober jl. ook zelf gepubliceerd op haar website.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over de artikelen ‘Data arbeidsbeperkte werkzoekenden ontbreken massaal bij UWV’ en ‘UWV-manager Astrid Hendriks legt uit hoe de onlinekaartenbak mislukte’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister and state secretary about press reports that data on candidates with work limitations were missing from UWV's candidate finder, and about the tool's failure, including the completeness of candidate profiles and the Mediatest evaluation. The government acknowledges the tool's value as one channel, says profile completeness is an ongoing challenge shared with municipalities, and points to the broader Breed Offensief and Doe agenda measures without a concrete new step on the tool itself.
The report was enclosed with the answers and thereby shared with the House.
Het rapport is meegezonden als bijlage bij de antwoorden en daarmee gedeeld met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Palland over het ontbreken van data van arbeidsbeperkte werkzoekenden in de kandidatenverkenner van het UWV

Two CDA MPs asked why the UWV candidate browser for people with work limitations is not working due to missing data, and why so few such people were helped into work despite IT investment. The minister and state secretary replied that complete profiles are a long-standing challenge, that about 8% of profiles are available for work, that many profiles are incomplete, and that additional measures such as Perspectief op Werk and regional agreements are being taken.

Question 4: Is it true that the makers of the candidate browser system already knew that many necessary data were missing and reported this to the UWV top in 2016, but that nothing was done with this notice?

Vraag 4 Is het juist dat bij de makers van het systeem van de kandidatenverkenner al bekend was dat veel noodzakelijke gegevens ontbreken en dat zij dit in 2016 ook hebben gemeld bij de UWV-top, maar dat met deze mededeling niets is gedaan?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Menstruatiearmoede: geen geld voor maandverband, dan maar wc-papier’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the government about reports that some young women in the Netherlands cannot afford menstrual products, and whether the government would investigate price barriers, identify at-risk groups, change VAT or adopt a free-provision policy like Scotland's. The Secretary of State answered that the government supports an integrated poverty approach, points to school sex education, a planned handreiking for schools and municipal support, and declined to commission separate price research.
Are you willing to conduct further research into the extent to which the price of menstrual products hinders access to these products for people living near the poverty line?
Bent u bereid nader onderzoek te doen naar in welke mate de prijs van menstruatieproducten de toegankelijkheid van deze producten belemmert voor mensen die rond de armoedegrens leven?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Medewerkers onbeschermd blootgesteld aan landbouwgif'

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked about a broadcast report showing farm workers exposed to pesticides without protection, including inspection and enforcement figures, health studies, and whether the Labour Inspectorate has acted. The minister answers that the situation is unacceptable, cites NVWA inspection data for 2018, notes the Labour Inspectorate cannot establish violations from footage alone, and promises a Health Council advice on residents' health risks expected in summer 2020.
I have no information on whether the health of the workers involved in this case has been examined.
Ik heb geen informatie over het feit of de gezondheid van betrokken medewerkers in dit geval is onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het zonder waarschuwing incasseren van een openstaande toeslagschuld

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether it is normal that a missed payment within two weeks under a debt arrangement for a childcare-benefit debt triggers payment of the full outstanding amount, and how this fits with incasso policy. The state secretary answered that a reminder is sent first, that the procedure has applied since 2005, that about 212,000 cases were cancelled in 2018, and that personal payment arrangements remain available, while promising to reconsider policy on intent or gross negligence.
Only if that request is not met and no other response follows the payment reminder is the payment arrangement withdrawn, after which the citizen must pay the outstanding amount in one go.

Pas als niet aan dat verzoek wordt voldaan en op de betalingsherinnering evenmin een andere reactie is gevolgd, wordt de betalingsregeling ingetrokken waarna de burger gehouden is het openstaande bedrag in één keer te betalen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Palland over de toename van bedrijfsongevallen door risicovol werk

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary about a reported rise in workplace accidents in risky jobs, including whether unreported accidents are common, enforcement and reporting efforts, and whether work pressure is a factor. The State Secretary acknowledged under-reporting by employers, announced an Inspectorate study and capacity expansion, listed fines for late reporting, and described ongoing programmes on safety culture and psychosocial workload.
It is known that there are employers who do not comply with the obligation to report work accidents immediately ("under-reporting").
Het is bekend dat er werkgevers zijn die zich niet houden aan de verplichting om arbeidsongevallen direct te melden («de ondermelding»).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Loonkloof tussen man en vrouw verder gegroeid: gat van 175 euro in het bedrijfsleven'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about press reports that the gender pay gap widened in the private sector, including the causes of the gap, overtime, international examples and possible legislation. The State Secretary answered that the unexplained (corrected) gap is not closing, pointed to the CBS monitor and the forthcoming part-time review, described existing measures, and deferred a position on the proposed pay equality bill until it is tabled.
I am awaiting the submission of the bill and will then determine a position.
Ik wacht indiening van het wetsvoorstel af, en zal vervolgens een standpunt bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Een klik verwijderd van je schuldeisers’

VVD MPs asked the state secretaries about schuldenwijzer.nl, a debt-overview site that currently shows only debts enforced by bailiffs, and why tax authority, municipal and water board debts are not yet included, plus the legal obstacles around citizen service numbers. The government answered that the site helps citizens gain insight, that expansion is in progress led by bailiffs and the Belastingdienst is working on its own portal, and that no concrete legal obstacle has been identified beyond what is still to be signalled by bailiffs.
The Ministry of SZW discusses progress with SNG and KBvG and whether and how government organisations can join.
Het Ministerie van SZW bespreekt met SNG en KBvG de voortgang en ook of en zo ja, hoe overheidsorganisaties kunnen aansluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Palland over de arbeidskrapte in de kinderopvang en het niet kunnen inzetten van gediplomeerde kraamverzorgenden

MPs De Pater-Postma and Palland asked the State Secretary about labour shortages in childcare and why qualified maternity nurses cannot be deployed in baby groups, including whether the sector-agreed list of qualifying diplomas should be revised. The State Secretary said a labour market plan will follow in the first half of next year, that the diploma list is a matter for the social partners in the collective agreement, and that a equivalence request procedure exists for candidates outside the list.
Addressing bottlenecks around the established list of training programmes is up to the social partners themselves and does not fit the role of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment.
Het oppakken van knelpunten rondom de vastgestelde lijst van opleidingen is aan de sociale partners zelf en past niet bij de rol van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Smals over ‘de Nieuwsuurreportage over arbeidsmigranten’

MPs Tielen and Smals asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Nieuwsuur report on migrant workers, including inspection complaint figures, enforcement capacity, EU posted-worker rules, and labour market matching. The minister answered that complaints rose from 1182 in 2015 to 1817 in 2018, described inspection priorities and the extra funding, and outlined EU-level and domestic measures while largely restating existing policy.
The number of complaints and signals increased from 1182 in 2015 to 1307 in 2016, 1382 in 2017 and 1817 in 2018.
Het aantal klachten en signalen is toegenomen van 1182 in 2015 naar 1307 in 2016, 1382 in 2017 tot 1817 in 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Renkema over "de bureaucratie rondom het aanvragen van de dubbele kinderbijslag"

GroenLinks MPs asked the state secretary about bureaucracy in applying for double child benefit for intensive care, including repeat applications and possible simplification. The secretary reported application and appeal figures, said a follow-up study is underway with results due before summer 2020, and committed to simplifying the process if feasible.
I am in favour of simplifying processes, especially when this relieves citizens of burdens.
Ik ben een voorstander van vereenvoudiging van processen, zeker als burgers hiermee ontlast worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de ‘Ontmanteling van sw-bedrijf Soweco’

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary about the planned dissolution of the Soweco sheltered workplace company, the lack of works council involvement, and whether six municipalities hold a veto, citing two adopted motions. The State Secretary replied that municipalities decide on the future role of these companies, jobs and support are said to continue, the works council will be involved in later stages, and a meeting with the municipalities is scheduled for 5 December.
It is up to the municipalities, which own the social development companies including Soweco, to decide what role these companies can play in the future.
Het is aan gemeenten, die de eigenaren zijn van de sociale ontwikkelbedrijven, waaronder Soweco, om te bepalen welke rol deze bedrijven in de toekomst kunnen spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Breda willens en wetens in strijd met de wet voorwaarden verbindt aan het afgeven van een briefadres

An SP MP asked whether Breda imposes conditions on issuing a postal address (briefadres) contrary to the Personal Records Database Act, and whether the minister will act. The minister confirmed the law requires registration, said Breda deliberately keeps some homeless people registered as a way to monitor them, which is not permitted, and said the Rijksdienst and a letter to Breda have pointed out the violation.
I have had the Dutch Identity Data Agency contact the municipality of Breda.
Ik heb de Rijksdienst voor Identiteitsgegevens contact laten opnemen met de gemeente Breda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de inkomensachteruitgang voor mensen met een Wajong-uitkering

A PvdA MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs to calculate the income and Wajong support for hypothetical cases of persons with a disability benefit under the old and proposed new Wajong rules, including after job loss. The State Secretary provided detailed calculations showing the proposed scheme yields similar or higher total income in the examples and committed to answering before the vote on the bill.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Rog over de geplande opschaling van Respect Education Foundation

MPs Peters and Rog asked the government about the planned scaling-up of the Respect Education Foundation and what it had done on the earlier motion to support the RespectPact. The minister answered that the departments saw no financial room, that the foundation has not yet sent a proposal for immaterial support, and that the cabinet is willing to offer immaterial support once that proposal arrives.
The cabinet is willing to provide immaterial support for the REF's work, but is awaiting a proposal from the REF.
Het kabinet is bereid tot immateriële ondersteuning van het werk van het REF, maar is in afwachting van een voorstel van het REF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht "Arbeidsmigranten Westland luiden noodklok: Ik mocht niet naar huis toen ik ziek was”

An MP asked the government about reports that migrant workers in Westland were refused permission to go home when sick, including a pregnant worker, and about pregnancy leave, inspections, rights information and the integrated approach to abuses. The minister condemned such treatment as contrary to good employership, explained leave and dismissal rules for temporary agency workers, stated inspections are unannounced, and said an integrated approach would be sent to parliament by year end.
The Labour Inspectorate does not comment on whether investigations are or are being conducted at companies.
De Inspectie SZW laat zich niet uit over de vraag of bij bedrijven onderzoek is of wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over incasso-Cowboys die geld verdienen aan de handel in schulden

An MP asked the State Secretary about debt collectors charging excessive fees and reselling debts, and whether government collection practices worsen debt problems. The government says collection costs are bound by statutory rules (WIK), a new collection register and a bill are in preparation, and it is studying debt sales and offering more tailored payment arrangements.
The bill including the establishment of this collection register is in preparation.
Het wetsvoorstel tot onder meer het instellen van dit incassoregister is in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Ouderen komen amper uit de bijstand’

Member Van Brenk (50PLUS) asks whether the small decline of over-45s on welfare and their low exit to work signal failure of labour market policy for older workers, and whether the government will intensify support. The ministers answer that the decline is lagged behind the economic upturn, point to existing plans (Perspectief voor vijftigplussers, Perspectief op Werk, STAP budget) and to a planned exploration of non-voluntary offers by municipalities, but reject calling it a defeat or a lost generation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over de verdubbeling van het aantal daklozen

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about the reported doubling of the number of homeless people in the Netherlands, including the state's duty to provide housing, the causes, the adequacy of social assistance, shelter capacity and broader societal effects. The state secretary answered that housing and health are constitutional social rights shared with municipalities and housing corporations, that the government will present an additional plan this autumn, and that CBS research on the rise is pending.
That is why the Cabinet, together with other (local) parties, will come this autumn with an additional plan to significantly reduce the number of homeless people in the coming years.
Daarom komt het Kabinet dit najaar samen met andere (lokale) partijen met een aanvullend plan om het aantal dak- en thuislozen de komende jaren fors terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de berichten dat er opnieuw chroom-6 is gevonden op trams in Amsterdam en Utrecht

An MP asked the state secretary about chromium-6 found on trams in Amsterdam and Utrecht, including whether inspectors were sent, workers' protection, risk inventories and record-keeping duties. The state secretary answered that the Labour Inspectorate started inspections at the transport companies with results expected by year end, referred questions on worker numbers and protective measures to the employers, and confirmed that employers must keep records of exposed workers.
Following reports of possible exposure to chromium-6 during maintenance of trams and metro, inspections were started at the transport companies in Amsterdam, The Hague, Rotterdam and Utrecht.

Naar aanleiding van de berichten over de mogelijke blootstelling aan chroom-6 bij onderhoud aan trams en metro zijn inspecties gestart bij de vervoersbedrijven in Amsterdam, Den Haag, Rotterdam en Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het verband tussen landbouwgif en de ziekte van Parkinson

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether pesticide risks for Parkinson's disease are adequately assessed, whether moratoria, reporting duties, inspection checks and occupational-disease recognition should apply. The minister answered that EU approval procedures already test neurotoxicity, that the EU will be asked to strengthen procedures for neurological effects, and that a moratorium or reporting duty is unnecessary, while the inspectorate monitors risk-based and Parkinson's is not a recognised occupational disease in the Netherlands.
I support this recommendation and will ask the European Commission to take this up promptly.
Ik ondersteun deze aanbeveling en zal de Europese Commissie vragen dit voortvarend op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over kosten gerelateerd aan de sociale zekerheid van personen met een migratieachtergrond

An MP asked the minister, for the second time in a decade, for a full financial breakdown of social security costs attributable to non-Western migrants, including benefits, remigration payments and workers' insurance. The minister answered with CBS data on benefit use by migration background and said total cost attribution cannot be made one-to-one, though some figures were given.
The CBS has no data on the costs of social security use broken down by persons with and without (non-Western) migration background.
Het CBS heeft geen gegevens over de kosten van het gebruik van de sociale zekerheid uitgesplitst naar personen met en zonder (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Diploma honderden medewerkers kinderopvang ongeldig door nieuwe cao’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the list of diplomas giving access to childcare jobs, produced in collaboration with social partners in the collective labour agreement, was consistent with the quality requirements of the Innovation and Quality Childcare Act and whether it should be revisited amid staff shortages. The State Secretary replied that the diploma list is a matter for social partners under the CAO, that the IKK agreement contains no diploma rules, and that the ministry will discuss labour shortages with the sector without taking up the diploma list itself.
Addressing bottlenecks around the established list of training programmes is up to the social partners themselves and does not fit the role of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment.
Het oppakken van knelpunten rondom de vastgestelde lijst van opleidingen is daarbij aan de sociale partners zelf en past niet bij de rol van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het SCP-rapport ‘Armoede in kaart 2019’

MP Van Brenk (50PLUS) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about SCP poverty figures for 60-64 year olds, 90-plus, pensioners and social assistance recipients, and about take-up of allowances. The State Secretary answered that the government is taking measures for older unemployed and high care costs, notes the SCP data are from 2017 and omit later measures, and promises an interdepartmental review of allowances.
An interdepartmental policy review (IBO) on allowances is also currently underway.
Tevens loopt op dit moment het interdepartementaal beleidsonderzoek (IBO) toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de documentaire De schuldmachine

An MP asked the state secretary about the documentary De Schuldmachine, including debt traps, a young person's debt for school books, debt sales to collectors, toll-free health insurance penalties, and the role of debt advisers. The government answered that the Brede Schuldenaanpak is needed, pointed to measures on stacking of costs, a bill on collection quality, a study on buying back debts, and an evaluation of the health insurance defaulter scheme, while refusing to comment on individual cases.
I cannot make statements about specific cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Honderden ouderen in Caribisch Nederland hebben nauwelijks te eten'

Kuiken (PvdA) asked the ministers about a report by the National Ombudsman finding that hundreds of elderly people in Caribbean Netherlands have barely enough food, asking whether the conditions are unacceptable, whether the government will act on the recommendations, the proposed Caribbean table, how the poverty threshold relates to elderly living conditions, what measures will be taken, and whether child poverty will be investigated. The ministers acknowledge the difficult situation, say they will discuss the findings with the Ombudsman, list income and cost-of-living measures already taken or planned, commit to annual monitoring, and point to a forthcoming UNICEF-based letter on children's rights.
The cabinet considers the National Ombudsman's point about looking more broadly than only the income of the elderly valuable.
Het kabinet vindt het aandachtspunt van de Nationale ombudsman om breder te kijken dan alleen het inkomen van ouderen waardevol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Kabinet laat Caribische ouderen achter in ‘mensonwaardig bestaan’

An MP from D66 asked several ministers about reports that elderly residents of the Caribbean Netherlands live in poverty and that government support is inadequate. The state secretaries acknowledged the difficult situation, pointed to measures and shared responsibility with island authorities, but gave limited concrete timelines and said the Ombudsman's criticisms are addressed through ongoing monitoring.
The cabinet understands the wish of the National Ombudsman for more clarity on the timeline of the announced measures.
Het kabinet begrijpt de wens van de Nationale ombudsman om meer houvast voor wat betreft het tijdpad van de aangekondigde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake ‘een incassobureau dat zijn klanten uitknijpt’

An SP MP asked the government how a debt collection agency could operate for years squeezing small business clients, what enforcement the ACM and AFM had taken, and how to keep such agencies from using court resources. The Minister answered that collection must follow existing law, that individual cases are not for the Minister to address, that ACM and AFM lack competence over business-to-business conduct, and that a debt collection register bill is being prepared.

As I already indicated in answer to your parliamentary questions of 22 March 2019, which also addressed the functioning of a debt collection agency, it is not for me as Minister to address individual cases.

Zoals ik eerder al aangaf in antwoord op uw Kamervragen van 22 maart 2019, waar ook het functioneren van een incassobureau aan de orde kwam, is het evenwel niet aan mij als Minister om in te gaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de toenemende armoede onder mensen met schulden

MP Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about rising poverty among people with debts, including whether basic costs have outpaced net income and whether minimum-income levels and special assistance are adequate. The State Secretary answered that the government is working on debt prevention, points to income-support measures and a CBS study due in spring 2020, and says individual municipalities decide on special assistance.
Based on the research carried out by Zelf, in my view such a general statement about the income position of the clients concerned cannot be made.
Op basis van het onderzoek dat «Zelf» heeft uitgevoerd kan naar mijn mening een dergelijke algemene uitspraak over de inkomenspositie van betrokken cliënten niet gedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht 'Gemeenten niet gericht op schuldenvrij maken inwoners'

An MP asks the state secretary for Social Affairs about a report finding that municipal debt assistance focuses on behavioural change rather than debt-free futures, that registrations are incomplete, and that access and quality vary. The state secretary largely defends the current system, points to benchmarks, a planned amendment to the Wgs, CBS research and a checklist, but mostly leaves quality control and steering with municipalities.
Municipalities are responsible for debt assistance. They must have, or obtain, (numerical) insight in order to steer on the effectiveness of the implementation of their debt assistance.

Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de schuldhulpverlening. Zij moeten (cijfermatig) inzicht hebben of verkrijgen om te kunnen sturen op de effectiviteit van de uitvoering van hun schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Gemeentepolis minima staat onder druk’

Labour MP Kerstens asked the Health Minister and State Secretary of Social Affairs about a CPB report on municipal health insurance collectives (gemeentepolis) for low-income people and whether improvement options such as better risk-equalisation compensation, choice aids and a no-claim alternative to the deductible will be pursued. The government says the polis can help but depends on design, points to the voorzieningenwijzer and ongoing risk-equalisation improvements, stresses municipalities and insurers are free to offer collectives, and commits to further review of chronic-illness compensation without a full policy overhaul.
Municipalities and insurers are free to decide whether or not to conclude collectives.
Gemeenten en verzekeraars zijn vrij om wel of geen collectiviteiten af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het bericht 'Rotterdamse rechter passeert Participatiewet'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a court's binding debt arrangement (dwangakkoord) overriding a municipality's refusal to participate in a voluntary debt settlement is undesirable, and whether the Participatiewet should be changed. The State Secretary answered that such cases are not tracked, that the court appropriately weighs interests case by case, that the Participatiewet requires full repayment of fraudulent benefits, and that no law change is needed.
It is not tracked how often situations like this occur.
Het wordt niet bijgehouden hoe vaak situaties als deze voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Peters over ‘meer dan 100.000 ouders die de komende maanden meer dan 1.000 euro kindgebonden budget krijgen nabetaald en mogelijk geen enkele band meer hebben met hun kind(eren)

MPs Omtzigt and Peters asked about over 100,000 parents receiving retroactive kindgebonden budget payments of over 1,000 euro, including cases where a parent has lost parental authority or been convicted of offences against a child, the position of separated parents, deceased parents, parents abroad, anti-cumulation rules, and seizure. The government answered that only the parent entitled to child benefit receives the payment, that entitled parents may still receive it after losing parental authority or being convicted, that the payment is protected from seizure, and that cross-border anti-cumulation arrangements are still being worked out.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de opnamestop bij de daklozenopvang van het Leger de Heils in Amsterdam

An MP asked whether Amsterdam's cut in subsidy caused the admission stop at the Leger des Heils homeless shelter and what the consequences for neighbouring cities are. The state secretary replied that Amsterdam's budget actually rose and that Amsterdam's own taskforce, not the national government, is responsible for fixing the situation, so no national action was committed.
Amsterdam's executive board has taken its responsibility by freeing up funds to lift the admission stop and by setting up a taskforce.
Het college van B&W van de gemeente Amsterdam heeft zijn verantwoordelijkheid genomen door middelen vrij te maken om de instroomstop op te heffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over "opvallend baanverlies binnen banenafspraak"

An MP asked the State Secretary about a reported net loss of 1,411 jobs under the jobs agreement for people with disabilities in Q1 2019 compared with Q4 2018, and whether the 55,000-job target would be met. The State Secretary answered that the quarter-on-quarter drop is largely seasonal and due to fewer Wsw workers placed with regular employers, that year-on-year jobs rose by 13,235, and that the target is considered achievable, with simplification of the system to follow.
I therefore consider the target of realising 55,000 additional jobs by the end of 2019 to be achievable.
Ik acht daarom de doelstelling om eind 2019 55.000 extra banen te realiseren, haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Luchtkwaliteit babybedjes onder de maat’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a TU Eindhoven study finding poor air quality around and in cot beds in childcare, and whether GGD inspections address this and whether cot-numbers and CO2 rules should be reviewed. The State Secretary said childcare must be safe and healthy, that inspections can cover air quality under existing rules, that GGDs and VNG will discuss the study, and that the sector is primarily responsible, offering to raise it with sector bodies.
Given the importance of the subject, I am therefore pleased to commit to discussing with the VNG and GGD GHOR Nederland the TU Eindhoven study and its significance for supervision and enforcement.

Gezien het belang van het onderwerp, zeg ik daarom graag toe om met de VNG en GGD GHOR Nederland in gesprek te gaan over het onderzoek door de TU Eindhoven en de betekenis daarvan voor het toezicht en de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over "gepensioneerden met een lager inkomen die arm zijn of moeilijk rond kunnen komen"

An MP asked the State Secretary about low-income pensioners who are poor or struggle to make ends meet, including AOW-only households, rent and care costs, municipal relief, IOAW rules and migrant elderly. The minister answered that the AOW is generally sufficient for basic needs, that municipalities handle case-by-case support, and promised to review some measures such as the IOW age limit and the minimum wage evaluation.
On average, national schemes are sufficient to cover basic needs, with room for savings and social participation.
Gemiddeld genomen zijn landelijke regelingen voldoende om in de basisbehoeften te voorzien, waarbij ook ruimte is voor reserveringsuitgaven en sociale participatie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over de berichten ‘Rotterdam loopt teruggeëist bijstandsgeld mis’, ‘Man mag 35.000 euro te veel uitgekeerde bijstand houden’ en ‘Stoïcijnse reacties op CRvB-uitspraak vord

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about news reports that municipalities such as Rotterdam may fail to recover welfare overpayments because of the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling that the five-year limitation period was not properly interrupted, and about the possible financial consequences. The State Secretary answered that the limitation rules are the same regardless of fraud, that municipalities are responsible for administering recovery and interruption, that the financial impact is not known nationally, and that she will raise the issue with VNG and Divosa.

It is the explicit authority and (financial) responsibility of the municipal executives and councils to properly carry out the recovery of undue payments and to determine the consequences of the CRvB ruling in their own municipality.

Het is de expliciete bevoegdheid en (financiële) verantwoordelijkheid van de colleges en gemeenteraden om de terugvordering van onverschuldigde betalingen goed uit te voeren en om de gevolgen van de CRvB-uitspraak in de eigen gemeente vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat gemeenten de stekker uit sociaal werkbedrijf Soweco trekken

An MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities closing the sheltered work company Soweco, with 1,150 employees, would leave those workers without suitable jobs and lose its expertise. The secretary answered that municipalities are free to decide on such organisations, that employees receive a job guarantee, and that a letter on the wider trend will follow.
It is up to municipalities, which own the social development companies including Soweco, to decide what role these companies can play in the future.
Het is aan gemeenten, die de eigenaren zijn van de sociale ontwikkelbedrijven, waaronder Soweco, om te bepalen welke rol deze bedrijven in de toekomst kunnen spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat werklozen uit Amsterdam op gesprek moeten komen

Two MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs how she views reports that all 40,000 Amsterdam benefit recipients will be invited to interviews, given that municipalities already have the task and tools under the Participatiewet. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for activation, she makes no judgement on individual municipalities, supports activation through a Perspectief op Werk programme, and commissioned a study of promising municipal approaches due in autumn.
Municipalities are responsible for labour support for people receiving social assistance. I make no statements about individual municipalities.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de arbeidsondersteuning aan mensen met een bijstandsuitkering. Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Stop verplichte zoekperiode voor bijstand’

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the state secretary whether the four-week mandatory job-search period for young welfare applicants should be scrapped, and how many young people find work or education during it and why some do not return to municipalities. The state secretary said municipalities should keep track of young people, that they do not report how many start work or education in the period, and that the mandatory search period will not be abolished or shortened categorically, though an exemption for young people with work disabilities is planned in a forthcoming bill.
Municipalities do not report how many young people start work or education during the search period.
Gemeenten rapporteren niet hoeveel jongeren starten met werk of onderwijs tijdens de zoekperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Stop verplichte zoekperiode voor bijstand'

An SP MP asked the state secretary about calls to abolish the mandatory four-week job-search period for welfare claimants, especially young people, and whether it pushes vulnerable youths out of view. The state secretary acknowledged the signal, pointed to municipal tools and partnerships to keep youths in view, and said a exemption for young people with work disabilities is being prepared in a bill expected in the second half of 2019.
In my letter of 23 May 2019 on the progress of the 'Breed Offensief' work, I addressed the possibility of this.
In mijn brief van 23 mei 2019 4 over de stand van zaken uitwerking «Breed Offensief» ben ik ingegaan op de mogelijkheid hiertoe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Smeulders over "het bericht 'Rouwbegeleiding op het werk vaak onvoldoende'”

MPs Stoffer and Smeulders asked the government about reports that bereavement support at work is often inadequate, sick leave among the bereaved is higher than necessary, and there is no statutory right to bereavement leave. The minister answered that bereavement is individual and that a guidance handbook for employers will be developed, while arguing that a statutory right to bereavement leave is not appropriate and that the evidence cited is not representative.
A statutory right to bereavement leave is currently not on the agenda.
Een wettelijk recht op rouwverlof is nu niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de onvoorspelbaarheid van het budget voor gebundelde uitkeringen voor gemeenten (BUIG-budget)

An SP MP asked why Sittard-Geleen's BUIG welfare budget fell by 2.7 million euro, whether the calculation is transparent and checkable, whether municipalities can predict budget changes earlier, and whether the system should be revised. The State Secretary attributed the drop to a lower budget share from the objective allocation model (including a new price component and annual updates of regional indicators), stated the model is not a black box and is verified by experts and the Auditdienst Rijk, but declined to change the system or move the publication date earlier than 1 October.
Every municipality receives a detailed, step-by-step calculation of the build-up of the amount to be received in the following year before 1 October.
Iedere gemeente ontvangt vóór 1 oktober een gedetailleerde, stap-voor-stap berekening van de opbouw van het te ontvangen bedrag in het volgende jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over menstruatie-armoede in Nederland

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked whether period poverty, the inability to afford menstrual products, occurs in the Netherlands and whether the government would investigate it. The state secretary replied that there is no evidence yet, that the feminist platform De Bovengrondse is researching it with results due in August, and that the government will decide on further steps after those results.
On the basis of the outcomes we will determine whether and which further steps are necessary or desirable.
Op basis van de uitkomsten zullen wij bepalen of en welke verdere stappen nodig dan wel wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over beschut werk

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary about UWV work-assessment quality for sheltered work (beschut werk), including reports that employment-expert decisions often fail and whether an independent objection committee should be set up. The State Secretary answered that UWV has taken quality measures, that existing objection and appeal procedures under the Awb are sufficient, and that the report is already available to Parliament in confidence.
I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het Vertrouwensexperiment bijstand Tilburg

An MP asked whether the Tilburg welfare trust experiment's early positive results are known, whether they will be shared, and whether experiments will be extended and expanded to other municipalities. The State Secretary replied that interim results will not be published to protect the scientific evaluation, that the experiments run until 1 October 2019 with a proposed three-month extension, and that a final report with conclusions will be sent to Parliament by 1 May 2020.
For this reason it is desirable not to publish provisional, interim results.
Hiertoe is het wenselijk om geen voorlopige, tussentijdse resultaten naar buiten te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat marktwerking voor gerechtsdeurwaarders te ver is doorgeslagen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked whether market competition among bailiffs has gone too far, creating perverse incentives that undermine bailiffs' independence and whether government should encourage debt assistance and alternative procurement. The minister disagreed that competition has gone too far, said a commission is reviewing the tariff system, pointed to existing responsible-collection commitments, and said price will not be part of the CJIB tender competition.
I am awaiting the results of that investigation.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over een aangenomen resolutie door de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

The MP asks whether the government will act on a UN Human Rights Council resolution calling for full implementation of the UN Children's Rights Convention and whether it will lift its reservation on article 26. The minister says the resolution is non-binding, the government awaits a UN treaty-body evaluation before deciding on optional protocols, and it sees no reason to lift the reservation because the child's social security right is derivative of parents' entitlements.
I therefore see no reason to lift the reservation.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden om het voorbehoud op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht ‘Reactie Expertise Centrum Asbest & Vezels op de commotie rondom de risico’s van blootstelling aan asbest’

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked the ministers about an opinion piece from the Expertise Centrum Asbest & Vezels criticising asbestos policy, including whether the debate has shifted towards cost, whether asbestos is dangerous only with long exposure, and whether the ministers will meet the centre on the roof-asbestos ban and certification of removal firms. The minister answered that health risks remain central, that asbestos is carcinogenic and removal is required where it poses a risk, that officials will make contact with the centre, and that the government will report on implementation this autumn.
However, I also placed an important caveat on the cost calculations made in this report.
Ik heb echter ook een belangrijke kanttekening geplaatst bij de berekeningen van de kosten die in dit rapport gemaakt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een onvoldoende voor het UWV

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister about a poor UWV quality assessment, why parliament was not informed earlier, whether internal reports would be shared, and whether errors in disability assessments would be corrected and affected people compensated. The minister acknowledged concerns about caseworker quality, said the impact on benefits could not be established, announced confidential inspection of the documents for parliament, and ruled out an independent appeal commission.
I will make the documents requested by newspaper Trouw under the Open Government Act available for confidential inspection by your House.
Ik zal de documenten die op grond van een beroep op de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur door dagblad Trouw zijn opgevraagd ter vertrouwelijke inzage leggen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Koerhuis en Lodders over het  bericht ‘Leidse  steuntrekker mag  kamer verhuren aan student om bij te verdienen’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether a Leiden plan to let welfare recipients sublet rooms and keep part of the income was lawful, and what the government would do. The government answered that the plan contravened the Participatiewet, that it was a serious shortcoming in lawful implementation, and that Leiden withdrew the pilot after contact with the ministry, so no formal sanction was needed.

Given its scale (both the target group and the monthly amount to be exempted) and its possible spillover effect, implementing the plan would in my view lead to a serious shortcoming in the lawful implementation of the law.

Gelet op de omvang daarvan (zowel qua doelgroep als het vrij te laten maandbedrag) en het mogelijke uitstralingseffect, zou de uitvoering van het plan naar mijn mening leiden tot een ernstige tekortkoming in de rechtmatige uitvoering van de wet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange, Van Gent en Peters over inning van alimentatie

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the collection of child maintenance owed by ex-partners who do not pay, including whether preferential collection priority should be studied and how other countries handle it. The minister agreed that non-payment is undesirable, promised a study of preference and collection by LBIO to be reported after the summer, and argued that existing enforcement adequately secures payment.
By letter of 27 February I informed you of the advantages and disadvantages of preference for child maintenance claims.
Antwoord 3 Bij Kamerbrief van 27 februari jongstleden heb ik u geïnformeerd over de voor en- nadelen van preferentie voor kinderalimentatievorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Aukje de Vries over een bericht op facebook

MPs Nijkerken-de Haan and Aukje de Vries asked the State Secretary about a Wajong recipient whose 12.5-year work anniversary bonus was deducted from his benefit by UWV. The State Secretary said UWV is independently responsible for individual cases, explained the income-offset rules, and committed to exploring with UWV whether a limited list of bonuses could be exempted, while stating broader exemptions are not currently feasible.
UWV is an independent administrative body with its own responsibility for implementing, among other things, the Wajong. I therefore cannot respond to individual cases.
Het UWV is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan met eigen verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van onder meer de Wajong. Ik kan daarom niet reageren op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Breed moratorium schulden 'dode letter'

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether the statutory broad debt moratorium is a dead letter, why municipalities cannot apply it at intake, and whether the 22 conditions and other criteria should be loosened. The State Secretary answered that the broad moratorium is an ultimum remedium still little tested, prefers voluntary settlements, will evaluate the decree after more experience, and will wait for national agreements before deciding whether municipalities may put overheidsschuldeisers on hold.
I would like, as also announced in the explanatory memorandum, to evaluate the Decree on the broad moratorium.
Ik wil graag, zoals ook aangekondigd is in de nota van toelichting, het besluit Breed moratorium evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over elke week een maaltijdbezorger gewond naar het ziekenhuis

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the frequent serious accidents involving meal delivery workers, their piece-rate pay, uninsured status, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate. The State Secretary said worker safety is a SZW concern, that minimum wage law still applies to platform workers, that the Inspectorate runs risk-based oversight and a meal-delivery project, and that accident notification duties exist but the Inspectorate has not launched a dedicated sector investigation.

The Labour Inspectorate exercises risk-based supervision of compliance with labour legislation and uses instruments such as information campaigns, sector influencing, client approaches and inspections.

De Inspectie SZW houdt risicogericht toezicht op de naleving van de arbeidswetgeving en gebruikt instrumenten als voorlichtingen, branchebeïnvloeding, opdrachtgeversaanpak en het uitvoeren van inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over jonge maaltijdkoeriers die op grote schaal ’s avonds werken

An MP asked the state secretary about 15-year-old meal couriers working late evenings despite the legal ban, tight time pressure, traffic risks, pay-per-piece bonuses, and inspection capacity. The answer acknowledges that working until 22:00 breaches the rules, describes a 2018 inspection project targeting delivery restaurants with about 100 interventions, and states that light work is assessed case by case with no blanket ban.
The Inspectorate SZW saw reason to actively monitor this sector in the Takeaway & Delivery Restaurants project.
De Inspectie SZW heeft aanleiding gezien om deze sector actief te gaan volgen in het project Afhaal- & Bezorgrestaurants.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Kuik en Peters over het bericht 'Schuldhulpverlening lastig voor studenten met schulden'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the rising number of young people, including students, seeking debt assistance, and about municipal measures, study-stopping rules, DUO paying tuition directly, and a warning banner on DUO's website. The government gave partial answers: it had no exact figures, supported initiatives and dialogue with municipalities, declined the banner and direct tuition payment for now, and pointed to ongoing experiments and measures.
We cannot give you exact numbers and percentages.
We kunnen u geen exacte aantallen en procenten geven.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over de schrijnende werkwijze van de sociale dienst Laborijn

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked how the state views social services whose conduct frightens benefit recipients, whether the legal framework should be tightened, what training staff receive, and whether the state will follow up a pending investigation into Laborijn. The Secretary of State answered that recipients must be treated respectfully and privacy protected under existing law, that no national register of training exists, and that the Laborijn investigation is a local matter outside national involvement.
The announced investigation is primarily a local matter, in which involvement from central government is not at issue.
Het aangekondigde onderzoek is primair een lokale aangelegenheid, waarbij bemoeienis vanuit het Rijk niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Slootweg over schuldenlast

CDA MPs Peters and Slootweg asked the state secretary about the societal costs of problem debt, a general debt pardon, compulsory administration (bewind) for at-risk people, and the number of young people and children affected. The government answered that the cost figures come from reliable but non-linkable sources, rejected a general debt pardon and compulsory bewind as undesirable, and said national representative data are not yet available, with a CBS study expected in 2020.
Nationally representative figures on the extent of debt problems in the Netherlands broken down by household background characteristics are currently lacking.
Landelijke representatieve cijfers over de omvang van schuldenproblematiek in Nederland uitgesplitst naar achtergrondkenmerken van huishoudens ontbreken op dit moment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over ‘de arbeidsomstandigheden bij online supermarkt Picnic’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about working conditions at online supermarket Picnic, including lifting instructions, use of NIOSH and DUTCH methods, electric carts, and whether the Inspectorate SZW should inspect the distribution centres. The State Secretary answered that employers are responsible for compliance, that the Inspectorate follows the sector risk-based and will forward the questions, but declined to say whether a specific company is under investigation.
I am happy to forward your questions and my answers to the Inspectorate SZW so that the Inspectorate can take them into account in its work.
Ik ben graag bereid uw vragen en mijn antwoorden aan de Inspectie SZW door te geleiden zodat de Inspectie deze kan betrekken bij haar werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Na twee jaar subsidiebaan weer kwijt: hoe schrijnend is dat?'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a news report on a man whose two-year participation job at the Amsterdam transport company GVB ended without a permanent contract, and whether the government would act to secure permanent jobs for former Wsw and Wajong clients. The State Secretary answered that the Participatiewet is implemented locally, so she would not intervene in the individual case, cited tracking data on employment rates among former Wsw and Wajong clients, and pointed to ongoing evaluation work.
The Participatiewet is implemented locally, so it is not appropriate to intervene in individual cases within local competences.
De Participatiewet wordt decentraal uitgevoerd en het past daarom niet om in individuele gevallen in lokale bevoegdheden te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Kinderdagverblijf Montessori Bilthoven op slot: onveilig, vies en ongezond'

An MP asks the State Secretary about a childcare centre in Bilthoven reported as unsafe and unhygienic, its prior violations, and whether investment-backed operators should be restricted. The State Secretary answers that municipalities and GGDs enforce childcare rules, the centre was closed for 7 days and has reopened, and that existing rules apply to all operators without a legislative ban on profit-driven investors.
The municipality indicated that if a future inspection again shows one or more serious violations, the location will be permanently closed.
Daarbij heeft de gemeente aangegeven dat wanneer uit een toekomstige inspectie blijkt dat er opnieuw sprake is van één of meerdere ernstige overtredingen, de opvanglocatie definitief gesloten wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over intimidatie door een incassobureau

MPs Van Dijk asked the government about intimidation by debt collection agency Hendriks Incasso, including threats of powers it lacks, and whether the ACM's warning-only response and the planned debt collection register would stop such firms. Minister Dekker answered that incasso practices must stay within the law, declined to judge the individual case, and said the register with sanctions is planned for mid-2021.
It is not for me as Minister to judge individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om te oordelen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de oplopende vaste lasten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about rising fixed housing and living costs, citing a Nibud report that more than half of household budgets go to fixed costs, and asked about government responsibility, the burden on tenants, and possible measures. The State Secretary attributes the rise mainly to price increases and a shift of taxes from labour to consumption, points to income tax cuts, the expanded rent allowance and a planned cap on social housing rent increases, and says households should monitor their spending.
The share of fixed costs has risen because both prices and taxes have gone up.
Het aandeel vaste lasten is gestegen doordat zowel de prijzen als de belastingen omhoog zijn gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het rapport ‘Behoorlijk invorderen vanuit het burgerperspectief’ van de Nationale ombudsman

An MP asked the Minister about the National Ombudsman's report on fair debt collection and about the government's approach to stacking and escalation of administrative fines and premiums, including whether authorities should send free payment reminders. The Minister answered that the government is taking steps such as relaxed payment arrangements and a planned emergency-stop procedure, but that free reminders may not reach the indebted group and that the policy reply to the Ombudsman will follow.
In the coming months a plan for an emergency-stop procedure will be developed.
De komende maanden zal worden gewerkt aan een plan voor een noodstopprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Regeling die moet zorgen voor meer banen, houdt lonen laag’

An SP MP asked the government whether the LIV low-income wage subsidy keeps wages low and creates jobs, and asked for recipient lists and whether it should be abolished. The minister denied wage suppression signals, cited CPB expectations of about 7,000 extra full-time jobs, announced an evaluation by year-end, and refused to disclose individual company subsidy recipients as business-confidential.
Decisions under the Wtl wage-domain subsidy act are not public.
De beschikkingen op basis van de Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein (Wtl) zijn niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Kwint over de fusie van Partou en KidsFoundation

MPs Bruins and Kwint asked about the merger of childcare providers Partou and KidsFoundation, their takeover by investment firms Onex and Waterland, and whether private equity harms public interests in childcare. The State Secretary answered that all providers must meet the Childcare Act, that the competition authority ACM reviews such mergers, that sector margins are modest, and that studies show no quality decline.
In 2017 parents reported €3.5 billion in gross childcare costs to the Tax Administration.
In 2017 hebben ouders voor € 3,5 mld aan bruto kosten voor hun kinderopvang doorgegeven aan de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over een app die de invoering van de wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet kan versnellen

MPs Van Dijk and Peters asked whether an app from Stichting Financieel Paspoort could speed up the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet and whether people can use GDPR access rights to obtain the data needed. The state secretary answered that the app does not replace the implementation trajectory because it cannot cover partner and household data, that interim measures are planned, and that GDPR access alone does not suffice for the calculation.
The foundation's proposal is therefore not a full alternative to the implementation trajectory of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet, including accelerating it.
Het voorstel van de Stichting is dan ook geen volwaardig alternatief voor het – versnellen van – het implementatietraject van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Sociale dienst Achterhoek checkt zelfs ondergoed'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the Achterhoek social services body Laborijn searches homes, requires recipients to log showers and meals, and is intimidating, plus questions on privacy, gifts counted as income, external monitoring, client council protection and sanctions. The State Secretary said respectful treatment and proportionate enforcement are required, that the law protects privacy and allows checks, that Laborijn runs enforcement in-house, that municipalities are accountable to their councils rather than subject to national intervention, and that Laborijn's board announced an independent external investigation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over kindgebonden budget voor co-ouders

An MP asks the government about co-parents' access to the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget), following an Ombudsman report that the scheme does not adequately reach co-parents and that payments cannot be split like child benefit. The minister acknowledges the problems, promises a broader exploration of post-divorce allocation and information improvements, but rejects splitting the benefit between co-parents.

The cabinet response indicated that this complex implementation situation requires a solution, and that I also want to look more broadly at the design to improve the allocation of the child-related budget after a divorce.

In de kabinetsreactie is aangegeven dat deze complexe uitvoeringssituatie om een oplossing vraagt, waarbij ik ook breder naar de vormgeving wil kijken om de toekenning van het kindgebonden budget na een echtscheiding te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over kinderen in armoede naar nul

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the government would join the Alliance Child Poverty's goal of ending child poverty by 2030 and whether a poverty action plan would be started. The State Secretary welcomed the alliance, said the government shares the goal, and referred to ambitions letter of 1 April 2019 with biennial reporting, without committing to a new concrete plan.
I refer you to the child poverty ambitions that I sent to your House on 1 April, in which the ambitions and what is needed to realise them are set out.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar de ambities kinderarmoede die ik op 1 april aan uw Kamer heb verstuurd, waarin de ambities en wat nodig is voor het realiseren daarvan, zijn uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over een groot tekort aan personeel in de kinderopvang en de gevolgen hiervan voor kleine ondernemers

MP Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary about a large staff shortage in childcare, its effect on parents, and whether stricter quality rules hurt small childcare providers. The State Secretary acknowledged local labour shortages and longer waiting lists, said the number of small providers is not falling, and promised to keep monitoring and report quarterly.
I am closely monitoring the developments and will share them with your House through the quarterly childcare reports.
Ik houd de ontwikkeling nauwgezet in de gaten en deel deze met uw Kamer middels de kwartaalrapportages kinderopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een rechterlijke uitspraak over ‘onredelijk hoge boetes’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs how she responds to a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that fines imposed under the tightened 2013-2014 sanctions regime were evidently unreasonably high and must be reviewed, and whether all such fines will be reassessed ex officio and affected people informed or compensated. The State Secretary says she is studying the ruling, will send a fuller response with consequences for implementation before the summer recess, and will provide the number of fines imposed in the period later.
I will send my response to the ruling and explanation of the consequences for implementation to your House before the summer recess.
Mijn reactie op de uitspraak en uitleg over de gevolgen voor de uitvoering stuur ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het opheffen van de subsidieregeling «Kansen voor alle kinderen» en de besteding van de hierdoor vrijgekomen middelen aan projecten voor de bestrijding van armoede onder kindere

An MP asked the state secretary whether the freed-up funds from the terminated 'Kansen voor alle kinderen' subsidy would be used to combat child poverty, and about school cost burdens. The government answered that the funds go to the 'Tel Mee met Taal' programme against low literacy, with partial child-poverty ambitions, and that school parental contributions must be voluntary, with schools' codes being tightened.
Following these discussions, it was decided to use these funds for the action programme 'Tel Mee met Taal' aimed at tackling low literacy.
Naar aanleiding van deze gesprekken is besloten om deze middelen in te zetten voor het actieprogramma «Tel Mee met Taal» gericht op de aanpak van laaggeletterdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Bedrijven vrezen heksenjacht op vermeende discriminatie’

VVD MPs asked the government about press reports that businesses fear witch-hunts over alleged discrimination after Amsterdam's local approach using fake applicants, and whether municipalities should intervene in labour-market discrimination alongside official bodies like the Inspectie SZW and the College voor de Rechten van de Mens. The state secretary affirmed that enforcement is for national bodies, said municipalities are responsible for their own local approach within legal frameworks, and committed to raising the issue with the G4 mayors.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for their local approach to discrimination.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun lokale aanpak van discriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over een dreigende uithuiszetting van een gezin met kinderen vanwege de vondst van 96 gram hennep

An MP asked the state secretary about a family with children facing eviction after 96 grams of cannabis was found in their home, questioning whether this was disproportionate and asking for a national action plan against evictions. The state secretary said municipalities and housing corporations are responsible, that the family was offered alternative housing, and that central government lacks full information on individual cases, so no new action was committed.
Regarding individual cases, central government generally does not have all the necessary information.
Met betrekking tot individuele casuïstiek beschikt de rijksoverheid over het algemeen niet over alle benodigde informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over schrijnende werkwijze van de sociale dienst Laborijn

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked the state secretary about reports that the Laborijn social services agency in the Achterhoek intrudes excessively on benefit recipients, including checking fridges and shower times, and about its costs. The state secretary replied that enforcement is a municipal responsibility subject to objection and appeal, that no national intervention is warranted, and that Laborijn's board has commissioned an independent external investigation.

Within its decentralised context, it is primarily the municipal executive's responsibility to ensure the correct implementation of the Participation Act and to account for it to the municipal council.

Binnen haar gedecentraliseerde context, is het primair aan het college van B&W om zorg te dragen voor een juiste uitvoering van de Participatiewet en om daarover verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de uitvoering van de motie-Stoffer

MP Stoffer asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the implementation of his motion on the wage-cost allowance (LKV) for employers hiring workers with disabilities, questioning the timing of the transitional leniency scheme and the lack of timely information for schools and young people. The State Secretary maintained that communication was sufficient, that the nine-month leniency period was adequate, and that stagiaires may still qualify for the low-income allowance, while planning to abolish the doelgroepverklaring for the group already on the register.
I therefore announced in my letter of 20 November 2018 that I intend, subject to an implementation test by UWV, to abolish the target group declaration for this group.
Daarom heb ik in mijn brief van 20 november 2018 3 aangekondigd voornemens te zijn, onder voorbehoud van een uitvoeringstoets door UWV, de doelgroepverklaring voor deze groep af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van der Molen over het bestaan van zogenaamde “spookburgers.”

MPs Peters and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers about homeless people being refused registration and mail addresses by municipalities despite a 2016 agreement, and whether the government would compel municipalities to register them. The government acknowledged the problem and the duty to register, said it is pursuing guidance, workshops and a legislative clarification making registration on a mail address mandatory, but declined to name the refusing municipalities or to use direct enforcement powers for now.
Antwoord op vragen va het lid Jasper van Dijk over spookburgers en gemeenten die een briefadres weigeren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Interior about municipalities refusing mail addresses (briefadres) to homeless and 'ghost' citizens, leaving them without access to insurance, benefits and passports. The government acknowledged the problem, said it was contacting municipalities and the Nationale ombudsman, and announced a legislative amendment to make municipalities register people at a mail address ex officio.
