The Ministry of BZK organised and facilitated national workshops for municipalities in early 2017 and in September and October 2018 to draw attention to the topics in the circular on the BRP and mail addresses.
Zo heeft het Ministerie van BZK begin 2017, en in september en oktober 2018, landelijke workshops voor gemeenten georganiseerd en begeleid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over landelijk meldpunt en onderzoek naar giftig chroom-6

An MP asked whether chromium-6 is used in more sectors than known, whether a national reporting point and investigation should be set up, and whether a claims assessment body should be created for victims. The government said the Inspectorate SZW works risk-based and will inventory known risky uses, that complaints can go to the Inspectorate and a central reporting point is under discussion with social partners, and that a commission will be set up to facilitate future compensation for occupational diseases.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Nispen over het bericht dat slechte arbeidsomstandigheden en uitbuiting bij nagelsalons geen prioriteit hebben bij de Inspectie SZW

MPs Aartsen and Van Nispen asked why the Inspectorate SZW does not prioritise exploitation, illegal employment and underpayment in nail salons despite its stated priorities and warnings from the National Rapporteur on Human Trafficking and the Public Prosecution Service. The government replied that the Inspectorate runs a risk-based programme covering the wellness sector including nail studios, that 29 salons were inspected with violations found in half, that enforcement and signals receive continued attention, and that cooperation with police and partners exists, though exploitation is hard to detect.
Within this programme there is indeed attention for the wellness sector, and within it for nail studios.
Binnen dit programma is er wel degelijk aandacht voor de wellnessbranche, en daarbinnen voor nagelstudio's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Pieter Heerma over het bericht ‘Zorgen om uitbuiting in goedkope nagelsalons’

CDA MPs Kuik and Heerma asked the State Secretaries of Justice and Social Affairs about reported exploitation, human trafficking and money laundering in cheap nail salons. The government answered that few signals reach the Inspectorate or police, that it will keep attention on the sector, run a study within the inspection programme, and strengthen municipal anti-trafficking efforts and international cooperation.
The Inspectorate SZW has informed me upon request that addressing abuses in nail salons will continue to receive attention from the Inspectorate.
De Inspectie SZW heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat de aanpak van misstanden in de nagelsalons blijvende aandacht van de Inspectie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in nagelsalons

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about abuses in nail salons, including the National Rapporteur's call for more investigation, victims' reluctance to report, and police and Inspectorate capacity. The government answered by listing the 'Samen tegen mensenhandel' programme measures, reduced reporting barriers, and additional funding for the Inspectorate, while noting few signals have reached the authorities.
In addition, the Inspectorate SZW will receive a national human trafficking expert who will form the link between the investigative service and chain partners.
Bovendien krijgt de Inspectie SZW een landelijke expert mensenhandel die de verbinding vormt tussen de opsporingsdienst en ketenpartners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over twee jaar uitstel voor een wet die mensen met schulden moet helpen

An MP asks why the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet (simplifying the garnishment-free amount act) is delayed by two years, how many people are harmed, and whether bank garnishment and household goods seizure rules will be modernised. The State Secretary attributes the delay to ICT and data-exchange challenges at UWV and the Tax Authority, states that the government is working on interim measures, and says the broader garnishment reform bill is with the Council of State before being submitted to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "armoede en achterblijvende lonen"

An SP MP asks the government about a Nibud report showing households on minimum income falling short for essential and social participation costs, especially large families, and about raising the minimum wage, wage growth and municipal poverty policy. The government answers that most households are covered by national schemes, points to child-benefit reforms and tax cuts already planned, rejects a 10% minimum wage increase on cost and employment grounds, and says it will study reallocating child-scheme funds and continue talks with municipalities.
In its response to the policy review, the cabinet indicated there is reason for further study of a possible reallocation of available financial resources within the child schemes.

In de reactie op de beleidsdoorlichting heeft het kabinet aangegeven dat er daarom aanleiding is voor nader onderzoek naar een mogelijke herallocatie van de beschikbare financiële middelen binnen de kindregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Wiersma over het bericht dat zzp’ers geen schuldhulp krijgen

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about reports that self-employed people (zzp'ers) with debts often do not get municipal debt assistance, and what is causing this. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said the Wgs does not exclude the self-employed but the 2012 explanatory memorandum causes confusion, and promised a Wgs amendment, a 2019 knowledge-sharing initiative, and further information.
I find it worrying that self-employed people with debts still have insufficient access to municipal debt assistance.
Ik vind het zorgwekkend dat zelfstandigen met schulden nog onvoldoende toegang krijgen tot de gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Weyenberg over zzp’ers zonder schuldhulp

MPs Raemakers and Van Weyenberg (D66) asked why many large municipalities deny debt assistance to self-employed people, why partners' income can block access, and what the government will do. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, says municipalities cannot exclude self-employed groups, and promises a change to the Wgs, guidance and knowledge sharing, though some data requests are answered only partially.
Self-employed people may not be excluded as a group from debt assistance.
Zelfstandigen mogen niet als groep worden uitgesloten van schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Smeulders, Renkema en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de distributiecentra van Picnic niet veilig zijn

MPs from SP, GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of high workload, unsafe equipment and poor pay at online supermarket Picnic, including whether the Inspectorate SZW would investigate, whether its risk assessment was in order, and whether it should fall under the supermarket collective agreement. The Minister answered that employers are responsible for safe work and workload, that the Inspectorate acts on complaints and risk-based priorities without commenting on specific investigations, that no company collective agreement is registered for Picnic and interpreting the scope of sector agreements is for the social partners, and that the government is taking measures against competition on labour conditions.
No statements are made about whether the Inspectorate SZW is conducting an investigation or not.
Er worden geen uitlatingen gedaan of de Inspectie SZW al dan niet onderzoek doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Omtzigt over de vertraging van de invoering van de wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet

MPs Peters and Omtzigt (CDA) asked why implementation of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet was delayed by at least two years, why the Belastingdienst and UWV implementation assessments were not published earlier, and what interim measures will protect debtors. The state secretaries explain that the delay stems from ICT and process redesign, that the revised assessments will be published before the 14 February 2019 debate, and that interim measures are being sought, but give no firm dates or concrete commitments yet.
We aim to publish the Besluit beslagvrije voet before the committee debate on poverty and debt policy scheduled for 14 February 2019, so that you can review the implementation assessments.
Wij streven ernaar het Besluit beslagvrije voet vóór het voor 14 februari 2019 geplande AO Armoede- en schuldenbeleid te publiceren, zodat u van de uitvoeringstoetsen kennis kunt nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk, Van Rooijen en Geleijnse over berichten dat de Scandinavische schuldenindustrie zich met woekerrentes richt op de Nederlandse zzp'er

Three 50PLUS MPs asked the ministers whether Scandinavian lenders charging 18% to 200% interest to Dutch self-employed people (zzp'ers) are a problem requiring a rate cap, a duty of care, AFM supervision and standard creditworthiness checks. The Finance Minister answered that the government takes such signals seriously but that the scale of the problem is unclear, so it will first map the issue and rely on the industry's self-regulatory code for now, with no concrete measures yet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat sociale werkvoorziening ATEA te Breda verdwijnt en dat dit tot veel onrust leidt

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about reported unrest over the closure of the ATEA sheltered employment organisation in Breda, and whether Breda's failure to adopt the legally required client-participation ordinance under the Wsw invalidates its policy, plus related questions on beschut werk and other municipalities. The State Secretary says the municipality guarantees staff continuity, that the missing ordinance does not affect the lawfulness of policy, that the council is responsible for overseeing the executive, and that the evaluation of beschut werk will be concluded in autumn 2019.
It is up to the municipal council to check the executive on correct implementation.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad het college te controleren op een juiste uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Smeulders over het bericht dat jonge gehandicapten geregeld geen uitkering krijgen terwijl ze er wel recht op hebben

MPs Renkema and Smeulders asked about a report that young disabled people are often denied a Wajong benefit they are entitled to, and about a UWV internal study finding wrong conclusions in 21% of files. The State Secretary answered that the study could not confirm incorrect outcomes with certainty, that UWV introduced retraining and quality controls, that the 2018 risk fell to 7%, and that the internal report was not shared with the ministry.
The internal study report in question was not provided to me for information at the time.
Het bewuste interne onderzoeksrapport is destijds niet ter informatie aan mij aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over fouten bij keuring van zieke jongeren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a UWV internal study finding that in 2016 about one in five Wajong disability assessments carried a risk of incorrect decisions, low quality of labour expert reports, why the report was not sent to parliament, and access to appeal. The State Secretary disputed the 33% reading, said the report was not forwarded to him, declined to list all internal audits, rejected independence changes, and pointed to re-assessments and a 2019 Wajong evaluation.
The internal audit report in question was not submitted to me at the time for information.
Het bewuste interne onderzoeksrapport is destijds niet ter informatie aan mij aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het rapport 'Financiële problemen 2018'

A VVD MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the NIBUD report on financial problems 2018, including why people with serious payment problems do not seek debt assistance, barriers to access, and early detection. The State Secretary answered that the report shows fewer households struggle but problems are more severe, attributed non-use to life events and lack of awareness, and pointed to the Broad Debt Approach, early signalling pilots and a planned amendment of the Municipal Debt Assistance Act.
As far as I am aware, no statistics are available to answer this question.
Voor zover mij bekend zijn er geen statistieken beschikbaar om deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over onvoldoende bescherming voor leden van cliëntenraden vanuit de Participatiewet

Two PvdA MPs asked whether members of client councils under the Participation Act can be dismissed by municipal boards for being too political, and whether the law protects them adequately. The state secretary said the matter is for the municipality and gemeenteraad, that the law sufficiently anchors client participation, and that no legislative change is planned, pointing instead to a Movisie project and the evaluation due end 2019.
I do not intend to amend the Participation Act.
Ik ben niet voornemens de Participatiewet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het gebruik van SyRI in Capelle aan den IJssel

An MP asked about the SyRI risk-profiling system in Capelle aan den IJssel, including how many cases were investigated, whether investigative powers were used against people without suspicion, and whether SyRI operations should be documented and reported annually. The state secretary said the 62 no-violation cases came from a separate collaboration rather than SyRI, that data were destroyed late, that risk reports are not proof, that SyRI methods will remain undisclosed, and that SyRI use is already documented with a possible mention in a semi-annual letter.
I maintain that the data files and analysis methods used by SyRI should not be made public.
Ik blijf van mening dat gebruikte databestanden en analysemethoden van SyRI niet openbaar moeten worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aartsen over het onderzoek van TNO waaruit blijkt dat asbesthoudende vensterbanken veilig zijn te verwijderen in de laagste risicoklasse

MPs Ziengs and Aartsen asked the state secretary about TNO research suggesting asbestos window sills can be removed under the lowest risk class, the cost implications, and the governance of the SMA-rt instrument managed by Ascert. The state secretary answered that a pilot and a redesign of the instrument are being prepared, while acknowledging ongoing disputes about oversight and Ascert's representativeness.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over onderzoek van Sociaal Werk Nederland waaruit blijkt dat meer ouders peuters thuishouden

Two MPs asked whether administrative burden of the childcare allowance application is causing parents to keep toddlers out of playgroup-type care, with consequences for language delay, and proposed free preschool. The state secretary answered that research shows no national trend of parents dropping out, that a verbetertraject for the allowance and a new study are underway, and that a precise cost estimate for free preschool is difficult but a rough figure of about 850 million euro was given.
That is why I will again examine at the beginning of 2019 what the effects of the harmonisation are.
Daarom zal ik begin 2019 opnieuw onderzoeken wat de effecten van de harmonisatie zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Pieter Heerma over het bericht 'Heya! Kilo’s knallen!'

MPs Van Weyenberg and Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions, agency staffing, pension and WW-benefit practices, hygiene training and inspection in the meat processing sector, following a press report. The Minister responded that the picture from the article is not reflected in complaints to the Inspectorate, pointed to existing collective agreements, complaint routes and prevention projects, and did not commit to new action.
The picture in the article regarding the working conditions of migrant workers is not something I recognise in the complaints and reports submitted to the Inspectorate SZW.
Het beeld dat naar voren komt in het artikel waarbij het gaat om de arbeidsomstandigheden van arbeidsmigranten zie ik niet terug in klachten en meldingen die worden ingediend bij de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de uitzending van Radar inzake een 93-jarige dame die in de schulden is gekomen door een fout van het CAK

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a Radar broadcast in which a 93-year-old woman fell into debt after a CAK administrative error on her care contribution. The minister admitted errors, offered a settlement, shortened retroactive recovery to twelve months, and promised a general administrative order and a letter to the CAK.
In response to this undesirable situation, I have decided to shorten the retroactive effect of revisions arising from a serious shortcoming or serious delay on the part of the CAK to twelve months.

Naar aanleiding van deze onwenselijke situatie heb ik besloten de terugwerkende kracht van herzieningen, die ontstaan naar aanleiding van een ernstige tekortkoming of ernstige vertraging aan de kant van het CAK, te verkorten naar twaalf maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht 'Miljoenen aan buitenlands bezit verzwegen bij aanvraag uitkering'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that millions in undeclared foreign assets were found in benefit applications, including €17 million in Turkey in 2016-2017, and asked for total fraud and recovery figures by country, and whether foreign fraudsters should be expelled. The State Secretary confirmed the €17 million figure, explained that national statistics are not broken down by type of violation or country, said handling of foreign assets is being improved with the IBF, SVB and municipalities, and stated that violating Participatiewet obligations is not grounds to revoke a residence permit.
The Ministry of SZW therefore does not have the total detected fraud amount and total recovered amount over the past five years, broken down by country where asset investigations were carried out.

Het Ministerie van SZW beschikt zodoende niet over het totale aangetroffen fraudebedrag en het totale ingevorderde en terugbetaalde bedrag in de afgelopen vijf jaar, uitgesplitst naar land waar vermogensonderzoeken zijn verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht ‘Amper controle zwendel’

The MP asks whether 20 to 30 percent of Turkish welfare recipients commit fraud, whether gemeenten should be forced to enforce and face fund cuts, and whether non-Western fraudsters should lose residence rights. The Secretary of State replies that statistics do not distinguish by nationality, that enforcement is the municipalities' responsibility with working on recovery and asset seizure abroad, that residence cannot be revoked for benefit fraud, and that no fund cuts are planned.
There is therefore no estimate possible of the fraud rate among Turkish Dutch or other groups in the Netherlands.
Er is dan ook geen schatting te maken over het fraudeerpercentage onder Turkse Nederlanders of andere groeperingen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het opsporen van uitkeringsfraude van mensen met vermogen in het buitenland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about detecting benefit fraud by people holding assets abroad, including a Nieuwsuur report and alleged threats against fraud investigators in Turkey. The State Secretary said enforcement is complex abroad, that municipalities bear primary enforcement responsibility, that a handbook on investigations is being updated, and that asset-check agreements are being pursued in treaties, but gave no figures on success rates and withheld some data because municipalities choose their own methods.
The Ministry of SZW does not have the percentage of successful investigations per agency.
Het Ministerie van SZW beschikt niet over het percentage succesvolle opsporingen per instantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over armoede in Nederland en weken alleen gekookte rijst

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about poverty in the Netherlands, including a reported woman who lived for weeks on only boiled rice, and whether the anti-poverty policy has been effective. The State Secretary answers that poverty is a priority, cites CBS and Eurostat trends, and lists measures such as lowering taxes on work, the broader employment offensive, and funds for municipalities and anti-poverty organisations, plus a planned talk with the VNG about better reaching low-income workers.
I will continue to critically examine the current participation and poverty policy in order to further reduce the number of people living in poverty in the Netherlands.
Ik blijf kritisch kijken naar het huidige participatie- en armoedebeleid om het aantal mensen dat in Nederland in armoede leeft steeds verder terug te kunnen dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de toename van het aantal daklozen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about a wheelchair-using homeless woman refused at a Haarlem night shelter, the rising number of homeless people, waiting lists, and municipalities refusing postal addresses to homeless people. The State Secretary answers that the woman now has shelter, that CBS figures show homelessness rising to 2015 with a dip in 2016, that no national waiting-list data exist, and that the Ministry of BZK has pursued municipalities on postal-address refusals and will raise the issue with them.
Municipalities are legally responsible for providing good help and support.
Gemeenten zijn wettelijk verantwoordelijk voor het bieden van goede hulp en ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over Ryanair die basis Eindhoven sluit

An MP asked the government whether it would enforce Dutch labour and social security law on Ryanair after its Eindhoven base closure, including preventing an unlawful collective dismissal or transfer. The minister answered that Dutch courts decide when Dutch employment law applies, that the government has written to Ryanair asking it to apply home-country labour law, and that the Labour Inspectorate has no supervisory role here.
It is therefore for the Dutch judge to determine under which circumstances Dutch employment law applies, and not for the Dutch government.
Het is dus aan de Nederlandse rechter om te bepalen onder welke omstandigheden het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht van toepassing is, en niet aan de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de toegang tot schuldsanering

MP Peters asked the state secretary whether the falling inflow into statutory debt rescheduling (Wsnp) while debt problems grow signals that eligible people are not admitted, and how access to help is guaranteed. The government acknowledges the trend, says it will verify the alignment between municipal debt assistance and the Wsnp in a review due in the first half of 2019, but does not yet draw conclusions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Jasper van Dijk over "vingerscan-affaire in Spijkenisse"

MPs Renkema and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the illegal collection of welfare recipients' fingerprints in Spijkenisse, the reversal of sanctions, and the treatment of claimants as criminals were acceptable. The State Secretary called fingerprint scanning undesirable and contrary to privacy law, said the practice had ended and the AP was responsible for enforcement, and left sanction disputes to the courts.
Scanning and collecting fingerprints of welfare recipients to check their attendance at a work company is, in my view, undesirable and moreover contrary to the applicable privacy legislation.

Het scannen en verzamelen van vingerafdrukken van bijstandsgerechtigden ter controle van hun aanwezigheid bij een werkbedrijf acht ik onwenselijk en bovendien in strijd met de geldende privacywetgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Tielen en Lodders over het bericht ‘Onterecht geld opstrijken; Ouders kunnen zich inschrijven voor studie en, zonder ooit op te dagen, kinderopvangtoeslag ontvangen. Wat

MPs from the VVD asked whether a student enrolment certificate alone is enough to receive childcare allowance, how many households receive it for study, and how enrolment is checked. The government answered that enrolment is one eligibility condition checked by the Tax Authority against Dutch education-agency data, that a certificate alone is not sufficient, and that the check is effective.
A certificate of enrolment alone is therefore not sufficient.
Een bewijs van inschrijving alleen is dus niet voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de personeelsuitbuiting en soms ook mensenhandel die chuil gaat achter de idyllische wereld van riviercruises

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports of exploitation of river cruise staff, including excessive hours, unpaid overtime and possible trafficking. The State Secretary said the Working Time Decree for inland shipping allows long hours, that the Labour Inspectorate has fined operators and keeps attention on the sector, but declined to commit to new measures beyond its existing programme.
I therefore see no reason to point this out to the Inspectorate.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om de Inspectie hierop te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over toename van werkende armen

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about the rising number of working poor, including the SCP findings, self-employed low-rate workers, flexible and on-call contracts, and municipal outreach. The government acknowledged the concern, pointed to planned measures such as the ALT contract and the Arbeidsmarkt in balans bill, and committed to talks with municipalities and the VNG.
The cabinet will discuss the report with the VNG to examine how municipalities can better reach and support working people with low incomes.
Het kabinet gaat met de VNG over het rapport in gesprek, om te bezien hoe gemeenten werkenden met een laag inkomen beter kunnen bereiken en ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in het Europese wegtransport

An MP asks the ministers about abuses in European road haulage, including the ease of obtaining driver certificates in other EU states, Polish control capacity, poor living conditions and low pay of non-EU drivers, enforcement of rest times, supply-chain liability, and applying the Posted Workers Directive to transport. The government answers that it lacks comparative data, cites enforcement figures (165 fine reports), explains existing supply-chain liability rules, and says it is pursuing equal pay for equal work through the EU Mobility Package.
As far as I have been able to ascertain, no comparative research has been carried out into the requirements that different member states impose on applications for certificates.
Er is, voor zover ik heb kunnen nagaan, geen vergelijkend onderzoek gedaan naar de eisen die in de verschillende lidstaten worden gesteld aan aanvragen van attesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over uitstel van het verschijnen van het onderzoek naar de blootstelling aan asbestvezels bij werkzaamheden met straalgrit

An SP MP asked why the publication of an investigation into worker exposure to asbestos-contaminated blasting grit keeps being postponed, and what is being done for workers left uncertain for a year. The state secretary replied that additional RIVM research was needed for careful assessment, that TNO and RIVM reports are sent alongside the answers, and that the Arbobesluit requires employers to keep lists of exposed workers.
On the basis of the TNO and RIVM reports, which you receive in parallel with these answers, a definitive answer can be given.
Op basis van de rapporten van TNO en RIVM, die u parallel aan deze antwoorden ontvangt, kan uitsluitsel worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over terugloop van het aantal kinderen met een (leer)achterstand in de voorschoolse opvang in Amsterdam

The SP MP Kwint asked the minister whether the share of children with a learning disadvantage in Amsterdam pre-school care is falling by 20-25% as a city alderman claimed, whether this is a national trend, and how the government will tackle it. The minister answered that the Inspectorate will report reach figures in 2020, that a harmonisation study is planned, that additional funding of 170 million euros per year is provided from 2020, and that no national trend of drop-out due to income-related contributions has been found.
State Secretary Van Ark will conduct research early next year into the state of affairs of the harmonisation.
Staatssecretaris Van Ark zal begin volgend jaar onderzoek doen naar de stand van zaken van de harmonisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de daling van het aantal kinderen met een risico op (taal)achterstand in de voorschoolse educatie in Amsterdam en Rotterdam

An MP asked the government about the reported drop in toddlers at risk of language and education delay attending pre-school in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, and how this fits with the government's aim to reduce inequality of opportunity. The minister replied that the government prioritises combating educational disadvantage, that monitoring and a follow-up study on harmonisation and possible demand drop-out are planned, and that municipalities can already offer free or low-cost pre-school places using existing funds.

Should the outcomes of the aforementioned study show a drop in participation of target-group toddlers in pre-school education, I will enter into discussion with representatives of municipalities and childcare organisations about the policy choices municipalities make.

Mocht uit de uitkomsten van het eerder genoemde onderzoek blijken dat er sprake is van een terugloop in deelname van doelgroeppeuters aan voorschoolse educatie, dan zal ik in gesprek gaan met de vertegenwoordigers van gemeenten en van kinderopvangorganisaties over de beleidskeuzes die gemeenten maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "de oproep van Belgische minister Peeters aan Ryanair om te voldoen aan Belgisch arbeidsrecht"

An MP asks the government about a Belgian minister's letter to Ryanair demanding compliance with Belgian labour law, precarious self-employment of pilots, and whether Dutch labour and social security law applies to Dutch-based crew. The minister answers that Dutch courts decide on applicable law, Dutch social security applies to Dutch-based crew, and a joint letter to Ryanair is being prepared with other EU states.
It is therefore for the Dutch court to determine under which circumstances Dutch labour law applies, and not for the Dutch government.
Het is dus aan de Nederlandse rechter om te bepalen onder welke omstandigheden het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht van toepassing is, en niet aan de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de verwachte prijsstijging voor kinderopvang

An MP asked the state secretary whether the stricter baby staff ratio would cause childcare price rises that hit small providers and low-income families hardest, and what monitoring and intervention was planned. The secretary acknowledged the cost concerns, pointed to a 7.65% increase in the maximum hourly rate and planned monitoring with a mid-2019 update, but did not commit to specific intervention beyond close monitoring.
The Ministry of SZW periodically monitors the development of hourly rates using childcare allowance data made available by the Tax Administration.
Het Ministerie van SZW monitort periodiek de ontwikkeling van de uurtarieven via data over de kinderopvangtoeslag die beschikbaar worden gesteld door de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Onzekerheid heerst voor gehandicapte werknemers’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that workers with disabilities in the Participatiewet face insecure contracts, low share of permanent contracts (18%), sober employment conditions without a cao, missing pensions, and the role of municipalities and sheltered work. The State Secretary answered that the 18% figure relates only to the Participatiewet group in the jobs agreement, that 61% of hours for the whole target group are under permanent contracts, that employment conditions are a matter for social partners, and that the government will pursue a broad offensive including support for sheltered workplaces and the SER advice.
The central government has no role in this.
Het rijk heeft hierin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het recht op onbereikbaarheid

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the right to disconnect (onbereikbaarheid) after reports that Lidl restricted after-hours emailing, and whether the government would promote similar arrangements, discuss them with social partners, and continue the work-stress awareness campaign. The State Secretary replied that work stress is a matter for tailored solutions reached through dialogue between employers and employees on the shop floor, that causal links between constant connectivity and burnout are not yet established, and that the ministry will keep supporting activities but will not pursue a legal right to disconnect or discuss it with social partners.
An approach to work stress is tailor-made.
Een aanpak tegen werkstress is maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over toegang tot de gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening

An MP asked the state secretary about the Nationale ombudsman's follow-up report on access to municipal debt assistance, including low intake rates, missing registration data, and limited access for self-employed people. The state secretary replied that municipalities are responsible for access, that improvements are underway through the debt-reduction agenda and benchmarks, and committed to further knowledge-sharing and talks with municipalities.
Municipalities are responsible for access to and the quality of debt assistance for their residents.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de toegang en de kwaliteit van de schuldhulpverlening aan hun inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de reactie van Bonaire op het 'onderzoek ijkpunt sociaal minimum Caribisch Nederland en kabinetsreactie'

An MP asks whether Bonaire's island council was properly consulted on the Regioplan minimum-living-standard study and cabinet response, and whether its objections were taken into account. The State Secretary answers that consultation was carried out through the required channels, that the study's design was agreed with a steering group including Bonaire, and that Bonaire's objections were not all accepted, with talks on a governance agreement continuing.
As I indicated in my letter to the Bonaire executive board, I have held various discussions in recent period with the members of the executive board and the island council of Bonaire.

Zoals ik in mijn brief aan het bestuurscollege van Bonaire heb aangegeven, heb ik in de afgelopen periode diverse gesprekken met (de leden van) het bestuurscollege en de eilandsraad van Bonaire gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het benutten van sociale ondernemingen via de Aanbestedingswet voor het creëren van banenkansen voor mensen met achterstand op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked the State Secretaries whether Article 2.82 of the Public Procurement Act is meant to increase employment for people far from the labour market, whether reserved contracts should be attractive to authorities, and whether seconded workers count toward the 30% threshold for reserved tenders. The government answered that Article 2.82 does aim to increase such employment, that reserved contracts are supported, and that whether seconded workers count depends on interpreting 'werknemer' and is ultimately for the courts to decide.
Whether seconded workers can be classed as employees under this article is a question of interpreting the law.
Of gedetacheerde werknemers aangemerkt kunnen worden als werknemers binnen dit artikel is een vraag naar de interpretatie van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over verplichte diensten op zaterdagmiddag bij VDL Nedcar die in strijd zijn met de Arbeidstijdenwet

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether mandatory Saturday-afternoon shifts at VDL Nedcar, imposed after a strike and allegedly in breach of the Working Hours Act, were lawful, and what would be done about it. The secretary said the shifts were not in themselves unlawful, that the Labour Inspectorate would investigate complaints, that VDL Nedcar had reduced the planned overtime, and that no reason was seen yet to assume a breach.
Reports of possible breaches of the Working Hours Act will be investigated by the Labour Inspectorate and, if breaches are actually found, will lead to an enforcement procedure and possibly a fine.

Meldingen van mogelijke overtredingen van de Arbeidstijdenwet zullen door de Inspectie SZW onderzocht worden en indien er daadwerkelijk sprake blijkt van overtredingen, leiden tot een handhavingstraject en mogelijk tot boeteoplegging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het niet beschikbaar zijn van het loonkostenvoordeel voor mensen met een militair invaliditeitspensioen

An MP asked why people receiving a military disability pension (MIP) are excluded from the employer wage-cost subsidy and whether the rules will change. The minister answered that the MIP is compensation for invalidity rather than an incapacity benefit, so it does not qualify, and pointed to Defence's support arrangements and UWV expertise instead.
The MIP is financial compensation for invalidity and not an income provision for incapacity for work, like the WIA or WAMIL.
Het MIP betreft een financiële compensatie vanwege invaliditeit en is geen inkomensvoorziening vanwege arbeidsongeschiktheid, zoals de WIA of WAMIL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de volmacht en de Participatiewet

Two SP MPs asked whether a son holding a power of attorney for his incapacitated mother can lose his Participatiewet benefit merely by being deemed able to dispose of her assets, and what options exist to prevent this. The Secretary of State replied that a power of attorney does not affect benefit entitlement if the funds are used solely for the principal, that the benefit must be stopped only if the duty to disclose is breached, and that municipalities have been informed via a Gemeentenieuws notice.
A power of attorney and being reasonably able to dispose of funds has no effect on the right to benefits, provided the funds are used exclusively for the benefit of the authorised person.
Een volmacht en het redelijkerwijs over middelen kunnen beschikken heeft geen invloed op het recht op bijstand, mits de middelen uitsluitend ten behoeve van de gemachtigde worden aangewend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over "de problemen met het recht op dubbele kinderbijslag voor ouders met kinderen met autisme"

An MP asked the state secretary about perceived arbitrariness, application volumes and outcomes, and the complexity of applications for double child benefit for parents of children with autism. The secretary denied arbitrariness, reported 2017 figures (9,283 granted, 11,081 rejected, 403 objections, 164 upheld) and pointed to communication improvements and an ongoing evaluation.
In the ongoing evaluation of the Wet Hervorming Kindregelingen I am specifically also looking at the double child benefit for intensive care and the related process.
Ik kijk bij de nu lopende evaluatie van de Wet Hervorming Kindregelingen nadrukkelijk ook naar de dubbele kinderbijslag intensieve zorg en het bijbehorende proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over "uitkeringsfraude"

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary for Social Affairs about a university study finding that a hard enforcement approach to benefit fraud may increase fraud, and about the harm to trust between benefit recipients, social services and government. The state secretary answers that she supports effective enforcement, is studying the 'slimmer handhaven' research, stresses respectful treatment and personal contact, and says the rules are regularly reviewed with stakeholders while pointing to a 2017 change in the Fraudewet allowing more tailored sanctions.

To gain more insight into what does and does not work in enforcement with the ultimate aim of promoting compliance, the Rijksuniversiteit Groningen research on 'smarter enforcement' is also being taken under consideration and studied further by SZW.

Om meer zicht te krijgen op wat wel en niet werkt in de handhaving met als uiteindelijke doel naleving te bevorderen, wordt ook het onderzoek van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen over «slimmer handhaven» 5 door SZW in beraad genomen en verder bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bespioneren van uitkeringsgerechtigden

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reported surveillance, camera use, and intrusive questioning of welfare recipients by municipal social services, and about rules on cohabitation and cooperation with fraud investigations. The State Secretary declined to judge individual cases, said camera surveillance is no longer permitted after Central Raad van Beroep rulings, and announced an exploration of strengthening the legal basis for technical enforcement tools.
Currently I am exploring whether and how the legal basis for the use of technical tools in enforcement can be strengthened.
Momenteel verken ik of en zo ja, hoe de wettelijke grondslag voor de inzet van technische hulpmiddelen in de handhaving, kan worden verstevigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het lage-inkomensvoordeel

An SP MP asked the minister whether the low-wage allowance (LIV) discourages wage increases, whether it benefits large profitable firms such as Primark and Jumbo, and for transparency on recipients, including the share going to EU workers and to the quota register. The minister denied receiving signals that employers keep wages low for the LIV, declined a CPB study as premature, gave only sector-level LIV figures citing privacy, and promised a later analysis of overlap with the ET-regeling.
For privacy reasons, I do not consider it desirable to provide this kind of business-confidential information at employer level.
Ik acht het, vanuit privacy overwegingen, niet wenselijk om dit soort bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie op werkgeversniveau te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "Maaltijdbezorger Deliveroo ronselt minderjarigen"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Deliveroo recruits minors as couriers, whether this is tolerable, whether Deliveroo breaches OECD guidelines, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that child delivery work is prohibited under the Working Hours Act, placed primary responsibility on companies, declined to comment on concrete cases, and said the Inspectorate will focus on the platform economy without confirming any investigation.
I do not comment on any ongoing investigations by the Inspectorate.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het niet uitvoeren van een motie over meervoudig gehandicapte kinderen

An SP MP asks why the 2016 Siderius motion, which asks for a Wajong benefit for severely multiply disabled pupils who leave special school at 18, has still not been implemented, and when it will be. The State Secretary says she is willing to implement it through a legal amendment removing the 'studying' exclusion, with a target entry into force of 1 January 2020, subject to feasibility.
I am therefore willing to implement the Siderius motion with the aim of preventing the right to a benefit from being a reason to stop education.
Ik ben dan ook bereid om uitvoering te geven aan de motie Siderius met het doel te voorkomen dat het recht op een uitkering reden is om te stoppen met onderwijs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over “Strijdigheid van bepalingen van de verordening Re-integratie en loonkostensubsidie van de gemeente Teylingen en andere ISD Bollenstreek-gemeenten met de Par

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether the Teylingen and other ISD Bollenstreek municipalities' rules limiting wage-cost subsidy hours conflict with the Participatiewet, and what supervisory options exist. The State Secretary confirmed the conflict, said the ISD will propose reversing the policy to municipal councils, and stated that interbestuurlijk toezicht measures are not needed for now.
It is therefore good that the ISD Bollenstreek will propose to the municipal councils, via the college of mayor and aldermen, to bring municipal policy back into line with the Participatiewet.
Het is daarom goed dat de ISD Bollenstreek via de colleges van B&W de gemeenteraden zal voorstellen het gemeentelijk beleid weer in overstemming met de Participatiewet te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Gijs van Dijk over “de pakketsorteerders die via een schijnconstructie worden ingehuurd bij PostNL”

MPs Van Kent and Van Dijk asked the State Secretary about PostNL using a contracting scheme to hire parcel sorters outside the post CAO, heavy lifting limits, sick-leave practices and their call to ban parcels over 23 kg. The government answered that enforcement of CAOs is primarily for social partners, that the Labour Inspectorate can only report findings, that the Arbowet and NIOSH method govern lifting, and that the motion was rejected.
It is therefore not for the Labour Inspectorate to take further steps, even if in an investigation under article 8 of the Waadi it has established that the wage-ratio provision was not complied with.

Het is dus niet aan de Inspectie SZW om nadere stappen te nemen, ook niet als zij bij een onderzoek op grond van artikel 8 van de Waadi heeft vastgesteld dat het loonverhoudingsvoorschrift zoals vastgelegd in de Waadi niet is nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Aantal mensen in de bijstand daalt verder’ en de Divosa Benchmark Werk & Inkomen jaarrapportage 2017

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that 62% of benefit recipients say they are exempt from job-search duties, versus 10% formally exempted, and about informal exemptions, the role of exemption grounds, and municipal reporting to councils. The State Secretary acknowledged the gap and cited inspection findings on informal exemptions, but declined to intervene in municipal reporting to councils and said informal exemption numbers are not registered.
I cannot and will not step into this.
Ik kan en wil hierin niet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Diertens en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Maak vaccineren verplicht’

MPs asked whether mandatory childhood vaccination should apply in daycare centres, how other EU countries handle it, and whether parents can learn daycare vaccination rates. The government opposes mandatory vaccination in daycare (limited effect, constitutional objections) and says a rate-disclosure obligation has little benefit and lacks support, promising a plan of action in autumn.
I am not in favour of making vaccination mandatory for children at daycare centres.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het verplicht stellen van vaccinatie voor kinderen op kinderdagverblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over schuldenaars onder schrikbewind

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen (SP) asked about abuses by professional debt administrators (bewindvoerders), the lack of oversight, municipalities' ability to refer or assess them, liability for damages, and the market-law constraints on municipalities acting as administrators. The minister responded that existing court supervision, the ongoing evaluation of the 2013 reform, and the Wet markt en overheid apply, promising results of the evaluation around summer and largely pointing to the courts and the evaluation for answers.
I am awaiting the outcomes. These are expected around the summer and will be sent to your House as promised.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten af. Deze zijn rond de zomer te verwachten en worden zoals toegezegd aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van den Berg over kinderrechten in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Diertens and Van den Berg asked whether funding exists to support families with children in Caribbean Netherlands, how child poverty will be tackled there, and how the social minimum and the 1 July 2018 deadline will be met. The government replied that the claim of no funding is premature, that a benchmark study on subsistence security is pending with a reaction to follow, and that BZK is involved through its coordinating role.
A study into a benchmark for subsistence security in Caribbean Netherlands has been promised to both chambers of the States General.
Aan de beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is een onderzoek naar een ijkpunt voor de bestaanszekerheid in Caribisch Nederland toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Zelfstandige ondernemers met schulden kunnen vaak niet bij hun gemeente terecht’

MPs De Lange and Wiersma asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about reports that self-employed people with debts are often turned away by municipalities, and why municipal practice differs. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance access and quality, that the Wgs does not exclude groups in principle, that the Bbz2004 is a suitable instrument, and that the government will support municipalities with knowledge development and funding.
Municipalities are responsible for access to and the quality of debt assistance for their residents.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de toegang en de kwaliteit van de schuldhulpverlening aan hun inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘de afbraak van de sociale werkplaats’

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary about the dismantling of the sheltered employment system (sociale werkplaats), the slow rollout of sheltered jobs, the continuing efficiency cut per SW place, the Venlo municipality's practice, and the fate of people on the former Wsw waiting list. The State Secretary responded that existing Wsw rights are retained, banenafspraak and beschut werk numbers are rising, the efficiency cut was settled under the IBP, and municipalities are responsible for implementation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het aantal jonggehandicapten zonder uitkering snel stijgt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the rise in young disabled people with neither work nor benefits is caused by the Participation Act, and what municipalities and the government will do about it, including on the Wajong criteria and a legal right to support. The State Secretary disputed the causal link, pointed to positive employment figures and municipal support measures, and promised a further report and policy response in 2019.
This is not yet a report but an infographic analysing the position of Vso, Pro and Mbo-entry youths leaving education.
Het betreft hier nog geen rapport maar een infographic waarin de positie van Vso, Pro en Mbo-entree jongeren die het onderwijs verlaten, is geanalyseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een recordaantal mensen bij schuldhulpverlening

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the record number of people seeking debt assistance, the gap between households with problematic debts and those helped, the time to debt freedom after WSNP, and the sale of debts by ING to debt collectors. The State Secretary attributed the rise mainly to more people finding debt help, said there is no target for the share helped, gave a WSNP duration of just over three years, and declined to comment on ING's specific case while pointing to the broad debt approach and existing answers on debt sales.
I have no information about ING's specific situation. It is not for me to judge this case.
Over de specifieke situatie van ING heb ik geen informatie. Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Financiële administratie voor velen een worsteling’

MPs Bruins and Raemakers asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a Nibud study showing many people struggle with financial administration, especially due to automatic direct debits and digital post, and asked about measures on hidden direct debits, youth support, free paper post and the debt collection register. The State Secretary answered that the findings are concerning, pointed to Nibud recommendations, existing financial literacy initiatives, and said the scope of a debt collection register is still being investigated with a further letter to follow.
I am not aware of figures on how often these direct debits lead to payment problems, accumulation of (collection) costs and debt problems.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend over hoe vaak deze incasso's leiden tot betalingsproblemen, stapeling van (incasso)kosten en schuldenproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘het levenlanglerenkrediet voor Wajongers’

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a life-long learning credit that would stop Wajong benefits for disabled students, and asked for a faster fix so students can start in September 2018 without benefit cuts. The state secretary explained the credit affects Wajong2015 benefits but not oWajong, plans to correct it through the Verzamelwet SZW effective 1 January 2019, and declined to send a letter to all Wajongers as disproportionate.
I agree that it is desirable that Wajongers who want to start studying in September can use the planned changes as soon as possible.
Ik deel de mening dat het wenselijk is dat Wajongers die in september willen gaan studeren, zo snel mogelijk een beroep kunnen doen op de hiertoe voorgenomen wijzigingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Omtzigt over een gezin waarvan de vrouw werkt, de man permanent in een WLZ-instelling verblijft en de kinderen dus geen recht hebben op kinderopvangtoeslag omdat de man niet werk

MPs Peters and Omtzigt asked why a family where the father is permanently in a WLZ care facility and the mother works cannot get childcare allowance, and why statutory articles on social-medical indicators have never entered into force. The Secretary of State acknowledges the rule can be harsh, says she will examine a statutory exception and report this autumn, but declines to comment on individual cases and points to municipalities for SMI.
Unfortunately I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan helaas niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over stress veroorzakende klantbeoordelingssystemen

An MP asks the minister whether customer rating systems that pressure workers, feed personnel files and dismissal dossiers, and carry bias risks are acceptable, and whether the Inspectorate will investigate. The minister says the systems are not inherently unacceptable, that employers must manage privacy and workplace-stress risks, and that the Inspectorate supervises employers' policies generally rather than these systems specifically, while bias should be tackled directly.
The system itself does not lead to this behaviour.
Het systeem zelf leidt niet tot dit gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over asbestverwijdering door middel van “Minicontainment”

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the Minicontainment asbestos-removal method, reportedly used in residents' presence, is proven safe, whether it should be suspended, and whether independent research will be done. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate has no reason to doubt its safety when used correctly, that residents' exposure stays below the limit value, and that the method will not be suspended, while promising a broader policy response on the asbestos system.
For now, however, the Inspectorate has no reason to assume that doubts about safety are warranted when the method is used correctly.
Vooralsnog heeft de Inspectie evenwel geen reden om aan te nemen dat bij correct gebruik getwijfeld zou moeten worden aan de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Ouders draaien op voor hogere kosten in de kinderopvang» en het rapport «War for talent» ontspruit op de kinderopvang'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that tighter childcare staffing rules (BKR) would require at least 2,500 extra staff, raising costs for parents and risking reduced opening hours. The government answered that the sector has known of the stricter ratio since 2017, that parents are largely compensated through higher childcare allowances and maximum hourly rates, that recruitment and retraining are the sector's own responsibility, and that inspection by municipal GGD bodies will uphold minimum quality standards.
I am monitoring the development of the number of childcare hours offered in day care with the quarterly figures.
De ontwikkeling van het aantal aangeboden opvanguren in de dagopvang houd ik in de gaten met de kwartaalcijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Jasper van Dijk over "werken zonder loon in de vijf gemeenten in de Hoeksche Waard"

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether municipalities in the Hoeksche Waard may require welfare recipients to take part in unpaid work placements, whether this displaces paid jobs, and how the region performs on the jobs agreement and sheltered work. The State Secretary answered that the Dove trajectory is a work-experience step with supervision and a maximum of three months, not a tegenprestatie, that no unlawful coercion or underpayment is evident, that the municipality is responsible for preventing displacement within legal limits, and that the region is on track for its targets.
Based on the information from WIHW, I see no reason to assume that there is unlawful coercion or underpayment here.
Op basis van de informatie van WIHW zie ik geen reden om aan te nemen dat hier sprake is van ongeoorloofde dwang of onderbetaling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Algoritme voorspelt wie fraude pleegt bij bijstandsuitkering’

MPs Raemakers and Verhoeven asked whether municipalities use algorithms to detect welfare benefit fraud, which firms supply them, what data is used, and how discrimination and transparency are controlled. The state secretary answered that data-driven enforcement is supported within legal limits, that the algorithm may be withheld to protect detection methods, that data comes from municipal benefit records, and that a BZK study on government algorithms is expected in the second half of 2018.
In the interest of protecting the modus operandi for detecting fraud, the municipal executive may decide not to release the algorithm.
In het belang van het beschermen van de modus operandi om fraude op te sporen, kan door het college worden besloten het algoritme niet vrij te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de afhandeling van de asbestbrand in Wateringen

An MP asked the state secretaries about how the 2015 Wateringen asbestos fire was handled, including whether inventory reports were public, whether areas were properly cleared and re-checked, and whether inspection capacity is adequate. The government answered mostly by pointing to COT and Wob-disclosed documents, concluding that municipal measures were lawful and that inspection capacity appears sufficient, while committing to no new concrete action beyond noting the 2016 guidance update.
I will therefore not press for publication of these documents because the municipality has already made a consideration under the Wob request.
Ik zal derhalve niet aandringen op openbaarmaking van deze stukken omdat de gemeente in het kader van het Wob-verzoek al een afweging heeft gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht “VNO wil UWV-lijsten openbaar"

MPs Wiersma and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the minister and state secretary of Social Affairs about VNO-NCW's call to make UWV and municipal candidate lists public, and about the labour market mismatch. The government answered that it is working through regional matching programmes, data exchange between UWV and municipalities, extra funding for personal services, and a forthcoming follow-up letter, but did not commit to opening the lists.
We share your concern about mismatches on the labour market.
Wij delen uw zorg betreffende mismatches op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie door uitzendbureaus

An MP from DENK asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about discrimination by temp agencies, how it persists, whether the Labour Inspectorate can investigate more intensively and use unconventional methods such as test calls, and when an action plan will be sent. The government answers by referring to a letter sent in response to a motion from another MP, so the substantive questions are not answered in this document.

The written questions from MP Kuzu (DENK), question number 2018Z01649, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to the request from MP Özütok, made during the Regeling van werkzaamheden of 30 January 2018, on discrimination at temp agencies'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kuzu (DENK), vraagnummer 2018Z01649 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op het verzoek van het lid Özütok, gedaan tijdens de Regeling van werkzaamheden van 30 januari 2018, over discriminatie bij uitzendbureaus» (Kamerstuk 29 544, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Kindcentra krijgt 'extra punten' in Den Bosch’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the new admissions policy of a primary school foundation in Den Bosch, which gave extra points to children attending certain childcare centres, was acceptable and whether it creates unfair competition. The minister replied that the policy was adjusted after local debate, that schools may use priority criteria within legal limits, that complaints or court review are available, and that no further action is planned.
In the meantime I have understood that the proposed admissions policy in Den Bosch has been adjusted in response to the local debate.
Ondertussen heb ik begrepen dat het voorgestelde aanmeldbeleid in Den Bosch is aangepast als reactie op het lokale debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Peters over het bericht 'Kindcentra krijgt ‘extra punten’ in Den Bosch'

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister whether a school admission point system in Den Bosch, which favoured children in certain childcare centres, unduly restricted parental school choice and the level playing field for childcare providers. The minister replied that the policy had already been revised after local debate, that schools may use admission criteria if applied consistently and transparently, and that he saw no reason to instruct school boards further.
I see no reason to do so, see the answers to questions 2, 3 and 4.
Hier zie ik geen aanleiding toe, zie het antwoord op vragen 2, 3 en 4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over visueel gehandicapten die opeens een veel hogere bijdrage voor vervoer naar werk moeten betalen

An MP asked whether the state would soften the sharp jump in the employee contribution for work-commute transport for visually impaired workers once their income crosses a modal level, for example by phasing it in gradually. The state secretary declined, explaining that the contribution norm reflects average commuting costs and that UWV advises clients on cheaper alternatives instead.
Softening the income effects through a gradual increase of the employee contribution, as proposed, would mean introducing steps around the current generally customary norm.
Een verzachting van de inkomenseffecten via geleidelijke verhoging van de eigen bijdrage zoals voorgesteld, betekent dat stapjes rondom de huidige algemeen gebruikelijke norm worden geïntroduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Bruins, Ziengs, Van Aalst, Baudet en Von Martels over het gebruik van werkbakken aan hijskranen bij asbestsanering

MPs asked whether the government will allow cranes with work baskets for asbestos roof removal in exceptional cases, given a sector decision system and an Aboma report criticising stricter Dutch rules. The State Secretary said a независимый study will report before summer 2018 and that a decision on any regulatory change will follow, without committing to temporary relief now.
As promised to the House, I will commission an independent study into the problems the asbestos removal contractors describe.
Ik laat, zoals aan uw Kamer is toegezegd, een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitvoeren naar de problematiek die de asbestsaneerders aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Gehandicapten slachtoffer van ruziënde politiek en bedrijfsleven’

An SP MP asks the state secretary about Bollenstreek municipalities cutting wage-cost subsidies for disabled workers from 40 to 25.5 hours, questioning its legality, retroactivity, and the democratic legitimacy of the joint social service (ISD). The state secretary answers that hours are a matter for employer and employee, that municipalities cannot exclude subsidy-eligible persons, that the measure applies only to new contracts in 2018, and that the ISD acts under municipal ordinances, which he expects will be amended.
I will inform the aldermen of the municipalities concerned of my position.
Ik zal de wethouders van de betrokken gemeenten over mijn standpunt informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over “Aantallen beschut werkplekken per gemeente 2018 en 2019”

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs how municipal sheltered-work place allocations for 2018 and 2019 were calculated, why some municipalities receive zero places, and whether the list could be adjusted. The state secretary explained the allocation method, admitted the budget exceeds the place numbers due to a phased schedule, and committed to examine adjusting the list from 2019 so every municipality has at least one place.
I am willing to examine how this can be adjusted from 2019 onwards.
Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken hoe dit met ingang van 2019 aangepast kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de toegang tot de WSNP voor private schuldhulpverleners

An MP asked why courts declare WSNP debt-restructuring applications inadmissible when filed by private debt-assistance organisations, and about the resulting harm to debtors and municipalities. The State Secretary confirmed the courts' reading, citing the Hoge Raad ruling and the rule that debt mediation must be carried out by the municipality or listed persons, and promised consultation with VNG and NVVK with an update to parliament within months.
In that case, a request for admission to debt rescheduling is declared inadmissible, because the requirements of the Bankruptcy Act in conjunction with the Wck have not been met.
Een verzoek tot toelating tot de schuldsanering wordt in dat geval niet-ontvankelijk verklaard, omdat niet aan de vereisten uit de Faillissementswet in samenhang met de Wck is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Özdil over het bericht ‘Callgirl voor Albert Heijn’

MPs Özütok and Özdil asked the minister whether reported practices at Albert Heijn distribution centres, including intimidation, unpaid on-call work and unworkable rosters, amount to labour exploitation, whether working conditions are safe and the Inspectorate monitors them, and whether OTTO's wage deductions and the WAADI are breached. The minister answered that the article does not show labour exploitation, that the Inspectorate handles complaints and no recent relevant complaints are known, that deductions are unclear but housing deductions are capped by law, and that no enforcement action or new commitment is announced.
There are no known recent reports relating to the situation described in the article.
Er zijn geen recente meldingen bekend die betrekking hebben op de in het artikel genoemde situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over jongeren in de Participatiewet

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary why the number of benefit recipients under 27 has not fallen despite the strong economy, and about youth with temporary incapacity, employability, and volunteer-work allowances. The secretary answered that the group has stabilised rather than fallen, explained the pathways for youth, and said data on training and volunteering are not kept nationally, while noting municipalities hold primary responsibility and commitments to monitoring and to a new statistics round.
Support for young people on social assistance is the responsibility of the municipalities.
De ondersteuning van jongeren in de bijstand is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep inzake de bestrijding door gemeenten van bijstandsfraude door vermogende Turkse Nederlanders

An MP asks the state secretary whether the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that targeting welfare-fraud checks at Turkish-origin beneficiaries is discriminatory undermines municipal fraud enforcement and whether Dutch-nationality beneficiaries face unequal treatment. The secretary answers that municipalities may still investigate foreign assets and use risk profiles based on country of origin, but not on a single nationality, and promises to inform municipalities and improve cooperation with the IBF.
Selecting beneficiaries on the basis of country of origin alone is contrary to the non-discrimination prohibition laid down in Article 14 ECHR and Article 1 of Protocol 12 to the ECHR.

Het maken van een selectie van belanghebbenden op basis van het land van herkomst, als enkele feit, is in strijd is met het discriminatieverbod zoals neergelegd in artikel 14 EVRM en artikel 1 van Protocol 12 bij het EVRM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘De Volkswagens zijn nog altijd veel te vies’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary whether the Volkswagen diesel software update really brings emissions into compliance, given press reports that cars remain far above the norm on the road, and whether the RDW omitted odd results. The government answered that the German approval authority judges the update compliant, emissions fall slightly, and it will commission TNO tests on a Polo before and after the update, with results promised to parliament.
To nevertheless gain more insight into the effects of the software update, I will have a Volkswagen Polo examined, both before and after the software update.
Om toch nog meer inzicht in de effecten van de software-update te vergaren zal ik een Volkswagen Polo laten onderzoeken, zowel voor als na de software-update.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Gemeenten: laat ons discrimineren op leeftijd'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary about municipalities wanting exemption from the ban on age-based rejection of applicants, the legal basis for youth-unemployment age measures, generatiepact limits, and preferential hiring rules. The state secretary answered that age distinctions were permitted only under a legally anchored labour-market policy, that municipalities could target the 18-27 age group in vacancy texts until 1 January 2018, and that the government would invest in attracting young employees.
Selecting on age is, however, as I already indicated in my answer to question 2, only possible where there is statutorily anchored employment or labour-market policy.
Selecteren op leeftijd is evenwel, zoals ik reeds heb aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 – alleen mogelijk als sprake is van wettelijk verankerd werkgelegenheids- of arbeidsmarktbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Vertrouwenspersonen #metoo-slachtoffers gedwarsboomd door werkgevers'

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that employers obstruct workplace confidential advisers (vertrouwenspersonen) supporting #metoo victims, and how the government will strengthen their position. The State Secretary called the figures worrying, stressed adviser independence under the Arbowet, and pointed to a forthcoming study and policy response before summer.
A confidential adviser must indeed be sufficiently independent to be able to support victims of unwanted behaviour in confidence.
Een vertrouwenspersoon moet immers in voldoende mate onafhankelijk zijn om in vertrouwen slachtoffers van ongewenst gedrag bij te kunnen staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over kloksystemen op basis van vingerafdrukken

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked whether employers may require employees to give fingerprints for clock systems, whether unpaid hours for refusers is unlawful, and whether private collection of fingerprints is acceptable. The state secretary answered that under the GDPR and the UAVG, biometric fingerprint processing is allowed only for authentication or security purposes, that refusers must be offered an alternative, and that the Data Protection Authority and courts assess specific cases.
In any case, the regulation in the GDPR and UAVG precludes using an employee's fingerprints for purposes other than authentication and security purposes.
In ieder geval verzet de regeling in de AVG en UAVG zich tegen het gebruiken van vingerafdrukken van een werknemer voor andere doelen dan authenticatie en beveiligingsdoeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat de burgemeesters van de grote steden een verbod willen op knalvuurwerk en vuurpijlen

An MP asked the government whether it would act on the OVV report on New Year's fireworks and on the mayors' call for a national ban on rockets and banger fireworks, and whether it would tighten protection of emergency workers. The state secretary answered that a national approach is being prepared with partners, that the mayors' call will be considered, that a ban requires time and consultation, and that a letter on the approach is expected by end of March.
Currently I am working together with the Minister of Justice and Security and our partners on a national approach to the New Year's problem.
Momenteel werk ik samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid en onze partners aan een landelijke aanpak van de jaarwisselingsproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over “schijnconstructies en het ontduiken van de CAO bij sociale werkvoorzieningen”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about disguised employment constructions in sheltered workshops (sociale werkvoorzieningen) that may circumvent the CAO, including whether he had misinformed parliament about Alescon and Werkzaak Rivierenland. The State Secretary said Alescon was the only known case, that SZW lacks an overview of similar constructions since implementation is decentralised to municipalities and social partners, and that he sees no reason for an independent investigation.
The Ministry of SZW does not currently have the requested overview.
Het Ministerie van SZW beschikt op dit moment niet over het gevraagde overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over compensatieregeling zwangere ZZP’ers

An MP asked the state secretary about a Facebook group of self-employed women waiting for a pregnancy compensation scheme, when the promised ministerial regulation would be published, why it was delayed, how the target group would be informed, and where funds were budgeted. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the delay due to feasibility checks and payment timing in 2019, announced publication in March 2018 with an application window to 1 October 2018, described UWV-led communication, and stated a 38 million euro reservation in the 2018 budget.
My aim is to publish the regulation in the Staatscourant in March and to have it take effect on 15 May 2018.
Mijn streven is om de regeling in maart te publiceren in de Staatscourant en in werking te laten treden op 15 mei 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Rijkswaterstaat deelde vertrouwelijke informatie van 'weggepeste' vuurtorenwachter met haar collega's’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reports that Rijkswaterstaat shared confidential, medical information about a lighthouse keeper allegedly bullied by colleagues, and about the independence of the investigating body, the role of the Labour Inspectorate, and measures against workplace bullying. The minister answered that the report was wrongly shared and excuses were given, defended ECO&P's independence, explained the Inspectorate's existing role, and described general prevention efforts and ongoing studies.
That the data on the health condition of the person concerned became known in this way should not have happened.
Dat de gegevens over de gezondheidstoestand van betrokkene hierbij bekend zijn geworden, had niet mogen gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Özütok over “de oproep van een toxicoloog dat werknemers van Custom Powders moeten worden getest op omstreden stof GenX”

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether Custom Powders employees exposed to GenX should be tested, and whether the labour inspectorate had engaged the company. The State Secretary answered that exposure assessment and any blood testing are the employer's responsibility under the Working Conditions Act, that the inspectorate visits such firms on a risk basis without discussing individual inspection results, and that it sees no reason to raise blood testing with the employer.
I will not go into the results of individual inspections.
Ik ga niet in op resultaten van individuele inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Gemeenten negeren wettelijke taaleis bijstand’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister and state secretary about a report that municipalities ignore the statutory language requirement for welfare recipients, and how this fits with plans to give municipalities a bigger role in integration. The government acknowledged the CBS findings, said municipalities must enforce the law, committed to talks with the VNG, and noted that ultimate sanctions against municipalities are possible.
It is unacceptable if it were to turn out that people who do not speak the language receive a welfare benefit for years and are left alone.
Het is onacceptabel als zou blijken dat mensen die de taal niet spreken jarenlang een bijstandsuitkering ontvangen en met rust gelaten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de toenemende langdurige armoede in Nederland
