An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about rising long-term poverty, the vulnerability of the 55+ group, the effects of the Participatiewet on income protection, and the link between the minimum income and municipal policy. The government answered that poverty is a priority, that the sociaal minimum is adequate for basic needs, that work is the way out of poverty, and that it will consult municipalities to reduce the poverty trap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over het bericht dat energiebedrijven experimenteren met prepaid energie

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked whether prepaid energy pilots that bypass disconnection protections are acceptable and whether the minister would ban them. The minister replied that the voluntary pilots are small, that existing disconnection rules still apply, that no ministerial permission was required, and that the ACM and a broader debt-relief approach will be relied on.
No permission was requested or obtained.
Er is geen toestemming gevraagd of gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over onderdelen in de Arbeidstijdenrichtlijn die niet in overeenstemming zijn met het verslag van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the Dutch Working Time Act conflicts with the EU Working Time Directive and the Commission's implementation report, in particular the 16-week reference period for night work and the absence of special protection categories. The State Secretary disagreed with the Commission on the reference period, citing SER advice and a 2012 evaluation, and declined to amend the law for either point.
I do not share the European Commission's view.
Ik deel die mening van de Europese Commissie niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over belabberde kolfruimtes

An MP asked the state secretary about inadequate breastfeeding (milk-expression) rooms at work, whether this amounts to pregnancy discrimination, and what is being done to inform employers and women. The state secretary answered that employers have a legal duty to provide a suitable room, that discrimination is unacceptable and an anti-discrimination action plan covers it, and that information was spread via social media and the Arboportaal website.
Employers have a legal duty to have or make available a suitable milk-expression room.
Het is een wettelijke plicht voor de werkgever om een geschikte kolfruimte beschikbaar te hebben of beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Koopmans over "het artikel ‘gemeente Tilburg mag niet specifiek speuren naar Turkse bijstandfraudeurs’"

MPs Nijkerken-de Haan and Koopmans asked whether municipalities may screen welfare recipients by country of origin and pursue foreign assets after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling found Tilburg's targeting of Turkish benefit fraudsters discriminatory. The State Secretary answered that selecting on country of origin alone violates the non-discrimination rule, that municipalities should work with the IBF on cross-border fraud, and that he will promote IBF cooperation and guidance for municipalities.

The consequence of the CRvB ruling is that selecting on the basis of country of origin, as the sole factor, is contrary to the non-discrimination prohibition laid down in Article 14 ECHR and Article 1 of Protocol 12 to the ECHR.

De consequentie van de uitspraak van de CRvB is dat selecteren op basis van land van herkomst, als enkele feit, in strijd is met het discriminatieverbod zoals neergelegd in artikel 14 EVRM en artikel 1 van Protocol 12 bij het EVRM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Kinderopvang kampt met personeelstekort'

The SP MP Kwint asked the state secretary how the childcare sector will be helped to recruit enough qualified staff, given the staff shortage linked to the stricter staff-child ratio, the stalled collective bargaining, and whether employers' stance and fixed contracts could ease the problem. The state secretary answered that the sector itself must secure staffing, that the stricter ratio for infants takes effect in 2019 with a looser rule for after-school care, that bargaining is for the social partners, and that the government wants more permanent jobs but leaves this to the sector.
It is up to the sector itself to ensure that enough qualified staff are recruited.
Het is aan de sector zelf om te borgen dat er voldoende kwalitatief personeel wordt aangetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat arbeidsbeperkten geen werk vinden

An SP MP asks the state secretary about reports that many people with work disabilities, including those on the former Wsw waiting list, have not found jobs, and questions the effectiveness of disability employment policy, Wajong cuts, loonkostensubsidie abolition and temporary contracts. The secretary disputes the framing, cites rising employment and support figures, and promises a memo on replacing loonkostensubsidie with loondispensatie and repairing the levenlanglerenkrediet effect.
I therefore intend to repair this unintended effect in the Verzamelwet SZW.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om dit onbedoelde effect in de Verzamelwet SZW te repareren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "discriminatie door uitzendbureaus"

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the government whether it considers it unacceptable that employment agencies take part in discrimination, whether penalties and public naming of offending agencies are possible, and whether the Team Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie's powers should be extended. The state secretary condemns discrimination, points to the planned follow-up action plan and talks with the staffing sector, but defers the answers on penalties, naming, powers and enforcement to a letter to parliament.
I will answer questions 3 through 9 together in the letter that the House of Representatives has requested.
De vragen 3 t/m 9 zal ik in samenhang beantwoorden in de brief die de Tweede Kamer heeft gevraagd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman en Van Kent over het bericht dat de bouw zich niets aantrekt van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether the construction sector ignores recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) and how recurring recommendations on coordination, responsibility, safety awareness and risk assessment will be implemented. The minister acknowledges the problem, lists steps taken (guidelines, a Kwaliteitsborging bill, Arbeidsomstandighedenbesluit changes, a study on a central party for site safety) and commits to further follow-up, though some recommendations remain unaddressed.
It is currently being examined how a single central party can be made responsible for safeguarding site safety at construction sites.
Er wordt momenteel nagegaan hoe één centrale partij verantwoordelijk kan worden gemaakt voor de borging van de omgevingsveiligheid bij bouwplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Incasso-oplichting blijft ongemoeid’

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked how debt collectors could wrongly charge debtors up to 500 euro in collection costs for years, and why the OM, curator and BFT had not acted. Minister Dekker answered that the BFT investigated, sought suspension and filed a disciplinary complaint, the chamber struck the bailiffs off in March 2017, and the OM is now handling a criminal complaint and will give extra attention to such cases in 2018.
The BFT did however intervene, as the answers below also show.
Het BFT heeft echter wel degelijk ingegrepen, zoals ook uit onderstaande antwoorden blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de werkdruk bij buschauffeurs

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about bus drivers lacking time for toilet and lunch breaks due to work pressure, and whether tendering by provinces and transport regions contributes to it. The State Secretary answered that employers are primarily responsible for working conditions and breaks, that CAO parties can address breaks, that the Labour Inspectorate can investigate reported violations, and that she sees no reason to consult other ministers on tendering policy.
Under the Working Conditions Act, the employer has primary responsibility for ensuring good working conditions.
Volgens de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet is het de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van de werkgever om voor goede arbeidsomstandigheden te zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gijs van Dijk over het rekruteren van arbeidsgehandicapten voor sekswerk

MPs Jasper and Gijs van Dijk asked why 2016 questions about the website werkenmetwajong.nl, which recruits Wajong beneficiaries with disabilities for sex work, were never answered, and asked what was done to prevent abuse and where complaints can be filed. The State Secretary says the earlier questions were not answered by agreement with the MPs to avoid drawing more attention to the site, now answers them, and says he knows of no complaints, directing people to UWV and private complaint platforms.
My predecessor, in consultation with the questioners, decided not to answer the parliamentary questions.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft in overleg met de vragenstellers besloten de Kamervragen niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Jasper van Dijk over het afsluiten van gas, water en licht

Two SP MPs asked whether households failing to pay energy bills will be cut off less quickly now that suppliers must first refer them to debt assistance, and how that works, plus questions on water cut-offs, health risks and a similar water rule. The minister confirmed the referral duty, described the winter-period procedure, said a summer extension is planned, and committed to amending the water cut-off regulation with the VNG and Vewin.
I am willing to draw up a similar kind of regulation.
Ik ben bereid eenzelfde soort regeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Polen blijven weg: tuinbouwsector zit omhoog’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the horticulture sector's shift toward recruiting non-Polish workers and the labour-market reach of unemployed people reflects a growing problem, and what steps would make Dutch jobs attractive. The minister acknowledged the trend, placed primary responsibility for recruitment on employers, and described the government's role as preventing unfair competition and abuse through equal pay rules and anti-schijnconstructie legislation.
In this dossier I see my role mainly in preventing unfair competition and tackling abuses such as underpayment and exploitation.
In dit dossier zie ik mijn rol vooral in het voorkomen van oneerlijke concurrentie en het aanpakken van misstanden zoals onderbetaling en uitbuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht  "Minder loon in werkplaats nieuwe stijl’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that wages fall for workers in new-style sheltered workplaces, including the 130% minimum wage cap with pension for old Wsw workers, loon dispensation, Wajong cuts, and pension accrual. The State Secretary answers that employment terms are set by employers and social partners, that the Wsw was closed to new entrants in 2015, that a new wage supplement for loon dispensation will ensure people earn more than social minimum, and that municipalities are responsible for organising referral to work.
It is up to municipalities to decide how they organise the referral of people to work and what role the existing Sw companies play in this.
Het is aan gemeenten om te bepalen hoe zij de toeleiding van mensen naar werk organiseren en welke rol de bestaande Sw-bedrijven daarin hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de bezuiniging op mensen met een handicap

MP Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the state secretary whether the coalition's replacement of wage-cost subsidies with wage-dispensation for disabled workers, reported as a 500 million euro cut, should be scrapped and whether it is budget-driven. The state secretary denied it is a cut, described it as reallocation of funds, and stated that new employees will earn above the social minimum and that the regulation will be detailed later.
There is no question of a cut but of a reallocation of funds for people with work disabilities.
Er is geen sprake van een bezuiniging maar van herallocatie van middelen voor mensen met arbeidsbeperkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat gemeenten zich verzetten tegen het besluit om gehandicapten onder het minimumloon te laten werken

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary about reports that municipalities oppose the plan to let disabled workers earn below minimum wage, and whether this amounts to a 500 million euro cut, pensions, and lost motivation. The State Secretary denies a cut, says loonkostensubsidie will be replaced by loondispensatie with municipalities topping up income to minimum wage pro rata, applies only to new employment relations, and refuses to withdraw the plan while promising consultation.
I am not willing to withdraw this plan from the coalition agreement.
Ik ben niet bereid dit plan uit het Regeerakkoord in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het afwijzen van een uitkering aan zwaar zieke jonge mensen in hun laatste levensjaren

An SP MP asked why a seriously ill young woman with a progressive lung disease was refused a Wajong benefit and why there is no more humane approach to terminally ill people seeking benefits. The state secretary declined to comment on the individual case, explained the Wajong and WIA assessment rules, pointed to municipal support under the Participatiewet, and described the review and appeal procedures without agreeing to create a new independent commission.
I cannot go into an individual case, but I will explain the policy regarding the Wajong assessment.
Ik kan niet ingaan op een individuele casus, maar zal wel het beleid ten aanzien van de Wajong beoordeling toelichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over ‘toiletrestricties’ voor beveiligers op Schiphol

An MP asked the State Secretary whether toilet restrictions imposed on Schiphol security guards by contractors, in which the state is a shareholder, are acceptable and whether the labour inspectorate and Schiphol as client should act. The State Secretary answered that employees must be allowed to use the toilet when needed, that the employer is primarily responsible, that complaints can go to the Inspectorate, and that Schiphol is free to agree conduct rules with contractors but is not obliged to.
In the first instance it is up to the collective labour agreement parties to hold each other to agreements made and to raise any bottlenecks.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de cao-partijen om elkaar aan te spreken op gemaakte afspraken en eventuele knelpunten aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht «Bijstandsproef is nep experiment»

MP Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary about reports that Amsterdam is loosening welfare rules outside the national experiment and whether it is in conflict with the ministry over the tegenprestatie. The answer refers the MP to an earlier letter (Kamerstuk 34 352, nr. 75) about the Amsterdam request, without answering the questions in substance.

The written questions from MP Peters (CDA), question number 2017Z15014, have been answered by means of the letter 'Reaction to the request from MP Nijkerken-De Haan, made during the Regeling van Werkzaamheden of 8 November 2017, on an experiment with looser welfare rules in Amsterdam'.

Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Peters (CDA), vraagnummer 2017Z15014 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op het verzoek van het lid Nijkerken-De Haan, gedaan tijdens de Regeling van Werkzaamheden van 8 november 2017, over een experiment met soepelere bijstandsregels in Amsterdam» (Kamerstuk 34 352, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Voortman over zwerfjongeren

MPs Westerveld and Voortman asked about the rising number of young homeless people (zwerfjongeren), including estimates, possible causes such as the kostendelersnorm and the youth-to-adult care transition, and plans to prevent further growth. The government state secretary disputes the cited figure (citing CBS's 12,400 for 2016), says it is studying the trends, sees no need to change the kostendelersnorm or conduct new research now, and points to ongoing trajectories with results due in early 2018.
This study will be completed at the beginning of 2018.
Dit onderzoek zal begin 2018 worden afgerond.

m: Motie Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over schrappen van de eenlocatie-eis
Asks the government to scrap the single-location requirement for childminders by the end of 2010 so they can offer care at multiple addresses.
requests the government to scrap the single-location requirement as soon as possible and by end 2010
verzoekt de regering zo snel mogelijk, en in ieder geval voor het einde van 2010, de eenlocatie-eis te schrappen
Motie Van Toorenburg/Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink over geen extra financiële middelen voor de inspectie van gastouders door de VNG en GGD Nederland
Expresses the preference that no extra funds be provided for inspecting childminders by VNG and GGD, and that inspection be prioritised within existing budgets.
expresses as its preference that no extra financial means be made available for the inspection of childminders
spreekt als haar voorkeur uit dat er geen extra financiële middelen beschikbaar worden gesteld voor de inspectie van gastouders
Motie Dezentjé Hamming-BLuemink over herziening van de diplomalijst
Asks the government to revise the list of qualifying diplomas for childminders so that relevant training for childcare work is included.
requests the government to revise the diploma list so that all relevant training for working in childcare is included in the list
verzoekt de regering de diplomalijst te herzien zodat alle relevante opleidingen voor het werken in de kinderopvang in de lijst worden meegenomen
Motie Van Gent c.s. over schrappen van de terugbetalingsplicht
Asks the government to waive the repayment obligation for childcare benefit for 2010 unless fraud or abuse is involved.
requests the government to scrap the repayment obligation for the year 2010 unless there is fraud or abuse
verzoekt de regering voor het jaar 2010 de terugbetalingsplicht te schrappen tenzij er sprake is van fraude of misbruik
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over toetsing vooraf op deugdelijkheid

Amendment requires that new schools prove beforehand, to the minister's satisfaction, that they will meet quality requirements (school plan, teacher competence, instruction time) before being placed on the funding plan.
An institution will have to demonstrate to the minister's satisfaction that these soundness requirements are met.
Een instelling zal ten genoegen van de minister moeten aantonen dat wordt voldaan aan die deugdelijkheidseisen.
Amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over toetsing vooraf op deugdelijkheid
Amendment requires that a new school prove, to the satisfaction of the inspectorate, that it can meet quality requirements (school plan, teacher competence, instruction time) before it can be funded.
An institution will have to demonstrate to the satisfaction of the inspectorate that those quality requirements are met.
Een instelling zal ten genoegen van de inspectie moeten aantonen dat wordt voldaan aan die deugdelijkheidseisen.
Amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink over het verplicht stellen van een VOG voor eenieder die in de kinderopvang werkzaam is
Requires a certificate of good conduct (VOG) for all volunteers working in childcare.
The submitter is of the view that every volunteer working in childcare must be able to submit a certificate of good conduct.
De indiener is van mening dat elke vrijwilliger die in de kinderopvang werkzaam is een verklaring omtrent het gedrag moet kunnen overleggen.
Motie Van Toorenburg en Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink over betrokkenheid van ouders bij vve-programma's
Asks the government to ensure only early-childhood programmes that include parental involvement are offered to children with language delays.
requests the government to promote that only vve programmes including parental involvement are offered to children with a language delay
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat alleen vve-programma’s waarin ouderbetrokkenheid is opgenomen, worden aangeboden aan kinderen met een taalachterstand
Motie Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over schrappen van de éénlocatie-beperking
Asks the government to drop the one-location restriction for child-minders and adjust GGD inspection accordingly.
requests the government to remove the one-location restriction from the regulations
verzoekt de regering de één-locatiebeperking uit de regelgeving te schrappen
Motie Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink/Bosma over de geschatte meerkosten voor opleiding
Asks the government to report to the House on the estimated extra costs of training childminders and how they will be covered in the budget.
requests the government to report to the House by 15 December 2009 what the estimated extra costs will be
verzoekt de regering voor 15 december 2009 aan de Kamer te rapporteren wat de geschatte meerkosten zullen zijn
Motie van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over schrappen van de terugbetalingsplicht voor vraagouders
Asks the government to scrap the obligation for parents using childcare-by-host arrangements to repay childcare allowance if the host does not meet quality requirements by 2011.
requests the government to remove the repayment obligation for parents from the scheme
verzoekt de regering de terugbetalingsplicht voor vraagouders uit de regeling te schrappen
Motie Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over uitstel van invoering van regelgeving
Asks the government to postpone by one year the introduction of new childcare host (gastouder) regulations due to uncertainty.
requests the government to pause and postpone the intended introduction of regulations by one year
verzoekt de regering pas op de plaats te maken en de beoogde invoering van regelgeving met een jaar uit te stellen
Motie Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over ongedaan maken van de bezuiniging op het basisonderwijs
Asks the government to investigate how subsidy schemes could be redirected to reverse the cut in primary education funding.
requests the government to investigate how money can be freed up within the many subsidy schemes to reverse the cut in primary education
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe binnen de vele subsidieregelingen geld kan worden vrijgespeeld om de bezuiniging in het basisonderwijs ongedaan te maken
Motie-Dijsselbloem c.s. over een verkenning naar de toekomst van de jeugdzorg
Asks the Presidium to have the committee propose a parliamentary working group to explore the future of youth care before the spring 2010 policy debate.
requests the Presidium to instruct the committee for Youth and Family to propose as soon as possible the design and form of an exploration of the future of youth care
verzoekt het Presidium de algemene commissie voor Jeugd en Gezin op te dragen, zo spoedig mogelijk voorstellen te doen over de opzet en de vorm van een verkenning naar de toekomst van de jeugdzorg
Motie-Dezentjé Hamming Bluemink/Agema over beëindigen van het gedoogbeleid voor drugs in jeugdzorginstellingen
Asks the government to end the tolerance policy for drug use within youth care institutions.
requests the government to stop the tolerance policy within youth care institutions.
verzoek de regering het gedoogbeleid binnen jeugdzorginstellingen te stoppen
Motie-Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink over reorganisatie van de crisisopvang
Asks the government to end the practice of holding children in police cells for crisis shelter and to propose reorganizing crisis shelter to the House.
requests the government to end as soon as possible the situation in which children are placed in police cells for crisis shelter
verzoekt de regering zo snel mogelijk een einde te maken aan de situatie waarin kinderen in politiecellen worden gestopt voor crisisopvang
Motie Van Gent c.s. over laten voortbestaan van het recht op kinderopvangtoeslag bij aantoonbare verwerving van de deskundigheidseisen
Asks the government to let childcare allowance rights for parents continue until 1 January 2011 when their childminder is demonstrably working toward the qualification requirements.
requests the government to let the right to childcare allowance for parents continue unchanged until 1 January 2011
verzoekt de regering het recht op kinderopvangtoeslag voor vraagouders tot 1 januari 2011 onverkort te laten voortbestaan
Motie Van Gent c.s. over automatisch voldoen aan de eisen ingevolge het EVC-traject met een EHBO-diploma
Asks the government to ensure childminders with a first-aid diploma and relevant knowledge automatically meet the requirements of the EVC recognition track.
requests the government to ensure that childminders with a first-aid diploma and demonstrable knowledge of safety, hygiene and child abuse automatically meet the requirements set in the EVC track

verzoekt de regering erop toe te zien dat gastouders die een EHBO-diploma hebben en aantoonbare kennis omtrent veiligheid, hygiëne en kindermishandeling, automatisch voldoen aan de eisen die worden gesteld in het EVC-traject

Gewijzigd Amendement van de leden Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink en Jasper van Dijk ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 17 over het bevorderen van de integratie van minderheden als voorwaarde voor bek
Makes promoting the integration of minorities and respect for the Dutch legal order an explicit requirement for funding of primary, special and secondary education.
does not hinder the integration of minorities and explicitly proceeds from the Dutch legal order.
belemmert niet de integratie van minderheden en gaat nadrukkelijk uit van de Nederlandse rechtsorde.
Amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink over een aanwijzingsbevoegdheid van de minister bij onvoldoende leerresultaten
Gives the minister power to issue binding instructions to school boards when learning results are insufficient, not only for financial or regulatory mismanagement.
This amendment provides that the minister has an instruction power when there are insufficient learning results.
Dit amendement regelt dat de minister een aanwijzingsbevoegdheid heeft wanneer sprake is van onvoldoende leerresultaten.
Amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink over het bevorderen van de integratie van minderheden als voorwaarde voor bekostiging
Adds integration of minorities as an explicit condition for government funding of primary, special and secondary education schools.
The submitter wants promoting integration of minorities to also become a condition for funding.
De indiener van dit amendement wil dat het bevorderen van de integratie van minderheden ook een voorwaarde voor bekostiging wordt.
Amendement van de leden Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink en Jasper van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 15 over een aanwijzingsbevoegdheid van de minister bij onvoldoende leerresultaten
Adds a ministerial instruction power over schools where learning outcomes are insufficient, not only for financial or regulatory mismanagement.
This amendment provides that the minister has an instruction power when there are insufficient learning outcomes.
Dit amendement regelt dat de minister een aanwijzingsbevoegdheid heeft wanneer sprake is van onvoldoende leerresultaten.
Amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink over het voorkomen dat zwakke scholen die onder verscherpt toezicht staan nieuwe scholen kunnen oprichten
Bars school boards of weak or very weak schools under intensified supervision from founding or receiving funding for new schools while their pupils' results remain insufficient.
This amendment ensures that boards of weak schools under intensified supervision can no longer found new schools.
Met dit amendement wordt bewerkstelligd dat besturen van zwakke scholen die onder verscherpt toezicht staan, geen nieuwe scholen meer kunnen oprichten.
Amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink over een organieke in plaats van een functionele scheiding van intern toezicht en bestuur
Replaces the functional separation of internal supervision and management in school governance with an organic separation.
This amendment brings about an organic rather than a functional separation of internal supervision and management.
Dit amendement bewerkstelligt een organieke in plaats van een functionele scheiding van intern toezicht en bestuur.
Motie van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink over onderzoek bij gemeenten naar de behoefte aan registratie van etniciteit
Motion asks the government to investigate whether municipalities want to register ethnicity in youth risk management.
requests the government to investigate whether there is a need among municipalities to register ethnicity
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of er bij de gemeenten behoefte bestaat om etniciteit te registreren
Motie-Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink over herformulering van het doel van de verwijsindex
Asks the government, after consulting professionals, to reformulate the purpose of the referral index so it is clear which young people it targets.
requests the government, after consultation with professionals, to reformulate the purpose of the referral index
verzoekt de regering na overleg met de professionals het doel van de verwijsindex zo te herformuleren
Amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink waarin wordt geregeld dat de risico’s op basis waarvan een melding plaatsvindt eenduidig, meetbaar en te herleiden moeten zijn
Narrows the risk criteria for referring young people to the youth referral index by making them clear and measurable, dropping vague grounds and requiring reports via the child abuse reporting point.
The risks on the basis of which a report is made must be unambiguous, measurable and traceable.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Ontslagen bij de Zeeuwse politie na grensoverschrijdend gedrag’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of discriminatory and boundary-crossing conduct by Zeeland police officers, including whether supervisors were aware and why two officers received conditional dismissal and were reassigned to armed posts. The minister answered that leadership acted once the conduct surfaced, supervisors were not involved, and the officers' conditional dismissal, probation and supervision were considered sufficient safeguards.
Based on the investigation, it appeared that supervisors were not part of this boundary-crossing conduct and were also not aware of it.
Op basis van het onderzoek is gebleken dat leidinggevenden geen onderdeel waren van dit grensoverschrijdende gedrag en hiervan ook niet op de hoogte waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Man overleed nadat de politie hem taserde, Rijksrecherche doet onderzoek’

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a man who died after police used a taser, with questions on taser safety, handling of people with confused behaviour, family information, and the justification for force and the 2023 incident. The minister expressed sympathy, said the Rijksrecherche is investigating under the Openbaar Ministerie and declined to comment on the case while the investigation runs, while defending taser use as de-escalating and pointing to ongoing health monitoring and a planned evaluation of force instruments by 2025.
Because the investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about it.
Omdat het onderzoek nog loopt, kan ik hier geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht 'Omstreden moskee-infiltrant gaat bij politie aan de slag met discriminatie en uitsluiting: 'Zorgwekkend''

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that a controversial mosque infiltrator was hired by the police as programme manager for racism and discrimination, and whether this appointment is appropriate and should be reversed. The minister answered that the police leadership judged the hire acceptable, that the person's work as external project leader is valued, and that appointments are the police's responsibility, so the minister does not intervene in individual cases.
It is not for me to intervene in individual cases.
Het is daarbij niet aan mij om te treden in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de Zuidas die meebeslist over docenten en inhoud van het universitair onderwijs over direct belastingen.

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about sponsorship of indirect tax education at four universities by Zuidas law firms and the Tax Authority, including funding, accreditation, quality, professors tied to PwC, and commercial influence on higher education. The minister answered that the cooperation dates from 2008, sponsorship totals about 128,750 to 135,000 euros per year plus secondment, programmes are accredited, universities will tighten contract transparency, and no separate investigation is needed beyond the upcoming external accreditation visitations.
Additional investigation beyond this assessment within the external accreditation is therefore not considered necessary at this moment.
Extra onderzoek naast deze beoordeling in het kader van de externe accreditatie acht ik daarom op dit moment niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Azarkan en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht over het algoritmeregister

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Azarkan asked about an NOS report that the government's algorithm register offers little insight into algorithms and decision rules, and whether it will be expanded or evaluated. The State Secretary answers that the register is still being developed, that 123 algorithms are registered with only some fields complete, that government bodies are encouraged to publish, and that the aim is full coverage of high-risk AI by 2025, with a link to the upcoming EU AI Act registration duty.
It is important for transparency that all relevant algorithms are published by government bodies.
Het is voor de transparantie van belang dat alle relevante algoritmen gepubliceerd worden door overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over discriminatie van moslims door banken

Azarkan asks the Finance Minister about reported discrimination of Muslims by banks under anti-money-laundering rules, including reports to a complaints point, account refusals, extra questioning based on names or purchases, and whether the Wwft is too strict. The minister responds that discrimination is unacceptable, that DNB will examine whether banks control discrimination risks, and that an investigation into discriminatory elements will be announced in an autumn report, while largely defending the risk-based Wwft framework.
To get more clarity following the signals, I want to investigate the presence of discriminatory elements in the approach to money laundering, terrorist financing and fraud.
Om naar aanleiding van de signalen meer duidelijkheid te krijgen, wil ik de aanwezigheid van discriminerende elementen in de aanpak van witwassen, financieren van terrorisme en fraude onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht dat ‘de overheid de gegevens van vliegpassagiers verzamelt’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the government collects airline passenger data beyond what the CJEU and the Data Protection Authority consider necessary. The Minister acknowledges the CJEU ruling, describes the data collected and retention periods, and commits to reducing the general retention period from five to three years and adding independent review and filtering measures.

In addition to the existing privacy safeguards, this year I will still make a number of adjustments to the processing of passenger data, in line with the Court's ruling and the request of the Data Protection Authority.

Naast de bestaande privacy waarborgen zal ik dit jaar nog – in lijn met de uitspraak van het Hof en het verzoek van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens – een aantal aanpassingen doen in de verwerking van passagiersgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Dood gehandicapte Naoufel (10) leidt tot conflict nabestaanden en politie’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the handling of a disabled 10-year-old's body after his death, including why police seized it and why the mother was not informed. The Minister expressed sympathy, described the general procedure, declined to comment on the individual case, and pointed to the complaint routes via the police and the National Ombudsman.
However, I cannot go into this or other individual cases in more detail.
Echter, kan ik niet nader op deze of andere individuele casussen ingaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Agema, Kuiken, Westerveld, Koekkoek, Stoffer, Azarkan, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Van Esch en Van der Plas over longcovid onderzoek

MPs from many parties asked the health minister about the future of Long COVID research, the 2022 motion calling for more structural biomedical research, earlier incorrect answers on biomedical studies, the funding available and its duration, and whether structural money will be provided. The minister answered that about 14 million euro is currently spent on around twenty studies, thirteen with a biomedical component, that a knowledge agenda is being commissioned from ZonMw, and that extra multi-year funding and an expertise centre are being considered, to be decided in May.
In addition, I intend to make extra budget available for multi-year research and an expertise centre for post-COVID.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens om extra budget beschikbaar te maken voor meerjarig onderzoek en een expertisecentrum post-COVID.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over dividendstripping door de staatsbank Fortis

Opposition MP Azarkan asked the Finance Minister about dividend stripping (CumEx and CumCum) by state-owned Fortis/ABN AMRO, including what the bank, supervisors, the tax authority and accountants knew. The minister answered that the Dutch anti-stripping rules do not cover German dividend tax, that the internal document could not be verified, that tax confidentiality and supervisory confidentiality prevent comment on individual cases, and that measures to strengthen the fight against dividend stripping are being prepared.

The Tax Administration has a duty of fiscal confidentiality. Therefore I cannot make any statements about the actions the Tax Administration does or does not take with respect to individual taxpayers.

De Belastingdienst kent een fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht. Derhalve kan ik geen mededelingen doen over de handelingen die de Belastingdienst al dan niet uitvoert ten aanzien van individuele belastingplichtigen.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Onwel geworden arrestant Borne overleden’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the death of a man who became unwell during arrest and transport in Borne, including the police conduct, use of force, and the Rijksrecherche investigation. The minister confirmed the death and the standard investigation, but declined to answer most detailed questions individually because the case is under investigation, while describing disciplinary statistics and the national sentencing consultation body.
Anticipating the conclusions of the investigation, I cannot go into the substance of this specific case, and for that reason I cannot answer questions 3 to 14 and 16 to 26 individually.
Vooruitlopend op de conclusies van het onderzoek kan ik niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze specifieke zaak, de vragen 3 t/m 14 en 16 t/m 26 kan ik om die reden niet individueel beantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het artikel 'Onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsing kinderen toeslagenouders tegengehouden'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why independent research by Groningen University into out-of-home placements of children of childcare-benefit parents was blocked by the judiciary, and how the process will be accelerated. The Minister says the judiciary will do its own file research with an external supervisory committee, the Inspectorate is conducting its own study, and an independent investigative commission is being set up with a chair to be found, expected to start this autumn.
The Council for the Judiciary has indicated that research into those cases by a third party cannot be considered.
De Raad voor de Rechtspraak heeft aangegeven dat onderzoek naar die zaken door een derde partij niet aan de orde kan zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de berichten 'Meeste toeslagenouders hebben migratieachtergrond, vaak met schulden', nieuwe data van het CBS: 'Kenmerken van gedupeerde gezinnen toeslagenaffaire' en 'Belasting

An MP (Azarkan, DENK) asked the State Secretaries of Finance about CBS data showing that most families harmed by the childcare benefits scandal have a migration background and often debts, and about reports that the Tax Service knew of ethnic profiling already in 2019. The government acknowledged the findings as painful, denied that Toeslagen collected ethnicity data or actively selected on nationality, admitted that the risk model disadvantaged certain groups without a valid basis, and pointed to reforms, a screening team clarification, and ongoing restitution efforts, but did not concede the 2019 knowledge claim.
It is not the case, and the DPA has not established either, that the handlers selected on the basis of second nationality.
Het is niet zo, en ook niet door de AP vastgesteld, dat de behandelaren in dit verband geselecteerd hebben op tweede nationaliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de NPO Radio 1-uitzending van Argos op zaterdag 11 juni 2022: 'Een onzichtbare muur' en het delen van persoonsgegevens met buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten

The MP asks about an Argos radio report on people wrongly placed on foreign and Dutch terrorism-related lists, the sharing of personal data with foreign intelligence services, and the NCTV's internet monitoring weekly reports on citizens. The Minister answers that wrongly listed people can seek help and that Dutch services share data only under the Wiv 2017 with oversight, while declining to comment on individual cases and conceding that NCTV monitoring of citizens went wrong and will not return in that form.

I am of the view, as I have stated earlier, that when the NCTV analyses or interprets developments, these analyses or interpretations must be factual in nature and aimed at developments relevant to national security.

Ik ben van mening, zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, dat als de NCTV ontwikkelingen analyseert of duidt, deze analyses of duidingen feitelijk van aard moeten zijn en gericht op relevante ontwikkelingen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de fiscale behandeling van Uber

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the tax treatment of Uber, alleged favouritism by the Tax Authority, delayed foreign information requests, the role of other agencies and former Commissioner Neelie Kroes's StartupDelta post. The State Secretary declines to discuss individual tax files under confidentiality rules, offers a confidential briefing to Parliament, and gives procedural explanations and references to past enforcement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Azarkan, Dassen, Van der Plas en Eerdmans over de situatie op Schiphol

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Schiphol's management had lost control of operations, whether shareholders could face claims and dividend losses, and whether shareholders should call an extraordinary meeting, a letter of objection, or an Enterprise Chamber inquiry. The minister attributed the problems to staff shortages and rising demand, pointed to Schiphol's summer action plan and a passenger cap, said operational responsibility lies with the board, and declined to share the confidential AGM documents while rejecting an extraordinary meeting or formal written objection for now.
The minutes of the General Meeting of Shareholders (including the relevant documents) are classified as commercially confidential and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
Het verslag van de Algemene Vergadering van Aandeelhouders (inclusief de relevante stukken) wordt aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het breder toepassen van het discriminerende risico-selectiemodel door Toeslagen

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance how the discriminatory risk-selection model used by Toeslagen (childcare and housing benefits) was applied more widely, which teams used it, when it was used, and when an external investigation would start. The government answered that the model's risk scores were used beyond manual-review selection, that nationality and other indicators were part of the model, and that an external investigation would start in summer 2022 with a report expected early the following year.
Therefore an external investigation will be carried out.
Daarom zal een extern onderzoek worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Azarkan en Omtzigt over recente nihilstellingen in de kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Leijten, Azarkan and Omtzigt asked about recent nihilstellingen (zeroing-out of childcare allowance) for 2020/2021, including how the process, notification, reasons, objection and repayment are handled after the Ongekend Onrecht report. The State Secretary answered that about 4,500 2020 cases were zeroed out, described new procedural safeguards, admitted decisions do not yet state reasons in the formal beschikking, and promised improvements without firm dates.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Sylvana Simons over discriminerende rapportages van de NCTV

MPs Azarkan and Simons asked the Justice Minister about NCTV weekly reports that examined and stigmatised parties such as DENK and BIJ1, including a remark calling MP Kuzu the 'long arm of Turkey', and whether this amounted to political monitoring. The Minister acknowledged that some normative remarks about MPs should not have appeared, said the reports were discontinued in March 2021, and explained the planned legal basis and the ongoing data clean-up, while denying that parties were monitored as such.
That should not have happened. Analyses and interpretations must be factual in nature and focused on developments relevant to national security.
Dat had niet gemoeten. Analyses en duidingen moeten feitelijk van aard zijn en gericht zijn op relevante ontwikkelingen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de Belastingdienst die discriminerende criteria verzweeg

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority used discriminatory selection criteria (nationality, age, religion) for fraud investigations and whether ministry and agency knew of it earlier. The State Secretary confirms the Tax Authority's internal handbooks contained such references, says the 2020 handbook was declared invalid and the process halted, and states the criteria were not formally approved at political level, while refusing to give a definitive judgement on discrimination or racism and promising to return later.
These handbooks were not formally adopted within the Tax Authority, for example by management or by the corporate service Vaktechniek.
Deze handleidingen zijn niet formeel binnen de Belastingdienst vastgesteld, bijvoorbeeld door het management of door de corporate dienst Vaktechniek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over risicoselectie op basis van uiterlijk voorkomen

An MP asked the government whether the Tax Authority used risk profiles based on appearance, nationality and other personal traits, following PwC findings on its FSV blacklist. The State Secretary acknowledged examples referring to nationality and migration background, said no explicit appearance-based criteria were found beyond one 2016 email, stated that discrimination in risk selection is not permitted except in exceptional cases, and announced further investigations and safeguards while not answering all questions fully.
Unfortunately it has not proven possible to answer the questions within the deadline set by the member.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken de vragen binnen de door het lid gestelde termijn te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over Nederland als belastingparadijs

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Netherlands is a tax haven given that many large multinationals route profits through Dutch entities, and about dividend withholding tax, shell companies and the Secretary's own past involvement in tax structures. The government denied the Netherlands is a tax haven, cited secrecy rules that prevent discussing individual firms, and described recent anti-avoidance measures (conditional withholding taxes, the principal purpose test) with monitoring promised, though it declined to say how much tax has yet been collected and did not answer whether the Secretary had been involved in avoidance structures beyond general statements.
Based on the fiscal secrecy obligation laid down in article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.

Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht die is neergelegd in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht 'Undercover naar de moskee: geheim onderzoek naar islamitische organisaties'

The MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that municipalities covertly commissioned NTA to analyse mosques and Islamic organisations, raising legality, privacy and NCTV responsibility. The Minister answered that the agreements were between municipalities and NTA so he cannot judge legality, that the NCTV had internal concerns in 2017 and it will strengthen guidance and conditions, and that he will restore trust with Islamic organisations.

Because the precise agreements on carrying out and delivering the power-field analyses were made between municipalities and NTA, I cannot make statements on whether unlawful investigative methods were used.

Omdat de precieze afspraken over de uitvoering en oplevering van de krachtenveldanalyses gemaakt zijn tussen gemeenten en NTA, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de vraag of er onrechtmatige onderzoeksmethodieken hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het nieuwsartikel 'Raad van Europa: Nederlandse rechter normaliseert discriminatie door marechaussee'

MP Azarkan asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of the Interior about press reports on a Council of Europe rapporteur's criticism of ethnic profiling by the Royal Marechaussee and a court ruling that ethnicity may play a role in selection for mobile security checks, asking about training, complaint routes, the use of skin colour and ethnicity in risk profiles, and whether a ban is planned. The government answered that it opposes discrimination, that the court ruling is limited to mobile security checks and is under appeal, that training and complaint procedures exist, and that a cabinet position on ethnicity and nationality in risk profiles will follow after the College voor de rechten van de mens publishes its legal framework, with no ban committed to yet.
The cabinet considers it important to provide clarity on the legal frameworks that apply and are applied in the Netherlands regarding the use of ethnicity and nationality in risk models.

Het kabinet acht het van belang helderheid te bieden over de juridische kaders die van toepassing zijn en in Nederland worden toegepast ten aanzien van het gebruik van etniciteit en nationaliteit in risicomodellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan inzake de Arnhemse villamoord

The MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the Arnhem villa murder case, including alleged tunnel vision, coercive interrogation methods, paid junkie informant testimony, and calls for a new investigation and compensation. The Minister declines substantive comment because a new revision request is announced to the Supreme Court, notes that the police and prosecution will cooperate, and rejects a new investigation or additional capacity, citing the Supreme Court's role.
Given the announced new revision request in this case, it is appropriate for me as Minister to exercise restraint in answering the questions concerning the substance of the Arnhem villa murder case.

Gelet op het aangekondigde nieuwe herzieningsverzoek in deze zaak past mij als Minister terughoudendheid bij de beantwoording van de gestelde vragen die betrekking hebben op de inhoud van de Arnhemse Villamoord-zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de dreigende ondergang van Evergrande

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the risk of Evergrande's collapse, its effects on China and the world economy, possible state rescue, the analogy with Lehman Brothers, monitoring, and criticism of austerity and MMT. The minister answered that Evergrande's exposure to foreign parties is limited, that the government monitors China's economy through diplomatic channels and experts, and that any support package depends on the crisis type, while largely declining to comment on analysts' views and speculating on China's intervention.
Statements by analysts or other parties on whether the Chinese government will intervene are their own assessments.
Uitspraken van analisten of andere partijen over het al dan niet ingrijpen van de Chinese overheid zijn hun eigen inschattingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Omtzigt, Azarkan, Inge van Dijk, Arib en Ceder over het bericht ‘Uithuisplaatsingen onder gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire’

MPs asked the government about reports that over 1,100 children of parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal were placed out of home, requesting the grounds, the CBS data scope, plans to return children and a dedicated helpline. The minister answered that a causal link is hard to establish, that CBS data cover 2015–2020, that no central record of placement grounds exists, and that a plan for affected families will be sent to parliament as soon as possible.
No, this specific information is not available. There is no central registration of the grounds on which an out-of-home placement is ordered.
Nee, deze specifieke informatie is niet beschikbaar. Er is geen centrale registratie van de gronden op basis waarvan een uithuisplaatsing wordt ingezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de Fraude Signaleringsvoorziening (FSV)

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including the number of people listed, possible ethnic profiling, legal basis, responsibility for its creation, compensation, and access to documents. The government answers that the FSV did not meet GDPR requirements and was shut down, that independent investigations by PwC and the Data Protection Authority are ongoing with results expected around September 2021, that it cannot rule out nationality-related information in free-text fields, and that documents will be provided only in a limited, interpreted manner under the Wob-like approach.
No, I cannot rule that out.
Nee, dit kan ik niet uitsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Baarle en Azarkan over de huidige stand van zaken met betrekking tot discriminatie en racisme in Nederland

MPs Van Baarle and Azarkan asked about the current state of discrimination and racism in the Netherlands, covering complaint and prosecution figures over ten years, reporting willingness, and government measures on housing, labour, education, healthcare and spending. The minister answered with detailed statistics on antidiscrimination-service complaints, police reports, prosecutions, sentences and sanctions, and described planned measures including a National Coordinator and a State Commission on discrimination and racism.
The approach to discrimination will receive an important and substantial boost in the coming period.
De aanpak van discriminatie zal in de komende periode een belangrijke en wezenlijke impuls krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over aanslagen op drie Poolse winkels

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether three bomb attacks on Polish-owned Biedronka shops in Aalsmeer, Heeswijk-Dinther and Beverwijk were linked, whether they amount to terrorism, what the motives are, and whether all threatened premises can obtain state protection. The minister replied that a broad criminal investigation is under way led by the public prosecutor, that terrorism cannot be established for now and the link to Polish people is unclear, and that security is a shared responsibility with the state providing tailored protection.
The police, under the direction of the public prosecution service, have started an extensive criminal investigation.
De recherche is onder leiding van het openbaar ministerie een uitgebreid opsporingsonderzoek gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over “het mislopen van inkomsten door moskeeën als gevolg van het coronavirus”

Azarkan (DENK) asked whether mosques facing financial losses from COVID-19 should receive state support to protect their social role and maintenance of buildings. The minister answered that religious communities are financially responsible themselves, pointed to existing general schemes (NOW, Tozo, Nationaal Restauratiefonds loans) and said the cabinet cannot offer other funding.
The cabinet cannot offer any funding other than the various generic (emergency) schemes currently available.
Het kabinet kan geen andere financiering bieden dan de diverse generieke (nood-)regelingen die op dit moment beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over tienduizenden burgers die jaren last hadden van 'fraudevermoedens' van de Belastingdienst

The MP Azarkan asks the State Secretary of Finance about tens of thousands of citizens who for years faced tax fraud suspicions under Belastingdienst project 1043, including ethnicity-based selection, profiling, and institutional bias. The government answers that the project is not secret, that the investigation is ongoing with interim measures, that selection on ethnicity or second nationality no longer plays a role, and provides figures on the number of tax returns assessed, while withholding some details pending further research.
To prevent risks of disproportionate treatment during the follow-up investigation, we are taking the following measures, at least for the duration of the follow-up investigation.
Om te voorkomen dat er, gedurende het vervolgonderzoek, risico's voor een disproportionele behandeling zijn, nemen wij, in ieder geval voor de duur van het vervolgonderzoek, de volgende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de rituele slacht en het Offerfeest

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Agriculture whether NVWA rules made ritual slaughter during the Eid al-Adha (Offerfeest) practically impossible, whether many slaughterhouse applications were rejected, and whether the state would guarantee ritual slaughter could proceed. The minister denied that the rules changed, stated that 48 of 53 applicant slaughterhouses slaughtered during the festival after COVID plan adjustments, and said unstunned slaughter was able to take place within COVID guidelines without committing to new action.
The statutory rules for performing unstunned slaughter and supervising it have not changed compared with previous Offerfeesten.
De wettelijke voorschriften voor het uitvoeren van onbedwelmde slacht en het toezicht hierop zijn niet gewijzigd ten opzichte van vorige Offerfeesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bestaan van een geheime zwarte lijst van vermeende fraudeurs die veel mensen gedupeerd heeft

MP Azarkan asked the State Secretary of Finance about a secret blacklist of alleged fraudsters (the FSV application) that reportedly harmed many people, including whether it was hidden from parliament and citizens and whether people could object. The answers confirm about 180,000 registrations before the February 2020 cleanup, admit parliament was not explicitly informed, say registrations cannot themselves be appealed but follow-up acts can be challenged via AVG rights and administrative appeal, and state the application was stopped due to GDPR concerns.
The existence of an administration of signals was not explicitly shared with your House.
Het bestaan van een administratie met signalen is niet expliciet gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht 'Landelijk coördinator nodig om discriminatie aan te pakken'

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Interior about calls from the College voor de Rechten van de Mens for a national discrimination coordinator, and whether such a coordinator, sector-specific policy and more resources would be pursued. The Minister confirmed awareness, referred to motions adopted in the plenary debate on institutional racism and a promised letter this autumn on a Staatscommissie and a national coordinator, and pointed to existing sector-specific measures.

During the debate, in response to these motions, I indicated that a letter will appear this autumn in which I will address the state commission and the requests for a national discrimination coordinator.

Tijdens het debat heb ik in reactie op deze moties aangegeven dat er dit najaar een brief zal verschijnen waarin ik zal ingaan op de staatscommissie en de verzoeken om een nationaal coördinator discriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over discriminatie en etnisch profileren in alle lagen van de overheid

MP Azarkan (DENK) asked the Minister of the Interior about discrimination and ethnic profiling across all levels of government, following a report by the National Ombudsman, and asked about the police complaints procedure, the scope of the Ombudsman's investigation, and possible legal changes. The Minister answered that training, integrity policy and complaints handling address bias, that the Ombudsman's investigation will focus on complaints handling and report in autumn 2020, that the police complaints procedure uses an independent advisory commission but is aimed at restoring trust rather than sanctions, and that current law already covers nationality and language under the existing discrimination grounds.
The National Ombudsman expects to complete the investigation in autumn 2020.
De Nationale ombudsman verwacht het onderzoek in het najaar van 2020 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht 'Te weinig aandacht voor genocide Srebrenica in geschiedenisonderwijs'

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the limited attention to the Srebrenica genocide in history textbooks, and the victims' perspective, should be expanded. The minister acknowledged the importance of Srebrenica, pointed to existing curriculum references and the curriculum.nu process, but said content of teaching materials is not for the cabinet to assess under article 23(6) of the Constitution.

As my predecessors and I have already indicated to the House in earlier written questions, under article 23(6) of the Constitution it is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials, but for schools.

Zoals mijn voorgangers en ik aan uw Kamer in eerdere schriftelijke vragen hierover ook al hebben aangegeven, is het – conform artikel 23, lid 6 van de Grondwet – niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen, maar aan scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat een op de drie Amsterdamse makelaars bereid is om te discrimineren

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Interior whether she knows of the report that one in three Amsterdam estate agents would discriminate, and what measures will be taken against discrimination in the housing market, including monitoring, complaint procedures and sanctions. The minister answers that a broader anti-discrimination approach is under way, with mystery-guest and practice-test research due in early 2021, that agents' associations are cooperating but no disciplinary cases are known, and that she is considering how to pursue discriminating landlords and agents while promoting reporting and pilots in cities.
In the interest of results that are as realistic as possible, I cannot currently share any further details about this research.
In het belang van zo reëel mogelijke resultaten van dit onderzoek, kan ik er nu geen verdere mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de extreem-rechtse organisatie Feuertag Division

MP Azarkan asked the Justice Minister about the extreme-right group Feuertag Division, including reports it is led from the Netherlands, plans to attack politicians and spread COVID-19, and what the government will do about it. Minister Grapperhaus largely declined to comment on ongoing cases, citing OM, police and AIVD policy, and described the threat in general terms and the existing local, persons-focused approach.
The OM, the National Police nor the General Intelligence and Security Service make statements about ongoing cases or not.
Het OM, de Nationale Politie noch de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst doet mededelingen over al dan niet lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over repatriëringsdiscriminatie bij Nederlanders vanuit Marokko

Parliamentarian Azarkan asked the Foreign Minister about claims that Dutch repatriation flights from Morocco discriminated against passengers by surname or migration background, and about the number of stranded Dutch citizens. The minister denied discrimination, said the embassy had no role in compiling passenger lists, noted over 1,000 remain registered, and committed to organising further repatriation flights under the Bijzondere Bijstand Buitenland initiative.
The passenger lists of these commercial flights are therefore not in the possession of the government.
De passagierslijsten van deze commerciële vluchten zijn dan ook niet in het bezit van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over steunmaatregelen voor taxichauffeurs en marktkooplieden tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Azarkan and Öztürk asked why taxi drivers and market traders were excluded from the Noodloket and later TOGS support schemes due to wrong SBI codes, and whether these groups would be admitted. The minister answered that both groups were added to the TOGS scheme (taxi from 15 April, non-food market traders from 30 March and 15 April) and that the technical problems with the Noodloket had been resolved, with applications open until 26 June 2020.
This group can submit an application to the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO.nl) from 15 April 2020.
Deze groep kan vanaf 15 april 2020 een aanvraag indienen bij de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO.nl).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over politieagenten met PTSS
