MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police officers with PTSD, including the independence of the Achmea-funded Buitensporigheid commission, the handling of complaints, reports of the police opposing claims through lawyers, and forced resignations. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the commission is needed for expertise, that a independent police ombudsman was installed in January 2020, that the compensation system is being revised, and that no concrete evidence of forced resignations was found.
Since 1 January 2020 an independent police ombudsman has been installed.
Er is sinds 1 januari 2020 een onafhankelijke ombudsfunctionaris voor de politie geïnstalleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de RIVM-presentatie over de verschillende corona-scenario’s

An MP asked the health minister when the government knew that pre-23 March measures would overshoot IC capacity, why stricter measures and household isolation came late, and why the emergency ordinances took 23 days. The minister said he was kept informed through weekly briefings, referred to a letter of 7 April for the model questions, explained household isolation was added as IC admissions rose, and attributed the delay to the need for ordinances drafted with the safety regions.
For the answers to these questions I refer you to my letter to the House of 7 April.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik u naar mijn Kamerbrief van 7 april jl.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over schooladviezen die jongeren kansen ontnemen

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked about reports that school recommendations underestimate children from low-educated families, and about measures against under-advising. Minister Slob acknowledges the concern, cites monitoring and a second opinion via the final test, and says a guidance handbook will be piloted and distributed, but denies being able to rule out under-advising.
I find it worrying that for some pupils there is under-advising.
Ik vind het zorgelijk dat er bij een deel van de leerlingen sprake is van onderadvisering.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Man na arrestatie overleden in het ziekenhuis’ van Omroep West

Deputy Azarkan asked the Justice Minister about a man who died in hospital after a police arrest, including proportionality of force, the handling of evidence, and oversight of police violence. The minister declined substantive comment while the Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing, but gave statistics, described disciplinary procedures, and rejected a new independent complaints body.
In the first instance it is for the public prosecutor to assess whether the police officers involved acted in accordance with the rules.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de officier van justitie om te beoordelen of de betrokken politieambtenaren volgens de regels hebben gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de verbijsterende CAF-affaire met de kinderopvangtoeslag

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the CAF childcare benefit affair, including unlawful suspensions and recovery, withheld information, possible ethnic profiling, and accountability of the Tax Administration. The State Secretary answers most questions by referring to pending investigations by the Adviescommissie and Auditdienst Rijk, acknowledges some unlawful decisions, and states he will not comment on individuals.
All relevant information about the cases is currently being inventoried for the Advisory Committee and the ADR.
Alle relevante informatie over de zaken wordt op dit moment geïnventariseerd ten behoeve van de Adviescommissie en de ADR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Politiechef Fatima stelt dat ‘klokkenluiders’ intern tegen muur lopen’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers who raise internal misconduct such as intimidation, racism and abuse of power face a 'blue wall of silence', and about monitoring, discipline, exit interviews and independent investigation. The minister said such conduct has no place in the police, that complaints are investigated, that existing programmes and monitoring are in place, and that he sees no reason for an independent investigation.
I currently see no reason for an independent investigation.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over moslimfobie en intimidatie bij de politie

An MP from DENK asks the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of racist and discriminatory messages by police officers, intimidation of Muslim colleagues, and a gag order on a team chief, asking whether the minister will sanction, investigate, or set up an inquiry. The minister condemns discrimination in principle, explains disciplinary procedures and existing diversity and reporting measures, declines to give details on individual cases or statistics not in the registrations, and refers to a letter to parliament without committing to an independent inquiry.
I therefore see no reason at this time for an independent investigation.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Azarkan over  verboden staatssteun aan Nike

The MP Azarkan asks the State Secretary of Finance about reported improper tax benefits for Nike via a tax ruling that shifts profits to commanditaire vennootschappen, whether tax will be recovered, and whether rulings and substance requirements will be tightened. The State Secretary says the ruling sets an arm's-length remuneration, that it is not yet established that too little tax was paid since the European Commission is investigating state aid, offers a confidential technical briefing, and states that the new Besluit vooroverleg from 1 July 2019 bars rulings where tax saving is the sole or decisive motive and introduces an economic nexus test.
I have offered your House confidential and closed technical briefing information on the investigation procedure, the concluded rulings and the Netherlands' position.
Ik heb uw Kamer aangeboden in een vertrouwelijke en besloten technische briefing informatie te verstrekken over de onderzoeksprocedure, de afgesloten rulings en het standpunt van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het onderwijsboek Geobas 7

Azarkan (DENK) asked whether the minister finds passages in the textbook Geobas 7 about grey suburbs, guest workers, mosques and crime stereotyping, and whether the publisher should be pressed to revise it or a scan of teaching materials should be ordered. The minister answered that content of teaching materials is the responsibility of schools under freedom of education, and that parents and pupils can raise concerns via the school council or complaints procedure, with criminal law as the only external limit.
As I and my predecessors have already indicated in answers to earlier written questions, it is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials, but for the schools.
Zoals ik en mijn voorgangers in de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen al hebben aangegeven, is het niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen, maar aan de scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Rechts-radicalen trainen in Frankrijk voor ‘nieuwe burgeroorlog’’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that far-right groups such as Identitair Verzet send supporters to combat-training camps in France in preparation for a 'race war', and what the government will do about it. The minister said the AIVD sees no recent indications of such trips, that unlawful violence by any group is unacceptable and monitored, and pointed to existing structures, online-content measures and EU legislation without committing to a new dedicated action plan.
There are no indications that this has also happened recently.
Er zijn geen indicaties dat dit recent ook is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat woedende Urker jongeren het huis van Soufyan (18) binnendringen en ‘Geertje Wilders!’ roepen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that angry youths on Urk entered the home of an 18-year-old and chanted a discriminatory slogan, and about threats to the family and the safety response. The minister declined to give details because criminal investigations are ongoing, confirmed arrests and protection measures, and said a possible penalty-enhancement ground for discrimination-related offences is under study.
Given that the questions above are the subject of the criminal investigation into this incident, no further statements can be made about them.
Gelet op het feit dat de hierboven gestelde vragen onderwerp zijn van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar dit incident, kunnen hier geen verdere mededelingen over worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het artikel ‘Lijst van haatincidenten tegen moskeeën’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a list of hate incidents against mosques, the implementation of the 'Veilige Moskee' guidance, the threat picture and funding for mosque security. The minister condemned the incidents, said responsibility lies mainly with mosques and municipalities, declined to keep central records of measures or to fund extra security, and pointed to existing threat assessments.
I therefore see no reason to keep a central overview of the measures taken; in my view this does not contribute to the safety of mosques.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om op centraal niveau een overzicht bij te houden van de genomen maatregelen; dit levert mijns inziens geen bijdrage aan de veiligheid van de moskeeën.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat vliegmaatschappijen privédata van passagiers gaan delen met de overheid

MP Azarkan asked whether airlines sharing passenger data (PNR) with the government would record halal meal orders as a proxy for religion, and whether this should be made impossible. Minister Grapperhaus answered that halal meal preferences are not in the bill, are not among the limitative PNR data elements, that any such data sent in error would be destroyed immediately, and that special personal data is prohibited and overseen by a data protection officer and the Data Protection Authority.
Information on meal preferences such as ordering a halal meal is not provided to the passenger information unit (Pi-NL) and therefore is not stored either.
Informatie over maaltijdvoorkeuren zoals het bestellen van een halal-maaltijd wordt niet verstrekt aan de passagiersinformatie-eenheid (Pi–NL) en dus ook niet opgeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Man uit Doornenburg verdacht van voorbereiden aanslag op moslims’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a suspect from Doornenburg accused of preparing an attack on Muslims, his alleged ties to an extreme-right group and past Defence service, and whether the security services and government monitor far-right groups and their possible links to police or Defence. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, said far-right groups are fluid and monitored by AIVD/MIVD where threats arise, and stated that jihadism has long been the dominant threat, while far-right violence is seen as coming mainly from small radicalising groups or individuals.
I do not make statements about individual criminal cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele strafzaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over fraude met de dividendbelasting

An MP asked the Finance Minister and State Secretary about alleged large-scale dividend tax fraud (cum-ex/dividend stripping) involving Dutch banks, the Tax Authority's role, and whether banks and the Public Prosecution Service would be held to account. The government replied that it lacks sufficient information on the scale and on the involvement of specific banks, that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating potential fraud, and that the Tax Authority bears the burden of proof and could recover unlawfully refunded tax, while declining to comment on individual cases.
The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements about individual investigations.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen uitspraken over individuele onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over flitskredieten die worden aangeboden tegen woekerrentes

MPs Azarkan and Öztürk asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about flash loans offered to businesses at usurious rates, their exclusion from consumer credit rules, and whether research into their effects would be done. The minister answered that no serious abuses are known, that the sector is developing self-regulation, and that a general market study is planned, but declined specific research and extension of consumer credit protection to small businesses.
At present I have no signals of serious abuses or major problems in this sector due to high interest rates or other costs.
Op dit moment heb ik geen signalen over ernstige misstanden of grote problemen in deze branche vanwege hoge rentes of andere kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat er een zwarte lijst komt voor frauduleuze aanbieders van bedevaarten naar Mekka

An MP asked the government about reports of a blacklist for fraudulent Hajj travel providers, whether consumers are adequately protected, and whether the regulator and prosecutor should be alerted. The state secretary said existing consumer protection rules are sufficient, that organising the market is not a government task, and that the signal was passed to the ACM, which is independent in setting its enforcement priorities.
I have meanwhile passed this signal on.
Ik heb inmiddels dit signaal doorgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Slachtoffer discriminatie woningmarkt: Het is vernederend’

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Interior about reports of ethnic discrimination on the housing market and what the government would do, including spot-checks and enforcement. Minister Ollongren acknowledged the problem as unacceptable, pointed to complaint routes and preventive measures, and promised talks with industry bodies on good landlordship and possible regulatory changes, but declined to launch a new investigation or stronger enforcement.
I have announced that I will enter into discussion with the industry organisations to make agreements on good landlordship.
Ik heb aangekondigd het gesprek aan te zullen gaan met de brancheorganisaties om afspraken te maken over goed verhuurderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over de situatie van Nederlandse kinderen in Syrië en Irak

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the government about the situation of Dutch children in Syria and Iraq, whether it will actively help them return, and whether consular assistance and child protection cooperation are possible. The minister answered that at least 175 minors with a Dutch link are there, that consular help is only given when families present themselves in person at a Dutch post, that Syria and crisis areas are largely beyond reach, and that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming is ready to support returnees.
The Dutch government does not provide consular assistance to Dutch travellers and families who are in unsafe areas in Syria and Iraq and wish to leave.
De Nederlandse regering verleent geen consulaire bijstand aan Nederlandse uitreizigers en families die zich in onveilige gebieden in Syrië en Irak bevinden en deze willen verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over een 14-jarig meisje, dat vanwege een hoofddoek van haar fiets werd geduwd en op de grond liggend het ziekenhuis in werd geslagen en geschopt

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a 14-year-old girl wearing a headscarf was pushed off her bicycle and beaten and kicked, and about rising anti-Muslim incidents and government plans to combat them. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service closed its criminal investigation over doubts about the complaint, that discrimination figures fell in 2016, and that no separate action plan, budget or police unit targeting anti-Muslim hatred will be created because policy must apply to all groups.
The criminal investigation led by the Public Prosecution Service into the alleged assault on a 15-year-old girl from Emmeloord has been concluded.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie naar de vermeende mishandeling van een 15-jarig meisje uit Emmeloord is afgerond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat een Turks-Nederlandse vereniging in Rotterdam is besmeurd met PKK-leuzen door sympathisanten van de terroristische beweging PKK

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about the graffiti of PKK slogans on a Turkish-Dutch association building in Rotterdam, measures to protect members, and PKK demonstrations with flags. Minister Grapperhaus replied that local authorities and police are handling protection, a criminal investigation has no suspects yet, the PKK is monitored and on the terrorism sanctions list, and flag displays are regulated under the right to demonstrate.
I have viewed the defacement with abhorrence.
Ik heb met afkeer kennisgenomen van de bekladding.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat de voorzitter van de Ulu moskee in Utrecht aangifte heeft gedaan tegen de PVV-lijsttrekker in Utrecht over zijn angstwekkende uitspraak over het afbr

MPs from DENK asked about a PVV lijsttrekker's remark that the Ulu mosque could burn, which made worshippers fearful, and about his employment as a municipal employee. The minister distanced himself from the remark, pointed to existing mosque security guidance and local contacts, and said the municipality of Nieuwegein must judge whether the employee's conduct breached the rules.

It is up to the college of mayor and aldermen of the municipality of Nieuwegein, as employer and competent authority, to assess whether the political statements made by Mr Van Deún lead to the conclusion that the so-called performance norm has been exceeded.

Het is aan het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de gemeente Nieuwegein als werkgever en bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of de door de heer Deún gedane (politieke) uitlatingen leiden tot de conclusie dat de zogenaamde functioneringsnorm is overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Kuzu over het bericht dat vier Marokkaanse Nederlanders onderwerp van een arrestatiebevel zijn van het Marokkaanse openbaar ministerie

DENK MPs asked whether four Dutch-Moroccans are subject to arrest warrants from Morocco's prosecutor over Rif protests, what contact the Netherlands had with Moroccan authorities, and how the Netherlands would refuse unjustified extradition or legal-assistance requests. The government replied that Morocco said these were witness summonses rather than arrest warrants, that it cannot say more than it knows, that each request is assessed case by case under Dutch law and the ECHR including free expression, and that it raised the treatment of detained demonstrators with Moroccan ministers.
Legal assistance and extradition requests are always assessed case by case and in compliance with Dutch law and international treaties.
Rechtshulp- en uitleveringsverzoeken worden altijd per geval en met inachtneming van de Nederlandse wet en internationale verdragen beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat Turks-Nederlandse gezinnen worden bedreigd met dreigbrieven met een hakenkruis en bloedspetters op hun voordeur

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of threatening letters with swastikas and blood-like splatters left on Turkish-Dutch families' doors, asking about victim support, suspects, anti-Muslim discrimination policy, mosque security and hate speech penalties. The minister condemned the threats, said no comparable cases are known to police, declined to comment on individual cases or ongoing investigations, pointed to existing discrimination and mosque security policy, and announced a bill to raise the penalty for hate speech in spring 2018.
As is known, I do not make statements about ongoing investigations.
Zoals bekend doe ik geen mededelingen over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat een Marokkaans-Nederlandse vrouw en haar kinderen zijn bekogeld met uitwerpselen

An MP from DENK asked the Justice Minister about a report that a Moroccan-Dutch woman and her children were pelted with excrement, and about government measures against discrimination and anti-Muslim hatred. The government condemned discrimination, said no suspects had been identified, saw no reason for policy change from this incident, and declined to introduce mystery-guest tests, which it judged outside the Inspectorate's powers and undesirable.
For now I see no reason to make policy changes based on the incident you mention.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen aanleiding om op basis van het door u genoemde incident te komen tot beleidswijzigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat medewerkers van de politie een zwartboek discriminatie hebben gemaakt

Azarkan (DENK) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a reported 'black book' of police discrimination experiences, whether a large-scale culture study is needed, what measures exist, and whether they are effective. Minister Grapperhaus answered that discrimination occurs in the police as in other organisations, pointed to the De Kracht van het Verschil programme, said ethnicity is not registered and exit trends are not yet known, promised to discuss exit interviews with the Chief Constable and inform parliament in spring 2018, and rejected the claim that the programme is inadequate.
There is no legal basis for the police to register ethnicity.
Voor registratie van etniciteit door de politie is geen wettelijke grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat de bouwplaats van een moskee in Enschede is besmeurd met varkensbloed

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Pegida action smearing pig's blood on a mosque construction site in Enschede, whether the threat picture has changed, what protection and coordination measures are taken, and whether Pegida can be banned. The minister answered that the action fits a pattern of intimidation without signs of violence, that existing advice and the 'Veilige Moskee' handbook remain in force, and that a ban requires high legal thresholds, so no extra general security measures or funding are planned.
An organisation cannot be banned merely because it is radical right-wing extremist.
Een organisatie kan niet verboden worden louter omdat zij radicaal rechts-extreem is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over Nederland als belastingparadijs voor Amerikaanse bedrijven

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Dutch subsidiaries of many Fortune 500 US companies make the Netherlands a tax-avoidance hub, and whether government should stop encouraging such firms. The State Secretary said he had not verified the ITEP figures, argued the Netherlands has an internationally focused tax system with legitimate uses, and pointed to BEPS, EU anti-avoidance directives and new anti-abuse withholding taxes as responses.
I have not conducted independent research into these figures and therefore cannot say whether they are correct.
Ik heb geen zelfstandig onderzoek gedaan naar deze cijfers en kan dus niet aangeven of deze kloppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat in korte tijd vijf Turkse Nederlanders zijn vermoord

Two DENK MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that five Turkish-Dutch men were killed in a short period, including whether the cases might be linked to the NSU murders and whether a special police unit should be set up. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said victims' families were offered victim support, and said no suspect had yet been identified, so he could not share further details such as possible motives; he described the police capacity deployed as flexibly scaled per case.
The criminal investigation into these cases has not yet led to the identification of a suspect. For that reason I cannot make further statements, such as about possible motives of suspects.

Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar deze zaken heeft nog niet geleid tot identificatie van een verdachte. Om die reden kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen, zoals over mogelijke motieven van verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over het bericht dat PSV-spelers racistisch zijn bejegend in Venlo

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the government about racist chanting directed at PSV players in Venlo, including what clubs, referees and the KNVB did, whether criminal prosecution is underway, and whether penalties for discriminatory football-related offences should be raised. The Minister said the KNVB disciplinary process is pending, a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and he will not comment on it, and that prosecutors may raise sentence demands by 50% for football-related discrimination offences.
As is customary, while the criminal investigation is ongoing, I make no statements on the progress of this criminal investigation and the prosecution.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk doe ik, gaande het strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen uitspraken over het verloop van dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek en de vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de bezetting van een islamitische middelbare school en een moskee

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the occupation of an Islamic secondary school and a mosque by Identitair Verzet, including government funding for protection, the role of the Education State Secretary, and calls to ban the group. The minister condemned the actions, said the group was not linked to violence so a ban was not justified, and rejected claims that government conduct fostered the climate, while leaving prosecution and school oversight to the competent authorities.
The Public Prosecution Service is currently examining whether the actions of Identitair Verzet constitute criminal offences, including calls for violent conduct.
Het Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt momenteel of met de acties van Identitair Verzet sprake is van strafbare feiten, waaronder het oproepen tot gewelddadig optreden.
Vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan (beiden DENK) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de demonstraties in Marokko (ingezonden 1 juni 2017).

DENK MPs asked the foreign and social affairs ministers about protests in northern Morocco, the government's stance, the response of Moroccan authorities, arrests, tensions in the Netherlands, contact with Morocco, risks to Dutch nationals and possible de-escalation. The minister answered that peaceful protest is a right, that incidents should be investigated, that exact arrest numbers cannot be verified, that Dutch nationals face no generally increased danger, and that Dutch projects in the region contribute, while the resolution lies with Moroccan actors.
The exact number of arrests cannot currently be verified.
Het exacte aantal arrestaties is op dit moment niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de aanslag met een bestelbus op moskeegangers in Londen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the June 2017 van attack on mosque-goers in London, including the government's response, the threat level for places of worship, consultation with Muslim umbrella organisations, the Handreiking Veilige Moskee, and whether more funding for mosque security would be provided. The minister answered that the threat picture is set out in a separate threat report, that regular consultation takes place, that the rejected motions are not adopted while the Recourt motion is treated as policy support, and that local monitoring and contact continue.
For the current threat level I refer to the Terrorism Threat Picture Netherlands that I sent to the House on 23 June 2017.
Voor het actuele dreigingsniveau verwijs ik naar het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland dat ik 23 juni 2017 naar de kamer stuurde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk, Azarkan en Kuzu over hoe de vrijheid van meningsuiting, de vrijheid van demonstratie en de vrijheid van vereniging zich verhouden tot de openbare orde

MPs Öztürk, Azarkan and Kuzu asked how freedom of expression, assembly and association relate to public order, including the bans on Eritrean and Turkish-minister-linked events, the Rotterdam police handling, and the expulsion of a Turkish minister. The government defended the mayors' powers under the Wet openbare manifestaties, declined to assess the mayors' conduct against human rights treaties (leaving that to courts), and said it could not judge mayoral decisions that fall to municipal councils.
It is for the court to form a judgement on that, if and insofar as such legal questions are submitted to a court in any procedure.
Het is aan de rechter om zich daarover een oordeel te vormen indien en voor zover aan de rechter in enigerlei procedure dergelijke rechtsvragen worden voorgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat er voor de zoveelste keer wordt gediscrimineerd tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked ministers about reported job-application discrimination, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens's ruling against Yacht B.V., how such rulings relate to prosecution, whether the College and OM have enough capacity, and whether government contracts and staffing agency oversight should be tightened. The government calls discrimination unacceptable, says the College's equal-treatment track is separate from criminal law, rejects expanding OM capacity and a licensing system for agencies, and points to a study on procurement exclusion and an added Inspectie SZW budget.
On the question of a licensing system for the temporary staffing sector, I am focusing on improving public-private cooperation within the Stichting Normering Arbeid quality mark.
Ten aanzien van de vraag over een vergunningstelsel voor de uitzendbranche zet ik in op verbetering van de publiekprivate samenwerking in het kader van het keurmerk van de Stichting Normering Arbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over de rellen in Rotterdam van 7 mei 2017

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the Justice Minister about the 7 May 2017 Rotterdam riots after Feyenoord's loss, including prosecution, the mayor's enforcement choices compared with other demonstrations, and integration. The minister condemned the rioters, said prosecution is ongoing, and stated that public order enforcement is a matter for the local mayor and council.
Policy on this and its implementation is tailored and a matter for local authorities.
Het beleid ten aanzien hiervan en de uitvoering daarvan is maatwerk en aan het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk en Azarkan over het bericht dat de Algemene Rekenkamer het kabinet steeds minder goed kan controleren

MPs Öztürk and Azarkan asked whether budget cuts threaten the Algemene Rekenkamer's ability to check the executive, including financial functions in ministries and other Hoge Colleges van Staat. The minister replied that the colleges manage their own budgets under agreements, that finance capacity has fallen about 30% since 2009 with programmes to strengthen it, and that no current review of ministry finance departments is needed, while agreeing to a further analysis of the colleges' finances.
In the period 2009–2015 the capacity of the financial function fell by almost 30%.
In de periode 2009 – 2015 is de capaciteit van de financiële functie met bijna 30% afgenomen.

m: Motie-Albayrak c.s. over een kabinetsreactie op de Defensie Verkenningen en het rapport Internationale Veiligheid

Asks the cabinet to send a government-wide policy response to the Defence Explorations and the International Security report to parliament, no later than the forthcoming defence policy letter, and to base that letter on it.
that cabinet response be sent to the House no later than with that defence policy letter
die kabinetsreactie uiterlijk met die defensiebeleidbrief aan de Kamer te doen toekomen
Motie-Albayrak c.s. over schadeloosstelling van veteranen uit oude missies
Asks the government to propose funding from the state budget for 200 million euro compensation to veterans of earlier missions, following an ombudsman proposal.
requests the government to come with a proposal by the next Spring Memorandum 2011 to finance these 200 million from the national budget
verzoekt de regering uiterlijk bij de komende Voorjaarsnota 2011 met een voorstel te komen ter financiering van deze 200 mln. uit de rijksbegroting
Motie-Albayrak c.s. over een parlementair onderzoek naar de administratieve beheerssystemen van Defensie
Asks the Presidium to propose how a parliamentary inquiry into Defence's administrative management systems should be set up, citing weak Court of Audit findings and limited parliamentary control.
considers a parliamentary inquiry into the causes, consequences and possible improvements of the defects in Defence's administrative management systems desirable
van oordeel, dat een parlementair onderzoek naar de oorzaken, gevolgen en mogelijke verbeteringen van de haperingen en manco's bij de administratieve beheersystemen van Defensie gewenst is
Motie-Grashoff/Albayrak over beleidsrijke afstoting van gronden en gebouwen
Asks the government to draw up a plan for selling off surplus defence land and buildings, focusing on fewer efficient locations.
requests the government, in upcoming considerations on the future of the armed forces, to draw up a plan for strategic disposal of land and buildings
verzoekt de regering bij de komende afwegingen rondom de toekomst van de krijgsmacht een plan van aanpak op te stellen voor een beleidsrijke afstoting van gronden en gebouwen
Motie Van Bochove c.s. over het alsnog verstrekken van koopsubsidie
Asks the government to provide funds so that a group of buyers who applied for a purchase subsidy between 30 March and 13 April 2010 receive it after all.
requests the government to make funds available to still grant a purchase subsidie to this group
verzoekt de regering middelen beschikbaar te stellen om alsnog een koopsubsidie te verstrekken aan deze groep
qa: Antwoord vragen Albayrak en Timmermans over het rapport “Second class citizens. Discrimination Against Roma, Jews and Other National Miniorities in Bosnia and Herzegovina” van Human Rights Watch

MPs Albayrak and Timmermans asked whether the EU Roma inclusion programme in Bosnia and Herzegovina has had little effect because the government does not prioritise it, whether the Netherlands pressed for its implementation, and whether the EU should weigh constitutional reform after the 2009 ECtHR ruling more heavily in SAA progress reports. The minister answered that discrimination against Roma persists, that action plans exist and progress is uneven in health and education, that the Netherlands raises minority reforms with Bosnia, and that the EU is involved in constitutional reform, which the SAA's entry into force depends on, so no separate push was announced.
In its contacts with the government of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Netherlands urges the country to carry out reforms.
Nederland dringt er in zijn contacten met de regering van Bosnië-Herzegovina op aan dat het land hervormingen doorvoert.
Antwoord vragen Albayrak en Timmermans over de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Roemenië

MPs Albayrak and Timmermans asked whether Romania's president was refusing to accept the credentials of the Dutch ambassador, whether this was linked to the Dutch veto on Romania's Schengen accession, and whether relations were damaged. The minister replied that the credentials had not yet been presented, the reason was not disclosed, the ambassador's duties are not materially hindered, Romania's new ambassador has agrément, and relations are good.
No statement has been made about the precise reason why the credentials could not yet be presented.
Over de precieze reden waarom de geloofsbrieven nog niet konden worden aangeboden, is geen mededeling gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Albayrak en Plasterk over consumentenvertrouwen en consumptie

MPs Albayrak and Plasterk asked why Dutch consumer confidence fell and why Dutch consumer spending diverged from Germany's after EU consumer spending stalled in Q4 2011. Minister Verhagen attributed the decline to stock prices, unemployment, inflation and housing prices, said the divergence reflects Germany's stronger recovery, and stressed the government's efforts to preserve confidence in public finances.
The cabinet is therefore working hard to safeguard confidence in the sustainability of public finances.
Het kabinet werkt daarom hard om het vertrouwen in de houdbaarheid van de overheidsfinanciën te borgen.
Antwoord vragen Albayrak over het bericht dat de samenwerkingsovereenkomst tussen Havenbedrijf Rotterdam en de haven van het Roemeense Constanza op losse schroeven staat

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the cooperation agreement between Rotterdam port authority and the Romanian port of Constanza was stalling, including the effect of a Dutch Schengen veto and a PVV reporting line on Dutch reputation and economic consequences. The government replied that relations with Romania are good, it has no indication the agreement will not be implemented, and it has no insight into Constanza's other talks.
I have no insight into the talks that the port of Constanza is conducting.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de gesprekken die de haven van Constanza voert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albayrak over het artikel 'Boycot Roemenië en Polen gevreesd'

The MP Albayrak asks the Foreign Minister about fears of a boycott of Dutch goods by Romania and Poland linked to the Dutch refusal to allow free movement of workers for Romania, and whether the government shares concerns about export harm. The minister says the government is aware of the concerns, sees no evidence of negative export effects, and leaves the call by two MEPs to them, noting a boycott would violate EU internal market rules.
There are no indications that Dutch policy actually has negative consequences for Dutch exports.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat het Nederlands beleid daadwerkelijk negatieve gevolgen heeft voor de Nederlandse export.

Vragen van de leden Albayrak en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de Servische regering zwicht voor homofoben (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

Two MPs asked the government about reports that Serbia's government was giving in to homophobic pressure, after the Belgrade Gay Pride was cancelled for security reasons, and how the Netherlands would press Serbia to protect sexual minorities. The minister answered that the Pride cancellation was a step back, that Serbia should work to hold future events, and that the Netherlands raised the issue with EU and Serbian officials and supports NGOs promoting LGBT rights.
The cabinet understands these considerations, but believes Serbia should do everything possible to allow the Gay Pride to take place in the future.
Het kabinet heeft begrip voor deze overwegingen, maar vindt dat Servië alles in het werk moet stellen om de Gay Pride in de toekomst doorgang te laten vinden.

Vragen van de leden Albayrak en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de kritiek in het Europees parlement op Nederland (ingezonden 15

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about European Parliament criticism of Netherlands over blocking extension of the Globalisation Adjustment Fund and how much Dutch workers benefited. The minister answered that the Netherlands does not block the fund but opposes extending the eased eligibility rules, and gave figures on Dutch applications (13 applications, EUR 21.1 million, 6,382 workers).
I therefore advocate a prompt and thorough external evaluation of the use and effects of the EGF as an instrument to counter the effects of globalisation and the crisis.
Ik pleit dan ook voor een spoedige en gedegen externe evaluatie over het gebruik en de effecten van het EGF als instrument om de effecten van globalisering en de crisis tegen te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Albayrak (beiden PvdA) aan de minister-president en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Europese markt voor diensten (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

Two Labour MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Economics minister about the government's joint letter with eight other countries urging openness in the EU services market, and about the government's stance on the Services Directive and the country-of-origin principle. The minister confirmed the letter, said the directive is to be fully implemented and evaluated by 2011-2012 with possible amendments, and stated that labour law, minimum wage and working conditions are outside the directive and will not be used to undermine Dutch rules.
The country-of-origin principle is not part of the current Services Directive, which for the cabinet is the starting point for further strengthening the internal services market.
Het land-van-oorsprongbeginsel maakt geen deel uit van de huidige dienstenrichtlijn, die voor het kabinet het uitgangspunt is voor de verdere versterking van de interne markt voor diensten.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Albayrak (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de nieuwe Hongaarse mediawet (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether the new Hungarian media law, which creates a regulatory body that can impose fines for 'non-objective' reporting, breaches press freedom and EU obligations, and what action the Netherlands would take. The minister acknowledged the law may conflict with press freedom, said the European Commission should analyse it, and said the Netherlands would hold EU member states to account if it breaches EU law, without committing to a specific step.
It is therefore good that the European Commission (EC) analyses this law.
Het is daarom goed dat de Europese Commissie (EC) deze wet analyseert.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans, Albayrak en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een «homotest» die de Tsjechische autoriteiten gebruiken bij asielzoekers die vanwege hun geaardheid in eigen

MPs Timmermans, Albayrak and Marcouch asked the Foreign Minister about the Czech authorities' use of a 'homotest' on asylum seekers persecuted for their sexual orientation, how often it was used, and whether concerns were raised with Czech authorities. The minister answered that ten asylum seekers were tested voluntarily in 2008-2009, that the test was discontinued in early 2010, and that no concerns were raised since the test had ended.
I am, together with the EU agency, of the view that such tests are not compatible with existing European and international treaties and are an infringement of the right to privacy.
Ik ben, met het EU-agentschap, van mening dat dergelijke testen niet verenigbaar zijn met bestaande Europese en internationale verdragen en een aantasting zijn van het recht op privacy.
qn: An MP asks the state secretary of Justice about reports that the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek pressured a woman to convert to Islam as a condition for a new marriage ceremony in a residence-related case, and whether this breaches freedom of religion and marriage rights. The state secretary responds that the answers are provided only for confidential inspection by the Tweede Kamer's information point because of privacy-sensitive aspects, so the substance is not publicly available.
Given the privacy-sensitive aspects of the answers, I request that they be made available only for confidential inspection at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives.
Gelet op de privacy-gevoelige aspecten van de beantwoording verzoek ik u deze enkel ter vertrouwelijke inzage bij het Centraal Informatiepunt van de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal te leggen.

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch youth were being displaced from housing in Almere (Biathlon Park and starter homes) to make way for asylum seekers, and what the government would do. The state secretary denied displacement in principle, said COA centres are not for youth, outlined the housing allocation of permit holders, and explained that the Biathlon Park contracts were extended to March 2010 so residents could rehouse.

COA, with the approval of the then minister for Aliens Affairs and Integration, temporarily deployed the Almere asylum centre as the Biathlon Housing Park to achieve efficient use of operational resources.

Het COA heeft het azc Almere, met instemming van de toenmalige minister voor Vreemdelingenzaken en Integratie, tijdelijk ingezet als Biathlon Woonpark teneinde tot een doelmatige aanwending van bedrijfsmiddelen te komen.

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice about the early-morning removal of a Maastricht family to a detention centre, questioning the medical advice, the children's rights, municipal involvement and whether the removal should be suspended. The government answers that it will address the individual case only in a confidential annex available for inspection, withholding the substantive details from the public record.
In view of the images that have emerged, I have chosen to go into the circumstances of the individual case in detail. I therefore offer you this answer for confidential inspection.

Gelet op de beelden die zijn ontstaan, heb ik ervoor gekozen gedetailleerd in te gaan op de omstandigheden van de individuele zaak. Derhalve bied ik u deze beantwoording ter vertrouwelijke inzage aan.

An MP asked the state secretary of Justice whether a family would be removed from the Ter Apel facility onto the street, whether this breaks an agreement with the Vlagtwedde municipality, and whether such removals have happened before. The government answered that the answers are privacy-sensitive and placed them only for confidential inspection at the Central Information Point.
Given the privacy-sensitive aspects of the answers, I request that they be made available only for confidential inspection at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives.
Gelet op de privacy-gevoelige aspecten van de beantwoording verzoek ik u deze enkel ter vertrouwelijke inzage bij het Centraal Informatiepunt van de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal te leggen.

m: Motie van het lid Hoogeveen over het onderzoek naar de effecten van de vliegbelasting actualiseren
Asks the government to update the study on the effects of the aviation tax and share the updated results with parliament before the 2027 Tax Plan.

to update the research on the effects of the aviation tax based on the new situation in several European countries, including the observed leakage and competition effects, and to share this with the House before the Tax Plan 2027

het onderzoek naar de effecten van de vliegbelasting te actualiseren op basis van de nieuwe situatie in meerdere Europese landen, inclusief de geconstateerde weglek- en concurrentie-effecten, en dit voor het Belastingplan 2027 met de Kamer te delen
Motie van het lid Hoogeveen over een beleidskader met de voorwaarden voor en maximale bandbreedte van het beperken van de tabelcorrectiefactor
Asks the government to present a policy framework setting conditions and maximum bandwidth for limiting the income tax table correction factor.
requests the government to submit to the House a policy framework setting out under which conditions and within which maximum bandwidth the table correction factor can be limited
verzoekt de regering een beleidskader aan de Kamer voor te leggen waarin wordt vastgelegd onder welke voorwaarden en binnen welke maximale bandbreedte de tabelcorrectiefactor kan worden beperkt
Motie van het lid Hoogeveen over in de MFK-onderhandelingen uitdragen dat uitbreiding van Europese eigen middelen voor Nederland geen optie is
Asks the government to advocate in the multiannual financial framework negotiations that expanding EU own resources is not an option for the Netherlands.
expansion of European own resources is not an option for the Netherlands
uitbreiding van Europese eigen middelen voor Nederland geen optie is
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Hertzberger ter vervanging van nr. 11 over aanvullende CCMO toetsingscriteria
Adds explicit ethical and necessity criteria to the embryo law that the CCMO must apply, including weighing research benefits against embryo use and limiting embryo numbers and culture duration.
With this amendment it is clarified what is meant by that invasive nature
Met dit amendement wordt verduidelijkt wat wordt verstaan onder die ingrijpende aard
Amendement van het lid Hertzberger over geslachtsceldonatie ten behoeve van het in kweek brengen van embryonale cellen niet invoeren
Removes the planned extension of the Embryo Act provision so that embryo-derived cell donation for culturing embryonic cells is not introduced.
Given the ethical sensitivity of commodifying early human life, the submitters propose to leave this article out.
Gezien de ethische gevoeligheid van het commodificeren van beginnend menselijk leven hiervan stellen de indieners voor dit artikel achterwege te laten.
Amendement van het lid Hertzberger over aanvullende CCMO toetsingscriteria
Adds ethical test criteria for the CCMO on embryo research, requiring weighing of research interest against embryo use, and checks on numbers of embryos and culture duration.
the goal cannot be achieved through a trial using fewer embryos
het doel niet kan worden bereikt door middel van een proef waarbij minder embryo’s worden gebruikt
Amendement van het lid Hertzberger over een verbod op met IVG tot stand gebracht embryo's voor zwangerschap
Amendment would prohibit introducing into a human embryos created using in vitro produced gametes, banning reproductive use of IVG embryos.
to include a ban on reproductive application of IVG embryos
een verbod op reproductieve toepassing van IVG-embryo's op te nemen
Motie van de leden Hertzberger en Van Zanten over binnen het Fonds Podiumkunsten financiering proberen te vinden voor een theatergezelschap of theaterproductiehuis in alle twaalf provincies
Asks the government to explore funding a theatre company or production house in all twelve provinces via the Fonds Podiumkunsten and to ensure regional distribution in the new funding system.
requests the government to talk with the Fonds Podiumkunsten to explore whether funding can be found within the fund
verzoekt de regering om met het Fonds Podiumkunsten in gesprek te gaan om te onderzoeken of binnen het fonds financiering kan worden gevonden

Motie van de leden Hertzberger en Van Campen over het eerste jaar na invoering van de wet experimenteerruimte bieden en samen met bedrijven de implementatie inclusief informatiesystemen gereed krijgen
Asks the government to give businesses a first-year grace period and build information systems with firms for the EU deforestation regulation, and to standardise due-diligence formats for SMEs.
requests the government to give the first year after introduction of the law room for experimentation
verzoekt de regering het eerste jaar na invoering van de wet experimenteerruimte te bieden
Motie van de leden Hertzberger en Meulenkamp over zich ervoor inzetten dat uitgangsmateriaal of eigenschappen in de NGT niet patentbaar zijn

Asks the government to support the ENVI compromise in the Council so that plant material and traits from new genomic techniques are not patentable, and to press the European Patent Office to grant no such patents.
requests the government to work so that the Council position on the NGT regulation supports the ENVI compromise
verzoekt de regering zich zo in te zetten dat de positie van de Europese Raad, met betrekking tot de verordening NGT, het ENVI-compromis steunt
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Hertzberger ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het behouden van de propedeutische fase voor voltijdopleidingen in het hoger beroepsonderwijs
Amendment limits the option to omit a propedeutic phase to part-time and dual programs in higher vocational education, removing it for full-time programs.
This amendment limits this option so that only part-time and dual programs in higher professional education can still use it
Dit amendement beperkt deze mogelijkheid zodat alleen deeltijdse en duale opleidingen in het hoger beroepsonderwijs nog van deze mogelijkheid gebruik kunnen maken
Subamendement van het lid Hertzberger over een aanvulling op het amendement Krul (stuk nr. 11) met betrekking tot de propedeutische fase

Subamendment limiting the option for hbo bachelor programmes to skip a propedeutic phase, so it does not apply to full-time programmes, which the subamendment says are the ones the Krul amendment would extend the learning-outcomes law to.
This amendment safeguards the important function that a propedeuse has for students.
Dit amendement waarborgt de belangrijke functie die een propedeuse heeft voor studenten.
Motie van het lid Hertzberger c.s. over een plan met hogeronderwijsinstellingen om het aandeel Engelstalige opleidingen stevig terug te dringen
Asks the government to draw up a plan with higher education institutions to sharply reduce the share of English-taught programmes.

requests the government to draw up within eight weeks a plan with higher education institutions containing concrete measures that each institution will individually take to sharply reduce the share of English-taught programmes

verzoekt de regering om binnen acht weken een plan te maken met hogeronderwijsinstellingen met daarin concrete maatregelen die elke instelling afzonderlijk gaat nemen om het aandeel Engelstalige opleidingen stevig terug te dringen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Bruyning over de Kamerbrief 'Uitvoering van de motie van het lid Daniëlle Jansen c.s. over de verkoop van nicotineproducten vanaf 2028 voorbehouden aan enkel tabaksspeciaalz

MPs Hertzberger and Bruyning asked why the government will not implement the motion to restrict nicotine product sales to specialist tobacco shops from 2028, and whether compensation or cost-benefit estimates were considered. The Secretary of State answered that without funding a compensation scheme is not feasible and risks court annulment, that the earlier 2030/2032 timeline stands, and that he declines to reconsider the decision.
Because the motion does not provide financial resources, including a compensation scheme in the bill is not feasible.
Omdat de motie niet voorziet in financiële middelen is het opnemen van een compensatieregeling in het wetsvoorstel niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het NGT-voorstel naar aanleiding van het Argos artikel

An MP asks the agriculture and economic affairs ministers about Dutch lobbying to loosen EU rules on new genomic techniques (NGT) after an Argos report, including whether the parliamentary motion against patents on NGT traits was respected in trilogue negotiations and whether small breeders' concerns were given priority. The Staatssecretaris answers that the Dutch government is not directly in the trilogues, that it pursued the motion's aim of avoiding patent blockades and transparency, that patent issues have only been discussed exploratively, and that the Raad agreement is a fair compromise on labelling, choice and patents, while promising to inform parliament before votes.
I always inform the House about votes in the Agriculture and Fisheries Council via the annotated agenda, and I will continue to do so.
Ik informeer uw Kamer altijd over stemmingen in de Landbouw- en Visserij Raad middels de geannoteerde agenda, dit zal ik blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Hertzberger over de toezegging over de minimale stagevergoeding gedaan bij het commissiedebat MBO van 1 oktober 2025

MPs Van Hijum and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Education whether the promised preparation of a legally mandatory minimum internship allowance was limited, whether employers were expected to act first, and whether the Stagepact had worked. The minister confirmed the commitment to send the outline of a bill in Q2 2026, said an exploration of legal options is ongoing and that legislation is the next step if employer progress stays insufficient.
That is why I am now exploring how we can make this legally mandatory, and you will receive, as promised, the outline of a bill before summer 2026.
Daarom verken ik nu hoe we dit wettelijk kunnen verplichten en ontvangt u, zoals toegezegd, de contouren van een wetsvoorstel voor de zomer 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Saris over het bericht 'Basisscholen mogen helft van de lessen in het Engels, Duits of Frans geven: ‘een verrijking’'

Two MPs asked the state secretary whether allowing primary schools to teach up to 50% of lessons in English, German or French endangers Dutch language skills, given low literacy levels and the weight of the pilot's findings. The secretary answered that bilingual primary education does not harm Dutch skills, that schools will adopt it only where they have reason to, and that the pilot results and new core objectives adequately address the concerns.
With the decision on bilingual primary education, schools are given the option to provide up to 50% of instruction in English, French and German.
2 Met het besluit tweetalig primair onderwijs krijgen scholen de mogelijkheid om tot maximaal 50% onderwijs te geven in het Engels, Frans en Duits.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het Advies Informatievoorziening Infectieziektebestrijding (IV-IZB)

The MP asks why the IV-IZB infectious disease information programme was not checked earlier by the ICT review body, whether there were signs of coordination and governance problems, and how the programme will continue after the review advised stopping it in its current form. The minister answers that the programme was externally reviewed and that the review body postponed its planned check in 2024, that the programme will be stopped and restarted in phases with stronger ministry steering and SMART goals, and promises to inform parliament on the continuation.
The programme is being stopped in its current form, in line with the advice of AcICT.
Het programma wordt in zijn huidige vorm gestopt, in lijn met het advies van AcICT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Bruyning over de onderzoeksjournalistiek van Zembla naar de toename van illegale THC-vapes onder scholieren

Two Nieuw Sociaal Contract MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about rising use of illegal THC and synthetic-cannabinoid (spice) vapes among pupils, including health harms, enforcement, penalties, social media liability and possible bans. The government acknowledges serious concern, reports limited structured data and some local incidents, outlines penalties and enforcement responsibilities, and promises a meldpunt and further EU-level work, but declines a general vape ban as contrary to EU law and gives no answer splitting the questions separately.
This means that a general ban on vapes is in breach of European law.
Dit betekent dat het verbieden van vapes in zijn algemeenheid in strijd is met Europees recht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Bikker over het bericht Meisje (3) kan glimlachen en kijkt Peppa Big, maar van rechter mag haar beademing stoppen

MPs Hertzberger and Bikker asked about a court ruling allowing a hospital to stop ventilation for a severely ill three-year-old, and about the criteria for medically futile care, parental rights, reanimation policy and appeal procedures. The minister answered that the hospital's assessment of futility was shared by second opinions, that the court weighed the rights involved, that parents need not be removed from parental authority, and that appeal and review of the court's marginal test are matters for the courts.
It is not for me, as Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport, to sit in the judge's chair.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, om op de stoel van de rechter te zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Van Vroonhoven over het Onderwijsraadadvies 'Talige diversiteit benutten'

MPs Hertzberger and Van Vroonhoven asked the state secretary about the Onderwijsraad advice on linguistic diversity, including its evidence base, whether multilingual teaching is evidence-based, and whether other languages should get more room in primary education. The state secretary cited the advice's research basis, said schools may already use other languages under conditions, and promised a policy response in November, without committing to adopt the advice.
Your House requested a policy response to the Onderwijsraad advice on 11 September.
Uw Kamer heeft op 11 september om een beleidsreactie op het advies van de Onderwijsraad verzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het bericht Eén op de vijf horecazaken en supermarkten lapt tabaksverbod aan laars: ’Vapes en sigaretten liggen in achterkamertje in holle bank’

Hertzberger asked the State Secretary about reports that one in five shops and horeca businesses violate the tobacco sales ban, the adequacy of NVWA enforcement powers, and the generational sales ban. The State Secretary said enforcement is risk-based and that fines will rise 50% and first offences fined directly, while promising further measures after an online vape trade study and reports due later this autumn.
To increase compliance and give the NVWA more strength, I am structurally investing 3 million in enforcement.
Om de naleving te verhogen en de NVWA meer slagkracht te geven investeer ik structureel 3 miljoen in de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Six Dijkstra over het datalek van medische en persoonlijke gegevens bij het laboratorium van Clinical Diagnostics in Rijswijk

MPs Hertzberger and Six-Dijkstra asked how a hack at the Clinical Diagnostics laboratory exposed medical data of about half a million Dutch citizens, when the government was informed, why the breach was not disclosed sooner, and what minimum data security standards apply. The state secretary answered that independent investigations by BVO NL, the AP and the IGJ are underway, gave a timeline of notifications, stated that the cooperation with the laboratory was suspended, and largely deferred the detailed questions on data minimisation, certification and other laboratories to those ongoing investigations.
Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland (BVO NL) has launched an independent investigation into the exact scope and cause of this hack.
Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland (BVO NL) heeft een onafhankelijk onderzoek ingesteld naar de exacte omvang en de oorzaak van deze hack.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over enkele aspecten van de embryo-wetswijzigingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health about the embryo law amendments, covering the 14-day culture limit, whether research scope restrictions work in practice, CCMO oversight, clinical use of embryonic and iPS stem cells, patents, profit rules, IVG cloning and the new embryo definition. The State Secretary declined to change the 14-day limit because the cabinet is caretaker, and otherwise gave mostly descriptive answers without new commitments beyond noting CCMO could publish clarifications.
Because the cabinet is currently caretaker, I am leaving the substantive response to the advice to the next cabinet.
Omdat het kabinet momenteel demissionair is, laat ik de inhoudelijke reactie op het advies aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van Zanten en Hertzberger over het bericht ‘Niet-rendabele talenstudies verdwijnen, want studenten doen liever een brede bachelor’

MPs Stoffer, Van Zanten and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Education about reports that small language programmes such as French and German are being closed at Leiden and Utrecht, and what the government will do to keep a national offering. The minister acknowledges the concern, points to the sector plan Talen & Culturen, says institutions decide on closures under an existing advisory procedure, and commits to talks with the sector and a DLG action plan, while declining to set minimum norms or a numerus fixus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Martens-America over het bericht 'Experts waarschuwen: Chinese spionage escaleert en Westen krijgt er geen grip op'

MPs Martens-America and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Education about reports that Chinese espionage in Dutch knowledge institutions is escalating, including CSC scholarship PhD students, study-switching by Chinese students, and a Wageningen collaboration with Tencent. The Minister responded that knowledge security is a priority, pointed to a planned screening obligation and an expanded espionage offence bill, said study-switching is very limited, and that partnership decisions lie with institutions.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het antwoord op de feitelijke vragen van de vaste commissie voor OCW over de nota van wijziging inzake de vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Onderw

Hertzberger asked the Minister of Finance for the full calculation behind distributing the cross-government subsidy cut across departments, how subsidy budgets were defined and corrected, and how the coalition agreement cuts were taken into account. The Minister explained the allocation pro rata to subsidy budgets, excluding items already cut, items exempt under the coalition agreement, and compensation or Ukraine funds, reducing the base from about 14 to 3.9 billion euros for an effective cut of about 26%.
In the allocation the cabinet decided not to count subsidy budgets already cut under the coalition agreement in the base, because otherwise they would be cut twice.

Bij de verdeling heeft het kabinet besloten om de subsidiebudgetten waarop in het hoofdlijnenakkoord al wordt omgebogen niet mee te tellen in de grondslag omdat hier anders twee keer op wordt omgebogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen over studiefinanciering voor internationale studenten

An MP asks the Minister of Education how many international students receive supplementary grants, broken down by nationality, legal grounds and parental income assessment. The Minister declines to provide most figures for now, citing missing data, DUO's non-registration of nationality, and privacy rules on data linkage, promising to report in a spring monitor.
I do not yet have all the necessary data at this time to give a complete picture
Ik beschik op dit moment nog niet over alle benodigde gegevens om een compleet beeld te geven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over studiefinanciering voor internationale studenten

An MP asked the ministers how many international students enrolled in 2024/25, the working-hour rules for student finance, cross-EU comparisons, cumulation with foreign child benefit, and how parental income is assessed. The minister said 2024/25 enrolment data are not yet available (expected in the 2025 forecast), gave EER student finance figures, described the 32/24-hour rules, committed to pushing an EU-level definition of migrant worker, and answered the remaining questions on cumulation and income assessment.
The number of international students who have enrolled to study in the Netherlands in academic year 2024–2025 is not yet known.
Het aantal internationale studenten dat zich heeft ingeschreven om in studiejaar 2024–2025 in Nederland te studeren is nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het bericht in Leids Universitair Weekblad Mare “Fors bezuinigen? Dan moeten we terug naar de kern (en al het andere zonder morren opofferen)”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a student newspaper article on overhead spending at universities, including staff ratios, the share of central funding going to the core process, and how to monitor that spending. The Minister said universities have spending freedom and are accountable to internal bodies, that OBP staff are about 32% of total staff (stable since 2010), and that no definition of the 'primary process' exists, so no single percentage can be given.
There is no definition of what can be understood as the 'primary process'.
Er bestaat geen definitie van wat kan worden verstaan onder het «primaire proces».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over Hittegolven

An MP asked the Minister of Housing and Spatial Planning what crisis plans exist to protect vulnerable people during heatwaves, what policy applies to extreme heat like the 2021 Canadian heat dome, and whether cooled shelters can be organised locally. The government replied that the National Heat Plan is activated during heat periods and is being evaluated by RIVM, that current policy would continue in extreme heat with more emphasis on self-reliance, and that cooled shelters are a local matter that is not simple to organise.
In 2024 the Ministry of VWS commissioned RIVM to evaluate the National Heat Plan.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft in 2024 het RIVM opdracht gegeven om het Nationaal Hitteplan te evalueren

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het interview met Hoogleraar Psychiatrie Damiaan Denys in NRC Handelsblad 'De wens om niet te willen leven mag je niet gelijk stellen aan de wens om dood te zijn.'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a professor's NRC interview on euthanasia for psychiatric suffering, the rising number of such notifications among under-30s, psychiatrists' willingness to perform euthanasia, and whether the procedure and guideline should change for young patients. The government denied any loosening of the euthanasia law, gave the notification figures, said the guideline is being revised, and declined to propose a new multi-clinician decision body.
It is not known how much support exists within the profession for granting euthanasia requests from younger patients.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel steun bestaat voor het inwilligen van euthanasieverzoeken van jongere patiënten binnen de beroepsgroep.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk-Raeven en Hertzberger over de Kamerbrief 29338-276 over het Nationaal Versterkingsplan van Micro-chiptalent als reactie op het advies van speciaal gezant microchipindustrie Dhr. H.

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science about how the Nationaal Versterkingsplan Microchip-talent allocates funds across regions, including consultation with regions, the Beethoven-motion compliance, selection of regions, training numbers, and whether Twente, Groningen and Limburg receive fair shares. The Minister answered all 17 questions, explaining that regional plans exceeded the budget and failed to show delivery to industry, that allocation follows industry hiring practices concentrated in Brainport, and that revised plans are due by 29 September.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Holman over het bericht ‘Experts bezorgd om vogelgriep bij Amerikaanse koeien: is Nederland voorbereid op een uitbraak? 'Tests liggen klaar'’

MPs Hertzberger and Holman asked the Minister of Agriculture about H5N1 avian flu in US dairy cattle, including surveillance, risks for Dutch dairy farming, trade restrictions and vaccines. The minister answered that the Netherlands is well informed via several channels, that the Dutch monitoring system would detect an infection quickly, and that contingency scenarios are being prepared, but gave no firm commitments beyond informing parliament later.
Once the research results are known, expected shortly after summer 2024, I will inform the House of Representatives about this.
Zodra de onderzoeksresultaten bekend zijn, naar verwachting kort na de zomer van 2024, zal ik de Tweede Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Olger van Dijk over het bericht ‘Kabinet versoepelde exclusief voor Schiphol de bestaande stikstofregels’

MPs Hertzberger and Olger van Dijk asked the government why Schiphol's nitrogen permit allowed external netting without an additionality requirement, why 500,000 flights were permitted despite advice pointing to 440,000, and about nearby habitat overload. The Minister of Nature and Nitrogen answered that the permit followed a technical assessment and that the reference situations and external netting were applied as before, with limited nitrogen increases, while partly deferring to other responsibilities and procedures.
I was advised by officials to make the decision, as I did in September 2023.
Mij is ambtelijk geadviseerd om het besluit te nemen, zoals ik dat in september 2023 genomen heb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Hertzberger  over perinatale zorg

MPs Bikker and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Medical Care about the 24-week lower limit for active neonatal care of extremely premature babies, international comparison, and whether guidelines should change given new evidence. The minister answered that the guideline keeps the 24+0 week threshold, that clinicians may deviate in individual cases after consultation with parents, and that the guideline was published in March 2024 with a new revision planned from 2025.
In the previous and revised guideline, the lower limit for offering active care is an estimated gestational age of 24+0 weeks.
In de vorige en herziene richtlijn is de ondergrens voor het bieden van actieve opvang een geschatte zwangerschapsduur van 24+0 weken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het artikel ‘Overijssel voorlopig niet van stikstofslot: boeren en projecten langer in onzekerheid?’

An MP asked the minister about stalled permitting in Overijssel and the PAS-melders awaiting legalisation under the nitrogen policy, including how many have been legalised and when the piekbelasting scheme will deliver results. The minister answered that external netting is only very limitedly allowed, that 2488 legalisation requests exist with most still pending, and that no precise timeline or deposition reduction can yet be given, while promising a broader action plan.
It is still too early in the implementation process to give a picture of the potential nitrogen deposition reduction of the peak-load approach.
Het is nog te vroeg in het uitvoeringsproces om een beeld te geven van de potentiële stikstofdepositiereductie van de aanpak piekbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het toepassen van een rekenkundige ondergrens in AERIUS Calculator

MP Hertzberger asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen why a 25 km calculation cut-off was adopted in AERIUS Calculator instead of a minimum deposition threshold, how much deposition it shifts, what compensating measures would be needed, and whether the IPO round-table records and the interbestuurlijke verkenning can be shared. The minister answered that the 25 km limit applies to all sources on modelling grounds, that a legally defensible lower threshold still requires further research with results expected mid-2024, and committed to sharing the verkenning results and the round-table minutes.
I will inform your House as soon as the results are available.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren zodra de resultaten beschikbaar zijn.

m: Motie van het lid Bamenga c.s. over steun uitspreken voor de totstandkoming van het EU-Mercosur-verdrag
Motion asks the government to express support for the EU-Mercosur trade agreement while respecting Dutch strategic sovereignty, agriculture and food safety.
requests the government to express support for the conclusion of the EU-Mercosur agreement
verzoekt de regering steun uit te spreken voor de totstandkoming van het EU-Mercosur-verdrag

Asks the government, in consultation with BO Akkerbouw, for a concrete phased plan to introduce a crop protection benchmarking system.
requests the government, in consultation with at least BO Akkerbouw, to come as quickly as possible with a concrete step plan
verzoekt de regering in overleg met in ieder geval BO Akkerbouw zo snel mogelijk met een concreet stappenplan te komen
