Asks the government to allow use of contraceptive darts on wolves if it decides to control wolf packs.
requests the government, should it decide to control our wolf packs, to make possible the use of contraceptive darts
verzoekt de regering om, mocht men besluiten tot beheersing van onze wolvenroedels over te gaan, de inzet van anticonceptiedarts mogelijk te maken
Motie van het lid Van Campen c.s. over de middelen voor Agrarisch Natuur- en Landschapsbeheer inzetten in het landelijke gebied en direct laten bijdragen aan de verplichtingen ten aanzien van natuur,

Asks the government to use the agricultural nature and landscape management funds for measures in the countryside that directly contribute to nature, climate and water obligations, following the existing collectives structure.
requests the government to ensure that the ANLb funds are deployed in the rural area
verzoekt de regering ervoor zorg te dragen dat de middelen voor ANLb worden ingezet in het landelijk gebied
Motie van het lid Beckerman c.s. over een call-inbevoegdheid voor de ACM om overnames te toetsen zodat lokale machtsposities in de dierenzorg kunnen worden voorkomen

Asks the government to give the ACM a call-in power to review small acquisitions creating local market dominance in animal care, and to examine tackling existing monopolies, reporting to the House in early 2025.
requests the government to give the ACM a call-in power to review targeted acquisitions
verzoekt de regering om de ACM een call-inbevoegdheid te geven om gericht overnames te toetsen
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over een deel van het budget voor Agrarisch Natuur- en Landschapsbeheer en ecosysteemdiensten gebruiken voor een extensiveringsregeling
Asks the government to use part of the structural budget for agricultural nature and landscape management for an extensification scheme.
requests the government to also use part of the available budget for agricultural nature and landscape management and ecosystem services for an extensification scheme
verzoekt de regering een deel van het beschikbare budget voor Agrarisch Natuur- en Landschapsbeheer en ecosysteemdiensten ook te gebruiken voor een extensiveringsregeling
Motie van het lid Flach c.s. over zorgen voor consistentie in de hoogte van de vergoedingen voor de eco-regeling en voor voldoende middelen binnen de beschikbare budgetten
Asks the government to align eco-scheme payment rates for nitrogen-binding crops in 2025 with past years and secure sufficient funds.
requests the government to align the payments for nitrogen-binding crops in the eco-scheme for 2025
verzoekt de regering de vergoedingen voor onder meer stikstofbindende gewassen in de eco-regeling voor 2025 in lijn te brengen
Motie van de leden Holman en Van Campen over voor het aankomende mestdebat een uitgangspuntennota aan de Kamer sturen over de nieuwe brede beëindigingsregeling
Asks the government to send the House a policy outline on the new broad termination scheme for farms before the manure debate, so parliament can be involved early.
requests the government to send the House a policy outline on the new broad termination scheme before the upcoming manure debate
verzoekt de regering om voor het aankomende mestdebat een uitgangspuntennota aan de Kamer te sturen over de nieuwe brede beëindigingsregeling
Motie van de leden Van Campen en Van der Plas over meer differentiatie in toezichtskosten en bestuurlijke kosten bij zelfslachtende slagers en grotere slachthuizen
Asks government for a fixed NVWA contact point for small slaughterhouses and differentiated supervision fees and fines favouring self-slaughtering butchers, budget-neutral.
requests the government to differentiate more in supervision costs and administrative fines
verzoekt de regering meer te differentiëren in toezichtskosten en bestuurlijke boetes
Motie van de leden Van Campen en Holman over bij weegmomenten monitoren hoe de leasemarkt voor pluimvee- en varkensrechten zich ontwikkelt en eventuele ongewenste effecten tegengaan
Asks the government to monitor, at weighing moments, how the pig and poultry lease market develops and to consider measures if undesirable effects arise.
requests the government, in consultation with the poultry and pig sectors, to monitor at the weighing moments how the lease market for poultry and pig rights develops.
verzoekt de regering in overleg met de pluimvee- en varkenshouderij bij de weegmomenten te monitoren hoe de leasemarkt voor pluimvee- en varkensrechten zich ontwikkelt
Motie van de leden Van Campen en Grinwis over het PBL de effecten van de voorgestelde maatregelen ten aanzien van waterkwaliteit en stikstof- en broeikasgasemissies laten analyseren
Asks the government to have the PBL analyse the water quality, nitrogen and greenhouse gas effects of the derogation bill measures and propose alternatives if water quality improves insufficiently.
requests the government to have the proposed measures analysed by the Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency on target achievement regarding water quality
verzoekt de regering om de voorgestelde maatregelen te laten analyseren door het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving op doelbereik ten aanzien van waterkwaliteit
Motie van de leden Holman en Van Campen over invulling geven aan een samenhangend maatregelenpakket voor ondersteuning van bedrijfsopvolgingen in de agrarische sector
Asks the minister to talk with young farmers and develop a package of measures to support farm succession inside and outside families.
requests the Minister to soon talk with young farmers and give substance to a coherent package of measures
verzoekt de Minister op korte termijn in gesprek te gaan met jonge boeren en invulling te geven aan een samenhangend maatregelenpakket
Motie van de leden Grinwis en Van Campen over de brede beëindigingsregeling zo snel mogelijk in 2025 openstellen en dit bij de voorjaarsbesluitvorming betrekken
Asks the government to open the broad manure-farm termination scheme as early as possible in 2025 and inform the House on progress.
requests the government to do everything possible to open the broad termination scheme as soon as possible in 2025
verzoekt de regering alles in het werk te stellen om de dit jaar meermaals aangekondigde brede beëindigingsregeling zo snel mogelijk in 2025 open te stellen

Motie van de leden Hertzberger en Van Campen over het eerste jaar na invoering van de wet experimenteerruimte bieden en samen met bedrijven de implementatie inclusief informatiesystemen gereed krijgen
Asks the government to give businesses a first-year grace period and build information systems with firms for the EU deforestation regulation, and to standardise due-diligence formats for SMEs.
requests the government to give the first year after introduction of the law room for experimentation
verzoekt de regering het eerste jaar na invoering van de wet experimenteerruimte te bieden

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Van Campen ter vervanging van nr. 16 over een aangepaste invulling van intrinsieke waarde, het afbouwen van ingrepen zonder diergeneeskundige noodz
Requires that the order-in-council on animal husbandry under the new article 2.3a may only be submitted four weeks after the draft has been laid before both Houses, giving parliament a pre-review.

The proposal for a general administrative order to be established under article 2.3a, first and third paragraphs, shall not be submitted earlier than four weeks after the draft has been laid before both Houses of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens artikel 2.3a, eerste en derde lid, vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Motie van het lid Vedder c.s. over het oprichten van een onafhankelijke autoriteit dierwaardige veehouderij
Asks the government to set up an independent authority to monitor progress on animal welfare in livestock farming across sector, market, chain and government.
requests the government to start as soon as possible setting up an independent authority for animal-worthy livestock farming
verzoekt de regering om zo snel mogelijk aan de slag te gaan met het oprichten van een onafhankelijke autoriteit dierwaardige veehouderij
Motie van de leden Van Campen en Bromet over zich hardmaken voor verbetering van dierenwelzijn in de veehouderij in heel Europa
Asks the government to advocate at European level for better animal welfare in livestock farming across Europe.
requests the government to press at European level for improved animal welfare in livestock farming across Europe
verzoekt de regering zich in Europees verband hard te maken voor verbetering van dierenwelzijn in de veehouderij in heel Europa

Sets design principles and a 2040 deadline in law for animal-welfare-based livestock farming and phasing out certain procedures.
This amendment aims to realise animal-worthy livestock farming.
Dit amendement beoogt een dierwaardige veehouderij te realiseren.

Amendement van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Van Campen ter vervanging van nr. 15 over een aangepaste invulling van intrinsieke waarde en het in de wet vastleggen van ontwerpprincipes voor regels ten be

By or pursuant to a general administrative order, rules are set for designated physical interventions
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden voor de op grond van artikel 2.8, tweede lid, onder b, aangewezen lichamelijke ingrepen
Motie van het lid Van der Plas c.s. over alsnog de aangenomen motie-Van Campen c.s. over innovatieve technologieën uitvoeren
Asks the government to implement the previously adopted motion on innovative technologies to reduce nitrogen emissions in agriculture.
Motie van de leden Grinwis en Van Campen over voortzetting van het meetinitiatief in de Regio Foodvalley mogelijk maken
Motion asking the government to enable continuation of a farm measurement initiative in Regio Foodvalley and expand such systems.

Antwoord op van het lid Van Campen over het bericht dat Europese subsidies mogelijk hebben bijgedragen aan de sluiting van Vredestein in Enschede

An MP asks whether EU-approved Hungarian state aid to Apollo Tyres, which may have contributed to the closure of Vredestein in Enschede, is acceptable and what can be done about job losses and staff support. The minister replies that the Commission approved the aid under the rules then in force and found no direct causal link, acknowledges a possible indirect effect, and promises to monitor the application of anti-relocation rules and to explore European support for affected workers.
The cabinet critically monitors the application of these provisions and is attentive to the risk of relocation resulting from expanded possibilities for EU member states to grant state aid.

MP Van Campen asked the minister about using EU defence-related funding for civil infrastructure such as the Sicily bridge, and whether criteria for 'defence-related' projects are sharp enough. The minister answered that CEF dual-use rules, military mobility requirements and Commission assessment guard against misuse, and that he will urge the Commission to prioritise military urgency in a future financial instrument.
I therefore call on the Commission to look closely at the criteria for projects eligible for financing from the EU budget.

The minister declined to comment on the ruling, said the law already covers entry without forced entry, and pointed to a WODC study due in summer 2025 that may inform possible legal changes.
I understand the discomfort the ruling will cause for some. At the same time, it is an independent judicial ruling that we must respect, and as Minister I will not comment on its substance.

I will shortly hold a discussion with the Raad van Beheer on this and will also invite the NVWA given its knowledge of some breeding regulations.

An MP asks the state secretary about RVO findings that the Dolfinarium breaches its show permit conditions with about twenty unnatural animal behaviours, and about the contradictory NVWA inspection, breeding, a possible ban and revocation. The state secretary confirms the RVO findings, says the NVWA inspection was a pre-announced snapshot without violations, names the performances as the first breach of their kind, and announces a study into a possible ban on public interaction, due early next year.
I find it objectionable; clear agreements were made that are attached as conditions to the permit.
Ik vind het kwalijk, er zijn duidelijke afspraken gemaakt die als voorschriften aan de vergunning zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Terwijl Hongaarse parlement Pride verbiedt, radicaliseert Orbán: zijn critici betitelt hij als ‘bedwantsen’’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about Hungary's 2025 anti-LGBTIQ+ legislation banning Pride and restricting assembly, its compatibility with EU fundamental rights, the suspension of EU cohesion funds, and possible Article 7 steps. The minister replied that the Commission must first assess legal compatibility, that the Netherlands has voiced concern bilaterally and in Council of Europe and EU fora, and that the Article 7 majorities are not currently in sight.
The Netherlands calls on the Commission to do this expeditiously and to take action if it finds that EU law has been infringed.
Nederland roept de Commissie op om dit voortvarend te doen en actie te ondernemen indien zij constateert dat het Unierecht is geschonden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Meulenkamp, Bromet, Holman, Boomsma en Podt over gesprekken met de Deutsche Umwelthilfe en Agora Agrar gedurende het werkbezoek aan Berlijn van 15 tot en met 18 januari 2025

Six MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the German Stoffstrombilanzverordnung, a nutrient balance regime for farms, could inform the Dutch design of an enforceable nutrient balance and emissions targets, and whether the Dutch government would engage German authorities and report back. The minister answered that the German scheme is similar to the planned Dutch balance, that Dutch data sources exist, that lessons will be drawn, and that the minister is willing to talk with Germany and inform parliament if this yields insights.
I am willing to discuss this with the German government. If this leads to additional insights, I will inform you about it.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met de Duitse overheid. Indien dit tot aanvullende inzichten leidt, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Waveren en Van Campen over het bericht “EU betaalt voor 'groene promotie'; Subsidie aan milieuclubs in ruil voor lobby”

MPs Omtzigt, Van Waveren and Van Campen asked the Foreign Minister whether EU Commission subsidies to NGOs for lobbying MEPs on climate plans ("lobbycontracten") were known to the Dutch government, whether the Commission should be pressed for disclosure, and whether Dutch ministries have similarly commissioned lobbying. The minister answered that the Dutch government had no knowledge of these contracts, that no transparency rules were reported broken, that the government awaits the Commission's follow-up, and that no central overview of Dutch subsidies for lobbying is kept.
The cabinet awaits further steps from the Commission.
Het kabinet wacht nadere stappen van de Commissie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Van Campen, Graus en Pierik over de dure importcontroles bij groente en fruit

MPs from SGP, VVD, PVV and BBB asked why residue controls on imported fruit and vegetables at the national reference lab WFSR are so expensive compared with private labs in Belgium, and whether private labs could be allowed to do them. The government answered that the NVWA cost-recovery tariffs cover sampling, transport and lab analysis, that WFSR is non-profit and independence rules rule out private labs for now, and that a study and consultation with industry are underway with results promised before summer.
I will also commission a research bureau to look into this further. Your House will be informed about this before the summer.
Ook zal ik een onderzoeksbureau opdracht geven om dit nader uit te zoeken. Uw Kamer zal hier voor de zomer over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Van Campen over het bericht 'Moldavië kondigt noodtoestand af vanwege wegvallen Russisch gas'

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister how she views Moldova's declared state of emergency over the loss of Russian gas, Russia's role, and what the Netherlands can do to support Moldova's energy security and reduce dependence on Russia. The minister answered that Russia's gas cut-off is destabilising, that the Netherlands is considering short-term EU support, and cited past and ongoing Dutch and EU energy and resilience assistance, without committing to new specific measures.
The Netherlands is currently considering, within the EU, how it can provide additional short-term support to Moldova.
Nederland beziet momenteel in EU verband op welke manier het Moldavië extra kan ondersteunen op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Holman over stikstofvergunning plasticfabrikant

MPs Van Campen and Holman asked the minister about a court ruling forcing the province of Brabant to reduce the unused nitrogen permit space of plastics producer Sabic, asking about legal basis, precedent, and national nitrogen policy. The minister answered that the court's order is conditional, that the province must decide anew, that precedent is only relevant if upheld on appeal, and that the government is pursuing structural emission reduction, while committing to inform parliament on a motion about intern salderen.
I will inform you shortly about the implementation of this motion.
Over de uitwerking van deze motie zal ik u op korte termijn informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Van Campen over het bericht «Europese miljarden voor bestrijding migratie in Afrika komen nauwelijks goed terecht: «school zonder elektriciteit kreeg blender cadeau»»

MPs Kamminga and Van Campen asked the ministers whether the EUR 4.5 billion EU Trust Fund for Africa spent on curbing migration had real impact, following a European Court of Auditors report on poor spending. The minister answered that the government does not share the report's conclusion of negligible impact, accepts the auditors' recommendations, will press the Commission to implement them, and says there is no ready-made formula for migration control.
The Netherlands will firmly urge the European Commission to implement this and will ask the Commission to inform the member states about it.
Nederland zal er bij de Europese Commissie stevig op aandringen dat dit ook gebeurt en zal de Europese Commissie vragen de lidstaten hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het Radio 1 interview ‘5 jaar BBB: Waar komt de partij vandaan en waar gaan ze naar toe’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture whether she endorses a BBB MP's remarks on agricultural policy and whether the government will fully implement the coalition agreement's commitments on nitrates derogation, Natura 2000, manure and generic cuts to animal rights. The minister declined to comment on the party colleague's remarks, said she is working to deliver the agreement while depending on negotiations and EU factors, and referred to earlier letters for details, stating she cannot guarantee no generic cut.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Brug en Van Campen over bericht ‘Georgië neemt omstreden wet aan tegen lhbtqia+-rechten’ en het bericht ‘Beroemde trans vrouw vermoord in Georgië na invoering wet tegen lhbtqia+-re

MPs Van der Burg and Van Campen asked the Foreign Minister about Georgia's new anti-LGBTQ+ law and the reported murder of a trans woman after its adoption. The minister condemned the law as undermining fundamental rights and EU values, said EU accession has effectively stalled, and said the government would await the murder investigation and keep pressing Georgian authorities.
Regarding the horrific murder of Kesaria Abramidze, the cabinet is awaiting the investigation into it.
Met betrekking tot de gruwelijke moord op Kesaria Abramidze wacht het kabinet het onderzoek hiernaar af.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Michon-Derkzen over het uitrijden van mest met drugsafval door boeren in Baarle-Nassau

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Campen asked the ministers whether drug waste being spread with manure on Baarle-Nassau fields reflects a wider problem, what tools police and environmental services have, and how municipalities and farmers can be protected. The ministers answered that the case is still under investigation, the scale of drug-waste dumping is unknown, existing enforcement tools and the Veilig Buitengebied and farmer contact-person initiatives are described, and no cases of food-chain harm are known.
The investigation into the Baarle-Nassau case is still ongoing. It has not yet been established how the drug waste ended up on the field.
Het onderzoek in de casus Baarle-Nassau loopt nog. Er is nog niet vastgesteld hoe het drugsafval op de akker terecht is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Grinwis en Bromet over het bericht dat de minister alle basisscholen in Nederland het boek “Wat zeg ik? Hondentaal voor kids”

MPs Van Campen, Grinwis and Bromet asked whether the ministry of agriculture was really sending the children's dog-behaviour book to all primary schools, why, and at what cost. The state secretary confirmed it, said it was meant to reduce dog bites among children aged 6-10 and cost about EUR 45,000, but that after consultation with the education ministry the mailing was cancelled and an alternative destination is being considered.
In consultation with the State Secretary of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (OCW), it has now been decided not to send the books to primary schools anymore.
Inmiddels is in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW) besloten de boeken niet meer te versturen aan basisscholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht ‘Brussels considers sanctions on Slovakia over backsliding on rule of law.’

Dutch MP Van Campen asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Brussels is considering sanctions on Slovakia over rule-of-law backsliding, including abolition of the special prosecutor's office and dismantling of public broadcasting, and about parallels with Hungary and Russian influence. The minister answered that the government monitors Slovakia closely, that it is primarily for the Commission to assess Union-law breaches, and that the government urges swift, effective EU action using existing rule-of-law instruments, without taking a new national position.
It is primarily for the Commission, in its role as guardian of the EU Treaties, to assess whether Slovakia has breached Union law and to act against it where necessary.
Het is primair aan de Commissie om, in haar rol als hoedster van de Verdragen, te beoordelen of Slowakije het Unierecht schendt en hier indien nodig tegen op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht ‘Minister Wiersma trekt ruim 200 miljoen extra uit voor aanpak PAS-melders’

MP Van Campen asks whether the €226.9 million for PAS-melders is on top of the €250 million from the Voorjaarsnota 2024, how it is effective, what provinces must do, and whether external netting can legalise PAS-melders. Minister Wiersma explains the €250 million was reduced by reserved amounts, outlines the provincial approach, the Lbv-plus and planned TNO follow-up research, and that the Transitiefonds is replaced by a €5 billion budget.
The amount made available under this scheme is lower because part of it is held separately for anticipated costs, as explained in the publication.
Het beschikbaar gestelde bedrag in deze regeling is lager omdat hiervan een deel apart wordt gehouden voor voorziene kosten zoals is toegelicht in de publicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Kahraman, Paternotte, Dobbe, Van Campen en Ceder over het vredesproces tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs asked the government about the Armenia-Azerbaijan peace process, including the trilateral meeting in Washington, Azerbaijan's demand to amend Armenia's constitution, and what the Netherlands could do to speed up a deal. The minister said the government urges both sides toward a durable agreement based on mutual recognition of territorial integrity, declined to comment publicly on negotiating positions, and noted EUMA's de-escalating role and a mandate running to February 2025.
However, it is not in the interest of the negotiating parties to publicly address their negotiating positions in this answer.
Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelende partijen om in deze beantwoording publiekelijk in te gaan op de onderhandelingsposities van de partijen bij de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Bulgaria's new anti-LGBTQ law is official. Opponents beg EU to take action.’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether a Bulgarian law banning 'propaganda' of non-traditional sexual orientation and gender identities in and around schools breaches EU non-discrimination principles, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government answered that the European Commission is primarily responsible for assessing compliance with EU law, that the Netherlands will raise concerns bilaterally and at EU level, has already voiced concerns publicly, and funds LGBTQ+ organisations including in Bulgaria.
The Netherlands will, together with like-minded member states, raise concerns about the amendment bilaterally and at EU level.
Nederland zal, in samenwerking met gelijkgezinde lidstaten, zorgen over de wetswijziging bilateraal en in EU-verband aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Rajkowski over het zonder veiligheidsonderzoek toelaten door Hongarije van Russische en Wit-Russische «gastarbeiders» tot het Schengengebied

Two MPs asked whether Hungary's extension of its National Card work permit to Russian and Belarusian workers without security screening violates Schengen and sanctions rules, and what risks this poses for the Netherlands. The government answered that individual entry bans still apply, that Hungary must still carry out border checks, that the Commission has asked Hungary for information and the Netherlands is awaiting its assessment, and that the risk of intelligence officers using this route is taken seriously.

EU Commissioner for Home Affairs Ylva Johansson requested by letter on 1 August that Hungary's Minister of Internal Affairs provide text and explanation at short notice on the extension of the National Card to Belarusian and Russian nationals.
Eurocommissaris voor Binnenlandse Zaken Ylva Johansson heeft op 1 augustus jl. per brief aan de Hongaarse Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken Hongarije verzocht op korte termijn tekst en uitleg te geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Bromet, Vedder en Holman over het rondetafelgesprek Wolf van 4 april 2024

MPs from four parties asked the ministers about LIFE and Regional Development Fund subsidy options for wolf coexistence measures raised at a round-table meeting, and whether these had been examined. The minister replied that LIFE and EFRO funding are possible in principle but no concrete study was done, provinces are responsible, and she will raise the options with the provinces and set up a long-term coexistence vision.
I will bring these options to the attention of the provinces.
Ik zaldeze mogelijkheden onder de aandacht brengen bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht ‘Boetes elk jaar omhoog, behalve voor dierenleed in slachthuizen’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why fines for animal welfare violations in slaughterhouses have not been raised since 2012/2013 while other fines rise yearly. The Minister answered that an inflation correction is planned, that larger slaughterhouses may face higher fines, that a new procedure is targeted for July 2025, and that the NVWA is working to shorten the long delays before fines are issued.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Campen over de productie van groengas via monomestvergisting

Two VVD MPs asked the minister why small monomanure digestion projects already granted SDE++ subsidies at the old lower rate cannot switch to a new higher-rate category, and whether this undermines viable business cases. The minister confirmed that switching is not possible once a subsidy decision is granted, that the rate increase was communicated in advance, and that projects which did not proceed can reapply in 2024.
It is undesirable, and therefore not possible, to submit a new SDE application in a subsequent year after receiving an SDE++ decision merely because tariffs have risen in that year.

Het is niet wenselijk, en daarom niet mogelijk, om nadat men een SDE++ beschikking heeft gekregen opnieuw in een daaropvolgend jaar een SDE-aanvraag in te dienen, enkel omdat in dat jaar de tarieven gestegen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Van Hijum over het bericht 'Slovakia’s president warns Robert Fico is testing ‘limits of democracy''

MPs Van Campen and Van Hijum asked the Foreign Minister about Slovakia's rule-of-law backslide, Russian influence and Fico's pro-Russian statements, and what the Netherlands would do in EU fora. The minister answered that the Commission is the primary actor to assess and act on Slovakia's rule-of-law problems, that the Netherlands stresses full use of EU rule-of-law instruments, and that it will keep raising the issue with the Commission and member states without committing to a specific new step.

It is now primarily for the Commission, in its role as guardian of the Treaties, to assess whether Slovakia violates the rule-of-law principles laid down in the Treaties and to act against this if necessary.

Het is nu primair aan de Commissie om, in haar rol als hoedster van de Verdragen, te beoordelen of Slowakije de rechtsstatelijke beginselen die in de Verdragen zijn neergelegd schendt en hier indien nodig tegen op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het artikel ‘Wilde theorieën’ over hoe sporen van amfetamine bij 23 mestfabrieken terechtkwamen’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that amphetamine was found in digestate at 23 manure digesters, whether a chemical process could explain the positive tests, the effect on manure processing capacity and the manure market, and the status of a motion requesting cost-benefit analyses of losing the derogation. The minister confirmed the detections, said the cause is still under investigation with no evidence yet for the chemical explanation, and said the affected digesters cannot sell digestate under the Opium Act while the market effects are unclear and cost-benefit results are expected after the Christmas recess.
Once the cause is known, measures can be taken to prevent the presence of amphetamine in the future.
Zodra de oorzaak bekend is, kunnen maatregelen worden getroffen om de aanwezigheid van amfetamine in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht 'Achttien boeren willen Veluwse boerderij kopen, maar horen al ruim een jaar niks na bod'

The MP asks the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about a stalled provincial tender in which eighteen farmers want to buy a Veluwe farm, and about provinces' tools and capacity for extensification, innovation and relocation, plus PAS-melder legalisation budget rules. The minister says Gelderland is responsible for the tender, promises an instrument toolkit by early 2024, a guidance note on passende beoordeling by end 2023, and will look welwillend at a provincial proposal to extend the Rpmp deadline.
In this case the province of Gelderland is responsible for the tender procedure of this company.
In dit geval is de provincie Gelderland verantwoordelijk voor de aanbestedingsprocedure van dit bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Campen over het artikel «Rekenfout in groengas-subsidie absurd: honderd Overijsselse boeren missen nu smak geld»

MPs Erkens and Van Campen (VVD) asked the Climate and Energy and Agriculture ministers about a calculation error that lowered SDE++ subsidy base amounts for green gas projects by 20-25%, affecting farmers' planning. Minister Jetten answered that PBL corrected its advice, that the amounts remain higher than in prior years, that no specific project or volume expectations exist, and refused to restore the original amounts or compensate preparation costs, while promising PBL advice on small-scale digesters for SDE++ 2024.
I have asked PBL to provide advice on small-scale digesters so that they can be appropriately stimulated in SDE++ 2024.
Ik heb wel PBL gevraagd om advies uit te brengen voor kleinschalige vergisters, zodat ze in de SDE++ 2024 passend gestimuleerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Campen over het bericht 'Anje dreigt haar boerderij kwijt te raken: 'Het is ons levenswerk, maar er is geen uitweg''

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about a farm family facing loss of their dairy farm, and whether government advisers discuss all buy-out and relocation/innovation schemes or only the cessation schemes. The minister answered that advisers discuss all schemes on the farmer's initiative, that the conversation is confidential and voluntary, and that the remaining schemes will be published or opened by end 2023.
Given the confidentiality of this conversation, no details about it are shared here.
Gezien de vertrouwelijkheid van dit gesprek worden hier geen details over gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Van Campen over het bericht 'Uitspraak gebruik pesticiden bij lelieteelt slaat in als een bom'

MPs Vedder and Van Campen asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a court ruling restricting pesticide use at a lily farm near residents in Dwingeloo, and whether it undermines the Ctgb's authority. The minister answered that the appeal court overturned the injunction, that the precautionary principle leaves room for case-by-case restrictions, that the Ctgb remains a reputable authority, and that a brochure on good neighbourliness was sent to the House.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Boerenorganisatie LTO wil dat dierenextremisten worden gestraft: 'Bijna elke dag insluipingen''

MPs Van Campen and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked about reports that farm organisation LTO wants animal-rights extremists punished for stable occupations and break-ins, and whether current law and police registration are adequate. The Minister of Justice answered that existing offences (trespass and unlawful entry) can be prosecuted, that a separate police classification for such incidents is currently undesirable, and that follow-up steps such as talks with the sector and a review of earlier agreements are being considered.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van Campen over het adviesrapport 'Goed water goed geregeld' van de Raad voor de leefomgeving en infrastructuur (Rli)

Two VVD MPs (Minhas and Van Campen) asked the minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government responds to the Rli advice on the Water Framework Directive, whether the 2027 targets are achievable, what the main obstacles are, and whether projects could stall. The minister answers that urgency is high, the KRW impulse programme has started, exemptions are possible only under strict conditions, and that project stalling is not expected generically though specific projects may be affected, referring largely to the separate cabinet response for further measures.
As indicated in the Water Committee debate of 7 June, achieving the goals of the Water Framework Directive is a top priority.
Zoals aangegeven in het Commissiedebat Water van 7 juni is het behalen van de doelen van de Kaderrichtlijn Water een topprioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Boer Erik Jan doelwit criminele bendes:” Ze hebben alles gesloopt”

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Campen (VVD) asked whether GPS theft from farm vehicles by organised, mostly Eastern European gangs is rising, where it occurs, what police and the ministers are doing about it, and how agricultural areas are protected against criminal takeover. The government answered that GPS thefts have risen slightly, concentrated in four regions, and described police prevention, cross-border information exchange, registration databases and ongoing public-private cooperation, while stating these thefts do not qualify as high impact crimes.
In 2023, up to 30 May, around 50 reports or complaints were received of GPS theft from barns, stables or a farmyard.
In 2023 zijn er tot 30 mei ongeveer 50 meldingen of aangiftes ontvangen van diefstal van GPS uit schuren, stallen of van een erf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Weer een tegenvaller bij Gecombineerde opgave’

MPs Boswijk and Van Campen asked the Minister of Agriculture about a system error in the Gecombineerde opgave that forced farmers to re-confirm their parcels, and about compensation, deadlines and support. The Minister acknowledged the error and its burden on farmers, but ruled out compensation or a general deadline extension, offering only two extra weeks to add eco-activities and extended helpdesk hours.

I have decided that farmers who indicated in the Gecombineerde opgave that they participate in the eco-scheme have until 30 June, after the closing of the Gecombineerde opgave, to make adjustments and add eco-activities.

Ik heb besloten dat boeren die in de Gecombineerde opgave hebben aangegeven dat ze aan de eco-regeling deelnemen, na de sluiting van de Gecombineerde opgave tot 30 juni hebben om aanpassingen te doen en eco-activiteiten toe te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Boswijk en Van Campen over het ontbreken van consumptieaardappelen op de lijst met winterteelten

MPs Bisschop, Boswijk and Van Campen asked why late-harvested consumption potatoes were left off the winter-crop list, which exempts fields from the cover-crop rule and the nitrogen-norm cut, and whether exceptions could be granted based on residue measurements or sustainability scores. The minister answers that potatoes fail all three winter-crop criteria, that the 1 October cover-crop deadline and the reduced nitrogen norm are required under the 7th Nitrates Directive action programme, and that no exceptions are possible for now.
There is therefore no room for alternatives that are less effective at improving water quality.
Er is dan ook geen ruimte voor alternatieven die minder effectief zijn voor het verbeteren van de waterkwaliteit.
Antwoord op van de leden Valstar, Van Campen, Bisschop, Grinwis en Boswijk over ‘bestaand gebruik’ in relatie tot de toetsing van de garnalenvisserij aan de Wet natuurbescherming

MPs from VVD, SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about the Landsadvocaat's advice on whether shrimp fishing licences under the Visserijwet can count as existing use (bestaand gebruik) for Wet natuurbescherming permits, and whether the 1994 licences should be investigated. The minister answered that the legal route is highly complex, that the sector must itself reconstruct licence and emission data via AIS and logbooks, and that the sector remains responsible for the nitrogen deposition calculations.
I share that observation and gladly give these fishers the opportunity and room to demonstrate this.
Ik deel die constatering en biedt deze vissers graag de kans en ruimte om dit aan te tonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Valstar over de bedreiging van de inheemse natuur door het rode gevaar: ‘de Amerikaanse rivierkreeft’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the threat posed by the American crayfish to native nature, including the status of a strategy and pilots, the feasibility of large-scale culling, dike safety, and the legal framework for fishing gear. The minister answered that the strategy is still being developed, large-scale eradication in open waters is not feasible, pilots and a new selective trap are underway, and broader non-professional fishing would need careful weighing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Campen en Michon-Derkzen over bescherming van boeren tegen drugscriminaliteit en het tegengaan van ondermijning in het buitengebied.

Two VVD MPs asked how farmers can be protected against drug crime and undermining activity in rural areas, including whether a Brabant model rental contract could be rolled out nationally and how it relates to mayors' powers under Article 13b of the Opium Act. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the risk is real nationwide, describes existing pilots and a model contract, says municipalities should decide how to apply it, and declines to consult the VNG and IPO.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I want to encourage such initiatives and take them further.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid wil ik dergelijke initiatieven stimuleren en verder brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van Campen en Sahla over het bericht “Veel vraag naar kinderopvang bij boer, maar regels belemmeren uitbreiding”

MPs Van den Hil, Van Campen and Sahla asked about reports that rules hinder agricultural childcare on farms, and about the obstacles raised by sector bodies, municipal zoning tied to farm turnover, staffing, health effects and next steps. The ministers answered that a 'Life event' regulatory review with VNG, LTO and the Chamber of Commerce is underway, that the Multifunctional Agriculture and Spatial Planning guidance is being updated, and that they see no evidence that agricultural childcare is disadvantaged on quality or staffing.
We are in discussion with the parties involved about the obstacles that have been raised.
Met de betrokken partijen zijn we in gesprek over de belemmeringen die zijn aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over een Agro E-label

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture about the Agro E-label, a digital label for plant protection product barcodes, and whether labels could be digitised and integrated with location and weather data. The minister answered that physical labels are required by EU law, that digital labelling depends on pending EU amendments, and that she is favourably disposed to allowing digital labels in principle.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het artikel ‘Agractie vreest consequenties wijziging Habitatrichtlijngebieden'

Van Campen (VVD) asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about the addition of about 150 habitat types and 70 species to Natura 2000 areas through an amendment decision, its legal basis, and the resulting uncertainty for businesses and citizens. The minister answered in detail, defending the amendment as a correction of incomplete designations required by the Habitats Directive, acknowledging limited nitrogen-permit consequences, and stating that further amendments are not ruled out.
It concerns the 'Amendment decision Habitats Directive areas due to present values' of 22 November 2022.
Het gaat om het «Wijzigingsbesluit Habitatrichtlijngebieden vanwege aanwezige waarden» van 22 november 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over de vergunningsaanvragen in de visserijsector

MPs Valstar and Van Campen (VVD) asked about expiring Wnb nature permits for the shrimp fishing sector, the late deadline for new permit applications, the Brexit adjustment subsidy, the existence of an acquired right, and the delayed emissions-reduction subsidy. The minister answered that permits expire on 1 January 2023, applications were submitted on 30 June 2022 but required supplementation, the Landsadvocaat advised that no acquired right exists, and a subsidy is expected to open in January 2023 with a possible nine-month tolerance arrangement.
The Landsadvocaat considers it highly uncertain whether the specific requirements for claiming such an acquired right can be met.
De Landsadvocaat acht het uiterst onzeker of de specifieke vereisten voor het kunnen claimen van een dergelijk bestaand recht zijn in te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen Van den Hil en Van Campen over het artikel ‘Populaire kinderopvang bij de boer gehinderd door starre regels’

Two VVD MPs asked whether rules hinder agricultural childcare (kinderopvang bij de boer), including limits on the side branch, fine-particulate norms, procedures, and relaxed staffing rules. The ministers answered that they are in talks with LTO, VAK and VNG about local permitting obstacles, but gave no concrete list of rules or a coulance scheme.
Unfortunately it was not possible to send the answers before the committee debate, because coordination with the various parties took more time.
Het is helaas niet gelukt de antwoorden voor het commissiedebat te versturen, omdat de afstemming met de verschillende partijen meer tijd vergde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Campen en Grinwis over het bericht 'Boer Arjan moet verplicht zijn veestapel drastisch verkleinen; "Ze maken je helemaal kapot"'

MPs Boswijk, Van Campen and Grinwis asked the minister why promised legalisation of PAS-melder farms has not been delivered, whether the state will pay enforcement penalties, and whether an emergency law or provincial relief is possible. The minister says the legalisation programme, a 250 million euro provincial grant and a damages desk are being pursued, but that withholding enforcement is legally very difficult and penalties cannot be paid by the state.
It is a statutory obligation to have the measures implemented in time.
Het is een wettelijke opgave om de maatregelen tijdig uitgevoerd te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Campen en Bisschop over het bericht 'Wolf blijft zorgen voor problemen: ook kalveren en pony’s slachtoffer'

Three MPs (Boswijk, Van Campen, Bisschop) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about rising wolf attacks on livestock, the handling of damage compensation, the legal status and management options for the wolf, and related policy. The minister replied that the issues are known, that prevention measures under the Interprovincial Wolf Plan are considered adequate, that management is not currently permitted because no favourable conservation status has been reached, and that an international wolf plan with Germany is in preparation.
That is why I, together with the provinces, am committed to properly protecting livestock and hobby animals in order to prevent animal suffering.
Daarom zet ik, samen met de provincies, in op het goed beschermen van vee en hobbydieren om daarmee het dierenleed te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen naar aanleiding van het artikel 'nieuwe uitkoopregeling op de tocht'

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen whether the new buy-out scheme for farmers ceasing operations risks being unlawful state aid, given the European Commission's insistence on a no-restart condition, and what steps are being taken to get EU approval for voluntary buy-out schemes. The minister confirmed the Commission's conditions, said the government is working on the Lbv and MGA-2 schemes and will notify them as soon as possible, and gave the status of the running MGA-1 scheme.
It is my intention to notify the Lbv to the European Commission as soon as possible and open it.
Het is mijn voornemen om de Lbv zo snel mogelijk bij de Europese Commissie te notificeren en open te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Haverkort over het bericht 'Grote giftige spin rukt op: in hele land gesignaleerd'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about a newspaper report on the false wolf spider spreading across the Netherlands, its danger to humans, and whether it should count as an invasive alien species. The minister answered that the spider poses little danger to humans, that it has established itself in the Netherlands through human-assisted introduction, that it is not on the EU invasive species list, and that the ministry works with other governments on prevention, control and restoration.
This spider poses no danger to humans.
Deze spin vormt voor mensen geen gevaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Boswijk en Van Campen over ‘werkbezoeken aan de grensregio in het kader van stikstof en de aangenomen motie over verschillen aan de grens’

Omtzigt, Boswijk and Van Campen ask about nitrogen-related management and differing rules at the German border, including Natura 2000 areas, cross-border cooperation, monitoring, and planned visits to border farms. The minister answers that cooperation with Germany works well, that the KDW is exceeded in some habitats due to foreign deposition, that cross-border management is being coordinated, and that she will visit three border locations on 22 August while withholding exact locations for security reasons.
In light of all the unrest, during the preparation of working visits, on the advice of the security services (police and the ministry's security service), we do not make the exact locations public.

In het licht van alle onrust maken we tijdens de voorbereiding van werkbezoeken, op advies van de veiligheidsdiensten (politie en beveiligingsdienst binnen het ministerie), de exacte locaties niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Verstrekkend stikstofvonnis zet bouwvergunningen voor meer dan 30 duizend woningen op losse schroeven’

Two VVD MPs asked the housing and nitrogen ministers how a court ruling blocking nitrogen permits for about 30,000 homes affects housing permits, who is responsible for mitigation measures, and how natuurinclusief building could help. The minister answered that finalized permits remain in force, that nitrogen space from the speed-reduction measure is no longer allocated, that responsibility for national mitigation lies with the Rijk while initiators handle project-level measures, and that a binding nature-inclusive construction scheme is too early to develop.
No, permits that have become irrevocable remain in force.
Nee, onherroepelijk geworden vergunningen blijven in stand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Bevers over het bericht 'Fryslân wil geen extra stikstofgevoelig Natura 2000-gebied'

MPs Van Campen and Bevers (VVD) asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about reports that Fryslân opposes additional nitrogen-sensitive Natura 2000 areas through the Wijzigingsbesluit Habitatrichtlijngebieden. The Minister answered that the amendment will be adopted after the recess, that the underlying data date from 2017, that no new nitrogen-sensitive areas are added, and that legal consequences for permit holders are still being investigated.
The draft amendment decision was developed in good consultation with the lead parties of the areas.
Het ontwerpwijzigingsbesluit is in goed overleg met de voortouwnemers van de gebieden tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van Campen over het jachtbeleid

MPs Bisschop and Van Campen asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about the hunting policy after a court annulled the national exemption for fox hunting, and about contested counts suggesting game populations are underestimated. The minister said she will appeal, is preparing a new exemption decree, and will not open the hunt for rabbit in any province and for hare in three provinces next season while reviewing the rest.
I therefore intend to appeal against the ruling.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om hoger beroep in te stellen tegen de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Van Campen over het bericht 'Levend koken van varkens in slachthuizen gaat nog altijd door'

MPs De Groot and Van Campen asked the minister about reports that pigs were still being scalded alive in slaughterhouses, repeat violations, sanctions, late reporting, camera surveillance and the Beter Leven label. The minister answered that repeat cases were handled with maatwerk interventions and fines, promised a verscherpt toezicht procedure and a camera-surveillance bill, but declined to lower slaughter speeds generically and left the label question to private bodies.
The report the questioners refer to concerns information the NVWA made public following a Wob request.
Het bericht waarop de vragenstellers doelen, ziet op informatie die de NVWA heeft openbaargemaakt op grond van een Wob-verzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van Campen over investeringen in stalsystemen Noord- Brabant

MPs Boswijk and Van Campen asked whether the stricter Noord-Brabant ammonia limits for livestock stables from 2024, and the lack of national transition funds until 2023-2024, create an unequal playing field, and asked the minister to give Brabant farmers early access to subsidies. The minister acknowledged the province's stricter norms and its support, said national stable subsidies will open in Q3 2022 with the aim of giving Brabant farmers early access, and said the timing of stricter emission norms is being explored.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over het bericht 'waanzinnige regels dreigen garnalenvisser Eddy Sinke de nek om te draaien'

MPs Valstar and Van Campen (VVD) asked the ministers of Agriculture and of Nature and Nitrogen about shrimp fishers facing new Nature Conservation Act permit requirements by 1 January 2023, including nitrogen rules, unclear assessment methods, monitoring of engine hours, and the absence of a phased path to compliance. The ministers answered that the sector must apply for permits itself with LNV support, that the 1 January 2023 date will not be moved, that provinces are not parties, and that a subsidy scheme and a fisheries vision are being developed.
I am therefore not willing to make an exception for the fishers regarding the date of the new nature permit.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid een uitzondering te maken voor de vissers als het gaat om de datum van de nieuwe natuurvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van Campen over het bericht 'Schoon water is in Nederland nog ver weg'

MPs Minhas and Van Campen (VVD) asked the ministers about a news report that clean water is far off in the Netherlands, including the EU Water Framework Directive risks for 2027. Minister Harbers answered that the water quality picture is complex, that most chemical norms are met but biological and nutrient norms lag, and that further measures and possible use of exemptions are planned.
I do not share the view that water quality is not good in all respects.
Het beeld dat de waterkwaliteit op alle onderdelen niet goed is, deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Boswijk over ‘het meten van stikstofuitstoot, het stikstofregistratiesysteem en latente stikstofruimte in vergunningen’

Two MPs asked how nitrogen emissions from agriculture and industry are measured and reported, how the SSRS registry tracks available nitrogen space, and how latent unused permit space is handled. The minister answered that reporting rules are largely EU-based, that the registry tracks only deposition space not emissions, that latent space is not registered, and that measures to restrict its use are being explored with provinces.
The size and use of latent space in permits is not registered.
De omvang en ingebruikname van latente ruimte in vergunningen wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Michon-Derksen over activiteiten van radicaal extremistische dierenactivisten

MPs Van Campen and Michon-Derkzen asked about criminal activities by radical animal-rights extremists (stable occupations, break-ins, arson, smear campaigns, online intimidation), overview of cases and sentences, enforcement roles, legal basis and disclosure of farm data. The minister said no overview is available since there is no specific classification for animal-rights extremism, police remain primarily responsible with an agreed contact point and factsheet, and existing legal grounds suffice, while committing to examine stronger penalties and to send a letter to farm organisations before summer.
It is not possible for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to provide an overview of the past 10 years of such criminal activities on and around agricultural businesses.
Het is voor de politie en het OM niet mogelijk om een overzicht te geven van de afgelopen 10 jaar betreffende dergelijke strafbare activiteiten op en rond een agrarisch bedrijf
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van Campen over het gebruik van de RAV-lijst voor vergunningverlening

MPs Boswijk and Van Campen asked the minister about Utrecht province's decision to stop using the RAV emission-factor list for permits pending appeal, and whether emission-reducing stables can be relied on. The minister answered that provinces may depart from standard factors, that the RAV method is not in question (only its use for Natura 2000 certainty), rejected removing factors from the list, and promised further study and consultation without firm deadlines.
Provinces are the competent authorities for granting permits under the Wet Natuurbescherming.
Provincies zijn bevoegde gezagen voor het verlenen van vergunningen in het kader van de Wnb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink, Kamminga en Van Campen over de nadelige gevolgen van het sluiten van de grenzen in Groot-Brittannië met betrekking tot de invoer van aardappelpootgoed uit de EU

MPs asked whether Brexit trade barriers harming the Dutch seed potato sector, including SMEs, would be eased by a derogation or by Brexit Adjustment Reserve support. The minister acknowledged the sector's difficulties, rejected a special derogation for seed potatoes, said export options to the UK are being explored but are complex, and pointed to an internationalisation programme and individual support.
However, this is extremely complex and time-consuming.
Dit is echter uiterst complex en tijdrovend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Van Campen over de fok en verkoop van kortsnuitige honden

MPs Haverkort and Van Campen asked about a Kassa broadcast showing online sales of short-snouted puppies below the legal skull-nose ratio, the NVWA's enforcement, and the Raad van Beheer's use of the Cambridge test and pedigree papers. The minister said the NVWA inspects breeders against six criteria (15 controls in 2021, 6 violations), that the Raad van Beheer should be held to account, and that the stock of imported and bred pets is still under study with a letter promised this spring.
I am looking into this. I will inform the House about it this spring.
Ik ben dit aan het onderzoeken. Ik informeer uw Kamer dit voorjaar hierover.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Campen over het bericht ‘Explosie in stal in Maarsbergen, brandweer redt twintig koeien uit de mestput’

MP Van Campen asked the ministers about a 2021 barn explosion in Maarsbergen and whether emission-reducing floor systems raise explosion risks, and about research, sector measures, safety requirements and RVO permitting. The minister answered that the studies do not show explosions caused by emission-reducing floors, that several safety measures and innovation requirements are being pursued, and that RVO will consider safety in permit applications.
The studies do not show that stable explosions have occurred as a result of an emission-reducing floor system.
Uit de onderzoeken volgt niet dat er stalexplosies zich hebben voorgedaan als gevolg van een emissiearm vloersysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over de berichten 'Vogelgriepuitbraken ondanks ophokplicht, strop pluimveesector dreigt» en «Europa kampt met zwaarste vogelgriepuitbraak ooit'

MP Van Campen asked the minister about rising avian influenza outbreaks despite the housing order, how infections enter farms, enforcement and reporting of dead wild birds, the case for regional lifting of the housing order, vaccination, free-range egg labelling, and the EU animal health regulation. The minister answered that transmission is mainly via wild birds, that enforcement is by sampling with written warnings so far, that a new risk assessment by the expert group will be requested, and that vaccination and free-range egg rules are under consideration.
I am asking the expert group for a new risk assessment in the short term.
Ik vraag de deskundigengroep op korte termijn om een nieuwe risicobeoordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over de beoordeling van de European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) van noodtoepassingen van neonicotinoïden op suikerbieten in 2020/2021

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the Netherlands did not grant emergency derogations for neonicotinoid pesticides on sugar beet in 2020 and 2021 when eleven other EU member states did, and whether this put Dutch farmers at a competitive disadvantage. The Minister replied that granting derogations is a member state competence, that the NVWA and Ctgb advised negatively on the applications, that alternative non-neonicotinoid derogations were granted instead, and that a sector research project seeking alternatives is under subsidy consideration.
I have therefore entered into consultation with the sector to look for solutions that fit within the principles of integrated crop protection and within my Future Vision Crop Protection 2030.
Ik ben daarom met de sector in overleg gegaan om te zoeken naar oplossingen die passen binnen de principes van geïntegreerde gewasbescherming en binnen mijn Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Valstar over de berichten ‘Dode en gewonde schapen in Vlijmen, waarschijnlijk door wolf’ en ‘Duitsland pleit voor intensievere jacht op wolf’

Two VVD MPs asked the agriculture minister about reports of sheep killed by wolves in Vlijmen, calls for more farmer support, compensation levels, the 2023 end of the compensation scheme, and hunting wolves as in Germany. The minister replied that prevention is primary, the existing compensation procedure is adequate, attack figures rise with wolf numbers, the scheme is extended to 2022 pending a new wolf plan, and lethal culling has little proven effect.
The coming year will therefore focus on more information and communication about the wolf in the Netherlands and on prevention methods.
Het komende jaar zal daarom worden ingezet op meer voorlichting en communicatie over de wolf in Nederland en over preventiemethoden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht 'Honderden veehouderijen bij natuurgebieden mogen toch uitbreiden'

An MP asked the Minister whether farms near nature areas have expanded and added nitrogen emissions, and whether low-emission stable measures are less effective than expected and legally sound. The minister answered that there is no overview of expansions because internal use of already-permitted emission space needs no new permit, that the legal certainty of existing permits is safeguarded, that a CBS/CDM study and provinces' appeal against court rulings are pending, and that she is willing to talk with provinces about fairness for farmers acting in good faith.
There is no overview, either with me or with the provinces, of the number of farms that have actually expanded.
Er is geen overzicht, bij mij en bij provincies, over het aantal bedrijven dat daadwerkelijk is uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Erkens over het bericht: ‘Klimaatimpact Nederlandse veestapel fors overschat’

MPs Van Campen and Erkens asked the ministers about a report claiming the climate impact of the Dutch livestock herd was overestimated, including whether an IPCC method change reduces cow impact threefold and how methane should be treated versus CO2. The government answered that the IPCC report does not claim cows' impact is three to four times lower, that GWP* only expresses short-lived gases' warming differently over time while GWP100 remains the international standard, and promised to send a cabinet appreciation of the IPCC report, which it had already done.
The IPCC report 'assessment report 6' does not contain such a claim.
In het IPCC rapport «assessment report 6» is een dergelijke stelling niet opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Aanscherping leenregime banken zet boeren in de kou’

MPs Heinen and Van Campen asked whether the planned Basel IV bank capital rules would make financing agricultural investment harder, and what the government was doing about it. The Finance Minister answered that the impact depends on how the EU implements the rules and on banks' choices, that talks with banks and DNB have taken place, and that the Commission's proposal and impact analysis will be awaited before the government sets its position.
The cabinet acknowledges the importance of ensuring that agricultural sector financing remains guaranteed now and in the future.
Het kabinet erkent het belang dat de financierbaarheid van de agrarische sector nu en in de toekomst gewaarborgd blijft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht 'Rechter: Overijssel moet handhaven op vergunning beweiden en bemesten'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a court ruling requiring the province of Overijssel to enforce permit requirements for grazing and manure application, and about how clearly 'existing use' must be substantiated and how nitrogen targets can be made feasible. The minister replied that enforcement against grazing and manure application is disproportionate in most cases, that national guidelines on proving existing use will be developed, and that some answers were delayed.
With the provinces it has been agreed that no enforcement action is taken when grazing and manure application take place, because no permit under the Nature Conservation Act is required for them.
Met provincies is afgesproken dat er niet handhavend wordt opgetreden indien er wordt beweid en bemest, omdat daarvoor geen vergunning op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming is vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over het bericht ‘hartenkreet van boeren: ‘Alsjeblieft, pak het jacobskruiskruid aan!’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about farmers' complaints over the toxic ragwort (jacobskruiskruid), its spread, inconsistent local management and a possible eradication duty. The minister acknowledged the toxicity and said the number of affected animals is probably small and the species is native and valuable for biodiversity, so no national policy or eradication duty is planned, with management left to local managers.
I regret that, but this is no reason to draw up policy for it.
Dat betreur ik, maar dit vormt geen aanleiding om hier beleid voor op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Nederland raakt met landbouw-innovaties achter op China’

MPs Valstar and Van Campen asked whether Dutch agricultural biotechnology (CRISPR-Cas) is falling behind China and the US due to outdated EU rules, and what the government is doing to relax EU GMO regulation for plants. The ministers answered that CRISPR-Cas patent publications are lower in Europe, that the Commission study confirms current GMO rules need adapting, that the Netherlands is lobbying for a derogation, though the EU has not granted one.

The cabinet will continue to stress the urgency of this subject and continue to advocate for future-proof European regulation that leaves sufficient room for innovation while safeguarding human and environmental safety.

Het kabinet zal de urgentie van dit onderwerp blijven benadrukken en blijven pleiten voor toekomstbestendige Europese regelgeving die voldoende ruimte biedt voor innovatie en tegelijkertijd de veiligheid voor mens en milieu borgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht dat veel minder varkensboeren gebruikmaken van de Subsidieregeling sanering varkenshouderijen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that far fewer pig farmers than expected are using the pig farm closure subsidy, attributing this to municipalities not cooperating on land repurposing and to slow procedures. The minister denied that municipalities are obstructing, said deadlines were extended up to 1 April 2021 so farmers had six to eight months, and promised a status letter in June with updated figures.
I cannot inform the House in May as previously promised, because the expected nitrogen effect is not yet known.
Ik kan uw Kamer niet in mei informeren, zoals eerder toegezegd, omdat het verwacht stikstofeffect nog niet bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht dat de natuur in het Korenburgerveen bij Winterswijk zich beter ontwikkelt dan voorspeld op basis van theoretische stikstofmodellen

An MP from the VVD asked the minister whether nature at the Korenburgerveen is developing better than nitrogen models predict, and whether water-management measures and area-specific approaches should be used more widely. The minister confirmed the research, said area-by-area inventories and hydrological measures are already part of policy, and partly endorsed the conclusions while cautioning that nitrogen effects remain visible.
That call fits seamlessly with the policy pursued by me and my predecessors.
Die oproep sluit naadloos aan bij het door mij en mijn voorgangers gevoerde beleid.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Wassenberg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 19 over verhoging van de strafmaxima
Amendment raises maximum criminal penalties for animal abuse and neglect offences from three to five years and from category four to five fines, and for lesser offences from six months to one year.
This amendment provides for an increase in the maximum penalty for all offences related to animal cruelty and neglect.
Dit amendement regelt een verhoging van het strafmaximum op alle delicten gerelateerd aan dierenmishandeling en -verwaarlozing.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Wassenberg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over verhoging van de strafmaxima
Amends the Animal Welfare Act to raise maximum criminal penalties for animal cruelty and neglect offences, from three to five years and from six months to one year for lesser offences.
This amendment provides for an increase in the maximum penalty for all offences related to animal cruelty and neglect.
Dit amendement regelt een verhoging van het strafmaximum op alle delicten gerelateerd aan dierenmishandeling en -verwaarlozing.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Haverkort c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over aanpassing van de termijn van het houdverbod en/of gebiedsverbod
Allows courts to impose an animal-keeping or area ban for life or up to thirty years in cases of animal cruelty.
The measure may be imposed for life or for a period of at most thirty years.
De maatregel kan voor de duur van het leven of voor een periode van ten hoogste dertig jaren worden opgelegd.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Haverkort c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over aanpassing van de termijn van het houdverbod en/of gebiedsverbod
Lets judges impose a animal-keeping and area ban for life or up to thirty years for animal cruelty, expanding sentencing discretion.
This amendment provides that the keeping ban and/or area ban may be imposed for a period set by the judge of up to 30 years or for life.
Dit amendement regelt dat het houdverbod en/of gebiedsverbod voor een door de rechter te bepalen tijd van maximaal 30 jaar dan wel voor levenslang kan worden opgelegd.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Wassenberg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 15 over verhoging van de strafmaxima
Raises maximum penalties for animal cruelty, neglect and dogfighting offences to five years or a fifth-category fine, and for lesser animal welfare offences to one year or a fourth-category fine.
So as not to tamper with the current system of the Animals Act, a general increase has been chosen for all offences related to animal cruelty and neglect.
Om niet te tornen aan de huidige systematiek van de Wet dieren is gekozen voor een algemene verhoging van alle delicten gerelateerd aan dierenmishandeling en -verwaarlozing.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Haverkort c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over aanpassing van de termijn van het houdverbod en/of gebiedsverbod
Lets judges impose an animal-keeping or area ban for life or up to thirty years instead of the previously set limit.
The measure may be imposed for life or for a period of at most thirty years
De maatregel kan voor de duur van het leven of voor een periode van ten hoogste dertig jaren worden opgelegd.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haverkort over het Telegraaf artikel ‘afval scheiden is een grote bende’

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about reports that much separated plastic waste is incinerated due to contamination, and about waste policy (standardisation, diftar, restwaste targets). The state secretary acknowledged some cases, stressed local variation, said standardisation is being explored and a report is due in early 2024, and largely rejected the claimed links between diftar or machine sorting and contamination.
The rejection of waste streams is something that occurs between municipalities and processors, and I have no national oversight of it.
Het afkeuren van afvalstromen is iets dat speelt tussen gemeenten en verwerkers en daar heb ik op landelijk niveau geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haverkort over de berichtgeving in diverse media inzake het potentieel sluiten van hertenkampen

Haverkort (VVD) asked the minister about media reports that deer parks may be closed under the new house and hobby animal list, covering heritage status, consequences, consultation, transition rules, and whether the list can be amended. Minister Adema answered that the ban follows from objective criteria, transition rules let existing deer be kept until death, heritage protection covers structures rather than animals, and objections or change requests are possible after six weeks.
I do not have figures on the number of fallow deer in the state-protected deer parks.
Ik beschik niet over de aantallen damherten die in de rijksbeschermde hertenkampen staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haverkort over het artikel in dagblad Trouw over ‘Schone as van afval legt het af tegen goedkopere vuile variant’

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Trouw report that clean bottom ash from waste incinerators is left unused while dirty ash is used, and about the lack of progress since the 2012 green deal. The State Secretary acknowledged the contamination, stated that ash must meet the Besluit bodemkwaliteit, said the 2020 green-deal goal is achieved, and committed to further talks with industry and inclusion of immobilisation in the Circulair Materialenplan.
I am aware of this signal and will engage with the companies on the further sustainable use of bottom ash and the bottlenecks they experience.
Ik ben bekend met dit signaal en ga met de bedrijven in gesprek over de verdere verduurzaming van bodemassen en de knelpunten die daarbij worden ervaren.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Erkens en Haverkort over wind op land

MPs Erkens and Haverkort asked whether the planned timetable for new national noise and distance norms for onshore wind turbines (including the Danish 4x tip-height norm) is still feasible and when temporary norms can be applied. The State Secretary answers that the new rules are expected in early 2024 after a plan-MER procedure, that legally no temporary national norm can be imposed before that, and that municipalities must set site-specific conditions in the meantime.
The State Secretary of I&W is committed to ensuring that new regulations for onshore wind turbines can enter into force in early 2024.
De Staatssecretaris van IenW zet zich ervoor in dat begin 2024 nieuwe regelgeving voor windturbines op land in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Haverkort over het bericht dat Bouwend Nederland waarschuwt dat er gaten in de weg komen door een dreigende asfaltcrisis

Two VVD MPs asked whether the government would delay scrapping the approved measure for asphalt production, warning of asphalt shortages and effects on roads, circularity and costs. The Staatssecretaris answered that asphalt plants can meet the emission norms, so production will not stop, that the measure was withdrawn because it could not guarantee compliance, and that she will not relax the emission norms.
No, the approved measure has been withdrawn, see the answer to question 4.
Nee, de erkende maatregel is ingetrokken, zie antwoord onder vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Agnes Mulder en Haverkort over de rol van afvalenergiecentrales in Nederland

MPs Bontenbal, Agnes Mulder and Haverkort asked about the Royal HaskoningDHV report on waste-to-energy plants, the effects of the waste import levy on CO2 emissions, the role of waste incinerators in a climate-neutral system, CO2 capture and chemical recycling. State Secretary Heijnen answered that the levy reduced cross-border waste incineration, disputed the claimed emissions increase, and said incinerators will play a shrinking role as waste is shifted to higher-value recycling, while committing to examine how instruments can support both transitions.
The cabinet will examine in the coming period how instruments can be deployed to support both the transition to a climate-neutral economy and the transition to a circular economy.

Het kabinet zal de komende tijd bezien hoe instrumenten zo kunnen worden ingezet dat zij zowel de transitie naar een klimaatneutrale economie als de transitie naar een circulaire economie ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen die van het lid Haverkort over de campagne ‘Drafsport? Onsportief!’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Dier&Recht campaign against harness aids and bits in harness racing, citing a Finnish study on mouth injuries. The minister acknowledged the concerns, noted a correlation rather than causation, said the sector's rules are being reviewed and that a research institute is inventorying welfare risks, but declined to commit to a ban and said the NVWA supervises animal welfare mainly on complaints.
I can agree with this call. Aids that carry a high risk of harm to animal welfare should not be used.
Ik kan me vinden in deze oproep. Hulpmiddelen waarbij er een groot risico is op welzijnsaantasting zouden niet gebruikt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haverkort over het bericht ‘Nederland is kampioen plastic afval exporteren, Plastic Soup Foundation wil een verbod’

MP Haverkort (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the Netherlands exports the most plastic waste within the EU to non-EU countries such as Indonesia and Vietnam, and about calls for an export ban, recycling rates, and chemical recycling. The State Secretary answered at length, defending export for high-grade recycling pending EU capacity, pointing to the EU waste shipment regulation revision and existing 2% contamination limits, and describing recycling investment programmes.
Export to countries outside the EU is only permitted if those plastics are recycled in the destination countries.
