Uitvoer naar landen buiten de EU is alleen toegestaan als die kunststoffen in de bestemmingslanden worden gerecycled.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Haverkort over de campagne 'Koop geen kortsnuit'

MPs Wassenberg and Haverkort asked the minister about the 'Koop geen kortsnuit' campaign, criteria for breeding, Cambridge-method screening, and Raad van Beheer pedigrees issued to brachycephalic dogs bred contrary to law. The minister supports the campaign and information efforts, says criteria are still being developed with the EGD, and says the pedigree issuing is a private matter the government cannot prohibit.
Issuing pedigrees is a private matter for which there is no statutory regulation.
Het afgeven van stambomen is een private aangelegenheid waarvoor geen wettelijke regeling geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Chris Simons over het bericht 'Tientallen Deventenaren trekken witte pakken aan om asbest te verwijderen: 'Dat sjouwen wordt nog zwaar''

MPs Haverkort and Chris Simons asked about a Deventer initiative in which residents helped remove asbestos, the scale of remaining asbestos on private, business and government roofs and buildings, the cost of government asbestos removal, and why a foam-based removal method had not been approved by the VIP. The State Secretary answered that such initiatives exist via Milieu Centraal's asbestos-free shed week, that complete inventories of asbestos in government buildings are not feasible or efficient, that cost data are unavailable, and that foam methods have been approved in several cases while applicants are encouraged to submit requests.
This is unfortunately not possible. Research to find this out would cost a lot of time and money due to the large number of clients
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk. Een onderzoek om dit te achterhalen zou veel tijd en geld kosten vanwege het grote aantal opdrachtgevers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Haverkort over het bericht 'Grote giftige spin rukt op: in hele land gesignaleerd'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about a newspaper report on the false wolf spider spreading across the Netherlands, its danger to humans, and whether it should count as an invasive alien species. The minister answered that the spider poses little danger to humans, that it has established itself in the Netherlands through human-assisted introduction, that it is not on the EU invasive species list, and that the ministry works with other governments on prevention, control and restoration.
This spider poses no danger to humans.
Deze spin vormt voor mensen geen gevaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Koerhuis over het bericht dat chemisch afval massaal wordt gebruikt als scheepsbrandstof

MPs Haverkort and Koerhuis asked the government about reports that chemical waste is being mixed into marine fuel, including questions on enforcement, EU waste definitions and the financial incentive to mix waste. The State Secretary and Minister mostly deferred substantive answers to a promised letter to parliament on ILT enforcement results, while describing existing REACH, MARPOL and Dutch fuel rules.
The further answering of these questions will address existing regulations and efforts, pending the results of the commitments being carried out.
De verdere beantwoording van deze vragen zal ingaan op bestaande regelgeving en inzet, in afwachting van de resultaten van de in uitvoering zijnde toezeggingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort, Koerhuis en Peter de Groot over de uitzending van EenVandaag over mogelijke tekorten in industriezand en grind

VVD MPs asked the government whether extraction permits for sand and gravel are expiring, whether shortages will arise, and how supply will meet the infrastructure and housing ambitions. The minister answered that a monitoring system and a national demand forecast are being developed, that circularity measures are underway, and that talks with provinces and the sector are ongoing.
At present, the need for sand and gravel is being mapped in cooperation with knowledge institutes and industry organisations. The House will be informed of the results before the end of the year.

Op dit moment wordt – in samenwerking met kennisinstituten en brancheorganisaties – de behoefte aan zand en grind in beeld gebracht. De Kamer zal voor het eind van het jaar over het resultaat worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden van de leden Koerhuis en Haverkort over ongelukken met e-bikes en drukte op fietspaden

MPs Koerhuis and Haverkort asked the minister about reports of more accidents with fast e-bikes and crowded cycle paths, including causes, prevention, sales information, speed tuning, and path design. The minister answered that the role of e-bikes is still being studied with results due by end 2022, outlined educational campaigns and infrastructure investments, and said the government will inform parliament before year end.
By the end of 2022 at the latest, your House will be informed of the results.
Uiterlijk eind 2022 wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Van Campen over de fok en verkoop van kortsnuitige honden

MPs Haverkort and Van Campen asked about a Kassa broadcast showing online sales of short-snouted puppies below the legal skull-nose ratio, the NVWA's enforcement, and the Raad van Beheer's use of the Cambridge test and pedigree papers. The minister said the NVWA inspects breeders against six criteria (15 controls in 2021, 6 violations), that the Raad van Beheer should be held to account, and that the stock of imported and bred pets is still under study with a letter promised this spring.
I am looking into this. I will inform the House about it this spring.
Ik ben dit aan het onderzoeken. Ik informeer uw Kamer dit voorjaar hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Visser en Azmani over de gevolgen van toenemende agressie van verstekelingen

MPs Visser and Azmani asked about reports of rising aggression by stowaways targeting truck drivers near Calais, the scale of harm to Dutch drivers and transport firms, and whether the government will re-engage France and EU partners. The minister says the government has received no signals of increasing problems, cannot provide figures on driver victims, points to French responsibility for Calais security and existing EU rules, and sees no need for new talks now.
I have no figures on the number of Dutch drivers who have fallen victim to violence and threats since 2015.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend over aantallen Nederlandse chauffeurs die sinds 2015 slachtoffer zijn geworden van geweld en bedreigingen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Jetten over het bericht ‘Reclameborden op A'dam CS weten wanneer en hoelang jij kijkt’

MPs Verhoeven and Jetten asked the government about reports that cameras in advertising billboards at Dutch railway stations, including Amsterdam Centraal, collect viewer data. The government answered that NS and operator Exterion Media turned off the cameras and software after the publicity, claimed only anonymous statistical counts were generated, and noted the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is asking questions.

Following the conversation, it was decided to switch off the cameras and underlying software on the billboards, even though according to Exterion Media it falls within all applicable laws and regulations.

Naar aanleiding van het gesprek is besloten om de camera’s en achterliggende software op de borden uit te zetten, ondanks het feit dat het volgens Exterion Media binnen alle geldende wet- en regelgeving valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse truckers die niet meer naar Engeland rijden vanwege agressie door verstekelingen

MPs Gijs and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Dutch truckers have stopped driving to England because of violence by stowaways and what the government is doing about it. The minister says there is no general picture of companies halting England routes, cites ongoing EU-level cooperation, secure parking funding via CEF and joint anti-crime work with industry, and reports contact with transport associations.
According to the information currently available to me, there is no general picture of transport companies in the Netherlands no longer driving to England because of aggression by stowaways.

Volgens de mij op dit moment beschikbare informatie is er geen sprake van een algemeen beeld dat transportondernemingen in Nederland niet meer naar Engeland rijden vanwege agressie door verstekelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Groothuizen over de Nederlandse transporteur die stopt met ritten naar Engeland vanwege problemen met vluchtelingen die als verstekeling meereizen

MPs Jetten and Groothuizen asked the government what it has done about stowaway migrants in Calais threatening Dutch truck drivers, and whether a European approach and insurance measures are in hand. The minister replied that the Calais security situation is the responsibility of the French authorities, that the government raises it in European and bilateral channels, and that it works with the transport sector, without committing to new concrete steps.
The security situation in Calais falls under the responsibility of the French authorities.
De veiligheidssituatie in Calais valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Franse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het afsluiten van drinkwater

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether disconnecting a single mother and her three children from drinking water in Hoorn is acceptable, how often households were disconnected for water, gas and electricity, and what the government will do to prevent disconnections of vulnerable households and children. The minister acknowledged that disconnection is serious and must be avoided, announced a planned revision of the water disconnection regulation requiring a minimum water supply for four days, and otherwise defended the existing policy, declining to change the rules, to investigate the convenant, or to treat minors as vulnerable consumers.
I therefore see no reason to carry out the research you requested.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om het door u gevraagde onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de naleving van de Richtlijn Industriële Emissies (RIE) (2010/75/EU)

Mr Laçin (SP) asks about the Commission's letter on Dutch compliance with the Industrial Emissions Directive regarding the Afvaloven Nee case and the treatment of measurement uncertainty margins at the Omrin waste incinerator. The Secretary of State says the facts are unchanged, that exploitants set uncertainty margins under provincial supervision as upheld by the Council of State, that work on better and harmonised methods is ongoing, and that the Commission has not taken Netherlands to task, while promising to update guidance once better methods exist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat grond van een bungalowpark is vervuild met GenX

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that soil at a new holiday park in Papendrecht was contaminated with GenX and C8, and whether authorities should take stronger measures such as stricter permit conditions. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the contamination is consistent with earlier air-deposition findings, noted that no reuse standards yet exist for these substances, and stated that the emission permit is under legal challenge so she cannot judge the authority's conduct, while pointing to ongoing coordination and prior letters.
For that reason I cannot give a judgment on this matter.
Om die reden kan ik geen oordeel geven over deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Kröger over het bericht 'Minister Schultz in beeld als nieuwe baas Schiphol'

GreenLeft MPs Van Tongeren and Kröger asked whether a minister moving to a state-owned company (Schiphol) in his own policy field is acceptable, and about the cooling-off rules, the Schiphol CEO succession and any contacts with the Finance Minister. The government replied that a two-year cooling-off period applies to lobbying in one's own policy field, that former ministers decide on their own integrity, and that the minister had not been approached and had no contacts about the succession.
Cabinet policy is that a two-year cooling-off period applies to lobbying in one's own policy field.
Het kabinetsbeleid is dat er een afkoelingsperiode van twee jaar geldt voor het lobbyen op het eigen beleidsterrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het rapport gebiedsdossier Weerselo, onderdeel van de Gebiedsdossiers drinkwaterwinningen Overijssel

An MP asked whether the minister knows that the Weerselo groundwater dossier leaves unclear whether NAM actually monitors effects of wastewater injection, and what powers the province has to enforce monitoring and safeguard drinking water. The minister answered that the monitoring passage was included in error, that risk is considered negligible and existing NAM permits and SodM supervision apply, and that provinces have sufficient instruments.
The province will inform all parties involved about this.
De provincie zal alle betrokken partijen hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over administratieve rompslomp bij de import van elektrische auto’s

An MP asked whether Chinese low-speed electric vehicles face extra RDW inspection in the Netherlands unlike in other EU states, and whether the registration procedure is unnecessarily burdensome. The minister answered that vehicles with EU type approval and a CoC are registered without extra technical testing, that the procedure is comparable to other member states, and that stimulating light electric vehicles is part of existing policy.
There is therefore a level playing field.
Er is dus sprake van een gelijk speelveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat via een omweg de noodzakelijke toetsen omtrent luchtvervuiling en natuurwaarden probeert te omzeilen

An MP asked whether Rijkswaterstaat was circumventing mandatory air-pollution and nature tests to speed up the Blankenburg tunnel, and whether a court case on air quality affects it. The minister denied any circumvention, said a project-specific nature assessment with compensation measures was added to the route decision, and said the air-quality court ruling does not touch this project.
There is no question of circumventing necessary tests.
Van het omzeilen van noodzakelijke toetsen is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat honderd miljoen euro aan subsidie is toegewezen voor een grote mest(co)vergistingsinstallatie in Rilland

An SP MP asked the ministers about the EUR 100 million subsidy for a large manure co-digestion plant in Rilland, covering nuisance from traffic, siting, emissions, landscape integration, the total energy gains from the EUR 2.5 billion spent on manure digesters, and whether such subsidies remain a sound investment. The minister answered that the provincial permit covers environmental effects, that the subsidy is a maximum under SDE+ and depends on actual output, that he considers subsidising digesters cost-effective, and that local residents' information is a municipal and provincial responsibility.
Informing residents about this initiative and organising the participation that goes with it is a task of local authorities.
Het informeren van bewoners over dit initiatief en het organiseren van inspraak die daarbij hoort is een taak van de lokale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de berichten dat er een grote brand heeft plaatsgevonden bij de Esso-raffinaderij in het Botlekgebied

An MP asked the Minister about a large fire at the Esso refinery in the Botlek area, including the failure of the regional website, a delayed and incomplete NL-Alert, health risks and compensation for residents, and whether communication failures across recent incidents would be jointly investigated. The Minister replied that crisis communication is the responsibility of the safety region and its mayors, described the website outage and the corrected NL-Alert, said the GGD informed residents on health risks and Esso is compensating damage, and stated the region is evaluating the communication with the parties involved.
Responsibility for crisis communication lies under the Wet veiligheidsregio's with the mayor and, for incidents with regional effects, with the safety region board.

De verantwoordelijkheid voor de crisiscommunicatie ligt krachtens de Wet veiligheidsregio’s (Wvr) bij de burgemeester en, in geval van een incident met regionale effecten, bij het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over containercongestie bij de binnenvaart

An MP asked the minister about container congestion slowing inland waterway shipping at Rotterdam, its causes, the economic risk of modal shift back to trucks, and concrete remedies. The minister acknowledged the congestion, cited multiple causes, said the port authority will invest 3 million euros and hold follow-up talks, and offered to assist if needed.
At the meeting the port authority HbR announced it will make 3 million euros available to develop plans to counter delays in container transshipment to inland vessels.
HbR heeft in het overleg aangekondigd € 3 miljoen beschikbaar te stellen om plannen uit te werken om vertragingen bij de containeroverslag op binnenvaartschepen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Van Eijs over de Redichemse Waard en de bredere problematiek van verondieping van Nederlandse (diepe) waterplassen

MPs Jetten and Van Eijs asked the government about the planned shallowing of the Redichemse Waard lake with contaminated sludge and soil, its recreational and ecological value, and the legal basis for dumping, including imported waste. The minister answered that shallowing is not automatically a useful application, that Rijkswaterstaat assesses the draft plan without approving it, and that existing rules and the Omgevingswet give limited scope for further protection.
Shallowing a deep lake is not by definition a useful and functional application.
Het verondiepen van een diepe plas is niet per definitie een nuttige en functionele toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het uitstel van de invoering van de Omgevingswet

An MP asked why the planned July 2019 start of the Environment and Planning Act (Omgevingswet) was postponed and reported in the media rather than to parliament, and how this squares with the minister's earlier rejection of a motion on enforceable revision permits. The minister confirmed the postponement is under review with no new date yet, said the transition end date stays 2029, and argued that existing law already allows permits to be tightened so a separate amendment is unnecessary.
As soon as there is more clarity about the new planning, both chambers will be informed about it.
Zodra er meer duidelijkheid is over de nieuwe planning, worden beide Kamers hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat Kustpact over bebouwing leidt tot scherpe conflicten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about conflicts over coastal construction under the Kustpact, including permits in Kijkduin, whether the pact can be enforced, and the number of pipeline projects. The minister answered that zoning under provincial guidance will guide new recreational building, that permits predate the pact and are a matter for the municipality, that consequences for non-compliance are possible but not yet relevant, and that pipeline figures are not reliably inventoried.
I will inform your House annually about the progress of the agreements.
Ik zal uw Kamer jaarlijks over de voortgang van de afspraken informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het afbreken van een mast van de tweemastklipper Amicitia

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the government about the mast collapse of the sailing ship Amicitia, the state of certification and inspection of the 'brown fleet', and inspection staffing compared with Germany and Denmark. The minister acknowledged the OVV findings, described inspection intensification and staffing, and promised a fuller response to the OVV recommendations by January 2018.
The accident with the Amicitia has been the reason for me to intensify the existing supervision of the inspection bodies.
Het ongeluk met de Amicitia is voor mij aanleiding geweest om het bestaande toezicht op de keuringsinstanties te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over de zeehondentochten op de Wadden

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked about proposed closures of sandbanks in the Wadden Sea to seal tour operators, the basis for those proposals, stakeholder consultation and enforcement. The minister replied that the proposals are preliminary, follow a set consultation procedure with a decision planned for spring 2018, and that closures are based on monitoring and enforced, while seal populations are stable.
The closed area is also not enlarged under the current proposals in the starting document, but rather reduced.
Het gesloten gebied wordt ook met de huidige voorstellen in het startdocument niet vergroot, maar juist verkleind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de informatievoorziening rondom de incidenten bij Shell Pernis eind juli 2017

An SP MP asked the government about criticism from residents near Shell Pernis over information provided after two July 2017 incidents, including whether NL-Alert should have been used and whether causes would be shared. The state secretary answered that crisis communication lies with local and regional authorities (VRR, DCMR), that Shell and authorities used several channels, that NL-Alert was not used because no health risks were expected, and that causes will be reported to the province of Zuid-Holland which decides on disclosure.
It is up to the competent authority to share relevant information about the causes of these incidents.
Het is aan bevoegd gezag om relevante informatie omtrent de oorzaken van deze incidenten te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de berichten dat een toxicoloog meermaals alarm sloeg over gifgas bij Chemours

An MP asked the government to respond to reports that a toxicologist repeatedly warned about the toxic gas PFIB released by Chemours in Dordrecht, and to explain the health risks and detection levels. The state secretary answered that PFIB arises only as a minimal by-product, that the permit imposes strict controls and a shutdown obligation, that measured peaks stayed below RIVM norms, and described its serious inhalation health effects.

For that reason the substance has been designated a substance of very high concern, and the competent authority must impose strict requirements when granting permits to minimise risks to the surroundings.
Om die reden is de stof aangemerkt als zeer zorgwekkende stof en dient het bevoegd gezag bij vergunningverlening strenge eisen op te leggen om risico's voor de omgeving te minimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over kartelafspraken van de grote Duitse autobouwers over prijzen en ook om niet of slechts minimaal aan de milieunormen te voldoen

Questions from MP Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) ask whether reported German car-maker cartel arrangements on prices and emissions, the possible deal on recall without type-approval withdrawal, and the emissions-defeat software issue have legal consequences in the Netherlands, and how APK, type approval and urban zones should respond. The government answers that cartels are a European Commission matter, that Dutch law currently gives no basis to compel recalls or prosecute the manufacturers, that about 77,000 Dutch vehicles still have an open Volkswagen recall, and that type-approval withdrawal and zone exclusion are limited or up to municipalities.
Currently there is no legal basis to prosecute manufacturers for this conduct or impose sanctions.
Momenteel is er geen juridisch aanknopingspunt om fabrikanten met deze handelwijze te vervolgen en sancties op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat meer mensen veteranenziekte krijgen

MP Laçin (SP) asked the minister about rising Legionnaires' disease cases, whether industrial and biological air scrubbers were investigated, the BRL 6010 revision, ILT compliance and whether a lighter inspection regime could follow. The minister said the rise has several possible causes, that research into scrubbers was limited to cases where there were indications, that BRL 6010 revision is underway, and that inspection compliance is improving.
No, the RIVM is closely monitoring developments.
Nee, het RIVM volgt de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de uitgifte van een invalidenparkeerkaart voor zorginstellingen gefinancierd door een persoonsgebonden budget

MP Bergkamp asked about the status of changes needed so care institutions funded by a personal budget (PGB) can obtain a disabled parking card, and about interim options. The government answered that it is coordinating with the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment on a single comprehensive regulatory amendment to be presented in autumn, and that competent authorities can grant exemptions under article 87 RVV 1990 in the meantime.
The Minister of IenM therefore aims to present you with one comprehensive amendment of the relevant regulations in the autumn.
De Minister van IenM streeft er daarom naar u in het najaar één omvattende wijziging van de relevante regelgeving voor te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen de vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat recent twee ernstige incidenten hebben plaatsgevonden op Schiphol

An SP MP asked the government about two reported serious incidents at Schiphol (a runway incursion involving a bird patrol and a tailstrike) and what was known about them, the status of OVV recommendations, whether the incidents were avoidable, and air traffic controller workload. The Staatssecretaris answered that investigations are ongoing, that the sector bears primary responsibility under the ILT's supervision, that a response to the OVV will follow in October, and that the ILT has not found workload to create uncontrolled risks.
The Aviation Incident Analysis Bureau (ABL) of the ILT does not conduct independent investigations into individual incidents.
Het Analyse Bureau Luchtvaartvoorvallen (ABL) van de ILT doet geen zelfstandig onderzoek naar afzonderlijke incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over de aanhoudende berichten dat er paraffine aanspoelt op de Nederlandse stranden

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, after repeated paraffin wash-ups on Dutch beaches, what action has been taken since parliamentary debates, why further discharges occurred, and about costs, enforcement, and international bans. The minister replies that discharges are currently legal under MARPOL, that the Netherlands is pushing for a global ban via the IMO with a decision expected in 2018, and that enforcement and cost recovery face practical difficulties.
An overview of the scale for environmentally hazardous chemicals in general is not available.
Een overzicht van de schaal voor milieugevaarlijke chemicaliën in algemene zin is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘weer paraffine gevonden op Noord- en Zuid-Hollandse stranden’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports of paraffin washing up on North and South Holland beaches, including volumes and cleanup costs, prevention measures, IMO negotiations and public warnings. The minister withheld current volume and cost figures pending a contract negotiation, described existing controls and an IMO discharge-ban push with decisions expected in 2018, and said no extra at-sea checks are currently planned.
I cannot yet inform you about the quantity of paraffin washed ashore in recent months and the cleanup costs.
Over de hoeveelheid aangespoelde paraffine van de afgelopen maanden en kosten voor het ruimen ervan kan ik u nog niet informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over websites als zorgtoeslag.nl en mijntheorieaanvragen.nl

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about commercial intermediary websites such as zorgtoeslag.nl and mijntheorieaanvragen.nl that resemble government sites and charge more than official services. The government answered that such intermediaries are not prohibited if they are not misleading, that legal instruments exist against deceptive sites, and that the Tax Office and CBR send warning letters and can take legal action.
When commercial websites look too much like government websites, action is taken against the sites concerned.
Als commerciële websites teveel lijken op overheidswebsites wordt actie ondernomen richting de desbetreffende sites.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de problemen met het digitale Kiwa-loket

An MP asked the minister about problems with the new Kiwa digital portal for tachograph cards, including complaints, causes, and whether drivers were harmed. The minister acknowledged delays affecting 52 drivers caused by migration problems, said Kiwa was warned and apologised, and described a planned new tariff regime.
The ILT has held Kiwa to account for the problems identified.
De ILT heeft Kiwa aangesproken op de geconstateerde problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de permanente bewoning op vakantieparken

An MP asked the ministers about permanent residence on holiday parks, including whether residents are being steered there, whether municipal enforcement in the Veluwe leaves people homeless, and whether arbeidsmigranten get new housing while other residents do not. The minister says there is no national overview, that referrals were individual and temporary, that enforcement and housing are local matters coordinated through a municipal programme, and that gemeenten are responsible for their own housing policy.
At national level there is no overview of holiday parks where people live permanently in breach of the applicable zoning, or of the reasons they live there.
Op landelijk niveau is er geen overzicht van vakantieparken waar mensen permanent en in strijd met de geldende bestemming verblijven en om welke redenen zij hier verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Eijs over de permanente bewoning van vakantieparken

MPs asked the government about people living permanently in holiday parks, including the size of such groups, the blacklist of landlords, and solutions for people without housing. The minister said there is no national overview of permanent residents, that the government is studying the housing need for temporary housing, and that municipalities are responsible for housing supply and enforcement.
At national level there is no overview of the number of people who permanently live in a holiday park and the reasons why they stay there.
Op landelijk niveau is er geen overzicht van het aantal mensen dat permanent op een vakantiepark verblijft en om welke reden zij er verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over de permanente bewoning van vakantieparken

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked the government about permanent residence on holiday parks, including the number affected, the burgemeester of Putten's call for a national approach, reviving a withdrawn bill, and provincial housing shortages. Minister Plasterk answered that no national count exists, that municipalities hold the primary responsibility, that the bill will not be revived, and gave provincial statistical housing shortage figures while noting affordability and elderly-suitable housing cannot be precisely quantified.
The municipality is responsible for its own enforcement and housing policy and therefore holds the lead role in giving shape to a solution.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen handhaving- en woonbeleid en heeft daarmee de regierol in handen om invulling te geven aan een oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Visser en Van der Molen over het bericht “IFKS: comedy met Europese regels” in de Leeuwarder Courant

MPs Aukje de Vries, Visser and Van der Molen asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about EU certification (CvO) and AIS obligations affecting race skûtsjes reported in the Leeuwarder Courant. The minister says a clear transitional regime exists, enforcement only starts after 1 January 2019, and no legal basis exists for exemptions from the AIS or CvO obligations.
However, I am convinced that a clear and workable transitional arrangement exists for the vessels concerned.
Ik ben er echter van overtuigd dat er voor de betrokken schepen een heldere en werkbare overgangsregeling bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over een pilot naar het besparingspotentieel bij een lagere minimumtemperatuur voor tapwater

An MP asked whether the minister still stands by the 2014 estimate that alternative legionella-prevention techniques could save considerable heat nationally, and what was done to promote pilots with suppliers, other ministries, and the SDE+ and VAMIL subsidy schemes. The minister reaffirmed the potential, reported that suppliers showed no interest in pilots and that the matter was passed to the industry body, and said a pilot could be run in a housing experiment if a supplier takes the initiative.
Following that, no proposals for carrying out pilots were received from the suppliers.
Naar aanleiding daarvan zijn er vanuit de leveranciers geen voorstellen ontvangen voor het uitvoeren van pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over het bericht ‘Overheid, doe iets tegen vertraging containerterminals’ en ‘Wereldwijde scheepvaart worstelt met stookolie’

The MP Jetten (D66) asks about container terminal congestion in Rotterdam harbour that delays inland shipping and about the failure of IMO talks to phase out heavy fuel oil in shipping, and whether the government will lead on climate ambitions. The minister acknowledges the congestion, lists measures under way and says the government supports the Arctic heavy fuel ban at the IMO and pursues 2020 sulphur limits, without committing to a new concrete step beyond ongoing consultation.
I have no insight into the business information of the companies involved.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de bedrijfsinformatie van de betrokken ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Helvert over de staat van onderhoud van het Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen en wateroverlast Sluiskil

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about the maintenance state of the Ghent-Terneuzen canal near Sluiskil, sheet-pile rust, water nuisance for residents, water-level agreements with Belgium and legal responsibility. The minister answered that renovation is underway, a joint study into the water nuisance is planned, water-level agreements were respected, and responsibility is divided among Rijkswaterstaat and Zeeland Seaports.
Rijkswaterstaat, as manager of the canal, is responsible for the water level.
Rijkswaterstaat is als beheerder van het kanaal verantwoordelijk voor het waterpeil.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Laçin over oneerlijke mededinging in wegtransport

MPs Jetten and Laçin asked the minister about reports that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport struggles to keep road transport firms compliant as they devise new manipulation methods, and whether the inspectorate has enough knowledge and capacity. The minister acknowledges increasingly sophisticated manipulation, says inspectors receive ongoing training and equipment and that the ILT works with manufacturers and European partners, but gives no figures on the total scale of the problem.
Since these are targeted inspections, the number of detected manipulation cases says nothing about its total scale.
Aangezien het om gerichte inspecties gaat, zegt het aantal ontdekte gevallen van manipulatie niets over de totale omvang ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de situatie voor chauffeurs in Calais

MP Van Helvert (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about dangers for truck drivers at Calais after a Polish driver died when migrants blocked the road, including coordination with France, Benelux, and damage estimates. The minister said France is responding alertly, is increasing police numbers and lighting on the A16, that no Benelux role is needed for now, and that Dutch damage figures are not known.
I therefore see no role for the Benelux Union or the Benelux Parliament at this moment.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen rol voor de Beneluxunie of het Beneluxparlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de problemen op en rond de Haringvlietbrug

An MP asked the minister about the Haringvlietbridge problems, including motorists dismantling a barrier during a power outage, the response time for faults, and recent incidents. The minister defended the response times, condemned the barrier removal as dangerous, and reported repairs and inspections of the bridge's expansion joints and structure.
Following this incident, Rijkswaterstaat is making additional working agreements with contractors so they can reach the location faster in case of congestion.
Wel maakt Rijkswaterstaat naar aanleiding van dit incident aanvullende werkafspraken met aannemers om hen, in geval van file, sneller op locatie te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de slechte staat van onderhoud van bruggen rond Rotterdam

An MP asked the minister about reports that bridges around Rotterdam are poorly maintained and risk a traffic collapse, and about a Sweco study and filing-cost estimates. The minister rejected the claim that the bridges are poorly maintained, said they are adequately maintained though vulnerable due to heavier traffic and age, and pointed to a renovation programme and new road links.
This report is not correct. The bridges around Rotterdam, managed by the national government, are adequately maintained.
Dit bericht klopt niet. De bruggen om Rotterdam, in beheer bij het Rijk, worden adequaat onderhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat ijzerhoudend grondwater fosfaat in landbouwgebieden minder schadelijk maakt

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary whether iron-rich groundwater reduces phosphate's impact on water quality, and whether the WFD standards, the STONE model, the Nitrates Directive programme and EU reporting should be adjusted accordingly. The government largely maintains current policy, saying new insights will be incorporated in updates for 2022-2027 and the 7th programme, and that the 6th programme focuses on good agricultural practice.
Water managers can, on the basis of new scientific insights, adjust water quality targets for the river basin management plans 2022–2027.
Waterbeheerders kunnen op grond van nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten waterkwaliteitsdoelen voor de stroomgebiedbeheerplannen 2022–2027 bijstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van Toorenburg over drugsdumpingen en waterkwaliteit

MPs Geurts and Van Toorenburg asked the ministers about rising illegal drug waste dumping and its effects on water quality, enforcement in rural areas and registration. The state secretary confirmed rising recorded dumpings, said they affect wastewater treatment and surface water only occasionally, and described existing cooperation, saying further enforcement measures are sufficient and registration is being improved.
I acknowledge the importance of good registration, both for obtaining a complete picture and for tracing the perpetrators.
Ik erken het belang van goede registratie, zowel ten behoeve van het verkrijgen van een volledig beeld als ten behoeve van het opsporen van de daders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Helvert over parkeren van vrachtwagens langs rijkswegen

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the shortage of truck parking along motorways, long-term parking misuse, differing rest-time enforcement in neighbouring countries, and a possible Benelux role. The minister said parking capacity is sufficient network-wide but overcrowded on busy corridors, that enforcement of long-term parking is not possible without a legal time limit, and that Dutch policy aims for a Europe-wide level playing field, with the Benelux role limited to intelligent transport systems.
I have no data on how the situation in Belgium and Luxembourg is regarding the long-term parking of vehicles or parts thereof at rest areas along the main road network.
Ik heb geen gegevens over hoe de situatie in België en Luxemburg is ten aanzien van het langdurig stallen van voertuigen of onderdelen daarvan op een verzorgingsplaats langs het hoofdwegennet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Paternotte over het grote aantal gunningen van infrastructuurprojecten aan buitenlandse bouwers

MPs Jetten and Paternotte asked why foreign builders won a large share of major infrastructure contracts and how this fits the Marktvisie. The minister replied that most GWW contracts went to Dutch firms, that foreign partners add expertise and better price-quality, and that the government and market will jointly implement the Marktvisie.
The large majority of the contracts went to Dutch construction firms: 49 of the 53 GWW contracts in the study were awarded to (combinations of) companies with no foreign involvement.

Het overgrote deel van de opdrachten is naar Nederlandse bouwbedrijven gegaan: 49 van de 53 GWW opdrachten uit het onderzoek zijn gegund aan (combinaties van) bedrijven waar geen sprake is van buitenlandse inbreng.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht forse toename boetes voor kleine snelheidsovertredingen

An MP asked why fines for minor speeding offences rose sharply, whether the cause is new speed cameras or more section controls, and how this affects road safety and police credibility. The minister says many factors influence offence numbers, partly points to the abolition of the 4 km/h threshold on 130 km/h roads and more such roads, defends enforcement of small speeding offences, and reports the progressive fines study was sent to parliament.
It is possible that part of the increase is due to the replacement of the digital poles and section controls and part to the expansion of the number of sections where 130 km/h may be driven.

Het is mogelijk dat een deel van de stijging komt door de vervanging van de digitale palen en trajectcontroles en een deel door de uitbreiding van het aantal trajecten waar 130 km/u mag worden gereden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Groothuizen en Bouali over het bericht dat verdachte schepen niet worden gecontroleerd

MPs Jetten, Groothuizen and Bouali (D66) asked whether ships that switched off their AIS signal or changed identification before entering Dutch waters are being properly checked, and what the consequences for security and enforcement are. The government answers that AIS gaps have many legitimate causes, that the Kustwacht and Douane use risk profiling and treat AIS switch-offs as a risk indicator, that the numbers from Winward cannot be confirmed, and that modernisation and EU cooperation are underway.
The Coast Guard does not have the investigation data on which Winward based its conclusions and therefore cannot confirm the numbers Winward cites.
De Kustwacht beschikt niet over de onderzoekgegevens waarop Winward haar conclusies heeft gebaseerd en kan derhalve de door Winward genoemde aantallen niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over inwerkperiodes tegen nultarieven voor zelfstandigen bij Rijkswaterstaat

An MP asked the ministers whether Rijkswaterstaat's contracts with intermediaries that impose zero-cost onboarding periods on self-employed workers shift onboarding costs onto them, and whether the government will stop such arrangements. The ministers answered that the contract places replacement and onboarding costs on the contractor, that the intermediary's zero-tariff wording was a mistranslation it has acknowledged, and that the ministry raised the matter with the contractor, which is reconsidering its approach.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het boetebeleid voor onverzekerde auto’s

An MP asked ministers about fines for uninsured cars, including fines after suspension lapses, the legality of indefinite suspension, and debt collection and imprisonment for those unable to pay. The government said suspension is meant to be temporary, described existing prevention measures and a changed approach to imprisonment-for-debt requests, and promised to report back on the outcomes of consultations.
It is not known what the personal motives are of all owners of suspended vehicles in the Netherlands for whether or not to extend the suspension.
Het is niet bekend wat de persoonlijke motieven zijn van alle eigenaren van geschorste voertuigen in Nederland om de schorsing wel of niet te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van den Berg over een inschattingsfout van Rijkswaterstaat bij de A58

CDA MPs asked the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat misjudged traffic on the A58 when scheduling roadworks on 6 June 2017, and how holiday traffic is factored into planning. The minister answers that the Pentecost traffic pattern differed from past years, that holiday peaks are considered in planning, and that no further commitment beyond taking the experience into account is made.
This experience will of course be taken into account in the future planning of works.
Deze ervaring zal uiteraard wel worden meegenomen bij de toekomstige planning van werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over 'duidelijkheid omtrent de bestemming van de Spiegelwaal in Nijmegen'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment for clarity on the rules governing the Spiegelwaal in Nijmegen, including whether a promised clarification before summer 2017 had materialised and whether a rescue brigade could be involved. The Minister answered that existing regulations apply, that the government, municipality and province are negotiating practical arrangements, and that agreement on a cooperation agreement and development plan is targeted for early July.
The aim is to approve these documents and the practical arrangements made in them at administrative level in early July.
Het streven is om deze documenten en de daarin gemaakte, praktische afspraken begin juli op bestuurlijk niveau te accorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de gevolgen van gasboringen in de Wadden

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether recent NAM research shows that subsidence forecasts after gas production stops are highly uncertain, whether the Natura 2000 policy premise still holds, whether the Wadden 'accommodation space' is exceeded, and why the LTS study was delayed. The minister answered that SodM judged the NAM study insufficient but correctable by October 2017, that no exceedance of the natural limit is currently foreseen, that the 'hand on the tap' commitment stands, and that no evidence of deliberate delay was found.

The State Supervision of Mines (SodM) indicates that the identified shortcomings in the NAM study, traced by SodM to a number of concretely named points for improvement, can and must be remedied by 31 October 2017.

Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) geeft aan dat de geconstateerde tekortkomingen in de NAM-studie, die door SodM zijn herleid tot een aantal concreet benoemde verbeterpunten, uiterlijk 31 oktober 2017 hersteld kunnen en moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat Duitsland het cabinekamperen verbiedt

Rep. Van Helvert (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the Netherlands should ban truck cabin camping after Germany did, and whether parking nuisance and uneven enforcement across Europe are a concern. The minister answered that a level playing field is needed, that the issue should be handled at EU level in the Mobility Package, that Rijkswaterstaat will monitor parking pressure, and that the Netherlands will not ban cabin rest for now.
I will have Rijkswaterstaat monitor whether parking pressure along motorways to and from Germany increases.
Ik zal Rijkswaterstaat laten monitoren of de parkeerdruk langs autosnelwegen van en naar Duitsland een toename kent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de plannen voor olie- en aardgaswinning bij Woerden

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers about plans to extract gas at the Papekop field near Woerden, covering Vermilion's financial guarantees, the cumulative risk and reservation of funds, and the weight given to local objections. The minister answered that Vermilion has not yet applied for an environmental permit or submitted an updated extraction plan, that creditworthiness is assessed through several means, and that regional authorities will be consulted under the new Mining Act procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over nieuwe bruggen in de Afsluitdijk

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked whether the Afsluitdijk bridges would not be replaced until after 2050, causing repeated breakdowns, and asked about the delay, cost and temperature causes. The minister denied any delay, said replacement of the superstructure is planned for 2023-2025 with a repair in 2020, and gave no estimate of future breakdowns or their costs, citing lack of registration.
Incidentally, between mid-July 2016 and end April 2017 no breakdowns with consequences for (waterborne) road traffic occurred at either bridge.
Overigens hebben zich in de periode van midden juli 2016 tot eind april 2017 aan beide bruggen geen storingen met gevolgen voor het (vaar)wegverkeer voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Genoeg van Faalsluitdijk”

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about press reports on repeated breakdowns of the Afsluitdijk bridges, their causes, stand-by staffing, repair plans and economic damage. The minister explained the heat-related failures, announced continuous cooling and a bridge superstructure replacement in 2023-2025, but declined to quantify economic damage since it is not recorded.
Should the situation change, I will consider which measures are needed.
Mocht de situatie wijzigen dan bekijk ik welke maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Von Martels over berichten dat consumenten problemen met hun voertuig ondervinden na het toepassen van de software-update van Volkswagen

MPs Van Eijs and Von Martels asked whether the Volkswagen software update causes higher fuel use, power loss and EGR valve failures, whether EGR removal is adequately regulated, and how consumers are compensated. The minister replied that independent tests (KBA, RDW, TNO) found no negative effects on fuel use or power, that a ban on removing emission controls is being prepared, and that PON handles complaints individually while the recall is voluntary for consumers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat Vlaanderen de binnenvaart gaat ondersteunen

An SP MP asked the minister whether the Netherlands would launch an initiative similar to Flanders' resolution promoting inland shipping, and about supporting sustainable transport. The minister said existing policy already covers these aims, citing the Goederencorridors Oost and Zuidoost study, the topsector Logistiek, and the Brandstofvisie.
The inland shipping initiatives mentioned in the article already fall within my policy.
De in het stuk genoemde binnenvaartinitiatieven passen reeds binnen mijn beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over ontwikkelingen rondom het Road Package van de Europese Commissie

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the ministers about the European Commission's Road Package on road transport, including fears of social dumping, worse working conditions for truck drivers, and whether the Netherlands will press for tighter cabotage rules and action against letterbox companies. The minister replied that the Commission's proposals were not yet published (expected 31 May), so their content could not yet be assessed, and pointed to a 2014 joint ministerial declaration calling for better implementation of EU law; the answer to the cabotage and Road Alliance questions is largely pending.
Only then will it be possible for me to assess the content of the proposals.
Het is voor mij dan pas mogelijk om de inhoud van de voorstellen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over berichten dat Duitsland en andere lidstaten in Europa verbetervoorstellen naar aanleiding van het dieselgateschandaal blokkeren

An MP from D66 asked the ministers whether Germany and other member states are blocking EU proposals to strengthen type-approval and market surveillance after the diesel emissions scandal, including EU retesting and fining powers, and what the Dutch position is. The ministers replied that negotiations are ongoing, the Dutch position broadly supports the Commission proposal with alternative methods, and they will report on RDW follow-up investigations and the D66 and European Parliament recommendations later.

To prevent a potential new diesel scandal, I am committed to strengthening the system of market surveillance of, and type approval for, motor vehicles and the uniform application of regulations throughout the EU.

Om een potentieel nieuw dieselschandaal te voorkomen zet ik me in voor versterking van het systeem van markttoezicht op – en typegoedkeuring van motorvoertuigen en de uniforme toepassing van de regelgeving in de gehele EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de opstelling van Rijkswaterstaat inzake de oeverbestorting in de Oosterschelde

MP Bisschop asked whether Rijkswaterstaat's reaction to lobster fishers' concerns about the Oosterschelde bank protection conflicts with earlier answers on an 'ecotoplaag', and how lobster living and foraging conditions will be ensured. The minister replied that earlier answers caused confusion, that Rijkswaterstaat has structural consultation with lobster fishers' representatives on the design, that a varied hard and soft habitat is beneficial for lobsters, and that the sector will remain involved in the design.
In the future too, the lobster sector will remain involved in the design of the 'ecotoplaag'.
Ook in de toekomst zal de kreeftensector betrokken blijven bij het ontwerp van de «ecotoplaag».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de wachttijden bij het CBR oplopen

An SP MP asked the minister about rising waiting times for practical driving exams at the CBR, the causes, measures to curb them, safeguards against rijschool misuse, and a BOVAG proposal to prioritise well-performing driving schools. The minister acknowledged the overruns, attributed them to economic recovery and rule changes, described capacity expansion and booking rules, and said the CBR would advise on the BOVAG suggestion by autumn.
The CBR already recruited 60 examiners last year. This year another 60 will be added.
Het CBR heeft vorig jaar al 60 examinatoren geworven. Dit jaar komen er nog eens 60 bij
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jetten over de aanschaf van een Boeing 737 Business Jet als nieuw regeringsvliegtuig

Two D66 MPs asked why all four bids in the government aircraft tender were declared invalid, why negotiations went only with Boeing rather than retendering, the claimed 18 million euro price difference, Airbus's objection, and the King's role in choosing the aircraft. The minister answered that no bid met all criteria, that Airbus did not supply required documents, that the price gap is under 2 million euro once VAT is considered, that Airbus did not appeal, that the King had no role in the decision, and provided a timeline, while citing procurement-law limits on disclosing bid details.
The principles of procurement law limit me in making information about the bids public.
De beginselen van het aanbestedingsrecht beperken mij in het openbaar kunnen maken van informatie over de inschrijvingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de reikwijdte en gevolgen van het Kustpact voor Zeeland

An SP MP asked the minister about a protest against the Brouwerseiland plan, whether the Kustpact is breached by coastal holiday-home developments in Zeeland, the scale of Noord-Beveland plans, the secret Veerse Meer agreement with the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, holiday-home supply and occupancy, and the Kustpact's geographic reach. The minister answered that the plans fall under the Kustpact's pre-existing category and are primarily the municipality's responsibility, granted a Barro exemption for Brouwerseiland, declined to publish the Veerse Meer letter citing business-sensitive content, and said PBL monitoring will follow.
The letter is not public because it contains business-sensitive information.
Deze brief is niet openbaar omdat er bedrijfsgevoelige informatie in staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht 'Mariënheem timmert stevig aan de weg in N35-actie'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the N35 at Mariënheem should be upgraded to a full motorway with 2x2 lanes after residents' 'Traverse-plus' plan was rejected as too expensive, and why the project has taken 27 years. The minister answered that the plan was judged too costly, that about 600 million euro has been invested in the N35, and that a staged package of safety measures through 2020 is being pursued within existing budgets, with no further upgrade planned.
However, this plan was dropped because it is too expensive.
Dit plan is echter afgevallen omdat het te duur is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht op Telegraaf.nl “Schipholtunnel toch niet open voor avondspits”

An MP asked the minister why the damaged Schiphol tunnel was reopened later than announced, whether repairs could be done outside rush hour, whether tunnel law hinders faster reopening, and whether an investigation is warranted. The minister explained that safety systems had to be fully restored and tested before reopening, denied tunnel law caused delay, rejected the call for an inquiry given the incidental nature, and regretted the inconvenience.
Given the incidental nature, I currently see no need to launch an investigation.
Ik zie op dit moment, gelet het incidentele karakter, geen noodzaak om een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de aanhoudende stremmingen bij de Coentunnel en de rol van de instelling van de meetapparatuur

An MP asked the minister whether truck height detections at the Coentunnel, which the minister says are not false, cause unnecessary closures and whether the measuring system is accurate, given that few fines followed. The minister replied that the system is periodically checked and functions correctly, that fines are the responsibility of the Public Prosecution Service, and that Rijkswaterstaat is pursuing measures to reduce tall trucks.
Rijkswaterstaat does not have figures showing how often the police attend on site and how often a fine is issued in those cases.
Rijkswaterstaat beschikt niet over cijfers die aangeven hoe vaak de politie ter plaatse komt en hoe vaak in die gevallen een bekeuring wordt uitgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jetten over de aanschaf van een Boeing 737 Business Jet als nieuw regeringsvliegtuig

MPs Van Meenen and Jetten asked why four tenders for a new government aircraft were rejected, why negotiations went exclusively with Boeing, the role of the Royal House, total costs, pricing comparisons, future rules on scheduled flights, and related matters. The minister answered most questions substantively, explaining the procedure, costs (about 89 million euro net), and that the Royal House had no say in the procurement decisions, while declining to verify external price figures.
The Royal House had no say in decision-making on the design of the tender procedure, the assessment of bids, or the negotiations with Boeing.
Het Koninklijk Huis had geen zeggenschap in besluitvorming over de vormgeving van de aanbestedingsprocedure, de beoordeling van inschrijvingen alsmede de onderhandelingen met Boeing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Nijkerken-de Haan en Visser inzake de Duitse tol

MPs Ten Broeke, Nijkerken-De Haan and Visser asked whether the German Bundesrat's approval of the road toll (vignette) removes obstacles to its introduction, what its effects are for Dutch motorists, transport and border regions, and what the minister will do, including a border-impact assessment. The minister answered that the EU-required changes were adopted, that the infringement procedure continues, that he opposes the toll, will seek clarification from the Commission and Austria, and will carry out a border-effects assessment once the German law is final.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over gesjoemel met de uitstoot van schadelijke stoffen door vrachtwagens

An MP asked the minister about trucks having their AdBlue emission systems switched off with illegal boxes sold by garages and whether controls and enforcement are adequate. The state secretary condemns the practice, cites existing offences, says detection research with TNO and ECN is ongoing and results will come around summer, but repeatedly refers to the same answer and gives no figures on scale.
It is not known on what scale AdBlue systems are being switched off.
Het is niet bekend op welke schaalgrootte AdBlue-systemen worden afgeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over uitbreiding trajectcontroles naar de Provinciale wegen

Visser (VVD) asked the ministers about extending average-speed (trajectory) controls to provincial roads, including pilot results, selection criteria and the role of parliament. The minister answered that 15-20 N-road locations are being assessed by the OM, police and road managers, that provinces are responsible for road safety and that parliament has no formal role beyond its oversight of national policy.
Beyond its supervisory role over national policy, I see no role for the House here, since road safety on provincial roads is a responsibility of the provinces.
Buiten haar controlerende taak op het rijksbeleid zie ik hier geen rol weggelegd voor de Kamer, aangezien de verkeersveiligheid op provinciale wegen een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over onduidelijke totstandkoming prijzen voor drinkwater

MP Geurts (CDA) asked why drinking water tariff-setting remains opaque despite repeated ILT and ACM criticism and promised improvements, and what will change. The minister acknowledges the lack of transparency in cost separation and tariff justification, says ILT's enforcement continues via a 2018 instruction, and promises the Drinkwaterwet evaluation (summer 2017) will address tariffs and ACM's position.
The formation of the tariffs must be transparent.
De totstandkoming van de tarieven dient transparant te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het alternatief “Vaargeul Walvischstaart” voor de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder

An MP asks the minister about the 'Vaargeul Walvischstaart' alternative to the Hedwigepolder de-poldering, including a report by a nautical adviser and whether the idea was discussed at the ministry. The minister says the studies and report are not known to him, that Rijkswaterstaat judged rerouting the channel unnecessary and risky, and sees no need for further research.
Rijkswaterstaat indicated at the time that rerouting the shipping route from Oostgat to Walvischstaart was not necessary from a nautical safety perspective.
Door Rijkswaterstaat is destijds aangegeven dat een vaarrouteverlegging van Oostgat naar Walvischstaart vanuit het oogpunt van nautische veiligheid niet noodzakelijk was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat er nog steeds Europese schepen op Aziatische sloopstranden belanden

An SP MP asked the government how it responds to reports that European ships are still dumped on Asian breaking beaches, why the Hong Kong Convention is not yet ratified, how Dutch shipowners are obliged to ensure responsible scrapping, and whether it will agree hard sector agreements with the KVNR. The government condemns the practice, points to EU waste rules requiring prior consent for recycling, refers to ongoing IMVO talks with the KVNR and an expected covenant this year, and refers to earlier answers on the convention.
The cabinet is in talks with the KVNR within the framework of agreements on International Corporate Social Responsibility.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met de KVNR in het kader van de afspraken over Internationaal Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht 'Veiligheid Belgische kerncentrale Doel is nog niet op orde'

An MP asked the government whether it would press Belgium to temporarily close the Doel nuclear plant, accelerate interconnector expansion, and request more frequent IAEA follow-up missions. The minister replied that there is no indication Doel is currently unsafe, that the decision on the plant is a Belgian national competence, and that a two-year IAEA follow-up is normal and up to the Belgian regulator FANC.
The judgment on whether it is necessary to keep the Doel nuclear plant open is a national competence of the Belgian government.
Het oordeel of het noodzakelijk is de kerncentrale Doel op te houden, is een nationale bevoegdheid van de Belgische regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over een mogelijke onjuiste uitvoering door Nederland van de Europese Richtlijn Industriële Emissies (RIE)

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch implementation of the Industrial Emissions Directive lets waste incinerator operators deduct the maximum permitted measurement uncertainty from continuous emission readings, as advised by InfoMil, rather than the actual measured uncertainty. The state secretary replied that the implementing rules conform to the directive, that the uncertainty correction is legally anchored, and that the Commission has not put the Netherlands in default.
The European Commission has not put the Netherlands in default under the Industrial Emissions Directive.
De Europese Commissie heeft Nederland niet in gebreke gesteld voor de Richtlijn industriële emissies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over bescherming van natuurgebied ’t Merske

SP MPs asked the state secretary about chicken barns planned on the Belgian side of the Mark near natural area 't Merske, including nitrogen emissions, water quality, EU Water Framework Directive effects, and buffer zones. The government replied that the province of Noord-Brabant and Brabantse Delta water board are primarily responsible, that they raised concerns with Flemish authorities leading to extra permit conditions and an agreement to inform each other earlier, and that the buffer zone motion does not apply since the area is not a Natura 2000 site.
The natural area 't Merkske is not a Natura 2000 area. Therefore the Smaling motion (parliamentary document 31 038, no. H) does not apply to this natural area.
Het natuurgebied ’t Merkske is geen Natura2000-gebied. Derhalve is de motie Smaling (Kamerstuk 31 038, nr. H ) niet van toepassing op dit natuurgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat de fosfaat-stikstof verhouding in de Noordzee uit balans is

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the phosphorus-nitrogen imbalance in the North Sea, linked to manure and detergent policy, justifies easing or pausing phosphate reduction and the phosphate rights system, and what measures could restore the balance. The state secretary rejected the claim of a phosphate shortage, argued that nitrogen reduction (including from abroad) is the priority, and said the findings will feed into the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme and EU reporting.
There is no shortage of phosphate in the coastal zone of the North Sea.
Er is geen sprake van een tekort aan fosfaat in de kustzone van de Noordzee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het opspuiten van de Roggenplaat in de Oosterschelde

An SGP MP asked the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat's plan to spray sand onto the Roggenplaat in the Oosterschelde, as compensation for wrongly placed fine gravel on the shoreline, is sound, given lobster habitat and mussel-plot risks. The minister answered that the permits are being prepared for submission in May 2017, that an ecotoplaag will be added for lobsters, and that monitoring and consultation with fishing sectors are in place.
The intention is to submit these permits to the competent authority in May 2017.
Voornemen is om deze vergunningen in mei 2017 in te dienen bij Bevoegd Gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het aantal alcoholcontroles in het verkeer

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers why the number of recorded alcohol checks in traffic fell 17.5 percent in 2016, whether registration is mandatory, and whether individual checks are more effective. The Justice minister answered that the decline reflects a shift away from large checkpoints toward individual checks, that recording individual checks is not mandatory, and that alcohol limit violations are always recorded as offences but not separately per check.
Recording individual checks, which also test for alcohol use, is not mandatory, so the number of recorded alcohol checks does not give a complete picture of police deployment.

Het registreren van individuele controles, waarbij ook getest wordt op het gebruik van alcohol, is niet verplicht, waardoor uit het aantal geregistreerde alcoholcontroles geen volledig beeld van de inzet van politie kan worden afgeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het niet afnemen van files na de opening van de Velsertunnel

An MP from CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why, after the reopening of the Velsertunnel, rush-hour congestion on the A9 toward Haarlem-Alkmaar had not eased and whether the renovation had solved any bottleneck. The minister answered that the renovation was a 60-year maintenance and safety upgrade, not a capacity expansion, that no structural bottleneck exists on the A22, and that the A9 congestion lies near Zijkanaal C and Velsen, with monitoring and a MIRT study promised.
The goal of the Velsertunnel renovation project was a complete renovation of the 60-year-old tunnel.
Het doel van het project Renovatie Velsertunnel was een volledige renovatie van de 60 jaar oude tunnel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Harbers en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Brusselse eis zet Rotterdamse haven in financiële klem”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the Rotterdam port's financial squeeze after the European Commission ended the corporate tax exemption for ports, and about the level playing field across EU ports. The minister replied that port investment room is not currently under pressure, that the Commission's state aid procedures against Belgium and France and the port regulation are on track, and that the Netherlands continues to press for fair competition.
At present the investment room of HbR is not under pressure and the port company is able to carry out the planned investments.
Op dit moment staat de investeringsruimte van HbR niet onder druk en is het Havenbedrijf in staat de geplande investeringen uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over zandwinning onder het Markermeer

An MP asked whether sand extraction under the Markermeer is being made unprofitable by the clay layer and the abolished domain-fee discount, and whether the government will reconsider and create instruments to make it as profitable as IJsselmeer extraction. The minister replied that the clay layer does not make extraction unprofitable, that no discounts have been granted for regular sand extraction since 2014, and that no new instrument is planned.
Given what has been stated in the answers to questions 1, 3 and 5, the Real Estate Agency sees no reason to revise its decision.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf ziet gezien het gestelde in de beantwoording van vraag 1, 3 en 5 geen reden haar besluit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Tongeren over de ‘bijna ramp’ en illegale oliepraktijken voor de Nederlandse kust

MPs Van Veldhoven and Van Tongeren asked about a near-disaster involving chemical processing on the tanker Franz Schulte off Scheveningen and whether inspectorates can detect such illegal practices. The minister said the ILT found no violations since the 2014 SOLAS ban, that it is considering joint checks with other inspection services, and that international action depends on further information.
Based on inspections of ships in ports, the ILT has found no violations of the ban on chemical processing during sea voyages since 1 January 2014.
Op basis van controles aan boord van schepen in havens heeft de ILT sinds 1 januari 2014 geen overtredingen van het verbod op chemische bewerkingen gedurende zeereizen vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Smaling over een mogelijk tekort aan accountants die gemeentelijke jaarrekeningen controleren

MPs Merkies and Smaling asked whether a shortage of accountants auditing municipal annual accounts threatens timely audit opinions, and whether decentralisations and the Omgevingswet strain municipal staff. The government acknowledges some tender failures and capacity pressure, relies on market forces and new entrants, and says municipalities bear responsibility for their own staffing.
The equipping of the civil service is, within the administrative relations, the responsibility of municipalities as independent tier of government.
Het toegerust zijn van het ambtenarenapparaat is binnen de bestuurlijke verhoudingen de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten als zelfstandige bestuurslaag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over de berichten 'Scenario kernramp grote onzin' en 'Vals rampscenario Tihange'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about press reports calling a Vienna IRS study of a nuclear disaster at Tihange 2 nonsense and exaggerated. The minister answered that the national nuclear regulator ANVS found the study unrealistic and of no added value for preparedness, that the German government also questioned it, and that transparent information sharing with the Limburg region is being pursued.
It is good that a public debate is held on a subject as important as nuclear safety.
Het is goed dat over een zo belangrijk onderwerp als nucleaire veiligheid een maatschappelijk debat wordt gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Helvert over ongevallen op A73

MPs Ronnes and Van Helvert asked whether accidents on the A73 are increasing and what causes them, and whether further research will be done. The minister confirms registered accidents have risen, partly due to better registration, attributes the rise to economic recovery and mobility, and says Rijkswaterstaat will analyse the Cuijk–Boxmeer stretch where accident risk is above average.
Therefore I have asked Rijkswaterstaat to carry out an analysis of this road section in the short term, to establish the causes of the accidents
Daarom heb ik Rijkswaterstaat gevraagd op korte termijn een analyse uit te voeren op dit weggedeelte, om na te gaan wat de oorzaken zijn van de ongevallen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de financiële bijdragen van provincies aan het hoofdwegennet

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Infrastructure minister about provincial co-financing of national motorway projects, noting that Overijssel and Gelderland pay far more than other provinces. The minister answered that the figures are distorted by timing of payments, that provinces have varying motives and financial capacity, and provided a table of co-financing shares, but the answer largely explains the differences by project phase and does not commit to new action.
This reasoning cannot be linked to the cited figures; see my answer to question 3.
Deze redenering kunt u niet aan de aangehaalde cijfers verbinden, zie hiervoor mijn antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Ten Broeke en Azmani over de financiële bijdragen van provincies aan het hoofdwegennet

VVD MPs asked the minister why Overijssel appears to contribute the most provincial co-financing to national motorway projects, and how investment priorities and the Infrastructure Fund figures were determined. The minister answered that investments follow the SVIR and NMCA bottleneck analyses and File Top 50, that the table reflects cash flows (inflated for Overijssel by a 2015 transfer), and listed 2006-2015 and upcoming Overijssel projects with co-financing amounts.
The table was compiled from the annual reports of the Infrastructure Fund (IF).
De tabel is tot stand gekomen vanuit de jaarverslagen van het Infrastructuurfonds (IF).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over gebrek aan snelheidscontroles in diverse gemeenten

An MP asked whether police in several municipalities are not enforcing speed limits on 30 and 60 km/h roads and whether this policy should be tightened for road safety. The minister replied that enforcement is decentralised to local tripartite arrangements, that police and prosecutors set national enforcement priorities including speed, and that no overview exists of how many municipalities include road safety in their plans.
I do not have an overview available of the total number of municipalities that have included road safety as a priority in their safety plans.
Ik heb geen overzicht beschikbaar van het totaal aantal gemeenten dat de verkeersveiligheid als prioriteit in de veiligheidsplannen heeft opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Jacobi over de hulpverlening op het Schelde-Rijnkanaal

MPs de Vries and Jacobi asked the ministers how rescue duties on the Schelde-Rijnkanaal were reorganised between two safety regions, whether the new rescue vessel meets comparable standards, whether other stakeholders were consulted, and whether shipping will face delays. Minister Blok answered that the safety regions decided on the split, that the new vessel meets at least the same standards, that stakeholders were consulted in working groups, and that shipping delays are not expected, while declining to account for the regional boards' decisions to parliament.
I do not wish to enter into this accountability relationship.
In deze verantwoordingsrelatie wil ik niet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the CBR (driving licence authority), including criticism of its communication, the handling of medical re-examinations and code 100 restrictions, and whether it has enough legal instruments. The minister answered that communication has improved, that the Gezondheidsraad advises on fitness criteria with new advice coming, that medical specialists play a role, and that the CBR has sufficient legal instruments.
