Following the Omroep Max broadcast, the CBR has adjusted the instructions for the experts who conduct driving tests.
Het CBR heeft naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Omroep Max de instructies aangepast voor de deskundigen die rijtesten afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het kappen van beschermd ooibos

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the felling of protected riverside forest in the Stiftse uiterwaarden under the Stroomlijn programme, including whether local support and alternatives were adequately considered. The minister answered that the programme is nearly complete, that the southern part's plan was adjusted with the owner, and that the process was transparent, while maintaining that the vegetation removal is necessary for flood safety.
In consultation with the owner/manager of the Stiftsche Uiterwaard, it was agreed to adjust the locations for vegetation removal in the southern part.
In overleg met de eigenaar/beheerder van de Stiftsche Uiterwaard is afgesproken de locaties voor vegetatieverwijdering op het zuidelijk deel aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat vrachtautochauffeurs hun wagen uitrusten met apparatuur om uitstoot te verdoezelen

Member Smaling (SP) asked about reports that truck drivers fit devices to switch off AdBlue systems, hiding excess NOx emissions, and asked how widespread this is and what will be done. The State Secretary condemns the practice, estimates that manipulated trucks emit roughly Euro-I levels of NOx, says the number of affected trucks on Dutch roads is unknown, and commits to studying enforcement options with TNO and ECN and reporting back.
I am currently in discussion with TNO and ECN about roadside inspection options for switching off AdBlue systems.
Ik ben momenteel met TNO en ECN in gesprek over controlemogelijkheden langs de weg voor het afschakelen van AdBlue-systemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over onderbezetting van verkeersposten langs de Westerschelde

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether understaffing at the Westerschelde traffic posts causes economic damage and delays, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged staffing pressure at Terneuzen, said no economic damage resulted, described temporary task reductions and new traffic controller training, and denied that efficiency is at stake.
I am of the opinion that with the recruitment and training of new RWS traffic controllers, the pressure on staffing will be structurally removed.
Ik ben van mening dat met het aannemen en opleiden van nieuwe RWS-verkeersleiders de druk op de bezetting structureel weggenomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Ronnes over schadevergoeding door de kapotte stuw bij Grave

Three CDA MPs asked the minister whether the state bears responsibility, through the lack of a calamity plan and slow repairs, for damages from the broken Grave weir, and whether the damage should be compensated. The minister answered that the damage was caused by the ship collision rather than a government act, so no nadeelcompensatie applies; the investigation is ongoing and the shipowner's liability-limitation request is pending in court.
However, this damage is not the result of a government decision or action, but the direct consequence of the collision.
Deze schade is echter niet het gevolg van een besluit of handeling van de overheid, maar het directe gevolg van de aanvaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Potters en Veldman over de A73

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the A73 motorway, including accident figures, traffic congestion, the German truck toll, and whether extending the A77 would help. The Minister said accident risk on most of the A73 is below average, but the Cuijk–Boxmeer stretch is above average, so Rijkswaterstaat was asked for an analysis; she also gave congestion and maintenance details and said extending the A77 is not foreseen.
That is why I have asked Rijkswaterstaat to carry out an analysis of this stretch in the short term, to establish the causes of the accidents
Daarom heb ik Rijkswaterstaat gevraagd op korte termijn een analyse uit te voeren op dit weggedeelte, om na te gaan wat de oorzaken zijn van de ongevallen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over vorderingen rondom mobiel bereik in tunnels

MPs Hoogland and Oosenbrug asked about progress on mobile coverage in tunnels, including how new tunnel standards, tender specifications, provider cooperation and the Ketheltunnel and Blankenburg projects are handled. The minister answers that coverage is being facilitated through updated standards and provider agreements, with providers responsible for funding and installation, and that no Building Decree change is planned.
I will inform your House in the second half of the year about the results of this inventory of mobile accessibility in existing tunnels.
Ik zal uw kamer in de tweede helft van het jaar over de resultaten van deze inventarisatie van mobiele bereikbaarheid in bestaande tunnels informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jan Vos over de berichtgeving over het langer openhouden van Belgische kerncentrales Tihange en Doel

MPs Fokke and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about Belgian plans to extend the Tihange and Doel nuclear reactors beyond 2025, the Belgian response, and whether the Dutch government had pressed Belgium to close them. The minister answered that the lifetime decision is a Belgian national matter for the FANC regulator, that he had relayed parliament's wish for closure to Belgian minister Jambon, and that he would monitor the process.
I have conveyed the wish of your House to Minister Jambon and informed your House of this.
Ik heb de wens van uw Kamer overgebracht aan Minister Jambon en uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over een plan voor een recreatieproject in het Veerse Meer

An MP from GroenLinks asks the ministers about a proposed large recreational peninsula in the Veerse Meer, including the municipality's stance, a 50-year ground lease by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, land exchanges, and whether the government will block the plan before the coastal pact. The minister replies that the municipality decides, that the lease is subject to permits by competent authorities, and that the government will not block the plan now but will set rules in the Kustpact and the Barro.
Ahead of the final signing of the Kustpact and applications for permits, I cannot yet give insight into that.
Vooruitlopend op de definitieve ondertekening van het Kustpact en aanvragen voor vergunningen kan ik daar nog geen inzage in geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek, Albert de Vries en Vermue over een plan voor een recreatieproject in het Veerse Meer

MPs Çegerek, Albert de Vries and Vermue asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a large recreational development at the Veerse Dam in a Natura 2000 area, its tension with the Coastal Pact, the land lease agreement signed by the state property agency, and related permit and nitrogen questions. The minister answered that the project falls under the Nature Conservation Act permit regime, that the Coastal Pact will set zones and manage pending initiatives, that the state's role is only assessed at permit stage, and that the municipality council declined an anterior agreement with the initiator.
Ahead of the definitive signing of the Coastal Pact and permit applications, I cannot yet give insight into that.
Vooruitlopend op de definitieve ondertekening van het Kustpact en aanvragen voor vergunningen, kan ik daar nog geen inzage in geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het project Brouwerseiland

MPs Cegerek, De Vries and Vos asked the minister whether the Brouwerseiland coastal project fits her earlier stance against building up the coast, and whether she would refuse a derogation under the Barro that would block it. The minister said the Kustpact will set zoning, that the derogation decision will be made carefully under the legal test without pre-judging outcomes, and that local procedures and the municipal council will weigh local views.
I will take a decision on the derogation request as soon as possible, carefully weighing the presence of special circumstances and the national interests to be served.
Ik zal zo spoedig mogelijk een besluit nemen over het ontheffingsverzoek, waarbij ik de aanwezigheid van bijzondere omstandigheden en de te dienen nationale belangen zorgvuldig zal wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over verzekering voertuig bij medische testrit CBR

An MP asked whether a driving school vehicle is uninsured during a CBR medical driving test when the person lacks a valid licence, and whether such tests must be supervised by a holder of a Wrm-pas. The minister replied that insurers do pay out, the CBR knows of no such cases, the CBR and insurers will clarify the matter, and no change in regulation is needed.
Therefore the CBR and the Verbond van Verzekeraars will, at my request, ensure that the unclarities are removed.
Daarom zullen het CBR en het Verbond van Verzekeraars op mijn verzoek ervoor zorgen dat de onduidelijkheden worden weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Nijkerken-De Haan over de Duitse tolheffing in grensregio’s

Two VVD MPs asked the Dutch Infrastructure minister about German road tolls affecting border regions, including whether he would act and whether he would go to court with Austria. The minister said he has objected to Germany's plans, that the German plan was amended after his objections, that consultations with Austria and the European Commission are ongoing, and that going to court is not currently an option.
Going to court is therefore not currently an issue.
Een gang naar de rechter is nu dan ook niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de discussie rondom de aanleg van een bypass bij Kampen

An MP asked the minister about the dispute over the Kampen bypass and the Reeve housing plans, including consequences for financing and existing agreements. The minister answered that the bypass is independent of the housing plans, is financed from the Deltafonds, and that the 2013 agreements with the province and municipality are being honoured.
The bypass near Kampen is being built to improve water safety and does not depend on the building plans the municipality of Kampen wants.
De bypass bij Kampen wordt aangelegd ter bevordering van de waterveiligheid en is niet afhankelijk van de door de gemeente Kampen gewenste bouwplannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over hoge boetes in de binnenvaart

MP Jacobi asks the minister about high fines in inland shipping, the motion on anticipatory enforcement of crew rules, the 80 percent fine reduction not applying to owner-skippers, and whether bonds were involved in setting fines. The minister says anticipatory enforcement is only possible in specific cases and will be considered for the December 2017 crew rule change, justifies the differing fines for employees versus self-employed skippers, notes that ILT convenants with major shipping firms reduce checks, and commits to evaluating fine levels again in 2017 with sector partners.
Following proposals from social partners to modernise crew regulations, the CCR recently decided to amend parts of the Rhine Shipping Personnel Regulations.

Naar aanleiding van voorstellen van sociale partners voor modernisering van de bemanningsregelgeving is onlangs in de CCR besloten om onderdelen van het Reglement Scheepvaartpersoneel op de Rijn aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over een mogelijke maas in de wet inzake de vergunningplicht voor reclameverlichting

An SP MP asked whether illuminated advertising behind glass facades, such as The Sting in Utrecht, is exempt from permit requirements and whether the government will close this gap. The minister replied that regulation lies with municipalities and the Activiteitenbesluit, that Utrecht's advertising rules require no permit for this sign, and that a defective dimmer was replaced, so no statutory loophole exists.
In short, there is no loophole in the law.
Kortom, er is geen sprake van een maas in de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vertrekregeling voor ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked about early-retirement schemes for civil servants, RVU levies owed by the Belastingdienst, emails on internal warnings, contracts of the Broedkamer and unauthorised spending of 38 million euro under the Investment Agenda. The government answered that the schemes follow general ARAR rules, that 24 million euro in RVU levy was paid, that the emails are withheld to protect internal advice under Article 68 of the Constitution, and that the contracts will be made available confidentially.
On the basis of this cabinet line I do not provide the emails.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de emails niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Ronnes over de stuw bij Grave

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the damaged weir at Grave, its causes, impacts on inland shipping, residents of houseboats, dikes and other businesses, and why municipalities in Gelderland were informed later than those in Brabant. The minister answered that the cause cannot yet be determined pending a police investigation, described temporary and permanent repair measures, said the damage is not fully quantified, and promised an independent evaluation of the incident expected in spring 2017.
I cannot assess that at present. An independent evaluation will be carried out into the incident with the ship at the Grave weir.
Ik kan dat momenteel niet beoordelen. Er zal een onafhankelijke evaluatie worden uitgevoerd naar het incident met het schip bij de stuw Grave.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-de Haan en De Boer over het ongeval bij de stuw bij Grave

MPs of the VVD asked the minister about the causes and consequences of a ship colliding with the Grave weir on the Maas, including damage claims, repair timing, responsibility for coordination, and an evaluation. The minister answered that the cause awaits police findings, damages are unknown and claimable from the ship owner, repairs take at least six months, and an independent evaluation will be delivered by spring 2017.
Pending the results of the police investigation, I cannot make statements about the precise cause of the accident.
In afwachting van de resultaten van het onderzoek door de politie kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de precieze oorzaak van het ongeval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels, Belhaj en Van Veldhoven over de berichten 'Druk aan de Poort' en 'Zelfverrijking normale gang van zaken bij Rotterdams containerbedrijf'

D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and Security, Infrastructure and Environment, and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that many containers in Rotterdam port are not systematically scanned for nuclear material and that fraud occurred at a container firm. The government answered that customs uses a risk-based approach, that scanning and inspection capacity was adequate for the Second Maasvlakte, that radiological screening is applied where feasible, and that it cannot comment on ongoing investigations.
However, I cannot make any statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik echter geen mededeling doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over vervuilende afvalstort op Sint Eustatius

MP Van Laar asked whether a storm on Sint Eustatius washed a large part of the landfill into the sea, whether the landfill still sits on the coast, and why the new waste installation is not yet operational. Minister Plasterk answered that only a small part slid onto Zeelandia beach with limited environmental damage, that the Island Government is responsible for operating the new installation and is working on a budget solution, and that the Rijksvertegenwoordiger will keep discussing the timeline with the island.
The Island Government is currently looking for a solution.
Het OL is op dit moment bezig met het zoeken naar een oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht ‘Help we verzuipen in de vochtige doekjes’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about persistent sewage blockages and damage caused by flushed wet wipes, including the cost to water boards, weaknesses in the 2007 EDANA self-regulation, the need for a stricter ISO norm, labelling, and whether producers should bear extra costs. The minister acknowledged the problem, said self-regulation has not yet delivered a satisfactory solution, committed to a stricter norm developed by stakeholders and to reviewing EDANA's improved labelling, but rejected charging extra costs to manufacturers.
Given the problems described by sewer and treatment managers, it must be concluded that these agreements have not yet led to a satisfactory solution.
Gezien de door de riool- en zuiveringsbeheerders beschreven problematiek moet echter worden geconstateerd dat deze afspraken nog niet hebben geleid tot een bevredigende oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashof over ‘Brabants grondwater stinkt’

An MP asked the ministers whether they share concerns about health risks from hydrogen sulphide released when groundwater is pumped in Noord-Brabant, and whether they would check all measuring points and start follow-up research with the province. The minister answered that the province, as competent authority, has acted responsibly by commissioning TNO research and is itself primarily responsible for further steps and communication, with the issue placed on the agenda of regular national-provincial consultation.
In my view, the province, as competent authority, has discharged its responsibility appropriately by having TNO carry out thorough research into hydrogen sulphide gas in groundwater in Noord-Brabant.

Antwoord 4, 5 De provincie heeft als bevoegd gezag naar mijn mening op een verantwoorde wijze invulling gegeven aan haar verantwoordelijkheid door TNO een gedegen onderzoek 2 naar waterstofsulfidegas (H 2 S) in grondwater in Noord-Brabant uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Grote steden voelen niks voor bouwen in groene zones’

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Housing and Infrastructure about a report claiming big cities resist building on green zones, and whether the government should steer housing growth towards urban infill. The minister answered that municipalities and provinces hold the regie over housing, that the Ladder for Sustainable Urbanisation guides the choice between inner-city and edge-of-city building, and that further research and a National Environment Vision are forthcoming.
Municipalities and provinces have the lead role in making spatial considerations in urbanisation and housing construction.
Gemeenten en provincies hebben bij verstedelijking en woningbouw de regie bij het maken van ruimtelijke afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het terugdraaien van kilometertellers door hackers

MP Hoogland asked the minister about odTellerfraud (odometer hacking) and what has been done to implement his motion against mileage fraud in imported cars, including RDW practice and EU-wide mileage exchange. The minister answers that the RDW now gives 'onlogisch' ratings for imports where the recorded mileage is lower than at export, that a Belgian mileage exchange pilot has started, and that mandatory EU exchange by 2018 is unlikely to be met due to slow negotiations.

In line with the Hoogland motion, the RDW now gives the rating 'illogical' for imported vehicles previously registered in the Netherlands when the odometer reading is lower than at the time of export from the Netherlands.

Conform de motie Hoogland geeft de RDW inmiddels het oordeel «onlogisch» bij import van voertuigen die eerder al in Nederland waren geregistreerd als de tellerstand bij deze voertuigen lager is dan de tellerstand op het moment dat deze voertuigen werden geëxporteerd uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Martin Bosma over het bericht dat waterschappen risicovolle buitenlandse projecten aangaan

MPs Madlener and Bosma asked whether water boards should stop risky foreign projects and be placed under provinces. The minister replied that water boards invest no money abroad, only limited staff time, that the government wants them to keep sharing expertise, and declined to intervene or restructure water governance.
Under the Netherlands Financing of Decentralised Governments Act, water boards do not invest money abroad.
Conform de Wet Financiering Decentrale Overheden (wet FIDO) investeren waterschappen geen geld in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Jan Vos over het bericht dat waterschappen risicovolle buitenlandse projecten aangaan.

MPs Jacobi and Jan Vos asked about reports that water boards invest in risky foreign projects via the NWB Fund, including coco loans, export credit insurance, OECD guidelines, and the Cali (Colombia) evacuations. The minister answered that water boards do not undertake commercial activities abroad, that the NWB Fund made an AT1 loan to NWB Bank rather than a coco loan, that export credit insurance is unavailable to public bodies, and that the Cali situation is being followed by the embassy.
Under the Decentralised Governments Financing Act (wet FIDO), water boards do not undertake commercial activities abroad.
Conform de Wet Financiering Decentrale Overheden (wet FIDO) ondernemen waterschappen geen commerciële activiteiten in het buitenland.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van Helvert en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Andere zorgen over kerncentrale Tihange’

MPs from the CDA asked whether it is alarming that safety plans of the Tihange nuclear plant were publicly accessible online, whether the minister will raise this with Belgium, and what cyber-security rules apply. The minister agreed it is alarming, said the ANVS has discussed it with Belgium's FANC and will raise it with his Belgian counterpart, and described existing nuclear cyber-security rules and reporting obligations.
I will also do so when I am in contact with my Belgian colleague Jambon.
Ik zal dit ook doen als ik contact heb met mijn Belgische collega Jambon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichtgeving dat de veiligheidscultuur van de kerncentrale Doel ver onder de maat is

MP Smaling (SP) asked the minister about reports that the Belgian regulator FANC raised serious concerns about safety culture at the Doel nuclear plant, including whether Dutch neighbouring municipalities were informed and whether the minister would urge closure. The minister answered that the ANVS informed local authorities, that closure is solely a Belgian regulator decision, that a letter was sent to Belgian minister Jambon, and that the FANC letters would be provided to parliament.
The assessment of whether a nuclear plant should be shut down or closed for nuclear safety reasons is a competence of the national authorities of the country where the plant is located.
De beoordeling óf een kerncentrale vanwege de nucleaire veiligheid zou moeten worden stilgelegd of worden gesloten, is een bevoegdheid van de nationale autoriteiten van het land van de kerncentrale.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Fokke over veiligheidsrisico’s van de Belgische kerncentrales

MPs Jan Vos and Fokke asked the minister about safety risks at the Belgian Doel and Tihange nuclear plants, including reports of lax conduct by the operator and the government's response to a parliamentary motion urging Belgium to close them. The minister said the Netherlands would press Belgium for measures and, in the extreme case, closure if risks to Dutch residents are shown, while noting the Belgian regulator found no direct safety problem and that joint inspections were carried out.
I implemented your motions by contacting my Belgian counterpart Jambon by telephone at the time.
Ik heb uw moties uitgevoerd door hierover destijds telefonisch contact op te nemen met mijn Belgische ambtsgenoot Jambon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het project Brouwerseiland

MPs Cegerek, Albert de Vries and Jan Vos asked the minister about the Brouwerseiland recreation project, covering Natura 2000 protection, nitrogen limits, the Kustpact, recreation oversupply, noise barriers, displaced recreation and participation. The minister replied that the Barro exemption and Nb-wet permit are handled by the competent authorities, with the Kustpact still pending and remaining decisions left to the province and municipality.

Beyond the national interests named in the Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte and the Barro, it is the responsibility of decentralised governments, for good spatial planning, to determine the need for space and weigh it.

Buiten de in de Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte en in het Barro benoemde rijksbelangen is het ten behoeve van de goede ruimtelijke ordening de verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheden om de ruimtebehoefte te bepalen en hiervoor een afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over mogelijke staatssteun aan Lelystad Airport

MP Van Tongeren asks whether discounts for charter and low-cost airlines at Lelystad Airport amount to unlawful state aid, how this fits the Aldersakkoord, and what profit expectations apply to regional airports and Lelystad. The Staatssecretaris rejects the state-aid claim, says discounts are not in themselves unlawful and are left to the operator within competition rules, and gives general profit outlooks while noting some details are not yet known.
Applying discounts as such in principle does not constitute (unlawful) state aid.
Het hanteren van eventuele kortingen als zodanig vormt in beginsel geen (onrechtmatige) staatssteun.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Vermue en Albert de Vries over berichten dat er steun van Europa te verwachten is voor twee goederenspoorverbindingen die de Zeeuwse havens kunnen aansluiten op het spoorwegnet v

Opposition PvdA MPs asked whether EU co-funding for two Zeeland rail links to the Antwerp and Ghent ports was realistic, and whether the government would join talks with the EU coordinator. The state secretary replied that cost-benefit analyses found the links socially unprofitable, that no EU co-funding has been signalled, and that a capacity analysis with Zeeland Seaports and ProRail is under way with results expected in early 2017.
Cost-benefit analyses were carried out for the additional rail link Axel–Zelzate (canal zone Ghent–Terneuzen) and the rail link between Antwerp and Vlissingen (VEZA arc).
Er zijn kosten baten analyses uitgevoerd voor de (extra) spoorverbinding Axel – Zelzate (kanaal zone Gent Terneuzen) en de spoorverbinding tussen Antwerpen en Vlissingen (VEZA boog).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Geurts over de aansluiting A30/A1

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about regional co-financing for the A30/A1 junction, after local authorities and the province offered funds. The minister confirms awareness of the offers, says she is willing to agree co-financing but only if there is a national bottleneck, and will wait for the 2017 NMCA results before talking with the region.
I am willing to make agreements with the region on co-financing the reconstruction of the A1/A30 junction.
Ik ben bereid met de regio afspraken te maken over cofinanciering bij de reconstructie van de aansluiting A1/A30.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de verkeers (on)veiligheid op de N36

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the minister about road safety on the N36, including fatality figures over ten years and how it compares with other N-roads. The minister answered that the N36 has 18 fatalities in the period, lists completed and planned Meer Veilig measures, and says a behaviour-change approach is being prepared, but declined to commit to a plan matching the average N-road.
In addition, I constantly monitor the safety of the N36 and all other national roads and take measures where necessary to improve safety.
Daarnaast houd ik de veiligheid van de N36 en alle andere Rijkswegen constant in de gaten en neem ik waar nodig maatregelen om de veiligheid te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Bergkamp, Koser Kaya en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Politie heeft geen zicht op dumpingen drugsafval’

Four D66 MPs asked the ministers whether police and partner agencies have sufficient visibility and capacity over illegal dumping and discharge of synthetic drug waste, given a report that many dumpings go undetected and carry health and environmental risks. The government answered that dumping is difficult to detect, that enforcement focuses on production, that regional protocols and projects are being developed, and that it sees no need for additional research, controls or a national approach.
At this moment I see no reason for additional actions.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende acties.
Antwoord op van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Duitse tolheffing

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the planned German road toll for passenger cars, its compatibility with EU law, its cross-border effects and possible Dutch complaints. The minister answered that the Commission and Germany are still negotiating, that the plan was already softened for border regions, and that no concrete figures or border-effect study exist yet.
I will study the outcome as soon as it is known, and will consider further steps.
Ik zal de uitkomst zodra deze bekend is bestuderen, en zal mij beraden op vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An MP asked whether the CBR's self-declaration approach to driver fitness is adequate, whether drivers' self-interest was examined, and whether the CBR should get more powers over psychological fitness for practical exams. The minister defends the current system, citing a 2012 study, driver responsibility and proportionality, and rejects additional CBR powers.
Therefore I do not consider it desirable to introduce additional powers and control mechanisms before the practical exam.
Daarom acht ik het niet wenselijk om extra bevoegdheden en controlemechanismen te introduceren vooraf aan het praktijkexamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de ondoorzichtige tarieven van publieke laadpalen

An MP asked ministers whether they would make public charging-point tariffs transparent and engage market parties on this after a Radar broadcast. The minister replied that price transparency is the responsibility of market parties and ACM, pointing to open protocols like OCPI and the NKL platform without committing to a concrete new step.
Making tariffs visible at the charging point is a responsibility of market parties.
Het inzichtelijk maken van tarieven aan de laadpaal is een verantwoordelijkheid van marktpartijen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Fokke over het bericht ‘Chemelot loost opnieuw een omstreden stof in de Maas’

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about reports that Chemelot discharged melamine into the Maas again, and whether Sitech broke rules and what action can be taken. The minister confirmed elevated melamine levels from Sitech's treatment plant, said it is for the water board and courts to judge rule breaches, and declined to change the division of responsibilities while promising a risk assessment and possible review of the permit.
Ultimately it is for the court to judge to what extent an appeal against permits or against a decision whether or not to enforce is well-founded.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te oordelen in hoeverre een beroep tegen vergunningen of tegen een besluit om al dan niet te handhaven, gegrond of niet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over dodenweg A59 Hooipolder

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment how dangerous the Hooipolder junction on the A59 is, after a TV programme on it, and whether it should be fully redesigned and funded jointly with the province. The Minister replied that accident figures show no elevated risk, that some warning measures already exist, and that a partial redesign is part of the planned A27 Tracébesluit, with a regional proposal still under discussion and a promise to inform parliament once clear.
When there is definitive clarity on this, I will inform your house of it.
Wanneer hierover definitieve duidelijkheid is, zal ik uw kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de inzameling van medicijnafval

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the ministers whether municipalities are living up to their responsibility for collecting unused medicines, whether pharmacies are being charged for it, and how waste costs are divided. The State Secretary answers that cooperation between municipalities and pharmacies is needed, that municipalities should make agreements to collect medicines without pharmacies bearing the costs, and that information will be provided to municipalities and pharmacies.
I therefore ask municipalities to reach agreements with pharmacists on the collection of unused medicines.
Ik vraag gemeenten daarom om samen met apothekers tot afspraken te komen voor de inzameling van ongebruikte geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Visser over de brief Drinkwatertarieven Evides Recreatieparken Zeeland

MPs Ziengs and Visser asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the sharp water-tariff increases for holiday parks at Evides, caused by fixed charges per address in the BAG register, were justified and compatible with the Drinkwaterwet, and whether gemeenten would remove wrongly registered stacaravans by 1 December 2016. The Minister answered that the tariff matter is for the courts and Evides, that the ILT exercises system-level oversight only, that most parks gain while 36 lose, and that municipalities are responsible for cleaning the register, with monitoring ongoing.
It is now up to the court to judge whether the tariff methodology of the drinking water company is soundly argued and fair in the individual case.
Het is nu aan de rechter om te oordelen of de tariefsmethodiek van het drinkwaterbedrijf deugdelijk is beargumenteerd en rechtvaardig is in het individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the CBR's plan to reduce driving-test locations from 53 to 30, including whether the plan was discussed with staff and industry and how it affects users with extra travel costs. The minister replies that the 30 locations offer longer opening hours and better facilities, that job losses are avoided, and that the change was discussed with staff and trade organisations.
The number of locations where practical examinations are held remains 53.
Het aantal locaties waar praktijkexamens worden afgenomen blijft 53.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Visser inzake de staat van de bruggen (ook wel kunstwerken) in Nederland

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about bridge failures in Noord-Holland, inspection and maintenance priorities, funding for bridge upkeep in the Infrastructure Fund, and the Merwedebrug. The Minister rejects the claim that maintenance has been deprioritised, describes inspection routines and flexible planning, reports how maintenance budgets were increased since 2011, and says the Merwedebrug inspection approach is under evaluation without concluding that the whole system must change.
Financial damage caused by traffic jams due to failures is unpleasant. However, this type of damage is not registered by Rijkswaterstaat and I cannot provide information on it.

Financiële schade die ontstaat door files als gevolg van storingen is vervelend. Dit type schade wordt echter niet door Rijkswaterstaat geregistreerd en ik kan hierover dat ook geen informatie aanleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het Voorlopige Kustpact

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment about the draft Coastal Pact, its definition of coastal values, the zoning and building ban, how it relates to Natura 2000, and how compliance by provinces and municipalities will be ensured. The minister answered that zoning will be worked out by provinces with partners, that the pact is a set of intentions to be translated into provincial and municipal rules, and that annual progress reports will be sent to parliament.
On the progress of the implementation of these agreements I will inform your House annually.
Over de voortgang van de uitvoering van deze afspraken zal ik uw Kamer jaarlijks informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over fraude met de WRM-bevoegdheidspas

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about fraud with WRM competence cards held by driving instructors, including whether the CBR's checks are adequate, why spot checks rather than checks on every candidate, and how many instructors have been found without a valid card. The minister answered that the CBR checks are only an extra instrument alongside police enforcement, that the ILT will take on an enforcement role under a pending bill, and that the CBR's limited checks do not allow conclusions about the scale of unlicensed teaching.
Depending on the ILT's experiences, I will take further action where necessary.
Afhankelijk van de ervaringen van de ILT zal ik zo nodig verdere acties ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van Helvert over de gevolgen van het sluiten van de Merwedebrug A27 voor vrachtverkeer

MPs Visser and Van Helvert asked the Minister about the closure of the Merwede bridge on the A27 to heavy traffic, its causes, traffic diversions, compensation for transport firms and repair timing. The Minister explained that fatigue in the steel main girders led to a ban on vehicles over 3.5 tonnes, that repairs were planned to allow heavier traffic again around late November or early December, that diversions and compensation procedures were in place, and that the situation was not expected to affect the broader A27 planning.
The decision not to allow traffic heavier than 3.5 tonnes was taken to safeguard the safety of (waterway) road users.
Het besluit om geen verkeer zwaarder dan 3,5 ton toe te staan is genomen om de veiligheid van (vaar)weggebruikers te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Leenders over het bericht ‘Merwedebrug op A27 nog weken dicht voor vrachtverkeer wegens slijtage’

MPs Hoogland and Leenders asked the minister about the closure of the Merwedebrug for heavy traffic, its effects on buses, schoolchildren and hospital visitors, inspection findings, and compensation. The minister answered that detours, emergency bus timetables, repair works and a compensation procedure are in place, and that an evaluation with provinces will follow, but declined to exempt buses from the closure for safety reasons.
I have also committed to evaluating the closure process with them.
Ook heb ik toegezegd het proces van de afsluiting met hen te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de sluiting van de Merwedebrug A27 voor vrachtverkeer

An MP asked why the Merwede bridge on the A27 was closed to freight without consulting Noord-Brabant, nearby municipalities or transport operators, whether other large bridges are safe, and whether a speed limit could have avoided closure. The minister answered that action was taken immediately for safety, dynamic loading rather than weight was the main concern, and repairs aim to allow heavier traffic again by late November or early December.
To guarantee the safety of (waterway) road users, action was taken immediately.
Om de veiligheid voor (vaar)weggebruikers te waarborgen is direct tot actie overgegaan.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over de nieuwe veerboot Texelstroom van TESO

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport has not yet decided TESO's over one-year-old request to bunker CNG for the new Texel ferry, and when a decision will come. The minister replied that the assessment is ongoing because technical information is still missing from the company, that the Amsterdam sightseeing boats are not comparable, and that a decision will follow as soon as the information is supplied.
The assessment of the application is still ongoing because the ILT has not yet received all the necessary technical information to assess the application fully.
De beoordeling van de aanvraag loopt nog doordat de ILT nog niet alle benodigde technische informatie heeft ontvangen om de aanvraag volledig te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het project Watertruck-plus

The MP asks about the Watertruck-plus pilot, a publicly co-funded project (about EUR 23 million, with EU support) to introduce small standardized barges for inland shipping, and whether it risks unfair competition with existing inland shipping and how it is justified. The minister answers that the project is an innovation pilot in Flanders targeting goods not yet carried by waterway, that additionality is a Flemish responsibility, and that the Commission views any market interference as acceptable given the potential gains.
Ensuring the additional character of the goods flows is the responsibility of the Flemish government.
Het borgen van het additionele karakter van de goederenstromen is aan de Vlaamse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Dijkgraaf, Visser, Geurts, Graus, Bruins, Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over het bericht dat een groot deel van de Noordzee nauwelijks bevist wordt

MPs asked the minister whether the finding that nearly 40% of the North Sea is barely fished changes the government's commitment to closing 10% of Dutch waters to bottom-trawling and the proposed extra closures on the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden. The minister answered that the study does not address protected ecological areas, which is the focus of the Dutch ambition, that the proposal remains a valid implementation of the 10-15% goal, and that she will inform parliament on how the Bisschop motion is executed, but could not answer before the committee meeting.
Soon I will, on behalf of the State Secretary for Economic Affairs as well, inform your House how I have executed the Bisschop motion.
Binnenkort zal ik, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, uw Kamer informeren hoe ik de motie Bisschop heb uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Lodders over het onderhoud van sloten door waterschappen

MPs Visser and Lodders asked the minister whether they share farmers' concerns about Vechtstromen water board reducing ditch maintenance and abolishing inspections, and how this fits the motion on flood prevention and the Water Framework Directive. The minister says the board is following a careful procedure with public consultation and appeal, that maintenance responsibility for the smallest waters shifts to owners, and that water-quality and flood risks are not expected to rise.
Furthermore, it applies a careful procedure in which public participation and appeal are possible.
Voorts hanteert ze daarbij, een zorgvuldige procedure waarbij inspraak en beroep mogelijk is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de berichten ‘Nederland ligt dwars bij aanpak dieselschandaal’ en dat een jaar na Dieselgate blijkt dat alle dieselmerken nog vervuilender zijn dan Volkswagen

An MP (D66) asked the ministers about reports that the Netherlands is resisting tougher diesel emissions testing and that most diesel models exceed emission limits, plus the RDW's positions in Brussels on independent testing, peer review and typeapproval for models such as the Opel Zafira. The ministers answered that a letter on the report would follow, that withdrawing approvals during ongoing investigations would be unlawful, and that the Netherlands supports Commission proposals for independent testing and peer review.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Jacobi, Bosman en over een onderhoud met schippers uit de binnenvaart

MPs asked why commercial shipping was barred from the Krammer recreational lock, whether this and deferred maintenance cause delays and safety concerns, and about weekend closure of the Middensluis. The minister replied that the lock's structures cannot safely bear commercial use, that the maintenance is planned rather than overdue, and that weekend closure reflects low demand pending a new lock.
When commercial shipping uses the Krammer recreational lock, the structural capacity of the scaffolding and fenders is insufficient, so safety cannot always be guaranteed.

Bij gebruik van de Krammerjachtensluis door de beroepsvaart is de constructieve capaciteit van de steigers en remmingwerken niet voldoende, waardoor de veiligheid dan niet te allen tijde kan worden gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over ernstige klachten van bewoners door de aanleg van extra rijstroken en een tunnel op de A9 (Gaasperdammerweg) in Amsterdam

MP Smaling asked the minister about severe resident complaints over noise, vibration, compensation and damage from the A9 Gaasperdammerweg tunnel works in Amsterdam, including night work, delayed compensation and monitoring. The minister answered that the nuisance is significant but mitigated through measures, that compensation and damage claims are handled by an independent commission and a building inspection process, and that noise monitoring and a 24-hour complaints line exist.
I am willing to start settling damage claims this year in the neighbourhoods next to the parts of the tunnel whose foundation works are being completed this year.
Ik ben bereid om dit jaar reeds te starten met het afhandelen van de schadeclaims in de wijken gelegen naast die delen van de tunnel waarvan de funderingswerkzaamheden dit jaar reeds worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over de convenanten met KLM en TUI ter voorkoming van recidive van drugskoeriers

MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked about the convenants with KLM and TUI listing drug couriers, including legal protection, duration of listing and whether the listing amounts to extra punishment. Minister Van der Steur answered substantively on each point, describing the listing as a civil-law measure with rights of access and correction under the Wpg and Wbp and a three-year term, while stating the measure is reasonable and has few complaints.
It concerns a term that can be considered reasonable.
Het gaat om een redelijk te achten termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de ruimtelijke inpassing van windpark De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Infrastructure and Environment about the spatial planning of the Drentse Monden en Oostermoer wind farm, covering objections handling, compensation and participation, the Energy Agreement, the Crisis- en herstelwet, the Aarhus Convention and ECHR compliance, LOFAR interference, and the rule of law. The minister answered that objections were handled in a Nota van antwoord, that a gebiedsfonds and planschade rules exist, that the plan meets good spatial planning and the ECHR/Aarhus standards, and that the process was carefully conducted.
In view of the foregoing, I am of the opinion that the decision is compatible with the ECHR and the Aarhus Convention.
Gelet op het vorenstaande ben ik van oordeel dat het besluit zich verdraagt met het EVRM en het Verdrag van Aarhus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Hoogland over het beginnersrijbewijs

Two MPs from VVD and PvdA asked the Ministers of Justice and of Infrastructure about weak enforcement undermining the beginners' driving licence, including stops, points, and police capacity. The government reported few suspensions since 2011, admitted unrecorded cases and capacity gaps, and promised an improvement trajectory and an evaluation of the scheme.
As indicated in the covering letter, there is an improvement trajectory regarding the beginners' scheme and the scheme will be evaluated.
Zoals aangegeven in de aanbiedingsbrief is er een verbetertraject met betrekking tot de beginnersregeling en zal de regeling geëvalueerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de handhaving van het strafpuntensysteem voor beginnersrijbewijzen

An MP from D66 asked why enforcement of the penalty-point system for novice drivers appears weak, citing very few suspensions, a sharp drop in traffic stops from 2007 to 2015, and the link to road safety goals. The Minister answered that the figures refer to prosecutor notifications rather than suspensions, attributed the drop mainly to police CAO actions and shifting priorities, listed enforcement priorities for 2016–2018, and committed to informing the House further and evaluating the novice regulation.
I informed your House by letter of 18 February 2016 about various topics concerning traffic enforcement.
Antwoord 11 Ik heb uw Kamer bij brief van 18 februari 2016 2 geïnformeerd over verschillende onderwerpen op het gebied van verkeershandhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over ongelukken met fietsers bij de Heinenoordtunnel

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about cyclists falling on escalators and lifts at the Heinenoordtunnel, including whether toezichthouders may not help people and whether the lift was repeatedly out of order. The minister acknowledged the accidents, said supervisors are not there to help cyclists but may do so if asked, and listed measures such as using the ramp, curbing vandalism and possibly letting supervisors restart equipment.
Rijkswaterstaat is further examining whether supervisors can restart the lifts and/or escalators themselves after a fault report, without intervention by the contractor.
Rijkswaterstaat bekijkt verder de mogelijkheid of de toezichthouders na storingsmelding de liften en/of de roltrappen zelf kunnen herstarten zonder tussenkomst van de aannemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Sjoemelsoftware Volkswagen: update auto’s helpt niet bij Audi Q5’

An MP from D66 asks the minister about reports that a software update for VW/Audi Q5 cars does not deliver the promised performance, whether Dutch cars should be re-tested, compensation, independent EU oversight, and Renault emissions findings. The minister says RDW and TNO will conduct a second opinion, that the German KBA is responsible for recall verification, that Europe-wide compensation is for the Commission to pursue, and that no Renault recall is indicated.
At the request of your House, I am having the RDW and TNO carry out a second opinion on Volkswagen.
Op verzoek van uw Kamer 2 laat ik de RDW en TNO een second opinion uitvoeren bij Volkswagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over de definitie van staatssteun inzake investeringen in havens in een richtlijn

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries (VVD) asked whether the government had raised the port state-aid issue with the European Commission and about the timing of EU guidance on subsidies to seaports. The minister answered that the Netherlands urged the Commission to publish state-aid guidance for seaports and to speed up revision of the block exemption, that the Commission has no current plans for such guidance, and that the Dutch corporate tax exemption for ports was ended while similar exemptions in Belgium and France are under formal investigation.
Together with the EP rapporteur for the new port regulation, Mr Fleckenstein, I sent a letter in June to EU Competition Commissioner Ms Vestager.
Samen met de EP rapporteur voor de nieuwe havenverordening, dhr. Fleckenstein, heb ik in juni jl. een brief gestuurd aan de EU Commissaris voor mededinging, mw. Vestager.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de berichten rondom de veiligheid van de reactor in Petten

An MP asked the ministers whether financial pressure on NRG, the operator of the Petten reactor, has subordinated nuclear safety, whether management pressures staff to keep the reactor running, and whether an independent investigation (e.g. by the Safety Board) and phasing out nuclear installations are warranted. The government answers that the regulator ANVS found no compromise of safety, that it has conducted intensified oversight and will host IAEA missions in October 2016 and early 2017, and that the financial questions will be addressed in a decision in Q4 2016, without committing to phasing out.
The ANVS exercises independent supervision over NRG.
De ANVS houdt onafhankelijke toezicht op NRG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het rapport ‘Zorg tussen wal en schip’

An MP asked several ministers about the OVV report on medical assistance at sea by the Kustwacht, covering staffing, investment, coordination with healthcare, and whether the Kustwacht annual report is sent to parliament. The minister defers substantive answers on most questions to a forthcoming full response to the OVV report, providing only partial information on summer incident patterns and the state of helicopter talks.
The answer to the above questions 2, 3, 4 and 5 I will include in my response to the OVV report.
Het antwoord op bovengenoemde vragen 2, 3, 4 en 5 neem ik mee in mijn reactie op het OVV-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over de inzameling van scheepsbedrijfsafval in de binnenvaart

MPs Jacobi and De Boer asked whether the shipping association ASV withdrew from consultations on ship waste collection, how the process will proceed, and whether more containers, cheaper subscriptions and waste separation will be pursued. The minister answered that ASV will present its ideas separately and at the October sector meeting, that all proposed improvements will be discussed together within a cost-recovery framework, and that expanding waste separation is included in those talks.
I want to discuss the sector's ideas with all involved parties at the same time and jointly assess which improvements are feasible
Ik wil graag de ideeën vanuit de sector met alle betrokken partijen tegelijk bespreken en gezamenlijk bezien welke verbeteringen haalbaar zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de voorgenomen ontwikkelingen en professionalisering van het havenbedrijf van Sint Eustatius

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about plans to expand and professionalise the port of Sint Eustatius, including container and cruise facilities, and whether such expansion would damage protected coral reefs. The minister answered that cruise, diving and fishing are the focus, a professionalised port company is the precondition, no structural planning exists yet, and any plan will go through an environmental impact assessment under the Wet maritiem beheer BES with results shared with parliament.
Your House will be informed of the outcomes.
Uw Kamer zal over de uitkomsten worden geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de verleende vergunning voor het vervoer van twee hoogradioactieve bronnen van NRG naar de COVRA en het bericht ‘Gevaarlijk nucleair afval wordt verkeerd vervoerd’

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked why two highly radioactive sources must be transported from NRG to COVRA now, whether certificates have expired, whether the ANVS supervises intact-source checks, and related risks and future special-arrangement transports, and whether the permit will be suspended. The minister answered that NRG must remove the waste within two years, that expired production certificates do not prevent use and are not reportable, that the ANVS oversees integrity checks, that a limited number of special-arrangement transports are expected, and that the permit cannot be suspended because no interim-relief request was filed with the Council of State.
No request for interim relief has been submitted to the Council of State, therefore the permit cannot be suspended.
Er is geen verzoek voor voorlopige voorziening ingediend bij de Raad van State, derhalve kan de vergunning niet worden opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Flessenhals A4 levensgevaarlijk’

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about rising accidents on the A4 near Leiden and the claim that a narrowing at the aqueduct was a wrong choice. The minister attributed the rise to growing traffic and congestion, said planned measures and a third-lane study are underway with results expected in 2017, and rejected the claim that the narrowing alone caused the accidents.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Hoogland over tunnels voor dassen en otters

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about badger and otter tunnels, noting that 12 of 13 otter crossing problems ordered by a 2014 court ruling for 2015-2016 remain unresolved, and who is responsible for maintenance. The government answered that the problems are complex, responsibility for most tunnels lies with provinces and municipalities, one problem is solved and others are being investigated, with some targeted for 2017-2018.
The Court set phased deadlines within which measures, such as construction or repair of ledges, fences or culverts, must be implemented.
Het Hof stelde gefaseerde termijnen vast waarbinnen voorzieningen, zoals aanleg of herstel van looprichels, rasters of duikers, getroffen dienen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht "Woningtekort dreigt door droog koken nieuwbouwmarkt"

An MP asks the ministers whether the shortage of new housing, shown by falling building permits, requires stronger central government action, rising prices, reform of the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation, and easier land acquisition for municipalities. The minister answers that housing supply is primarily a local responsibility, cites existing measures such as tax relief, expert teams and a planned simplification of the Ladder, and rejects restricting zelfrealisatie as a route to faster construction.
Responsibility for the quantitative development of the housing stock and for taking measures on it lies at the local level.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwantitatieve ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad en het treffen van maatregelen daarop ligt op het lokale niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Gemeenten gaan eigen weg’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about unclear road signs and markings set by municipalities, and about complaints handled by road authorities. The minister said road layout is the road authority's responsibility, guidelines are not mandatory, legal rules still apply, and only aggregate complaint numbers are available, with a VVN report due in 2017.
I do not have an overview of how these reports have been handled by the various road authorities.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de afhandeling van deze meldingen door de diverse wegbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Cegerek over de verdieping van de Nieuwe Waterweg en de Botlek in relatie tot oude milieumisdrijven

MPs Jacobi and Cegerek asked whether soil contamination in the Nieuwe Waterweg and Botlek had been systematically investigated before deepening, given past environmental scandals, and where dredged sludge would go. The minister answered that extensive soil research (TAUW 2015, MER documents) gave sufficient insight, that most material is clean enough for reuse, and that contaminated sludge goes to the Slufter depot.
With the research carried out, sufficient insight has been gained into the state of the soil.
Met de uitgevoerde onderzoeken is voldoende inzicht gekregen in de staat van de bodem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Visser over gebrek aan informatie binnen de transportsector over ‘inklimmers’ en de oproep om de 'jungle' van Calais te ontmantelen

MPs Visser and Azmani asked about the transport sector's lack of information on migrants climbing into lorries at Calais ('inklimmers') and calls to dismantle the Calais 'jungle'. The State Secretary answers that information is shared with TLN through periodic consultation, that the French authorities are primarily responsible for Calais, and that the government will keep raising the issue in European and bilateral channels.
The claim that information would not be shared with TLN is not correct.
De stelling dat informatie niet met TLN zou worden gedeeld klopt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over normoverschrijding bij vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about reports that hazardous goods trains in Brabant might be replaced by barges, whether registration of dangerous substances on trains is up to date, how registration quality is checked, and when water transport could start. The state secretary answered that a sample shows about 95% accurate registration on running trains, that registration at marshalling yards is insufficiently compliant, that the inspectorate will expand enforcement and report again at end 2016, and that the promised letter on the water-transport motion will follow in autumn.
The ILT will report to me again at the end of 2016 on the results of its supervision of information on dangerous substances at railway yards.
De ILT zal mij eind 2016 opnieuw rapporteren over de resultaten betreffende het toezicht op de informatie over gevaarlijke stoffen op spooremplacementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over de veiligheid van de Belgische kernreactor Tihange 2

MPs Mulder and Van Helvert asked the minister about the safety of Belgian reactor Tihange 2 after reports of irregularities in forged reactor components. The minister replied that the Belgian regulator FANC found no safety risk, that the dossier was incomplete, that no link to the reactor vessel cracks exists, and that the ANVS will keep monitoring the case and a communication plan is being developed.

I have, however, asked the ANVS to continue following the matter surrounding the irregularities at the Creusot forge and to inform me when new developments arise that are important for the safety of Dutch citizens.
Wel heb ik aan de ANVS gevraagd om de zaak rondom de onregelmatigheden bij de Creusot smederij te blijven volgen en mij te informeren wanneer er zich nieuwe ontwikkelingen voordoen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van Veen naar aanleiding van het bericht kartelvorming Europese truckfabrikanten

MPs Visser and Van Veen asked whether the government had noted the European Commission's truck cartel fine, and how much direct and indirect subsidy went to the truck makers and Dutch operators during the cartel period. The minister confirmed awareness, listed modest direct subsidies to DAF, Scania, Volvo and Renault, and programme subsidies to operators, and said clawback was not possible because no grounds existed and the subsidy rules were not affected.
There are therefore no indications that the cartel agreements affected or violated the relevant subsidy rules.
Er zijn dan ook geen aanwijzingen dat de kartelafspraken de betreffende subsidieregels heeft geraakt dan wel heeft overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat er sprake is van een ophoping van kernafval in Petten door falende apparatuur

MPs from D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the minister about reports of a build-up of nuclear waste at Petten caused by failing equipment, including how often the COVRA transfer deadline has been postponed, the VINISH problems, cost estimates and financial risks for ECN/NRG. The minister answered that the deadline was extended three times to 2022, that current VINISH problems are software-related and expected to be resolved, that cost estimates from 2015 remain valid, and agreed to publish the Turkenburg and Holtkamp reports with some passages redacted.
In accordance with articles 10 and 11 of the Open Government Act, a number of passages in the letter and the reports have been redacted.
Overeenkomstig de artikelen 10 en 11 van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur is een aantal passages in de brief en de rapporten weggelakt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hoogland over problemen inzake autohuur in het buitenland

An MP asked ministers about problems Dutch consumers face when renting cars abroad, what actions were taken and the status of the EU-level Joint Action with car rental firms. The minister acknowledged the problems, described the EU-led self-cleaning process and stated that new rules are not opportune for now, while awaiting the effects of measures taken.
At this moment I do not consider it opportune to come with proposals for new rules, as we are still awaiting the effects of the measures taken.
Op dit moment acht ik het niet opportuun om te komen met voorstellen voor nieuwe regels, nu we nog in afwachting zijn van de effecten van de genomen maatregelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid  Van Veldhoven over de verleende vergunning voor het vervoer van twee hoogradioactieve bronnen van NRG naar de COVRA en het bericht ‘Gevaarlijk nucleair afval wordt verkeerd vervoerd’

An MP from D66 asks the minister whether the ANVS permit for transporting two high-radioactivity sources from NRG to COVRA via a special arrangement instead of Type B packaging is safe and justified, and why applicants and external review were not used. The minister answers that the permit and packaging meet ADR and Bvser requirements, that no suitable Type B packages are available, that three safety barriers and additional conditions make transport safe, and declines external second opinion.
Are you prepared to submit the risk assessment for the stated solution to external experts, such as the IAEA, TNO and/or a body that certifies such packaging?

Bent u bereid de risico inschatting voor de genoemde oplossing voor te leggen aan externe experts, zoals van het Internationaal Atoomagentschap (IAEA), TNO en/of een instantie die dit soort verpakkingen certificeert
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Visser en Bruins over het bericht ‘Drenthe naar Tweede Kamer om borden TT en Wildlands’

MPs asked why Rijkswaterstaat enforced a 1.5 million visitor threshold to deny signposting to the TT circuit and Wildlands, despite exceptions elsewhere and public investment in the access road. The minister answered that the rule is uniform for verkeersveiligheid reasons, kept the southern sign, ordered the others removed, and rejected renewed talks.
An exception is therefore made for the signpost coming from the south on the A28; that sign may remain.
Voor het verwijsbord komend uit zuidelijke richting op de A28 wordt daarom een uitzondering gemaakt; dat bord mag blijven staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over de certificering van zeegaande zeilschepen

Two MPs asked the minister about outsourcing certification of sailing ships to classification societies, replacing Register Holland, including tender concerns, price rises and transition timing. The minister answered that EU rules require EU-recognised classification societies, that the ILT will oversee the transfer and arbitrate interpretation disputes, that prices will rise without a known amount, and that the transfer is planned between October 2016 and mid-2017.
I have instructed the Human Environment and Transport Inspectorate to closely supervise the transition.
Ik heb de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport de opdracht gegeven de overgang intensief te begeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de uitstoot van kankerverwekkende stof door Chemours

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the Chemours plant emits a carcinogenic substance (FRD-903/GenX) and whether animal tests showing effects like PFOA require consequences. The state secretary replied that FRD-903 is classified as toxic and persistent but not as carcinogenic, that RIVM is studying it further, and that workers' exposure falls under employers' duty of care supervised by the Inspectorate SZW.
I have therefore asked RIVM to report to me in more detail on what is known about the persistence, bioaccumulation, toxicity, carcinogenicity, mutagenicity and reprotoxicity of FRD-903.

Ik heb daarom het RIVM inmiddels gevraagd mij uitgebreider te rapporteren over wat bekend is over de persistentie, bioaccumulatie, toxiciteit, carcinogeniteit, mutageniteit en reprotoxiciteit van FRD-903.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht 'Recreatieplassen in de uitverkoop, bedrijven nemen exploitatie over’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about municipalities handing recreational lakes to commercial operators, including whether this is legal, its scale, access and parking costs, the role of recreation boards, and the salary of Leisurelands' director. The minister answered that decentralised authorities are free to set recreation policy, that no national overview exists, that the matter belongs to local democracy, and that Leisurelands' supervisory board and shareholders are responsible for monitoring spending.
There is no national insight into the accessibility of recreational lakes or how any local parking tariffs are set at recreational lakes.
Er is op landelijk niveau geen inzicht in de toegankelijkheid van recreatieplassen of hoe eventuele lokale parkeertarieven worden vastgesteld bij recreatieplassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Monasch en Jacobi over de verscherpte Stempelplicht Opvarenden van de Zeehavenpolitie Rotterdam

MPs Kerstens, Monasch and Jacobi asked whether the Rotterdam Seaport Police has tightened application of the Schengen Borders Code, shortening stays of foreign crew and limiting shipowners' freedom to deploy their crews, and why existing practice was abandoned. The government answers that the police apply the Code no more strictly than before, that exit stamps are given only when departure is imminent (about 300 persons were not stamped), and that it will work with the sector until 1 October to reach a workable implementation.
The Rotterdam Seaport Police does not apply the Schengen Borders Code more strictly than before.
De Zeehavenpolitie Rotterdam past de Schengengrenscode niet strikter toe dan voorheen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Vermue en Bisschop over de veiligheid van binnen- en zeevaart op de Westerschelde

MPs asked whether shipping safety on the Westerschelde is adequate and whether a speed limit for sea-going vessels should be imposed after complaints from inland skippers about wash damage. The minister acknowledges the concerns, describes existing separation measures and evaluation mechanisms, argues a speed limit would not solve the problem and could worsen safety, and says the issue will be discussed in the existing nautical platform.
Imposing a speed limit may actually adversely affect safety on the Westerschelde.
Het opleggen van een snelheidsbeperking kan de veiligheid op de Westerschelde juist nadelig beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over brugstoringen in Friesland

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about repeated breakdowns of the Skarster Rien bridges in Friesland, including their causes, prevention, whether traffic jams increased, and maintenance plans. The minister answered that there is no increase in breakdowns or traffic jams, explained the July 2016 pump failure and the inspection and maintenance regime, and noted major maintenance is scheduled for 2024.
No, there is no question of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Controle werktijden en bemanningsterkte op binnenvaartcontainerschepen’

An MP asked the minister whether the inspectorate had been told to enforce anticipatorily on inland shipping crew and working-time rules, and how that squared with announced checks. The minister replied that anticipatory enforcement is not yet applicable because the rules are still being modernised with social partners, so current rules are enforced and checks are announced in advance.
However, anticipatory enforcement can only apply when legislation is about to be amended.
Van «anticiperend handhaven» kan echter alleen sprake zijn indien wetgeving op het punt staat om gewijzigd te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers, Visser, De Boer en Van Veen over het bericht ‘Nederland traag met investeren via Europa’

VVD MPs asked why the Netherlands uses relatively little EFSI investment funding, whether projects were rejected, and whether EFSI should be extended beyond 2018. The minister replied that seven Dutch EFSI transactions worth EUR 287 million have been approved, that rejections are not recorded, that the NIA was set up to help pipeline projects, and that the government will assess any extension constructively, demanding budget clarity and evaluation.
The number of rejections for EFSI is not recorded, because that may contain business-sensitive information.
Het aantal afwijzingen voor EFSI wordt niet geregistreerd, omdat dat bedrijfsgevoelige informatie kan bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de Nederlandse kust wordt volgebouwd

An SP MP asked the minister whether the surge in coastal recreational construction revealed by a Natuurmonumenten inventory was a surprise, whether it breaches the building ban, whether the minister will issue a reactive directive to coastal municipalities, and whether irreversible steps will be avoided before a new National Environmental Vision. The minister replied that the inventory is a first step to be deepened with parties in the Kustpact, that no breaches of the Barro rules are reported, that a reactive directive is not warranted at present, and that current coastal rules will remain unchanged.
I have given my response there in broad outline and in line with the above answers.
Ik heb daar op hoofdlijnen en in lijn met bovenstaande beantwoording mijn reactie gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat woningprijzen dalen door windturbines

An MP asked the minister about reports that house prices fall near wind turbines, whether affected owners are compensated, and whether the burden of proof should be reversed. The minister denied that residents are left without redress, said effects cannot be established from WOZ values, and rejected reversing the burden of proof, pointing to the existing planschade procedure.
Nationally, this information, how many houses stand within a specific distance of a wind turbine, in this case the 2,000 m chosen by the researchers, has not been mapped.
Landelijk is deze informatie, de vraag hoeveel huizen er binnen een specifieke afstand van een windturbine staan, in dit geval de door de onderzoekers gekozen 2.000 m, niet in kaart gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Visser over het bericht ‘Miljoenenstrop door kosten aan Botlekbrug’

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked the minister for a full account of the costs from the recurring Botlek bridge faults, borne by Rijkswaterstaat, other authorities and the contractor, and why the state pays some of them. The minister itemised costs (about 1.3 million euro for tug escorts, 1.37 million for monteurs, 37,500 for the SMS service, 24,500 for the review), said the state pays costs it chose to incur as network manager, and said repair costs fall to the contractor and that fault repairs are being finetuned.
Rijkswaterstaat has no knowledge of costs incurred by other authorities or other parties.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft geen kennis van kosten die gemaakt zijn door andere overheden of andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over mobiele dekking in spoor- en autotunnels

Two MPs asked the government about the lack of mobile coverage in rail and road tunnels, including the Delft rail tunnel, and why it was delayed. The State Secretary answered that coverage in the Delft tunnel became available on 12 May 2016, admitted it came later than wished, and promised to report to parliament in autumn 2016 on talks with providers and to inform on responsibilities and tunnel standards.
It would have been better for travellers if they had been able to use a well-functioning mobile network directly when the rail tunnel opened.
Het was voor de reizigers beter geweest wanneer zij direct bij open telling van de spoortunnel over een goed werkend mobiel netwerk hadden kunnen beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat er sprake is van een ophoping van kernafval

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks asked the minister about reports that faulty measuring equipment at Petten leaves stored nuclear waste drums uncertain in content, and about delays in transferring the waste to COVRA. The minister confirmed the ANVS knew of the equipment shortcomings since spring 2015, said the waste remains safely stored, and gave partial answers on costs, delays and the NRG safety culture while referring some points to the regulator and the parliamentary debate.
The ANVS has been aware since spring 2015 that the accuracy of the VINISH installation at that time was not sufficient to achieve the characterisation agreed with COVRA.

De ANVS is sinds het voorjaar 2015 op de hoogte van het feit dat de nauwkeurigheid van de VINISH-installatie op dat moment niet voldoende was om de met COVRA afgesproken karakterisering te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht doorstroming A4 bij Leiden bijna net zo slecht als voor verbreding

An MP asked the minister about reports that traffic flow on the A4 near Leiden is nearly as poor as before widening, and whether a design error was made. The minister acknowledged rising congestion since 2013, defended the design, announced limited measures and a traffic study that will consider an extra lane, but refused to reopen the 2013 temporary layout or the Tracébesluit.
In addition, I will commission a traffic study into the problems on the A4, which will at least consider the solving capacity of an extra lane on the main carriageway.
Aanvullend zal ik een verkeerskundig onderzoek laten doen naar de problemen op de A4 en daarbij zal in elk geval gekeken worden naar het oplossend vermogen van een extra rijstrook op de hoofdrijbaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gevolgen van extreme weersomstandigheden

An MP asked the ministers about the consequences of extreme weather, climate scenarios, municipal climate risk preparedness, funding for adaptation, and event planning. The government answered that existing Delta Programme decisions remain valid, gave an overview of current programmes and an evaluation due end 2016, and said municipal capacity is the responsibility of local authorities.
The ambition is that by 2020 climate-resilient action and water-robust planning will be an integral part of their policy and conduct.
De ambitie hierbij is dat in 2020 klimaatbestendig handelen en waterrobuust inrichten een integraal onderdeel van hun beleid en handelen is
