Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het rapport “Marktwerking en Samenwerking in de Binnenvaart”

An MP asked the minister about a 2012 report on market competition and cooperation in inland shipping, including whether a freight auction could help and how market transparency is arranged abroad. The minister answered that an auction would not address sector fragmentation, that private platforms exist, and that cooperation within competition law is preferred, while stating no government-run auction exists in neighbouring countries.
In my view, an auction system has no influence on an important characteristic of the inland shipping sector in relation to price formation.
Een veilingsysteem heeft naar mijn oordeel geen invloed op een belangrijk kenmerk van de binnenvaartsector in relatie tot het proces van prijsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Aukje de Vries en Visser over de uitgave van Dagblad van het Noorden 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the navigability of the Westgat channel serving the port of Lauwersoog, whether vessels are diverting, and whether dredging or other action is justified. The minister acknowledged limited depth and possible future deepening, but argued that the situation is not urgent, that the port remains reachable, and that dredging would be costly with a low chance of payback, while offering to discuss the issue with the region.
I do not share your view that there is an urgent situation requiring action in the short term.
Ik deel uw mening niet dat hier sprake is van een urgente situatie welke noopt tot actie op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Houwers over eventueel achtergebleven medicijnresten in drinkwater

MP Houwers asked the minister about the drinking water norm for medicine residues, how far they can be filtered, whether current capacity suffices, and what the ministry is doing. The minister answered that there is no specific legal norm, only a 1 microgram/L signalling value, that a RIVM report is due by year end, and that a chain approach to medicines is being studied.
By the end of the year the RIVM will deliver an interpretation report, which will explain the seriousness of the medicine residue problem
Voor het eind van het jaar levert het RIVM een duidingsrapport op, waarin de ernst van de medicijnrestenproblematiek geduid zal worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over files bij de Afsluitdijk

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about repeated closures of the Afsluitdijk bridges, their cause, the repair measures taken and a planned event closing the road. The minister reports 17 unplanned closures in the first half of 2016 versus 8 in 2015, explains the causes and additional measures, and confirms the event has been moved to 4 September with the road closed from 2:00 to 12:00.
In this period there were a total of 17 closures outside the planned obstructions.
In deze periode zijn er in totaal 17 afsluitingen buiten de geplande stremmingen geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over de CvO-plicht betreffende sleepboten

MPs Jacobi and De Boer asked whether the mandatory inspection certificate (CvO) for tugboats is proportionate for recreational boating, and whether enforcement would be relaxed. The minister acknowledged the problems, said talks with the sector were ongoing and enforcement for small tugs was suspended pending their outcome, but gave no firm commitment to change the rules.
Pending the outcome of these talks, the ILT has for now suspended enforcement of the CvO obligation for small tugboats intended or used to tow small vessels.

In afwachting van de uitkomst van deze gesprekken heeft de ILT de handhaving op de CvO-plicht voor kleine sleepboten die zijn bestemd of worden gebruikt om kleine schepen te slepen vooralsnog opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht 'RDW onderzoekt bijna 300 voertuigen op verkeersveiligheid'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the RDW's investigation of nearly 300 vehicles from a former car dealer in Swalmen, including the safety problems, whether the dealer's name should be disclosed, cost recovery, and the delay between the police raid and the RDW investigation. The minister answered that the vehicles have poorly repaired damage and stolen parts, that the dealer's name cannot yet be given due to a criminal investigation, that the EU ruling limits technical inspection at import so the RDW will consider further measures once facts are known, that owners must pursue legal steps themselves while RDW costs are still being assessed, and that the delay reflected multi-party preparation.
Because of the criminal investigation, the name of the company cannot be mentioned at this time.
Vanwege het strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan de naam van het bedrijf op dit moment niet genoemd worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer inzake een werkbezoek aan een internationaal bedrijf dat zich richt op het ontwikkelen, ontwerpen en bouwen van schepen en materieel voor de bagger- en offshore- industri

MPs Visser and De Boer asked whether the government has policy supporting Dutch firms in international deep-sea mining, and whether a national legal framework is needed for such activities beyond national jurisdiction. The minister answers that deep-sea mining is embedded in the Topsector Water innovation agenda, that a national law is being considered through the Integraal Afwegingskader without commitment, and that Dutch influence in the International Seabed Authority does not depend on national legislation.
The preparatory process for a possible Dutch legislative process has started, in the form of applying the Integral Assessment Framework (IAK).
Het voorbereidingstraject voor het eventuele Nederlandse wetgevingsproces is gestart, in de vorm van het toepassen van het Integraal Afwegingskader (IAK).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Visser over overschrijding van geluidsnormen op de A8 bij Zaanstad

MPs Smaling (SP) and Visser (VVD) asked whether noise and air-quality limits are exceeded along the A8 near Zaanstad, residents' concerns, screen adequacy, traffic and modelling methods. The minister answers that legal noise production ceilings are not exceeded, air quality meets limits, screens are adequate, and a Schinkelbrug-based noise measure study will be checked for the Coenbrug, with several technical follow-ups.

Although the noise production ceilings are not exceeded, I have committed to examining whether the measures proposed from the noise reduction study on the comparable Schinkelbrug are also applicable to the Coenbrug.

Hoewel de geluidsproductieplafonds niet overschreden worden, heb ik toegezegd om te onderzoeken of de maatregelen die aangedragen worden uit het onderzoek naar geluidsreductie aan de – vergelijkbare – Schinkelbrug, ook toepasbaar zijn voor de Coenbrug
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Visser over aanhoudende problemen met de Botlekbrug en de Spijkenisserbrug

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked about repeated breakdowns of the Botlek bridge and the Spijkenisser bridge, including whether design faults exist and why Rijkswaterstaat cannot recover detour costs from contractor A-Lanes. The minister answered that the bridge was built as contracted, contractual penalties apply but detour damage cannot be recovered, Rijkswaterstaat has spent about 2.7 million euros on mitigation, and the integral analysis and design decision are due in autumn 2016.
Detour damage, however, cannot be recovered from the contractor on the basis of the contract.
Omrijschade kan op basis van het contract echter niet op de opdrachtnemer worden verhaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Duisenberg en Aukje de Vries over de uitgave van de Skûtsjekrant 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Binnenvaartbesluit and Binnenvaartregeling apply to historic sailing vessels, the bruine vloot and skûtsjes, what the effects are, whether there was consultation with the sector, and whether any fines have been issued. The minister answered that the rules have existed since 2009 with no known unclarity, that skûtsjes are exempted in key respects after sector consultation, that fines cannot be traced by vessel type, and that only the 31 December 2018 certificate obligation is new.
Fines issued in inland navigation since 2009 cannot be traced back to vessel type.
Boetes die in de binnenvaart sinds 2009 zijn afgegeven zijn niet naar type schip te herleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat opnieuw de stickers op de A12 gaat vervangen

The MP asks whether Rijkswaterstaat will again spend 120,000 euro replacing stickers on the A12 motorway and whether this is a waste of public money. The minister denies the 120,000 euro figure, says the stickers were added under a previous cabinet and their added value was insufficient, and states they will not be included in future maintenance contracts and existing contracts will be revised unless this costs more.
Therefore, when the still-running maintenance contracts are renewed, it will no longer be included that the stickers must be applied.
Daarom zal bij de vernieuwing van de nog lopende onderhoudscontracten niet meer worden opgenomen dat de stickers moeten worden aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over de uitvoering van het programma Stroomlijn, deelgebied 1 en 2)

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked the minister about public opposition to the Stroomlijn flood-safety vegetation-clearing programme, the balance with nature protection, the role of residents and organisations, the beaver habitat, the mid-term evaluation and the lack of compensation for felled trees. The minister answered that the programme is proportionate, consulted stakeholders, that the mid-term evaluation was completed and found the goals achievable, and that compensation is limited because most protected nature is spared.
Yes, the mid-term evaluation of the Stroomlijn programme has now been carried out.
Ja, de tussenevaluatie van het programma Stroomlijn is inmiddels uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over kaalslag in broedgebied Keteleiland

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked whether clearing a ten-metre vegetation strip on Keteleiland during the bird breeding season was lawful under the Flora and Fauna Act, why it was done then, and what alternatives existed. The minister said the Act permits work if nesting birds are not disturbed, that a survey found insufficient distance from some nests but no significant loss of breeding success, that the clearing was necessary for bank stability, navigation safety and flood risk, and that a Ministry of Economic Affairs investigation is ongoing.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs, as competent authority for the Flora and Fauna Act, is currently having further investigation carried out.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, als bevoegd gezag voor de Flora en Faunawet, laat momenteel nader onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Veldman over vleermuizen die bouwprojecten belemmeren

MPs Van der Linde and Veldman asked about bats (vleermuizen) blocking construction projects and housing for migrants under the Flora and Fauna Act, and whether the upcoming Environment Act could prevent delays. The minister answered that the government commissioned research into the economic effects and will respond, that about 250 exemptions were granted in 2014-2015 without data on stoppages, and that integrated planning, provincial responsibility under the Nature Conservation Act and standardised project approaches can prevent delays.
I have commissioned research into the problem and its economic consequences.
Ik heb onderzoek laten doen naar de problematiek en de economische gevolgen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de bouw van een outletcentrum in Zevenaar

An MP asked the Economics and Infrastructure ministers whether the approved Zevenaar outlet centre conflicts with the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation, regional retail deals and provincial steering, and what further action is possible to stop it. The minister answered that the Ladder is only a duty to motivate, that the decision belongs to local and provincial authorities and the courts, and that no further appeal is possible against the Council of State ruling.
No appeal is possible against the Council of State's decision.
Tegen het besluit van de Raad van State is geen beroep mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Tongeren over de noodstroomvoorziening Borssele

An MP asked ministers about the Borssele nuclear plant's emergency power supply, the absence of an environmental impact assessment for the licence revision, and whether the plant meets its safety commitments. The minister answered that the regulator found no significant environmental impact, that the plant has a backup grid connection and diesel generators, and that a planned upgrade in 2017 will further improve safety.
The ANVS has judged that these proposed changes do not involve significant adverse environmental effects and that an environmental impact assessment is not necessary for them.
De ANVS heeft geoordeeld dat bij deze voorliggende wijzigingen geen sprake is van belangrijke nadelige gevolgen voor het milieu en dat het niet nodig is om hiervoor een m.e.r. uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf inzake de onderbouwing van landelijke emissiecijfers voor erfafspoeling en riooloverstorten

An SGP MP asked the minister whether the national emission figures for surface runoff from farms and sewage overflows are reliable, since they rest on limited measurements. The minister answered that the farm estimate is based on 19 farms that had already taken measures and that total emissions are probably higher, promised to update the emission factsheet and sewage overflow estimate by the end of 2016, and described measures underway.

I see the measurement-based estimate by Stichting RIONED as a good starting point to work with the Emissieregistratie and the sewer and water managers toward an update of the total national surface water load from overflows.

Ik zie de op meetgegevens gebaseerde inschatting van Stichting RIONED als een goed startpunt om in samenwerking met de Emissieregistratie en de riool- en waterbeheerders tot een actualisatie van de totale nationale belasting van het oppervlaktewater uit overstorten te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de resultaten van de meetcampagne luchtkwaliteit 2015 van Milieudefensie

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Netherlands risks breaching EU nitrogen dioxide limits, citing a Milieudefensie measurement report, and what measures would follow, along with questions on speed-limit increases and low-emission zone signage. The State Secretary answered that only a limited number of NO2 hotspots remain, that additional funds were allocated for Amsterdam and Rotterdam, that compliance will be clear from the RIVM monitoring report at the end of the year, and that further measures will be decided then.
The monitoring over 2015, due at the end of this year, will show to what extent the standard was actually exceeded in 2015.
Uit de monitoring over 2015 die eind van dit jaar uitkomt, zal blijken in hoeverre er sprake is van daadwerkelijke overschrijding van de norm over 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over onderhoud van de A59

Two CDA MPs asked why a stretch of the A59 near Rosmalen will receive single-layer ZOAB in 2017 while other roads get double-layer, and whether the maintenance contract is deficient. The minister says single-layer is in line with the contract and the applicable rules, that no noise ceiling breach is foreseen, and that double-layer would be beyond legal requirements, so it will not be applied there.
In those consultations Rijkswaterstaat indicated that laying double-layer ZOAB goes beyond legal requirements and that it adheres to the applicable laws and regulations.
In die overleggen heeft Rijkswaterstaat aangegeven dat het aanleggen van tweelaags ZOAB bovenwettelijk is en zich te houden aan de geldende wet-en-regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Lodders en Veldman over de berichtgeving over de Nijkerkerbrug

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the one-year delay in renovating the Nijkerkerbrug, why the experimental tender approach was kept despite an agreement to revert to the classic method, the safety and economic consequences, and whether the renovation will be sped up. The Minister attributes the delay to technical and procedural risks and the new market-oriented tender approach, says the temporary safety and weight-limit measures are in place, and promises to explore partial recovery of the delay when the contract is awarded in spring 2017.
I have chosen to put the Nijkerkerbrug on the market in a different way, in a form suited to the recently presented Market Vision.
Ik heb ervoor gekozen om de Nijkerkerbrug op een andere manier op de markt te zetten, in een vorm passend bij de onlangs gepresenteerde Marktvisie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het voorstel van het college van burgemeesters en wethouders aan de Raad van de gemeente Arnhem over het voorstel voor mogelijke woningbouw in het uiterwaardengebied van de Ned

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about Arnhem's proposal to allow 250-350 homes in the Meinerswijk floodplain of the Nederrijn before any river hydraulic assessment, and whether this conflicts with flood-safety goals and the Barro. The Minister answered that the plan is only permissible if it creates more room for the river and meets Bgr and Barro conditions, which are not yet verified because the required river study is incomplete.
At present, from Rijkswaterstaat's perspective, there is no insight yet into whether the plan for Stadsblokken Meinerswijk is permissible under the Barro and the Bgr.
Op dit moment is er vanuit het perspectief van Rijkswaterstaat nog geen zicht op het al dan niet toelaatbaar zijn van het plan voor Stadsblokken Meinerswijk via het Barro en de Bgr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over de onnodige regeldruk voor vrijwilligers die voortvloeit uit de Regeling verkeersregelaars 2009

Two MPs asked about excessive regulatory burden on volunteer traffic marshals under the 2009 traffic marshals regulation, following Actal advice, and about sports bodies' exclusion from consultation and proposed reforms such as a national database and removal of individual appointments. The minister replied that a working group has a draft amendment ready for internet consultation, that the national e-learning database will replace separate appointment passes, and that motorcycle marshals remain barred from giving signals from vehicles for safety reasons.
It is expected that this draft proposal will be put to internet consultation by the Ministry of IenM this spring.
Naar verwachting zal dit conceptvoorstel dit voorjaar door het Ministerie van IenM in internetconsultatie kunnen worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over de aanpak van verkeershufters

MPs Van Helvert and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked why fines for road offences such as overtaking on the right and tailgating have fallen and how this fits the 2020 road-casualty target. The minister attributes the drop mainly to police CAO actions in 2015, vacancies and shifting priorities, announces a 2016-2018 enforcement plan, and declines to reinstate the alcohol-lock programme as not opportune.
An important reason for the decline in the number of fines imposed is the police CAO actions in 2015.
Een belangrijke reden voor de daling van het aantal opgelegde boetes zijn de CAO-acties van de politie in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over miljardeninvestering in nieuwe verkeersprojecten

An MP asks the minister whether the Infrastructure Fund top-up commits money a future cabinet should spend, whether there is a long-term mobility vision, why modal shift from road to inland waterways is not a goal in itself despite EU policy, and about emissions comparisons, the EU 30% modal shift target, success cases and cost-benefit of the Twente-Mittelland canal. The minister defers the spending question to the budget debate, points to existing energy and climate agreements, shows road share falling only slightly to 66% by 2014, and concludes the canal project is not socially profitable.
On Prinsjesdag I will inform you about the draft budget 2017.
Op Prinsjesdag informeer ik u over de ontwerpbegroting 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichtgeving inzake halvering van het aantal flitspalen

An MP asks why the number of speed cameras (flitspalen) in the Netherlands has halved, whether this reduces road safety, and how placement and removal decisions are made. The minister explains that placement follows the Openbaar Ministerie policy framework, that the number fell mainly because analogue cameras were replaced by digital ones (642 suitable locations identified), and that digital cameras enforce around the clock, so enforcement has in fact increased.
I do not have the precise number of speed cameras that were actively enforcing in 2011.
Het precieze aantal van het aantal flitspalen dat in 2011 in handhaving stond heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert inzake ongevallen op de A2

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about accidents on the A2 motorway, including trucks, the causes analysed, and five years of accident data. The Minister reports 1,918 accidents on the Leenderheide–Kerensheide stretch in 2010–2014, 44 involving trucks, notes causes are often unknown, and states that police records do not capture distraction or driving-hour violations.
Aspects such as distraction from calling or texting, failure to observe driving hours, and whether the driver is licensed to drive a truck are not routinely recorded in the accident registration.

Aspecten zoals afleiding door bellen of appen, het niet naleven van rijtijden en of de chauffeur gerechtigd is om met een vrachtwagen te rijden worden niet standaard in de ongevallenregistratie vastgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het gebruik van sluiproutes na de invoering van de Belgische kilometerheffing voor vrachtvoertuigen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether trucks were using Dutch side routes to avoid the new Belgian road charge, and whether she would consult her Belgian counterpart and address cross-border fuel purchases. The Minister said early counts show only route optimisation during a transition period with no clear evidence of lasting rat-running, that the matter would be raised with her Flemish colleague, and that the transport sector weighs costs when choosing routes.
In my next meeting with my Flemish colleague, Mr Weyts, I will certainly raise the road charge instrument.
Ik zal in mijn eerstvolgende gesprek met mijn Vlaamse collega, dhr. Weyts, zeker het instrument kilometerheffing aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Bosman over de berichtgeving over het Vlaamse voornemen om tol te heffen op personenauto’s

MPs Visser and Bosman asked the minister about Flemish plans to levy road tolls on passenger cars, Belgian truck tolls, the Eurovignette, and German car tolls. The minister said there are no concrete Flemish plans yet, that discrimination is not allowed under EU law, that Flemish roads are a Flemish responsibility, and that she will raise kilometre charging with her Flemish counterpart.
At my next meeting with Minister Weyts, which is not yet scheduled, I will certainly put the kilometre charge on the agenda.
Ik zal bij het eerstkomend gesprek met Minister Weyts, dat nog niet gepland is, zeker het onderwerp kilometerheffing agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert en Visser over het besluit om het alcoholslot op te heffen

MPs Van Helvert (CDA) and Visser (VVD) asked why the government abolished the alcohol interlock programme (ASP) after court rulings, questioning its cost, recidivism effects and whether alternatives were examined. The minister defended the abolition on cost and legal grounds, saying the programme could not be kept in administrative law and would add little in criminal law, while pointing to other measures and pending WODC research.

Weighing everything, we conclude that placing the ASP in criminal law offers too little added value beside existing instruments to tackle drink-driving, and that it is therefore not expedient to maintain the ASP.

Alles afwegende komen wij tot de conclusie dat het onderbrengen van het ASP in het strafrecht te weinig meerwaarde biedt naast het bestaande instrumentarium om rijden onder invloed aan te pakken en dat het derhalve niet opportuun is om het ASP in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de uitspraak van de rechter inzake Amsterdam versus Colt Technology Services b.v. ten aanzien van energiebesparende maatregelen

An MP asked the ministers about a court ruling on Amsterdam versus Colt Technology Services concerning the energy-saving obligation under the Activities Decree, and whether municipalities have enough enforcement tools and whether recognised measure lists resolve disputes. The minister answered that the agreements in the Energy Agreement are being implemented, that the recognised measure lists are a voluntary but legally anchored route for companies, and that the system will be evaluated after two years.
It has also been agreed to evaluate the new system two years after the new regulations entered into force (December 2015).
Er is bovendien afgesproken om twee jaar na inwerkingtreding van de nieuwe regelgeving (december 2015) de nieuwe systematiek te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het sjoemelen met spitsmijden

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports of widespread cheating in rush-hour avoidance (spitsmijden) projects, including whether improperly paid rewards must be repaid and whether a central exclusion database exists. The minister answered that no improper payments were made because checks run before payouts, that 3,600 participants were excluded, that repayment and sanctions are not warranted in the cases reported, and that a central database is undesirable on privacy grounds.
I am not aware that improper payments were made to the excluded participants.
Het is mij niet bekend dat onterechte uitbetalingen zijn gedaan aan de uitgesloten deelnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het onderzoek ‘Als de bliksem’ van de PvdA over het opvoeren van snorscooters

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, following a party study, why moped dealers affiliated with BOVAG so readily tune mopeds, and whether self-regulation and BOVAG remain suitable partners. The minister expressed disappointment, said BOVAG must do more and has been asked to tighten membership rules, but rejected banning tuning, lure-scooter checks, and ending the BOVAG cooperation for now.
I am therefore disappointed in the conduct of these dealers and expect Bovag to keep its promises and act even harder against members who tune mopeds.
Ik ben dan ook teleurgesteld in het gedrag van deze dealers en verwacht dat Bovag haar beloften waarmaakt en nog harder optreedt tegen leden die opvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat milieuzones in steden worden tegengewerkt

An MP asked whether the minister was obstructing city low-emission zones by delaying a uniform road sign and extending zones to lighter vehicles, despite a 2012 motion and requests from four municipalities. The minister answered that the sign delay stemmed from a Council of State advisory and redesign, that the passenger-car extension was dropped after a Visser motion, and that municipal zones are a local choice with local accountability.
To implement the Visser motion, the proposed amendment will drop the extension of the environmental zone sign to passenger cars.
Om uitvoering te geven aan de motie Visser zal uit de voorgenomen wijziging het voorstel tot uitbreiding van het milieuzonebord naar personenauto's worden geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Hoogland over het bericht dat milieuzones in steden worden tegengewerkt

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister whether the central government is undermining municipal discretion to set up environmental zones (milieuzones) for cleaner air, and how drivers can more easily know which zones apply. The minister denied any obstruction, said the government will drop the proposal to extend zone signage to passenger cars following the Visser motion, and said municipalities remain responsible and that communication on access rules is a local task.
The municipality is and remains responsible for taking local measures to improve air quality and can thereby proceed to establish an environmental zone.
De gemeente is en blijft verantwoordelijk voor het treffen van lokale maatregelen om de luchtkwaliteit te verbeteren en kan daarbij overgaan tot het instellen van een milieuzone.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over de bestuursrechtelijke uitspraak inzake de Utrechtse milieuzone

MPs Visser and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the government to respond to a court ruling that found the Utrecht environmental zone decision insufficiently reasoned, questioning the proportionality of environmental zones for passenger cars and the evidence on their air-quality effects. The State Secretary answered that the municipality is responsible for such zones, that the ruling leaves the zone in force, that the proposed extension to passenger cars would be dropped in line with a motion, and that effects and alternatives are for the municipality to assess, with an evaluation expected.
To implement the Visser motion, the proposal to extend the environmental zone sign to passenger cars will be removed from this planned amendment.
Om uitvoering te geven aan de motie Visser zal uit deze voorgenomen wijziging het voorstel tot uitbreiding van het milieuzonebord naar personenauto's worden geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over handel in praktijkroutes van het CBR

An SP MP asked the minister about a website selling exam routes for the practical driving test, and about a driving school with suspected fraud still operating, and whether entry requirements for driving schools should be tightened. The minister said there are no fixed exam routes, that the CBR terminated its contract with the driving school in question last year, and that rules for driving schools will not be tightened since SMEs are not regulated in the Netherlands.
I believe good information about choosing a driving school is important and I have strongly advocated for it.
Ik ben van mening dat goede voorlichting over de keuze van een rijschool belangrijk is en heb ik mij sterk voor gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, De Boer en Visser over de adviesaanvraag dienstregeling 2017 en de diverse nieuwsberichten over de te verwachten chaos in het (openbaar) vervoer in Noord-Kennemerland vanaf

Three VVD MPs asked the government about NS's 2017 timetable request for Noord-Kennemerland, the planned Velsertunnel closure and the risk of rail and road disruption and overcrowding in the region. The State Secretary answered that NS will adopt some stopping changes at Heiloo and Castricum, that the timetable is NS's responsibility, that Rijkswaterstaat has a mitigation plan, and that NS is monitoring capacity without having quantified combined economic impacts.
The timetable is the responsibility and expertise of NS.
De dienstregeling is de verantwoordelijkheid en deskundigheid van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch en Geurts over ontheffing lengte samenstel van landbouwtrekkers en aanhangwagen(s)

MPs from the CDA asked why the RDW cannot grant exemptions for tractor-trailer combinations longer than 18.75 metres, whether enforcement is underway, and whether the RDW's mandate should be widened. The minister confirmed the 18.75 m limit (aligned with EU Directive 96/53/EG), said there is no national enforcement campaign though regional checks occurred, and declined to widen the RDW's mandate because exemptions fall to provincial or municipal road authorities.
The authority to grant an incidental exemption, for example for an indivisible load, lies with the provincial or municipal road authority.
De bevoegdheid om een incidentele ontheffing verlenen, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om een ondeelbare lading, ligt bij de provinciale of gemeentelijke wegbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat de Coentunnel vier keer per dag gestremd is door te hoge vrachtwagens

An MP asked the minister about reports that the Coentunnel is closed several times a day by overly high trucks, and whether this harms Amsterdam's accessibility and whether it will be fixed before summer 2016. The minister acknowledged 3-4 height-related closures per day, said the government is taking measures such as signage, sector talks and police priority, but defended the existing traffic flow and gave no new firm solution.
Rijkswaterstaat monitors the number of overly high vehicles.
Rijkswaterstaat monitort het aantal te hoge voertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert inzake afwikkeling verkeer rond Utrecht

Two CDA MPs asked the infrastructure minister about traffic congestion risks on national and provincial roads around Utrecht from the city's draft mobility plan, including doubts about the modelling and the business impact. The minister said the effects cannot yet be determined, that Rijkswaterstaat has concerns and submitted an objection, and that the plan is a municipal matter, with follow-up agreements and talks with the municipality promised.
Rijkswaterstaat does have concerns about traffic flow on the main road network and the access roads in the city, and therefore about the city's accessibility.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft wel zorgen over de doorstroming op het hoofdwegennet en de toeleidende wegen in de stad en daarmee over de bereikbaarheid van de stad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch over de zorgen van waterschappen over de verdieping van de Nieuwe Waterweg en de Botlek

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about water boards' concerns over deepening the Nieuwe Waterweg and Botlek, including salinisation, groundwater, freshwater supply and whether source-based mitigation was considered beyond compensation. The minister answered that source measures are not feasible per the MER, that the permit procedure is ongoing and monitoring and conditions will be set in the Ontgrondingenwet permit, while declining to anticipate the draft decision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de uitwerking van de Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte (SVIR) voor de bereikbaarheid van Nederland

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, in 14 questions, how the Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte (SVIR) is being implemented for national accessibility, covering congestion, road widths, separation of through and local traffic, financing, real-time travel information and the Infrastructure Fund extension. The Minister answered that investments are proceeding within limited budgets, that some 2x4 and 2x3 targets are conditional on demonstrated need, that further studies are under way, and that she expects to inform parliament about the Infrastructure Fund extension on Prinsjesdag.
I therefore expect to be able to inform you on Prinsjesdag about the elaboration of the Harbers motion.
Ik verwacht u dan ook bij Prinsjesdag te kunnen informeren over de uitwerking van de motie Harbers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over verzakkingen rond de A4

An MP asked the minister about subsidence near the A4 motorway, including criticism that Rijkswaterstaat dismissed risks to houses and pressured the water board. The minister rejected that criticism, said subsidence is not caused by groundwater extraction, and described a monitoring and reinjection plan reported to the water board and municipality.
Rijkswaterstaat does not conduct research into possible other causes.
Rijkswaterstaat doet geen onderzoek naar mogelijke andere oorzaken.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Hoogland en Vermue over de gevolgen van het voornemen tot kilometerheffing in België voor de regio Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

MPs Hoogland and Vermue asked the minister about the effects on Zeeuws-Vlaanderen of Belgium's plans for a per-kilometre charge on passenger cars, and whether concrete steps had been taken. The minister replied that no concrete plans or timeline exist yet, that the decision lies with the Belgian regions, and that she will discuss cross-border effects with the Flemish minister once concrete plans emerge.
When there are concrete intentions, I am willing to talk with the Flemish Minister about possible cross-border effects.
Wanneer er sprake is van concrete voornemens ben ik bereid om met de Vlaamse Minister te gaan praten over mogelijke grenseffecten.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Helvert over tol voor personenauto’s op Belgische wegen

An MP from the CDA asks the Dutch Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether she knows of and will challenge Flemish plans for a per-kilometre road charge on passenger cars in Belgium, and whether she will raise the matter with the European Commission. The minister answers that no concrete Flemish plans or timetable exist yet, that she will ask the Flemish minister to stay informed as agreed under Benelux arrangements, and that she opposes new road pricing but sees no basis for Dutch action absent EU-law conflict.
In my discussions with my Flemish colleague I will certainly ask to be kept informed of plans and intentions, as also agreed within the Benelux framework.
In mijn gesprekken met mijn Vlaamse collega zal ik zeker vragen om geïnformeerd te blijven over plannen en intenties, zoals dit ook afgesproken is in Benelux-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Verkeersveiligheid 130km-wegen onbekend’

MP Belhaj (D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether it is true that the causes of accidents on 130 km/h roads cannot be determined, how the 85 million euro for road safety on those roads was spent and what it achieved, and how causes could be better recorded. The minister answered that police reports give the location and circumstances but not the precise contribution of each factor, that the 85 million was largely spent on Meer Veilig 3 and AKOE measures with an evaluation planned for 2018, and that improving accident data is a general priority.
I will inform you further about this with the 2017 budget.
Ik zal u hierover bij de begroting 2017 nader informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels en Van Veldhoven over de militaire beveiliging van Belgische kerncentrales en het oordeel van de Hoge Gezondheidsraad dat België onvoldoende is voorbereid op een kernramp

Two D66 MPs asked whether Belgian nuclear plants guarded by the army reflect a terrorist threat, whether the Netherlands faces similar risks, and how the Belgian Health Council's finding of inadequate nuclear emergency preparedness affects Dutch policy. The minister answered that no concrete threat information underlies the Belgian measures, that Dutch nuclear security is standard and in line with law, and that the Council's findings do not change the risk picture; the OVV is still considering an investigation.
No substantive information is given on specific security measures, including whether or when military personnel are deployed.
Over specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen worden verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan, dat geldt ook voor het moment waarop al dan niet militairen worden ingezet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het herzien van de wijze waarop het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu inbreng levert in onderzoeken en het onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de aanschaf van de Search and Rescu

An MP asked whether the ministry of Infrastructure and Environment would set rules on its input into studies, and why it did not disclose its involvement in the independent SAR helicopter study. The minister said internal guidance and an inter-departmental integrity process were underway, that the ministry was the commissioning party for the SAR study, and that involvement by Rijkswaterstaat did not compromise the study's independence.
The subject has since been raised in the Inter-departmental Platform on Integrity Management.
Het onderwerp is inmiddels ingebracht in het Interdepartementaal Platform Integriteitsmanagement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over te weinig capaciteit van beunschepen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the shrinking capacity of sand and gravel barges, the effects of CCR technical rules (ROSR) on small vessels, and whether small vessels should be exempted. The minister largely defended existing policy, citing the Panteia study and the CCR transition periods, and said exemptions from CCR rules are not within the government's power.
I therefore do not have the possibility to make exceptions.
Ik heb dus niet de mogelijkheid om uitzonderingen te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over veiligheidsnormen voor gemeentelijke bruggen en viaducten

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about how municipalities assess safety, weight limits and measurement of their bridges and viaducts, and about enforcement and costs. The minister said municipalities, not the national government, are responsible, deferred most questions to a pending exploratory study by the Minister for Housing, and pointed to ongoing TNO research and NEN working groups, promising follow-up only after the study.
I have no insight into this.
Ik heb hier geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat te hard rijden in Frankrijk je een rijverbod kan opleveren en antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake geflitste buitenlandse bestuurders

An MP asks whether French points-based licence penalties for speeding would affect Dutch drivers, and asks follow-up questions on enforcement of cross-border traffic fines, parking fee collection and access to flash photos. The minister answers that the French system only applies to CBE offences, does not strip Dutch licences, and that enforcement gaps and data retention questions are being addressed through technical changes and ongoing procedures.
The system does not infringe on the Netherlands' competence to conduct road safety policy for its own territory.
Het systeem maakt geen inbreuk op de bevoegdheid van Nederland om een verkeersveiligheidsbeleid voor het eigen grondgebied te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de koppositie van Nederland in transportcriminaliteit

An MP asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about the Netherlands' leading position in cargo theft, citing a TAPA report showing high figures and falling reporting willingness. The Minister answered that police figures show a 20 percent drop in cargo theft from 2014 to 2015, explained differences with TAPA's methodology, outlined reporting facilitation, enforcement cooperation, secured truck parking efforts and cross-border cooperation, while defending ANPR camera use.
Based on the reported figures for 2014 and 2015, it can be stated that the number of cargo thefts in the Netherlands has decreased by 20 percent.
Afgaande op de aangiftecijfers van 2014 en 2015 kan worden gesteld dat het aantal ladingdiefstallen in Nederland met 20 procent is afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over kritische rapporten over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij de verbreding van het Egyptische Suezkanaal

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked ministers about critical reports (SOMO and One World) alleging that Dutch dredging firms and the state-backed export credit insurer Atradius DSB failed to apply due-diligence standards to the Suez Canal widening, and whether commercial interests outweighed human and environmental rights. The government rejects the conclusion that economic interests prevailed, says it gathered sufficient information for an environmental and social assessment, and explains the differing findings of the SOMO report and the Witteveen & Bos study.
The cabinet has taken good note of the SOMO report in question and takes its observations and findings seriously.
Het kabinet heeft goede nota genomen van het betreffende SOMO-rapport en de observaties en bevindingen nemen wij serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Otwin van Dijk over de stand van zaken rondom projecten waarbij medicijnresten uit het water worden gezuiverd

MPs Jacobi and Otwin van Dijk asked about the halting of a pilot medicine-residue water treatment installation at Isala hospital, its cost-effectiveness, and related Pharmafilter projects. The state secretary answered that the Isala installation was a time-limited research facility now stopped due to high operating costs, that treatment is being explored in a broader chain approach, and that no specific new commitments were made beyond further reviews.
The installation was stopped because there are currently no new research questions related to it and its operating costs are considerable.
De installatie is stopgezet omdat er op dit moment geen nieuwe onderzoeksvragen in relatie tot deze installatie zijn en de exploitatiekosten van de installatie aanzienlijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de Belgische kilometerheffing

An MP from the CDA asked the Infrastructure and Environment minister about Belgium's truck road-charging system, which had technical problems and too few onboard units, and asked whether the minister had pressed Belgium for postponement and leniency in enforcement. The minister answered that contacts with Belgian authorities and the Flemish minister had taken place, that Belgium would show leniency if drivers could prove the device was faulty without fault of their own, and that the operator was being held to its obligations.
I have requested that the problems be resolved urgently and asked for leniency regarding enforcement while the introduction problems remain unresolved.
Ik heb verzocht de problemen met spoed op te lossen en om coulance gevraagd ten aanzien van de handhaving zolang de invoeringsproblemen niet zijn opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichten rondom de veiligheid van de kerncentrale in Doel

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that Belgium's Hoge Gezondheidsraad found a serious nuclear accident at Doel possible and that Belgian crisis plans were inadequate, and what Dutch citizens' safety is. The minister answered that the Belgian council assumed an accident could occur and assessed preparedness, that Dutch preparation zones were extended to 100 km and food-chain measures cover all of the Netherlands, and that safety is governed by strict international standards and independent oversight.
On 24 March you received a letter from me going into detail on the advice of the Belgian Hoge Gezondheidsraad.
Op 24 maart jl. heeft u van mij een brief ontvangen waarin ik uitgebreid in ga op het advies van de Belgische Hoge Gezondheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht ‘machtige lobby houdt scheepvaart milieuvervuilend’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether shipping is held back on sustainability by a powerful lobby, and what measures exist for LNG uptake, enforcement of emission rules, a European fine system and global climate rules for shipping. The minister answered that shipping is globally regulated via the IMO, outlined LNG incentives and port discounts, said enforcement is being intensified without seeing signs of weak enforcement, and described a phased IMO approach to shipping CO2 emissions.
I have no signals that the European environmental rules on emissions of harmful substances from ships are being poorly enforced.
Ik heb geen signalen dat de Europese milieuregels omtrent de uitstoot van schadelijke stoffen door schepen slecht worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over mogelijke maatregelen naar aanleiding van de gepleegde fraude met dieselauto’s

MPs Hoogland asked the government about possible measures following the diesel emissions fraud at Volkswagen, covering prosecution, regulation, testing (WLTP and RDE), type approval and fiscal options. The government answered that no facts currently justify a criminal investigation, that Dutch national bans on type-approved diesel cars are legally excluded, and that it is pursuing stricter EU-level testing and market surveillance rules.
There are currently no facts or circumstances known on the basis of which the Public Prosecution Service can start a criminal investigation.
Er zijn thans geen feiten of omstandigheden bekend geworden op grond waarvan het Openbaar Ministerie een strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over strengere eisen aan elektrische auto’s

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the total costs of individually approving self-built or converted electric cars, the EMC certificate requirement, and whether earlier cost figures misled individuals. The Minister answered that costs are about EUR 1,700 for an average vehicle, that EMC tests must be done at accredited test houses, that earlier figures excluded some costs, and that compensation for small builders is not warranted.
I see no reason for my Ministry to compensate these costs, if only for state aid considerations.
Ik zie geen reden om vanuit mijn Ministerie deze kosten te compenseren, alleen al vanuit staatssteunoverwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Hoogland en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Luchtkwaliteit in gevaar door 130 kilometer per uur’.

MPs Cegerek, Hoogland and Jan Vos asked the minister whether RIVM and TNO criticism of raising motorway speed limits to 130 km/h, and of the air-quality modelling, was taken into account and whether the forecasts were sound. The minister replied that the methodology follows the legal framework and Raad van State practice, that monitoring will track NO2 and PM10 annually, and that some route boundaries were adjusted after objections.
In the annual NSL monitor it is checked whether the air quality limit values are exceeded.
In de jaarlijkse NSL-monitor wordt getoetst of de grenswaarden voor luchtkwaliteit worden overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Luchtkwaliteit in gevaar door 130 kilometer per uur’

Two MPs asked the minister whether raising motorway speed limits to 130 km/h complies with environmental and safety norms, and questioned RIVM and TNO statements on air quality. The minister answered that the speed increases were tested against safety and environmental conditions, that monitoring shows no norm exceedances after the increase, and that the RIVM and TNO statements do not contradict the NSL 2015 report.
The speed increases of 5 February were – as with previous speed increases – tested against safety and environmental preconditions.
De snelheidsverhogingen van 5 februari zijn – evenals voorgaande snelheidsverhogingen – getoetst aan randvoorwaarden van veiligheid en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de aanpak van geluidoverlast en fijnstof bij de Coenbrug

An SP MP asked whether the Coenbrug on the A8 amplifies traffic noise for residents, what measures will reduce it, and whether residents' health concerns about fine particulates are justified, and whether noise screens should be replaced with ones that also capture fine dust. The minister replied that the bridge's steel construction causes a rumbling noise, that noise and air quality levels meet legal norms, that Rijkswaterstaat shared study results with residents and will keep them informed, and that replacing the screens is not being considered.
The fine particulate concentrations around the A8 at the Coenbrug, however, fall within the set limit values.
De concentraties fijnstof in de omgeving van de A8 ter hoogte van de Coenbrug vallen echter binnen de daarvoor gestelde grenswaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichtgeving omtrent louche rijscholen die frauderen met theorie-examens

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that driving schools use tricks to help tens of thousands of candidates pass theory exams fraudulently, including whether candidates can be made to retake, how exams leak, and whether driving schools can be excluded. The minister answered that no overview exists, that the CBR has taken many anti-fraud measures and can cancel contracts with schools, that fraud is reported to police, and that quality standards for instructors will be tightened.
There is no overview of how candidates completed their training.
Er bestaat geen overzicht van de wijze waarop kandidaten hun opleiding hebben gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de berichtgeving omtrent louche rijscholen die frauderen met theorie-examens

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that driving schools use tricks and turbo courses so candidates pass the CBR theory exam, and whether the CBR and government will act. The minister acknowledges the reports, says the CBR has removed non-substantive mnemonics, commissioned an external review of exam questions, and that the CBR can terminate contracts with schools, while the government is in ongoing consultation with the sector and rejects the claim that exam validity is compromised.
Such figures cannot be provided, because 'turbo driving schools' are not registered as such.
Dergelijke cijfers zijn niet te geven, immers » turbo-rijscholen» zijn niet als zodanig geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over rijscholen laten met trucjes tienduizenden cursisten slagen voor theorie-examen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment how rijscholen teach trucs and mnemonics that help candidates pass the driving theory exam, why this has not been stopped, and what oversight exists. The Minister condemns the practice, lists CBR anti-fraud measures such as new exam questions, external review and enforcement by police, ILT and the Belastingdienst, but says no data exist on how many candidates use such methods.
The CBR has commissioned an external expert firm to examine all exam questions for known and possibly new systematic predictabilities without substantive basis.
Het CBR heeft opdracht gegeven aan een extern deskundig bureau om alle examenvragen te onderzoeken op bekende en mogelijk nieuwe systematische voorspelbaarheden zonder inhoudelijke grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de fileproblematiek bij de Haringvlietbrug

An MP asked the minister about traffic congestion at the Haringvliet bridge after the new A4 near Steenbergen shifted freight routes toward Antwerp, and how bridge opening frequency relates to the jams. The minister said the traffic shift was anticipated, the current opening regime is proportionate, the norms for noise and air quality are not exceeded, and he is willing to consult transport sector, boating and local authorities and share the outcome with the House.
I am willing to consult with the transport sector, recreational boating and provincial and local authorities. I would like to share the outcome of the consultation with the House.
Ik ben bereid om in overleg te treden met de transportsector, recreatievaart en provinciale en lokale overheden. De uitkomsten van het overleg wil ik graag met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de waterschapsbelasting 2016

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the fairness of water board taxes in 2016, including regional tariff differences, the flat 3-unit charge for multi-person households, and whether to fund flood safety fully nationally. The minister defended the mixed national/regional financing, attributed tariff differences to local conditions and democratically elected water boards, and said an ongoing OECD follow-up study would be reported to parliament in mid-2016.
Your House will be informed around mid-2016 about the progress of the study.
Uw kamer zal medio 2016 worden geïnformeerd over de voortgang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Veen, Visser en Duisenberg over de financiering van kennisinstituut Wetsus na 2016

Four VVD MPs asked how the knowledge institute Wetsus, a public-private water technology research centre, would be financed after 2016 and whether it could be moved into NWO, KNAW or a TO2 status. The minister replied that funding continues through transition money, NWO calls, regional funds and private contributions, that structural funding falls outside IenM's remit, and that no move to NWO or KNAW is currently planned.
For the period from 2016 onward, the Wetsus funding is foreseen as follows.
Voor de periode vanaf 2016 is de Wetsus-financiering als volgt voorzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Fileprobleem neemt ook dit jaar verder toe’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the government shares the ANWB's concern that traffic congestion will keep rising in 2016 and whether commuting should be spread out. The minister confirmed the rise in congestion fits government forecasts, defended continued road building and the Beter Benutten programme, and said spreading commuter traffic is a promising but not sole solution, with talks with employers ongoing.
I expect that congestion will also increase this year, but less than the ANWB expects.
Ik verwacht dat de files dit jaar ook nog zullen toenemen, maar minder dan de ANWB verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Hoogland over alcoholcontroles in het verkeer

MPs Volp and Hoogland asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about alcohol checks in traffic, including how many occur at night, whether the night-time share cited by EenVandaag is correct, and whether night-time enforcement chances are lower. Minister Van der Steur answered with tables showing most checks occur in the evening and night, that the cited 10 percent figure is incorrect, that police target checks by information, and that the data cannot separate offences by check type.
The police registration does not separately record how many offences are found per check.
In de politieregistratie wordt niet apart bijgehouden hoeveel overtredingen per controle worden geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal, Hoogland en Kerstens over het verloren gaan van 45 duizend gezonde levensjaren als gevolg van het VW-schandaal

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Volkswagen emissions scandal really caused 45,000 lost healthy life-years, and what it means for public health and mechanics' occupational risk. The State Secretary disputes that conclusion, says the extra NOx emissions are not quantified, notes that air quality limits are largely met, and points to the Air Quality Action Plan and EU efforts on real-driving emissions testing.
It is not known how much the emission of nitrogen oxides increases as a result of the software fraud as found at Volkswagen.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel de emissie van stikstofoxiden toeneemt als gevolg van de softwarefraude zoals die bij Volkswagen is geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Visser over het lakse beheer van verkeerslichten

Visser (VVD) asks whether the minister will act on a survey showing lax traffic light management by road managers and whether CROW guidelines bind municipalities and provinces. The minister says the survey draws no conclusions, that CROW guidelines are not binding and municipalities cannot be held to them, and that she will only remind local authorities of the benefits of good management.
I cannot hold provinces and municipalities to account for that.
Ik kan provincies en gemeenten daar niet op aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Meer ongelukken door smartphone dan door bumperkleven’

An MP asks the transport minister about a US study finding that smartphone distraction causes more crashes than tailgating, whether its findings apply to the Netherlands, and whether the awareness campaign is effective. The minister answers that the US findings cannot simply be transferred, points to the ongoing UDrive study due in 2017, cites campaign evaluation data, and lists further measures such as the Fietsmodus app and a toolbox for employers.
To encourage this, I have asked VVN to create a toolbox for employers with low-threshold measures that contribute to responsible smartphone use.
Om dit te stimuleren heb ik VVN gevraagd een toolbox te maken voor werkgevers met laagdrempelige maatregelen die bijdragen aan verantwoord smartphonegebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over hernieuwbare energie in Noordwest-Europa en regelgeving voor de visserijsector

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government to respond to a European Parliament manifesto on North Sea renewable energy and to address fishing-sector rules around offshore wind farms, including transit for vessels over 24 metres. The minister agreed to strengthen North Sea cooperation, to broaden its scope to include fisheries, and to review transit rules after a two-year trial period from 2017.

Yes. It is important that the scope of North Sea cooperation on renewable energy is broadened, integrating among other things maritime spatial planning, including the fisheries and environmental dimensions.

Ja. Het is belangrijk dat de reikwijdte van de Noordzeesamenwerking rondom hernieuwbare energie wordt verbreed, waarbij onder andere maritieme ruimtelijke ordening, inclusief de visserij- en milieudimensie, integraal wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de erkenning van non-EU rijbewijzen en certificaten in de sector transport en logistiek

An MP asks why Turkish truck driver licences and certificates are not recognised in the Netherlands, whether they can be exchanged, and whether this harms the transport sector's labour shortage. The ministers explain that non-EU licences are recognised only for temporary driving, that exchange requires a bilateral agreement, and that there is currently sufficient EU driver supply, and they decline to add the issue to the transport sector plan.
Turkish driving licences cannot be exchanged in the Netherlands for a Dutch driving licence.
Turkse rijbewijzen kunnen in Nederland niet omgewisseld worden tegen een Nederlands rijbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat er weer een storing was op de Botlekbrug

An MP asked the minister why a Botlek bridge fault took over seven hours to fix, how often the bridge has failed, and how the builder is held liable for the damage. The minister explained the fault and repair steps, pointed to an independent review to be sent to parliament, and said the contract with the builder covers repairs but not damage from failures.
An independent review has taken place on the faults and their handling on the new Botlek bridge. I will send the results of this review to the House of Representatives at the beginning of March.

Er heeft een onafhankelijke review plaatsgevonden op de storingen en de afhandeling van de storingen op de nieuwe Botlekbrug. De resultaten van deze review zal ik begin maart aan de Tweede Kamer versturen
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Opel ontkent gesjoemel met software’

An MP asked the minister whether Opel had secretly modified emissions software after the dieselgate scandal, as reported by Belgian broadcaster VRT, and what the government would do. The government answered that neither it, the RDW nor TNO had prior suspicion, that Opel denies the allegations and the German KBA confirmed the service update was unrelated to emissions, and that it will monitor other brands and raise the matter in an EU working group.
That does not alter the fact that I remain vigilant regarding any other brands that may have applied fraudulent software to meet the European emission standard.
Dit neemt niet weg dat ik onverminderd alert blijf op eventuele andere merken die frauduleuze software hebben toegepast om aan de Europese emissienorm te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het gebrek aan autoafzetplaatsen langs de Rijn in Duitsland

An MP asked the minister whether the government would press Germany to provide more car-unloading and mooring places along the Rhine for Dutch inland shipping. The minister acknowledged the shortage, said the matter lies with the German Länder and federal authorities, and said the government raised it through regular contacts and would pass it on to the CCR and EU.
I have also asked my contact at the federal government to pass the signals on to the responsible regional authorities.
Ik heb mijn contactpersoon bij de federale overheid ook gevraagd de signalen door te geleiden naar de verantwoordelijke regionale autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘De kust zou leeg blijven. Toch gaat het volbouwen door’

Two MPs from D66 asked the minister how construction plans in Groote Keeten, Nieuwvliet-Bad and Hollum are legally based and whether they predate the withdrawn Barro expansion for building in dunes. The minister answered that these sites lie landward of the coastal foundation, so municipal and provincial rules under the Wro and Wabo govern them, and that the Barro coastal rules do not apply there.
These fall under the competence of the relevant municipality and province.
Deze vallen onder de bevoegdheid van de desbetreffende gemeente en provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser inzake spitsstroken

An MP asked the minister about peak-hour lanes: the top ten most-used lanes in 2015, whether they become permanent lanes, a stricter opening regime, safety and aggressive driving, driver awareness of the rules, and risky manoeuvres. The minister listed the top ten, said most will get or are being prepared for permanent measures, announced a follow-up study on the opening regime with first changes expected in Q2, and answered the safety questions mostly by pointing to existing reports and general campaigns.
The follow-up study into further improvement options for the opening regime, which I promised, has been started.
Antwoord 4 Het door mij toegezegde 1 vervolgonderzoek naar verdere verbetermogelijkheden van het openingsregime is in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over laad- en losfaciliteiten aan de Spijksedijk in de gemeente Rijnwaarden

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the wish of the municipality of Rijnwaarden for additional water-bound loading and unloading facilities at the Spijksedijk, including the feasibility study commissioned by the province, the role of Rijkswaterstaat, possible modal shift, and financial contributions. The minister answered that the initiative lies first with business, municipality and province, that Rijkswaterstaat is only competent for the water permit, that no national financial scheme exists for such private initiatives, and that the province will decide on follow-up after further research.
This is first and foremost a matter for business, the municipality and the province.
Dit is allereerst een zaak van het bedrijfsleven, de gemeente en provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Aukje de Vries over stremmingen op de Afsluitdijk

MPs Jacobi and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about repeated breakdowns and closures of the Afsluitdijk bridges, their causes, prevention and whether postponed maintenance is involved. The minister answered that storm-related disruptions stem mainly from ageing control systems being replaced in 2016, that emergency response and repair times are being shortened, and that maintenance is not postponed for the Afsluitdijk project.
In anticipation of the planned major maintenance, Rijkswaterstaat has started additional inspections of critical components to prevent breakdowns.
Vooruitlopend op het geplande groot onderhoud is Rijkswaterstaat gestart met extra inspecties van kritische onderdelen, om storingen te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over een kapotte brug op de Afsluitdijk

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a broken bridge on the Afsluitdijk, its repeated breakdowns, communication to motorists, and contingency plans. The minister answered that breakdowns are linked to the age of control systems being replaced in 2016, that information to drivers could have been better and signposts are being added, and that maintenance and extra staffing are underway.
The information provided to motorists could, in hindsight, have been better.
De informatievoorziening naar automobilisten had achteraf bezien beter gekund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht «Herstelwet niet langer deugdelijk»

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a Raad van State ruling that partly annulled the implementing decree of the Crisis- and Recovery Act, making the 'bestemmingsplan met verbrede reikwijdte' experiment temporarily unusable. The minister acknowledged the omission, explained the legal defect, and committed to repairing the decree via the 13th tranche with retroactive effect.
In the Division's view, this last condition has not been met.
Naar het oordeel van de Afdeling is niet aan deze laatste voorwaarde voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over carnavalswagens over de snelweg A76 in Limburg

A CDA MP asked the Infrastructure minister whether carnival floats could be escorted over a two-kilometre stretch of the A76 motorway in Limburg, as the province proposed, and whether such slow special transport has occurred elsewhere. The minister confirmed the province's position but refused to allow the floats on the motorway, citing unmet Wegenverkeerswet 1994 requirements, costs and police advice, and pointing to alternative routes.
Since the preconditions of the Wegenverkeerswet are not met and road safety cannot therefore be guaranteed, I am and remain of the view that these carnival floats may not use the motorway.

Nu niet aan de randvoorwaarden van de Wegenverkeerswet wordt voldaan en daarmee de verkeersveiligheid niet kan worden geborgd, ben en blijf ik van mening dat deze carnavalswagens geen gebruik mogen maken van de autosnelweg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de haven Rotterdam verdwijnt als groene omschakeling uitblijft

An MP asked the minister how she views a report warning that Rotterdam port may lose its position without a green transition, and what the state as shareholder will do to make the port greener. The minister answered that the transition is underway, that the port has the largest biobased cluster in Europe, and that the state supports it through several programmes, without committing to new binding steps.
I recognise the importance of a transition to a biobased and circular economy, including in the Rotterdam port.
Ik onderken het belang van een transitie naar een biobased en circulaire economie, ook in de Rotterdamse haven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat de filedruk op de A76 explosief groeit

An MP asked the minister about reports that congestion on the A76 motorway grew sharply in 2015, and whether this was linked to traffic patterns and German tolls. The minister answered that congestion rose 44% but the road is not a national bottleneck under current norms, that the 2013 analysis showed no bottleneck, and that a new analysis will start at the end of 2016.
Of course I will continue to monitor traffic developments on the A76.
Uiteraard blijf ik de ontwikkelingen van het verkeer op de A76 volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Cegerek over waterveiligheid in het kustgebied

MPs Jacobi and Cegerek asked the minister about the proposal to allow more building along the Dutch coast, the adequacy of coastal defences, changes to the Barro rules, decentralisation of coastal quality policy and related stakeholder demands. The minister answered that the current coastal rules stay unchanged for now, that a renewed consultation with stakeholders will follow, and that coastal safety is currently well in order, though many answers restate policy without detailing specific safeguards.
In addition, I have indicated that I will again consult the relevant societal and administrative parties on coastal policy.
Daarnaast heb ik aangegeven dat ik opnieuw in overleg zal treden met de betrokken maatschappelijke en bestuurlijke partijen over het kustbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over kentekenregistratie (in Kampen en Zwolle) om fietsgebruik te bevorderen

An MP asked the minister about licence-plate registration used in Kampen and Zwolle to encourage cycling, including whether a privacy impact assessment was done and whether motorists could opt out. The minister said no PIA was required or carried out by the regional government, motorists cannot opt out of the registration beyond blocking postal advertising, and similar cycling projects, such as in Breda, are expected.
A PIA was not carried out by the Province of Overijssel and therefore cannot be shared.
Een PIA is niet door de Provincie Overijssel doorlopen en kan derhalve ook niet gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de reeks van incidenten bij de kerncentrale Tihange

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about a series of incidents at the Belgian Tihange and Doel nuclear plants, including a leak in Tihange 2, a request for an incident overview, and whether the Netherlands would join legal action by Maastricht and Aachen. The minister said the Belgian regulator judged the leak not safety-relevant, provided an incident count, declined to join the legal steps as a Belgian national responsibility, and relied on the Belgian regulator's assessment of plant safety.
No, I am not joining the aforementioned legal steps.
Nee, ik sluit niet aan bij de genoemde juridische stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de sluiting van een parkeerplaats voor vrachtwagenchauffeurs bij Venlo

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the municipality of Venlo's closure of a truck parking area (Keulse Barrière), the blocked access road, the loss of a function for handing over escorts of exceptional transports, and whether the minister would seek a solution with the municipality. The minister replied that the municipality owns the site and decides on it, that the access was closed for safety reasons, that the exceptional-transport handover can take place at a dedicated site near the border, and that finding an alternative is not primarily the minister's responsibility, though regional parties are cooperating on parking solutions.
Proposing an alternative to the planned closure of the Keulse Barrière is not primarily my responsibility.
Het aandragen van een alternatief voor de voorgenomen sluiting van de Keulse Barrière zie ik niet primair als mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de gevolgen van de nieuwe loodsplicht voor kleine Nederlandse zeeschepen

An MP asked the minister about the effects of the new pilotage obligation on small Dutch sea vessels and whether they would be disadvantaged. The minister described the timetable, confirmed that exemptions will be tied to captain, ship and route, and promised calculations of effects while admitting some tightening for registered vessels.
After that I will bring the final proposal into procedure in the form of draft legislation.
Daarna zal ik het definitieve voorstel in de vorm van conceptwetgeving in procedure brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over het bericht ”Bron drinkwater deel Randstad vervuild met gif”

MP Grashoff asked the ministers about reports that dimethoate contaminated the source water for drinking water in the Randstad, the health risks to residents, support for the Waterschap Rivierenland investigation, cost recovery from polluters, and additional agricultural measures under the Water Framework Directive. The minister answered that residents faced no health risk because intake was halted and treatment removes such substances, that the water board is responsible for the source investigation with Rijkswaterstaat offering help, that cost recovery powers exist but cannot yet be confirmed, and that no new agricultural measures beyond the existing policy are planned unless targets are missed.
They have not run any health risks.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Hachchi over de vervuiling van een drinkwaterbron in Zuid-Holland

MPs Koşer Kaya and Hachchi (D66) asked about pesticide pollution of a drinking water source in Zuid-Holland, including incident frequency, substances and health risks, and what support and enforcement measures exist against the polluter. The minister answered that pesticide norm exceedances cause near-annual intake stops at several Maas and Lekkanaal intake points, that the source lies in the Bommelerwaard under the Waterschap Rivierenland's responsibility, and that the waterschap has administrative enforcement tools, with Rijkswaterstaat offering help.
The Waterschap Rivierenland has administrative enforcement instruments available to address the discharge in the Bommelerwaard.
Het Waterschap Rivierenland heeft voor de aanpak van de lozing in de Bommelerwaard bestuurlijke handhavingsinstrumenten tot haar beschikking
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de drinkwaterbron van 1,3 miljoen huishoudens is vervuild

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that a drinking water intake serving 1.3 million households in the Randstad was contaminated with the pesticide dimethoate, asking how it happened, whether health was at risk, the ecological effects and what measures would prevent recurrence. The government answered that the source is not yet identified, that intake was halted and treatment prevents health risks, that ecological effects cannot be excluded, and that the regular pesticide policy stands without new measures.
Regarding progress in establishing the cause, Waterschap Rivierenland, in the interest of the investigation, does not wish to make further statements.
Over de voortgang ten aanzien van het achterhalen van de oorzaak wil het Waterschap Rivierenland in het belang van het onderzoek verder geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over de inhuur van een interimmer door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about the hiring of an interim director by Rijkswaterstaat at a rate above the Balkenende norm, covering reimbursed living costs, non-publication in annual reports and the absence of a tender. The minister acknowledges the rate exceeded the norm for five months in 2013 and that it was not reported in the 2013 annual report, but defends the arrangement as a justified exception and promises stricter reporting of deviations.
