I will monitor more strictly that such deviations are consistently reported to the House of Representatives.
Ik zal strakker toezien op het consequent melden van dergelijke afwijkingen aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht op RTV Oost dat extra geld nodig is voor de N35

An MP asked the minister whether the national government is providing too little funding for the N35 road, which the state owns, and whether it will meet the province of Overijssel. The minister replied that about 600 million euros has been invested, roughly 450 million from national funds, that no further talks are planned unless the province raises a topic with its own financing, and that the N35 receives sufficient attention.
There is no reason for me to initiate an additional conversation with the province of Overijssel on this.
Er is voor mij geen aanleiding om aanvullend hierop een gesprek met de provincie Overijssel te initiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de aanpak van de N35, naar aanleiding van haar werkbezoek aan de gemeenten Raalte en Hellendoorn

An MP asked the minister about the N35 road upgrade, the Bos crossroads, traffic growth, the 2x2 widening and safety measures at Wijthmen-Nijverdal. The minister answered that the province's request for extra funding was declined, traffic monitoring and forecasts are in place, and the safety measures will be realised by 2018 after a participation process.
The administrative agreement stipulates that the measures will be realised by 2018 at the latest.
In de bestuursovereenkomst is afgesproken dat de maatregelen uiterlijk 2018 worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over aanhoudende problemen bij de kerncentrale bij Doel

An SP MP asked the minister about repeated shutdowns and incidents at the Doel nuclear plant in Belgium, including whether the Netherlands should urge closure and how residents were informed. The minister answered that the shutdowns stemmed from non-nuclear components with no safety consequences, that Belgium's independent regulator FANC confirms safety, and that joint inspections and information arrangements are in place, but declined to call for closure.
The independent Belgian Federal Agency for Nuclear Control (FANC) supervises the safety of these reactors.
Het onafhankelijke Federaal Agentschap voor Nucleaire Controle (FANC) houdt toezicht op de veiligheid van deze reactoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van Helvert en Knops over aanhoudende incidenten bij Belgische kerncentrales

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about recent incidents at Belgian nuclear plants Doel and Tihange, including Dutch involvement in extended operation, follow-up of IAEA recommendations, closure scenarios, communication with Dutch authorities, and joint inspections. The Minister answered that nuclear safety is a national Belgian matter, that she supports better involvement of Dutch authorities and has asked Belgium to explore it, that closure decisions rest with the Belgian regulator FANC, and that joint inspections with Belgium have started and more are planned.
The FANC will take a decision on that, if the FANC sees reason to do so.
Het FANC zal daarover, indien het FANC daar aanleiding toe ziet, een besluit nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Dik-Faber over aanhoudende incidenten bij Belgische kerncentrales

MPs Van Tongeren and Dik-Faber asked the minister about Belgian nuclear plants Doel and Tihange: life extension without a full environmental impact assessment, alleged illegal state aid, joint inspections, municipal involvement, and reliability ratings. The minister said the Belgian authorities judged an EIA unnecessary, that the Dutch and Belgian regulators held a first joint inspection and will do more, that Dutch municipalities are informed but lack formal involvement in Belgian decisions, and that state aid is for the European Commission to assess.

The Belgian authorities, on the basis of the relevant law and regulations and licence, judged that drawing up an EIA is not necessary for extending the operating life of Doel 1 and Doel 2 nuclear plants.

De Belgische autoriteiten hebben op basis van de relevante wet en regelgeving en vergunning geoordeeld dat het opstellen van een MER niet noodzakelijk is voor de bedrijfsduurverlenging van de kerncentrales Doel 1 en Doel 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over vissterfte bij waterkrachtcentrales

An MP asked the minister about fish mortality at the Linne and Lith hydropower plants on the Maas, which exceeds the 10% norm, and about progress on a motion and enforcement. The minister answered that consultations with operators have led to a requirement to submit a permit application by 1 July 2016, with enforcement possible afterwards, but gave no firm timeline for reaching the norm.
If no admissible application is received after 1 July 2016, I will consider further steps, including initiating an enforcement procedure.
Indien na 1 juli 2016 geen ontvankelijke aanvraag is ontvangen, zal ik mij beraden omtrent de verder te nemen stappen, waaronder het opstarten van een handhavingstraject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat glyfosaat gaat gebruiken op de kribben in de IJssel

An SP MP asked the government about reports that Rijkswaterstaat would use glyphosate on river groynes in the IJssel, and whether this was assessed against drinking-water and water-quality rules. The minister answered that glyphosate is currently legally permitted for treating tree stumps, that its use is targeted and limited to dry weather in the growing season with negligible water impact, and that no permit is required for this maintenance.
For this type of maintenance work there is no permit requirement, but there are rules for safe and sustainable use.
Er is bij dit type beheer en onderhoudswerk geen sprake van een vergunningsplicht, wel zijn er voorschriften voor veilig en duurzaam gebruik
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het nieuwsbericht “Kampen denkt na over extra bypass naast Reevediep”

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the government accepts that Overijssel and Kampen are seeking alternatives to a navigable Reevediep after the Council of State ruled it may not be a through shipping route, and about related zoning annulment. The minister answered that recreational shipping is part of an integrated area development, that the channel's construction does not depend on a shipping route, and that no concrete bypass plan yet exists.
As far as I am aware, there is (as yet) no concrete plan.
Voor zover mij bekend is er (nog) geen sprake van een concreet plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het afschaffen van het bouwverbod aan de kust

An SP MP asked the minister why the general building ban on the coast is being lifted before the Omgevingswet debate, and why the Grevelingen initiative was used to force legislation. The minister answers that the Nationale Visie Kust shows a safe coast allowing less strict water-safety rules, that the draft Barro amendment will be pre-tabled to parliament and published for four weeks of comment, and that parliament can debate it before entry into force.
The draft decision will be pre-tabled to your House and the Senate and published in the Government Gazette.
Het ontwerpbesluit wordt voorgehangen bij uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer en in de Staatscourant bekendgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over bouwen in de duinen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the ban on building in the coastal zone has been abolished, why, and what the consequences are for nature and the openness of the coast. The government confirmed it intends to replace the building ban with conditions for initiatives, leaving nature protection law in force and placing more responsibility on provinces and municipalities, while committing to talks with stakeholders.
The cabinet intends to replace the building ban in the coastal zone, outside urban areas, with new conditions for initiatives in the coastal zone.
Het kabinet heeft het voornemen om het bouwverbod in de kustzone – in gebieden buiten stedelijk gebied – te vervangen door nieuwe randvoorwaarden voor initiatieven in de kustzone
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over bouwen in de duinen

An MP from D66 asked how the planned removal of the general ban on new building outside built-up areas in the coastal zone fits with the Van Veldhoven amendment on protecting landscape values, and whether coastal provinces plan to designate their coast as provincial landscape. The minister answered that provinces may pursue landscape policy under the new Nature Conservation Act and that it is not yet clear whether coastal provinces will designate their coast.
Under the draft amendment to the General Rules for Spatial Planning Decree (Barro), provinces and municipalities can pursue policy in the coastal area in the interest of spatial quality.

Ingevolge het ontwerpbesluit tot wijziging van het Besluit algemene regels ruimtelijke ordening (Barro) kunnen provincies en gemeenten in het belang van de ruimtelijke kwaliteit beleid voeren in het kustgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Hoogland inzake storingen Botlekbrug

MPs Visser and Hoogland asked about recurring malfunctions of the Botlek bridge since its July 2015 opening, including costs to businesses, causes, a review team, diversion of hazardous goods traffic, and whether pressure from Rijkswaterstaat contributed to premature opening. The minister answered that the faults are being fixed and a review is underway, but declined to hold the contractor financially liable and said no commitments on hazardous goods exemptions had been made.
Rijkswaterstaat cannot hold A-Lanes liable for compensating the costs resulting from the detours.
Rijkswaterstaat kan A-Lanes niet aanspreken op het vergoeden van de kosten ten gevolge van het omrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het krantenartikel ‘Misschien Arabische verkeersborden Oranje’

Two MPs asked the minister whether Arabic traffic signs were being seriously considered for introduction in the Netherlands, following a newspaper report. The minister answered that there are no plans to add Arabic signs to the official traffic sign regulation and that local road managers handle site-specific safety issues.
There are no plans to include Arabic traffic signs in it.
Er zijn geen plannen om hier Arabische verkeersborden in op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de autofabrikant de automobilist overal volgt

An MP asked the minister whether car manufacturers tracking drivers everywhere infringes privacy, whether drivers should control their data, and whether the government will act. The minister replied that the Data Protection Act applies and the Dutch data protection authority supervises compliance, that drivers should have control and informed consent, and pointed to a privacy reference architecture and further work in the sector and at EU level.
It is up to her to judge whether the Wbp is being complied with.
Het is aan haar om te oordelen of de Wbp wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Hoogland en Visser over onnodige files als gevolg van tunneldoseren

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked the minister whether tunnel metering (tunneldosering) causes unnecessary traffic jams, citing VID findings, and asked about its purpose, effectiveness, use in new tunnels, and communication to drivers. The minister maintained that metering prevents jams inside tunnels, admitted uncertainty about side effects, and committed to further research into the effects on traffic flow.
Because doubts remain in the media and among road users about the effect of tunnel metering on traffic flow (a side effect), I am however willing to investigate this further.

Omdat er in de media en bij weggebruikers twijfels blijven bestaan over het effect van tunneldoseren op de verkeersdoorstroming (een neveneffect) ben ik echter wel bereid dit nog nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over achterstallig onderhoud aan de openbare verlichting op meerdere locaties langs de A15

An MP asked the minister why street lighting along the A15 motorway has been broken for months, why earlier repair orders were delayed, and what standards apply to repair times. The minister confirmed the problems, attributed delays to a costlier structural overhaul and budget reallocation, said the work is now scheduled for 2016-2017, and stated there are no fixed repair-time norms beyond traffic safety.
This approach is now planned for 2016/2017 (start 2016).
Deze aanpak is nu gepland in 2016/2017 (start 2016).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Monasch over het faillissement van onder andere V&D en Macintosh

MPs Cegerek and Monasch asked about the bankruptcies of V&D and Macintosh, the risk of retail vacancy, and why the ministers suspended parts of Zuid-Holland's retail ordinance without informing parliament. The government answered that restructuring is underway, pointed to the Retailagenda and Retaildeals, and explained that suspension was justified by doubts about compliance with national and EU law, with the provincial dispute still pending.
When there is genuine doubt that this is being complied with, intervention is necessary.
Wanneer er gerede twijfel is dat hier niet aan wordt voldaan, is ingrijpen noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de veiligheid van de A4-tunnel Midden-Delfland

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether cracks and detached concrete sections in the A4 Midden-Delfland tunnel were serious, whether they relate to earlier criticism and to reinforcement and monitoring. The minister answered that the damage was repaired, the structure meets all norms, monitoring continues until the municipality of Schiedam releases it, and no link to earlier criticism exists.
Rijkswaterstaat will continue to specifically monitor the repairs until the municipality of Schiedam, as competent authority (permit issuer), indicates that monitoring is no longer necessary.
Rijkswaterstaat blijft specifiek op de reparaties monitoren tot de gemeente Schiedam als bevoegd gezag (vergunningverlener) aangeeft dat monitoring niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de aanpak van (micro)plastics in de Rijn

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about microplastic pollution of the Rhine, its contribution to the North Sea, and whether current national and EU policy is adequate. The minister said the Rhine is an important source, outlined national measures (waste reduction, phasing out primary microplastics in cosmetics by 2017) and EU/OSPAR efforts, and offered to raise the issue with German and Swiss counterparts.
In addition, I am willing to raise the approach to microplastic sources via the Rhine during my regular contacts with German and Swiss counterparts.
Daarnaast ben ik bereid om de bronaanpak van microplastics via de Rijn aan de orde te stellen tijdens mijn reguliere contacten met de Duitse en Zwitserse ambtsgenoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven heeft gesteld over het bericht ‘Verplicht duurzaam beton’ en ‘Blog: de betrekkelijke waarheid van duurzaam beton’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary whether the government is failing to invest in sustainable concrete, whether Rijkswaterstaat specifies recycled concrete enough, and whether binding rules should replace voluntary Green Deals. The State Secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat already uses recycled concrete as foundation material, that the Green Deal is progressing slowly and a broader Betonakkoord is planned for 2016, but declined to make recycled aggregate mandatory.

I do not make mixed granulate mandatory as a raw material for concrete, because its technical performance is insufficient for general applications at Rijkswaterstaat and concrete is less readily recyclable in a subsequent lifecycle.

Menggranulaat schrijf ik niet verplicht voor als grondstof voor beton, omdat de technische prestaties onvoldoende zijn voor algemene toepassingen bij Rijkswaterstaat en het beton in een volgende levenscyclus minder goed recyclebaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over de vergunning verleend aan Urenco voor de export van 1000 ton verarmd uranium naar Rusland

D66 MPs asked how the ANVS issued a transport permit for depleted uranium to Russia despite a text error, what risks, oversight and Russian end-use guarantees apply, and whether the permit should be withdrawn. The government admits the error should not have been issued, says it was corrected by amendment, and defends the export licence as legally permissible with formal Russian guarantees, declining to withdraw it.
I regret the error made. The ANVS has in the meantime taken measures so that a strict application of the justification principle will apply from now on.
Ik betreur de gemaakte fout. Er zijn intussen door de ANVS maatregelen getroffen die er toe leiden dat voortaan sprake zal zijn van een strikte toepassing van het rechtvaardigingsbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het onderzoek van de respectievelijke ministeries naar het ‘te strikte beleid’ van de provincie Zuid-Holland inzake de vestiging van megawinkels

MP Smaling asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment and of Economic Affairs about their review of whether Zuid-Holland's restrictive retail-location rules for megastores are too strict, and about the status of the Raad van State advice, the national retail structure vision and the Bro provision. The minister answers that the review concerns a request by Decathlon for annulment of provincial rules, that a partial suspension of article 2.1.4(3)(a) is proposed, that the Bro provision does not restrict provinces, and that the government will not draft a national retail structure vision, relying on the Retailagenda instead.
It has been decided, prior to that decision and for the reasons given in the previous paragraph, to propose suspension of one part of article 2.1.4, third paragraph, of the provincial regulation.
Besloten is om voorafgaande aan die beslissing, om redenen genoemd in de vorige alinea, een onderdeel van artikel 2.1.4, derde lid, voor te dragen voor schorsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de voornemens voor een nieuwe helikopterhaven in de Eemshaven

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a proposed helicopter port at Eemshaven next to the Wadden Sea, questioning its environmental impact, the need for a permit, its long-term viability, and its effect on Den Helder airfield. The minister answered that the environmental impact report is not finished, that an exemption from the Wadden Sea no-new-airfields rule would be needed and cannot yet be assessed, and that permit applications are expected in early 2016.

This environmental impact report is not yet fully completed, so at this stage it is not possible to assess whether the effects (disturbance) on nature and the environment from the helicopter flights will be acceptable.

Deze milieueffectrapportage is nog niet helemaal afgerond, waardoor het in dit stadium niet mogelijk is te beoordelen of de effecten (verstoring) op natuur en omgeving als gevolg van de helikoptervluchten aanvaardbaar zullen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over een aan Urenco verleende vergunning voor de levering van verarmd uranium aan Rusland

MPs from D66 asked whether a November 2015 transport permit for up to 1,000 tonnes of uranium hexafluoride to Russia, and the related export licence, were justified given the sanctions climate, Russian plutonium and weapons risks, storage conditions and Euratom rules. The government answered that the permit wrongly mentions depleted uranium (only natural UF6 is covered, with a textual error to be corrected), that the export is civil and subject to Russian formal guarantees and IAEA safeguards, and that transport risks are low; several questions were answered by restating the regulatory framework.
The textual error will be corrected as soon as possible and the transport permit will be amended.
De tekstuele fout zal zo snel mogelijk worden hersteld en de vervoersvergunning zal worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over de voorgenomen proef met een peilverhoging in het Lauwersmeer

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about a planned two-year trial raising the water level at Lauwersmeer, including risks to residents, entrepreneurs and its role as a water storage area, and compensation for damage. The minister answered that the trial follows from the Natura 2000 management plan, stays within existing safety margins and is subordinate to water safety, that the matter is regional competence to be raised with the province, and that damage claims can be made under provincial compensation schemes.
I will forward the concerns and questions you have to the province of Groningen.
Ik zal de zorgen en vragen die u heeft aan de provincie Groningen doorgeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over het werkbezoek aan Port of Twente en de daar gevestigde bedrijven d.d. 30 november 2015

MPs Jacobi and De Boer asked the minister how she will limit the lengthy closure of Twente Canal locks during renovation, whether business was consulted on alternatives, and whether a long closure fits the policy of stimulating water transport. The minister answered that the tender challenges the market to minimise closure days (maximum 35), that business was consulted on temporary loading points, and that phasing the works is not an option because it would lengthen total closure.
I am preparing the tender for the renovation of the Delden and Hengelo lock complexes in the Twente Canal.
Ik bereid de aanbesteding voor van de renovatie van de sluiscomplexen Delden en Hengelo in het Twentekanaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het sjoemelen met spitsmijden

An MP asked the minister how drivers could easily cheat the peak-avoidance (spitsmijden) scheme Wild! Van de spits, and whether such attempts at fraud should disqualify participants and how large the fraud is. The minister acknowledged the reports, described the verification controls, excluded 949 of 12,638 participants (7.5%), and said fraud is hard to prove, while promising to return to the topic in the MIRT consultation in spring 2016.
It cannot be ruled out that there are participants who knowingly break the rules.
Niet kan worden uitgesloten dat er deelnemers zijn die bewust de regels overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over TNO-metingen van Euro 5-motorvoertuigen

MP Van Tongeren asked the government about TNO measurements of Euro 5 vehicle emissions, including whether chassis dynamometer tests reflect real-world emissions and whether the proposed 130 km/h limit on the A2 affects local air quality. The Staatssecretaris answered that the dynamometer tests remain a good indicator of practical emissions, that the TNO conclusions were already incorporated into the emission factors, and that the 130 km/h plan has no consequences for the A2.

It is correct that TNO indicates chassis dynamometer, or roller bench, tests are used, but it is not correct that this test method does not adequately approximate real-world emissions for Euro 5 diesel cars.

Het klopt dat TNO aangeeft dat er chassis dynamometer oftewel rollenbanktests worden gehanteerd, maar het klopt niet dat deze testmethodiek in geval van Euro-5 dieselauto's de werkelijke praktijkemissie niet goed benadert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Jacobi over het wegpompen van grondwater bij de A4 Midden-Delfland

MPs Hoogland and Jacobi asked the Minister about groundwater pumping at the A4 Midden-Delfland tunnel, including its causes, responsibility, impacts and whether the road can open by year-end. The Minister confirmed the problem, said the contractor is responsible for design and construction, and deferred the outcome to a pending Hoogheemraadschap decision expected in December, while describing further measures and reporting to the Chamber if desired.
Given the ongoing procedure at the Hoogheemraadschap, I do not want to anticipate the outcome of this procedure.
Ik wil gezien de lopende procedure bij het Hoogheemraadschap niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomst van deze procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over grote hoeveelheden lekkend grondwater aan de aangelegde A4

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about groundwater leakage at the newly built A4 Midden-Delfland road, its effect on the planned opening, responsibility for errors, and information for residents. The minister answers that the water board decision is expected mid-December, that the contractor is responsible for design and construction, and that the full answers to the questions could not be provided in time.
It was known at the design stage that the walls of the sunken section would be somewhat permeable.
Het was bekend bij het ontwerp dat de wanden van de verdiepte ligging enigszins doorlatend zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht “Scheurtjes in tunnel A4 Midden-Delfland”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about cracks in the new Ketheltunnel on the A4 and whether they relate to an engineer's earlier criticism of the design. The minister answered that the cracks were repaired, the structure is safe, the earlier criticism was checked by independent experts, and the opening is still planned for the turn of the year, while the groundwater pumping question is left to the water board's pending procedure.
Given the ongoing procedure at the water board, I do not wish to anticipate the outcome of that procedure.
Ik wil gezien de lopende procedure bij het Hoogheemraadschap niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomst van deze procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat een geflitste buitenlandse bestuurder vaak vrijuit gaat

MPs Visser (VVD) asked follow-up questions on foreign drivers escaping fines for traffic offences, including EU CBE directive enforcement, French blockades, and collection of parking and traffic fines from non-Dutch plate holders. The minister answered that enforcement and collection depend on directive implementation, bilateral treaties and technical adaptations, that some collection routes are working while others (Belgium, France, other EU states) are not yet effective, and that a law amendment is planned by year-end.
We aim to bring a proposal amending the Act on mutual recognition of financial sanctions into procedure by the end of the year.
Wij streven er naar voor het einde van het jaar een voorstel tot aanpassing van Wet wederzijdse erkenning van geldelijke sancties en beslissingen tot confiscatie in procedure te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over berichten in de media dat buitenlandse verkeersovertreders de dans ontspringen

A Dutch MP asks why photos of traffic offences by foreign-plated vehicles were destroyed and whether foreign offenders escape fines, and asks about research access and road safety. The minister explains that fines are issued to foreign drivers caught at the roadside, that digital enforcement fines are not yet sent to most foreign plate holders pending EU cross-border agreements, that the photos contain personal data under privacy rules and the law will not be changed, and that the government has not committed to new research access beyond the data's availability.
The flash photos contain privacy-sensitive data to which privacy legislation applies.
De flitsfoto’s bevatten privacy gevoelige gegevens, waarop privacy wetgeving van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Berndsen-Jansen over berichten in de media omtrent de “massale vernietiging van bewijsmateriaal van buitenlandse verkeersovertreders”

MPs Hachchi and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether evidence on foreign traffic offenders was massively destroyed, why, and how EU cooperation on collecting traffic fines works. The Minister answered that no fines were destroyed, that about 20% of fines are not collected, that cooperation generally works well, and that digital enforcement is being extended to foreign plates, though the reasons for deleting some data are only set out in a separate letter.
There is no question of destroyed fines.
Er is geen sprake van vernietigde boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Smaling over de verdere besluitvorming inzake Pallas

MPs Van Tongeren and Smaling asked about the province of Noord-Holland withholding the second tranche of the Pallas reactor loan, the business case, go/no-go milestones, isotope supply, state aid and the Petten contamination. Minister Kamp answered that the bestuursakkoord would be shared, but declined to share the business case or provincial correspondence, and gave general answers on timetable, isotopes and the cleanup.

Given the importance of efficient and well-considered implementation of the decision-making on the project, in particular the Foundation's task of attracting private financing for the construction of the Pallas reactor, I do not consider it desirable to share the business case with the House of Representatives, whether confidential or not.

Gelet op het belang van een efficiënte en weloverwogen uitvoering van (de besluitvorming over) het project, in het bijzonder de taak van de Stichting voorbereiding Pallas-reactor om private financiering voor de bouw van de Pallas-reactor aan te trekken, acht ik het niet wenselijk om de business case – al dan niet vertrouwelijk – te delen met de Tweede Kamer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert en Geurts over de decharge die de aandeelhouder van de NS verleende op 4 maart 2015 tijdens de ALV, ondanks het feit dat toen al duidelijk was dat NS in 2014 de Spoorw

MPs Omtzigt, Van Helvert and Geurts asked why the shareholder granted discharge to NS management on 4 March 2015 although an ACM finding of a Railway Act breach was already foreseeable, and about the handling of the Veolia tender case, remuneration reports and bonuses. The minister answers that ministries were informed step by step, that NS did not yet know the ACM decision date on 4 March, that discharge covers only facts known at that time, and that remuneration information is publicly available in the annual reports.

Moreover, the shareholder grants discharge to the directors only for what the shareholder knew at that moment, and it does not amount to approval of the conduct for which the legal entity remains responsible.

Overigens geeft de aandeelhouder alleen decharge aan de bestuurders voor wat de aandeelhouder op dat moment (moment decharge) bekend is en betreft het hier geen goedkeuring van de gedragingen waarvoor de rechtspersoon verantwoordelijk is en blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Veldman over het conflict tussen de gemeente Nijmegen en Rijkswaterstaat over het gebruik van de nevengeul van de Waal

MPs Hachchi and Veldman asked the minister about a dispute between Nijmegen municipality and Rijkswaterstaat over use of the Waal side channel and the Veur-Lent island, including whether Rijkswaterstaat is backtracking on earlier agreements. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat is working constructively with the municipality, will draw up a joint plan for the area, and indicated where a boathouse and seasonal catering may be located.
Rijkswaterstaat will, in consultation with the municipality, draw up a plan for how this area is to be used.
Rijkswaterstaat zal in afstemming met de gemeente een plan opstellen voor de invulling van dit gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het terugvorderen van ten onrechte verleende belastingvoordelen bij sjoemelende autofabrikanten

An MP asked whether tax benefits given to Volkswagen cars should be recovered after the emissions fraud, and whether lost tax revenue from CO2 misreporting would be pursued. The State Secretary said the NOx fraud is outside the scope of CO2-based tax incentives, that an investigation into possible CO2 irregularities and their tax consequences has started, and that Volkswagen will bear any additional levies, but could not yet quantify lost revenue.
I have therefore started an investigation into the possible consequences of these irregularities for tax collection.
Ik ben daarom een onderzoek gestart naar de mogelijke gevolgen van deze onregelmatigheden voor de belastingheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de Hoogwatergeul Varik-Heesselt

An MP (SP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the design flow of 18,000 m3/s at Lobith, alternatives to the Varik-Heesselt high-water channel, and cost and public support. The minister answered that the basis is the best available knowledge, referred to an annex on peak discharge, explained that climate change is applied only once in the GRADE model, and defended the channel as the only realistic alternative to dike raising, promising a further MIRT exploration.
Following questions raised in the June 24, 2015 Water committee meeting, I committed to send the Chamber the report on determining the Rhine river discharge.

Naar aanleiding van de vragen die in het AO Water van 24 juni 2015 (Kamerstuk 31 710, 43 ) gesteld zijn heb ik toegezegd de rapportage over de bepaling van de rivierafvoer van de Rijn aan de kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Nijkerken-de Haan en Öztürk over de keuringen beperkt houdbare producten die via Maastricht Aachen Airport (MAA) ons land binnen komen in Zuid-Limburg

MPs asked why perishable goods imported via Maastricht Aachen Airport must be tested at a single NVWA laboratory in Wageningen, why more labs are not certified, and whether the long turnaround times disadvantage the airport compared with Germany and Belgium. The government confirmed the Wageningen lab handles high-risk non-EU produce under EU rules, and said an ongoing MAR-L study of laboratory procedures and tariffs will report by year end.
The results of this study are expected to be ready by the end of this year.
Naar verwachting zijn de resultaten van dit onderzoek eind dit jaar gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de wijziging van het Besluit gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden betreffende gewasbescherming buiten de landbouw

The MP Geurts (CDA) asked the minister why a ministry official suggested the ban on pesticide use on paved areas outside agriculture would take effect in 2016 before the Chamber had discussed the draft decree, and how this fits with earlier promises not to take irreversible steps. The state secretary answered that no irreversible steps had been taken, that the official was only communicating expected timing, and that the Raad van State advice is expected in early 2016.
For the proper implementation of regulations it is important to be transparent and provide information during the drafting phase.
In het kader van de goede uitvoering van regelgeving is het belangrijk in de totstandkomingsfase daarvan transparant te zijn en voorlichting te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de rookoverlast van houtkachels, haarden en vuurkorven

An MP asked the government about health warnings from the GGD on wood-smoke pollution, how advice on stove use is disseminated, and its response to a 2006 RUG report criticising municipalities for under-enforcing smoke nuisance. The Staatssecretaris pointed to a handbook, MilieuCentraal information, a new Platform Houtstook, the principle that municipalities decide how to use their powers, and an EU Ecodesign tightening of stove standards.
It is further up to municipalities to determine how they give substance to their powers in combating smoke nuisance.
Het is verder aan gemeenten om te bepalen op welke wijze zij invulling geven aan hun bevoegdheden bij het bestrijden van rookoverlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht “Nieuwe druk op KLM”

An MP from the CDA asks ministers whether Air France-KLM plans to absorb Transavia and whether this breaches earlier commitments on KLM's position. The government answers that talks are ongoing, that earlier agreements were reaffirmed and are expected to be honoured, and that a transfer of Transavia France is not harmful to Schiphol network quality.
No conclusion can yet be given on changes to the governance structure of Transavia Netherlands, because these talks are still ongoing.
Over wijzigingen in de governancestructuur van Transavia Nederland is nog geen uitsluitsel te geven, omdat deze gesprekken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het verhogen van de maximumsnelheid op de A2 en de inwerkingtreding van de PAS (Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof) per 1 juli aanstaande

An MP asked whether the speed limit on the A2, including the Holendrecht-Vinkeveen stretch, can be raised to 130 km/h now that the PAS nitrogen programme takes effect, and for a list of eligible stretches. The minister said most of the A2 may later be raised as air quality and noise ceilings allow, that a court ruling on Vinkeveen-Maarsen is awaited, and that a draft decree for speed increases on several stretches was published.
I will inform the House about this this year.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hierover dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht «Trajectcontrole A2 levert 48 miljoen aan boetes op»

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why 31% of fines on the A2 trajectory-control stretch are collected, whether fines still have a corrective effect, and whether the speed limit will be raised or changed. The minister answered that only about 2% of vehicles speed there, that high traffic volume and fewer active systems in 2014 explain the number of fines, and that a decision on raising the limit awaits a court ruling and will be communicated this year.
I will inform the House this year about the options available on the A2.
Ik informeer uw Kamer dit jaar over de mogelijkheden die er zijn op de A2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Helder over het bericht dat de snelheidscamera’s op de A2 goed zijn voor 48 miljoen euro aan boeteopbrengsten

MPs Madlener and Helder asked whether speed cameras on the A2 generating 48 million euro in fines treat motorists as a cash cow, how many minor violations are involved, whether the controls are necessary for road safety, and whether the speed limit will be raised to 130 km/h. The minister replied that the controls aim at compliance with limits, gave the breakdown of fines by excess speed, cited a Rijkswaterstaat analysis showing reduced speeds, and said a decision on raising limits awaits a court ruling and will be communicated this year.
I will inform the House about this still this year.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hier dit jaar nog over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over trajectcontroles en boeteregen op de A2

An MP asked the Infrastructure and Environment minister why the A2 tops speeding-fine lists, whether speed limits on the A2 and A4 should rise to 130 km/h, and for an overview of section speed checks and their safety rationale. The minister answered that the A2's high traffic volume explains the fines, that limits below 130 km/h rest on air quality, noise or safety grounds, and that studies on raising limits on the A2 and A4 will be sent to parliament.
This year I expect to be able to inform you of the outcomes for the A2, and in the first half of 2016 about the options for the A4.
Nog dit jaar verwacht ik u te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van de A2 en in de eerste helft van 2016 over de mogelijkheden op de A4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over enorme verwarring bij automobilisten over de maximumsnelheid op de A2

MP Bashir asked about widespread driver confusion over the speed limit on the A2 and the large number of speeding fines from the average-speed check there. The minister replies that about 98% of drivers keep to the limit, the A2 share of fines is well under a third, signage follows guidelines with extra measures taken, and the limit will be raised on parts of the A2 subject to a pending court decision.
I will inform the House about this within this year.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hier dit jaar nog over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het als nieuw verkopen van geïmporteerde sloopauto’s

An MP asked the minister about imported US salvage cars being resold as new via other EU countries, such as Lithuania, and about inspection, liability and possible EU-level measures. The minister said the RDW tracks only the last EU registration, offered RDW figures on Lithuanian imports with few WOK statuses, saw no concrete signs of inadequate Lithuanian inspection, and declined to refuse recognition of Lithuanian inspections.
I have no insight into the total number of vehicles with a damage history from the US offered in the Netherlands for re-registration via other EU countries.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de totale hoeveelheid voertuigen die met een schadeverleden vanuit de VS via andere EU-landen worden aangeboden in Nederland voor herinschrijving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over overlast onderhoud Afsluitdijk

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about traffic nuisance, accidents and queues caused by maintenance on the Afsluitdijk, including the coordination of bridge and lock operations. The minister answered in detail, describing the works, the accident audit and extra signage, and the information given to road and shipping users, but did not concede that the works had caused a clear rise in accidents or offer structural changes.
Based on current insights, I note that on the carriageway from Den Oever to Kornwerderzand, from 3 km before the works up to the works on the bridge, the number of accidents has increased.

Op basis van de huidige inzichten constateer ik dat op de rijbaan van Den Oever naar Kornwerderzand van 3 km voor de werkzaamheden tot aan de werkzaamheden op de brug het aantal ongevallen is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Ontploffing en brand bij Belgische kerncentrale Doel vlakbij Woensdrecht’

An MP asked the ministers about the explosion and fire at Belgian nuclear plant Doel near the Dutch border, the extension of Doel 1 and 2, crisis communication with Dutch municipalities, and how Belgian incidents are prevented. The minister answered that there was no danger to the Dutch population, that the Belgian regulator FANC handles licensing and informs municipalities within 5 km, and that cross-border cooperation and joint exercises exist.
I will also contact my Belgian counterpart myself to discuss further the importance of the safety of the nuclear power plants.
Ook zal ik zelf met mijn Belgische collega in contact treden om nader te spreken over het belang van de veiligheid van de kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over de berichten “Werkgroep: “Haven Lauwersoog is gedoemd te verdwijnen” en “Haven Lauwerseach ferdwynt as polityk neat docht”

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about reports that the Lauwersoog harbour is doomed, the state of the Westgat shipping channel and its economic effects, responsibilities for dredging, and an ongoing study. The minister disputes the doom conclusion, describes the silting and Rijkswaterstaat's responsibilities and planned studies, and promises to inform the House when the studies are finished.
I will inform you of the outcomes afterwards.
Ik zal u daarna over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser naar aanleiding van berichtgeving over boeteregen op spitsstroken

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that speed-limit camera fines on hard-shoulder lanes opened as peak-hour lanes were rising, and whether the rules on opening such lanes are clear and how many fines are issued when they open. The Minister answered that the rules are clear, that the cited police figures are too limited to show more violations when lanes are open, and that the ministry does not record whether a lane was open when a fine was issued, so it would not provide that breakdown.
When recording violations, it is not tracked whether a plus or peak-hour lane is open.
Bij de registratie van overtredingen wordt niet bijgehouden of een plus- of spitsstrook open is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de toepassing van het innovatieve concept ‘whisstone’

An MP asked the minister about the 'Whisstone' noise diffractor, whether it should be added to the Reken- en meetvoorschriften 2012 before wider use, and about regulatory barriers to innovation. The minister said pilots are already possible, that more evidence from further pilots is needed before the calculation rules can be changed, and that RIVM will be asked for an opinion once enough information exists.
Therefore Rijkswaterstaat will carry out additional pilots in 2015/2016 at 2 locations along the main road network, with extensive noise measurements.
Daarom gaat Rijkswaterstaat in 2015/2016 aanvullende pilots uitvoeren op 2 locaties langs het hoofdwegennet waarbij uitgebreide geluidsmetingen zullen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat grensgemeenten moeten kunnen meepraten over de kerncentrales in het Belgische Doel

An SP MP asked the government about calls for neighbouring Dutch border municipalities to use consultation rights over extending the lifetime of the Belgian Doel 1 and Doel 2 nuclear plants, including whether an environmental impact assessment is needed. The minister answered that the Belgian regulator FANC decides independently on safety, that no environmental impact assessment is required, that contacts and joint exercises exist, and that she will inform the Chamber of new developments.
It is up to the Belgian government to give a judgement on the extension of the operating life.
Het is aan de Belgische overheid om een oordeel te geven over de levensduurverlenging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het gevaar van lozingen in de Rijn

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about PFT contamination from Düsseldorf airport reaching the Rhine, its known history since 2007, and cross-border cooperation to improve river water quality. The minister replied that there is currently no danger to the Netherlands, monitoring shows negligible concentrations, a German cleanup plan takes effect in 2016, and cooperation with neighbouring countries already exists.
So far there is no danger to the Netherlands.
Tot op heden is er geen gevaar voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht “Miljardenverspilling om bruggen te ‘verbeteren’”

An MP asked whether municipalities will spend about five billion euros replacing bridges and viaducts that may still be sound, and whether the Moerdijk bridge set an excessive structural standard. The minister said bridge safety and replacement at municipal level are not her responsibility, that the rules allow realistic traffic loads rather than Moerdijk-level loads, and that work to get better traffic measurements is under way.
As Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment, I am not responsible for the safety assessment and replacement of municipal bridges and viaducts.
Als Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu ben ik niet verantwoordelijk voor de veiligheidsbeoordeling en vervanging van gemeentelijke bruggen en viaducten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de normering van pyrazol in de Maas en Rijn

An SP MP asked the minister why the temporary maximum concentration of pyrazol in the Maas and Rijn was raised from 1 to 15 microgram per litre, whether this weakens pressure on polluters, and what happens after two years, among other questions. The minister explained the 15 microgram limit is a temporary intake maximum based on a conservative expert calculation pending a toxicological standard, said the regional water board has enforced against the polluter, committed to a protocol and review of the rules, and to raising the issue at European level.
Therefore I have set a temporary maximum concentration of 15 μg/l for water intake for drinking water production.
Daarom heb ik een tijdelijke maximale concentratie van 15 μg/l aangegeven voor de inname van water voor de drinkwaterbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over de slechte bereikbaarheid en gebrekkige kennis van de politie te water

MPs Kooiman and Bashir asked why water-police calls are poorly handled, why police officers without shipping expertise are deployed on water, and whether the abolished Deelorgaan Binnenvaart should be reinstated. The minister says the national service line is professional, the Landelijke Eenheid has invited shipping association ASV to discuss its complaints, the integrated Dienst Infrastructuur is designed to add capacity and knowledge, existing consultation forums exist, and no reinstatement is needed because the function is secured in current law.
The National Unit of the police has invited shipping association ASV to a meeting to gain more clarity about the problems it raised
De Landelijke Eenheid van de politie heeft de schippersverenging ASV uitgenodigd voor een gesprek om meer duidelijkheid te krijgen over de door haar genoemde problemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het recente arrest van het Europese Hof van Justitie inzake de uitvoering van de Kaderrichtlijn Water

MP Bisschop asked the minister how a CJEU ruling on the Water Framework Directive affects Dutch water law, permitting and the programmatic approach in the Omgevingswet. The minister answered that the ruling supports the Dutch implementation, that it is assumed to have no consequences for permitting or the Omgevingswet, and that developments will be monitored, with no concrete new commitment beyond informing parliament if adjustment is needed.
Based on the interpretation given in answer 2, it is assumed that the conclusions of the ruling have no consequences for permit granting in Dutch practice.
Op grond van de interpretatie gegeven in antwoord 2, wordt aangenomen dat de conclusies van het arrest geen gevolgen hebben voor vergunningverlening in de Nederlandse praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Hoogland over vertraging van de aanpak van de verkeersveiligheid op de N35

MPs Visser (VVD) and Hoogland (PvdA) asked why improvements to road safety on the N35 between Wijthmen and Nijverdal are delayed, whether Rijkswaterstaat is blocking local 'Raalte mobiel' initiatives, and what the planning is. The minister admitted a delay caused by limited staffing of the project team, said work is expected to start in December with a participation process and reprioritisation, and insisted the 2018 realisation target and the 2014 administrative agreement still stand.
It is correct that a delay has arisen in the start of the elaboration of the measures from the administrative agreement.
Het klopt dat vertraging is ontstaan in de start van de uitwerking van de maatregelen uit de bestuursovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het beleid van Rijkswaterstaat ten aanzien van de loodsplicht havengebied Moerdijk en de Dordtse Kil

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why Rijkswaterstaat imposes pilotage obligations on oversized ships in the Moerdijk harbour area and Dordtse Kil even for pilot-exempt captains, and whether exemptions can be reinstated and VTS coverage introduced. The Minister answered that oversized ships are excluded from exemptions for safety reasons, that the pilotage exemption system is under review in the 'Loodsplicht nieuwe stijl' project with consultation planned for early 2016, and that a decision on VTS or other safety measures will follow.
Currently, within the project 'Loodsplicht nieuwe stijl', it is being examined whether the current pilotage exemptions and the current system still suffice.
Momenteel wordt in het kader van het project «Loodsplicht nieuwe stijl» bezien of de huidige loodsplichtvrijstellingen en de huidige systematiek nog voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht 'Verkeer rond scholen onveilig voor kinderen'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a report on traffic safety around primary schools, its causes, effective measures, and the roles of local, regional and national government. The minister answered that school traffic safety is primarily a municipal responsibility, that the national government can only stimulate and facilitate, and that no national inventory of effective measures is planned.
Traffic safety around schools is primarily a responsibility of the local government.
Verkeersveiligheid rond scholen is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het ligplaatsenbeleid van de Rijksbinnenhaven in IJmuiden

An SP MP asked the minister about complaints from inland shipping skippers over mooring policy in the Rijksbinnenhaven at IJmuiden, safe run-off berths, forced empty sailing after maximum mooring times, and planned measures. The minister said there is no reduction in official berths, that the eviction of two vessel owners aims at efficient port use, that she will investigate extra run-off facilities and possible bottlenecks, but that providing long-term berths is not the state's responsibility.
I will investigate whether it is possible to make better use of the existing mooring places by installing extra run-off facilities.
Ik ga onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om door het aanbrengen van extra afloopvoorzieningen de bestaande ligplaatsen beter te benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verdwijnen van ligplaatsen in de eerste Rijksbinnenhaven in IJmuiden en het ligplaatsenbeleid voor de binnenvaart

An MP asked the minister about the closure of berths in the first Rijksbinnenhaven in IJmuiden, the berth policy for inland shipping, and the ASV's proposal for longer berthing. The minister answered that the number of official berths is unchanged, that the eviction concerns vessels occupying the area unlawfully, and that longer stays should be sought at municipal berths, rejecting the ASV's proposal.
I am willing to examine this further.
Ik ben bereid om dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het rapport van het PBL en ECN

An MP from the VVD asks the minister about a PBL/ECN quick scan of possible additional emission-reduction measures for the Urgenda climate case, including transport charges such as road pricing, an car-free Sunday and the 130 km/h motorway limit. The minister replies that the scan is a technical estimate without social cost or political feasibility analysis, that most measures are not government policy, that the cabinet does not choose road pricing, and that no further burden analysis is planned.
The PBL itself states in this quick scan that it did not take into account, among other things, (indirect) social costs of the measures, such as welfare loss.
Het PBL geeft zelf in deze quickscan aan geen rekening te hebben gehouden met o.a. (indirecte) maatschappelijke kosten van de maatregelen, zoals welvaartsverlies.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht dat de Maas in Limburg sinds 4 augustus 2015 ongeschikt zou zijn voor drinkwaterwinning door een chemische lozing van pyrazool door het bedrijf Sitech op het industr

MP Jacobi asked whether the Maas has been unfit for drinking water since a pyrazole discharge from Sitech at Chemelot, and what the central government's role is. The minister denies the river is unfit, explains that the water board Roer en Overmaas is the competent authority and that the national government supports the drinking water companies and monitors the issue.
The competent authority lies with the Waterschap Roer en Overmaas, because discharge takes place into a regional water, the Ur (a tributary of the Maas).
Het bevoegd gezag ligt bij het Waterschap Roer en Overmaas, omdat wordt geloosd op een regionaal water, de Ur (een zijriviertje van de Maas).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat een automobilist €2500,00 aan onterechte boetes heeft gekregen

An MP asked whether a motorist wrongly received EUR 2,500 in speeding fines from a speed camera, how many such cameras exist, and whether other drivers were affected. The minister said the case involved one vehicle with specific characteristics, that a supplier fix has been implemented on all cameras of this type, and that no further investigation is needed.
There are no known other cases in which an offence was wrongly recorded.
Er zijn geen andere gevallen bekend waarbij ten onrechte een overtreding is geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de eindberging van kernafval

An SP MP asked why the government requested an extension for its national nuclear waste disposal programme, how public consultation will be ensured, how the disposal fund will cover costs, and whether postponing a final solution to later generations is acceptable. The minister explained delays from supporting studies, promised public consultation this autumn and a Tweede Kamer submission, and defended interim surface storage with a final decision around 2100.
The draft programme will be made available for public inspection this autumn for citizens to comment on.
Het ontwerp programma wordt dit najaar ter inzage gelegd voor burgers voor inspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het incident bij Urenco

An SP MP asked the minister about a radioactive contamination incident at Urenco, including exposure of workers, aftercare, how Urenco concluded there was no threat, who is responsible for such incidents, and whether independent parties are involved. The minister answered that no workers were exposed beyond regular work, that environmental measurements found no threat, that the license holder bears responsibility under ANVS supervision, and that the ANVS, an independent inspectorate, and RIVM are involved.
Is it correct that no third parties are involved in the further investigation, such as an independent inspectorate?
Klopt het dat er bij het verdere onderzoek geen derden worden betrokken, zoals een onafhankelijke inspectie?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het uitblijven van een Nationaal Programma voor eindberging van radioactief afval

An MP asked why the government missed the 23 August 2015 deadline to submit a national programme for final disposal of radioactive waste to the European Commission, and about the cost and funding of final disposal. The minister acknowledged the delay due to longer supporting studies, promised public consultation this autumn, said the Waarborgfonds holds about 68 million euro against an estimated 2 billion euro cost, and deferred some answers.

The national radioactive waste programme will be submitted to the European Commission after it has been open for public consultation, the House of Representatives has been informed and I have adopted the programme.

Het nationale programma radioactief afval zal aan de Europese Commissie worden aangeboden nadat dit programma voor inspraak ter inzage heeft gelegen, de Tweede Kamer is geïnformeerd en ik het programma heb vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichtgeving dat Rotterdam tegen de huidige plannen voor de A13/A16 is

An MP asked the minister about reports that Rotterdam opposes the current A13/A16 road plans, including claims of the least funding and a failed participation process. The minister rejected that characterisation, said the participation trajectory was carried out with regional partners, and described the funding of extra-legal measures as the regions' responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over mogelijke risico’s van het plaatsen van windturbines aan weerszijden van de Oude Maas ter hoogte van Barendrecht en Binnenmaas

An MP asked the ministers about risks of wind turbines near the Oude Maas for shipping radar, turbulence and noise, dike safety, and whether turbines might have to be shut down. The ministers answered that Rijkswaterstaat tests radar and sightline effects, no study on sound or turbulence was done since no evidence suggests an effect, and the initiator bears the feasibility responsibility while the waterschap checks dike impacts.
As far as I am aware, no research has been carried out into the possible influence of sound waves and turbulence on the radar systems used in shipping.
Voor zover mij bekend heeft geen onderzoek plaatsgevonden naar de mogelijke invloed van geluidsgolven en turbulentie op de in de scheepvaart gebruikte radarsystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de uitzending van VPRO Zomergasten van 16 augustus 2015

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a VPRO television programme criticising the visual quality of the Dutch landscape, roadside 'viewing locations', and the influence of short-term market interests on public space. The minister largely rejected the criticism, saying there is no 'wildgroei', pointing to existing instruments such as the ladder for sustainable urbanisation, the College van Rijksadviseurs, and a forthcoming National Environmental Vision, while declining to take specific action on individual projects.
No, I do not think there is any question of 'wildgrowth'.
Nee, ik vind niet dat er sprake is van «wildgroei».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Klever over het bericht dat windmolenparken op zee 80% minder energie opleveren

MPs Madlener and Klever asked whether offshore wind farms really produce 80% less energy than claimed, whether subsidy and cost calculations should be revisited, and whether all wind plans should be halted. The minister replied that the wake effect is known and accounted for, that the press report confused installed capacity with output per square kilometre and used a hypothetical scenario unrealistic for the Netherlands, that no new insights change subsidy or costs, and that plans will not be halted.
No, see the answers to questions 2 and 3.
Nee, zie de antwoorden op vraag 2 en 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over verstekelingen die zich verstoppen in vrachtwagens, mede naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan Calais

MPs Visser and Azmani asked the government about stowaways hiding in lorries near Calais, the damage to Dutch transport, and whether France and the UK enforce EU asylum and immigration rules. The government answered that the damage is evident, that a meeting with French authorities and TLN is postponed to autumn, that extra Franco-British measures and joint enforcement commitments were agreed, and that it will raise secondary migration with France.
In my meeting with the French authorities this autumn I will raise attention to combating secondary illegal migration flows.
In mijn gesprek met de Franse autoriteiten dit najaar zal ik aandacht vragen voor de bestrijding van secundaire illegale migratiestromen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over externe veiligheid in Zuid-Nederland

An MP asked about safety at the Shell Moerdijk plant, the hazard-control record of the Moerdijk site, rail transport of dangerous goods in West-Brabant and the naphtha tank incident in Geleen. The state secretary promised to inform parliament before the hearing on the Shell investigations, gave inspection and incident data, and said the rail risks remain within legal limits while acknowledging local concern and committing to more transparent information.
I will inform you more fully about the investigations into the Shell Moerdijk incident before the External Safety committee hearing of 30 September 2015.
Ik zal u vóór het AO Externe Veiligheid van 30 september 2015 nader informeren over de onderzoeken naar het incident bij Shell Moerdijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over borden ter verduidelijking van de milieuzone

MPs Visser and Dijkstra asked whether Rijkswaterstaat would display milieuzone information on motorway matrix signs and who should bear the cost of signage for local low-emission zones. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat has no such plans, that informing drivers about local zones is a municipal task, and that the existing legal framework does not allow permanent signs on motorways, pointing instead to personalised navigation information.
Rijkswaterstaat will therefore inform the municipality of Utrecht that no fixed signs with milieuzone information may be placed along the motorways.
Rijkswaterstaat zal de gemeente Utrecht dan ook melden dat er geen vaste borden, met informatie over de milieuzone, langs de snelwegen geplaatst mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Haven gaat zelf treinlijn opzetten’

Two MPs asked whether the Rotterdam port authority's plan to invest in rail lines raises questions about the government's role and public control over the tracks. The minister answered that the port invests in rail services through the 'rail incubator' programme rather than in infrastructure, that the ministry has no role in strategic port choices but supports initiatives within the Havenvisie 2030, and that the port operates as an independent company with public control limited to safety rules.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment has no role in strategic choices of the Port of Rotterdam Authority.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu heeft geen rol bij strategische keuzes van het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over de vennootschapsbelasting

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about corporate tax (VpB) treatment of municipal land development companies, including whether each project is taxed separately, how land positions are valued, and when land should be written down to agricultural value. The government answered that taxation depends on case facts and that projects may be netted only where activities are interwoven, that separate valuation follows BBV rules, and that talks with the VNG resumed, with a planned BBV change from 1 January 2016.
The consultation was already ongoing again at the time the article appeared.
Het overleg was al weer gaande ten tijde van het verschijnen van het artikel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Lodders inzake schade door waterplanten

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about waterplant obstructions on the Zuidelijke Randmeren, including a rescue boat hampered during a storm, and whether incidents are tracked and what maintenance responsibilities apply. The Minister confirmed the incidents, reported 9 waterplant-related incidents nationally in 2012-2014 (2 significant), said safety comes first and fairway maintenance is Rijkswaterstaat's responsibility while other maintenance lies with third parties, and committed to monitoring developments without further inquiry.
Given the low number of significant accidents and the fact that shipping routes are regularly available, I see no reason to make further inquiries.
Gezien het lage aantal significante ongevallen en het feit dat de scheepvaartroutes regulier beschikbaar zijn zie ik geen aanleiding hier verdere navraag te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het verhogen van de maximumsnelheid op de A20 bij Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel naar 130 kilometer per uur

An MP asked the minister why the speed limit on the A20 near Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel is being raised to 130 km/h despite accident and congestion concerns, and whether consultation with the Zuidplas municipality would be reopened. The minister confirmed a draft traffic decision has been published, said the road's accident risk is rated medium, and said objections will be assessed before a final decision.
The objections submitted by stakeholders are assessed by Rijkswaterstaat and taken into account in formulating a definitive traffic decision.
De ingebrachte zienswijzen van belanghebbenden worden door Rijkswaterstaat beoordeeld en meegenomen in de formulering van een definitief verkeersbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de alarmerende staat van de Duitse dijken net over de grens

An SP MP asked the minister about the poor condition of German dikes near the Dutch border and the risk of flooding in the Netherlands, including the flood-probability gap, cooperation with Germany and investment in the Bislicher Insel retention area. The minister replied that the German dikes are being reinforced, that a joint Dutch-German study will assess cross-border flood risk, and that cooperation is positive, but gave no commitment to new action beyond that study.

Together with North Rhine-Westphalia, the Netherlands has this year started a study aimed at gaining insight into current and future flood risk on both sides of the border, based on the new Dutch methodology and new insights into flood probabilities and consequences.

Samen met Nordrhein-Westfalen is Nederland dit jaar een studie gestart met als doel op basis van de nieuwe Nederlandse methodiek en nieuwe inzichten over kansen en gevolgen van overstromingen inzicht te krijgen in het huidige en toekomstige overstromingsrisico aan beide zijden van de grens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Visser over storingen aan de Botlekbrug

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked the minister about repeated malfunctions of the new Botlek bridge since its opening, including traffic impact, the adequacy of Rijkswaterstaat's testing, cost responsibility under the DBFM contract, and the division of responsibilities. The minister acknowledged 18 malfunctions were too many, defended RWS's handling and testing as adequate, stated that the contractor bears repair costs and that no design errors were found, and announced corrective measures and a further evaluation of the testing process.
RWS has no insight into the costs incurred, because these are for the account of the contractor.
RWS heeft geen inzicht in de gemaakte kosten, omdat deze voor rekening van de opdrachtnemer zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de positie van zeilende zeegaande en binnenvaartpassagiersschepen en motorpassagiersschepen binnen de Woningwet, Omgevingswet en de Erfgoedwet

Two MPs asked whether sailing sea-going and inland passenger ships and motor passenger ships should fall under the building definition in the Woningwet and Omgevingswet, given their minor residential use. The minister agreed they should not be treated as buildings, said this will be clarified in the explanatory memorandum, and promised further information on the heritage vessel position by year end.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over het bericht ‘Havens verliezen hun belastingvrijstelling’

MPs Albert de Vries and Groot asked whether the European Commission has moved to a new phase and issued an ultimatum over the temporary corporate tax exemption for Dutch seaports, how the Commission treats indirect state aid to ports in other member states, and what alternatives exist. The Secretary of State declined to disclose the content or outcome of ongoing talks with the Commission and did not assess alternatives, referring instead to the earlier answers, while noting that talks aim to avoid forced recovery of the aid from 1 January 2016.
The talks between the cabinet and the European Commission are still ongoing.
Het gesprek tussen het kabinet en de Europese Commissie is nog steeds gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser inzake berichtgeving over “monsterfile” op de A2 door ongeval bij Everdingen

An MP asked whether Rijkswaterstaat creates artificial traffic jams through tunnel metering (tunneldosering) on the A2 at Utrecht, and about its legal basis, costs and alternatives. The minister answered that metering only shifts existing queues out of the tunnel, that it rests on administrative agreements rather than the 2013 tunnel safety law, and that she sees no urgent reason to revise them, while promising better public communication about the measure.
Options are being examined to improve traffic flow on the connecting road network.
Er wordt gekeken naar mogelijkheden om de doorstroming op het aansluitende wegennet te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser naar aanleiding van de acties van de Franse boeren

VVD MPs Lodders and Visser asked ministers about French farmers' blockades that disrupted Dutch transport, the lack of French police action, damages, state aid and whether Dutch inspections could allow derogations from driving-time rules. The government condemned the actions, protested to France and the Commission, said damages are a civil matter, and said it would raise the issue at the 7 September Agriculture Council.
We condemn these actions. Like the Spanish government, the Netherlands has also protested.
Wij keuren deze acties af. Net als de Spaanse regering heeft ook Nederland geprotesteerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over de berichten ‘Boete voor wachtende chauffeurs’ en ‘Verstopt tussen bloemen en wasmachines; Hoek van Holland geliefde startplaats gelukszoekers’

MPs Hoogland and Kerstens asked whether truck drivers are fined under driving and rest-time rules although the stowaway problem at Calais and Hoek van Holland makes compliance unreasonable, and what is being done about port controls and infrastructure. The government says enforcement of rest times is a priority, that exceptional situations allow deviation, that the minister has raised concerns with the EU Commissioner and French and British counterparts, and that enhanced intelligence-led controls by the Marechaussee are in place without infrastructure measures for now.
It is up to the carrier to draw up a schedule within the limits of this regulation.
Het is aan de vervoerder om binnen de grenzen van deze regelgeving een planning te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over verstekelingen die zich verstoppen in vrachtwagens

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about drivers being fined in the UK for stowaways found in their trucks and about the Calais migrant problem, including whether Dutch drivers are penalised twice for rest-time violations caused by queues. The minister answered that the UK fines follow the Code of Practice, the number of affected Dutch drivers is unknown, EU rest-time rules leave room for exceptional situations, the government has raised the issue with the Commission and UK/French counterparts, and it has intensified border controls and consulted the transport sector.
The number of (possibly) affected Dutch drivers in 2014 and 2015 is not known.
Het aantal (mogelijke) Nederlandse gedupeerde chauffeurs in 2014 en 2015 is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de sluiting van de kerncentrale Tihange

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked whether the government would act on Dutch municipal motions urging closure of the Belgian Tihange plant, press Belgian counterparts, and clarify iodine tablet distribution and emergency planning. The minister replied that nuclear safety is a Belgian national responsibility handled by FANC, that cooperation with FANC is being strengthened, and described the regional emergency plans and iodine tablet stocks without giving an exact distribution radius.
Nuclear safety is a national responsibility and it is therefore the Belgian regulator that decides whether the plant is safe or must be closed.
Nucleaire veiligheid is een nationale verantwoordelijkheid en het is dan ook de Belgische toezichthouder
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Ronnes over het bericht dat bij de A4 bij Steenbergen geluidsschermen staan bij onbewoonde en gesloopte huizen

MPs Van Helvert and Ronnes asked why noise barriers were built along the A4 at Steenbergen next to homes that were bought and demolished, and whether this wasteful situation can be prevented, and whether residents without barriers will get relief. The minister explained the barriers serve as noise protection for remaining homes and the building plots, that all measures follow the Tracébesluit and noise law, and that no money is wasted.
All barriers along the route have a function in dampening noise.
Alle schermen langs het tracé hebben een functie in het dempen van geluid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het Convenant Bodem en Ondergrond

An MP asked the state secretary about soil contamination remaining after the priority-site cleanup under the soil covenant, including whether groundwater and drinking water sources are adequately protected and whether the drinking water sector should be involved. The state secretary answered that remaining sites are inventoried through area dossiers and cleanup is the responsibility of competent authorities, while largely referring to existing instruments and future Omgevingswet arrangements without committing to new concrete steps.
The figure of 200,000 is a rough estimate of locations where substance concentrations may exceed the background value.
Het aantal van 200.000 is een grove inschatting van locaties waar de concentratie van stoffen boven de achtergrondwaarde kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over gebiedsaanwijzing op de Noordzee

An MP asked the minister about when and how wind-at-sea zones between 10 and 12 nautical miles will be designated, how stakeholders are involved, which studies and cumulative-effects analyses underpin the decision, and why an extension beyond 12 miles is not pursued. The minister answered that the strips will be designated around mid-2016 after an MER and draft structural vision, that stakeholders have been consulted, that cumulative effects will be assessed under the MER, and that extension beyond 12 miles is not feasible.
Before the areas between 10 and 12 miles are designated, an environmental impact assessment (MER) will be carried out.
Voordat wordt overgegaan tot aanwijzing van gebieden tussen de 10 en 12 mijl wordt een milieueffectrapportage (MER) uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Afvalgigant kaalgeplukt’

MPs Van Veldhoven and Koolmees asked whether Attero's sale to Waterland drained 183 million euro, including 87 million earmarked for pre-aftercare, and whether closed landfills stay safely financed and provinces accept the cut. The Staatssecretaris confirms the 183 million figure from Waterland's statement, says prior provincial consent was not needed and was not sought, and says legal aftercare and capping guarantees are unchanged while Attero must report to the competent authority.
No prior consultation took place with the provinces of Drenthe, Limburg and Noord-Brabant on this matter.
Met de provincies Drenthe, Limburg en Noord-Brabant heeft hierover vooraf geen overleg plaats gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Hoogland over het gebruik van RFID-chips in kentekens

MPs Oosenbrug and Hoogland asked about a planned RFID-chip trial in licence plates, including the technical design, data access, privacy safeguards and alternatives to combat plate fraud. The government described a test at a defence training centre, deferred decisions on data access and whether to adopt the chip until results are known, and promised a later government position and parliamentary debate.
