Once the results of these tests are known, the cabinet will take a position on whether or not to introduce an RFID chip in licence plates.
Op het moment dat de resultaten van deze testen bekend zijn, zal het kabinet een standpunt innemen over de wenselijkheid van het al dan niet doorvoeren van een RFID-chip in kentekenplaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de gevaarlijke situatie voor motorrijders op het Kooimeerplein in Alkmaar

An SP MP asked the minister about motorcyclists falling at the Kooimeerplein in Alkmaar, how many falls occurred, their causes, and whether more than signs would be taken. The minister acknowledged the problem, reported about fifty incidents via motorcycle organisations, identified road markings, camber and repair patches as likely causes, and promised monitoring and longer-term measures.
Rijkswaterstaat did not record or register these numbers because most motorcyclists continued on their way independently after the incident.
Bij Rijkswaterstaat zijn deze aantallen niet gemeld of geregistreerd omdat de meeste motorrijders na het incident hun weg zelfstandig vervolgden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat windturbines de telescoop van Lofar kunnen verstoren

An MP asked whether wind turbines can disturb the Lofar telescope and whether turbines near it should be removed or stopped nationwide. The minister confirmed possible interference, said the interest of Lofar is weighed in the zoning plan and consultation with Astron is ongoing, but refused to halt turbine construction.
In this context I am in consultation with the management of Astron, the operator of Lofar, to limit possible disturbances from wind turbines to an acceptable level.
In dit kader ben ik in overleg met de directie van Astron, de exploitant van Lofar, om mogelijke verstoringen van windturbines tot een acceptabel niveau te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hachchi over de haven van Saba in Caribisch Nederland

An MP asked the minister about reports that the Saba harbour's poor condition and mooring problems deter tourists, and what has been done since 2013. The minister said infrastructure repairs may be needed, a harbour expert was seconded and new rules adopted, and he will examine financial options for harbour improvements in the spring budget decision.
I have indicated to the Kingdom Representative that I will look into whether financial resources can be freed up in the short term to improve the harbour of Saba.
Ik heb aan de Rijksvertegenwoordiger aangegeven dat ik op korte termijn zal gaan bezien of er financiële middelen vrij gemaakt kunnen worden voor de verbetering van de haven van Saba.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over meer risico’s voor de staat bij het megaproject Zuidas

The VVD MP Visser asks whether the government's new risk allocation and minimum price for the Zuidasdok megaproject shifts more risk onto the state, and whether it reduces competition and is a precedent for other projects. The minister replies that the risk split is standard for D&C contracts, the minimum price is project-specific and only applies to Zuidasdok, and competition is adequate though only two consortia bid.
Rijkswaterstaat is examining, partly based on experience with Zuidasdok, whether this method can be applied more often.
Rijkswaterstaat bekijkt – mede op basis van de ervaringen bij Zuidasdok – of deze methode vaker toegepast kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de stijging van rioolbelasting door klimaatverandering

An SP MP asks the minister whether rising sewer charges caused by more intense rainfall from climate change are a problem, and whether municipalities and water boards lack funds. The minister acknowledges the link to climate change, rejects the claim of insufficient funds, says rising sewer charges are unavoidable but a local matter, and points to existing cost-saving agreements and adaptation programmes.
I therefore assume that municipalities will keep a close eye on this themselves.
Ik ga er daarom vanuit dat gemeenten dit zelf goed in het oog zullen houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de slechte samenwerking bij grote infrastructuurprojecten

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about poor cooperation on large infrastructure projects, citing five criticisms in a NRC article and asking what steps will be taken and what happens to ongoing projects and DBFM contracts. The Minister responds that Rijkswaterstaat is in ongoing dialogue with the construction sector, addresses each criticism (project size, risk allocation, tender costs, relations, low bids), and says changes to ongoing tenders will be considered carefully, though no concrete new commitments are made.
Rijkswaterstaat is continuously in discussion with the construction sector about all aspects of projects and tendering.
Rijkswaterstaat is voortdurend in gesprek met de bouwsector over alle aspecten van projecten en aanbesteden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat een falende directeur van een waterschap bijna een miljoen euro heeft meegekregen

An SP MP asked ministers about a Hefpunt water-board tax-collection director receiving a severance package of about EUR 950,000 despite WNT pay-cap rules, including prior suspension, the timing of informing the water board, the legality of in-house unemployment benefits, and possible reclaim. The minister answered that the severance (EUR 905,000 provision) is under WNT investigation, that the WNT was reported as not exceeded, that nullity and reclaim are possible if non-compliant, and that no separate policy for water boards will be pursued.
I am currently having it examined whether all these components, assessed under the WNT, were rightly and on the correct basis granted, and will inform you once this examination is completed.
Ik laat momenteel nader onderzoeken of al deze componenten – beoordeeld in het kader van de WNT – terecht en op de juiste grondslag zijn toegekend en zal u informeren zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Rudmer Heerema over de beantwoording in mijn brief van 3 maart 2015 van eerdere vragen over oversteekplaatsen voor otters

MPs Visser and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about measures, costs, targets and monitoring for otter crossings following a court ruling requiring 21 urgent road-otter conflict points to be resolved by 1 May 2017. The government answered that seven urgent points are being prepared, that Rijkswaterstaat budgets €665,000 for four of them, that the 79 potential hotspots carry no court-imposed deadline, and that the population target is a sustainable size defined by a 5% extinction risk over 100 years.
In the run-up to 1 May 2016 and 1 May 2017, when the 14 remaining points must be resolved, I expect to be able to inform you further about my consultations with the provinces.
Ik verwacht u in de aanloop naar de datum van 1 mei 2016, respectievelijk 1 mei 2017 waarop de 14 knelpunten opgelost moeten zijn, nader te kunnen informeren over mijn overleg met de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over de oproep van de Vereniging van waterbedrijven in Nederland (Vewin) om de waterkwaliteit te verbeteren

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked the minister about a list of 62 measures to improve water quality proposed by the drinking water association Vewin, including whether the government requested it and whether it will be included in the National Water Plan. The minister welcomed the list, said it was drawn up after a meeting with drinking water companies, and promised a further discussion with Vewin and a debate in parliament before the measures are finalised in the National Water Plan.
The definitive package of measures will be included in the National Water Plan and the river basin management plans for the Water Framework Directive that form part of it.
Het definitieve pakket maatregelen zal worden opgenomen in het Nationaal Waterplan en de stroomgebiedbeheerplannen voor de Kaderrichtlijn Water die daarvan onderdeel uitmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Verhoeven over het clusteren van werkzaamheden bij een aanbesteding door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Schouten and Verhoeven asked whether Rijkswaterstaat's combined multi-year maintenance tender for the West-Nederland-Zuid area breached the Aanbestedingswet's ban on unnecessary clustering and disadvantaged SMEs. The government answered that a complaint was upheld, the tender was withdrawn and split into three smaller lots, and it will evaluate the law's clustering rules in the summer.
Rijkswaterstaat found the complaint well-founded and withdrew the tender.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft de klacht gegrond bevonden en heeft de aanbesteding ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de terugkeer van files op de verbrede en deels verdiepte A4

An MP asked the minister why congestion on the widened A4 near Leiden has returned to the top-10 list, whether accidents and jams are being monitored, and what short-term fixes are planned. The minister attributes the return mainly to high traffic on a busy Randstad route and recent resolution of other bottlenecks, reports a sharp fall in congestion after widening, announces continued monitoring and an investigation into small-scale measures expected by autumn, and points to the Rijnlandroute for a longer-term improvement.
I am having research carried out into whether an improvement in traffic flow on this road section is possible in the short term through small-scale layout and utilisation measures.
Ik laat nog onderzoeken of een verbetering van de doorstroming op dit wegdeel met kleinschalige inrichtings- en benuttingsmaatregelen op korte termijn mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat Brussel registratie van rij- en rusttijden van bestelauto’s wil

An MP asked the minister whether the EU plans to require tachograph recording of driving and rest times for delivery vans, and what the consequences would be for the Netherlands. The minister replied that the Commission is not considering extending the tachograph obligation to vans, that the 2014 regulation does not require digital tachographs in vans, and that no lobbying against the measure is needed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het dumpen van grote zwerfkeien door Greenpeace op de Klaverbank

An MP asked whether the government would suspend its cooperation with Greenpeace after the NGO dumped large boulders on the Klaverbank, whether dumping should require a permit, and how Greenpeace could be held liable for damage to fishing. The Staatssecretaris answered that cooperation remains open, that the protest was disapproved of as risky and counterproductive, that the Raad van State ruled the earlier 2011 stones were not waste, that the Kustwacht monitored the action, and that any liability claim would be for fishers to pursue.
It will be assessed to what extent international law of the sea offers possibilities to make a provision for this in national regulation in the short term.
Beoordeeld zal worden in hoeverre er onder het internationale zeerecht mogelijkheden zijn om op korte termijn in de nationale regelgeving hiervoor een voorziening te treffen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht dat de kwaliteit van het Olympisch water een schande is voor Brazilië

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about reports that the water quality in Rio's Olympic waters is a disgrace, and how Dutch expertise and companies could help clean it up. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described a Dutch fact-finding mission and a joint approach with other ministries, and said the Brazilian government ultimately decides on investments and partnerships.

I am of course willing, together with Minister Schultz van Haegen and my colleagues from EZ, BZ and BHOS, to work with Dutch companies and Dutch-developed sustainable innovations to make a successful contribution to reducing pollution of Guanabara Bay and building a circular economy in Rio de Janeiro.

Ik ben uiteraard bereid om samen met Minister Schultz van Haegen en mijn collega’s van EZ, BZ en BHOS mij in te zetten om met Nederlandse bedrijven en met inzet van in Nederland ontwikkelde duurzame innovaties een succesvolle bijdrage te leveren aan de terugdringing van vervuiling van de Guanabara Bay en de opbouw van een circulaire economie in Rio de Janeiro.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over het bericht “Stad is klaar met tunnelmalaise”

MPs Visser and De Boer asked about reports of frequent tunnel closures at the Coentunnel and Schipholtunnel caused by overheight trucks, fire alarms and power failures, and their economic cost. The minister confirms 25 to 30 weekly overheight stoppages at the Coentunnel, lists six Schiphol tunnel disruptions in Q1 2015, says no damage cost estimate exists, and promises intensified monitoring and further study.
For this reason I will intensify the monitoring of the closures at the Coentunnel.
Om deze reden zal ik de monitoring van de stremmingen bij de Coentunnel intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat een geflitste buitenlandse bestuurder vaak vrijuit gaat

An MP asked the government whether EU member states have implemented the cross-border vehicle registration directive, how foreign-plated drivers can be fined and collected from, and what a 2014 Raad van State ruling means for enforcement. The minister answered that enforcement against foreign plates is not yet fully operational because IT and procedural changes are needed, that the Raad van State ruling requires changes to the collection framework, and that private collection use is possible but limited.

To be able to fine vehicle holders from countries other than the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, France and Switzerland, the systems and processes in the enforcement and execution chain must be adapted.

Om kentekenhouders uit de andere landen dan Nederland, België, Duitsland, Frankrijk en Zwitserland te kunnen beboeten, dienen de systemen en processen in de handhaving- en executieketen te worden aangepast
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi, Van Veldhoven en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht ‘Bluscapaciteit ontoereikend bij grote brand’

MPs Hachchi, Van Veldhoven and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether insufficient firefighting water capacity in the water mains poses a national risk to businesses, schools and hospitals, whether the government knew of it, and what should be done. The minister answered that he was not aware of such a problem, that the Veiligheidsberaad sees no national issue and deems water supply a matter for municipalities and safety regions, and that no extra action is needed.
The Veiligheidsberaad indicates that the availability of firefighting water is a matter for municipalities and safety regions; the fire service is part of the safety region.
Het Veiligheidsberaad geeft daarbij aan dat de beschikbaarheid van bluswater een zaak is van gemeenten en veiligheidsregio's; de brandweer maakt deel uit van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Overheid heeft windmolen-video gemanipuleerd’

An MP asks whether government information footage showing offshore wind farms off the Dutch coast was manipulated and whether spreading it amounts to improper governance, and whether beach-tent owners should be compensated for tourism losses. The minister denies manipulation, explains the footage was made by an independent bureau using KNMI weather data, says the government informs stakeholders carefully, and points to a parliamentary motion under study on tourism and economic effects.
The commissioned bureau ROM3D is an independent advisory firm specialised in making this kind of simulation.
Het ingeschakelde bureau ROM3D is een zelfstandig adviesbureau, gespecialiseerd in het maken van dit soort simulaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de inwerkingtreding van de negende tranche van de Crisis- en herstelwet in Groningen

An MP asked whether adding earthquake-related measures (Groningen reinforcement, value-enhancing works, cables and pipelines) to the ninth tranche of the Crisis and Recovery Act would limit provincial and municipal influence, conflict with the Onderzoeksraad's recommendation, and allow faster expropriation or other rule changes. The minister answered that the tranche only accelerates administrative procedures without changing local competences, that other rules (expropriation, monuments, nature, environment) are unchanged, and that the Act will not be reconsidered.
Including the said measures in Annex I of the Crisis and Recovery Act means that the administrative-law procedural accelerations of chapter 1, section 2 of the Act apply to them.
Het opnemen van de genoemde maatregelen in Bijlage I van de Chw betekent dat hierop de bestuursrechtelijke procedurele versnellingen van hoofdstuk 1, afdeling 2, van de Chw van toepassing zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht “Ministeries zijn het nog niet eens over alle details in Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof”

MPs Lodders and Visser asked whether ministries disagree on details of the Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof and whether new recalculations are needed, with consequences for timing and consultation. The State Secretary answers that the Rijk and 12 provinces reached agreement on finalising the programme, with entry into force on 1 July 2015 and a partial amendment by 15 December 2015 after an AERIUS Monitor update, subject to public consultation.
The Rijk and the 12 provinces have reached agreement on the finalisation and entry into force of the programme aanpak stikstof.
Het Rijk en de 12 provincies hebben overeenstemming bereikt over de afronding en inwerkingtreding van het programma aanpak stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het krantenartikel ‘Regeltjes nekken bloemencorso’

An MP asked the ministers about newspaper reports that rules were hampering a flower parade (bloemencorso), whether stricter rules were justified, and about Rijkswaterstaat's role in transporting carnival floats on the A76. The minister answered that local events fall under municipal permits, the state sets no explicit rules for them, and float transport on motorways cannot be permitted under the current traffic law.
The national government is not a party to the organisation of local events.
Het rijk is geen partij bij de organisatie van lokale evenementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over Ballast Nedam dat zich terugtrekt uit infrastructurele projecten

An MP asked the Infrastructure minister about Ballast Nedam withdrawing from the A15 and A2 Maastricht road projects, whether project deadlines, costs, replacement contractors, the A9 Gaasperdammerweg, claims against Rijkswaterstaat, and splitting megaprojects are affected. The minister answered that deadlines and costs are not expected to change, that Strukton and Strabag take over stakes, that an arbitration procedure is ongoing over A15 costs, and that the Aanbestedingswet and DBFM contract models are under evaluation with results due in summer and autumn 2015.
There is no reason to assume that Ballast Nedam's decision leads to higher costs for these projects.
Er is geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat het besluit van Ballast Nedam leidt tot hogere kosten voor deze projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat Ballast Nedam stopt met complexe werkzaamheden

PVV MP Madlener asked the minister whether Ballast Nedam's withdrawal from complex infrastructure work affects the A15 widening and national infrastructure, and whether complex projects can still be awarded to single bidders. The minister answered that the A15 deadline is unaffected, that enough other bidders exist, and that large projects are awarded to consortia.
For completion of the project, Ballast Nedam's decision to partly withdraw from the A15 Maasvlakte-Vaanplein project has no consequences.
Voor de afronding van het project heeft het besluit van Ballast Nedam, om zich deels terug te trekken uit het project A15 Maasvlakte-Vaanplein, geen gevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over verantwoordelijkheid bij bodemonderzoek door de overheid

An SP MP asked the Minister whether the province of Noord-Holland and municipality Stede Broec were negligent in delaying soil investigation and informing residents about groundwater contamination in Bovenkarspel, and who is liable for resulting damage. The state secretary replied that the national government has no competence under the Soil Protection Act in this case, cannot judge civil liability, and offered financing of investigation and remediation as a goodwill gesture while the province committed to remediation.
Under the Soil Protection Act the national government is not competent with regard to this specific case.
Op grond van de Wet bodembescherming is het Rijk niet bevoegd met betrekking tot deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Nijboer, Van Dekken en Albert de Vries over vestigingsplaatsen voor een kerncentrale

Three PvdA MPs asked whether earthquake risk in Groningen makes the Eemshaven unsuitable as a nuclear plant site and whether it should be dropped from the SEV III energy structure plan. The minister answered that the risk is premature grounds to exclude the site, that Eemshaven remains a safeguarded location, and that it will be reviewed in the second SEV III evaluation in 2016.
This will be considered at the second evaluation of SEV III, in 2016.
Dit zal worden bezien bij de tweede evaluatie van het SEV III, in 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de problemen die de bruine vloot ondervindt in Denemarken

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the status of a deal with Denmark allowing Dutch commercial sailing charter vessels to sail in Danish waters, the BBZ's concerns, and whether ILT inspections would be done in time before 1 April. The minister said the solution is being formalised with Denmark, the BBZ will endorse it, certification will be done by Bureau Veritas with ILT as fallback, and extra time is being sought with Denmark for implementing the safety management system.
I am therefore in consultation with Denmark to allow extra time for this.
Ik ben daarom in overleg met Denemarken om hiervoor extra tijd in te ruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Recourt over het bericht ‘Wegpiraat ontloopt zijn straf’

MPs Hoogland and Recourt asked whether the number of fines for serious traffic offences had fallen sharply, what explains the drop in stops since 2007, and how the government will respond. The Minister answered that criminal traffic stops have been stable (around 84,000 a year), attributed the earlier decline mainly to lower traffic volume and the abolition of ticket quotas, said the actual detection probability cannot be determined, and noted an early start to a new repeat-offender approach from 1 January 2015.
The number of stops for criminal traffic offences has been stable in recent years.
Het aantal staandehoudingen voor strafrechtelijke verkeersovertredingen is de laatste jaren stabiel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over niet functionerende trajectcontroles

An SP MP asked why speed trajectory controls on several motorways were switched off, whether tenders caused delays, what the costs were, and how road safety and enforcement would be maintained. The minister replied that the replacement is on schedule (nine systems by mid-2015, a tenth in early 2016), that police use mobile radar at the affected locations, and that she is not willing to study a narrower targeting of enforcement.
The media suggest that the replacement of the trajectory controls has been delayed. This is incorrect.
In de media wordt de suggestie gewekt dat de vervanging van de trajectcontroles is uitgelopen. Dit is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Tellegen over verkeershufters die minder vaak worden gepakt

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers why traffic offenders are caught less often, and whether this undermines the effectiveness of the beginner-driver and repeat-offender measures and road safety. The minister attributes the decline mainly to reduced traffic during the economic crisis and the abolition of ticket quotas, states that stopping offenders remains important but that no effectiveness-of-stop research exists, and reports on the status of enforcement experiments and speed camera systems, promising to monitor the experiments.
After that period, all final results will be mapped out and decisions will be taken on any further steps to be taken.
Na afloop van die periode zullen alle eindresultaten in kaart worden gebracht en beslissingen worden genomen over eventuele te zetten verdere stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over “notoire snelheidsovertreders”

An SP MP asked the government why persistent speeding offenders keep receiving fines while ordinary drivers bear most penalties, and how bumper-clinging is being tackled. The Minister replied that since 1 January 2015 repeat traffic offences are handled under criminal law to bring offenders into view of the Public Prosecution Service, and gave figures on bumper-clinging cases showing 4,213 reports over three years with a stated adequate recidivism approach.
Since 1 January 2015 a new approach to repeat traffic offenders has started.
Per 1 januari 2015 is een nieuwe aanpak van de veelplegers in het verkeer gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht ‘Doorgegeven parkeerkaartje ongeldig.’

An MP asked whether fining drivers who passed on a parking ticket is fair, and whether enforcement is consistent across municipalities after a Gelderland court ruling. The minister answered that passing on a ticket is not valid payment of parking tax, that the ruling only applies to this case, and that such misuse is not normally detectable.
Passing on a parking ticket can never lead to paying that parking tax; it is merely a proof of payment.
Het doorgeven van een parkeerkaartje kan nimmer leiden tot het voldoen van die parkeerbelasting, het is slechts een betaalbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over het bericht “Doorgegeven parkeerkaartje ongeldig”

Two CDA MPs asked whether it is acceptable that a motorist who took over a transferred parking ticket that was still valid was fined, and whether the rules should allow such tickets to be passed on. The minister answered that these are two separately taxable facts, that there is no refund or transfer of remaining parking time, and that changing the regulation is not necessary based on this single case.
Changing the substantive basis of the relevant regulations as a foundation is not necessary in my view based on this single case.
Wijziging van de inhoudelijke grondslag als fundament voor de terzake doende regelgeving acht ik niet noodzakelijk op basis van deze ene casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van der Linde over het bericht dat de Staat de bouwsector genadeloos uiteen speelt

VVD MPs asked the minister whether the state shifts nearly all project risks onto construction firms under DBFM(O) contracts, whether projects have become too large, and how contracts reflect the Aanbestedingswet evaluation and bankruptcy risk. The minister rejects the criticism, says risks are allocated to the party best able to bear them, and promises to review contracts after the evaluation in summer.
I do not recognise myself in the criticism.
Ik herken me niet in de kritiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Bashir en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de overheid de bouwsector genadeloos uiteen speelt

MPs of the SP asked the government about reports that it squeezes the construction sector, including cost overruns on A15 and A2 projects, the risks of a Ballast Nedam bankruptcy, and whether lowest-price awarding and design-build-finance-maintain contracts cause sector losses. The minister answered that cost overrun figures are confidential, that Rijkswaterstaat compensates responsibly-caused extra costs, that EMVI (best value) is the main award criterion, and that the Aanbestedingswet evaluation will be sent to parliament by summer.
Financial information from contractors, insofar as I have it, I cannot make public.
Financiële informatie van opdrachtnemers, voor zover ik hierover beschik, kan ik niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over burgerparticipatie bij de A13/A16

An MP asked the minister how the Code Maatschappelijke Participatie was applied in the public participation process for the A13/A16 road project, including the handling of resident proposals in the gebiedstafels, timing of the Oplossingenkaart consultation, and whether the participation process could be improved. The minister defends the process as extensive and intensive, says proposals outside the scope of the Standpunt were not adopted, and states she is discussing with regional officials whether to decouple the ontwerp-tracébesluit from the regional measures package.
I am in discussion with the regional officials involved about this.
Ik ben hierover in gesprek met de betrokken bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over onduidelijkheden in vergunningaanvragen en het Besluit omgevingsrecht bij onderhoud

An MP asked whether routine maintenance and certain alterations to buildings (roof covering, window frames, render) can proceed without an environmental permit, and whether permit-free changes should be limited to parts not facing public space. The minister answered that maintenance must keep detailing, profiling and appearance unchanged, that building plans and repressive welfare supervision still apply to permit-free changes, and that no further restriction is needed.
Such a restriction is not necessary in my view.
Een dergelijke inperking is naar mijn oordeel niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Van Dekken over de “toename van antibiotica in water”

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about rising antibiotics in surface water, including whether swimmers could develop resistance and whether drinking water is at risk, and what steps would reduce emissions. The government answered that no research shows low antibiotic concentrations cause resistance in swimmers, that drinking water treatment is effective and meets norms, that residues come from both livestock and human use, and that an integrated approach letter will follow before summer.
No research data are known on the presence of antibiotics specifically in Dutch recreational waters.
Over de aanwezigheid van antibiotica specifiek in Nederlandse recreatiewateren zijn geen onderzoeksgegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bashir over ‘de dubbele petten bij Bijzonder Beheer Rabobank’

An SP MP asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about alleged 'double hats' at Rabobank's Bijzonder Beheer unit, its subsidiary Bodemgoed buying assets of failing clients, the transparency of auctions, and use of the BMKB guarantee scheme. The government defended the practice as in the client's interest, rejected concerns about deliberate harm to clients, and provided purchase and portfolio figures while stating it saw no reason to intervene.
Due to confidentiality of company data, payments to individual banks are not disclosed.
Vanwege vertrouwelijkheid van bedrijfsgegevens worden uitkeringen aan individuele banken niet geopenbaard
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over douanecontroles op de Waddenzee

MP Jacobi asked whether customs inspections on the Wadden Sea will only occur after emergencies or third-party reports due to cuts in staff and inspections, and whether the crew of the Stormmeeuw will be cut. State Secretary Wiebes denies that inspections will be limited to emergencies, arguing that two fast, intelligence-driven vessels will replace the slower patrol boat, and says crew members are being redeployed by Rijkswaterstaat.
It is not correct that the inspection of the Wadden Sea by Customs will only take place in emergencies and on reports from third parties.
Het is niet correct dat de controle op de Waddenzee door de Douane alleen nog maar bij calamiteiten en meldingen van derden zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de gevolgen van in Nederland begane verkeersovertredingen met auto’s met een buitenlands kenteken

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about enforcement of traffic fines against foreign-plated vehicles, including data exchange under the Cross Border Enforcement directive, collection rates, and a 2013 Wob request by RTL. The minister answered that the new directive was adopted in March 2015, that enforcement of French plates began in December 2014 and Polish plates was still being prepared, that collection rates are partial, and that the RTL request was partly granted after court proceedings, with some information unavailable.
RTL did not receive data overviews because there were no overviews or other documents within my ministry containing such data.
RTL heeft geen data-overzichten ontvangen, omdat er zich geen overzichten of andere documenten binnen mijn ministerie bevonden waarin dergelijke data zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over uitspraken van de Eurocommissaris voor Betere Regelgeving over de Nederlandse implementatie van het Europese natuurbeleid

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary whether the government shares the EU Better Regulation Commissioner's view that Dutch implementation of EU nature directives causes many problems, and whether it will inventory these with the provinces and address them. The State Secretary acknowledged the Commissioner's remarks, said Dutch implementation is largely shaped by EU requirements but that national law can be improved (pointing to a pending nature protection bill), and said the economic and social factors are taken into account in management plans, while no firm new commitment beyond inventorying knowledge gaps was made.
Yes, the weighing takes place within the development of the management plan for the designated Natura 2000 area.
Ja, de afweging vindt plaats in het kader van de ontwikkeling van het beheerplan voor het aangewezen Natura 2000 gebied.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de aanvraag van carnavalsverenigingen in Limburg om in het kader van halfvasten carnavalswagens via de A76 over de Maas naar België te vervoeren, op 8 en 22 maart, zoals da

An MP asked why Rijkswaterstaat refused permission for Limburg carnival floats to cross the A76 motorway into Belgium during half-Lent, when Belgian authorities permit it with police escort. The minister answered that the request was new, that the floats would travel too slowly and endanger safety under the Road Traffic Act, and that police deployment is not the ministry's responsibility.
In the case of this carnival procession, the mandatory requirements set by the Road Traffic Act 1994 are not met.
In het geval van deze carnavalsoptocht wordt niet voldaan aan de dwingende eisen die de Wegenverkeerswet 1994 stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht 'Sluis op losse schroeven'

An MP asked the minister why bidders for major lock renovation projects (Limmel, IJmuiden, Beatrix locks) appear reluctant, whether talks with the construction sector occurred, and whether projects would be delayed. The minister answered that interest is sufficient, consultation occurs via existing platforms, no delay is planned, and Rijkswaterstaat is exploring tender adjustments.
Rijkswaterstaat is examining the possibilities of making changes to the tendering process to limit tender costs and capacity and thereby promote market parties' interest.
Rijkswaterstaat beziet de mogelijkheden om wijzigingen aan te brengen in het aanbestedingsproces om tenderkosten en -capaciteit te beperken en daarmee de interesse van marktpartijen te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Van Helvert over het bericht 'Sluis op losse schroeven'

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether delays threaten several lock projects, what the economic effects would be, which consultations were held, and how regional builders can be involved. The minister denied that delays are expected, said the schedules are stable, and gave a project timetable with planned start years.
Because I do not intend to delay these projects, no economic consequences are expected.
Omdat ik niet voornemens ben om deze projecten te vertragen, zijn hier geen economische consequenties van te verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht 'Sluis op losse schroeven'

MP Albert de Vries asked the minister about reports that tenders for major lock renovation projects risk delays because contractors find them too complex and risky and because many large tenders overlap, including the role of DBFM contracts. The minister denied delays are expected, said Rijkswaterstaat is consulting the market and examining tender process changes, and stated no reason yet to postpone tenders or set priorities.
Rijkswaterstaat is examining options to change the tendering process to reduce tender costs and capacity and so keep market parties interested.
Rijkswaterstaat beziet de mogelijkheden om wijzigingen aan te brengen in het aanbestedingsproces om tenderkosten en -capaciteit te beperken en daarmee de interesse van marktpartijen te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht ‘Tweede Maasvlakte niet op tijd klaar voor containervloed’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reported congestion in the Rotterdam port, delays at the new Maasvlakte 2 terminals, and requests from inland shipping and terminal operator groups for a problem analysis and mitigation. The minister attributed waiting times to a combination of growing cargo volumes and the ramp-up of new automated terminals, said the market parties should resolve peak congestion, and planned a meeting with the sector without committing to a government-led intervention.
I consider it primarily a matter for the market parties themselves to resolve congestion during peak moments.
Ik vind het overigens primair een zaak van de marktpartijen zelf om de drukte tijdens piekmomenten op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman, Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over de beoordeling van luchtkwaliteit bij plattelandswoningen

MPs Veldman, Lodders and Dijkstra asked the minister why air quality (fine dust) must be assessed for former farm dwellings occupied by third parties, unlike active farm housing, and whether exemptions or flexibility are possible. The minister explains that EU air quality rules apply except at workplaces, that the Council of State ruling requires assessment for former farm homes, and promises to explore flexibility, including a provision in the future Environment Quality Decree under the Omgevingswet.
However, I will examine whether there are other possibilities to achieve nuance and flexibility.
Wel zal ik nagaan of er anderszins mogelijkheden zijn om te komen tot nuancering en flexibilisering.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Bashir over de huisvuilinzameling in de binnenvaart

An SP MP asked the minister about the reduced number of waste containers, the paid household-waste subscription for inland shipping, complaints, and whether bargee households pay twice and can deduct the costs as business expenses. The minister defended the subscription system on cost grounds, referred complaints and the CDNI complaint question to other bodies, and deferred the tax question to the Tax Authority.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over diverse plannen voor Factory Outlet Centres in Zevenaar

An SP MP asks the minister about competing factory outlet centre plans in Zevenaar, the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation, a new A12 slip road, and regional retail planning. The minister answers that the BAT-site decision lies with the municipality, that a joint province-municipality fact-finding study was completed, and that talks on improving the Ladder are ongoing without planned test cases.
The responsibility for deciding whether to allow a Factory Outlet Centre (FOC) in Zevenaar lies with the municipality.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het nemen van een besluit over het al dan niet toestaan van een Factory Outlet Centre (FOC) in Zevenaar ligt bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat door een solidariteitsheffing de belastingen voor middeninkomens worden verhoogd

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether it is unjust that middle-income earners pay a solidarity levy to fund water board tax exemptions for people on low incomes, and whether water boards should be abolished. The government answered that water board costs, including exemptions, are shared by all taxpayers, that exemption policy is a Rijk responsibility, and that efficiency targets are on track, but it did not answer the question on abolishing the water boards.
So it is not the case that the exemption costs are borne by one particular category or by a particular group of persons within a category.
Het is dus niet zo dat de kwijtscheldingskosten door één bepaalde categorie of door een bepaalde groep personen binnen een categorie worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het niet meenemen van alternatieven van bewoners voor onder andere dijkverzwaring

An MP asked the minister whether water boards must thoroughly examine and weigh residents' alternatives to dike reinforcement, give residents full early information on plans and costs, and allow more time for such research. The minister answered that all serious alternatives must be weighed under the participation code, that residents should be involved early, that preparation costs are reimbursed, and that the water board's decision is subject to provincial approval and appeal to the Council of State.
In decision-making on dike reinforcements, all serious alternatives, including those of residents, must be weighed.
In de besluitvorming over dijkverzwaringen dienen alle serieuze alternatieven, waaronder die van bewoners, te worden meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Recourt over het bericht «Bonnenregen onterecht»

MPs Hoogland and Recourt asked whether many motorists were wrongly fined on the N261 near Tilburg due to roadworks and unclear speed limits, and what would be done about it. The Minister of Justice replied that the public prosecutor found no evidence the fines were wrong, that individual appeals remain possible, that no separate count of wrongful fines is kept, and that no new measures are planned beyond the earlier answer.
I cannot provide such an overview. No separate registration is kept of this.
Een dergelijk overzicht kan ik niet geven. Hiervan wordt geen aparte registratie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over windenergie op zee voor de Hollandse kust

An MP asked whether a closed information meeting for councillors of Zandvoort, Noordwijk and Katwijk on visual impacts of offshore wind farms was cancelled after councillors refused to keep the data confidential, and about the status of visualisations. The minister denies that confidentiality was requested, says the meeting was postponed to coincide with the public consultation on the designation of the zones, and that visualisations are still in development and will be presented to parliament when the formal procedure starts this spring.
The aim is to show a realistic representation of the plans.
Het streven is om een realistische weergave van de plannen te laten zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over onveilige situaties op de vaarwegen door onderbezetting bij verkeersleiding Rijkswaterstaat

An SP MP asked the minister about unsafe conditions on inland waterways caused by understaffing of Rijkswaterstaat traffic control, citing worries from traffic controllers, fewer patrol vessel hours, unreachable traffic posts and staffing levels. The minister answered that efficiency gains allow the same work with fewer staff, that shortages are managed by reallocating staff and prioritising, that the vessel-hours comparison will follow within five weeks, that the Westerschelde incidents fall under the Flemish centre and are under police investigation, and that safety remains a high priority.
The requested comparison cannot be retrieved directly. Comparing vessel hours across the different years takes more time and I will send it to the House within 5 weeks.
De gevraagde vergelijking is niet direct opvraagbaar. Het vergelijken van het aantal vaaruren over de verschillende jaren kost meer tijd en zal ik binnen 5 weken aan de kamer opsturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de verkeersveiligheid op de N36

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about road safety on the N36 after a site visit and about the timing of planned improvement measures. The minister said some measures will be realised in 2015-2016 by folding them into existing contracts, while the rest will follow in 2017-2018 with no possibility of acceleration, and offered to discuss a grade-separated junction with the region if it takes the initiative and funds it.
Acceleration of these schedules is not among the possibilities.
Versnelling van deze planningen behoort niet tot de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat kilometertellerfraude bij geïmporteerde auto’s door RDW wordt gedoogd

MP Bashir asked the minister whether it is acceptable that the RDW registers imported cars with apparently tampered odometers, whether the 50% figure is accurate, and what will stop this before EU rules arrive in 2018. The minister answered that registration cannot be refused under EU law, that the RDW records 'no judgement', that a Belgian-Dutch data exchange pilot and a consumer campaign are planned, and that prosecution of odometer-tampering firms is being prepared.
Even if the RDW suspects a rolled-back odometer, registration of a vehicle from another EU country cannot be refused because of European law.
Ook al heeft de RDW een vermoeden van een teruggedraaide teller kan registratie van het voertuig uit een ander EU-land vanwege Europees recht niet worden geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over rijscholen die sjoemelen met slagingspercentages

An SP MP asked the minister whether multi-company driving schools that split pupils by pass rates, and possible tax evasion by such 'fop' schools, could be curbed and whether CBR data could show pass rates per company. The minister answered that the market is free and such structures are not in themselves fraudulent, that CBR already knows which school books each exam, and that the Tax Authority has monitored schools against exam data, adding about EUR 22 million in revenue, with continued monitoring promised.
The approach to the driving school sector has led to roughly EUR 22 million in additional turnover being established at several hundred driving schools beyond what the original tax returns showed.

De aanpak ten aanzien van de rijschoolbranche heeft er toe geleid dat er bij enkele honderden rijscholen ongeveer € 22 miljoen meer omzet is vastgesteld dan uit de oorspronkelijke aangiftes naar voren kwam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht «Fiasco dreigt voor Leidsche Rijn centrum»

An MP asks the government about the risk of vacancy at the Leidsche Rijn shopping centre and wider retail overcapacity, and whether provinces and municipalities are acting adequately. The minister replies that retail spatial policy is decentralised, that the government supports local action and will address the issue in the forthcoming Retailagenda.
Spatial policy regarding retail has been decentralised.
Het ruimtelijk beleid met betrekking tot detailhandel is gedecentraliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het bericht ’Hoe een illegale windmolen blijft doordraaien’

Two MPs asked whether an illegal wind turbine that the Council of State ruled must be stopped should be enforced by the municipality, and how wind energy is sited with local residents. The minister answered that the Council of State confirmed enforcement was required but the decision now rests with the municipality, which the national government has no role in, and that participation will be anchored in the Omgevingswet.
It is up to the municipality to take a new decision. The national government has no role in this.
Het is aan de gemeente om een nieuw besluit te nemen. Het Rijk heeft hierin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over sluiting van tunnels in de A73

Member Van Helvert (CDA) asked the minister about the roughly 600 closures of the A73 tunnels at Roermond and Swalmen in 2014, the applicable availability norms, how to reduce unplanned closures, and freight rail versus road safety data for hazardous substances. The minister disputed that closures were excessive (98.8% availability), noted a 98% national availability standard and a uniform tunnel standard, planned to reduce scheduled closures from 11 to 9, and declined to express a general modal preference.
RWS consults with the industry to inform transport companies about the permitted height and about heeding warnings for an overly high truck.
RWS voert overleg met de branche om transportbedrijven te informeren over de toegestane hoogte en het opvolgen van waarschuwingen bij een te hoge vrachtwagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de veiligheid van tunnels

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about safety defects in Dutch national tunnels (Schiphol, Wijker, Zeeburger and Coen tunnels) reported by EenVandaag, and whether the tunnels meet Rijkswaterstaat's own safety standards. The minister answered that all tunnels comply with the tunnel law, that identified defects were remedied on schedule, that inspection findings are programming tools rather than signs of immediate danger, and rejected the claim that the cause is backlog maintenance or removal of independent oversight.
No, the tunnels are adequately maintained by Rijkswaterstaat to keep the tunnel safe and therefore available for traffic.
Nee, de tunnels worden door Rijkswaterstaat adequaat onderhouden om de tunnel veilig en daarmee beschikbaar voor het verkeer te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de crisis bij zeegaande zeilschepen op de Oostzee

An SP MP asked the minister about safety rules and operating restrictions for Dutch sailing ships in the Baltic after Danish pressure, including the five-mile limit, ship stability, and compensation for operators. The minister answered that the rules are being updated with industry, that Denmark's proposed solution limits sailing areas but avoids stricter certification than needed, and that operators must bear normal business risk without compensation.
I do not have this data available.
Deze gegevens heb ik niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Visser over de vervanging van de Borgbrug in Groningen

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the lengthy closure of the Borgbrug in Groningen after a ship collision, the delay in reopening, alternatives such as using the ring road, and safety on the Driebondsweg. The minister explained the damage and repair timeline (reopening expected mid-July), said alternative routes and bus transport were arranged, and reported police and municipal measures on safety.
Rijkswaterstaat expects to be able to put the bridge back into use around mid-July.
Rijkswaterstaat verwacht de brug op medio juli weer in gebruik te kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Schouw over de stijging van waterschapslasten ten gevolge van het hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked whether rising water board levies caused by shifting flood-protection costs to water boards breach the minister's earlier pledge that citizens would not bear these costs. The minister answered that the Water Governance Agreement targets efficiency gains offsetting cost increases, that monitoring shows the agreement on track, and that no individual-level commitments were made.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob en Dik-Faber over de verkeersveiligheid en de doorstroming op de N36

MPs Slob and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about road safety and traffic flow on the N36, including whether the Beerzerveld junction meets the three-star RPS target and whether a grade-separated junction should replace the planned traffic-light solution. The minister confirmed the target and that Beerzerveld has three stars, said traffic flow is not a bottleneck, and stated the traffic-light redesign remains the agreed solution while the regional partners may propose alternatives and preparatory work continues.

In administrative consultation with the region it was agreed that for safety at the Mariënberg (Beerzerweg) junction, redesign with traffic-light installations is the best solution within the existing constraints of time and money.

In het bestuurlijk overleg met de regio is overeengekomen dat voor de veiligheid op de aansluiting bij de Mariënberg (Beerzerweg) de herinrichting met verkeersregelinstallaties de beste oplossing is binnen de bestaande randvoorwaarden, tijd en geld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Rudmer Heerema met betrekking tot oversteekplaatsen voor otters

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries of Economic Affairs and Infrastructure and Environment how the government will respond to a Hague appeals court ruling requiring measures for otter road crossings, including which bottlenecks will be fixed, when, at what cost, and how this relates to the national ecology programme and provincial responsibilities. The government answered that seven urgent bottlenecks will be addressed immediately, the other 14 urgent ones by about 2016 and all 21 by mid-2017, funded from the Economic Affairs budget, with provinces responsible for nature policy implementation and some costs and measures still undetermined.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (Rijkswaterstaat) and the provinces of Friesland and Overijssel will immediately start on the seven most urgent bottlenecks named in the ruling.

Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (Rijkswaterstaat) en de provincies Friesland en Overijssel starten direct met de zeven meest urgente knelpunten zoals benoemd in het arrest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Veldhoven over de veiligheid van wegwerkers

D66 MPs asked the ministers about the safety of road workers, including fatal accidents over ten years, whether the union's concerns are shared, trade-offs with traffic, and links to maintenance budgets. The ministers answered that safety follows CROW guidelines, a covenant and inspections are in place, and no link to budgets exists.
At the end of 2014 I concluded a covenant with the construction and infrastructure sector to work more safely.
Eind 2014 heb ik een convenant afgesloten om met de bouw- en infrabranche te komen tot veiliger werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de website ruimtelijkeplannen.nl

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about outdated address data (ACN from 2011) used on ruimtelijkeplannen.nl, delays in connecting to the BAG, how residents can find new plans, whether objection rights were missed, the tax service's indirect use of BAG data, system readiness for the Omgevingswet, and digitalisation of permitting. The minister acknowledged the ACN is outdated, promised BAG connection via PDOK in 2015, and largely deferred other matters to responsible bodies or future digital plans.
I expect to be able to realise the connection of Ruimtelijkeplannen.nl to the BAG via the connection to the national PDOK facility in 2015.
Het aansluiten van Ruimtelijkeplannen.nl op de BAG via de aansluiting op de Landelijke Voorziening Publieke Dienstverlening Op de Kaart (PDOK) voorzie ik in 2015 te kunnen realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het strooibeleid bij gladheid

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about delayed gritting of the A2 in Limburg on 24 January 2015 and how winter road treatment timing is decided and coordinated, and whether accident data by road section can be shared. The minister answered that the Limburg response was not longer than usual because the snow moved from west to east, that gritting is coordinated with decentralised authorities, and that Rijkswaterstaat has only an incomplete incident overview for that day that cannot show which accidents were caused by slippery roads.
Rijkswaterstaat does not keep an exhaustive record of all accidents caused by slipperiness.
Rijkswaterstaat houdt niet uitputtend alle ongelukken bij die veroorzaakt zijn door gladheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht ‘Storing Spijkenisserbrug duurt langer’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about repeated faults on the Spijkenisse bridge, whether regular maintenance had taken place, and what measures would resolve the problem. The minister answered that the bridge is in the regular maintenance programme, that the cause of the latest faults is not yet known, and listed measures taken, including a broader investigation and possible earlier renovation.
A comprehensive investigation has now been started to determine the cause of the faults.
Er is nu een uitgebreid onderzoek gestart om de oorzaak van de storingen te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Verhoeven over het bericht dat Valkenburg de ideale plek is voor een ‘Unmanned Valley’

MPs Van Veldhoven and Verhoeven asked the government about a report proposing Valkenburg airfield as a testing site for unmanned vehicles, and whether the land-use plan for housing, work and recreation is consistent with the government's innovation ambitions. The minister answered that the masterplan allows room for smaller drone testing but not larger drones, that a self-driving car test regulation has been sent to parliament, that the central government re-offered an alternative solution to local parties in January 2015, and declined the request for a one-week answer deadline.
In July 2014 the central government offered the solution direction mentioned in the answer to question 4 to the parties involved.
Het Rijk heeft in juli 2014 de oplossingsrichting, zoals genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 4, aangeboden aan de betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Verheijen over het bericht dat truckchauffeurs ecocombi’s bij de grens moeten splitsen

MPs Visser and Verheijen asked the minister about reports that trucks carrying flowers and longer combined vehicles (ecocombi's/LZVs) must be split at the border, and whether this reflects protectionism and obstructs the EU internal market, along with questions on Benelux and German cooperation. The minister answered that member states disagree on cross-border LZVs, that a compromise on Directive 96/53 allows bilateral arrangements, that a Benelux decision and a Netherlands-Flanders pilot are being prepared, and that North Rhine-Westphalia does not permit LZVs at all.
From May 2013 negotiations were held on the revision of Directive 95/53/EC.
Vanaf mei 2013 is onderhandeld over de herziening van richtlijn 95/53/EG
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het grote aantal ongevallen met dodelijke afloop op de rijksweg N36 tussen Almelo en Ommen

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the minister for an overview of fatal and serious accidents on the N36 between Almelo and Ommen, its casualty rates against comparable national roads, and the timing of promised safety measures. The minister supplied accident counts, fatality figures, a risk comparison showing the N36 slightly above average, and said the measures will be built between 2015 and 2018 with a further safety decision pending.
The number of seriously injured in this period is not yet known.
Het aantal zwaargewonden in deze periode is nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de veiligheid op de N36 tussen Almelo en Ommen

An MP asked the minister whether lowering the N36 speed limit to 80 km/h should be studied and which behaviour-influencing measures could improve safety on the road. The minister replied that a 2013 study found a speed reduction not effective, that eight improvement measures are planned for 2015-2018 with additional options under review, and that communication and enforcement are not warranted at present.
Based on the study, it was concluded among other things that lowering the maximum speed is not an effective measure.
Op basis van het onderzoek is o.a. geconcludeerd dat het verlagen van de maximumsnelheid geen effectieve maatregel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de bevriezing van de A50 en de A59

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why the A50 and A59 were left frozen overnight and whether preventive closures or an evaluation would be appropriate. The minister replied that warnings were issued and Rijkswaterstaat gritted preventively and curatively, that preventive closures would cause more inconvenience, and that a separate evaluation was not currently considered necessary, though Rijkswaterstaat is reviewing the situation.
Rijkswaterstaat is reviewing how the situation on the A50/A59 unfolded and whether there are points for improvement.
Rijkswaterstaat bekijkt hoe de situatie op de A50/A59 is verlopen en of er verbeterpunten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Afsluitdijk gaat dicht”

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked the minister why the Afsluitdijk must be closed for ten weekends, what alternatives were considered, what the impact on transport and public transport is, and how communication will be handled. The minister confirmed the closures are needed for heavy hoisting work on sluice complexes, that alternatives with more disruption were rejected, that public transport will not be affected, and that stakeholders will be consulted and informed in advance, though costs are unknown and the contractor selection is still pending.
It is not known what additional costs this will entail for motorists and the transport sector.
Het is niet bekend tot welke extra kosten dit leidt voor automobilisten en de transportsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de invloed van de muizenplaag op veendijken in Friesland

An MP asked the ministers about the vole plague damaging Frisian peat dykes, including safety risks and measures to prevent future damage. The ministers answered that damage to primary defences is limited (about 10 km of 200 km), that the water board repairs it and has contingency plans, and that a study into vole control and early warning is underway.
The water board repairs the damage and has contingency plans in place, with which damage can if necessary be repaired using clay applied by cranes, sandbags and rock armouring.
Het Wetterskip herstelt de schade en heeft calamiteitenplannen achter de hand, waarmee schade zo nodig met door kranen aan te brengen klei, zandzakken en steenbestorting kan worden hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Helvert en Oskam over het grondwaterproblemen in de Vliettunnel Leidschendam

MPs Van Helvert and Oskam (CDA) asked the minister about recurring groundwater problems in the Vliettunnel in Leidschendam that forced closures, and whether lowering the groundwater level could be explored with the province and water board. The minister confirmed the problems and said a study on a structural solution, including groundwater lowering and other options, is underway with completion expected in summer 2015.
That is why I am now having research carried out into a structural solution.
Daarom laat ik nu onderzoek doen naar een structurele oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de voortdurende reeks ongevallen op de A20 bij Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel en Moordrecht

An MP asked the minister about a recurring series of accidents and traffic jams on the A20 near Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel and Moordrecht, including why the new Moordrecht slip roads had not improved safety. The minister answered that earlier road works reduced queuing and accidents, that the monitoring period is too short for firm conclusions, and that the situation will be reviewed with the region if late lane-merging proves structural.
If traffic monitoring shows that this phenomenon is structural, it will be examined in consultation with the region whether additional measures are possible.
Als uit de verkeersmonitoring blijkt dat dit verschijnsel structureel is, zal in overleg met de regio onderzocht worden of aanvullende maatregelen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over het bericht dat de Duitse regering nu ook tol wil op het water

MPs Visser and De Boer asked the minister about reports that Germany wants to introduce tolls on waterways, and about the consequences for Dutch inland shipping, ports, competitiveness and EU internal market goals. The minister replied that the German plans are still in preparation and cannot yet be assessed, that she opposes tolls on other waterways than the Rhine because they could shift cargo to other modes, and that she follows the matter actively and will raise it with her German counterpart when warranted.
There is as yet no clarity whatsoever about the content and publication of a specific regulation for toll charging on waterways.
Over de inhoud en publicatie van een specifieke regeling voor tolheffing op vaarwegen bestaat nu nog geen enkele duidelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht “Opnieuw ongeval met vrachtwagens op A73”

An MP asked the minister whether the A73 stretch has a disproportionate accident rate, whether a truck tank carrying hydrochloric acid could split open given safety rules, and what the response would be. The minister answered that the stretch is not more accident-prone than comparable roads, that the tank complied with all rules, and that the rupture was an unforeseen accident.
The risk of an accident on the stretches you mention is also not greater than the average risk of an accident on a comparable road (2x2 motorway) elsewhere in the Netherlands.
Het risico op een ongeval op de door u genoemde weggedeelten is ook niet groter dan het gemiddelde risico op een ongeval op een vergelijkbare weg (2x2 autosnelweg) elders in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over ongevallen op de A73 en de A2

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether the answers on accidents on the A73 should also cover the A2, especially the junction at Maasbracht. The minister referred to the answers to questions 2 and 3 and to earlier questions on the A73.
See my answers to questions 2 and 3
Zie mijn antwoorden op vragen 2 en 3
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Geurts en De Rouwe over de toename, omvang en gevolgen van muizenschade in Friesland

MPs asked the state secretary about the growth and damage of mouse plagues in Friesland, the ban on ploughing grassland, the risk to dykes, and possible derogations from the Nitrates Directive action programme. The state secretary referred to earlier letters on most questions, said the ploughing ban rests on both environmental and agronomic considerations, and noted that nitrate levels in the affected area are well below the norm.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to my letter of 27 January 2015
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar mijn brief van 27 januari 2015

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de voor 3 februari geplande vliegshow met onbemande commerciële systemen (drones) op vliegveld Valkenburg niet door dreigt te gaan

MPs Van Helvert and Agnes Mulder asked whether the planned drone show at Valkenburg airfield, part of the TUSExpo 2015 event, is threatened by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf starting demolition of the runway, whether consultation took place, and why demolition begins now. The minister answers that the demolition follows a Masterplan and a contract signed in December 2013 that was widely known, that the organisers only contacted the agency on 26 January, that the agency offered alternative venues which were declined, and that the sloop proceeds under that contract.
The demolition has therefore been known for some time and has received media attention.
De sloop is hierdoor geruime tijd bekend en heeft media-aandacht genoten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht «Automobilist de klos in de Randstad»

PVV MPs asked whether higher municipal parking tariffs and more section controls on motorways are unfair extra burdens on motorists and whether the government will stop the big cities' plans. The state secretary answered that parking tariffs are a municipal matter, that section controls improve compliance rather than add costs, and that they do little for urban air quality, promising talks with the G7 cities.
Setting the height of parking tariffs is a responsibility of the municipalities and not of the national government.
Het vaststellen van de hoogte van parkeertarieven is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten en niet van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over het SOMO-onderzoek naar misstanden op bouwprojecten waarvan Rijkswaterstaat de opdrachtgever is

MPs Hoogland and Kerstens asked whether Rijkswaterstaat, as client, checks compliance with labour rules and minimum wage/cao obligations in subcontracting chains on road projects, and whether standard contracts should refer to them. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat requires compliance with statutory rules and checks Arbeidsomstandighedenwet and foreign-worker rules, but lacks powers over cao wage compliance, which lies with cao parties, the Inspectie SZW and sectoral bodies, so no change to standard contracts or project screening is planned beyond supporting competent authorities.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de bereidheid van de provincie Overijssel en de gemeente Raalte om zelf (mede) te investeren in de aanpak van het knelpunt in de N35 bij Raalte (kruispunt-Bos N35/N348)

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister whether the province of Overijssel and the municipality of Raalte are willing to co-invest in fixing the N35/N348 junction, and whether national funds can be used for a level crossing there. The Minister confirmed the local willingness, pointed to the signed 15 million euro package (10 million provincial, 5 million national) that includes this junction, declined extra national money, and said the level-crossing budgets cannot fund it while the municipality has not yet responded on the project scope.
I see no reason to make additional funds available for the N35 Wijthmen-Nijverdal beyond the funds already provided.
Ik zie geen reden om naast de reeds beschikbaar gestelde middelen, additionele middelen beschikbaar te stellen voor de N35 Wijthmen-Nijverdal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat de Duitse Ministerraad heeft ingestemd met het tolplan

An MP asked the Infrastructure minister about the German plan to introduce a road toll (vignette) for passenger cars, its discriminatory effects on Dutch drivers and border residents, possible legal action, and whether Dutch registration data could be used for German enforcement. The minister opposed the plan, said talks with Germany continue and that the plan was softened for local border traffic, noted no court action is currently on the table, and confirmed the RDW may provide registration data to foreign authorities on request.
At this moment, taking the matter to the European Court of Justice is not on the agenda.
Op dit moment is een gang naar het Europese Hof van Justitie niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Waddenfonds: versterking economie in Waddengebied blijft achter”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why economic investment from the Wadden Fund lags behind, and how the 50% economy allocation agreed in the decentralisation accord is monitored and enforced. The minister answered that recent figures show economic allocations developing well, that the allocation split for 2012-2014 was 47/53 ecology/economy in ceilings and 56/44 in awards, that the provinces hold autonomous competence, and that no further action is planned.
The Wadden Fund was decentralised to the Wadden provinces in 2012. This means the Wadden provinces have been given the autonomous competence to spend the funds.
Het Waddenfonds is in 2012 gedecentraliseerd naar de Waddenprovincies. Dat betekent dat de Waddenprovincies de autonome bevoegdheid hebben gekregen om de middelen te besteden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de plannen om het financiële beheer van KLM van Nederland naar Frankrijk over te hevelen en daarmee KLM een groot deel van haar resterende autonomie te laten ve

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether Air France KLM plans to move KLM's financial management to Paris, whether the Memorandum of Understanding and other agreements are respected, and related questions on the state's shareholding and KLM's profits. The State Secretary answered that concrete plans are not yet known, that the state's influence as shareholder is limited, that the 2010 MoU safeguards KLM's Dutch base and hub network, and offered confidential inspection of the MoU.
I am willing to make this Memorandum of Understanding and the agreements with the State available for confidential inspection.
Ik ben bereid om dit Memorandum of Understanding en de afspraken met de Staat vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over schepenveilingen door de Rabobank aan de Rabobank

An SP MP asked whether Rabobank buys back its own foreclosed inland vessels through a subsidiary and whether state guarantees of up to 1 million euro per vessel create an incentive and harm skippers. The minister confirmed the practice, defended it as protecting against sales below expert floor prices, said the guarantee does not double-compensate the bank and that the skipper remains liable for the residual debt, and denied any subsidy or incentive problem.
There is therefore no double compensation paid to the bank.
Er vindt dus geen dubbele vergoeding aan de bank plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Poolse werknemers uitgebuit ; vakbond FNV Bouw meldt flinke reeks misstanden bij verbreding A15’

Two PvdA MPs asked the Infrastructure and Environment and Social Affairs ministers about reports of exploitation of Polish workers on the A15 widening, including underpayment, lack of insurance and unpaid overtime. The minister said the allegations could not yet be confirmed, that the Labour Inspectorate had inspected the site in April 2014 without finding minimum-wage or working-time violations, and that investigations and new contractor-liability rules were underway.

These cases are currently being investigated by the special team of the Labour Inspectorate responsible for tackling sham constructions and supporting social partners in enforcing collective agreement conditions.

Deze zaken worden thans onderzocht door het speciale team van de Inspectie SZW dat belast is met de aanpak van schijnconstructies en de ondersteuning van sociale partners bij de handhaving van de cao-voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Tellegen over het gebruik van verkeersdata

MPs Visser and Tellegen (VVD) asked about sharing traffic data by road managers and about warning systems for approaching emergency services. The minister says the national data databank and Beter Benutten projects improve data quality, that a radio-warning trial was not scaled up, and that no regulatory barriers exist so no new legislation is planned.
There are no regulatory barriers to applying such technologies.
Er liggen geen belemmeringen op het gebied van wet- en regelgeving voor het toepassen van dergelijke technieken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het achteraf regelen van vergunningen voor reeds uitgevoerde projecten door het Waterschap Roer en Overmaas

An MP asked the minister whether the Roer en Overmaas water board routinely granted permits retroactively for its own projects, and what oversight and action would follow. The minister relied on the National Ombudsman's finding that retroactive permits occurred in two cases, were undesirable but not harmful to citizens, and that the water board will now grant overarching permits in advance and has appointed an external integrity contact.
The National Ombudsman's report indicates that it has not been shown that citizens were harmed by the water board's practice or that their legal protection was reduced.
Het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman geeft aan dat niet is gebleken dat burgers door de werkwijze van het waterschap zijn benadeeld of in hun mogelijkheden van rechtsbescherming zijn gekort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat er plannen zijn om een vismigratierivier ter waarde van meer dan 80 miljoen te maken in de Afsluitdijk

An MP asked the minister about reports that a fish migration river costing over 80 million euro is planned at the Afsluitdijk, asking about effectiveness, necessity, consequences if not built, funding, management, dike safety and comparable projects. The minister replied that the project is effective and estimated at about 55 million euro, that it replaces a required EU Water Framework Directive fish passage, that the region bears most of the funding with limited Rijk contributions, and that dike safety is not weakened.
The Ministry of IenM has not yet received a request from the region and therefore has not yet made a decision on the contribution.
Het Ministerie van IenM heeft nog geen verzoek van de regio ontvangen en dus ook nog geen besluit genomen over de bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de flessenhals van de A4

An MP asked the minister why speed was limited to 80 km/h and a lane closed on the A4 near Leiden, whether contractor costs could be recovered, and why road users were not informed proactively. The minister answered that the final three-lane layout opened in late 2014, that remaining works until March 2015 keep the 80 km/h limit, that repairs are at the contractor's expense, and that road users were informed through press releases, newsletters and other channels.
Recovering costs from the contractor is not an issue.
Het verhalen van kosten bij de aannemer is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het rapport ‘Ecologische gevolgen van bollenteelt op de Veluwe’ van Alterra

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether the Alterra report on high pesticide use in Veluwe bulb cultivation, which found larger potential effects than arable crops, should lead to consequences for bulb growing near drinking water catchments and for Water Framework Directive goals.
