The state secretary replied that the Ctgb assesses risks of individual pesticides including to protected areas and drinking water catchments, that the report did not establish the actual risk, and that no consequences follow, and declined to answer before the scheduled water committee meeting in time.

Because the Alterra study does not indicate how large the risk of bulb cultivation on the Veluwe actually is, and because risks to drinking water catchments are assessed when pesticides are authorised, the conclusions of the Alterra report have no consequences for bulb cultivation in and around drinking water catchments.

Omdat de studie van Alterra niet aangeeft hoe groot het risico van de bollenteelt op de Veluwe daadwerkelijk is en omdat bij de toelatingen van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen de risico's voor drinkwaterwingebieden worden beoordeeld, hebben de conclusies uit het Alterrarapport geen gevolgen voor de bollenteelt in en rond drinkwaterwingebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over de berichten “Nieuwe 380 kV hoogspanningslijn: 'Aantasting leefklimaat Oosterhout” en “Oosterhout blijft zich verzetten tegen hoogspanningstracé 380kV”

An MP asked why TenneT only recently changed the planned 380 kV power line route near Oosterhout, whether residents and local officials were excluded, why information evenings were cancelled, and whether residents are still unclear about the new route. The minister explained the reliability analysis and redundancy findings, said information was delayed for safety and uncertainty reasons, and announced five new information evenings.
As indicated, this concerns postponement of the information evenings, not cancellation.
Zoals aangegeven gaat het om uitstel van de informatieavonden, niet om afstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht 'Lokale lasten maken onze haven te duur'

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the Minister whether Rotterdam port firms pay double local levies that make the port less competitive, whether small firms are leaving and few new firms settling. Minister Schultz van Haegen replied that the double-payment claim is incorrect since property and advertising levies are general taxes set by Rotterdam municipality, that she has no signals of small firms leaving, and that she will press the European Commission for state aid guidelines for seaports.
The claim about paying levies twice is incorrect.
De stelling omtrent het dubbel betalen van lasten is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat de techniek faalt in de zogenaamde combi-tunnel in Nijverdal

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether she was aware of reports that technology fails in the Nijverdal combi-tunnel, what actions have been taken, the cause and timing of fixes, and whether similar ICT is used elsewhere. The minister confirmed awareness, explained that data communication between tunnel systems is not yet working, that the cause is still under investigation with no firm reopening date, and that other tunnels use comparable systems with measures to be taken once the problem is understood.
Until it is clear which adjustments exactly need to be made, it is not known when the tunnel can be fully reopened.
Totdat duidelijk is welke aanpassingen precies moeten worden gedaan, is niet bekend wanneer de tunnel volledig kan worden opengesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over het bericht dat TenneT een tracé voor hoogspanningskabels plotseling verlegt

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked why TenneT's planned 380kV cable route between Roosendaal and Tilburg was moved from the northern to the southern alignment and when the planning procedures would proceed. Minister Kamp answered that the northern route was dropped because four-circuit connections are unacceptable for grid security and international obligations, that the new route will be optimised with local stakeholders, and that formal procedures are expected in autumn 2017.
The new planned route must first be technically elaborated in consultation with regional parties and optimised where necessary and possible.
Het nieuwe voorgenomen tracé moet eerst in overleg met de regionale partijen technisch uitgewerkt worden en waar nodig/mogelijk worden geoptimaliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht «Ministerie durft info-avonden hoogspanningsmasten Oosterhout, Zevenbergen niet aan: «Te gevaarlijk»

MP Van Veldhoven asked why the information evenings on the Zuid-West 380 kV high-voltage line in Oosterhout and Zevenbergen were cancelled, and whether the route change and the need for the line were justified. Minister Kamp answered that the evenings were postponed for public order and safety reasons, five new evenings are planned, the southern route was chosen to avoid sensitive destinations, and a Ministry report on grid quality norms was sent to the House.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over wildparkerende vrachtwagenchauffeurs langs de A20 en het verdwijnen van parkeercapaciteit door de realisatie van de Blankenburgtunnel en de doortrekking van de A15

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about truck drivers overnighting informally along the A20 near Rotterdam, the lack of paid or free parking, and parking capacity lost to the Blankenburg tunnel and A15 extension. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is working with the region on a parking and enforcement plan, rejected responsibility for providing free long-stay parking on the main road network, and said she would expand short-rest capacity and develop private truck parkings.
I do not intend to reduce the current parking capacity.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de huidige parkeercapaciteit te reduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Albert de Vries over de problemen met weekendverblijf van vrachtwagenchauffeurs in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

MPs Kerstens and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about problems with lorry drivers spending weekend rest periods on Zeeland-Flanders car parks, whether this breaches EU and municipal rules, whether the ILT will investigate, whether Belgian stricter rules cause a waterbed effect, and how municipalities will be involved. The minister answered that spending a long rest on a car park is not in itself an infringement, that the ILT checks for alternatives and warns drivers, that the ILT has consulted Belgian authorities, and that municipalities and police are primarily responsible for public order.
Within the framework of public order and safety, the municipality and police are in the first instance responsible for taking measures where necessary.
Het is in het in het kader van openbare orde en veiligheid in eerste instantie een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeente en politie om indien nodig maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken over extra maatregelen tegen autodiefstal

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked about a news report on car theft, rising theft numbers, police priority, a ban on sale of key duplicators and car-theft electronics, ANPR camera privacy rules, and online sale of moped tuning kits. The minister denied a rise in thefts, said a sales ban is legally hard to justify under proportionality and EU law, noted a pending bill allowing 28-day retention of ANPR passage data, and offered to consult the trade on other options.
A sales ban is very difficult if it cannot be shown that these systems have no other use than carrying out criminal activities.
Een verkoopverbod is erg lastig als niet kan worden aangetoond dat er geen enkel ander nut is voor dit soort systemen dan het uitoefenen van criminele activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje De Vries over het bericht over overboord geslagen containers boven Ameland

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked about ten containers lost overboard near Ameland, their recovery, liability, follow-up on a 2010 inspection report on container lashing, and the frequency of losses. The minister answered that recovery is the owner's responsibility under Rijkswaterstaat supervision, that lashing enforcement continues within regular inspections, and that IMO work on container mass is nearing completion.
It is not customary to publicize details about the ship widely, so as to avoid negatively affecting the further cooperation of those involved.
Het is niet gebruikelijk gegevens over het schip breed bekend te maken om te voorkomen dat nadere medewerking van betrokkenen negatief kan worden beïnvloed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het voornemen van de gemeente Rotterdam om parkeergeld te heffen op de verschillende Park+Rides

An MP asked the minister whether Rotterdam's plan to charge for parking at Park+Ride sites, partly funded by the national Beter Benutten programme and the regional authority, was appropriate and whether the national government could intervene. The minister replied that Rotterdam is fully competent to set its own parking tariffs, that national intervention is not warranted given the modest fee, and that Beter Benutten conditions aim to balance occupancy and business case.
Rotterdam is therefore fully competent to introduce parking tariffs at its own discretion and approval for parking facilities in its territory.
De gemeente Rotterdam is derhalve volledig bevoegd om naar eigen inzicht en goedkeuring parkeertarieven in te voeren voor het gebruik van parkeervoorzieningen op haar grondgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de Nederlandse chartervaart in Denemarken

An MP asks the minister about the dispute over Dutch sail charter vessels (bruine vloot) in Denmark, which Denmark requires to meet SOLAS safety rules, and about bilateral talks and possible EU court action. The minister acknowledges the problem, reports a rejected Danish compromise, says she is willing to contact her Danish counterpart again, and says the Commission infringement procedure is nearly closed while a bilateral solution is still sought.
I am willing to contact my Danish colleague to reach an agreement acceptable to the majority of the skippers.
Ik ben bereid contact op te nemen met mijn Deense collega, om tot een voor de meerderheid van de schippers acceptabel akkoord te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het gebrek aan steun onder de Nederlandse beroepschartervaart voor het Deense voorstel voor regulering van de vaart op Denemarken

Albert de Vries (PvdA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about Danish demands that Dutch sailing charter vessels meet SOLAS standards, and whether Denmark discriminates against Dutch vessels relative to Danish ones. The Minister answered that the dispute turns on interpreting 'not mechanically propelled', that Denmark's safety concerns are substantive, that Dutch charter regulation will be modernised, and that she will contact her Danish counterpart on the main pain points.
I will contact my Danish counterpart to resolve the two main pain points.
Ik zal in contact te treden met mijn Deense collega om de twee voornaamste pijnpunten opgelost te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de spitsstrook zou werken als een boetefuik

An MP asked whether the A12 hard-shoulder (spitsstrook) acts as a speed-fine trap, whether it should be permanently opened, and whether speed enforcement on motorways is justified. The minister said the A12 and A4 lanes will be opened permanently, that police data cannot show more speeding when shoulders are open, and that fines aim to improve compliance rather than raise revenue.
As I indicated in the General Consultation with your House on 9 October 2014, the plus lane on the A12 between Woerden and Gouda will be permanently opened by mid-2015.
Zoals ik in het Algemeen Overleg met uw Kamer op 9 oktober 2014 heb aangegeven wordt de plusstrook op de A12 tussen Woerden en Gouda medio 2015 permanent opengesteld.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de invoering van de maximumsnelheid van 100 km/u op de A1/A35 nabij Borne en Hengelo

MP Van Tongeren asks whether the government has sent the promised written response on the A35 complaints point concerning the 100 km/h speed limit near Borne and Hengelo to parliament, and asks it to do so if not. The minister confirms the earlier promise and states that the response was given in the letter of 13 June 2014 ahead of the MIRT committee meeting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over het bestraffen van chauffeurs met te hoog beladen vrachtwagens

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked why drivers of overheight trucks at the Velsertunnel are rarely fined, how often fines are issued nationally, and whether road inspectors could be given enforcement powers. The minister explained the notification procedure, reported low fine counts due to police attendance and the planned 2016 renovation, and said talks on a Rotterdam inspector pilot are ongoing.
I refer further to my answer to question 2 for an explanation of the number of height signals compared to the number of fines.
Ik verwijs verder naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 voor een toelichting op het aantal hoogtesignaleringen ten opzichte van het aantal boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de relingplicht voor binnenvaartschepen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the temporary railing requirement (relingplicht) for inland vessels, including its scope and whether the inspectorate applies the same rules. The minister explained the transitional rules, that the requirement was extended to 30 November 2017, and that the inspectorate applies CCR rules without deviation.
In working out this, I aim to ensure that existing vessels are left untouched.
Bij de uitwerking hiervan zet ik erop in dat bestaande schepen ongemoeid worden gelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de dreiging van ziekmakende en levensbedreigende bacteriën op vlees

An MP asked the minister about Wakker Dier findings of bacteria such as ESBL-producing strains, E. coli, Listeria and Campylobacter on barbecue meat, and whether bacterial counts above ten million cfu per gram show spoiled meat and call for a legal limit. The minister confirmed the findings, said that bacterial counts are a hygiene signal rather than a spoilage measure, and declined to introduce a legal cfu limit for fresh meat, pointing to producer and supermarket responsibility.
This is also the reason why there is no legal norm for the number of bacteria per gram of meat.
Dit is ook de reden dat er geen wettelijke norm is voor het aantal bacteriën per gram vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het niet nakomen van afspraken met betrekking tot Hoogwatergeul Veessen-Wapenveld

MP Jacobi asked the minister whether agreements on enforcement support for the Veessen-Wapenveld flood relief channel with the municipality of Heerde were being kept, given a redistribution of tasks between Rijkswaterstaat and the ILT, and whether this fits a reliable government. The minister replied that a joint supervision plan was completed in September 2014, that the ILT will act as competent authority as specified, and that the agreements were kept.
Yes. The earlier agreements were worked out and fulfilled in cooperation with the parties involved.
Ja. De eerder gemaakte afspraken zijn in samenwerking met de betrokken partijen uitgewerkt en nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de nieuwe regels op het Prinses Margrietkanaal en het Van Starkenborghkanaal

MP De Boer asked about new speed limits and restricted bridge operation on the Prinses Margrietkanaal and Van Starkenborghkanaal, including collision risk, accident data, wind and fog rules. The minister answered that speed reductions respond to damaging collisions and bridge constraints, bridges can operate up to wind force 8, and fog restrictions are for safety, with some information not available.
It is not known whether accidents specifically caused by fog have occurred on the main waterway Lemmer-Delfzijl.
Het is niet bekend of op de hoofdvaarweg Lemmer-Delfzijl er specifiek door mist ongevallen zijn gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat door middel van een WOB-verzoek aan het licht is gekomen dat windmolens worden geplaatst op een gevaarlijke plek

The MP Madlener asks whether the minister plans wind turbines on the Tweede Maasvlakte beach that would displace kitesurfers, whether residents and recreational users have a say, and what extra costs arise. The minister answers that a 2009 convenant covers wind energy in the Rotterdam port, that further study is ongoing with interests of kitesurfers to be considered later, that stakeholders will be involved when preparations start, and that any extra costs fall on the potential market party.
In the planning for the Second Maasvlakte, both wind energy and a beach for extensive recreation were considered.
Bij de planvorming rond de 2 de Maasvlakte is gekeken naar zowel windenergie als aanleg van strand voor extensieve recreatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en De Rouwe over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof Den Haag dat het Openbaar Ministerie iemand die een alcoholslot opgelegd heeft gekregen niet ook nog eens strafrechtelijk mag vervol

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a Hague appeals court ruling that the prosecutor may not also prosecute a driver already subject to a mandatory alcohol-lock programme, and about reports of faults in alcohol locks. The government answered that the ruling does not affect the administrative alcohol-lock measure, that the matter is still before the courts, that the CBR imposes the programme uniformly without individual balancing (with an investigation into possible change), and that it is studying mouth-alcohol false readings with a Wageningen University study.
When the alcohol-lock programme was introduced, the legislature deliberately chose to impose it mandatorily and uniformly, without room for individual balancing of interests.
Bij de introductie van het alcoholslotprogramma is door de wetgever bewust gekozen om het programma dwingend en uniform op te leggen zonder ruimte voor individuele belangenafweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over het bericht dat de kans op een dodelijk ongeval in de Velsertunnel bijna twee maal groter is dan wat de wet maximaal toelaatbaar acht

An MP asked the minister whether the Velsertunnel's accident risk, found by a 2014 risk analysis to exceed the legal group-risk norm, was known and why parliament was not informed, and what measures would follow. The minister answered that the tunnel meets the 2013 Tunnel Act now but must meet the 2019 norm, that the findings were already known when the law was made, and that the needed works and traffic metering are planned for the 2016 renovation.
The House has thereby been informed of the outcome of the QRA.
De Kamer is daarmee geïnformeerd over de uitkomst van de QRA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over een coördinerend minister voor de maritieme sector

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a proposed coordinating minister for the maritime sector, the level playing field for shipping, and work permit problems facing the owner of the cruise ship Oasis of the Seas. The minister supports better coordination without changing other departments' responsibilities, and says the permit problems stem from late applications and should be resolved through cooperation.
I am in favour of better coordination and alignment of maritime policy and a transparent and accessible government, so that matters for the sector can be resolved quickly.
Ik ben voorstander van een betere coördinatie en afstemming van het maritieme beleid en een transparante en toegankelijke overheid, zodat zaken voor de sector snel opgelost kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat het werk aan de brug bij Ewijk stil ligt door ruzie

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether work on the Ewijk bridge had stalled due to a dispute with contractors, and about consequences, safety and prevention. The minister denied the bridge work was stopped, explained the cable-replacement dispute went to court which ordered work resumed, and described Rijkswaterstaat's safety and prevention measures.
Rijkswaterstaat submitted the stopping of the work to the judge in summary proceedings.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft het stilleggen van de werkzaamheden in een kortgeding voorgelegd aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Smaling over zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Smaling and Klaver asked whether the government had properly examined using German brine instead of salt extraction under the Wadden Sea, and whether that option was included in the environmental permit and appropriate assessment. The minister answered that German brine is economically unviable due to lower salt concentration, high transport costs and supply risks, so no renewed talks with Frisia are planned, and that the permit cannot be revoked while objection proceedings are pending.
I see no reason to question this conclusion.
Ik zie geen reden om deze conclusie in twijfel te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Madlener over het bericht 'Moldaviërs halen Roemenen in'

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Foreign Affairs and Infrastructure about reports of Dutch transport firms 'flagging out', foreign drivers, lorry parking and the sale of passports and driving licences, and whether borders should be closed to Eastern European workers. The government answered that data on flagged-out firms and job losses is unavailable, that it cannot track non-EU nationality entitlements, that enforcement is being strengthened in cooperation with the ILT and Inspectie SZW, and that closing the labour market is not a realistic option.
It is not known how many Dutch lorry drivers have lost their jobs since the labour market was opened to Romanians, Bulgarians and Poles.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel Nederlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs sinds de openstelling van de arbeidsmarkt voor Roemenen, Bulgaren en Polen hun baan hebben verloren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de bevinden van FNV Bondgenoten, dat op de Nederlandse wegen opmerkelijk veel vrachtwagenchauffeurs van buiten de EU zijn aangetroffen.

An MP asked the ministers whether FNV's finding of many non-EU truck drivers on Dutch roads is accurate, whether they hold Polish work permits and whether this is a sham construction, and what enforcement, cooperation and legislative steps are planned. The government replies that no data show such numbers, gives Polish permit figures without knowing how many worked in the Netherlands, and points to expanded ILT enforcement, Inspectie SZW support for collective agreement enforcement, EU-level action and the forthcoming Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies.
There are no figures available showing that a remarkably large number of truck drivers from outside the European Union are driving on Dutch roads.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar waaruit blijkt dat opmerkelijk veel vrachtwagenchauffeurs van buiten de Europese Unie op de Nederlandse wegen rondrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat IKEA de Nederlandse wet omzeilt met Slowaakse chauffeurs

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked whether the government will act on reports that IKEA circumvents Dutch law using Slovak drivers, and whether the inspectorate will check the Slovak carrier's operations. The minister says the inspectorate supervises Dutch carriers, has met the FNV about its reports, and cannot itself investigate a foreign company but could request action from the foreign authority.
The ILT has no authority to conduct its own investigation at a company established abroad.
De ILT heeft geen bevoegdheid om zelf onderzoek te doen bij een in het buitenland gevestigd bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over het omzeilen van de Nederlandse wet door IKEA

MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether IKEA circumvents Dutch wage law by using Slovak drivers paid partly through allowances, and whether the minister will hold principal clients like IKEA accountable and have the Inspectorate investigate. The minister said the Inspectorate lacks a legal basis to examine clients, that the client's responsibility is being studied within the anti-sham-constructions action plan, and pointed to planned measures in the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies.
The ILT has no legal basis for conducting such an investigation.
De ILT heeft geen wettelijke basis voor het doen van dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de provincie Drenthe de gemeente Emmen dwingt windturbines te plaatsen

An MP asked the minister whether the province of Drenthe is coercing the municipality of Emmen into accepting wind turbines, whether the government will support the municipal council against the province, and whether a municipal ban should bind the province and national government. The minister answered that the province acted within its statutory powers, that the national government will not intervene, and that a municipal no-turbine decision is not decisive given provincial and ministerial competences under the Electricity Act.
In my view the province of Drenthe has acted in accordance with its legal authority.
De provincie Drenthe heeft naar mijn mening conform haar wettelijke bevoegdheid gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over het bericht ‘Brug Kornwerderzand sluit uur lang niet’

MP De Rouwe asked the minister about a bridge malfunction on the Afsluitdijk, recurring storms, safety and maintenance adequacy, economic damage, and the planned widening of the Kornwerderzand lock. The minister explained the causes and remedies of the four recent storms, announced large-scale maintenance through 2018, and said a letter on lock widening would follow.
As promised in the general consultation on water safety of 19 June, your House will be informed by letter about the regionally desired widening of the Kornwerderzand lock.
Zoals toegezegd in het algemeen overleg Waterveiligheid van 19 juni jl. zal uw Kamer bij brief nader worden geïnformeerd over de door de regio gewenste verbreding van de sluis bij Kornwerderzand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat er te veel defecten zijn bij trucks

Madlener (PVV) asked the minister about reports of excessive truck defects, the share of unsafe trucks over five years, whether defective trucks should be banned from the road, whether controls should be intensified, and whether postponed maintenance creates unfair competition. The minister acknowledged the reports, gave police inspection figures (2.7% of checked trucks received a driving ban), said no new measures were needed for now, and agreed that postponed maintenance is unfair competition.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Litjens over de toepassing van het Besluit algemene regels ruimtelijke ordening (Barro) in Druten

MPs Dijkstra and Litjens asked the minister whether the Barro rules, which the Raad van State found a zoning plan in Druten to breach, were not blocking a business's storage on high ground and water transport, and whether an exemption could be granted. The minister defended the Barro flood-safety rules, rejected amending them, and said a municipal exemption request received on 10 June would be assessed carefully.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over ernstige wateroverlast op maandag 28 juli 2014

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the July 2014 extreme rainfall, damage estimates, and whether the Delta Decision on Spatial Adaptation could enforce water-resilient planning. The minister answered that damage figures are not fully known, that the Delta Programme relies on voluntary interbestuurlijke cooperation rather than enforceable measures, and that implementation will be monitored.
The extent of the damage from 28 July and its distribution across sectors or objects is not known to me.
De omvang van de schade van 28 juli jl. en de verdeling daarvan over sectoren of objecten is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over storingen bij de Coentunnel

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about breakdowns, height-detection false alarms and traffic jams at the Coentunnel, including whether measures taken in 2013 worked and what they cost. The minister disputed the criticism, listed the 2013 measures (cost EUR 235,000), said there were no jams in the peak hours since reopening but short stoppages from overheight trucks and some incidental faults, and declined to add technical measures while describing enforcement fines and contacts with the transport sector.
I see no reason yet to take additional (technical) measures, because the height detection systems are well set up and functioning correctly.
Ik zie nog geen aanleiding om aanvullende (technische) maatregelen te nemen, omdat de hoogtedetectiesystemen goed staan ingesteld en juist functioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht over parkeergarages

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Grontmij report claiming most parking garage designs are unsafe and inaccessible, and about whether national norms such as NEN 2443 should be written into the Bouwbesluit. The minister answered that Grontmij had no national study, that preventing car damage is not a national government task, that the Bouwbesluit protects persons rather than cars, and that no new parking dimension rules will be added.
It is not the task of the national government to prevent damage to cars in parking garages.
Het is niet aan de rijksoverheid om schade aan auto’s in parkeergarages te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de belastingvoordelen voor Nederlandse havens

An MP asked when the minister knew that tax advantages for Dutch ports could be seen as illegal state aid, why the impression arose that Germany and Belgium favour their ports, and why the European Commission started its investigation. The minister answered that the Commission invited measures in May 2013, opened a formal procedure in July 2014 covering all non-corporate-tax-paying public companies, and that the government opposes subjecting Dutch ports to corporate tax before neighbouring countries.
I am opposed to the Netherlands subjecting its seaport operators to corporate tax earlier than the surrounding countries.
Ik ben er op tegen dat Nederland eerder dan de ons omringende landen zijn zeehavenbeheerders aan vpb onderwerpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over uitstoot op zee

An MP asked the minister whether stricter sulphur rules from January 2015 would sharply raise bunker costs for container shipping and harm Dutch ports' competitiveness, and whether the government would limit the cost increase. The minister answered that shippers can comply via low-sulphur fuel, LNG or scrubbers, that modal shift risk is limited to 1-9% on a few routes, and declined to intervene in fuel price formation.
I will keep an eye on what the practical consequences of the new sulphur oxide emission standards for ships are.
Ik zal in de gaten houden wat in de praktijk de gevolgen zijn van de nieuwe normen voor uitstoot van zwaveloxide door schepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Monasch over het bericht dat de gasleiding van honderdduizenden Nederlanders lekt

MPs Albert de Vries and Monasch asked about reports that gas pipes leak in hundreds of thousands of homes, including claims of explosion risk, deaths, lost gas, lapsed municipal inspections and a periodic inspection scheme. The minister answered that leaks are rare and mainly in older homes, that owners are responsible under the Building Decree, that a national inspection programme is not justified, and that a possible ministerial regulation will be explored with municipalities and report in 2015.
The Minister for Housing and Central Government Organisation will take the initiative for this exploration and will inform the House of Representatives further on its results in 2015.
De Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst zal het initiatief nemen voor deze verkenning en zal in 2015 de Tweede Kamer nader informeren over de resultaten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het afsluiten van de waterlevering door drinkwaterbedrijven in geval van wanbetaling

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about water cut-offs for non-payment by Limburg water company WML, including high salaries, human right to water, the 50-litre minimum, and whether the rules should be evaluated. The minister answered that the cut-off rules are being followed correctly, that the Inspectorate supervises them, that a new arrangement with debt-relief services is in place, and that no evaluation is needed yet.
This supervision shows that the Regulation is well complied with by drinking water companies.
Uit dit toezicht blijkt dat de Regeling door drinkwaterbedrijven goed wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Verheijen over de voornemens inzake tolheffing op de Duitse wegen

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about German plans to extend a road toll (vignette) to local roads, including its effects on cross-border residents, transport, EU law and possible joint action with neighbouring countries. The minister opposed the plan, said the Commission will be asked to assess it under EU law, and said Nederland will consider joint action with other countries if useful.
I will ask Commissioner Kallas to examine whether this planned measure and its implementation are compatible with EU law.
Ik zal Eurocommissaris Kallas verzoeken na te gaan of deze voorgenomen maatregel en de uitwerking ervan verenigbaar is met het EU recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het uitwijken van schepen van de haven van Rotterdam naar Antwerpen

An MP asked whether deep-sea shipping lines are shifting cargo from Rotterdam to Antwerp due to congestion, how much, and whether urgent action is needed. The minister disputes that a substantive shift is occurring, attributes congestion to market fluctuations and terminal adjustments, and points to new terminal capacity opening on Maasvlakte 2.
From information I obtained from the Rotterdam port business community, I gather that the conclusions in the cited article are not shared.
Uit informatie die ik heb ingewonnen bij het Rotterdamse havenbedrijfsleven maak ik op dat de conclusies in het aangehaalde artikel niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over de tol op wegen in Duitsland

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment about the German road toll plan for foreign cars, its consistency with the 2013 Kleef agreements, its expected damage, and whether a toll summit with neighbouring countries would be organised. The minister said the European Commission will assess the plan's EU-law compliance, that the Netherlands will act jointly with neighbours if useful, and that she will not convene a toll summit.
I will ask Commissioner Kallas to examine whether this planned measure and its implementation are compatible with EU law.
Ik zal Eurocommissaris Kallas verzoeken na te gaan of deze voorgenomen maatregel en de uitwerking ervan verenigbaar is met het EU recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over het bericht dat de Velsertunnel onveilig is

The MP De Rouwe (CDA) asked whether the Velsertunnel is unsafe after a press report, what measures followed an inspection report, whether it meets current law, and how safety was compromised. The minister replied that defects affecting safety were fixed immediately, other installations were replaced, remaining findings will be resolved in the 2016 renovation, and that the tunnel meets the Warvw though not yet the 2019 safety norm, with safety never having been compromised.
The Velsertunnel complies with the law (Warvw).
De Velsertunnel voldoet aan de wet (Warvw).

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat tijdens de brand op het Shellcomplex aan de Chemieweg in Moerdijk d.d. 3 juni 2014 tegen de afspraken in de drinkwaterbedrijven niet zijn geïnformeerd

An MP asked whether drinking water companies Brabant Water and Evides were not properly informed during the June 2014 Shell Moerdijk fire, and what this means for water quality, cooperation with safety regions and convenant implementation. The minister answered that Midden- en West-Brabant did not alert the water companies because no risk was seen, that Zuid-Holland Zuid did inform Evides, that water quality was not endangered, and that implementation of the covenants is being monitored and pushed, with a fuller plan to follow.
The Dutch Safety Board is conducting further investigation into, among other things, crisis management including communication.
De Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid verricht nader onderzoek naar o.a. de crisisbeheersing inclusief de communicatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Visser over het aan te leggen stuk spoor bij Beverwijk en overige werkzaamheden naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek van de leden van de VVD-fractie aan Tata Steel in IJmuiden

Two VVD MPs asked about extending the Beverwijk rail head track to 750 metres, the cost of rail freight, and coordination of overlapping infrastructure works in the North Sea Canal area. The State Secretary answered that ProRail is responsible for the track extension due in 2016, that rail freight measures are in the Long-Term Rail Agenda, and that Rijkswaterstaat coordinates works through annual multi-year planning and regional consultation.
It is of great importance for businesses that infrastructure works are well coordinated with one another.
Het is voor bedrijven van groot belang dat werkzaamheden aan de infrastructuur goed op elkaar worden afgestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over het bericht “dat er nauwelijks verkeer is voor de dure snelweg naar Almere”

The MP De Rouwe asked whether declining traffic forecasts for the Almere motorway (A1, A6, A9) should lead to revising the road-widening plans, and whether slower Almere growth was included in the revised forecasts. The minister replied that the widening decisions remain necessary because traffic is still forecast to rise sharply, that the latest models already incorporate the crisis-driven slowdown, and that a status overview of other widening projects will follow in the MIRT project book.
The decision to widen the A1, A6 and A9 was a well-considered decision, based on the best information available at the time and after extensive consultation with the region and your House.
Het besluit om de A1, de A6 en de A9 te verbreden is een weloverwogen besluit geweest, op basis van de best beschikbare informatie destijds en na veelvuldig overleg met de regio en uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over stremmingen bij sluizen in Duitsland

MP De Rouwe asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the closure of small locks on the Wesel-Datteln canal in Germany due to staff shortages, and whether the Dutch inland shipping sector was informed and whether the minister would contact the German counterpart. The minister confirmed the closures, said the sector was informed via ELWIS, judged the restriction limited because large chambers remain open, and saw no reason to contact the German minister.
I see no reason in the current situation to contact my German colleague.
Ik zie in de huidige situatie geen aanleiding om contact op te nemen met mijn Duitse collega.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Veldhoven over fraude bij schadeherstel van auto’s

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Van Veldhoven asked about widespread fraud in car bodywork repair, reported by the insurers' association, and whether the government would act if the sector fails to fix it. Minister Opstelten said he supports industry measures within legal and proportionality limits, pointed to a convenant and a shared-data approach with RDW and VbV, and described existing police and prosecution arrangements, without announcing new government intervention.
I think it is good that the Association of Insurers has investigated irregularities and fraud in the repair of bodywork damage to passenger cars.
Ik vind het goed dat het Verbond van Verzekeraars onderzoek heeft gedaan naar onregelmatigheden en fraude bij de reparatie van blikschade aan personenauto's
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht “VS willen meer veiligheid luchthavens Europa”

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the US is pressing for tighter security at European airports with direct flights to the US, whether Dutch airports are affected, and whether explosives without metal are a threat to Schiphol. The government confirmed that only Schiphol is affected, that the threat of non-metal explosives is known and monitored with the US and partners, and that additional security measures for US-bound flights took effect on 8 July.
Schiphol is the only Dutch airport to which this applies.
Schiphol is de enige Nederlandse luchthaven waarop dit van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Jacobi en Kuiken over de plannen voor ontwikkeling van het KNSF-terrein in Muiden

PvdA MPs asked the minister about the draft zoning plan for the former KNSF site in Muiden, including very high building heights, its effect on the Kruitbos nature area, the EUR 376 million damage claim, and Schiphol flight path and Stelling van Amsterdam implications. The minister answered that zoning is the municipality's responsibility and that the Council of State is the appeal forum, while stating that nature agreements are upheld and that the damage claims are frozen pending the plan becoming final.
Under the Spatial Planning Act (Wro), it is the municipality's responsibility to adopt zoning plans for 'good spatial planning'.
Op grond van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening (Wro) is het de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente om bestemmingsplannen vast te stellen ten behoeve van «een goede ruimtelijke ordening».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht dat de Nederlandse loodsen recht hebben op 7,8 miljoen euro van het Vlaams Gewest

MP Albert de Vries asked the minister whether the Antwerp court confirmed that Flanders owes the Dutch pilotage service EUR 7.8 million in compensation for underpriced pilotage tariffs, and what the minister would do to ensure payment, avoid an appeal, and secure fairer future pricing. The minister confirmed the ruling, said she had urged her Flemish counterpart to respect the arbitration decision, and stated that the 2012-2013 claim and future tariffs are matters for Flanders and the Dutch pilotage service, with new arrangements awaiting Flemish political approval.
No, this is between the Flemish Region and the Dutch Pilotage Service.
Nee, dit is tussen het Vlaams Gewest en het Nederlands Loodswezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het 380 kV hoogspanningstracé Borssele – Rilland

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers about the urgency, necessity and routing of the 380 kV Borssele–Rilland power line, including links to offshore wind, health concerns and alternative routes. The government answered that capacity is needed given grid overload and interconnection plans, that the project is not being rushed but split procedurally, and that the health precautionary policy and buy-out scheme apply, with alternatives assessed in the environmental procedure.
There is no question of accelerated realisation of the Borssele-Rilland route.
Er is geen sprake van een versnelde realisatie van het traject Borssele-Rilland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht “Sluiswachter keert terug in Zeeland”

MP Smaling asked why remote control of four Zeeland locks was suspended, whether there were incidents, and whether camera-based remote operation is unreliable. The minister explained inspection-found emergency-stop defects, listed three communication incidents without danger, rejected the camera criticism, and agreed to send the inspection report.
Yes, I am willing to do so. The adopted report of the findings of this investigation into the emergency-stop facility is attached to this answer.
Ja, daartoe ben ik bereid. Het vastgestelde rapport van de bevindingen van dit onderzoek naar de noodstopvoorziening is als bijlage bij deze beantwoording gevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht dat een kwart van het winkeloppervlak in de toekomst leegstaand en kansloos zal zijn

An MP asked the ministers whether the projected 25 percent reduction in retail floor space and rising shop vacancy warrant government intervention, including convening stakeholders and new regulation. The minister answered that shop vacancy is a market-driven, structural issue best handled through regional tailor-made agreements via the Winkeltop, and that existing instruments suffice, with a PBL analysis due in autumn.
For now I choose to actively facilitate the efforts from the Winkeltop to stimulate regional parties to reach tailor-made solutions
Ik kies er vooralsnog voor om de inzet vanuit de Winkeltop, om regionale partijen te stimuleren om te komen tot maatwerkoplossingen, actief te faciliteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en van Tongeren over de mogelijkheid om een spoorverbinding tussen Utrecht en Breda te realiseren langs de A27

MPs Smaling and van Tongeren asked why the government chose to widen the A27 between Utrecht and Breda for over 800 million euro rather than a rail link, and whether a rail line was studied, including its jobs and benefits. The State Secretary answered that the widening addresses a capacity problem on a national freight and traffic corridor, that the rail link was studied and rejected on a cost-benefit score of 0.05 with investment costs above 4 billion euro, and that infrastructure investment will continue to support jobs.
From these studies the conclusion was drawn that it is not justified to take further steps regarding this possible new railway line.
Uit deze onderzoeken is de conclusie getrokken dat het niet verantwoord is verdere stappen te ondernemen ten aanzien van deze mogelijke nieuwe spoorlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de ladder voor duurzame verstedelijking

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether Venray municipality and Inalfa had examined redeveloping the existing site and applied the ladder for sustainable urbanisation before approving a relocation, and how the ladder fits with reports that it is often skipped. The Minister answered that the municipality applied the ladder only after a public objection to the draft plan, that the ladder is a motivation requirement enforced via objections and appeals to the courts, and that how regional need is determined is left to the competent authority.
The requirement in the Bro is a motivation requirement, not a substantive norm.
De eis in het Bro is een motiveringseis, geen inhoudelijke norm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘vergrijzing transport levert baankansen op’

MPs Kuiken and Jadnanansing asked about logistics sector labour shortages, whether school leavers are choosing logistics careers, and whether enough workers are being recruited and retrained. The government answered that the sector itself must attract workers, pointed to a sector plan with 30 million euro of training measures and 1,250 extra driver trainees, and said vacancies are not above average.
It is up to the sector itself to present itself as an attractive employer and to entice young people to choose a career in logistics.
Het is aan de sector zelf om zich een aantrekkelijk werkgever te tonen en jongeren te verleiden om te kiezen voor een carrière in de logistiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe over het conflict tussen Rijkswaterstaat en de gemeente Ommen over de aanpak van de verkeersonveilige kruising van de N36 bij Beerze

CDA MPs asked the minister about the dispute between Rijkswaterstaat and Ommen over a traffic-light solution at the N36/Beerze junction instead of a grade-separated junction, including how the decision was made, cost differences, the basis for cost-sharing, and whether a new talk or deadline extension was possible. The minister defended the traffic-light option as most cost-effective and quickest, said no cost-sharing agreement with the VNG exists, and refused to reopen talks or extend the deadline.
No. Within the budget for cost-effective road safety measures there are no funds available for a grade-separated junction.
Nee. Binnen het budget voor kosteneffectieve verkeersveiligheidsmaatregelen zijn geen middelen beschikbaar voor een ongelijkvloers kruispunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe over de aanpassing van regelgeving voor maritieme opleidingen in Nederland in verband met de Manilla-wijzigingen op het STCW-Verdrag

Two CDA MPs asked the minister why the Enkhuizer Zeevaartschool's examination oversight and related articles were removed from the maritime crew regulation during the STCW Manila amendments, despite sector opposition. The minister answered that oversight of the school's sailing-vessel training remains with the ILT, that merchant-shipping training must run within regular WEB/WHW education, and that no regulatory change is planned.
I do not want to give up the supervisory role over the EZS.
Ik wil de toezichtsrol op de EZS niet kwijt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de afname van het aantal verkeersslachtoffers en de aanpak om deze dalende lijn te continueren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the 2013 fall in road deaths, how the downward trend will be sustained, which municipalities have the most casualties relative to population, and measures for cyclists including senior training and path maintenance. The minister confirmed the fall, said no clear cause could be identified, pointed to a package of 23 road safety measures with SWOV monitoring, and referred to a model local cycling safety approach that municipalities must adopt, while noting that per-capita rankings fluctuate yearly.
I therefore have the development of road safety monitored annually by SWOV.
Ik laat de ontwikkeling van de verkeersveiligheid daarom jaarlijks monitoren door SWOV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht ‘dat mensen die gezakt zijn, wel een rijbewijs ontvangen van het CBR’

An SP MP asked the minister about RTL reports that the CBR issued driving licences to 137 candidates who had failed their practical exams, and whether it would recover them and address repeated CBR problems. The minister disputed the scale of the reported errors, said the CBR found no unlawfully issued categories in its database checks, cited correction and new control measures, and declined to take further action.
With the recognisable driving school owners interviewed by RTL, the CBR held conversations about the cases they named, from which no need for recovery emerged.
Met de herkenbare rijschoolhouders die zijn geïnterviewd door RTL zijn door het CBR gesprekken gevoerd over de door hen genoemde gevallen waaruit geen noodzaak tot terugvordering is gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de aanpak van de overschrijding van luchtkwaliteitseisen op de ’s-Gravendijkwal in Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether closing the 's-Gravendijkwal to heavy traffic is insufficient to meet EU air quality limits, what is needed structurally, whether the Maastunnel renovation could address it, whether the national government shares responsibility, and whether ring-road 'inprikkers' were studied and what they would cost. The state secretary confirmed closure alone is insufficient, said primary responsibility for local measures lies with the municipality of Rotterdam, referred to the NSL programme, and said no concrete proposals for the ring-road approach were known.
The primary responsibility for measures to improve air quality along the 's-Gravendijkwal lies with the municipality of Rotterdam.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor maatregelen om de luchtkwaliteit langs de 's-Gravendijkwal te verbeteren, ligt bij de gemeente Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht «Boeren en waterschappen koppelen grondgebruik aan waterbeheer»

MPs Lodders and Visser asked about reports that farmers and water boards are launching 30 new area projects under the Deltaplan Agrarisch Waterbeheer, and whether this creates overlapping regulation with the Nitrates Directive and crop protection rules. The State Secretary answered that LTO leads the initiative with water boards, that the government plays a supporting role, and that equivalent measures could give farmers exemptions from generic use norms from 2015, without adding new binding regulation.
I do not foresee that this will lead to an accumulation of regulation.
Ik voorzie niet dat dit leidt tot een stapeling van regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de verkeersveiligheid op de A15

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the minister about road safety on the A15 after fatal and serious truck crashes, the high casualty count over ten years, and when measures would be taken. The minister answered that risk on the A15 is below average for motorways, announced a local traffic detection system, extra traffic inspectors, a planned overtaking ban for trucks and improved road markings.
Following research, as promised during the MIRT debate in autumn 2013, I have decided to install a local traffic detection system on the Deil towards Valburg road section.
Na onderzoek, zoals toegezegd bij de behandeling van het MIRT in het najaar van 2013, heb ik besloten om een locaal filedetectiesysteem te plaatsen op het weggedeelte Deil richting Valburg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Paulus Jansen inzake het voornemen dienstregeling Uithoflijn door het BRU

Two SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that the Uithoflijn tram, built with 110 million euro in national subsidy, will not run in evenings and at weekends, and whether the national government agreed service hours with the regional authority BRU. The state secretary replied that no specific service-hour agreements were made, that service levels are the responsibility of the regional authority under the Wet Personenvervoer, and that he will not intervene in that responsibility.
Investigating traveller needs in the Utrecht region and determining a suitable public transport offer is primarily a responsibility of the decentralised authorities (Passenger Transport Act).

Het onderzoeken van de behoeften van reizigers in de regio Utrecht en het bepalen van een daarbij passend OV-aanbod is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheden (Wet Personenvervoer).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘gaswinning zorgt opnieuw voor een conflict tussen provincie en het Rijk’

MPs Jacobi, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether the national government requires water boards to pay half the cost of strengthening dikes in Groningen because of gas-field economic interests, and how the government will limit gas-extraction harm and fund dike reinforcement. The minister denies any such demand, describes the standard 50/40/10 cost split under the flood protection programme and a separate 100 million euro fund for earthquake-proofing vital infrastructure, and says talks with water boards are ongoing.

There is, however, no requirement from the central government that the water board pay half the costs of dikes that receive a stricter standard because of the economic importance of the gas locations and therefore need to be strengthened.

Er is echter geen sprake van een eis van het Rijk dat het waterschap de helft van de kosten betaalt voor dijken die vanwege het economisch belang van de gaslocaties een strengere norm krijgen en daardoor versterkt zouden moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat weinig leerlingen slagen bij beginnende rijscholen

MP Kuiken asked the minister about reports that few pupils pass at new driving schools, the growth in driving school numbers, and whether the government will improve oversight of driving school quality. The minister answered that quality rests mainly on instructor requirements and market forces, announced a planned role for the Inspectorate (ILT) in supervising WRM instructor passes after a 2016 law change, and declined an ondernemersstage.
For this a change of the WRM is necessary, which is expected to be ready in 2016.
Hiervoor is een wijziging van de WRM noodzakelijk, die na verwachting in 2016 gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over het bericht dat transportbedrijven zwarte lijsten hanteren voor parkeerplaatsen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether they know transport firms keep blacklists of unsafe lorry parking places, whether the government will act on the rise in cargo theft, and for statistics and an action plan. The minister confirms ongoing talks with the sector, says the government lacks those blacklists, outlines public-private prevention efforts and cargo theft figures, and promises to inform parliament before summer.
I expect to be able to inform the House about this this summer.
Ik verwacht Uw Kamer hierover deze zomer te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jacobi over de verkeersonveilige situatie op de A6 bij Lemmer

MPs Kuiken and Jacobi asked the minister about congestion at A6 exit 17 near Lemmer in the tourist season and whether it creates unsafe situations, and whether temporary measures are planned. The minister answered that no structural congestion or unsafe situation is evident, no temporary measures are planned, and the province of Fryslân is studying N359 ring road improvements with Rijkswaterstaat involved.
As previously indicated, there is currently no unsafe traffic situation on the A6 at Lemmer.
Zoals eerder aangegeven is er op dit moment geen sprake van een verkeersonveilige situatie op de A6 ter hoogte bij Lemmer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over het bericht dat de Raad van State een streep heeft gezet door de bouw van 700 woningen bij Schiphol

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked whether the Council of State's ruling blocking 700 homes near Schiphol affects future housing plans and the airport, and whether support was sought before the zoning plan was adopted. The state secretary answered that the municipalities bear responsibility for weighing aircraft noise in zoning decisions, that the ruling does not affect airport use, and that Haarlemmermeer ran a broad participation process linked to the A9 relocation.
This concerns the responsibility of the relevant municipalities to seek support and ensure a sound weighing of interests.
Het betreft hier de verantwoordelijkheid van betreffende gemeenten om draagvlak te zoeken en te zorgen voor een goede afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over onnodige medische keuringen door CBR bij mensen met stabiele aandoeningen

An MP asked the minister whether unnecessary periodic driving-licence medical checks by the CBR burden people with stable chronic conditions, and what the rules are. The minister agreed that stable conditions should not be re-examined, listed which conditions require periodic checks, and promised to improve information and consult stakeholders and the Health Council on neurological rules.
To this end I will sit down this year with various parties such as healthcare providers, doctors, patient organisations, road safety organisations, municipalities and the CBR.
Ik ga hiervoor dit jaar rond de tafel met verschillende partijen zoals zorgverleners, artsen, patiëntenorganisaties, verkeersveiligheidsorganisaties gemeenten en het CBR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Paulus Jansen over de bouw van cavernen in De Duitse Dollard

SP MPs Van Gerven and Paulus Jansen asked whether brine from salt caverns in Jemgum (Germany) could be used by Frisia Zout BV instead of dumping it, and whether this would be more environmentally friendly than mining salt under the Wadden Sea. The minister answered that the German brine appears technically suitable but transport costs make it commercially unviable for now, that environmental effects of the dumping are considered negligible, and that Frisia's Wadden Sea permit application is still under review.
I do not consider it self-evident that salt extraction under the Wadden Sea can take place.
Ik vind het niet vanzelfsprekend dat zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Öztürk over de sluiting van vrachtwagenparkeerplaats Traffic Port in Venlo

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister why the free truck parking area Traffic Port in Venlo is being closed, given its use by 150 to 500 trucks daily, and how the resulting nuisance and unsafe situations will be prevented. The minister answered that the lease will not be renewed and no longer fits the SecureLane market-transition model, that about 100 alternative night-time spaces exist nearby with signposting from 1 April 2014, and that keeping the site open is not an option.
As I indicated in my answer to questions 1, 2 and 3, keeping TrafficPort open is not an option.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op de vragen 1 2 en 3 heb aangegeven is het openhouden van TrafficPort geen optie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de problemen bij de Coentunnel

An MP asked the minister about incidents, breakdowns and criticism of the Second Coen Tunnel project, including contract penalties and who pays for extra measures. The minister said incident numbers have returned to pre-opening levels, that contractual norm times and penalties apply, that extra costs fall outside the DBFM contract, and that an internal evaluation is planned for next year.
After opening, an internal, project-specific evaluation will take place.
Na openstelling zal er een interne, projectspecifieke evaluatie plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over Oost-Europese parkeertoestanden in Spijkenisse

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether she knew of reports about Eastern European truck drivers causing disruption in Spijkenisse, whether such conduct belongs in the Netherlands, whether she would tackle it with the ILT and SZW inspectorates, and whether she would reprimand the municipality for weak enforcement. The minister confirmed awareness, said unwanted nuisance would be taken seriously, pointed to existing action plans and extra ILT capacity for cabotage enforcement, noted that the police handle enforcement here, and said the municipality bears responsibility for finding a solution with the police.
It is the responsibility of the municipality of Spijkenisse to look for a solution together with the police.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Spijkenisse om samen met de politie naar een oplossing te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Albert de Vries over de extra sluiskolk bij Eefde

MPs Dik-Faber and Albert de Vries asked the minister why the Midden-Noord variant for the second lock at Eefde was not chosen despite the Commission for EIA's advice, and about costs, safety, timing and the capacity outlook. The minister defended the Noord location on cost (about 20 million euro cheaper, with regional support), said the planning cannot be accelerated, and stated that no revision of the preference decision is warranted.
All things considered, I see no reason in this finding of the commission to revise my preference decision.
Alles overziend, zie ik in deze constatering van de commissie geen aanleiding mijn Voorkeursbeslissing te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de uitvoering van de motie over flitsen op trajecten waar staat aangegeven dat er trajectcontrole is

An MP asked whether police flash-speed checks on the A4 near Hoofddorp on 4 March 2014 breached the earlier motion-Bashir commitment not to conduct spot checks where a trajectory-control sign is displayed. The minister answered that the radar check there was not in line with that commitment, so no fines were issued and police were reminded to follow the instruction.
The radar check at that point was not in line with the commitment made to your House referred to in question 1.
De radarcontrole was op dat punt niet in overeenstemming met de in vraag 1 aangehaalde toezegging aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het storten van staalslakken in de Oosterschelde

Two SGP MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat should cover steel slag dumped in the Oosterschelde with rubble to protect the Oosterschelde lobster and benthic life, and whether it will do so. The minister acknowledged the species' value, said consultation with lobster fishers and a provincial permit are in place, and offered an ecological finish on a test section and a joint exploration for the next cluster, but did not commit to rubble cover.

Besides the test section with ecological finishing being dumped in the second cluster, I will explore with the parties involved and the market what options exist within the current financial frameworks

Naast het testvak met de ecologische afwerking dat in het tweede cluster wordt bestort, zal ik samen met de betrokken partijen en de markt verkennen welke mogelijkheden er binnen de huidige financiële kaders zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de ‘s Gravendijkwal in Rotterdam de smerigste straat is van Nederland

An SP MP asked the minister about air quality on 's Gravendijkwal in Rotterdam, whether the city can solve it alone, and whether the government will help realise a covering of the street. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said both national and municipal measures are needed, and noted that Rotterdam has decided against covering the road but will ban heavy traffic.
To improve air quality, both national and municipal measures are needed.
Om de luchtkwaliteit te verbeteren zijn zowel rijksmaatregelen als gemeentelijke maatregelen nodig.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat de Commissie voor de milieueffectrapportage (Commissie voor de m.e.r.) niet wordt betrokken bij de opstelling van een milieueffectrapport voor de Blankenbu

An MP asked the minister why the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment (Commissie m.e.r.) would not be involved in the environmental impact study for the Blankenburg tunnel, and whether that is justified given the project's size, complexity and public opposition. The minister answered that the Crisis- and Herstelwet does not require advice from the Commission for this project, that the environmental effects will still be examined carefully through the project-MER with stakeholder involvement, and that the Commission will not be consulted.
I will not involve the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment in the studies of environmental effects of the Blankenburg connection.
Ik zal de commissie voor de m.e.r. niet betrekken bij de onderzoeken naar milieueffecten van de Blankenburgverbinding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het besluit van de minister om de snelheidsverhogingen op de A10 en A13 terug te draaien

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister why she reversed speed-limit increases on the A10 and A13, and whether this affected other roads, legal challenges, air quality recalculation and EU targets. The minister defended her principle of faster where possible, slower where necessary, said the decision had no consequences elsewhere, and declined to recalculate air quality outside the annual NSL monitoring.
Comparable specific situations, such as at the A13 Overschie and the A10 West, do not occur elsewhere along the main road network.
Vergelijkbare specifieke situaties, zoals bij de A13 Overschie en de A10 West doen zich verder langs het hoofdwegennet niet voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de invoering van de maximumsnelheid van 100 km/u op de A1/A35 nabij Borne en Hengelo

GroenLinks MP Van Tongeren asked the minister about rising accidents on the A1/A35 near Borne and Hengelo, the closely spaced junctions, residential exposure, fine dust and noise, and whether the speed limit should be cut to 100 km/h. Minister Schultz van Haegen answered that the road meets design and air and noise standards, that a lower speed would not ease congestion, and that she sees no reason to lower the limit, while promising a written reaction on the complaints portal before the June MIRT debate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de aanpassingen aan de sluis Eefde

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about objections from the municipality of Lochem to the electrification of the pumping station and the choice of location for a second lock at Eefde, and whether an alternative site and independent costing should be reconsidered. The Minister replied that no objections to the lock itself are known, that renovation is necessary, that the cost difference remains large, and that the commission for environmental impact assessment found the information sufficient, so no new study will be done.
The final advice of the commission for environmental impact assessment gives me no reason to revise my preferred decision.
Het definitieve advies van de commissie m.e.r. geeft mij geen aanleiding mijn Voorkeursbeslissing te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het verschuiven van de waterschapsbelasting van boeren naar burgers

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked about a TV report claiming water board levies shifted from farmers to citizens, and whether reserved seats on water boards misrepresent interests. The minister says the figures cover the whole 'Ongebouwd' category, not just farmland, are not directly comparable over time, and that the reserved seats are a deliberate balance of interests, with evaluation planned alongside the 2015 elections.

As I promised in debate with your House on the bill amending the water board elections, the system of reserved seats will be included in an evaluation of the upcoming provincial elections combined with the water board elections in 2015.

Antwoord 7 Zoals ik heb toegezegd in debat met uw Kamer over het wetsvoorstel Wet aanpassing waterschapsverkiezingen ( Tweede Kamer, 2013–2014, 33719 ), wordt het systeem met geborgde zetels betrokken in een evaluatie van de komende statenverkiezingen gecombineerd met waterschapsverkiezingen in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Raak over de verandering in de wijze van bekostiging van de waterschapslasten

MPs Van Gerven and Van Raak asked the ministers whether the shift of water board charges from agriculture to households is real, and whether the Delfland-inspired tariff differentiation and cost-allocation changes are consistent with the principle that charges are paid in proportion to benefit. The minister confirmed the shift is linked to water boards' growing urban role, that the 2012 amendment widening tariff differentiation was used by seven boards with provincial approval, and provided a table of cost shares for 2010 and 2013.

It is indeed the case that the water boards' task performance has changed substantially over the past decades and that they have taken more measures that serve the interests of urban areas and therefore of households.

Het is inderdaad zo dat de taakuitoefening van de waterschappen de laatste decennia ingrijpend is veranderd en dat zij meer maatregelen zijn gaan treffen die in het belang van het stedelijk gebied en daarmee van de huishoudens zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dik-Faber over opwaardering van de N57 en N59

MPs Bisschop and Dik-Faber asked the minister about road safety and accessibility on the N57 and N59 in Zeeland and Zuid-Holland, including whether fatality rates are five times the national average and what funding the Rijk could provide. The minister denied the fatality claim, stated that €18 million is reserved for bringing these roads to three-star EuroRAP level, and said no extra funding or accessibility problem exists, while noting the projects already count as MIRT projects.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over bedrijventerreinen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the large gap between supply and demand for business sites, the vacancy and financial costs of unused land, and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that provinces and municipalities bear responsibility, notes that available land is 25 times annual take-up though much is not immediately developable, and states that the Rijk has not withdrawn from the convenant and that the SER-ladder is a binding motivation requirement, while declining to provide a municipal breakdown.
Business park policy is after all a decentralised responsibility.
Bedrijventerreinenbeleid is immers een decentrale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over een gelijk Europees speelveld voor de Nederlandse havens

MPs De Vries and Groot asked whether the government would delay or drop corporate tax for Dutch port operators until an EU study on port competition is published and EU-level state aid rules are agreed. The minister answered that no general EU-wide tax comparison is possible, that talks with the Commission on modernising corporate tax liability for state enterprises are ongoing, and that a bill is aimed for Prinsjesdag 2014 with transitional arrangements considered.
We have no insight into the progress of processing the results and the analysis thereof.
Wij hebben geen inzicht in de voortgang van de verwerking van de resultaten en de analyse daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over een stop op kantoren in Utrecht

An MP asks the minister whether the province of Utrecht's decision to scrap planned office developments, which may lead to planning-damage claims and land losses for municipalities, is acceptable and whether rules should be tightened. The minister defends the provincial approach as regional coordination, says no uniform cost-sharing system or new legislation is planned, and states that planning-damage claims would be assessed later by the courts.
I see the decision of the province of Utrecht as a fulfilment of this.
Ik zie het besluit van de provincie Utrecht als een invulling hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht dat de bouw van windmolens 6000 banen kost

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked whether the reported loss of 6,000 jobs from offshore wind farms within the 12-mile zone is acceptable and whether those plans will be scrapped, and why regional effects are not studied. The minister answered that the figures come from a preliminary study measuring intended visits rather than actual effects, that the feasibility study is still in its final phase, and that regional effects are acknowledged and may be examined in a later phase.
It is therefore too early to conclude that placing wind turbines within the 12-mile zone would cost 6,000 jobs.
Het is daarom te vroeg om te concluderen dat plaatsing van windmolens binnen de 12-mijlszone 6.000 banen zou kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over de berichten “Rijbewijs gewoon te koop in Litouwen” en “Litauiske forekort kjopes for 80 Euro”

Two PVV MPs asked the transport minister whether Lithuanian driving licences bought for 80 euros should no longer be accepted in the Netherlands and whether Lithuanian vehicles should be barred from Dutch roads. The minister answered that no fraud has been established, that EU rules require mutual recognition of licences and free movement precludes banning Lithuanian vehicles, and that roadside checks continue.
This could be the case if fraud had been demonstrated. However, this is not the case.
Dit zou het geval kunnen zijn als fraude zou zijn aangetoond. Dit is echter niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over geluidreducerend asfalt

Two SP MPs asked the minister about quieter road surfaces: whether savings would fund noise relief for households above noise limits, whether wet-road noise and aging effects are modelled, and the design and reporting of trial programmes. The minister answered that the new PERS surface is still in early development with cost-effectiveness under study until 2018, that noise models use annual averages without a wet-road correction judged not to underestimate exposure, and that results will be reported to parliament then.
Cost-effectiveness is one of the topics in the research now started.
Kosteneffectiviteit is een van de onderwerpen in het nu gestarte onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over grote weerstand tegen het gevoerde afvalbeleid voor de binnenvaart

An MP asked the minister about strong opposition to the new waste policy for inland shipping, including the low number of subscriptions, the double payment, the flat tariff, and risks of litter and dumping. The minister defended the subscription system as cost-recovering under the polluter-pays principle, noted the subscription is optional, and committed to consultation with shipping organisations on the collection network.
I do not have exact data on the full waste streams generated by the sector.
Van de volledige afvalstromen die de sector genereert heb ik geen exacte gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Ypma over het niet baggeren van de gekanaliseerde Hollandsche IJssel door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Jacobi and Ypma asked the minister why Rijkswaterstaat handed over the Gekanaliseerde Hollandsche IJssel to Hoogheemraadschap De Stichtse Rijnlanden without dredging, and whether combined sanitation and maintenance dredging could save costs. The minister confirmed the handover and the EUR 37.5 million lump sum, said sanitation dredging was decoupled and is under joint investigation, and called it worth considering that HDSR undertake the combined dredging.
To allow the GHIJ to be transferred quickly, it was decided at the end of 2012 to decouple the sanitation of the riverbed below the required depth from the December 2012 transfer.
Omwille van het snel kunnen overdragen van de GHIJ is eind 2012 besloten om het saneren van de waterbodem onder de leggerdiepte te ontkoppelen van de overdracht van december 2012.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Graaf over Oost-Europese overlast op vakantieparken

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about nuisance and overcrowding caused by Eastern European migrant workers housed on holiday parks, including whether a deterrence policy should replace the national housing declaration and whether work permits should be reintroduced. The government answered that municipalities enforce nuisance rules, that regional agreements have added 31,000 housing places, that free movement of workers cannot be reversed under the accession treaties, and that permanent occupation of recreational homes is a municipal matter.
Statistics Netherlands examined, in the municipalities of the 9 regions of the Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten programme, how many migrant workers are housed in which municipality.
Het CBS heeft onderzocht in de gemeenten uit de 9 regio’s van het programma Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten hoeveel arbeidsmigranten er in welke gemeente gehuisvest zijn.
