Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Aukje de Vries over het bericht over de visie van natuurclubs op het Waddengebied in relatie tot de Natuurwet

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about natuurclubs' call to prioritise nature over economy in the Wadden area and whether tourism and harbour development should remain possible there. The government replied that the Structuurvisie allows economic development within the nature-protection aim, that the Wadden area is already well protected, and that it will present a new Natuurwet proposal balancing economy and ecology.
I will soon present my proposals for the new Natuurwet.
Ik kom binnenkort met mijn voorstellen voor de nieuwe Natuurwet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat patiënten met schildklierproblemen van geneesmiddel moeten wisselen door het preferentiebeleid van verzekeraars ondanks dat de NHG-richtlijn en de KNMP-richt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that patients with thyroid problems must switch levothyroxine brands due to insurers' preferential policy despite NHG and KNMP guidelines, asking about the risks, costs and whether insurers may override guidelines. The Minister replied that to her knowledge no preferential policy exists for levothyroxine, that any switching has other causes, and that insurers' websites show whether a preferential policy applies.
Contrary to what is stated in the blog cited by Mr Van Gerven, no preferential policy is pursued for levothyroxine by health insurers as far as I am aware.
In tegenstelling tot wat wordt aangegeven in het door de heer Van Gerven aangehaalde blog, wordt er geen preferentiebeleid gevoerd voor Levotyroxine door zorgverzekeraars voor zover mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jacobi over het nemen van onomkeerbare maatregelen bij sluis Eefde

MPs Kuiken and Jacobi asked why a rook colony at lock Eefde is being relocated and irreversible measures taken before the new lock chamber decision and zoning plan are final, and whether the relocation could wait. The minister answered that a Flora and Fauna Act exemption was granted, no objection was filed, no irreversible steps will be taken before the zoning plan is adopted, and relocation must start before the next breeding season.
Moreover, no irreversible measures will be taken pursuant to the exemption before the zoning plan has been adopted.
Overigens worden er ter uitvoering van de ontheffing geen onomkeerbare maatregelen genomen voordat het bestemmingsplan is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de voortgang van de Structuurvisie Windenergie op Land

An MP from D66 asked the minister why the final decision on the Structuurvisie Windenergie op Land, planned for autumn 2013, had not been taken, what the new timeline is, and what the progress is per province, and whether intervention is planned to meet the 6,000 MW target for 2020. The minister explains that the vision is being updated after consultations and promises the final vision by April, with provincial progress to follow then, while expressing confidence that provinces will fix the remaining capacity.
I will inform your House, when sending the final structuurvisie, about the current progress per province.
Ik zal uw Kamer met de toezending van de definitieve structuurvisie informeren over de actuele voortgang per provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over het project «modernisering zuiveringsheffing

MPs Jansen and Van Gerven asked about industrial firms leaving public wastewater treatment, the scope and composition of the 'modernisering zuiveringsheffing' project, and monitoring and transparency of private treatment plants. Minister Schultz answered most questions on substance, citing ongoing study by Royal Haskoning DHV, while declining to change self-regulation or the household cost allocation, which she said falls outside the project.
The research is being carried out on behalf of IenM by Royal Haskoning DHV.
Het onderzoek wordt in opdracht van IenM uitgevoerd door Royal Haskoning DHV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het bericht dat de gemeente Amsterdam snorscooters nog dit jaar wil weren van het fietspad

An MP asked the minister about Amsterdam's plan to ban mopeds from bike paths and make helmets mandatory, and whether a national helmet rule should follow. The minister confirmed talks with Amsterdam and the G4, but kept her objection to a national helmet requirement, saying local bylaws would be the route.
I told the House in that committee meeting that I will continue these talks and inform the House of their outcome.
Ik heb aan uw kamer in bovengenoemd AO aangegeven deze gesprekken voort te zetten en uw Kamer te informeren over de uitkomst van die gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat het waterschap Aa en Maas aan Heineken subsidie verstrekt

An MP asks whether a water board's confidential handling of an anti-disconnection subsidy to Heineken, and the limited public information on such schemes, undermines voters' ability to be informed. The minister replies that the scheme is an approved, publicly documented mechanism, that the decision was taken in public session with the criteria available, and that no action is needed.
No current data are available on the number of companies per water board receiving subsidies under the scheme.
Over het aantal bedrijven per waterschap dat op grond van de regeling subsidie ontvangt zijn geen actuele gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Dijkhoff, Elias en Litjens over het artikel ‘Onderzoek naar corruptie KLM werd vroegtijdig gestaakt’

MPs from the VVD asked whether a Caribbean corruption investigation into KLM-linked bribery was stopped early after a judge-commissioner imposed a four-month time limit, and why. The minister answered that the time limit was set under the reasonable-time rules, the prosecution prioritised two of eight files, the Oil Trading Bonaire file was dropped, and a later court complaint was only partly upheld.
The Public Prosecution Service on Bonaire has informed me that neither the Oil Trading Bonaire file nor other investigation has shown any free business-class flights.
Het Openbaar Ministerie op Bonaire heeft mij bericht dat noch uit het dossier «Oil Trading Bonaire», noch uit overig onderzoek, is gebleken over gratis businessclassvluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de inzameling van Klein Gevaarlijk Afval (KGA) en huisvuil in de binnenvaart

An SGP MP asked the minister why the national scheme for collecting small hazardous waste and household waste from inland shipping lacks sector support and why collection points along the Maas and Twente canal were removed, and asked about subscriptions, cost-coverage, an international CDNI alternative and vessels that only sail on those waterways. The minister defended the polluter-pays principle, reported that collection points were reduced from about 95 to 25 with subscriptions at about 245, and said an international harmonised system is still being pursued, though fuel-levy financing would need a treaty change.
I am, however, open to suggestions for improving the system now introduced.
Ik sta wel open voor suggesties tot verbetering van het nu ingevoerde systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over munitiestortplaats Engelsmanplaat (Waddenzee)

Two MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about a WWII munitions dump near the Engelsmanplaat in the Wadden Sea, including whether it is monitored and who is responsible. The government answered that the dump lies under about 10 metres of sand, is covered by regular Rijkswaterstaat bed and water-quality surveys, and that the Ministry of Defence's EOD handles explosives clearance.
Rijkswaterstaat includes this area in the regular six-yearly depth measurements of the Wadden Sea region.
Rijkswaterstaat neemt dit gebied in het kader van de reguliere 6-jaarlijkse dieptemetingen van het Waddenzeegebied mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het opstellen van nota’s en meterstanden voor energie en water

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Infrastructure and Environment about disputes over annual energy and water bills, estimated meter readings, price comparison sites, and smart meter rules. The government answered that disputes are rare and falling, that estimates are used mainly when consumers do not report meter readings, and that it sees no structural overestimation or need for new rules.
The share of annual bills that leads to a dispute between consumer and energy supplier is very small.
Het aandeel jaarnota’s dat leidt tot een geschil tussen afnemer en energieleverancier is erg gering
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over Legionella op de Verpleegafdeling kortverblijf inwendige geneeskunde in het LUMC

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers why legionella bacteria were found in water at a LUMC ward for years, why patients are told not to drink or shower with tap water, and why bottled water is used instead of filters, and whether this is acceptable. The ministers answer that LUMC is taking preventive measures, that the contaminated pipes are being replaced, that the Inspectorate (ILT) reports and enforcement approach are described, and that other measures were chosen by the hospital.
It is good that the LUMC takes preventive measures when legionella exceeds the norm in the drinking water installation, to prevent contamination of persons with the legionella bacterium.
Het is goed dat het LUMC preventieve maatregelen neemt bij een normoverschrijding van legionella in de drinkwaterinstallatie ter voorkoming van besmetting van personen met de legionellabacterie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Boer over het artikel ‘Juridische spaghetti rond de Baltic Ace’

An MP asked the minister whether the state bears the cost of salvaging the Baltic Ace wreck and whether it can recover those costs from owners, and whether the government is pursuing better ways to hold shipowners liable. The minister answered that the state pays the salvage company and recovers costs from the owners, though liability limitation treaties allow only part to be recovered, and promised a letter in spring 2014 plus implementing legislation for the Nairobi Wreck Removal Convention in Q3 2014.
I expect to be able to inform the House in more detail about this in spring 2014.
Ik verwacht de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2014 hierover nader te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert De Vries naar aanleiding van het geschil tussen het Vlaams Gewest en het Nederlands loodswezen

An MP asked the minister about the Flemish region's attempt to annul an arbitration award of 7.9 million euros owed to the Dutch pilotage corporation, whether she had contacted her Flemish counterpart, and about unfair competition between Dutch and Flemish ports. The minister confirmed the dispute, said she would write to her Flemish counterpart urging compliance with the award while keeping talks open, and said she opposes unfair state aid and is working on an EU port regulation and state aid guidelines.
In the letter I will state that, in the context of successful operational cooperation between the Flemish and Dutch pilot services, it is of great importance that the parties remain in discussion.

In de brief zal ik aangeven dat in het kader van de succesvolle operationele samenwerking tussen de Vlaamse en Nederlandse loodsdiensten het van groot belang is dat betrokken partijen in gesprek blijven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over gevaar door uitschakeling van verlichting op snelwegen

An SP MP asked the minister how the decision to switch off motorway lighting at night relates to traffic volume, accident risk, weather and alternatives such as traffic-responsive lighting. The minister answered that lighting will be switched off only 23:00 to 05:00 with adjustments for rush hours and hazardous sections, that no lasting safety effect is found, and that the regime will be revised in early 2014.
To respond to reactions from society, I have reconsidered the lighting regime, and lighting will be switched off between 23:00 and 05:00 on all roads or parts thereof covered by this measure.
Om tegemoet te komen aan de reacties uit de samenleving heb ik het verlichtingsregime heroverwogen en wordt de verlichting tussen 23:00 uur en 05:00 uur uitgeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over winkelleegstand

An SP MP asked the minister about rising shop vacancy in city centres, the role of out-of-town retail, who bears the costs, and whether a national retail structure plan should be made. The minister answered that vacancy is mainly local and regional, that out-of-town retail plays only a limited role, that municipalities are primarily responsible, and that regional authorities should prepare retail visions with a report to parliament by summer 2014.
It is clear that this should mainly be tackled at local and regional level.
Duidelijk is dat dit vooral lokaal-regionaal aangepakt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Gerven over Munitiestortplaats Oosterschelde

SP MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about risks, oversight, and remediation options for the Oosterschelde munitions dump, following an EenVandaag report. The minister replied that TNO studies found spontaneous explosion practically nil and no proven environmental harm, that monitoring continues with added measures in 2014, and that remediation (estimated at €7 million in 2004) was not pursued because risks are low.
In 2014 the water quality above the former munitions dump will be measured monthly.
In 2014 zal de waterkwaliteit boven de voormalige munitiestortplaats maandelijks worden gemeten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over de vestiging van een nieuwe nertsenhouderij in Gemert

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked about a new mink farm in Gemert that appears to expand or relocate mink farming despite the 2013 ban, and about distance rules and whether such expansion is undesirable. The government answered that the relocation is permitted if animal numbers do not increase, that the permit is under appeal, and that the NVWA will check compliance on site.
The NVWA monitors the standards of the Fur Animal Farming Ban Act and will determine whether specific situations fit within the purpose and scope of that Act.
De NVWA controleert de normen uit de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij en zal constateren of specifieke situaties binnen doel en strekking van de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de begrenzing van auto’s tot de derde versnelling

An MP asked the minister whether cars limited to first to third gear escape APK inspection, road tax and licence requirements, and what should be done. The minister answers that such vehicles qualify as limited-speed motor vehicles (MMBS) only if they meet strict conditions, that roughly 300 are deregistered yearly with no data on misuse, and that the T-rijbewijs from 2015 and a planned category review will close the gap.
The number of drivers who use these vehicles not for agricultural purposes but to evade the APK and road tax is not known.
Het aantal bestuurders dat deze voertuigen niet voor agrarische doeleinden gebruikt, maar hiermee de APK en wegenbelasting omzeilt is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat rijinstructeurs onbevoegd les geven

An MP asked the minister about a report that around 1,200 driving instructors teach without valid authorisation, and whether enforcement, recertification costs and market saturation should be addressed. The minister disputed the figure, reported only one concrete notification, pointed to police enforcement and planned ILT oversight in spring 2014, and stated that pricing and market entry are left to the market.
In addition, my Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport is examining how additional enforcement can be effectively provided.
Hiernaast onderzoekt mijn Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport op welke wijze aanvullende handhaving effectief vorm kan worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over de effectiviteit van de Bob-campagne

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP and CDA asked the ministers whether independent research shows the Bob campaign works, especially for young drivers, and whether a new, harder campaign concept is needed. The minister answered that annual effect measurements show a decline in drink-driving offenders, particularly among 18–24 year old men, and rejected a new youth concept and harder confrontational messaging as unsupported by evidence.
I do not agree with that finding.
Ik ben het niet eens met die constatering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Duitse plannen om tol te heffen op buitenlandse auto’s

An MP asked the government about Germany's planned vignette for foreign passenger cars, its economic impact on the Netherlands, level-playing-field concerns and contacts with the German minister. The minister answered that the plan is not yet concrete, that the Commission will scrutinise it for non-discrimination, and that the Dutch concerns were raised with the German minister.
As long as there are no concrete plans from the German government, I cannot assess the consequences for the Netherlands.
Zolang er geen concrete plannen zijn van de Duitse regering, kan ik de gevolgen voor Nederland niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over drankrijders die toch hun rijbewijs mochten behouden

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked whether some police regions failed for years to report drunk and asocial drivers to the CBR, endangering road safety. The minister denies police negligence, attributes the rise in reports in 2012 to improved automation and information, and says no structural problems remain.
In my view there has been no negligence on the part of the police.
Er is naar mijn mening geen sprake geweest van verzuim door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de voortdurende onduidelijkheid over de snelheidslimieten op de snelwegen

MP Bashir asked the ministers about persistent confusion among motorists over speed limits on Dutch motorways, including unclear signage, varying speeds, and navigation data. Minister Schultz van Haegen-Maas Geesteranus answered that Rijkswaterstaat is pursuing harmonised speeds, reviewing signage, improving navigation data and communication, but gave no firm new commitments beyond ongoing work.
Rijkswaterstaat is currently working on a proposal to adapt roadside signage so that it meets the road user's wish to be informed more frequently about the maximum speed.

Rijkswaterstaat werkt momenteel een voorstel uit om de bebording langs de weg zodanig aan te passen dat deze voldoet aan de wens van de weggebruiker om frequenter geïnformeerd te worden over de maximumsnelheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Kuiken en Fokke over uitbuiting van werknemers die werken aan de A2-tunnel in Maastricht

MPs from the PvdA asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Infrastructure about exploitation of foreign workers on the A2 tunnel project in Maastricht, and about whether public bodies should screen contractors and prevent unfair competition. The minister says the Inspectorate SZW is investigating, an expert committee found likely violations of the Bouw cao, and he points to planned chain liability and a study on displacement, while rejecting a change to selection criteria and the Rijkswaterstaat procurement role.
Now that there is a report from the expert committee, it is becoming clearer what is going on.
Nu er een rapport ligt van de expertcommissie wordt inzichtelijker wat er aan de hand is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Rebel over het alcoholslot

MPs Kuiken and Rebel asked about three Council of State rulings on imposing the alcohol-interlock programme on truck drivers, the status of the exploration of interlocks in lorries, and when the Chamber would be informed. The minister confirms the rulings were noted, says the exploration is completed, and promises to inform the Chamber before the 30 January 2014 committee meeting.
I intend to inform you as soon as possible, and at the latest before the scheduled committee meeting of 30 January 2014.
Ik ben voornemens u zo spoedig mogelijk te informeren, doch uiterlijk voor het geplande AO van 30 januari 2014.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe over de vastgelopen onderhandelingen met de Deense Maritieme Autoriteit (DMA) over de erkenning van de nationale certificaten van traditionele zeezeilschepen door Den

MPs Van Hijum and De Rouwe asked whether negotiations with Denmark's maritime authority over recognition of Dutch traditional sailing ship certificates had stalled, and whether the minister would intervene personally. The minister denied a full stall, reported progress on sailing areas and agreed to continue talks, while saying personal intervention was not yet needed but would follow if necessary.
However, I am closely monitoring progress towards an agreement and will, if necessary, personally take action towards my Danish counterpart.
Ik volg echter de voortgang over een overeenkomst nauwlettend en zal indien noodzakelijk alsnog persoonlijk actie ondernemen richting mijn Deense counterpart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Albert De Vries over de financiële gevolgen van gemeenten met hun grondpositie

MPs Albert de Vries and Fokke asked ministers whether the financial crisis hitting municipal land companies is worse than the 2012 study showed, whether the minister will allow longer write-downs, support provinces' plans to help municipalities, and agree to renegotiate Rijk-subsidised building contracts to cut building capacity. The minister replied that current rules suffice, longer write-down periods are possible only under enhanced provincial supervision, and that the Rijk no longer has partner status in the remaining housing subsidies, with a further report promised in December.
As I already reported in my letter of 14 October and as promised in the VAO of 12 November, this report will be sent to your House in December on behalf of my colleague of the Interior Ministry.

Zoals ik al in mijn brief van 14 oktober heb gemeld en zoals ook in het VAO van 12 november heb toegezegd, zal dit rapport in december mede namens mijn collega van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties aan uw Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de berichten ‘Dode door brand in windmolen in Ooltgensplaat’ en ‘Tweede dode bij brand windmolen Ooltgensplaat’

An MP from the PVV asked whether the regional fire brigade was equipped to fight a turbine fire at height, how municipalities account for fire height when granting permits, and whether emergency plans exist for rescuing people from turbines. The government answered that the Rotterdam-Rijnmond fire service considers itself generally equipped, that an investigation is underway into the cause and firefighting options, that permits account for collapse and blade-failure risks, and that no turbine-specific emergency plans exist, relying instead on general working-at-height procedures and specialist rescue teams.
The Rotterdam-Rijnmond Safety Region is launching an investigation into the fire at the wind turbine in Ooltgensplaat.
De Veiligheidsregio Rotterdam-Rijnmond stelt een onderzoek in naar de brand van de windturbine in Ooltgensplaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Albert de Vries over stremmingen op het Zeeuwse deel van de A58

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether closures on the Zeeland stretch of the A58 after accidents last too long and whether Zeeland is effectively cut off. The minister denies that closures are longer than elsewhere, explains existing incident procedures and detour routes, and offers only to consult road managers on improving traffic flow, rejecting the suggested crossover measures as ineffective.
I am willing to consult with the road managers on whether traffic flow on the detour routes during an incident can be improved.
Ik ben bereid om met de medewegbeheerders te overleggen of de doorstroming op de omleidingsroutes tijdens een incident bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de medische keuring voor mensen met Aandachtstekort Stoornis met Hyperactiviteit (ADHD) door het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An SP MP asked the minister whether the CBR's handling of medical re-examination for drivers with ADHD is fair, especially for those previously declared unconditionally fit, and whether existing records could avoid unnecessary re-tests. The minister answered that the generic re-examination requirement was abolished, that CBR checks prior reports itself, and that a specialist must still see some people once where the earlier report is unclear.
I am pleased that, on the advice of the Health Council, I was able to abolish the generic re-examination requirement for ADHD.
Ik ben blij dat ik met het advies van de Gezondheidsraad de generieke herkeuringseis ingeval van ADHD heb kunnen afschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het bericht wel of geen keuring voor het rijbewijs

The MP asked whether drivers aged 70 to 75 whose licence expires in January 2014 and who applied early should still need a medical check, and whether a transitional rule or compensation should apply. The minister said about 1% of the group needs a check for medical reasons, that RDW reminder letters are only a service and not advice to be examined, and that no transitional rule or financial compensation is warranted.
Nor do I see any reason for financial compensation.
Evenmin zie ik hierin aanleiding voor een financiële compensatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over trajectcontroles

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about average-speed (trajectory) checks, including boete counts on the Utrecht-Amsterdam route, revenue, and accident effects on the A2. The minister answered that the 2012 comparison cannot be made reliably, reported roughly 43.6 million euro in sanctions from May to August 2013, said revenue goes to the state treasury, and deferred the accident question until 2014 data is available.
The requested comparison cannot be made properly.
De gevraagde vergelijking is niet goed te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Rebel over het alcoholslot

MPs Kuiken and Rebel asked about reports that a drink-driver escaped punishment through the alcohol-lock programme, the Judiciary's use of sentencing guidelines, technical reliability of alcohol locks, and whether the programme evaluation could be brought forward. The government said the judiciary, not the Council for the Judiciary, sets the guidelines, that no case data are kept, that technical faults are rare, and that the evaluation runs to end 2014 with the full period to 2022, and it did not meet the deadline for answering before the budget debate.
Unfortunately, this deadline was not met.
Deze termijn is helaas niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de betaling van havengelden voor de recreatievaart

MP Albert de Vries asked whether berth payment and cancellation terms in marinas are set by HISWA conditions, what legal framework applies, and whether monthly or quarterly payment and monthly cancellation could be legally mandated for private boat owners. The minister explained that private marinas follow their own terms, municipal and provincial harbour fees are retributions under provincial and municipal law, and rejected national rules on this detail, preferring self-regulation by the sector.
I see no reason for national regulation at this level of detail.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nationale regelgeving op dit detailniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de bareboat-out regeling

Labour MP Albert de Vries asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment how the bareboat-out scheme, which temporarily suspends Dutch sea-vessel registration while keeping the ship on the Dutch private register, squares with the explanatory memorandum stating that such a scheme is not possible in the Netherlands, and whether it can be halted. The Minister answers that 55 ships were affected, that the suspension practice rests on a 1990s interpretation pending the RNZ bill which creates a statutory basis, and that the practice will continue until then, while labour concerns are being discussed with the seafarers' union.
It is my aim to create a statutory basis for bareboat-out as quickly as possible.
Het is mijn doel om zo snel mogelijk een wettelijke grondslag te creëren voor bareboat-out.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en De Boer over het bericht «Uitstel aanleg Seine-Nord-kanaal domper voor havens Zeeland»

MPs Bosman and De Boer asked the Infrastructure minister whether the postponement of the Seine-Nord canal, a TEN-T priority project, harms Zeeland ports, whether France can delay it alone, and whether the Netherlands can recover financial losses or pressure France. The minister answered that France decides on timing, EU coordination is limited, financial consequences are hard to state, and Dutch contacts with France continue without a formal demand.
The Netherlands supports France's subsidy application, but the construction remains a French matter.
Nederland steunt de subsidieaanvraag van Frankrijk, maar de aanleg blijft verder een Franse aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht ‘Polenprijsje voor niet handsfree bellen: 50 euro’

Two PVV MPs asked whether foreign truck drivers are favoured in traffic fines, citing a Polish driver fined 50 euros instead of 220 for phone use, and whether the government will stop this and re-sanction affected drivers. The minister answered that foreign drivers are not favoured, that the reduced amount was an exceptional prosecutorial decision given perishable cargo, that data on foreign fines is limited, and that a settled sanction cannot be increased.
Foreign drivers are not favoured when imposing traffic fines.
Buitenlandse chauffeurs worden niet bevoordeeld bij het opleggen van verkeersboetes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over een lagere watertemperatuur bij drinkwaterinstallaties, in relatie tot energiebesparing bij gebouwverwarming en warmtapwaterbereiding

MPs Jansen and Van Gerven asked whether warm tap water may be set at 50 degrees where certified copper-silver ionisation systems are installed, and whether lower temperatures could enable energy savings from waste heat and solar heat. The minister answered that such lower temperatures are permitted only via pilots under expert supervision and strict legal restrictions, and that the potential savings are limited to specific situations.

If the results are satisfactory, agreement can be given from a public health perspective to lowering the hot tap water temperature and/or flushing frequency at all locations where the system concerned is installed.

Indien de resultaten bevredigend zijn, kan uit oogpunt van de volksgezondheid akkoord worden gegaan met verlaging van de warm tapwatertemperatuur en/of spoelfrequentie op alle locaties waar het betreffende systeem is geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de gevolgen van de snelheidsverhoging langs snelwegen voor de gezondheid van burgers

MP Van Gerven asks whether raising motorway speed limits worsens air quality and health near roads, and whether the limit should be reversed. The minister replies that the effect is limited, that the government stays within legal air quality norms, and that it will not restore the old speed limit.
No. I remain within the legally established norms, which are partly based on the health effects.
Nee. Ik blijf binnen de wettelijk vastgestelde normen, die mede zijn gebaseerd op de effecten voor de gezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over een rapport over overheidsinkomsten en –uitgaven betreffende gemotoriseerd wegverkeer

An MP asks the minister about a Ecorys report on public revenues and expenditures from motor road traffic, and about a letter from motoring organisations claiming revenues exceed spending. The minister confirms awareness, says the handbook on external infrastructure costs will be sent in Q1 2014, declines to pre-judge the unfinished report's conclusions, and states that budget rules separate revenues from expenditures.
It is foreseen that the 'Handbook external and infrastructure costs traffic' will be completed in the first quarter of 2014 and then sent to the House.
Voorzien is dat het «Handboek externe en infrastructuurkosten verkeer» het eerste kwartaal van 2014 wordt afgerond en dan ook aan de Kamer zal worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de Buitenring Parkstad Limburg

An SP MP asked the minister whether the Buitenring Parkstad road project in Limburg, whose costs rose from 200 to about 500 million euro, could be halted or redirected via a directive given the court ruling and the Crisis- and Recovery Act status. The minister repeatedly declined, stating that the project is a provincial competence and that she sees no reason to issue a directive.
The Buitenring Parkstad Limburg project is a provincial project. It is therefore not for me, but for the province of Limburg, to give a judgement on opinions regarding this project.
Het project Buitenring Parkstad Limburg is een provinciaal project. Het is dus niet aan mij, maar aan de provincie Limburg om een oordeel te geven over meningen betreffende dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over werelderfgoed Wadden

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the ministers about a Waddenvereniging report on opportunities from Wadden Sea World Heritage status, including tourism limits, whether the status added restrictions, and the tourism strategy. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the status adds no extra restrictions beyond existing law, pointed to promotion and a trilateral tourism strategy due at the February 2014 conference, and said the status did not itself impose new limits.
The World Heritage status in itself does not impose any additional restrictions or rules.
De werelderfgoedstatus op zich levert géén extra beperkingen of regels op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de verhoging van de pakkans en boetes voor malafide vrachtwagenchauffeurs

MP De Graaf asked the minister about truck drivers fitting a second licence plate over the original, mainly Eastern European plates, and whether this circumvents cabotage rules, including penalties for Dutch firms employing such drivers and more inspection capacity. The minister said the inspectorate has not encountered this in practice, that such double plating violates traffic law and would be enforced under existing penalty policy with a company inspection if it were not an isolated incident, and that a study of cabotage enforcement is underway.
Should it turn out that manipulation by a company's drivers is not an isolated incident, a company inspection by the ILT will follow.
Mocht blijken dat manipulatie door chauffeurs van een bedrijf geen incident is, volgt een bedrijfsinspectie door de ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het Droge Lading Comité en de crisis in de binnenvaart

An SP MP asked the minister about the Droge Lading Comité, its exclusion of smaller barges, the involvement of a brokerage firm linked to overcapacity, and the failed EU crisis declaration for inland shipping. The minister replied that the committee was an initiative of individual large-vessel operators, that smaller vessels face no overcapacity problem, that no views were expressed on individual firms, and that the government awaits Belgium's EU process before reconsidering.
I have no opinion on the role or position of individual companies or persons in this regard.
Over de rol of positie van individuele ondernemingen of personen in dit verband heb ik geen oordeel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Nederland innoveert niet genoeg’

MP De Graaf (PVV) asked the minister whether the PBL merely compares countries and produces green propaganda, whether its statistics could be done by CBS, and whether the minister would close the PBL. The minister rejected all three, defending the PBL's strategic analysis role, its independent position and its positive international visitation review.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het plan om de leefbaarheid van het dorp Moerdijk op te offeren voor economische ontwikkeling

MP Ouwehand asked ministers whether the advisory commission's view that port and industrial growth at Moerdijk should take priority over village liveability, and the resulting environmental, health and traffic impacts, were acceptable. The government answered that the trade-off is a matter for the regional authorities in the consultation on the port vision, that environmental norms still apply, and that it sees no role for the national government at this stage.
Given this consultation process, I currently see no role for the national government.
Gelet op dit consultatieproces zie ik thans geen rol voor de rijksoverheid weggelegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de Blankenburgtunnel

An MP asked the minister about the Blankenburg tunnel, including why environmental groups did not take part in the consultation on the integration vision and whether residents and public-private financing would be involved. The minister replied that the environmental groups declined to participate, that residents will be involved in the detailed design, and that the integration vision is a regional responsibility, while stating that the financing will be mainly public with some toll revenue.
The integration vision, as drawn up by the regional parties, I will send to you shortly, together with the Preferred Decision and the Structure Vision.
De inpassingsvisie, zoals opgesteld door de regiopartijen, zal ik u binnenkort toezenden, tezamen met de Voorkeursbeslissing en de Structuurvisie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het uitblijven van werkzaamheden die nodig zijn voor de toegankelijkheid van de haven Vlissingen-Oost

An MP asked why the ministry has not removed a sill blocking access to the Sloehaven for certain ships, despite requests from Zeeland Seaports and the province, and about the lost revenue and cost. The minister answered that talks are ongoing with the province, Zeeland Seaports and Flanders, that the port company is willing to pay for the dredging, and that data on lost revenue and the cost estimate are not yet available.
I have no data on this.
Hierover zijn mij geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de brandweer zorgen heeft over de borging van brandveiligheid in het omgevingsrecht

An MP asks the government whether fire-safety responsibilities of municipalities and safety regions will be safeguarded under the planned Omgevingswet and private quality assurance in construction, given fire service concerns. The minister replies that municipal fire-service responsibility is unchanged, private quality assurance will keep the Bouwbesluit 2012 as the test framework, and further details will follow in a letter this autumn.

The Omgevingswet proposal, however, contains no such changes and does not alter the principle that the tasks and powers for the physical living environment that government must address lie primarily with the municipalities.

Het voorstel Omgevingswet bevat dergelijke wijzigingen echter niet en brengt geen wijzigingen aan in het beginsel dat de taken en bevoegdheden voor de fysieke leefomgeving die de overheid moet behartigen in de eerste plaats bij de gemeenten liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de nieuwe sluiskolk in de Twentekanalen bij Eefde

An MP asked the minister about the Commission for EIA's preliminary criticism of placing the new lock chamber at Eefde on the northern side, and whether a middle-northern alternative should be studied as a full option. The minister acknowledged the preliminary advice, said Rijkswaterstaat is preparing a supplement to the planMER, and declined to pre-empt the final advice, rejecting a second opinion and promising to compare the sites in that supplement.
I will await the final assessment advice of the Commission for EIA before responding.
Ik wacht het definitieve toetsingsadvies van de commissie m.e.r. af alvorens te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van Ojik over de dreigementen van de Russische kustwacht aan het adres van het Greenpeace-schip Artic Sunrise

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Ojik asked the government about Russian coast guard threats to fire on the Greenpeace ship Arctic Sunrise, the denial of access to the Kara Sea, and Russian oil exploration in the Arctic. The minister condemned the threats, invoked UNCLOS coastal-state rules on the Northern Sea Route, reported summoning the Russian ambassador, and referred to earlier policy on Arctic oil exploration.
On 27 August the Russian embassy was summoned to obtain clarification about the inspection of the Arctic Sunrise carried out by Russia.
Op 27 augustus jl. is de Russische ambassade ontboden teneinde opheldering te verkrijgen over de door Rusland uitgevoerde inspectie van de Artic Sunrise.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman en De Boer over het artikel ‘Havenbaronnen kapen onze bedrijven weg’

MPs Bosman and De Boer asked whether Belgian ports receive state subsidies that disadvantage Dutch ports and whether this breaches a level playing field in Europe. The minister acknowledged Flemish funding for Flemish seaports, said Dutch ports are not on a level playing field in harbour-internal costs, and said existing EU rules are insufficient but she supports the proposed EU Port Regulation and state-aid guidelines.
That is why I am in principle positive about the proposed EU Port Regulation.
Daarom sta ik in beginsel positief tegenover de voorgestelde EU Havenverordening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de beslissing van Verbrugge Terminals om niet in Vlissingen-Oost maar in Zeebrugge te investeren in een containerterminal

An MP asks the ministers whether they know Verbrugge Terminals chose to invest in Zeebrugge rather than Vlissingen-Oost, whether Flemish state aid to ports distorts competition, and whether the government will raise this with the European Commission and condition its support for the EU port regulation on state-aid rules. The minister confirms the facts, calls the Flemish funding regime an unequal playing field that the Commission has already found compatible with EU rules, says the case strengthens his push for port state-aid guidelines, and makes no commitment to raise it with the Commission directly.
The Dutch view of port management and port services is a business-like one, in which users pay fully and at market-conform rates for the products and services delivered to them.

Het Nederlandse beeld van havenbeheer en havendienstverlening is een bedrijfsmatige, waarbij de gebruikers volledig en marktconform voor de kosten van de aan hen geleverde producten en diensten betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht ‘forse groei rijscholen is ongewenst’

MP Bashir (SP) asked the minister to substantiate claims that new driving schools do not underperform, given pass-rate data, and questioned enforcement of driving-instructor licensing and business skills. The minister answered that the pass-rate site does not show school novelty or quality, that enforcement is adequate with reporting to police and IBKI revocation powers, and that IBKI issues certificates with expiry dates, while several questions were only partly answered and deferred to a committee meeting.
I am not aware that the control and enforcement of competence under the WRM is below standard and leads to problems.
Mij is niet bekend dat de controle en handhaving van de bevoegdheid op basis van de WRM onder de maat is en tot problemen leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de Belgische aanmelding van de crisis in de binnenvaart

MP Albert de Vries asked whether Belgium would formally request EU recognition of the inland shipping crisis and what the Dutch government would do about overcapacity and a scrapping fund. The minister replied that Belgium is still preparing the request, that the Netherlands found no sector support for scrapping measures, and that she will reconsider her own request only if Belgium does not file.
If that ultimately does not lead to the announced submission, I will reconsider.
Als dat uiteindelijk niet leidt tot de aangekondigde indiening, zal ik mij opnieuw beraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over recidive na educatieve verkeersveiligheidsmaatregelen

An MP asked the ministers whether a quarter of motorists who must follow a traffic behaviour course re-offend within two years, and what recidivism rate is acceptable, and asked about the WODC evaluation, the longer-term recidivism and other offence types. The minister states the government aims for the lowest possible recidivism, notes the WODC figures (about 13% and 14% same-type reoffending, nearly 25% combined), says the EMG has been revised, and that longer-term data will come in 2016 and 2021 with ongoing optimisation of the measures.
I strive for recidivism percentages that are as low as possible.
Ik streef naar zo laag mogelijke recidivepercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht 'Tunnel levert ING miljoenen op'

An MP from D66 asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that the Noord tunnel public-private partnership, led by a consortium including ING, yields large profits, and whether returns, renegotiation and oversight by the ACM are appropriate. The minister defended the 1988 contract as reflecting the risks and knowledge of the time, said the passage tariff will be reset in January 2014 within contract terms, rejected seeking extra ACM advice, and promised to keep the House informed through budget debates and progress reports.
Question 9: Are you willing to keep the House informed of developments in this area? Answer 9: Yes, information exchange is arranged through the budget debate and the regular DBFM(O) progress report.
Vraag 9 Bent u bereid de Kamer van de ontwikkelingen op dit terrein op de hoogte te houden? Antwoord 9 Ja, de informatie-uitwisseling is geregeld via de begrotingsbehandeling
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Van Hijum over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat voorbereidingen treft voor een nieuwe bezuiniging op de bediening van sluizen en brugge

Two CDA MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat is preparing a new cut to the operation of locks and bridges, whether the Eilandbrug and Ketelbrug in Overijssel will be operated remotely, and how charter shipping in Kampen is being taken into account. The minister replied that the measure implements existing coalition-agreement savings due by 2018, that remote operation of the Eilandbrug already exists while the Ketelbrug is not planned for it, and that consultation with the charter shipping association has already taken place.
After the nationwide remote-operation pilot still under way ends, the technical aspects will be examined in an evaluation, which will be sent to your House.
Na afloop van de nu nog lopende landelijke pilot «bediening op afstand» zullen de technische aspecten worden belicht in een evaluatie. Deze zal aan uw Kamer worden toegezonden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bisschop over de noodklok van Rijkswaterstaat over de veiligheid van de Oosterscheldekering

An SGP MP asked the minister about press reports of an internal Rijkswaterstaat report claiming the Oosterscheldekering storm barrier had been neglected, and whether it met safety norms. The minister replied that the report does not say the barrier was neglected, that the barrier has always met and still meets the legal norm, and that management has been tightened and staffing adjusted.
I informed you in April 2013 about this and, in line with the report's conclusions, indicated that the landslides did not lead to problems for the Oosterscheldekering.
Ik heb u in april 2013 hierover geïnformeerd en in lijn met de conclusies van het rapport aangegeven dat de afschuivingen niet tot problemen voor de Oosterscheldekering hebben geleid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de verkeersveiligheid op de A15

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about the many accidents on the A15 motorway and what could improve road safety there. The minister attributed the accidents to diverse causes, outlined measures such as road markings, local traffic detection and lane-overtaking changes, and said matrix signalling was not cost-effective.
To improve road safety, Rijkswaterstaat is examining the possibility of applying chevron stripes on the road surface.
Om de verkeersveiligheid te verbeteren onderzoekt Rijkswaterstaat de mogelijkheid om zogenaamde chevronstrepen op het wegdek aan te brengen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elias over het verhogen van de maximumsnelheid op de A2

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the speed limit on the entire A2 motorway could be raised to 130 km/h, its cost within existing budgets, the cost of enabling this earlier, and which sections could be done quickly. The minister answered that a large part of the A2 can eventually be raised to 130 km/h within environmental and nature conditions, with the pace set by air quality and noise ceilings, and that about 28 km could be raised in 2014 depending on the PAS nitrogen programme.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het aantal gereden kilometers met een oldtimer

MP Bashir (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about criticism from the FEHAC that the Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving overstated oldtimer mileage, whether the report should be improved, the reasons for abolishing the oldtimer motor vehicle tax exemption, and how revenue and motion implementation were calculated. The government answered that the PBL figures rest on CBS data, that the exemption removal serves environmental and budgetary aims, and that an agreed alternative with the trade sector will be included in the 2014 tax plan.
This alternative will be included in the Tax Plan 2014 and will be covered within the overall package of measures.
Dit alternatief zal worden meegenomen in het Belastingplan 2014 en zal binnen het totaalpakket aan maatregelen worden gedekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verjagen van herten met gemeenschapsgeld in de Hierdense Poort

MP Thieme asks why community money (EUR 5,000 from the province of Gelderland) is paid to a hunting unit to chase red deer away from a wildlife overpass, and whether the overpass should be closed to deer and the province held to account under the Flora and Fauna Act. The State Secretary replies that the payment is a one-off support measure to build goodwill and prevent damage, that ecoducts are important for biodiversity but deer should be chased from farmland, and that she sees no violation or need to amend the code.
No, I do not share this view. The province implements nature policy, including by reconnecting nature areas through ecoducts.
Nee, deze mening deel ik niet. De provincie geeft uitvoering aan natuurbeleid, onder andere door het (weer) verbinden van (natuur)gebieden door ecoducten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Vries over de bereikbaarheid van de jachthaven van Schiermonnikoog

MPs Jacobi and De Vries asked why the Schiermonnikoog marina will not be dredged in 2013, whether Natura 2000 rules prevent dumping silt for salt-marsh creation, and whether silt disposal can be restored. The minister explains the municipality stopped unpermitted dumping, its 2009 permit was refused for lack of information, and that options including a Rijkswaterstaat disposal arrangement are being explored, with clarity expected in autumn.
In the autumn, more clarity will emerge on this.
In het najaar ontstaat hierover meer duidelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de onveiligheid van Provinciale wegen

An MP asked the minister whether provincial roads should have 3.30m lanes rather than 2.75m for safety, whether a star-rating system like the national roads would help, and what steps will be taken to improve safety on provincial roads. The minister answered that wider lanes may be safer at 80 km/h if drivers do not speed, that EuroRAP ratings are being piloted for provincial roads, and that road safety on these roads is primarily the responsibility of provinces and municipalities.
Improving road safety on 80 km/h roads is the responsibility of the relevant road manager, mainly municipalities and provinces.
Het verbeteren van verkeersveiligheid op 80 km/uur wegen is de verantwoordelijkheid van de desbetreffende wegbeheerder, dit zijn vooral gemeenten en provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de stormvloedkering

An MP asked the minister about large scour holes near the Oosterschelde storm surge barrier, whether they were anticipated at construction, whether they have grown beyond design assumptions, and what structural maintenance and costs follow. The minister answered that safety was never at risk, that scour was anticipated and monitored, that slides near the Noordbeveland dikes were not foreseen and have been stabilised, and that tightened management with a costed programme through 2014 is in place, while withholding cost figures due to an ongoing tender.
I endorse the thrust of these articles; safety is and was not at stake.
Ik onderschrijf de strekking van deze artikelen, de veiligheid is en was niet in het geding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht ‘Duitse sluiswachters houden schippers op’

An MP from the VVD asked the minister whether she knew of reports that German lock keepers were obstructing Dutch barge operators, and whether she would press her German counterpart to end the strikes given the harm to the Dutch economy and EU free movement of goods. The minister confirmed awareness, said she had already raised the issue with her German counterpart in July and again by letter on 27 August, asking Germany to do its utmost to end the strikes.
In the letter I called on my German counterpart to make every effort to have the strikes ended.
In de brief heb ik beroep gedaan op mijn Duitse ambtgenoot om zich maximaal in te spannen om de stakingen te doen beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over staking van de sluismeesters op de Duitse vaarwegen

The MP De Rouwe (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about strikes by lock-keepers on German waterways, which harm Dutch inland shipping and may breach the EU free movement of goods principle. The minister acknowledges the strikes' financial consequences, says she cannot assess the damage to Dutch firms or insolvency risk, and reports she raised the issue with her German counterpart and will inform the House of outcomes.
I cannot make substantiated statements about the extent of the damage to Dutch inland shipping companies.
Over de omvang van de schade voor Nederlandse binnenvaartondernemingen kan ik geen onderbouwde uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over knelpunten bij invoering van het Wijzigingsbesluit Bodemenergiesystemen

An MP asked the minister about implementation problems with the Wijzigingsbesluit bodemenergiesystemen, including provinces and municipalities using exceptions, inconsistent permit rules, and a proposed evaluation. The minister replied that it is too early to draw conclusions, that provinces have regional discretion, and agreed to monitor implementation and shorten the evaluation period to three years.
I propose that my ministry, together with these parties, will draft the evaluation questions for the amendment decision in the short term
Ik stel voor dat mijn ministerie samen met deze partijen de vraagstelling voor de evaluatie van het Wijzigingsbesluit op korte termijn gaat opstellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over de recordopbrengst aan boetes en onduidelijkheid rond 130 km/u-wegen

Two SP MPs asked why the ministry ran an information campaign after confusion about the 130 km/u limit on the A2, whether speeding fines show confusion, which road sections account for most tickets, and whether matrix signs should show limits. The minister said fines data cannot show the cause of speeding, that road signs are clear and flyers were distributed, that the CJIB has no data by road section, and that a Rijkswaterstaat user survey covering signage is due in September 2013 with fixed signs kept for permanent limits.
The CJIB has informed me that its registration system does not distinguish by road section.
Het CJIB heeft mij meegedeeld dat het in zijn registratiesysteem geen onderscheid maakt naar wegvakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra en Voortman over autisme en rijbewijskeuringen

MPs asked why people with autism must be medically re-examined for a driving licence, whether a standard test and a public list of examining specialists should exist, why examination fees vary, and whether periodic re-examination can be dropped after the Health Council advice. The minister explains the Health Council basis and checklist, notes that the NZa sets maximum fees and plans tariff differentiation from 2014, declines free choice of doctor for now while promising to weigh a list with the CBR and specialists, and intends to adopt the advice dropping triennial re-examination by 1 October.
I intend to adopt this advice from the Health Council.
Ik ben voornemens dit advies van de Gezondheidsraad over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de rol van de Rijksoverheid bij het inpassen van windparken in de provincie Drenthe

An MP from GroenLinks asks why the national government should coordinate the siting of Drenthe wind farms over 100 MW, whether the provincial alternative will be assessed, and how the national government will keep control. The ministers answer that the national coordination scheme applies, the provincial variant will be assessed in the environmental report, and the national government retains decision-making on spatial siting after consulting the province and municipalities.
Decision-making regarding spatial integration is and remains reserved for the national government.
Besluitvorming met betrekking tot de ruimtelijke inpassing is en blijft voorbehouden aan het Rijk.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat de regering, ondanks veel toezeggingen, nooit een plan gemaakt heeft om ingezetenen van Nederland met een buitenlands kenteken, belasting te laten betalen

Omtzigt (CDA) asks why the government, despite repeated promises, never produced a plan to make residents with foreign-registered cars pay Dutch motor vehicle tax, and when the promised letter and tax rules will arrive. State Secretary Weekers answers that residents must register cars in the Netherlands, that enforcement data is being collected, and that a letter with combined legislative and enforcement measures will follow, with legislation in the Belastingplan 2014.
The final touches are currently being put to it.
Daaraan wordt op dit moment de laatste hand gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de constructieve veiligheid van de landtunnel in de A4 bij Schiedam

An MP asked the minister whether she knows of the criticism by the former structural reviewer of the A4 Schiedam land tunnel, what actions were taken, whether independent research will be done, and what risks motorists face. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat, the contractor and an independent expert checked the design, the municipality concluded structural safety is not at issue, and no risk to motorists exists.
Rijkswaterstaat informed Mr De Kanter about these investigations and their results.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft de heer De Kanter geïnformeerd over deze onderzoeken en over de resultaten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat een klokkenluider melding maakt van falende controle bij de bouw van de A4 Midden Delfland

An MP asked the minister whether a whistleblower's report of inadequate checks on the A4 Midden Delfland tunnel construction was accurate, and whether inspections were rushed and should be independent of government. The minister answered that structural safety is not in doubt, that municipal and Rijkswaterstaat checks are thorough, that government building-code oversight is a legal public task, and pointed to forthcoming private quality assurance proposals.
Experts from the municipality check the design against requirements and regulations as set out in the Building Decree.
Deskundigen van de gemeente toetsen het ontwerp op eisen en voorschriften zoals die zijn opgenomen in het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en De Boer over de aanpak van illegale taxi’s en aanbieders van illegale taxidiensten op internet

Two MPs asked how the government tackles illegal taxi services offered online, including via Facebook, and how many such operators were contacted, warned or sanctioned. The state secretary agreed these services should be tackled, said the size of the illegal market cannot be measured, and described ILT warning letters (about 60 in 2013) and proceedings, but gave no figures on sanctions or seized cars.
Seizure of cars is generally carried out by the police. The number of cars of unlicensed drivers seized on the order of the Public Prosecutor is not separately registered.
In beslagname van auto’s gebeurt in de regel door de politie. Het aantal op last van de Officier van Justitie in beslag genomen auto’s van snorders wordt niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de argumenten voor het afwijzen van het bewonersalternatief Portway 2012 c.q. Portway Budget voor de A13/A16

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the minister why the Portway 2012 residents' alternative to the A13/A16 was rejected, citing noise screens, traffic, robustness and the consultation process. The minister answered that the regional authority found the project goals of A13/16 not met and Portway 2012 not fundable within budget, and defended the treatment of the citizens' initiative.
Portway 2012 was tested by the Rotterdam city region on goal achievement (mainly traffic performance and environmental effects), compared with A13/16.
De Portway 2012 is door de stadregio Rotterdam getoetst op doelbereik (voornamelijk verkeerskundige prestatie en milieueffecten), in vergelijking met A13/16.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het niet functioneren van de trajectcontrole op de A2

An SP MP asked why the A2 average-speed (trajectory) control between Utrecht and Amsterdam was split between two suppliers, why it is not yet operational, what it has cost and how speeding is enforced meanwhile. The minister answers that the split was a deliberate choice for competition and risk spreading, that delays stem from a difference of view on test quality which is now resolved, that the system goes live on 15 July 2013, and that mobile checks cover the gap.
The system will be put into operation on 15 July 2013.
Het systeem zal op 15 juli 2013 in werking worden gesteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over regelgeving met betrekking tot drones

An MP asks the Justice and Infrastructure ministers whether the repeal of the aerial photography decree and the rules on drones and model aircraft adequately protect privacy against high-resolution camera drones. The state secretary answers that existing criminal and data protection law suffices, that tighter model-aircraft and drone rules are being drafted, and that operators need an exemption in the meantime.
I consider the current and forthcoming laws and regulations sufficiently equipped to take account of protecting private life in the civil use of cameras mounted on unmanned aircraft.

Ik acht de geldende en aanstaande wet- en regelgeving hiermee voldoende toegerust om rekening te houden met het beschermen van de persoonlijke levenssfeer als het gaat om het civiele gebruik van op een onbemand luchtvaartuig gemonteerde camera's.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven zijn gesteld over de stijging van de waterschapslasten bij het waterschap Brabantse Delta

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why water board Brabantse Delta plans cost increases of up to 5% a year, how this fits earlier promises of no net tariff rises and the Bestuursakkoord Water, and about the board's governance. The minister replied that the increases stem from task transfers and long-running EU-driven measures, that the water board's leadership is responsible for tariff decisions, and that the Bestuursakkoord Water sets a collective goal of moderate increases; the minister also said the long-term organisation of water governance will be examined together with partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen, Hoogland en De Rouwe over aanleg en beheer van wandel- en fietsroutes

MPs asked about the state of national walking and cycling route networks, their financing after central funding ended, obstruction by waterboards and infrastructure, and planning protection. The government replied that responsibility for these networks now rests with the regions, that it will not intervene, and that it will not add new reporting obligations.
With the signing of the Nature Governance Agreement, care for the national route networks is the responsibility of the regions (mainly provinces, municipalities and recreation boards).
Met de ondertekening van het Bestuursakkoord Natuur is de zorg voor de Landelijke Routenetwerken de verantwoordelijkheid van de regio (met name provincies, gemeenten en recreatieschappen).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over de ontwikkeling en de internationale concurrentiepositie van de Nederlandse havens

MPs De Vries and Groot asked the ministers about the OECD study on Rotterdam and Amsterdam port competitiveness, corporate tax exemption for state port companies, and EU support for smaller ports. The government said the OECD study draws no competitiveness conclusions, that the consequences of ending the tax exemption are not yet clear, and that a level playing field is important to the Netherlands.
However, it is not yet clear at this moment how the revision of the corporate tax liability for state-owned enterprises will be shaped.
Het is op dit moment echter nog niet duidelijk hoe de herziening van de vennootschapsbelastingplicht voor overheidsbedrijven wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Rouwe over het rapport “Schaatsaccommodatie voor de topsport”

An MP asked the minister about a report on speed skating facilities, claiming the national government had made 200 million euro available to Almere that Icedome would use for operations. The minister denied any national contribution to the project, its operation, or top-sport event subsidies, and said no such commitment had been made.
There is no question of a contribution from the national government to the operation of a top-sport venue.
Er is geen sprake van een bijdrage van het Rijk aan de exploitatie van een topsportlocatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bashir en Paulus Jansen over de gevolgen van de auto van de zaak voor het autogebruik

MPs Bashir and Jansen (SP) asked the ministers whether they endorse Van Ommeren's analysis that the company car tax regime causes large economic losses through extra car travel, parking and vehicle choice. State Secretary Weekers rejected the analysis and its conclusions, arguing the evidence for the claimed effects is weak and that existing tax burdens and employer incentives already address these issues.
No, I endorse neither the main lines of the analysis nor all of the conclusions.
Nee, ik onderschrijf noch de hoofdlijnen van de analyse noch alle conclusies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over een mogelijke ‘bevriezing’ van deelcertificaten van het motorexamen

An SP MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a possible freeze of motorcycle licence theory certificates, equal treatment, A2/A-zwaar access, and compensation for candidates who could not sit exams in autumn 2012. The minister answered largely by pointing to EU directive requirements and stated policy choices, offering a EUR 150 goodwill payment and declining to reopen the exam or change the A1 rules.
I will examine in the coming years whether it is desirable to do that for those moving from A1 via A2 to A.
Ik zal de komende jaren bezien of het wenselijk is om dat voor doorstromers van A1 via A2 naar A wel te doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de verkeersveiligheid op de N57

An MP asked the minister whether serious accidents occur on the N57 without a physical median and whether a full median barrier and a concrete safety plan with the provinces would be pursued. The minister acknowledged accidents, said the N57's risk figure is not out of line with comparable roads, and listed completed and planned measures already discussed with the provinces.
The risk figure (number of [serious] casualties per million vehicle kilometres driven) for the N57 is, however, not deviant from similar national roads in other regions.
Het risicocijfer (aantal [ernstige] slachtoffers per miljoen gereden voertuigkilometers) voor de N57 is echter niet afwijkend ten opzichte van soortgelijke rijkswegen in andere regio's.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Graus over het bericht “EU wil meer concurrentie met haven Rotterdam”

PVV MPs Madlener and Graus asked ministers whether the government would act against EU port-liberalisation proposals that could strengthen competitors of Rotterdam and how much EU money would fund them. The minister said the Port Regulation is still being studied, that TEN-T funds are not linked to the regulation and effects on the second Maasvlakte cannot yet be stated, and that the Netherlands opposes unfair competition and will treat all applications equally.
Via the BNC procedure I will inform you as agreed no later than 14 June 2013.
Via de BNC procedure zal ik u volgens afspraak uiterlijk op 14 juni 2013 informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Hamer over rijopleidingen en het opleiden van rijinstructeurs door het UWV

MPs Kuiken and Hamer asked about high dropout from UWV-funded driving instructor training, selection of trainees, recovery of training costs, a bankruptcy that disrupted 255 trainees, and how many have been trained. The government answered that dropout is in line with average re-integration training, selection followed protocol, cost recovery occurs in some cases via sanctions, affected trainees were placed in other training, and only 144 of 391 tracks ended in placement.
The number of dropouts from the driving instructor training does not differ from the average dropout rate for training within the re-integration of benefit recipients.
Het aantal uitvallers bij de opleiding rijinstructeur wijkt niet af van de gemiddelde uitval bij de opleidingen in het kader van de re-integratie van uitkeringsgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Oztürk over de ontwikkeling van winkelruimte

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about rising retail vacancy and whether municipalities should be restrained from developing new shop space, including whether the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation is applied and supervised. The minister acknowledged rising vacancy, said local tailoring and the ladder suffice, rejected intervention at a set vacancy level and new provincial instruments, and did not commission research on the ladder's application.
I will not restrict municipalities in the development possibilities included in existing zoning plans.
Ik ga gemeenten niet beperken in de ontwikkelmogelijkheden die in vigerende bestemmingsplannen zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over de onduidelijkheid rond praatpalen langs de snelweg

MP De Rouwe asked the minister about the unclear future of roadside emergency call posts (praatpalen) on Dutch motorways, including their costs, usage trends, the ANWB contract running to 2017, and whether the service should be phased out in favour of mobile phones and in-car eCall. The minister answered in detail on costs and call numbers, said phasing out the service is possible in the long term in consultation with the ANWB, but did not answer the question on usage figures for 1992 and 2002 in full, deferring those data and the timing of answers.
Tracing the data needed for answers 4 and 5 has taken more time than anticipated.
Het opsporen van de gegevens nodig voor de antwoorden 4 en 5 heeft meer tijd gevergd dan voorzien.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman, Litjens, en Aukje de Vries over mosselkweek en natuur op de Waddenzee

MPs Bosman, Litjens and Aukje de Vries asked about the Produs research on mussel farming and Wadden Sea nature, including the withdrawn press release and whether mussel seed fishing should continue until harm is proven. The state secretary said the findings will feed into the convenant evaluation due spring 2014, that the government will not prejudge policy decisions, and that a spring fishing permit was granted on 7 May.
I want to give the covenant parties the room to reach agreements based on the evaluation.
Ik wil de convenantspartijen de ruimte geven om op basis van de evaluatie tot afspraken te komen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht “Bonnenregen op A4 wekt ergernis”

MPs De Graaf and Helder asked why many speeding fines were issued on the A4 after average-speed (trajectory) checks started, and whether signage ambiguity should be fixed and fines dropped. The minister replied that the 100 km/h limit has long applied, signage was unchanged, warning signs and press releases preceded the checks, and that fines will not be dropped.
The maximum speed on the section of the A4 where the trajectory check is located has been 100 km/h for many years.
De maximumsnelheid op het gedeelte van de A4 waar de trajectcontrole staat, is al vele jaren 100 km/h.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over misstanden bij rijscholen

An MP asked the minister about abuses at driving schools, including UWV training of instructors, transparency and oversight of driving school quality, which bodies tackle abuses, a complaints desk, and a new industry organisation. The minister answered that the market is free, that the CBR publishes pass rates, that tax, police, IBKI and ACM handle parts of the problem, and that complaints and a new industry body are matters for the branch itself.
I am of the opinion that a complaints desk for aggrieved students is a matter for the driving school branch itself.
Ik ben van menig dat een klachtenmeldpunt voor gedupeerde cursisten een zaak is van de rijschoolbranche zelf.
Antwoord vragen Elias over het publiceren van een videoschouw op de website van het departement van Infrastructuur en Milieu

An MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment to publish on the ministry's website a video inspection of unclear speed-limit signage on the A2 motorway between Vinkeveen and Abcoude, which the minister had earlier said could not be sent to parliament because it was a video. The minister agreed to make the video publicly available and gave a link to it on the Rijkswaterstaat website.
Yes, I am willing to make the video inspection concerning the speed limit signage on the A2 publicly available.
Ja, ik ben bereid de videoschouw betreffende de bebording van de maximumsnelheid op de A2 openbaar te maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes, Kuiken en Albert De Vries over het bericht “actie ANWB tegen tolvignet België

MPs asked the government about Belgium's planned toll vignette for Belgian roads, its effects on cross-border workers and Zeeland residents, and whether the minister had raised it with Belgium. The minister confirmed the plans for 2016, said the vignette would add costs but be manageable, and reported talks with Flemish and Benelux counterparts, promising to report further developments.
If this consultation shows that further developments on the vignette can be reported, I will of course inform you of them.
Mocht uit dit overleg blijken dat er nadere ontwikkelingen rond het vignet gemeld kunnen worden, dan zal ik u daarvan uiteraard op de hoogte stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klein over het aantal verkeersdoden in 2012

An MP from 50PLUS asked the minister what is being done to reduce road deaths among people aged 65 and over, including via consultation with senior organisations, electric bicycle and scooter accidents, and vehicle safety rules. The minister pointed to the existing 23-measure programme, the Blijf Veilig Mobiel partnership, ongoing research by VeiligheidNL and SWOV, and EuroNCAP-driven vehicle safety, while declining to change the vehicle regulation for now.
Amending the Vehicle Regulation is not yet on the agenda.
Aanpassen van de Regeling Voertuigen is nog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir over de skydivesport

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked whether air traffic control's limits on skydiving centres' altitude and frequency threaten the sport, and what the government will do. The state secretary replied that a 2010 regulation and the 2012 Luchtruimvisie prioritise Schiphol traffic, that talks are under way with the KNVvL and clubs on relocating springing sites, and that the sport will be facilitated but the choice of location is not the ministry's.

It is now essential to start a process for General Aviation as a whole to accommodate these functions in a future-proof way and, if necessary, relocate them within the framework of the Luchtruimvisie.

Het is nu zaak om voor de General Aviation in den brede een traject te starten om deze functies toekomstvast te accommoderen en indien nodig te verplaatsen binnen de kaders die de Luchtruimvisie biedt.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de crisis in de binnenvaart en nieuwe motorenrichtlijn voor binnenvaartschepen

An SP MP asks the minister about the inland shipping crisis, the government's progress in requesting an EU crisis declaration, and an EU engine directive that could apply to existing vessels. The minister answers that Belgium is preparing the crisis notification, that the Netherlands supports it, that concrete industry proposals are needed, and that the EU engine study is not finished and has no 2020 deadline.
I have already pointed out to the European Commission, and will repeat on occasion, that any proposals must take proper account of their affordability, given the current economic crisis.

Ik heb de Europese Commissie al eerder er op gewezen, en zal dat bij gelegenheid herhalen, dat bij het formuleren van eventuele voorstellen terdege rekening gehouden moet worden met de financierbaarheid daarvan.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber over de binnenvaartblokkades in België

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the Infrastructure and Environment minister about Belgian inland shipping blockades, the sector crisis, a possible EU crisis declaration, a scrapping fund, and support measures.
