The minister condemned the blockades, reported contacts with Belgian counterparts, committed to forwarding the sector report to Belgium, and promised a transparency study by the October 2013 committee meeting, while deferring EU and competition-law matters.
I have promised my Belgian colleagues my support for their crisis notification.
Ik heb mijn Belgische collega's mijn steun toegezegd bij hun crisismelding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bereikte akkoord over crisismaatregelen in de binnenvaart in België

An MP asked the Infrastructure and Environment minister about the Belgian crisis-measures agreement for inland shipping and whether the Netherlands would join Belgium's EU structural market disruption notification. The minister said Belgium had not yet formally notified, that the Netherlands supports the initiative, will work with the sector and Commission, and urged Germany and possibly France to back it.
I have already informed my Belgian counterparts that I will support Belgium's initiative to notify the crisis to the European Commission.
Ik heb mijn Belgische ambtsgenoten al laten weten dat ik het Belgische initiatief om de crisis aan te melden bij de Europese Commissie zal steunen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht “België werkt aan verbod op dumpvrachten”

An MP asked the minister whether the Netherlands should follow Belgium in banning sailing below cost in inland shipping, given Belgium's plan for a royal decree. The minister said the Belgian measure is not yet specified, that such proposals should be considered at EU level, and that he will urge Belgian counterparts to raise them there.
I will therefore urge my Belgian counterparts to raise these proposals in the upcoming consultation at European level on inland shipping
Ik zal derhalve bij mijn Belgische ambtsgenoten erop aandringen deze voorstellen in te brengen in het komende overleg op Europees niveau over de binnenvaart
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de Garantieregeling Scheepsnieuwbouwfinanciering

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs and Infrastructure ministers whether the shipbuilding loan guarantee (GSF) applies to inland vessels, why it is not extended to modernisation, and what the budget and risks are. The minister answered that the guarantee is a level-playing-field measure for shipyards, not a capacity stimulus, that it covers new builds with a ceiling of 1 billion euro per year, and that modernisation is excluded to preserve EU state-aid compliance.
The purpose of the GSF is to enable shipyards to finance the construction of a vessel, not to stimulate an increase in inland shipping capacity.
Doel van de GSF is scheepswerven in staat te stellen de financiering van de bouw van een schip te realiseren en niet om de vergroting van de capaciteit in de binnenvaart te stimuleren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over privatisering van waterbedrijven

Member Van Gerven (SP) asked whether the government would act against privatisation of water utilities, citing price rises in Paços de Ferreira, Portugal, and an EU concessions directive. The government answered that privatisation is a sovereign national choice under EU treaty rules, that Portugal's MoU was agreed with the Troika and is monitored by it, and that transparency and universal access should be preserved, without committing to halt privatisation.
The cabinet regards the way the drinking water sector is organised in other member states as a national sovereign competence.
Het kabinet beschouwt de wijze van inrichting van de drinkwatersector in andere lidstaten als een nationale soevereine bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over privatisering van drinkwaterbedrijven

An SP MP asks the government to reconcile the Finance Minister's statement that privatising utilities including water can benefit society with the Infrastructure Minister's assurance that Dutch drinking water stays public, and whether the EU concession directive should exclude water. The government answers that its line on Dutch drinking water is unchanged, that member states keep sovereignty over ownership and organisation of water services, and that the Drinkwaterwet will not be amended.
The Netherlands' position is shared by the Council of the European Union.
Het standpunt van Nederland wordt gedeeld door de Raad van de Europese Unie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Fokke en Kuiken over het niet vernietigen van een bouwvergunning voor een geitenstal in Landerd (Noord-Brabant)

Three PvdA MPs asked why the Crown did not annul the municipality of Landerd's building permit for a goat barn despite the province of Noord-Brabant's request, and whether the expansion should be allowed on public health grounds. The minister replied that no conflict with law or the general interest was found, so annulment under the Constitution's Article 132 could not be applied, and that the decision takes no position on the desirability of the expansion or the provincial building freeze.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een vergunning voor de omstreden geitenstal in Landerd

An MP asked the ministers whether the controversial goat stable in Landerd may proceed despite a provincial construction stop and the Health Council's report on livestock health risks, and whether the Crown should annul the building permit. The government answered that annulment is discretionary, that no conflict with law or the general interest was found, that the permit was lawfully granted, and that it will not further suspend or annul the permit or await the cabinet response.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de weigering om de bouwvergunning te vernietigen die de gemeente Landerd heeft afgegeven voor de bouw van een grote geitenstal

MP Van Gerven (SP) asks why the minister refused to ask the Crown to annul the Landerd municipal building permit for a large goat barn during the Q-fever context, despite the provincial building freeze, and questions the legal basis and discretion involved. The minister answers that the permit was lawfully granted, that no conflict with law or the general interest was shown, and that the Crown's annulment discretion was not triggered, while declining to comment on the wisdom of the freeze or the municipal inquiry's conclusions.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht in de Gelderlander “Forse groei rijscholen is ongewenst”

An SP MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a sharp rise in driving schools, whether UWV-funded retraining had caused it, whether municipalities should stop referring people to driving instructor training, and how pupils could be protected from unqualified or underpriced schools. The minister answered that the driving school market is free, that instructor qualifications are set by law, that UWV-funded training has fallen and no recent figures exist, that municipalities have full discretion, that entrepreneurship training will not be required, and that the CBR and tax authority supervise and publish pass rates.
Recent figures specifically for the driving school sector are not available.
Recente cijfers voor specifiek de rijschoolbranche zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht ‘Europees Parlement stemt voor sloopfonds zeeschepen’

An MP asked the minister whether the European Parliament's proposed ship-scrapping fund, financed by a levy on ships calling at EU ports, would harm the Dutch competitive position and why a one-off levy at registration would not be preferable. The minister agreed the levy could harm the Dutch short sea sector and that a one-off levy would be more logical, and stated the Netherlands opposes the per-call levy in the negotiations.

The Netherlands is in principle open to a financial instrument to encourage compliance with the regulation, but there is insufficient support from industry for the scrapping fund as proposed by the European Parliament.

Nederland staat in principe open voor een financieel instrument om het naleven van de verordening te stimuleren, maar voor het sloopfonds zoals voorgesteld door het Europees Parlement bestaat onvoldoende draagvlak bij het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch, Albert De Vries Albert en Otwin Van Dijk over mantelzorgwoningen en groepswonen

MPs asked about the savings potential of care annexes (mantelzorgwoningen) and group housing for elderly care, the status of housing experiments, deregulation under the BOR, the risk that temporary housing becomes permanent, and a barrier inventory for care providers. The government answered that savings cannot be quantified, experiments have ended and a new programme is being discussed, deregulation is planned via the BOR, enforcement remains with municipalities, and a municipal guidance note is expected after the summer.
On the subject of care annexes, a guidance note for municipalities is being prepared.
Op het terrein van mantelzorgwoningen is een handreiking voor gemeenten in de maak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het realiteitsgehalte van het bestuursakkoord IPO/Rijk over 6.000 megawatt wind op land

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked whether the provincial site realty check for 6,000 MW onshore wind had been completed, what the provinces' guarantee in the 2013 administrative accord means, and what happens if sites are annulled by courts. Minister Kamp answered that the Bosch en Van Rijn report was finished, found the IPO bid fell short, and that extra agreements now require provinces to guarantee 6,000 MW with monitoring but no legal sanctions.
The report was completed on 22 March 2013. You will find the report attached to the answer.
Het rapport is op 22 maart 2013 afgerond. U treft het rapport als bijlage bij de beantwoording aan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf inzake de berichten “Goedkope Filippijnen op truck” en “Filippijn rijdt voor € 650,-“.

An MP asked ministers about reports of cheap Filipino truck drivers undermining Dutch truckers, and whether the government would curb inflows of Eastern European and Filipino drivers. The minister answered that the case concerned a Latvian firm, that Dutch wage and labour rules apply to work for Dutch firms, and promised a letter on tackling sham constructions by 1 May.
The Minister of Social Affairs and Employment will inform the House by letter before 1 May about the approach to sham constructions.
De Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid zal uw Kamer voor 1 mei per brief informeren over de aanpak van schijnconstructies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir inzake overlast door dichte spitsstroken en het belang van een vluchtstrook

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the 18 March 2013 failure to open the A12 peak-hour lane, the software update behind it, back-up systems for traffic cameras, and the need for emergency lanes after an accident on the A2. The minister explained the software-update failure, the planned weekend maintenance and existing back-up systems, and said emergency lanes remain part of the basic motorway design while peak-hour lanes are used only after case-by-case safety weighing.
The importance of the emergency lane is certainly recognised by me.
Het belang van de vluchtstrook wordt zeker door mij erkend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven inzake de benoeming van de heer Meijdam in de gebiedscommissie Amstel, Gooi en Vecht

An SP MP asked the minister whether she shares the Commissie Schoon Schip conclusion that a KNSF-site report near Muiden was kept secret under Meijdam's responsibility, and why earlier advice to publish under the Wob was not followed. The minister deferred to the province of Noord-Holland for judgement on the commission's conclusions, noted the commission's findings without adopting them, and stated that appointments to advisory bodies rest on expertise and no explicit conflict-of-interest exclusion exists beyond the advisory body's own safeguards.
I note that it is an independent responsibility of the provincial government of Noord-Holland to form its own judgement on the commission's conclusions.
Ik stel vast dat het een eigenstandige verantwoordelijkheid van het provinciaal bestuur van Noord-Holland betreft om zich een oordeel te vormen over de conclusies van de Commissie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over nieuwe bezuinigingen op het infrastructuurfonds

An ChristenUnie MP asked the infrastructure minister about the reported €2.6 billion cut from withholding the price-indexation tranche for the infrastructure fund, the effect on MIRT project planning, the total cuts since 2010, and job losses. The minister confirmed the maximum effect on the infrastructure fund is €1.6 billion through 2028, that there is no current effect on MIRT projects yet, a net cut of over €10 billion since 2010, and gave an EIB-based estimate of roughly 3,200 job-years per year without giving a precise figure for this measure.
The maximum effect of the measure on the Infrastructure Fund is therefore 1.6 billion euros for the entire period through 2028.
Het maximale effect van de maatregel op het Infrastructuurfonds is daarmee 1,6 miljard euro voor de totale periode tot en met 2028.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de Marine wederom ingeroepen moest worden om de watervoorziening op Saba te redden

MPs Hachchi and van Veldhoven asked about the Navy being called in again to supply water on Saba, the adequacy of the island's water supply, and the government's promised structural solution. The minister answered that a drinking water study was launched to produce a durable solution by summer 2013, that imported water is an emergency measure, and that the Caribbean Netherlands water law differs from the Drinkwaterwet.
The study will be ready around summer, after which it will be jointly determined with Saba which measures will be implemented.
Het onderzoek zal rond de zomer gereed zijn, waarna gezamenlijk met Saba zal worden bepaald welke maatregelen zullen worden geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hachchi over de stijging van de waterschapslasten in 2013 met meer dan 5%.

MP Hachchi (D66) asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment why water board levies rose more than 5% in 2013 in some boards, including Vallei & Veluwe and Aa & Maas, and whether this is worrying. The minister answered that water boards set their own rates, attributed the increases to reserve depletion, merger effects and investment needs, and noted that most boards stayed below 5% and near expected inflation of 2.75%.
I want to emphasise that it is not up to me but to the boards of the water authorities themselves to set the rates and determine what is necessary and acceptable.
Ik wil hierbij benadrukken dat het niet aan mij, maar aan de besturen van de waterschappen zelf is om de tarieven vast te stellen en te bepalen wat nodig en aanvaardbaar is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over problemen bij de aanleg van de A4 Midden-Delfland

An MP asked the minister whether problems with soft-soil piles discovered during construction of the A4 Midden-Delfland would breach agreed tunnelling and landscape-integration commitments, why the piles were only found now despite a 1979 report, and what extra costs follow. The state secretary answered that the solution stays within the approved route decision and agreements, that the piles were reported by the contractor in June 2012 and linked to a 1979 report, and that no cost estimate exists yet pending research.
Research is being carried out into the best solution. I therefore do not yet have an estimate of the costs.
Er wordt onderzoek verricht naar de beste oplossing. Ik heb daarom nog geen raming van de kosten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de verwerking van teerhoudend asfalt

An SP MP asks whether policy on tar-containing asphalt granulate is working, given continued export of large volumes to Baltic states, what has been done since a motion to prevent export, and why not all road managers require thermal cleaning in their tenders. The state secretary replies that Dutch policy works for Dutch-origin material but about half is still exported legally under EU rules, lists actions such as revising CROW guidance and standard tender clauses, and gives 2012 export figures without naming individual exporters.
Can you indicate how many tonnes of asphalt have been exported since the motion was adopted, where to, and by whom?
Vraag 3 Kunt u aangeven hoeveel ton asfalt sinds het aannemen van de motie is geëxporteerd, waarheen en door wie?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elias over de kwetsbaarheid van vangrails

An MP asks the minister about a truck that broke through a median guardrail on the A1, how this fits earlier statements that guardrails are adequate for heavier trucks (LZVs), and whether Dutch guardrails are designed for proposed 44-tonne vehicles. The minister answers that such breaches are rare and depend on circumstances, that the H2 performance class was chosen on cost-effectiveness and accident analysis, and that the current class is considered sufficient without committing to new measures.
I do not consider it necessary to assume the heaviest vehicles and the most unfavourable impact conditions.
Ik acht het niet noodzakelijk van de zwaarste voertuigen en de ongunstigste inrijdcondities uit te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven inzake de benoeming van de heer Meijdam door de provincie Noord-Holland in de gebiedscommissie Amstel, Gooi en Vecht

An SP MP asked the minister whether the appointment of Mr Meijdam to the Amstel, Gooi en Vecht area committee by the province of Noord-Holland was wise, given earlier secrecy about a report on the KNSF site and his resignation from another provincial post, and whether the appointment would be reversed. The minister confirmed the appointment, said the province saw no obstacles and that the reasons for appointing former officials are for the province and the person concerned, and declined to reverse it.
The reasons for (former) officials to sit on a committee on behalf of the province are a matter for the province concerned and the (former) official concerned.
De redenen voor (voormalig) bestuurders om namens de provincie zitting te hebben in een commissie is een zaak van de betreffende provincie en de betreffende (voormalig) bestuurder.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bosman over het vangstverbod voor wolhandkrab

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the ban on catching Chinese mitten crab in Dutch waters, citing reports suggesting limited health risk and the export potential of clean crab, and asking whether the ban should be reconsidered. The government answered that the latest risk assessment still shows elevated risks from high-dioxin brown meat in closed areas, that the ban stays, and that it declined to give a full opinion on some questions pending interdepartmental coordination.
The most recent analysis results for the mitten crab and the risk assessment by the bureau give me no reason to reconsider this catch ban.
De meest recente analyseresultaten van de wolhandkrab en de risicobeoordeling door bureau geven mij geen aanleiding op dit vangstverbod terug te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Bashir over “premieshoppen op Cyprus”

MPs Ulenbelt and Bashir asked about Dutch lorry drivers employed through Cypriot agencies to pay social premiums in Cyprus, and about SVB and inspectorate controls. The minister says the SVB applies EU coordination rules, has had slow information exchange with Cyprus, will ask Cyprus to investigate, and promises an integrated approach to sham constructions by 1 May.
By 1 May at the latest I will inform you about an integrated approach to curbing sham constructions.
Uiterlijk 1 mei zal ik u informeren over een integrale aanpak voor het terugdringen van schijnconstructies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over energiebesparing door minder en duurzame verlichting

An MP asked the government about reducing energy use through less and more sustainable road and building lighting, including switching off road lighting after 21:00, dimmable or presence-sensitive lighting, LED road markings, cooperation with provinces and municipalities, night-time lighting rules for offices and shops, and designating dark areas. The state secretary answered that the road-lighting switch-off was being prepared for spring 2013, that presence-sensitive lighting is unsuitable on main roads, that existing rules already cover energy-saving measures in buildings, and that dark-area designation is a provincial responsibility, though the topic can be raised with local climate ambassadors.
However, I am willing to raise this topic at the local level in the consultations with the 'climate ambassadors'.
Wel ben ik bereid om in het overleg met de «klimaatambassadeurs» dit onderwerp op lokaal niveau te agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over het transitokenteken voor de doorvoer van niet-gekentekende voertuigen

An MP asked the minister whether the transit plate for non-registered vehicles is rarely used due to strict requirements and whether it disadvantages Dutch exporters compared with other countries. The minister replied that the plate protects road safety and prevents theft, that the RDW procedure is efficient, and that she is willing to explore faster procedures with the sector but will not allow administrative issuance because of fraud.
I am certainly willing to examine with the sector whether the procedures can be made faster and better, but returning to administrative issuance is not an option because of fraud.
Ik ben zeker bereid met de sector te onderzoeken of de procedures nog sneller en beter kunnen, maar teruggaan naar het verleden met administratieve verstrekking is vanwege fraude geen optie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Eijsink over het bericht dat de Hydrografische Dienst de verschijning van de 1800-serie kaarten opschort

Two MPs asked whether suspending the spring publication of the 1800-series nautical charts endangers navigation safety and whether digital publication is possible. The government answered that safety is not compromised because free online notices to mariners keep charts current, that budget cuts and Northsea traffic-scheme changes justify ending the annual spring edition, and that a new system may enable digital editions.
The budget cuts at Defence also affect the processing and production capacity of the Hydrographic Service.
De bezuinigingen bij Defensie treffen ook de verwerking- en productiecapaciteit van de Dienst der Hydrografie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over een hardheidsclausule bij annulering van rijexamens door het winterweer

An MP asked the minister whether the CBR's cancellation of motorcycle exams due to winter weather could be remedied through a hardship clause for under-24 candidates facing the new licence rules, and how many were affected. The minister said the EU directive is binding and leaves no room for old-style licences, but agreed to financially compensate affected under-24 candidates for extra costs and asked the CBR to elaborate this.

I am willing to financially compensate candidates for a motorcycle licence under 24 who could not take their exam in January due to weather conditions for the extra costs they face under the new regulation.

Ik ben bereid om de kandidaten voor het motorrijbewijs onder de 24 jaar die vanwege de weersomstandigheden in januari geen examen konden doen, financieel tegemoet te komen in de extra kosten die zij onder de nieuwe regeling hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Raak over de aankoop door de Rijksgebouwendienst van een kantoorpand in Den Haag

SP MPs Paulus Jansen and Van Raak asked why the Rijksgebouwendienst bought an office building in The Hague near the Eurojust site, questioning the fit with the vacant-office convenant and whether vacant state property could have been used, and asked for an overview of state-owned offices. The minister confirmed the purchase for €7.9 million as part of arrangements for a possible future Eurojust expansion, said it does not conflict with the convenant, and promised an overview plus a forthcoming joint plan with the municipality.

With the purchase of the building, effect is given to the agreements between the Dutch State and Eurojust to make a possible future expansion of Eurojust feasible in the immediate vicinity of the new building.

Met de aankoop van het pand wordt invulling gegeven aan de afspraken tussen de Nederlandse Staat en Eurojust om een mogelijke uitbreiding van Eurojust in de toekomst mogelijk te maken in de directe nabijheid van de nieuwbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over de Boordcomputer Taxi (BCT)

MP De Rouwe asked the minister about reports that the mandatory on-board computer for taxis (BCT) may not be certified in time for the 1 October 2013 deadline, and whether an extension is needed. The state secretary answered that development was left to the market, that manufacturers expect certification in February-March 2013, that no agreements were made on late availability, and that she is willing to grant some extension if the deadline proves unworkable, with the Chamber to be informed.
Yes, in view of the answer to question 4. I have consistently indicated that I am keeping a close watch on the situation.
Ja, gelet op het antwoord op vraag 4. Ik heb steeds aangegeven dat ik de vinger aan de pols houd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Rouwe over het bericht 'Ministerie wijst WOB-verzoek Kiwa-contract af'

The MP asks why a WOB request on the Kiwa contract was refused despite a European tender, how the 2013 tachograph card and transport permit fees were set, how industry was involved, and how Dutch fees compare with other EU states. The minister says the contract contains confidential business and employee information and public-interest negotiating considerations, that fees were only raised for inflation after consulting industry, and that he has no insight into fee-setting in other member states.
The request was refused because the agreement contains confidential business data of Kiwa N.V. and labour-law information about employees.
Het verzoek is geweigerd omdat de overeenkomst vertrouwelijke bedrijfsgegevens van Kiwa N.V. en arbeidsrechtelijke informatie met betrekking tot medewerkers bevat
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de werking van het in-car alarmeringssysteem eCall, waarover bij hulpdiensten onduidelijkheid heerst

An MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether fire and emergency services are prepared for the in-car eCall system, whether it links directly to the 112 centres, whether 112 notifications will rise, and whether eCall triggers on every accident. The minister replied that no EU obligation exists yet, that the 112 responsibility lies with the Security and Justice ministry, that a direct 112 link is used in the HeERO project, that notifications will be limited initially, and that eCall will trigger only on serious crashes.
I would point out that responsibility for receiving and handling eCall emergency calls ("112 notifications") rests with my colleague at the Ministry of Security and Justice.

Ik wil u overigens aangeven dat de verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontvangen en afhandelen van eCall noodoproepen («112-meldingen») bij mijn collega van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie berust.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat rijexamens door de sneeuw zijn uitgesteld

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the roughly 1766 driving tests postponed by snow and whether candidates whose tests were scheduled before the new EU licence rules took effect on 19 January 2013 could still sit under the old regime. The minister said the old rules could no longer legally be applied after that date, that adapting the automated system would take months, and that the agency would examine free re-tests for affected motorcyclists.
It is legally not possible to continue conducting examinations and issuing driving licences under the old regime after 19 January 2013.
Het is juridisch niet mogelijk om na 19 januari 2013 door te gaan met het afnemen van examens en het afgeven van rijbewijzen onder de oude regeling.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Knops over de voorgenomen sluiting op- en afrit Nuth (A76)

MPs De Rouwe and Knops asked why the Nuth A76 on/off ramp is to be closed while a new ramp is planned nearby, and about rat-running traffic and consultation with the province and municipalities. The minister answered that the closure is agreed in a 2010 convenant, is part of the Parkstad Buitenring plan led by the province, and that the province, as competent authority, handles the trade-offs and consultation.
The province of Limburg is the responsible competent authority and has initiated a PIP procedure to weigh the interests.
De provincie Limburg is het verantwoordelijke bevoegde gezag en heeft ten behoeve van de belangenafweging een PIP-procedure ingezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de oplopende wachttijden voor rijexamens bij het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An SP MP asked the minister about rising waiting times for driving tests at the CBR, whether they are reasonable, whether labour negotiations are linked, and whether capacity is sufficient. The minister said waiting times are mostly within the 7-week norm (exceptions for re-tests in two locations), sees no reason to intervene, denies a link with the CAO talks, and states capacity is adequate, with the late-2012 rise attributed to the new EU directive and snow.
Given the development outlined under question 1, I see no reason to intervene.
Gezien de onder vraag 1 geschetste ontwikkeling zie ik geen reden in te grijpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verdwijnen van de Beneluxtrein en het ontbreken van een alternatieve snelle verbinding voor West-Brabant

An MP asked whether the Amsterdam–Brussels intercity was being replaced by the more expensive Fyra with no West-Brabant stop and lower frequency, and asked about capacity, the reservation requirement and an alternative Antwerp–Roosendaal–Breda connection. The state secretary confirmed the Beneluxtrein ended and the Fyra runs with reduced frequency, announced a fast Breda–Antwerp link from April 2013 without reservation, and explained the reservation rules are a matter for the operators.
That is why I have made every effort to secure a direct and fast rail connection between Belgium and North Brabant.
Daarom heb ik mij tot het uiterste ingespannen voor een directe en snelle treinverbinding tussen België en Noord-Brabant.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Fokke over de vervuiling van oppervlaktewater door microplastics

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about microplastics and nanomaterials polluting surface water, including measures on cosmetics, research on health effects, filtering, and producer responsibility. The minister answered that the government focuses on source-based action, ongoing research, EU cosmetics rules, and a voluntary packaging agreement, without yet filtering microplastics from water.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment for now steers towards a source-based approach.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu stuurt vooralsnog aan op een brongerichte aanpak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht in het Algemeen Dagblad ‘Een op de vijf rijscholen werkt zwart’

An MP asked the ministers whether driving schools that appear to under-report revenue, and whether cheap lessons and possible examination irregularities, warrant action, and asked about instructor entry requirements and entrepreneurship training. The government said the Tax Administration is targeting about 20% of driving schools with a themed approach, that discrepancies do not automatically imply fraud, and declined to judge the entry requirements while the WRM evaluation is ongoing.
The intention is to take firm action against driving school owners who deliberately commit fraud.
Daarbij is het de bedoeling dat bewust frauderende rijschoolhouders krachtig worden aangepakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Maij over het slopen van schepen op stranden in Azië

Two MPs asked the government about deaths during ship breaking on Asian beaches after a Nieuwsuur broadcast, and whether it would set minimum safety, environmental and labour conditions and engage shipowners and financiers. The minister said the Netherlands supports the Hong Kong Convention and an EU ship recycling regulation, notes voluntary industry initiatives, and sees no need to convene shipowners and financiers.
The Netherlands actively contributes to the adoption of this European regulation so that ship dismantling takes place in a safe and environmentally responsible manner.
Nederland draagt actief bij aan de totstandkoming van deze Europese verordening om het slopen van schepen op een veilige en milieuverantwoorde manier te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het afschieten van herten omwille van de openstelling van een ecoduct

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked the state secretary about the culling of deer near the Hierden/A28 ecoduct, questioning who initiated it, its cost, the buffer zone, consistency with animal welfare, and the central government's role. The state secretary answered that the ecoduct was a national-funded MJPO project on provincial initiative, that culling follows the provincial Faunabeheerplan and is unrelated to the ecoduct, and that natural policy is decentralised so the province is responsible.
Because of the decentralisation of nature policy, the province is responsible.
Vanwege de decentralisatie van het natuurbeleid is de provincie verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de pilot tot legaliseren van recreatiepark Patersven in Zundert

An SP MP asked the minister about the status and evaluation of the pilot to legalise the Patersven recreation park in Zundert, and about the consequences for owners' expectations and planning damage claims. The minister replied that the municipality ended the process in December 2011, that evaluation and legalisation decisions are the municipality's responsibility, that owners keep their existing legal status, and that the national government collects no data on other cases.
It is for the municipality to decide whether the pilot project is evaluated or not.
Het is derhalve aan de gemeente om te bepalen of het pilotproject al dan niet wordt geëvalueerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Treinkaartjes naar België fors duurder' en over de hoge tarieven op de Hanzelijn

An MP asked about reported sharp fare increases on rail routes, including the Hanzelijn and Amsterdam–Brussels Fyra service. The state secretary said the Hanzelijn fares shown were wrong due to a routing error, that Fyra fares are set commercially by NS Hispeed and NMBS, and that the government will monitor market response.
As a result, the displayed fares are not correct.
Daardoor zijn de weergegeven tarieven niet juist.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en De Rouwe over het persbericht ‘Studenten onredelijk behandeld bij defecte OV-chipkaart’

Two CDA MPs asked why students cannot receive a temporary replacement for a defective OV-chipkaart as other travellers can, and whether DUO, RSR and TLS exchange enough information. The minister explains that student privacy rules (privacy by design) prevent carriers from verifying students, that no exception is planned, and that only efforts to speed up replacement will be explored.
The privacy provisions will not be changed.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Veldhoven over de kwartaalrapportage van het OV loket waarin wordt gesteld dat studenten onredelijk worden behandeld bij een defecte OV-chipkaart

Two D66 MPs asked why students get no replacement OV-chipkaart at counters while other travellers do, citing an ombudsman report calling this unequal and unnecessary. The minister answered that privacy rules prevent carriers from verifying student status, that these rules will not change, and that only faster replacement is being explored.
For students this service is not possible with any carrier, for privacy reasons.
Voor studenten is deze service om privacyredenen bij geen enkele vervoerder mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over de studenten OV-chipkaart

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why students cannot use the temporary replacement and refund arrangements available to other OV-chipkaart holders, and whether one uniform scheme could be created. The minister replied that student data protection rules prevent carriers from verifying students, so the differences remain, though the government judges the refund process not unduly complicated.
For privacy reasons, individual carriers may never have access to students' personal data.
Om privacyredenen zullen individuele vervoerders nooit over de persoonsgegevens van studenten mogen beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Bashir en Van Tongeren inzake publieke functies voorzitter Raad voor de Leefomgeving

MPs Van Gerven and Bashir asked whether the chair of the Raad voor de Leefomgeving en Infrastructuur, Meijdam, should step down given questions about his integrity and an appearance of conflict of interest, while also chairing the Meijdam committee on the OV-chipkaart. The minister answered that transparency safeguards were agreed (code on conflicts of interest, disclosure of ancillary positions, ending his lobbying activities) and saw no reason for further measures.

Thirdly, I made agreements with the chair of the Rli well before his appointment that he would cease his activities as a lobbyist for building companies and developers regarding plots and positions, after completion of ongoing assignments.

Ten derde heb ik met de voorzitter van de Rli al ruim vóór zijn aantreden afspraken gemaakt dat hij zijn activiteiten als belangenbehartiger voor plots en posities van bouwbedrijven en ontwikkelaars zou staken, na afronding van lopende opdrachten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Geurts naar aanleiding van het artikel ‘De meerwaarde van dynamisch rekenen aan emissies’ d.d. 31 oktober 2012 van Verkeersadviesbureau Goudappel Coffeng en de Universiteit Twe

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether static traffic models ignore congestion and whether dynamic models should be used to re-examine air quality and noise at knooppunten like the A10 and A13 and to modernise the models. The minister rejected both, saying static models give reliable forecasts for air and noise policy while dynamic models suit detailed design and traffic management.
No. Static models provide good forecasts of future traffic volumes and the associated effects.
Nee. Statische modellen leveren goede prognoses van de verkeersomvang in de toekomst en de bijbehorende effecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Fokke over de berichtgeving dat het gebruik van statische verkeersmodellen zou kunnen leiden tot verkeerde beleidskeuzes

MPs Kuiken and Fokke asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about press reports that static traffic models could lead to wrong policy choices, and whether dynamic models should be used instead. The minister answered that static models underpin environmental measures for road projects and noise/air programmes, that dynamic models are used for traffic management and road design details, and that static models are more accurate for future traffic volumes while dynamic models are more accurate for flow details.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf over het artikel “wie weet hoe hard je waar mag rijden”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment whether speed-limit signs on Dutch motorways are incorrect or unclear and how fines based on wrong signage would be dealt with. The minister answered that about 100 locations were improved after an inspection, that controllers check signage before enforcement and report errors, and that people can object fines at the Public Prosecution Service.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over geluidsoverlast langs de HSL-Zuid bij Breda

Two SP MPs asked the minister whether she endorsed a student report finding that noise standards along the HSL-Zuid near Breda are exceeded at several locations and that noise screens underperform. The state secretary rejected the conclusions as based on measurements not meeting Dutch rules and wrong legal assumptions, but committed to honour the tracébesluit noise limits and to decide on additional measures after pending TNO measurements and pilot effect studies.
Yes, I will of course keep my commitment.
Ja, ik zal mijn toezegging vanzelfsprekend nakomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Bontes over het artikel ‘Drugrunners vechten met NS-personeel’

MPs De Graaf, Helder and Bontes asked whether a permanent public transport ban, a permanent police post at Rotterdam CS, tasers for NS staff, and broader group liability should follow a violent attack on NS staff by drug runners. The minister answered that a travel and stay ban bill is being prepared, that the police post will return after renovation, that tasers have no legal basis for NS staff, and that existing criminal law suffices.
A bill amending the Passenger Transport Act 2000 to allow a stay ban at stations, for example, is currently being prepared.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een voorstel tot wetswijziging van de Wet personenvervoer 2000 ten behoeve van een verblijfsverbod op bijvoorbeeld een station.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over de aanpak van koperdiefstal

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about copper theft, including low arrest rates, registration of thefts by the KLPD, and delays on the railways. The government answered that arrest rates rose slightly, that registration is handled through agreed codes, and that the Actie Koperslag convenant progress report was sent to parliament.
In the first half of 2012, 13 suspects of copper theft (mainly on the railways) were arrested.
In de eerste helft van 2012 zijn 13 verdachten van koperdiefstal (vooral op het spoor) aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over ambulances op de vluchtstrook

An ChristenUnie MP asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment and of Health about ambulances using the hard shoulder, including why buses get exemptions while B-transport ambulances must queue and request permission per ride, and about a terminal cancer patient stuck in traffic. The minister referred to earlier answers, said the Amsterdam dispatch centre had no record of the incident, reported no signals of frequent refusals, and noted that existing rules already allow upgrading B-rides to A-rides, with the health minister to clarify scope with the ambulance association.
To give a substantively correct answer about the incident mentioned, it is important to have the date, time and possibly patient details and/or ride number.
Om inhoudelijk een correct antwoord te kunnen geven op het genoemde incident is het van belang om over datum, tijdstip en eventueel patiëntgegevens en/of ritnummer te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elissen over ambulances die nog steeds niet over de busbaan mogen rijden

An MP asked ministers why ambulances still cannot use bus lanes despite a 2011 motion, and questioned the delay in implementing it. The minister acknowledges the delay, says overlap with a related Kamervragen answer caused it, and points to a reply sent to the Tweede Kamer stating no regulatory change is needed.
Unfortunately, a response to the motion and answering the questions from MP Wiegman required much consultation, which caused delays in handling.
Tot mijn spijt heeft een reactie op de motie en de beantwoording van de vragen van lid Wiegman veel overleg gekost, waardoor vertraging in de afhandeling is opgetreden.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber over de kosten voor een (defecte) OV-chipkaart

An MP asked why Trans Link Systems now charges €11 for replacing a defective OV-chipkaart versus €7.50 for a new card, who decided the increase, whether consumer groups were consulted, and whether the price should be lowered. The minister confirmed the new replacement price, said operators and TLS decided it without a formal consumer role, noted replacement costs include transferring subscriptions, and declined to lower the price.
The General Conditions of the OV-chipkaart apply to the application, issue, use and surrender of a personal and anonymous OV-chipkaart issued by TLS.
De Algemene Voorwaarden OV-chipkaart zijn van toepassing op de aanvraag, uitgifte, gebruik en inname van een door TLS uitgegeven persoonlijke en anonieme OV-chipkaart.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “Oprichting sloopfonds kantoren loopt spaak” en “Huurder kantoor is lachende derde”

An MP asks the minister about reports that municipalities oppose a demolition fund for vacant offices and fear subsidies keep office prices high, and asks how the convenant on vacant offices survives without municipal approval. The minister says the fund is optional, will not talk with municipalities that have already refused, keeps talks open with others, and says all parties must take responsibility, with progress reviewed in early 2013.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht “Oprichting sloopfonds kantoren loopt spaak”

An MP asked the minister about reports that a demolition fund for empty offices had stalled after some municipalities objected to public money, and whether a fund under the office vacancy convenant is compulsory or could threaten prices. The minister replied that VNG support has not been withdrawn, that the fund is voluntary and market-led, that no price distortion is expected, and that the national expert team is operating.
It is explicitly intended that the desire to establish an office fund comes from the bottom up.
Het is nadrukkelijk de bedoeling dat de wens om te komen tot een kantorenfonds «van onderop komt».
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht dat er bijna geen mobiele dekking op Utrecht C.S. is

Mr Monasch (PvdA) asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether NS refuses to cooperate on a solution to nearly absent mobile coverage at Utrecht Centraal and whether the minister will mediate. The minister replied that NS is not refusing, is working on a fix including free wifi at major stations and talks with telecom providers to improve capacity this year.
NS is in talks with various telecom providers to improve capacity at the major stations this year.
NS is in gesprek met diverse telecom-aanbieders om de capaciteit op de grote stations nog dit jaar te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘Weg-verbreding leeglopende A9 stuit op kritiek”

An MP asked the minister whether widening the A9 from four to ten lanes is still needed given falling traffic, and asked for a new cost-benefit analysis. The minister said traffic fell mainly due to a shift to the parallel A10, forecasts still expect growth to 2030, no new CPB study is needed, and the Amsterdam Zuidoost tunnel design has changed with an equivalent effect on the environment.
I attach importance to decisions taken with public support being implemented in line with the advice of the Elverding committee, and additional research is not needed for that.
Ik hecht eraan met draagvlak genomen besluiten uit te voeren conform de adviezen van de commissie Elverding en een aanvullend onderzoek is daarvoor niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over het be-richt ‘Wegverbreding leeglopende A9 stuit op kritiek”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about criticism of widening the A9, given falling traffic volumes since 2005 and a CPB second opinion showing the A9 widening alone has lower social benefits than costs. The minister acknowledged the traffic decline but expects structural growth to 2030, and said the CPB did not advise studying postponement and that a technically different, cheaper tunnel design is being pursued via the Tracébesluit amendment procedure.
For this I am going through the amendment procedure for the Tracébesluit, in which I am mapping out the effects mentioned.
Ik doorloop hiervoor de wijzigingsprocedure voor het Tracébesluit, waarbij ik de genoemde effecten in kaart breng.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het transport van gevaarlijke stoffen over de weg

An MP asked ministers about inspection findings that around 30% of trucks carrying dangerous goods failed safety rules, mostly minor lapses, and about gaps in emergency-services knowledge and incident management. The government accepted the inspection finding, said most violations are minor and the industry is primarily responsible, pointed to ongoing ILT inspections and existing emergency-response arrangements, and disputed that cooperation with emergency services is insufficient.
I endorse the conclusion of the ILT.
Ik onderschrijf de conclusie van de ILT.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken over de onveilige situaties als gevolg van de inzet van niet gekwalificeerde Poolse en Hongaarse chauffeurs bij transport van gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Wolbert and Kuiken asked the minister about unqualified Polish and Hungarian drivers transporting dangerous goods, following a ZEMBLA broadcast alleging certificates were bought without training. The minister replied that certificate oversight lies with the country of origin, that the ILT checks certificates and fines violations, and that the issue will be raised with member states and the Commission.
I am also willing to raise this issue with the member states concerned and the European Commission.
Ik ben ook bereid deze kwestie bij de betrokken lidstaten en de Europese Commissie aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Haverkamp over het bericht “NMa geeft nog geen toestemming voor overdracht reisinformatie naar NS”

An MP asked the minister why the competition authority NMa had not finished its review of the transfer of travel information from ProRail to NS in time, and about effects on operations, the winter weather programme and a rail disruption at Schiphol. The minister answered that the NMa approved the transfer in October 2012 on conditions after NS and ProRail revised the proposal, that current operations continued unchanged meanwhile, and that the disruption was caused by a backup power failure and measures are being taken.
Now that the NMa has given the green light, the transfer can also be formally completed in the short term, observing the conditions the NMa attached to its decision.
Nu de NMa groen licht heeft gegeven, kan de overdracht op korte termijn ook formeel worden afgerond met inachtneming van de voorwaarden die de NMa aan haar besluit heeft gesteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over het bericht “Wordt de reizigersinformatie beter als de NS het gaat verzorgen?”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the delayed transfer of passenger information from ProRail to NS, its consequences for travellers, and any conflict with other carriers. The minister answered that the NMa has now cleared the transfer subject to conditions, that NS and regional carriers are resuming talks on non-discriminatory service, and that the transfer remains government policy.
Yes, the report is known to me.
Ja, het bericht is mij bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over open data in het openbaar vervoer

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment about open data for public transport, including compliance with the reporting duty under the Besluit Personenvervoer 2000, licensing terms, the NDOV loket timeline and budget. The minister answered that operators supply static data and most supply real-time data, that no enforcement is needed because concession agreements cover data delivery, and that the NDOV criteria are a minimum requirement with budget largely unspent.
Since the decentralised authorities have agreed in their concessions on the supply of data, I see no need at this time to enforce the provisions of the Besluit personenvervoer.

Aangezien de decentrale overheden in hun concessies afspraken hebben gemaakt met betrekking tot levering van gegevens, zie ik geen noodzaak op dit moment tot handhaving van de bepalingen uit het Besluit personenvervoer over te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Geurts en De Rouwe over meetresultaten luchtkwaliteit A13

CDA MPs asked the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat used incorrect traffic data in noise and air quality studies for the A13 near Overschie, and whether it would be sent to parliament and corrected. The minister admitted a wrong table in the noise report's annex 1b (calculations used correct figures), sent the data, said the air study used correct figures, and said the error was raised in the pending objection procedure with no consequences for the speed increase.
A check by Rijkswaterstaat showed that the noise report contained, unfortunately, a table with incorrect data in annex 1b.
Een toets hierop door Rijkswaterstaat heeft laten zien dat er in het rapport van het geluidonderzoek helaas in bijlage 1b een tabel met verkeerde gegevens opgenomen is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en De Rouwe over spoedwerkzaamheden om de Lauwersmeerdijk te verstevigen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the minister about emergency reinforcement works on the Lauwersmeerdijk, earlier 2010 test results, other weakened dikes, innovative monitoring and the 2013 budget cut. The state secretary answered that the works prevent an acute safety problem, that the dike failed the third test round and will be addressed in the nHWBP programme to be fixed in 2014, and that the budget cut has no effect on 2013 works.
The emergency works on the Lauwersmeerdijk prevent an acute safety problem, as the channel has shifted landward.
Met de spoedwerkzaamheden aan de Lauwersmeerdijk wordt een acuut veiligheidsprobleem, doordat de geul zich landwaarts heeft verplaatst, voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Slob over de veiling van GSM-frequenties en de mogelijke interferentie met GSM-Rail

MP Slob asked ministers whether the 2012 auction of mobile frequencies would cause interference with GSM-R railway communications, including its frequency, costs, safeguards and whether licence conditions protect rail safety. The ministers acknowledge interference at several sites, describe filters, a new 'adequate protection' licence condition, ongoing studies of signal-strength ceilings and cost questions, and state that no irreversible steps have been taken before the auction starts on 31 October 2012.

On 18 April 2012 I informed your House that the start of the application procedure for potential auction participants from 16 April 2012 is not an irreversible step regarding the resolution of the possible interference problems.

Op 18 april 2012 heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat de start van de aanvraagprocedure voor potentiële deelnemers aan de veiling vanaf 16 april 2012 geen onomkeerbare stap is met betrekking tot het oplossen van de mogelijke interferentieproblemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de NS die in een brief aan haar leveranciers te kennen heeft gegeven dat ze 3 maanden moeten gaan wachten op hun geld

An MP asks the ministers whether NS, the state-owned railway company, may impose 90-day payment terms with a 4% discount on its suppliers, and how SMEs can resist and what the government will do. The ministers reply that NS withdrew the letter and keeps the 30-day norm, that the state as shareholder will not intervene, and that the late-payment directive does not apply to NS but 30 days remains the norm.
NS has now withdrawn this letter.
NS heeft deze brief inmiddels ingetrokken
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent naar aanleiding van het bericht dat NS de plannen van ProRail voor het schrappen van wissels vreest

MP Van Gent (GroenLinks) asked whether NS fears ProRail's plans to remove switches, whether NS experts warned of timetable problems, and whether switch removal caused high-speed departure delays and cost-cutting drove it. Minister Schultz denied any disagreement, said no switch is changed without consultation with operators, attributed the delays to a defective bridge anchorage, and said the minister decides on significant changes after advice from stakeholders.
I am not aware of any documents in which NS experts state that ProRail's plans would lead to timetable problems.
Ik ken geen documenten waarin experts van NS stellen dat de plannen van ProRail zouden leiden tot problemen met de dienstregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe over de vertraging bij de verbreding van de N35 tussen Zwolle en Wijthmen

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why the widening of the N35 between Zwolle and Wijthmen is delayed by eleven months, what the cause is, and whether the region can take over management of the road. The minister confirmed the delay (about one year, cause: budget shortfall and new noise rules), set a 2015 completion target, referred to the regional agreements, and declined to decentralise management of the national road network.
My ambition is now to complete the project in 2015.
Mijn ambitie is nu om het project in 2015 op te leveren.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over de vertraging ten aanzien van de start Fyra-verbinding Antwerpen – Breda

An MP from D66 asks the Minister why the Fyra high-speed service between Breda and Antwerp is delayed again, why contact with Belgian minister Magnette has been slow, and what the consequences are for the Beneluxtrein and finances. The Minister answers that the start depends on a financing agreement on the Belgian side, that talks with Magnette were only recently scheduled, that the Beneluxtrein will be replaced, and gives no expected start date.
This consultation has now been scheduled.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Haverkamp over station Naarden Bussum

An MP asked the minister about long level-crossing closure times at Naarden Bussum station, including whether ProRail's findings could be shared early, whether narrowing the crossing and separating traffic would help, and whether the minister would seek cost estimates for a pedestrian and cycle tunnel. The minister answered that ProRail's results are expected in spring 2013 and cannot be shared earlier, that narrowing and separation would improve safety and shorten closures, and that a planning study and talks with the municipalities are underway.
Given the way this research programme is carried out, it is not possible to make information about this specific level crossing available earlier.
Gezien de wijze waarop dit onderzoeksprogramma wordt uitgevoerd is het niet mogelijk informatie over deze specifieke overweg eerder ter beschikking te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Jong en Helder over het bericht Controle A2 op 23 juli in werking

Two PVV MPs asked whether traffic enforcement should focus on urban roads rather than motorway speed checks, whether the 100 km/h limit on the A2 should be raised, and whether the A2 speed trajectory checks should stop as a revenue measure. The minister replied that speed enforcement on motorways serves safety, air quality and noise goals, that the limit may be raised to 130 km/h at night and evening between Vinkeveen and Maarssen via a forthcoming traffic decision, and that the checks will not be stopped because they were agreed with neighbouring municipalities.
I am therefore not willing to stop this.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid hiermee te stoppen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over dubieuze faillissementen en doorstarters in de transportsector

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked ministers about bankruptcy fraud and abusive re-startups in the transport sector, including whether curators' criminal complaints and Dutch-German cross-border transport permits are adequately handled. The ministers answered that an integrated anti-fraud approach is underway, an analysis of bankruptcy fraud is being prepared, and Dutch and German authorities have strengthened cooperation on transport licences, but they declined to add further measures or meet with the unions and foundation.

In addition to this report, I can inform your House that an analysis of bankruptcy fraud is being drawn up, on the basis of which the information position and cooperation in the chain can be further strengthened.

In aanvulling op deze rapportage kan ik uw Kamer melden dat er een analyse faillissementsfraude wordt opgesteld op basis waarvan de informatiepositie en de samenwerking in de keten verder kan worden versterkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Slob over realisatie van station Barneveld-Zuid

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about delays to the Barneveld-Zuid railway station, including its opening date, a temporary stop, and whether ProRail's linking with the Barneveld Noord double-track project was justified. The minister answered that ProRail expects opening in 2015, that the delay was partly due to a link with the Barneveld Noord project which has since been revised, that a temporary facility is not a clear option, and that a cost-effective capacity package on the Valleilijn will be sent to the House once NS agrees.
I am willing to send the elaboration of the cost-effective measures to improve the robustness of the Valleilijn to the House of Representatives as soon as it is available.
Ik ben bereid de uitwerking van de kosteneffectieve maatregelen ter verbetering van de robuustheid van de Valleilijn aan de Tweede Kamer toe te zenden, zodra die beschikbaar is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dijsselbloem over de (on)veiligheid op en rond het water

Two MPs asked ministers about drowning risk, reduced lifeguard supervision in the Gelderland river area, subsidies to lifeguard organisations and who is responsible for supervision. The state secretary answered that supervision is a local decision, that the ministry funds a regional lifeguard cooperation but not local brigades, and that no supervision requirements will be included in the new Zwemwaterwet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bemmel over het bericht “Amsterdam wil publiek geld inzetten voor sloop”

An MP from the PVV asks whether public money should be used to demolish vacant offices in Amsterdam and whether the government will object to this plan and inform the VNG. The minister answers that office owners are primarily responsible, points to the national convenant on vacant offices, says the Amsterdam regional fund is a municipal autonomy matter, and declines to intervene or inform the VNG.
In my view this is a clear case of municipal autonomy.
Mijns inziens betreft het hier een duidelijk geval van gemeentelijke autonomie.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent en Hachchi over de verwoestende olievervuiling op de kusten van Curaçao

Two MPs asked whether PdVSA delayed acting on an oil leak at Bullenbaai, Curaçao, what the scale was, whether it was deliberate, and whether the Kingdom government should intervene given PdVSA's record. The minister answered that the government cannot judge the cause and that the Curaçao prime minister's investigation may clarify it, that the situation is an incident rather than irreversible, and that Curaçao as an autonomous country must lead the response and prevent recurrence.
Curaçao is an autonomous country within the Kingdom. It is therefore up to the government of Curaçao to lead the further containment of the pollution and the clean-up operations.
Curaçao is een autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk. Het is daarom aan de regering van Curaçao om leiding te geven aan verdere indamming van de vervuiling en de opruimwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Elias en Van der Steur over misbruik door NS van gegevens van de OV -chipkaart

MPs Elias and Van der Steur asked the ministers whether NS misused OV-chipkaart travel data for marketing, as the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) found, whether this breached 2008 agreements, and what would ensure the misuse has stopped. The minister accepts the CBP's findings, notes NS has already destroyed the data and changed its practice, and states that monitoring and enforcement lie with the CBP rather than with the government.
The CBP is charged with supervising compliance with and enforcement of the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp).
Het CBP is belast met toezicht op de naleving en handhaving van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over  een landelijke norm voor het aandeel groen in steden en dorpen

An MP asked the minister whether the UN green standard of 48 m2 per inhabitant is met in Dutch cities, and about the health, water and biodiversity benefits of urban green and whether a joint action plan with the VNG would follow. The minister said that about half of the 31 largest municipalities exceed the 75 m2 per dwelling benchmark, that no per-inhabitant figures exist, endorsed the benefits in general terms, and said green is a municipal responsibility, pointing to existing Rijk support programmes and a three-year intention declaration with the VNG.
No analyses are available of square metres of green per inhabitant in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen analyses beschikbaar van vierkante meters groen per bewoner in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Grashoff over de weigering van Rijkswaterstaat folders van stichting de Batavier ter inzage te leggen

An MP asks why Rijkswaterstaat refused to display folder material from citizen initiative Stichting de Batavier in the A4 Delft-Schiedam information centre, and how this fits the open planning advice of the Elverding committee. The minister answers that government information centres should not mix in third-party material to avoid confusion over sender, that Batavier can distribute its material at information meetings, that it has regular consultation with RWS, and that the Elverding advice has been followed with agreements kept and monitored in consultation groups.
By also housing information from other parties at a government centre, confusion may arise about who the sender is.
Door informatie van andere partijen ook bij een overheidscentrum onder te brengen, kan er verwarring ontstaan over het afzenderschap.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de grote zorgen bij de kleine binnenvaart

An SP MP asked the ministers about serious concerns in the small inland shipping sector, including fears for vessels under 1000 tonnes, bottom tariffs, crisis measures and the modal shift target. The minister responded that market parties bear primary responsibility, that regulatory changes depend on the Central Commission for Rhine Navigation, that a Transition Committee is implementing structural recommendations, and that no short-term crisis measures are feasible.
I sent this report to the House on 16 November 2011, together with my response.
Ik heb dit rapport op 16 november 2011 samen met mijn zienswijze naar de Kamer gestuurd
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent inzake het bericht dat er geen controles zullen zijn door het ontbreken van verkeersborden

An MP asked the minister whether the lack of correct speed-limit signs on some motorway sections meant no enforcement, and whether the speed increase should be suspended until signs were in place. The minister replied that the signs were placed on time per guidelines, that enforcement continues, that the speed increase is accepted safety-wise, and that complaints can be reported to Rijkswaterstaat or the ANWB.
The signs were placed in accordance with the guidelines and on time.
De borden zijn conform de richtlijnen en op tijd geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Alarm over gifalg’

An MP asked why water from the Ouwerkerkse Kreek was pumped into the Oosterschelde after a toxic algae species was detected and a swimming ban issued, who decides on discharge of poor-quality water, and whether water boards can isolate contaminated water. The state secretary answered that discharge stopped on 7 August after joint Rijkswaterstaat and water board decision, that Rijkswaterstaat as waterbeheerder decides on admissibility, and that the water board isolated the creek and adjusted drainage.
Rijkswaterstaat, as water manager of the Oosterschelde, decides whether discharge is admissible.
Rijkswaterstaat beslist als waterbeheerder van de Oosterschelde of spuien toelaatbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over mogelijke belastingontwijking door NS

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether NS Financial Services Co, NS's financing subsidiary, is based in Dublin to avoid Dutch tax, and what the tax and dividend effects are. The government explains the Dublin location was chosen for lease-company investment conditions, declines to give individual tax figures citing secrecy rules, denies any effect on executive bonuses, and says Dutch tax is not earmarked for public transport.
The confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents disclosing information about individual taxpayers.
De geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat eraan in de weg informatie over individuele belastingplichtigen openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Jacobi en Dikkers over de geplande aanleg van het agrologistieke bedrijventerrein Nieuw-Reijerwaard bij Ridderkerk

MPs Jacobi and Dikkers asked why the province of Zuid-Holland omitted air quality from the MER for the Nieuw-Reijerwaard logistics business park, questioning its demand, location and irreversible steps. The minister answered that the province is the competent authority under a decentralised budget, that air quality is covered by the NSL monitoring tool, and that the Rijk backed the project as an alternative location, with the provincial inpassingsplan due for adoption in spring 2013.
The province of Zuid-Holland is therefore also the competent authority for determining the scope and level of detail of the MER to be drawn up.
De provincie Zuid-Holland is daarmee ook het bevoegde gezag voor het vaststellen van de reikwijdte en het detailniveau van het op te stellen MER.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de verhoging van de tarieven van het openbaar vervoer in Haaglanden

An SP MP asked the minister about steep fare increases in Haaglanden public transport (about 11.6% for bus and tram, 15.7% for Randstadrail), questioning their link to budget cuts and whether they were introduced covertly. The minister defended the increases as legally permitted tariff freedom of the regional authority, attributed the revenue shortfall to the concession design, and stated that passengers were adequately informed.
The Haaglanden regional authority has tariff freedom under the Passenger Transport Act 2000 and may decide on tariffs, subject to the statutory duty to seek advice from consumer organisations.

Het Stadsgewest Haaglanden heeft tariefvrijheid als opgenomen in de Wet personenvervoer 2000 en het staat haar vrij, met inachtneming van de wettelijke adviesplicht van consumentenorganisaties, om besluiten te nemen over de tarieven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de Goederenroutering Oost-Nederland van het PHS

MPs Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked why the studies on east Netherlands freight routing in the PHS progress report were late, why the Zutphen-Hengelo description was not updated as a standalone note, how ERTMS affects freight routing, and whether the freight routing component should be reconsidered. The minister answers that the studies were delivered in mid-2012, the Zutphen-Hengelo description is a technical overview pending the MER due spring 2013, ERTMS will be covered in a roadmap, and reconsideration is not on the table because the Chamber declared the component controversial.
According to the current planning the MER will be ready in spring 2013, so that on that basis, and after public consultation and advice, substantiated choices can be made.
Het MER zal volgens de huidige planning in het voorjaar van 2013 gereed zijn, zodat op basis daarvan, en na inspraak en advisering, onderbouwde keuzes kunnen worden gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over het convenant ‘Uitvoering Havenvisie 2030’

An MP asked whether the Blankenburg tunnel is named as a required accessibility action in the Port Vision 2030 covenant the minister signed, and whether signing it is appropriate given the project is controversial. The minister replied that the tunnel is not named in the covenant, that the Rijk keeps the right to take differing positions on individual action points, and refused to withdraw the signature.
I will comply with that and will of course form my own judgement on it.
Ik zal daaraan voldoen en mij daar natuurlijk ook een oordeel over vormen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over gratis draadloos internet in de trein

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked whether NS would end free wifi on trains in 2013, whether past agreements with the state covered it, whether the minister would include it in a new concession, and whether a national standard is needed. The minister replied that the current contract ends in 2013 and NS aims to keep free wifi depending on the new contract, that a 15 million euro subsidy covered it, that the minister will consider it in the new concession without guaranteeing it, and that a national standard is not his responsibility.
I propose to make an integrated assessment once the picture is complete.
Ik stel me voor om als het beeld compleet is een integrale afweging te maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen en Verhoeven over de onveilige wegen op Goeree-Overflakkee

D66 MPs Berndsen and Verhoeven asked the minister about road safety on Goeree-Overflakkee, including the absence of lighting and crash barriers, fragmented responsibility among several authorities, and the quality of accident data. The minister replied that the Rijk roads follow the Handboek Wegontwerp, that the province is coordinating road safety, that accident risk there is average, and that planned upgrades on the N57 will finish by end 2013.
I do not recognise the picture that on Goeree-Overflakkee there is slow implementation of consistent and safe infrastructure as a result of divided responsibilities.
Ik herken het beeld dan ook niet dat er op Goeree-Overflakkee sprake is van een trage implementatie van een consistente en veilige infrastructuur als gevolg van verdeelde verantwoordelijkheden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over een incident met een lekkende wagon op station Oss

An SP MP asked the minister about a train carrying hazardous goods that caused a leak and disruption at Oss station, including its route, frequency of such incidents, false alarms, liability for damage, and whether procedures and preventive inspections should be tightened. The minister said the operator may choose its route, reported 35 leaks and four station evacuations since early 2011, stated liability rests with the infrastructure manager who can recover costs from the operator, and announced an ILT thematic inspection action while seeing no need to change reporting procedures.
No registration is kept of cases of false alarms.
Er wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van gevallen van loos alarm.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de benoeming van de raadsleden van de Raad voor de Leefomgeving en infrastructuur (RLI)

An MP asked whether the newly created RLI advisory council, which replaces the abolished Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen, has adequate external safety expertise, whether former AGS members are included, and what budget and concrete plans exist. The minister answered that one member with external safety expertise was appointed, that no former AGS member was appointed formally but all will be invited as associated members, and that concrete programming is left to the next cabinet.
Because of the start of the Rli and the caretaker status of the cabinet, it was decided to leave the making of concrete agreements on programming for the coming years to the new cabinet.
Vanwege de start van de Rli en de demissionaire status van het kabinet is besloten om het maken van concrete afspraken over de programmering in de komende jaren over te laten aan het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de benoeming van de raadsleden van de Raad voor de Leefomgeving en infrastructuur (RLI)

An MP asked the minister what the three knowledge platforms (relEVant, the Kennisplatform Externe Veiligheid and the specialists' forum) did last year to replace the abolished Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen, how often the Strategisch Kennisplatform met, and how the government justifies its claim that strategic knowledge cooperation is adequately safeguarded. The minister listed activities of relEVant and DORA, noted the SKP met in early 2011, and argued cooperation is sufficiently ensured given existing universities and institutes.
All things considered, I believe that cooperation in the area of strategic knowledge is sufficiently guaranteed.
Alles bij elkaar genomen, meen ik dat de samenwerking op het gebied van strategische kennis voldoende gewaarborgd is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de schorsing van de zwanenredder

An MP asked the minister why NS suspended a railway worker who tried to rescue an injured swan on the tracks, and whether this sets a bad example given leniency toward animal abusers. The minister answered that the suspension is a labour matter between NS and the employee, that an investigation will establish whether the worker breached the safe-working norms, and that the rescue attempt was not an intention issue.
This is a labour law matter between employer and employee in which I do not intervene.
Dit is een arbeidsrechtelijke kwestie tussen werkgever en werknemer waar ik niet in treed.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Aptroot over schade aan woningen door goederentreinen

MP Aptroot asked the minister about complaints of housing damage from freight trains in eastern Netherlands and whether ProRail's handling of claims was adequate. The minister said ProRail receives few damage reports, that freight volumes on the lines have fallen, that ProRail should be the first point of contact and handle claims integrally, and that he considers ProRail's referrals to other bodies incorrect.

Residents of homes along the railway must be able to rely on ProRail, as the rail infrastructure manager, taking complaints seriously as a good neighbour and generally not referring them to third parties.
