De bewoners van woningen langs het spoor moeten ervan uit kunnen gaan dat ProRail, vanuit zijn positie als beheerder van de spoorinfrastructuur, als goede buurman serieus omgaat met klachten.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de Rotterdamsebaan

An MP asked the minister why the planned capacity of the Rotterdamsebaan was reduced from about 70,000 to 38,000 vehicles per day, and questioned weaving sections, budget feasibility, traffic reduction points and disclosure of the cost-benefit analysis. The minister attributed the reduction to inadequate absorption on the urban network, affirmed space and feasibility, and said the cost-benefit analysis is for the municipality and Stadsgewest to publish, as a regional/local project.
It is up to the municipality of The Hague and the Stadsgewest Haaglanden to publish it or not.
Het is aan de gemeente Den Haag en het Stadsgewest Haaglanden om deze al dan niet te publiceren.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de nieuwe sluis bij IJmuiden

MP Kuiken asked why the replacement of the Noordersluis at IJmuiden should be brought forward ten years, what economic justification exists, and whether Amsterdam can credibly pursue intercontinental container handling without harming Rotterdam. The minister answers that the early investment is a regional wish with costs borne by the region under a 2009 covenant, that a cost-benefit analysis supports it in two of three growth scenarios, and that container growth in Amsterdam is expected to be complementary to Rotterdam.
Given the agreed cost distribution, the MIRT projects up to 2020 therefore suffer no hindrance from the earlier construction of a new sea lock at IJmuiden.
Gezien de overeengekomen kostenverdeling ondervinden de MIRT-projecten tot 2020 dus geen enkele hinder van de eerdere aanleg van een nieuwe zeesluis in IJmuiden.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de MIRT-Verkenning Haaglanden c.q. de A4 Passage en Poorters & Inprikkers

An MP asked the minister for detailed traffic intensities and I/C ratios on Haaglanden road segments under the A4 Passage scenarios, plus questions on weaving sections, calamity scenarios, and model consistency. The minister referred to existing reports, declined exact I/C figures as spurious precision, deferred calamity analysis to the planning phase, and promised an integrated traffic analysis by 1 September 2012.
Exact I/C figures would suggest false precision.
Exacte I/C-cijfers zouden een schijnnauwkeurigheid suggereren.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de A13/16 en de Nieuwe Westelijke Oeververbinding

An MP asked the minister for projected traffic intensities and I/C ratios on A13 and nearby junctions if the A13/16 link and Blankenburg tunnel were built. The minister replied with counts of road sections below the 0.9 congestion threshold under two scenarios and listed the sections at or above 0.9 in an annex.
With my letter of 19 June 2012 I already informed the House about the traffic calculations made for the A13/16 and the New Western Scheldt Crossing.
Met mijn brief van 19 juni 2012 (IENM/BSK-2012/94964) heb ik de Kamer reeds geïnformeerd over de gemaakte verkeersberekeningen voor de A13/16 en de Nieuwe Westelijke Oeververbinding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de status van MIRT-projecten

MP Kuiken asked the minister for a schematic overview of all MIRT and Infrastructure Fund projects by phase, budget, contracted amounts and prioritisation, with a 1 September 2012 reference date, and a reply by 16 August 2012. The minister refers to the MIRT projectenboek 2013 and the 2013 budget for the information, and declines to give a preview before then.
You will receive the information you requested in and with the 2013 budget. I do not wish to anticipate this now.
U ontvangt de door u gevraagde informatie in en bij de begroting 2013. Ik wil hier nu geen voorschot op nemen.

An MP from the CDA asks the minister about state-owned Bredius land in Muiden, which a municipal council motion wants used for a local sports club, and whether the minister will advocate for part of it. The minister confirms the land is state-owned for the SAA road project, will not release it while the project is ongoing, and says talks with the municipality and the Finance Ministry are underway on a partial arrangement.
Rijkswaterstaat is currently in consultation with the municipality of Muiden and the Ministry of Finance to arrange rehousing of the Sport Combinatie Muiden.
Rijkswaterstaat is op dit moment wel in overleg met de gemeente Muiden en het ministerie van Financiën om een regeling te treffen voor het herhuisvesten van de Sport Combinatie Muiden.
Antwoord vragen Haverkamp en Van der Werf over het rapport ‘Beter OV voor de stadsregio Amsterdam’

CDA MPs Haverkamp and Van der Werf asked the minister whether she knows the report 'Beter OV voor de stadsregio Amsterdam' and whether she will have its proposals tested for feasibility by ProRail and include them in the new main rail concession. The minister confirmed knowledge of the report, said she will consider its vision in the Long-Term Rail Agenda and that IenM will take the initiative for a feasibility analysis with ProRail, NS and the Amsterdam city region, but deferred concrete decisions and left the dienstregeling responsibility mainly with NS.
IenM will take the initiative for this analysis together with rail infrastructure manager ProRail, carrier NS and the Amsterdam city region.
IenM zal het initiatief nemen voor deze analyse samen met spoorbeheerder ProRail, vervoerder NS en de stadsregio Amsterdam.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de onbeveiligde spoorwegovergangen van de Valleilijn (herdruk)

An SP MP asks the minister about unprotected level crossings on the Valleilijn, including a fatal 2010 collision at Doolhoflaan, a near-miss at Wildzoom, and a 2012 collision at Zandkamp in Lunteren near a childcare centre. The minister admits ProRail's timelines were too ambitious, says the Doolhoflaan crossing was actively secured in 2011 and that Zandkamp removal stalled due to non-cooperating rights holders, and gives a general assurance that sufficient attention and urgency exist.

In general terms it can be said that ProRail, when drawing up the schedule for the measures of the Valleilijn level crossing safety project, planned the lead times for consultation, design, tendering and execution too ambitiously.

In algemene zin kan worden gesteld dat ProRail bij het opstellen van de planning voor de maatregelen uit het Project Verbetering Overwegveiligheid Valleilijn de doorlooptijden van bijvoorbeeld overleg, ontwerp, aanbesteding en uitvoering te ambitieus heeft gepland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht dat NS Poort zijn positie in Zaanstad misbruikt

An MP asked the minister whether NS Poort is abusing its position in a dispute with the municipality of Zaanstad over a office building and a rail overbuilding, and whether the minister will hold NS to account as concession grantor. The minister says the dispute is in confidential mediation, that the minister has no substantive knowledge of it, and that the minister sees no reason to engage NS because NS Stations' activities fall outside the concession.
Given the ongoing mediation and its confidentiality, I have no substantive knowledge of this file.
Gezien de lopende bemiddeling en de vertrouwelijkheid daarvan, heb ik geen inhoudelijke kennis van dit dossier.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over de voortgang van de infrastructuuraanpassingen van de spoorlijn Heerlen-Aachen en de realisatie van een intercityverbinding op dit traject

An MP asked the minister about progress on rail infrastructure works and an intercity link Heerlen-Aachen, including whether NS should bear full responsibility and whether the link should be a binding result obligation in the new concession. The minister answered that a variant study is underway, that a heavy effort obligation rather than a result obligation applies to NS, and that a concession-level result obligation is not planned.
I expect to have insight into the planning in July 2012, based on the action plan from ProRail and DB Netz.
Ik verwacht in juli 2012, op basis van het Plan van Aanpak van Prorail en DB Netz, zicht te hebben op de planning.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over geluidsoverlast van de Betuweroute

An MP asked the minister about a second opinion by Peutz disputing DGMR's noise measurements for Betuweroute freight noise at Hardinxveld-Giessendam, including speed correction, measurement spread, and whether planned traffic will exceed Tracébesluit values. The minister rejected most of the objections, stated current use does not exceed the values, and pointed to new noise production ceilings from 1 July 2012 with annual reporting and quieter rolling stock initiatives.
From 2013 the manager will report annually on compliance with these noise production ceilings.
Vanaf 2013 rapporteert de beheerder jaarlijks over de naleving van deze geluidproductieplafonds.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over spoorcapaciteitsproblemen rondom Zwolle

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the minister why rail capacity around Zwolle and the Herfte-Emmen stretch was only declared overloaded in March 2012, why ProRail did not act earlier, why signal densification and a third or fourth track were not pursued, and about Robuust Spoor priority projects. The minister answers that the overload declaration followed the normal timetable process, that capacity analyses and a capacity plan are pending, that the 8-minute problem analysis is outdated, and that about 50 locations are being studied under the Kleine Functiewijzigingen budget.
Following an overload declaration, ProRail will carry out a capacity analysis exploring possible cost-effective solutions.
Volgend op een overbelastverklaring zal door ProRail een capaciteitsanalyse uitgevoerd worden waarin mogelijke kosteneffectieve oplossingen verkend zullen worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over de toekomstplannen van de ISLA raffinaderij te Curaçao

An MP asked the ministers of Interior and Kingdom Relations and of Infrastructure and Environment about Curaçao's plans for the ISLA refinery, including the basis for its choices, timelines, and whether it should cause no pollution after modernisation. The government replied that the matter is autonomous for Curaçao, the plan follows the Ecorys report, no timeline is given, and it will keep Parliament informed.
It is not appropriate for the Dutch government to have an opinion on this, because it is an autonomous matter for Curaçao.
Het past de Nederlandse regering niet hier een mening over te hebben, omdat dit een autonome aangelegenheid is van Curaçao.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht “Treinpersoneel elke week slachtoffer van fysiek geweld”

An MP asked the minister whether train staff are assaulted weekly, requested recent figures on violence in public transport, and asked whether perpetrators should always receive a public transport ban and how often such bans were imposed. The government answered that violence against public-service workers is unacceptable, pointed to existing programmes, aftercare protocols and NS's power to impose transport bans, and referred to earlier letters and a progress report for the figures.
Specifically regarding the number of public transport bans, I refer you to the progress report of the Safe Public Service programme.
Specifiek ten aanzien van het aantal OV-verboden verwijs ik u naar de voortgangsrapportage van het programma Veilige Publieke Taak
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over standaardisatie van software rond het Omgevingsloket

An SP MP asked the minister whether a single national database for enforcement data under environmental and spatial planning law, as proposed by the municipality of Delft, could cut ICT costs, improve transparency and be investigated further. The minister said the proposal will be considered alongside alternatives and reported on in early 2013, without committing to a statutory registry.
Alongside a central database, I will investigate alternatives, in line with the capabilities of the subnational governments and efficient in terms of management and maintenance.
Naast een centrale database zal ik alternatieven onderzoeken, aansluitend bij de mogelijkheden van de medeoverheden en efficiënt in termen van beheer en onderhoud.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de A13-A16

An MP from the PvdA asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about traffic forecasts, tolling, congestion, the Terbregseplein tunnel options, environmental effects and air and noise limits for the A13/A16 motorway project. The minister answered that no congestion is expected on the affected routes, that a tunnel option was weighed against a fly-over, and that the government will meet legal air and noise standards.
From this it may be concluded that there are no routes on which congestion arises as a result of the construction of the A13/16.
Hieruit mag geconcludeerd worden, dat er geen trajecten zijn waarop ten gevolge van aanleg A13/16 congestie ontstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over de negatieve gevolgen van verplichte bijscholing en praktijktoetsen zoals vastgelegd in de Wet Rijonderricht Motorrijtuigen (WRM)

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about negative consequences of mandatory refresher training and practical tests for driving instructors under the WRM, including job losses and whether re-examinations should be allowed. The minister said he had no view yet pending the evaluation, stated that about 1% of instructors who took practical refresher training lost their licence, and committed to evaluating and possibly tightening the WRM without interim changes.
In line with the motion, I will now evaluate the WRM in advance and tighten it if necessary.
Conform de motie ga ik de WRM nu alvast evalueren en zo nodig aanscherpen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groot over de berichtgeving over een eventuele verhoging van de kilometervergoeding

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance whether he knew of reports on raising the mileage allowance from 19 to 24 cents per km, what the budget effect would be, and whether he would seriously consider the ANWB's smart travel budget alternative. The state secretary confirmed awareness, stated a 5-cent increase would cost about 500 million euro in forgone revenue, and said he was positive about B50 plans but that the budget agreement now puts the emphasis on fiscal consolidation.
A rise in the tax-free mileage allowance of 5 cents results in a budgetary loss of about 500 million.
Een stijging van de onbelaste kilometervergoeding met 5 cent heeft een budgettaire derving van circa 500 miljoen als gevolg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Smeets over de Haringvlietbrug

MP Smeets asked the minister about operating failures of the Haringvlietbridge since 2008, a defective cable limiting openings to twice daily, and whether openings and maintenance budgets should change. The minister described repaired faults with temporary measures, said openings return to eight per day by 19 June, and stated that maintenance budgets are spent on a cost-risk basis without compromising safety.
In advance it cannot be said how often the bridge can open during a possible failure and at what additional cost.
Vooraf is niet aan te zeggen hoe vaak de brug bij een eventuele storing open kan en tegen welke meerkosten dat is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Bashir over het invoeren van een meldingsplicht voor buitenlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs om de naleving van cabotageregels makkelijker te kunnen controleren

MPs Ulenbelt and Bashir asked the minister whether a registration duty for foreign truck drivers would make cabotage rules easier to enforce, and whether Belgian practice and tax losses justify it. The minister answered that the ILT will first run an inventory study after the WWG amendment takes effect, and only then will consider a registration study, while stating that no evidence yet exists on the scale of violations.
After the ILT study mentioned in the answer to question 1 is completed, I will consider whether a study into the possibilities of a registration duty is desirable.
Na afronding van het onderzoek van de ILT, genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 1, zal ik bezien of een onderzoek naar de mogelijkheden van een registratieplicht wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over vermeende kartelafspraken

MP Kuiken asked the government about alleged cartel arrangements among oil companies on petrol prices, including a German investigation, whether it extends to the Netherlands, signs of cartel formation in Dutch fuel sales, and steps to lower pump prices. The minister said the German probe is limited to Germany, that NMa has no findings of cartel conduct in the Dutch market but will not comment on ongoing probes, that pricing patterns are for the NMa to assess, and listed tax and crude price factors and a planned tender-information measure.
It is for the NMa to assess whether patterns or conduct in the market point to possible cartel arrangements between the oil companies.
Het is aan de NMa om te beoordelen of patronen of gedragingen in de markt duiden op mogelijke kartelafspraken tussen de oliemaatschappijen.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over de reële en politieke planning voor de Omgevingswet

An SP MP asks the minister why she does not accept the civil servant's view that the political timetable for the Omgevingswet is not realistic and that 2018 is a more plausible start date, and whether she knew of this when informing parliament on 9 March 2012. The minister answers that the timetable remains ambitious but feasible, that the entry-into-force date is not yet fixed pending the Invoeringswet and implementing rules, and that she informed parliament as fully as possible at the time.
I am then, as Minister, responsible for informing parliament fully and correctly, both orally and in writing.
Ik ben vervolgens als Minister verantwoordelijk om het parlement volledig en juist te informeren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
Antwoord vragen Houwers over de doorlooptijden van ruimtelijke ordeningszaken bij de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State

An MP asked the minister about rising processing times (from 45 to 53 weeks) for spatial planning cases before the Council of State's Administrative Jurisdiction Division and the causes of the increase. The minister attributed it mainly to the new Spatial Planning Act, the Crisis and Recovery Act and a rise in cases, and pointed to planned simplification of the environmental law.
The Administrative Jurisdiction Division aims to reduce the rising time limits in the coming years towards an average of 40 weeks and, for spatial planning cases, to a maximum of 52 weeks.

Inzet van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak is om het oplopen van de termijnen in de komende jaren weer terug te dringen in de richting van gemiddeld 40 weken en bij zaken op het terrein van de ruimtelijke ordening tot maximaal 52 weken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de potentieel onveilige spoorbrug over de Eefsche Beek

An SP MP asked the minister about a possibly unsafe rail bridge over the Eefsche Beek, after a report that contractor VolkerRail released it for train traffic without proper anchoring, and about maintenance quality, contracting and whistleblowing. The minister said ProRail judged the bridge unsafe after the works and that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport is investigating, with an ongoing inspection into ProRail's maintenance philosophy whose results are awaited, while stating existing channels for anonymous reports suffice and no reason to exist to bring maintenance back in-house.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de gigantische stijging van het aantal klachten in het openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the minister whether the austerity policy contributed to a sharp rise in public transport complaints, whether tariff increases should be restrained, and what will be done about the star-subscription chip card transition and quality. The minister denied that austerity caused the rise, defended regional tariff increases, and promised a winter programme and a request to improve passenger communication.
Relative to the number of passengers, I do not find this to be enormous.
In verhouding met het aantal reizigers vind ik dit niet gigantisch veel.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en De Jong over grote problemen op het spoor

MPs Elissen and De Jong asked about union criticism of Keyrail, alleged manipulation of punctuality figures, safety on the Betuweroute, and the relationship between Keyrail and ProRail. The minister says there is no evidence of manipulation, describes the controls and the inspectorate's view that safety is comparable to ProRail's, and promises to keep the interfaces limited and to consider an audit.
ProRail is one of the three shareholders of Keyrail.
ProRail is één van de drie aandeelhouders van Keyrail.

MP Slob (ChristenUnie) asked ministers of Justice and Security and of Infrastructure and Environment about copper theft on and near the railways, including concrete measures, statistics, risk locations, sentencing, registration rules and European cooperation. Minister Opstelten answered with figures from ProRail, an action plan with ID requirements for copper purchases planned for 2013, a sentencing guideline expected in autumn 2012, and ongoing cooperation in the Waakzaam Koperslag project, while stating some conclusions are premature.
The Public Prosecution Service expects that the present guideline can take effect in autumn 2012.
Het Openbaar Ministerie verwacht dat de onderhavige richtlijn in het najaar van 2012 van kracht kan zijn.
Antwoord vragen Van der Werf over het bericht "TenneT moet grondverbruik vergoeden"

MP Van der Werf asked ministers whether TenneT refuses to negotiate annual compensation for permanent cable easements affecting landowners and farmers, and whether this could stall grid construction. The minister replied that negotiations between LTO, FPG and TenneT are ongoing and a private matter, while the Belemmeringenwet Privaatrecht and expropriation-like powers (gedoogplicht) remain available if no agreement is reached.
I regard those negotiations as a matter between LTO, FPG and TenneT.
Die onderhandelingen beschouw ik als een zaak tussen LTO, FPG en TenneT.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent over de voortgang van de MIRT Verkenning Haaglanden

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about the progress of the MIRT exploration for The Hague region, including whether affected municipalities were given traffic and environmental reports in time and whether they can participate in decision-making. The minister answered that the studies are finalised, municipalities were involved early and informed, mitigation budget is included, and municipalities are represented via the Stadsgewest Haaglanden.
Municipal councils were also informed in the interim about preliminary results through public and, on their own request, closed council meetings.
Ook gemeenteraden zij tussentijds geïnformeerd over voorlopige resultaten via openbare en (op eigen verzoek) besloten raadsbijeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de noodzaak van tunnels bij spoorwegovergangen in Castricum en Heiloo

An SP MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about level crossings in Castricum and Heiloo, where barriers are closed for long periods, and about the funding shares offered to the municipalities for tunnels. The minister disputes the closure figures, says a methodology study on accessibility is underway, offers to fund up to half of cost-effective solutions in Castricum and points to a fixed lump-sum grant in Heiloo, promising to discuss further funding with the province and report in the next PHS progress letter.
Antwoord vragen De Rouwe, Van der Werf en Bruins Slot over de erfpacht in Amsterdam

Three CDA MPs asked several ministers about municipal ground leasehold (erfpacht) in Amsterdam, including canon increases, the lack of a right to buy the land, the legal remedies available, the threat of fines, and whether the municipality meets banking-sector criteria. The minister answered that leasehold is a private-law matter for the landowner (the municipality), that objection is possible only via the civil courts, that the municipality is revising its terms, and that the fine clause is rarely used.
Because leasehold is a private-law figure, public-law objection and appeal are not open here; the route to the civil court must be followed.
Omdat erfpacht een privaatrechtelijke figuur is, staan publiekrechtelijk bezwaar en beroep hier niet open, maar moet de weg naar de burgerlijke rechter worden gevolgd.
Antwoord vragen Slob over de verkeersveiligheid op de A44 bij de Kaagbrug

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about road safety on the A44 at the Kaagbrug after reported multi-car collisions, including whether the bridge's road layout and sun glare contribute. The minister acknowledged an elevated accident count but no black spot, found no bumps, noted the narrow profile, and announced warning signs, a 100 km/h limit and a structural review by Rijkswaterstaat.
I will place warning signs in the short term in connection with the narrowed road profile, and locally I will introduce a speed limit of 100 km/h.
Ik plaats op korte termijn waarschuwingsborden in verband met het versmalde wegbeeld en lokaal zal ik een snelheidsbeperking van 100 km/u instellen.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de juistheid van de verkeersveiligheidcijfers

An MP asked the minister whether the VIA road-safety statistics per municipality are reliable and how they differ from the ministry's figures, and asked her to comment on VIA's conclusions about speeding and unsafe municipalities. The minister said the ministry has no municipal breakdown of serious injuries, that the VIA differences stem from a different selection and an uplift factor, that she cannot judge VIA's conclusions, and that the ministry still considers its own picture of road safety accurate, launching a speed-limit campaign.
I cannot give a judgement on VIA's conclusions, because I do not have a breakdown of the number of seriously injured road users by municipality.
Over de conclusies van VIA kan ik geen oordeel geven, omdat ik niet over een uitsplitsing beschik van het aantal ernstig verkeersgewonden naar gemeenten

An MP asks whether the Dutch guardrail type is outdated and no longer used elsewhere in Europe, and why better alternatives are used only at high-risk locations. The minister answers that the type is also used in Belgium and Germany, meets the European H2 standard, and that a higher-containment guardrail is not always safer, so it is used only in specific situations.
This type meets the European standard (performance class H2).
Dit type voldoet aan de Europese norm (prestatieklasse H2).
Antwoord vragen Bashir over vangrails die niet bestand zijn tegen zware vrachtwagens

An SP MP asked the Infrastructure minister whether older median guardrails can no longer withstand heavy trucks, how many crashes occurred, whether SWOV's call for a review would be followed, and whether guardrails would be made motorcycle-friendly. The minister replied that guardrails meet the EU H2 standard, reported 8 truck crashes in 2011, declined a new study for now while agreeing to discuss with SWOV, and stated that risky locations have been fitted with motorcycle-friendly barriers.
I do not consider the requested study necessary for now, given the current policy on the application and maintenance of guardrails.
Ik acht het gevraagde onderzoek vooralsnog niet nodig gelet op het vigerende beleid ten aanzien van de toepassing en instandhouding van vangrails.
Antwoord vragen Slob n.a.v. het bericht “kort volgen op de Flevolijn niet haalbaar” van de provincie Flevoland

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the minister about the feasibility of 'kort volgen' (shortened train headways) for the OV-SAAL rail corridor, including a delayed consultation with regional authorities, the NS factsheet doubting its adequacy, and the promised second opinion. The minister answered that the consultation is pending, the second opinion is due before summer recess, no assessment of the cost and legal aspects is yet needed, and first steps (signal optimisation on the Flevolijn) will proceed in 2016.
The requested report I cannot yet send you, because it is not yet available.
Het gevraagde rapport kan ik u echter nog niet toesturen omdat het nog niet beschikbaar is.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over het bericht dat kantoren vaak energiezuiniger kunnen

MP Dikkers asked whether energy-efficient offices waste energy through misuse, whether the government will engage owners and users, and whether the same problem affects government buildings and what savings are possible. The government answered that the Jones Lang LaSalle study rests on a small sample and does not separate building energy from plug-load, so it gives little basis for conclusions, while the Rijksgebouwendienst has already started a programme to improve climate installation use in government buildings.

The Rijksgebouwendienst already found some years ago that too much energy is structurally consumed due to insufficient attention to the proper functioning of climate installations, including through incorrect use.

Door de Rijksgebouwendienst is reeds enkele jaren geleden geconstateerd dat er structureel te veel energie wordt verbruikt door onvoldoende aandacht aan de goede werking van klimaatinstallaties, onder andere door onjuist gebruik daarvan.
Antwoord vragen Aptroot over de aanbesteding van autoberging voor de periode 1 april 2013 tot 31 maart 2016

Aptroot (VVD) asked why the night-time tow-truck arrival norm was relaxed from 20 to 25 minutes and the compliance share lowered from 90% to 80%, and whether the minister would intervene in the tender. The minister defended the differentiated norms as concentrating effort on peak congestion, and declined to intervene in the tender.
No, on the basis of the norms set and the performance delivered by the towing companies, I see no reason to intervene in the tender.
Nee, ik zie op basis van de gestelde normen en de prestaties die door de bergingsbedrijven worden geleverd, geen aanleiding tot ingrijpen in de aanbesteding.
Antwoord vragen Slob over het bericht  ‘Kamervragen Zevenaar’

An MP asks the minister about the planned change of the 1500 V overhead power at Zevenaar, which may create a new power-system barrier for cross-border passenger trains to Germany, and about whether the procedure under the Spoorwegwet was followed. The minister answers that the procedure is correct, that no formal decision under article 17(3) is needed, and that the 25 kV change will go ahead as planned despite NS Hispeed's objections.
No, this does not concern a decision under article 17(3).
Nee, het betreft hier geen besluit conform artikel 17 lid 3.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over de politieke en reële planning voor de Omgegevingswet

An SP MP asked the minister whether she agreed that the political timetable for the Omgevingswet (environment act) was not the realistic one, and whether she had known of the civil servant's realistic planning before informing parliament. The minister denied the conclusion, said no distinction exists between political and realistic planning, and refused to send a separate list of other legislative projects with diverging timetables.
There is no distinction between political and realistic planning, so I cannot answer the question.
Er bestaat geen onderscheid tussen politieke en reële planning, waardoor ik niet aan de vraag kan voldoen.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over het bericht dat de NS niet bereikbaar is vanuit het buitenland

An MP asked the minister whether NS (Dutch Railways) is unreachable by phone from abroad and whether a Dutch bank account is required to buy NS products, and whether abroad-based travellers can reach NS and whether a solution is in progress. The minister said NS has launched a regular phone number for calls from abroad, that one-off payments are possible abroad but monthly direct debits still need a Dutch account until a planned change by July 2013, dependent on banks.
According to NS's current planning, customers with a foreign bank account will be able to make the same payments as customers with a Dutch bank account by 1 July 2013 at the latest.
Volgens de huidige planning van NS zullen klanten met een buitenlandse bankrekening uiterlijk vanaf 1 juli 2013 dezelfde betalingen kunnen doen als klanten met een Nederlandse bankrekening.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de IJsselbrug bij Westervoort

An SP MP asks the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the narrowing of the IJssel bridge at Westervoort, its cost, and lessons learned, including whether the side barriers were justified by a single incident and whether they will be replaced by lower barriers and traffic lights. The minister defends the barriers as necessary to protect the inspection path, gives cost figures of about 145,000 and 50,000 euros, confirms the chosen alternative with traffic lights and a curb, and gives a vague answer on lessons learned.
The precise design of the curb is still being discussed by Rijkswaterstaat with the municipalities, so the costs are not yet clear.
Over de precieze vormgeving van de schamprand is Rijkswaterstaat nog in overleg met de gemeenten en daarom zijn de kosten nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord vragen De Caluwé inzake de oorzaak van het incident bij de sluis Eefde op 3 januari 2012

An MP asked the minister whether she knows and endorses the TNO report on the cause of the Eefde lock accident, the timing of follow-up research, the consequences for damage claims by entrepreneurs, and how similar accidents will be prevented given that the damage escaped normal inspection. The minister confirmed the report and its conclusions, said follow-up research is underway with results expected by September, referred damage claims to individual entrepreneurs and an open nadeelcompensatie scheme, and announced a redesign of the upper door suspension that can be inspected normally.
The approach and delivery date are still being discussed between RWS and TNO. The expectation is that the results of the follow-up research will be known by September this year at the latest.
Over de aanpak en opleverdatum vindt nog overleg plaats tussen RWS en TNO. De verwachting is dat uiterlijk september dit jaar de resultaten van het vervolgonderzoek bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe over de N35 Wierden Nijverdal

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about delays and cost overruns in widening the N35 between Wierden and Nijverdal, including budget and planning consequences. The minister confirmed the planning delay, a cost overrun of several tens of millions of euros, and that a fuller cost analysis and agreement with the region are due by end April.
The precise overrun is not yet known, but the current estimate is that it will be several tens of millions of euros.
De precieze overschrijding is nog niet bekend, maar de inschatting is nu dat dit meerdere tientallen miljoenen euro’s zullen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over vermeende fraude bij het GVB

An MP asked the minister whether millions of euros had disappeared through alleged ov-chip fraud at GVB Amsterdam, what the independent investigation covers, when results are expected, and whether the damage to travellers and the role of TLS are included. The minister confirmed the investigation is necessary and waits for results, deferring the scope and timing details to the municipality, the sole shareholder, which expects first results in about four weeks.
The municipality of Amsterdam has informed me that the investigation will primarily focus on the alleged fraudulent acts and irregularities at GVB Amsterdam.
De gemeente Amsterdam heeft mij geïnformeerd dat het onderzoek zich primair zal richten op de vermeende frauduleuze handelingen en onregelmatigheden bij het GVB Amsterdam.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de analyse van ING Economisch Bureau over de binnenvaart

MP Bashir asked the minister whether she shares ING Economic Bureau's view on the inland shipping sector, including the vulnerability of independent skippers, the need for small vessels, and calls for a sector crisis declaration with bottom tariffs. The minister replied that ING does not say the free market fails but confirms the sector's structural weaknesses, that market parties are primarily responsible, that a 2009 request for a crisis declaration was rejected by the Commission and no new grounds exist, and that she will investigate bottom tariffs in other member states.
The ING Economic Bureau report provides no new arguments that could lead the European Commission to a different assessment.
Het rapport van ING Economisch Bureau geeft geen nieuwe argumenten die de Europese Commissie tot een andere afweging zouden kunnen brengen.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Klijnsma over het bericht dat toegankelijkheid van stations zeer te wensen overlaat

MPs Monasch and Klijnsma asked the minister about a TV report that station accessibility for people with disabilities is poor, including whether assistance is available at only about 110 of 386 stations and how far in advance it must be booked. The minister responded that the government aims for self-reliant accessibility by 2015 for visually and auditorily impaired people and faster for motor-impaired people, and committed to reducing the advance booking window in the 2015-2024 rail concession.
Within the concession for the main rail network 2015-2024, I will make agreements with NS on improving assistance provision.
In het kader van de concessie voor het hoofdrailnet 2015–2024 ga ik met NS afspraken maken over het verbeteren van assistentieverlening.
Antwoord vragen Haverkamp en Aptroot over geluidsoverlast in Lansingerland

MPs Haverkamp (CDA) and Aptroot (VVD) asked the minister about noise nuisance in Lansingerland, including when V250 trains start on HSL-Zuid, the timing of reference measurements, speed reduction effects, and whether a covering is feasible. The minister answered that measurements are underway and may be delayed by weather, gave the expected dB(A) reductions from speed cuts, and said a covering is not being included in the pilot while additional measures will be assessed later.
For now I am focusing first on the reference measurements and carrying out the pilot.
Ik richt mij nu eerst op de referentiemetingen en het uitvoeren van de pilot.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over de aanpak van geluidsoverlast bij Lansingerland

MP Monasch asks the minister of Infrastructure and Environment why the M+P bureau dismissed adjusting noise barriers in the pilot phase for noise nuisance from the HSL-Zuid near Lansingerland, and whether this option should be excluded and what measures can reduce noise in 2012. The minister answers that M+P's plan focuses on additional measures judged more effective, that barrier insulation will be studied by TNO, that the option is not excluded, and that measures are expected to be in place by late summer 2012.
I expect that these measures, if no safety-technical aspects affect them, will be implemented by the end of the summer, so that noise reduction will already occur in 2012.
Ik verwacht dat deze maatregelen, indien er geen veiligheidstechnische aspecten van invloed zijn, eind van de zomer zijn getroffen, zodat er in 2012 al sprake zal zijn van geluidreductie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Van Hijum over de inspectie van Nederlandse zeilschepen in Duitsland

MPs De Rouwe and Van Hijum asked the minister whether German Wasserschutzpolizei inspections of Dutch sailing ships, some repeated six times in as many months, conflict with the Port State Control Directive, and whether the Netherlands should press Germany for restraint. The minister acknowledged the facts, said interpretation disputes are for the Commission and flag-state channels, and reported a letter and bilateral talks urging restraint before the new sailing season.
That is why I decided to send a letter on this matter to my German counterpart.
Daarom heb ik besloten tot het sturen van een brief over deze kwestie aan mijn Duitse ambtgenoot.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent over de mogelijke aanleg van een vrije busbaan op de A27 ten behoeve van HOV het Gooi

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister whether a dedicated bus lane on the A27 for the HOV Gooi public transport link could be built alongside the widening, and whether a spatial reservation could be included. The minister answered that the HOV Gooi initiative is a regional project being optimised with Rijkswaterstaat, that a reservation is included in the middle strip between Eemnes and Utrecht-Noord, that no widening is planned between Eemnes and Huizen, and that the regional authorities will include the project in their spatial plans.
For the section of the A27 north of junction Eemnes, no widening is planned.
Voor het deel van de A27 ten noorden van knooppunt Eemnes is geen verbreding voorzien.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over de verlichting op het hoofdwegennet

An MP asked the minister whether street lighting on the main road network would be switched off on parts of the network, what effects this has on road safety, the results of an LED lighting pilot on the A44, and the pace of LED rollout. The minister confirmed that lighting will be turned off between 23:00 and 05:00 on roads without demanding traffic conditions, that a study found no demonstrable negative safety effect, and gave the LED pilot results as forthcoming while describing LED rollout as tied to replacement cycles.
On roads without demanding traffic conditions, the lighting will be switched off between 23:00 and 05:00 from the summer onward.
Op wegen zonder rijtaakverzwarende omstandigheden wordt de verlichting vanaf de zomer uitgezet tussen 23.00 en 05.00 uur.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over aanlegplaatsen in Capelle aan den IJssel

MP Bashir asks whether binnenvaart vessels can no longer moor anywhere in Capelle aan den IJssel, whether the municipality can be asked to create a berth, how often Rijkswaterstaat bars use of mooring places, and how adequate mooring capacity will be ensured. The minister confirms there are no public moorings in Capelle aan den IJssel under the current policy, offers to have the municipality create two berths that Rijkswaterstaat could exempt, says such bans occur regularly without registration, and points to MIRT studies and local consultation as the way to secure capacity.
There are no public mooring places at Capelle aan den IJssel, and there have not been any in the recent past.
Bij Capelle aan den IJssel zijn geen openbare ligplaatsen en die zijn er in het recente verleden ook niet geweest.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over het advies van de Commissie voor de Milieu Effect Rapportage (CieMER) over de Goederenroutering Oost Nederland van het Programma Hoogfrequent Spoorvervoer (PHS).

An MP from the PvdA asked the minister whether the government would heed the CieMER advice to first clarify long-term freight rail needs before the environmental impact assessment for Eastern Netherlands freight routing, and whether the EIA comment deadline should be extended. The minister declined to adopt the CieMER advice, arguing a parallel approach avoids delay, and said the comment period need not be extended since the EIA already provides for interim decisions.
I do not adopt the CieMER advice to carry out the studies one after another.
Het advies van de CieMER om de onderzoeken ná elkaar uit te voeren neem ik niet over.
Antwoord vragen De Jong over het bericht ‘Buskaartje te duur door truc NS’

An MP asked the minister whether NS financially disadvantaged bus and train passengers through a financial arrangement with chipkaart operator TLS, whether NS made loans to TLS, whether NS withheld state subsidy, and whether TLS should be dissolved. The minister denied any NS loans to TLS, explained the FENS funding and TLS losses, declined a new investigation citing existing audits, and said the TLS position will be addressed in the permanent chipkaart structure.
I therefore see no reason to investigate NS's conduct and all funds of chipkaart manager TLS.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om onderzoek te doen naar het handelen van NS en naar alle gelden van chipkaartbeheerder TLS.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over het bericht ‘Buskaartje te duur door truc NS’

An MP asked whether NS's 2000 share sale proceeds (226 million euro for OV-chipkaart development) were misused, whether TLS losses were financed by NS loans, and whether bus and tram fares would rise as a result. The minister answered that the money was earmarked private funds under an agreement with ProRail and the ministries, that 121 million went into TLS, and that NS gave no loans to TLS, so fare increases can be excluded.
Through quarterly reports, your House is informed about the spending of the FENS funds.
Via kwartaalrapportages wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de besteding van de FENS-gelden.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over heling van gestolen koper van ProRail

MP Bashir asked the ministers whether they would act against fencing of stolen copper from ProRail and whether railway scrap dealers could be summoned, and asked about measures against copper theft and alternatives to copper. The ministers said they were alarmed, pointed to a convenant and action group, listed prevention measures and planned steps, but declined to name the scrap dealers, citing journalistic source protection.
PowNews then indicated it did not want to provide that information, invoking the protection of journalistic sources.
PowNews heeft toen aangegeven die gegevens niet te willen verstrekken met een beroep op de bescherming van journalistieke bronnen.

Antwoord vragen Haverkamp, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de inloopavond in Bathmen over plannen tot intensivering van het goederenvervoer per spoor, in het kader van het Programma Hoogfrequent Spoorvervoer (PHS)

CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that a January 2012 information evening in Bathmen on rail freight plans (PHS) descended into chaos, with ministry staff unable to answer residents' questions. The minister acknowledged the disorder, regretted that not all questions could be answered, and pointed to a follow-up evening, websites, written questions and the formal MER objection channel.
I regret that as a result not everyone's questions could be answered.
Ik betreur het dat daardoor niet ieders vragen beantwoord konden worden.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Gesthuizen over sluizen, gemalen en bruggen die slecht beveiligd zijn

Two SP MPs asked whether locks, pumping stations and bridges that can be operated remotely over the internet are insecure, whether other municipalities use the same SCADA systems, why earlier warnings from the NCTb were not acted on, and whether these structures should be manned again. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat-managed structures are largely not internet-connected, that security is continuously monitored, and that she is responsible only for Rijkswaterstaat objects, not for municipalities.

As minister I am responsible for the management of locks, pumping stations and bridges managed by Rijkswaterstaat, and I therefore cannot answer for the municipality of Veere or for other municipalities or authorities.

Als minister ben ik verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van sluizen, gemalen en bruggen die door Rijkswaterstaat beheerd worden en ik kan derhalve niet antwoorden voor de gemeente Veere of voor andere gemeenten of overheden.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent over de tijdelijke buitendienststelling van het spoor Groningen – Assen

An MP asked the minister whether rail services between Assen and Groningen would be suspended for nine days to carry out station works, and whether Intercity trains could run at least to Haren instead of replacing them with buses. The minister confirmed the temporary suspension is needed for the Groningen Europapark station works, and explained that running to Haren was considered but rejected because of overhead wire modifications, limited logistic capacity and costly temporary infrastructure.
This has indeed been considered. However, this option was not chosen because Haren station lies within the suspension area.
Dit is inderdaad overwogen. Voor deze optie is echter niet gekozen, omdat station Haren binnen het buitendienststellinggebied ligt.
Antwoord vragen Haverkamp en Van Hijum over historische treinstellen

MPs Haverkamp and Van Hijum asked whether historic trains fitted with ATB could still run on ATB-NG lines after an exemption was reportedly withdrawn, and whether this harms heritage and wasted subsidy. The minister denied any exemption remains, said such trains may run on ATB-NG lines only where no alternative route exists and at up to 40 km/h, and saw no need for further measures.
No, there is no longer any such exemption.
Nee, er is geen sprake meer van een dergelijke ontheffing.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over snoepautomaten in Connexxion bussen

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Connexxion's ban on eating self-brought food in snack-machine buses, while snacks are sold, is absurd, amounts to forced retail, and whether Connexxion should be called to order. The minister replied that fruit was tolerated, the change is a pilot, the concession authority is the regional body, and that the ministry cannot instruct Connexxion on its products, with results to be discussed with the Stadsregio.
It is not for me to call Connexxion to account for its products.
Het is niet aan de mij om Connexxion aan te spreken op zijn producten.
Antwoord vragen Smeets en Jacobi over over de berichtgeving dat het Loodswezen een miljoenenstrop lijdt vanwege de aanhoudende discussie over de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Vlaanderen's refusal to pay the Loodswezen is linked to the Netherlands not honouring its commitment to de-embank the Hedwigepolder, and whether other projects are affected. The state secretary said the dispute is between the Loodswezen and Flanders under binding arbitration, that the minister will raise it with her Flemish counterpart, and that de-embanking the Hedwigepolder is not on the table.
It should be noted that the Dutch government is not a party to the dispute over the payments.
Daarbij zij aangetekend dat de Nederlandse overheid geen partij is in het geschil over de betalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Mos en De Jong over de artikelen ‘Regeringsstad zonder internationale trein’ en ‘Hedwige-conflict kwelt Loodswezen’

PVV MPs De Mos and De Jong asked about a Telegraaf report that Belgium had not ordered the rolling stock needed for the Den Haag-Brussel HSL-Zuid agreement, about a Hedwige polder alternative, and about roughly EUR 9 million in unpaid pilotage deficits owed by Flemish authorities to the Dutch pilotage service. The minister said Belgium had pledged to implement the agreements but NMBS had not ordered the trains, that the Hedwige polder de-polderisation is no longer on the table under the June 2011 decision, and that the pilotage dispute is under binding arbitration, which she will raise with her Flemish counterpart.
In the short term I have a meeting with my Belgian colleague minister Magnette in which the implementation of these agreements will be discussed.
Op korte termijn heb ik een overleg met mijn Belgische collega minister Magnette, waarin de uitvoering van deze afspraken zal worden besproken.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent over een onderzoek naar overvolle treinen

An MP asked the minister whether she would support an Inspectorate investigation into overcrowded trains requested by FNV Bondgenoten, and whether binding norms for crowding should exist. The minister declined an investigation, citing NS measures that reduced complaints, and said no legal norm exists while noting NS's safety duties and performance agreements on seat availability.
I do not support an investigation into the capacity problem, given the measures taken by NS.
Een onderzoek naar de capaciteitsproblematiek steun ik niet, gezien de maatregelen die door de NS zijn genomen.
Antwoord vragen Koolmees en Verhoeven over het voorstel tot een ‘Slim Reisbudget’ vanuit 50 grote werkgevers

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the B50 proposals for a 'Smart Travel Budget' (Persoonlijk Mobiliteitsbudget and Bonus Malus Leasebudget), including whether the government would assess them, how they relate to the Autobrief tax study, and the expected effects on traffic and emissions. The State Secretary responded positively in principle, promised to test budget neutrality and administrative costs and to report on the proposals before the summer recess, while stating that effects depend on how employers and employees implement them.
I previously committed to sending the results of that study to your House before the summer recess.
Ik heb eerder toegezegd de resultaten van dat onderzoek voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer te zullen toezenden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het vermeende negeren van adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid aangaande de veiligheid op het treinspoor door de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en ProRail

An MP asked the minister whether railway safety recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board had gone unimplemented a year after publication, and what measures were taken. The minister denied that the recommendations were unimplemented, referred to earlier letters on safety measures, and stated that the roles and responsibilities in the rail sector are clear and need no sharpening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de opvolging van adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid over het spoor

An SP MP asked the minister whether the rail sector and the ministry are failing to follow Safety Board (OvV) recommendations, notably on the Barendrecht collision, on signals passed at danger (STS), ERTMS, and registration of recommendations. The minister rejects the claim that recommendations are generally ignored, gives a timeline of the sector's responses and STS figures, refers to attachments for the full overview, and promises to inform parliament on the ERTMS strategy.
The recommendations of the Dutch Safety Board are generally followed up by the parties concerned.
De adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid worden in het algemeen door partijen opgevolgd.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over het bericht dat passagiers met een OV-chipkaart geweigerd worden in De Gelderlander van 12 januari 2012

MP Monasch asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that passengers with valid paper subscriptions were refused boarding on some bus lines because operators would not load subscriptions onto OV-chipkaarts. The minister explained that regional authorities chose differing transitional arrangements, acknowledged the refusal in the specific case was regrettable, and said regional authorities and operators are taking additional measures such as better passenger communication and a customer-friendly coulance policy.
This unfortunately could not prevent that in the specific case from the report, access to the bus was refused.
Dit heeft helaas niet kunnen voorkomen dat in het specifieke geval uit het bericht de toegang tot de bus werd geweigerd.
Antwoord vragen Aptroot over de nieuwe dienstregeling van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen die afgelopen december in werking is getreden

An MP asked the minister about overcrowding, delays and reduced Intercity services on the Amsterdam–Den Haag–Rotterdam corridor after the December 2011 NS timetable change, and whether this was a deliberate push toward the pricier Fyra. The minister said complaints about crowding are known, denied a link to the Fyra, said NS is responsible for the timetable and no evaluation is planned, while noting the competition authority NMa is considering a signal on the matter.
As is known, making the timetable is the responsibility of NS.
Zoals bekend is het maken van de dienstregeling de verantwoordelijkheid van NS.
Antwoord vragen De Rouwe over het artikel ‘Animo onder jongeren voor rijles met 16,5 jaar valt tegen

An MP asked the minister about low youth uptake of the 2toDrive early driving-licence experiment, its effects, and whether 17-year-olds who turned 17 before the start date could still join. The minister said uptake is developing as expected, sees no need for extra measures now, and refused to admit those 17-year-olds, citing road safety and CBR capacity.
I currently see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie momenteel dan ook geen aanleiding om extra maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent over de storing in het OV-chipkaartsysteem

An MP asked the minister about the OV-chipkaart outage of 9 January 2012 that prevented travellers from loading subscriptions, who was responsible, and whether a protocol for automatic compensation would be developed. The minister said the fault lay in central software run by TLS, about 4,500 travellers were compensated automatically, TLS is responsible, and the minister will ask TLS and the carriers to draft a protocol for future incidents.
I will therefore ask TLS and the transport operators to work this out as quickly as possible in cooperation with the consumer organisations and to inform me about it.
Ik zal TLS en de vervoerders dan ook verzoeken om dit, in samenwerking met de consumentenorganisaties, zo spoedig mogelijk nader uit te werken en mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over het voorkomen van kijkfiles

An MP asked the infrastructure minister about 'rubbernecking' traffic jams, including their cost, police waving traffic on, and deploying mobile screens at accidents. The minister reported 267 such jams in 2011 costing an estimated 4 to 8 million euros, said waving traffic on by inspectors is sufficient, and noted screens are used only when deemed effective, with no shortage found so far.
So far, in practice it has not been shown that there is a shortage of screens.
Tot nu toe is in de praktijk niet gebleken dat er een tekort aan schermen is.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en De Rouwe over het incident met de sluis bij Eefde

MPs Omtzigt and De Rouwe asked the minister about the economic damage, traffic impact, duration of the repair and prevention measures after a broken lock gate at Eefde closed the Twente canal. The minister said damage cannot yet be quantified, gave the traffic figure of about 40 vessel movements per day, and promised research and a planned second lock chamber but no firm prevention measures yet.
At this moment an investigation is underway into the cause of the incident at Eefde and possible solutions.
Op dit moment vindt er een onderzoek plaats naar de oorzaak van het voorval bij Eefde en mogelijke oplossingen.
Antwoord vragen Slob over de stremming van de sluis bij Eefde

An MP asked the minister why the Eefde lock capacity expansion decision was still pending, whether a second lock chamber could be built sooner, and whether there is a funding shortfall. The minister answered that the decision slips to Q1 2012, the second chamber starts in 2014 and opens in 2017, and no shortfall exists since a budget portion will be allocated.
The MIRT project book 2012 lists the end of 2011 as the deadline for the preferred-option decision for the Eefde lock.
Het MIRT projectenboek 2012 vermeldt eind 2011 als termijn voor de Voorkeursbeslissing voor sluis Eefde.
